chapter.verse: Wɛn PAPA GƆD bigin mek di wanol wɔl
di wɔl nɔ bin gɛt shep ɛn natin nɔ bin de de yet. Daknɛs bin de oba di wata ɛn PAPA GƆD in Spirit bin de oba di wata.
Nain Gɔd se, “Mek layt kam” nain layt kam.
PAPA GƆD si di layt i si se i gud. Dɛn PAPA GƆD mek di layt ɛn di daknɛs de difrɛn say,
i gi di layt nem “De” ɛn di daknɛs i gi nem “Nɛt.” Ivin tɛm kam ɛn do klin, dat na bin di fɔs de.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD se, “Mek sɔntin de we go sheb di wata tu say.”
So PAPA GƆD mek dis tin ya. I mek wata de ɔnda am ɛn wata de pantap am.
I gi dis tin ya nem ‘Skay’ Ivin tɛm kam ɛn do klin, dat na bin di sɛkɛn de.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD se, “Mek di wata we de ɔnda di skay gɛda na wan ples, ɛn mek dray ples sɛf de,” ɛn dat bin bi.
PAPA GƆD gi di dray ples nem “Grɔn,” ɛn di wata we bin gɛda na wan ples i gi am nem, “Si.” PAPA GƆD bin si se i gud.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD se, “Mek ɔlkayn plant gro na di grɔn; gras gras ɛn dɛn wan we de bia sid. Dɛn lɛ dɛn tik we de bia frut we gɛt sid sɛf de. Di sid dɛn fɔ bia ɔda plant ɛn tik dɛn,” ɛn dat bin bi.
So di grɔn bin ful wit plant ɛn tik we de pul sid, ɛn dɛn sid de sɛf bin bia ɔda plant ɛn tik dɛn lɛkɛ dɛnsɛf. PAPA GƆD si se i gud.
Ivin tɛm kam ɛn do klin, dat na bin di tɔd de.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD se, “Mek layt dɛn kam na di skay fɔ sheb de ɛn nɛt, ɛn we go sho di de dɛn, di ia dɛn, ɛn di sizin dɛn.
Mek dɛn go shayn na di skay fɔ gi layt na di wɔl,” ɛn dat bin bi.
So PAPA GƆD mek di tu big layt dɛm lɛ di san we na di big wan go de, de tɛm, ɛn di mun we na di smɔl wan, shayn na nɛt. I mek di sta dɛnsɛf.
PAPA GƆD put dɛn layt ya so ɔpskay fɔ shayn na di wɔl,
ɛn fɔ sho layt de ɛn nɛt, ɛn fɔ sheb layt ɛn daknɛs. PAPA GƆD bin si se i gud.
Ivin tɛm kam ɛn do klin, dat na bin di de we mek fo.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD se, “Mek ɔlkayn tin we gɛt layf de bɔku bɔku wan insay di wata, ɛn mek bɔd dɛn flay ɔpskay.”
So PAPA GƆD mek big big si krichɔ dɛn fɔ de insay wata, ɛn ɔlkayn pan ɔl di ɔda si animal dɛm, ɛn ɔlkayn difrɛn bɔd dɛn we de flay. PAPA GƆD bin si se i gud.
PAPA GƆD blɛs dɛn ɛn se, “Una bɔn bɔku bɔku pikin dɛn fɔ mek una go bɔku na di wata we de na di si ɛn mek di bɔd dɛnsɛf bɔn bɔku pikin dɛm.”
Ivin tɛm kam ɛn do klin, dat na bin di de we mek fayv.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD se, “Mek ɔlkayn animal kam na di wɔl: big wan o, smɔl wan o, wayl wan o, dɛn wan we go tap wit pipul na os o, ɛniwan nɔmɔ,” ɛn dat bin bi.
So PAPA GƆD mek ɔlkayn animal kam na wɔl: big wan o, smɔl wan o, wayl wan o, ɛn dɛn wan we go tap wit pipul na os. Dɛn ɔl fɔ bɔn pikin we tan lɛkɛ dɛnsɛf. PAPA GƆD bin si se i gud.

Dɛn PAPA GƆD se, “Naw, lɛ wi mek mɔtalman we go tan lɛkɛ wi. Lɛ dɛn gɛt pawa oba dis wɔl, oba dɛn fish, dɛn bɔd, ɛn ɔl dɛn krichɔ dɛm, di wan we go tap wit pipul ɛn dɛn wayl bist, di big wan dɛm ɛn di smɔl wan dɛm.”
So PAPA GƆD mek mɔtalman: i mek am lɛkɛ insɛf. I mek man ɛn uman.
PAPA GƆD blɛs dɛm, ɛn tɛl dɛn se, “Una bɔn bɔku pikin dɛn, fɔ mek una de ɔlsay na di wɔl ɛn kɔntrol di wɔl. Una go gɛt pawa fɔ kɔntrol ɔl di fish dɛm, ɔl di bɔd dɛm ɛn ɔl dɛn animal dɛm.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD se, “Luk ya, a dɔn gi una ɔl dɛn plant we de pul sid na di wanol wɔl, ɛn dɛn tik we de bia frut fɔ mek una go it.
Dɛn a gi ɔl dɛn gras to dɛn animal ɛn bɔd dɛn fɔ it,” ɛn dat bin bi.
PAPA GƆD luk ɔl wetin i bin dɔn mek, ɛn i si se ɔltin gud ɛn fayn. Ivin tɛm kam ɛn do klin - dat na bin di de we mek siks.
Na so PAPA GƆD tek mek di wanol wɔl, ɛvin ɛn ath ɛn ɔl wetin de insay de.
Bay di tɛm we di de we mek sɛvin rich, PAPA GƆD bin dɔn dɔn ɔl wetin i bin de du, so i blo da de de.
I blɛs da sem de de ɛn mek am oli, bikɔs bifo da de de bin kam, i bin dɔn dɔn ɔl wetin i gɛt fɔ du, ɛn na da de de i blo.
Na so PAPA GƆD tek mek di wanol wɔl; ɛvin ɛn ath ɛn ɔl wetin de insay de. We PAPA GƆD dɔn mek ɛvin ɛn ath dɔn,
plant dɛn nɔ bin de na grɔn, ɛn sid sɛf nɔ bin bigin bɔs yet. Natin nɔ bin de gro na di grɔn bikɔs PAPA GƆD nɔ bin mek ren bigin kam yet, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de yet fɔ dig di grɔn;
bɔt wata bin de kɔmɔt ɔnda di grɔn ɛn mek ɔl di grɔn sok.
PAPA GƆD tek sɔm pan di dɔti na grɔn ɛn mek mɔtalman; i blo insay in nos dɛn mɔtalman gɛt layf.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD mek wan fam na Idɛn we de na di ist ɛn put di man we i bin dɔn mek de.
I mek fayn fayn tik dɛn gro de we gɛt gud frut fɔ it. Wan tik bin de midul di fam we nem “Layf tik.” Dɛn igen, wan ɔda tik bin de de we nem “Sɛns tik.”
Wan big riva bin de flo ɛn wata di fam; ɛn i bin sheb to fo riva dɛn wɛn i kɔmɔt na di fam.
Di fɔs riva nem Pishɔn; in bin pas insay di kɔntri Avila usay gold de.
Piɔ gold bin de de, wit fayn pafyum ɛn miniral ston dɛm.
Di sɛkɛn riva nem Giɔn; insɛf pas insay di kɔntri Kush.
Di tɔd riva in nem Taygris, we de to di ist we yu kɔmɔt Ashɔ, ɛn di riva we mek fo na Riva Yufretis.
PAPA GƆD bin put di man we i mek na di fam na Idɛn, fɔ mek i go tek kia ɔf am ɛn wok de.
I tɛl am se, “Yu kin it di frut dɛn pan ɛni tik na di fam,
bɔt yu nɔ fɔ it pan di “Sɛns tik,” bikɔs if yu it pan am, da sem de de, yu go day.”
Naw PAPA GƆD se, “I nɔ gud fɔ mek di man in wangren de. A go mek sɔmbɔdi we dɛn tu go de, fɔ ɛp am.”

PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tek sɔm dɔti na grɔn mek ɔl dɛn animal ɛn ɔl dɛn bɔd. Dɛn i briŋ dɛn kam to di man fɔ si uskayn nem i go gi dɛm; ɛni nem we i gi dɛm, na da nem de lɛf pan dɛm. Na so dɛn ɔl tek gɛt dɛn nem.
So di man bin gi dɛn ɔl nem; bɔt nɔn pan dɛm nɔ bin fit fɔ de wit di man fɔ ɛp am.
So PAPA GƆD mek di man slip dip dip wan. We i de slip, i pul wan pan di man in ribs nain sayd ɛn lɔk di ples bak.
I tek di ribs we i pul na di man in sayd mek wan uman. Wɛn i briŋ am kam to di man,
di man se, “E, i dɔn bi. Dis na mi kayn, dis na bon we kɔmɔt pan mi yon bon, ɛn flɛsh we kɔmɔt pan mi yon flɛsh. I nem ‘Uman’ bikɔs, na pat pan man dɛn tek mek am”
Na fɔ dis mek man go lɛf in mama ɛn papa ɛn go de wit in wɛf, ɛn dɛn tu go bi wan.
Di man ɛn di uman bin de nekɛd, bɔt dɛn nɔ bin de shem.
Naw di snek bin kɔni pas ɔl di ɔda animal dɛn we PAPA GƆD bin mek. Di snek aks di uman se, “Fɔ tru tru PAPA GƆD tɛl una se, una nɔ fɔ it di frut dɛn pan ɔl di tik dɛn na di fam?”
Di uman ansa se, “Wi kin it frut pan ɛni tik na di fam,
pas nɔmɔ pan di wan we de midul di fam. PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl wi se, wi nɔ fɔ it da frut de ɛn nɔ fɔ tɔch am sɛf; if wi du so, wi go day.”
Di snek tɔk bak se, “Dat nɔto tru; una nɔ go day.
PAPA GƆD bin se so bikɔs i no se if una it am, una yay go opin ɛn una go tan lɛkɛ am; dɔn una go no wetin gud frɔm wetin bad.”
Di uman si aw di tik bin fayn, ɛn aw di frut dɛn gud fɔ it. I tink to insɛf se, “I go fayn fɔ gɛt sɛns o.” So i tek di frut ɛn it am. Dɔn i go gi in man sɔm, ɛn insɛf it am.
We dɛn dɔn it am dɔn, dɛn yay opin ɛn kechɔp se dɛn bin nekɛd; so dɛn so klos wit fig lif fɔ kɔba dɛnsɛf.
Da ivin tɛm de dɛn yɛri we PAPA GƆD de waka na di fam, so dɛn go ayd pan am midul dɛn tik dɛn.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD kɔl Adam; i se, “Usay yu de?”
Adam ansa se, “A yɛri we yu de waka na di fam; a fred bikɔs a bin de nekɛd so a ayd pan yu.”
PAPA GƆD aks am se, “Udat tɛl yu se yu nekɛd? Yu dɔn it da frut we a tɛl yu se nɔ fɔ it ɛ?”
Adam ansa se, “Na di uman we yu put ya wit mi, gi mi fɔ it.”
PAPA GƆD aks di uman se, “Wetin mek yu du so?” Di uman ansa se, “Na di snek ple in kɔni pan mi ɛn mek a it am.”

Dɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl di snek se, “Fɔ wetin yu dɔn du so a de swɛ yu; na yu wangren go gɛt dis swɛ pan ɔl dɛn animal ɛn krichɔ dɛn we a mek: Frɔm naw sote go, yu go de drɛg wit yu bɛlɛ, ɛn na dɔti yu go de it te yu day.
A go mek yu ɛn di uman et unasɛf; in pikin dɛn ɛn yu yon pikin dɛn go bi ɛnimi fɔ layf. In pikin go wap yu ed, ɛn yu go bɛt in il.”
Dɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl di uman se, “A go mek i nɔ izi fɔ yu we yu gɛt bɛlɛ, ɛn na pan traŋa pen yu go bɔn pikin. Pan ɔl dat, yu nɔ go ebul kɔmɔt biɛn yu man ɛn i go de kɔntrol yu.”

Dɔn PAPA GƆD tɛl di man se, “Yu dɔn du wetin yu wɛf tɛl yu, ɛn yu dɔn it di frut we mi se yu nɔ fɔ it. Fɔseka wetin yu dɔn du, a de swɛ di grɔn mek i nɔ bɛtɛ yu. Te yu day, yu go de wok traŋa wan, fɔ mek yu go gɛt tin fɔ it.
Na soso gras ɛn chuk chuk go de gro na di grɔn, ɛn yu go it dɛn bush plant dɛn.
Yu go wok traŋa wan ɛn swɛt fɔ mek ɛnitin gro na di grɔn sote yu go bak na di grɔn we yu kɔmɔt. Na dɔti a bin tek mek yu, ɛn na dɔti yu go go bak we yu day.”
Adam gi in wɛf nem Iv bikɔs nain na di mama fɔ ɔl mɔtalman.
So PAPA GƆD mek klos wit animal kanda fɔ Adam ɛn in wɛf Iv, ɛn gi dɛn fɔ wɛr.
PAPA GƆD se, “Naw, mɔtalman dɔn tan lɛkɛ wi, ɛn i dɔn gɛt sɛns fɔ no wetin gud frɔm wetin bad. Wi nɔ fɔ mek i tek da frut we de na di “Layf tik” ɛn it am, ɔ nɔ so i go gɛt layf we go de sote go.”
So PAPA GƆD bin drɛb am kɔmɔt na di fam na Idɛn ɛn mek i go wok na di grɔn usay i kɔmɔt.
Dɔn na di istɛn say na di fam, PAPA GƆD put chɛryubim dɛn ɛn sɔd we gɛt faya ɔlsay pan am. Di sɔd de tɔn rawnd ɛn rawnd fɔ gyad di ‘Layf tik’ so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go go nia.
Adam gi in wɛf bɛlɛ ɛn i bɔn wan bɔypikin. I se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn ɛp mi fɔ gɛt bɔypikin,” so i gi am nem Ken we min ‘gɛt’.
I nɔ tu te i bɔn ɔda bɔypikin we nem Ebɛl. Ebɛl na bin man we de mɛn ship, bɔt Ken in na bin fama.
Wande, Ken kɛr sɔm pan di tin dɛn we i plant ɛn mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD.
Ebɛl in kɛr sɔm pan di fɔs ship dɛn we bɔn. I kil dɛn, dɔn i gi di bɛst pat dɛn to PAPA GƆD as in yon sakrifays. PAPA GƆD bin pliz wit Ebɛl in sakrifays,
bɔt i nɔ bin pliz wit Ken in yon. Dat mek Ken vɛks bad bad wan, ɛn sawa in fes.
Nain PAPA GƆD aks am se, “Wetin du yu vɛks so? Wetin mek yu sawa yu fes so?
If yu bin du wetin rayt, a nɔ bin fɔ tek yu sakrifays? Bɔt bikɔs yu nɔ du wetin rayt, sin de na yu domɔt de wet fɔ yu, bɔt yu fɔ tray nɔ fɔ kɔmit sin.”
So Ken tɛl in brɔda Ebɛl lɛ dɛn go na gras fil. We dɛn rich de, Ken fɔdɔm pan in brɔda ɛn kil am.
PAPA GƆD aks Ken se, “We yu brɔda Ebɛl?” I ansa se, “Mi nɔ no o! Mi na mi brɔda in wachman?”
Nain PAPA GƆD se, “Wetin mek yu dɔn du dis bad tin ya so? Yu brɔda in blɔd de kray to mi frɔm di grɔn.
Swɛ de pan yu ɛn yu nɔ go ebul fɔ mek fam igen. Di grɔn dɔn sɔk yu brɔda in blɔd, lɛkɛ se i bin opin in mɔt de wet fɔ am.
Di grɔn nɔ go gro ɛnitin bɛtɛ fɔ yu ivin if yu wok traŋa wan; dɔn yu go de wirɔn ɔlɔbɔt na di wɔl.”
Ken ansa PAPA GƆD se, “A nɔ go ebul fɔ bia dis pɔnishmɛnt ya.
Yu de pul mi kɔmɔt pan fam wok ɛn fɔ de wirɔn na dis wɔl, ɛn ɛnibɔdi we si mi go kil mi.”
Bɔt PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, “Nɔ o, If ɛnibɔdi kil yu, i go sɔfa sɛvin tɛm mɔ fɔseka dat.” Dɛn PAPA GƆD mak Ken, so dat ɛnibɔdi we si am nɔ go kil am.
So Ken kɔmɔt go tap fa frɔm PAPA GƆD na wan kɔntri we nem “Nɔd” we min “Wirɔn” we de na di ist pat we yu kɔmɔt Idɛn.
Ken in wɛf bɔn bɔypikin ɛn i gi am nem Inɔk. I bil wan big siti ɛn i gi am in pikin in nem, Inɔk.
Inɔk bin gɛt wan bɔypikin we nem Irad, we na bin Mɛujaɛl in papa, ɛn Mɛujaɛl bin gɛt wan bɔypikin we nem Mɛtushaɛl, we na bin Lamɛk in yon papa.
Lamɛk bin gɛt tu wɛf: wan nem Ada, di ɔda wan nem Zila.
Ada bɔn Jabal, we in jɛnareshɔn na dɛn wan we de slip insay tɛnt ɛn de mɛn kaw.
In brɔda na Jubal we in jɛnareshɔn na ɔl dɛn myuzishian dɛn we de ple ap ɛn flut.
Zila bɔn Tubal Ken, we bin de mek ɔlkayn tul wit bras ɛn ayɛn. Tubal Ken in sista na Naama.
Lamɛk tɛl in wɛf dɛn se: “Ada ɛn Zila, una lisin to mi: Lamɛk in wɛf dɛn una lisin nɔ: a dɔn kil wan man bikɔs i wund mi, wan yɔŋman fɔ we i nak mi.
If pɔsin go sɔfa sɛvin tɛm mɔ fɔ we i kil Ken, dɛn udat kil mi go sɔfa sɛvinti sɛvin tɛm mɔ.”
Adam ɛn in wɛf bɔn ɔda bɔypikin we dɛn gi nem Sɛth In wɛf se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn gi mi ɔda bɔypikin fɔ tek Ebɛl in ples, we Ken kil.”
Sɛth bin gɛt wan bɔypikin we nem Inɔsh. Na da tɛm de pipul dɛn bigin fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD ɛn kɔl in Oli Nem.
Dis na di wan dɛn na Adam in Jɛnareshɔn. We PAPA GƆD mek mɔtalman, i mek dɛn lɛkɛ insɛf.
I mek man ɛn uman, i blɛs dɛn, ɛn i kɔl dɛn “Mɔtalman.”
We Adam bin ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn tati ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we tan lɛkɛ am, ɛn i gi am nem Sɛth.
Afta dat, Adam de fɔ et ɔndrɛd ia mɔ, ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
Adam ol nayn ɔndrɛd ɛn tati ia we i day.
We Sɛth bin ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fayv ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Inɔsh.
Afta dat, i de fɔ et ɔndrɛd ɛn sɛvin ia mɔ. Sɛth bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn,
ɛn day we i ol nayn ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛlv ia.
We Inɔsh ol naynti ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Kenan.
Afta dat, i de fɔ et ɔndrɛd ɛn fiftin ia mɔ. I bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
Inɔsh ol nayn ɔndrɛd ɛn fayv ia we i day.
We Kenan ol sɛvinti ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Maalalɛl.
Afta dat, i de fɔ et ɔndrɛd ɛn fɔti ia mɔ. I bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
Kenan day we i ol nayn ɔndrɛd ɛn tɛn ia.
We Maalalɛl ol siksti-fayv ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Jarɛd.
Afta dat, i de fɔ et ɔndrɛd ɛn tati ia mɔ. Insɛf bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
Maalalɛl day we i ol et ɔndrɛd ɛn naynti-fayv ia.
We Jarɛd ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti-tu ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Inɔk.
Afta dat, i de fɔ et ɔndrɛd ia mɔ. I bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
Jarɛd day we i ol nayn ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti-tu ia.
We Inɔk ol siksti-fayv ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Mɛtyusila.
Inɔk ɛn PAPA GƆD na bin padi fɔ tri ɔndrɛd ia, ɛn na da tɛm de i bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
Inɔk ol tri ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti-fayv ia.
Inɔk ɛn PAPA GƆD na bin padi; wande i jɛs lɔs, bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin tek am go.
We Mɛtyusila ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn eti-sɛvin ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Lamɛk.
Afta dat, Mɛtyusila de fɔ sɛvin ɔndrɛd ɛn eti-tu ia mɔ. I bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn,
Mɛtyusila day we i ol nayn ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti-nayn ia.
We Lamɛk ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn eti-tu ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin,
ɛn i se, “PAPA GƆD bin dɔn swɛ dis grɔn se i nɔ go bɛtɛ. Dis pikin ya so go ɛp pul wi pan di traŋa wok we wi bin dɔn de du. Fɔseka, dat i gi am nem Noa.
Afta dat, Lamɛk de fɔ fayv ɔndrɛd ɛn naynti-fayv ia mɔ. I bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
I day we i ol sɛvin ɔndrɛd ɛn sɛvinti-sɛvin ia.
Bay di tɛm we Noa de ol fayv ɔndrɛd ia, i bin dɔn bɔn tri bɔypikin dɛn we i gi nem Shɛm, Am ɛn Jefɛt.
We mɔtalman bigin bɔku na di wɔl ɛn na soso gyal pikin dɛn bin de bɔn,
sɔm pan PAPA GƆD in pikin dɛn dɛn bin si se dɛn gyal pikin ya so fayn, so dɛn fɔl fɔ dɛn ɛn bigin maredd dɛn.
Na dat mek PAPA GƆD se, “Mi Spirit nɔ go de wit mɔtalman sote go as dɛn na ɔdinari mɔtalman; as frɔm tide dɛn nɔ go de pas wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti ia.”
Da tɛm de, ɛn ivin afta dat, di pikin dɛn we di enjɛl dɛn bin de bɔn wit dɛn uman we dɛn bin mared, na bin jayant dɛn. Na dɛn sem wan bi big bigman dɛn ɛn dɛn bin femɔs.
We PAPA GƆD si se mɔtalman in wikɛdnɛs dɔn pasmak, ɛn na bad nɔmɔ i de mɛmba ɔltɛm,
i fil am bad we i mek mɔtalman ɛn put am na di wɔl. In at pwɛl,
ɛn i se, “A go kil ɔl wetin a dɔn put na di wɔl; mɔtalman, big ɛn smɔl animal, dɛn tin dɛn we de krip na grɔn ɛn dɛn bɔd dɛn we de flay. A rigrɛt sɛf we a mek dɛn ɔl put na wɔl.”
Bɔt pan ɔl dis, Noa bin mek PAPA GƆD in at gladi wit am.
Noa bin de du wetin rayt bifo PAPA GƆD. Nain wangren nɔ bin gɛt fɔlt pan ɔl in kɔmpin dɛn. Ɛn in ɛn PAPA GƆD na bin padi.
I bin gɛt tri bɔypikin dɛn. Dɛn nem na Shɛm, Am ɛn Jefɛt.
Da tɛm de ɔlman na di wɔl bin bad na PAPA GƆD in yay dɔn na soso fɛt fɛt ɛn bad bad tin dɛn bin de apin.
PAPA GƆD si se dis bad dɔn pasmak na di wɔl.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Noa se, “A dɔn mekɔp fɔ dɔnawe wit ɔlman na dis wɔl as na soso fɛt fɛt ɛn bad bad tin de apin ɛn na dat mek di wɔl bad so. A go kil ɔlman ɛn pwɛl di wanol wɔl.
Tek gud bod ɛn bil Ak fɔ yusɛf; mek rum dɛn insay ɛn kɔba am wit ta insay ɛn na do.
Mek i bi fɔ ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti fut lɔŋ, sɛvinti fayv fut wayd, ɛn fɔti-fayv fut ay.
Mek i gɛt ruf ɛn lɛf wan etin inchis spes bitwin di ruf ɛn di sayd dɛn. Mek am tri dɛk ɛn put do na di sayd.
A de sɛn flɔd na di wɔl fɔ pwɛl ɔltin we gɛt layf. Ɔltin na di wɔl go day.
Bɔt a go mek Kɔvinant wit yu. Yu go go insay di ak wit yu wɛf, yu bɔypikin dɛn, ɛn dɛn wɛf.
Tek tu tu pan ɔltin we gɛt layf na di wɔl, wan man, wan uman.
Tek tu-tu pan ɔl di difrɛn difrɛn bɔd dɛn, tu-tu pan di difrɛn difrɛn animal dɛn, tu-tu pan ɔltin we de krip na grɔn. Yu fɔ tek tu-tu pan ɔl wetin a dɔn mek fɔ de wit yu insay di ak mek dɛn nɔ day.
Yu fɔ kɛr ɔlkayn it go insay di ak ɛn kip am de fɔ yu ɛn fɔ dɛn.”
Noa du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ du.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Noa se, “Go insay di ak wit ɔl udat tap na yu os. A dɔn si se na yu wangren pan yu kɔmpin dɛn de du wetin rayt na mi yay.
Pan ɔl dɛn animal we dɛn de it, tek sɛvin pia, bɔt pan di wan dɛn we dɛn nɔ de it, jɛs tek wan man ɛn wan uman nɔmɔ.
Tek sɛvin pia pan dɛn bɔd dɛnsɛf, man ɛn uman. Yu fɔ du so fɔ mek ɔl di animal ɛn bɔd dɛn go bɔn dɛn yon pikin so dɛn kayn go de bak na di wɔl.
Frɔm tide, di de we mek sɛvin a go sɛn flɔd we go kam fɔ fɔti de ɛn fɔti nɛt. I go pwɛl ɔltin we a bin dɔn mek.”
Noa du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ du.
Noa bin ol siks ɔndrɛd ia we PAPA GƆD sɛn dis flɔd kam na di wɔl.
In, in wɛf, in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn dɛn wɛf, bin de insay di ak so di flɔd nɔ mit dɛn.
Dɛn animal dɛn we ‘klin’, dɛn wan we ‘nɔ klin’, dɛn bɔd dɛnsɛf ɛn ɔl dɛn tin we de krip na grɔn, ɔl go insay di ak wit dɛn.
Dɛn bin de tu-tu, wan man ɛn wan uman, jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl Noa.
Di flɔd kam di de we mek sɛvin.
Di flɔd kam di ia we mek Noa siks ɔndrɛd ia, ɛn i kam di sɛvintin de na di sɛkɛn mɔnt. Da de de, ɔl dɛn wata we de pas ɔnda di grɔn bɔs opin ɛn di klawd sɛf opin.
Di flɔd bin de na di wɔl fɔ fɔti de ɛn fɔti nɛt.
Da sem tɛm de, Noa, in wɛf ɛn in tri bɔypikin dɛn we na Shɛm, Am, ɛn Jefɛt ɛn dɛn yon wɛf, bin go insay di ak.
Ɔlkayn animal bin de insay di ak; di wan dɛn fɔ tap wit pipul ɛn dɛn wayl bist, big ɛn smɔl, ɛn ɔlkayn bɔd.
Tu-tu pan ɔlkayn tin we gɛt layf bin de insay di ak wit Noa,
man ɛn uman, jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin tɛl am fɔ du. We dɛn ɔl dɔn go insay, PAPA GƆD lɔk di ak in do.
Di flɔd kam fɔ fɔti de ebi, ebi wan, ɛn di wata bin ay we mek di ak flot.
Di wata bin so bɔku ɛn ay, so di ak bigin fɔ drif.
I ay sote i kɔba ɔl di ay ay mawnten dɛn;
i kam ɔp sote i rich bɔt sɔm twɛnti-fayv fut pas ɔl di mawnten dɛn.
Ɔltin we bin de na di wɔl day, ɔl dɛn bɔd, animal, di wan dɛn we tap wit pipul, di wayl bist, ɛn ɔl dɛn mɔtalman sɛf.
Ɔltin we bin de na di wɔl we gɛt layf day.
PAPA GƆD pwɛl ɔltin we gɛt layf na wɔl, mɔtalman, animal ɛn bɔd. Di wan dɛn nɔmɔ we bin lɛf, na Noa ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we bin de insay di ak wit am.
Di wata nɔ bin bigin go dɔŋ te te wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti de dɔn pas.
PAPA GƆD nɔ bin fɔgɛt se Noa ɛn ɔl dɛn animal bin de insay di bot; i mek big briz blo, ɛn di wata bigin go dɔŋ.
PAPA GƆD lɔk ɔl dɛn say we wata bin de pas ɔnda grɔn, ɛn lɔk di klawd fɔ mek ren nɔ kam.
Di wata bigin go dɔŋ smɔl smɔl. Bay di tɛm we i de wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti de, i dɔn go dɔŋ dɔn.
Di sɛvintin de na di mɔnt we mek sɛvin, di ak bin slam na mawnt Ararat.
Di wata bin de go dɔŋ te di mɔnt we mek tɛn. Di fɔs de na da mɔnt de dɛn bigin si di mawnten dɛn.
Afta fɔti de bifo Noa bin opin wan winda,
ɛn i sɛn wan revɛn Di bɔd go ɛn i bigin de flay rawnd rawnd sote di wata dray.
Afta dat Noa sɛn wan dɔv fɔ go luk if di wata dɔn dray,
bɔt we di dɔv si se di wata bin stil de ɔlsay ɛn nɔ gɛt ples fɔ tinap, i flay go bak na di ak. Noa put in an na do ɛn briŋ di bɔd kam insay saful.
Noa wet fɔ ɔda sɛvin de bifo i sɛn di dɔv go bak.
Di dɔv tɔn bak ivin tɛm wit ɔliv lif nain mɔt. Dat mek Noa no se di wata dɔn de dray.
Noa bin wet fɔ ɔda sɛvin de bak bifo i sɛn di dɔv wantɛm mɔ; dis tɛm di dɔv nɔ kam bak.
Di fɔs de na di fɔs mɔnt, we Noa siks ɔndrɛd ɛn wan ia, ɔl di wata dray. Noa pul di kɔba we de pan di ak, i luk rawnd, ɛn i si se di wata dɔn dray na di grɔn.
Na di twɛnti-sɛvin de na di sɛkɛn mɔnt di wata dray na di grɔn ɔltogɛda.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Noa se,
“Kɔmɔt insay di ak wit yu wɛf, yu bɔypikin dɛn, ɛn dɛn wɛf.
Pul ɔl di bɔd ɛn di animal dɛn na do, dɛn go bɔn pikin ɛn de ɔlsay na di wɔl.”
So Noa kɔmɔt insay di ak wit in wɛf, in bɔypikin dɛn, ɛn dɛn wɛf.
Ɔl di animal ɛn bɔd dɛn bin kɔmɔt insay di ak bay pia, wankayn to wankayn.
Noa bil ɔlta fɔ PAPA GƆD. I tek tu-tri pan di ‘klin’ animal ɛn klin bɔd dɛn, ɛn bɔn dɛn wanol wan fɔ sakrifays pantap di ɔlta.

We di sakrifays bin de bɔn, in sɛnt bin so fayn dat i mek PAPA GƆD in at gladi, nain i tɔk nain at se, “A nɔ go swɛ di wɔl igen fɔseka wetin mɔtalman de du; a no se frɔm we i smɔl na soso bad tin i de tink bɔt. A nɔ go ɛva pwɛl ɔltin we gɛt layf na dis wɔl, lɛkɛ aw a jɛs du.
Wans di wɔl nɔ dɔn yet, tɛm go de fɔ plant ɛn tɛm go de fɔ avɛst; di ples go kol ɛn di ples go wam; Sɔma ɛn Winta” go de; do go klin, nɛt go kam. Ɔl dis nɔ go ɛva tap.
PAPA GƆD blɛs Noa ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn. I se, “Una bɔn bɔku bɔku pikin dɛn so dat una go de ɔlsay na di wɔl.
Ɔl dɛn animal, dɛn bɔd, ɛn fish dɛn go de fred una. Na una go de kɔntrol dɛn.
A dɔn gi dɛn to una fɔ it jɛs lɛkɛ aw a bin dɔn gi di grin plant dɛn fɔ it.
Wan tin nɔmɔ, una nɔ fɔ it ɛnitin we rɔ we gɛt blɔd pan am, bikɔs na di blɔd gɛt layf.
If ɛnibɔdi kil in kɔmpin, insɛf fɔ day. We animal kil mɔtalman, dɛn fɔ kil am bak.
So dɛn fɔ kil ɛnibɔdi we kil in kɔmpin mɔtalman bikɔs a mek mɔtalman lɛkɛ misɛf.”
“Una fɔ bɔn bɔku bɔku pikin so dat una go de ɔlsay na di wɔl.”
PAPA GƆD tɛl Noa ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn se,
“Naw, a de mek Kɔvinant wit una ɛn una jɛnareshɔn dɛn,
ɛn wit ɔl dɛn tin we gɛt layf; dɛn bɔd, dɛn animal we tap wit pipul, dɛn wayl bist ɛn ɔl wetin kɔmɔt insay di ak wit una
Dis na di Kɔvinant: A nɔ go ɛva sɛn ren fɔ pwɛl ɔltin na di wɔl igen.
Na di sayn dis we go sho se a dɔn mek Kɔvinant wit una, una jɛnareshɔn dɛn ɛn ɔl wetin gɛt layf sote go.
A de put mi rembo ɔp na di klawd we go bi di sayn fɔ dis Kɔvinant wit di wɔl.
Ɛnitɛm we a mek di skay dak ɛn di rembo sho,
a go mɛmba dis Kɔvinant we a mek wit una, se, igen igen a nɔ go mek big big ren kam fɔ pwɛl ɔltin we gɛt layf.
We di rembo sho na di klawd, a go si am ɛn a go mɛmba di Kɔvinant wit una; ɛn ɔl wetin gɛt layf na di wɔl.
Na di rembo go bi di sayn fɔ sho se a bin dɔn mek Kɔvinant wit una.”
Noa in bɔypikin dɛn we bin kɔmɔt na di bot na bin Shɛm, Am, ɛn Jefɛt. Am na Kenan in papa.
Na frɔm Noa in tri bɔypikin dɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn na dis wɔl kɔmɔt.
Noa na bin fama, ɛn nain na di fɔs man we plant greps.
Wande we i drink sɔm pan di wayn we i mek, i drɔnk pasmak te i pul in klos, ɛn lidɔm nekɛd insay in tɛnt.
We Am we na Kenan in papa kam, i si Noa lidɔm nekɛd, ɛn rɔn go tɛl in tu brɔda dɛn.
Shɛm ɛn Jefɛt naw tek klos, ol am biɛn dɛn sholda, tɔn dɛn fes ɛn go insay di tɛnt wit dɛn bak so dat dɛn nɔ go si dɛn papa in nekɛd wan. Dɔn dɛn kɔba am.
We Noa soba, i gɛt fɔ no wetin in las pikin Am du,
so i swɛ Am in pikin Kenan. I se, “Kenan, nɔ go bɛtɛ. I go bi ɔdinari slev to in brɔda dɛn.”
Dɔn i tɔk se, “Mek PAPA GƆD blɛs Shɛm di PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD ɛn mek Kenan bi slev to am.
Lɛ PAPA GƆD gi Jefɛt mɔ land. Mek Jefɛt gɛt pan wetin Shɛm gɛt ɛn mek Kenan bi slev to Jefɛt insɛf.”
Afta di flɔd Noa bin de fɔ tri ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti ia mɔ,
ɛn i day we i ol nayn ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti ia.
Dɛn pipul ya so na Noa in pikin dɛn, Shɛm, Am ɛn Jefɛt, dɛn jɛnareshɔn. Afta di flɔd dɛn bin bigin bɔn pikin dɛn ɛn gɛt grampikin ɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛn.
Jefɛt in bɔypikin dɛn na bin Goma, Magɔg, Maday, Javan, Tubal, Mishɛk ɛn Tayras.
Goma in bɔypikin dɛn na Ashkɛnaz, Rifat, ɛn Togama.
Javan in bɔypikin dɛn na Ilaysha, Tashish, Kitim ɛn Dodanim.

Dɛn pipul ya, we na Jefɛt in yon jɛnareshɔn na bin di grampa dɛn fɔ di pipul dɛn we bin de na di kost ɛn ayland dɛn. Dɛn bin gɛt dɛn yon kɔntri, ɛn ɔlman bin de tɔk difrɛn laŋwej wit in yon pipul dɛn.
Am in bɔypikin dɛn na Kush, Ijipt, Put, ɛn Kenan.
Kush in bɔypikin dɛn na Sɛba, Avila, Sabta, Raama, ɛn Sabtɛka. Raama in bɔypikin dɛn na Shiba ɛn Didan.
Kush bin gɛt wan bɔypikin we nem Nimrɔd. In na bin di fɔs sojaman: i gɛt trɛnk ɛn sabi fɔ fɛt.
PAPA GƆD gi am skil fɔ ɔntin. Ɛn na dat mek pipul dɛn kin tɔk se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn mek pɔsin sabi ɔntin lɛkɛ Nimrɔd!”
In yon say we i bigin rul na Babilɔn, Irɛk, Akad ɛn Kalnɛ; dɛn ɔl bin de insay Shina.
Frɔm de, i go na Asiria ɛn bil Ninivɛ, Rɛobɔt Ir, Kala,
ɛn Resɛn, we de bitwin Ninivɛ ɛn da big big siti we nem Kala.
Ijipt na di papa fɔ dɛn na Ludayt dɛn, Anamayt dɛn Liabayt dɛn, Naftuayt dɛn,
Patrɔsayt dɛn, Kaslɔayt dɛn, we na frɔm dɛn, dɛn Filistin dɛn kɔmɔt ɛn dɛn Kaftɔrayt dɛn.
Kenan na di papa fɔ Saydɔn, we na bin di fɔs wan pan dɛn Itayt,
dɛn Jɛbyusayt, dɛn Amɔrayt, dɛn Gagashayt,
dɛn Ivayt, dɛn Akayt, dɛn Sinayt,
dɛn Avadayt, dɛn Zɛmarayt, ɛn dɛn Amatayt dɛn: ɔl di difrɛn Kenan pipul dɛn prɛd ɔlɔbɔt,
sote dɛn bawndri rich na Saydɔn te go na Gɛra we de nia Gaza, ɛn na Sɔdɔm, Gomɔra, Adma, ɛn Zɛboim we de nia Lasha.
Dɛn wan ya so na Am in yon jɛnareshɔn dɛn, we bin gɛt dɛn yon kɔntri, ɛn ɔlman bin de tɔk difrɛn laŋwej wit in yon pipul dɛn.
Di Ibru pipul dɛn na bin Shɛm, we na Jefɛt in big brɔda in jɛnareshɔn dɛn ɛn dɛn na Eba in bɔypikin dɛn.
Shɛm in bɔypikin dɛn na Ilam, Ashɔ, Apakshad, Lud, ɛn Aram.
Aram in bɔypikin dɛn na Ɔz, Ɔl, Gɛtha, ɛn Mishɛk.
Apakshad bɔn Shila, dɔn Shila in bɔn Eba.
Eba bin gɛt tu bɔypikin dɛn: wan nem Pɛlɛg, bikɔs nain tɛm di pipul dɛn na di wɔl bin sheb dɛnsɛf bay dɛn laŋwej; ɛn di ɔda wan nem Joktan.
Joktan in jɛnareshɔn dɛn na Almɔdad, Shɛlɛf, Azamavɛt, Jɛra,
Adoram, Yuzal, Dikla,
Obal, Abimaɛl, Shiba,
Ofir, Avila, ɛn Jobab. Ɔl dɛn wan ya na bin Joktan in jɛnareshɔn dɛn.
Di say we dɛn bin tap bigin frɔm Mɛsha sote rich Sɛfa we de ɔp il na di ist pat na di kɔntri.
Dɛn wan ya so na Shɛm in yon jɛnareshɔn dɛn. Dɛn bin gɛt dɛn yon kɔntri ɛn ɔlman bin de tɔk difrɛn laŋwej wit in yon pipul dɛn.
Ɔl dɛn pipul ya so na Noa in jɛnareshɔn dɛn, dɛn bin de bay dɛn yon neshɔn, bay usay dɛn kɔmɔt. Na frɔm dɛn wan ya ɔlman kam na di wɔl afta di flɔd.
Fɔs fɔs tɛm, na wangren laŋwej ɔlman na di wɔl bin de tɔk, ɛn na bin di sem we dɛn bin de tɔk am.
As di pipul dɛn de wirɔn ɔlɔbɔt na di ist, dɛn rich na Babilɔn; ɛn dɛn tek de mek dɛn siti ɛn tap de.
Dɛn tɛl dɛn kɔmpin se, “Una kam! Lɛ wi mek kle blɔk dɛn ɛn bek dɛn mek dɛn go traŋa gud gud wan.” So dɛn mek di kle blɔk ɛn yuz dɛn fɔ bil. Dɛn yuz ta lɛkɛ mɔta fɔ fasin dɛn.
Dɛn se, “Lɛ wi bil wan big siti we gɛt tawa we go rich ɔpskay, so wi go mek nem fɔ wisɛf ɛn wi nɔ go skata ɔlsay na di wɔl.”
We di pipul dɛn de bil di tawa, PAPA GƆD kam dɔŋ kam luk wetin dɛn de du.
I se, “If dɛn pipul ya so we dɛn de tɔk wan laŋwej kin ebul du dis kayn tin, wetin lɛf we dɛn nɔ go ebul du?
Lɛ wi go dɔŋ go miksɔp dɛn laŋwej so dat dɛn nɔ go ebul fɔ ɔndastand dɛnsɛf.”
So PAPA GƆD skata dɛn ɔlsay na di wɔl, ɛn dɛn tap fɔ bil di big siti.
Na dat mek di siti nem Bebɛl, bikɔs na de PAPA GƆD miksɔp dɛn laŋwej, ɛn na de i skata dɛn go ɔlsay na di wɔl.
Dɛn wan ya na Shɛm in jɛnareshɔn dɛn. We Shɛm ol wan ɔndrɛd ia, dat na tu ia afta di flɔd, nain i bɔn Apakshad.
Afta dat, i de fayv ɔndrɛd ia mɔ ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
We Apakshad in ol tati-fayv ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Shila.
Afta dat, i de fo ɔndrɛd ɛn tri ia mɔ ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
We Shila ol tati ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Eba.
Afta dat, i de fo ɔndrɛd ɛn tri ia mɔ ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
We Eba ol tati-fo ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Pɛlɛg.
Afta dat, i de fo ɔndrɛd ɛn tati ia mɔ ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
We Pɛlɛg ol tati ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Reu.
Afta dat, i de tu ɔndrɛd ɛn nayn ia mɔ ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
We Reu ol tati-tu ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Sirug.
Afta dat, i de tu ɔndrɛd ɛn sɛvin ia mɔ ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
We Sirug ol tati ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Neɔ.
Afta dat, i de tu ɔndrɛd ia mɔ ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
We Neɔ ol twɛnti-nayn ia, i bɔn wan bɔypikin we nem Tɛra.
Afta dat, i de wan ɔndrɛd ɛn nayntin ia mɔ ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn.
Tɛra bin ol sɛvinti ia we i bɔn Ebram, Neɔ, ɛn Eran.
Dɛn wan ya na Tɛra in jɛnareshɔn dɛn. Tɛra na bin Ebram, Neɔ, ɛn Eran dɛn papa. Eran in na Lɔt in papa,
bɔt Eran day bifo in papa Tɛra na Ɔ, di siti we i bɔn.
Ebram ɛn Neɔ dɛn tu bin mared. Ebram in wɛf nem Seray, ɛn Neɔ in yon wɛf nem Milka we na Eran in gyal pikin. Iska na bin Neɔ in ɔda gyal pikin.
Seray in nɔ bin ebul bɔn pikin.

Tɛra tek in bɔypikin Ebram, in grampikin Lɔt, we na Eran in bɔypikin, ɛn in dɔtɛnlɔ Seray, Ebram in wɛf, kɔmɔt na Ɔ we de na Babilonia fɔ go na Kenan. Bɔt we dɛn rich na wan ples we nem Eran, dɛn disayd fɔ tap de.
Tɛra day na Eran we i ol tu ɔndrɛd ɛn fayv ia.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Ebram se, “Lɛf yu fambul dɛn, yu papa in os, kɔmɔt na yu kɔntri ɛn go na wan kɔntri we a go sho yu.
A go mek yu jɛnareshɔn bɔku te dɛn bi wanol neshɔn. A go blɛs yu ɛn mek yu femɔs, ɛn yu go bi blɛsin to ɔda pipul dɛn.
A go blɛs dɛn wan dɛn we go blɛs yu, ɛn swɛ udat go swɛ yu. Na yu go mek dɛn neshɔn na wɔl gɛt dɛn blɛsin.”
Ebram kɔmɔt na Eran lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin tɛl am fɔ du ɛn Lɔt sɛf go wit am. Da tɛm de Ebram bin ol sɛvinti-fayv ia.
Ebram go Kenan wit in wɛf Seray, in brɔda in pikin Lɔt ɛn ɔl wetin dɛn bin dɔn gɛda wit di slev dɛn we dɛn bin dɔn gɛt na Eran. We dɛn rich na Kenan,
Ebram waka insay di kɔntri te i rich Shɛkɛm, usay di oli tik na Mɔrɛ de. Da tɛm de di Kenan pipul dɛn bin stil tap na di kɔntri.
PAPA GƆD apia to Ebram, dɔn i tɛl am se, “Na dis kɔntri a go gi yu ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn.” So Ebram bil ɔlta fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD na da ples de usay i bin apia to am.
Afta dat, Ebram muf go na di sawtɛn pat we na il ɛn bil in tɛnt bitwin Bɛthɛl we de na di wɛst ɛn Ayi we de na di ist. Dɛn i bil ɔlta ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD de.
Afta dat i bin de muf muf te i rich na di sawtɛn pat na Kenan fɔ go na Nɛgɛv.
It nɔ bin bɔku na Kenan so aŋri bin de. Di aŋri bin so mɔna dat Ebram muf fɔs go tap na Ijipt.
As i de rɛdi fɔ krɔs di bɔda fɔ go insay Ijipt, i tɛl in wɛf Seray se, “A no se yu na fayn uman.
We dɛn pipul na Ijipt si yu, dɛn go se yu na mi wɛf so dɛn go want fɔ kil mi ɛn lɛf yu.
Duya tɛl dɛn se yu na mi sista ya; so fɔseka yu dɛn go lɛf mi ɛn dɛn go trit mi fayn.”
We dɛn krɔs di bɔda go insay Ijipt, di Ijipt pipul dɛn si se di uman fayn.
Ivin sɔm pan di bigman dɛm we de wok na di kiŋ in os we si Seray, go tɛl di kiŋ bɔt aw i fayn, dɔn dɛn kɛr am go na di kiŋ in os.
Fɔseka am, di kiŋ trit Ebram fayn ɛn i gi am bɔku ship, kaw, man ɛn uman dɔŋki, man ɛn uman slev ɛn kamɛl dɛn.
Bikɔs di kiŋ tek Seray fɔ bi in wɛf, PAPA GƆD sɛn bad bad sik pan in ɛn di pipul dɛn we de nain os.
Dis mek di kiŋ sɛn kɔl Ebram ɛn i aks am se, “Wetin yu du mi so? Wetin mek yu nɔ bin tɛl mi se Seray na yu wɛf?
Wetin mek yu se na yu sista, ɛn mek a tek am fɔ mi wɛf? Ya! Luk yu wɛf; tek am kɔmɔt na ya, una go wantɛm.”
Di kiŋ ɔda in man dɛn fɔ drɛb Ebram kɔmɔt na di kɔntri, wit in wɛf ɛn ɔl wetin i gɛt.
So Ebram kɔmɔt na Ijipt, wit ɔl wetin i gɛt. In wɛf ɛn Lɔt bin de wit am. Dɛn go tap na Nɛgɛv.
Ebram na bin jɛntri man. I bin gɛt ship, got, ɛn kaw dɛn, wit silva ɛn gold.
I kɔmɔt de fɔ go Bɛthɛl na di ples usay i bin de fɔs, bitwin Bɛthɛl ɛn Ayi
usay i bin dɔn bil ɔlta. Ebram wɔship PAPA GƆD we i rich de.
Lɔt insɛf bin gɛt ship, got ɛn kaw, ɛn in yon pipul dɛn.
Di ples bin kam tayt fɔ dɛn tu fɔ tap togɛda, bikɔs dɛn bin gɛt bɔku bɔku animal dɛn.
Plaba bigin bi bitwin Lɔt in wokman dɛn ɛn Ebram in yon wokman dɛn bɔt usay fɔ fid di animal dɛn. Da tɛm de di Kenanayt ɛn di Pɛrizayt dɛn bin stil de na di kɔntri.
So Ebram tɛl Lɔt se, “Mi ɛn yu na fambul, lɛ wi nɔ mek plaba; yu man dɛn ɛn mi yon dɛn nɔ fɔ de mek plaba.
Di land bɔku, so, duya, lɛ wi pat kɔmpin. Pik ɛnisay we yu want na di kɔntri. If yu go lɛft mi go go rayt, if yu go rayt mi go go lɛft.”

So Lɔt es in ed ɔp ɛn luk rawnd. I si se di flat grɔn na Jɔdan, sote go Zoa bin fayn ɛn gɛt plɛnti wata lɛkɛ da ples we PAPA GƆD mek fɔ Adam ɔ lɛkɛ di land na Ijipt. Dis na bifo PAPA GƆD dɔnawe wit Sɔdɔm ɛn Gomɔra.
Lɔt bin pik di wanol Jɔdan Vali fɔ insɛf, ɛn i bin go na di istɛn say. Na so dɛn tu pipul ya tek pat kɔmpin.
Ebram bin lɛf na Kenan, bɔt Lɔt in go bil in tɛnt ɛn tap nia Sɔdɔm we na wan pan di big siti dɛn na di vali.
Di pipul dɛn we bin tap na Sɔdɔm bin wikɛd, ɛn bin de du bad bad tin we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk.
We Lɔt dɔn go, PAPA GƆD tɛl Ebram se, “Es yu ed ɔp ɛn luk nɔth, sawt, ist ɛn wɛst.
A go gi yu ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn ɔl dis land we yu si so, ɛn i go bi una yon sote go.
A go mek yu jɛnareshɔn bɔku lɛkɛ sansan; if dɛn ebul kɔnt sansan, dɛn, dɛn go ebul kɔnt dɛn.
Naw, go luk ɔl di land, bikɔs a de kam gi yu ɔl.”
So Ebram muf wit in tɛnt go tap na wan ples we nem Ɛbrɔn nia Mamrɛ in ok tik dɛn. I bil ɔlta de fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD.
Dɛn fo kiŋ ya so, Amrafɛl, di kiŋ na Shina; Ariɔk, di kiŋ na Ɛlasa; Kɛdɔlaoma, kiŋ na Ilam; ɛn Tidal, kiŋ na Goim,
bin go fɛt wa agens fayv ɔda kiŋ dɛn. Di fayv ɔda kiŋ dɛn, Bɛra, we na kiŋ na Sɔdɔm; wit Basha, kiŋ na Gomɔra; Shinab, kiŋ na Adma; Shɛmɛba, kiŋ na Zɛboim; ɛn di kiŋ na Bɛla: Bɛla in ɔda nem na Zoa.
Dɛn fayv kiŋ ya so bin mek wanwɔd ɛn dɛn mitɔp na wan vali we nem Sidim Vali, we naw na di Sɔl Si.
Dɛn bin dɔn de ɔnda Kiŋ Kɛdɔlaoma in kɔntrol fɔ twɛlv ia, bɔt di ia we mek tɔtin dɛn bin tɔn agens am.
Di ia we mek fotin, Kiŋ Kɛdɔlaoma ɛn in kɔmpin sojaman dɛn bin bit dɛn pipul ya so, di Rɛfaayt dɛn na Ashtɛrɔth Kanaim, di Zuzayt dɛn na Am, di Ɛmayt dɛn na di flat grɔn na Shavɛ - Kiriathaim,
ɛn di Orayt dɛn na dɛn yon mawnten na Sɛir. Dɛn rɔnata dɛn sote dɛn rich na Ɛl Paran we de na di ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap in bɔda
dɔn dɛn tɔn bak na Ɛnmishpat, we naw na Kedɛsh. Dɛn siz ɔl di Amalɛkayt dɛn land dɛn, ɛn usay di Amɔrayt dɛn bin de na Azazɔn Tama.
Dɔn, fayv kiŋ dɛn we kɔmɔt na Sɔdɔm, Gomɔra, Adma, Zɛboim, ɛn Bɛla bin gɛda dɛn sojaman dɛn fɔ go fɛt na di vali na Sidim. Dɛn bin fɛt
fo ɔda kiŋ dɛn we kɔmɔt na Ilam, Goim, Shina, ɛn Ɛlasa: So fo kiŋ bin de fɛt agens fayv kiŋ.

Dis vali bin pak ful wit ol dɛn we gɛt ta insay ɛn wɛn di kiŋ dɛn na Sɔdɔm ɛn Gomɔra bin de tray fɔ rɔnawe pan di fɛt, sɔm pan dɛn sojaman dɛn bin fɔdɔm insay dɛn ol ya, dɔn di balans rɔn go ɔp sɔm mawnten dɛn.
Di fo kiŋ dɛn tek ɔl wetin de na Sɔdɔm ɛn Gomɔra, ɛn ɔl wetin dɛn bin gɛt fɔ it, ɛn kɛr dɛn go.
Dɛn kɛr Lɔt insɛf ɛn ɔl in prɔpati go. Lɔt na Ebram in brɔda pikin, we bin tap na Sɔdɔm.

Bɔt wan man bin rɔnawe ɛn go tɛl Ebram, da Ibru man, ɔl wetin apin. Da tɛm de Ebram bin tap nia Mamrɛ da Amɔrayt man in ok tik dɛn. Mamrɛ ɛn in tu brɔda dɛn, Ɛshkɔl ɛn Ana, na bin Ebram in tayt padi dɛn.
We Ebram yɛri se dɛn dɔn kech in brɔda in pikin, i tek di tri ɔndrɛd ɛn etin man dɛn nain os we bin dɔn tren fɔ fɛt, ɛn dɛn rɔnata di fo kiŋ dɛn sote rich Dan.
Dɔn i sheb dɛn to difrɛn difrɛn grup. Dɛn atak di ɛnimi na nɛt ɛn bit dɛn. Ebram bin rɔnata dɛn ɔda wan dɛn sote dɛn rich na Oba, we de na di nɔtan say na Damaskɔs.
I gɛda ɔl wetin dɛn bin dɔn lut ɛn tek in brɔda in pikin Lɔt wit ɔl in prɔpati dɛn, wit di uman dɛn, ɛn di ɔda pipul dɛn we dɛn bin dɔn abdɔkt go wit am.
We Ebram dɔn bit Kiŋ Kɛdɔlaoma ɛn di ɔda kiŋ dɛn, di kiŋ na Sɔdɔm bin go mit am na di vali na Shavɛ we dɛn kin kɔl Kiŋ in Vali.
Mɛlkizidɛk, we na bin kiŋ na Selɛm ɛn na bin man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin to PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl, bin kɛr bred ɛn wayn go to Ebram.
Mɛlkizidɛk blɛs Ebram. I se, “Mek PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl, we mek di wanol wɔl, ɛvin ɛn ath, blɛs yu Ebram!
Lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl we dɔn mek yu bit yu ɛnimi dɛn!” Ebram sheb ɔl di tin dɛn we di ɛnimi bin dɔn lut tɛn pat. Ɛn i gi Mɛlkizidɛk wan pat.
Di kiŋ na Sɔdɔm tɛl Ebram se, “Tek ɔl wetin yu dɔn gɛda, bɔt gi mi ɔl mi pipul dɛn bak.”
Ebram ansa am se, “A dɔn swɛ to PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl, we mek di wanol wɔl, ɛvin ɛn ath,
se, a nɔ go tek ɛnitin we na yu yon, i lɛk sɛf na trɛd ɔ les. Mek yu nɔ go se na yu mek Ebram jɛntri.
Mi nɔ go tek natin fɔ misɛf. Wetin mi sojaman dɛn dɔn it na dɛn yon. Mek mi sojaman dɛn, Ana, Ɛshkɔl, ɛn Mamrɛ, tek wetin dɛn want.”
Afta ɔl wetin bin dɔn apin, PAPA GƆD apia to Ebram na vishɔn. I tɛl am se, “Nɔ fred, Ebram. A go kɔba yu ɛn a go gi yu ɔlkayn gud tin.”
Bɔt Ebram ansa se, “E PAPA GƆD, uskayn gud tin yu go gi mi we a nɔ gɛt pikin sɛf? Na Ɛliaza we kɔmɔt Damaskɔs nɔmɔ go bɛnifit we a day.
Yu nɔ gi mi pikin, so na wan pan mi wokman dɛn go gɛt ɔl mi prɔpati.”
Nain PAPA GƆD tɔk to am igen se, “Nɔ-o, nɔto Ɛliaza go bɛnifit; a go gi yu yu yon yon pikin we go gɛt yu prɔpati we yu day.”
So PAPA GƆD kɛr Ebram go na do ɛn tɛl am se, “Luk ɔp di skay ɛn tray fɔ kɔnt di sta dɛn; lɛkɛ aw di sta dɛn bɔku so na so yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn go tan.”
Ebram biliv wetin PAPA GƆD se ɛn dat mek PAPA GƆD luk am se in na pɔsin we de waka tret wit am.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Ebram se, “Na mi na di PAPA GƆD, we pul yu kɔmɔt Ɔ we de na Babilonia, ɛn a go gi yu dis land fɔ mek i go bi yu yon.”
Bɔt Ebram aks am se, “PAPA GƆD, aw a go no se i go bi mi yon?”
PAPA GƆD ansa se, “Briŋ wan tri ia ol kaw, wan tri ia ol uman got, ɛn wan tri ia ol man ship wit wan dɔv ɛn wan pijin fɔ mi.
Ebram bin kɛr dɛn animal ya go gi PAPA GƆD. I kil dɛn ɛn plit dɛn midul wan bay wan. Dɔn i mek di tu af dɛn de ɔpozit dɛn kɔmpin. Na di bɔd dɛn nɔmɔ i nɔ kɔt tu.
Wɛn dɛn yuba dɛn kam fɔ kam it di animal dɛn, Ebram drɛb dɛn.
We di san go dɔŋ nain slip kɛr Ebram go, ɛn i tan lɛkɛ se di ples dak ɛn i bigin fɔ fred.
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, “No naw fɔ tru tru se, yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn go bi trenja na ɔda kɔntri; dɛn go bi slev de ɛn dɛn go trit dɛn bad fɔ fo ɔndrɛd ia.
Bɔt a go pɔnish di kɔntri we go tɔn dɛn to slev, ɛn we dɛn de kɔmɔt na da kɔntri de dɛn go jɛntri.
Yusɛf go de te yu ol, bifo yu day, ɛn yu go day wit kolat.
Fo jɛnareshɔn go dɔn bɔn bifo ɛniwan go kam bak na ya so, bikɔs di tɛm nɔ go rich yet we di Amɔrayt dɛn sin go dɔn pasmak.”
We di san dɔn go dɔŋ ɛn di ples dɔn dak, Ebram jɛs si wan pɔt we smok bin de kɔmɔt pan, ɛn wan faya tik jɛs pas midul di bif dɛn we i bin dɔn kɔt.
Da sem tɛm de PAPA GƆD mek Kɔvinant wit Ebram. I se, “A dɔn prɔmis fɔ gi yu jɛnareshɔn ɔl dis kɔntri frɔm di bɔda na Ijipt sote rich na Riva Yufretis,
dat na usay dɛn Kɛnayt, dɛn Kɛnizayt, dɛn Kadmɔnayt,
dɛn Itayt, dɛn Pɛrizayt, dɛn Rɛfaayt,
dɛn Amɔrayt, dɛn Kenanayt, dɛn Gagashayt, ɛn dɛn Jɛbyusayt dɛn de.
Ebram in wɛf Seray nɔ bɔn. Seray bin gɛt wan slev gyal we nem Ega we kɔmɔt Ijipt.
So i tɛl Ebram se, “PAPA GƆD nɔ mek a bɔn, yu nɔ tink se yu fɔ tek Ega mek yu wɛf? Sɔntɛm wi go gɛt pikin bay dat.” Ebram gri wit wetin Seray se,
so Seray gi Ega in slev gyal to Ebram fɔ tek mek wɛf. Dis apin afta Ebram dɔn de na Kenan fɔ tɛn ia.
Ebram bin gɛt biznɛs wit Ega, ɛn i gi am bɛlɛ. We Ega kam no se i dɔn gɛt bɛlɛ fɔ Ebram, i bigin mek prawd ɛn fityay Seray.
Nain Seray tɛl Ebram se, “Na yu mek Ega de fityay mi so. Na mi bin tek am gi yu, bɔt frɔm we i no se i gɛt bɛlɛ, nain i bigin fityay mi. Na PAPA GƆD go jɔj bitwin mi ɛn yu!”
Ebram ansa se, “Wɛl, na yu slev gyal ɛn i de ɔnda yu; du ɛnitin we yu want du wit am.” Seray bigin trit Ega bad sote i gɛt fɔ rɔnawe.
Ega go te i rich na wan ples we gɛt smɔl wata na di ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, na di rod fɔ go Shɔ. PAPA GƆD in enjɛl mit am de.
I aks am se, “Ega, yu we na Seray in slev gyal, usay yu kɔmɔt ɛn usay yu de go?” I ansa se, “A de rɔnawe pan mi misis, sa.”
Di enjɛl se, “Tɔn bak go wok fɔ yu misis ɛn put yusɛf dɔŋ.
A go mek yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn bɔku so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul kɔnt dɛn.
Naw yu dɔn gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn na bɔypikin yu go bɔn. PAPA GƆD dɔn si yu waala, so yu fɔ gi di pikin nem Ishmɛl,
Yu bɔypikin go wayl ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul kɔntrol am. In ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go gri. In ɛn in brɔda dɛnsɛf nɔ go pul.”
Ega tɔk nain at se, “Fɔ tru se a dɔn si PAPA GƆD ɛn a nɔ day?” So i kɔl di PAPA GƆD we dɔn tɔk to am “PAPA GƆD We De Si.”
Na dat mek di pipul dɛn kɔl di wɛl “Bia-laay-rɔy”. I de bitwin Kedɛsh ɛn Bɛrɛd
Ega bɔn bɔypikin fɔ Ebram, ɛn Ebram gi am nem Ishmɛl.
Da tɛm de Ebram bin ol eti-siks ia.
We Ebram bin ol naynti-nayn ia, PAPA GƆD apia to am ɛn tɛl am se, “Mi na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti. Obe mi ɛn du wetin rayt ɔltɛm.
A go mek Kɔvinant wit yu ɛn a go gi yu bɔku gret grampikin.”
Ebram lidɔm flat wit in fes na grɔn wantɛm. PAPA GƆD se,
“A de mek dis Kɔvinant wit yu naw ɛn a de prɔmis yu se yu go bi di papa fɔ bɔku neshɔn.
Yu nɔ go nem Ebram igen, naw yu nem go bi Ebraam bikɔs a dɔn mek yu di papa fɔ bɔku neshɔn dɛn.
A go mek yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn so bɔku, dat dɛn go bi difrɛn difrɛn neshɔn dɛn ɛn sɔm pan dɛn go bi kiŋ.”
“A de mek dis Kɔvinant bitwin mi ɛn yu ɛn bitwin mi ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet. Dis Kɔvinant go de sote go ɛn a go bi yu PAPA GƆD ɛn ɔl yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn PAPA GƆD.
Dis land we yu de so naw lɛkɛ trenja go blant yu ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn. A go gi yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn dis wanol Kenan. I go bi dɛn yon sote go, ɛn a go bi dɛn PAPA GƆD.”
PAPA GƆD tɛl Ebraam se, “Yusɛf ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn, ɛn ivin dɛn wan we nɔ bɔn yet gɛt sɔntin fɔ du fɔ kip di Kɔvinant.
Una yon pat we una fɔ kip pan di Kɔvinant na dat ɔl di man dɛn fɔ sakɔmsayz.
Frɔm naw sote go, ɔl di man dɛn fɔ sakɔmsayz we nain go sho se Kɔvinant de bitwin mi ɛn una.
Ɔl bɔypikin fɔ sakɔmsayz we i dɔn ol et de; wɛda i bɔn na yu os ɔ yu bay am frɔm ɛni trenja,
as lɔŋ as na bɔypikin yu fɔ sakɔmsayz am. Na dis go mek di Kɔvinant de sote go.
Ɛni man we nɔ sakɔmsayz dɔn brok mi Kɔvinant. I nɔ fɔ de wit in pipul dɛn.”
PAPA GƆD tɛl Ebraam igen se, “Fɔ yu wɛf Seray in yon say, yu nɔ fɔ kɔl am Seray igen; frɔm naw sote go in nem na Sera.
A go blɛs am, ɛn a go mek i bɔn bɔypikin fɔ yu. A go blɛs am, ɛn i go bi di mami fɔ bɔku neshɔn dɛn, ɛn kiŋ dɛn go kɔmɔt nain bɛlɛ.”
Ebraam lidɔm flat wit in fes na grɔn, i bɔs laf ɛn aks insɛf se, if man kin bɔn pikin we i ol wan ɔndrɛd ia. Ɛn if Sera go ebul bɔn pikin we i ol naynti.
Ebraam beg PAPA GƆD se, “Duya, mek Ishmɛl bi di pikin we go gɛt di blɛsin.”
Dɛn PAPA GƆD se, “Nɔ-o! Yu wɛf Sera go bɔn bɔypikin fɔ yu ɛn yu fɔ gi am nem Ayzak. A go mek mi Kɔvinant wit am ɛn wit insɛf yon jɛnareshɔn dɛn, we go bi Kɔvinant we gɛt fɔ de sote go.

Fɔ Ishmɛl in yon say, a dɔn yɛri wetin yu se. A go blɛs insɛf, ɛn gi am bɔku pikin dɛn ɛn mek insɛf yon jɛnareshɔn bɔku. I go gɛt twɛlv bɔypikin dɛn we go rul, ɛn a go mek am bi di papa fɔ big big neshɔn dɛn.
Bɔt mi Kɔvinant go bi wit yu bɔypikin Ayzak, we Sera gɛt fɔ bɔn dis sem tɛm nɛks ia.”
We PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk to Ebraam dɔn, i lɛf am.

Ebraam obe PAPA GƆD in kɔmand ɛn sakɔmsayz in bɔypikin Ishmɛl ɛn ɔl di ɔda man dɛn nain os. I sakɔmsayz di wan dɛn we bɔn nain os ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we i bin bay. Dɛn ɔl sakɔmsayz da sem de de jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin tɛl am.
Ebraam bin ol naynti-nayn ia we i sakɔmsayz,
ɛn in bɔypikin Ishmɛl in bin ol tɔtin ia.
Dɛn ɔl tu bin sakɔmsayz da sem de de.
Ɔl di man dɛn we tap nain os, di wan dɛn we bɔn nain os, ɛn di wan dɛn we i bin sakɔmsayz wit am.
PAPA GƆD apia to Ebraam wan aftanun we di san bin tinap. We Ebraam bin sidɔm bifo in tɛnt domɔt nia usay Mamrɛ in ok tik dɛn bin de.
I es in ed ɔp ɛn si tri man dɛn tinap bifo am. We i si dɛn, i grap kwik go mit dɛn ɛn butu in fes na grɔn.
Dɛn i se, “Du sa, una nɔ jɛs pas mi os go; una blo lilibit.
Lɛ dɛn briŋ wata fɔs mek una was una fut; dɔn una kin blo ɔnda dis tik.
Lɛ a go briŋ smɔl tin kam fɔ una fɔ it, so una go gɛt trɛnk fɔ una patrol. Una dɔn gi mi rɛspɛkt we una kam na mi os, so mek a sav una.” Dɛn ansa se, “Ɔrayt wi gri, tɛnki.”
Ebraam mekes go insay in tɛnt ɛn tɛl Sera se, “Mekes, tek wan smɔl bag flawa ɛn bek sɔm bred kwik.”
Dɔn in rɔn go tek wan smɔl fayn kaw pikin ɛn gi in wokman fɔ mekes kuk.
I tek sɔm yogɔt, milk, ɛn di bif we bin dɔn kuk ɛn go sav di man dɛn ɔnda di tik. I tinap de we dɛn de it.
Nain dɛn aks am se, “We yu wɛf Sera?” I ansa dɛn se, “I de insay di tɛnt.”
Dɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, “A de kam fɛn yu bak dis sem tɛm nɛks ia. Bɔt bifo a kam yu wɛf Sera go dɔn bɔn bɔypikin.” Sera bin tinap biɛn di tɛnt in domɔt, de lisin.
Ebraam ɛn Sera bin dɔn ol, ɛn Sera nɔ bin de si in piriɔd igen
We Sera yɛri wetin dɛn se, i laf nain at ɛn se, “Lɛkɛ aw a ol so, luk mi we de go bɔn pikin we mi man insɛf dɔn ol so”
Dɔn PAPA GƆD aks Ebraam se, “Wetin du Sera laf to insɛf ɛn se, lɛkɛ we i dɔn ol so if in go ebul bɔn pikin?
Wetin de we a nɔ ebul du? Lɛkɛ aw a se nɔmɔ, a de kam fɛn yu bak dis sem tɛm nɛks ia, bɔt bifo a kam, Sera go dɔn bɔn bɔypikin.”
Bikɔs Sera bin de fred, i dinay se, in nɔ laf. Bɔt PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, i laf.
Di man dɛn grap fɔ go ɛn Ebraam go lɛf dɛn na rod. We dɛn bin de go dɛn luk dɔŋ say to usay Sɔdɔm de.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to insɛf se, “I nɔ go fayn lɛ a ayd wetin a want du pan Ebraam, bikɔs
nain gɛt fɔ bi di papa fɔ big, big neshɔn dɛn ɛn nain go mek ɔl dɛn neshɔn na wɔl gɛt dɛn blɛsin.
A dɔn pik am fɔ tɛl in jɛnareshɔn dɛn fɔ obe mi ɛn du wetin rayt ɛn tret wit mi. Dat go mek misɛf du ɔl wetin a bin prɔmis am.”
So PAPA GƆD tɛl Ebraam se, in dɔn yɛri bad bad tin dɛn bɔt di pipul dɛn na Sɔdɔm ɛn Gomɔra, ɛn dɛn dɔn pasmak
so i de go dɔŋ de fɔ go si if wetin yɛri na tru.
Di tu man dɛn lɛf fɔ go dɔŋ na Sɔdɔm, bɔt PAPA GƆD in bin lɛf wit Ebraam.
Ebraam go nia PAPA GƆD ɛn aks am se, “Fɔ tru, tru, yu go mek di pipul we de du rayt sɔfa wit di wan dɛn we de du bad?
If na fifti pipul de de we de du wetin rayt, yu go stil pwɛl di siti? Yu nɔ go lɛf fɔseka dɛn fifti pipul dɛn de?
A no se yu nɔ go du dat. Yu nɔ tan so! Yu nɔ go mek udat du rɔŋ ɛn udat du rayt gɛt di sem pɔnishmɛnt. Yu we na jɔj fɔ di wanol wɔl go jɔj tret wan.”
Dɛn PAPA GƆD se, “If a fɛn fifti pipul dɛn we de du wetin rayt na Sɔdɔm a go lɛf di siti fɔseka dɛn.”
Ebraam tɔk igen se: “PAPA GƆD, duya fɔgiv mi fɔ we a de tɔk. Yu no se mi na ɔdinari mɔtalman.

Sɔpoz na fɔti-fayv pipul dɛn nɔmɔ de de we de du wetin rayt, dɛn nɔ rich fifti, yu go stil pwɛl di wanol siti bikɔs fayv shɔt tin?” PAPA GƆD ansa se, “A nɔ go pwɛl di siti if a fɛn fɔti-fayv pipul de we de du wetin rayt.”
Ebraam tɔk igen se: “Sɔntɛm i go bi se na fɔti de de.” PAPA GƆD ansa bak se, “A nɔ go pwɛl am if na fɔti a fɛn de.”
Nain Ebraam se, “PAPA GƆD, duya nɔ vɛks pan mi we a de tɔk bɔku. Bɔt, wetin go apin if na tati nɔmɔ yu mit?” PAPA GƆD se, “A nɔ go pwɛl am if a fɛn tati.”
Ebraam se, “PAPA GƆD, duya, lɛ a nɔ taya fɔ tɔk to yu igen Wetin go apin if na twɛnti nɔmɔ yu fɛn?” PAPA GƆD ansa se, “A nɔ go pwɛl di siti if na twɛnti nɔmɔ a fɛn.”
Ebraam se, “PAPA GƆD, duya nɔ vɛks pan mi, na di las tɛm dis. Wetin go apin if na tɛn nɔmɔ yu fɛn?” PAPA GƆD se, “A nɔ go pwɛl am if a fɛn tɛn.”
Afta we dɛn dɔn tɔk dɔn, PAPA GƆD go in we, dɛn Ebraam tɔn bak go nain os.
We di tu enjɛl dɛn rich na Sɔdɔm da ivin tɛm de, dɛn mit Lɔt sidɔm na di siti in get. As i si dɛn de kam so, i grap go mit dɛn. I butu in fes na grɔn bifo dɛn,

ɛn se, “Du sa, una nɔ pas mi os go. Mek a briŋ wata fɔ una fɔ was una fut. Duya una slip to mi dis nɛt, dɛn una kin grap ali mɔnin ɛn go usay una de go.” Bɔt di man dɛn ansa se, “Nɔ-o, wi go go slip na trit midul siti.”
Bɔt Lɔt fos dɛn, ɛn dɛn go wit am insay in os. Lɔt mek gud it fɔ dɛn ɛn sav dɛn bred we nɔ gɛt yist, dɔn dɛn it.
Bay di tɛm we dɛn de rɛdi fɔ go lidɔm, ɔl di man dɛn na di siti dɔn sɔrawnd di os, big wan ɛn smɔl wan dɛn.
Dɛn ala aks Lɔt se, “We di trenja dɛn we kam slip to yu dis nɛt? Pul dɛn na do mek wi lidɔm wit dɛn.
Lɔt kɔmɔt go na do ɛn lɔk di do.
I beg dɛn mek dɛn nɔ du da kayn wikɛdnɛs de.
I se, “A gɛt tu gyal pikin dɛn we na vajin. Mek a gi una lɛ una du wetin una want du wit dɛn. Bɔt duya, una nɔ ambɔg dɛn po man dɛn ya, dɛn na mi trenja.”
Bɔt dɛn se, “Bo kɔmɔt bifo wi, yu we na trenja! Na yu de kam tɛl wi wetin fɔ du? Bo kɔmɔt bifo wi ya! Ɔ nɔ so wi go du yu wɔs tin pas wetin wi want du dɛn.” Dɛn push Lɔt te dɛn wan brok di do.
Bɔt di tu man dɛn we bin de insay, ol Lɔt ɛn drɔ am bak insay di os, ɛn lɔk di do.
Dɔn dɛn mek ɔl di man dɛn we bin de na do dɛn yay blɛn so dat dɛn nɔ go ebul fɔ si di domɔt.
Di tu man dɛn aks Lɔt, if i gɛt ɛnibɔdi na di siti lɛkɛ bɔypikin, gyal pikin, sɔnɛnlɔ, ɔ ɛni ɔda fambul, lɛ i pul dɛn kɔmɔt de,
bikɔs dɛn de kam pwɛl di siti kpatakpata. Dɛn se PAPA GƆD dɔn yɛri bɔt di bad bad tin dɛn we di pipul dɛn na di siti de du, ɛn i dɔn sɛn dɛn fɔ kam pwɛl di siti.
So Lɔt go to di man dɛn we gɛt fɔ mared in gyal pikin dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn fɔ mekes kɔmɔt na di siti, as PAPA GƆD want fɔ pwɛl dis siti kpatakpata. Bɔt dɛn fil se na ple i de ple.

We do klin di enjɛl dɛn tɛl Lɔt bak fɔ mekes. Dɛn tɛl am se, mek i mekes tek in wɛf ɛn tu gyal pikin dɛn we de wit am ɛn kɔmɔt de kwik kwik wan ɔ nɔ so dɛnsɛf go miks pan di pwɛl we di siti gɛt fɔ pwɛl.
Lɔt bigin drɛg fut. Bɔt PAPA GƆD sɔri fɔ am, so di tu man dɛn kapu Lɔt, in wɛf ɛn in tu gyal pikin dɛn bonikali ɛn drɛg dɛn kɔmɔt na di siti.
We di enjɛl dɛn dɔn pul dɛn kɔmɔt de, wan pan di enjɛl ala se, “Una rɔn fɔ una layf! Una nɔ luk biɛn ɛn una nɔ tinap na di vali. Una rɔn go na dɛn il fɔ lɛ una nɔ go day.”
Bɔt Lɔt beg se, “Duya a nɔ ebul go ɔp di il dɛn bikɔs dɛn de tu fa.
Du sa yu dɔn du big tin fɔ mi we yu sev mi layf. Bɔt di il dɛn de fa tumɔs; di waala go mit mi na rod, ɛn a go day bifo a rich de.
Yu si da smɔl siti de oba yanda? I de nia lilibit. Duya, mek a go de; yu kin si se na smɔl ples ɛn natin nɔ go apin to mi de.”
Di enjɛl gri se i kin go de. I se, “Ɔrayt, A nɔ go pwɛl da siti de.
Mekes! Rɔn! A nɔ go du natin te yu rich de.” Lɔt se di siti smɔl, na dat mek dɛn kɔl di siti Zoa.
Bay di tɛm we Lɔt rich Zoa, san dɔn tinap.
Da sem tɛm de nain PAPA GƆD mek big, big faya ɛn sɔlfa kɔmɔt na ɛvin ɛn bɔn Sɔdɔm ɛn Gomɔra.
I pwɛl pwɛl ɔl di siti dɛn, di vali dɛn, di pipul dɛn, di plant ɛn ɔl di animal dɛn.
Bɔt Lɔt in wɛf tɔn biɛn fɔ luk wetin de apin. As i du dat so, in wanol bɔdi jɛs stif ɛn tɔn to sɔl.
Ebraam grap di mɔnin go tinap na di ples we in ɛn PAPA GƆD bin tinap de tɔk.
I luk dɔŋ na Sɔdɔm ɛn Gomɔra ɛn di vali, ɛn si tik tik smok de kɔmɔt dɔŋ de. Di smok tan lɛkɛ we big big faya de kech.
We PAPA GƆD bin wan pwɛl di siti dɛn we de na di vali usay Lɔt bin tap, i mɛmba Ebraam ɛn na dat mek i sev Lɔt ɛn nɔ mek natin du am.
Lɔt bin de fred fɔ tap na Zoa, so in ɛn in tu gyal pikin dɛn muf go ɔp dɛn il go tap na wan kev.
Wande big gyal pikin tɛl in sista se, “Wi papa dɔn ol, man nɔ de na ya we go mared wi fɔ lɛ wi go bɔn pikin.
Yu no wetin lɛ wi gi papa rɔm lɛ i drɔnk we i chak we go go lidɔm wit am so wi go gɛt pikin we go mek wi nem nɔ day.”
Da nɛt de dɛn gi dɛn papa rɔm fɔ drink we mek i drɔnk, ɛn di big gyal pikin lidɔm wit am. Lɔt bin so drɔnk dat i nɔ no natin.
Di nɛks de, di big gyal pikin tɛl in sista se, “A lidɔm wit papa yɛstade nɛt; lɛ wi mek i drɔnk bak dis nɛt, so dat yu kin lidɔm wit am. Dɔn wi ɔl tu go gɛt pikin we go mek wi nem nɔ day.”
Da nɛt de dɛn mek i drɔnk gud, ɛn di smɔl gyal pikin lidɔm wit am. I bin so drɔnk dat i nɔ no natin.
Na so Lɔt in gyal pikin dɛn tek gɛt bɛlɛ fɔ am.
Di big wan bɔn bɔypikin, we i gi nem Moab. Moab na di papa fɔ di Moabayt dɛn we de te tide.
Di smɔl wan insɛf bɔn bɔypikin, we i gi nem Bɛn Ami, Bɛn Ami na di papa fɔ di Amonayt dɛn we stil de te tide.
Ebraam muf kɔmɔt Mamrɛ ɛn go sawt fɔ go na Nɛgɛv pat ful ɛn tap bitwin Kedɛsh ɛn Shɔ na wan ples we nem Gɛra.
I lay tɛl di pipul dɛn se in wɛf Sera nain sista. So Kiŋ Abimɛlɛk mek dɛn kɛr Sera go to am.
Wan nɛt PAPA GƆD apia to Abimɛlɛk na drim. I se, “Abimɛlɛk, bikɔs na pipul wɛf yu dɔn tek yu go day.”
Bɔt Abimɛlɛk nɔ bin gɛt biznɛs wit Sera yet, so i se, “PAPA GƆD, duya, a beg, a nɔ bin no. Nɔ mek inosɛnt pipul dɛn sɔfa fɔseka dat.
Na Ebraam insɛf sɛf tɛl mi se Sera nain sista, ɛn Sera insɛf kɔnfam se Ebraam nain brɔda. Duya a nɔ du am bay wilful, a nɔ bin no.”
PAPA GƆD ansa am bak na di drim se, “Yɛs, a si se yu kɔnshɛns klia, ɛn na dat mek a nɔ mek yu tɔch am sɛf, fɔ lɛ yu nɔ go kɔmit sin.
So naw, sɛn di uman go bak to in man. Na prɔfɛt, i go pre fɔ yu, ɛn yu nɔ go day. Mek a wɔn yu. If yu nɔ sɛn am go bak, no se yu wangren nɔ go day, yu ɛn ɔl yu pipul dɛn go day.”
So Abimɛlɛk grap ali mɔnin, i kɔl in ɔfisa dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn ɔl, ɔl wetin apin na nɛt. We dɛn yɛri dat i mek dɛn fred bad.
Afta dat Abimɛlɛk sɛn kɔl Ebraam ɛn aks am se, “Wetin du yu du wi so? Us bad a dɔn du yu we mek yu briŋ dis kayn waala pan mi ɛn mi pipul dɛn? Nɔbɔdi nɔ ɛva du wetin yu du so to mi.
Wetin mek yu du so?”
Ebraam ansa se, “A bin fil se nɔbɔdi nɔ de ya we de fred PAPA GƆD, ɛn sɔntɛm dɛn bin fɔ kil mi ɛn tek mi wɛf na mi an.
Usay tru de fɔ tɔk na mi sista, bikɔs wi na wan dadi pikin, bɔt nɔto di sem mami bɔn wi, ɛn a mared am.
So we PAPA GƆD pul mi kɔmɔt na di kɔntri usay a bin de, a tɛl am se, if i lɛk mi, i fɔ se mi nain brɔda ɛnisay we wi go.”
So Abimɛlɛk gi ship, kaw ɛn man ɛn uman slev dɛn to Ebraam, dɔn i gi am in wɛf bak.
I tɛl Ebraam se, di wanol kɔntri nain yon, i kin tap ɛnisay we i fil fɔ tap.
Dɔn i tɛl Sera se, “A de gi yu brɔda wan tawzin silva kɔpɔ fɔ sho se yu nɔ gɛt blem pan natin.”
Ebraam pre fɔ Abimɛlɛk, in wɛf ɛn ɔl di ɔda uman dɛn nain os we mek dɛn bigin bɔn pikin.
Bifo dat PAPA GƆD bin dɔn mek in wɛf ɛn ɔl di ɔda uman dɛn nain os nɔ ebul bɔn bikɔs Abimɛlɛk bin dɔn tek Sera as in wɛf.
PAPA GƆD blɛs Sera, lɛkɛ aw i bin prɔmis.
I gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn bɔypikin fɔ Ebraam we Ebraam bin dɔn ol. Di bɔbɔ bɔn di tɛm we PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl Ebraam se i go bɔn.
Ebraam gi di pikin we Sera bɔn nem Ayzak,
ɛn we Ayzak bin dɔn ol et de, Ebraam sakɔmsayz am, lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin tɛl am fɔ du.
Ebraam bin ol ɔndrɛd ia we Ayzak bɔn.
Sera se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn briŋ laf kam na mi os ɛn ɛnibɔdi we yɛri mɔs laf wit mi.”
Dɛn i se, “Udat bin fɔ tɛl Ebraam se Sera go ebul bɔn pikin! Bɔt na mi dis dɔn bɔn bɔypikin fɔ am ivin we i dɔn ol so.”
We di tɛm rich fɔ Sera fɔ win Ayzak, Ebraam mek big big pati.
Wande Sera si di pikin we da slev gyal we kɔmɔt Ijipt bɔn fɔ Ebraam de ambɔgin Ayzak.
So i tɛl Ebraam fɔ drɛb di slev gyal ɛn in pikin kɔmɔt nain os. I se, “Dis uman in pikin nɔ fɔ gɛt ɛnitin pan yu prɔpati, na mi bɔypikin Ayzak fɔ gɛt ɔltin.”
Dis tin ya bin mɔna Ebraam bad wan bikɔs Ishmɛl insɛf nain pikin.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD tɛl Ebraam se, mek in nɔ wɔri bɔt di pikin ɛn in mama Ega. PAPA GƆD se mek i du ɛnitin we Sera se, bikɔs na frɔm Ayzak i go gɛt di jɛnareshɔn dɛn we in bin dɔn prɔmis.
PAPA GƆD tɔk igen se, bɔt as Ishmɛl sɛf na ɔda bɔypikin we Ega, di slev gyal bɔn fɔ am, insɛf go gɛt bɔku pikin we dɛnsɛf go bi wanol neshɔn.

As do klin di nɛks de, Ebraam mek Ega ɛn in pikin kɔmɔt na di os. I gi dɛn it fɔ kɛr go, ɛn put wata na wata-rɔba we Ega ɛŋ nain sholda. Na so dɛn tek kɔmɔt na di os de wirɔn na di ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Biashiba.
Wɛn di wata dɔn, i mek di bɔbɔ lidɔm ɔnda shed, dɔn
in go sidɔm fawe. I de tɔk ɛn kray se in nɔ go ebul bia fɔ si in pikin de day.
PAPA GƆD yɛri di bɔbɔ de kray, nain PAPA GƆD in enjɛl aks Ega se, “Ega, wetindu yu de kray so, nɔ fred. PAPA GƆD dɔn yɛri we di bɔbɔ de kray usay i de.
Grap, go es di bɔbɔ ɛn mek i tinap. A go mek in jɛnareshɔn bi wan big big neshɔn.”
PAPA GƆD mek Ega si wan say we wata de bɔs ɔnda di grɔn. Insɛf tek in wata rɔba, ful am, ɛn gi di bɔbɔ wata fɔ drink.
PAPA GƆD bin de wit di bɔbɔ as i de gro. I bin de na di ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Paran ɛn i bin sabi fɔ ɔntin.
In mama fɛn wan uman we kɔmɔt Ijipt fɔ am fɔ mared.
Da tɛm de Abimɛlɛk mek Fikɔl, di kapten fɔ in ami, fala am go to Ebraam. Abimɛlɛk tɛl Ebraam se, i no se, PAPA GƆD de wit am pan ɔl wetin i de du.
I se Ebraam fɔ swɛ bifo PAPA GƆD se i nɔ go ambɔg ɛni wan pan in pipul dɛn. I tɛl am se, “A nɔ wande ambɔg yu, so swɛ se yusɛf nɔ go ambɔg mi ɛn kɔz prɔblɛm na dis kɔntri ya we yu tap.”
Ebraam insɛf swɛ.
Na de Ebraam le kɔmplen bɔt di wɛl we Abimɛlɛk in wokman dɛn siz nain an.
Abimɛlɛk insɛf se, “A nɔ no udat du so. Yusɛf nɔ ɛva se ɛnitin bɔt dat; na di fɔs tɛm dis a de yɛri tin lɛkɛ dat.”
Dɛn Ebraam gi Abimɛlɛk sɔm ship ɛn kaw dɛn, ɛn dɛn tu tay bagin se nɔbɔdi nɔ go ambɔg in kɔmpin.
Ebraam pul sɛvin yɔŋ uman ship pan in yon dɛn ɛn put dɛn wan say.
Dat mek Abimɛlɛk aks am, “wetin mek i du dat.
Ebraam ansa am se, “If yu tek dɛn sɛvin yɔŋ uman ship ya so, dat go sho se yu gri se na mi dig dis wɛl.”
Dɛn gi da ples de nem Biashiba, bikɔs na de dɛn ɔl tu bin tay bagin.
We dɛn dɔn tay di bagin dɔn na Biashiba, Abimɛlɛk ɛn Fikɔl go bak na Filistia.
Afta dat Ebraam plant tamarisk tik na Biashiba ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD de, di PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD sote go.
Ebraam bin tap na Filistia fɔ lɔŋ.
I nɔ tu te afta dat, PAPA GƆD tɛst Ebraam; i kɔl am, “Ebraam!” Ebraam ansa am se, “Yɛs, luk mi!”
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, “Tek yu pikin, yu wangren bɔypikin, Ayzak, we yu lɛk, lɛkɛ yu bɔlyay, kɛr am go na Mɔria, yu fɔ tek am mek sakrifays to mi. Bɔn am pantap wan pan dɛn mawnten we a go sho yu.”

As do klin so di nɛks de, Ebraam kɔt wud fɔ di sakrifays, ɛn lod am pan in dɔŋki, ɛn i tek Ayzak ɛn tu pan in wokman fɔ go wit am. Wɛn dɛn ɔl dɔn rɛdi, dɛn ol rod fɔ go na di ples we PAPA GƆD bin tɛl am bɔt.
We dɛn dɔn travul fɔ tri de, Ebraam es in ed ɔp, nain i si di ples fawe.
I tɛl in wokman dɛn se, “Una wet na ya wit di dɔŋki. Mi ɛn di bɔbɔ de go yanda fɔ go wɔship PAPA GƆD. Wi go kam mit una bak.”
Ebraam gi Ayzak di wud fɔ tot. Ebraam insɛf ol di nɛf ɛn ɔltin we i fɔ tek mek di faya. As dɛn tu de go,
Ayzak se, “Papa,” Ebraam ansa am se, “Yɛs,” Ayzak se, “A si se yu gɛt wud ɛn tin fɔ mek faya fɔ di sakrifays, bɔt a nɔ si di ship.”
Ebraam ansa se, “Na PAPA GƆD insɛf go gi wi di yɔŋ ship.” So dɛn ɔl tu kɔntinyu fɔ waka go.
We dɛn rich na di ples we PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl Ebraam bɔt, i bil di ɔlta ɛn put di wud de. I tay in pikin ɛn put am fɔ lidɔm pantap di wud na di ɔlta.
Togɛda we i de tek di nɛf fɔ kil in pikin,
nain PAPA GƆD in enjɛl na ɛvin ala, “Ebraam, Ebraam!” Ebraam ansa se, “Yɛs, luk mi.”

Nain di enjɛl se, “Nɔ du natin to da po pikin, nɔ tɔch am! A dɔn no naw se, yu de fred PAPA GƆD, bikɔs yu gri fɔ sakrifays yu wangren bɔypikin to am. Dat dɔn sho se yu rɛdi fɔ obe PAPA GƆD pan ɔltin.”
Wɛn Ebraam tɔn rawnd, i si wan yɔŋ manship fasin wit in ɔn dɛn na di bush. I go tek di ship ɛn bɔn am as sakrifays to PAPA GƆD.
Na dat mek Ebraam gi di ples nem ‘PAPA GƆD go provayd’ Na dat mek di Ibru pipul dɛn pul parebul se, ‘PAPA GƆD go provayd nain mawnten ɔltɛm.’
PAPA GƆD in enjɛl na ɛvin ala kɔl Ebraam di sɛkɛn tɛm,
i se, “PAPA GƆD se in dɔn swɛ to insɛf se i go blɛs yu bikɔs yu gri fɔ gi am yu wangren bɔypikin ɛn nɔ ol am to yusɛf.
I prɔmis se i go mek yu jɛnareshɔn bɔku lɛkɛ di sta dɛn na di skay ɛn lɛkɛ sansan na bich. Dɛn go gɛt pawa oba dɛn ɛnimi ɛn dɛn go tek dɛn siti sɛf na dɛn an.
Ɔl dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn go gɛt blɛsin tru yu jɛnareshɔn bikɔs yu obe am.”
Ebraam go mit in wokman dɛn, dɔn dɛn ɔl tɔn bak go na Biashiba, usay i bin tap.
Afta da tɛm de, Ebraam yɛri se in brɔda Neɔ in wɛf Milka, dɔn bɔn bɔypikin dɛn fɔ am.
Di fɔs wan nem Ɔz. Dɔn Ɔz kɔl Buz we kɔl Kɛmuɛl. Na Kɛmuɛl bɔn Aram;
afta dat dɛn bɔn Kɛsɛd, dɛn Ezɔ, Pildash, Jidlaf ɛn Bɛthuɛl.
Na Bɛthuɛl bin kam bi Ribɛka in papa. Dɛn et pikin ya nain Milka bɔn fɔ Neɔ, Ebraam in brɔda.
Ruma, Neɔ in ɔda uman insɛf bɔn Tɛba, Gaam, Taash ɛn Mayaka.
Sera bin ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti-sɛvin ia we i day,
ɛn i day na Ɛbrɔn we na Kiriath Aba insay Kenan. Ebraam fil am bad ɛn kray fɔ am.
Ebraam kɔmɔt usay in wɛf in dedebɔdi bin de, ɛn go to di Itayt pipul dɛn.
I beg dɛn fɔ sɛl ples gi am fɔ bɛr in wɛf as in na fɔrina.
Dɛn ansa am se,
“Duya lisin to wi, sa. Na yu na bigman pan wi ɔl, go bɛr yu wɛf na di bɛst grev we wi gɛt, sa. Nɔn pan wi nɔ go se yu nɔ fɔ bɛr de.”
Na de Ebraam grap ɛn baw bifo dɛn,
i se, “If una gri fɔ mek a bɛr mi wɛf na ya, duya una beg Ɛfrɔn, Zoa in bɔypikin
mek i sɛl Makpila kev, we de nain land, gi mi. Una tɛl am mek i sɛl am gi mi di ɛgzakt prayz bifo una ɔl na ya, so dat i go bi mi yon fɔ bɛriŋrɔn.
Da sem tɛm de Ɛfrɔn insɛf bin sidɔm wit sɔm ɔda Itayt pipul dɛn bifo di siti in get; so i ansa Ebraam bifo ɔlman we bin de de se,
“Lisin, sa, a gi yu di wanol fil ɛn di kev sɛf we de de. Bifo ɔl mi pipul dɛn, a de gi yu am fɔ mek yu bɛr yu wɛf de.”
Na de Ebraam baw bifo di Itayt pipul dɛn
ɛn tɔk fɔ mek ɔlman go yɛri se i go pe fɔ di wanol fil. I beg Ɛfrɔn duya mek i tek di mɔni, mek i go bɛr in wɛf.
Ɛfrɔn ansa am se,
“Pa, da grɔn de na fo ɔndrɛd silva kɔpɔ nɔmɔ fɔ am. Ɔmɔs na da mɔni de bitwin mi ɛn yu? Go bɛr yu wɛf.”
Ebraam si wit am bɔt i stil pe am fo ɔndrɛd silva kɔpɔ fɔ di kev bifo ɔl di pipul dɛn lɛkɛ aw dɛn biznɛsman bin fɔ sɛl am.
Na so Ebraam tek gɛt Makpila kev we na bin Ɛfrɔn in yon prɔpati nia di istɛn pat na Mamrɛ. Di land, di kev we de nia di land, ɛn ɔl di tik dɛn we de de bi in yon.
Ɛn na bifo ɔl di Itayt pipul i bay am.
Afta ɔl dis, Ebraam bɛr in wɛf Sera na di kev we de na Kenan we i bay.
Di fil ɛn di kev kam bi Ebraam in yon, ɛn di Itayt pipul dɛn gri fɔ lɛ de bi in yon bɛriŋrɔn.
Ebraam bin dɔn ol bad bad wan ɛn PAPA GƆD blɛs am pan ɔl wetin i bin de du.
So i tɛl di wokman we dɔn te pas ɔl nain os, ɛn we de inchaj ɔf ɔl in prɔpati, se, “Put yu an midul mi lɛg
ɛn swɛ to PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD na ɛvin ɛn ath, se, yu nɔ go fɛn wɛf fɔ mi bɔypikin Ayzak pan dɛn uman dɛn we de ya na Kenan.
Bɔt yu go go bak na mi kɔntri go fɛn wɛf fɔ am to mi yon pipul dɛn.”
Di wokman aks am se, “Wɛl, if di uman nɔ gri lɛf in pipul dɛn fɔ kam wit mi, lɛ a mek yu pikin in go mit am de?”
Ebraam ansa se, “Nɔ, mek shɔ se yu nɔ sɛn mi pikin go de bak!

PAPA GƆD, we na PAPA GƆD na ɛvin, bin pul mi kɔmɔt na mi papa in os ɛn usay ɔl mi fambul dɛn de, ɛn prɔmis mi se, in go gi mi ɛn mi jɛnareshɔn dɛn dis land ya so. Da sem PAPA GƆD de go sɛn in enjɛl bifo yu, so dat yu go gɛt wɛf fɔ mi pikin yanda.
If di gyal nɔ gri fɔ kam wit yu, yu dɔn pul yu ed. Bɔt lɛ natin nɔ mek yu kɛr mi pikin go de bak.”
So di wokman put in an midul Ebraam in lɛg ɛn swɛ lɛkɛ aw Ebraam tɛl am fɔ du.
Dis wokman we nem Ɛliaza, ɛn we bin de inchaj ɔf Ebraam in prɔpati, tek tɛn pan Ebraam in kamɛl ɛn plɛnti ɔda fayn fayn tin dɛn. I lɛf go Aram Naaraim to usay Neɔ de.
We i rich de, i mek di kamɛl dɛn blo nia wan wɛl we de na di rod fɔ go insay di siti. Da tɛm de na bin ivin tɛm, ɛn na da sem tɛm de dɛn uman dɛn kin go gɛt wata.
So i pre se, “PAPA GƆD, yu we na mi masta Ebraam in PAPA GƆD, mek bɛtɛ fala mi tide ɛn sho mi masta se yu lɛk am ɛn de du gud to am.
Mek i bi se we a tinap nia dis wɛl usay dɛn yɔŋgyal dɛn na dis siti kin kam gɛt wata,

mek a tɛl ɛni wan pan dɛn fɔ gi mi wata fɔ drink. If i gri fɔ gi mi di wata ɛn tɛl mi mek a drink, dɛn i go briŋ wata kam fɔ mi kamɛl dɛnsɛf, mek i bi se na da uman de yu dɔn pik fɔ yu pikin Ayzak. If dat apin a go no se yu lɛk mi masta ɛn de du gud to am.”
Bifo i de pre dɔn, Ribɛka dɔn rich na di wɛl wit in wata jɔg nain sholda. Ribɛka na bin Bɛthuɛl in gyal pikin. Bɛthuɛl na wan pan di bɔypikin we Milka bɔn fɔ Neɔ, Ebraam in brɔda.
Ribɛka na bin fayn ledi ɛn na bin vajin. I go dɔŋ na di wɛl, ɛn gɛt wata. As i de tɔn bak,
Ɛliaza rɔn go mit am ɛn tɛl am se, “Duya, gi mi wata fɔ drink nɔ.”
Ribɛka se, “Ya, drink, sa,” I mekes pul in wata jɔg nain sholda ɛn ol am te di man drink dɔn.
We i dɔn drink dɔn, Ribɛka se, “A de go briŋ wata kam fɔ yu kamɛl dɛn sa, lɛ dɛnsɛf drink te dɛn satisfay.”
Kwik kwik wan so i dɔn ɛmti in wata jɔg usay di kamɛl dɛn de drink ɛn rɔn go bak na di wɛl ɛn gɛt mɔ wata, sote i gi ɔl di kamɛl dɛn.
Na so Ɛliaza bin de wach am, fɔ si if nain prea PAPA GƆD dɔn ansa wantɛm so.
Wɛn di kamɛl dɛn dɔn drink dɔn, Ɛliaza tek wan gold riŋ ɛn put am na Ribɛka in nos, ɛn put tu gold baŋuls we dɛn wet na lɛkɛ tɛn kɔpɔ.
I aks am se, “Yu na udat in pikin? If wi want slip dis nɛt, ples go de na una os fɔ lɔj wi ɔl?”
Ribɛka ansa am se “Mi papa na Bɛthuɛl, wan pan di bɔypikin dɛn we Milka bɔn fɔ Neɔ.
Wi gɛt plɛnti it fɔ di kamɛl dɛn ɛn ples de fɔ una fɔ slip.”
We Ɛliaza yɛri dis, i nildɔŋ ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD.
I se, “A de prez yu PAPA GƆD. Yu we na PAPA GƆD fɔ mi masta Ebraam. Fɔ tru tru yu lɛk mi masta ɛn de du gud to am. Yu dɔn briŋ mi tret to mi masta in fambul dɛn.”
Ribɛka rɔn go na os to in mama ɛn tɛl am ɔl wetin dɔn bi.
So Ribɛka bin gɛt wan brɔda we nem Leban. We i yɛri di stori, ɛn si di riŋ nain sista in nos wit di baŋuls.
I go mit Ebraam nain an i rɔn kɔmɔt na di os go na di wɛl usay Ebraam in wokman dɛn bin de.
Dɛn i se, “Wetin mek yu tinap na ya? Kam lɛ wi go na os. Yu na man we PAPA GƆD dɔn blɛs. A dɔn rɛdi wan rum fɔ yu, ɛn ples de fɔ yu kamɛl dɛn fɔ slip.”
So Ɛliaza go insay di os, dɔn Leban pul di lod pan di kamɛl dɛn ɛn gi dɛn tin fɔ it. Dɔn i briŋ wata fɔ Ebraam in wokman ɛn in man dɛn fɔ was dɛn fut.
We dɛn gi dɛn tin fɔ it, Ɛliaza se, in nɔ go it te i tɔk wetin i want fɔ tɔk. Nain Leban se, tɔk nɔ.”
Di man bigin fɔ tɔk. I se, in na Ebraam in wokman.
I tɔk aw PAPA GƆD dɔn blɛs in masta, ɛn aw i dɔn mek i bi jɛntri man. PAPA GƆD gi am bɔku bɔku ship, kaw, silva, gold, wokman ɛn wokuman dɛn wit kamɛl ɛn dɔŋki.
I se in masta in wɛf, Sera, nɔ bin bɔn pikin fɔ am te i dɔn ol, ɛn in masta dɔn gi di pikin ɔl in prɔpati.
I se, in masta mek i swɛ se, i go du wetin i se. Dat na fɔ mek i nɔ fɛn wɛf fɔ in pikin pan dɛn gyal dɛn we de na Kenan.
Bifo dat, in Ɛliaza, fɔ go nain papa in os, usay in fambul dɛn de ɛn fɛn wɛf de fɔ in pikin.
I tɔk se, i aks in masta se if di uman nɔ gri go bak wit am wetin i fɔ du.
I se in masta ansa am se, PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we i de sav ɛn obe ɔltɛm go sɛn in enjɛl wit am ɛn bɛtɛ go fala am, ɛn i go fɛn wɛf fɔ in pikin nain fambul dɛn os.
I se in Masta se, na wan we nɔmɔ i go ebul pul in ed pan di swɛ, dat na if i go to di pipul dɛn, dɔn dɛn nɔ gri fɔ gi am di uman fɔ go bak.
I se, we i bin de go na di wɛl tide, i pre to PAPA GƆD we nain masta Ebraam in PAPA GƆD, fɔ mek bɛtɛ fala am pan wetin i de go du.
As i tinap na di wɛl so i beg PAPA GƆD se, we ɛni yɔŋgyal kam fɔ gɛt wata ɛn i aks am fɔ gi am wata,
if i gri, ɛn igen if i gi in kamɛl dɛnsɛf wata, mek i bi se na di uman dat we PAPA GƆD dɔn pik fɔ in masta in bɔypikin.
I se, bay di tɛm we i de pre dɔn in si Ribɛka kɔmɔt gɛt wata wit in wata jɔg nain sholda. I se i aks Ribɛka fɔ gi am wata fɔ drink.
So Ribɛka pul in wata jɔg nain sholda mek i drink, ɛn tɛl am se in de go briŋ wata kam fɔ in kamɛl dɛnsɛf. So i drink, dɔn di kamɛl dɛnsɛf drink.
I se i aks Ribɛka udat nain papa. Ribɛka ansa am se, in papa na Bɛthuɛl we na Neɔ ɛn Milka dɛn bɔypikin. So i put riŋ nain nos ɛn baŋuls nain an.
Dɔn i nildɔŋ ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD. I prez PAPA GƆD we nain masta Ebraam in PAPA GƆD, fɔ we i dɔn briŋ am tret to in masta in fambul dɛn os, usay i dɔn fɛn wɛf fɔ in masta in bɔypikin.
I tɛl Ribɛka in pipul dɛn se, “If una want du gud to mi masta Ebraam, una tɛl mi; if nɔto so igen, una tɛl mi, mek a go no wetin fɔ du.”
Leban ɛn Bɛthuɛl ansa am se, “We i dɔn bi se PAPA GƆD gɛt an pan dis biznɛs, wi nɔ gɛt natin fɔ se.
Luk Ribɛka, ya! Tek am go. Lɛ i go bi yu masta in bɔypikin in wɛf, lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD insɛf dɔn se.”
We Ɛliaza yɛri wetin dɛn se, i nildɔŋ na grɔn ɛn prez PAPA GƆD.
Dɔn i gi Ribɛka klos, silva ɛn gold. Dɛn i gi in mama ɛn in brɔda ɔda valyuebul tin dɛn.
Afta dat Ɛliaza ɛn di ɔda man dɛn we bin de wit am it ɛn drink, ɛn dɛn slip de da nɛt de. We dɛn grap na mɔnin, Ɛliaza tɛl dɛn se i want go bak to in masta.
Bɔt Ribɛka in brɔda ɛn in mama se, dɛn want Ribɛka fɔ de wit dɛn fɔ lɛkɛ tɛn de mɔ.
Ɛliaza beg dɛn mek i go wantɛm to in masta lɛkɛ we PAPA GƆD dɔn mek i gɛt wetin i want, lɛ i nɔ wes mɔ tɛm igen
Dɛn ansa am se, “Lɛ wi kɔl di uman lɛ i tɔk fɔ insɛf.”
So dɛn kɔl Ribɛka ɛn aks am if i want fɔ go wit di man naw. I ansa dɛn se yɛs, in want fɔ go.
So dɛn mek Ribɛka ɛn di nɔsi we dɔn de wit am frɔm we i bɔn go wit Ɛliaza ɛn in man dɛn.
Dɔn dɛn blɛs Ribɛka wit dɛn wɔd ya so. Dɛn se, “Wi sista, PAPA GƆD go wit yu ya. Lɛ PAPA GƆD gi yu bɔku pikin, ɛn mek yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn kɔnka ɔl dɛn ɛnimi dɛn!”
So Ribɛka ɛn in nɔsi jomp pantap di kamɛl ɛn fala Ɛliaza. Dɛn dɛn ɔl ol rod fɔ go bak.
Da tɛm de Ayzak bin dɔn kɔmɔt na Bia-laay-rɔy ɛn kam tap na Nɛgɛv.
Ivin tɛm we san dɔn go dɔŋ i kɔmɔt na do go na di fil fɔ mɛditet; i es in ed ɔp ɛn si di kamɛl dɛn de kam.
We Ribɛka si Ayzak, i jomp kam dɔŋ di kamɛl
ɛn aks Ɛliaza udat Ayzak bi? Ɛliaza ansa am se, nain masta. So Ribɛka kɔba in fes wit in vel.
We dɛn rich, Ɛliaza tɛl Ayzak ɔl wetin apin.
Ayzak tek Ribɛka go insay di tɛnt we in mama Sera bin tap. Ayzak bin lɛk Ribɛka ɛn mared am. Dat ɛp am fɔ bɔkɔp as in mama bin dɔn day.
Ebraam mared wan ɔda uman, we nem Kɛtyura.
Kɛtyura bɔn siks bɔypikin fɔ am. Dɛn nem Zimran, Jɔkshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak ɛn Shua.
Jɔkshan bɔn Shiba ɛn Didan, ɛn Didan in jɛnareshɔn dɛn na bin dɛn Ashurayt, dɛn Lɛtushayt, ɛn dɛn Lɛumayt.
Midian bɔn Ɛfa, Ɛfɔ, Anɔk, Abida, ɛn Ɛldaa. Ɔl dɛn wan ya na Kɛtyura in jɛnareshɔn dɛn.
Ebraam bin lɛf ɔl in prɔpati gi Ayzak.
Bɔt i gi di ɔda uman dɛn pikin dɛnsɛf gud prɛzɛnt dɛn ɛn mek dɛn go tap na ɔda kɔntri so dat dɛn go kɔmɔt nia in bɔysɔn Ayzak. Di kɔntri we i sɛn dɛn go, de na di ist pat. I du ɔl dis bifo i day.
Ebraam day we i ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn sɛvinti-fayv ia.
Ebraam bin dɔn tɔn prɔpa olpa we i kik di bokit, dɔn dɛn bɛr am na dɛn famili grev.
Tu pan in bɔypikin dɛn, Ayzak ɛn Ishmɛl kɛr am go bɛr am na Makpila kev, we de nia Mamrɛ na da land we Zoa da Itayt, in bɔypikin Ɛfrɔn gɛt.
Ebraam bin dɔn bay dis land ya na di Itayt dɛn an. Na de dɛn bɛr Ebraam ɛn in wɛf Sera.
Afta Ebraam dɔn day, PAPA GƆD blɛs Ayzak we bin tap na Bia-laay-rɔy.
Dɛn pipul ya na Ishmɛl in jɛnareshɔn. Ishmɛl na bin da pikin we Ega, Sera in slev gyal we kɔmɔt Ijipt bɔn fɔ Ebraam.
Na dɛn nem dɛn dis bay aw dɛn bɔn. Nɛbayɔth, Kida, Adbeɛl, Mibsam,
Mishma, Duma, Masa,
Adad, Tɛma, Jɛtu, Nafish, ɛn Kɛdɛma.
Dɛn twɛlv pipul ya na bin di papa dɛn fɔ ɔl di twɛlv fambul dɛn we gɛt dɛn nem dɛn. Na dɛn nem dɛn bin gi to di ples we dɛn bin tap.
Ishmɛl ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn tati-sɛvin ia we i day go mit in pipul dɛn.
Ishmɛl in jɛnareshɔn bin skata ɔlɔbɔt frɔm Avila te rich Shɔ, we de nia di Ijipt bɔda, na di rod fɔ go Ashɔ. Ishmɛl in pipul dɛn bin de nia in ɔda brɔda dɛn.
Dis stori na bɔt Ayzak. In na bin Ebraam in bɔypikin.
I bin ol fɔti ia we i mared Ribɛka, we na Bɛthuɛl in gyal pikin ɛn na Leban in sista. Bɛthuɛl na Aramean we kɔmɔt Padan Aram.
Ayzak pre to PAPA GƆD fɔ mek Ribɛka go gɛt pikin bikɔs i nɔ bin bɔn yet. So PAPA GƆD ansa Ayzak in prea, ɛn Ribɛka gɛt bɛlɛ.
Di pikin dɛn bin de fɛt nain bɛlɛ so i aks PAPA GƆD se, “Wetin mek dis kayn tin de bi to mi?”

PAPA GƆD ansa am se, “Wande wande, di bɔypikin dɛn na yu bɛlɛ go bi tu neshɔn we nɔ go ɛva gri. Wan pan dɛn go trɔŋ pas in kɔmpin. Di big wan in yon jɛnareshɔn go de ɔnda di smɔl wan in yon jɛnareshɔn.”
We di tɛm rich fɔ Ribɛka fɔ bɔn, i bɔn twin.
Di fɔs wan in bɔdi bin rɛd, soso ia bin kɔba in wanol bɔdi. Pɔsin go min se na klos i wɛr, so dɛn gi am nem Isɔ.
We di sɛkɛn wan bɔn, in grip Isɔ nain bakfut, so dɛn gi am nem Jekɔb. Ayzak bin ol siksti ia we Ribɛka bɔn dɛn twin ya.
Dɛn tu bɔbɔ ya gro te dɛn big. Isɔ bin sabi ɔntin, ɛn i bin lɛk fɔ go na bush. Bɔt Jekɔb in na bin di kwayɛt tayp we lɛk fɔ sidɔm na os.
Ayzak bin lɛk Isɔ patikla we i kin ɛnjɔy di bush bif we Isɔ kin briŋ kam na os, bɔt Ribɛka in bin lɛk Jekɔb.
Wande Jekɔb bin de kuk sup we Isɔ kɔmɔt ɔntin in taya ɛn aŋri wan.
I tɛl Jekɔb se in aŋri bad so mek i gi am sɔm (pan di rɛd sup) we i de kuk. Na dat mek dɛn kɔl am Idɔm.
Jekɔb ansa am se in gri wans Isɔ gri fɔ sɛl in bathrayt gi am.
Isɔ se na aŋri de kil am so, ɛn bathrayt nɔ gɛt natin fɔ bɛnifit am da momɛnt de.
Jekɔb pin se paopa, i fɔ swɛ se nain di Jekɔb gɛt di bathrayt naw. So Isɔ swɛ ɛn sɛl ɔl in rayt as di fɔs-bɔy-pikin to in smɔl brɔda.
Na de Jekɔb insɛf gi Isɔ bred ɛn sɔm pan di sup. Isɔ it ɛn drink wata ɛn go abawt in biznɛs. I nɔ bisin sɛf se nain bathrayt i dɔn sɛl so.
Aŋri bin de na di kɔntri bak afta da wan we bin de Ebraam in tɛm. So, Ayzak muf go tap na Gɛra usay Abimɛlɛk, di Filistin dɛn kiŋ bin de.
We i de de, PAPA GƆD apia to am ɛn tɛl am se, “Nɔ go na Ijipt, de usay a tɛl yu fɔ de.
Nɔ muf na ya naw ɛn a go de wit yu ɛn blɛs yu. A go gi yu ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn ɔl dis land lɛkɛ aw a bin dɔn swɛ to yu papa Ebraam se a go du.
A go mek yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn bɔku lɛk di sta dɛn de na di skay, ɛn a go gi dɛn dis wanol ples. Na tru dɛn ɔl dɛn ɔda neshɔn go gɛt blɛsin.
A go du so bikɔs Ebraam bin de yɛri mi wɔd, ɛn du ɔl wetin a lɛk, ɔl wetin a tɛl am fɔ du, ɛn obe ɔl di lɔ we a gi am.
So Ayzak insɛf nɔ muf kɔmɔt Gɛra.
We di man dɛn na Gɛra aks am bɔt Ribɛka, i tɛl dɛn se nain sista. I fred fɔ tɔk se nain wɛf. I bin tink se di man dɛn go kil am ɛn tek in wɛf nain an, bikɔs Ribɛka bin fayn.
We Ayzak bin dɔn de de lɔŋ lilibit, Abimɛlɛk, di Filistin dɛn kiŋ, luk oba in winda ɛn di we we i si Ayzak ɛn Ribɛka de ple
mek i sɛn kɔl Ayzak ɛn se, “E e!, so na yu wɛf? Wetin mek yu se na yu sista?” Ayzak ansa se, “Bikɔs a bin de fred se dɛn go kil mi ɛn tek am na mi an, sa.”
Abimɛlɛk se, “Wetin mek yu du dat to wi? Yu bin fɔ put wi pan waala if wan pan mi man dɛn bin dɔn lidɔm wit yu wɛf.”
So Abimɛlɛk wɔn ɔlman nɔ fɔ ambɔg di man ɔ in wɛf ɔ nɔ so da pɔsin de go day.
Da ia de, di tin dɛn we Ayzak plant bɔs fayn. Di avɛst we i gɛt bin wan ɔndrɛd tɛm bɔku pas wetin i plant, bikɔs PAPA GƆD blɛs am.
Ayzak kam jɛntri ɛn na so i bin de jɛntri mɔ ɛn mɔ.
Bikɔs i bin gɛt bɔku, bɔku got, ship, kaw ɛn wokman dɛn, di Filistin dɛn bigin jɛlɔs am,
so dɛn pak dɔti insay Ayzak in wɛl dɛn. Dɛn wɛl dɛn de nain papa Ebraam in wokman dɛn bin dig dɛn bifo i day.
Abimɛlɛk drɛb Ayzak kɔmɔt na di kɔntri. I se, “Yu dɔn kam jɛntri ɛn gɛt pawa pas wi.”
So Ayzak insɛf kɔmɔt de ɛn go tap na di vali na Gɛra.
I opin di wɛl dɛn we in papa bin dɔn dig, we di Filistin dɛn bin ful-ɔp afta Ebraam day. Ayzak gi dɛn di sem nem dɛn we in papa Ebraam bin gi dɛn.
Ayzak in wokman dɛnsɛf bin de dig dig rawnd di vali na Gɛra te dɛn fɛn sɔnsay we wata bɔs na di grɔn.
Bɔt di man dɛn we de mɛn dɛn animal dɛn na Gɛra kam se na dɛn yon, ɛn bigin agyu wit Ayzak in yon wokman dɛn. Dat mek Ayzak gi di wɛl nem, Ɛsɛk bikɔs dɛn bin de mek plaba wit am.
Ayzak in wokman dɛn dig ɔda wɛl, bɔt di man dɛn we de mɛn dɛn animal dɛn mek plaba bak wit dɛn fɔ da wande insɛf. Fɔseka dat Ayzak kɔl di wɛl Sitna we min “Ɔpozishɔn.”
So dɛn muf kɔmɔt de go ɔda say ɛn go dig ɔda wɛl. Plaba nɔ bin de fɔ dis wan, so Ayzak kɔl am Rɛobɔt we min “Speshɔs ples” ɛn se, PAPA GƆD dɔn gi dɛn big ples ɛn bɛtɛ go fala dɛn usay dɛn de.
Frɔm de Ayzak kɔmɔt go Biashiba.
Da nɛt de PAPA GƆD apia to am ɛn tɛl am se, “Mi na yu papa Ebraam in PAPA GƆD. Nɔ fred; A de wit yu. A go blɛs yu ɛn mek yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn bɔku bikɔs na so a bin dɔn prɔmis mi savant Ebraam.”
Ayzak bil ɔlta de ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD. Dɔn i bil in kamp de, ɛn in wokman dɛn dig ɔda wɛl.
Abimɛlɛk kɔmɔt na Gɛra wit Auzath we nain advaysa, ɛn Fikɔl, we na kɔmanda fɔ in sojaman dɛn, fɔ kam si Ayzak.
Ayzak aks dɛn wetin dɛn kam du we dɛn bin dɔn drɛb am kɔmɔt na dɛn kɔntri.
Dɛn ansa am se, dɛn dɔn no naw se PAPA GƆD de wit am so dɛn kam fɔ mek dɛn go tay bagin fɔ sho se dɛn gɛt wan wɔd. Dɛn want fɔ mek i swɛ
se i nɔ go du dɛn bad lɛkɛ aw dɛnsɛf nɔ bin du am bad. Dɛn se dɛn bin gud to am ɛn dɛn pat kɔmpin saful wan ɛn si aw PAPA GƆD dɔn blɛs am naw.
So Ayzak mek pati fɔ dɛn ɛn dɛn it ɛn drink nɔf.
Dɛn grap ali mɔnin, ɛn swɛ wan bay wan to dɛn kɔmpin. Afta dat Ayzak tɛl dɛn gudbay ɛn ɔlman go om pisful wan.
Da sem de de, Ayzak in wokman dɛn kam tɛl am bɔt di wɛl we dɛn dɔn dig. Dɛn se dɛn dɔn fɛn wata.
Ayzak gi di wɛl nem Shiba we min “Swɛ.” Na so di big siti Biashiba tek gɛt in nem te tide.
We Isɔ ol fɔti ia, i mared Judith, da Itayt man we nem Bieri in gyal pikin; dɔn i mared Basimath we na Ɛlɔn in gyal pikin. Ɛlɔn insɛf na Itayt.
Dɛn bin mek layf traŋa fɔ Ayzak ɛn Ribɛka.
Ayzak bin dɔn ol ɛn i nɔ bin de si fayn. Wande i sɛn kɔl in big bɔypikin Isɔ fɔ tɔk to am. We i kam i ansa am se, “Luk mi sa.”
Ayzak se, “Yu si se a dɔn ol ɛn a kin day ɛnitɛm.
Tek yu bo ɛn aro, go na bush, ɛn kil bif fɔ mi.
Kuk di it we yu no se a lɛk, mek i swit ɛn briŋ am kam fɔ mi. We a it am dɔn, a go blɛs yu bifo a day.”
We Ayzak bin de tɔk to Isɔ, Ribɛka bin yɛri wetin i se. We Isɔ go ɔntin,
Ribɛka tɛl Jekɔb se, “A dɔn yɛri wetin yu papa tɛl yu brɔda, I tɛl am se,
mek i kil bush bif ɛn kuk fayn it fɔ am. We i it am dɔn, i go blɛs am bifo PAPA GƆD, bifo i day.
Naw mi pikin, lisin gud ɛn du wetin a se.
Go pik tu fat yɔŋ got pan dɛn got dɛn mek a kuk di it we yu papa lɛk.
Dɔn yu go kɛr am go gi am, ɛn wɛn i it dɔn, i go blɛs yu bifo i day.”
Bɔt Jekɔb ansa in mama se, “Luk we Isɔ gɛt bɔku ia nain bɔdi, ɛn mi nɔ gɛt.
If papa go tɔch mi naw ɛn no se a de tray fɔ trik am, bifo i blɛs mi nɔto swɛ i go swɛ mi?”
Na de Ribɛka se, “Bɔbɔ, lɛ di swɛ kech mi; yu jɛs du wetin a se nɔmɔ ɛn go briŋ di got dɛn kam fɔ mi.”
So Jekɔb insɛf go briŋ di got dɛn kam, ɛn in mama kuk am aw Ayzak lɛk am.
Ribɛka tek Isɔ in bɛst klos, we bin de na os, ɛn wɛr am pan Jekɔb.
I put sɔm pan di got ia rawnd in nɛk ɛn in an dɛn usay ia nɔ de.
I gi am di it we de smɛl tes, ɛn sɔm bred we i bek.
So Jekɔb kɛr di it go insay to in papa. We i kɔl in papa, in papa bin aks fɔ no uswan pan di pikin dɛn i bi.
Nain Jekɔb se, “Mi na yu big bɔypikin Isɔ, a dɔn du wetin yu tɛl mi fɔ du, sa. Grap nɔ, sidɔm lɛ yu it di it we yu tɛl mi fɔ kuk lɛkɛ aw yu lɛk am, mek yu blɛs mi.”
Na de Ayzak se, “Mi pikin, aw yu manej fɛn di bif kwik kwik wan so?” Jekɔb insɛf ansa se, “PAPA GƆD we na yu PAPA GƆD nain ɛp mi fɛn am kwik kwik wan so, sa.”
Ayzak tɛl Jekɔb se, “kam nia mi mek a tɔch yu. Fɔ tru tru yu na Isɔ?”
So Jekɔb go nia in papa, ɛn in papa fil fil am ɛn se, “Yu vɔys fiba lɛkɛ Jekɔb in vɔys, bɔt yu an dɛn fil lɛkɛ Isɔ in yon.”
I nɔ bin no se na Jekɔb bikɔs in an dɛn bin gɛt ia lɛkɛ Isɔ in yon. We i rɛdi fɔ blɛs am,
i aks bak se, “Yu na Isɔ fɔ tru, tru?” Jekɔb ansa se, “Yɛs, na mi sa.”
Na de Ayzak se, “Gi mi sɔm pan di it. We a it am dɔn a go blɛs yu.” So Jekɔb gi di it to in papa, wit sɔm wayn fɔ drink. Ayzak insɛf it bɛlful ɛn drink di wayn we Jekɔb sav am.
Dɔn i tɛl Jekɔb se “lɛ kis am.”
So Jekɔb go nia am ɛn kis am. We Ayzak smɛl in klos na da tɛm de i biliv se na Isɔ, so i blɛs am. I se, “Mi pikin in sɛnt tan lɛkɛ di fayn sɛnt we de kɔmɔt na bush we PAPA GƆD dɔn blɛs.
Mek PAPA GƆD mek ɛnitin we yu put yu an pan bɛtɛ! Mek i gi yu plɛnti it ɛn wayn!

Mek bɔku neshɔn dɛn sav yu, ɛn lɛ pipul dɛn baw bifo yu. Mek yu rul oba yu brɔda dɛn ed, ɛn mek yu mama in jɛnareshɔn dɛn ɔl baw bifo yu. Mek swɛ de pan ɛniwan we go swɛ yu, ɛn mek PAPA GƆD blɛs dɛn wan we go blɛs yu.”
We Ayzak dɔn blɛs Jekɔb dɔn so, Jekɔb de rɛdi fɔ go na do, nain Isɔ kɔmɔt ɔntin kam.
Isɔ insɛf kuk di it we in papa lɛk ɛn kɛr am go to am, ɛn se, “papa, a dɔn kam, sidɔm nɔ lɛ yu it di it we a kuk fɔ yu fɔ lɛ yu go blɛs mi.”
Bɔt Ayzak aks se, “Na udat de tɔk?” Isɔ ansa se, “Na mi Isɔ yu big bɔypikin.”
Na de Ayzak bigin trimbul bad bad wan, so i aks se, “Bɔt na udat go ɔntin we kuk it kam gi mi fɔ it jisnɔ? A jɛs it dɔn bifo yu kam ɛn a dɔn blɛs am. Natin nɔ de fɔ du igen”
We Isɔ yɛri dis i ala big big wan ɛn kray bita bita wan ɛn se, “Papa, duya blɛs misɛf!”
Ayzak ansa am se, “Yu brɔda dɔn kam mek mi ful. I dɔn tek yu blɛsin.”

Isɔ se, “Dis na di sɛkɛn tɛm we i de ple mi dis trik. Nɔto dat mek dɛn de kɔl am Jekɔb. I dɔn tek mi ples lɛkɛ se in na di fɔs-bɔy-pikin, dɔn naw i dɔn tek mi blɛsin. Papa, nɔn blɛsin nɔ lɛf fɔ mi sɛf?”
Ayzak ansa se, “A dɔn mek i bi masta oba yu, ɛn a dɔn put ɔl in fambul dɛn fɔ sav am ɛn i go gɛt bɔku fɔ it ɛn drink. Naw, mi pikin natin nɔ lɛf we a kin gi yu!”
Isɔ tɛl in papa se: “Papa, a nɔ tink se na wangren blɛsin nɔmɔ yu gɛt? Duya blɛs misɛf” So i bigin fɔ kray bak.
Nain Ayzak tɛl am se, “Tin go traŋa fɔ yu na di say we yu go tap, ɛn natin bɛtɛ nɔ go kɔmɔt na di grɔn fɔ yu.
We yu fɛt ɛn kil yu go gɛt wetin fɔ it, Yu go de ɔnda yu brɔda as wokman. Bɔt wɛn yu nɔ ebul fɔ bia igen, Yu go kɔmɔt ɔnda in kɔntrol.”
Isɔ bin et Jekɔb bad wan, bikɔs Jekɔb dɔn gɛt di blɛsin we dɛn papa bin wan gi am. So i tɔk to insɛf se, “We mi papa day, a go kil Jekɔb.”
Bɔt sɔmbɔdi kam tɛl Ribɛka wetin Isɔ wan du. I sɛn kɔl Jekɔb ɛn tɛl am se, “Yu brɔda Isɔ dɔn mekɔp fɔ kil yu.
Naw, mi pikin, du wetin a de tɛl yu. Go wantɛm to mi brɔda Leban na Eran,
ɛn tap de fɔs, sote yu brɔda in at kol,
ɛn i fɔgɛt wetin yu dɔn du am. Dɛn a go sɛn pɔsin go briŋ yu kam bak. Wetin du a fɔ lɔs ɔl tu mi bɔypikin dɛn di sem de?”
Afta dat Ribɛka tɛl Ayzak se, “A dɔn gens wit aw dɛn Itayt uman ya de biev. Bifo Jekɔb mared wan pan dɛn, i go bɛtɛ mek a day.”
So Ayzak sɛn kɔl Jekɔb, i blɛs am, ɛn tɛl am se, “Nɔ mared nɔn pan dɛn Kenan gyal ya.
Bifo dat, go na Padan Aram, usay yu grampa Bɛthuɛl kɔmɔt ɛn mared wan pan yu ɔnkul Leban in gyal pikin dɛn.
Mek PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti blɛs yu ɛn gi yu bɔku pikin dɛn, so dat yu go bi papa fɔ plɛnti neshɔn.
Mek PAPA GƆD mek di blɛsin we i bin dɔn gi Ebraam fala yu ɛn yu gret grampikin dɛn, ɛn mek dis land we wi de so naw as trenja bi yu yon bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin dɔn gi Ebraam!”
Na so Ayzak tek mek Jekɔb go na Padan Aram, to in ɔnkul Leban, in mama in brɔda, we na Bɛthuɛl di Aramean in bɔypikin.
Isɔ gɛt fɔ no se Ayzak dɔn blɛs Jekɔb ɛn sɛn am go Padan Aram fɔ go fɛn wɛf de. Ɛn we i de blɛs am i tɛl am se lɛ i nɔ mared nɔn pan dɛn Kenan gyal dɛn.
Ɛn Jekɔb tek in mama ɛn papa dɛn wɔd ɛn go Padan Aram.
Isɔ kam no se in papa nɔ lɛk dɛn Kenan uman dɛn at ɔl.
So i go fɛn in ɔnkul Ishmɛl we na Ebraam in bɔypikin, ɛn mared in gyal pikin, Maalath ɛn ad pan di wɛf dɛn we i bin dɔn gɛt. Maalath na Nɛbayɔth in sista.
Jekɔb lɛf Biashiba fɔ go na Eran.
