I rich na wan ples as di san de go dɔŋ ɛn bil in tɛnt de. I fɛn wan ston we i tek mek pila ɛn lidɔm de fɔ slip.
We i de slip, i drim i si ay ay stɛp kɔmɔt na grɔn te rich ɔp na ɛvin, ɛn i si enjɛl dɛn de go ɔp ɛn dɔŋ di stɛp.
PAPA GƆD insɛf bin tinap nia am ɛn tɛl am se, “Mi na PAPA GƆD, Ebraam yu grampa, ɛn Ayzak, yu papa dɛn PAPA GƆD, A go gi yu ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn dis land usay yu lidɔm so.
Yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn go bɔku lɛkɛ dɔti na grɔn ɛn dɛn go de na di ist, wɛst, nɔth ɛn sawt. Na yu ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn go mek ɔl dɛn ɔda neshɔn gɛt dɛn blɛsin.
Mɛmba se, A go de wit yu ɛnisay yu go. A go gyad yu, ɛn briŋ yu kam bak na dis land. A nɔ go kɔmɔt biɛn yu sote a dɔn du ɔl wetin a dɔn prɔmis yu.”
Jekɔb skyad wek na di drim ɛn se, “So PAPA GƆD de na dis ples ɛn a nɔ no natin!”
I fred ɛn tɔk se, “Dis na wɔndaful ples, I mɔs bi se na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn dis na di get fɔ go ɛvin.”
Jekɔb grap ali mɔnin. I yuz di ston we i tek mek pila fɔ mak di ples we i bin lidɔm fɔ mek i nɔ go fɔgɛt de. I tɔn ɔliv ɔyl pan di ston.
I kɔl di ples Bɛthɛl, bɔt di siti bin nem Luz.
Na de Jekɔb prɔmis PAPA GƆD se “If PAPA GƆD de wit mi pan dis patrol we a de go so, if i gi mi tin fɔ it ɛn klos fɔ wɛr,
sote a tɔn bak wit wɛl bɔdi na mi papa in os, a go mek am misɛf yon PAPA GƆD.
A go yuz dis ples usay dis ston de so fɔ wɔship am. Ɛn a go gi am wan pan tɛn pat pan ɔl wetin i go gi mi.”
Jekɔb waka sote i rich na di istɛn pat na di kɔntri.
Na de i si wan wɛl na di fil ɛn bɔku ship dɛn na tri grup lidɔm rawnd am. Na da wɛl de dɛn ship kin drink wata, bɔt big big ston bin kɔba di wɛl.
Ɛnitɛm we ɔl di ship dɛn kam fɔ drink, di man dɛn we de mɛn di ship dɛn kin pul di ston kɔmɔt, ɛn we dɛn dɔn drink dɔn, dɛn kin put di ston bak.
Jekɔb aks di man dɛn we de mɛn di ship dɛn usay dɛn kɔmɔt. Dɛn ansa am se dɛn kɔmɔt na Eran.
Dɔn i aks dɛn if dɛn sabi Leban we na Neɔ in grampikin. Dɛn se, dɛn no am.
I aks dɛn, if i wɛl ɛn, dɛn ansa am se i wɛl. Dɔn dɛn pɔynt to wan uman we bin de kam wit ship dɛn. Dɛn se na Leban in gyal pikin Rechɛl dat.
Jekɔb se di san nɔ go dɔŋ yet ɛn i nɔ rich tɛm yet fɔ gɛda di ship dɛn. I se lɛ dɛn gi dɛn wata ɛn lɛf dɛn lɛ dɛn go it?
Bɔt dɛn se, dɛn nɔ go du dat pas ɔl di ɔda ship dɛn kam; dɔn dɛn go pul di ston kɔmɔt ɛn gi dɛn ɔl wata fɔ drink.
Jekɔb bin stil de tɔk to dɛn, we Rechɛl rich de wit in papa in ship dɛn, as nain bin de luk afta dɛn.
We Jekɔb si Rechɛl wit in ɔnkul Leban in ship dɛn, i go na di wɛl, pul di ston kɔmɔt ɛn gi wata to in ɔnkul in ship dɛn.
Dɔn i kis am ɛn bɔs kray bikɔs i gladi tumɔs.
I tɛl am se, in na Ribɛka in bɔypikin ɛn in na Leban in fambul. So Rechɛl rɔn go tɛl in papa.
We Leban yɛri di nyuz bɔt in sista in pikin Jekɔb se i kam, i rɔn go mit am, kis am, ɛn kɛr am go nain os. Dɔn Jekɔb tɛl Leban ɔl wetin dɔn apin.
We Leban yɛri Jekɔb in stori, i tɔk se, fɔ tru tru na mi yon blɔd dis. So Jekɔb bin tap de fɔ wan mɔnt.
Leban tɛl Jekɔb se, nɔto bikɔs in nain fambul mek i fɔ wok fɔ am fɔ natin. I aks am ɔmɔs i go want fɔ in pe.
Leban bin gɛt tu gyal pikin dɛn; Lia we na di big wan ɛn Rechɛl we na di smɔl wan.
Lia bin gɛt fayn yay bɔt Rechɛl in bin gɛt fayn shep ɛn i bin fayn fɔ luk.
Jekɔb bin dɔn fɔl fɔ Rechɛl, so i tɛl Leban se, in go wok sɛvin ia fɔ am, if i go gri fɔ mek i mared Rechɛl.
Leban ansa am se in nɔ go lɛf fɔ gi Rechɛl to am fɔ mared i gi am to ɔda pɔsin; so i tɛl Jekɔb fɔ tap na os wit am.
Jekɔb wok fɔ sɛvin ia fɔ Leban fɔ lɛ i go gɛt Rechɛl. Di tɛm bin tan to am lɛkɛ na tu-tri de nɔmɔ bikɔs i bin lɛk Rechɛl bad bad wan.
We di sɛvin ia dɔn, Jekɔb tɛl Leban fɔ gi am di uman fɔ mared bikɔs in dɔn wok fɔ am.
So Leban mek mared pati ɛn invayt ɔlman na di eria.
Bɔt da nɛt de, Leban kɛr Lia to Jekɔb, ɛn i slip wit am as wɛf,
dɔn i gi in yon savant-gyal Zilpa to Lia fɔ bi in nɔsi.
We do klin na da tɛm de Jekɔb si se na Lia i bin lidɔm wit. I go tret to Leban ɛn blez pan am. I aks am se, “Wetin mek yu du mi so? Nɔto Rechɛl a wok fɔ? Wetin mek yu ple mi dis kayn gem?
Leban ansa am se, nɔto dɛn kɔstɔm fɔ mek di smɔl wan mared bifo di big wan.
I tɛl am lɛ i wet lɛ di mared wik pas, dɛn i go gi am Rechɛl, if i prɔmis am se i go wok fɔ am fɔ sɛvin ia mɔ.”
Jekɔb gri, ɛn we di mared wik pas. Leban gi am Rechɛl fɔ bi in wɛf.
(Leban gi Bila in savant-gyal to Rechɛl fɔ bi in nɔsi.)
Jekɔb lidɔm wit Rechɛl insɛf, ɛn i bin lɛk am pas Lia. Dɔn i wok fɔ Leban fɔ sɛvin ia mɔ.
We PAPA GƆD si se Jekɔb nɔ bin lɛk Lia, i mek Lia gɛt pikin dɛn bɔt Rechɛl nɔ bin gɛt pikin.
Lia gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn i bɔn wan bɔypikin. I se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn si mi trɔbul, ɛn naw mi man go lɛk mi,” so i gi di pikin nem Rubɛn.
I gɛt bɛlɛ bak ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔypikin. I se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn yɛri se mi man nɔ lɛk mi na dat mek i gi mi ɔda pikin,” so i gi di pikin nem Simiɔn.
I gɛt bɛlɛ bak ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔypikin. I se, “Naw mi man go tay insɛf to mi, bikɔs a dɔn bɔn tri bɔypikin dɛn fɔ am;” na dat mek i gi di pikin nem Livay.
Dɔn i gɛt bɛlɛ bak ɛn i bɔn ɔda bɔypikin. I se, “Dis tɛm a go prez PAPA GƆD;” so i gi di pikin nem Juda. Afta dis wan ya, i tap fɔ bɔn.
We Rechɛl si se i nɔ de bɔn pikin fɔ Jekɔb, i bigin jɛlɔs in sista dɔn i tɛl Jekɔb se, “If yu nɔ mek a bɔn a go day.”
Jekɔb bin vɛks bad bad wan pan Rechɛl ɛn i se, “Mi na PAPA GƆD we mek yu nɔ gɛt pikin yet?”
Na de Rechɛl se, “Tek mi nɔsi Bila, lɛ i go bɔn pikin fɔ mi.”
So Rechɛl gi Bila to Jekɔb fɔ tek mek wɛf.
Bila gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn bɔypikin fɔ Jekɔb.
Nain Rechɛl se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk fɔ mi. I yɛri mi prea ɛn i gi misɛf bɔypikin” I gi am nem Dan.
Bila gɛt bɛlɛ bak ɛn bɔn bɔypikin fɔ Jekɔb.
Rechɛl se, “Mi ɛn mi sista dɔn fɛt traŋa traŋa wan, ɛn a dɔn win am;” so i gi di pikin nem Naftali
We Lia kechɔp se i dɔn lɛf fɔ bɔn, i gi in nɔsi Zilpa to Jekɔb fɔ tek mek wɛf.
Zilpa insɛf bɔn bɔypikin fɔ Jekɔb.
Lia se, “A gɛt lɔk o” so i gi di pikin nem Gad.
Zilpa bɔn ɔda bɔypikin fɔ Jekɔb,
ɛn Lia se, “A gladi bad bad wan; ɔl dɛn uman go ɛp mi gladi;” ɛn i gi di pikin nem Asha.
We di tɛm rich fɔ avɛst wit, Rubɛn go na di fam fɔ fɛn mandrek ɛn briŋ sɔm kam fɔ in mama Lia. Rechɛl beg Lia fɔ gi am sɔm pan in pikin in mandrek.

Nain Lia ansa se, “Yu dɔn tek mi man dat nɔ du fɔ yu? Dɔn naw yu de tray fɔ tek mi bɔypikin in mandrek dɛn?” Rechɛl se, “A go mek Jekɔb slip to yu dis nɛt if yu mek yu pikin gi mi sɔm pan in mandrek dɛn.”
We Jekɔb kɔmɔt na di fam da ivin tɛm de, Lia rɔn go na do go mit am ɛn tɛl am se, “Na mi yu de slip to dis nɛt, bikɔs a dɔn bay yu wit mi pikin in mandrek dɛn.” So Jekɔb slip to am da nɛt de.
PAPA GƆD ansa Lia in prea ɛn mek i gɛt ɔda bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn in nɔmba fayv bɔypikin fɔ Jekɔb.
Lia se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn gi mi bunya bikɔs a gi mi nɔsi to mi man;” ɛn i gi di pikin nem Isaka.
Lia gɛt bɛlɛ bak ɛn i bin bɔn in nɔmba siks bɔypikin fɔ Jekɔb, i gi di pikin nem Zɛbyulɔn.
I kɔl am Zɛbyulɔn bikɔs i se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn gi mi fayn prɛzɛnt. Ɛn naw mi man go lɛk mi bikɔs a dɔn bɔn siks bɔypikin dɛn fɔ am.
I nɔ tu te igen i gɛt bɛlɛ bak ɛn bɔn wan gyal pikin, we i gi nem Dayna.
Dɔn PAPA GƆD sɔri fɔ Rechɛl. I ansa in prea ɛn mek i ebul fɔ gɛt pikin dɛn.
I gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn bɔypikin. I se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn pul disgres pan mi we i gi mi bɔypikin.”
I gi di pikin nem Josɛf ɛn tɔk se lɛ PAPA GƆD gi am ɔda bɔypikin.
Afta we Rechɛl dɔn bɔn Josɛf, Jekɔb tɛl Leban se in want fɔ tɔn bak go nain om.
So lɛ i gi am in wɛf dɛn we dɔn wok fɔ gɛt fɔ lɛ i go wit di pikin dɛn. I se Leban no wetin i dɔn bɛnifit frɔm in wok.
Leban beg am se, lɛ i nɔ lɛf am. I se in dɔn go luk grɔn ɛn dɛn tɛl am se na fɔseka am mek PAPA GƆD dɔn blɛs am.
Ɛn i aks Jekɔb ɔmɔs i go want fɔ in pe fɔ mek i go kɔntinyu fɔ wok fɔ am.
Jekɔb ansa am se in di Leban, no aw i dɔn wok fɔ am ɛn aw in animal dɛn dɔn bɔku we i de mɛn dɛn.
I se, di smɔl wan we Leban bin gɛt dɔn plɛnti tumɔs, ɛn na bikɔs ɔf in di Jekɔb mek PAPA GƆD de blɛs am mɔ ɛn mɔ so ustɛm in go provayd fɔ in yon famili
Leban aks am se ɔmɔs in fɔ pe am. Jekɔb tɛl am se lɛ i nɔ pe am fɔ di wok we i dɔn du. Bɔt i se wetin i want am fɔ du fɔ mek i go kɔntinyu fɔ mɛn in animal dɛn,
na fɔ mek i luk rawnd ɔl in animal dɛn da sem de de ɛn tek fɔ insɛf ɔl di blak ship pikin dɛn ɛn ɔl di got ɛn ship dɛn we gɛt mak pan dɛn. Na dɛn wan dɛn de go bi in pe.
I se if Leban want fɔ no ɛnitɛm if i de waka tret wit am, i fɔ kam luk di animal dɛn we i dɔn tek fɔ in pe. If i si ɛni got ɔ ship we nɔ gɛt mak ɔ we nɔ blak, da tɛm de i go no se i dɔn tif am.
Leban gri wit wetin Jekɔb se.
Bɔt da de de, Leban pul ɔl di man got dɛn we gɛt mak we nɔto bin piɔ wayt ɛn ɔl di uman got dɛn we nɔto bin piɔ wayt we gɛt spɔt ɛn mak. I pul ɔl di blak ship dɛnsɛf. I gi in bɔypikin dɛn fɔ mɛn dɛn.
Dɛn kɔmɔt nia Jekɔb ɛn go na wan ples we na tri de i go tek fɔ rich de. Bɔt Jekɔb bin kɔntinyu fɔ mɛn Leban in animal dɛn we lɛf.

Jekɔb kɔt frɛsh branch kɔmɔt pan sɔm tik dɛn. Ɛn dɛn tik dɛn ya na bin di pɔpyula tik, almɔn tik ɛn wan ɔda wan tik we na plen tik. Dɔn i pil sɔm di kanda kɔmɔt pan di tik dɛn we mek di insay pat we na wayt bin de sho.
I put dɛn tik ya na di say we di ship ɛn got dɛn kin go drink wata, bikɔs wɛn dɛn go drink wata, nain dɛn kin mek lɔv.
Di wan dɛn we kin gɛt bɛlɛ bifo dɛn tik ya, kin bɔn soso blak ɛn wayt ship ɛn got dɛn.

Jekɔb kin pul di uman ship ɛn got dɛn ɛn put dɛn wan say dɔn i kin mek dɛn tinap luk Leban in yon dɛn we nɔto we piɔ dɛn want mek lɔv wayt ɔ piɔ blak so wɛn ɛn dɛn kin bɔn pikin di pikin dɛn nɔba gɛt wangren kɔla. Na so Jekɔb tek gɛt in yon ship ɛn got dɛn.
We di fayn ɛn trɔŋ uman animal dɛn kin want man, Jekɔb kin put di grin ɛn wayt tik dɛn na di wata usay dɛn de drink so dat dɛn go mek lɔv frɔnt di tik dɛn.
Bɔt i nɔba put di tik dɛn bifo di wik wik animal dɛn. Na so Leban tek get ɔl di wik animal dɛn, ɛn Jekɔb in bin gɛt di fayn ɛn trɔŋ wan dɛn.
Jekɔb du so, te ɛn gɛt bɔku ship, got. I jɛntri ɛn gɛt bɔku slev, kamɛl ɛn dɔŋki dɛn.
Jekɔb yɛri se Leban in pikin dɛn de tɔk se in dɔn tek ɔl wetin dɛn papa gɛt, na dat mek i dɔn jɛntri.
Jekɔb notis se Leban no de biev to am lɛkɛ aw i bin de du bifo.
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl Jekɔb se, “Go bak to yu fambul dɛn na da kɔntri we yu papa dɛn kɔmɔt. A go de wit yu.”
Na de Jekɔb sɛn wɔd to Rechɛl ɛn Lia fɔ mit am na di fil usay in ship ɛn got dɛn de.
Wɛn dɛn kam i tɛl dɛn se in notis se dɛn papa in atityud nɔ tan lɛkɛ aw i bin bi. Bɔt in papa in PAPA GƆD dɔn de wit am.
I se dɛn no se in dɔn wok fɔ dɛn papa traŋa traŋa wan.
Bɔt pan ɔl dat i rog am tɛn difrɛn tɛm we i de pe am, bɔt PAPA GƆD mek i nɔ ebul du am ɛnitin we bad pas dat.

I se ɛnitɛm we dɛn papa tɔk se ɔl di wan dɛn we gɛt spɔt nain pe, ɔl di ship ɛn got dɛn kin bɔn pikin we gɛt spɔt, dɔn ɛnitɛm i se dɛn wan we gɛt blak ɛn wayt layn dɛn nain pe, dɛn ɔl kin bɔn pikin we gɛt blak ɛn wayt layn dɛn.
Ɛn na so PAPA GƆD tek dɛn papa in ship ɛn got dɛn, ɛn gi dɛn to am.

I se we di tɛm kam we di ship ɛn got dɛn kin mek lɔv, in bin drim. Pan dis drim i es in ed ɔp ɛn si se di rangot dɛn de mek lɔv wit di ship ɛn got dɛn we gɛt layn layn ɔ blak spɔt ɛn wayt spɔt ɛn gi dɛn bɛlɛ.
I se PAPA GƆD in enjɛl kɔl am na di drim se “Jekɔb!” Ɛn in bin ansa se, “Luk mi.”
Nain di enjɛl tɛl am se, mek in es in ed ɔp, opin in yay ɛn luk; ɔl di rangot dɛn dɔn gi di got ɛn ship dɛn we gɛt layn, ɛn spɔt bɛlɛ bikɔs in bin dɔn si ɔl wetin Leban dɔn de du in.
I se in na di sem PAPA GƆD we a bin mit na Bɛthɛl, usay a bin mek ston pila ɛn put ɔyl pan, dɔn a mek prɔmis to am. I se mek a kɔmɔt na dis ples ɛn go bak na di kɔntri we a bɔn.
Rechɛl ɛn Lia ansa am se, “Dat nɔ bad, wi nɔ gɛt fɔ gɛt natin pan wi papa in prɔpati.
Infakt i de luk wi lɛkɛ trenja? I dɔn sɛl wi, ɛn i dɔn pwɛl ɔl di mɔni we dɛn tek bay wi.
Ɔl di prɔpati we PAPA GƆD dɔn pul na wi papa in an dɔn blant wi ɛn wi pikin dɛn so du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl yu fɔ du.”
Jekɔb tek in pikin dɛn ɛn in wɛf dɛn ɛn put dɛn pantap kamɛl fɔ go.
I gɛda ɔl in animal dɛn we i bin dɔn gɛt na Padan Aram ɛn sɛn dɛn go bifo. Dɔn i ol rod fɔ go bak to in papa Ayzak we de na Kenan,
da tɛm de Leban bin dɔn go fɔ kɔt in ship dɛn ia. Bifo dɛn lɛf, Rechɛl bin dɔn tif in papa in gɔd dɛn we bin de nain os ɛn go wit dɛn.
Jekɔb rɔnawe na Leban da Aramean in ples ɛn nɔ tɛl am natin.
I rɔnawe wit ɔl in prɔpati dɛn. I krɔs riva Yufretis, ɛn chuk ed fɔ go na Giliad.
Na afta tri de Leban no se Jekɔb dɔn rɔnawe.
Leban tek in man dɛn ɛn rɔnata Jekɔb. I tek sɛvin de bifo dɛn ebul mit am ɛn na Giliad we de ɔp il dɛn kech am.
PAPA GƆD apia to Leban na drim ɛn se, “Bikiaful aw yu de tɔk to Jekɔb.”
Wɛn Leban rich usay Jekɔb bin dɔn bil in tɛnt na Giliad, in sɛf bil in tɛnt nia usay Jekɔb in yon tɛnt de, na di say we gɛt il usay in ɛn in fambul dɛn bin tap.
Leban aks Jekɔb wetin mek i rog am ɛn rɔnawe wit in gyal pikin dɛn go lɛkɛ dɛn wan dɛn we dɛn kapchɔ.
I aks bak wetin mek i jɛs lɛf am ɛn nɔ se natin to am. I se dɛn bin fɔ mek pati fɔ am ɛn dɛn bin fɔ siŋ ɛn dans, bit tamborin ɛn ple ap.
I se Jekɔb nɔ mek i kis in gyal pikin dɛn ɛn in grampikin dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn gudbay. Ɛn dis mek i tɔk se Jekɔb biev lɛkɛ fulman.
I se in ebul fɔ dil wit am bɔt na we Jekɔb in papa in PAPA GƆD bin tɛl am na drim yɛstade nɛt se, mek i bikiaful wit wetin i de tɔk to am.
I se in no se Jekɔb want fɔ go naw bikɔs in at dɔn grap fɔ go nain papa in os, bɔt wetin mek i tif in gɔd dɛn.
Nain Jekɔb ansa se in rɔnawe bikɔs i de fred se i go tek in gyal pikin dɛn nain an bay fos.

I se in nɔ tek in gɔd dɛn, ɛn ɛnibɔdi we i fɛn in gɔd dɛn to fɔ day. I swɛ bifo ɔl in fambul dɛn se ɛnitin we Leban fɛn we nain yon pan in prɔpati lɛ i tek dɛn. Bɔt Jekɔb nɔ bin no se Rechɛl bin tif in papa in gɔd dɛn.
Fɔs, Leban go luk insay Jekɔb in tɛnt, dɛn i go na Lia in tɛnt. Afta dat, I go insay di tu slev-uman dɛn tɛnt, bɔt i nɔ fɛn natin. Na Rechɛl in tɛnt las i go.
Rechɛl bin dɔn tek dɛn gɔd ya ayd dɛn insay di bag we kin ɛŋ pan di kamɛl, ɛn sidɔm pan am. So Leban luk ɔlɔbɔt na di tɛnt bɔt i nɔ ebul fɛn dɛn.
Nain Rechɛl tɛl am se lɛ i nɔ vɛks pan am we a nɔ ebul grap, bikɔs i de si in piriɔd. So in papa luk ɔlɔbɔt bɔt i nɔ ebul fɛn dɛn.
Dat mek Jekɔb vɛks bad. I aks Leban se, “Wetin yu fɛn? Wetin a du yu we mek yu de rɔnata mi?
Luk we yu dɔn tɔnoba ɔl mi tiŋs dɛn, wetin yu fɛn we na yu yon? Briŋ am kam ɛn put am bifo yu fambul dɛn ɛn mi yon, ɛn mek dɛn jɔj bitwin mi ɛn yu.
Fɔ di twɛnti ia we a dɔn wok fɔ yu, natin nɔ du yu uman ship ɛn got dɛn; dɛn de bɔn fayn fayn; ɛn a nɔ wande it pan yu rangot dɛn.
Dɛn wan sɛf we wayl animal kin kil, a nɔ wande kɛr dɛn go sho yu; a kin bia di lɔsis. Yu mek a pe fɔ ɛniwan pan yu got ɔ ship we dɛn tif, wɛda na nɛt ɔ na santɛm dɛn tif dɛn.
Na so san kin de bɔn mi ɛn kol de mɔna mi, dɔn a nɔba ebul slip na nɛt, ɔl dis na fɔseka yu.
A de na yu os fɔ twɛnti ia. Fotin ia a bin de wok fɔ gɛt yu tu gyal pikin dɛn. Siks ia a de mɛn yu got ɛn ship dɛn, ɛn na tɛn tɛm yu kɔt mi pe.

If nɔto fɔ PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD we na mi papa in PAPA GƆD, ɛn Ebraam insɛf yon PAPA GƆD, we Ayzak de fred, a no se yu bin fɔ dɔn drɛb mi ɛn nɔ gi mi natin. PAPA GƆD insɛf si se a dɔn sɔfa ɛn a dɔn wok fɔ yu, nain mek i apia to yu yɛstade nɛt ɛn wɔn yu fɔ kɔmɔt biɛn mi.”
Leban ansa Jekɔb se, “Di uman dɛn na mi yon, dɛn pikin dɛn na mi pikin dɛn, di got ɛn ship ɛn ɔl wetin yu gɛt naw, ɔl na mi yon. Bɔt wetin a go du to mi yon yon flɛsh ɛn blɔd?
Kam lɛ wi tay bagin, we go de bitwin mi ɛn yu.”
So Jekɔb tek wan ston ɛn put am fɔ tinap tret wan fɔ mɛmba dis bagin ya.
Dɔn i tɛl in fambul dɛn fɔ gɛda ston rawnd da ston de. Dɛn bin tek dɛn ston ya ɛn payl dɛn ɔp; ɛn na nia dis payl ya dɛn it.
Leban kɔl de Jɛga Saadutha, bɔt Jekɔb kɔl am Galid.
Leban se, “Lɛ dis payl bi witnɛs fɔ mi ɛn yu tide fɔ mɛmba wi bɔt dis bagin. Na dat mek di ples nem Galid.”
Na dis sem ples i kɔl Mizpa, i se, “Mek PAPA GƆD in yay de pan wi tu so dat ivin we wi nɔ de togɛda, wi go stil de mɛmba dis bagin ya.
If yu want du mi gyal pikin dɛn bad ɔ yu mared ɔda uman dɛn, mɛmba se PAPA GƆD de si yu, ɛn na witnɛs bitwin mi ɛn yu.”
Leban tɛl Jekɔb se, “Yu si dis ston payl ɛn pila,
dɛn tu na witnɛs, ɛn nɔn pan wi nɔ fɔ krɔs de fɔ go ambɔg in kɔmpin.
Mek Ebraam in PAPA GƆD, we na Neɔ insɛf yon PAPA GƆD ɛn dɛn papa dɛn PAPA GƆD jɔj bitwin mi ɛn yu.” Jekɔb insɛf swɛ to in papa Ayzak in PAPA GƆD se i gri.
Jekɔb mek animal sakrifays to PAPA GƆD ɛn kɔl ɔl in fambul dɛn fɔ kam it; we dɛn dɔn it dɔn dɛn slip de da nɛt de.
We do klin Leban grap, i kis in gyal pikin dɛn ɛn in grampikin dɛn ɛn blɛs dɛn; dɔn i lɛf dɛn ɛn tɔn bak go nain yon os.
We Jekɔb bin de na rod de go, in ɛn sɔm pan PAPA GƆD in enjɛl dɛn mitɔp.
As i si dɛn so, i se, “Dis na PAPA GƆD in Kamp” so i kɔl di ples Maanaim.
Jekɔb sɛn mɛsenja dɛn to in brɔda Isɔ na di Sɛir eria insay Idɔm.
I tɛl dɛn fɔ tɛl mista Isɔ se in bɔbɔ Jekɔb de tɛl am adu. I se mek dɛn tɛl am se i bin tap to Leban ɛn na de i bin de te i de tɔn bak so.
I se i gɛt kaw, dɔŋki, ship, ɛn slev dɛn ɛn i de sɛn wɔd to am, mek i no se i de kam ɛn abop se i go gladi fɔ si am.
We di mɛsenja dɛn kam bak to Jekɔb, dɛn tɛl am se, dɛn mit in brɔda Isɔ de na rod de kam mit am wit fo ɔndrɛd man dɛn.
We Jekɔb yɛri dis i bin fred so i sheb di pipul dɛn we bin de wit am wit in ship, got, kaw ɛn kamɛl dɛnsɛf to tu say.
Dɔn i tɔk nain at se, “If Isɔ kam atak wan grup, di ɔda grup go rɔnawe.”
Dɔn Jekɔb pre se, “PAPA GƆD, we na mi grampa Ebraam ɛn mi papa Ayzak dɛn PAPA GƆD, yu bin dɔn tɛl mi se a fɔ go bak na mi kɔntri ɛn to mi fambul dɛn, ɛn yu go mek ɔltin fayn fɔ mi.

A nɔ fit fɔ gɛt ɔl di gudnɛs ɛn di fethfulnɛs we yu de sho mi we na yu savant. Di tɛm we a bin de go, a krɔs Riva Jɔdan wit natin pas wɔkinstik, bɔt naw a dɔn kam bak wit ɔl dɛn bɔku pipul ya so we a dɔn sheb to tu grup.
A de pre duya, nɔ mek mi brɔda Isɔ du mi ɛnitin bad. A de fred se i de kam fɔ kil mi wit mi wɛf ɛn pikin dɛn.
Yu bin dɔn se yu go mek ɔltin fayn fɔ mi ɛn yu go mek mi jɛnareshɔn bɔku lɛkɛ sansan na bich we nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul fɔ kɔnt.”
Jekɔb slip da nɛt de ɛn we do klin i tek sɔm pan di animal dɛn we i gɛt, fɔ go gi Isɔ as prɛzɛnt.
I tek tu ɔndrɛd uman got, twɛnti man got, tu ɔndrɛd uman ship, twɛnti man ship,
tati uman kamɛl wit dɛn pikin dɛn, fɔti uman kaw, tɛn man kaw, twɛnti uman dɔŋki ɛn tɛn man dɔŋki dɛn.
I mek di wokman dɛn waka bifo am wit dɛn animal ya, bɔt i lɛf spes bitwin di grup dɛn.
I tɛl di wokman we de bifo se, if in brɔda Isɔ mit am na rod ɛn aks am udat nain masta, usay i de go ɛn udat gɛt dɛn animal ya we de wit am so,
i fɔ ansa am se, “Nain bɔbɔ Jekɔb gɛt dɛn. I se fɔ briŋ dɛn kam to in brɔda mista Isɔ fɔ prɛzɛnt, ɛn insɛf de biɛn dɛn de kam.”
Jekɔb tɛl ɔl in wokman dɛn na di difrɛn grup di sem tin. I se, dɛn ɔl fɔ gi mista Isɔ di sem mɛsej we dɛn mit am.
I wɔn dɛn bak se dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn tɛl Isɔ se in bɔbɔ Jekɔb de biɛn de kam. Jekɔb du so bikɔs i bin de op se we Isɔ si di prɛzɛnt dɛn in at go kol bifo dɛn tu mit. I se sɔntɛm Isɔ go gladi fɔ mi.
I sɛn di prɛzɛnt dɛn go bifo bɔt insɛf bin lɛf na di kamp da nɛt de.
Da sem nɛt de Jekɔb grap, tek in tu wɛf, di tu savant-gyal dɛn ɛn in ilɛvin bɔypikin dɛn dɔn dɛn krɔs Riva Jabɔk.
Wɛn dɛn dɔn krɔs go oba, i sɛn ɔl in prɔpati go mit dɛn.
In wangren bin lɛf biɛn ɛn wan man fɛt am te do klin.
We di man si se i nɔ ebul win di fɛt, i wap Jekɔb nain wesbon, ɛn mek di bon shift.
Di man tɛl Jekɔb lɛ i lɛf am fɔ go bikɔs do dɔn klin. Jekɔb ansa am se in nɔ go lɛf am, pas i blɛs am.
Di man aks am wetin i nem I ansa se nem Jekɔb.
Nain di man tɛl am se in nɔ go nem Jekɔb igen In nem naw na Izrɛl bikɔs i dɔn chalenj wit PAPA GƆD ɛn mɔtalman, ɛn i dɔn win.
Nain Jekɔb aks di man, wetin nain yon nem Bɔt di man aks am wetin mek i want fɔ no in yon nem. Dɔn i blɛs Jekɔb de.
Jekɔb gi di ples nem Pɛniɛl, bikɔs i se, in dɔn si PAPA GƆD fes to fes ɛn i nɔ day.
Di san bin jɛs de kɔmɔt we Jekɔb bin de lɛf Pɛniɛl, ɛn i nɔ bin de waka tret bikɔs ɔf in wesbon.
Na dat mek te tide, di Izrɛlayt dɛn nɔ de it di bif we de na di wesbon, bikɔs na da say de di man bin wap Jekɔb.
As Jekɔb de go so, i si Isɔ de kam wit di fo ɔndrɛd amiman dɛn, so i mek Lia, Rechɛl ɛn di tu savant-gyal dɛn ɔl ol dɛn yon pikin dɛn.
I put di savant-gyal dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn fɔ lid, dɛn nɛks na Lia ɛn in pikin dɛn, ɛn las na Rechɛl ɛn Josɛf.
Jekɔb in go bifo. As i de rich nia Isɔ so i baw bifo am sɛvin tɛm.
Isɔ rɔn go mit am, grip am ɛn kis am. Dɛn ɔl tu bɔs kray.
We Isɔ luk rawnd ɛn si di uman dɛn ɛn di pikin dɛn, i aks Jekɔb udat na ɔl dɛn pipul dɛn ya we de wit am. Jekɔb ansa am dɛn se na di pikin dɛn we PAPA GƆD blɛs am wit.
Di uman dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn kam baw bifo Isɔ. Fɔs na di savant-gyal dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn,
dɔn Lia ɛn in yon pikin dɛn, dɔn Rechɛl ɛn Josɛf.
Isɔ aks Jekɔb wetin ɔl dɛn animal we i mit na rod min. Jekɔb ansa am se dɛn na prɛzɛnt fɔ mek in at go kol
Bɔt Isɔ tɛl Jekɔb se in gɛt bɔku lɛ i kip wetin i gɛt.
Jekɔb beg am se nɔ, if in at dɔn kol ɛn if i gladi fɔ am bak, lɛ i tek di prɛzɛnt dɛn. I se we in dɔn si Isɔ in fes bak i tan lɛkɛ na PAPA GƆD in fes i dɔn si; nɔ lɛkɛ we i dɔn lus bɔdi to am.
I beg am lɛ i tek di prɛzɛnt dɛn bikɔs i se PAPA GƆD nɔ gridi am ɛn i dɔn gi am ɔl wetin i want. Jekɔb koks Isɔ sote i gri fɔ tek di prɛzɛnt dɛn.
So Isɔ tɛl am se lɛ dɛn de go ɛn in go de bifo.
Bɔt Jekɔb ansa am se i si se di pikin dɛn smɔl smɔl, ɛn dɛn uman ship ɛn kaw dɛnsɛf gɛt yɔŋ wan dɛn fɔ fid. If dɛn waka tumɔs fɔ wanol de, dɛn ɔl go day.
So, i beg am se lɛ in di Isɔ de bifo, dɛn go de biɛn am. Dɛn go tek dɛn tɛm waka bɔt dɛn go mit am na Sɛir.
Na de Isɔ se if na so, mek i lɛf sɔm pan in man dɛn fɔ am. Jekɔb ansa se i nɔ nid fɔ du ɔl dat, wans i dɔn sho se i dɔn sɔri fɔ am
So Isɔ lɛf da sem de de fɔ go bak na Sɛir.
Bɔt Jekɔb ɛn in pipul dɛn go na Sɔkɔt, usay i bin bil os fɔ insɛf ɛn mek ples fɔ in animal dɛn fɔ de. Na dat mek dɛn kɔl di ples Sɔkɔt.
Jekɔb ɛn in famili rich sef wan na Shɛkɛm, we na wan big siti na Kenan dɔn i bil in tɛnt nia di big siti.
I bin bay di grɔn to Amɔ in famili fɔ wan ɔndrɛd silva kɔpɔ we i bil in tɛnt. Amɔ na bin Shɛkɛm in papa.
I bil ɔlta de ɛn kɔl am Ɛl-Ɛloe-Izrɛl.
Wande Dayna, Jekɔb in gyal pikin we Lia bɔn, go waka to sɔm uman dɛn na di eria.
Bɔt we Shɛkɛm si am i kech am ɛn rep am. Shɛkɛm na Amɔ, da Itayt chif in bɔypikin.
Shɛkɛm bin lɛk Dayna bad bad wan so i fɔl fɔ am, ɛn i bin de koks am fɔ mek dɛn tu de.
I ivin tɛl in papa Amɔ se, mek i fɛn di gyal fɔ am bikɔs i want mared am.
We Jekɔb yɛri se dɛn dɔn tampa wit in gyal pikin, bɔt, nɔ du natin bikɔs in bɔypikin dɛn nɔ bin de. Dɛn bin de mɛn dɛn animal dɛn na fil. I bin de wet te dɛn kam.
Amɔ we na Shɛkɛm in papa, go to Jekɔb, fɔ go tɔk wit am.

As i de rich de so, Jekɔb in bɔypikin dɛn de kɔmɔt na di fil kam bak. We dɛn yɛri wetin apin, dɛn fil bad ɛn vɛks bad bad wan fɔseka we Shɛkɛm tampa wit dɛn sista. Na disgres fɔ mek Shɛkɛm fityay Izrɛl pipul dɛn da we de ɛn rep Jekɔb in gyal pikin we na tin dat we nɔ fɔ bi.
Amɔ tɛl Jekɔb ɛn i bɔypikin dɛn se in bɔypikin Shɛkɛm lɛk Jekɔb in gyal pikin bad bad wan ɛn want fɔ mared am.
I se, Jekɔb fɔ mek in gyal pikin dɛn mared to dɛn bɔypikin dɛn, ɛn dɛnsɛf go mek dɛn yon bɔypikin dɛn mared Jekɔb in yon gyal pikin dɛn.
Dɔn dɛn kin tap ɛnisay we dɛn want na di kɔntri ɛn tredin fri wan, ɛn gɛt prɔpati.
Shɛkɛm bin de de wit in papa, so i beg Daynain papa ɛn in brɔda dɛn fɔ mek i mared Dayna. I se i go gi dɛn ɛnitin we dɛn want.
I aks dɛn fɔ tɛl am wetin dɛn want, ɛn se dɛn kin mek i pe dia wan sɛf. I se in go gi dɛn ɛnitin we dɛn aks fɔ, wans nɔmɔ in mared am.
Jekɔb in bɔypikin dɛn ple gem pan Shɛkɛm ɛn Amɔ fɔ we Shɛkɛm bin dɔn tampa wit dɛn sista.
Dɛn tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ go gri mek dɛn sista mared to man we nɔ sakɔmsayz bikɔs dat na disgres to dɛn.
Dɛn se dɛn go gri if ɔl di man dɛn gri fɔ sakɔmsayz lɛkɛ dɛn.
Da tɛm de dɛn go gri fɔ mek dɛn yon pipul dɛn ɛn Amɔ in yon pipul dɛn mared. Dɛn se dɛn go tap na di siti ɛn dɛn ɔl go bi wan pipul.
Bɔt if dɛn nɔ gri to wetin dɛn se ɛn sakɔmsayz dɛn go tek dɛn sista go usay dɛn de go.
Amɔ ɛn in pikin Shɛkɛm bin gladi fɔ wetin Daynain brɔda dɛn se,
so Shɛkɛm nɔ westɛm fɔ du wetin dɛn se, bikɔs i bin want Dayna bad bad wan. Shɛkɛm na bin impɔtant pɔsin nain fambul.
Amɔ ɛn in bɔypikin Shɛkɛm dɛn go tɛl dɛn kɔntriman dɛn wetin Jekɔb in bɔypikin dɛn se.
Dɛn se Jekɔb ɛn in pikin dɛn na dɛn padi dɛn; mek dɛn tap wit dɛn ɛn mek dɛn tredin fri wan. Di land big fɔ mek dɛnsɛf tap de. Lɛ dɛn mared dɛn gyal pikin dɛn ɛn mek dɛnsɛf mared dɛnsɛf yon dɛn.
Bɔt Jekɔb ɛn in pikin dɛn go gri fɔ tap wit dɛn ɛn bi wan pipul wit dɛn if nɔmɔ ɔl di man dɛn gri fɔ sakɔmsayz, lɛkɛ dɛn.
I se dɛn animal dɛn ɛn ɔl wetin dɛn gɛt go bi dɛn yon. So dɛn koks dɛn kɔmpin dɛn fɔ mek dɛn gri fɔ mek dɛn tap wit dɛn.
Ɔl di pipul dɛn gri wit wetin Amɔ ɛn Shɛkɛm se, ɛn ɔl di man dɛn bin sakɔmsayz.
Afta tri de, we di man dɛn wund bin rɔ ɛn dɛn stil de fil pen, Simiɔn ɛn Livay, we na Daynain brɔda dɛn, tek sɔd ɛn go insay di siti. Nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul tap dɛn so dɛn kil ɔl di man dɛn.
Dɛn kil Amɔ ɛn in bɔypikin Shɛkɛm, dɔn dɛn pul Dayna kɔmɔt na Shɛkɛm in os ɛn tek am go.
We dis dɔn bi, Jekɔb in ɔda bɔypikin dɛn go insay di siti ɛn lut bikɔs na de dɛn bin tampa wit dɛn sista.
Dɛn tek ɔl di animal dɛn, di dɔŋki dɛn, ɛn ɔl wetin de na di siti, ɛn di tin dɛn we de na di fam dɛn.
Dɛn tek ɔltin we valyu, abdɔkt ɔl di uman ɛn pikin dɛn, ɛn kɛr ɔltin go.

Jekɔb tɛl Simiɔn ɛn Livay se dɛn dɔn put am pan waala. I se di Kenanayt dɛn, di Pɛrizayt dɛn, ɛn ɔlman we de na di kɔntri nɔ go luk am wit bɛtɛ yay. I se dɛn nɔ bɔku ɛn if di pipul dɛn disayd fɔ fɛt dɛn, dɛn go dɔnawe wit dɛn.
Bɔt dɛn ansa wit vɛksteshɔn se if Shɛkɛm fɔ trit dɛn sista lɛkɛ rare gyal.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Jekɔb se, “Go na Bɛthɛl ɛn go tap de. Bil ɔlta de fɔ wɔship mi we na di PAPA GƆD we bin apia to yu di tɛm we yu bin de rɔnawe pan yu brɔda Isɔ.”
So Jekɔb tɛl ɔl dɛn wan we de nain os fɔ trowe ɔl dɛn tin we dɛn kin de wɔship, fɔ was ɛn wɛr klin klos.
I se dɛn de kɔmɔt usay dɛn de so fɔ de go Bɛthɛl, usay in de go bil ɔlta fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD we bin ɛp am di tɛm we i bin de pan trɔbul ɛn we dɔn de wit am ɔlsay we i bin de go.
So dɛn gi Jekɔb ɔl dɛn tin dɛn we dɛn bin de wɔship ɛn dɛn yerin dɛn ɛn i bɛr dɛn ɔnda wan big Ok tik nia Shɛkɛm.
We Jekɔb ɛn i bɔypikin dɛn bin lɛf fɔ go, PAPA GƆD mek di pipul dɛn we bin de na di ɔda siti dɛn fred, so dɛn nɔ bin atak dɛn.
Jekɔb go wit ɔl in pipul dɛn na Luz, we naw nem Bɛthɛl, na Kenan.
I bil ɔlta de ɛn gi di ples nem Ɛl-Bɛthɛl, bikɔs na de PAPA GƆD bin apia to am di tɛm we i bin de rɔnawe pan in brɔda.
Afta dis, Ribɛka in fɔs nɔs Dɛbora day ɛn dɛn bɛr am ɔnda wan ok tik dɔŋ say na Bɛthɛl. Fɔseka dis bɛrin dɛn gi di ok tik nem Alɔn Bakuth
PAPA GƆD apia to Jekɔb bak na Bɛthɛl we i kɔmɔt Mɛsopotemia ɛn blɛs am.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, i nɔ go nem Jekɔb igen, bɔt frɔm da de de in nem na Izrɛl. So PAPA GƆD gi am nem Izrɛl.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, “Mi na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti. Bɔn bɔku bɔku pikin we go de ɔlsay na di wɔl. Yu go bi papa fɔ bɔku dɛn neshɔn dɛn, kiŋ dɛn go de insay yu jɛnareshɔn.
A go gi yu di land we a bin gi Ebraam ɛn Ayzak, ɛn a go gi am to yu ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn.”
So PAPA GƆD lɛf am na di ples usay i bin de tɔk to am.
We PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk to am dɔn, Jekɔb bil ston pila de fɔ mak de, ɛn tɔn ɔyl ɛn wayn pan am we i tek mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD.
I gi di ples nem “Bɛthɛl.”
Jekɔb ɛn in fambul dɛn kɔmɔt na Bɛthɛl, bɔt dɛn bin de fawe lilibit fɔ rich na Ɛfrat. We di tɛm rich fɔ mek Rechɛl bɔn in pikin, di pen bin traŋa fɔ am.
We i de pan dis pen, di uman we bin de ɛp am fɔ bɔn tɛl am se, lɛ i nɔ fred, na ɔda bɔypikin i de bɔn.
Bɔt i bin de day, so bifo i blo in las blo, i gi in bɔypikin nem Bɛnonay, bɔt in papa in gi am nem Bɛnjamin.
We Rechɛl day, dɛn bɛr am na di rod fɔ go na Ɛfrat, we nem Bɛtliɛm naw.
Jekɔb put ston fɔ mɛmba de. Di mak stil de na Rechɛl in grev te tide.
Izrɛl muf go bifo say ɛn put in tɛnt na wan ɔda say afta di tawa we nem Ɛda.
We Izrɛl bin de na da kɔntri de, Rubɛn go gɛt biznɛs wit Bila, wan pan in papa in ɔda uman dɛn we bɔn fɔ in papa ɛn Jekɔb bin gɛt fɔ no bɔt dat. Jekɔb bin gɛt twɛlv bɔypikin dɛn.
Di bɔypikin dɛn we Lia bɔn na Rubɛn, we na Jekɔb in fɔs-bɔy-pikin, Simiɔn, Livay, Juda, Isaka, ɛn Zɛbyulɔn.
Rechɛl in bɔn Josɛf ɛn Bɛnjamin.
Rechɛl in savant-gyal Bila bɔn Dan ɛn Naftali.
Dɔn Lia in savant-gyal in bɔn Gad ɛn Asha. Na Jekɔb dis we i bin bɔn na Padan Aram.
Jekɔb faynali rich to in papa Ayzak na Mamrɛ, nia Kiriath Aba, dat na Ɛbrɔn usay Ebraam ɛn Ayzak bin dɔn tap.
Ayzak bin dɔn ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn eti ia,
ɛn i day we i dɔn ol gud gud wan. Nain bɔypikin dɛn Isɔ ɛn Jekɔb bɛr am.
Na dɛn wan ya mekɔp Isɔ in Jɛnareshɔn dɛn, we dɛn ɔda nem na Idɔm.
Isɔ bin mared Kenan uman dɛn: Ada, we na Ilɔn in gyal pikin. Ilɔn na bin Itayt; Oolibama, we na Anain gyal pikin ɛn Anain papa na Zibiɔn we na Ivayt;
ɛn Basimath, we na Ishɛm in gyal pikin ɛn na Nɛbayɔth in sista.
Ada bɔn Ɛlifaz; Basimath bɔn Reuɛl;
ɛn Oolibama bɔn Jɛush, Jalam, ɛn Kora. Na ɔl dɛn bɔypikin ya so dɛn bɔn fɔ Isɔ na Kenan.

Isɔ bin tek in wɛf dɛn, in bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn we bin tap nain os, wit ɔl in animal dɛn ɛn ɔl di prɔpati we i bin dɔn gɛt na Kenan ɛn kɔmɔt nia in brɔda Izrɛl ɛn go na ɔda kɔntri.
I kɔmɔt de bikɔs di ples usay in ɛn in brɔda Izrɛl bin tap nɔ bin du fɔ dɛn igen, dɛn tu bin dɔn gɛt bɔku animal dɛn ɛn dɛn nɔ bin ebul fɔ tap togɛda igen
So Isɔ we nem Idɔm go tap na di il say na Sɛir.
Dis na Isɔ in Jɛnareshɔn dɛn, ɛn in na dɛn Idɔmayt dɛn papa.
Isɔ in bɔypikin Ɛlifaz, we in wɛf Ada bɔn fɔ am,
bin gɛt fayv bɔypikin dɛn: Tɛman, Oma, Zɛfo, Gatam, ɛn Kɛnaz.
Ɛlifaz in ɔda uman, Timna, bɔn wan mɔ bɔypikin, we nem Amalɛk.
Dɔn Basimath, Isɔ in ɔda wɛf bɔn wangren bɔypikin fɔ am we nem, Reuɛl, ɛn Reuɛl bɔn fo bɔypikin dɛn: Naath, Zɛra, Shama, ɛn Miza.
Isɔ in wɛf Oolibama we na Anain gyal pikin ɛn na Zibiɔn in grampikin, bɔn tri bɔypikin dɛn: Jɛush, Jalam, ɛn Kora.
Dɛn ɔl kam bi papa fɔ difrɛn fambul dɛn. Isɔ in fɔs-bɔy-pikin, Ɛlifaz na bin di papa fɔ dɛn fambul ya so: Tɛman, Oma, Zɛfo, Kɛnaz,
Kora, Gatam, ɛn Amalɛk. Dɛn ɔl bin kɔmɔt na Isɔ in wɛf Ada in yon say.
Isɔ in bɔypikin Reuɛl na bin di papa fɔ dɛn fambul dɛn ya so: Naath, Zɛra, Shama ɛn Miza. Dɛn ɔl bin kɔmɔt na Isɔ in wɛf Basimath in yon say.
Dɛn wan ya na di fambul dɛn we kɔmɔt to Isɔ ɛn in wɛf Oolibama, we na Anain gyal pikin: Jɛush, Jalam, ɛn Kora.
Ɔl dɛn fambul ya so na Isɔ we in ɔda nem na Idɔm in jɛnareshɔn.
Di pipul dɛn we bin tap na Idɔm bin de bay fambul, ɛn na Sɛir, wan pan dɛn Ɔrayt na bin di papa fɔ dɛn ɔl: Lotan, Shobal, Zibiɔn, Ana,
Dishɔn, Ɛza, ɛn Dishan. Na dɛn wan ya kɔmɔt na Sɛir in yon say we i bin de na Idɔm
Lotan na Ori ɛn Iman dɛn papa. Lotan in sista na Timna.
Shobal na Alvan, Manaat, Ebal, Shɛpo, ɛn Onam dɛn papa.
Zibiɔn bɔn tu bɔypikin dɛn, Eya ɛn Ana. Dis Ana nain bin fɛn wata na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap we i bin de mɛn in papa in dɔŋki dɛn.
Ana bɔn Dishɔn ɛn Oolibama nain gyal pikin.
Dishɔn in yon pikin dɛn na Ɛmdan, Ɛsban, Itran, ɛn Kɛraan.
Ɛza na Bilan, Zavan, ɛn Akan dɛn papa.
Dishan na Ɔz ɛn Aran dɛn papa.
So di papa dɛn fɔ di Ɔrayt fambul dɛn na Lotan, Shobal, Zibiɔn, Ana,
Dishɔn, Ɛza, ɛn Dishan. Na di papa dɛn nem di fambul dɛn bin gɛt ɛn dɛn ɔl bin tap insay Sɛir na Idɔm
Bifo Izrɛl bigin gɛt kiŋ, na dɛn kiŋ dɛn ya so bin de rul Idɔm:
Bɛɔ in bɔypikin Bɛla i bin de nain siti na Dinaba we i de rul;
Zira in bɔypikin Jobab we kɔmɔt Bozra nain bi kiŋ we Bɛla day.
Usham we kɔmɔt na Timani nain bi kiŋ we Jobab day;
Bidad in bɔypikin Adad bi kiŋ we Usham day. I bin de na wan siti we nem Avith we i de rul. Nain bin fɛt ɛn dɔnawe wit di Midian pipul dɛn na di wa we dɛn fɛt na Moab.
Samla we kɔmɔt Masrɛka bi kiŋ we Adad day.
Shaul bi kiŋ we Samla day, i bin de na Rɛobɔt nia di riva.
Akbɔ in bɔypikin Baal-Anan bi kiŋ we Shaul day.
Adad bi kiŋ we Baal-Anan day. I bin de na Pawa we i de rul. In wɛf na bin Mɛɛtabɛl we na Matrɛd in gyal pikin ɛn na Mɛzaad in grampikin.
Na di papa fɔ di Idɔm fambul dɛn dis. Na dɛn bin tap na dɛn ples ya Timna, Alva, Jɛthɛth,
Oolibama, Ɛla, Pinɔn,
Kɛnaz, Tɛman, Mibza
Magdiɛl, ɛn Iram. Na di fambul dɛn nem dɛn dis fɔ dɛn fambul we kɔmɔt frɔm Isɔ we gɛt dɛn Idɔmayt as in Jɛnareshɔn dɛn. Ɔl di fambul dɛn gi dɛn nem to di eria usay dɛn bin de.
Jekɔb bin tap na Kenan, usay in papa bin de,

ɛn dis na di stori bɔt Jekɔb ɛn in fambul dɛn. We Josɛf ol sɛvintin ia, i bin de mɛn ship ɛn got wit in brɔda dɛn dat na: dɛn wan we in papa bɔn wit Bila ɛn Zilpa, in ɔda wɛf dɛn. Josɛf bin de tɛl in papa bɔt di bad tin dɛn we in brɔda dɛn bin de du.
Jekɔb bin lɛk Josɛf pas ɔl in ɔda bɔypikin dɛn, bikɔs i bɔn am we i dɔn ol. I mek wan fayn lɔŋsliv gawn fɔ am.
We di brɔda dɛn si se dɛn papa lɛk Josɛf pas dɛn, dɛn et am ɛn dɛn nɔ bin de tɔk fayn to am.
Wan nɛt Josɛf drim, ɛn i tɛl in brɔda dɛn di drim, dat mek dɛn et am mɔ ɛn mɔ.
I tɛl dɛn fɔ lisin to di drim we i drim.
I se dɛn ɔl bin de na fam de kɔt wit, nain in yon bɔndul grap tinap tret wan, dɔn dɛn yon bɔndul dɛn gɛda rawnd in yon ɛn baw to in yon.
In brɔda dɛn aks am se if i tink se i go bi kiŋ ɛn rul dɛn. So dat mek dɛn et am mɔ ɛn mɔ.
Afta dat Josɛf bin drim ɔda drim bak we i tɛl in brɔda dɛn. I se, i gɛt ɔda drim, ɛn insay dis drim i si di san, di mun, ɛn ilɛvin sta dɛn baw to am.
We i tɛl in papa dis drim, in papa tɔk pan am ɛn aks am uskayn drim dat. I se if Josɛf tink se in, in mami, ɛn in brɔda dɛn go kam baw to am
Josɛf in brɔda dɛn bin de jɛlɔs am bɔt in papa in bin de tink bɔt di drim ɛn de wɔnda wetin i min.
Wande we Josɛf in brɔda dɛn bin dɔn go na Shɛkɛm fɔ go mɛn dɛn papa in ship ɛn got dɛn,
nain Jekɔb tɛl Josɛf se in wan mek i go na Shɛkɛm usay in brɔda dɛn de mɛn di ship ɛn got dɛn. Josɛf ansa se in rɛdi
In papa tɛl am se lɛ i go luk if ɔltin ɔlrayt wit in brɔda dɛn ɛn di ship ɛn got dɛn, ɛn kam bak kam tɛl am. So Josɛf lɛf in papa na Ɛbrɔn vali ɛn go na Shɛkɛm.
I bin de wirɔn de we wan man si am ɛn aks am se, “Bɔbɔ wetin yu de luk fɔ?”
Josɛf ansa se, “A de luk fɔ mi brɔda dɛn, sa. Yu kin tɛl mi usay dɛn de wit di ship ɛn got dɛn?”
Di man ansa se, “Dɛn dɔn kɔmɔt ya. A yɛri dɛn se dɛn de go na wan ples we nem Dotan.” So Josɛf go mit in brɔda dɛn na Dotan.
We dɛn si am fawe de kam, dɛn bigin fɔ tay bagin wantɛm fɔ kil am.
Dɛn tɛl dɛn kɔmpin se, “Luk Josɛf di drima.
Una lɛ wi kil am ɛn trowe in bɔdi insay wan pan dɛn dray wɛl ya so. Wi go se na wan wayl bush animal kil am. Dɔn wi go si wetin go apin to in drim dɛn.”
We Rubɛn yɛri dis i tray fɔ sev Josɛf. I tɛl dɛn se, lɛ dɛn nɔ kil am.
Bifo dat lɛ dɛn trowe am insay di ol, bɔt lɛ dɛn nɔ kil am. I bin se so, bikɔs i bin mekɔp fɔ kam pul am ɛn sɛn am bak to in papa.
We Josɛf rich to in brɔda dɛn, dɛn pul in fayn lɔŋsliv gawn pan am.
Dɔn, dɛn tek am ɛn trowe am insay di ol. Di ol bin ɛmti ɛn i nɔ gɛt wata.
Wɛn dɛn sidɔm fɔ it, na de dɛn si sɔm Ishmɛlayt dɛn de kɔmɔt Giliad de go na Ijipt. Dɛn bin lod dɛn kamɛl dɛn wit spays, gɔm, ɛn ɔda tin dɛn.
Juda aks in brɔda dɛn se us bɛnifit dɛn go gɛt if dɛn kil dɛn brɔda ɛn tray fɔ kɔba wetin dɛn dɔn du.
I se lɛ dɛn sɛl am gi dɛn Ishmɛlayt dɛn. Mek dɛn nɔ du ɛnitin bad wit am, afta ɔl na dɛn brɔda, dɛn yon flɛsh ɛn blɔd. In ɔda brɔda dɛn bin gri wit am. We di Ishmɛlayt treda dɛn rich dɛn,
dɛn pul Josɛf kɔmɔt insay di wɛl ɛn sɛl am fɔ twɛnti silva kɔpɔ to di Ishmɛlayt dɛn we kɛr am go na Ijipt.
We Rubɛn kam bak na di ol ɛn si se Josɛf nɔ de de, i so fil am dat i chɛr chɛr in klos.
So i go bak to in brɔda dɛn ɛn se di bɔbɔ nɔ de na di wɛl. So wetin in go du naw.
Afta dat dɛn bin kil wan got ɛn dɛn dɔk Josɛf in fayn fayn gawn insay di blɔd.
Dɔn dɛn tek di gawn ɛn kɛr am go to dɛn papa ɛn tɛl am se, “Luk wetin wi fɛn. Na yu pikin gɛt am?”
Wɛn Jekɔb si di klos i sabi am wantɛm. I se, “Yɛs na Josɛf in yon! Bad bif dɔn kil am. I dɔn chɛr mi pikin Josɛf in bɔdi pispis.”
Jekɔb chɛr in yon klos we i bin wɛr, dɔn i wɛr munin. I munin fɔ in pikin fɔ lɔŋ.
In pikin dɛn tray fɔ kɔrej am bɔt i nɔ tek. I se, in wan day go mit in pikin na Shiol wit di munin. I bin stil de kray fɔ am.
We di Ishmɛlayt dɛn rich Ijipt dɛn sɛl Josɛf to Pɔtifa, we na bin wan pan di kiŋ in ɔfisa dɛn. In na bin di kapten fɔ di gyad dɛn na di kiŋ in os.
Da sem tɛm de, Juda bin lɛf in brɔda dɛn ɛn go tap to wan man we nem Ira, we kɔmɔt Adulam.
Na de Juda mit wan Kenan man we nem Shua, in gyal pikin ɛn mared am,
ɛn dɛn bɔn wan bɔypikin, we dɛn gi nem A.
Di uman bin gɛt bɛlɛ bak ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔypikin we dɛn gi nem Onan.
Dɔn i bɔn ɔda bɔypikin we dɛn gi nem Shila. Juda bin de na Kɛzib we Shila in bin bɔn.
Juda fɛn wɛf fɔ in fɔs-bɔy-pikin A. Dis uman nem Tama.
A bin de du bɔku wikɛd tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk, so PAPA GƆD tek in layf.
Na de Juda tɛl Onan se i fɔ mared Tama, yu brɔda we dɔn day in wɛf, so dat i go bɔn bɔypikin we go mek in brɔda insɛf gɛt jɛnareshɔn dɛn.
Bɔt Onan bin no se di bɔypikin nɔ go bi in yon, so ɛnitɛm i lidɔm wit in brɔda in wɛf, i kin trik am ɛn grap kwik so i nɔ go gɛt bɛlɛ, bikɔs i nɔ want gɛt pikin fɔ in brɔda.
PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk wetin i bin de du so i tek insɛf yon layf.

Na de Juda tɛl Tama we nain dɔtɛnlɔ mek i go bak nain papa in os; i se Tama nɔ fɔ mared te in bɔypikin Shila big. I bin se so bikɔs i de fred se Shila insɛf go day lɛkɛ in brɔda dɛn. So Tama go bak nain papa in os.
Afta sɔm tɛm Juda in wɛf day. We i dɔn munin dɔn fɔ am, in ɛn in padi Ira we de Adulam go na Timna, usay dɛn bin de kɔt in ship dɛn ia.
Sɔmbɔdi go tɛl Tama se in fadɛnlɔ dɔn go na Timna fɔ go kɔt in ship dɛn ia.

Tama bin dɔn no se Juda in smɔl bɔypikin we nem Shila bin dɔn big, bɔt dɛn nɔ mek i mared am. So i pul in klos we uman we i man dɔn day kin wɛr, wɛr ɔda klos, ɛn kɔba in fes wit vel. Dɛn i sidɔm bifo say na Ɛnaim, wan siti we de na di rod fɔ go na Timna.
We Juda si Tama, i tink se na rare gyal, bikɔs in fes bin kɔba.
I go mit am usay i bin sidɔm oba di rod ɛn tɛl am se i want fɔ du biznɛs da nɛt de. Bɔt i nɔ bin no se nain dɔtɛnlɔ. Tama aks am se, if i gri wetin i go gi am.
Juda ansa se, i go sɛn wan pan in yɔŋ got dɛn fɔ am. Nain Tama se, ɔrayt, bɔt i fɔ plɛj sɔntin to am we i go kip.

Juda aks am se lɛkɛ wetin so i go want fɔ plɛj. Tama ansa am se, in want in riŋ we gɛt Juda in inishal wit di kɔd ɛn in wɔkin stik Juda gri. I gi Tama ɔl wetin i aks fɔ as plɛj, dɔn i gɛt biznɛs wit am we mek i gɛt bɛlɛ.
Tama go bak nain os, pul in vel ɛn wɛr di klos we uman we i man dɔn day kin wɛr, bak.
Juda sɛn in padi Ira fɔ kɛr di yɔŋ got go, so i go gɛt in tiŋs dɛn bak we i bin plɛj to di uman; bɔt Ira nɔ bin ebul fɔ fɛn di uman.
I aks sɔm man dɛn na Ɛnaim se usay da rare gyal we kin sidɔm na di rod de. Dɛn ansa am se, dɛn nɔ wande gɛt rare gyal na dɛn ples.
So i tɔn bak go tɛl Juda se in nɔ ebul fɛn di uman. I tɛl am se di man dɛn we de na di ples se dɛn nɔ gɛt rare gyal de.
Juda se, lɛ di uman kip di tiŋs dɛn ɔ nɔ so pipul dɛn go laf dɛn. I se in no se in dɔn sɛn di got bɔt na Ira nɔ ebul fɔ fɛn di uman.
Afta tri mɔnt sɔmbɔdi tɛl Juda se in dɔtɛnlɔ dɔn tɔn rare gyal, ɛn i dɔn gɛt bɛlɛ. Nain Juda gi ɔda se, mek dɛn kɛr am go na do ɛn bɔn am na faya.

We dɛn de kɛr am go na de i sɛn wɔd to in fadɛnlɔ wit di tiŋs dɛn se di man we gɛt dɛn tiŋs de nain gi am bɛlɛ. I se lɛ Juda luk dɛn gud ɛn si if i no udat gɛt dɛn, dat na di riŋ we gɛt inishal wit di kɔd ɛn di wɔkinstik.
Juda bin no se nain tiŋs dɛn so i se, di uman dɔn du di rayt tin. Nain nɔ du wetin i bin fɔ du fɔ am ɛn dat na fɔ mek in bɔypikin Shila mared am. Juda nɔ gɛt biznɛs wit am igen
We di tɛm rich fɔ mek i bɔn, i bɔn twin.
We i bin de bɔn, wan pan di pikin pul in an kɔmɔt na do. Di uman we de ɛp am fɔ bɔn tay rɛd trɛd pan di an, ɛn se, “dis na di fɔs wan we bɔn.”
Bɔt i put in an insay bak, ɛn in brɔda kɔmɔt bifo am. Na de di uman se, “So na so yu de kɔmɔt!” Fɔseka dat i gi am nem Pɛrɛz.
Dɔn in brɔda bɔn wit di rɛd trɛd nain an ɛn dɛn gi am nem Zira.
Di Ishmɛlayt dɛn kɛr Josɛf go na Ijipt ɛn sɛl am gi Pɔtifa, wan pan di kiŋ in ɔfisa dɛn. Nain na bin di kapten fɔ di gyad dɛn na di kiŋ in os.
PAPA GƆD bin de wit Josɛf ɛn mek bɛtɛ fala am. I bin tap nain Ijipshian masta in os.
Pɔtifa bin si se PAPA GƆD de wit Josɛf ɛn de mek bɛtɛ fala am pan ɛnitin we i de du.
Pɔtifa in at bin so tek am dat i lɛf ɔl in biznɛs nain os nain an.
Fɔseka Josɛf PAPA GƆD blɛs ɔl wetin de insay di Ijipt kapten in os ɛn in fam dɛn.
Pɔtifa an ova ɔl in biznɛs to Josɛf ɛn i nɔ wɔri insɛf bɔt ɛnitin pas di it we i de it. Josɛf na bin fayn man,
ɛn afta sɔm tɛm Josɛf in masta in wɛf bi want am, so i aks am fɔ mek dɛn gɛt biznɛs.
Josɛf nɔ gri ɛn tɛl am se, in masta nɔ de wɔri insɛf fɔ ɛnitin na di os, bikɔs in de. I se i dɔn put am inchaj ɔf ɔl wetin i gɛt.
I se in gɛt pawa na di os lɛkɛ insɛf, ɛn i nɔ ayd natin pan am pas in we nain wɛf. I se, wetin fɔ mek in du dis kayn wikɛd tin ɛn sin to PAPA GƆD.
Di uman bin de mɔna Josɛf ɛvride, bɔt i nɔ gri fɔ lidɔm wit am ɔ go nia am.
Wande we Josɛf go insay di os fɔ go du in wok, we nɔn pan di ɔda wokman dɛn nɔ bin de insay,
Pɔtifa in wɛf grip in klos ɛn tray fɔ fos fɔ lidɔm wit am. Bɔt Josɛf jɔg kɔmɔt nain an ɛn rɔn go na do, bɔt in klos lɛf na di uman in an.
We i si se Josɛf in klos dɔn lɛf nain an ɛn i dɔn rɔn go na do,
i bigin ala kɔl di ɔda pipul dɛn na di os. I se, “Una kam o! Dis Ibru bɔy we mi man briŋ kam na mi os wan briŋ disgres pan wi. I kam insay mi rum fɔ rep mi, bɔt a ala lawd wan.
We i yɛri mi de ala i rɔn go na do, ɛn i lɛf in klos ya.”
I kip di klos sote in man kam bak na os da nɛt de
ɛn tɛl am di sem stori. I se da Ibru slev we i briŋ kam na dɛn os go insay in rum fɔ disgres am.
Bɔt we in ala, i rɔn kɔmɔt na do, ɛn i lɛf in klos de.
We Josɛf in masta yɛri wetin in wɛf tɛl am bɔt aw in slev bin wan disgres am, i vɛks bad ɛn
mek dɛn ol Josɛf ɛn put am na di jel we di kiŋ kin kip in jelman dɛn.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD bin de wit Josɛf ɛn i blɛs am, ɛn mek di wɔda lɛk in biznɛs.
Di wɔda mek Josɛf bi edman fɔ ɔl di jelman dɛn ɛn put am inchaj ɔf ɔltin na di jel.
Di wɔda nɔ bin de wɔri bɔt natin we Josɛf de du, bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin de wit am ɛn i bin mek bɛtɛ fala am pan ɔl wetin i bin de du.
Afta sɔntɛm di man we bin de sav di kiŋ na Ijipt wayn ɛn di edman fɔ in bekaman dɛn bin ambɔg di kiŋ.
Dat mek i vɛks bad bad wan pan di tu wokman dɛn,
so i sɛn dɛn go jel na di kapten fɔ di gyad in os, na di sem ples we Josɛf bin de.
Dɛn bin te na di jel ɛn di kapten fɔ di gyad mek Josɛf tek kia ɔf dɛn.
Wan nɛt we dɛn de na jel nain di man we bin de sav wayn to di kiŋ ɛn di edman fɔ di bekaman dɛn drim, ɛn di drim dɛn bin gɛt difrɛn minin.
We Josɛf kam to dɛn na mɔnin, i si se sɔntin de wɔri dɛn.
I aks dɛn se wetin de wɔri dɛn.
Nain dɛn se dɛn ɔl tu drim, bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ de de fɔ intaprit di drim dɛn. Josɛf aks dɛn if nɔto PAPA GƆD de gi sɛns fɔ intaprit drim. I se lɛ dɛn tɛl am dɛn drim.
Na de di man we bin de sav wayn to di kiŋ se, in drim i si grep tik tinap bifo am.
Di tik gɛt tri branch dɛn pan am bɔt as di lif dɛn pan di tik bigin bɔs so, di flawa dɛnsɛf bigin bɔs fayn fayn wan dɔn i bigin bia bɔnch greps we rɛp wantɛm.
I se in bin ol di kiŋ in kɔp; so i pik di greps dɛn ɛn kwis dɛn insay di kɔp ɛn gi di kiŋ.
Na de Josɛf tɛl am wetin di drim min. I se, di tri branch dɛn min tri de.
Insay tri de di kiŋ go pul am na jel. I go fɔgiv am ɛn gi am in wok bak. In go de sav am wayn lɛkɛ aw i bin de du.
Josɛf beg am se duya lɛ i nɔ fɔgɛt am we i kɔmɔt na di jel, lɛ i tɛl di kiŋ bɔt am ɛn ɛp am mek insɛf kɔmɔt de
bikɔs, na kech dɛn kech am na Ibru kɔntri we mek in de de ɛn naw in nɔ du natin fɔ mek dɛn put am na jel.
We di edman fɔ di bekaman dɛn si se di drim bin fayn fɔ di man we bin de sav wayn to di kiŋ bay aw Josɛf intaprit am, insɛf tɛl Josɛf in drim. I se insɛf bin drim i tot tri blay bred nain ed.
Di blay we bin de pantap gɛt ɔlkayn gud it dɛn we dɛn bek fɔ di kiŋ, bɔt bɔd dɛn bin de it dɛn.
Josɛf tɛl am wetin di drim min: I se di tri blay min tri de.
Insay tri de di kiŋ go pul am na jel ɛn i go kɔt in ed kɔmɔt! Dɛn go ɛŋ in bɔdi na tik, ɛn bɔd dɛn go it in bɔdi.
Insay tri de di kiŋ mek pati fɔ in bathde ɛn kɔl ɔl in ɔfisa dɛn; i pul di tu man dɛn kɔmɔt na jel ɛn mek dɛn tinap bifo di ɔfisa dɛn.
I mek di man we bin de sav wayn bigin wok ɛn gi am in post bak,
bɔt i kil di edman fɔ di bekaman dɛn. Ɔltin apin jɛs lɛkɛ aw Josɛf bin tɛl dɛn.
Bɔt di man we bin de sav wayn to di kiŋ nɔ mɛmba Josɛf igen sɛf. I fɔgɛt bɔt am ɔltogɛda.
Afta tu ia dɔn pas, di kiŋ na Ijipt drim se i tinap nia Riva Nayl.
I si sɛvin fat kaw dɛn we bin fayn fɔ luk, kɔmɔt insay di riva ɛn dɛn bigin fɔ it di gras.
Dɛn i si sɛvin ɔda kaw dɛnsɛf kɔmɔt insay di riva; bɔt dɛn bin wɔwɔ ɛn dray tumɔs. Dɛn dray wɔwɔ kaw ya kam tinap nia di fat fayn kaw dɛn nia di riva.
Di dray wɔwɔ kaw dɛn it di fat, fayn kaw dɛn. Nain i skyad wek.
Di kiŋ lidɔm slip bak ɛn drim igen Insay dis drim i si sɛvin ed kɔn we dɔn ful ɛn trɔŋ de gro na wan tik.
Sɛvin ɔda ed kɔn bin bɔs, bɔt di briz we kɔmɔt na di ist bin mek dɛn dray bad bad wan.
Nain dɛn dray ed kɔn dɛn ya so, swɛla di wan dɛn we bin dɔn ful. Di kiŋ skyad wek ɛn kechɔp se na drim i bin de drim.
We do klin i bin wɔri, so i sɛn kɔl ɔl in majikman ɛn sɛnsman dɛn we de na Ijipt. I tɛl dɛn in drim, bɔt nɔn pan dɛn nɔ bin ebul fɔ intaprit dɛn.
Na de di man we de sav wayn to di kiŋ se, na da de de in mɛmba wetin i fɔ dɔn du.
I se wan tɛm bin de we di kiŋ bin vɛks pan am ɛn di edman fɔ di bekaman dɛn, so i put dɛn na jel na di kapten fɔ di gyad dɛn, in os.
Wan nɛt dɛn ɔl tu bin drim ɛn di drim dɛn bin gɛt difrɛn minin.
I se wan yɔŋ Ibru bɔy bin de na jel wit dɛn, we bin de wok fɔ di gyad dɛn bɔsman. I se dɛn tɛl am dɛn drim, ɛn i intaprit di drim fɔ dɛn.
Tin dɛn bi, jɛs lɛkɛ aw i bin se. I se di kiŋ bin gi am in wok bak, ɛn i bin kil di bekaman.
Di kiŋ sɛn kɔl Josɛf, ɛn dɛn pul am kɔmɔt na jel wantɛm. We i dɔn shev ɛn chenj in klos, i go mit di kiŋ.
Di kiŋ tɛl am se in drim wan drim bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul fɔ intaprit am fɔ am, bɔt dɛn tɛl am se i kin intaprit drim.
Josɛf ansa am se di kiŋ se, nɔto in de intaprit drim, bɔt PAPA GƆD go intaprit am fɔ am.
Di kiŋ se, in drim se i tinap nia Riva Nayl,
nain sɛvin fat kaw dɛn we fayn fɔ luk, kɔmɔt insay di riva ɛn dɛn bigin fɔ it di gras.
Dɛn sɛvin ɔda dray kaw dɛn we gɛt soso bon bon apia. I se in nɔ wande si dɛn kayn wɔwɔ kaw de na Ijipt.
Di dray kaw dɛn it di fat wan dɛn,
bɔt ɔl we dɛn dɔn it di fat wan dɛn dɔn, na so dɛn dray lɛkɛ aw dɛn bin tan. Na de in skyad wek.
Dɔn i drim bak se i si sɛvin ed kɔn we ful ɛn trɔŋ bin de gro na di sem tik.
Dɔn ɔda sɛvin ed kɔn bɔs na di sem tik we di ist briz blo dɛn mek dɛn dray bad bad wan.
Di dray ed kɔn dɛn swɛla di wan dɛn we ful ɛn trɔŋ. I se we i tɛl di majikman dɛn in drim dɛn nɔn nɔ ebul intaprit am fɔ am.
Josɛf tɛl di kiŋ se, di tu drim dɛn min di sem tin; PAPA GƆD dɔn sho am wetin i gɛt fɔ du.
Di sɛvin fat kaw na sɛvin ia, ɛn di sɛvin ed ful trɔŋ kɔn dɛnsɛf na sɛvin ia; dɛn gɛt di sem minin.
Di sɛvin dray kaw dɛn ɛn di sɛvin ed dray kɔn min sɛvin ia aŋri.
Jɛs lɛkɛ aw i tɛl am, PAPA GƆD dɔn sho am wetin i gɛt fɔ du.
Sɛvin ia go de we it go de bɔku na Ijipt,
bɔt afta dat aŋri go de fɔ sɛvin ɔda ia. Ɔlman go fɔgɛt bɔt di tɛm we it bin de bikɔs di aŋri go so bad dat i go pwɛl di kɔntri.
Dɛn go fɔgɛt bɔt di tɛm we tin bin plɛnti, bikɔs di aŋri we go kam go traŋa bad bad wan.
I se di kiŋ drim di sem tin tu tɛm bikɔs na tin we PAPA GƆD dɔn disayd fɔ du, ɛn i go bi jisnɔ.
I tɛl di kiŋ se lɛ i pik man we gɛt sɛns ɛn put am inchaj ɔf di wanol kɔntri.
Dɔn lɛ i pik ɔda man dɛn we go de inchaj fɔ kɔlɛkt wan pan fayv pat pan di tin dɛn we dɛn go avɛst insay di fɔs sɛvin ia we it go bɔku.
Dɛn fɔ gɛda dɛn it ya ɛn kip dɛn na di kiŋ in yon sto so dat it go de ɔlsay na di kɔntri.
Dɛn fɔ kip dɛn it ya so fɔ di sɛvin ia dɛn we it nɔ go de na di kɔntri so aŋri nɔ go kil di pipul dɛn.
Di kiŋ ɛn di ɔfisa dɛn bin gri fɔ du wetin Josɛf se.
Ɛn i tɛl dɛn se, nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul du di wok bɛtɛ pas Josɛf, we gɛt PAPA GƆD in spirit insay am
I tɔn to Josɛf ɛn tɛl am se, as PAPA GƆD dɔn sho am ɔl dis, nɔbɔdi nɔ de igen we gɛt da kayn sɛns de nain kɔntri.
So i go mek am bi edman nain kɔntri fɔ di projɛkt, ɛn ɔl in pipul dɛn go obe am. Di wan tin nɔmɔ, Josɛf go de sɛkɛn to am.
Ɛn frɔm da de de in di kiŋ dɔn mek Josɛf bi gɔvna na di kɔntri.
Di kiŋ pul in riŋ nain fiŋa we gɛt in mak pan am ɛn put am na Josɛf in fiŋa fɔ sho se i dɔn gɛt pawa. I wɛr fayn linin klos pan am, ɛn put gold chen rawnd in nɛk.
I mek i rayd pan di ɔs ɛn karej we di sɛkɛn in kɔmand kin rayd ɛn in sikyɔriti dɛn de bifo de ala se, “Una gi rod! Una gi rod!” Na so Josɛf tek bi gɔvna na Ijipt.
Dɛn di kiŋ tɛl am se, “Mi na di kiŋ bɔt nɔbɔdi na Ijipt nɔ go muf wan inch if yu nɔ tɛl am fɔ du so.”

Di kiŋ chenj Josɛf in nem to Zafɛnath Pania we na Ijipshian nem, ɛn gi am Asɛnath we na Pɔtifɛra in gyal pikin fɔ bi in wɛf. Pɔtifɛra na bin man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na On. So Josɛf ebul fɔ go ɔlsay insay Ijipt.
Josɛf bin ol tati ia we i bigin fɔ sav di kiŋ na Ijipt. I bin kɔmɔt na di kiŋ in ples ɛn i waka ɔlsay na di kɔntri.
We di fɔs sɛvin ia kam it bin plɛnti na di kɔntri.
Josɛf gɛda bɔku it ɛn kip dɛn na di big siti dɛn sto. I kip di it we kɔmɔt na ɛni fam na di big siti in sto we de nia da fam de.
Di it bin so plɛnti dat Josɛf tap fɔ mɛnshɔ am. It bin bɔku lɛkɛ sansan na bich.
Bifo di ia dɛn kam we di aŋri fɔ de, Asɛnath dat na Pɔtifɛra di man we kin mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, in gyal pikin bin dɔn bɔn tu bɔypikin dɛn fɔ Josɛf.
Josɛf gi in fɔs-bɔy-pikin nem Manasɛ. I se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn mek a fɔgɛt ɔl mi waala ɛn ɔl mi papa in fambul dɛn.”
I gi in sɛkɛn pikin nem Ifrem. I tɔk se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn gi mi pikin na di kɔntri usay a sɔfa.”
Di sɛvin ia we it bin plɛnti na Ijipt bin kam ɛn pas,
dɔn di sɛvin ia we di aŋri fɔ bigin kam lɛkɛ aw nɔmɔ Josɛf bin se. Aŋri bin de na dɛn ɔda kɔntri, bɔt it bin de na Ijipt.
We di aŋri bigin fɔ mɔna di pipul dɛn na Ijipt, dɛn go kray to di kiŋ fɔ it, so di kiŋ tɛl dɛn fɔ go to Josɛf, ɛn du wetin i tɛl dɛn fɔ du.
Di aŋri bin traŋa dat i prɛd ɔlɔbɔt na di kɔntri. Josɛf opin di sto ɛn sɛl kɔn gi di pipul dɛn na Ijipt.
Pipul dɛn bin de kɔmɔt ɔlsay na di wɔl fɔ go bay it to Josɛf na Ijipt, bikɔs di aŋri bin dɔn pasmak ɔlsay.
We Jekɔb yɛri se it de na Ijipt i aks in bɔypikin dɛn wetin mek dɛn sidɔm ɛn nɔ du natin.
I tɛl dɛn se, in yɛri se, it de na Ijipt so dɛn fɔ go de go bay it mek aŋri nɔ kil dɛn ɔl.
So Josɛf in tɛn big brɔda dɛn go na Ijipt fɔ go bay it,
bɔt Jekɔb nɔ bin sɛn Josɛf in bɛlɛ bɔn brɔda Bɛnjamin wit dɛn, bikɔs i bin de fred se mek sɔntin nɔ go apin to am.
So Jekɔb in bɔypikin dɛn go wit ɔda pipul dɛn fɔ bay it na Ijipt, bikɔs di aŋri bin dɔn rich Kenan insɛf.
Josɛf we na bin di gɔvna na Ijipt, nain bin de mek dɛn sɛl it gi ɔlman. So Josɛf in brɔda dɛn kam baw bifo am.
We Josɛf si in brɔda dɛn, i mɛmba dɛn, bɔt i mek lɛk se i nɔ no dɛn. I tɔk to dɛn rɔf wan. I se, “Usay una kɔmɔt?” Dɛn ansa se dɛn i kɔmɔt na Kenan fɔ kam bay it.
Josɛf in bin mɛmba in brɔda dɛn, bɔt dɛn nɔ bin mɛmba am.
I mɛmba in drim dɛn we i bin dɔn drim lɔntɛm ɛn se, “Una jɛs kam fɔ kam luk usay mi kɔntri wik?”
Dɛn ansa se, nɔ sa, dɛn kam lɛkɛ in slev dɛn, fɔ kam bay it.
Dɛn se dɛn ɔl na brɔda, dɛn nɔ kam fɔ kam fɔ luk usay in kɔntri wik. Dɛn se dɛn na ɔnɛs pipul dɛn.
Josɛf tɛl dɛn se, “Na lay! Una kam fɔ luk usay wi kɔntri wik.”
Dɛn se, dɛn na bin twɛlv brɔda dɛn, dɛn papa de na Kenan wit dɛn las brɔda ɛn dɛn ɔda brɔda dɛn nɔ no if i de ɔ i nɔ de.
Josɛf se, “Na di tin dis we a de tɔk, una kam fɔ kam luk usay wi kɔntri wik.
Dis na aw a de kam tɛst una: A swɛ to di kiŋ in nem se, una nɔ go go pas una smɔl brɔda kam na ya.
Una sɛn wan pan una fɔ go briŋ una brɔda kam. Una go lɛf. A go kip una na prizin sote a no if wetin una se na tru. If nɔto tru dɛn a go no se, fɔ tru una kam fɔ kam luk usay wi kɔntri wik.”
We i dɔn tɔk so, i put dɛn na jel fɔ tri de.
Di de we mek tri, nain Josɛf tɛl dɛn se in na man we de fred PAPA GƆD, if dɛn du wetin in tɛl dɛn, dɛn nɔ go day.
Fɔ sho se na tru dɛn de tɔk, wan pan dɛn go lɛf na di jel usay i bin kip dɛn; di ɔda wan dɛn go tɔn bak to dɛn fambul dɛn wit di it we dɛn dɔn bay mek aŋri nɔ kil dɛn.
Dɔn dɛn go briŋ dɛn smɔl brɔda kam to am ɛn dat go sho se ɔl wetin dɛn tɛl am na tru ɛn i nɔ go kil dɛn. Dɛn ɔl bin gri.
Dɛn tɛl dɛnsɛf se, dɛn de sɔfa fɔ wetin dɛn bin du to dɛn brɔda. Dɛn se, dɛn bin si aw i bin sɔri we i de beg dɛn, bɔt dɛn nɔ yɛri. Na dat mek dɛn de pan trɔbul so naw.
Na de Rubɛn se in bin tɛl dɛn mek dɛn nɔ du natin to di bɔbɔ, bɔt dɛn nɔ bin lisin. Naw na dɛn ɔl de pe fɔ in day.
Dɛn nɔ bin no se Josɛf bin de ɔndastand ɔl wetin dɛn bin de tɔk bikɔs na ɔda pɔsin bin de intaprit fɔ dɛn.
Josɛf lɛf dɛn go na kɔna go kray. We i kam bak i ebul fɔ tɔk mɔ wit dɛn. I pik Simiɔn, ɛn mek dɛn tay am bifo dɛn.
Josɛf gi ɔda fɔ mek dɛn ful-ɔp in brɔda dɛn bag wit it, ɛn dɛn fɔ put ɔl dɛn mɔni insay dɛn bag bak. I tɛl dɛn fɔ gi dɛn tin fɔ it na rod.
Di brɔda dɛn lod dɛn dɔŋki wit di it we dɛn bay, ɛn tɔn go bak.
We dɛn rich na di ples usay dɛn de slip da nɛt de, wan pan dɛn opin in bag fɔ fid in dɔŋki ɛn si se in mɔni de insay di bag.
I kɔl in brɔda dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn se, in fɛn in mɔni insay in bag. Dɛn at pwɛl, dɛn fred ɛn aks dɛnsɛf se, “Wetin PAPA GƆD de du to wi so?”
We dɛn rich to dɛn papa Jekɔb na Kenan, dɛn tɛl am ɔl wetin dɔn apin to dɛn.
Dɛn se di gɔvna na Ijipt bin ala pan dɛn ɛn se dɛn go fɔ go luk usay in kɔntri wik.
Bɔt dɛn tɛl am se dɛn na ɔnɛs pipul, ɛn nɔto dat dɛn go fɔ.
Dɛn se na bin dɛn twɛlv, ɛn na di sem papa bɔn dɛn ɔl, bɔt dɛn nɔ no if wan pan dɛn de ɔ i nɔ de, ɛn dat di smɔl wande wit dɛn papa na Kenan.
Di man se, in go tɛst dɛn fɔ no if dɛn na di ɔnɛs pipul dɛn we dɛn se dɛn bi. So wan pan dɛn go lɛf wit am ɛn di ɔda wan dɛn go briŋ it kam fɔ wi fambul dɛn.

Dɛn se di man se dɛn fɔ kɛr dɛn smɔl brɔda go to am ɛn na bay dat i go no if na tru dɛn de tɔk se dɛn nɔto spay, dɛn na ɔnɛs pipul dɛn. I se in go gi dɛn dɛn brɔda bak ɛn dɛn go fri fɔ de go ɛn kam fɔ tredin.
As dɛn de ɛmti dɛn bag dɛn, ɔlman fɛn in yon mɔni insay in bag, so dɛn papa fred.
Dɛn papa tɛl dɛn se if dɛn want mek i lɔs ɔl in pikin dɛn. I se Josɛf nɔ de igen; Simiɔn nɔ de; ɛn naw dɛn want fɔ kɛr Bɛnjamin insɛf go. I tan lɛkɛ se tin jɛs de bad fɔ am.
Rubɛn tɛl in papa se, If in nɔ briŋ Bɛnjamin kam bak to am lɛ i kil in tu bɔypikin dɛn. I se lɛ i put di bɔbɔ nain an. In go mɔs briŋ am kam bak.

Bɔt Jekɔb se in bɔypikin nɔ go go wit am in brɔda dɔn day, ɛn nain nɔmɔ dɔn lɛf pan in mama in pikin dɛn. If sɔntin go apin to am na rod lɛkɛ we in dɔn ol so, na da sɔri de go de pan am te i day go Shiol.
Di aŋri bin dɔn traŋa na Kenan
ɛn we Izrɛl ɛn in fambul dɛn dɔn it ɔl wetin dɛn bin briŋ kɔmɔt Ijipt, Izrɛl bin tɛl in bɔypikin dɛn fɔ go bak go bay it fɔ dɛn ɔl.
Juda tɛl am se di man bin wɔn dɛn traŋa wan se i nɔ go gri lɛ dɛn si am pas dɛn kɛr dɛn smɔl brɔda go.
If Izrɛl gri fɔ lɛ dɛn ɛn dɛn brɔda go, dɛn go go bay di it kam,
bɔt if in nɔ gri, dɛn nɔ go go, bikɔs di man bin tɛl dɛn se in nɔ go gri lɛ dɛn si am pas dɛn brɔda go wit dɛn.
Dat mek Izrɛl aks dɛn uskayn waala dɛn dɔn put pan am so. Wetin mek dɛn fɔ tɛl di man se dɛn gɛt smɔl brɔda.
Dɛn tɛl am se, di man aks bɔt dɛn fambul dɛn, if dɛn papa nɔ day yet ɛn if dɛn gɛt ɔda brɔda. Dɛn se dɛn bin jɛs gɛt fɔ ansa am. Ɛn dɛn nɔ bin no se i bin go tɛl dɛn fɔ kɛr dɛn brɔda go.
Juda tɛl in papa se lɛ i gi am di pikin, lɛ dɛn go wantɛm mek aŋri nɔ kil dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn.
I se in de le in layf dɔŋ. I go briŋ am bak to am. If i nɔ briŋ am kam bak in go tek di blem sote go.
I se dɛn de westɛm, lɛk dɛn dɔn go ɛn kam tu tɛm sɛf.
Dɛn papa tɛl dɛn se if na so i gɛt fɔ bi, fayn. Bɔt lɛ dɛn tek sɔm fayn tin dɛn we dɛn gɛt go gi di gɔvna fɔ prɛzɛnt: lɛkɛ tin fɔ rɔb, ɔni, spays, pistashio ɛn almɔn.
I se lɛ dɛn dɔbul di mɔni we dɛn de kɛr go, bikɔs dɛn gɛt fɔ kɛr di mɔni we dɛn bin fɛn insay dɛn bag go bak. Sɔntɛm na sɔmbɔdi mek mistek.
I se lɛ dɛn tek dɛn brɔda de go wantɛm,
ɛn pre mek PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti mek di man sɔri fɔ dɛn, ɛn lɛ i mek Bɛnjamin ɛn dɛn ɔda brɔda kam bak wit dɛn. I se as fɔ in di Izrɛl, if na so in fɔ lɔs in pikin dɛn, lɛ i bi so.
Di brɔda dɛn tek Bɛnjamin, di prɛzɛnt dɛn ɛn di dɔbul mɔni, ɛn go Ijipt go sho dɛnsɛf to Josɛf.
We Josɛf si Bɛnjamin wit dɛn, i tɛl di wokman nain os fɔ kɛr di man dɛn go insay in os. I se, dɛn go it wit am da aftanun de, so lɛ i kil wan animal ɛn rɛdi it fɔ dɛn.
Di wokman du wetin Josɛf tɛl am fɔ du.

We dɛn bin de go na di os, dɛn bin de fred. Dɛn tink se na fɔ di mɔni we dɛn fɛn insay dɛn bag dɛn, mek i mek dɛn de kɛr dɛn go nain os. Dɛn se Josɛf want tek dat mek ɛskyuz fɔ siz dɛn dɔŋki dɛn ɛn tɔn dɛn to slev.
We dɛn rich na di domɔt, dɛn tɛl di wokman
se dɛn bin dɔn kam de wan tɛm fɔ kam bay it.
Dɛn se we dɛn de go na os dɛn bin blo smɔl bit na rod. We dɛn opin dɛn bag dɛn, dɛn fɛn dɛn mɔni insay dɛn bag bɔt dɛn dɔn briŋ am kam bak.
Dɛn se dɛn briŋ sɔm mɔni kam bak fɔ bay mɔ it ɛn dɛn nɔ no udat bin put dɛn mɔni bak insay dɛn bag.
Di wokman se lɛ dɛn put dɛn at dɔŋ lɛ dɛn ɔ fred. I se dɛn PAPA GƆD, we na dɛn papa in PAPA GƆD, nain go put di mɔni na dɛn bag. I se in gɛt dɛn mɔni. Afta dat i go briŋ Simiɔn kam.
Di wokman kɛr di brɔda dɛn go insay di os. I gi dɛn wata fɔ was dɛn fut, ɛn gi dɛn dɔŋki dɛn it.
Dɛn rɛdi di prɛzɛnt dɛn fɔ gi Josɛf we i kam fɔ it santɛm, bikɔs dɛn bin dɔn tɛl dɛn se dɛn gɛt fɔ it wit am.
We Josɛf rich na os, dɛn kɛr di prɛzɛnt dɛn we dɛn bin dɔn briŋ insay di os, go gi am ɛn dɛn baw to am.
I aks dɛn if dɛn wɛl ɛn se dɛn bin tɛl am bɔt dɛn papa, so aw i de du, if i stil ɛn de alayv ɛn if i wɛl.
Dɛn ansa am se dɛn papa de ɛn i wɛl. Dɔn dɛn baw to am fɔ sho rɛspɛkt.
We Josɛf si in bɛlɛ bɔn brɔda Bɛnjamin i aks dɛn if na dɛn smɔl brɔda da wande we dɛn bin tɛl am bɔt. Dɔn i se “Mek PAPA GƆD blɛs yu mi pikin.”
We Josɛf si in brɔda, i want bɔs kray. I luk fɔ ples fɔ go kray, so i rɔn go insay in rum ɛn go kray.
We i dɔn was in fes ɛn bɔkɔp insɛf, i kɔmɔt na do ɛn gi ɔda fɔ mek dɛn sav di it.
Dɛn bin sav Josɛf na wan tebul, ɛn in brɔda dɛn na ɔda tebul, di Ijipshian dɛn na di ɔda tebul bikɔs na bad bad tin fɔ mek di Ijipshian ɛn Ibru pipul dɛn it wan say as di Ijipshian dɛn nɔ lɛk dat.
Josɛf tɛl in brɔda dɛn usay fɔ sidɔm na di tebul. I mek dɛn sidɔm lɛkɛ aw dɛn ol frɔm di big wan to di smɔl wan. We dɛn si aw dɛn sidɔm, dɛn luk dɛnsɛf ɛn wɔnda.
Di it we dɛn bin sav dɛn na pan di wan we bin de na Josɛf in tebul. Bɛnjamin in yon it bin bɔku fayv tɛm pas dɛn ɔl. So dɛn it ɛn drink fri wan wit Josɛf.
Josɛf tɛl di wokman nain os mek i ful-ɔp di man dɛn bag dɛn wit it we dɛn go ebul fɔ tot, ɛn put dɛn mɔni bak insay dɛn bag.
I se mek i put in silva kɔp insay di smɔl brɔda in bag wit in kɔpɔ. Di wokman du wetin Josɛf tɛl am.
We do klin di brɔda dɛn ol rod fɔ go bak wit dɛn dɔŋki.
We dɛn dɔn go fa lilibit frɔm di big siti, Josɛf tɛl in wokman se, lɛ i mekes kwik ɛn go biɛn di man dɛn. I se we i mit dɛn, i fɔ aks dɛn wetin mek dɛn du bad fɔ gud
ɛn wetin mek dɛn tif in masta in silva kɔp we i de drink wit, ɛn de tek luk grɔn. I fɔ tɛl dɛn se dɛn dɔn du bad bad tin.
We di wokman rich dɛn, i tɛl dɛn jɛs wetin Josɛf se.
Dɛn aks am wetin mek i de tɔk to dɛn so. Dɛn se dɛn nɔ ɔndastand. Dɛn swɛ se dɛn nɔ go du da kayn tin de.
Dɛn se dɛn no se we dɛn bin fɛn mɔni na dɛn bag dɛn, dɛn bin kɛr am go bak. Dɛn se wetin mek dɛn go kam tif silva ɔ gold naw nain masta in os.
Dɛn, if i fɛn di kɔp wit ɛniwan pan dɛn, dɛn fɔ dɛn kil da pɔsin de, dɔn dɛn ɔl go bi in masta in slev dɛn.
Di wokman se ɔrayt; bɔt dat na di wan nɔmɔ we tek di kɔp go bi in masta in slev, dɔn dɛn kin go.
Dɛn mekes put dɛn bag dɛn dɔŋ na grɔn ɛn bigin opin dɛn wan bay wan.
Josɛf in wokman bigin sach frɔm di big wan in bag sote rich to di smɔl wan, ɛn i fɛn di kɔp na Bɛnjamin in bag.
We dis bi, di brɔda dɛn chɛr chɛr dɛn klos fɔ sho se dɛn fil am bad. Dɛn lod dɛn dɔŋki dɛn bak ɛn tɔn bak go na di siti.
Josɛf bin stil de na os we Juda ɛn in brɔda dɛn kam. Dɛn lidɔm na grɔn bifo am.
Josɛf aks dɛn wetin mek dɛn tif in kɔp. I se if dɛn nɔ no se bigman lɛkɛ am kin luk grɔn fɔ no udat tek am.

Juda ansa se dɛn nɔ gɛt ɛnitin fɔ se. I se natin nɔ de we dɛn go du fɔ sho se dɛn nɔ tif in kɔp. I se na PAPA GƆD de pɔnish dɛn fɔ di bad dɛn we dɛn dɔn du. I se dɛn ɔl dɔn tɔn bak fɔ bi in slev dɛn, nɔto di wan nɔmɔ we dɛn fɛn di kɔp to.
Na de Josɛf se, nɔ in nɔ go du da! Na di wan nɔmɔ we dɛn fɛn di kɔp to go bi in slev. I tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn go bak saful wan to dɛn papa.
Juda go mit Josɛf ɛn beg am mek i gi am chans fɔ tɔk to am. I se duya, mek i nɔ vɛks pan am, lɛ i bia am bikɔs in na lɛkɛ di kiŋ insɛf to am.
I se i bin aks am if dɛn gɛt papa ɛn smɔl brɔda.

Dɛn tɛl am se dɛn gɛt ɛn se dɛn papa na olpa naw ɛn i bin bɔn da dɛn smɔl brɔda de we i bin dɔn ol. I se di bɔbɔ in wan mami brɔda bin dɔn day, so nain wangren dɔn lɛf pan in mama in pikin dɛn; in papa lɛk am bad bad wan.
I se in bin tɛl dɛn fɔ briŋ am kam mek i kam si am.
Dɛn bin ansa am se di bɔbɔ nɔ fɔ kɔmɔt nia in papa, ɔ nɔ so in papa go day.
Nain i se, i nɔ go gri mek dɛn si am igen pas dɛn briŋ dɛn smɔl brɔda kam.
We dɛn go bak to dɛn papa dɛn bin tɛl am wetin i se.
Bɔt dɛn papa tɛl dɛn fɔ kam bak kam bay smɔl mɔ it.
So dɛn ansa am se, dɛn nɔ go pas dɛn briŋ dɛn smɔl brɔda kam wit dɛn. I se dɛn tɛl am se di man nɔ go gri mek dɛn si am igen pas dɛn kam wit dɛn brɔda.
Bɔt dɛn papa tɛl dɛn se, dɛn no se in wɛf bin bɔn tu bɔypikin dɛn fɔ am.
Wan dɔn go lɛf am ɛn na wayl animal go dɔn chɛr chɛr am, bikɔs i nɔ si am igen frɔm we i go.
So, if dɛn tek da wande naw nain an ɛn sɔntin go apin to am, na da sɔri de go de pan am te i day go Shiol lɛkɛ aw i dɔn ol so.
So Juda beg Josɛf se in nɔ go ebul go bak to in papa if i nɔ kɛr di bɔbɔ go bikɔs i tan lɛkɛ dɛn ɔl tu layf na wan.
If in papa si se di bɔbɔ nɔ de wit am, i go jɛs fɔdɔm day: da tɛm de dɛn go se na dɛn kil am wit brok at lɛkɛ we i dɔn ol so.
I se in di Juda bin dɔn le in layf dɔŋ se in go go bak wit di bɔbɔ, ɛn se if i nɔ go bak wit am, in rɛdi fɔ tek di blem te i day.
So i beg Josɛf fɔ mek in bi di slev, lɛ di bɔbɔ in go bak wit in brɔda dɛn. Juda se in go tap de mek i tek di bɔbɔ in ples ɛn bi Josɛf in slev; bɔt beg lɛ di bɔbɔ go bak wit in brɔda dɛn.
I aks aw in go go bak to in papa if di bɔbɔ nɔ go wit am. I se in nɔ go want fɔ si wetin go bi to in papa.
Josɛf nɔ bin ebul kɔntrol insɛf igen bifo in wokman dɛn, so i tɛl dɛn ɔl fɔ jɛs go na do saful. I nɔ bin want ɔda pɔsin fɔ de de we i de tɛl in brɔda dɛn udat i bi.
I kray lawd lawd wan. Di Ijipshian dɛn yɛri, so dɛn kɛr di nyuz go na di kiŋ in os.
I tɛl in brɔda dɛn se in na Josɛf ɛn aks if in papa de te naw. In brɔda dɛn so skyad dat dɛn tɔn mumu wantɛm. Dɛn nɔ ebul biliv se nain tinap bifo dɛn korokoro wan so.
Josɛf kɔl dɛn fɔ go nia am. We dɛn go nia am, i tɛl dɛn se in na dɛn brɔda Josɛf, we dɛn bin sɛl gi dɛn Ijipshian dɛn.
I se lɛ dɛn nɔ fil bad ɛn lɛ dɛn nɔ blem dɛnsɛf bikɔs na PAPA GƆD du am so. I se, PAPA GƆD sɛn am go bifo dɛn fɔ mek de lɛkɛ da de de bɔku pipul nɔ go day.
I se na tu ia nɔmɔ di aŋri dɔn de fɔ, ɛn i gɛt fɔ de fayv mɔ ia we pipul nɔ go ebul fɔ mak fam ɛn avɛst ɛnitin.
I se PAPA GƆD sɛn am go bifo dɛn so dat dɛn ɛn dɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛn nɔ go day.
I se na PAPA GƆD sɛn am go de, nɔto dɛn, ɛn ɔl di kiŋ in biznɛs nain os de nain an. Infakt PAPA GƆD dɔn mek i bi bigman pas ɔlman na Ijipt pas di kiŋ nɔmɔ.
So i tɛl dɛn mek dɛn mekes go tɛl in papa se, in se, PAPA GƆD dɔn mek i bi di bigman pas ɔlman na Ijipt; so mek i mekes kam mit am de.
I se in papa fɔ kam tap na di siti we nem Goshɛn so i go de nia am. I fɔ kam wit in pikin ɛn grampikin dɛn, in ship, got, ɛn ɔl wetin i gɛt.
I se dɛn fɔ tɛl am se, di aŋri gɛt fɔ de fɔ fayv ia mɔ. So i fɔ mek kam mek in fambul dɛn ɛn ɔl udat de wit am nɔ sɔfa.
Josɛf bin tɛl dɛn igen se, dɛn ɔl wit Bɛnjamin insɛf dɔn si fɔ tru tru se in we de tɔk to dɛn so na Josɛf.
I se dɛn fɔ tɛl in papa bɔt di pawa we i gɛt na Ijipt. Dɛn fɔ tɛl am bɔt ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn si, mek i mekes kam na Ijipt.
I grip in brɔda Bɛnjamin ɛn dɛn tu bɔskray wit gladi.
Dɛn i kis in brɔda dɛn wan bay wan. Na so i de kray wit gladi. Afta dat, in brɔda dɛn fil fri fɔ tɔk to am.
We di nyuz rich di kiŋ se Josɛf in brɔda dɛn dɔn kam, di kiŋ ɛn in ɔfisa dɛn ɔl gladi.
Di kiŋ tɛl Josɛf se mek i tɛl in brɔda dɛn mek dɛn lod dɛn animal ɛn mek dɛn go kwik na Kenan,
ɛn lɛ dɛn tek dɛn papa ɛn ɔl dɛn fambul dɛn mek dɛn tɔn bak kam na Ijipt. I se in go gi dɛn di say we fayn pas ɔl na Ijipt ɛn dɛn go gɛt bɔku gud tin fɔ it.
I tɛl am igen se mek dɛn go wit wagɔn dɛn frɔm Ijipt we dɛn go put dɛn wɛf ɛn di smɔl pikin dɛn ɛn fɔ dɛn papa fɔ briŋ dɛn kam.
I se lɛ dɛn nɔ wɔri bɔt dɛn prɔpati we dɛn de lɛf biɛn, di ples we fayn pas ɔl na Ijipt go bi dɛn yon.
Izrɛl in pikin dɛn bin du wetin di kiŋ se, Josɛf gi dɛn di wagɔn dɛn, lɛkɛ aw di kiŋ bin se, ɛn it fɔ di patrol.
I gi dɛn ɔl nyu klos, bɔt i gi Bɛnjamin tri ɔndrɛd silva kɔpɔ ɛn fayv sɛt nyu klos.
I sɛn tɛn dɔŋki we lod wit fayn Ijipt it to in papa, ɛn tɛn dɔŋki lod wit it lɛkɛ bred, tin fɔ mek pap, ɛn ɔda af af tin dɛn we i go it na rod we i de kam.
I sɛn in brɔda dɛn go; ɛn we dɛn de go, i tɛl dɛn mek dɛn nɔ mek plaba na rod.
Dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt ɛn go bak to dɛn papa Jekɔb na Kenan.
Dɛn tɛl dɛn papa se Josɛf de ɛn i nɔ day yet. In na big bigman na Ijipt. We Jekɔb yɛri dis in mɔt ful ɛn i nɔ bin biliv wetin dɛn se.
Bɔt we dɛn gi am ɔl Josɛf in mɛsej, ɛn we i si di wagɔn dɛn wit it we Josɛf sɛn, in at kam dɔŋ.
I se, in biliv fɔ tru tru se in pikin Josɛf nɔ day yet ɛn in fɔ go si am bifo i day.
So Izrɛl pak ɔl in prɔpati dɛn fɔ go na Ijipt. We i de na rod de go as i rich na Biashiba, i mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD we nain papa Ayzak in PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to am da nɛt de na vishɔn. I kɔl am “Jekɔb, Jekɔb!” Dɛn Jekɔb ansa se, “Yɛs sa.”
Nain PAPA GƆD se, “Mi na PAPA GƆD, yu papa in PAPA GƆD. Nɔ fred fɔ go dɔŋ na Ijipt. A go mek yu jɛnareshɔn bi big big neshɔn de.
A go go Ijipt wit yu ɛn a mɔs briŋ yu jɛnareshɔn kam bak na ya. Yu go day na Ijipt ɛn Josɛf go de nia yu we yu de day.”
Jekɔb kɔmɔt na Biashiba. In bɔypikin dɛn put in ɛn dɛn smɔl pikin dɛn ɛn dɛn wɛf dɛn na di wagɔn dɛn we di kiŋ na Ijipt gi dɛn.
Dɛn tek ɔl dɛn animal ɛn di prɔpati we dɛn bin dɔn gɛt na Kenan go wit dɛn na Ijipt. Jekɔb bin kɛr ɔl in fambul dɛn go wit am.
I kɛr in bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn we go na Ijipt wit am na bin in fɔs-bɔy-pikin Rubɛn.
Rubɛn ɛn in yon bɔypikin dɛn we na Anɔk, Palu, Ɛzrɔn ɛn Kami.
Simiɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn we na Jɛmuɛl, Jamin, Oad, Jakin, Zoa, ɛn Shaul di bɔypikin we wan Kenanayt uman bɔn fɔ am.
Livay ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn we na Gashɔn, Koath ɛn Mɛrari.
Juda ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn we na Shela, Pɛrɛz, ɛn Zɛra. Juda in ɔda bɔypikin dɛn Ɛr ɛn Onan, bin dɔn day na Kenan. Pɛrɛz ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn we na Ɛzrɔn ɛn Amul.
Isaka ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn we na Tola, Puva, Job, ɛn Shimrɔn.
Zɛbyulɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn we na Sɛrɛd, Ɛlɔn, ɛn Jalil.
Na Lia in bɔypikin dɛn dis we in bin bɔn fɔ Jekɔb na Padan Aram, ɛn i gɛt gyal pikin we nem Dayna. Ɔl ɛn ɔl, Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn to Lia in yon say na bin tati-tri.
Gad ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn we na Zɛfɔn, Agi, Shuni, Ɛzbɔn, Ɛri, Arɔdi, ɛn Arɛli.
Asha ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn we na Imna, Ishva, Ishvi, Bɛria ɛn dɛn sista Sera. Bɛria in bɔypikin dɛn na Eba, ɛn Malkiɛl.
Dɛn sikstin pikin dɛn ya kɔmɔt to Zilpa, di savant-gyal we Leban bin gi to in gyal pikin Lia.
Jekɔb in wɛf Rechɛl bin bɔn tu bɔypikin nɔmɔ we na Josɛf ɛn Bɛnjamin.

We Josɛf de na Ijipt, i bɔn tu bɔypikin dɛn we nem Manasɛ ɛn Ifrem. Dɛn mama na bin Asɛnath we in papa na bin di man we de tɔk to PAPA GƆD fɔ di pipul dɛn. In papa nem Pɔtifɛra ɛn i bin tap na Ɛliopolis.
Bɛnjamin in yon bɔypikin dɛn na Bɛla, Bɛka, Ashbɛl, Gɛra, Neman, Ei, Rosh, Mupim, Upim, ɛn Ad.
Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn to Rechɛl in yon say na bin fotin.
Dan ɛn in bɔypikin we na Ushim.
Naftali ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn we na: Jazil, Guni, Jɛzɛr ɛn Shilɛm.
Dɛn sɛvin pikin ya kɔmɔt to Bila di savant-gyal we Leban bin gi in gyal pikin Rechɛl.
Izrɛl we bin go Ijipt na siksti-siks; in dɔtɛnlɔ dɛn nɔ miks pan da nɔmba de.
Josɛf in tu bɔypikin dɛn we i bɔn na Ijipt mek dɛn rich sɛvinti pan Izrɛl we bin go de na Ijipt.
Nain Jekɔb sɛn Juda go bifo go Josɛf fɔ mit dɛn na Goshɛn. Bay di tɛm we dɛn rich na di eria we Goshɛn de,
Josɛf dɔn rɛdi in ɔs ɛn karej ɛn go de go mit in dadi Izrɛl. As Josɛf rich to in dadi so, i grip am ɛn kray fɔ lɔŋ pan am wit gladi.
Izrɛl tɛl Josɛf se, naw in kin day, wans i dɔn si am wit in tu bɔlyay se i de ɛn i nɔ day yet.
Josɛf tɛl in brɔda dɛn ɛn ɔlman we tap wit in dadi se i de go tɔk to di kiŋ ɛn tɛl am se, in brɔda dɛn ɛn ɔlman we bin tap wit in dadi, na Kenan dɔn kam to am.
I tɛl dɛn se, in go tɛl am se dɛn na man we de mɛn ship ɛn ɔda animal dɛn, ɛn dɛn kam wit dɛn animal ya we dɛn de mɛn: wit ɔl wetin dɛn gɛt.
So we di kiŋ kɔl dɛn ɛn aks dɛn uskayn wok dɛn de du,
dɛn fɔ ansa am se dɛn dɔn de mɛn animal frɔm we dɛn smɔl jɛs lɛkɛ aw dɛn dadi dɛn bin de du. Da tɛm de, i go gri fɔ mek dɛn tap na Goshɛn, bikɔs di Ijipshian dɛn nɔ lɛk ɛnibɔdi we de mɛn ship.
Josɛf go to di kiŋ ɛn tɛl am se, in papa ɛn in brɔda dɛn dɔn kɔmɔt Kenan wit ɔl dɛn animal dɛn ɛn ɔl wetin dɛn gɛt. I se dɛn tap na Goshɛn.
I sho fayv pan in brɔda dɛn to di kiŋ.
Di kiŋ aks dɛn uskayn wok dɛn de du. Dɛn ansa am se, dɛn na man dɛn we de mɛn ship jɛs lɛkɛ dɛn papa dɛn.
Dɛn se dɛn dɔn kam fɔ tap na dis kɔntri, bikɔs dɛn kɔntri Kenan nɔ gɛt it fɔ dɛn animal dɛn ɛn di aŋri dɔn pasmak de. So, dɛn beg se lɛ dɛn tap na Goshɛn.
Na de di kiŋ tɛl Josɛf se, as in papa ɛn in brɔda dɛn dɔn kam,
Ijipt na dɛn yon. I se lɛ dɛn pik ɛnisay fɔ tap ɛn lɛ Josɛf gi dɛn di bɛst say na di kɔntri. I se Goshɛn nɔto bad ples fɔ tap ɛn if ɛniwan pan dɛn sabi di wok mek i ɛp in mɛn in yon animal dɛn.
Na da tɛm de Josɛf kɛr in papa, Jekɔb go sho am to di kiŋ. Jekɔb blɛs di kiŋ,
ɛn di kiŋ aks am ɔmɔs ia i ol Jekɔb ansa se,
in dɔn de fɔ wan ɔndrɛd ɛn tati ia ɛn di tin dɛn we in yay dɔn si, i nɔ smɔl. Ɛn i nɔ rich in pipul dɛn ej yet.
Jekɔb blɛs di kiŋ bak ɛn se gudbay.
Dɔn Josɛf mek in papa ɛn in brɔda dɛn tap na Ijipt, ɛn i gi dɛn di bɛst land we na di land na Ramisis distrikt, lɛkɛ aw di kiŋ bin se.
Josɛf gi in papa, in brɔda dɛn ɛn ɔl in papa in fambul dɛn it lɛkɛ aw dɛn tap na os.
Bay dis tɛm, di aŋri bin so traŋa ɛn it nɔ bin de. Dat mek di pipul dɛn na Ijipt ɛn Kenan wik.
Josɛf bin gɛda ɔl di mɔni we de na Ijipt ɛn Kenan as i bin de sɛl it gi di pipul dɛn, ɛn put dis mɔni ya na di kiŋ in os.
We di pipul dɛn na Ijipt ɛn Kenan dɛn kɔpɔ dɔn, dɛn kin kam na Ijipt to Josɛf ɛn tɛl am se, lɛ i gi dɛn it, lɛ i nɔ mek dɛn day bifo in yay. Dɛn se ɔl dɛn kɔpɔ dɔn dɔn.
Josɛf ansa dɛn se, lɛ dɛn briŋ dɛn animal dɛn kam, in go gi dɛn it if dɛn kɔpɔ dɔn.
So dɛn briŋ dɛn animal dɛn kam to Josɛf; dɛn ɔs, ship, got, kaw ɛn dɔŋki dɛn. Dɔn i gi dɛn it. Na dat mek dɛn nɔ day da ia de.
Di ɔda ia dɛn kam bak, ɛn beg am se, dɛn nɔ go ayd tru pan am, ɔl dɛn kɔpɔ dɔn dɔn ɛn dɛn animal dɛn ɔl de nain an. Natin nɔ lɛf pas dɛn bɔdi ɛn dɛn land.

Dɛn beg am se duya, lɛ i du sɔntin fɔ dɛn. Lɛ i nɔ mek dɛn day ɛn lɛ dɛn fam dɛn lɛf ɛmti wan. Dɛn se lɛ i bay dɛn ɛn dɛn land dɛn bɔt lɛ i gi dɛn it fɔ it. Dɛn se dɛn go bi di kiŋ in slev ɛn in go gɛt dɛn ɛn dɛn land. Dɛn beg am lɛ i gi dɛn it we go mek dɛn nɔ day, ɛn sid fɔ plant na dɛn fam.
Josɛf bin bay ɔl di land na Ijipt fɔ di kiŋ. Ɔlman na Ijipt bin gɛt fɔ sɛl dɛn land, bikɔs di aŋri bin dɔn traŋa. Na so ɔl di land dɛn tɔn di kiŋ in prɔpati.
Dat mek di pipul dɛn ɔl bi slev to di kiŋ na di wanol Ijipt.
Di land dɛn nɔmɔ we i nɔ tek na di wan dɛn we dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ di pipul dɛn gɛt, bikɔs di kiŋ bin mek shɔ se dɛn de gɛt it, so dɛn nɔ bin gɛt fɔ sɛl dɛn land.
Josɛf tɛl di pipul dɛn se in dɔn bay dɛn ɛn dɛn land dɛn fɔ di kiŋ. So i de gi dɛn sid naw fɔ plant na dɛn fam.
We di tɛm rich fɔ avɛst wetin dɛn plant, dɛn fɔ sheb am fayv pat ɛn wan pat go bi di kiŋ in yon. Di wan we lɛf dɛn go kip sɔm fɔ plant ɛn yuz di balans fɔ dɛnsɛf ɛn dɛn fambul dɛn.
Dɛn ansa se i dɔn sev dɛn layf; lɛ dɛnsɛf nɔ pruv ɔngretful to am. Dɛn se dɛn gri fɔ bi di kiŋ in slev dɛn.

So Josɛf pas lɔ bɔt land biznɛs na Ijipt we de te tide. Di lɔ se ɔlman fɔ sheb in avɛst fayv pat ɛn wan pat fɔ go to di kiŋ. Bɔt bikɔs di kiŋ nɔ bin tek di man dɛn we de tɔk to PAPA GƆD fɔ dɛn, dɛn nɔ bin gɛt fɔ pe ɛn taks land.
So di Izrɛlayt dɛn kam tap na Goshɛn insay Ijipt. We dɛn de de dɛn gɛt bɔku bɔku prɔpati ɛn pikin dɛn.
So Jekɔb bin de Ijipt fɔ sɛvintin ia. I ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fɔti sɛvin ia we i day.
Wɛn Jekɔb bin no se i wan day, i sɛn kɔl in bɔypikin Josɛf ɛn se if i no se i lɛk am fɔ tru tru, put lɛ Josɛf put in an midul in di Jekɔb in lɛg ɛn swɛ se i nɔ go bɛr am insay Ijipt.
Ɛn i day in di Josɛf go tek in dedebɔdi kɔmɔt na Ijipt go bɛr am wit in yon pipul dɛn. Josɛf se in go du wetin i se.
Jekɔb pin se Josɛf fɔ swɛ, so Josɛf insɛf swɛ. We i dɔn, Jekɔb baw in ed na di bed ed ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD.
I nɔ tu te igen, dɛn tɛl Josɛf se in papa sik bad, so i go fɛn am wit in tu bɔypikin dɛn, Manasɛ ɛn Ifrem.
We dɛn tɛl Jekɔb se in pikin Josɛf dɔn kam fɛn am, i olɔp insɛf ɛn sidɔm tret wan na di bed.
Jekɔb tɛl Josɛf se PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti bin apia to am na Luz insay Kenan ɛn i blɛs am.
I se i tɛl mi se i go mek in jɛnareshɔn bɔku ɛn Kenan go bi dɛn yon sote go.
Jekɔb tɛl Josɛf bak se in tu bɔypikin dɛn, we Josɛf bɔn na Ijipt bifo in di Jekɔb kam na Ijipt nain di Jekɔb yon. I se Ifrem ɛn Manasɛ nain pikin dɛn lɛkɛ aw Rubɛn ɛn Simiɔn nain pikin dɛn.
Josɛf, yu tu bɔypikin dɛn, we yu bɔn na Ijipt bifo a kam ya, na mi yon. Ifrem ɛn Manasɛ na mi pikin dɛn lɛkɛ aw Rubɛn ɛn Simiɔn na mi pikin dɛn.

I se wɛn a bin de kɔmɔt na Padan Aram de go na Kenan, Rechɛl day nain an na rod. I se dɛn nɔ bin de tu fa frɔm Ifrath we dis bi so i bɛr am kɔnasay na di rod de. (Ifrath in nem naw na Bɛtliɛm.) I se in fil am bad.
We Jekɔb si Josɛf in tu bɔbɔ dɛn, i aks udat dɛn bi.
Josɛf tɛl am se dɛn nain bɔypikin dɛn, we PAPA GƆD gi am na Ijipt. Jekɔb se lɛ Josɛf kɛr dɛn go nia am mek i blɛs dɛn
Jekɔb nɔ bin de si bɛtɛ igen bikɔs i bin dɔn ol. Josɛf kɛr di pikin dɛn go nia am, dɔn Jekɔb put in an dɛn rawnd dɛn ɛn i kis dɛn.
Jekɔb tɛl Josɛf se, i nɔ bin tink se a go si am igen wit in tu bɔl yay ɛn naw PAPA GƆD dɔn mek i si in pikin dɛnsɛf.
Josɛf tek di pikin dɛn na Jekɔb in lap, dɔn i baw rayt dɔŋ.
Josɛf mek shɔ se i put Ifrem na Jekɔb in lɛfan dɔn i put Manasɛ na Jekɔb in raytan.
Bɔt Jekɔb krɔs in an dɛn, ɛn put in raytan na Ifrem in ed, pan ɔl we nain smɔl, dɛn i put in lɛfan na Manasɛ in ed, we na di big wan.
Dɔn i blɛs Josɛf. I se, “Mek PAPA GƆD, we mi papa dɛn Ebraam ɛn Ayzak bin de sav, di PAPA GƆD we dɔn de wit mi ɔl dis tɛm ya,
mek di enjɛl we dɔn pul mi pan ɔl mi trɔbul, blɛs dɛn pikin ya so! Mek pipul dɛn mɛmba mi nem, mi papa Ayzak ɛn mi grampa Ebraam dɛn nem sote go! Mek dɛn jɛnareshɔn bɔku na dis wɔl!”
Josɛf bin fil bad we i si se in papa put in raytan na Ifrem in ed; i tray fɔ pul in papa in an na Ifrem in ed ɛn put am na Manasɛ in ed.
I tɛl in papa se, nɔto so i fɔ du, na Manasɛ na di big wan; so lɛ i put in raytan nain ed.

In papa nɔ gri, i se, in no. Bɔt Manasɛ in yon jɛnareshɔn sɛf go bɔku ɛn dɛnsɛf go bi bigman na di kɔntri. Bɔt in smɔl brɔda in yon jɛnareshɔn go bɔku pas am, ɛn bi big big neshɔn. I go bi bigman pas in brɔda.
So i blɛs dɛn da de de. I se, “Di Izrɛlayt dɛn go yuz una nem dɛn we dɛn de gi blɛsin. Dɛn go se lɛ PAPA GƆD mek yu tan lɛkɛ Ifrem ɛn Manasɛ.” So Jekɔb put Ifrem bifo Manasɛ.
Dɛn Jekɔb tɛl Josɛf se, na day in de day so, bɔt PAPA GƆD go de wit yu ɛn i go kɛr am go bak na di land usay in pipul dɛn kɔmɔt.
I se in a de gi Josɛf wan mɔ land pas in brɔda dɛn. Dat na di land we gɛt il we i tek to dɛn Amɔrayt dɛn di tɛm we i bin fɛt dɛn wit in bo ɛn aro. I gi Josɛf da land de.
Jekɔb bin kɔl ɔl in bɔypikin dɛn, ɛn i se, “Una kam rawnd mi mek a tɛl una wetin go gɛt fɔ apin to una bambay:
“Mi pikin dɛn, una kam lisin, Una lisin to wetin una papa Izrɛl gɛt fɔ se.
“Rubɛn, yu na mi fɔs-bɔy-pikin, yu sho se mi na man ɛn a bɔn yu we a yɔŋ. Yu pas yu kɔmpin dɛn bay yu pozishɔn ɛn pawa.
Bɔt ɔl dis go dɔn. Yu go tan lɛkɛ wata na di si we nɔ de ɔnda kɔntrol, Bikɔs yu lidɔm wit mi uman ɛn briŋ shem pan mi.
“Simiɔn ɛn Livay dɛn na ‘Tatu ɛn Yawa’ dɛn kin yuz dɛn sɔd dɛn fɔ du bad.
A nɔ go miks pan dɛn wikɛdnɛs bikɔs dɛn dɔn kil pipul dɛn we dɛn vɛks ɛn dɛn kin ɛnjɔy fɔ brok dɛn man kaw dɛn fut.
Swɛ go de pan dɛn bikɔs dɛn vɛks wan nɔ gud fɔ si. A go mek dɛn jɛnareshɔn skata ɔlsay na Izrɛl ɛn dɛn nɔ go tap bay dɛnsɛf.
“Juda, yu brɔda dɛn go prez yu. Yu go bit yu ɛnimi dɛn. Yu brɔda dɛn go baw to yu.
Juda, yu tan lɛkɛ yɔŋ layɔn, we dɔn kil ɛn it dɔn. Lɛkɛ layɔn nɔmɔ yu butu ɛn lidɔm Lɛkɛ uman layɔn, nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛt maynd fɔ ambɔg am.
Juda, kiŋ wok nɔ go kɔmɔt biɛn yu, yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn go rul te rich to di wan we mek dɛn bi kiŋ. Ɔl di ɔda neshɔn dɛn go obe am.
I go tay in dɔŋki pan greps tik, ɛn in yɔŋ dɔŋki pan di fayn greps tik. I go tek wayn was in klos bikɔs di wayn we kɔmɔt de pan di greps tik go so bɔku.
In yay go rɛd pas wayn. In tit go wayt pas milk.
“Zɛbyulɔn go tap na waf. Ɔl dɛn big ship dɛn go slam de. Ɛn in bɔda go de te rich Saydɔn.
“Isaka tan lɛkɛ dɔŋki we gɛt trɛnk ɛn i kin lidɔm de blo wit bɔku lod nain bak.
I si se di ples we i lidɔm de blo fayn. Ɛn di grɔn de mek i fil fayn. I go bɛn in bak fɔ tot mɔ lod; ɛn go gri mek i tɔn slev fɔ tot lod ɔltɛm.
“Dan insɛf go bi rula fɔ in pipul dɛn lɛkɛ di ɔda fambul dɛn na Izrɛl.
Dan go tan lɛkɛ snek kɔna say na rod, lɛkɛ snek we gɛt pɔyzin ɛn lidɔm na bush rod, i go bɛt di ɔs in bak fut, dɔn di wan we go de rayd am go fɔdɔm wit in bak.
“E papa PAPA GƆD, a de wet fɔ mek yu pul mi kɔmɔt pan waala!
“Tif man dɛn go atak Gad bɔt i go ebul dɛn ɛn rɔnata dɛn.
“Asha in grɔn go pul gud it. Di it dɛn so go fayn, kiŋ dɛn go lɛk dɛn.
“Naftali tan lɛkɛ uman dia we de rɔn fri wan ɛn de bɔn fayn pikin dɛn.
“Josɛf na tik we de bia bɔku frut, na tik we de nia usay wata de bɔs na grɔn. In branch dɛn kin klem oba wɔl.
In ɛnimi dɛn atak am, traŋa wan ɛn dɛn shut dɛn bo ɛn aro pan am ɛn mɔna am.
Bɔt in yon bo tinap stɛdi wan. I tan lɛkɛ se in yon an dɛn traŋa pasmak, bikɔs na Jekɔb in GƆD, di GƆD Ɔlmayti de gi am di trɛnk we na lɛkɛ di man we de mɛn ship ɛn nain de kɔba Izrɛl.
Mek yu papa dɛn GƆD ɛp yu. Mek GƆD Ɔlmayti blɛs yu wit blɛsin we kɔmɔt na ɛvin ɛn blɛsin we kɔmɔt ɔnda, ɛvin ɛn mek yu gɛt di blɛsin we go mek yu mɛn plɛnti animal ɛn plɛnti pikin dɛn.
Di blɛsin we mi bin dɔn gɛt pas di gud tin dɛn we kin kɔmɔt na di mawnten. Mek dɛn blɛsin ya de pantap Josɛf in ed, Josɛf we nɔ gro wit in brɔda dɛn.
“Bɛnjamin tan lɛkɛ bad bad wulf we de kil ɛn pwɛl in ɛnimi na mɔnin dɔn ivintɛm i de sheb wetin i kil.”
Dɛn wan ya mekɔp di twɛlv difrɛn fambul dɛn na Izrɛl ɛn dis na wetin dɛn papa Jekɔb bin tɛl dɛn wɛn i de blɛs dɛn. I gi ɔl man i yon spɛshal blɛsin.
Jekɔb tɛl dɛn se na day in de day so. So dɛn fɔ kɛr am go bɛr am usay dɛn bɛr in pipul dɛn na di kev we de na Ɛfrɔn da Itayt man in fil.
I se, di kev de na Makpila nia Mamrɛ na Kenan we Ebraam bin bay fɔ bɛrin grɔn wit di fil na Ɛfrɔn da Itayt man in an.
I se na de dɛn bɛr Ebraam ɛn in wɛf Sera; na de dɛn bɛr Ayzak ɛn in wɛf Ribɛka; ɛn na de i bɛr Lia.
I se dɛn bay di fil ɛn di kev na di Itayt dɛn an.
Wɛn Jekɔb dɔn tɛl in bɔypikin dɛn usay fɔ bɛr am, i drɔ in fut ɔp na di bed ɛn blo in las blo. Na so i day.
Josɛf lidɔm pan in papa. I kis am ɛn kray pan am.
Dɔn, i gi ɔda to di dɔkta dɛn we de wok fɔ am fɔ ɛmbam di bɔdi.
Di dɔkta dɛn tek fɔti de fɔ ɛmbam di bɔdi. Dɔn di Ijipshian dɛn tek sɛvinti de, de munin fɔ Jekɔb.
We di tɛm fɔ munin dɔn, Josɛf tɛl di kiŋ in bigman dɛn fɔ tɔk to di kiŋ fɔ am. I tɛl dɛn fɔ tɛl di kiŋ se
in papa bin mek i swɛ se, we i day ɛnitɛm, fɔ go bɛr am na di bɛrin grɔn usay dɛn bɛr in pipul dɛn na Kenan. I tɛl dɛn fɔ aks di kiŋ fɔ pamishɔn fɔ mek i go go bɛr in papa ɛn kam bak.
Di kiŋ gri fɔ mek i go bɛr in papa lɛkɛ aw i bin dɔn swɛ.
So ɔl di kiŋ in bigman dɛn ɛn ɔl dɛn ɔda wan dɛn we de bifo na di kot na Ijipt fala Josɛf go bɛr in papa.
In fambul dɛn, ɛn in brɔda dɛn ɔl bin go wit am. Na dɛn smɔl smɔl pikin dɛn nɔmɔ wit dɛn ship, got ɛn dɛn ɔda animal dɛn bin lɛf na Goshɛn.
Dɛn mek layn wit di ɔs ɛn ɔs ɛn karej dɛn. Bɔku pipul bin go di bɛrin.
We dɛn rich na wan ples we nem Atad nia Riva Jɔdan usay dɛn kin dray sid, dɛn kray bita bita wan ɛn mek bɛrin de fɔ sɛvin de.
We di Kenanayt dɛn si aw di pipul dɛn de kray na Atad, dɛn chenj di ples in nem ɛn kɔl am “Ebɛl Mizraim” bikɔs dɛn se “na di ples dis fɔ di Ijipshian dɛn fɔ kam kray ɛn mek bɛrin.”
Jekɔb in bɔypikin dɛn du wetin i bin tɛl dɛn fɔ du;
dɛn kɛr in dedebɔdi go na Kenan ɛn bɛr am na di kev we de na di fil na Makpila we de nia Mamrɛ, we Ebraam bin dɔn bay fɔ bɛrin grɔn na Ɛfrɔn da Itayt man in an.
We Josɛf dɔn bɛr in papa dɔn, in ɛn in brɔda dɛn ɛn ɔl di pipul we bin go di bɛrin tɔn bak go Ijipt.
