Ɔl di man pikin dɛn na Erɔn in fambul layn kin it pan am, dat na pan di ɔfrin we dɛn mek to PAPA GƆD na faya ɛn na so i fɔ bi na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn dɛn; ɛni ɔda pɔsin we tɔch dɛn go sɔfa fɔ dat
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
na di ɔfrin dis we Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn fɔ gi PAPA GƆD di de we dɛn pre pan ɛniwan: et kɔp fayn flawa fɔ bi di wan we i de gi ɔltɛm fɔ in sid ɔfrin. I fɔ gi af na mɔnin ɛn af ivintɛm.
I fɔ miks am wit ɔyl ɛn bek am na pɔt, jɛs lɛk aw dɛn de mek sid ɔfrin ɛn gi PAPA GƆD so dat i go pul fayn sɛnt we go mek i gladi.
Di pɔsin we dɛn dɔn pre pan se nain fɔ de afta am, go ɔfa am to PAPA GƆD lɛkɛ aw dɛn bin dɔn se fɔ bi; na wanol wan fɔ bɔn am.
Ɛni sid ɔfrin we di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin de mek, fɔ bɔn ɔltin. Nɔ fɔ it am.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,

i fɔ tɛl Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn wetin dɛn fɔ du we dɛn de mek sin ɔfrin. Na di ples we dɛn kin kil di animal fɔ di bɔn sakrifays, na de dɔn fɔ kil di wan fɔ sin ɔfrin insɛf, frɔnt PAPA GƆD; nain oli pas ɔltin.
Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we mek da sakrifays de fɔ it am, ɛn na di oli ples i go it am we nainsay di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in kɔmpawnd.
Ɛnibɔdi ɔ ɛnitin we tɔch am go sɔfa fɔ dat; ɛn if blɔd go pan di klos we i wɛr, fɔ was di klos we di blɔd go pan, na di tɛnt in kɔmpawnd.
Fɔ brok di kɔntri pɔt sɛf we dɛn bwɛl am; bɔt if na ayɛn pɔt dɛn bwɛl am, na fɔ krɔb am ɛn rench am wit wata.
Ɔl di man dɛn na Erɔn in fambul layn fɔ it pan am, nain oli pas ɔltin.
Bɔt if dɛn kɛr di blɔd go insay di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD so dat dɛn kin beg padin na di ples we oli, nɔ fɔ it pan am; na bɔn dɛn fɔ bɔn dɛn na faya.
Na di lɔ dɛn dis we pɔsin fɔ fala we i de mek ɔfrin fɔseka wetin i fɔ sɔfa. I oli pas ɔltin;
na di sem ples we dɛn bin kil di animal fɔ di bɔn sakrifays na de fɔ kil di wan we pɔsin de mek fɔseka wetin i fɔ sɔfa ɛn fɔ ib di blɔd rawnd di ɔlta.
Na fɔ gi ɔl in fat, di fat nain tel, di fat we kɔba di gɔt dɛn,
di tu kidni wit di fat we de pan dɛn bay di tel ɛn di af af we lɛf na di liva we yu dɔn pul di kidni dɛn;
di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de dyuti go bɔn ɔl na di ɔlta as sakrifays we dɛn mek na faya to PAPA GƆD; na ɔfrin we na fɔ udat fɔ sɔfa.
Ɔl di man dɛn we na man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ it pan am; na oli ples fɔ it am; i oli pas ɔl.
Dis ɔfrin ya tan lɛk di sin ɔfrin, na di sem lɔ dɛn gɛt; di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de dyuti, we de beg padin wit am fɔ gɛt am.
Igen, di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de dyuti fɔ tek di kanda pan di animal we i de gi fɔ pɔsin in bɔn sakrifays.
Ɛn igen nain fɔ gɛt ɔl di ɔfrin we dɛn bek, wɛda na pɔt ɔ na ovin.
If dɛn miks di sid ɔfrin wit ɔyl ɔ lɛf am dray wan, na ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ gɛt am ɛn dɛn fɔ sheb am lɛ i ikwal.
PAPA GƆD se we dɛn de mek pis ɔfrin bikɔs dɛn want wanwɔd wit PAPA GƆD, na dɛn tin ya dɛn fɔ du.

If i de du am bikɔs i wan fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki, dɛn i fɔ miks ɔyl wit kek we nɔ gɛt yist, wefa we insɛf nɔ gɛt yist bɔt we dɛn put ɔyl pan, ɛn ɔda kek we dɛn mek wit fayn flawa we dɛn miks gud wan wit ɔyl.
I fɔ kɛr di ɔfrin we na fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki wit di sakrifays fɔ in pis ɔfrin go wit bred we gɛt yist.
Pan dɛn ɔl, i fɔ pul wan wan we i go gi to PAPA GƆD; na di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, we de dyuti, we sprinkul di blɔd fɔ di pis ɔfrin go gɛt am.
Fɔ it di bif da sem de de we dɛn mek di ɔfrin, nɔ fɔ lɛf am te mɔnin.
Bɔt if i bawn fɔ ɔ jɛs fil fɔ mek di ɔfrin, i fɔ it am di sem de ɛn i kin it di wan we lɛf, di nɛks de mɔnin,
bɔt if i stil lɛf fɔ di tɔd de, i fɔ bɔn am na faya.

If pɔsin it di bif we lɛf pan di pis ɔfrin di tɔd de, PAPA GƆD nɔ go aksɛpt in sakrifays ɛn i bin fɔ bɛtɛ i nɔ wes in tɛm; bifo dat i de mek insɛf lɛk udat nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn i go gɛt fɔ bia wetin go apin.
If di bif we i de sakrifays tɔch tin we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, nɔ fɔ it am; na fɔ bɔn am na faya. Ɔl udat klin na PAPA GƆD yay kin it pan di bif,
bɔt if pɔsin it pan di bif wɛn i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, PAPA GƆD nɔ go kɔnt am as wan pan in pipul dɛn.

Ɛn if ɛnibɔdi tɔch tin we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, i kin bi mɔtalman ɔ animal ɔ ɛni ɔda tin we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, dɔn i kam it pan di bif we dɛn sakrifays to PAPA GƆD as pis ɔfrin, PAPA GƆD nɔ go kɔnt da pɔsin de as wan pan in pipul.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
i fɔ tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, dɛn nɔ fɔ it fat we kɔmɔt pan man kaw, ship ɔ got.
I se nɔ fɔ it animal we day fɔ insɛf in fat, ɔ di fat we kɔmɔt pan animal we dɛn wayl bif kil. Dɛn kin du ɔda tin wit am bɔt nɔ fɔ it am.
Ɛnibɔdi we it fat we kɔmɔt pan animal we dɛn sakrifays na faya to PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD nɔ go kɔnt am as wan pan in pipul.
Dɔn igen, nɔ fɔ it ɛnikayn blɔd wɛda na bɔd yon ɔ na animal yon, i lɛk usay dɛn de.
Ɛnibɔdi we it blɔd, PAPA GƆD nɔ go kɔnt insɛf as wan pan in pipul.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
i fɔ tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, if ɛnibɔdi de mek pis ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD, i fɔ gi am lɛk se na spɛshal prɛzɛnt i de gi PAPA GƆD;
nainsɛf fɔ gi PAPA GƆD as ɔfrin we i de mek na faya; i fɔ kɛr di animal in fat wit di chɛst, ɛn i go wev am as spɛshal prɛzɛnt to PAPA GƆD.
Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de dyuti go bɔn di fat na di ɔlta bɔt di chɛst go bi fɔ Erɔn ɛn in fambul dɛn.
Fɔ gi di rayt lɛg to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin as in yon prɛzɛnt pan di pis ɔfrin.
Na di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, we de dyuti, we gi di blɔd frɔm di pis ɔfrin ɛn di fat go gɛt di rayt lɛg as prɛzɛnt.
Di chɛst we dɛn wev ɛn di lɛg we dɛn gi, PAPA GƆD tek am na di pipul dɛn an ɛn gi dɛn to di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. Na dɛn fɔ de gɛt dɛn pat dɛn de sote go.
Na di tin dɛn dis we fɔ bi fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin pan di ɔfrin dɛn we dɛn mek na faya to PAPA GƆD, frɔm di tɛm we dɛn pre pan dɛn na so i fɔ bi;
na so PAPA GƆD dɔn se i fɔ bi fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn, frɔm di tɛm we dɛn mek dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, nain PAPA GƆD dɔn mek i bi so ɛn na so i fɔ bi ɔltɛm na di jɛnareshɔn.

Na di lɔ dɛn dis we fɔ fala we pɔsin de mek bɔn ɔfrin, sid ɔfrin, sin ɔfrin, ɔfrin we na fɔseka wetin i fɔ sɔfa, di ɔfrin we dɛn man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ mek di de we dɛn de pre pan dɛn, ɛn di ɔfrin we pɔsin de mek if i want gɛt wanwɔd wit PAPA GƆD;
we PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis we i bin de na Mawnt Saynay, di de we i se di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ de gi PAPA GƆD dɛn ɔfrin.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
mek i tek Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn wit dɛn klos dɛn, ɛn di ɔyl we fɔ yuz fɔ anɔynt dɛn, ɛn di man kaw fɔ di sin ɔfrin, ɛn tu man ship wit wan blay ful wit bred we nɔ gɛt yist;
ɛn kɔl ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ go na di domɔt na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD.
Mozis du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ du; ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn gɛda na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt.
We dɛn ɔl dɔn gɛda, i tɛl dɛn se na wetin PAPA GƆD se fɔ du dɛn de kam du so.
Dɛn i mek Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn tinap frɔnt ɔlman ɛn mek lɛk dɛn de was dɛnsɛf.
I wɛr wan vɛst pan Erɔn ɛn put sɔm brɔd band rawnd in wes, dɔn i wɛr gawn pan am ɛn put di ifɔd pan am, dɔn i tay wan ɔda kayn bɛlt pan am we dɛn mek wit di sem matirial we dɛn tek mek di ifɔd.
I put di pawch we na pɔkit insay di gawn we nainsay de dɛn gɛt fɔ put di Yurim ɛn Thumim
Dɔn i wɛr tɔban nain ed ɛn pan di tɔban, dɛn put wan shayn tin we flat lɛk plet fɔ sho se in na pɔsin we dɛn dɔn gi to PAPA GƆD fɔ wok. Na so PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se fɔ du.
Dɛn Mozis tek di ɔyl we fɔ anɔynt, anɔynt di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD wit ɔl wetin de de ɛn pre pan dɛn.

Ɛn i sprinkul sɔm pan di ɔyl pan di ɔlta sɛvin tɛm, dat na di tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz ɛn di besin wit in bes we de midul di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD, ɛn di ɔlta, so dat i kin sho se na PAPA GƆD gɛt dɛn.
I tɔn sɔm pan di ɔyl sɛf na Erɔn in ed fɔ sho se na PAPA GƆD gɛt insɛf.
Dɔn Mozis mek Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛn go tinap bifo ɛn i wɛr vɛst dɛn pan dɛn ɛn put sɔm brɔd band rawnd dɛn wes dɛn, dɔn i wɛr kyap dɛn pan dɛn jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis.
Dɔn igen, i mek dɛn briŋ di man kaw fɔ di sin ɔfrin kam; ɛn Erɔn wit in bɔypikin dɛn le dɛn an dɛn pantap di man kaw.

Mozis kil am ɛn tek sɔm pan di blɔd wit in fiŋa ɛn put am pan di ɔn dɛn rawnd di ɔlta ɛn tɔn di balans blɔd na di bɔtɔm pat na di ɔlta fɔ sho se i dɔn pul di sin kɔmɔt de ɛn dɔn mek i fit fɔ de beg PAPA GƆD padin de.
Dɔn i pul ɔl di fat we bin de pan di gɔt, di af af we ɛŋ pan di liva, ɛn di tu kidni wit dɛn yon fat ɛn Mozis bɔn ɔl na di ɔlta.
I nɔ bɔn di ɔda pat dɛn pan di man kaw insay di kamp, i bɔn dɛn na do.
Dɛn Mozis kɛr di man ship go bifo fɔ bɔn ɔfrin; ɛn Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn le dɛn an dɛn pantap di man ship in ed.
Mozis kil di man ship insɛf ɛn ib di blɔd rawnd di ɔlta.
Ɛn wɛn dɛn dɔn kɔt kɔt di man ship, Mozis bɔn di ed, di pat dɛn we dɛn kɔt kɔt ɛn di fat.
Wɛn dɛn dɔn was di gɔt ɛn lɛg dɛn, Mozis bɔn di wanol man ship na di ɔlta as bɔn ɔfrin; na ɔfrin we dɛn mek na faya, i go pul fayn sɛnt we go mek PAPA GƆD gladi lɛk aw i tɛl Mozis.
Mozis gi wan ɔda man ship. Dis wan na fɔ di ɔdineshɔn; ɛn Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn le dɛn an dɛn pantap di man ship in ed.
Mozis kil dis man ship insɛf ɛn put sɔm pan di blɔd kɔna say na Erɔn in rayt yes ɛn na di big fiŋa nain raytan ɛn in big to nain rayt fut.

Afta dat, Mozis mek Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛn go bifo dɔn i put sɔm pan di blɔd na dɛnsɛf yon rayt yes kɔna, na di big fiŋa dɛn na dɛn raytan ɛn na di big to dɛn na dɛn rayt fut ɛn Mozis ib di blɔd rawnd di ɔlta.
Dɛn i tek di fat dat na di wanol tel ɛn ɔl di fat we de na di gɔt, wit di af af dɛn we ɛŋ na di liva, wit di tu kidni ɛn di fat we de pan dɛn ɛn di rayt lɛg;
ɛn frɔm di blay we de bifo PAPA GƆD we gɛt bred we nɔ gɛt yist, i tek wan kek we nɔ gɛt yist, wan lof bred wit ɔyl, ɛn wan wefa ɛn put dɛn pan di fat ɛn di rayt lɛg;
i put dɛn ɔl na Erɔn in an ɛn na Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛn an ɛn dɛn wev dɛn to PAPA GƆD as spɛshal prɛzɛnt to am.
Dɛn Mozis tek di tin dɛn na dɛn an ɛn bɔn dɛn na di ɔlta wit di bɔn ɔfrin as ɔdineshɔn ɔfrin we i go pul fayn sɛnt, na ɔfrin we dɛn de mek na faya to PAPA GƆD.
Dɛn Mozis tek di chɛst ɛn wev am to PAPA GƆD as spɛshal prɛzɛnt; na bin Mozis in yon pan di man ship we na fɔ di ɔdineshɔn, lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin tɛl Mozis.

Dɛn Mozis tek sɔm pan di ɔyl we na fɔ anɔynt ɛn sɔm pan di blɔd we bin de pan di ɔlta ɛn sprinkul am pan Erɔn, in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn dɛn klos dɛn; na so i sho se na PAPA GƆD gɛt Erɔn, in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn dɛn klos dɛn.

Fɔ dɔn di sɛrimɔni, Mozis tɛl Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn se dɛn fɔ kɛr di bif go na di tɛnt we dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt fɔ kuk am ɛn it am de. I se dɛn fɔ it am wit di bred we de insay di blay we gɛt di ɔdineshɔn tiŋs dɛn ɛn as PAPA GƆD se, na Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn nɔmɔ fɔ it am;
dɛn fɔ bɔn di wan we lɛf pan di bif ɛn di bred na faya.
Dɛn nɔ fɔ kɔmɔt insay di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD fɔ sɛvin de, pas we dɛn dɔn du ɔl wetin dɛn fɔ du fɔ di ɔdineshɔn.
PAPA GƆD se, wetin dɛn du so nain dɛn fɔ du fɔ beg padin fɔ dɛn sin.
I se, na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt dɛn fɔ de ol de ɛn nɛt fɔ sɛvin de, de du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD dɔn gi dɛn fɔ du, ɔ nɔ so dɛn go day.
Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se dɛn fɔ du.
Di de we mek et we dɛn du di ɔdineshɔn, Mozis kɔl Erɔn, in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn di big wan dɛn na Izrɛl;
ɛn tɛl Erɔn se i fɔ mek sin ɔfrin wit wan yɔŋ man kaw we nɔ gɛt bɔt, ɛn bɔn ɔfrin wit wan man ship we insɛf nɔ fɔ gɛt bɔt to PAPA GƆD.
I se Erɔn fɔ tɛl di Izrɛlayt mek dɛn gi wan man got as sin ɔfrin wit wan yɔŋ kaw ɛn wan yɔŋ ship we nɔ gɛt bɔt as bɔn ɔfrin,
wan man kaw ɛn wan man ship fɔ pis ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD, ɛn sid ɔfrin we miks wit ɔyl, bikɔs da de de PAPA GƆD go sho insɛf to dɛn.
So dɛn kɛr ɔl wetin Mozis se go bifo di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛnsɛf gɛda frɔnt de bifo PAPA GƆD.
Wɛn dɛn ɔl dɔn gɛda, Mozis tɛl dɛn se na wetin PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ du, dɛn dɔn du ɛn dat go mek dɛn si di brayt brayt layt we de sho se PAPA GƆD de wit dɛn.

Dɛn Mozis tɛl Erɔn mek i go nia di ɔlta so dat i go mek in yon sin ɛn bɔn ɔfrin ɛn go beg padin fɔ insɛf ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn; i se i fɔ kɛr di pipul dɛn yon ɔfrin ɛn beg padin fɔ dɛn lɛk aw PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis.
So Erɔn go nia di ɔlta ɛn kil di yɔŋ kaw fɔ di sin ɔfrin we i de mek fɔ insɛf.
Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛn gi am ɛn i dɔk in fiŋa insay ɛn put sɔm blɔd pan di ɔn dɛn na di ɔlta, dɔn i tɔn di wan we lɛf na di bɔtɔm pat na di ɔlta;
bɔt fɔ bɔn di fat ɛn di kidni dɛn ɛn di af af fat we ɛŋ pan di liva pan di animal we dɛn yuz fɔ di sin ɔfrin as PAPA GƆD bin tɛl Mozis.
Nɔ fɔ bɔn di bif ɛn di kanda insay di kamp.
I kil di animal fɔ di bɔn ɔfrin; Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛn gi am di blɔd we i ib ib rawnd di ɔlta.
Dɔn dɛn kɔt kɔt di bɔn ɔfrin ɛn gi am wit di ed we in naw bɔn dɛn pantap di ɔlta.
We i dɔn, i was di gɔt ɛn lɛg dɛn ɛn bɔn ɔl wit di bɔn ɔfrin na di ɔlta.
We i dɔn da wande, Erɔn gi di pipul dɛn yon ɔfrin. I tek di got we na di pipul dɛn yon ɛn kil am ɛn mek di ɔfrin lɛkɛ aw i bin du in yon sin ɔfrin.
I mek di bɔn ɔfrin lɛkɛ aw di lɔ se.
I ful in wan an wit di sid ɔfrin ɛn bɔn am pantap di ɔlta wit di bɔn ɔfrin we dɛn kin mek ɛvri mɔnin.
Fɔ dɔn ɔltin, i kil di man kaw insɛf wit di man ship we na di pis ɔfrin fɔ di pipul; Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛn gi am di blɔd ɛn in ib ib am rawnd di ɔlta,
Erɔn put ɔl di pat dɛn we gɛt fat
pantap di chɛst ɛn bɔn di fat dɛn na di ɔlta,
bɔt Erɔn wev di chɛst ɛn di rayt lɛg as spɛshal prɛzɛnt bifo PAPA GƆD lɛk aw Mozis se.
Wɛn Erɔn dɔn mek in yon ɔfrin ɛn di pipul dɛn ɔfrin dɔn, i es in an ɔp ɛn blɛs di pipul dɛn ɛn pre fɔ mek PAPA GƆD kɔba dɛn ɛn gi dɛn wɛlbɔdi ɛn kɔmɔt na di ɔlta.
Mozis ɛn Erɔn go insay di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD; ɛn wɛn dɛn kɔmɔt na do, dɛn ɔltu blɛs di pipul dɛn bak ɛn di brayt brayt layt we de sho se PAPA GƆD de wit dɛn bɔs pan dɛn ɔl.
Wantɛm, wantɛm, nain PAPA GƆD sɛn faya we bɔn di bɔn ɔfrin ɛn di fat we bin de na di ɔlta. Wɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn si dat, dɛn ala ɛn butu dɛn fes na grɔn.
Nedab ɛn Abiu, we na tu pan Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛn ɔltu tek di pan we dɛn kin bɔn insɛns ɛn put faya insay am, ɛn put insɛns insay am ɛn gi faya we PAPA GƆD nɔ tɛl dɛn fɔ du.
Dat mek PAPA GƆD sɛn faya pan dɛn we bɔn dɛn ɛn dɛn day de bifo PAPA GƆD.
Mozis mɛmba Erɔn se na dat PAPA GƆD min we i se, i go sho in pipul dɛn we de nia am se in oli, ɛn na bifo dɛn dɛn go rɛspɛkt am. Erɔn nɔ se natin.
Mozis kɔl Mishaɛl ɛn Ɛlzafan, dat na Erɔn in ɔnkul Uziɛl in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn fɔ tot dɛn kɔzin dɛn dedebɔdi we lidɔm frɔnt di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD, kɔmɔt na di kamp.
So dɛnsɛf go tot di dedebɔdi dɛn bay di kot we dɛn wɛr ɛn pul dɛn kɔmɔt na di kamp lɛkɛ aw Mozis bin se.

Mozis tɛl Erɔn ɛn di ɔda bɔypikin dɛn we na Ɛlieza ɛn Ithama se dɛn nɔ fɔ lɛf di ia na dɛn ed so ɛn nɔ kom am, dɛn nɔ fɔ chɛr chɛr dɛn klos fɔ sho se dɛn gɛt bɛrin, ɔ nɔ so dɛnsɛf go day ɛn PAPA GƆD go vɛks pan ɔlman; i se na di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ munin fɔ di man dɛn we day, we PAPA GƆD mek faya kil.
Mozis tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ kɔmɔt na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD ɔ nɔ so dɛn go day bikɔs di ɔyl we de pan dɛn sho se dɛn na PAPA GƆD yon. Erɔn, Ɛlieza ɛn Ithama du wetin Mozis tɛl dɛn.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to Erɔn. I tɛl am se,
in ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn nɔ fɔ go insay di tɛnt we dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD afta dɛn dɔn drink ɛni kayn rɔm, wɛda na wayn ɔ na bia, ɔ nɔ so dɛn go day. I se dat fɔ bi lɔ na ɔl in jɛnareshɔn dɛn.
I se dɛn fɔ ebul no wetin na PAPA GƆD yon ɛn wetin na ɔlman yon, wetin klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn wetin nɔ klin nain yay;
i se dɛn fɔ ebul tich di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɔl di lɔ dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn gi Mozis fɔ tɛl dɛn.

Dɛn Mozis tɛl Erɔn, Ɛlieza ɛn Ithama we na Erɔn in tu bɔypikin we lɛf se dɛn fɔ tek di sid ɔfrin we lɛf pan di ɔfrin dɛn we dɛn bin mek na faya to PAPA GƆD, mek bred we nɔ gɛt yist de ɛn it am de na di ɔlta bikɔs na pat we oli pas ɔltin.
I se dɛn nɔ fɔ it am ɛniɔda say pas usay oli bikɔs na Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn nɔmɔ gɛt da rayt de fɔ it pan di ɔfrin we dɛn mek na faya to PAPA GƆD as na so PAPA GƆD tɛl am.

Bɔt dɛn ɛn dɛn famili wɛda man ɔ uman, kin it di chɛst ɛn di lɛg we dɛn bin gi PAPA GƆD as spɛshal prɛzɛnt na ɛnisay we klin na PAPA GƆD yay, bikɔs na dɛn yon we dɛn fɔ gɛt pan di pis ɔfrin dɛn we di Izrɛlayt dɛn gi.
Na dɛn gɛt di lɛg ɛn di chɛst we dɛn de wev as spɛshal prɛzɛnt to PAPA GƆD ɛn i fɔ bi dɛn yon na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn dɛn as na so PAPA GƆD se.
Mozis tek tɛm aks bɔt di got we na bin sin ɔfrin ɛn fɛnɔt se dɛn bin bɔn am. I vɛks pan Ɛlieza ɛn Ithama ɛn aks dɛn
wetindu dɛn nɔ it di sin ɔfrin na di tɛnt in kɔmpawnd as dɛn no se na tin we oli ɛn na dɛn nɔmɔ fɔ it am so dat dɛn go pul di pipul dɛn sin pan dɛn ɛn beg PAPA GƆD padin fɔ dɛn.
Mozis se sins dɛn nɔ bin kɛr di animal we dɛn gi in blɔd go insay di tɛnt, dɛn bin fɔ it am de lɛkɛ aw i bin tɛl dɛn.
Erɔn ansa Mozis se, if PAPA GƆD bin fɔ gladi wit am we i bin fɔ dɔn it di sin ɔfrin ɛn na da de de we di pipul dɛn gi PAPA GƆD dɛn sin ɛn bɔn ɔfrin nain in tu bɔypikin day.
We Mozis yɛri wetin Erɔn se, i satisfay.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis ɛn Erɔn,
fɔ tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se na dɛn wan ya pan di animal dɛn we de na wɔl dɛn fɔ it.
I fayn fɔ it animal we tan lɛk se in fut plit midul, ɛn we kin de cham ɔltɛm.
Bɔt nɔto ɛniwan we de cham ɔltɛm ɔ we in fut plit midul fɔ it. Nɔ fɔ it dɛn wan ya: kamɛl, dat na bikɔs pan ɔl we i de cham ɔltɛm, i nɔ gɛt fut we plit midul. I nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Nɔ fɔ it rɔk badja, dat na wan animal we de nia Ist ɛn Nɔth Afrika ɛn we kin de it gras. Dis na bikɔs pan ɔl we i de cham ɔltɛm, i nɔ gɛt fut we plit midul. I nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Nɔ fɔ it wan ɔda kayn animal we dɛn kɔl ɛa bikɔs pan ɔl we i de cham ɔltɛm, insɛf nɔ gɛt fut we plit midul. Insɛf nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Nɔ fɔ it bush ɔg bikɔs pan ɔl we in fut dɛn plit midul, i nɔ de cham ɔltɛm. I nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Nɔ fɔ it dɛn animal ya dɛn bif ɛn nɔ fɔ ivin tɔch di wan we dɔn day; dɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
I se na dɛn wan ya we de na wata fɔ it. Ɔltin we gɛt fin ɛn skel. Di wan dɛn we de na si ɔ na riva, yu kin it dɛn.
Nɔ fɔ it ɛnitin we de na wata bɔt we nɔ gɛt fin ɛn skel wɛda i de wit ɔda wan dɛn ɔ i gɛt layf. Fɔ et ɔl.
Fɔ et dɛn ɔl; nɔ fɔ it dɛn bif ɛn nɔ fɔ tɔch dɛn day wan.
Fɔ et ɔltin we de na wata we nɔ gɛt fin ɛn skel na abɔmineshɔn to yu.
Una nɔ fɔ it dɛn bɔd dɛn ya. Dɛn na abɔmineshɔn to PAPA GƆD: ak, yuba, kɔkɔ,
big bɔd we de flay lɛkɛ kayt we dɛn kin kɔl kayt, ɛn
dɛn difrɛn gridi bɔd dɛn we dɛn kɔl revɛn,
da bɔd we dɛn kin kɔl ɔstrich, difrɛn kayn ak, dɛn bɔd dɛn we kin de togɛda de flay oba wata fɔ kech fish we dɛn go it,
kɔkɔ, da blak bɔd we gɛt lɔŋ nɛk we kin de flay oba wata, wan ɔda kayn bɔd we tap nia wata, i gɛt lɔŋ nɛk, lɔŋ fut ɛn in bik sɛf lɔŋ,
wata fɔl, kaw enjɛl, wan kayn yuba
ɛn bat
Ɔl insɛkt we gɛt fɛda ɛn de waka wit fo fut na abɔmineshɔn.
Pan di insɛkt dɛn we gɛt fɛda ɛn de waka wit fo fut, una kin it dɛn wan dɛn we gɛt lɛg ɔp dɛn fut we dɛn kin tek jomp.
Fɔ it ɛni kayn lokɔs, ɛni kayn krikit ɔ grasɔpa.
Bɔt fɔ et ɔl di ɔda kayn insɛkt dɛn we gɛt fɛda ɛn de waka wit fo fut.
I se if dɛn du dɛn tin ya, dɛn nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay: ɛnibɔdi we tɔch di animal ɔ insɛkt in day wan nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm,
ɛn if ɛnibɔdi tot ɛni pat pan dɛn day wan, i fɔ was in klos ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
Ɔl animal we in fut plit midul bɔt gɛt sus ɔ nɔ de cham ɔltɛm nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; ɛnibɔdi we tɔch dɛn insɛf nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Pan di animal dɛn we de waka wit fo fut, di wan dɛn we de put dɛn fo fut flat na grɔn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn if pɔsin tɔch dɛn day wan, insɛf nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm,
ɛn if pɔsin tot dɛn day wan, i fɔ was in klos, dɔn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm; dɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Dɛn smɔl smɔl animal dɛn ya we de na wɔl nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay: wivul, arata, ɔl kayn kondo,
os pikin, krɔkɔdayl we nɔ de na wata, ɛn di kɔmiɛl.
Dɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn ɛnibɔdi we tɔch dɛn we dɛn dɔn day nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.

Fɔ put ɛnitin wɛda na tin we dɛn mek wit bod ɔ pisis ɔ lɛda ɔ bag ɔ ɛnitin we dɛn de put tin insay fɔ yus, we di day wan fɔdɔm pan, na wata ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm; dɔn i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Ɛn if ɛniwan fɔdɔm insay sɔntin we dɛn tek kle mek, ɔl wetin de insay de nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay, na fɔ brok am.

If i tɔch ɛnitin we na tin fɔ it we de na di wata we bin de insay di pɔt i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay; ɛni drink sɛf we fɔ drink bɔt we kɔmɔt na dɛn tin we dɛn mek wit bod, pisis, lɛda ɔ bag sɛf nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Ɛn ɔltin we ɛni pan dɛn day pat tɔch nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay; i lɛk wetin dɛn tek mek am, na fɔ brok am pis pis; dɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn dɛn nɔ go klin to ɛnibɔdi.
Pan ɔl we di wɛl we dɛn dig fɔ kip wata go klin na PAPA GƆD yay, if day bɔdi fɔdɔm insay ɛn pɔsin tɔch di day bɔdi, i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Ɛn if di day wan fɔdɔm pan sid we na fɔ plant, ɛn dɛn plant am, i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Bɔt if dɛn dɔn sok di sid na wata bifo di day bɔdi tɔch am, i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
If animal we pɔsin kin it ɔdinari wan day ɛnibɔdi we tɔch di day wan nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm,
ɛn if pɔsin it pan di day wan, i fɔ was in klos ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm; dɔn bak, di wan we tot di day bɔdi insɛf fɔ was in klos ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
Fɔ et dɛn ɔda tin dɛn ya; nɔ fɔ it dɛn.
Ɛnitin we nain bɛlɛ i de tek waka, ɛnitin we de waka flat na grɔn wit fo fut, ɛnitin we gɛt bɔku fut ɛn ɔl dɛn tin dɛn kin waka na grɔn, nɔ fɔ it dɛn bikɔs dɛn na abɔmineshɔn.
I se dɛn nɔ fɔ it dɛn kayn tin de we go mek i et dɛn; dɛn nɔ fɔ mek dɛn tin de ambɔg dɛn bikɔs dɛn nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
I se in na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd. I se so dɛn fɔ de klin wan fɔ am ɛn tan lɛk am bikɔs in na oli Gɔd. I se dɛn nɔ fɔ tek dɛn tin dɛn we de krip na wɔl fɔ ambɔg dɛnsɛf.
I se, in na PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we pul dɛn kɔmɔt pan slev layf na Ijipt fɔ mek i bi dɛn PAPA GƆD so dɛn fɔ bi difrɛn frɔm ɔda pipul dɛn lɛk am.
Na di lɔ dɛn dis bɔt dɛn animal, bɔd ɛn ɔltin we gɛt layf we de na wata ɛn ɔl dɛn smɔl smɔl tin we de pas pas na wɔl,
so dat pɔsin go no uswan klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn uswan nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, uswan fayn fɔ it ɛn uswan nɔ fayn fɔ it.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
fɔ tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se we uman bɔn bɔbɔ, i nɔ de klin na PAPA GƆD yay fɔ sɛvin de; jɛs lɛkɛ aw i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay we i de si in piriɔd.
Di de we mek et afta i bɔn, i fɔ sakɔmsayz di pikin.

Dɛn i fɔ wet fɔ tati-tri mɔ de te di blɔd dɔn dray gud ɛn i dɔn klin na PAPA GƆD yay; bay da tɛm de i nɔ fɔ tɔch ɛnitin we oli, ɛn i nɔ fɔ go na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt, te i dɔn du wetin fɔ mek i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Bɔt if na gyal pikin i bɔn, i nɔ de klin na PAPA GƆD yay fɔ tu wik, jɛs lɛk we i de si in piriɔd; i go de so fɔ siksti-siks de mɔ.

Ɛn wɛn i dɔn mek insɛf klin, wɛda na bɔbɔ ɔ na gyal pikin i bɔn, i fɔ kɛr wan yɔŋ ship we ol wan ia fɔ bɔn ɔfrin ɛn wan yɔŋ ɔdinari pijin ɔ wan bush pijin fɔ sin ɔfrin. I fɔ kɛr dɛn go gi di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD, in domɔt,
ɛn in go gi PAPA GƆD as ɔfrin ɛn beg padin fɔ am; na da tɛm de i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay we in blɔd go dɔn dray.

If i nɔ mitɔp fɔ bay di yɔŋ ship, dɛn i go kɛr tu yɔŋ bush pijin ɔ tu ɔdinari pijin, wan fɔ di bɔn ɔfrin ɛn di ɔda wan fɔ di sin ɔfrin; ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go beg padin fɔ am ɛn i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis ɛn Erɔn se,
wɛn pɔsin wund nain bɔdi, ɔ gɛt bwɛl nain bɔdi, ɔ ɛni ɔda mak nain bɔdi, we go tɔn bad sik we i kin gi pɔsin, dɛn fɔ briŋ am to Erɔn ɔ wan pan di ɔda man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin,

we go ɛgzamin am; ɛn if di ia we de gro usay di mak de dɔn wayt ɛn di mak dip te go insay in bɔdi, dat sho se na bad sik i gɛt nain bɔdi we i kin gi ɔda pɔsin; we di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɔn ɛgzamin am dɔn, i go lɛ ɔlman no se i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Bɔt if di mak we de na di bɔdi nɔ dip te go insay di bɔdi, ɛn di ia we de rawnd di mak nɔ wayt, di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ fɔ mek di pɔsin miks wit ɔda pipul fɔ sɛvin de;
bɔt i fɔ ɛgzamin am bak di de we mek sɛvin ɛn if i tink se di mak nɔ prɛd go ɔda say, bɔt de lɛk aw i bin de, i fɔ lɛ i de fɔ ɔda sɛvin de i nɔ miks wit pipul;

dɔn we da sɛvin de de insɛf dɔn, i go ɛgzamin am bak, ɛn if di mak mek lɛk i lɔs ɛn nɔ prɛd nain bɔdi, dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se di pɔsin klin na PAPA GƆD yay; na smɔl mak nɔmɔ i bin gɛt nain bɔdi we nɔ fɔ fred; dɛn i go was in klos nɔmɔ ɛn i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Bɔt if di mak we i gɛt nain bɔdi prɛd na di bɔdi afta i bin dɔn go to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ ɛgzamin am, i fɔ go bak to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin;
ɛn i go ɛgzamin am bak ɛn if i si se di mak dɔn prɛd nain bɔdi, dɛn i go lɛ ɔlman no se i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; na bad sik i gɛt nain bɔdi.
Wɛn pɔsin gɛt bad sik nain bɔdi, dɛn fɔ kɛr am go to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin;
ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go ɛgzamin am, ɛn if i gɛt wayt mak nain bɔdi we dɔn mek di ia nain bɔdi tɔn wayt, ɛn i dɔn de mek di mak opin lɛk wund we pɔsin de si in bif,

na bad sik i gɛt nain bɔdi we nɔ go wɛl so nɔmɔ, ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se di pɔsin nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ fɔ mek i miks wit ɔda pipul bikɔs dat sho se i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Ɛn if di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin si se di bad sik nain bɔdi prɛd ɔl oba in bɔdi, frɔm in ed te rich in fut,
i fɔ ɛgzamin am bak, ɛn if i fɛnɔt se di sik dɔn kɔba di pɔsin in wanol bɔdi, i go lɛ ɔlman no se i klin na PAPA GƆD yay, ɔlsay dɔn wayt nain bɔdi ɛn i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Bɔt if di mak opin we pɔsin de si in bif, i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.

Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go ɛgzamin di mak we opin lɛk wund fɔ lɛ pɔsin de si in bif ɛn lɛ ɔlman no se di pɔsin nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; di mak we opin lɛk wund fɔ lɛ pɔsin de si in bif sho se pɔsin nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, bikɔs na bad sik i gɛt nain bɔdi.
Bɔt if di mak we opin lɛk wund we mek pɔsin de si in bif wɛl ɛn tɔn wayt, dɛn i fɔ go to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin,
ɛn i go ɛgzamin am, dɔn if di mak we bin opin dɔn tɔn wayt, dɛn i klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
I tɔk bak se wɛn pɔsin gɛt bwɛl nain bɔdi we dɔn wɛl,
ɛn di ples usay di bwɛl bin de gɛt mak, dɛn i go sho am to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin;

dɔn in go ɛgzamin am, ɛn if di mak go insay in bɔdi ɛn di ia nain bɔdi tɔn wayt, di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; i gɛt bad sik nain bɔdi we dɔn prɛd ɔlsay afta di bwɛl we i bin gɛt.

Bɔt if we di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛgzamin am, i si se di ia nain bɔdi nɔ wayt ɛn di mak nɔ go insay di bɔdi, bɔt mek lɛk i lɔs, dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ fɔ mek i miks wit pipul fɔ sɛvin de;
ɛn if i prɛd ɔlsay nain bɔdi, dɔn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; na sik we i kin gi ɔda pɔsin.
Bɔt if di mak nɔ prɛd, na di mak we di bwɛl lɛf; dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
I se, if na faya bɔn pɔsin in bɔdi ɛn i mek opin wan lɛk wund ɛn mek wayt ɔ rɛd,

di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go ɛgzamin am ɛn if di ia we de rawnd di mak dɔn tɔn wayt ɛn di mak go insay di bɔdi, dɛn na bad sik na di bɔdi we prɛd afta i dɔn bɔn na faya, ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay;

Bɔt if we di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛgzamin am, i si se di ia nain bɔdi nɔ wayt ɛn di mak nɔ go insay di bɔdi, bɔt mek lɛk i lɔs, dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ fɔ mek i miks wit pipul fɔ sɛvin de;

ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go ɛgzamin am bak, di de we mek sɛvin, if i de prɛd nain bɔdi, dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; na bad sik na di bɔdi we i kin gi pɔsin.
Bɔt if di mak lɛf na di sem ples ɛn nɔ prɛd na di bɔdi, i mek lɛk i lɔs, na mak we lɛf afta di faya bɔn am, ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
I se, wɛn rash kɔmɔt na man ɔ uman in ed ɔ chin,

di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go ɛgzamin di rash; ɛn if i go insay di bɔdi, ɛn di ia we de rawnd am nɔ bɛtɛ bɔt i yala, dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se di pɔsin nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; na lakpalakpa, bad sik nain ed ɛn chin.

Ɛn if di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛgzamin di lakpalakpa, ɛn di lakpalakpa go insay di bɔdi ɛn i nɔ gɛt nɔmal ia de, dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ go mek di pɔsin miks wit ɔda pipul fɔ sɛvin de,
ɛn i fɔ ɛgzamin am bak di de we mek sɛvin ɛn if di lakpalakpa nɔ prɛd go ɔda say, ɛn nɔ gɛt nɔn yala ia de, bɔt de lɛk aw i bin de,
dɛn di pɔsin fɔ krep in ia nain ed ɛn di chin pas nɔmɔ di say we di lakpalakpa de; ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ go mek i miks wit ɔda pipul fɔ sɛvin mɔ de;

dɔn we da sɛvin de de insɛf dɔn, i go ɛgzamin am bak, ɛn if di lakpalakpa nɔ prɛd nain bɔdi ɛn nɔ go insay di bɔdi, dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se di pɔsin klin na PAPA GƆD yay; dɛn i go was in klos nɔmɔ ɛn i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Bɔt if di lakpalakpa we i gɛt nain bɔdi prɛd na di bɔdi afta i bin dɔn go to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ ɛgzamin am,
dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go ɛgzamin am bak ɛn if di lakpalakpa dɔn prɛd nain bɔdi, di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ gɛt fɔ luk fɔ if di ia yala i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Bɔt if i si se di lakpalakpa nɔ prɛd, ɛn nɔmal ia dɔn gro na di ples, na wɛl i dɔn wɛl so, ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
I se if man ɔ uman gɛt smɔl smɔl mak dɛn nain bɔdi,
di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ ɛgzamin am, ɛn if di smɔl smɔl mak dɛn tan lɛk mak dɛn we de lɔs, dɛn na ɛmti mak, i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
I se if man ia rut kɔmɔt midul in ed, i gɛt bɔled bɔt i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Ɛn if in frɔnt ia nain ed sɛf nɔ de, na bɔled i gɛt bɔt i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Bɔt if pan di bɔled, wɛda na midul di ed ɔ nain fɔrɛd i gɛt wan mak we mek wayt ɔ rɛd, na bad sik de kɔmɔt midul in ed ɔ in fɔrɛd so.
Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go ɛgzamin am, ɛn if di bɔled tan lɛk we pɔsin gɛt bad sik nain bɔdi,
i gɛt bad sik, i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay bikɔs i gɛt bad sik nain ed.
Di man we gɛt di bad sik go wɛr chɛr chɛr klos fɔ sho se i nɔ gladi ɛn lɛf in ia chakachaka wan nain ed ɛn kɔba af in fes de ala se, “Una gi rod! A nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay!”
Na so i go de te i wɛl; nain wan go tap bay insɛf bɔt nɔto insay di kamp.
Wɛn klos miliju, wɛda na wul ɔ na linin matirial,
na ɛnisay pan di matirial, ɔ lɛda,
if di tin we de nain bɔdi sho grin ɔ rɛd nain klos, wɛda na di wul ɔ di linin ɔ na lɛda, na bad sik nain bɔdi ɛn i go sho di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
Ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go ɛgzamin am ɛn mek i nɔ miks wit ɔda pipul fɔ sɛvin de;
dɛn i go ɛgzamin am bak di de we mek sɛvin. If di bad sik dɔn prɛd go pan di klos, wɛda na di wul ɔ na di linin ɔ lɛda, na sik we i kin gi ɔda pɔsin; i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Ɛn i go bɔn di klos wɛda na wul ɔ linin matirial ɔ na lɛda, bikɔs na sik we i kin gi ɔda pɔsin; na fɔ bɔn am na faya.
Bɔt if we di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛgzamin am, ɛn di sik nɔ prɛd go pan di wul ɔ linin matirial ɔ lɛda,
dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go mek dɛn was am ɛn i nɔ go mek i miks wit pipul fɔ sɛvin de mɔ;

ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go ɛgzamin am bak afta dɛn was am. Ɛn if di ples usay di sik de nɔ chenj kɔla bɔt stil grin ɔ rɛd, pan ɔl we i nɔ prɛd mɔ, i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; na fɔ bɔn am na faya i lɛk sɛf di miliju de insay di klos ɔ na do i de.
Bɔt if we di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛgzamin am, if di sik mak mek lɛk i lɔs, na usay di miliju mek nɔmɔ i go chɛr kɔmɔt wɛda na pan wul ɔ linin matirial ɔ na lɛda;
dɛn if i mek bak pan di klos, wɛda na di wul ɔ di linin matirial ɔ di lɛda, na prɛd i de prɛd; na fɔ bɔn di klos na faya.
Ɛniwe, if we pɔsin was di wul ɔ linin matirial, ɛn di lɛda, di miliju lɔs, na fɔ was am bak di sɛkɛn tɛm, ɛn da tɛm de, di pɔsin klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Na di lɔ dɛn dis if pɔsin in klos we na wul ɔ linin matirial ɔ na lɛda miliju, ɛn fɔ no if i klin ɔ i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,

na di lɔ dɛn dis we pɔsin we bin gɛt bad sik nain bɔdi fɔ du di de we di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin tɔk se i klin na PAPA GƆD yay. Dɛn fɔ briŋ am kam to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin;
ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go tek am kɔmɔt insay di kamp go na do fɔ go ɛgzamin am. Dɛn if di bad sik nain bɔdi dɔn wɛl,
di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go tɛl sɔmbɔdi fɔ briŋ tu layf bɔd we PAPA GƆD se dɛn kin it, wit sida wud, dak rɛd pisis ɛn wan isɔp plant fɔ di man;
di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go tɛl dɛn fɔ kil wan pan di bɔd dɛn oba bekin pɔt usay klin wata de bɔs na grɔn.
I go tek di layf bɔd wit di sida wud, di dak rɛd pisis ɛn di isɔp, dɔk dɛn ɛn di layf bɔd insay di wan we dɛn bin kil usay klin wata de bɔs na grɔn;
ɛn i go sprinkul am sɛvin tɛm pan di man we gɛt di bad sik; dɔn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go lɛ ɔlman no se i klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn i go lɛf di layf bɔd fɔ flay go usay i want.

Di man we bin gɛt di bad sik go was in klos dɛn, krep in ed ɛn was in bɔdi, dɔn i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay; ɛn na afta dat i go go insay di kamp, bɔt i go wet na do fɔ sɛvin de mɔ bifo i go insay in tɛnt.
Afta di sɛvin de dɔn pas i go krep in ed bak, shev in biabia, ɛn pul ɔl di ia we de nain yay. Dɛn i go was in klos dɛn ɛn was in bɔdi bak bifo i klin prɔpa wan na PAPA GƆD yay.
Di de we mek et, i go tek tu yɔŋ manship we nɔ gɛt bɔt, wan yɔŋ uman ship we nɔ gɛt bɔt ɛn fayv pawn flawa we miks wit ɔyl, fɔ sid ɔfrin ɛn af paynt ɔliv ɔyl.
Ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go mek di man we bin gɛt di bad sik tinap wit ɔl in ɔfrin bifo PAPA GƆD na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt.
Ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go tek wan pan di yɔŋ man ship ɛn gi PAPA GƆD as sɔntin we i fɔ gi PAPA GƆD, wit di af paynt ɔliv ɔyl, ɛn wev dɛn as spɛshal prɛzɛnt to PAPA GƆD;

ɛn i go kil di yɔŋ man ship na di sem ples usay dɛn bin dɔn kil di animal fɔ di sin ɔfrin ɛn di bɔn ɔfrin na di tɛnt in kɔmpawnd. Na di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de dyuti, nain gɛt di ɔfrin we dɛn gi PAPA GƆD fɔseka wetin i fɔ sɔfa; i oli pas ɔltin.

Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go tek sɔm pan di blɔd frɔm di ɔfrin we na fɔseka wetin i fɔ sɔfa ɛn put am na di pɔsin in rayt yes kɔna, na di big fiŋa nain raytan ɛn na di big to nain rayt fut.
Dɔn i go tek sɔm pan di ɔliv ɔyl ɛn put am nain yon lɛfan,
dɔk di fiŋa we i de tek pɔynt nain raytan insay di ɔyl we de nain lɛfan ɛn sprinkul am bifo PAPA GƆD sɛvin tɛm.
I put sɔm pan di ɔyl we lɛf nain an ɛn di blɔd pan di ɔfrin kɔna di pɔsin in rayt yes, ɛn nain big fiŋa nain raytan wit in big to nain rayt fut;
dɔn i go rɔb di wan we lɛf nain an na di pɔsin in ed ɛn beg padin fɔ am bifo PAPA GƆD.
Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go gi di animal fɔ di sin ɔfrin so dat i go beg padin fɔ di man we wan klin na PAPA GƆD yay. Ɛn we i dɔn i go kil di wan fɔ di bɔn ɔfrin;
dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go gi di bɔn ɔfrin ɛn di sid ɔfrin na di ɔlta. Na so di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go beg padin fɔ am ɛn i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.

I se if di pɔsin po ɛn nɔ mitɔp fɔ bay dɛn tin dɛn de, i fɔ kɛr wan yɔŋ man ship we na fɔseka wetin i fɔ sɔfa we i go wev as spɛshal prɛzɛnt fɔ beg PAPA GƆD fɔ am ɛn et kɔp fayn flawa miks wit ɔyl fɔ di sid ɔfrin wit af paynt ɔyl;
dɔn igen tu bush pijin ɔ tu yɔŋ pijin, bay wetin i ebul bay; wan fɔ bi fɔ sin ɔfrin ɛn di ɔda wan fɔ bi fɔ di bɔn ɔfrin.
Di de we mek et, i fɔ kɛr dɛn go to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt bifo PAPA GƆD;
ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go tek di yɔŋ ship fɔ di ɔfrin we na fɔseka wetin go bi ɛn di ɔyl, wev am as wev ɔfrin we na spɛshal prɛzɛnt to PAPA GƆD.

Ɛn i go kil di yɔŋ man ship we i gi fɔseka wetin i fɔ sɔfa; ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ sin we de dyuti go tek sɔm pan di ɔfrin we na fɔseka wetin pɔsin fɔ sɔfa in blɔd ɛn put am na di man in rayt yes kɔna, na di big fiŋa nain raytan ɛn na di big to nain rayt fut.
Dɔn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go tɔn sɔm pan di ɔliv ɔyl nain yon lɛfan;
ɛn i go dɔk di fiŋa we i de tek pɔynt nain raytan insay di ɔyl we de nain lɛfan ɛn sprinkul am bifo PAPA GƆD sɛvin tɛm;

dɔn i put sɔm pan di ɔyl we lɛf nain an na di pɔsin in rayt yes kɔna, ɛn nain big fiŋa nain raytan wit in big to nain rayt fut na di sem ples we i bin put di blɔd we kɔmɔt pan di ɔfrin we i gi fɔseka wetin fɔ bi;
dɔn i go rɔb di wan we lɛf nain an na di pɔsin in ed ɛn beg padin fɔ am bifo PAPA GƆD.
Na da tɛm de i go gi di tu bush pijin ɔ di tu yɔŋ pijin bay wetin i ebul bay,
Wan pan dɛn fɔ di sin ɔfrin ɛn di ɔda wan fɔ di bɔn ɔfrin wit in sid ɔfrin; ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go beg padin to PAPA GƆD fɔ di man we wan klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Na di lɔ dis fɔ man we gɛt bad sik nain bɔdi we nɔ mitɔp fɔ bay di tin dɛn we fɔ tek mek ɔfrin lɛ i go klin.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis ɛn Erɔn se,
wɛn dɛn rich na di land we i de gi dɛn na Kenan we nain i de gi dɛn as dɛn prɔpati, we i mek di wɔl dɛn na di os dɛn miliju,
dɛn di wan we gɛt di os fɔ tɛl di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin se i tan lɛk in os dɔn miliju.

Dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go gi ɔda mek dɛn ɛmti di os bifo i go ɛgzamin am, ɔ nɔ so na ɔl wetin de insay di os i go se nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay; bɔt afta dɛn dɔn ɛmti di os, i kin go insay de naw.
I go ɛgzamin usay di miliju de, ɛn if di mak we i mek na di wɔl grin ɔ rɛd ɛn if i mek lɛk i mek ol na di wɔl,
dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go kɔmɔt na di os ɛn lɔk am fɔ sɛvin de.
I go go de bak di de we mek sɛvin fɔ ɛgzamin am bak; ɛn if i si se di ol we i bin mek na di wɔl dɔn big,
dɛn i go gi ɔda mek dɛn brok di eria we di ol mek ɛn trowe am na do na di siti we dɛn mek fɔ de trowe dɛn kayn tin de;
dɔn i go mek dɛn krep ɔl di simɛnt insay di os ɛn kɛr dɛnsɛf go put na di sem ples we na de dɛn kin trowe tin we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay;
ɛn i go mek dɛn put ɔda blɔk dɛn ɛn plasta di wɔl bak.
If di os mek miliju bak afta dɛn bin dɔn brok di eria na di wɔl we gɛt di miliju ɛn krep di wɔl,
dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ ɛgzamin am bak, ɛn if i dɔn mek ɔda ol na di wɔl, dɛn, na miliju we nɔ fɔ ple wit, i dɔn mek di os nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Di man we gɛt di os fɔ brok di wanol os, di simɛnt, bod, plasta ɛn ɔltin; ɛn i fɔ kɛr ɔl go trowe na do na di siti usay dɛn kin trowe dɛn tin we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Dɔn igen ɛnibɔdi we go insay di os da tɛm we di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin bin se di os fɔ lɔk, nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm;
dɔn igen if pɔsin lidɔm insay di os, i fɔ was in klos dɛn; ɛn pɔsin we it insay de, insɛf fɔ was in klos dɛn.

Bɔt if we di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛgzamin di os bak, if i nɔ mek ɔda ol na di wɔl, dɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ lɛ ɔlman no se, di os klin na PAPA GƆD yay, di miliju dɔn dɔn.
Fɔ mek di os klin na PAPA GƆD yay, di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ gi tu smɔl bɔd wit sida wud, dak rɛd pisis ɛn wan isɔp plant fɔ di man we gɛt di os,
ɛn i fɔ kil wan pan di bɔd dɛn oba kɔntri pɔt usay klin wata de bɔs na grɔn,
ɛn i go tek di sida wud, di dak rɛd pisis ɛn di isɔp, wit di layf bɔd dɔk dɛn insay di wan we dɛn bin kil in blɔd, ɛn insay di klin wata we de bɔs na grɔn ɛn sprinkul am na di os sɛvin tɛm.
Na so fɔ mek di os klin na PAPA GƆD yay wit di bɔd in blɔd, ɛn di klin wata we de bɔs na grɔn, ɛn wit di layf bɔd ɛn wit di sida wud, di dak rɛd pisis ɛn di isɔp;
dɛn i go lɛf di layf bɔd fɔ flay go usay i want; na so di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go beg padin fɔ di os ɛn i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Na di lɔ dɛn dis fɔ ɛni kayn bad sik: fɔ lakpalakpa,
fɔ miliju pan klos ɛn na os,
fɔ ɔda kayn swɛl we di bɔdi kin swɛl ɔ mek mak.
Na di lɔ dɛn dis we go mek pɔsin no if i klin ɔ i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis ɛn Erɔn se,
fɔ tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, ɛnibɔdi we de dischaj nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Wɛda i de pul am ɔltɛm ɔ i bin de pul di wata fɔs, i stil nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Ɛni bed we i lidɔm pan ɛn ɛni say we i sidɔm sɛf nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Ɛn ɛnibɔdi we tɔch in bed go was in klos dɛn, was insɛf ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
Dɔn ɛnibɔdi we sidɔm na di sem ples we di pɔsin dɔn sidɔm fɔ was in klos dɛn, was insɛf ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivin tɛm.
If pɔsin tɔch in bɔdi sɛf, i fɔ was in klos dɛn, was insɛf ɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
If di pɔsin we de pul wata insay am pit pan ɔda pɔsin we klin na PAPA GƆD yay, dɛn da pɔsin de insɛf fɔ go was in klos dɛn, was in bɔdi ɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
If i sidɔm pan ɛnitin we i de rayd in ɔs, di tin insɛf nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Ɛnitin we pɔsin tɔch we i bin dɔn sidɔm pan, nɔ go klin te ivintɛm ɛn if pɔsin tot di tin fɔ was in klos dɛn, was in klos ɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
If di pɔsin we de pul di wata tɔch pɔsin dɔn i nɔ was in an dɛn i go gɛt fɔ was in klos dɛn ɛn was insɛf wit wata ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
Dɔn dɛn go brok di kɔntri pɔt sɛf we i go dɔn tɔch bɔt fɔ rench ɛnitin we na bɔd dɛn mek am wit we i dɔn put tin insay.

We di pɔsin we de pul di wata lɛf fɔ pul wata, i go gi insɛf sɛvin de bifo i bigin du di tin dɛn we go mek i klin na PAPA GƆD yay, ɛn i go was in klos dɛn; ɛn was insɛf insay wata we de bɔs na grɔn bifo i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Di de we mek et, i fɔ kɛr tu bush pijin ɔ tu yɔŋ ɔdinari pijin go bifo PAPA GƆD na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt ɛn gi dɛn to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin;
ɛn in naw go gi dɛn fɔ sakrifays, wan fɔ sin ɔfrin ɛn di ɔda wan fɔ di bɔn ɔfrin; dɔn i go beg PAPA GƆD fɔ padin am fɔ di wata we i de pul insay am.
If man pul wata kɔmɔt na wetin mek am man, i fɔ was in wanol bɔdi ɛn i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
If di wata we i de pul na wetin mek am man, go pan ɛni klos ɔ ɔda tin, na fɔ was da tin de wit wata ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
We di man lidɔm wit uman dɔn, in ɛn di uman fɔ go was ɛn dɛn nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
We uman de pul blɔd we i de si in piriɔd we na nɔmal tin, i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay fɔ sɛvin de ɛn ɛnibɔdi we tɔch am nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
Ɛn ɛnitin we i bin lidɔm pan we i de si in piriɔd nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɔ ɛnitin we i sidɔm pan sɛf nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Ɛn if pɔsin tɔch in bed, i fɔ was in klos dɛn ɛn was insɛf ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
Ɛn if pɔsin tɔch usay i bin dɔn sidɔm, fɔ was in klos dɛn, was in bɔdi ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm;
wɛda nain bed ɔ ɛni ɔda tin wans di uman bin dɔn sidɔm de, if i tɔch am i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
If man lidɔm wit am di tɛm we i de si in piriɔd, di man insɛf nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay, i go de so fɔ sɛvin de ɛn ɛni bed we insɛf go lidɔm pan nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
If uman de pul blɔd pan insɛf tɛm we i fɔ dɔn dɔn in piriɔd, i stil nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay jɛs lɛk aw i nɔba klin na PAPA GƆD yay di tɛm we i kin de si in piriɔd.

Ɛni bed we i lidɔm pan wɛn i de pul blɔd pan insɛf go tan lɛk bed we i lidɔm pan we i de si in piriɔd. I nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay; ɛn ɛnitin we i sidɔm pan sɛf nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay lɛkɛ aw i kin bi we i de si in piriɔd.
Ɛn ɛnibɔdi we tɔch wetin in bɔdi dɔn tɔch lɛkɛ di bed we i de lidɔm ɔ usay i dɔn sidɔm nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay, i fɔ was in klos dɛn, ɛn was insɛf ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm.
Bɔt if i dɔn lɛf fɔ pul blɔd pan insɛf, i go wet fɔs fɔ sɛvin de ɛn afta dat i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Di de we mek et, i fɔ kɛr tu bush pijin ɔ tu yɔŋ ɔdinari pijin go bifo PAPA GƆD na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt ɛn gi dɛn to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin;
ɛn in naw go gi dɛn fɔ sakrifays, wan fɔ sin ɔfrin ɛn di ɔda wan fɔ di bɔn ɔfrin; dɔn i go beg PAPA GƆD fɔ padin am fɔ di blɔd we i de pul pan insɛf.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis ɛn Erɔn se na so dɛn fɔ mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn nɔ day tɛm we dɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay bikɔs dɛn nɔ go go na di tɛnt we PAPA GƆD kin mit dɛn na di kamp ɛn pwɛl de.
Na di lɔ dɛn dɛn wan ya fɔ ɛni man we de pul wata insay am we mek i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay;
ɛn fɔ ɛni uman we de si in piriɔd; ɛn fɔ di man we go lidɔm wit am da tɛm de.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to Mozis afta tu pan Erɔn in bɔypikin bin day we PAPA GƆD kil dɛn fɔ we dɛn nɔ du wetin i want.

I se Mozis fɔ tɛl in brɔda we na Erɔn se nɔto ɔltɛm i fɔ jɛs de go biɛn di do klos we ɛŋ insay di ples we oli pas ɔl, we na de di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant in kɔba de, ɔ nɔ so i go day bikɔs in kin apia insay klawd ɛn sidɔm de.
I se pas if Erɔn go de wit wan yɔŋ man kaw fɔ sin ɔfrin ɛn wan man ship fɔ bɔn ɔfrin.
PAPA GƆD se i fɔ wɛr gawn we i mek wit linin, lɔŋ fut drɔz, put brɔd band we dɛn mek wit linin rawnd in wes ɛn tay linin tɔban nain ed; na di we dis we i fɔ drɛs bɔt i fɔ was in bɔdi bifo i wɛr dɛn.
Dɛn di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ gi am tu man got fɔ sin ɔfrin ɛn wan man ship fɔ bɔn ɔfrin.
Dɔn Erɔn go gi PAPA GƆD di man kaw we i de mek fɔ sin ɔfrin fɔ insɛf ɛn beg PAPA GƆD padin fɔ insɛf ɛn in wanol os.
Da tɛm de naw i kin tek di tu got ɛn put dɛn bifo PAPA GƆD na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit am in domɔt;
ɛn Erɔn go fɛnɔt to PAPA GƆD fɔ disayd udat gɛt uswan pan di got dɛn; uswan na fɔ PAPA GƆD ɛn uswan fɔ bi fɔ Azazɛl.
We Erɔn go dɔn no uswan fɔ bi fɔ PAPA GƆD, i go gi PAPA GƆD as sin ɔfrin;
bɔt i go gi PAPA GƆD di got we i fɔ lɛf fɔ go layv wan. I go beg padin wit am ɛn sɛn am go to Azazɛl na di say we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
I se na Erɔn insɛf fɔ gi di man kaw we na fɔ sin ɔfrin so i go beg padin fɔ insɛf ɛn fɔ in os; i go kil di man kaw fɔ insɛf.

Dɛn i go tek di pan we dɛn kin bɔn insɛns we dɛn dɔn ful wit faya kol we dɛn pul na di ɔlta go bifo PAPA GƆD, wit tu an insɛns we dɛn dɔn gren fayn ɛn we gɛt fayn sɛnt ɛn kɛr dɛn ɔltu go na di ples we oli pas ɔl
ɛn put di insɛns na di faya bifo PAPA GƆD, so dat di tik smok we di insɛns go pul go kɔba di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant in kɔba, ɔ nɔ so Erɔn go day if i si di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant in kɔba;
ɛn i go tek sɔm pan di man kaw in blɔd ɛn sprinkul am wit in fiŋa frɔnt di say we di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant in kɔba de ɛn sprinkul am sɛvin tɛm pan di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant insɛf.

Afta dat, i se Erɔn fɔ mek di pipul kil di got we dɛn bin kɛr go fɔ sin ɔfrin, ɛn kɛr di blɔd go to am na di ples we oli pas ɔl, ɛn in go du wetin i bin du wit di man kaw in blɔd, dat na fɔ sprinkul am pan di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant ɛn pan di kɔba;

na so i go mek di ples we oli pas ɔl klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn mek am fit fɔ de beg PAPA GƆD padin de fɔ we di Izrɛlayt dɛn nɔ du wetin rayt we na wetin PAPA GƆD want ɛn na so i go du wit di wanol tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD we na rawnd am di Izrɛlayt dɛn de sin.
We Erɔn go insay di ples we oli pas ɔl fɔ go beg padin fɔ insɛf, in wanol os ɛn di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn, nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ de de.

Afta dat, i go go to di ɔlta we na de dɛn de mek sakrifays bifo PAPA GƆD ɛn mek am fit fɔ sakrifays bifo PAPA GƆD. I go tek sɔm pan di man kaw ɛn di got dɛn blɔd ɛn put dɛn pantap di ɔn dɛn rawnd di ɔlta.
I go sprinkul sɔm pan di blɔd wit in fiŋa sɛvin tɛm pan am ɛn na so i go mek am klin na PAPA GƆD yay bak fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Wɛn Erɔn dɔn mek di ples we oli pas ɔl, di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD ɛn di ɔlta fit fɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ yus, i go gi di layf got;

we i go le in tu an pantap in ed, kɔnfɛs se di Izrɛlayt dɛn nɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ du, di bad tin dɛn we dɛn dɔn du to dɛn kɔmpin, ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn dɔn du we Papa nɔ lɛk, oba di got in ed. Dat min se na di got go tot ɔl di pipul dɛn sin. Dɛn go gi wan man we go kɛr am go na di dray ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap.
Di got go tot ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn sin go na ples we pipul nɔ de ɛn di man go lɛf am na di ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Dɛn Erɔn go go bak insay di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD, pul ɔl di linin tin dɛn we i bin wɛr we i de go insay di ples we oli pas ɔl ɛn lɛf dɛn de;
ɛn i go was in bɔdi na wan spɛshal ples, wɛr in yon klos bak, go na do ɛn mek di bɔn ɔfrin fɔ insɛf ɛn in pipul so dat i go beg padin fɔ dɛn ɔl.
I go bɔn ɔl di fat pan di sin ɔfrin dɛn na di ɔlta.
Di man we bin kɛr di got go to Azazɛl go was in klos dɛn ɛn was in bɔdi ɛn na afta dat i go go insay di kamp.
Dɛn go kɛr di man kaw ɛn di got we na fɔ di sin ɔfrin, we na dɛn blɔd i bin tek beg padin na di ples we oli pas ɔl go na do na di kamp; dɛn go bɔn in kanda ɛn in gɔt dɛn ɛn ɔl wetin nɔ gud fɔ it.
Di pɔsin we bɔn dɛn go was in klos dɛn, ɛn was in bɔdi bifo i go go insay di kamp.
PAPA GƆD se dat fɔ bi lɔ na ɔl in jɛnareshɔn dɛn, dat na di nɔmba tɛn de na di mɔnt we mek sɛvin, dɛn fɔ fast ɛn nɔ du ɛni wok, wɛda na de dɛn bɔn ɔ dɛn na trenja;
bikɔs na de we di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go beg padin fɔ dɛn mek dɛn go klin na PAPA GƆD in yay.
Na di sɛvin de we na di de fɔ blo ɛn dɛn fɔ fast; na lɔ dis ɛn i fɔ bi na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn.
Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we dɛn go dɔn pik fɔ bi di bigman pan dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we go tek in papa in ples, go wɛr di spɛshal linin klos dɛn fɔ beg padin;

na so i go mek di ples we oli pas ɔl klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn mek am fit fɔ de beg PAPA GƆD padin de fɔ we di Izrɛlayt dɛn nɔ du wetin rayt we na wetin PAPA GƆD want ɛn na so i go du wit di wanol tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD ɛn di ɔlta, i go beg padin fɔ ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn fɔ di wanol Izrɛlayt kɔmyuniti.
Na di lɔ dɛn dis we go de na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn dɛn te go. Na fɔ de beg PAPA GƆD padin fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn sin dɛn wan tɛm fɔ ia. Mozis du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ du.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
i fɔ tɛl Erɔn, in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn wetin in, PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ du.
Nɔn Izrɛlayt nɔ fɔ kil man kaw ɔ yɔŋ ship ɔ got ɛnisay na di kamp wɛda nainsay ɔ na do,
pas i kɛr am go na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt, ɛn gi PAPA GƆD de ɔ nɔ so dɛn go se di pɔsin dɔn kil ɛn i nɔ go miks wit di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn igen

I se dis lɔ na fɔ mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn no se naw, dɛn fɔ nɔ kɛr dɛn animal we dɛn kin kil ɛni ɔda say, pas to PAPA GƆD, dat na to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt, ɛn kil am de as pis sakrifays to PAPA GƆD;

ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go sprinkul di blɔd na PAPA GƆD in ɔlta we de na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD, in domɔt de, ɛn bɔn di fat so dat i go pul fayn sɛnt we go mek PAPA GƆD gladi.
I se dat fɔ mek dɛn lɛf fɔ mek sakrifays to ɔda gɔd dɛn, lɛk dɛn got-dɛbul we de mek lɛ dɛn biev to am lɛk rare gyal. I se dis fɔ bi lɔ na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn sote go.
I se Mozis fɔ tɛl dɛn bak se, ɛni Izrɛlayt ɔ fɔrina we tap wit dɛn, we mek bɔn ɔfrin ɔ bɔn sakrifays,
ɛn nɔ kɛr am go na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt, fɔ sakrifays am to PAPA GƆD, nɔ fɔ miks wit di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn igen
I se if ɛni Izrɛlayt ɔ fɔrina we tap wit dɛn it ɛnitin we gɛt blɔd, PAPA GƆD go dison da pɔsin de ɛn i nɔ go mek i miks wit in di Izrɛlayt dɛn igen
PAPA GƆD se na di blɔd di layf de; ɛn in dɔn gi dɛn fɔ put na di ɔlta fɔ pul sin na dɛn sol. Na di blɔd de beg fɔ dɛn bikɔs i gɛt layf.
Na dat mek PAPA GƆD se ɛni Izrɛlayt ɔ fɔrina we tap wit dɛn nɔ fɔ it ɛnitin we gɛt blɔd.
I se ɛni Izrɛlayt ɔ fɔrina we tap wit dɛn we de go ɔntin ɔ kech bɔd fɔ it, fɔ dig ol, put di blɔd afta i dɔn kil di animal ɔ bɔd, ɛn kɔba am wit dɔti.
Bikɔs we blɔd de pan ɛnitin dat min se i gɛt layf, na dat mek PAPA GƆD se nɔ fɔ it ɛnitin we gɛt blɔd, as na we ɛnitin gɛt blɔd yu go se i gɛt layf; if pɔsin it blɔd i nɔ go miks wit ɔda pipul igen
Ɛnibɔdi we it bif we day fɔ insɛf ɔ we wayl bist kil, wɛda na Izrɛlayt ɔ na fɔrina, fɔ was in klos, was insɛf ɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm, bifo i go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Bɔt if i nɔ was in klos ɛn was insɛf, i go bia wetin go bi to am.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis
fɔ tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, in se nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
I se nɔto wetin di Ijipshian dɛn we na dɛn land dɛn bin tap, nɔto di sem tin dɛn fɔ du ɛn dɛn nɔ fɔ ivin fala fɔ du wetin di Kenanayt, usay dɛn de go, de du. Nɔ fɔ fala dɛn aw dɛn de biev.
Na wetin PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ du, nain fɔ du, bikɔs nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD.
Na dat mek dɛn fɔ du wetin i se ɛn we pɔsin du wetin PAPA GƆD se fɔ du, dat go mek i bɛtɛ na wɔl. Nain na PAPA GƆD.
I se nɔn pan dɛn nɔ fɔ ask uman we i fambul to fɔ lidɔm wit am. I se nain na PAPA GƆD.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ si in papa in nekɛdnɛs bikɔs i jɛs tan lɛk na yu mama yu dɔn si, ɛn na yu mama, yu nɔ fɔ si in nekɛdnɛs.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ lidɔm wit in papa in wɛf. I jɛs tan lɛk na yu papa in nekɛdnɛs yu dɔn si.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ lidɔm wit in sista, wɛda dɛn gɛt di sem mama ɛn papa, ɔ na wan pan dɛn nɔmɔ na di sem, ɔ wɛda dɛn ɔl mɛn na di sem os ɔ nɔt.
Man nɔ fɔ lidɔm wit in grampikin we in bɔy ɔ gyal pikin bɔn, we na uman, bikɔs dɛn na yu yon blɔd..
If na pɔsin in papa in wɛf bɔn di gyal pikin sɛf, wans nain papa bɔn am, i nɔ fɔ mek i pul klos fɔ am bikɔs nain sista.
Pɔsin nɔ fɔ mek in papa in sista pul klos fɔ am bikɔs nain papa in klos fambul.
I nɔ fɔ mek in mama in sista sɛf pul klos fɔ am bikɔs nain mama insɛf yon klos fambul.
Nɔ fɔ mek pɔsin in ɔnkul wɛf pul klos fɔ am bikɔs i go disgres in ɔnkul ɛn i fɔ mɛmba se nain anti.
Pɔsin nɔ fɔ disgres in dɔtɛnlɔ ɛn mek i pul klos fɔ am; nain bɔypikin in wɛf so nɔ fɔ disgres am.
If pɔsin mek in brɔda wɛf pul klos fɔ am, nain brɔda i de disgres.

Nɔ fɔ mek mami ɛn in gyal pikin pul klos fɔ pɔsin, nɔ fɔ ivin mek ɛni pan in grampikin dɛn, wɛda nain bɔypikin, in pikin, ɔ nain gyal pikin, in pikin, pul klos fɔ am. Na bad, bad tin bikɔs dɛn ɔl nain klos fambul.
If pɔsin kin mared tu uman, i fɔ mek sho se dɛn ɔltu nɔto sista we wan nɔ day yet.
I se man nɔ fɔ mek uman pul klos fɔ am tɛm we i de si in piriɔd.
Man nɔ fɔ kip in kɔmpin wɛf bikɔs dat nɔ go mek i klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
PAPA GƆD se nɔn pan dɛn nɔ fɔ sakrifays ɛni pan dɛn pikin na faya to Molɛk bikɔs dat go mek dɛn put shem pan PAPA GƆD in nem. I se nain na PAPA GƆD.
Man nɔ fɔ ledɔm wit in kɔmpin man lɛkɛ se na uman, dɛn dɔn du bad bad tin.
Man nɔ fɔ tek animal mek wɛf ɛn mek insɛf nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, ɛn uman sɛf nɔ fɔ tek animal mek man: na bad bad tin da wande.
Mozis tɛl dɛn se, PAPA GƆD se dɛn nɔ fɔ du ɛni pan dɛn tin we i dɔn tɔn bɔt so bikɔs na dɛn sem tin dɛn de mek i drɛb di neshɔn dɛn we bin tap de mek dɛn nɔ go mek dɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay;
ɛn dat sɛf go mek di land insɛf nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, we go mek PAPA GƆD pɔnish di land fɔseka di bad tin dɛn we dɛn du, ɛn i go mek di pipul dɛn kɔmɔt na di land lɛkɛ aw pɔsin de vɔmit it.
I se di Izrɛlayt dɛn nɔ fɔ tan lɛk di pipul dɛn we bin tap na di land ɛn du ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we dɛn de du. I se dɛn fɔ du wetin i se, dat na, dɛn we bɔn de ɔ di wan dɛn we go tap wit dɛn
bikɔs na ɔl dɛn bad tin dɛn de di pipul dɛn we bin tap na di land bifo dɛn, bin du, we mek di land nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay;
na di sem tin go apin to dɛnsɛf if dɛn biev lɛkɛ dɛn pipul de. Di land go mek di pipul dɛn kɔmɔt de lɛkɛ aw pɔsin de vɔmit it, if dɛn mek i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
I se if ɛniwan pan dɛn du dɛn bad bad tin we nɔ fɔ du, dɛn fɔ drɛb dɛn kɔmɔt Izrɛl.
I se dɛn fɔ du wetin in se ɛn nɔ fala fɔ du di bad bad tin dɛn we di pipul bifo dɛn bin de du so dat dɛn nɔ go mek dɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay: nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
Dɔn PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis bak se,
mek i tɛl ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, dɛn fɔ oli bikɔs PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD oli.
I se ich wan pan dɛn fɔ rɛspɛkt in mama ɛn papa, du wetin in we na PAPA GƆD se fɔ du di de we mek sɛvin we na fɔ blo bikɔs nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
I se nɔ fɔ lɛf am go wɔship dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn we nɔ min natin we dɛn mɛlt ayɛn fɔ mek bikɔs nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
I se we dɛn kil animal fɔ mek sakrifays fɔ sho se dɛn want wanwɔd wit PAPA GƆD, dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn du ɔl wetin go mek PAPA GƆD gladi fɔ tek am.
Dɛn kin it am di sem de ɛn it di wan we lɛf, di nɛks de mɔnin, bɔt if i stil lɛf fɔ di tɔd de, dɛn fɔ bɔn am na faya.
If pɔsin it di bif we lɛf di tɔd de, na bad bad tin i du ɛn PAPA GƆD nɔ go aksɛpt in sakrifays,
ɛn ɛnibɔdi we it am go bia wit wetin gɛt fɔ bi bikɔs i go dɔn mek wetin oli to PAPA GƆD lɛk tin we nɔ oli ɛn so i nɔ go mek da pɔsin de miks wit in pipul igen
I se wɛn di pipul go dɔn rich na di land ɛn bigin fɔ avɛst di tin dɛn we dɛn plant, dɛn nɔ fɔ pik ɔltin we dɛn plant lɛkɛ dɛn wan we de na dɛn kɔna ɔ dɛn wan we kin fɔdɔm na dɛn an ɛn lɛf am arara.
Ɛn ivin we na frut dɛn de pik, dɛn nɔ fɔ pik ɔltin na di tik dɛn; dɛn fɔ lɛf sɔm fɔ poman ɔ fɔ ɛni trenja: nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
I se nɔ fɔ tif nɔ mek dabaru ɔ lay gi dɛn kɔmpin.
Nɔ yuz PAPA GƆD in nem fɔ swɛ mek pɔsin biliv dɛn we dɛn de lay, bay dat dɛn de sho se dɛn nɔ rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD: nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
Nɔ ple rikishi pan yu kɔmpin ɛn tif am. If man fɔ pe pɔsin fɔ wok we i du, di man fɔ mek shɔ se i pe di pɔsin we du di wok di sem de we di wok dɔn.
Nɔ fɔ tɔk tɔk we dɛfyes man nɔ go yɛri ɛn ansa bak ɔ put tin na rod we blɛnyay man go jam ɛn fɔdɔm.
I se we pɔsin dɛn de jɔj kes na kot, nɔ fɔ luk fes; dat na nɔ fɔ gi pɔsin rayt bikɔs i po ɔ jɛntri bɔt fɔ trit dɛn kɔmpin fia wan.
Nɔ fɔ sidɔm pan pwɛl nem midul pipul, ɛn nɔ mek pɔsin lɔs in layf bikɔs yu want in prɔpati.
I se nɔ fɔ kip pɔsin na at ɛn nɔ tɛl di wan we du rɔŋ wetin i du rɔŋ ɔ nɔ so di pɔsin we nɔ tɛl am go sɔfa lɛkɛ am fɔ dat.
Pɔsin nɔ fɔ du bad to udat du am bad ɛn i nɔ fɔ kip in kɔmpin na at bɔt i fɔ lɛk in kɔmpin lɛk aw i lɛk insɛf: i se nain na PAPA GƆD.
I se na fɔ du wetin in se. Nɔ fɔ mek tu difrɛn animal we pɔsin de mɛn bɔn pikin togɛda; nɔ fɔ plant tu difrɛn sid na di sem fil; ɛn nɔ fɔ wɛr klos we na tu difrɛn kayn matirial dɛn tek fɔ so am.

I se if ɛniman gɛt sɛks wit uman we na slev bɔt we man bin dɔn kɔmɔt fɔ, ivin if di man nɔ pe fɔ am yet, na fɔ pɔnish di uman slev ɛn di man we slip wit am. Bɔt dɛn nɔ go kil dɛn bikɔs di uman na slev stil;
bɔt di man we slip wit di slev fɔ kɛr ɔfrin fɔseka wetin i fɔ sɔfa go to PAPA GƆD na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit am in domɔt, na man ship i fɔ gi fɔ di ɔfrin.
Dɔn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go beg PAPA GƆD padin fɔ di sin we i dɔn sin wit di man ship we i kɛr fɔseka wetin i fɔ sɔfa ɛn PAPA GƆD go fɔgiv am.
I se, we dɛn go dɔn go insay Kenan ɛn go dɛn plant ɔlkayn tik we go bia frut fɔ it, dɛn dɛn nɔ fɔ it di ɔda pipul dɛn yon frut fɔ tri ia bikɔs i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Na di ia we mek fo, ɔl dɛn frut dɛn go dɔn fit fɔ mek dɛn gi PAPA GƆD fɔ prez ɔfrin.
Bɔt na te di ia we mek fayv, dɛn fɔ it pan dɛn frut. If dɛn du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD se, dɛn frut dɛn we dɛn plant go bia bɔku.
I se dɛn nɔ fɔ it bif we dɛn nɔ kɔt di animal in trot fɔ kil am. Nɔ fɔ miks pan wich ɔ ɛni majik biznɛs.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ shev pan di ia we de nain fes in sayd, ɔ shep in biabia lɛk got biabia fɔ seka dayman..
Pɔsin nɔ fɔ kɔt kɔt in bɔdi se i de munin, ɔ mek tatu ɔ ɛni ɔda mak nain bɔdi fɔ seka dayman.
Pɔsin nɔ fɔ disgres in gyal pikin ɛn mek i biev lɛk rare gyal fɔ go wɔship ɔda gɔd ɔ nɔ so, na so dɛn ɔl go biev ɛn go mek soso bad de na di land.
Pɔsin fɔ mɛmba fɔ blo di de we mek sɛvin ɛn rɛspɛkt usay dɛn kin wɔship PAPA GƆD: i se nain na PAPA GƆD.
I se dɛn nɔ fɔ go to dɛn wan we kin wek dayman ɔ kin tɔk bɔt wetin go apin bambay; ɔ nɔ so dɛn nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay. I se nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
I se fɔ sho se pɔsin de rɛspɛkt old pipul ɛn fred PAPA GƆD so fɔ du wetin i se: nain na PAPA GƆD.
I se if trenja kam tap wit dɛn, dɛn nɔ fɔ trit am bad.
Dɛn fɔ trit di trenja we tap wit dɛn lɛk wan pan dɛn; fɔ lɛk am lɛk aw dɛn lɛk dɛnsɛf bikɔs dɛnsɛf na bin trenja na Ijipt; I se nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
We dɛn de mɛzhɔ wet ɔ aw lɔŋ tin bi ɔ ɔmɔs fɔ gi pɔsin, nɔ fɔ rog.
I se dɛn fɔ yuz ɔnɛs skel, ɛn ɔda tin dɛn fɔ mɛnshɔ tin dɛn. I se nain na PAPA GƆD we pul dɛn kɔmɔt pan slev layf na Ijipt.
I se dɛn nɔ fɔ fɔgɛt fɔ du ɔl wetin in dɔn se bikɔs nain na PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
mek i tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, ɛni Izrɛlayt ɔ trenja we de na Izrɛl, we de gi in pikin fɔ sakrifays to Molɛk, dɛn fɔ kil am; di ɔda pipul fɔ ston am te i day.
I se insɛf go dison di pɔsin ɛn i nɔ go miks wit in pipul igen bikɔs nain tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit am i go de mek nɔ klin nain yay, ɛn i go de disgres in nem.
I se if di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn mek nɔ no wetin di man du, ɛn nɔ gri fɔ kil am,
dɛn nɔto di man nɔmɔ PAPA GƆD go dison, i go dison in famili ɛn ɔl udat de fala am pan wetin i de du we i de biev lɛk rare gyal to Molɛk we na ɔda gɔd.
I tɔk bak se if pɔsin biev lɛk rare gyal ɛn go to dɛn wan we kin wek dayman ɔ we kin tɔk bɔt wetin go apin bambay, i go dison da pɔsin de ɛn i nɔ go mek i miks wit in pipul igen
I se so naw, dɛn fɔ mek dɛnsɛf oli to PAPA GƆD; bikɔs nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
Dɛn fɔ du wetin i se bikɔs nain na PAPA GƆD ɛn i go mek dɛn oli.
I se if man tɔk bad bɔt in mama ɛn papa, dɛn fɔ kil am; nain tɔk bad bɔt in mama ɛn papa, so, nain fɔ day.
If man lɛf in wɛf go kip in kɔmpin in wɛf, dɛn fɔ kil di man ɛn di uman bikɔs na dɛn kɔmit sin.
Man we mek in papa in wɛf pul klos fɔ am dɔn disgres in papa, dɛn fɔ kil di man ɛn di uman bikɔs na dɛn kɔmit sin.
If man lidɔm wit in dɔtɛnlɔ, na bad bad tin; dɛn fɔ kil dɛn ɔltu bikɔs na dɛn kɔmit sin.
If man ledɔm wit in kɔmpin man lɛkɛ se na uman, dɛn ɔltu dɔn du bad bad tin; dɛn fɔ kil dɛn bikɔs dɛn blɔd go de na dɛn yon ed..
If man mared uman dɔn we i dɔn, i kip in mama, na bad bad tin da wande; dɛn fɔ bɔn dɛn ɔltu na faya ɛn dat go mek nɔbɔdi nɔ dat igen
If man lidɔm wit animal, dɛn fɔ kil am ɛn dɛn fɔ kil di animal insɛf.
If na uman sɛf go lidɔm wit di animal, na dɛn ɔltu fɔ kil, na dɛn fɛn dɛn day fɔ dɛnsɛf.

I se, if man tap na os wit in sista, wɛda nain papa in pikin ɔ nain mama in pikin, dɔn dɛn pul klos fɔ dɛn kɔmpin, na disgres da wande, nɔ fɔ mek dɛn miks wit di ɔda pipul igen, i dɔn mek in sista pul klos fɔ am, so dɛn go bia wetin go bi to am.
If man mek uman we de si in piriɔd pul klos fɔ am ɛn i lidɔm wit am, i dɔn ɛkspoz am ɛn di uman dɔn ɛkspoz di blɔd. Dɛn fɔ drɛb am kɔmɔt Izrɛl.
Pɔsin nɔ fɔ mek in mama ɔ papa sista pul klos fɔ am bikɔs nain klos fambul ɛn dɛn go bia wetin go bi to dɛn.
If man lidɔm wit in ɔnkul in wɛf, nain ɔnkul i disgres, dɛn ɔltu dɔn kɔmit sin, so, dɛn fɔ tek ɛni pikin we dɛn bɔn na dɛn an ɛn dɛn go day lɛk udat nɔ bɔn pikin.
If man mared in brɔda wɛf we di brɔda nɔ day yet, na dɔti gem ɛn i nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay; nain brɔda i disgres, na fɔ tek ɛni pikin we dɛn bɔn na dɛn an.
I se na dat mek dɛn fɔ du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD se ɛn obe in lɔ dɛn so dat di land we dɛn de go nɔ go mek di pipul dɛn kɔmɔt de lɛkɛ aw pɔsin de vɔmit it.
So dɛn nɔ fɔ biev lɛk di neshɔn we bin de de bifo dɛn as na ɔl dɛn bad tin we i dɔn tɔk bɔt so, nain dɛn bin du we mek PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk dɛn biznɛs.

Bɔt PAPA GƆD in dɔn tɛl dɛn se, dɛn go gɛt di land as dɛn prɔpati, dɛn go kapchɔ am, land we fayn fɔ plant ɛn mɛn animal dɛn. I se nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD ɛn nain dɔn mek dɛn difrɛn frɔm ɔda pipul.

Na dat mek dɛnsɛf fɔ sho se animal we klin na PAPA GƆD yay difrɛn frɔm di wan we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, bɔd we klin na PAPA GƆD yay difrɛn frɔm bɔd we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay. So, dɛn nɔ fɔ mek animal ɔ bɔd ɔ ɛni dɛn tin dɛn we de pas pas na wɔl we i se nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, mek dɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
I se dɛn gɛt fɔ oli lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD oli ɛn dɛn na PAPA GƆD yon pipul we mek dɛn difrɛn frɔm di ɔda wan dɛn.
I se fɔ ston dɛn wan we kin wek dayman ɔ we kin tɔk bɔt wetin go apin bambay te dɛn day; na dɛn kɔmit sin.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis fɔ tɛl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, dat na Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛn, se, dɛn nɔn nɔ fɔ mek dɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay fɔseka ɛni dɛn fambul we dɔn day,
pas nɔmɔ if dɛn ɔl tap na wan os lɛkɛ dɛn mama, papa, pikin, brɔda,
ɔ sista we de na os bikɔs i nɔ mared yet. Na fɔ lɛkɛ dɛn wan ya nɔmɔ dɛn go mek dɛnsɛf nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
If na bay mared dɛn fambul to di pɔsin, dɛn nɔ fɔ mek dɛnsɛf nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
I se dɛn nɔn nɔ fɔ krep wan pat pan dɛn ed fɔ mek bɔled, nɔ fɔ skrep pan di ia we de na dɛn dɛn fes in sayd ɔ shep dɛn biabia lɛk got ɔ mak mak idɛn bɔdi.
Dɛn fɔ oli fɔ PAPA GƆD ɛn nɔ put shem pan PAPA GƆD in nem; dɛn de mek sakrifays na faya to PAPA GƆD, ɛn nain it so dɛn fɔ oli.

Dɛn nɔ fɔ mared uman we de biev lɛk rare gyal fɔ go wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn ɔ uman we nɔto vajin ɛn dɛn nɔ fɔ mared uman we nɔ tap na os wit in fɔs man igen, bikɔs dɛn na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin so dɛn fɔ oli fɔ PAPA GƆD.
I se di pipul dɛnsɛf fɔ trit dɛn lɛkɛ se dɛn oli bikɔs na dɛn de gi PAPA GƆD it so dɛn fɔ oli as in PAPA GƆD we de mek dɛn oli, insɛf oli.
If di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin in gyal pikin disgres insɛf ɛn biev lɛk rare gyal fɔ go wɔship ɔda gɔd ɛn disgres in papa, na fɔ bɔn am na faya.

Di bigman pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we nain ed dɛn bin anɔynt wit ɔyl, ɛn we nain bin wɛr dɛn klos we na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin kin wɛr, nɔ fɔ lɛf di ia nain ed so ɛn nɔ kom am, i nɔ fɔ chɛr chɛr in klos fɔ sho se i gɛt bɛrin,
nɔ fɔ go nia dedebɔdi ɛn mek insɛf nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, i lɛk sɛf nain mama ɔ in papa;
i nɔ fɔ kɔmɔt na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD fɔseka bɛrin ɛn disgres di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD bikɔs di ɔyl we de pan am sho se in na PAPA GƆD yon; i se nain na PAPA GƆD.
Na uman we na vajin i fɔ mared.
Nɔ fɔ mared uman we in man dɔn day, ɔ wan we in man dɔn lɛf am, ɔ uman we biev lɛk rare gyal fɔ go wɔship ɔda gɔd bɔt i fɔ mared vajin we kɔmɔt na di sem fambul,
dis na fɔ mek i nɔ mek in pikin dɛn disgres midul pipul; bikɔs nain na PAPA GƆD we de mek am oli.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
mek i tɛl Erɔn se nɔn pan in pipul na ɔl in jɛnareshɔn, we go gɛt bɔt pan am, nɔ go gi PAPA GƆD it.
Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt bɔt nɔ go go nia in ɔlta, wɛda na blɛnyay man ɔ na man we nɔ de waka ɔ man we gɛt prɔblɛm wit in fes ɔ man we nɔ de waka bɛtɛ,
ɔ man we in an ɔ in fut gɛt smɔl prɔblɛm,
ɔ man we gɛt ɔmbak, ɔ man we shɔt lɛk dwaf, ɔ man we in yay ambɔg, ɔ we gɛt sɔm kayn rash nain bɔdi ɔ we dɔn tɔn okobo;
nɔbɔdi we na Erɔn in jɛnareshɔn we gɛt bɔt nɔ go go nia di ɔlta se i de mek ɔfrin na faya to PAPA GƆD; as i gɛt bɔt, i nɔ fɔ go nia di ɔlta fɔ gi PAPA GƆD it.
I kin it pan it we dɛn de gi PAPA GƆD, dat na ɔl di it we oli,
bɔt i nɔ fɔ go nia di klos we ɛŋ na di domɔt ɔ di ɔlta bikɔs i gɛt bɔt ɛn i go put shem pan di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD wit ɔl wetin de de; bikɔs nain na PAPA GƆD we de mek dɛn oli.
So Mozis tɛl Erɔn, in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn ɔl di pipul wetin PAPA GƆD se.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis,
fɔ tɛl Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn mek dɛn nɔ jok wit di oli tin dɛn we di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn pre pan so dat dɛn nɔ go put shem pan in nem: I se nain na PAPA GƆD.

I se Mozis fɔ tɛl dɛn se if ɛniwan na dɛn jɛnareshɔn go nia di oli tin dɛn we di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn pre pan, we i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD in yay, i nɔ go mek i bi man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin igen: I se nain na PAPA GƆD.

Nɔbɔdi we de na Erɔn in jɛnareshɔn we gɛt bad sik nain bɔdi ɔ we de pul wata kɔmɔt insay am fɔ it pan di oli tin dɛn te i klin na PAPA GƆD yay. I se ɛnibɔdi we tɔch wetin nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay lɛkɛ if i tɔch udat dɔn tɔch dedebɔdi ɔ if nainsɛf de pul wata kɔmɔt insay am,
ɛn ɛnibɔdi we tɔch tin we go mek i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, i lɛk wetin dat bi,
nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay te ivintɛm ɛn i nɔ go it pan di oli tin dɛn te i was in bɔdi.
Wans san dɔn go dɔŋ, i klin na PAPA GƆD yay so i kin it pan di oli tin dɛn, bikɔs na dɛn we na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin gɛt di it.
Nɔ fɔ it animal we day fɔ insɛf ɔ animal we dɛn wayl bif kil bikɔs dat go mek i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay: I se nain na PAPA GƆD.
I se ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ du ɔl wetin i tɛl dɛn fɔ du ɔ nɔ so dɛn go bia wetin go bi wit dɛn we dɛn put shem pan PAPA GƆD in nem: I se nain na PAPA GƆD we de mek dɛn oli.
Na udat de na di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn jɛnareshɔn nɔmɔ, fɔ it pan di oli tin dɛn. Ɛnibɔdi we na trenja nain os ɔ we de wok fɔ pe, nɔ fɔ it pan di oli tin dɛn;
bɔt if na slev i bay, we nain prɔpati, i fɔ it de; ɛn ɛnibɔdi we bɔn nain os kin it wetin in de it.
If i gɛt gyal pikin we dɔn mared pɔsin we nɔto man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, i nɔ fɔ it pan di oli tin dɛn.

Bɔt if di gyal pikin in man dɔn day, ɔ i dɔn drɛb am na os ɔ i nɔ bɔn pikin we go kia fɔ am, we mek i go bak nain papa in os, lɛkɛ se in na pikin stil, i kin it pan in papa in it bɔt nɔn ɔda pɔsin na di os we na trenja nɔ fɔ it de.
If pɔsin it pan di oli tin dɛn we i nɔ no se nain i de it, i fɔ gi di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin di it bak ɛn ad twɛnti pasɛnt pan di it.
Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ fɔ put shem pan di oli tin dɛn we di Izrɛlayt dɛn de gi PAPA GƆD,
we dɛn go mek udat nɔ fɔ it pan di oli tin dɛn it de ɛn dat go mek di pipul dɛn sɔfa fɔ dat: bikɔs nain na PAPA GƆD we de mek dɛn oli.
Dɔn PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se

mek i tɛl Erɔn, in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn se, wɛn ɛniwan pan dɛn ɔ ɛni trenja we tap wit dɛn, wɛda na fɔ du wetin dɛn prɔmis ɔ na bikɔs dɛn fil fɔ du am, wans na to PAPA GƆD i de mek am as bɔn ɔfrin,
if i wan PAPA GƆD fɔ tek am, i fɔ bi man we nɔ gɛt bɔt pan in man kaw dɛn, in ship ɔ in got dɛn.
Nɔ fɔ gi ɛnitin we gɛt bɔt bikɔs i nɔ go tek am.

Ɛn wɛn ɛniwan pan dɛn de gi animal fɔ sho se dɛn want wanwɔd wit PAPA GƆD, wɛda na fɔ du wetin dɛn prɔmis ɔ na bikɔs dɛn fil fɔ du am, frɔm di animal dɛn we dɛn de mɛn, dat na di kaw ɔ ship ɔ got dɛn, fɔ mek i bi wetin PAPA GƆD want; i nɔ fɔ gɛt nɔn bɔt.
Nɔ fɔ gi animal we blɛn ɔ we ambɔg ɔ we dɛn dɔn disloket ɔ we gɛt frɛsh wund ɔ we gɛt sɔm kayn sik nain bɔdi, fɔ ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD ɔ yuz am as ɔfrin we dɛn de bɔn na ɔlta to PAPA GƆD.
If di animal bɔn wit pat we nɔ nɔmal, pɔsin kin gi am as ɔfrin we i fil fɔ gi, bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ go tek am if na fɔ wetin i prɔmis se i go du.
Nɔ fɔ gi PAPA GƆD ɛni animal we in prayvet dɔn kɔt, chɛr ɔ brus as sakrifays na di land.
Ɛn nɔ fɔ mek ɔfrin fɔ it we na frɔm fɔrina an dɛn pul am. Dɛn dɔn gɛt bɔt ɔlrɛdi sins di pipul dɛn dɔn mek dɛn nɔ fɔ bɔn igen PAPA GƆD nɔ go tek dɛn kayn sakrifays de.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
If kaw ɔ ship ɔ got bɔn, dɛn fɔ lɛf dɛn pikin wit dɛn fɔ sɛvin de bifo dɛn pul dɛn kɔmɔt to dɛn mami dɛn; ɛn na afta i dɔn ol et de, nain PAPA GƆD go tek am as ɔfrin we dɛn go mek na faya to am.
If di mami na kaw ɔ na ship ɔ got, na fɔ kil in ɛn in pikin di sem de.
If di sakrifays we pɔsin de mek, na sakrifays fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnk, na fɔ mek shɔ se, i du wetin go mek PAPA GƆD tek am.
Na di sem de fɔ it ɔl; natin nɔ fɔ lɛf te mɔnin: I se nain na PAPA GƆD.
I se na ɔl dat dɛn fɔ de du: nain na PAPA GƆD.
Ɛn nɔ fɔ du ɛnitin we go put in nem pan shem bɔt we go mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn si se i oli; I se nain na PAPA GƆD we de mek dɛn oli,
we pul dɛn kɔmɔt pan slev layf na Ijipt fɔ mek i bi dɛn PAPA GƆD: I se nain na PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
mek i tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, na dɛn de dɛn we in PAPA GƆD dɔn pik fɔ mit am, we dɛn go gɛda fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD, i de kam tɛl dɛn so.
Na siks de nɔmɔ dɛn fɔ wok; bɔt di de we mek sɛvin na de fɔ blo, na de we fɔ gɛda ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD; nɔ fɔ du nɔn wok, na di de we mek sɛvin we na de fɔ PAPA GƆD, i lɛk usay dɛn de.
Na di fist dɛn dɛnwanya fɔ PAPA GƆD; di tɛm dɛn we dɛn fɔ gɛda bifo PAPA GƆD, we una sɔpoz fɔ du we di tɛm rich.
Di ivintɛm na di fotin de insay di fɔs mɔnt, dɛn fɔ sɛlibret di Pasova to PAPA GƆD.
Di fiftin de insay da sem mɔnt de, dɛn fɔ mek gladi-gladi we dɛn fɔ it bred we nɔ gɛt yist, fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD; na sɛvin de dɛn fɔ it bred we nɔ gɛt yist.
Di fɔs de na di sɛlibreshɔn, dɛn ɔl fɔ gɛda fɔ wɔship am; ɛn dɛn nɔ fɔ du dɛn nɔmal wok we dɛn kin du ɛvride.
Fɔ di sɛvin de, dɛn fɔ de mek ɔfrin na faya to PAPA GƆD; fɔ gɛda fɔ wɔship am di de we mek sɛvin ɛn dɛn nɔ fɔ du dɛn nɔmal wok we dɛn kin du ɛvride.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
mek i tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, wɛn dɛn rich na di land we i de gi dɛn, ɛn bigin avɛst di tin dɛn we dɛn plant, di fɔs bɔndul pan di bali we dɛn pul, na fɔ gi di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin;
ɛn in naw fɔ gi am lɛk se na spɛshal prɛzɛnt i de gi PAPA GƆD, so dat i go tek am; na di mɔnin afta dɛn dɔn blo, di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ gi am lɛk spɛshal prɛzɛnt.
Na da sem de de, dɛn fɔ gi wan yɔŋ man ship we nɔ gɛt bɔt as bɔn ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD.
Ɛn di sid ɔfrin we de go wit am fɔ bi sikstin kɔp fayn flawa miks wit ɔyl ɛn dɛn fɔ mek am na faya so dat i go pul fayn sɛnt we go mek PAPA GƆD gladi; ɛn di drink ɔfrin go bi wan lita wayn.
Ɛn nɔ fɔ it bred, pach it ɔ frɛsh it te dɛn dɔn gi dɛn ɔfrin to dɛn PAPA GƆD: na tin dis we na lɔ ɛn i fɔ bi na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn, i lɛk usay dɛn de.
I se fɔ kɔnt sɛvin wik frɔm di mɔnin afta di de we mek sɛvin we na fɔ blo, dat na di tɛm we dɛn bin avɛst di fɔs bali we dɛn bin gi as spɛshal prɛzɛnt,
te fifti de to di mɔnin afta di nɔmba sɛvin tɛm we na di sɛvin de fɔ blo ɛn na da tɛm de dɛn fɔ gi PAPA GƆD di nyu sid ɔfrin.

Fɔ pul tu lof bred we dɛn mek wit sikstin kɔp fayn flawa ɛn we dɛn bek wit yist kɔmɔt ɛnisay we dɛn de, so dat di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go gi am as spɛshal prɛzɛnt to PAPA GƆD as di fɔs tin we dɛn avɛst.

Ɛn fɔ gi bred wit sɛvin yɔŋ ship we ol wan ia, wan yɔŋ man kaw ɛn tu man ship ɛn dɛn nɔn nɔ fɔ gɛt bɔt,; dɛn fɔ bi bɔn ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD wit dɛn sid ɛn drink ɔfrin dɛn wit dɛn; na ɔfrin we dɛn go mek na faya ɛn i fɔ pul fayn sɛnt we go mek PAPA GƆD gladi.
Dɛn fɔ put wan man got de fɔ tek fɔ beg fɔ padin, ɛn tu man ship we ol wan ia, we go bi fɔ mek wanwɔd wit PAPA GƆD.
Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go gi di bred dɛn wit di tu yɔŋ ship as spɛshal prɛzɛnt to PAPA GƆD fɔseka ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin; dɛn oli.
Fɔ mek anawnsmɛnt da sem de de so dat pipul dɛn go gɛda fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD; dɛn nɔ fɔ du dɛn nɔmal wok we dɛn kin du ɛvride; na tin dis we na lɔ ɛn i fɔ bi na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn, i lɛk usay dɛn de.

I se wɛn dɛn de avɛst di tin dɛn we dɛn plant, dɛn nɔ fɔ pik ɔltin we dɛn plant lɛkɛ dɛn wan we de na dɛn kɔna ɔ dɛn wan we kin fɔdɔm na dɛn an ɛn lɛf am arara; dɛn fɔ lɛf sɔm fɔ poman ɔ fɔ ɛni trenja: I se nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
mek i tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, na di fɔs de na di mɔnt we mek sɛvin, fɔ blo pan ɔltin, fɔ blo trɔmpɛt dɛn we go kɔl ɔlman fɔ gɛda fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD.
Nɔ fɔ du dɛn nɔmal wok we dɛn kin du ɛvride; fɔ gi PAPA GƆD ɔfrin we dɛn mek na faya.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
di tɛn de na di sɛvin mɔnt na de we na fɔ fɔgiv sin, so i fɔ bi tɛm we dɛn fɔ gɛda fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD ɛn na di de we dɛn fɔ fast ɛn mek ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD na faya.
Na de we nɔ fɔ du nɔn wok bɔt na fɔ beg PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD fɔ padin dɛn sin.
Ɛnibɔdi we nɔ fast da de de, dɛn fɔ drɛb am kɔmɔt Izrɛl.
Ɛn ɛnibɔdi we du wok da de de go lɔs in layf.
Nɔ fɔ du nɔn wok: na tin dis we na lɔ ɛn i fɔ bi na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn, i lɛk usay dɛn de.
Dis de fɔ tan lɛk ɛni sɛvin de we na fɔ blo, ɛn dɛn fɔ fast; frɔm di ivintɛm na di de we mek nayn te di ɔda de ivintɛm, nain dɛn fɔ blo ɛn nɔ du wok ɛn fɔ fast.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
mek i tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, frɔm di fiftin de na di mɔnt we mek sɛvin ɛn fɔ sɛvin de, dɛn fɔ tap na bafa.
Di fɔs de, dɛn fɔ gɛda ɔlman fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD; nɔ fɔ du nɔn pan dɛn dɛn nɔmal wok we dɛn kin du ɛvride.

Fɔ sɛvin de fɔ de mek ɔfrin dɛn na faya to PAPA GƆD; di de we mek et fɔ mek ɔlman gɛda bak fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD ɛn gi wan ɔfrin na faya to PAPA GƆD; dɛn ɔl gɛda wan ples ɛn nɔ fɔ du dɛn nɔmal wok we dɛn kin du ɛvride.

I se na di de dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn pik fɔ mit am, we dɛn go gɛda fɔ wɔship GƆD ɛn we dɛn go gi ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD na faya wɛda na bɔn ɔfrin ɔ na sid ɔfrin, ɔda sakrifays dɛn ɛn drink ɔfrin di de we dɛn fɔ du am.
Ɔl dat nɔ fɔ miks pan di nɔmal ɔfrin we dɛn kin mek di de we mek sɛvin fɔ blo, dɛn ɔda prɛzɛnt dɛn, di wan we dɛn bawn fɔ mek ɛn di wan we dɛn fil fɔ mek.

Bay di fiftin de na di mɔnt we mek sɛvin, afta dɛn go dɔn avɛst wetin dɛn plant, dɛn fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se fɔ sɛvin de; di fɔs de dɛn fɔ blo bɔt fɔ gɛda fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD ɛn di de we mek et, dɛn fɔ du so bak.
Di fɔs de, dɛn fɔ tek dɛn frut we gɛt wata, pam branch ɛn ɔda branch dɛn we gɛt lif, wit dɛn smɔl smɔl flawa we kin gro nia watasay ɛn fɔ de gladi gladi fɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ sɛvin de.
Na sɛlibreshɔn dis fɔ PAPA GƆD ɛn fɔ de du am sɛvin de na di ia; na tin dis we na lɔ ɛn i fɔ bi na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn ɛn nainsay di mɔnt we mek sɛvin fɔ du am.
Na fɔ tap na bafa fɔ sɛvin de wans dɛn na bɔn Izrɛlayt,
so dat dɛn jɛnareshɔn go no se na bafa PAPA GƆD bin mek dɛn tap we i pul dɛn kɔmɔt Ijipt: i se nain na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD.
Na so Mozis tek tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn wetin fɔ du di tɛm dɛn we PAPA GƆD pik fɔ mit wit am.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
mek i gi ɔda to di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ kɛr piɔ ɔliv ɔyl we dɛn pul pan ɔliv we dɛn dɔn gren, fɔ di lamp, so dat di lamp go de layt ɔltɛm.
Bifo di klos we ɛŋ na di ples we oli pas ɔl we ayd di Ak ɔf Di Kɔvinant, Erɔn fɔ mek shɔ se di lamp dɛn de bɔn ɔl di tɛm we dɛn fɔ bɔn; na tin dis we na lɔ ɛn i fɔ bi na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn.
Erɔn fɔ mek shɔ se di lamp dɛn we de pan di gold lampstand dɛn layt ɔltɛm bifo PAPA GƆD.
I se fɔ yuz fɔti et pawns fayn flawa bek twɛlv lof bred. Fɔ pawns flawa fɔ wan kek.
Ɛn dɛn fɔ put am na di tebul we gɛt gold rawnd am, tu tu; so na siks go de na wan ro.
Dɔn fɔ put frankinsɛns na di ro dɛn so dat i go tek di bred in ples as wetin dɛn go sho to PAPA GƆD se nain yon; na ɔfrin we dɛn go bɔn na faya.
Ɛni sɛvin de we na fɔ blo, Erɔn fɔ mek am fayn bifo PAPA GƆD ɔltɛm fɔseka di Izrɛlayt fɔ sho se dɛn dɔn gri fɔ du am sote go.

Fɔ ɔl udat na man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, dɛn fɔ it di bred na ples we oli bikɔs nain na di pat we oli pas ɔl wetin dɛn de gi PAPA GƆD pan ɔl di tin we dɛn de mek na faya to PAPA GƆD, na tin we dɛn gɛt fɔ de du ɔltɛm.
Wande wan man we in mama na Izrɛlayt bɔt in papa na Ijipshian go mit di wan dɛn we dɛn mama ɛn papa na Izrɛlayt; dɔn in ɛn wan pan dɛn mek plaba,
we mek di wan we nɔto piɔ Izrɛlayt tɔk bad bɔt da Nem ɛn yuz am fɔ swɛ. Sɔm pipul we yɛri am kɛr am go to Mozis. In mama bin nem Shelomit we na bin Dibri in gyal pikin ɛn i kɔmɔt na Dan fambul.
Dɛn kip am te dɛn fɛnɔt wetin PAPA GƆD wan mek dɛn du wit am.
So PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se,
fɔ tek di man kɔmɔt insay di kamp; dɔn ɔl udat yɛri am we i de swɛ fɔ le dɛn an pantap in ed ɛn di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn we de rawnd de fɔ ston am te i day.
I se ɛnibɔdi we tɔk bad bɔt in PAPA GƆD go bia wetin go bi.
I se if na PAPA GƆD in nem i tɔk bad bɔt, dɛn fɔ kil am, ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ ston am te i day wɛda in na trenja ɔ na bɔn Izrɛlayt, i fɔ day fɔ we i tɔk bad bɔt PAPA GƆD.
Dɛn fɔ kil ɛnibɔdi we kil in kɔmpin mɔtalman.
If pɔsin kil ɔda pɔsin in animal, i fɔ gi am layf animal bak, na layf fɔ pe fɔ layf.
If pɔsin ambɔg in kɔmpin mɔtalman in bɔdi, di sem tin we i du di pɔsin nain fɔ du to am bak,
if i brok in bon, fɔ brok insɛf yon bon; if i bɔs in yay, fɔ bɔs insɛf yon yay, if i pul in tit, fɔ pul insɛf yon tit; wetin i du to in kɔmpin, nain fɔ du to am bak.
If pɔsin kil ɔda pɔsin in animal, i fɔ gi am layf animal bak; ɛn dɛn fɔ kil ɛnibɔdi we kil in kɔmpin mɔtalman.
I se na di sem lɔ fɔ gɛt fɔ di trenja midul dɛn ɛn fɔ di bɔn Izrɛlayt; bikɔs nain na PAPA GƆD.
So Mozis tɛl ɔl di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn wetin PAPA GƆD se; ɛn dɛn kɛr di man we bin tɔk bad bɔt PAPA GƆD, kɔmɔt insay di kamp ɛn ston am te i day. Na so di pipul dɛn tek du wetin PAPA GƆD se.
We Mozis de na Mawnt Saynay nain PAPA GƆD se,
mek i tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, wɛn dɛn rich na di land we i de gi dɛn, dɛn nɔ fɔ plant natin di ia we mek sɛvin fɔ mek dɛn go blo ɛn rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD.
I se na siks ia dɛn fɔ de wok na dɛn fam dɛn. Dɛn kin plant de ɛn avɛst wetin dɛn plant;
bɔt insay di ia we mek sɛvin, dɛn fɔ blo ɛn de gɛda fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD, na tɛm fɔ PAPA GƆD; dɛn kin plant de ɛn avɛst wetin dɛn plant.
