bikɔs na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD insɛf de go fɛt di ɛnimi fɔ dɛn, ɛn i go mek dɛn win.

Mozis se afta dat, na di ɔfisa dɛn go tɔk to di sojaman dɛn. Dɛn go tɛl dɛn se if ɛnibɔdi no se in dɔn bil os ɛn i nɔ pre pan am yet, lɛ i go pre pan am wantɛm, bikɔs if i day, na ɔda pɔsin go pre pan am fɔ am,
ɛn ɛnibɔdi we de de we bin plant frut dɛn we dɔn rɛp, bɔt nɔ bɛnifit pan dɛn yet, lɛ i go bak nain os wantɛm, bikɔs if i day insay di fɛt, na ɔda man go ɛnjɔy in lebɔ.
If ɛnibɔdi de de we jɔs mared bɔt i nɔ tek in wɛf in vajin yet, lɛ i go bak, bikɔs if i day na di fɛt, na ɔda man go tek in vajin fɔ am.
Mozis se we dɛn go dɔn tɔk ɔl dat dɔn, di ɔfisa dɛn go aks dɛn se if ɛnibɔdi de de we in at wik ɛn de fred, lɛ i go bak wantɛm lɛ i nɔ kam mek in kɔmpin dɛn kam bigin fred.
We di ɔfisa dɛn dɔn tɔk dɔn, dɛn go pik lida dɛn fɔ di difrɛn sojaman grup dɛn.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, ɛni siti we dɛn go fɔ go atak, dɛn fɔ tɛl di pipul dɛn wetin dɛn fɔ du lɛ dɛn nɔ go atak dɛn fɔs.
I tɛl dɛn se if dɛn gri fɔ pis, ɛn dɛn opin dɛn get lɛ di Izrɛlayt dɛn go insay ɛn go tek chaj na dɛn siti, di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ mek dɛn slev lɛ dɛn wok fɔ dɛn bay fos.
Bɔt if dɛn nɔ gri fɔ pis ɛn dɛn rɛdi fɔ fɛt dɛn, Mozis se dɛn fɔ tinap rawnd dɛn siti; nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ go insay, nɔbɔdi nɔ de kɔmɔt,
ɛn as PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD mek dɛn kapchɔ di siti so, di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ kil ɔl di bɔypikin dɛn ɛn di man dɛn.

Bɔt i tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ kil di uman dɛn ɛn di lili pikin dɛn, ɛn dɛn fɔ tek dɛn kaw ship ɛn got dɛn ɛn ɔltin we de na di siti fɔ dɛnsɛf. Mozis tɛl dɛn igen se dɛn fɔ ɛnjɔy dɛn ɛnimi dɛn prɔpati dɛn we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go gi dɛn.
I se na so di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ dil wit dɛn ɛnimi dɛn na ɔl dɛn siti dɛn we de fa frɔm di say we dɛn de.
Bɔt Mozis tɛl dɛn se we dɛn atak dɛn siti dɛn we de nia dɛn we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go gi dɛn fɔ dɛn prɔpati, dɛn nɔ fɔ lɛf natin we gɛt layf;
dɛn fɔ nyakanyaka di Itayt ɛn di Amɔrayt dɛn, di Kenanayt ɛn di Pɛrizayt dɛn, di Ivayts ɛn di Jɛbyusayt dɛn, bikɔs na so PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn se;
so dat dɛn nɔ go lan di Izrɛlayt dɛn, dɛn bad bad tin dɛn we dɛn bin de du, lɛk fɔ wɔship dɛn pegan gɔd dɛn we dat go mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD.

Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se if dɛn fɛt ɛni neshɔn dɛn ɛn i tek dɛn lɔŋ tɛm fɔ kapchɔ dɛn, dɛn nɔ fɔ kɔt di tik dɛn we de de. I tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ wɛr dɛn aks dɛnsɛf pan di tik dɛn bikɔs dɛn go it di frut dɛn wande, ɛn di tik dɛn nɔto mɔtalman we dɛn go se go tinap fɔ fɛt dɛn.
Mozis advays dɛn se dɛn kin kɔt dɛn tik dɛn we nɔ de bia frut, ɛn yuz dɛn fɔ mek lɛda dɛn fɔ klem na di pipul dɛn siti wɔl dɛn we dɛn go go fɛt, te dɛn ebul kapchɔ di siti.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se we dɛn go dɔn tap na di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go gi dɛn, ɛni dedebɔdi we dɛn fɛn na trit we nɔto insay ɛni siti, ɛn dɛn nɔ no udat kil am,
di jɔj dɛn ɛn di ɔda bigman dɛn na di siti dɛn nia usay di dedebɔdi lidɔm, fɔ go de, ɛn mɛnshɔ di grɔn fɔ no us siti di de de bɔdi de nia pas ɔl,
dɔn di bigman dɛn we de na di siti we di dedebɔdi de nia pas ɔl, go tek wan yɔŋ kaw we dɛn nɔ mek du ɛni wok yet,
ɛn kɛr am go na ɛni vali we wata de rɔn ɛn dɛn nɔ plant wande, ɛn twis in nɛk te i day.
Bikɔs na di Livayt dɛn PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn pik fɔ mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn pre fɔ blɛsin, na dɛn fɔ tɔk di kes; wetin dɛn se, nɛf kɔt.
Afta dat, ɔl di bigman dɛn we de na di siti we di dedebɔdi bin de nia pas ɔl, go was dɛn an oba di yɔŋ kaw we dɛn bin dɔn brok in nɛk na di vali.
We dɛn de was dɛn an, dɛn fɔ tɔk se nɔto dɛn kil di pɔsin we day ɛn dɛn nɔ bin si we dɛn de kil am.
So PAPA GƆD, fɔgiv Izrɛl, yu yon pipul dɛn we yu pul na Ijipt, ɛn nɔ mek di sin fɔ di kil we dɛn kil da pɔsin de, kam pan Izrɛl, duya, sɔri fɔ Izrɛl.
Mozis tɛl dɛn se, we dɛn du wetin PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ du, dɛn go ebul pul da kayn sin de kɔmɔt na dɛn land.
Mozis tɛl dɛn se ɛnitɛm we dɛn fɛt ɛn PAPA GƆD mek dɛn kapchɔ dɛn ɛnimi dɛn,
ɛn if sɔmbɔdi si ɛni fayn uman pan dɛn we i want fɔ wɛf,
i kin tek am go nain os, ɛn di uman go krep ɔl in ia nain ed, ɛn kɔt ɔl in fiŋanel ɛn tonel.
I fɔ chenj da klos we i bin wɛr we dɛn bin kapchɔ am ɛn i fɔ munin fɔs fɔ in mama ɛn papa fɔ wan mɔnt, bifo di man go mared am. Dɛn go bi man ɛn wɛf.
Bɔt if di man si se i nɔ want am fɔ wɛf igen afta dat, di man fɔ lɛf am lɛ i go usay i want fɔ go; i nɔ go rayt fɔ sɛt am ɔ trit am lɛkɛ slev afta i dɔn mek i shem.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, ɛnibɔdi we gɛt tu wɛf we na wan i lɛk pan dɛn tu, ɛn dɛn tu bɔn bɔypikin dɛn fɔ am, bɔt na di wan we i nɔ lɛk bɔn di fɔs-bɔy-pikin,
we i de sheb in prɔpati, i nɔ fɔ gi di uman we i lɛk in yon fɔs-bɔy-pikin, di fɔs-bɔy-pikin pawa, bikɔs na di uman we i nɔ lɛk in yon fɔs-bɔy-pikin na di big wan.

I fɔ trit di uman we i nɔ lɛk, in yon fɔs-bɔy-pikin as di big wan, so i fɔ sheb in prɔpati tri pat, ɛn gi am tu pat, bikɔs nain fɔs mek ɔlman no se in papa ebul bɔn bɔypikin. Nain gɛt di fɔs-bɔy-pikin pawa.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se if ɛnibɔdi gɛt bɔypikin we traŋayes bad bad wan, ɛn i nɔ de yɛri in mami ɛn dadi wɔd ɔl we dɛn dɔn bit bit am,
in mami ɛn dadi fɔ kɛr am go to di bigman dɛn na di famili dɛn na di kot os na dɛn siti get.
We dɛn kɛr am go de, dɛn fɔ tɛl di bigman dɛn na di famili dɛn se, da dɛn bɔypikin de nɔ de yɛri dɛn wɔd; i jɛs de du wetin i want. I de it ɛn drink drɔnk bɔku bɔku wan.

As dɛn tɔk dat so, ɔl di man dɛn we de na di siti fɔ ston am te i day. I se, dat go mek dɛn go de pul di bad tin dɛn kɔmɔt na Izrɛl, bikɔs, we pipul dɛn yɛri se dɛn kayn tin dɛn de apin, dɛn go de fred fɔ du bad.
Mozis tɛl dɛn se if pɔsin du tin we mek dɛn ɛŋ am na tik,
in de dedebɔdi nɔ fɔ de na di tik te di nɛks de. I se dɛn fɔ bɛr am di sem de lɛ dɛn nɔ mek swɛ go na di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD gi dɛn, bikɔs PAPA GƆD put swɛ pan dayman we ɛŋ na tik.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ si dɛn brɔda in man kaw ɔ in ship dɛn de go usay dɛn nɔ fɔ go, ɛn se dat nɔto dɛn biznɛs; dɛn fɔ kɛr dɛn go bak usay dɛn kɔmɔt.
I tɛl dɛn se if di pɔsin we gɛt dɛn de fa, ɔ dɛn nɔ no udat gɛt dɛn, dɛn fɔ kip dɛn na dɛn yon os te di wan we gɛt dɛn, tɔk se in ship ɔ kaw lɔs. We i aks, dɛn fɔ gi am.
Mozis se na dat dɛn fɔ du fɔ ɛnitin we dɛn fɛn we nɔto dɛn yon; dɔŋki, klos, ɛnitin, wans na dɛn kɔmpin Izrɛlayt gɛt am, dɛn nɔ fɔ se nɔto dɛn biznɛs.
I tɛl dɛn igen se if dɛn si dɛn kɔmpin Izrɛlayt in dɔŋki ɔ in man kaw fɔdɔm na rod, dɛn nɔ fɔ se nɔto dɛn biznɛs; dɛn fɔ ep am es am.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se di uman dɛn nɔ fɔ wɛr man klos, ɛn di man dɛn nɔ fɔ wɛr uman klos, bikɔs na wan pan di bad bad tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, et.
Mozis tɛl dɛn igen se, if dɛn si bɔd os na tik ɔ na grɔn, we di mami sidɔm nain eg ɔ butu pan in pikin dɛn, dɛn nɔ fɔ tek di pikin dɛn ɛn dɛn mami togɛda;
dɛn kin tek di pikin dɛn, bɔt dɛn fɔ lɛf di mami lɛ i go, so dat nɔn prɔblɛm nɔ go mit di Izrɛlayt dɛn, ɛn dɛn go gɛt lɔŋ layf.
I tɛl dɛn se we dɛn de bil nyu os, dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn mek relin rawnd di ruf, bikɔs if pɔsin fɔdɔm kam dɔŋ ɛn day, in blɔd go de na dɛn ed.
I se we dɛn de plant, dɛn nɔ fɔ plant ɛni ɔda frut na di sem fam wit di greps plant dɛn. If ɛnibɔdi du dat, dɛn fɔ siz di fam ɛn kɛr ɔl di frut dɛn go na PAPA GƆD in os, we dɛn bia.
Mozis se dɛn nɔ fɔ tay dɔŋki ɛn kaw togɛda na wan mashin we dɛn de dig dɛn fam.
Dɛm nɔ fɔ wɛr klos we dɛn miks wul ɛn linin mek.
Dɛm fɔ so lɔŋ trɛd dɛn na di fo kɔna na di klos we dɛn kin wɛr pantap dɛn klos.
If ɛnibɔdi mared uman ɛn nɔ kam lɛk am igen afta i dɔn lidɔm wit am,
ɛn bikɔs i nɔ lɛk am igen, i de tɔk se di uman nɔto bin vajin we i bin mared am, fɔ gi am bad nem ɛn mek i shem,
di uman in pipul dɛn fɔ kɛr di bedshit we gɛt di blɔd sten we di man bin tek dɛn pikin in vajin, go na di kot os, go sho di bigman dɛn na di siti.
Di uman in papa fɔ tɛl di bigman dɛn na di siti se i bin gi di man in gyal pikin fɔ mared, bɔt naw i se i nɔ want am igen,

ɛn i dɔn mek in gyal pikin dɔn shem we i de tɔk se, in gyal pikin nɔto bin vajin we i bin mared am. We i dɔn tɔk so dɔn, di dadi fɔ prɛd di bedshit we bin prɛd na di bed wɛn di man bin tek in vajin, bifo di bigman dɛn na di siti, ɛn tɛl dɛn se, dat na di pruf se na lay di man de lay.
Mozis se di bigman dɛn na di siti fɔ kech di man we lay pan in wɛf ɛn bit am gud wan,
ɛn i fɔ pe in wɛf in papa wan ɔndrɛd silva kɔpɔ, bikɔs i dɔn mek wan Izrɛlayt vajin, shem. Di uman fɔ stil bi in wɛf te dɛn day.
Bɔt if di uman in papa nɔ ebul pruv se di uman na bin vajin we di man bin mared am,

dɛn fɔ pul am kɔmɔt insay in papa in os, briŋ am kam na do, ɛn ston am te i day, bikɔs na shemful tin i bin du we i bin dɔn lidɔm wit man insay Izrɛl we nɔ bin mared am. Mozis tɛl dɛn se na so dɛn go ebul mek di swɛ fɔ dɛn kayn tin dɛn de, kɔmɔt na Izrɛl.
Mozis tɛl dɛn igen se if dɛn kech ɛni man de lidɔm wit in kɔmpin in wɛf, dɛn fɔ kil dɛn tu. I se na so dɛn go ebul pul di swɛ fɔ dɛn kayn tin dɛn de kɔmɔt na Izrɛl.
If dɛn kech ɛni man lidɔm wit vajin gial we ɔda man dɔn ɛŋej,

Mozis se dɛn fɔ tek dɛn tu kɔmɔt insay di siti, kɛr dɛn go na do pas di get, ɛn ston dɛn te dɛn day. Dɛm fɔ kil di uman bikɔs i nɔ ala we di man wan bin wan lidɔn wit am, we min se i bin gri, ɛn di man, bikɔs i lidɔm wit uman we in kɔmpin bin dɔn ɛŋej. Na so dɛn go ebul pul dɛn kayn swɛ dɛn de kɔmɔt na Izrɛl.
Bɔt if na kes we di man mit uman we dɔn ɛŋej na dɛn ples we nɔ de nia siti, grip am ɛn rep am, na di man nɔmɔ dɛn fɔ kil.
I se dɛn nɔ fɔ du di uman natin bikɔs, i nɔ du natin we fɔ mek dɛn kil am. Na kes we tan lɛk we pɔsin atak in neba ɛn kil am.
Mozis ɛksplen to di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, kes lɛk dat, di gial we dɔn ɛŋej nɔ gɛt blem, bikɔs nɔn siti nɔ bin de nia di ples we di man rep an, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de fɔ ɛp am ɔl we i bin de ala.
I tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn igen se, ɛnibɔdi we rep yɔŋ gyal we nɔ ɛŋej yet,
fɔ pe di yɔŋgyal in papa fifti Silva kɔpɔ, ɛn i fɔ mared am bikɔs i dɔn tek in vajin bay fos, ɛn i fɔ bi in wɛf te dɛn day.
I wɔn dɛn se nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ mared ɔ lidɔm wit in papa in wɛf ɔ ɛni uman we in papa gɛt, bikɔs dat go briŋ shem ɛn disgres to in papa.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se dɛn kayn pipul dɛn ya nɔ fɔ de na PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn mitin: ɛni man we na okobo, we bi bay aksidɛnt ɔ we i bin de fɛt na wa.
Ɛnibɔdi we in papa nɔ mared in mama, ɔ in papa nain mama in brɔda, ɔ in mama nɔto ju, te to di tɛn jɛnareshɔn, dɛn nɔ fɔ de na PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn mitin dɛn.
Di Amonayt ɛn di Moabayt dɛn, te to di tɛn jɛnareshɔn, nɔ fɔ de na PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn mitin,
bikɔs dɛn nɔ bin gi di Izrɛlayt dɛn wata ɛn tin fɔ it we dɛn bin de kɔmɔt Ijipt, bifo dat, dɛn bin go tek Belam, Bɛɔ we kɔmɔt Pɛtɔ na Mɛsopotemia in pikin, ɛn pe am fɔ put swɛ pan dɛn.
PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD bin lɛk dɛn so i nɔ bin lisin to Belam, bifo dat, PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD bin tɔn di swɛ to blɛsin.
Dɛm nɔ fɔ mek dɛn padi, ɛn dɛn nɔ fɔ du natin fɔ ɛp dɛn fɔ mek dɛn go bɛtɛ.

Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, dɛn nɔ fɔ luk dɔŋ pan di Idɔmayt dɛn, bikɔs dɛn na dɛn fambul. Di Ijipshian dɛn na ɔda wan dɛn we dɛn nɔ fɔ luk dɔŋ pan; I se dɛn fɔ mɛmba se dɛn bin dɔn de na dɛn kɔntri.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ gri mek di Ijipshian ɛn di Idɔmayt dɛn grampikin dɛn we bɔn na Izrɛl de na PAPA GƆD in pikin dɛn mitin.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se we dɛn go fɔ go fɛt, ɛn dɛn de na kamp, dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn nɔ du ɛnitin we go mek dɛn gɛt sin.
If ɛni sojaman du sɔntin na nɛt we mek i nɔ klin bifo PAPA GƆD, da sojaman de fɔ kɔmɔt na di kamp tret,
bɔt i fɔ was in bɔdi fayn bifo san go dɔŋ, ɛn we di san dɔn go dɔŋ, i kin go bak insay di kamp.
Mozis tɛl dɛn se dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn nɔ bil latrin insay di kamp; dɛn fɔ bil am na do usay dɛn go de go pis ɛn go na yad.
Dɛm fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn ɔl gɛt tik as pat ɔf dɛn wɛpɔn dɛn, we dɛn go tek dig we dɛn wan go na yad. We dɛn dɔn, dɛn fɔ kɔba di ol bak.

I tɛl dɛn se di kamp nɔ fɔ gɛt natin we go mek i nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD in yay, bikɔs PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go de wit dɛn ɔltɛm, fɔ de sev dɛn ɛn fɔ mek dɛn ebul fɔ de bit dɛn ɛnimi dɛn. So dɛn nɔ fɔ mek i si ɛnitin we go mek i vɛks kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se if slev rɔnawe kɔmɔt na ɔda kɔntri kam to dɛn, dɛn nɔ fɔ sɛn am go bak to in masta;
dɛn fɔ gri mek i de wit dɛn na di siti we in go lɛk fɔ de, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ ambɔg am ɔ trit am bad.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, nɔn pan dɛn, man o uman o, we de na Izrɛl, nɔ fɔ sɛl dɛn bɔdi fɔ mɔni na nɔn pegan gɔd os.

Nɔbɔdi, man o, uman o, we de sɛl in bɔdi fɔ mɔni, nɔ fɔ kɛr di mɔni we i gɛt pan di rare wok go na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD in os, fɔ go pe fɔ di tin dɛn we dɛn bin prɔmis fɔ pe fɔ. PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD et dɛn kayn pipul dɛn de bad bad wan.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ put intrɛst pan ɛnitin we i go lɛnt in kɔmpin Izrɛlayt; mɔni o, it o, ɛnitin, dɛn nɔ fɔ put intrɛst de atɔl.

If na fɔrina, dɛn kin put intrɛst, bɔt dɛn nɔ fɔ put intrɛst pan ɛnitin we dɛn go lɛnt dɛn brɔda, so PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go blɛs dɛn pan ɔl wetin dɛn go put dɛn an pan na di land we dɛn de kam go kapchɔ.

Mozis wɔn dɛn nɔ fɔ swɛ to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD se, dɛn go du sɔntin ɛn westɛm fɔ du an, bikɔs PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go mɔs de ɛkspɛkt dɛn fɔ du am, ɛn if dɛn nɔ du wetin dɛn bin dɔn se dɛn go du, dɛn go gɛt sin.
I if dɛn nɔ swɛ to PAPA GƆD fɔ gi ɔ du sɔntin, dɛn nɔ go gɛt sin fɔ dat.
I advays dɛn fɔ du ɛnitin we dɛn dɔn opin dɛn mɔt swɛ to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD se, dɛn go gi ɔ du.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se we dɛn go na dɛn kɔmpin dɛn greps fam, dɛn fri fɔ it in greps te dɛn bɛlful sɛf, bɔt dɛn nɔ fɔ put na bag kɛr go na dɛn os.
If dɛn go na dɛn kɔmpin in kɔn fam, dɛn kin pul ɔmɔs kɔn sid dɛn ebul fɔ cham, bɔt dɛn nɔ fɔ kɔt di kɔn kɔmɔt na di tik fɔ kɛr go na dɛn os.

Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se if man mared uman, leta, in at nɔ tek am igen, bikɔs i nɔ de biev lɛkɛ mared uman, dɔn di man rayt pepa se i nɔ want di uman fɔ bi in wɛf igen, ɛn sɛn di uman go bak to in pipul dɛn,
we di uman go, ɔda man go si am ɛn mared am,
dɔn dis nyu man sɛf rayt pepa se i nɔ want am igen, ɔ di man day,

da man we bin dɔn dayvɔs di uman fɔs nɔ fɔ tek da uman de fɔ bi in wɛf igen, bikɔs i go dɔn tɔn uman we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD in yay igen fɔ mared; na tin we PAPA GƆD et bad bad wan, so dɛn nɔ fɔ du dɛn kayn tin dɛn de lɛ dɛn nɔ briŋ sin na di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go gi dɛn.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se we pipul dɛn mared, fɔ di fɔs wan ia, di man nɔ fɔ go fɛt wit di ami ɔ go pan ɛni ɔda biznɛs we go mek i go lɛf in wɛf. I fɔ de na os wit in wɛf fɔ mek dɛn at swit.

I tɛl dɛn igen se if dɛn kɔmpin Izrɛlayt wan lɛf ɛnitin gi dɛn lɛ dɛn go lɛnt am mɔni ɔ ɔda tin, dɛn nɔ fɔ gri lɛ i lɛf tin we go mek dɛn nɔ ebul kuk. I se, dɛn nɔ fɔ tek am, bikɔs na layf dɛn go de tek so.
Mozis se if dɛn kech ɛnibɔdi we kech in kɔmpin Izrɛlayt, trit lɛk slev ɔ de tray fɔ sɛl am, dɛn fɔ kil am. I se dɛn fɔ kil am lɛ da swɛ de nɔ go de pan dɛn ɛn lɛ nɔbɔdi nɔ go tray fɔ du dat igen

If ɛnibɔdi gɛt da bad sik na bɔdi we dɛn kɔl lɛprɔsi, i fɔ du ɔl wetin di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin se, dɛn fɔ du. I se dɛn go tɛl dɛn fɔ du ɔl wetin in bin dɔn tɛl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, fɔ tɛl di pipul dɛn we gɛt da bad sik na bɔdi, so dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se, dɛn du ɔl wetin di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, se.
I se dɛn fɔ mɛmba wetin PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD bin du Miriam we dɛn bin jɔs kɔmɔt Ijipt.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se we dɛn de lɛnt dɛn brɔda ɛnitin, dɛn nɔ fɔ go insay in os go tek di tin we i go gi dɛn fɔ ol te i pe dɛn bak.
I se dɛn fɔ wet am na do lɛ insɛf go briŋ am kam gi dɛn.
If na po man, ɛn nain kot we i de tek slip i wan gi dɛn fɔ ol fɔ di tin we dɛn lɛnt am,
dɛn fɔ gi am in kot ɛvri ivintɛm lɛ i go gɛt am fɔ de slip. Mozis tɛl dɛn se PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go blɛs dɛn fɔ dat.
Mozis tɛl dɛn igen se dɛn nɔ fɔ trit wokman bad bikɔs i po, ɛn i want mɔni, wɛda na Izrɛlayt ɔ na trenja we de na di siti dɛn na di land.
I se dɛn no se po man abop pan wetin i go gɛt fɔ di de, so if dɛn nɔ pe am, i go kray to PAPA GƆD tɛl am bɔt dɛn, ɛn PAPA GƆD go lisin to am, ɛn na dɛn go gɛt di sin.
Mozis tɛl dɛn igen se mami ɛn dadi nɔ fɔ day fɔ wetin dɛn pikin dɛn du, ɛn pikin dɛn nɔ fɔ day fɔ wetin dɛn mami ɛn dɛn dadi dɛn du. Ɔlman fɔ day fɔ in yon sin.

I tɛl dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se nɔbɔdi nɔ tek advantej pan pɔsin bikɔs na trenja, ɔ dɛn pikin we dɛn mami ɛn dadi dɔn day, ɛn wɔn dɛn nɔ fɔ tek uman we in man dɔn day in klos we i de tek slip fɔ ol fɔ mɔni we i go wan lɛnt,
bɔt fɔ mɛmba se dɛnsɛf na bin slev na Ijipt, ɛn na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, bin pul dɛn kɔmɔt de. I se paopa, dɛn fɔ de du dɛn kayn gud tin dɛn de.

Mozis se we dɛn kɔt dɛn rɛs, pik dɛn kɔn ɛn ɔda tin dɛn na dɛn fam, ɛn dɔn kɛr dɛn go usay dɛn de kip dɛn, dɛn nɔ fɔ tɔn bak go tek di wan dɛn we dɛn nɔ bin ebul kɔt ɛn kɛr go; dɛn fɔ lɛf dɛn fɔ di trenja dɛn we de wit dɛn, fɔ dɛn pikin we dɛn mami ɛn dadi dɔn day ɛn dɛn uman we dɛn man dɔn day. I se PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go blɛs dɛn fɔ dat.

We dɛn go dɔn pik di ɔliv dɛn na dɛn ɔliv tik dɛn dɔn, ɛn dɔn gɛda dɛn go, dɛn nɔ fɔ go bak go pik di wan dɛn we nɔ bin fɔdɔm. Dɛm fɔ lɛf dɛn fɔ di trenja dɛn we de wit dɛn, di pikin dɛn we dɛn mami ɛn dadi dɔn day, ɛn dɛn uman we dɛn man dɔn day.

We dɛn dɔn pik dɛn greps dɛn na dɛn greps tik dɛn dɔn, ɛn dɔn gɛda dɛn go, dɛn nɔ fɔ go bak fɔ go pik di wan dɛn we dɛn nɔ bin ebul pik. Dɛn fɔ lɛf dɛn fɔ di trenja dɛn we de wit dɛn, dɛn pikin we dɛn mami ɛn dadi dɔn day ɛn dɛn uman we dɛn man dɔn day.
Mozis tɛl dɛn se dɛn fɔ de mɛmba ɔltɛm se, dɛn na bin slev na Ijipt, ɛn na dat mek in se, dɛn fɔ de du dɛn gud tin dɛn de.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se we tu pɔsin gɛt plaba, dɛn go na kot, we di jɔj dɔn jɔj di kes dɔn, ɛn no di wan we du in kɔmpin bad,
ɛn jɔj se na bit fɔ bit di pɔsin wit ratlan we du in kɔmpin bad, di jɔj fɔ mek i lidɔm lɛ dɛn bit am de bifo di pɔsin we i du bad to. Ɔmɔs kɔt dɛn go gi am go gɛt fɔ du wit di kayn bad tin we i du.
I se dɛn nɔ fɔ bit nɔbɔdi pas fɔti kɔt. If dɛn bit dɛn brɔda tumɔs na pɔblik, i go lɔs in rɛspɛkt.
Mozis tɛl dɛn igen se dɛn nɔ fɔ tay dɛn man kaw dɛn mɔt we dɛn de yuz dɛn fɔ mas mas dɛn sid dɛn we dɛn kɔt na dɛn fam.

Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se if tu brɔda dɛn de na wan yad, dɔn wan pan dɛn tu day, ɛn di wan we day nɔ bin bɔn bɔypikin bifo i day, di uman nɔ fɔ mared to nɔn ɔda man we nɔ de nain let man dɛn famili. Na di ɔda brɔda fɔ mared di brɔda we dɔn day in wɛf ɛn du ɔl wetin man sɔpoz fɔ du to in wɛf.
Di fɔs-bɔy-pikin we di uman we in man bin dɔn day go bɔn wit di brɔda we de, fɔ gɛt da brɔda we dɔn day in nem, so dat in nem nɔ go ɔt na Izrɛl.

Bɔt if di brɔda we de nɔ gri fɔ mared in brɔda we dɔn day in wɛf, di uman fɔ go na di kɔt to di bigman dɛn na di siti, go tɛl dɛn se, in man in brɔda nɔ gri fɔ mek in brɔda we dɔn day in nem nɔ ɔt na Izrɛl, ɛn i nɔ de du wetin man we dɔn day in brɔda, sɔpoz fɔ de du to in let brɔda wɛf.
Di bigman dɛn fɔ sɛn kɔl di man ɛn koks am lɛ i go mared in let brɔda wɛf. If i stil se nɔ, in nɔ go mared am,

di brɔda we dɔn day in wɛf, fɔ waka go mit am usay i tinap, pul in sandal nain fut, pit nain fes, ɛn tɛl am bifo ɔlman se, na so fɔ du pɔsin we nɔ gri fɔ du wetin fɔ du, fɔ mek in brɔda in nem nɔ ɔt na Izrɛl.
Datɛnde, we ɛnibɔdi wan tɔk bɔt in famili layn, dɛn go pɔynt dɛn se, na da famili we dɛn bin pul sandals kɔmɔt na dɛn fut.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se if tu man dɛn de fɛt, dɔn wan pan di tu man dɛn wɛf rɔn go grip di ɔda man in prayvet fɔ ɛp in man fɛt,
dɛn nɔ fɔ sɔri fɔ da uman de, dɛn fɔ kɔt in am.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ kip tu difrɛn kayn skel na dɛn bag fɔ tif pipul; wan big wan ɛn wan smɔl wan.
I tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ gɛt tu kayn mɛnshɔ pan na dɛn os; di big wan we na fɔ tif pipul dɛn we dɛn de bay to dɛn, ɛn di smɔl wan fɔ de tif pipul dɛn we dɛn de sɛl gi dɛn.
Di wet dɛn we dɛn de put na dɛn skel fɔ we tin dɛn, fɔ kɔrɛkt, ɛn di pan dɛn we dɛn de yuz fɔ mɛnshɔ, fɔ ful, so dat dɛn go gɛt lɔŋ layf na di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD de gi dɛn.
PAPA GƆD et pipul dɛn bad bad wan we de tif dɛn kɔmpin dɛn pan bay ɛn sɛl.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se dɛn fɔ de mɛmba wetin di Amalɛkayt dɛn bin du dɛn na rod we dɛn bin jɔs kɔmɔt Ijipt.

Dɛn nɔ bin fred sɛf se PAPA GƆD de wit di Izrɛlayt dɛn; di Amalɛkayt dɛn bin atak di Izrɛlayt dɛn na dɛn bak ɛn de bitwin di Izrɛlayt dɛn we bin dɔn pas ɛn di wan dɛn we bin de waka slo slo, ɔl we dɛn bin no se di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin dɔn taya bad bad wan, we dɛn bin dɔn waka ɔl da waka de.

Mozis se we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go dɔn mek dɛn dɔn kɔnka ɔl dɛn ɛnimi dɛn we de rawnd dɛn, ɛn dɛn dɔn sidɔm gud gud wan na di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go dɔn gi dɛn as dɛn yon prɔpati, dɛn nɔ fɔ fɔgɛt fɔ kil ɔl di Amalɛkayt dɛn, ɛn wan nɔ fɔ lɛf, so nɔbɔdi nɔ go mɛmba dɛn igen na dis wɔl.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se we dɛn go dɔn kapchɔ di land ɛn dɔn sidɔm gud na di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go gi dɛn as dɛn yon prɔpati,
dɛn fɔ put di fɔs frut dɛn we dɛn go pik na di difrɛn kayn frut tik dɛn, na blay, ɛn kɛr dɛn go na di ples we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, go pik fɔ de mek sakrifays to am ɛn wɔship am.
Dɛn fɔ go to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin da tɛm de ɛn tɛl am se, in kam tɛl PAPA GƆD we nain PAPA GƆD se in de na di land we i bin dɔn swɛ to dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛn se, i go gi dɛn.
Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go tek di blay na dɛn am ɛn put am na di ɔlta bifo PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD.

Dɔn dɛn go tinap bifo di ɔlta ɛn tɔk bifo PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD se, dɛn fɔstɛmpapa na bin Aramian man we bin jɔs de waka waka ɔlsay na di wɔl. So i waka waka te in ɛn tu tri in fambul dɛn, go Ijipt go tap de, bɔt dɛn nɔ bin bɔku. Bɔt dɛn bin kam bɔku aftawɔd lɛkɛ anch, ɛn ɔlman bin yɛri bɔt dɛn ɛn bin bigin fred dɛn.
Bɔt di Ijipshian dɛn nɔ bin trit dɛn gud atɔl; dɛn bin tɔn dɛn slev, bit dɛn ɛn mek dɛn wok fɔ dɛn lɛk dɔg.
So dɛn bin pre to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛn PAPA GƆD, ɛn i bin si ɔl wetin dɛn bin de pas.
So PAPA GƆD bin yuz in pawa mek ɔlkayn mirekul, sayn ɛn tin dɛn we bin mek pipul dɛn wɔnda, we mek di Ijipshian dɛn fred ɛn lɛf dɛn fɔ go.
Afta dat, PAPA GƆD bin kɛr dɛn go na da ples de ɛn gi dɛn da land de; di land we gud fɔ plant ɛn fɔ mɛn animal.
Na dat mek insɛf dɔn kɛr di fɔs tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD mek gro nain fam. We dɛn dɔn tɔk ɔl dat, dɛn fɔ put di blay dɔŋ na di ɔlta bifo PAPA GƆD, dɔn dɛn fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD de wantɛm;
dɛn fɔ gladi fɔ ɔl di gud tin dɛn we i dɔn gi dɛn ɛn ɔl udat de na dɛn os dɛn, dɛn ɛn di Livayt dɛn, ɛn di trenja dɛn we de wit dɛn.

Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, we dɛn dɔn pe ɔl dɛn tayth we di ia fɔ pa tayth rich, dat na wan tɛnth pan di ɛvri tri ia avɛst, to di Livayt dɛn, di trenja dɛn, dɛn pikin dɛn we dɛn mami ɛn dadi dɔn day ɛn di uman dɛn we dɛn man dɔn day, fɔ lɛ dɛn it ɛn bɛlful usay dɛn de,

datɛnde, dɛn fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD se, nɔn pan di tin dɛn we dɛn fɔ tayth nɔ lɛf na dɛn os; dɛn dɔn gi di Livayt, di fɔrina dɛn, di pikin dɛn we dɛn mami ɛn dadi dɛn dɔn day, ɛn dɛn uman dɛn we dɛn man dɔn day, jɔs lɛkɛ we PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ du, ɛn dɛn nɔ bin fɔgɛt fɔ du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ du.

Dɛn nɔ bin tek natin pan dɛn we dɛn bin gɛt bɛrin ɛn dɛn nɔ bin tɔch dɛn we dɛn nɔ bin klin na PAPA GƆD in yay, ɛn dɛn nɔ sakrifays natin pan am to dayman. Dɛn dɔn du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD bin se dɛn fɔ du we gɛt fɔ du wit di tayth, we dɛn fɔ giwe pan ɔltin we dɛn kɔt na dɛn fam.

We PAPA GƆD de nain oli os na ɛvin, i de si dɛn; luk Izrɛl, dɛn nain yon pikin dɛn. Duya, blɛs dɛn ɛn mek dɛn layf bɛtɛ. PAPA GƆD bin prɔmis dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn se i go gi dɛn land we gud fɔ plant ɛn fɔ mɛn animal.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛl pipul dɛn se, da de de, PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD bin se, dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn obe di lɔ dɛn ɛn du ɔl wetin i se wit ɔl dɛn at ɛn dɛn sol.
I se da de de, dɛn di Izrɛlayt bin tɛl PAPA GƆD se, nain na dɛn GƆD, ɛn dat dɛn go du ɔl wetin i se dɛn fɔ de du.
PAPA GƆD insɛf dɔn gri se dɛn nain yon pipul dɛn lɛkɛ we i bin dɔn prɔmis dɛn se, in go du, ɛn i dɔn tɛl dɛn traŋa wan se, dɛn fɔ du ɔl wetin i dɔn se dɛn fɔ de du.

Mozis tɛl dɛn se, PAPA GƆD dɔn prɔmis dɛn se, in go mek Izrɛl shayn na di wanol wɔl; i go mek dɛn gɛt pawa pas ɔl ɔda neshɔn dɛn na di wɔl, dɛn go yɛri bɔt dɛn, tɔk dɛn gud nem, ɛn rɛspɛkt dɛn ɔlsay na di wɔl.
Mozis ɛn ɔl di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl tɔk to di pipul dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn se dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se, paopa, dɛn du ɔl wetin i bin dɔn tɛl dɛn se PAPA GƆD se, dɛn bawn fɔ du.
I tɛl dɛn se di de we dɛn go krɔs Riva Jɔdan go na di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd bin dɔn se i go gi dɛn, dɛn fɔ put big big ston dɛn lɛ dɛn tinap ɛn plasta dɛn wit simɛnt;
dɔn dɛn fɔ rayt ɔl di lɔ dɛn pan dɛn.
Na Ebal Mawnten dɛn fɔ put di ston dɛn ɛn rayt ɔl di lɔ dɛn. Dɛn nɔ fɔ fɔgɛt fɔ plasta di ston dɛn gud.
Dɛn fɔ bil wan ɔlta fɔ PAPA GƆD. Dɛn fɔ bil am wit ston nɔmɔ. Dɛn nɔ fɔ yuz ayɛn fɔ bil da ɔlta de.
Di ston dɛn we dɛn fɔ yuz fɔ bil PAPA PAPA GƆD in ɔlta, na ston dɛn we nɔ kɔt atɔl. Na da ɔlta de dɛn fɔ mek dɛn sakrifays dɛn we dɛn de bɔn wit faya,

ɛn na de dɛn fɔ it dɛn yon pan da sakrifays we na af pat pan di animal nɔmɔ dɛn de bɔn na di faya, ɛn dɛn it di balans. Na usay PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go pik fɔ mek sakrifays to am ɛn wɔship am, dɛn fɔ sɛlibret.
Mozis tɛl dɛn se dɛn fɔ rayt ɔl di lɔ dɛn na di ston dɛn we i bin tɛl dɛn fɔ put fɔ tinap, ɛn dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn rayt am klia wan.

Afta dat, Mozis ɛn di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we kɔmɔt na di Livayt fambul, tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se lɛ dɛn lisin wetin dɛn de kam tɛl dɛn. Dɛn tɛl dɛn se, dɛn dɔn bi PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD in yon pipul dɛn.
Dɛn fɔ du ɔl wetin i dɔn tɛl dɛn tide se, PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD se, dɛn fɔ de du.
Mozis wɔn di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn traŋa wan se,
we dɛn krɔs Riva Jɔdan, Simiɔn, Livay, Juda, Isaka, Josɛf ɛn Bɛnjamin, fɔ tinap na Garizim Mawnten fɔ blɛs ɔl di pipul dɛn.
I se Rubɛn, Gad, Asha, Zɛbyulɔn, Dan ɛn Naftali, dɛn fɔ tinap na Ebal Mawnten fɔ swɛ di swɛ.
Di livayt dɛn go tɔk lawd wan lɛ ɔlman yɛri, ɛn dɛn go tɔk se:
“ ‘Ɛnibɔdi we go mek ɛnitin wit tik, ston ɔ ayɛn de wɔship am na kɔna, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am. ‘Ɔlman fɔ ansa, Emɛn!’
“ ‘Ɛni pikin we go du ɛnitin we go mek in mami ɛn dadi shem na pɔblik, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am.’ ‘Dɔn ɔlman fɔ ansa, Emɛn!’
“ ‘Ɛnibɔdi we push in neba in bawndri mak go biɛn, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am. “Dɔn Ɔlman fɔ ansa, ‘Emɛn!’
“ ‘Ɛnibɔdi we go kɛr blɛn yay pɔsin go usay i nɔ se in wan go, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am,’ “Dɔn ɔlman fɔ ansa, ‘Emɛn!’
“ ‘Ɛnibɔdi we go tek advantej pan trenja, dɛn pikin dɛn we dɛn mami ɛn dadi dɔn day, ɛn dɛn uman dɛn we dɛn man dɔn day, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am. “Dɔn ɔlman fɔ ansa se, “Emɛn”
“ ‘Ɛnibɔdi we lidɔm wit in papa in wɛf, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am.’ “Dɔn ɔlman fɔ ansa se, ‘Emɛn!’
“ ‘Ɛni bɔdi we go lidɔm wit animal, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am.’ “Dɔn ɔlman fɔ ansa se, ‘Emɛn!’
“ ‘Ɛnibɔdi we lidɔm wit in sista, in papa in gyal pikin ɔ in mama in gyal pikin, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am.’ “Ɔlman fɔ ansa se, ‘Emɛn!’
“ ‘Ɛnibɔdi we lidɔm wit in mɔdɛnlɔ, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am.’ “ ‘Ɔlman fɔ ansa se, ‘Emɛn!’
“ ‘Ɛnibɔdi we kil in kɔmpin sikrit wan, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am.’ “Dɔn ɔlman fɔ ansa se, ‘Emɛn!’
“ ‘Ɛnibɔdi we go gri fɔ tek mɔni fɔ kil pɔsin we nɔ du am natin, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am.’ “ ‘Ɔlman fɔ ansa se, ‘Emɛn!’
“ ‘Ɛnibɔdi we nɔ du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD in lɔ dɛn se, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek bad bad tin mit am. “Ɔlman fɔ ansa se, ‘Emɛn!’

Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, if dɛn obe PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, ɛn tek tɛm du ɔl wetin i dɔn tɛl dɛn da de de se PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ de du, PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn bɛtɛ pas ɔl di ɔda neshɔn dɛn na di wɔl.
PAPA GƆD go blɛs dɛn te i rɔn oba if dɛn de du wetin PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD se.
PAPA GƆD go put blɛsin pan ɔl dɛn biznɛs ɛn dɛn fam dɛn.
Dɛn pikin dɛn we dɛn bɔn go gɛt blɛsin, ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn plant, go gro fayn fayn wan, ɛn dɛn kaw, ship ɛn got, go bɔn bɔku bɔku wan.
PAPA GƆD go blɛs dɛn mɔntdɔn ɛn dɛn pɔt.
Blɛsin go de pan ɛnitin we dɛn put an pan.
PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd go mek dɛn bit dɛn ɛnimi ɔltɛm; dɛn go pas wansay fɔ kam fɛt una, ɛn dɛn go skata sɛvin say fɔ rɔnawe.
PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn rɛs sto dɛn ful ɔltɛm, we dɛn nɔ go ɛva kray aŋri, ɛn dɛn nɔ go fel pan natin we dɛn put an pan na di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, go gi dɛn.
PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn in yon oli pipul dɛn, jɛs lɛk aw i bin dɔn prɔmis, if dɛn obe PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD ɛn du wetin i se paopa, dɛn fɔ du.
Datɛnde, di wanol wɔl go si se dɛn na PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn ɛn dɛn go gɛt gud rɛspɛkt fɔ dɛn.
PAPA GƆD go gi dɛn ɔltin plɛnti plɛnti wan na di land we i bin dɔn swɛ to dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn se, i go gi dɛn: pikin, kaw, ship ɛn got, ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn de plant.

PAPA GƆD go opin in sto we i de kip di ren ɔp di klawd, ɛn mek dɛn gɛt ren di rayt tɛm, so dɛn plant dɛn go gro fayn fayn wan. Ren ɛn san de na PAPA GƆD in an. I go so blɛs dɛn, dat na ɔda neshɔn dɛn go de go lɛnt to dɛn.

If dɛn obe ɛn du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl dɛn traŋa wan se dɛn fɔ de du, na dɛn go de bifo ɔltɛm pan ɔltin na dis layf ɛn nɔ de biɛn. Na ɔp nɔmɔ dɛn go de go ɛn nɔ de kam dɔŋ. Ɛnitin we dɛn put an pan, go bɛtɛ,
dat na if dɛn nɔ ple tampale wit PAPA GƆD ɛn go wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn.
If dɛn nɔ obe PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD ɛn du ɔl wetin i se, na bad bad tin dɛn go mit dɛn, ɛn go de wit dɛn te go.
Ɔl dɛn biznɛs ɛn dɛn fam nɔ go bɛtɛ.
Dɛn sto dɛn go ɛmti ɛn dɛn nɔ go gɛt bɛtɛ it fɔ it.
PAPA GƆD nɔ go mek dɛn gɛt bɔku pikin dɛn. Dɛn fam dɛn nɔ go bɛtɛ ɛn dɛn animal dɛn bɔn wan sɛf go traŋa.
Ɔl dɛn biznɛs nɔ go bɛtɛ.
PAPA GƆD go put ɔlkayn swɛ pan dɛn; dɛn go de pan kɔnfyushɔn ɛn pwɛlat ɔltɛm. I go brok dɛn dɔŋ kpatakpata, ɛn dɛn layf dɛn nɔ go lɔŋ, fɔseka we dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn PAPA GƆD ɛn du bad bad tin dɛn.
PAPA GƆD go mek ɔlkayn siknɛs de mit dɛn, ɛn dɛn go fasin dɛn te dɛn kil dɛn ɔl. Wan pan dɛn nɔ go lɛf na di land we dɛn de kam go kapchɔ so.

PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn jɔs de kɔf, dɛn go jɔs de fil fiva ɛn dɛn bɔdi dɛn go jɔs de swɛl ɛn de wam. Di ples go de ɔt bad bad wan. I go so ɔt dat di grɔn go jɔs de dray, ɛn natin nɔ go de gro, we na dat go kil dɛn ɔl.
Wan ren nɔ go kam ɛn dat go mek di grɔn trɔŋ lɛk ayɛn.
Bifo ren kam fɔ mek tin gro, na big big briz wit bɔku bɔku dɔst ɛn sansan PAPA GƆD go mek de blo pan dɛn ol de ol nɛt, te dɛn ɔl day.
PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn bit dɛn bad bad wan ɛnitɛm we dɛn atak dɛn. We dɛn go na batul fil, na rɔnawe dɛn go de rɔnawe ɛn skata ɔlɔbɔt. Di wanol wɔl go fred we dɛn go si wetin de apin to dɛn.
Na bɔd ɛn animal go it dɛn de dedebɔdi dɛn, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go de fɔ drɛb dɛn.
PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn gɛt di kayn bwɛl dɛn we di Ijipshian dɛn bin gɛt we dɛn bin de de. Dɛn go gɛt sofut, ɔl kayn skebiz ɛn krɔ krɔ na dɛn bɔdi, we nɔ go mɛn te dɛn day.
Na kres, blɛn yay ɛn kɔnfyushɔn go mared dɛn na Izrɛl.
Sansan tɛm, dɛn nɔ go ebul waka fɔ dɛnsɛf, pas dɛn go de tek tik de fɛn di rod, ɛn na so dɛn go de molɛs dɛn ɛn tif dɛn, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go de fɔ ɛp dɛn. Natin nɔ go bɛtɛ na dɛn an.
We dɛn mared, na ɔda man go lidɔm wit dɛn wɛf dɛn. If dɛn bil os o, dɛn nɔ go slip de; na ɔda man go slip de. Dɛn plant frut o, na ɔda man go pik dɛn fɔ dɛn.
Dɛn go kil dɛn yon kaw bifo dɛn, ɛn nɔ gi dɛn de. Dɛn go tek pawa tek dɛn dɔŋki dɛn ɛn nɔ gi dɛn bak. Dɛn go tek dɛn ship gi dɛn ɛnimi dɛn, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tɔk fɔ dɛn.
Dɛn go sɛl dɛn pikin dɛn as slev ɛn dɛn nɔ go si dɛn igen; dɛn nɔ go ebul du natin fɔ mek dat nɔ bi.
Pipul dɛn we dɛn nɔ no wande, go kam it ɔl wetin dɛn wok fɔ, ɛn trit dɛn bad bad na dɛn yon kɔntri.
Dɛn go so trit dɛn bad, dat plɛnti pan dɛn go kres.
PAPA GƆD go mek bad bad bwɛl dɛn we nɔ de mɛn kɔmɔt na dɛn ni dɛn ɛn dɛn lɛg dɛn, ɛn bwɛl go de frɔm dɛn ed to dɛn fut.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn kɛr dɛn ɛn dɛn kiŋ we dɛn go pik go na kɔntri we dɛn ɛn dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn nɔ bin no wande, usay dɛn go go wɔship gɔd dɛn we dɛn mek wit tik ɛn ston.
Di pipul dɛn we de na di kɔntri we PAPA GƆD go skata dɛn, go wɔnda se wetin apin to pipul lɛkɛ dɛn; dɛn go tɔk bad bɔt dɛn ɛn go laf ɛn provok dɛn.
Lokɔs go it ɔl wetin dɛn plant na dɛn fam dɛn.
Di frut dɛn we dɛn go plant fɔ mek wayn nɔ go bɛtɛ; tumbu go it ɔl.
Di tik dɛn we kin pul ɔliv ɔyl, go gro ɔlsay na dɛn kɔntri, bɔt wan ɔyl dɛn nɔ go pul pan dɛn, bikɔs ɔl di ɔliv go dɔn fɔdɔm kɔmɔt na di tik.
Dɛn go bɔn pikin lɛkɛ dɛn nɔ bɔn, bikɔs dɛn go fɛt dɛn ɛn tek dɛn ɔl na dɛn an as slev.
Lokɔs go pwɛl ɔl dɛn tik dɛn, ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn plant na dɛn fam dɛn.
Bɛtɛ go fala di fɔrina dɛn, ɛn dɛn go gɛt pawa na dɛn land pas dɛn we gɛt dɛn land; dɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn go jɔs de po we di fɔrina dɛn go jɔs de jɛntri.
Di fɔrina dɛn go de lɛnt dɛn mɔni bɔt dɛn nɔ go ebul lɛnt di fɔrina dɛn mɔni; di fɔrina dɛn go tɔn di bigman dɛn oba dɛn.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se ɔl dɛn swɛ ya go kech dɛn ɛn de pan dɛn te dɛn ɔl day, if dɛn nɔ du ɔl wetin i dɔn tɛl dɛn se PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD se, dɛn fɔ de du.
Na dɛn tin dɛn de pipul dɛn go tek no se, na dɛn PAPA GƆD bin swɛ. I go sho pan dɛn pikin dɛnsɛf we nɔ bɔn yet.
Bikɔs dɛn nɔ du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ de du, ɔl we i gi dɛn bɔku bɔku blɛsin,
dɛn go wok fɔ dɛn ɛnimi dɛn, we PAPA GƆD go mek fɛt dɛn, ɛn dɛn go so trit dɛn bad, dat dɛn nɔ go gɛt bɛtɛ it fɔ it, dɛn nɔ go gɛt tin fɔ drink ɛn klos fɔ wɛr.
Na pipul dɛn we de fawe PAPA GƆD go mek trit dɛn bad; pipul dɛn we kin fɔdɔm pan pipul dɛn lɛkɛ we ak kin fɔdɔm pan fɔl pikin, ɛn dɛn nɔ go sabi dɛn laŋwej.
Na pipul dɛn we nɔ de laf ɛn dɛn nɔ de sɔri fɔ ol ɔ yɔŋ pɔsin.

Na aŋri go kil di Izrɛlayt dɛn bikɔs, di pipul dɛn go tek ɔl dɛn animal dɛn we dɛn de mɛn, dɛn pikin dɛn, ɛn ɔl wetin go gro na dɛn fam dɛn. Dɛn go tek dɛn sid dɛn we dɛn kip fɔ it, ɛn dɛn wayn, dɛn ɔyl ɛn dɛn kaw ship ɛn got dɛn; natin dɛn nɔ go lɛf fɔ dɛn.
Dɛn go atak ɔl dɛn siti dɛn te dɛn brok ɔl di wɔl dɛn we dɛn abop pan ɔlsay na di land; dɛn go kapchɔ ɔl dɛn siti dɛn na di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, bin dɔn gi dɛn.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, dɛn go it dɛn yon pikin dɛn we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD bin dɔn gi dɛn, we dɛn go de insay di slev layf we dɛn ɛnimi dɛn go put dɛn pan.
Di man dɛn we ɔlman bin no se na gud pɔsin, we ɔlman bin rɛspɛkt se kɔmɔt na gud famili, go so gridi in brɔda, in wɛf we i lɛk, ɛn in pikin we i nɔ it yet;
dat i nɔ go gi dɛn pan in pikin dɛn bif we i de it, bikɔs i nɔ go gɛt natin lɛf fɔ am fɔ it insay di slev layf we dɛn ɛnimi dɛn go dɔn put dɛn pan.
Di uman dɛn we ɔlman bin rɛspɛkt se kɔmɔt na gud famili, we nɔ waka wit bia fut na grɔn wande, bikɔs na yaŋa pɔsin, go gridi in man we i lɛk, ɛn in bɔypikin ɛn in gyal pikin,
di afta bath ɛn di pikin we i jɔs bɔn. I go it dɛn sikrit wan, bikɔs i nɔ gɛt natin fɔ it, ɛn aŋri de kech an bad bad wan, bikɔs dɛn ɛnimi dɛn go trit dɛn lɛkɛ slev.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn igen se if dɛn nɔ du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD rayt na di Lɔ buk, dat na fɔ rɛspɛkt ɛn tɔk gud tin bɔt PAPA GƆD in big big nem,
PAPA GƆD go mek bad bad siknɛs dɛn we nɔ de mɛn kech dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet.
PAPA GƆD go mek ɔl dɛn siknɛs dɛn we dɛn de fred, dat na dɛn siknɛs dɛn we nɔ de mɛn, we i bin put pan di Ijipshian dɛn, kech dɛn, ɛn dɛn nɔ go tek mɛn.
I se PAPA GƆD go sɛn ɔlkayn siknɛs ɛn waala dɛn we nɔ ivin rayt na di lɔ buk, pan dɛn. Dɛn siknɛs dɛn de go kil dɛn.
Ɛnti dɛn bin bɔku lɛkɛ di sta dɛn na di skay, na tu tri pan dɛn go lɛf, bikɔs, dɛn nɔ obe PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD.

Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin gladi fɔ mek dɛn jɛntri ɛn bɔn bɔku bɔku pikin dɛn, na semweso i go gladi fɔ du dɛn tin dɛn we go mek dɛn alaki ɛn day day na di land we i dɔn rɛdi fɔ gi dɛn.
I tɛl dɛn se PAPA GƆD go skata dɛn ɔlsay na di wɔl, ɛn na de dɛn go wɔship dɛn tik ɛn ston gɔd dɛn, we dɛn ɛn dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn nɔ ɛva no.

Dɛn nɔ go gɛt kol at na fɔren land, ɛn dɛn nɔ go gɛt ples we dɛn go se na dɛn yon. PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn nɔ gɛt wan kolat. Dɛn nɔ go gɛt tɛm fɔ blo, dɛn bɔdi dɛn nɔ go fayn, ɛn na kɔtat ɛn pwɛlat nɔmɔ dɛn go de pan;
Frɔm mɔnin to nɛt, dɛn at dɛn nɔ go rɛst bikɔs dɛn ɛnimi dɛn kin kil ɛnibɔdi ɛnitɛm.
Kɔtat go mek we dɛn wek na mɔnin, dɛn pre lɛ ivin tɛm kam, ɛn ivintɛm, dɛn pre lɛ mɔnin kam, bikɔs di tin we dɛn go si, mɔt nɔ go ebul tɔk am.

PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn kɛr dɛn go na Ijipt bak wit ship; di kayn travul we PAPA GƆD bin dɔn prɔmis dɛn se i nɔ go mek dɛn travul igen, ɛn na de dɛnsɛf go go tray fɔ sɛl dɛnsɛf as slev, bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ go bay dɛn.

Apat frɔm di Kɔvinant we Izrɛl dɛn bin dɔn mek wit PAPA GƆD na Mawnt Saynay, PAPA GƆD bin tɛl Mozis fɔ mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn mek frɛsh wan wit am na Moab. Na dɛn tin dɛn ya Mozis bin tɛl dɛn se dɛn fɔ de du we dɛn mek di sɛkɛn Kɔvinant wit PAPA GƆD.
Mozis bin gɛda ɔl di pipul dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn se, dɛn ɔl bin si ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD bin du Ijipt dɛn kiŋ ɛn in wokman dɛn ɛn di Ijipshian dɛn.
PAPA GƆD bin du tin dɛn we dɛn nɔ bin dɔn si ɛn yɛri bɔt wande,
bɔt tetide, PAPA GƆD nɔ mek dɛn ɔndastand ɔl wetin dɛn bin si ɛn yɛri, min.
I bin dɔn waka wit dɛn na di dray ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap fɔ fɔti ia bɔt dɛn klos dɛn nɔ chɛr, dɛn sandal dɛn nɔ kɔt.
Dɛn nɔ bin gɛt bred fɔ it, ɛn dɛn nɔ bin gɛt wayn ɔ spirit fɔ drink, so dɛn go no se in na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD.
We dɛn bin rich Moab, Sayɔn we na kiŋ na Ɛshbɔn, ɛn Ɔg we na kiŋ na Beshan, bin fɛt dɛn, bɔt di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin bit dɛn ɔl.
Dɛn bin tek dɛn land gi di Rubɛn fambul, di Gadayt ɛn af pan di Manasɛ fambul dɛn.
Mozis bin tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn mek shɔ se dɛn du ɔl wetin dɛn bin gri se dɛn go de du, we dɛn mek di Kɔvinant wit PAPA GƆD, so dat bɛtɛ go fala dɛn.
Mozis se, dɛn ɛn dɛn lida dɛn ɔl tinap bifo PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD,
dɛn wɛf ɛn smɔl smɔl pikin dɛn, ɛn di fɔrina dɛn we de kɔt wud ɛn tot wata fɔ dɛn, sɛf bin de de,
so dat dɛn go mek di nyu Kɔvinant wit PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD,
so ɔlman go no se, PAPA GƆD na dɛn Gɔd ɛn dɛn na PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn, jɔs lɛkɛ we i bin prɔmis se i go du, ɛn bin dɔn swɛ to Ebraam, Ayzak ɛn Jekɔb, we na dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn.
Mozis se, nɔto wit dɛn nɔmɔ we bin de de PAPA GƆD bin mek di Kɔvinant,
i se, na wit dɛn we de da de de na di ples we dɛn de mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, ɛn wɔship am, ɛn di wan dɛnsɛf we nɔ bɔn yet.
Dɛn bin no wetin dɛn ɔl bin pas na Ijipt, ɛn wetin dɛn bin pas na pipul dɛn an, we dɛn bin pas insay dɛn kɔntri we dɛn bin kɔmɔt Ijipt;
ɛn dɛn bin si dɛn bad bad tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk, dat na dɛn bod ɛn ston, dɛn silva ɛn gold lay lay gɔd dɛn insay di kɔntri dɛn we dɛn bin pas.

Mozis advays di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ tek tɛm lɛ nɔn pan di man dɛn, ɔl di uman dɛn, ɔl di famili dɛn ɛn ɔl di fambul dɛn, nɔ go bigin de wɔship dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn gɔd, lɛ dɛn nɔ go tan lɛk tik we gɛt rut, bɔt de bia frut we bita ɛn gɛt pɔyzin,

ɔ lɛk pɔsin we, pan ɔl we i no ɔl wetin di Kɔvinant se i fɔ de du, i stil de tɔk nain at se, natin bad nɔ go apin to am, i lɛk we i de traŋayes ɛn de du wetin in want. Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, dat go mek di pɔsin we de obe ɛn di wan we traŋayes, sɔfa togɛda.

PAPA GƆD nɔ go fɔgiv da pɔsin de. Bifo dat, PAPA GƆD go put in vɛksteshɔn ɛn in jɛlɔs pan am, ɛn go put ɔl di swɛ dɛn we rayt na dis buk pan am, ɛn PAPA GƆD go mek i day ɛn nɔn pan in pikin dɛn nɔ go de fɔ tek mɛmba am.
PAPA GƆD go put ɔl di pɔnishmɛnt pan da wan pɔsin de, dat na di swɛ dɛn we de na di Kɔvinant we rayt ni dis Lɔ buk.
We di pikin dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet, ɛn di fɔrina we go kɔmɔt fa kam, si di kayn tin dɛn we de apin na di land, ɛn di kayn siknɛs we PAPA GƆD mek kech dɛn,
we sɔlfa ɛn sɔl go mek di ples dɛn we dɛn fɔ plant nɔ gud fɔ plant. I go tan lɛkɛ Sɔdɔm ɛn Gɔmɔra, ɛn lɛkɛ Adma ɛn Zɛboli we PAPA GƆD bin bɔn we i bin vɛks bad bad wan.
Di wanol wɔl go aks wetin dɛn du PAPA GƆD we mek i vɛks te i trit dɛn so.
Pipul dɛn go de we go ansa se, na bikɔs dɛn kɔmɔt biɛn PAPA GƆD we na dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛn PAPA GƆD in Kɔvinant, we i bin mek wit dɛn we i bin pul dɛn kɔmɔt Ijipt,
ɛn dɛn go sav ɔda gɔd dɛn, we dɛn nɔ bin no wande, ɛn PAPA GƆD nɔ bin tɛl dɛn fɔ du dat;
so PAPA GƆD vɛks pan dɛn bad bad wan, ɛn sɛn ɔl di swɛ dɛn we rayt na dis buk, pan dɛn;
ɛn PAPA GƆD vɛks te i pul dɛn kɔmɔt na dɛn land ɛn put dɛn na fɔren land te datɛnde.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, tin dɛn de we PAPA GƆD kip as sikrit, bɔt di tin we i want lɛ dɛn no, i dɔn mek dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn no dɛm sote go, so dat dɛn ɔl go du wetin dis lɔ se.

Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se in de gi dɛn chans fɔ pik di gud tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD go du fɔ dɛn, ɔ di pɔnish we PAPA GƆD go pɔnish dɛn if dɛn nɔ biliv am. I tɛl dɛn se, we ɔl dɛn tin dɛn de we i bin dɔn tɛl dɛn bɔt go apin to dɛn na di fawe kɔntri dɛn we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go skata dɛn, dɛn go mɛmba se in bin tɛl dɛn fɔ mek dɛn mekɔp dɛn maynd.
I se if dɛn ɛn dɛn jɛnareshɔn gri fɔ obe PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, ɛn tɔn bak go to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD wit ɔl dɛn at ɛn sol;
datɛnde, PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go sɔri fɔ dɛn ɛn si dɛn lɛkɛ in yon pipul dɛn bak. PAPA GƆD go gɛda dɛn kɔmɔt na ɔl di kɔntri dɛn we i bin skata dɛn, ɛn mek dɛn gɛt ɔl dɛn jɛntri bak.
I lɛk us pat dɛn de na di wɔl, PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go pul dɛn ɔl kɔmɔt de;
ɛn PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go kɛr dɛn go bak na di land we na dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn prɔpati, so dat dɛn go go de de. PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn jɛntri ɛn plɛnti pas dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn.
PAPA GƆD go chenj dɛn ɛn dɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛn at, so dat dɛn go lɛk PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD wit ɔl dɛn at ɛn wit ɔl dɛn sol so dat dɛn go kɔntinyu fɔ de na di land.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD go mek ɔl di bad tin dɛn we i bin dɔn se go apin to di Izrɛlayt dɛn, go mit dɛn ɛnimi dɛn we bin dɔn du dɛn bad.
Dɔn di Izrɛlayt dɛn go tɔn to PAPA GƆD bak, ɛn obe ɔl wetin i bin se dɛn fɔ de du.

PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn si bɛtɛ pan ɔl wetin dɛn put an fɔ du; pan dɛn pikin dɛn we dɛn de bɔn, di pikin dɛn we dɛn kaw dɛn de bɔn, ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn de plant na dɛn fam, bikɔs PAPA GƆD go gladi fɔ mek dɛn jɛntri lɛkɛ aw i bin gladi fɔ mek dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn jɛntri.
Dat na if dɛn tɔn bak go to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, wit ɔl dɛn at ɛn ɔl dɛn sol, ɛn obe ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ de du, we rayt na di Lɔ buk.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, di kɔmandmɛnt dɛn we i gi dɛn da de de, nɔ at fɔ ɔndastand ɛn obe.
So na nɔnsɛns fɔ lɛ sɔmbɔdi se, aw dɛn fɔ manej yɛri ɛn obe dɛn kɔmandmɛnt dɛn de we dɛn nɔ de na ɛvin ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt fɔ krɔs wata fɔ briŋ am kam.
Ɔ fɔ sɔmbɔdi fɔ tɔk se, aw dɛn fɔ manej gɛt am, bikɔs i de fa.
Mozis tɛl dɛn se di kɔmandmɛnt dɛn de wit dɛn, bikɔs dɛn bin dɔn no dɛn ɔl na dɛn at ɛn bin de rid dɛn.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, in de gi dɛn chans fɔ pik fɔ gɛt ɔltin we dɛn want ɛn de na di land wit lɔŋ layf ɛn wɛl bɔdi, ɔ nɔ fɔ de na di land, ɛn de sɔfa ɛn day kwik.

I tɛl dɛn igen se, if dɛn obe ɔl PAPA GƆD in kɔmandmɛnt dɛn we in gi dɛn da de de, dat na fɔ lɛk PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, liv di we we PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ liv, ɛn du ɔl wetin i bin dɔn se dɛn fɔ de du, dɛn go bɔn bɔku bɔku pikin, ɛn PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go blɛs dɛn na di land we dɛn bin de rɛdi fɔ go kapchɔ ɛn tek as dɛn prɔpati.
I se bɔt if dɛn tɔn dɛn bak gi PAPA GƆD ɛn nɔ gri lisin ɔl we i de wɔn dɛn, ɛn fala ɔda pipul go wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn,
in wan mek dɛn no se, dɛn nɔ go gɛt lɔŋ layf na di land we dɛn bin de rɛdi fɔ go krɔs Riva Jɔdan fɔ go tek as dɛn prɔpati.
Mozis se ɛvin ɛn di ath nain witnɛs dɛn se, in bin dɔn gi dɛn chans fɔ pik layf ɔ day, blɛsin ɔ swɛ; ɛn bin advays dɛn fɔ pik layf so dat dɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛn go kɔntinyu fɔ de na dis wɔl

ɛn de traŋa wan wit PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, de sho am se dɛn lɛk an bay we dɛn de du ɔl wetin i se; bikɔs na da we de dɛn go kɔntinyu fɔ de na dis wɔl ɛn gɛt lɔŋ layf, so dat dɛn go de na di land we PAPA GƆD bin dɔn swɛ to di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn, dat na Ebraam, Ayzak ɛn Jekɔb, se i go gi dɛn.
Mozis bin kɔntinyu de tɔk to di Izrɛlayt dɛn.

I bin tɛl dɛn se in dɔn ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti ia da de de, ɛn i nɔ gɛt da trɛnk de igen lɛk fɔstɛm. I tɛl dɛn igen se PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD bin tɛl am se, i nɔ go gri mek in Mozis krɔs Riva Jɔdan.

I se na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD insɛf go de bifo dɛn fɔ krɔs oba Riva Jɔdan, ɛn i go kil ɔl di neshɔn dɛn we de oba Riva Jɔdan, so dɛn go tek ɔl dɛn land; na Jɔshwa go bi dɛn lida datɛnde, jɛs lɛk aw PAPA GƆD bin dɔn se.
Mozis se PAPA GƆD go trit di pipul dɛn we de na di land, di we we i bin trit Kiŋ Siɔn ɛn Kiŋ Ɔg, dɛn Amɔrayt kiŋ dɛn ɛn dɛn pipul.
I se PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn kapchɔ dɛn, ɛn se di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ du di pipul ɔl wetin in dɔn tɛl dɛn traŋa wan se dɛn fɔ du dɛn.
Mozis tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, dɛn fɔ tinap lɛk man, ɛn dɛn nɔ fɔ mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn mek dɛn fred, bikɔs PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD de wit dɛn ɔltɛm; i nɔ go kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn.

Mozis sɛn kɔl Jɔshwa ɛn tɛl am bifo ɔl di pipul dɛn se, i fɔ tinap lɛk man, mek ɔp in maynd ɛn nɔ fɔ fred natin, bikɔs nain go gɛt fɔ kɛr di pipul dɛn go na di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, bin dɔn swɛ to dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn se, i go gi dɛn, ɛn Jɔshwa fɔ si dat dɛn tek am as dɛn yon prɔpati.
I tɛl am se PAPA GƆD go de bifo dɛn ɛn i go de wit dɛn ɔltɛm; i nɔ go kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn, so i nɔ sɔpoz fɔ fred natin ɔ pwɛl at.
Mozis rayt PAPA GƆD in lɔ gi Livay in bɔypikin dɛn we na di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn de tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant. Ɛn i gi ɔl di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl dɛnsɛf.
Mozis tɛl ɔl di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl se paopa, ɛvri sɛvin ia, we na di tɛm dat fɔ fɔgiv dɛt ɛn fɔ sɛlibret di Fist ɔf di Bafa,

di tɛm we ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn go go na di ples we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD go pik fɔ mek sakrifays ɛn wɔship am, dɛn fɔ rid di lɔ ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn rayt bɔt aw dɛn fɔ de wit dɛn kɔmpin mɔtalman, lawd lawd wan mek ɔlman go yɛri.

I tɛl dɛn se ɔlman we de na Izrɛl fɔ de de; man uman ɛn pikin, ivin di trenja dɛn we de wit dɛn fɔ de de, so dat dɛn ɔl go yɛri di lɔ ɛn no se dɛn fɔ rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, ɛn mek shɔ se dɛn du ɔl wetin di lɔ se dɛn fɔ de du,
ɛn lɛ di pikin dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet sɛf go lan di lɔ dɛn, ɛn no se dɛn fɔ rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, te go, na di land we dɛn bin de go krɔs Riva Jɔdan fɔ go kapchɔ.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se i nɔ tu te igen, i go day; i tɛl am se mek in ɛn Jɔshwa go na di tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit wit PAPA GƆD, so dat i go mek am Izrɛl dɛn nyu lida. So Mozis ɛn Jɔshwa bin go de.
PAPA GƆD apia insay di tɛnt bay di domɔt say lɛkɛ klawd.

Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se di tɛm dɔn de rich fɔ lɛ i day go mit in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn; I se, datɛnde, di Izrɛlayt dɛn go kɔmɔt biɛn am ɛn go bigin wɔship di trenja gɔd dɛn we de na di land we dɛn de kam go, ɛn bay dat, dɛn go pwɛl di Kɔvinant we de bitwin dɛn ɛn PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, in go vɛks pan dɛn ɛn go nyakanyaka dɛn; bad bad tin dɛn go so mit dɛn, dat dɛn go aks dɛnsɛf se, if nɔto bikɔs PAPA GƆD nɔ de wit dɛn igen mek dɛn kayn bad tin dɛn de de mit dɛn.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Mozis se, in go tɔn in bak pan dɛn, bikɔs dɛn go dɔn tɔn dɛn at to ɔda gɔd dɛn, ɛn na bad bad tin dɛn go dɔn du.

I se so, Mozis ɛn Jɔshwa fɔ rayt wan siŋ we i de gi dɛn, ɛn dɛn fɔ tich di Izrɛlayt dɛn lɛ dɛn go lan an bay at, so dat dɛn go mɛmba se, in PAPA GƆD bin tɛl dɛn wetin ɛn wetin dɛn fɔ de du, ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt nɔn rizin nɔ fɔ obe an.

PAPA GƆD se, bikɔs we in go dɔn kɛr dɛn go na di land we gud fɔ plant ɛn fɔ mɛn animal, we in bin dɔn prɔmis dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn se in go gi dɛn, ɛn dɛn bɔdi dɛn go dɔn fayn fayn, dɛn go pwɛl di Kɔvinant we de bitwin in ɛn dɛn, ɛn kɔmɔt biɛn am.

We di trɔbul dɛn go dɔn mit dɛn plɛnti plɛnti wan, na dis siŋ dɛn go de siŋ we go de kɔrej dɛn, bikɔs, we dɛn go mɛmba wetin di siŋ min, dɛn go no se nain PAPA GƆD de pɔnish dɛn, ɛn dɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛn nɔ go fɔgɛt da siŋ de. I se, in dɔn no dɛn plan bifo in de kɛr dɛn go na di land we in bin dɔn swɛ se, in go gi dɛn.
So Mozis rayt di siŋ da sem de de, ɛn lan di Izrɛlayt dɛn.

PAPA GƆD bin gi Jɔshwa we na Nɔn in bɔypikin di pawa fɔ bi Izrɛl dɛn lida, ɛn bin tɛl am se, lɛ i tinap lɛk man, ɛn lɛ i nɔ fred natin; nain na di pɔsin we fɔ kɛr di Izrɛlayt dɛn go na di land we i bin dɔn swɛ se in go gi dɛn, ɛn in go de wit am.
We Mozis bin dɔn rayt di Lɔ na buk dɔn,
i bin tɛl di Livayt dɛn we kin tot PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant traŋa wan se,
lɛ dɛn tek di Lɔ Buk ɛn put am nia PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, so dat i go bi ɛvidɛns agens Izrɛl fɔ tumara bambay.
Mozis se, in no se, dɛn na traŋayes pipul dɛn, ɛn dɛn kin biev lɛkɛ rebɛl. I tɛl dɛn se, we in nɔ day yet, dɛn de tɔn dɛn bak pan PAPA GƆD, we sho se if in day, na wɔs tin go bi.
Mozis se mek ɔl di bigman dɛn gɛda go mit am, bikɔs in gɛt wɔd fɔ tɛl dɛn, ɛn na ɛvin ɛn ath go bi in witnɛs.

Mozis se in wan tɛl dɛn wetin in wan tɛl dɛn, bikɔs i no se dɛn nɔ go kia igen bɔt ɔl wetin i bin dɔn tich dɛn. I se tɛm go kam we bad bad tin dɛn go de apin to dɛn, bikɔs, dɛn go du bad bad tin te PAPA GƆD vɛks ɛn pɔnish dɛn.
Mozis bin kɔl mitin usay i tich ɔlman di siŋ we PAPA GƆD bin gi am. Na so di siŋ bin go:
Mek ath ɛn skay lisin wetin a de se.
Mek wetin a de kam tɛl dɛn go tan lɛk we ren de kam, Mek wetin a de tɔk go tan lɛkɛ we dyu kɔba ples, lɛkɛ we ren de drisl pan yɔŋ gras, ɛn lɛkɛ we ren de fɔdɔm pan trɔŋ plant.
A go prez PAPA GƆD in nem ɛn ɔlman go tɔk bɔt PAPA GƆD in pawa.
Na PAPA GƆD de fɛt fɔ dɛn ɛn i nɔ de mek mistek, I nɔ bɛn-bɛn pan ɛnitin we i de du. Na fethful Gɔd, ɛn i nɔ de lay Natin we i de du nɔ gɛt wan bɛn bɛn.
Bɔt dɛn nɔ waka tret wi am, so dɛn nɔ fit fɔ bi in pipul, dɛn na sinful ɛn bɛn bɛn pipul.
Na so dɛn fulish pipul dɛn de we nɔ gɛt sɛns fɔ trit PAPA GƆD? In nɔto dɛn papa we mek dɛn, we mek dɛn bi wanol neshɔn?
Mɛmba fɔstɛm o, mɛmba lɔntɛm, aks una pipul dɛn bɔt wetin bin dɔn apin, aks di ol pipul dɛn mek dɛn tɛl una.
We PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti gi neshɔn dɛn prɔpati, we i de sɛpret difrɛn difrɛn pipul dɛn, i sho ɔlman usay dɛn fɔ de akɔdin to aw di difrɛn fambul dɛn na Izrɛl plɛnti.
Na PAPA GƆD insɛf na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd.
I fɛn dɛn na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, ples we nɔbɔdi nɔ de, pas ebi ebi briz; i kɔba dɛn ɛn mɛn dɛn, i trit dɛn lɛk in bɔl yay.
Lɛkɛ aw Igul de tich in pikin fɔ flay we di pikin kin de nak nak in fɛda ɛn wan fɔdɔm, di big Igul kin opin in fɛda ɛn go ɔnda in pikin ɛn kech am ɛn mek i sidɔm nain fɛda.
Na PAPA GƆD waŋren bin de kɛr dɛn go, nɔn ɔda gɔd nɔ bin de de.
PAPA GƆD mek dɛn rul dɛn kɔntri we gɛt il ɛn mawnten, dɛn it wetin dɛn pul na fam; i mek dɛn pul ɔni insay dɛn big big ston ɛn ɔyl na ayɛn ston.
Dɛn kaw ɛn got dɛn bin de gi dɛn plɛnti milk; wit fat fat ship pikin dɛn, man ship dɛn, ɛn bɔku bɔku got ɛn kaw, wit di sid plant we fayn pas ɔl ɔda wan dɛn, ɛn nɔn wayn nɔ fayn pas dɛn yon.
Izrɛl, bin jɛs de jɛntri bɔt dɛn bin traŋayes; Izrɛl bin gɛt plɛnti fɔ it so i bin jɔs de rɔju. Dɔn i dɔn dray bak, dɔn i kɔmɔt biɛn PAPA GƆD we mek am, ɛn nɔ mɛmba di wan we sev am.
Izrɛl mek PAPA GƆD jɛlɔs fɔ dɛn fɔrena dɛn gɔd dɛn, di bad bad tin dɛn we dɛn bin de du, mek i vɛks bad bad wan.
Dɛn mek sakrifays to fɔrin gɔd dɛn we nɔto tru tru gɔd dɛn, gɔd dɛn we dɛn nɔ ɛva no, gɔd dɛn we kam yɛstade, we dɛn fɔstɛnpapa dɛn nɔ bin de fred.
Dɛn fɔgɛt bɔt dɛn Gɔd we mek dɛn, di wan we gi dɛn layf.
We PAPA GƆD si se dɛn dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn am, i vɛks ɛn i pul at pan dɛn.
I se in nɔ go ɛp dɛn igen ɛn i go si if dɛn go de lɛkɛ aw dɛn bin de we in bin de du fɔ dɛn, bikɔs dɛn na traŋayes pipul dɛn we nɔ de waka tret.
Dɛn mek PAPA GƆD vɛks bikɔs dɛn de wɔship lay lay gɔd, dɛn mek i jɛlɔs bikɔs dɛn gɔd dɛn nɔto gɔd dɛn. So i go drɔ ɔda pipul dɛn we nɔ bɛtɛ kam nia am so dat Izrɛl go vɛks, dɛn go jɛlɔs.
Mi vɛksteshɔn kin mek big big faya kech ɛn bɔn ɔltin na dis wɔl. I go rich ɔnda ɔnda di grɔn ɛn go bɔn ɔnda dɛn mawnten dɛn.
A go jɔs de mek waala de mit dɛn ɛn na ɔlkayn tin dɔn, nain a go sɛn pan dɛn.
Na aŋri ɛn fiva ɛn ɔda bad bad sik dɛn go kil dɛn. A go sɛn bad bad animal dɛn pan dɛn ɛn dɛn bad bad snek dɛn go bɛt ɛn kil dɛn.
Wa go mek dɛn kil dɛn plɛnti, bad bad pipul dɛn go atak dɛn na dɛn os dɛn. Yɔŋ man ɛn uman dɛn go day yɔŋ bebi dɛn ɛn ol pipul dɛnsɛf go day.
A bin fɔ dɔn kil dɛn ɔl lɔntɛm so nɔbɔdi nɔ go mɛmba dɛn.
Bɔt a nɔ bin wan lɛ mi ɛnimi dɛn blɔf se dɛn dɔn bit mi yon pipul dɛn, we na misɛf kil dɛn.
Izrɛl na pipul dɛn we nɔ gɛt sɛns; dɛn nɔ de tink dip atɔl
If na pipul dɛn we bin de tink dɛn bin fɔ dɔn no wetin go bi to dɛn if dɛn du wetin dɛn du so.
Aw kɔm waŋren pɔsin ebul bit wan tawzin pipul, ɛn tu pipul mek tu tawzin pipul rɔnawe? Pas if di wan we de fɛt fɔ dɛn pul an pan dɛn, ɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn pul at pan dɛm.
Bikɔs di wan we dɛn abop pan nɔ gɛt pawa lɛk di wan we wi abop pan, ivin wi ɛnimi dɛnsɛf de tɔk am.
Bikɔs dɛn greps kɔmɔt pan dɛn greps tik na Sɔdɔm, ɛn di fam dɛn na Gɔmɔra; dɛn greps dɛn gɛt pɔyzin, dɛn bɔnch greps dɛn bita;
dɛn wayn na lɛkɛ snek pɔyzin ɛn lɛkɛ dɛn bad bad snek pit.
“Dis nɔ de na mi sto usay a de, sil wit ɔl mi jɛntri?
Na mi gɛt rivɛnj ɛn na mi de pe pipul fɔ dɛn gud wok, fɔ di tɛm we dɛn go sket fɔdɔm; bikɔs di tɛm fɔ dɛn waala dɔn de rich, ɛn dɛn alaki wande kam lɛk briz.
PAPA GƆD go sev in pipul dɛn ɛn sɔri fɔ in wokman dɛm, we i si se dɛn pawa dɔn dɔn, ɛn nɔn pan di fribɔn ɔ slev nɔ de igen
Na datɛnde, I go aks dɛn se, ‘We dɛn gɔd dɛm, di wan we dɛn bin biliv se go sev dɛm,
we bin de it di fat na dɛn sakrifays dɛm, ɛn drink di wayn we dɛn kin mek drink ɔfrin?’ Lɛ dɛn grap ɛp una naw nɔ, lɛ dɛn protɛkt una.
Una dɔn si naw se na Mi, yɛs Mi, na im, ɛn nɔn ɔda gɔd nɔ de apat frɔm mi; A de kil ɛn mek pipul dɛn gɛt layf; a de wund ɛn a de mɛn; ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de we ebul sev una kɔmɔt na mi an.
Bikɔs a es mi an ɔp to ɛvin, ɛn swɛ se, Lɛk we mi go de sote go,
if a shap mi shayn sɔd we a bigin gi jɔjmɛnt, a go rivɛnj pan mi ɛnimi dɛn, ɛn pɔnish di wan dɛn we et mi.
A go mek mi aro drɔnk wit blɔd, ɛn min sɔd go it flɛsh blɔd we kɔmɔt pan di wan dɛn we dɛn kil ɛn di wan dɛn we dɛn kapchɔ, flɛsh we kɔmɔt pan mi ɛnimi dɛn we gɛt lɔŋ ia na dɛn ed.
Mozis siŋ se, “Una prez in pipul dɛn, una di neshɔn dɛm; bikɔs i de rivɛnj fɔ in wokman dɛm we dɛn kil ɛn de rivɛnj pan in ɛnimi dɛm, ɛn fɔgiv in pipul dɛn fɔ ɔl dɛn sin.
Na Mozis, ɛn Jɔshwa we na Nɔn in Bɔy pikin, bin siŋ lawd wan so dat ɔl di pipul dɛn go yɛri.
We Mozis dɔn tɔk to di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn,
I tɛl dɛn se, “Una kip ɔl wetin a dɔn tɛl una na una at, so dat una go ebul tich una pikin dɛn fɔ obe PAPA GƆD in lɔ dɛn.

I tɛl dɛn igen se, nɔto fɔ natin in bin de tich dɛn ɔl wetin i dɔn tich dɛn, bɔt na fɔ dɛn yon vɛri layf. I tɛl dɛn se if dɛn obe di lɔ dɛn, dɛn go gɛt lɔŋ layf na di land we dɛn bin de rɛdi fɔ krɔs Riva Jɔdan go kapchɔ.
Da sem de de, PAPA GƆD bin tɛl Mozis se
lɛ i go na dɛn mawnten dɛn we dɛn kin kɔl Abarim, we de na Moab, ɔpozit Jɛriko, ɛn klem go rayt ɔp Mawnt Nɛbo, go luk di land we nem Kenan, we i de gi di Izrɛlayt dɛn;
ɛn lɛ i de de te i day go mit in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn, lɛkɛ we Erɔn bin day na Mawnt Ɔ go mit in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn,
bikɔs dɛn nɔ bin du wetin PAPA GƆD bin want dɛn fɔ du we dɛn bin de na Mɛriba, na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Zin; i se dɛn nɔ bin rɛspɛkt am bifo di pipul dɛn se, in oli.
Dɔn i tɛl Mozis se, i go si di land, bɔt in fut nɔ go mas na da land de, we in de gi di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Na di blɛsin dis dis we Mozis bin blɛs di Izrɛlayt dɛn bifo i day.
I se, PAPA GƆD kam dɔŋ Mawnt Saynay ɛn kɔmɔt lɛkɛ di san ɛn shayn lɛk san oba Idɔm, ɛn in layt bin de shayn kɔmɔt Mawnt Paran, tawzin tawzin enjɛl dɛn bin de wit am ɛn faya bin de kɔmɔt nain raytan.
I lɛk in pipul dɛn, ɛn i de kɔba di wan dɛn we de fɔ am ɛn de tek wetin i se,
we ɔl di difrɛn fambul dɛn na Izrɛl bin gɛda, a bin gi dɛn PAPA GƆD in lɔ we dɛn tek pas ɔltin na di wɔl.
Dɛn bin kam gɛt kiŋ na Izrɛl we ɔl di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl bin de, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn na Izrɛl bin de de
Lɛ di Rubɛn fambul dɛn de te go, ɛn lɛ di man dɛn de plɛnti te go.
Mozis tɔk bɔt di Juda fambul dɛn se, Mek PAPA GƆD ansa Juda dɛn prea ɛn mek dɛn bi wan pan di fambul dɛn na Izrɛl bak. Mek PAPA GƆD fɛt fɔ dɛn ɛn ɛp dɛn fɛt dɛn ɛnimi dɛn.

I tɔk bɔt di Livay fambul dɛn se, Mek PAPA GƆD gi di Livay fambul dɛn in Thumim ɛn in Yurim to di wan dɛn we dɛn at de to am gud gud wan Yu mek dɛn pas ɔlkayn trɔbul na Masa fɔ si uskayn pipul dɛn bi ɛn yu bin si dɛn na Mɛriba se dɛn na pipul dɛn we lɛk yu.
Dɛn lɛk ɛn rɛspɛkt yu pas dɛn mami ɛn dadi, ɛn dɛn brɔda, sista ɛn pikin dɛn. Dɛn de obe yu ɛn de du ɔl wetin yu tɛl dɛn fɔ du, ɛn dɛn de waka tret wit yu insay di Kɔvinant.
Dɛn tich yu pipul dɛn fɔ obe yu lɔ dɛn; Dɛn mek sakrifays na yu ɔlta.
Mek di Livayt fambul dɛn jɛntri; ɛn gladi wit di wok we dɛn de du. Nyakanyaka ɔl dɛn ɛnimi dɛn so dat dɛn nɔ go ebul grap fɔ fɛt dɛn igen.
I tɔk bɔt di Bɛnjamin fambul dɛn se, dɛn na di fambul dɛn we PAPA GƆD lɛk pas ɔl; PAPA GƆD de kɔba dɛn ɔltɛm mek natin nɔ du dɛn, ɛn na wit dɛn i tap.
I tɔk bɔt Josɛf in jɛnareshɔn dɛn se, Mek PAPA GƆD du dɛn gud ɔltɛm ɛn lɛ i mek ren de kam na dɛn land, ɛn wata go de bɔs ɔnda grɔn.
Mek ɔl dɛn frut dɛn rɛp na di tik ɛn mek ɔltin na dɛn fam dɛn ful di tɛm we dɛn fɔ avɛst.
Mek fayn fayn frut dɛn gro na dɛn il dɛn.

Mek dɛn gɛt ɔl di gud tin dɛn we di land gɛt, we na bin di blɛsin we di Gɔd we bin tɔk na bush we de bɔn, gi dɛn. I se mek dɛn blɛsin de pan Josɛf in jɛnareshɔn dɛn bikɔs nain na bin di lida fɔ in brɔda dɛn.
Ifrem ɛn Manasɛ dɛn tawzin tawzin fɛt man dɛn trɔŋ, we yu si dɛn, dɛn fayn lɛk bush kaw in fɔs-bɔy-pikin. Dɛn gɛt trɛnk lɛk bush kaw we dɛn go tek kil ɔl dɛn ɛnimi ɛn pul dɛn kɔmɔt usay dɛn de.
Mozis tɔk bɔt di Zɛbyulɔn fambul se, bɛtɛ go fala dɛn we dɛn go du biznɛs na si ɛn jɛntri go de na Izrɛl.
Dɛn go invayt di ɔda fambul dɛn lɛ dɛn ɔl go wɔship PAPA GƆD na di mawnten usay dɛn kin mek dɛn sakrifays to PAPA GƆD; Dɛn jɛntri de kɔmɔt na di si ɛn di sansan we de na di sho.
Mozis tɔk bɔt di Gad fambul dɛn se, Blɛsin de fɔ di wan we mek di Gad fambul dɛn land big! Gad de waka saful saful lɛkɛ Layɔn; i mɔs si se i skrap in ɛnimi bifo in at kol.
I pik di bɛt land fɔ insɛf, land we dɛn kip fɔ di kɔmanda; we na lɛkɛ fɔ kiŋ, we di lida dɛn na Izrɛl mit na di Gad fambul kin du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD in lɔ se.
I tɔk bɔt di Dan fambul dɛn se, Dan na yɔŋ layɔn we go kɔmɔt nain kev na Beshan, ɛn jomp pan in ɛnimi.
Mozis tɔk bɔt di Naftali fambul se, Naftali de ɛnjɔy PAPA GƆD in lɔv ɛn dɛn gɛt plɛnti blɛsin, na dɛn gɛt ɔl di land frɔm nɔth to sawt.
Mozis tɔk bɔt di Asha fambul se, lɛ PAPA GƆD blɛs di Asha fambul pas ɔl di ɔda fambul dɛn; ɛn lɛ PAPA GƆD lɛk dɛn pas ɔl di ɔda fambul dɛn. Mek dɛn jɛntri bad bad wan.
Na ayɛn ɛn bras dɛn go tek mek dɛn get ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go atak dɛn sote go.
Nɔn gɔd nɔ de we gɛt pawa lɛkɛ Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD, di klawd dɛn nain chariɔt ɛn i de rayd ɔp na di klawd.
Na PAPA GƆD de kɔba dɛn, di Gɔd we nɔ de day, nain de drɛb dɛn ɛnimi kɔmɔt na di land dɛn we dɛn de go insay, ɛn tɛl dɛn se, mek dɛn kil dɛn ɔl.
So Izrɛl gɛt pis, nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ ambɔg am na di land we gɛt bɔku bɔku sid plant ɛn wayn, usay dyu de wata di grɔn.

Di pipul dɛn na Izrɛl na pipul dɛn we gɛt lɔk! Nɔn ɔda neshɔn nɔ tan lɛkɛ dɛn. Na PAPA GƆD insɛf de fɛt fɔ dɛn, I de kɔba dɛn ɛn mek dɛn win dɛn fɛt dɛn! Dɛn ɛnimi dɛn go beg dɛn lɛ dɛn nɔ kil dɛn, bɔt dɛn go kapchɔ dɛn ɛnimi dɛn land ɛn waka fri wande.
Mozis bin kɔmɔt usay i bin de na Moab we na flat grɔn ɛn go ɔp Mawnt Pisga we de ɔpozit Jɛriko. Na de PAPA GƆD sho am di land, frɔm Giliad te rich Dan,
I sho am Naftali, Ifrem ɛn Manasɛ, ɔl di land dɛn na Juda, te rich di Mɛditarenian Si,
I sho am di ɔt ɛn dray ples na Juda ɛn di flat grɔn dɛn, dat na di Jɛriko Vali, di Pam Tik Siti, te rich Zoa.
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, na di land dawande we i bin swɛ to Ebraam, Ayzak ɛn Jekɔb se i go gi dɛn jɛnareshɔn. I tɛl am se, I dɔn mek i si am wit in yay, bɔt i nɔ go gri mek i go de.
So Mozis we na PAPA GƆD in wokman, day na Moab, jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin dɔn se go bi,
ɛn PAPA GƆD bɛr am na di vali we de ɔpozit Bɛthpeɔ na Moab; bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ no di rayt ples te tide.
Mozis bin ol wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti ia we i day; i bin de si gud gud wan ɛn i bin stil gɛt in trɛnk.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn kray ɛn munin fɔ Mozis na Moab fɔ tati de.
Jɔshwa we na Nɔn in pikin, bin gɛt plɛnti sɛns, bikɔs Mozis bin dɔn blɛs am; so di pipul dɛn obe am ɛn du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD bin tɛl Mozis se dɛn fɔ du.
Wande Izrɛl nɔ gɛt prɔfɛt we tan lɛkɛ Mozis, we PAPA GƆD de tɔk to fes to fes,
nɔn ɔda prɔfɛt nɔ de we du dɛn wɔndaful tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD bin sɛn am fɔ go du na Ijipt, to di Ijipshian kiŋ ɛn wokman dɛn, ɛn ɔl in pipul dɛn,
ɛn igen, na di kayn pawa we i bin de tek du tin dɛn, ɛn di kayn fiaful tin dɛn we i bin de du, we ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin de si.
We Mozis we bin de wok fɔ PAPA GƆD day, PAPA GƆD tɛl Nɔn in pikin, Jɔshwa, we na bin Mozis in aprɛntis se,
Mozis we na bin in yon wokman dɔn day. So mek in ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn rɛdi mek in de bifo dɛn fɔ go krɔs oba Riva Jɔdan ɛn go na di land we in de gi di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
PAPA GƆD se, jɛs lɛk aw in bin dɔn prɔmis Mozis, ɔlsay we dɛn go gɛt fɔ waka, na ples dɛn we in bin dɔn se i de gi dɛn.

PAPA GƆD tɛl am se in go gi dɛn ɔl di land we bigin from di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap ɛn di il kɔntri dɛn we nem Libanɔn te rich di Riva Yufretis, ɛn ɔl di Itayt dɛn land te rich di Gret Si usay san de go dɔŋ, go bi dɛn land.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɔshwa se, wans in de, tete Jɔshwa go day, nɔn ɔda neshɔn nɔ go ebul bit Izrɛl. I se as in nɔ bin kɔmɔt biɛn Mozis, na so in nɔ go ɛva kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɔshwa se i fɔ tinap lɛkɛ man, bikɔs nain go gɛt fɔ de bifo di pipul dɛn fɔ go kapchɔ di land we in PAPA GƆD bin dɔn swɛ to dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn se, in go gi dɛn.
PAPA GƆD se na fɔ lɛ Jɔshwa tinap lɛkɛ man nɔmɔ ɛn lɛ i obe ɔl di lɔ dɛn we in bin dɔn gi Mozis, ɛn nɔ bɛn bɛn natin, ɛnisay dɛn go, bɛtɛ go fala dɛn.

PAPA GƆD se lɛ Jɔshwa mek shɔ se dɛn de rid di Lɔ Buk ɛnitɛm we dɛn pre to am ɛn wɔship am. I se dɛn fɔ de rid an de ɛn nɛt, so dat dɛn go no ɔl wetin de de fɔ ebul du ɔl wetin di lɔ se, so bɛtɛ go fala dɛn pan ɔl wetin dɛn put an pan.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɔshwa se wans nain PAPA GƆD dɔn tɛl am se mek i tinap lɛkɛ man, i nɔ fɔ fred natin ɛn i nɔ fɔ gɛt ɛni dawt nain maynd, bikɔs PAPA GƆD we nain PAPA GƆD go de wit am ɛnisay we i de go.
So Jɔshwa tɛl ɔl di difrɛn fambul dɛn bigman dɛn
fɔ tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, insay tri de, dɛn fɔ krɔs Riva Jɔdan fɔ go kapchɔ di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD de gi dɛn fɔ dɛnsɛf, so dɛn fɔ pak it we go du fɔ ɔl datɛnde.
Jɔshwa tɛl di Rubɛnayt dɛn, di Gadayt dɛn ɛn af pan di Manasɛ fambul dɛn se,
da tɔk we Mozis we na bin PAPA GƆD in wokman, bin tɔk, we i bin se PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD se in go gi dɛn ples we dɛn go de we nɔbɔdi nɔ go ambɔg dɛn, na di land dawande.
I tɛl dɛn se dɛn wɛf ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn ɛn dɛn animal dɛn go lɛf na da land de we Mozis bin dɔn gi dɛn, bɔt di trɔŋ man dɛn go tek dɛn wɛpɔn dɛn ɛn krɔs Riva Jɔdan go oba say fɔ go ɛp di ɔda fambul dɛn

te te PAPA GƆD mek dɛn ɛp di ɔda fambul dɛn kapchɔ di land we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD de gi dɛn fɔ dɛnsɛf. I se, datɛnde, dɛn kin go bak go tap na dɛn yon land we de na di say we dɛn tinap na Riva Jɔdan usay san kin kɔmɔt, di land we Mozis we na PAPA GƆD in wokman bin dɔn tɛl dɛn se na dɛn yon.
Nain di pipul dɛn ansa se dɛn go du ɔl wetin i bin tɛl dɛn fɔ de du ɛn ɛnisay i sɛn dɛn, dɛn rɛdi fɔ go.
Dɛn tɛl am igen se, dɛn go obe am jɔs lɛk aw dɛn bin de obe Mozis ɛn dɛn pre se lɛ PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD de wit am ɔltɛm lɛk aw I bin de wit Mozis.
Dɛn tɔk igen se, ɛnibɔdi we nɔ go wan du wetin Jɔshwa se, dɛn fɔ kil am. Di pipul dɛn tɛl am se lɛ i tinap lɛk man pan ɔltin.
We di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin kamp na Akeshia, Jɔshwa we na Nɔn in pikin sɛn tu man fɔ go ayd wach Kenan aw i tan. We dɛn go na Kenan, dɛn go tap na wan rare gyal we nem Reab in os.
Da sem nɛt de, wɔd rich di kiŋ se sɔm Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn go insay in kɔntri fɔ go wach aw di land tan.
Nain di kiŋ na Jɛriko sɛn wɔd to Reab se, mek i put di man dɛn we kam nain os, na do bikɔs dɛn go de fɔ go wach aw di land tan.
Bɔt Reab nɔ du an; bifo dat i ayd di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɛn tɛl di kiŋ in man dɛn se sɔm man dɛn bin go to an bɔt i nɔ no usay dɛn kɔmɔt,
ɛn na we tɛm bin dɔn de rich fɔ lɛ di get lɔk da nɛt de, nain dɛn go. I se bɔt in nɔ no usay dɛn go. I tɛl di kiŋ in man dɛn se mek dɛn mekes rɔnata dɛn kech dɛn bifo dɛn go fa.
Bɔt ɔl da tɛm de, i bin ayd dɛn ɔp in ruf usay i bin pak sɔm tik dɛn fayn fayn wan.

Wantɛm wantɛm, di kiŋ in man dɛn go. Tinkin dat dɛn de rɔnata dɛn, di kiŋ in man dɛn go te dɛn rich na di ist pat lɛk we yu de go Riva Jɔdan. As dɛn bin kɔmɔt se dɛn de go rɔnata di Izrɛlayt dɛn so, dɛn bin lɔk di get.
Bifo di tu Izrɛlayt dɛn we Jɔshwa bin sɛn fɔ go wach Kenan slip da nɛt de, Reab go mit dɛn ɔp di ruf
ɛn tɛl dɛn se in no se, PAPA GƆD dɔn gi Izrɛl di land, ɛn bikɔs di pipul dɛn na Kenan de fred dɛn, dat dɔn mek dɛn fil lɛkɛ kripul dɛn bifo Izrɛl.

Reab se dɛn bin dɔn yɛri bɔt aw PAPA GƆD mek di rɛd si dray lɛ di Izrɛlayt dɛn krɔs. I se dɛn bin yɛri igen bɔt aw dɛn bin nyakanyaka dɛn tu Amorayt kiŋ, Sayɔn ɛn Og we bin de na di ist pat na Riva Jɔdan.

Reab tɛl dɛn se, as dɛn yɛri bɔt dat so, dɛn bigin fred; dɛn fut dɛn bigin trimbul ɔnda dɛn bikɔs dɛn de fred di Izrɛlayt dɛn, ɛn dɛn fred di Izrɛlayt dɛn bikɔs PAPA GƆD we na di Izrɛlayt dɛn PAPA GƆD, na di PAPA GƆD na ɛvin ɛn na di ath.

Reab tɛl dɛn fɔ swɛ na PAPA GƆD in nem ɛn prɔmis an se, we in dɔn sev dɛn layf, dɛnsɛf go sev in ɛn in fambul dɛn layf we dɛn go go fɔ go nyakanyaka Jɛriko. I se dɛn fɔ tɛl an wetin go mek i biliv se dɛn go sev dɛn.
I se dɛn fɔ si dat dɛn nɔ kil in papa, in mama, in brɔda ɛn sista dɛn ɛn dɛn wɛf, man ɛn pikin dɛn.

So di tu man dɛn we Jɔshwa bin sɛn go wach di land tɛl Reab se if i nɔ tɛl nɔbɔdi bɔt dɛn ɛn wetin dɛn go de fɔ ɛn stil sev dɛn layf, dɛnsɛf go waka tret wit am ɛn sev in ɛn in fambul dɛnsɛf yon layf we PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn ebul kapchɔ di land.
Reab in os bin de na di siti in wɔl. So i mek dɛn klem kam dɔŋ di wɔl wit rop.

So Reab advays dɛn fɔ go ayd ɔp di il dɛn so dat di kiŋ in man dɛn nɔ go mit dɛn na rod. I se we di kiŋ in man dɛn go dɔn luk fɔ dɛn fɔ tri de, dɛn go tɔn bak go Jɛriko. Datɛnde, dɛn go fri fɔ go bak na dɛn kamp.
Bifo di man dɛn go, dɛn prɔmis Reab se dɛn go du wetin dɛn dɔn swɛ se dɛn go du.
Dɛn tɛl Reab se, di de we dɛn go atak di siti, i fɔ tay da rɛd rop we dɛn de tek go dɔŋ di winda ɛn fɔ gɛda ɔl in fambul dɛn we i wan lɛ dɛn sev nain yon os.
Dɛn se if ɛni wan pan dɛn go na trit ɛn dɛn kil am, nɔbɔdi nɔ go blem dɛn, bɔt if dɛn kil ɛnibɔdi insay di os, dɛn fɔ blem dɛn ɛn di swɛ go kech dɛn.
Di tu man we Jɔshwa sɛn fɔ kam wach di land wɔn Reab siriɔs wan se if i tɛl ɛnibɔdi bɔt wetin dɛn dɔn plan, nɔbɔdi nɔ go blem dɛn tu if ɛnitin apin to Reab dɛn ɛn di swɛ go go bɔf.
Reab tɛl dɛn se in gri to ɔl di kɔndishɔn dɛn. So di tu man we Jɔshwa sɛn fɔ go wach di land klem kam dɔŋ ɛn go, dɔn Reab tay di rɛd rop nain os winda.

We di tu man we Jɔshwa bin sɛn go wach di land kɔmɔt de, dɛn go ɔp di il dɛn go ayd, ɛn dɛn bin de de tri de, te di kiŋ na Jɛriko in man dɛn tɔn bak go Jɛriko, afta dɛn dɔn luk ɔlsay fɔ dɛn ɛn nɔ ebul fɛn dɛn.
Afta dat di tu man dɛn we Jɔshwa bin sɛn fɔ go wach di land kam dɔŋ na di il go na di Jɔdan vali to Jɔshwa we na Nɔn in pikin ɛn tɛl am ɔl wetin apin to dɛn.
Dɛn tɛl am se fɔ tru tru, PAPA GƆD dɔn gi dɛn da land de, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn dɔn fred dɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Di nɛks de, Jɔshwa ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn grap kwik na mɔnin. Dɛn kɔmɔt usay dɛn bin kamp na Akasia ɛn put ed wɛst de go Riva Jɔdan. Na de dɛn kamp de wet te di tɛm rich fɔ dɛn fɔ krɔs Riva Jɔdan.
Afta tri de, di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl go rawnd di kamp
ɛn tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, we dɛn si di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin tot PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔn in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant de go, dɛn ɔl fɔ de biɛn am,
so dɛn nɔ go mis rod fɔ go usay dɛn gɛt fɔ go bikɔs dɛn nɔ pas na da rod de wande. I se dɛn nɔ fɔ go nia di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant atɔl, dɛn fɔ de niali wan mayl frɔn ɛnisay we di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant go de.
Jɔshwa tɛl di pipul dɛn se mek dɛn mek dɛnsɛf klin bifo PAPA GƆD bikɔs PAPA GƆD go du wɔnda di nɛks de.
I tɛl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant de go bifɔ. Dɛn tek di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant ɛn go bifo.
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɔshwa se na da de de in go mek ɔlman no se na Jɔshwa na lida na Izrɛl, so dat dɛn go no se jɔs lɛkɛ aw in nɔ bin de lɛf Mozis, na so i go de wit am.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɔshwa igen se, lɛ i tɛl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant se, we dɛn rich Riva Jɔdan, lɛ dɛn jɔs waka go insay di wata lili bit ɛn tinap de.
Nain Jɔshwa kɔl ɔl di pipul dɛn lɛ i go tɛl dɛn wetin PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD se in go du.

I tɛl dɛn se we PAPA GƆD go dɔn drɛb ɔl di pipul dɛn we de na di land; dat na di Kenanayt dɛn, di Itayt dɛn, di Ivayt dɛn, di Pɛrizayt dɛn, di Gigashayt dɛn, di Amorayt ɛn Jɛbyusayt dɛn, na datɛnde dɛn go biliv se, fɔ tru tru PAPA GƆD de wit dɛn.
I se PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD fɔ ɔl di pipul dɛn na di wanol wɔl, in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant go go bifo ɛn go rich Riva Jɔdan bifo dɛn.
Jɔshwa tɛl dɛn se dɛn fɔ pik wan wan man pan di twɛlv fambul dɛn.

I se as di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de tot PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD fɔ ɔl di pipul dɛn na di wanol wɔl, in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, put dɛn fut insay Riva Jɔdan so, di wata go lɛf fɔ rɔn; di wata we de kɔmɔt ɔp say go jɔs tinap wan ples ay wan.
Di pipul dɛn kɔmɔt na di kamp ɛn go fɔ krɔs riva Jɔdan. Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant bin dɔn go bifo wit di ak.

Di tɛm we ɔl dis bin de bi, na bin di tɛm we pipul kin avɛst, ɛn na datɛnde Riva Jɔdan kin ful te i ovaflo. Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we tot di Kɔvinant bɔks put dɛn fut insay di wata.

As dɛn du dat so, di wata we bin de kɔmɔt ɔp say jɔs tinap wan ples ay wan fawe na di siti we dɛn kɔl Adam, we de nia Zarɛthan. Di wan we bin de rɔn go na di Dɛd Si, kɔtɔf totali. Nain di pipul dɛn krɔs Riva Jɔdan go oba say fesin Jɛriko.

We di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin de krɔs Riva Jɔdan we di wata bin dɔn dray, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we bin tot PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, bin tinap na di dray grɔn insay Riva Jɔdan te ɔl di pipul dɛn krɔs dɔn.
We ɔl di pipul dɛn dɔn krɔs oba Riva Jɔdan dɔn, PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɔshwa fɔ
pik wan wan man pan ɔl di twɛlv fambul,
ɛn tɛl dɛn traŋa wan fɔ pik wan wan ston usay di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant bin tinap na Riva Jɔdan, ɛn kɛr dɛn go usay dɛn go slip da nɛt de.
So Jɔshwa kɔl di twɛlv man we dɛn bin dɔn pik wan wan pan di twɛlv fambul,

ɛn tɛl dɛn traŋa wan se, lɛ dɛn go usay di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we tot PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, tinap insay Riva Jɔdan, ɛn tek wan wan ston put na dɛn sholda, we min se wan ston go tinap fɔ wan fambul na Izrɛl,
we go de mek dɛn mɛmba wetin PAPA GƆD bin du fɔ dɛn na Riva Jɔdan, ɛn i go bi di ɛvidɛns fɔ tumara if dɛn pikin dɛn go aks dɛn wetin dɛn ston de min.

I se dɛn fɔ ansa dɛn se, di wata na Riva Jɔdan bin dray we di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de tot PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant bin tinap insay de, so dɛn ston de go mek ɔl di jɛnareshɔn dɛn na Izrɛl de mɛmba wetin bin bi, te go.

Di twɛlv man du wetin Jɔshwa tɛl dɛn fɔ du; dɛn go tek di twɛlv ston na Riva Jɔdan we min se, wan wan fɔ di twɛlv fambul, jɔs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin tɛl Jɔshwa fɔ du, ɛn kɛr dɛn go put dɛn na di ples we dɛn bin kamp.
Pantap dat, Jɔshwa mek dɛn pak twɛlv ston na di ples we di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin bin tinap insay Riva Jɔdan, ɛn dɛn bin de de te di tɛm we dɛn bin de rayt dis buk.

Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant tinap insay Riva Jɔdan te Jɔshwa dɔn tɛl di pipul dɛn wetin Mozis bin dɔn tɛl an se PAPA GƆD se fɔ tɛl dɛn. Di pipul dɛn krɔs kwik kwik.
We di pipul dɛn dɔn krɔs dɔn, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de tot di Ak, krɔs wit PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant ɛn kɛr an go wet bifo say.
Di Rubɛnayt dɛn, di Gadayt dɛn ɛn af di Manasɛ fambul tek ɔl dɛn wɛpɔn dɛn ɛn de frɔnt di pipul dɛn, jɔs lɛk aw Mozis bin dɔn se i fɔ bi;
na bɔt fɔti tawzin sojaman dɛn we bin gɛt dɛn wɛpɔn dɛn rɛdi fɔ fɛt, bin krɔs go Jɛriko, ɛn PAPA GƆD bin de wit dɛn bikɔs di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant bin de de.
Da de de, PAPA GƆD mek di wanol Izrɛl rɛspɛkt Jɔshwa lɛkɛ aw dɛn bin rɛspɛkt Mozis te i day.
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɔshwa se
lɛ i tɛl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, we tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, lɛ dɛn kɔmɔt insay Riva Jɔdan.
So Jɔshwa du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ du.
As di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, we tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant pul fut na di wata so, Riva Jɔdan ful bak ɛn ovaflo lɛkɛ aw i bin de wantɛm wantɛm.
Na di de we mek tɛn insay di fɔs mɔnt, di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin waka krɔs Riva Jɔdan, ɛn dɛn bin go kamp na Gilgal, na di bɔda na di Ist pat na Jɛriko.
Na Gilgai de Jɔshwa bin mek dɛn pak di twɛlv ston we dɛn bin pul kɔmɔt insay Riva Jɔdan.
Jɔshwa tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se we dɛn pikin dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet go aks dɛn papa dɛn wetin dɛn ston dɛn de min,
dɛn fɔ tɛl dɛn bɔt aw Riva Jɔdan bin dray te Izrɛl krɔs dɔn.
I se dɛn fɔ mek dɛn no se na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD bin mek ɔl di wata na Riva Jɔdan dray te dɛn krɔs dɔn, jɔs lɛk aw PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD bin mek di Rɛd Si dray te dɛn krɔs dɔn,
so ɔlman na dis wɔl go no se PAPA GƆD gɛt pawa ɛn dɛn go rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD te go.

We ɔl di Amorayt kiŋ dɛn we bin de na di wɛst say na Riva Jɔdan ɛn ɔl di Kenanayt kiŋ dɛn we de nia di si yɛri se PAPA GƆD mek Riva Jɔdan dray fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ krɔs, ɛn i mek i dray te dɛn krɔs dɔn, dɛn ɔl at pwɛl ɛn dɛn nɔ bin gɛt op igen bikɔs dɛn de fred di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɔshwa se lɛ i mek ston nɛf dɛn ɛn du di sɛkɛn sɛt sakɔmsishɔn na Izrɛl.
So Jɔshwa mek dɛn mek di ston nɛf dɛn ɛn sakɔmsayz ɔl di man dɛn na wan ples we dɛn kin kɔl Gibɛat-aaralɔt.
Jɔshwa bin sakɔmsayz ɔl di man dɛn bikɔs, ɔl di man dɛn we dɛn bin sakɔmsayz, day na rod insay di fɔti ia we dɛn tek na rod na di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap we dɛn bin kɔmɔ Ijipt.
Al di man dɛn we bin kɔmɔ Ijipt bin sakɔmsayz, bɔt di bɔypikin dɛn we dɛn bɔn na rod nɔ bin sakɔmsayz.

Bɔt insay di fɔti ia we dɛn tek de waka na di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap, ɔl di man dɛn we bin dɔn machɔ fɔ ebul fɛt, bin dɔn day. Dɛn nɔ bin rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD ɛn I bin dɔn swɛ se in nɔ go mek dɛn si di land we gud fɔ plant ɛn fɔ mɛn animal, we i bin dɔn prɔmis dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn.
Bikɔs di wan dɛn we bɔn na rod nɔ bin sakɔmsayz, na dɛn Jɔshwa bin mek dɛn sakɔmsayz.
We Jɔshwa dɔn mek dɛn sakɔmsayz dɛn dɔn, dɛn nɔ go nɔwe te dɛn wund dɛn wɛl.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɔshwa se wetin apin so da de de, dɔn pul di disgres we mit dɛn na Ijipt, kɔmɔt pan dɛn, so dɛn fɔ kɔl da ples de Gilgal.
Di ivintɛm na di de we mek fɔtin da mɔnt de, di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin sɛlibret di Fist ɔf di Pasova na di ples we nɔ gɛt il na Gilgal.
Di nɛks de afta di pasova, na bin di fɔs tɛm we dɛn it it we na da land de i gro. Na di land di sid gro we dɛn pach ɛn bit ɛn mek bred we nɔ gɛt yist, we dɛn it.
Na di nɛks de afta di Izrɛlayt dɛn it pan tin dɛn we gro na di land PAPA GƆD lɛf fɔ sɛn mana fɔ dɛn, ɛn dɛn nɔ it mana igen, pas wetin dɛn plant we de gro na dɛn land we na Kenan, da ia de.
Wande we Jɔshwa ɛn in pipul dɛn bin stil kamp nia Jɛriko, Jɔshwa jɔs si wan man we ol sɔd tinap bifo an, so Jɔshwa go mit am ɛn aks am se if i de fɔ dɛn ɔ i nɔ de fɔ dɛn.
Nain di man ansa an se nɔ o, a kam ya bikɔs mi na di kɔmanda fɔ PAPA GƆD in ami. Nain Jɔshwa butu na grɔn ɛn wɔship am ɛn aks am se, na wetin in go wan lɛ i du.
Nain di kɔmanda fɔ PAPA GƆD in ami tɛl am se mek i pul in sandal bikɔs usay i tinap na oli grɔn. Nain Jɔshwa pul in sandal.
Di pipul na Jɛriko bin lɔk dɛn get lɛ di Izrɛlayt dɛn nɔ ebul go insay; nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de go insay ɔ kɔmɔt na do.
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɔshwa se in go mek Izrɛl kapchɔ Jɛriko; dɛn go bit di kiŋ ɛn in big big sojaman dɛn.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am igen se dɛn fɔ mach rawnd di siti wantɛm fɔ de fɔ siks de.

PAPA GƆD se na sɛvin man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ de mach bifo di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant de blo sɛvin trɔmpɛt we dɛn tek man ship ɔn mek; bɔt we di de we mek sɛvin rich, Jɔshwa ɛn di sojaman dɛn na Izrɛl fɔ mach rawnd di siti sɛvin tɛm ɛn di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, fɔ de blo dɛn trɔmpɛt.

PAPA GƆD se we dɛn dɔn mach rawnd di siti sɛvin tɛm, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ blo di trɔmpɛt lawd lawd wan fɔ lɔŋ, ɛn as dɛn blo di lɔŋ blo so, ɔl di pipul dɛn fɔ ala lawd lawd wan. Di wɔl na di siti go fɔdɔm flat wan ɛn ɔl di sojaman dɛn go jɔs rɔn go insay.

So Jɔshwa we na Nɔn in pikin kɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, we kin tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant ɛn tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant ɛn lɛ sɛvin ɔda man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, de blo sɛvin trɔmpɛt we dɛn tek man ship ɔn mek, bifo PAPA GƆD in ak.
I tɛl di pipul dɛn se lɛ dɛn mach rawnd di siti, ɛn sɔm sojaman wit dɛn wɛpɔn dɛn fɔ de bifo di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant.

Di pipul dɛn du ɔl wetin Jɔshwa tɛl dɛn fɔ du; sɛvin man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin de bifo di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant de blo trɔmpɛt we na man ship ɔn dɛn tek mek dɛn ɛn PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant bin de biɛn dɛn.
Fɛtman dɛn we ol wɛpɔn bin de mach bifo di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de blo di trɔmpɛt dɛn ɛn nɔ de tap we dɛn bin de mach, ɛn di sojaman dɛn we fɔ de biɛn, bin de biɛn di ak.
Jɔshwa tɛl di pipul dɛn traŋa wan se, dɛn nɔ fɔ ala ɔ ivin tɔk te di de kam we in go tɛl dɛn fɔ ala.
So i mek dɛn kɛr PAPA GƆD in ak go rawnd di siti wan tɛm dɔn dɛn go slip na dɛn kamp na nɛt.
Di nɛks de, Jɔshwa wek ali mɔnin. Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin tot PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant.

Di sɛvin man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de blo di trɔmpɛt we dɛn tek man ship ɔn mek, de bifo PAPA GƆD in ak de blo di trɔmpɛt dɛn ɛn nɔ de tap. Di sojaman dɛn we bin ol wɛpɔn bin de bifo dɛn, bɔt di gyadman dɛn we fɔ de biɛn bin de biɛn PAPA GƆD in ak ɛn dɛn bin de blo di trɔmpɛt ɛn nɔ de tap.
Dɛn mach rawnd di siti wan tɛm bak da sɛkɛn de de. We dɛn dɔn, dɛn go bak na dɛn kamp go slip. Na so dɛn du fɔ siks de.

Di de we mek sɛvin, dɛn grap ali mɔnin, as do klin so ɛn mach rawnd di siti, di sem we we dɛn kin mach rawnd di siti, bɔt da de de, na sɛvin tɛm dɛn go rawnd di siti, ɛn na da de de nɔmɔ dɛn dɔn mach rawnd di siti sɛvin tɛm.
As dɛn go rawnd di tɛm we mek sɛvin so, we di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin blo dɛn trɔmpɛt dɛn, nain Jɔshwa tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se lɛ dɛn ala, bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn gi dɛn di siti.
I se dɛn go sakrifays ɔltin we de na di siti to PAPA GƆD, pas da rare gial we nem Reab ɛn in fambul dɛn we de na os to an, bikɔs na im bin ayd di man dɛn we i bin sɛn go wach di land.
Jɔshwa wɔn di pipul dɛn lɛ dɛn nɔ tek natin pan di tin dɛn na di siti we dɛn dɔn se dɛn go sakrifays to PAPA GƆD, lɛ trɔbul nɔ go mit dɛn.
I tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ tɔch natin, bɔt ɔl di silva, gold, ɛn di bras ɛn ayɛn tin dɛn we dɛn fɔ yuz na di tɛmpul, oli to PAPA GƆD, so dɛn go put dɛn usay dɛn kin put PAPA GƆD in tiŋs dɛn.

So di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we ol di trɔmpɛt dɛn, blo dɛn. As dɛn blo di trɔmpɛt dɛn so, nain di pipul dɛn ɔl ala lawd lawd wan ɛn di wɔl we de rawnd Jɛriko, fɔdɔm flat wan na grɔn. Di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɔl rɔn go insay di siti ɛn kapchɔ di siti.
Dɛn nyakanyaka Jɛriko bad bad wan. Dɛn chap ɔlman wit dɛn sɔd; man o, uman o, pikin o, kaw o, ship o, dɔŋki o, dɛn nɔ lɛf nɔbɔdi.
Nain Jɔshwa tɛl di tu man we bin go wach di land se lɛ dɛn go tek da rare gial ɛn ɔl in pipul dɛn we de na os to an, jɛs lɛkɛ aw dɛn bin dɔn prɔmis se dɛn go du.
So di yɔŋ man dɛn we bin go wach di land, go ɛn go briŋ Reab ɛn in papa ɛn mama, in brɔda dɛn ɛn ɔl in fambul dɛn. Dɛn kɛr in ɛn in fambul dɛn go nia dɛn kamp.
Dɛn bɔn di wanol siti. Natin dɛn nɔ lɛf,, pas di tin dɛn we na gold, silva, bras ɛn ayɛn dɛn tek mek dɛn, ɛn dɛn put dɛn usay PAPA GƆD in tiŋs dɛn kin de.
Jɔshwa sev da rare gial we nem Reab ɛn in fambul dɛn, ɛn dɛn de na Izrɛl te di tɛm we dɛn bin de rayt dis buk bikɔs i bin ayd di man dɛn we jɔshwa bin sɛn go wach di land.
Jɔshwa bin swɛ se ɛnibɔdi we go tray fɔ bil Jɛriko, PAPA GƆD go pul at pan am. Di pɔsin we go le di fawndeshɔn in fɔs pikin go day. Di pɔsin we go bil di get in las pikin go day.
PAPA GƆD bin de ɛp Jɔshwa ɛn ɔlman bin yɛri bɔt am ɔlsay na da eria de.
