I se, Ruth fɔ de wach usay di man de go lidɔm ɛn wɛn i dɔn lidɔm, Ruth fɔ go es in kɔbaklos ɛn lidɔm nia in fut. I go tɛl am wetin i fɔ du.
Ruth ansa se in go du ɔl wetin Naomi tɛl am.
So i go dɔŋ na di milos ɛn du jɛs wetin in mɔdɛnlɔ bin tɛl am.
Wɛn Boaz dɔn it ɛn drink dɔn, in at layt. I go lidɔm midul di sid dɛn we dɛn payl. Di uman go saful, pul in kɔbaklos ɛn lidɔm to in fut.
Midul nɛt, di man skyad wek ɛn we i tɔn, biol, biol, na uman i fil lidɔm kɔna to in fut.
I aks udat de de. Ruth ansa se in na Ruth ɛn tɛl am fɔ prɛd in skat ɛn kɔba am as in na man we kin mared am.
Nain i se, mek PAPA GƆD blɛs am bikɔs wetin i du da tɛm de pas wetin i bin dɔn du, bikɔs i nɔ go fɛn yɔŋ bɔy fɔ mared ɛn nɔ bisin if i jɛntri ɔ if i po.
I se mek i nɔ fred bikɔs in go du wetin Ruth want am fɔ du ɛn ɔlman na di siti no se na uman we fit fɔ gɛt.
I se na tru se in na Ruth in man in gud gud fambul dɛn bɔt ɔda fambul de we nia pas am.
I tɛl Ruth se mek i slip de da nɛt de, dɔn na mɔnin, in go go aks di man if i go gri fɔ mared Ruth. I se mek i mared am. Bɔt if i se nɔ, i prɔmis bifo PAPA GƆD se in di Boaz go mared Ruth.
So insɛf lidɔm bay in fut te ali mɔnin bifo do klin ɛn grap kwik we nɔbɔdi nɔ go no se nain bikɔs Boaz nɔ bin want ɛnibɔdi fɔ no se uman go slip na di milos.
We i grap fɔ go, Boaz mɛzhɔ bɔt sɔm twɛnti-fayv kɔp bali, rap am insay di klos we i bin wɛr ɛn gi am fɔ tot. Dɔn i ol rod go bak na di siti.
We Ruth rich, in mɔdɛnlɔ aks am wetin apin. Nain Ruth tɛl am ɔl wetin di man du fɔ am,
ɛn gi am di bali we i mɛzhɔ fɔ am ɛn se in nɔ fɔ go ɛmti an.
Naomi tɛl am se lɛ i bia wet bikɔs Boaz go mek shɔ se ɔltin dɔn da de de.
Boaz go ɔp na di siti in get usay di bigman dɛn kin sidɔm fɔ jɔj kes ɛn biol biol, dis gud gud fambul ya we Boaz bin tɔk bɔt, insɛf go de. So Boaz kɔl am fɔ go sidɔm nia am ɛn i go.
Boaz kɔl tɛn man pan di bigman dɛn we bin de de fɔ go sidɔm to am; ɛn i go.
I tɛl am se Naomi dɔn kɔmɔt Moab ɛn i de sɛl di land we Ɛlimɛlɛk we na dɛn fambul bin gɛt.

So in tink se fɔ tɛl am, so dat na usay di ɔda bigman dɛn de i go bay am if i want am. I se if i wan bay am bak, i fayn bikɔs nɔn ɔda pɔsin nɔ de fɔ bay am, ɛn nain di Boaz de afta am. Di man se in go bay am bak.
Na da tɛm de Boaz tɛl am se, i fayn, bɔt di tɛm we i de bay di fil na Naomi in an, i fɔ bay Ruth insɛf we na di Moabayt uman we na di man we dɔn day in wɛf so dat in nem nɔ go day.
So di fambul we bin wan bay di land bak se i nɔ go bay am fɔ insɛf igen bikɔs dat min se in nɔ go gɛt natin pan di prɔpati. I se mek Boaz bay am bak bikɔs i nɔ ebul du dat.
Fɔstɛm we dɛn kin gɛt fɔ bay tin bak ɔ ɛkschenj tin na Izrɛl, fɔ sho se ɔlman gri wit wetin dɛn se, wan pɔsin go pul in sandals nain fut gi di ɔda wan.
So bikɔs di ɔda man de tɛl Boaz se i kin bay am, i pul in sandals nain fut gi am.
Dɔn Boaz tɛl di bigman dɛn ɛn di ɔda pipul dɛn se, dɛn de fɔ in witnɛs se, in dɔn bay ɔl wetin na bin Ɛlimɛlɛk, Malɔn ɛn Kiliɔn yon na Naomi in an da de de.
I se in dɔn bay Ruth we na Moabaytɛs ɛn we bin mared to Malɔn we dɔn day fɔ bi in wɛf so dat di dayman in nem nɔ go ɔt na di say we i bɔn as insɛf go gɛt prɔpati.

Dɛn di bigman dɛn ɛn ɔlman we bin de na di get se, yɛs, dɛn de fɔ witnɛs ɛn pre mek di uman we i de mared tan lɛk Rechɛl ɛn Lia we na dɛn ɔltu bɔn pikin ful os fɔ Izrɛl. Dɛn pre mek bɛtɛ fala am lɛk Ɛfrata ɛn mek ɔlman no am na Bɛtliɛm.
Dɛn pre bak mek dɛn os tan lɛk aw Pɛrɛz in os bin tan. Pɛrɛz na di bɔypikin we Tama bin bɔn fɔ Juda PAPA GƆD go mɔs mek Ruth insɛf bɔn pikin ful os fɔ Boaz.
So Boaz kɛr Ruth go nain os ɛn i bi in wɛf. Dɛn tu lidɔm ɛn PAPA GƆD mek i gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn bɔbɔ.
Dɛn di uman dɛn na di siti go mit Naomi ɛn jɔyn am fɔ prez PAPA GƆD. Dɛn se PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛ Naomi de i nɔ gɛt fambul. So lɛ di pikin bi bigman na Izrɛl.
Dɛn se nain go mek Naomi gɛt layf bak ɛn nain go mek i go rɔju bikɔs nain dɔtɛnlɔ we lɛk am bad lɛk aw sɛvin bɔypikin go lɛk am, nain bɔn am.
Naomi tek di pikin ɛn le am nain chɛst ɛn bayobayo am.
Di uman dɛn we de neba am gi am nem Obɛd, dɛn se na Naomi dɔn bɔn bɔypikin so. Obɛd na bin Jɛsi in papa ɛn na Devid in grampa.
Na Pɛrɛz in yon jɛnareshɔn dɛn wan ya: Pɛrɛz na Hɛzrɔn in papa,
Hɛzrɔn bɔn Ram, Ram bɔn Aminadab,
Aminadab bɔn Nashɔn, Nashɔn bɔn Salmɔn,
Salmɔn bɔn Boaz, Boaz bɔn Obɛd,
Obɛd bɔn Jɛsi, ɛn Jɛsi bɔn Devid.

Wan man bin de we bin nem Ɛlkena. Na bin wan pan di Ifrem fambul ɛn i bin tap na Rama na di ɔplayn pat na Ifrem. Jɛroam nain papa ɛn na Ilaɛlu in grampikin. Dɛn kɔmɔt na Tou in famili layn ɛn na bin wan pan di Zuf pipul dɛn.
I bin gɛt tu wɛf wan na Ana dɔn di ɔda wan na Pɛnina. Pɛnina bin gɛt pikin dɛn bɔt Ana nɔ bin gɛt.

Ɛvri ia dis man kin kɔmɔt usay i tap na Rama, i kin go ɔp na Shaylɔ fɔ go wɔship PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti de ɛn mek sakrifays to am. Na de Ofni ɛn Finɛas we na Ilaɛl in bɔypikin dɛn bin de as man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin to PAPA GƆD.
Wɛn di de kin rich fɔ mek Ɛlkena mek in sakrifays; i kin gi Pɛnina we na wan pan in wɛf, wit ɔl in bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn sɔm pan di bif.
Bɔt i kin gi Ana, wan big af nɔmɔ bikɔs pan ɔl we i lɛk am, PAPA GƆD nɔ bin mek i bɔn.
Ɛn bikɔs PAPA GƆD nɔ mek i bɔn, in met kin de trowe int pan am fɔ mek i go vɛks.
Ɔltɛm, ɔltɛm na so bin de apin. Ɛnitɛm we Ana kin go ɔp na PAPA GƆD in os, in met kin de trowe int pan am we go mek i de kray ɛn nɔ gri it.
In man, Ɛlkena kin aks am wetin mek i de kray. I kin koks am ɛn tɛl am se i kin du pas wetin tɛn bɔypikin kin du.
Wande we dɛn bin de na Shaylɔ, afta we ɔlman dɔn it ɛn drink, Ana grap. Ilaɛl we na bin di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin bin sidɔm na wan chia we bin de na di domɔt fɔ go na PAPA GƆD in os.
Aw Ana tinap wit in at we nɔ swit, na de i bigin kray ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD.
I swɛ to PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se if i kin sɔri fɔ am nɔmɔ ɛn gi am wan bɔypikin, i go gi am bak to PAPA GƆD fɔ wok fɔ am te i day ɛn i nɔ go kɔt in ia.
As i bin de pre to PAPA GƆD, na so Ilaɛl bin de wach in mɔt.
Ana bin de pre nain at bɔt i mɔt bin de shek bɔt pɔsin nɔ bin de yɛri wetin i de se. Ilaɛl bin tink se na drɔnk i drɔnk
so i tɔk pan am mek i lɛf fɔ drink ɛn biev lɛk drɔnkɔman.
Ana tɛl am se i nɔ drɔnk. I ɛksplen se in na uman we tin de mɔna. I se i nɔ drink wayn ɔ bia bɔt dat i de tɛl PAPA GƆD wetin de mɔna am.
I tɛl Ilaɛl nɔ fɔ luk am lo bɔt dat i gɛt siriɔs tin we de mɔna am we mek i de pre so.
Ilaɛl blɛs am ɛn tɛl am mek i nɔ wɔri ɛn pre se di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship go ansa in prea.
Ana se i wish Ilaɛl go trit am fayn ɔltɛm. I kɔmɔt de go it ɛn nɔ twis in fes igen
We do klin di nɛks de, dɛn grap ɛn go bak na Rama afta dɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD dɔn. Ɛlkena lidɔm wit in wɛf Ana, ɛn PAPA GƆD ansa Anain prea.
Na so Ana tek gɛt bɛlɛ dɔn we di tɛm rich i bɔn bɔypikin. I gi di pikin nem Samiɛl as i se bikɔs a aks PAPA GƆD fɔ am.
Wɛn in man Ɛlkena ɛn di ɔda pipul dɛn nain os go ɔp na Shaylɔ fɔ go mek sakrifays as dɛn kin du ɛvri ia ɛn fɔ kip in prɔmis to PAPA GƆD,
Ana nɔ go wit dɛn. I tɛl in man se we i dɔn win di pikin, i go kɛr am go gi PAPA GƆD ɛn di pikin go tap na PAPA GƆD in os, te i day.

In man we na Ɛlkena, tɛl am se, lɛ i du wetin i lɛk. I se Ana kin wet te i win in pikin wans nɔmɔ i du wetin i dɔn tɛl PAPA GƆD se i go du. So Anainsɛf sidɔm na os ɛn gi in pikin bɔbi te di tɛm rich we i win am.
Wɛn i dɔn win di pikin dɔn, i tek di pikin smɔl wan so, wit wan tri-ia ol man kaw, wan bushɛl flawa ɛn wan jɔg wayn, ɛn kɛr di pikin go na PAPA GƆD in os na Shaylɔ.
Afta dɛn dɔn kil di man kaw dɔn, dɛn kɛr di bɔbɔ go to Ilaɛl, dɛn
Ana tɛl Ilaɛl se nain na di uman we lɔntɛm bin tinap nia am de pre to PAPA GƆD.
I tɛl Ilaɛl se na di pikin we i pre fɔ de wit am so as PAPA GƆD gi am wetin i bin aks fɔ.
I se so insɛf dɔn briŋ di pikin fɔ gi am bak fɔ de to PAPA GƆD te i day. Na de di pikin lɛf fɔ de sav PAPA GƆD. Ɛn dɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD de.
Ana bin pre to PAPA GƆD bak se, “Mi at go es PAPA GƆD ɔp; a gladi we PAPA GƆD gi mi trɛnk. A de laf mi ɛnimi dɛn bikɔs a de gladi we yu fri mi.
“Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we oli lɛk PAPA GƆD: Natin nɔ de we tan lɛk am; Natin nɔ kin kɔba wi lɛk aw PAPA GƆD de kɔba wi.
Nɔ mek plɛnti nɔys se yu de blɔf nɔ de kak bikɔs PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD we no ɔltin, ɛn nain de pe ɔlman fɔ wetin i du.
I dɔn brok di tin we dɛn kin tek fɛt, bɔt dɛn wan we nɔ ebul fɛt, i dɔn gi dɛn trɛnk.

Dɛn wan, we bin gɛt bɔku fɔ it, de wok naw fɔ dɛn lili ɛn natin. Bɔt dɛn wan we nɔ bin gɛt tin fɔ it, nɔ de aŋri igen. Di uman we nɔ bin de bɔn dɔn bɔn sɛvin pikin naw, bɔt di wan we bin gɛt bɔku pikin lɛf in wan bikɔs ɔl in pikin dɛn dɔn day.
Na PAPA GƆD de gi layf, nain de tek layf; Nain de mek yu day ɛn nain de mek sik nɔ kil yu.
PAPA GƆD de mek yu po ɔ i gi yu jɛntri; nain de put yu dɔŋ ɔ es yu ɔp.
I kin pul poman kɔmɔt pan po ɛn pul am pan po layf; I mek i sidɔm wit ayɔps ɛn gɛt wetin dɛnsɛf de ɛnjɔy. Na PAPA GƆD mek di wɔl; i fiks ɔltin aw dɛn fɔ de.
“I de gayd udat de du wetin i want, bɔt i de mek di bad man day kwik. As wi nɔ de du natin bay wi pawa;
PAPA GƆD go skata in ɛnimi dɛn. I go trɛtin dɛn wit in vɔys lɛk tɛnda frɔm ɛvin. Na PAPA GƆD go jɔj ɔlman na wɔl. I go gi mɔ pawa to di wan we in dɔn pik fɔ bi Kiŋ fɔ in pipul dɛn.”
Dɔn Ɛlkena ɛn Ana go bak na dɛn os na Rama bɔt Samiɛl in lɛf fɔ wok na PAPA GƆD in os na Shaylɔ wit Ilaɛl we bin de de as di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
Ilaɛl in bɔypikin dɛn na bin bad baba dɛn. Dɛn nɔ bin de biev lɛk udat dɛn no PAPA GƆD.
Dɛn bin gɛt wan bad trik we dɛn kin du to di pipul dɛn. Ɛnitɛm we ɛnibɔdi go fɔ mek sakrifays, we di bif kin de bwɛl, dɛn bɔbɔ dɛn kin go de wit wan fɔk we gɛt tri tit.

Dɛn go chuk di bif insay di pɔt ɔ pan we dɛn put am fɔ bwɛl, dɔn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go tek wetin di fɔk chuk ɛn briŋ ɔp as in yon. Na so dɛn bin de biev to ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn we kin go na Shaylɔ.

Dɛn kin so du am dat ivin we di fat nɔ bɔn yet, we nain fɔ bi di sakrifays we PAPA GƆD fɔ gɛt, di bɔbɔ dɛn kin dɔn go aks di pɔsin we de bwɛl di bif fɔ gi di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn yon. Di bɔbɔ dɛn kin se di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ go tek bwɛl bif as i want fɔ go ros in yon, so na rɔ bif nɔmɔ i want.
If di pɔsin we de bwɛl di bif se nɔto fayn tin ɛn aks di bɔbɔ fɔ wet te di fat bɔn bifo i tek wetin i want, di bɔbɔ dɛn go tɛl am se if i nɔ gi dɛn saful wan, dɛn go tek am bay fos.
PAPA GƆD bin dɔn gens wit wetin dɛn de du as dɛn nɔ sho se dɛn gɛt ɛni rɛspɛkt fɔ PAPA GƆD.
Da sem tɛm de, Samiɛl bin de wok fɔ PAPA GƆD nain os. Na bin bɔbɔ. I kin wɛr wan spɛshal klos we dɛn tek linin matirial mek.
We in mama kin go ɔp de wit in man fɔ go mek di sakrifays we dɛn kin mek ɛvri ia, i kin kɛr wan smɔl klos go we i kin dɔn so fɔ am.
Ilaɛl go blɛs Ɛlkena ɛn in wɛf. I go tɛl dɛn se, lɛ PAPA GƆD gi dɛn mɔ pikin we Ana go bɔn so dat i go tek di ples ɔf di wan we i pre fɔ we i dɔn gi bak to PAPA GƆD. Afta dat, dɛn kin go na dɛn os.
PAPA GƆD bin gud to Ana; I gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn i bɔn tri bɔbɔ ɛn tu titi. Ɔl da tɛm de, Samiɛl in lɛf na PAPA GƆD in os usay i gro ɔp.

Ilaɛl bin dɔn tɔn olpa bɔt i bin de yɛri bɔt ɔl wetin in bɔypikin dɛn de du to di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɛn aw dɛn bin ivin de gɛt biznɛs wit di uman dɛn we bin de fɔ de wok na di Tɛnt usay dɛn kin mit PAPA GƆD in domɔt.
So i aks dɛn wetin mek dɛn de biev so. I tɛl dɛn se i dɔn yɛri wetin di pipul dɛn de se bɔt di bad tin dɛn we dɛn de du.
I tɛl dɛn nɔ fɔ de du so as di tin we i de yɛri ɔlman de tɔk, nɔ gud.

I mek lɛ dɛn no se if pɔsin ambɔg in kɔmpin mɔtalman, PAPA GƆD kin tɔk dɛn kes bɔt if na PAPA GƆD pɔsin ambɔg, nɔbɔdi nɔ go de fɔ tɔk fɔ am. Bɔt pan ɔl dat, dɛn nɔ yɛri in wɔd, bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin dɔn plan fɔ dɔnawe wit dɛn.
Bɔt Samiɛl in bin jɛs de rɔju, PAPA GƆD bin lɛk am ɛn ɔlman bin lɛk in biznɛs.
Wande, wan man we bin de tɔk fɔ PAPA GƆD go mit Ilaɛl. I se, PAPA GƆD tɛl am se i bin sho insɛf to Ilaɛl in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn na Ijipt.

I se, PAPA GƆD se i bin pik in papa fɔ bi man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin pan ɔl di fambul dɛn we bin de na Izrɛl. Nain papa i pik fɔ de go nain ɔlta, fɔ bɔn insɛns ɛn fɔ wɛr spɛshal klos usay i de. I se PAPA GƆD se i mek ɔl udat kɔmɔt na Ilaɛl in papa in os fɔ de gɛt ɔl di ɔfrin we bɔn na faya we di Izrɛlayt dɛn kin de mek.

I se PAPA GƆD se fɔ aks Ilaɛl wetin mek in ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn de trit di sakrifays we i dɔn se pipul fɔ mek, bad so. PAPA GƆD se fɔ aks bak se, wetindu Ilaɛl de gri mek in bɔypikin dɛn it wetin in fɔ gɛt as sakrifays frɔm di Izrɛlayt dɛn an.

Di man we de tɔk fɔ PAPA GƆD se, na dat mek PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship se in bin dɔn se na Ilaɛl in famili ɛn dɛn jɛnareshɔn go bi di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin te go, bɔt in de se i nɔ gɛt fɔ bi so igen, bikɔs na udat sho rɛspɛkt fɔ am, i go rɛspɛkt, bɔt udat de lili am, insɛf nɔ go bisin bɔt am.
I tɛl dɛn se, PAPA GƆD se, di tɛm de kam we in go dɔnawe wit ɔl di man dɛn we de nain os ɛn ɔlman nain fambul. Dɛn ɔl go kil dɛn ɔl
dɔn in ɛn in fambul dɛn go de kɔle pan wetin i de du. Dɛn go de fɔ si ɔl di gud we i de du na Izrɛl bɔt nɔn pan in fambul nɔ go de te i ol fɔ ɛnjɔy am.
PAPA GƆD tɛl di man fɔ tɛl am se, di pɔsin dɛn we i nɔ go dɔnawe wit bɔt we go de fɔ wok nain ɔlta, go blɛn ɛn go de kray ɔltɛm bikɔs dɛn at nɔ go swit, ɛn dɛn go kil ɔl di ɔda wan dɛn.
As fɔ in tu bɔypikin, Ofni ɛn Finɛas, PAPA GƆD se dɛn ɔltu go day di sem de ɛn na dat go mek Ilaɛl no se ɔl wetin i dɔn tɔk go bi.

Di man se PAPA GƆD se in go mɛn wan man we go de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, we go de du wetin in want fɔ mek i du we de nain at. PAPA GƆD se in go mek shɔ se bɔku pipul na dis man ya we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin in os, de fɔ am ɛn na dɛn go de wok wit di Kiŋ we i go pik ɔltɛm.
PAPA GƆD se ɔl Ilaɛl in yon fambul dɛn go go beg am fɔ fɛn wok fɔ dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os so dat dɛn go gɛt mɔni ɛn it.
Di bɔbɔ Samiɛl bin de sav PAPA GƆD ɛn i bin de wok ɔnda Ilaɛl. Dɛn tɛm dɛn de pɔsin nɔba yɛri we PAPA GƆD de tɔk so ɛn bɔku pipul nɔ bin de si vishɔn so.
Ilaɛl in yay bin dɔn bad ɛn i nɔ bin de si bɛtɛ igen. Wan nɛt, i bin lidɔm nain yuzhwal ples,
ɛn di spɛshal lamp we kin de bɔn na PAPA GƆD in os, bin stil de bɔn. Samiɛl bin lidɔm insay PAPA GƆD in os ɛn di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant sɛf bin de de.
Na da tɛm de PAPA GƆD kɔl Samiɛl. Samiɛl ansa se, “Luk mi, a de na ya.”
Dɔn i rɔn go to Ilaɛl as i bin min se na Ilaɛl de kɔl am. Bɔt Ilaɛl tɛl am se in nɔ kɔl am so i fɔ go lidɔm bak. So insɛf go lidɔm bak.
PAPA GƆD kɔl Samiɛl bak ɛn i rɔn go to Ilaɛl. I se “Luk mi, yu kɔl mi.” Ilaɛl se “Mi pikin, go lidɔm saful ya, a nɔ kɔl yu.”
Da tɛm de, Samiɛl nɔ bin no aw PAPA GƆD de tɔk to pɔsin as PAPA GƆD nɔ bin ɛva tɔk to am yet.
PAPA GƆD kɔl Samiɛl di tɔd tɛm, ɛn Samiɛl grap bak, rɔn go to Ilaɛl as i bin fil se na Ilaɛl de kɔl am. Na da tɛm de Ilaɛl kechɔp se na PAPA GƆD go de kɔl di bɔbɔ.
So i tɛl am mek i go lidɔm bak bɔt dat, dis tɛm we i yɛri di vɔys igen i fɔ se, “PAPA GƆD tɔk nɔmɔ, yu pikin de lisin.” So Samiɛl go bak go lidɔm.
So PAPA GƆD kam bak, tek pozishɔn ɛn kɔl am lɛk aw i dɔn yuz fɔ du. Samiɛl jɛs se “Tɔk, yu pikin de yɛri.”
PAPA GƆD tɛl Samiɛl se, “Luk ya, A de kam du sɔntin na Izrɛl we ɛnibɔdi we yɛri wetin bi go fred.
Na da tɛm de a go du ɔl wetin a bin dɔn se a go du to Ilaɛl ɛn in famili. A nɔ go lɛf natin.
A bin dɔn tɛl Ilaɛl se in famili go sɔfa sote go bikɔs i bin no aw in bɔypikin dɛn bin de biev to mi bɔt in nɔ du natin fɔ tap dɛn.
Na dat mek misɛf swɛ se ɔlman na Ilaɛl in famili go sɔfa fɔ dat ɛn nɔn sakrifays ɔ prɛzɛnt nɔ go mek a chenj mi maynd.”
Samiɛl lidɔm te mɔnin we i grap opin di do dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os. I bin de fred fɔ tɛl Ilaɛl bɔt di vishɔn,
bɔt Ilaɛl kɔl am ɛn aks am.
Ilaɛl se, “Wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl yu? Nɔ ayd am frɔm mi. Lɛ PAPA GƆD mek wetin fɔ mit mi, mit yu if yu ayd ɛnitin pan mi.”
So Samiɛl insɛf tɛl am ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD bin tɛl am. I nɔ ayd natin. We Ilaɛl yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD se, i se, “Nain na PAPA GƆD, lɛ i du wetin rayt fɔ am.”
PAPA GƆD bin de wit Samiɛl we i bin de gro ɔp ɛn i kin mek shɔ se i du ɔl wetin Samiɛl tɔk se go bi.
Ɔlman na Izrɛl bin no se Samiɛl na man we bin de fala PAPA GƆD gud gud wan ɛn tɔk wetin PAPA GƆD se.
PAPA GƆD kɔntinyu fɔ apia to Samiɛl na Shaylɔ ɛn mek Samiɛl no mɔ bɔt am aw i de rid in wɔd.
Ɛnitɛm we Samiɛl tɔk, Izrɛl de yɛri wɔd. Wan tɛm di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin gɛt fɔ go fɛt wa wit di Filistin dɛn. Di Izrɛlayt dɛn kamp na Ibɛniza, dɔn di Filistin dɛn kamp na Efɛk.
Di Filistin dɛn skata dɛn sojaman dɛn fɔ brakɛt Izrɛl. Dis mek di wa kɔmɔt bad pan dɛn ɛn so di Filistin dɛn win di Izrɛlayt dɛn. Dɛn kil fo tawzin pan dɛn na di wɔfrɔnt.

Wɛn di balans Izrɛlayt sojaman dɛn go bak usay dɛn de kamp, di bigman dɛn aks dɛnsɛf wetindu PAPA GƆD mek di Filistin dɛn win dɛn bad wan so. Dɛn se dɛn fɔ go tek di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant na Shaylɔ kam de wit dɛn. Dɛn se, di ak we go sho se PAPA GƆD de wit dɛn, go ɛp dɛn fɔ win di Filistin dɛn.

So dɛn sɛn man dɛn go na Shaylɔ we go briŋ PAPA GƆD, in ak ɔf di Kɔvinant kam bak. PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD na ɛvin ɛn ath, we gɛt Chɛryubim fɔ in sikyɔriti - Ilaɛl in bɔypikin dɛn we na Ofni ɛn Finɛas bin tot di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant.
We dɛn rich na di kamp wit di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, ɔlman na di kamp da tɛm de, so ala wit gladi dat di grɔn usay dɛn bin de insɛf shek.
We di Filistin dɛn yɛri di nɔys, dɛn aks wetindu di nɔys bɔku so na di Ibru dɛn kamp. Dɛn bin gɛt fɔ no se di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn go briŋ di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant kam na dɛn kamp.
Dat mek dɛn fred ɛn se, “Na gɔd dɔn kam na dɛn kamp so, wi dɔn dɔn. Na trɔbul dɔn mit wi so. Dis kayn tin nɔ wande bi.”
Dɛn se, “Wi dɔn alaki. Udat go pul wi kɔmɔt na dɛn gɔd ya dɛn an? Na di sem gɔd dɛn bin ib ɔlkayn waala pan di Ijipshian dɛn na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.”
Dɛn kɔrej dɛnsɛf lɛ dɛn nɔ giv ɔp bɔt fɛt lɛk man dɛn ɔ nɔ so dɛn go tɔn slev to di Ibru dɛn lɛk aw di Ibru dɛn bin dɔn bi dɛn slev.
So di Filistin dɛn fɛt gud te dɛn bit di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn we nɔ day rɔnawe go na dɛn difrɛn os dɛn. Dɛn kil bɔku. Na bin tati tawzin dɛn kil.
Dɛn siz di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant ɛn kil Ofni ɛn Finɛas.
Da sem de de, wan man we kɔmɔt na Bɛnjamin fambul rɔn frɔm di wɔfrɔnt go Shaylɔ. Na so in klos ɔl chɛr chɛr ɛn i put dɔti nain ed fɔ sho se in at nɔ swit.
Wɛn i rich de, i mit Ilaɛl sidɔm nain chia kɔna di rod de wach bikɔs i bin de skyad wetin go bi wit di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant. We di man tɔk wetin bi na di siti, di wanol siti bɔskray lawd lawd wan.
Ilaɛl yɛri ɛn aks wetin bi. So di man go to Ilaɛl,
we bin ol naynti-et ia ɛn nɔ bin de si bɛtɛ igen
Di man tɛl Ilaɛl se i jɛs kɔmɔt na wɔfrɔnt ɛn dat na da sem de de i rɔnawe. Ilaɛl kɔl am in pikin ɛn aks am wetin bi.

Di man ansa se di Filistin dɛn win Izrɛl we mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn rɔnawe bikɔs bɔku pan dɛn day. I tɛl am igen se in tu bɔypikin we na Ofni ɛn Finɛas sɛf day dɔn di Filistin dɛn siz di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant.
As i tɔk bɔt di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, Ilaɛl jɛs fɔdɔm oba in chia kɔna di get usay i bin sidɔm. I brok in nɛk ɛn day bikɔs i bin dɔn ol ɛn i gɛt bɔdi. I bi jɔj na Izrɛl fɔ fɔti ia.

Ilaɛl in dɔtɛnlɔ, we na Finɛas in wɛf bin gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn bin dɔn du fɔ bɔn. We i yɛri se dɛn dɔn siz di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, ɛn in fadɛnlɔ ɛn in man ɔl dɔn day, pen ol am wantɛm ɛn i bɔn, bɔt i nɔ bin ebul bia di pen.
We i de day, di uman dɛn we bin de grani am kɔrej am ɛn tɛl am se i dɔn bɔn bɔbɔ bɔt i nɔ pe atɛnshɔn to dɛnsɛf.
I gi di pikin nem Ikabɔd bikɔs i se Izrɛl nɔ gɛt rɛspɛkt igen PAPA GƆD dɔn lɛf Izrɛl to insɛf we mek dɛn siz di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, in fadɛnlɔ day ɛn in man sɛf day.
I se we yu si dɛn siz di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant na PAPA GƆD dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn Izrɛl so.
Afta di Filistin dɛn dɔn siz di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, dɛn pul am kɔmɔt na Ibɛniza kɛr am go na Ashdɔd.
Dɛn tek am go put na di os usay dɛn yon gɔd Degɔn de. Dɛn put di ak fɔ tinap nia Degɔn.
We dɛn grap na mɔnin di nɛks de, dɛn mit Degɔn dɔn fɔdɔm wit in fes na grɔn bifo di ak. Dɛn pik Degɔn ɛn put am bak na di ples we i fɔ de.
Bɔt di nɛks de bak we dɛn grap na mɔnin, dɛn mit Degɔn dɔn fɔdɔm bak wit in fes na grɔn bifo di ak. In ed ɛn an ɔl bin dɔn kɔt kɔmɔt ɛn we dɛn go na Degɔn in os domɔt nain bɔdi nɔmɔ bin lɛf.
Na dat mek, ɔp to di tɛm we dɛn rayt di stori, di man dɛn we bin de mek sakrifays to Degɔn, nɔ de tinap nain os in domɔt.
PAPA GƆD mek bɔku waala de pan di pipul dɛn we bin tap na Ashdɔd ɛn di ɔda siti dɛn nia de. Dɛn bigin gɛt bɔmp bɔmp na dɛn bɔdi.
Wɛn di pipul dɛn si wetin de bi, dɛn gri se di ak nɔ fɔ de de as na dat mek Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD de pɔnish dɛn ɛn dɛn gɔd we na Degɔn.
So dɛn kɔl ɔl dɛn bigman dɛn go mitin fɔ disayd wetin fɔ du wit di ak. Dɛn ɔl se na fɔ kɛr am go na Gath. Na so dɛn tek muf di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant.
Bɔt afta dɛn dɔn muf di ak go na Gath, PAPA GƆD kam ple wɔwɔ na da siti de ɛn kɔnfyushɔn fɔdɔm na di wanol ples. Ɔlman, yɔŋ ɛn ol, bigin gɛt di sem kayn bɔmp na dɛn bɔdi.
So dɛnsɛf sɛn di ak go na Ɛkrɔn. We dɛn rich na Ɛkrɔn wit di ak, di pipul dɛn na Ɛkrɔn se dɛn kɛr di ak go de fɔ go kil dɛn ɔl.

So dɛn kɔl ɔl di Filistin bigman dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn fɔ sɛn di ak usay i kɔmɔt we na to di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɔ nɔ so ɔl di pipul dɛn go day. Dɛn se di wanol siti de fred se dɛn go day, bikɔs PAPA GƆD de pɔnish dɛn bad wan.
Di wan dɛn we nɔ day, gɛt bɔmp na dɛn bɔdi ɛn dɛn ɔl bigin kɔl dɛn yon gɔd fɔ ɛp dɛn.
We di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant dɔn tek sɛvin mɔnt na di Filistin dɛn an,
di Filistin dɛn kɔl dɛn man dɛn we bin de mek sakrifays ɛn dɛn lukgrɔn man dɛn ɛn aks dɛn wetin dɛn fɔ du wit di ak ɛn aw dɛn fɔ sɛn am bak go usay i blant.

Dɛn ansa se we dɛn de sɛn di ak bak we na Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD gɛt am, dɛn nɔ fɔ sɛn am go ɛmti wan. Dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se, we dɛn de sɛn am, dɛn sɛn am wit sɔntin fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri fɔ wetin dɛn du. Dɛn se dat go mek PAPA GƆD mek dɛn wɛl bak, ɛn dɛn go ebul fɔ no wetin bin mek dɛn de gɛt bɔku waala so.

Di Filistin dɛn aks di man dɛn uskayn tin dɛn fɔ sɛn fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri fɔ wetin dɛn du. Dɛn ansa se na fɔ mek fayv sɔntin wit gold we de sho bɔmp na di bɔdi ɛn mek fayv arata sɛf wit gold lɛkɛ aw na fayv Kiŋ dɛn gɛt na Filistia. Afta ɔl di sem tin we de mit di pipul dɛn, nain de mit di Kiŋ dɛn.

Dɛn se na fɔ mek dɛn tin de we de sho di bɔmp na dɛn bɔdi ɛn di arata dɛn we dɔn de kil di pipul dɛn ɛn pwɛl di kɔntri. Dɛn se dat go sho Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD se dɛn biliv se in pawaful ɛn sɔntɛm dat go mek i lɛf fɔ pɔnish dɛn, dɛn land ɛn dɛn gɔd dɛn.
Di man dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ biev lɛk aw di Ijipshian dɛn ɛn dɛn Kiŋ biev we na pas we PAPA GƆD mek waala mit dɛn nain dɛn lɛf di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ kɔmɔt na Ijipt.
Di man dɛn se fɔ rɛdi nyu ɔmɔlanke wit tu kombra kaw we dɛn nɔ wande yuz fɔ drɛg lod. Dɛn fɔ put dɛn kombra kaw ya fɔ drɛg di ɔmɔlanke ɛn mek shɔ se dɛn kip di kaw pikin dɛn na fayn ples.

Dɛn tɛl di Filistin dɛn fɔ put di ak pantap di ɔmɔlanke dɔn nia am, dɛn fɔ put di bɔks we gɛt di gold tin dɛn we dɛn de sɛn fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri fɔ wetin dɛn du. Di man dɛn se dɛn fɔ jɛs lɛf am lɛ di kaw dɛn drɛg am go ɛnisay,

bɔt dɛn fɔ de wach dɛn. If dɛn go na di siti usay di ak blant, dat na Bɛth Shɛmɛsh, dat sho se na PAPA GƆD de lɛ dɛn gɛt ɔl dɛn waala ya. Bɔt if i nɔ go de dat min se wetin de bi to dɛn jɛs de bi nɔmɔ.
Di Filistin dɛnsɛf du wetin di man dɛn se. Dɛn fɛn di kombra kaw ɛn tay dɛn to di ɔmɔlanke. Dɛn mek shɔ se dɛn kip di kaw pikin dɛn sef wan.
Dɛn put di ak pantap di ɔmɔlanke wit di bɔks we gɛt di gold arata dɛn ɛn di tin we dɛn mek fɔ sho di bɔmp na dɛn bɔdi.
Di kaw dɛn waka tret na di rod fɔ go na Bɛth Shɛmɛsh; dɛn bin de kray fɔ dɛn pikin dɛn ɛn nɔ bɛn nɔn say. Di kiŋ dɛn fala dɛn te rich di bɔda fɔ go na Bɛth Shɛmɛsh.
Da tɛm de di pipul dɛn na Bɛth Shɛmɛsh bin de pik di wit we dɛn plant na di vali. Wande naw we dɛn es dɛn ed ɔp, dɛn si di ak. Dɛn gladi bad we dɛn si am.
We di ɔmɔlanke rich na wan man we nem Jɔshwa na Bɛth Shɛmɛsh in fam, i tap de, nia wan big ston. Di pipul dɛnsɛf plit di ɔmɔlanke mek wud ɛn bɔn di kaw dɛn as sakrifays to PAPA GƆD.
Di Livayt dɛn pul PAPA GƆD in ak na di ɔmɔlanke wit di bɔks we gɛt di gold tin dɛn, put pantap di big ston. Na da sem de de, di pipul dɛn na Bɛth Shɛmɛsh mek difrɛn kayn sakrifays dɛn to PAPA GƆD.
Di fayv Filistin kiŋ si ɔl wetin apin bifo dɛn tɔn bak go Ɛkrɔn, da sem de de.
Di tin dɛn we dɛn mek wit gold we gɛt bɔmp na dɛn bɔdi we dɛn sɛn fɔ PAPA GƆD de sho se na fayv kiŋ de. Wan na Ashdɔd, wan na Gaza, wan na Ashkɛlɔn, wan na Gath ɛn wan na Ɛkrɔn.

Di gold arata we dɛn mek na bay di sem nɔmba we de na di Filistin siti we di kiŋ dɛn gɛt, ayda na siti wit sikyɔriti wɔl ɔ na vilej. Di big ston we dɛn bin put di ak pantap stil de na Jɔshwa na Bɛth Shɛmɛsh in fam fɔ mak wetin bin bi.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD mek sɛvinti man na Bɛth Shɛmɛsh day, bikɔs dɛn wach insay PAPA GƆD in ak. Di pipul dɛn sɔri bad we PAPA GƆD trit dɛn so.
Di pipul dɛn na Bɛth Shɛmɛsh bigin aks dɛnsɛf udat go ebul fɔ de usay dis oli PAPA GƆD de. Dɛn bigin wɔnda usay di ak fɔ go mek dɛn nɔ gɛt mɔ prɔblɛm.
So dɛn sɛn mɛsej na Kiriath Jiarim se mek di pipul dɛn de kam fɔ di ak as di Filistin dɛn dɔn sɛn am bak.
So di man dɛn na Kiriath Jiarim go na Bɛth Shɛmɛsh ɛn go tek PAPA GƆD in ak. Dɛn kɛr am go na Abinadab in os pantap di il ɛn mek Ɛlieza we nain bɔypikin oli so dat i go de gyad PAPA GƆD in ak.
Di ak bin dɔn te na Kiriath Jiarim. I bin dɔn tek twɛnti ia naw so ɔl di Izrɛlayt bin dɔn de tɔn to PAPA GƆD bak.

So Samiɛl tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se if dɛn wan tɔn bak to PAPA GƆD wit ɔl dɛn at, dɛn fɔ trowe ɔl dɛn ɔda pipul dɛn gɔd dɛn we dɛn de wɔship ɛn di Ashtarɔt dɛn ɛn gi dɛnsɛf wit wan at to PAPA GƆD ɛn wɔship in nɔmɔ, dɔn i go pul dɛn kɔmɔt na di Filistin dɛn an.
So di Izrɛlayt dɛnsɛf trowe di Beal ɛn di Ashtarɔt dɛn we dɛn bin de wɔship ɛn gi dɛnsɛf fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ.
Dɛn Samiɛl tɛl dɛn ɔl se lɛ dɛn gɛda na Mizpa ɛn in go go pre fɔ dɛn de.

We dɛn ɔl dɔn gɛda na Mizpa, dɛn gɛt wata, trowe am na grɔn as sakrifays to PAPA GƆD. Dɛn fast fɔ da de de ɛn we dɛn de na Mizpa nain dɛn kɔnfɛs se dɛn dɔn sin to PAPA GƆD, ɛn na de dɛn mek Samiɛl lɛk chif na Izrɛl.
Wɛn di Filistin dɛn yɛri se ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn gɛda na Mizpa, dɛn kiŋ dɛn go ɔp de fɔ atak dɛn. We di Izrɛlayt dɛn yɛri, dɛn fred bikɔs dɛn bin de fred di Filistin dɛn.
Dɛn tɛl Samiɛl lɛ i nɔ tap fɔ pre to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD fɔ dɛn so dat i go pul dɛn na di Filistin dɛn an.
Dɛn Samiɛl tek wan yɔŋ ship we de sɔk bɔbi ɛn bɔn di wanol wan as bɔn sakrifays to PAPA GƆD. I kray to PAPA GƆD fɔseka Izrɛl ɛn PAPA GƆD ansa in prea.

Di tɛm we Samiɛl bin de bɔn di sakrifays, nain di Filistin dɛn bɔs fɔ ib fɛt pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn. Bɔt da de de PAPA GƆD ib kɔnfyushɔn pan di Filistin dɛn. I tɔk lawd na ɛvin wit in vɔys lɛk tɛnda we mek dɛn fred ɛn rɔnawe lɛf di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛnsɛf rɔnata dɛn kɔmɔt na Mizpa te rich dɔŋ na Bɛthka. Na so dɛn bin de kil dɛn as dɛn de rɔn.
Dɛn Samiɛl tek wan big ston we i put na Mizpa ɛn Shɛn. I kɔl am Ibɛniza ɛn se PAPA GƆD dɔn de ɛp dɛn te da tɛm de.
Na so di Filistin dɛn tek kɔmɔt biɛn Izrɛl. Dɛn shem ɛn nɔ atak Izrɛl igen Ɔl di tɛm we Samiɛl bin de, PAPA GƆD bin de fɛt di Filistin dɛn.

Di Filistin dɛn gi Ɛkrɔn ɛn Gath, di tu siti we dɛn bin dɔn siz to Izrɛl bak dɔn Izrɛl in pul di siti dɛn we de rawnd Ɛkrɔn ɛn Gath na di Filistin dɛn an. Bɔt Izrɛl ɛn di Amɔrayt dɛn nɔ bin gɛt plaba. Pis bin de bitwin dɛn.
Samiɛl kɔntinyu as chif na Izrɛl te i day.
Ɛvri ia, i bin de patrol frɔm Bɛthɛl go Gilgal ɛn go Mizpa fɔ go tɔk kes dɛn de.
I kin go te bɔt i mɔs kam bak na Rama usay i bɔn ɛn i bin rul Izrɛl de bak. Na de i bil ɔlta fɔ PAPA GƆD.
As Samiɛl bin dɔn ol, i pik in bɔypikin dɛn fɔ de lɛkɛ chif na Izrɛl.
Di fɔs pikin nem Joɛl dɔn di sɛkɛn wan nem Abija ɛn dɛn bin de na Biashiba frɔm usay dɛn de wok.
Bɔt dɛn nɔ bin tan lɛkɛ am atɔl. Dɛn bin de du wetin dɛn fil fɔ du. Dɛn bin de du ɔlkayn ɔnda-an tin fɔ mek mɔni, tek brayb ɛn de pan soso kukujumuku.
So ɔl di big wan dɛn na Izrɛl, gɛda go mit Samiɛl na Rama.
Dɛn tɛl am se, we in dɔn ol so ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn nɔ tan lɛk am, lɛ i pik pɔsin we go bi dɛn kiŋ fɔ rul dɛn lɛkɛ aw i bin de bi na di ɔda kɔntri dɛn.
Bɔt we dɛn tɛl Samiɛl se lɛ i pik pɔsin fɔ bi kiŋ fɔ dɛn, Samiɛl nɔ gladi so i pre to PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, “Lisin to ɔl wetin di pipul dɛn de se bikɔs nɔto yu dɛn de ib oba, na mi we na dɛn Kiŋ, dɛn de ib oba.
Dɛn bin dɔn de du so frɔm di de we a pul dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt te naw. Aw dɛn lɛf mi go wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn, na so dɛn wan du yu.
Lisin dɛn gud bɔt wɔn dɛn bɔt wetin i min fɔ gɛt Kiŋ fɔ rul dɛn.”
Samiɛl insɛf tɛl di pipul we go aks am fɔ pik kiŋ wetin PAPA GƆD se.
I tɛl dɛn ɔl wetin di kiŋ go du. Aw i go mek dɛn bɔypikin dɛn sojaman dɛn we go de gayd in ɔs ɛn karej fɔ go batul;

aw i go mek sɔm bi kɔmanda dɛn na ami fɔ de kɔmand tawzin, tawzin sojaman ɔ fifti, fifti sojaman, sɔm i go tɔn dɛn to fama fɔ de rɛdi in grɔn fɔ plant ɛn fɔ de pik di it we rɛp; sɔm i go aks dɛn fɔ mek wɛpɔn ɛn fɔ rɛdi in ɔs ɛn karej fɔ go batul;
aw i go tek dɛn gyal pikin dɛn, gi dɛn pafyum fɔ mek, ɛn sɔm go de kuk ɔ bek fɔ am;
aw i go tek di bɛst fam dɛn na dɛn an ɛn gi di wan dɛn we de wok fɔ am;
aw i go tek wan pat pan tɛn pat pan wetin dɛn plant ɛn gi am to di wan dɛn we de wok fɔ am ɛn di wan dɛn we de ɛp am;
aw i go tek di yɔŋ bɔy ɛn yɔŋgyal dɛn we de wok fɔ dɛn ɛn di ɔda yɔŋ man dɛn wit dɛn dɔŋki dɛn fɔ bi in yon;
aw i go tek wan pat pan ɛni tɛn pat pan dɛn ship ɛn got fɔ bi in yon dɔn i go mek dɛn bi in slev dɛn.
I tɛl dɛn se wɛn ɔl dis go bi, dɛn go kray fɔ mek PAPA GƆD pul dɛn na di kiŋ we dɛn go dɔn pik in an, bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ go ansa dɛn.
Pan ɔl dat, di pipul dɛn nɔ gri fɔ yɛri Samiɛl in wɔd. Dɛn se “Nɔba! Wi want kiŋ.
Wisɛf wan tan lɛk ɔda kɔntri we gɛt kiŋ fɔ rul dɛn so nain go lid wi fɔ go fɛt.”
Afta we Samiɛl dɔn yɛri ɔl wetin dɛn se, i tɛl PAPA GƆD ɔltin.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ gi dɛn di kiŋ. So Samiɛl tɛl dɛn mek ɔlman go bak nain siti.
Wan man bin de we kɔmɔt na Bɛnjamin fambul ɛn gɛt mɔni ɛn pawa. I nem Kish ɛn na bin Abiɛl we na Zɛrɔ in bɔypikin ɛn Bɛkorat in grampikin ɛn Apfia we kɔmɔt na Bɛnjamin fambul in gret grampikin.
In yon bɔypikin bin nem Sɔl ɛn na bin wan fayn yɔŋ man we in tu nɔ de na Izrɛl. Na so i bin laŋa pas ɔlman we i tinap.
Wan tɛm, Sɔl in Papa we nem Kish, in dɔŋki dɛn lɔs ɛn i tɛl Sɔl fɔ tek wan pan in bɔy dɛn mek dɛn go fɛn dɛn.
So Sɔl pas insay Ifrem we gɛt il dɛn ɛn insay Shalisha bɔt dɛn nɔ si dɛn. Dɛn go na di Shalim eria bɔt di dɔŋki dɛn nɔ de de. Dɛn luk insay Bɛnjamin land bak bɔt dɛn stil nɔ si dɛn.
Wɛn dɛn luk te dɛn rich Zuf, Sɔl tɛl in Papa in bɔy se lɛ dɛn go bak bikɔs jisnɔ in papa go lɛf fɔ tink bɔt in dɔŋki dɛn, i go bigin wɔri bɔt dɛn tu.
Di bɔy tɛl am se wan man de na da siti de we de tɔk fɔ PAPA GƆD. I se ɔlman rɛspɛkt am ɛn ɛnitin we i se go bi, mɔs bi, so lɛ dɛn go to am sɔntɛm i go tɛl dɛn usay dɛn fɔ go luk.
Sɔl tɛl di bɔy se dɛn nɔ gɛt natin fɔ go gi di man as ɔl di it we de na dɛn bag dɔn dɔn. I aks di bɔy wetin in gɛt.
Di bɔy ansa am se i gɛt smɔl mɔni we dɛn go gi di man mek i go tɛl dɛn usay fɔ go luk fɔ di dɔŋki dɛn.
Fɔstɛm na Izrɛl, we pɔsin wan no wetin PAPA GƆD se dɛn kin go to di Sia we dɛn de kɔl prɔfɛt naw.
Sɔl gri ɛn mek dɛn go to di Sia. So dɛn lɛf fɔ go na di siti we di man we de tɔk fɔ PAPA GƆD de.
As dɛn de klem di il fɔ go na di siti, dɛn mit sɔm yɔŋgyal dɛn we kɔmɔt gɛt wata ɛn dɛn aks di gyal dɛn fɔ am.
Dɛn ansa se i de bɔt dɛn tɛl dɛn fɔ ɔri as di Sia jɛs kam de bikɔs di pipul dɛn na di siti gɛt fɔ mek sakrifays da de de na di ples we dɛn kin go wɔship.

Di gyal dɛn tɛl dɛn se as dɛn go insay di siti, dɛn go mit am bifo i go usay di pipul dɛn de mek di sakrifays fɔ go it. Di gyal dɛn se di pipul dɛn nɔ go bigin it if i nɔ go de bikɔs i gɛt fɔ blɛs di sakrifays bifo di wan dɛn we dɛn invayt go bigin it. Di gyal dɛn se if dɛn go de da tɛm de, dɛn go mit am.
Sɔl ɛn in papa in bɔy waka fɔ go ɔp na di siti. As dɛn de go insay di siti so, dɛn mit Samiɛl de waka go to dɛn bɔt i bin de go usay di sakrifays fɔ de.
I kam bi se, di de bifo Sɔl go to Samiɛl, PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl Samiɛl se

in go sɛn wan man we kɔmɔt na Bɛnjamin fambul go to am, di sem tɛm we i de tɔk to am so. PAPA GƆD se, fɔ anɔynt am fɔ bi di pɔsin we in pik fɔ lid Izrɛl ɛn nain go pul dɛn na di Filistin dɛn an. I se in dɔn sɔri fɔ in pipul dɛn naw.
As Samiɛl si Sɔl so, PAPA GƆD se, “Na di man dis we a de tɔk bɔt; nain go rul mi pipul dɛn.”
Sɔl brakɛt Samiɛl na di get ɛn aks am fɔ tɛl am usay di Sia in os de.

Samiɛl ansa am se nain na di Sia. Dɔn i tɛl am se i fɔ waka go bifo am ɛn go ɔp usay dɛn de mek di sakrifays bikɔs dɛn ɔltu gɛt fɔ it wit am, dɔn na mɔnin i go lɛf am fɔ go ɛn i go tɛl am wetin i wan no.
I tɛl am se mek i nɔ wɔri bɔt in papa in dɔŋki dɛn bikɔs i dɔn si dɛn. I mek i no se ɔl wetin Izrɛl want de nain ɛn in papa in fambul dɛn an.
Sɔl se, “Noto di fambul we smɔl pas ɔl na Izrɛl a kɔmɔt? Wetin du yu se so?”
Dɛn Samiɛl kɛr Sɔl ɛn in bɔy go insay di ɔl we dɛn de it di sakrifays. I put dɛn fɔ sidɔm usay di bigman kin sidɔm na di tebul usay di pipul dɛn we i invayt de. Na bin dɛn tati ɔ so de de.
Samiɛl tɛl di kuk se mek i briŋ di bif we i bin tɛl am fɔ kip wan say fɔ am.
So di kuk kɛr di lɛg pat go ɛn ɔl wetin bin de de go put bifo Sɔl. Samiɛl tɛl Sɔl se lɛ i it bikɔs na fɔ in dɛn bin kip am fɔ da tɛm de we i se i de invayt pipul. So Sɔl it wit Samiɛl da de de.
Afta dɛn kɔmɔt it ɛn kam dɔŋ na di siti, Samiɛl ɛn Sɔl go ɔp di ruf na Samiɛl in os usay dɛn go kip kɔmpin,
te dɛn slip de. We do klin, dɛn grap. Samiɛl kɔl Sɔl ɛn tɛl am fɔ rɛdi bikɔs i de lɛf am fɔ go. Wɛn Sɔl rɛdi in ɛn Samiɛl go na do togɛda.
As dɛn de rich usay os dɛn nɔ de na di siti, Samiɛl tɛl Sɔl mek i tɛl in bɔy fɔ waka go bifo am. Di bɔy du so. Samiɛl tɛl Sɔl se lɛ i wet smɔl bit, in gɛt mɛsej frɔm PAPA GƆD fɔ am.
Dɛn Samiɛl tek wan smɔl jɔg we i bin dɔn put ɔyl pan ɛn tɔn sɔm pan di ɔyl na Sɔl in ed dɔn i kis am ɛn tɛl am se PAPA GƆD dɔn pik am fɔ bi lida fɔ in pipul dɛn.

Samiɛl tɛl Sɔl se we i de lɛf am go so, i go mit tu man nia usay dɛn bin bɛr Rechɛl na Zɛlza we de na di bɔda na Bɛnjamin. Dɛn man ya go tɛl am se dɛn dɔn fɛn di dɔŋki dɛn we i bin go luk fɔ. So in papa nɔ de tink bɔt di dɔŋki dɛn igen, nain i de wɔri bɔt ɛn de aks ɔlman wetin i fɔ du fɔ mek i ebul fɛn in bɔypikin.

Samiɛl se i go pas dɛn go te i rich wan big tik na Tabor. I se tri man we de go ɔp na Bɛthɛl fɔ go wɔship PAPA GƆD go mit am to di tik. I se wan pan dɛn go tot tri yɔŋ got, wan go ol tri lof bred dɛn wan go ol wan jɔg wayn.
I tɛl am se dɛn go tɛl am adu ɛn gi am tu pan di lof bred dɛn we i fɔ tek na dɛn an.

I se we i lɛf dɛn, i fɔ go na Gibia na PAPA GƆD in il usay di Filistin bes de. I se as Sɔl de rich na di siti, i go mit wan grup we na soso prɔfɛt dɛn, de pas, dɛn go de dans kam dɔŋ usay dɛn kɔmɔt mek sakrifays wit tamborin, flut ɛn ɔda myuzikal instrumɛnt dɛn we go de ple as dɛn go de tɔk PAPA GƆD wɔd.
Samiɛl tɛl Sɔl se PAPA GƆD in Spirit go go pan insɛf ɛn i go jɔyn dɛn fɔ tɔk PAPA GƆD wɔd so dat go mek i chenj ɔltogɛda.
Samiɛl se we ɔl dɛn tin ya we i tɔk bɔt dɔn bi to Sɔl, Sɔl naw fɔ du ɛnitin we i fil fɔ du bikɔs PAPA GƆD de wit am.

Samiɛl tɛl Sɔl fɔ waka go bifo am na Gilgal. I se in go mɔs go mit am so dɛn go bɔn animal as bɔn sakrifays ɛn mek pis ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD, bɔt dat i go gɛt fɔ wet fɔ sɛvin de bifo in go kam ɛn tɛl Sɔl wetin fɔ du.
As Sɔl tɔn fɔ lɛf Samiɛl so, PAPA GƆD chenj in at wantɛm ɛn ɔl wetin Samiɛl se go bi, bi da de de.
Wɛn Sɔl ɛn in bɔy rich Gibia, dɛn mit wan grup prɔfɛt dɛn de pas ɛn PAPA GƆD in Spirit kam pan Sɔl ɛn i jɔyn di prɔfɛt dɛn ɛn bigin tɔk PAPA GƆD wɔd.
Wɛn ɔl udat bin no am si am de tɔk PAPA GƆD wɔd wit di prɔfɛt dɛn, dɛn bigin aks dɛnsɛf se, “Wetin dis dɔn apin to Kish in bɔypikin? Insɛf na prɔfɛt naw?”
Wan man na di siti se nɔto udat na dɛn papa impɔtant. Ɛnibɔdi kin bi prɔfɛt. Naw, na wan tɔk we ɔlman kin de tɔk se, “Sɔl insɛf na prɔfɛt?”
Afta Sɔl dɔn lɛf fɔ tɔk PAPA GƆD wɔd, i go na di ples we dɛn de mek sakrifays.
Sɔl in ɔnkul aks in ɛn in bɔy usay dɛn bin de. Sɔl ansa am se dɛn bin de luk fɔ di dɔŋki dɛn bɔt we dɛn nɔ ebul fɛn dɛn, dɛn go to Samiɛl fɔ aks am usay dɛn de.
Di ɔnkul aks dɛn wetin Samiɛl tɛl dɛn se.
Sɔl ansa se i tɛl dɛn se dɛn dɔn fɛn di dɔŋki dɛn. Bɔt i nɔ tɛl in ɔnkul wetin Samiɛl se bɔt in kiŋ wan.
Samiɛl kɔl ɔlman na Izrɛl fɔ go Mizpa fɔ mit wit PAPA GƆD.

I tɛl dɛn se na wetin PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship se i de kam tɛl dɛn so. I se, PAPA GƆD se in pul dɛn kɔmɔt na di Ijipshian dɛn na Ijipt dɛn an usay dɛn bin de pas am pan dɛn ɛn dɛn ɔda kiŋ dɛn an.

Bɔt dat naw dɛn dɔn lɛf in dɛn PAPA GƆD we pul dɛn pan ɔl dɛn trɔbul ɛn brokat de, bɔt dɛn se dɛn want kiŋ. So dɛn fɔ rɛdi fɔ go mit PAPA GƆD ɛn dɛn fɔ de bay dɛn twɛlv fambul ɛn dɛn fɔ de na dɛn grup dɛn bay famili.
Wɛn Samiɛl dɔn mek ɔl di fambul dɛn kam togɛda dɛn pik di Bɛnjamin fambul.
Dɔn i kɔl ɔlman na Bɛnjamin fambul fɔ kam bifo na dɛn smɔl grup dɛn dɔn na Matri in yon grup i pik. Faynali na Sɔl we na Kish in bɔypikin nain dɛn pik. Bɔt we dɛn luk fɔ am, dɛn nɔ si am.
So dɛn aks PAPA GƆD if i nɔ go de yet. PAPA GƆD tɛl dɛn se i de de bɔt i ayd usay sɔm lod dɛn de.
So dɛn rɔn go fɛn Sɔl usay i de ɛn pul am na do, ɛn we i tinap in ed ay pas ɔl udat de de.
Samiɛl kɔl ɔlman fɔ luk Sɔl we na di man we PAPA GƆD pik. I se nɔbɔdi nɔ tan lɛkɛ am. Dɛn di pipul dɛn ala se “Lɛ di kiŋ gɛt lɔŋ layf!”
Samiɛl ɛksplen tɛl di pipul dɛn ɔl wetin i min, dat na, wetin ɛn wetin dɛn ɛn di kiŋ fɔ du. I rayt ɔl dɔŋ na pepa ɛn lɛf am na PAPA GƆD in os. Dɛn Samiɛl lɛf ɔlman fɔ go na dɛn os.
Sɔl insɛf go nain os na Gibia bɔt tɔf tɔf man dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk to fala am go.
Sɔm ɔda wan dɛn luk dawn ɔn Sɔl. Dɛn nɔ gi am prɛzɛnt sɛf bifo dat dɛn se, “Aw dis kayn man go fɛt fɔ wi?” Bɔt Sɔl nɔ se natin.
Wan man we na Amonayt we nem Neash go na Jebɛsh Giliad fɔ fos fɔ go insay de. Di pipul dɛn na Jebɛsh Giliad tɛl am se lɛ dɛn mek pepa dɔn dɛn go gri fɔ lɛ i bi dɛn kiŋ.
I se in go gri fɔ mek pepa if dɛn gri mek i pul dɛn ɔl wan yay na dɛn raytan so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go luk Izrɛl wit bɛtɛ yay.
Di big wan dɛn na Jebɛsh aks am fɔ gi dɛn sɛvin de mek dɛn aks ɔda pipul dɛn na Izrɛl fɔ ɛp dɛn. Dɛn se if nɔbɔdi nɔ ɛp dɛn, dɔn dɛn go du wetin i se.
Wɛn di pipul dɛn we dɛn sɛn to ɔlman na Izrɛl, rich Sɔl in siti we nem Gibia, ɛn tɛl dɛn ɔltin, dɛn ɔl bɔs kray lawd wan.
Sɔl kam mit dɛn de kray we in kɔmɔt nain fam wit in man kaw dɛn. In bin de biɛn dɛn. I aks wetindu ɔlman de kray ɛn dɛn tɛl am ɔl wetin di pipul we kɔmɔt Jebɛsh tɛl dɛn.
Wɛn Sɔl yɛri wetin dɛn se, PAPA GƆD in spirit kam pan am wantɛm ɛn in fukfuk grap.

I tek tu pan in animal dɛn, kɔt kɔt dɛn ɛn sɛn di kɔt kɔt wan dɛn to ɔlman na Izrɛl, ɛn tɛl di mɛsenja dɛn fɔ tɔk se na so dɛn gɛt fɔ du ɛnibɔdi in animal if i nɔ fala Sɔl ɛn Samiɛl go fɛt. Di pipul dɛn fred PAPA GƆD ɛn tɔn ɔp lɛk wan.
Wɛn Sɔl mek dɛn ɔl gɛda na Bizɛk ɛn di man dɛn frɔm Izrɛl na bin tri ɔndrɛd tawzin, ɛn tati tawzin kɔmɔt Juda.

Dɛn tɛl di mɛsenja dɛn fɔ go tɛl di pipul dɛn na Jebɛsh Giliad se bay di tɛm we di san de tinap gud, di nɛks de, dɛn nɔ go de pan trɔbul igen. Wɛn di mɛsenja dɛn go tɛl di pipul dɛn na Jebɛsh, dɛn so gladi, dɛn nɔ no wetin fɔ du.
Dɛn tɛl di Amonayt dɛn fɔ lɛ dɛn du wetin dɛn want wit dɛn.
Di nɛks de Sɔl mek in man dɛn go na tri grup, dɔn bifo do klin, dɛn lɔnch atak na di Amonayt dɛn kamp ɛn kil, kil dɛn te san wam da de de. Di wan dɛn we nɔ day skata wan wan ɔlɔbɔt.
Di pipul dɛn bigin bato Sɔl se, dɛn go kil dɛn wan we bin se Sɔl nɔ go ebul fɔ lid dɛn.
Bɔt Sɔl in se, dɛn nɔ go kil nɔbɔdi da de de bikɔs na di de we PAPA GƆD dɔn pul Izrɛl na dɛn ɛnimi dɛn an.
So Samiɛl kɔl ɔlman fɔ go na Gilgal wit am fɔ go mek Sɔl di kiŋ gud gud wan.

Ɔl di pipul dɛn fala am go Gilgal usay dɛn ɔl go tɔk bifo PAPA GƆD se na Sɔl dɛn want fɔ kiŋ. We dɛn de de, dɛn mek pis sakrifays bifo PAPA GƆD ɛn Sɔl wit ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn mek gladi gladi fɔ sɛlibret.
Samiɛl tɔk to ɔlman na Izrɛl. I se “A dɔn lisin ɔl wetin una se ɛn a dɔn mek una gɛt kiŋ.
Naw una dɔn gɛt una kiŋ. Mi dɔn ol, mi ia ɔl dɔn wet ɛn mi bɔypikin dɛn de ya wit una. Frɔm we a smɔl nain a dɔn bi una lida.

Na mi tinap so frɔnt PAPA GƆD ɛn di wan we i dɔn mek kiŋ. Udat in kaw ɔ dɔŋki a dɔn tek? Udat a dɔn rog ɔ buli wande ɔ udat a dɔn tek brayb nain an fɔ twis di lɔ? If ɛnibɔdi de we go se a du so, a go pe am bak.”
Di pipul dɛn ansa am se, i nɔ ambɔg nɔbɔdi wande ɛn i nɔ tek natin na pɔsin in an.
Samiɛl tɔk bak se, “PAPA GƆD de yɛri wetin una de tɔk o! Ɛn di kiŋ de fɔ mi witnɛs we una se a nɔ tek natin na una an.” Dɛn ansa se yɛs, na witnɛs.
Samiɛl tɛl di pipul dɛn se na PAPA GƆD bin pik Mozis ɛn Erɔn we pul dɛn grampa dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt.
I se mek dɛn rɛdi bikɔs i de kam tɛl dɛn ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD du fɔ dɛn ɛn dɛn fɔstɛm pipul dɛn.

I tɛl dɛn aw Jekɔb ɛn in famili bin go de na Ijipt we di Ijipshian dɛn bin de du dɛn bad, dɛn beg PAPA GƆD fɔ ɛp dɛn dɔn in sɛn Mozis ɛn Erɔn we go pul dɛn grampa dɛn na Ijipt ɛn lɛf dɛn fɔ sɛtul usay dɛn de so.
I tɛl dɛn bɔt aw dɛn fɔgɛt bɔt PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, so i lɛ Sisɛra we na di ami kɔmanda na Ezɔ, di Filistin dɛn ɛn di kiŋ na Moab we dɛn fɛt wit, gi dɛn gud bit.

Dɛn kray to PAPA GƆD ɛn tɛl am se dɛn dɔn sin we dɛn lɛf am go wɔship Beal ɛn dɛn Ashtarɔt dɛn. Dɛn beg am mek i nɔ lɛf dɛn gi dɛn ɛnimi dɛn ɛn tɛl am se if i pul dɛn ɛnimi kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn, dɛn go wɔship am.
Dat bin mek PAPA GƆD sɛn Gidiɔn, Berak, Jɛftha ɛn Samiɛl fɔ pul dɛn na dɛn ɛnimi dɛn we bin sɔrawnd dɛn, dɛn an, we mek dɛn gɛt pis.
Bɔt wɛn dɛn si Neash we na di Amonayt dɛn kiŋ kam fɔ fɛt dɛn, dɛn se dɛnsɛf want kiŋ pan ɔl we na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD na bin dɛn Kiŋ.
Samiɛl se, “Una luk di kiŋ we una want, di wan we una bin de aks fɔ. PAPA GƆD dɔn gi una di kiŋ o!
If una de fred PAPA GƆD ɛn wan sav am ɛn obe am, una fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se ɛn mɔ so, if una ɛn di kiŋ we de oba una du wetin PAPA GƆD se, i go fayn fɔ una.
Bɔt if una nɔ obe PAPA GƆD ɛn du wetin i se, na di sem we aw i trit una grampa dɛn, na so i go trit una.
Una jɛs sidɔm luk we PAPA GƆD de kam ple wɔndaz bifo una fes.
Na dray sizin dis, nɔto so? Naw a de kam aks PAPA GƆD lɛ i mek tɛnda rol ɛn big big ren fɔdɔm. Da tɛm de una go si se na bad bad tin una du to PAPA GƆD we una se una want kiŋ.”
So Samiɛl pre to PAPA GƆD ɛn da sem de de, tɛnda rol, dɔn big big ren fɔdɔm. Na so ɔl di pipul lɛf mɔt de wɔnda pan PAPA GƆD ɛn pan Samiɛl.
Di pipul dɛn tɛl Samiɛl fɔ pre to PAPA GƆD we nain PAPA GƆD fɔ dɛn mek dɛn nɔ day as dɛn dɔn ad pan dɛn ɔda sin dɛn we dɛn aks fɔ kiŋ.
Samiɛl se lɛ dɛn nɔ fred. I se, “Pan ɔl di bad we una dɔn du, una nɔ fɔ ɛva lɛf PAPA GƆD fɔ go wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn bɔt una fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD wit ɔl una at.
Una nɔ fala dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn de. Dɛn nɔ ebul du natin.
Bikɔs ɔf in nem, PAPA GƆD nɔ go ib una oba as nain dɔn se una nain yon.
As fɔ mi, mek PAPA GƆD nɔ gri mek a lɛf fɔ pre fɔ una. A go tɛl una wetin gud ɛn rayt.
I lɛf to una fɔ rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD ɛn sav am wit ɔl una at. Tink bɔt ɔl wetin i dɔn du fɔ una.
If una fasin fɔ du am bad, PAPA GƆD go jɛs swip una ɛn una kiŋ.”
Sɔl bin ol tati ia wɛn dɛn mek am kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn i bi kiŋ fɔ foti-tu ia.

Sɔl pik tri tawzin man fɔ de nain ami na Izrɛl. Tu tawzin pan dɛn lɛf wit am na Mikmash we de na di kɔntri, Bɛthɛl we gɛt il, di balans wan tawzin go de wit Jonɛthan na Gibia insay Bɛnjamin. I sɛn di man dɛn we i nɔ pik, go bak na dɛn os dɛn.
Jonɛthan atak usay di Filistin dɛn bes de na Giba ɛn di Filistin dɛn yɛri bɔt dat. Dɛn Sɔl mek dɛn blo trɔmpɛt ɔlɔbɔt na Izrɛl fɔ kɔl atɛnshɔn mek ɔlman yɛri di nyuz.
So ɔlman yɛri se Sɔl dɔn atak di Filistin dɛn bes ɛn naw Izrɛl dɔn fɛn di Filistin dɛn plaba. Sɔl naw sɛn se mek ɔl udat kin fɛt, mit am na Gilgal.

Di Filistin dɛnsɛf gɛda fɔ fɛt Izrɛl, wit tati tawzin ɔs ɛn karej, siks tawzin man fɔ rayd di ɔs ɛn karej, tu fɔ wan, ɛn bɔku bɔku sojaman dɛn we tan lɛk sansan we yu nɔ go ebul kɔnt. Dɛn go ɔp na Mikmash we de na di ist we yu kɔmɔt Bɛthavɛn. Na de dɛn kamp.
Wɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn si se di Filistin dɛn dɔn put dɛn na tayt kɔna ɛn di ami nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du, dɛn go ayd na ol, na dɛn big ston, insay grev yad, insay dɛn grev dɛn ɛn insay dɛn wɛl we dɔn dray,
sɔm ivin rɔnawe, krɔs Riva Jɔdan go na Gad ɛn Giliad. Sɔl lɛf na Gilgal ɛn ɔl di sojaman dɛn we bin de wit am bin de fred.
I wet fɔ di sɛvin de we Samiɛl bin se bɔt Samiɛl nɔ go kwik na Gilgal ɛn Sɔl in man dɛn bin dɔn de lɛf am to insɛf.
So Sɔl se lɛ dɛn gi am di tin dɛn we fɔ bɔn as sakrifays ɛn fɔ mek pis ɔfrin dɔn i mek di sakrifays dɛn fɔ insɛf.
As i dɔn so, nain Samiɛl kam ɛn Sɔl go fɔ tɛl am adu.
Samiɛl aks am wetin i jɛs du so. Sɔl ansa se na we i si ɔl in man dɛn de lɛf am ɛn Samiɛl nɔ bin kam yet, dɔn di Filistin dɛn bin de gɛda na Mikmash,
so i tɛl insɛf se if di Filistin dɛn atak am na Gilgal, in nɔ du natin fɔ PAPA GƆD yet. I se na dat mek insɛf mek di sakrifays to PAPA GƆD wantɛm.
Samiɛl ala pan am. I se, “Na bigful tin yu du so! Yu nɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD we na yu PAPA GƆD tɛl yu; if yu bin du wetin i se, yu ɛn ɔl yu jɛnareshɔn dɛn afta yu bin fɔ bi kiŋ.
Bɔt naw i nɔ gɛt fɔ bi so; PAPA GƆD dɔn fɛn di kayn man we go du wetin i want ɛn dɔn pik am fɔ bi kiŋ bikɔs yu nɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se.”
Dɛn Samiɛl lɛf Gilgal ɛn go ɔp na Gibia insay Bɛnjamin ɛn Sɔl kɔnt ɔmɔs pan in man dɛn bin de wit am. Na bin siks ɔndrɛd.
Sɔl, in bɔypikin Jonɛthan ɛn in man dɛn go kamp na Gibia insay Bɛnjamin, di sem tɛm we di Filistin dɛn lɛf na Mikmash.
Badman dɛn kɔmɔt na di Filistin dɛn kamp na tri grup. Wan go na Ofra we de na Shual,
di ɔda wan go bay Bɛth Orɔn, dɔn di tɔd grup go to di bɔda oba di Zɛboim Vali ɔpozit di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Wan blaksmith, nɔ bin de na Izrɛl as di Filistin dɛn se, mek di Ibru dɛn nɔ go ebul fɔ mek sɔd ɛn spia dɛn.
So na to di Filistin dɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin de go fɔ go mek di tin dɛn we dɛn bin de yus na fam, dɛn aks dɛn ɛn ivin fɔ shap dɛn nɛf dɛn.
Dɛn bin de pe tu tɛm mɔ fɔ shap nɛf pas wetin dɛn bin de pe fɔ mek di tin dɛn we dɛn bin de yuz na fam.
So di de we dɛn fɛt di Izrɛlayt dɛn, na Sɔl ɛn Jonɛthan nɔmɔ bin ol sɔd ɔ spia.
Naw di Filistin dɛn lɛf sɔm dɛn man dɛn na Mikmash fɔ gyad di rod fɔ go na dɛn bes.
Wande Jonɛthan we na Sɔl in bɔypikin tɛl in bɔbɔ we kin tot in tin dɛn fɔ fɛt se, mek dɛn go oba to di Filistin dɛn bes. Bɔt i nɔ tɛl in papa natin.
Da tɛm de Sɔl in bin tap ɔnda wan pomigranet tik na Migrɔn we nɔ de tu fa frɔm Gibia. Siks ɔndrɛd man bin de wit am,

ɛn pan dɛn Aija bin de we wɛr Ifɔd. Na bin Ikabɔd in brɔda we na Aitɔb dat na Finɛas in bɔypikin, nain bɔn am. Finɛas, in na bin Ilaɛl, di man we bin de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin to PAPA GƆD na Shaylɔ in yon bɔypikin. Nɔbɔdi nɔ bin no se Jonɛthan dɔn kɔmɔt de.
Na di ples we Jonɛthan want fɔ pas fɔ go na di Filistin dɛn bes, tu ay ay rɔk bin de de. Dɛn kɔl wan Bozɛz ɛn di ɔda wan Sɛnɛ.
Wan pan dɛn bin de bay di nɔth nia Mikmash ɛn di ɔda wan bay di sawt nia Giba.
Jonɛthan tɛl in bɔbɔ we kin tot in tin dɛn fɔ fɛt se lɛ dɛn go na dɛn ithɛn dɛn bes sɔntɛm PAPA GƆD go ɛp dɛn as PAPA GƆD de yuz bɔku pipul ɔ smɔl pipul if i wan fɔ ɛp pipul.
Di bɔbɔ se lɛ i du wetin i fil fɔ du. I tɛl Jonɛthan se in de wit am wit ɔl in at.
Jonɛthan tɛl am se lɛ dɛn krɔs go oba to di man dɛn lɛ dɛn si dɛn.
I tɛl di bɔbɔ se if di man dɛn se lɛ dɛn wet ɛn si if dɛn nɔ go kam mit dɛn, dɛn fɔ tinap usay dɛn de ɛn nɔ go mit dɛn.
Bɔt if dɛn tɛl dɛn fɔ go mit dɛn, dɛn fɔ go bikɔs dat go sho se PAPA GƆD de ɛp dɛn fɔ bit di Filistin dɛn.
So Jonɛthan ɛn in bɔbɔ go na di Filistin dɛn bes ɛn mek di Filistin dɛn si dɛn. As di Filistin dɛn si dɛn, dɛn ala, “Luk di Ibru dɛn de kɔmɔt na di ol we dɛn bin de ayd.”.
Di wan dɛn na di bes tɛl Jonɛthan ɛn in bɔbɔ se mek dɛn go dɔŋ go mit dɛn, dɛn go sho dɛn pɛpɛ. Jonɛthan tɛl in bɔbɔ fɔ fala am bikɔs PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn win.
Jonɛthan insɛf krip go mit dɛn wit in bɔbɔ biɛn am. Jonɛthan ɛn in bɔbɔ we bin de fala am kil di Filistin dɛn.
Da fɔs tɛm de, Jonɛthan ɛn in bɔbɔ kil bɔt sɔm twɛnti man na wan eria we na abawt af ɔf wan eka.
Dɛn fred jɛs grip ɔl di amiman dɛn wɛda dɛn de na kamp ɔ na di fil; na dɛn bes ɔ wit dɛn bad man dɛn, ivin di grɔn bigin shek we sho se na PAPA GƆD mek dɛn de fred so.
Di man dɛn we bin de wach fɔ Sɔl na Gibia insay Bɛnjamin si we di Filistin dɛn de rɔn ɔlɔbɔt.
Dɛn Sɔl tɛl di man dɛn we de wit am fɔ kɔnt ɔlman de fɔ lɛ dɛn no udat nɔ de de. We dɛn kɔnt dɛn ɔl, dɛn si se na Jonɛthan ɛn in bɔbɔ we kin tot in tin dɛn fɔ fɛt, nɔ de de.
Sɔl tɛl Aija fɔ briŋ di Ak as da tɛm de i bin de wit dɛn, di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
As Sɔl bin de tɔk to Aija, di nɔys na di Filistin dɛn kamp bin jɛs de lawd mɔ ɛn mɔ, so Sɔl tɛl Aija mek i nɔ wes in tɛm.
Sɔl ɛn in man dɛn gɛda fɔ go fɛt. Dɛn mit di Filistin dɛn de fɛt dɛnsɛf. Di wanol ples bin kɔnfyus so.
Di Ibru dɛn we bin dɔn go to di Filistin dɛn na dɛn kamp krɔs go jɔyn di Izrɛlayt dɛn we bin de wit Sɔl ɛn Jonɛthan.
Wɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn we bin ayd na Ifrem yɛri se di Filistin dɛn de rɔnawe, dɛnsɛf jɔyn fɔ rɔnata dɛn.
So da de de PAPA GƆD pul di Izrɛlayt dɛn na di Filistin dɛn an, dɔn nɔto Bɛthavɛn nɔmɔ wɔfrɔnt bin de igen
Di man dɛn na Izrɛl nɔ bin gladi da de de bikɔs Sɔl mek dɛn swɛ se te i dɔn dil wit in ɛnimi dɛn bifo dɛn it ɔ nɔ so dɛn go alaki. So nɔn sojaman nɔ tes it.
Di wanol ami bin go na bush usay dɛn si ɔni na grɔn.
Wɛn dɛn go insay di bush, dɛn si ɔni ɔlsay bɔt dɛn nɔn nɔ kres fɔ it am bikɔs dɛn bin de fred di swɛ we dɛn dɔn swɛ.
Jonɛthan nɔ bin de so i nɔ yɛri bɔt di swɛ we in papa mek in pipul dɛn swɛ, so in tek di tik we bin de nain an, tɔch di ɔni ɛn lik am. Wantɛm wantɛm, di taya we i bin taya jɛs go.
Dɛn wan pan di sojaman dɛn tɛl am bɔt di swɛ we in papa mek dɛn swɛ. Na dat mek ɔl di man dɛn taya so.
Jonɛthan se nain papa fɛn di trɔbul we de na di kɔntri. I se in we na lili ɔni nɔmɔ i tes, dɔn gɛt mɔ trɛnk.
I bin fɔ bɛtɛ fɔ di man dɛn if dɛn bin dɔn it sɔm pan di tin dɛn we dɛn tek na di Filistin dɛn an. I se da tɛm de dɛn bin fɔ kil mɔ Filistin dɛn.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn taya bad di de afta dɛn kil di Filisitin dɛn we bin de rɔn kɔmɔt Mikmash te rich Aijalɔn.
Dɛn jomp pan di tin dɛn we dɛn bin tek na di Filistin dɛn an, lɛkɛ di ship dɛn, kaw dɛn ɛn di kaw pikin dɛnsɛf, bucha dɛn usay dɛn de na di grɔn de ɛn it dɛn wit dɛn blɔd ɔl.
Sɔmbɔdi go tɛl Sɔl se in man dɛn de sin to PAPA GƆD as dɛn de it bif wit in blɔd pan am. Sɔl ala pan dɛn fɔ da bievɔ de ɛn tɛl dɛn fɔ briŋ wan big ston kam to am.
I se mek dɛn tɛl ɔlman fɔ tek in animal, kil am de ɛn it am. I tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ sin to PAPA GƆD ɛn it bif wit in blɔd pan am. So ɔlman kɛr in animal go de da nɛt de ɛn kil am de.
Dɛn Sɔl bil ɔlta fɔ PAPA GƆD; na di fɔs tɛm dis i bin du dat.

Sɔl se dɛn fɔ go dɔŋ go mit di Filistin dɛn, atak dɛn na nɛt ɛn fɛt dɛn te do klin so dat nɔn pan dɛn no go liv. Dɛn tɛl am se mek i du wetin i wan du. Bɔt di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin se mek dɛn aks PAPA GƆD usay dɛn de so.
So Sɔl aks PAPA GƆD if i fɔ rɔnata di Filistin dɛn ɛn if i go win dɛn. Bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ ansa am da de de.
Nain Sɔl kɔl di bigman dɛn nain ami ɛn tɛl dɛn se dɛn fɔ fɛn us sin dɛn sin da de de.
I swɛ se wans PAPA GƆD we de sev Izrɛl nɔ day, in mɔs kil di pɔsin i lɛk sɛf nain bɔypikin, Jonɛthan. Bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ se natin.
Sɔl tɛl ɔlman fɔ tinap wan say dɔn in ɛn Jonɛthan in bɔypikin go tinap ɔda say. Di man dɛn tɛl am se lɛ i du wetin i fil fɔ du.
Dɛn Sɔl pre to PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship se mek i ansa dɛn ɛn mek dɛn no udat sin. Ɛn di ansa na dat nain ɔ Jonɛthan, so di man dɛn fri.
Sɔl se lɛ dɛn luk if nain ɔ na Jonɛthan we nain bɔypikin, sin. Na Jonɛthan dɛn pik.
So Sɔl aks Jonɛthan wetin i du. Jonɛthan tɛl am se na tes nɔmɔ i tek in tik tes ɔni. I tɛl am se if i fɔ day fɔ dat, mek i day.
Sɔl se mek in sɔfa if in nɔ mek Jonɛthan day.

Bɔt ɔl di man dɛn tɛl Sɔl se dɛn nɔ go gri fɔ mek Jonɛthan, we dɔn mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmɔt na di Filistin dɛn an, day. Dɛn swɛ se wans PAPA GƆD nɔ day natin nɔ go du Jonɛthan bikɔs na PAPA GƆD ɛp am fɔ du wetin i du da de de. So di man dɛn mek Sɔl nɔ kil Jonɛthan.
Dɛn Sɔl lɛf fɔ rɔnata di Filistin dɛn ɛn ɔlman go nain yon ples.

Afta we Sɔl dɔn bi kiŋ na Izrɛl, i fɛt in ɛnimi dɛn we bin de ɔl rawnd am. Di ɛnimi dɛn na Moab, di Amonayt dɛn, di wan dɛn na Idɔm, di kiŋ dɛn na Zoba ɛn di Filistin dɛn. I bin de banja dɛn ɛnisay i tɔn.
I fɛt soba wan wit di Amalɛkayt dɛn ɛn pul di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmɔt na di wan dɛn we bin de atak dɛn, dɛn an.
Sɔl in bɔypikin dɛn na bin Jonɛthan, Ishvi ɛn Malkishua. In big gyal pikin bin nem Mɛrab ɛn di smɔl wan na bin Mikal.
In wɛf bin nem Ainoam we na bin Aimaaz in gyal pikin. Di man we na bin di kɔmanda fɔ in ami na bin Abna we na Nain bɔypikin ɛn Na na bin Sɔl in ɔnkul.
Sɔl in papa, Kish ɛn Abnain papa Na na bin Abiɛl in bɔypikin dɛn.
Ɔl di tɛm we Sɔl bin de as kiŋ in ɛn di Filistin dɛn bin gɛt siriɔs fɛt we mek as i si ɛni man we luk gɛt trɛnk ɛn ebul fɛt, i fɔ put am nain ami.
Samiɛl tɛl Sɔl se nain PAPA GƆD bin sɛn fɔ anɔynt am fɔ bi kiŋ na Izrɛl, so i fɔ lisin to di mɛsej we i gɛt frɔm PAPA GƆD.
I se na wetin PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, nain i de tɛl am. I tɛl am se PAPA GƆD se in de kam pɔnish di Amalɛkayt dɛn fɔ we dɛn bin atak di Izrɛlayt dɛn, di tɛm we dɛn bin de kɔmɔt insay Ijipt.
So naw in di Sɔl fɔ go atak di Amalɛkayt dɛn ɛn dɔnawe wit dɛn kpatakpata. I nɔ fɔ lɛf natin, man, uman, pikin, bebi, kaw, ship, kamɛl, dɔŋki, dɛn ɔl fɔ go.
So Sɔl kɔl ɔl in sojaman dɛn fɔ mit na Tɛlem. Tu ɔndrɛd tawzin na bin nɔmal sojaman dɛn, ɛn tɛn tawzin man kɔmɔt Juda.
Sɔl go na Amalɛk ɛn le ambush na di vali.

Dɛn i tɛl di Kɛnayt dɛn fɔ muf kɔmɔt to di Amalɛkayt dɛn mek i nɔ dɔnawe wit dɛn ɛn di Amalɛkayt dɛn togɛda, as dɛn bin trit di Izrɛlayt dɛn fayn we dɛn bin de kɔmɔt na Ijipt. So di Kɛnayt dɛn kɔmɔt usay di Amalɛkayt dɛn de.
Dɛn Sɔl atak di Amalɛkayt dɛn prɔpa wan frɔm Avila te Shɔ te di ist pat nia Ijipt.
I kil ɔlman bɔt lɛf Egag we na di Amalɛkayt dɛn kiŋ.

Sɔl ɛn in sojaman dɛn nɔ lɛf Egag nɔmɔ, dɛn nɔ pwɛl natin we gud lɛkɛ di bɛst ship ɛn kaw, dɛn fat fat kaw pikin ɛn dɛn fayn yɔŋ ship dɛn. Dɛn nɔ bin gladi fɔ dɔnawe wit dɛn tin ya bɔt ɛnitin we dɛn nɔ lɛk ɔ we nɔ fayn, dɛn bin dɔnawe wit dɛn kpatakpata.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD tɔk to Samiɛl. I se
“A fil am bad we a mek Sɔl kiŋ bikɔs i nɔ bisin fɔ du wetin a se igen” Dat mek Samiɛl in at pwɛl ɛn in nɔ slip ol nɛt, i de pre to PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ.
As do klin di nɛks mɔnin, i grap fɔ go mit Sɔl bɔt dɛn tɛl am se Sɔl go na Kamɛl usay i go put tablɛt fɔ lɛ dɛn tek mɛmba am ɛn i bin dɔn go dɔŋ na Gilgal da tɛm de.
Wɛn Samiɛl ɛn Sɔl mit, Sɔl pre mek PAPA GƆD blɛs Samiɛl ɛn tɛl Samiɛl se in dɔn du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ du.
Bɔt Samiɛl aks am, wetin mek a de yɛri ship ɛn kaw de kray.

Sɔl ansa se na di ship ɛn kaw dɛn we in sojaman dɛn tek na di Amalɛkayt dɛn an ɛn kip as di bɛst tin dɛn, fɔ kam sakrifays to in PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD. I tɛl Samiɛl se bɔt dɛn dɔnawe wit ɔl di ɔda tin dɛn kpatakpata.
Wantɛm, wantɛm, Samiɛl jɛs se, “Lisin, mek a tɛl yu wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl mi yɛstade nɛt.” Sɔl sɛf tɛl am lɛ i tɔk.
Samiɛl tɛl am se pan ɔl we i nɔ bin de luk insɛf wit bɛtɛ yay, i bi kiŋ na Izrɛl. I mɛmba am se na PAPA GƆD anɔynt am fɔ bi kiŋ na Izrɛl
ɛn dat na di sem PAPA GƆD sɛn am fɔ go dɔnawe wit dɛn bad bad Amalɛkayt dɛn. I tɛl am se PAPA GƆD sɛn am fɔ dɔnawe wit dɛn kpatakpata,
ɛn aks am wetindu i nɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se. I aks am wetindu i mek bigyay pan di tin dɛn ɛn du wetin PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk.
Sɔl stil pin se in du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ du. I se in go usay PAPA GƆD se fɔ go, in dɔnawe wit di Amalɛkayt dɛn kpatakpata ɛn ol dɛn kiŋ we na Egag.
I se na di sojaman dɛn kip di bɛst ship ɛn kaw dɛn fɔ mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD we na Samiɛl in PAPA GƆD na Gilgal.
Nain Samiɛl se “PAPA GƆD want yu fɔ bɔn sakrifays to am ɔ i want yu fɔ du wetin go mek i gladi? No se fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se fɔ du, bɛtɛ pas di sakrifays we yu de mek to am.
Bikɔs fɔ mek lɛk rebɛl pan PAPA GƆD jɛs tan lɛk yu de lukgrɔn ɛn fɔ mek tɔf pan am jɛs tan lɛk we man de wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn. So sins yu lɛf fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD want, insɛf nɔ want yu fɔ bi kiŋ igen”
Na da tɛm de Sɔl se in dɔn sin ɛn du wetin nɔ rayt to PAPA GƆD. I se, in bin de fred in pipul dɛn so i du wetin dɛn want.
I beg Samiɛl fɔ fɔgiv am ɛn fala am go wɔship PAPA GƆD.
Samiɛl tɛl am se i nɔ go fala am. I se sins Sɔl nɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se i fɔ du, PAPA GƆD sɛf nɔ want am fɔ bi kiŋ igen
As Samiɛl tɔn fɔ go so, Sɔl grip in klos in ɛm ɛn i chɛr.
So Samiɛl tɛl am se PAPA GƆD dɔn pul Izrɛl kɔmɔt nain an da de de ɛn i dɔn gi am to in neba we na ɔda pɔsin we bɛtɛ pas am.
Samiɛl tɛl am se PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn waŋren PAPA GƆD, nɔ de lay ɛn i nɔ de chenj in maynd as in nɔto mɔtalman we gɛt fɔ chenj in maynd.
Sɔl ansa se i no se i dɔn sin bɔt beg Samiɛl lɛ i go bak wit am fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD ɔ nɔ so i go shem pan di bigman dɛn we de na Izrɛl.
So Samiɛl fala am go ɛn Sɔl go wɔship PAPA GƆD.
Dɛn Samiɛl se fɔ pul Egag, di Amalɛkayt dɛn kiŋ na do. Egag insɛf waka go mit am. I bin de tink se day dɔn pas oba in ed.
Bɔt Samiɛl tɛl am se lɛk aw i dɔn kil bɔku pipul dɛn we mek dɛn mami nɔ gɛt pikin igen, na so insɛf yon mama nɔ go gɛt pikin igen ɛn Samiɛl kil Egag frɔnt PAPA GƆD na Gilgal.
Dɛn Samiɛl go bak na Rama ɛn Sɔl go bak nain os na Gibia.
Te Samiɛl day, i nɔ go fɛn Sɔl igen bɔt i bin sɔri fɔ am. PAPA GƆD fil am bad we i mek Sɔl bi kiŋ na Izrɛl.

PAPA GƆD tɛl Samiɛl se i nɔ go jɛs sidɔm de sɔri fɔ Sɔl sins in di PAPA GƆD nɔ want Sɔl fɔ bi kiŋ igen. PAPA GƆD se, “Grap, tek yu ɔn, put ɔyl insay ɛn go usay a tɛl yu. Yu de go to Jɛsi na Bɛtliɛm. A dɔn pik wan pan in bɔypikin dɛn fɔ bi kiŋ.
Bɔt Samiɛl aks se aw in go du so we if Sɔl yɛri i go kil am. PAPA GƆD tɛl am se lɛ i kɛr wan yɔŋ uman kaw we nɔ bɔn yet go ɛn se in de go mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD
dɔn i fɔ invayt Jɛsi to di sakrifays ɛn in go tɛl Samiɛl wetin fɔ du. PAPA GƆD se Samiɛl fɔ anɔynt di wan we i go tɛl am fɔ am.
Samiɛl insɛf du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am. Wɛn i rich na Bɛtliɛm, di bigman dɛn na di siti dɛn at kɔt ɛn aks am aw dɛn si am so.

Samiɛl ansa dɛn se lɛ dɛn nɔ wɔri. I se in kam mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD. I se lɛ dɛn mek dɛnsɛf klin bifo PAPA GƆD ɛn fala am go mek di sakrifays. Dɔn in mek Jɛsi ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn klin bifo PAPA GƆD ɛn invayt dɛn to di sakrifays.
Wɛn dɛn rich, as i si Ɛliab so i tɔk nain at se, na di wan we PAPA GƆD dɔn pik tinap bifo am so.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD tɛl Samiɛl se mek i nɔ luk in fayn ɔ in ayt bikɔs i nɔ pik am sins nɔto so PAPA GƆD in de wok. I se mɔtalman de luk wetin in de si bɔt PAPA GƆD in de luk insay pɔsin in at.
Dɛn Jɛsi kɔl Abinadab fɔ kam pas bifo Samiɛl. Bɔt Samiɛl se, “Noto dis wan insɛf PAPA GƆD pik.”
Dɛn Jɛsi mek Shama in pas, bɔt Samiɛl tɛl dɛn se PAPA GƆD nɔ pik insɛf.
Na so Jɛsi mek ɔl in sɛvin bɔypikin pas bifo Samiɛl bɔt Samiɛl tɛl am se PAPA GƆD nɔ pik ɛniwan pan dɛn wande.
I aks Jɛsi if na ɔl in bɔypikin dɔn so. Na da tɛm de Jɛsi tɛl am se na di wan we smɔl pas dɛn ɔl lɛf bɔt dat in de mɛn di ship dɛn. Samiɛl se dɛn fɔ go kɔl am bikɔs dɛn nɔ gɛt fɔ sidɔm it te i kam.
So Jɛsi sɛn fɔ di bɔbɔ. Na so i fayn fɔ luk. Nain PAPA GƆD se, “Grap, anɔynt am, nain na di wan.”
Samiɛl tek di ɔn we i bin put di ɔyl ɛn anɔynt am usay ɔl in brɔda dɛn de. Frɔm da de de, nain PAPA GƆD in spirit fɔdɔm gud gud wan pan Devid. Dɛn Samiɛl tɔn bak go na Rama.
Dis tɛm ya, PAPA GƆD in Spirit bin dɔn kɔmɔt pan Sɔl ɛn i sɛn ivul spirit fɔ de tɔmɛnt am.
Di man dɛn we bin de ɛp Sɔl, tɛl am se, as PAPA GƆD dɔn mek ivul spirit de tɔmɛnt am,
dɛn fɔ fɛn sɔmbɔdi fɔ am we kin ple di ap. Dɛn se if di pɔsin de ple ɛnitɛm we di ivul spirit kam pan am, i go wɛl.
So Sɔl tɛl dɛn fɔ go fɛn di pɔsin ɛn briŋ am kam to am.
Wan pan di man dɛn tɛl am se i sabi wan pan Jɛsi na Bɛtliɛm in bɔypikin we kin ple di ap gud gud wan. I se na pɔsin we gɛt trɛnk ɛn sabi fɛt, dɔn i sabi tɔk ɛn fayn fɔ luk. I se PAPA GƆD de wit am.
So Sɔl sɛn in mɛsenja dɛn fɔ go tɛl Jɛsi fɔ sɛn in bɔypikin, we nem Devid, we de mɛn Jɛsi in ship dɛn go to am.
Jɛsi insɛf lod wan dɔŋki wit bred, wan jɔg wayn ɛn wan yɔŋ got ɛn sɛn dɛn wit Devid go to Sɔl.
Na so Devid tek bigin wok fɔ Sɔl. Sɔl bin lɛk am bad so Devid bi wan pan in bɔbɔ dɛn we kin tot di tin dɛn we i de tek fɛt.
Dɛn Sɔl sɛn tɛl Jɛsi lɛ i lɛf Devid fɔ wok to am as i gladi wit wetin Devid de du.
Ɛnitɛm we di ivul spirit kin kam pan Sɔl, Devid go tek in ap ɛn ple. Dɔn Sɔl go fil bɛtɛ ɛn di ivul spirit go lɛf am.
Wan tɛm, di Filistin dɛn gɛda dɛn ami na Soko we de na Juda fɔ go fɛt. Dɛn kamp na Efɛz Damim we de bitwin Soko ɛn Azika.
Sɔl ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɛnsɛf bin gɛda ɛn kamp na di Ila Vali ɛn gɛt rɛdi fɔ go fɛt wit di Filistin dɛn.
Wan Vali bin de midul dɛn. Di Filistin dɛn bin de na wan il ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin de na di ɔda wan.
Wan man we kin fɛt fɔ dɛn we nem Golayath ɛn i kɔmɔt na Gath, kɔmɔt na di Filistin dɛn kamp kam tinap bifo. I bin nayn fut tɔl.
I wɛr bras ɛlmɛt nain ed dɔn di klos we i wɛr fɔ kɔba in bɔdi, tan lɛk na bras skel dɛn de pan am ɛn i bin we lɛkɛ wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti-fayv pawns;
dɛn bin mek di tin we i wɛr fɔ kɔba in fut sɛf wit bras dɔn i ɛŋ in wɛpɔn nain bak.
Di spia in andul bin tik lɛk di ayɛn we dɛn de tek fɔ mek kɔntri klos ɛn di mɔt nɔmɔ we lɛkɛ fiftin pawns. In bɔbɔ we bin ol in big shild bin de bifo am.
Golayath tinap de ɛn blɔf se in waŋren kin fɛt fɔ ɔl di Filistin dɛn so bifo di Izrɛlayt dɛnsɛf tinap so, dɛn fɔ pik wan pɔsin pan dɛn ɔl we na Sɔl in pipul dɛn we go go dɔŋ go mit am.
I se if da pɔsin de ebul fɛt am ɛn kil am dɔn ɔl di Filistin dɛn go tɔn di Izrɛlayt dɛn slev, bɔt if in ebul di pɔsin ɛn kil am, na di Izrɛlayt dɛn go tɔn di Filistin dɛn slev dɛn.
I se in de chalenj di Izrɛlayt dɛn da de de so lɛ dɛn mek in ɛn wan man nɔmɔ fɛt.
We Sɔl ɛn ɔl di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn yɛri wetin i se, dɛn ɔl at pwɛl ɛn fred grip dɛn.
Devid na bin wan pan Jɛsi we kɔmɔt na di Efrathayt fambul na Bɛtliɛm na Juda, in bɔypikin. Jɛsi bin gɛt et bɔypikin ɛn bay di tɛm we Sɔl na bin kiŋ, i na bin olpa.
Jɛsi in fɔs tri bɔypikin bin dɔn fala Sɔl fɔ go fɛt. Di fɔs wan na bi Ɛliab, di sɛkɛn wan na bin Abinadab ɛn di tɔd wan na bin Shama.
Na Devid bin smɔl pas dɛn ɔl. Di tri big wan bin de wit Sɔl,
bɔt Devid kin de go na di kamp ɛn kam bak na Bɛtliɛm fɔ de wach in papa in ship dɛn.
Fɔ foti de, na di sem blɔf di Filistin bin de blɔf na mɔnin ɛn ivintɛm.
Wande, Jɛsi sɛn Devid fɔ kɛr sɔm pach it ɛn tɛn lof bred fɔ in brɔda dɛn. I tɛl am fɔ mekes go mit dɛn na di kamp.
I gi Devid tɛn pakɛt chiz ɛn tɛl am fɔ gi di kɔmanda nain brɔda dɛn grup. Dɛn Jɛsi tɛl Devid lɛ i luk aw in brɔda dɛn de du ɛn briŋ sɔntin fɔ sho se dɛn ɔl rayt.
Jɛsi tɛl Devid se dɛn de wit Sɔl ɛn di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn na Ila Vali usay dɛn ɛn di Filistin dɛn de fɛt.

Doklin di nɛks de, Devid lɛf in ship dɛn wit wan ɔda man we de mɛn ship, pak ɔltin ɛn lɛf fɔ go na di kamp jɛs lɛkɛ aw Jɛsi dayrɛkt am. I rich na di kamp di tɛm we di ami de siŋ wa siŋ dɛn as dɛn de skata.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɛn di Filistin dɛn tinap ɔpozit bɔt ɔl man de nain yon say ɛn dɔn rɛdi fɔ fɛt.
Devid lɛf di tin dɛn we i kɛr go wit di kwatamasta ɛn rɔn go tɛl in brɔda dɛn adu na di wɔ frɔnt.
As i bin de tɔk to dɛn, Golayath di Filistin man we de fɛt fɔ di Filistin dɛn, we kɔmɔt Gath, kɔmɔt to in pipul dɛn ɛn bigin blɔf lɛk aw i kin du ɛn Devid yɛri am.
Wɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn si di man, dɛn ɔl rɔn kɔmɔt nia am wit fred.

Dɛn bin de tɔk se di man jɛs de chalenj Izrɛl so di kiŋ dɔn rɛdi fɔ mek di man we go kil am jɛntri. Dɛn se di kiŋ go mek di man mared in gyal pikin dɔn i nɔ go mek ɔlman nain papa in fambul nɔ pe taks igen na Izrɛl.
Devid aks di man dɛn we bin tinap nia am wetin go apin to di man we go kil di Filistin ɛn pul Izrɛl pan shem ɛn disgres. I se udat dis ithɛn bi we i fɔ de chalenj PAPA GƆD we nɔ de day in amiman dɛn.
Dɛn tɛl am di sem tin we dɛn bin dɔn de tɔk se na dɛn tin dɛn de go bi to di man we go kil di Filistin.

Wɛn Ɛliab we na Devid in brɔda, we big pas dɛn ɔl yɛri Devid ɛn di man dɛn de tɔk, in fukfuk grap dɛn i ala de aks Devid wetin i go du dɔŋ de ɛn udat i lɛf di ship dɛn to. I tɛl Devid se in no se Devid lɛk bigman biznɛs ɛn lɛk fɔ tink bɔt bad tin so i dɔn go dɔŋ de fɔ wach di fɛt.
Devid aks am wetin i dɔn du ɛn if i nɔ fɔ tɔk.
Devid jɛs lɛf am ɛn tɔn aks di sem kwɛshɔn to wan ɔda man, bɔt na di sem ansa dɛn gi am.
As yes bizabɔdi, sɔmbɔdi yɛri wetin Devid se ɛn i go tɛl Sɔl we sɛn kɔl am.
Devid tɛl Sɔl se lɛ nɔbɔdi nɔ mek in at pwɛl bikɔs ɔf wetin di Filistin de se. I tɛl Sɔl se in go go fɛt am.
Sɔl skyad ɛn tɛl Devid se i nɔ go ebul fɔ fɛt di Filistin as di Filistin dɔn de fɛt frɔm we in na bɔbɔ ɛn dat Devid na smɔl bɔbɔ.
Devid tɛl Sɔl bɔt aw we i bin de mɛn in papa in ship dɛn, wan layɔn ɔ wan bia kin atak dɛn ɛn tek wan pan di ship dɛn go.
I se in kin rɔnata di animal, wap am ɛn jɔg in ship kɔmɔt na di animal in mɔt. Dɛn di animal kin wan jomp pan am, dɔn in kin grip di animal in ia, wap am dɔŋ ɛn kil am.
Devid tɛl Sɔl se in dɔn kil layɔn ɛn bia so di Filistin we na ithɛn go bi lɛk dɛn bikɔs i dɔn chalenj PAPA GƆD we nɔ de day in ami.
Devid se, PAPA GƆD we mek di layɔn ɛn di bia nɔ kil am go mɔs mek di Filistin nɔ kil am. Sɔl tɛl Devid lɛ i go fɛt di fɛt. I pre mek PAPA GƆD de wit am.
So Sɔl wɛr di tin dɛn we in kin wɛr fɔ fɛt pan Devid wit in bras ɛlmɛt nain ed.
Devid fiks in sɔd ɛn tray fɔ waka rawnd di ples bikɔs i nɔ yus dɛn. I se in nɔ go ebul wɛr dɛn fɔ fɛt bikɔs i nɔ yus dɛn. So i pul dɛn.
Dɔn i tek in tik we i kin yuz we i de mɛn ship, ɛn pik fayv fayn ston na di watasay, put dɛn nain bag in pɔkit dɔn i ol in fak ɛn go bifo go mit di Filistin.
As in bin de waka go, na so di Filistin insɛf bin de waka go mit Devid. Di bɔbɔ we bin tot di Filistin in tin dɛn fɔ fɛt bin de bifo am.
We di Filistin luk gud, i si se na wan smɔl bɔbɔ we rɔju ɛn fayn fɔ luk de go mit am, dat mek i sɔktit.
I aks Devid uskayn fityay de kech am we i de tek tik fɔ go mit am lɛk se in na dɔg. I yuz di Filistin dɛn gɔd dɛn nem fɔ swɛ Devid.
I kɔl Devid fɔ go mit am ɛn tɛl am se dɛn yuba go gɛt tin fɔ it wit Devid in bɔdi.
Devid tɛl di Filistin se di Filistin de yuz sɔd ɛn spia fɔ fɛt am bɔt in di Devid gɛt PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ wit am fɔ fɛt di Filistin. I se PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nain gɛt di ami we di Filistin de chalenj.

I tɛl di Filistin se da de de PAPA GƆD go mek i ib am dɔŋ ɛn kɔt in ed. Devid tɛl am se, da de de dɛn yuba dɛn go ɛnjɔy ɔlman na di Filistin ami dɛn dedebɔdi dɔn di wanol wɔl go no se di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship, pawaful.
I tɛl am se ɔl udat de de, go no se PAPA GƆD nɔ nid sɔd ɔ spia fɔ fɛt as nain de fɛt, so PAPA GƆD go mɔs mek dɛn win di Filistin dɛn.
As di Filistin de go mit Devid so, Devid jɛs rɔn kwik go mit am na dɛn yon say.
I tek wan pan di ston dɛn kɔmɔt insay in bag ɛn fak am. Di ston nak di Filistin in fɔrɛd ɛn go insay, so di Filistin fɔdɔm wit in fes na grɔn, bup.
So na fak ɛn ston Devid tek win di Filistin, i nɔ ol sɔd bɔt i kil di Filistin.

Devid rɔn go tinap oba am. I pul di Filistin in sɔd insay di klos we kɔba am ɛn yuz am fɔ kɔt di Filistin in ed ɛn kil am. Wɛn di Filistin dɛn si wetin dɔn bi to di wan we de fɛt fɔ dɛn, se i dɔn day, dɛn bigin rɔnawe.

Di man dɛn frɔm Izrɛl ɛn Juda naw jomp bifo wit ala ɛn bigin rɔnata dɛn te rich Gath bɔda ɛn di get fɔ go insay Ɛkrɔn. Di Filistin dɛn dedebɔdi bin lidɔm lidɔm na di Shaaraim rod fɔ go na Gath ɛn Ɛkrɔn.
Afta di Izrɛlayt dɛn tɔn bak we dɛn bin dɔn rɔnata di Filistin dɛn dɔn, dɛn wutuwutu dɛn kamp.
Devid tek di Filistin in ed we i bin kɔt, ɛn kɛr am go na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn put in tin dɛn we i kin fɛt wit insay in yon tɛnt.
We Sɔl bin de wach as Devid bin de waka go mit di Filistin, i aks Abna we nain ami kɔmanda udat bɔn am. Abna bin tɛl am se insɛf nɔ no.
Nain di kiŋ tɛl Abna fɔ go aks udat in pikin di yɔŋ man bi.
So, as Devid go bak na di kamp, afta i bin dɔn kil di Filistin, Abna ol in an ɛn kɛr am go to Sɔl ɛn da tɛm de Devid bin stil ol di Filistin in ed nain an.
Dɔn Sɔl aks am udat i bi. Devid tɛl am se in na Jɛsi na Bɛtliɛm in bɔypikin.
Devid ɛn Sɔl dɔn di tɔk we dɛn bin de tɔk. Afta Devid dɔn tɔk dɔn, i mit Jonɛthan we na Sɔl in bɔypikin. Jonɛthan jɛs lɛk Devid in biznɛs ɛn in at tek am.
Frɔm da de de Sɔl mek Devid tap wit am ɛn nɔ mek i go nain papa in os.
Jonɛthan swɛ se in go lɛk Devid lɛkɛ insɛf.
So Jonɛthan pul di klos we i bin wɛr ɛn put am pan Devid wit in trɔsis ɛn ivin in sɔd, bo fɔ ɔntin ɛn in bɛlt.
Ɛnitin we Sɔl aks Devid fɔ du, i go so du am fayn dat Sɔl gi am ay pozishɔn nain ami. Ɔlman na di ami ɛn di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn bin gladi fɔ dat.

Wɛn di man dɛn bin de tɔn bak go na dɛn os afta Devid bin dɔn kil di Filistin, di uman dɛn kɔmɔt na ɔl di siti dɛn na Izrɛl wit siŋ ɛn dans fɔ go mit Kiŋ Sɔl. Na so dɛn bin de gladi we dɛn de siŋ ɛn shek tamborin ɛn ple flut.
As dɛn bin de dans, na so dɛn de siŋ se; “Sɔl kil wan tawzin pipul bɔt Devid in dɔn kil tɛn tawzin pipul.”
Dis mek Sɔl in at wam bad. I bigin tink bɔt wetin dɛn de siŋ se Devid kil tɛn tawzin pipul bɔt in kil wan tawzin nɔmɔ. I tink se natin nɔ go lɛf fɔ Devid pas fɔ bi kiŋ.
So frɔm da tɛm de Sɔl bigin jɛlɔs Devid ɛn kip am na at.
Di nɛks de PAPA GƆD mek ivul spirit fɔdɔm pan am at at wan. I bin de nain os de wayl, we Devid in bin de ple di ap lɛk aw i dɔn yuz fɔ du. Nain Sɔl jɛs gɛda in spia
ɛn sɛn am pan am. I tɛl insɛf se i go jɛs yus am fɔ chuk Devid so dat i go fasin am na di wɔl. Bɔt di tu tɛm we i du am, Devid bin de balans am.
Sɔl bin de skyad naw se PAPA GƆD de wit Devid bɔt i dɔn lɛf am.
Dis mek i pul Devid kɔmɔt nia am. I mek Devid kɔmanda ɛn gi am wan tawzin man fɔ de kɔmand so Devid bin gɛt fɔ de go fɛt.
Bɔt i bin de spak pan ɔl wetin i de du bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin de wit am.
Wɛn Sɔl si se i de pul nem pan ɔltin, i fred am mɔ.
Bɔt ɔlman na Izrɛl ɛn Juda bin lɛk Devid bikɔs nain bin de lid dɛn fɔ go fɛt.

Sɔl tɛl Devid se i de gi am in fɔs gyal pikin we nem Mirab fɔ mared if nɔmɔ Devid go prɔmis am se i go wok fɔ am gud ɛn fɛt di wa dɛn we PAPA GƆD gɛt. I bin de tink nain at se na fɔ lɛf am gi di Filistin dɛn nɔmɔ. So i nɔ go bɔda wit am.
Devid tɛl Sɔl se in na natin ɛn in famili sɛf nɔto ɛnitin fɔ mek lɛkɛ in bi di kiŋ in Sɔnɛnlɔ.
Bɔt we di tɛm rich fɔ lɛ dɛn an ova Mirab we na Sɔl in gyal pikin, to Devid fɔ mared, na to wan man we nem Adriɛl we kɔmɔt na Mɛola dɛn mek i mared.
Sɔl in ɔda gyal pikin we nem Mikal bin dɔn fɔl fɔ Devid, so we Sɔl yɛri dat i gladi.
I tɛl insɛf se na Mikal i go gi Devid so dat i go yuz am fɔ trap Devid we go mek di Filistin dɛn kil am. So Sɔl tɛl Devid se i gɛt sɛkɛn chans fɔ bi in Sɔnɛnlɔ.
Sɔl naw go tɔk to in wokman dɛn fɔ go koks Devid na kɔna mek i bi in Sɔnɛnlɔ as i lɛk am ɛn ɔl di wokman dɛn lɛk am.
Dɛnsɛf go tɛl Devid dɛn sem tin de bɔt Devid aks dɛn if dɛn tink se fɔ bi di kiŋ in sɔnɛnlɔ na smɔl tin. I se in na po poman ɛn bɛtɛ pipul nɔ sabi am sɛf.
Wɛn Sɔl in wokman dɛn tɛl Sɔl wetin Devid se,

i sɛn dɛn fɔ go tɛl Devid se i want am fɔ kil wan ɔndrɛd Filistin nɔmɔ, sakɔmsayz dɛn ɛn briŋ di kanda dɛn fɔ sho am. I tɛl Devid se na dat nɔmɔ go bi di put kola fɔ di mared so dat in go ebul pe in ɛnimi dɛn bak fɔ wetin dɛn dɔn du. Sɔl in plan na fɔ lɛ di Filistin dɛn kil Devid.
Wɛn di wokman dɛn go bak go tɛl Devid wetin Sɔl se, Devid gladi fɔ bi di kiŋ in Sɔnɛnlɔ.

Bifo di tɛm rich we Sɔl gi Devid, Devid tek in man dɛn go fɛt ɛn dɛn kil tu ɔndrɛd Filistin, sakɔmsayz dɛn ɛn briŋ dɛn kanda dɛn, fɔ sho se nain kil dɛn ɛn dɛn kɔnt ɔl wan wan fɔ tɛl di kiŋ so i go bi di kiŋ in Sɔnɛnlɔ. So Sɔl gi in gyal pikin, Mikal, to Devid fɔ mared.
Wɛn Sɔl fent se PAPA GƆD de wit Devid ɛn dat in gyal pikin lɛk am,
dat mek i fred mɔ ɛn Devid bi in ɛnimi te i day.
Di kɔmanda dɛn na di Filistin ami kɔntinyu fɔ de fɛt di Izrɛlayt dɛn bɔt ɛnitɛm we dɛn fɛt, Devid de fɛt pas Sɔl in man dɛn, so ɔlman kam no bɔt Devid.
Sɔl tɛl in bɔypikin we na Jonɛthan ɛn ɔl in wokman dɛn, fɔ kil Devid. Bɔt Jonɛthan bin lɛk Devid in biznɛs so
i tɛl am se in papa de fɛn we fɔ kil am. I tɛl Devid se di nɛks de mɔnin, i fɔ go ayd dɔn
in go go wit in papa na di fil we i de ayd ɛn tɔk to am bɔt Devid dɔn in go tɛl am ɛnitin bad we i yɛri.
Jonɛthan tɔk fayn bɔt Devid to in papa Sɔl. I tɛl Sɔl se mek i nɔ fɔ vɛks pan Devid bikɔs i nɔ du nɔn bad bɔt sɛf i dɔn prɔfit bɔku na Devid in ed.
I tɛl Sɔl se Devid risk in layf fɔ kil di Filistin ɛn bikɔs ɔf dat PAPA GƆD pul Izrɛl pan shem ɛn ɔlman si dat ɛn gladi. I aks am se wetindu i go want fɔ kil pɔsin lɛk Devid we nɔ du natin rɔŋ.
Sɔl lisin we Jonɛthan de tɔk ɛn swɛ se wans PAPA GƆD nɔ de day, in nɔ go kil Devid.
So Jonɛthan kɔl Devid ɛn tɛl am ɔl wetin dɛn tɔk. I briŋ Devid kam bak to Sɔl ɛn dɛn bin de lɛk aw dɛn bin dɔn de fɔs.
Wa fɔdɔm bak wit di Filistin dɛn ɛn Devid go fɛt. I so kil di Filistin dɛn dat dɛn gɛt fɔ rɔnawe.
Bɔt as Sɔl sidɔm nain os ɛn ol in spia, nain di ivul spirit frɔm PAPA GƆD kam pan am. As Devid bin de ple di ap,
Sɔl tray fɔ chuk am na di wɔl wit in spia bɔt Devid balans am ɛn di spia chuk di wɔl. Da nɛt de Devid kɔmɔt nia am saful.
Sɔl sɛn man dɛn na Devid in os as wachman dɛn so dat we do klin dɛn go kil am. Bɔt Mikal in wɛf tɛl am se if i nɔ rɔnawe da nɛt de, dɛn go kil am di nɛks de.
So Mikal mek Devid pas na wan pan di winda dɛn fɔ rɔnawe.
Afta dat Mikal tek wan dɔlbebi, le am na di bed, put got ia nain ed ɛn kɔba am wit Devid in klos.
Wɛn Sɔl sɛn di man dɛn fɔ go kech Devid, Mikal tɛl dɛn se i nɔ wɛl.
Bɔt Sɔl tɛl di man dɛn fɔ go bak fɔ Devid. I se mek dɛn briŋ am nain bed mek i go kil am.
Bɔt we di man dɛn go insay dɛn si se na dɔlbebi lidɔm na bed wit got ia nain ed;
Sɔl aks Mikal wetin mek i ple gem pan am ɛn mek in ɛnimi rɔnawe. Mikal tel am se i beg am fɔ rɔnawe ɛn trɛtin am se i go kil am.
Wɛn Devid dɔn rɔnawe, i go to Samiɛl na Rama ɛn tɛl am ɔl wetin Sɔl dɔn du am. So in ɛn Samiɛl go tap na Neɔth.
Wɔd rich Sɔl se Devid de na Neɔth insay Rama;

So i sɛn man dɛn fɔ go kech Devid. As dɛn bin de go, dɛn mit sɔm prɔfɛt dɛn de tɔk PAPA GƆD Wɔd ɛn Samiɛl bin de de as dɛn lida. Nain PAPA GƆD in spirit fɔdɔm pan Sɔl in man dɛn ɛn dɛnsɛf bigin fɔ tɔk PAPA GƆD Wɔd.
We Sɔl yɛri dat, i sɛn mɔ man dɛn ɛn di sem tin apin to dɛn. Sɔl stil sɛn wan ɔda sɛt fɔ di tɔd tɛm ɛn stil di sem tin apin.
Faynali insɛf go na Rama to usay wata wɛl de na Sɛku ɛn aks fɔ Samiɛl ɛn Devid. Dɛn tɛl am se dɛn de na Neɔth.
Sɔl go na Neɔth insay Rama bɔt as i bin de go PAPA GƆD in Spirit fɔdɔm pan am gud ɛn i bigin waka de tɔk PAPA GƆD Wɔd te i rich Neɔth.
I pul in klos ɔl ɛn insɛf tɔk PAPA GƆD Wɔd usay Samiɛl de. Na so i lidɔm ɛmti bɔdi di wanol de ɛn nɛt. Na dat mek pipul kin tɔk se, “Sɔl insɛf na prɔfɛt?”
Devid rɔnawe kɔmɔt na Neɔth insay Rama go to Jonɛthan go aks am wetin in du in papa we mek i de biɛn in blɔd.
Jonɛthan kɔrej am ɛn tɛl am se in nɔ gɛt fɔ day as in papa kin tɛl am wetin i want fɔ de du ɔltɛm, wɛda na big ɔ na smɔl tin. I se in papa nɔ go ayd tin lɛk dat pan am.

Bɔt Devid mek Jonɛthan no se in papa nɔ go tɛl am se i wan kil Devid bikɔs i no se Jonɛthan go fil bad, i tɛl Jonɛthan se in papa no gud gud wan se dɛn na tayt padi. Devid swɛ se in de tɛl Jonɛthan se wans PAPA GƆD nɔ day ɛn insɛf nɔ day yet, day nɔ de fa frɔm am.
Jonɛthan se in go du ɛnitin we Devid aks am fɔ du.
Nain Devid tɛl am se, di nɛks de we na di Nyu Mun fɛstival, i fɔ de fɔ it wit di kiŋ so in go lɛk fɔ go ayd na di fil ɛn de de te ivintɛm na di de we mek tri.
I se if Jonɛthan in papa fil am we i nɔ de fɔ it, Jonɛthan fɔ tɛl am se Devid tek pamishɔn fɔ go nain om na Bɛtliɛm kwik fɔ tek pat pan di famili sakrifays we dɛn kin gɛt ɛvri ia.
Devid se if we Jonɛthan se so, in papa jɛs se ɔrayt, dɛn i sef, bɔt if in papa in at wam fɔseka dat, dɛn Jonɛthan fɔ ɔndastand se i want fɔ du sɔntin bad to am.

Devid se dɛn ɔltu bin dɔn swɛ se dɛn go bi tayt padi so mek Jonɛthan nɔ kɔmɔt biɛn am. I se if Jonɛthan no se i nɔ de du fayn to in papa we na Sɔl, i bɛtɛ lɛ insɛf sɛf kil am bifo i mek in papa kil am.
Jonɛthan ansa se i nɔ gɛt fɔ day. I se in bin fɔ tɛl Devid if i bin no se in papa wan du bad to am.
Devid aks Jonɛthan aw i go no if in papa in at wam.
Jonɛthan kɔl am mek dɛn ɔltu go na di fil.
I swɛ to PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship se in go mɔs tray fɔ no wetin in papa fil di nɛks de ɔ bay di tɔd de.
I se wɛda i gladi wit Devid ɔ if i want fɔ du Devid bad, i mɔs sɛn tɛl Devid ɔ nɔ so mek PAPA GƆD lɛ i alaki if i nɔ lɛ Devid rɔnawe saful. I se mek PAPA GƆD de wit yu as I bin de wit mi papa.
I beg Devid se wans i nɔ day yet, Devid fɔ tan lɛkɛ PAPA GƆD to am ɛn trit am fayn wan we go mek i nɔ day ɛn
i fɔ trit ɔl di pipul nain famili dɛnsɛf di sem we, di tɛm we PAPA GƆD go dɔn pul in ɛnimi dɛn biɛn am.
So Jonɛthan ɛn Devid mek bagin ɛn i wish se PAPA GƆD go fɛt ɔl Devid in ɛnimi dɛn fɔ am.
Jonɛthan swɛ igen se natin nɔ go pat dɛn as in at tek Devid lɛk aw i lɛk insɛf.
Jonɛthan tɛl Devid se dɛn go si se i nɔ de na di Nyu Mun Fɛstival bikɔs in sit go ɛmti,
so we i go dɔn tek tu de, i fɔ go na di ples we i bin ayd fɔs, ivintɛm, ɛn wet fɔ am nia di Izrɛl ston.
I se in go shut tri aro nia di ston lɛkɛ se na sɔntin i de shut,
dɔn i go sɛn in bɔbɔ fɔ go fɛn di aro dɛn. I se if in tɛl di bɔbɔ se di aro dɛn de nia am mek i briŋ dɛn kam, dɛn Devid fɔ kɔmɔt na do bikɔs wans PAPA GƆD nɔ de day, i sef, nɔbɔdi nɔ go ambɔg am.
I se bɔt if i tɛl di bɔbɔ se mek i go yanda usay di aro dɛn de, dɛn Devid fɔ rɔnawe bikɔs dat sho se PAPA GƆD want am fɔ kɔmɔt de.
I mɛmba Devid se PAPA GƆD de fɔ dɛn witnɛs se dɛn ɔltu dɔn mek prɔmis ɛn i nɔ go ɛva kɔmɔt biɛn am.
So Devid insɛf go ayd na fil ɛn di kiŋ sidɔm na tebul fɔ it we di Nyu Mun Fɛstival de go ɔn.
I bin sidɔm usay i dɔn yus fɔ sidɔm, nia di wɔl ɔpozit Jonɛthan, ɛn Abna bin sidɔm nia am bɔt Devid in yon sit bin ɛmti.
Sɔl nɔ bin ebul se ɛnitin da de de bikɔs i bin de tink se na bikɔs Devid nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay mek i nɔ de de.
Bɔt di nɛks de, we na di sɛkɛn de na di mɔnt, Devid in sit bin stil ɛmti, so Sɔl aks Jonɛthan wetindu Jɛsi in bɔypikin nɔ go it wit dɛn di tu de.
Jonɛthan se Devid did tɛl am ɛn aks pamishɔn fɔ go na Bɛtliɛm.
I se Devid se in famili de mek sakrifays na di siti ɛn in brɔda dɛn aks am fɔ go. I se Devid se mek i trit am fayn ɛn lɛf am fɔ go si in brɔda dɛn. I tɛl in papa se na dat mek Devid nɔ de de.
Sɔl in at wam pan Jonɛthan ɛn i kɔs am se i mama we bɔn am alaki. I se if Jonɛthan nɔ no se we i de fasin pan Devid nainsɛf i de ambɔg ɛn i de put in mama pan shem.
I tɛl Jonɛthan fɔ sɛn go briŋ Devid kam lɛ i kil am bikɔs wans Devid nɔ day, in di Jonɛthan ɔ ɛni in jɛnareshɔn dɛn nɔ go bi kiŋ.
Jonɛthan aks in papa wetin mek i fɔ kil Devid we i nɔ du natin.
Bɔt we in papa sɛn in spia fɔ chuk am, i no gud wan se in papa riali want fɔ kil Devid.
So Jonɛthan blez ɛn grap kɔmɔt na di tebul, i nɔ it sɛf di sɛkɛn de na di mɔnt bikɔs i bin vɛks pan in papa fɔ aw i de disgres am bikɔs ɔf Devid.
Wɛn do klin Jonɛthan go na di fil we in ɛn Devid bin dɔn se dɛn go mit. I go wit in bɔbɔ.
I tɛl in bɔbɔ fɔ rɔn go fɛn ɛni aro we i shut. Bɔt as di bɔbɔ de rɔn, na so i de shut di aro go fawe.
We di bɔbɔ rich usay Jonɛthan in aro fɔdɔm, Jonɛthan ala se lɛ i go luk bifo say.
I ala se ɔri! Go wantɛm! Nɔ westɛm! Di bɔbɔ pik di aro ɛn go bak go mit in bra.
Di bɔbɔ nɔ no natin. Na Devid ɛn Jonɛthan nɔmɔ bin no dɛn kod.
Jonɛthan gi in bɔbɔ in bo ɛn aro dɛn ɛn tɛl am mek i go bak na siti.
Afta di bɔbɔ dɔn go, Devid grap na di say we i bin de ayd nia di ston ɛn baw tri tɛm wit in fes na grɔn to Jonɛthan. Dɛn grip dɛnsɛf, kis gud bay ɛn kray bɔt na Devid kray pas dɛn tu.

Jonɛthan tɛl Devid mek i nɔ wɔri sins dɛn ɔltu dɔn swɛ se dɛn nɔ go kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn kɔmpin ɛn na PAPA GƆD na dɛn witnɛs ɛn nain go bi witnɛs bak fɔ dɛn pikin dɛn te go. Dɔn Devid lɛf go, ɛn Jonɛthan in tɔn bak go na siti.
Devid go na Nɔb, usay Abimɛlɛk we na di man we bin de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, de. Abimɛlɛk skyad we i si am ɛn aks am wetindu nain wan i si.
Devid tɛl am se na di kiŋ sɛn am ɛn di kiŋ tɛl am nɔ fɔ tɛl nɔbɔdi usay i de go ɛn wetin i de go du. I tɛl Abimɛlɛk se in dɔn tɛl in man dɛn fɔ mit am sɔnsay.
Afta i ansa Abimɛlɛk, i aks am fɔ fayv lof bred ɔ ɛnitin we i gɛt.
Abimɛlɛk tɛl Devid se i nɔ gɛt ɔdinari bred, pas sɔm pan di bred we dɛn kin gi to PAPA GƆD as sakrifays. I tɛl Devid se in ɛn in man dɛn kin it am if Devid in man dɛn nɔ du uman biznɛs.
Devid mek i no se ɛnitɛm in ɛn in man dɛn de kɔmɔt, dɛn nɔ de gɛt tɛm fɔ uman biznɛs. Devid tɛl am se ivin we nɔto oli tin dɛn de go du, in man dɛn de kip dɛnsɛf oli ɛnitɛm we dɛn de go patrol.
So Abimɛlɛk insɛf gi am di bred we dɛn kin gi as sakrifays to PAPA GƆD as nain nɔmɔ bin de. Di wan we i gi Devid, na wan we dɛn bin dɔn pul na di tebul fɔ put frɛsh wan.
Doɛg we na di bigman fɔ dɛn man dɛn we bin de mɛn Sɔl in ship dɛn, bin de de. Na bin Idɔmayt ɛn i bin de wet na PAPA GƆD in os fɔ sɔntin.
Devid aks Abimɛlɛk fɔ gi am spia ɔ sɔd. I se as na kwik biznɛs di kiŋ sɛn am pan, i nɔ ol in sɔd ɔ ɛni ɔda wɛpɔn.
