Abimɛlɛk tɛl Devid se, di sɔd we i gɛt na bin Golayath in yon. Golayath na bin wan Filistin we Devid bin kil na Ila Vali. I tɛl Devid se dɛn rap am wit pisis biɛn di ifɔd, so if i want am, i kin tek am. So Devid tɛl am fɔ gi am as dat na di bɛst sɔd fɔ yuz.
Na da de de, Devid rɔnawe na Sɔl in an go to Ekish, we na kiŋ na Gath.
Ekish in man dɛn aks am if nɔto di Devid we dɛn bin de siŋ bɔt da wande. Dɛn bin dans ɔlɔbɔt ɛn siŋ se “Devid kil tɛn tawzin pipul bɔt Sɔl kil wan tawzin nɔmɔ.”
We Devid yɛri wetin Ekish in man dɛn se, i bigin wɔndrin ɛn dat mek i fred Ekish we na kiŋ na Gath.
So insɛf fɔmkres. Ɛnitɛm i de usay Ekish de, i kin de rayt rayt pan di do ɛn get dɛn, dɔn i kin lɛf in mɔt mek pit de rɔn dɔŋ go nain biabia lɛkɛ se in na kresman.
Ekish ala pan in man dɛn ɛn aks dɛn wetin mek dɛn kɛr Devid, we na kresman go to am.
I tɛl dɛn se dɛn gɛt bɔku kresman so dɛn nɔ gɛt fɔ briŋ mɔ fɔ am. I drɛb dɛn ɔl kɔmɔt nain os.
Devid lɛf Gath go tap na kev na Adulam. Wɛn in brɔda dɛn ɛn ɔl udat tap nain papa in os yɛri dat, dɛn ɔl go de go mit am.
Ɔl dɛn wan we bin dɔn gens wit wetin bin de bi ɔ we bin gɛt dɛt fɔ pe ɔ we bin de pan trɔbul go mit Devid. Na so i tɔn dɛn lida. Na bin bɔt sɔm fo ɔndrɛd man bin de wit am de.
Frɔm de i go na Mizpa we de insay Moab. I aks di kiŋ na Moab fɔ mek in papa ɛn mama tap wit am te i yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD want am fɔ du.
So Devid lɛf in papa ɛn mama wit di kiŋ na Moab ɛn dɛn tap wit am ɔl di tɛm we Devid bin de na di kev.
Wan prɔfɛt we nem Gad, tɛl Devid se i fɔ kɔmɔt na di kev go na Juda. So Devid insɛf kɔmɔt de go na wan bush we nem Ɛrɛt.
I kam bi se Sɔl yɛri se dɛn dɔn si Devid ɛn in man dɛn, da tɛm de Sɔl ol in spia ɛn sidɔm ɔnda di tamarisk tik we de na di il na Gibia ɛn i gɛt ɔl in yon man dɛn rawnd am.
I kɔl dɛn “Bɛnjaminayt” as na di sem ples dɛn kɔmɔt, ɛn aks dɛn if dɛn min se Devid go gi dɛn ɔl dɛn fil ɛn vinyad dɛn I tɛl dɛn se Devid nɔ gɛt fɔ mek ɛni ɔf dɛn kɔmanda.

I se dɛn ɔl de jɔyn gɛŋ wit Devid na dat mek nɔbɔdi nɔ bin tɛl am sɛf se Devid ɛn Jonɛthan na tayt padi. I se dɛn nɔn nɔ bisin bɔt am na dat mek dɛn nɔ tel am se Devid dɔn mek bagin wit in yon pɔsin fɔ ambush am da de de.
Doɛg we na Idɔmayt bin tinap de wit Sɔl in man dɛn. I se in si Devid gud gud wan we i go to Abimɛlɛk we na Aitɔb in bɔypikin na Nɔb.
I tɛl dɛn se Abimɛlɛk bin ivin tray fɔ no wetin PAPA GƆD want tɛl Devid. I tɛl dɛn se Abimɛlɛk gi Devid sɔm provishɔn ɛn di sɔd we Golayath, da Filistin man bin yuz.
Di kiŋ sɛn kɔl Abimɛlɛk we na Aitɔb in bɔypikin ɛn ɔl in papa in fambul dɛn as na dɛn na bin di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na Nɔb.
We dɛn ɔl kam to di kiŋ, i tɛl Abimɛlɛk fɔ lisin to am. Abimɛlɛk ansa am wit rɛspɛkt ɛn lisin to wetin i de se.
Sɔl aks Abimɛlɛk wetindu i jɔyn gɛŋ fɔ fɛt am. I se Abimɛlɛk gi Devid bred ɛn sɔd ɛn ivin tɔk to PAPA GƆD fɔ am so dat lɛkɛ da de de, Devid we na Sɔl in ɛnimi, go ebul fɔ kil am.

Abimɛlɛk aks di kiŋ se if ɛnibɔdi de nain os we tan lɛk Devid we nɔ de mek ipokrit to am. Abimɛlɛk mɛmba di kiŋ se na Devid mared in gyal-pikin, dat na Devid de luk afta in bɔdi gad dɛn ɛn dat ɔlman nain os lɛk ɛn de rɛspɛkt am.
Abimɛlɛk aks di kiŋ, if na di fɔs tɛm dat i de tɔk to PAPA GƆD fɔ Devid. I beg di kiŋ mek i nɔ miks in ɔ in papa in fambul dɛn pan wetin i de pan bikɔs dɛn nɔ no natin bɔt wetin i de tɔk.
Bɔt di kiŋ tɛl Abimɛlɛk se in ɛn ɔl in fambul dɛn go mɔs day fɔ dat.

Dɛn di kiŋ gi ɔda to in man dɛn nia am fɔ kil ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD fɔ pipul dɛn sin. I se dɛn jɔyn gɛŋ wit Devid na dat mek ivin we dɛn no se Devid de rɔnawe, dɛn nɔ tɛl am. Bɔt in man dɛn nɔ gri fɔ tɔch ɛni ɔf di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD fɔ pipul dɛn sin.

Dɛn di kiŋ tɔn to Doɛg, da Idɔmayt man ɛn ɔda am fɔ kil di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. So Doɛg insɛf tɔn ɛn kil dɛn ɔl. Na bin eti-fayv man i kil da de de, man dɛn we bin de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, man dɛn we kin wɛr di ifɔd.
Infakt, i kil ɔl udat de insay Nɔb, dat na bebi o, yɔŋ bɔy ɛn yɔŋgyal o, man ɛn uman o ɛn ɔl dɛn kaw, ship, got ɛn ɛni animal we de de.
Bɔt Abiata, wan pan Abimɛlɛk, we na Aitɔb in bɔypikin, in yon bɔypikin rɔnawe go jɔyn Devid.
I tɛl Devid se Sɔl dɔn kil ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD fɔ pipul sin.
Devid tɛl Abiata se wɛn i bin si. Doɛg, da Idɔmayt to in papa da de de, i bin no se i go mɔs go tɛl Sɔl. Devid se nain fɔ blem fɔ we ɔl Abiata in papa in fambul dɛn day.
So i tɛl Abiata fɔ lɛf to am as dɛn ɔltu gɛt di sem ɛnimi we want fɔ kil dɛn. Devid tɛl Abiata nɔ fɔ wɔri wans i de wit am, i sef.
Wɛn Devid yɛri se di Filistin dɛn de na Kiila de fɛt ɛn dat dɛn de tif ɔl dɛn sid dɛn na di os we dɛn de mil,
i aks PAPA GƆD if i fɔ atak di Filistin dɛn. PAPA GƆD ansa am se lɛ i atak di Filistin dɛn mek dɛn go lɛf fɔ ambɔg di pipul dɛn na Kiila.
Bɔt Devid in man dɛn tɛl Devid se, we dɛn de de na Juda, dɛn de fred bifo dɛn se fɔ go na Kiila go fɛt di Filistin dɛn.
So Devid insɛf go to PAPA GƆD bak go aks am if dɛn fɔ atak. PAPA GƆD ansa am se, dɛn fɔ go as i go mek dɛn bit di Filistin dɛn.
So Devid ɛn in man dɛn go Kiila ɛn fɛt wit di Filistin dɛn dɔn dɛn tek ɔl dɛn animal dɛn go. Devid ɛn in man dɛn kil bɔku pan di Filistin dɛn we mek dɛn lɛf fɔ ambɔg di pipul dɛn na Kiila.
Wɛn Abiata, we na Abimɛlɛk in bɔypikin bin de rɔnawe go to Devid na Kiila, i bin tek di ifɔd go wit am.
Dɛn tɛl Sɔl se Devid dɔn go na Kiila, nain i se na PAPA GƆD dɔn sɛl Devid gi am so we mek i go insay siti we gɛt get we de lɔk.
So Sɔl kɔl in man dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn se fɔ go fɛt na Kiila so dat dɛn go kech Devid ɛn in man dɛn na dɛn trap.
We Devid yɛri se Sɔl de plan bad fɔ am, i tɛl Abiata we na man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ kɛr di ifɔd go to am.
We Abiata gi am i pre to PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship. I tɛl PAPA GƆD se i yɛri se Sɔl de plan fɔ go pwɛl pwɛl tin dɛn na Kiila bikɔs ɔf am.
I beg PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD fɔ tɛl am if di pipul dɛn na Kiila go an am ova to Sɔl ɛn if Sɔl go riali go dɔŋ na Kiila as i dɔn yɛri. PAPA GƆD ansa am se Sɔl mɔs go.
Bɔt Devid aks am bak if di pipul dɛn na Kiila go an in ɛn in man dɛn ova to Sɔl. Ɛn PAPA GƆD se dɛn go du so.
So Devid ɛn in siks ɔndrɛd man kɔmɔt na Kiila ɛn bigin muf muf ɔlɔbɔt. Wɛn Sɔl yɛri se Devid dɔn rɔnawe na Kiila, i nɔ bɔda fɔ go de igen

Devid bin tap na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, na ples we i nɔ go izi fɔ kech am ɛn na di il dɛn na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, na Zif. Sɔl bin de fɛn am ɛvride lɛk tri kɔpɔ silva. Bɔt usay! PAPA GƆD nɔ mek i ebul fɛn am.
Devid bin de na Ɔrɛsh we de na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Zif. I yɛri se Sɔl dɔn go na di eria ɛn i de luk fɔ am fɔ kil am.
Da sem tɛm de, Sɔl in bɔypikin we na Jonɛthan go fɛn Devid ɛn tɛl am fɔ biliv PAPA GƆD.
Jonɛthan tɛl Devid se lɛ i nɔ fred bikɔs in papa Sɔl nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du am. I tɛl Devid se na Devid gɛt fɔ bi kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn in di Jonɛthan go de nɛks to am ɛn dat in papa sɛf no dat.
Jonɛthan ɛn Devid prɔmis fɔ de fɔ dɛnsɛf ɛn kɔl PAPA GƆD fɔ de as witnɛs. Afta dat, Jonɛthan tɔn bak go nain os, bɔt Devid in lɛf na Ɔrɛsh.
Di Zifayt dɛn go to Sɔl na Gibia ɛn tɛl am se Devid de ayd na ples we i nɔ izi fɔ kech am na Ɔrɛsh we de pantap di Akila il, na di sawtɛn pat frɔm di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap we de na Judia.
Dɛn tɛl di kiŋ se mek i go dɔŋ to dɛn, ɛn dɛn go mek shɔ se dɛn an Devid ova to am.
Sɔl pre mek PAPA GƆD blɛs dɛn fɔ di gud we dɛn gud to am.
I se mek dɛn go plan gud aw fɔ kech Devid. I se dɛn fɔ fɛnɔt usay i kin de go ɔltɛm ɛn udat dɔn si am de, as na pɔsin we in biznɛs traŋa.

I se dɛn fɔ fɛnɔt bɔt in difrɛn ayd-awt dɛn ɛn kam tɛl am di rayt tin. I se na da tɛm de i go go wit dɛn. If Devid de na di eria, i go mɔs gɛt am ivin if i min se i go gɛt fɔ sach ɔlman na Juda, wan bay, wan.
So di Zifayt dɛnsɛf go bifo ɛn lɛf Sɔl biɛn. Da sem tɛm de, Devid ɛn in man dɛn bin de na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Meɔn insay wan vali we de na di sawtɛn pat na Judia.

Sɔl ɛn in man dɛn bigin luk fɔ Devid, ɛn wɛn dɛn tɛl Devid bɔt dat, i go insay insay usay dɛn big ston de ɛn tap na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Meɔn. Wɛn Sɔl yɛri dat, insɛf go insay di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Meɔn fɔ go luk fɔ Devid.
Sɔl ɛn in man dɛn bin de na wan pat na di mawnten dɛn Devid ɛn in yon man dɛn bin de na di ɔda pat de rɔn fɔ kɔmɔt na di eria. As Sɔl ɛn in man dɛn dɔn de rich nia Devid ɛn in man dɛn,
wan mɛsenja kam kɔl Sɔl fɔ go kwik as di Filistin dɛn dɔn atak Izrɛl.
Dat mek Sɔl lɛf fɔ rɔnata Devid ɛn tɔn bak go mit di Filistin dɛn. Na dat mek dɛn kɔl di ples Di Sɛpreshɔn Il.
Devid insɛf kɔmɔt de go tap usay i nɔ go izi fɔ kech am na Ɛngɛdi.
Afta Sɔl dɔn tɔn bak, afta we i bin de rɔnata di Filistin dɛn, dɛn tɛl am se Devid de na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Ɛngɛdi.
So Sɔl tek tri tawzin man we i gɛda frɔm ɔlsay na Izrɛl ɛn dɛn ɔl lɛf fɔ go fɛn Devid ɛn in man dɛn nia di mawnten usay dɛn wayl got kin de.
We dɛn rich wan say usay dɛn de kip ship dɛn; i si wan kev, so i bɛn insay de fɔ atɛnd to nechɔ. Devid ɛn in man dɛn bin de insay insay dis sem kev.

Devid in man dɛn tɛl am se na da de de PAPA GƆD bin de tɔk bɔt we i se i go mek Devid ebul in ɛnimi ɛn du wetin i fil fɔ du wit am. So Devid insɛf krip saful wan go biɛn Sɔl ɛn kɔt af pisis kɔmɔt pan di klos we Sɔl bin wɛr.
Afta dat, Devid fil bad fɔ wetin i du.
I tɛl in man dɛn se mek PAPA GƆD nɔ gri fɔ mek i du ɛnitin to in bɔs, we PAPA GƆD dɔn pik ɔ tɔch am sɛf as na pɔsin we PAPA GƆD pik.
Na dɛn wɔd dɛn de Devid tek tɔk pan in man dɛn ɛn nɔ gri fɔ mek dɛn atak Sɔl. So Sɔl kɔmɔt insay di kev ɛn go in we.
Devid kɔmɔt insay di kev ɛn ala kɔl Sɔl. Wɛn Sɔl tɔn biɛn, Devid jɛs baw to am fɔ sho se i gɛt rɛspɛkt fɔ Sɔl.
Devid aks Sɔl wetindu i de biliv pipul dɛn we de tɛl am se in Devid de plan bad fɔ am.

Devid tɛl Sɔl se insɛf dɔn si korokoro wan aw PAPA GƆD sɛl am gi am da de de insay di kev. I tɛl Sɔl se sɔm pan in man dɛn se fɔ kil am, bɔt i nɔ gri. Devid tɛl am se i tɛl in man dɛn se in nɔ go tɔch in bɔs as na PAPA GƆD dɔn pik am.

Devid kɔl Sɔl in papa ɛn aks am fɔ luk di af pisis we de nain an we i kɔt kɔmɔt na Sɔl in klos bɔt dat i nɔ kil Sɔl. Devid beg Sɔl fɔ ɔndastand ɛn biliv se in nɔ de plan fɔ du am bad. I tɛl Sɔl se in nɔ du Sɔl natin bɔt Sɔl in de biɛn am fɔ kil am.
I tɔk se, mek PAPA GƆD jɔj bitwin dɛn tu ɛn fɛt fɔ am bɔt in nɔ go tɔch Sɔl.
Devid mɛmba Sɔl bɔt wetin dɛn kin se, “Ɔrinch nɔ de bia lɛm” so na udat bad nain de du bad, so in, Devid nɔ go tɔch Sɔl atɔl.
Devid aks di kiŋ na Izrɛl udat i de biɛn. I tɛl di kiŋ se in tan lɛk day dɔg na sanbich ɔ flay we nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du am.
I tɔk bak se na PAPA GƆD go bi dɛn jɔj ɛn nain go pas di sɛntɛns. I se mek PAPA GƆD si wetin de apin ɛn fɛt fɔ am ɛn pul in ed pan di trɔbul we Sɔl de fɛn fɔ am.
Wɛn Devid dɔn tɔk dɔn, Sɔl kɔl am in pikin ɛn aks if nain vɔys i de yɛri. Dɔn i bɔskray lawd lawd wan.
I tɛl Devid se Devid bɛtɛ pas am fawe bikɔs pan ɔl di bad we in de fɛt fɔ du Devid, Devid nɔ de fala am.
I se Devid jɛs tɛl am bɔt di gud we in di Devid du to am, tɛm we PAPA GƆD sɛl am gi Devid, bɔt Devid nɔ gri fɔ kil am.
I se na nɔmal tin fɔ mek we pɔsin mit in ɛnimi i dɔnawe wit am bɔt Devid nɔ du so. I aks PAPA GƆD fɔ blɛs Devid fɔ da tin de we i du.
I se, in no se Devid go mɔs bi kiŋ ɛn dat Izrɛl go ɛnjɔy we i bi kiŋ.
I aks Devid fɔ swɛ ɛn mek PAPA GƆD bi dɛn witnɛs se i nɔ go kil ɛni in fambul ɛn dɔnawe wit in papa in pipul dɛn kpatakpata.
Devid insɛf swɛ. Dɔn Sɔl tɔn bak go nain os bɔt Devid ɛn in man dɛn go ɔp bak usay dɛn bin de ayd.
Samiɛl day ɛn ɔlman na Izrɛl gɛda fɔ mek bɛrin fɔ am; dɔn dɛn bɛr am nain siti na Rama. Devid ɛn in man dɛn, muf go dɔŋ na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Meɔn.
Wan man bin de de we gɛt prɔpati na Kamɛl. Na bin jɛntri man. I bin gɛt wan tawzin got ɛn tri tawzin ship we dɛn bin de pul dɛn wul dɛn na Kamɛl.
In bin nem Nebal ɛn in wɛf bin nem Abigɛl. Na bin uman we gɛt sɛns dɔn i fayn. Bɔt in man we na Kelɛgayt, rud ɛn nɔ sabi biev to pɔsin.
Di tɛm we Devid bin de na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, i yɛri se Nebal de pul in ship dɛn ia.
So i sɛn tɛn yɔŋman fɔ go ɔp to Nebal na Kamɛl ɛn tɛl am se nain, Devid sɛn dɛn.
I tɛl dɛn fɔ tɔk fayn to am, wish lɔŋ layf ɛn wɛl bɔdi fɔ in ɛn in fambul dɛn ɛn tɛl am se dɛn want mek PAPA GƆD blɛs ɔl wetin i de put in an pan fɔ du.

I tɛl dɛn fɔ se i yɛri se tɛm dɔn rich fɔ pul di ship dɛn ia ɛn dat we Nebal in man dɛn we de luk di ship dɛn bin de wit in yon man dɛn, in man dɛn nɔ ambɔg dɛn ɛn ɔl di tɛm we dɛn tek na Kamɛl, dɛn nɔ lɔs natin.

I se dɛn fɔ tɛl am fɔ lɛ i aks in yon man dɛn ɛn dɛn go tɛl am. I se fɔ beg am mek i mɛmba in man dɛn ɛn du gud to dɛn sins dɛn go de di tɛm we dɛn de gladi-gladi. Devid se dɛn fɔ aks am fɔ luk fɔ wetin i go fɛn fɔ in man dɛn ɛn fɔ insɛf.
Wɛn Devid in man dɛn rich, dɛn gi Nebal, Devid in mɛsej ɛn sidɔm wet.
Nain Nebal ansa dɛn se “Udat na Devid? Udat dis Jɛsi in bɔypikin fil se i bi?” I se bɔku slev de rɔnawe na dɛn masta dɛn an,
so wetin fɔ mek i gi bred ɛn wata ɛn di bif we i dɔn kil fɔ in wokman dɛn to man dɛn we i nɔ no usay dɛn kɔmɔt.
Devid in man dɛn tɔn bak go usay dɛn kɔmɔt saful. Wɛn dɛn rich, dɛn naret ɔl wetin apin.
Devid ɔda in man dɛn fɔ rɛdi dɛn sɔd dɛn. So dɛn rɛdi dɛn sɔd dɛn ɛn Devid insɛf rɛdi in yon. Na bɔt sɔm fo ɔndrɛd man go wit Devid, bɔt tu ɔndrɛd lɛf fɔ luk dɛn tin dɛn.
Wan pan Nebal in wokman dɛn go tɛl Abigɛl we na Nebal in wɛf wetin apin. I tɛl am aw Devid bin sɛn man dɛn to in masta bɔt dat i kɔs, kɔs dɛn ɔl.
I tɛl Abigɛl aw di man dɛn bin gud to dɛn. I se Devid in man dɛn nɔ wande ambɔg dɛn ɛn dat fɔ ɔl di tɛm we dɛn de na di fil, dɛn nɔ lɔs natin.
I se de ɛn nɛt Devid in man dɛn bin tan lɛk wɔl rawnd dɛn di tɛm we dɛn bin de mɛn dɛn ship nia dɛn.
I aks Abigɛl fɔ tink bɔt dat ɛn si wetin i go du bikɔs in fil se in masta dɔn fɛn trɔbul fɔ insɛf ɛn di wanol os. I se na man we in biznɛs traŋa ɛn i nɔ de lisin to nɔbɔdi.

Abigɛl insɛf nɔ westɛm. I tek tu ɔndrɛd lof bred, tu bɔtul wayn, fayv ship we dɛn dɔn kuk ɛn drɛs fayn, tu bushɛl wit, wan ɔndrɛd kɔrant fɔ put pan kek, ɛn tu ɔndrɛd bɔnch dray fig we dɛn kin kwis fɔ travul. I lod dɛn ɔl pan dɔŋki.
Dɛn i tɛl in wokman dɛn fɔ lid, dɔn in go fala dɛn bɔt i nɔ tɛl in man Nebal natin.
As in ɛn in dɔŋki rich na wan say na di mawnten, dɛn mit Devid ɛn in man dɛn de kam dɔŋ nia usay i de.
Dɛn mit di tɛm we Devid jɛs se, ɔl di tɛm we i bin de wach di man in prɔpati dɛn na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na fɔ natin. I se di yuslɛs man dɔn tɔn in gud to bad ɛn gɛt fɔ pe fɔ dat.
I bin se mek PAPA GƆD dil wit am, if bay mɔnin i nɔ dɔnawe wit ɔl di man dɛn na Nebal in os.
Wɛn Abigɛl si Devid, i jomp dɔŋ in dɔŋki kwik, go mit Devid ɛn baw bifo am wit in fes na grɔn.
I ol Devid in fut ɛn beg am mek i put blem pan in nɔmɔ. I se mek Devid alaw am fɔ tɔk to am.
I se mek Devid nɔ fala da bad man we nem Nebal bikɔs na fulman lɛk aw in nem se, ɛn na so so bigful tin i de du. I se fɔ in yon say, i nɔ bin si di man dɛn we Devid bin sɛn.

I tɛl am se as PAPA GƆD nɔ mek i shɛd blɔd bay di we, we i go want fɔ fɛt fɔ insɛf, wans PAPA GƆD nɔ de day ɛn in di Devid nɔ day yet ɔl in ɛnimi dɛn go gɛt dɛn pe na PAPA GƆD in an lɛk aw Nebal gɛt fɔ gɛt in yon pe.
Dɔn i se mek Devid gi di lili ɛn natin we i kɛr to in man dɛn we de fala am.
I se duya mek Devid fɔgiv am. I se PAPA GƆD go mɔs mek i rul te go sins i de fɛt fɔ PAPA GƆD ɛn pre se natin bad nɔ go ɛva mit am wans i nɔ day yet.
I se pan ɔl we pɔsin de fɛn Devid fɔ kil am, Devid in layf de sef wan na PAPA GƆD we nain PAPA GƆD in an. Bɔt Devid in ɛnimi dɛn layf go de lɛk saliwansay to PAPA GƆD.
I tɛl Devid se di tɛm we PAPA GƆD go dɔn du ɔl di gud tin we i prɔmis Devid ɛn dɔn mek am fɔ bi kiŋ na Izrɛl,
Devid nɔ go gɛt kɔnshɛns we nɔ klia bikɔs i kil pɔsin fɔ fɛt fɔ insɛf, fɔ mɔna am. We i dɔn, i tɛl Devid se mek i nɔ fɔgɛt am we PAPA GƆD blɛs am.
So Devid tɛl Abigɛl se i fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship tɛnki fɔ we i sɛn Abigɛl to am da de de.
Ɛn i de tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnk fɔ di sɛns we i gi Abigɛl we dɔn tap am fɔ shɛd blɔd da de de se i de fɛt fɔ insɛf.
I se if nɔto bin fɔ se i go to am kwik, natin nɔ bin fɔ tap am fɔ kil ɔl di man dɛn na Nebal in os bay do klin wans PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship nɔ de day.
Na da tɛm de Devid tek ɔl wetin Abigɛl bin kɛr go nain an. Dɔn i tɛl am se mek i go na os wit kolat as i dɔn yɛri ɛn gri fɔ du wetin i aks fɔ.
Wɛn Abigɛl tɔn bak, i mit Nebal de mek big big pati lɛkɛ se in na kiŋ. I bin gladi ɛn i bin dɔn tot am. So Abigɛl nɔ se natin to am te do klin.
Wɛn i bin dɔn soba bay do klin, Abigɛl tɛl am ɔl wetin pas bitwin in ɛn Devid ɛn i gɛt strok we mek i nɔ ebul du natin. Afta tɛn de,
PAPA GƆD tek in layf ɛn i day.

Wɛn Devid yɛri se Nebal dɔn day, i tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki fɔ we i fɛt Nebal, fɔ aw i bin biev to am. I tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki fɔ we i mek i nɔ du bad bɔt pe Nebal fɔ di bad we in du. Dɔn Devid sɛn go aks Abigɛl fɔ mared am.
In wokman dɛn go na Kamɛl ɛn tɛl Abigɛl se Devid sɛn dɛn fɔ kam tek am fɔ bi in wɛf.
Abigɛl butu in fes na grɔn ɛn tɛl dɛn se in rɛdi fɔ sav Devid, so i go. I bin ivin was Devid in wokman dɛn fut.
Abigɛl grap kwik ɛn gɛt in fayv nani fɔ ɛp am. I jomp pantap di dɔŋki, go wit Devid in man dɛn ɛn tɔn Devid in wɛf.
Devid bin dɔn mared, Ainoam we kɔmɔt Jɛzril, so na dɛn ɔltu na bin in wɛf dɛn.
Sɔl bin dɔn tek Mikal we na Devid in wɛf, gi Paltiɛl we na Laish in bɔypikin ɛn we kɔmɔt Galim.
Di Zifayt dɛn go mit Sɔl na Gibia ɛn tɛl am se Devid de ayd pantap di Akila Il na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap we de na Judia.
Sɔl go dɔŋ na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Zif wit tri tawzin man we i pik na Izrɛl fɔ go fɛn Devid de.
Sɔl kamp kɔna say na di rod we de na di Akila Il na di say we tɔn to Judia bɔt Devid in lɛf na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap. Wɛn i si se Sɔl fala am go de,
i sɛn in yon man dɛn fɔ go fɛn di rayt say usay Sɔl de.
So Devid go na di say usay Sɔl bin de kamp. I si Sɔl ɛn Abna we na Nain bɔypikin we na di bɔs na Sɔl in ami lidɔm. Sɔl in bin lidɔm insay di kamp ɛn in sojaman dɛn bin de rawnd am.
Dɛn Devid aks Abimɛlɛk we na Itayt ɛn Abishay we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin ɛn we na Joab in brɔda se uswan pan dɛn go fala am fɔ go dɔŋ na di kamp fɔ go mit Sɔl. Abishay se in go go wit Devid.
So da nɛt de Devid ɛn Abishay go dɔŋ na Sɔl in kamp. Insay de, dɛn mit Sɔl de slip wit in spia chuk na di grɔn oba in ed. Abna ɛn di ɔda sojaman dɛn bin lidɔm nia am.
Abishay tɛl Devid se PAPA GƆD dɔn sɛl in ɛnimi to am da de de. I se lɛ i jɛs chuk am ɛn fasin am na di grɔn de wit in yon spia. I se i nɔ go gɛt fɔ chuk am tu tɛm sɛf.
Bɔt Devid tɛl Abishay se lɛ i sɔri fɔ am, as nɔbɔdi nɔ go du bad to di pɔsin we PAPA GƆD pik ɛn go fɔ natin.
Devid swɛ se wans PAPA GƆD nɔ de day, Sɔl in tɛm fɔ day go kam. I se i go ayda day ɔdinari wan ɔ i go day na wɔfrɔnt.
Bɔt mek PAPA GƆD nɔ mek i ambɔg ɛnibɔdi we PAPA GƆD insɛf dɔn pik. I tɛl Abishay fɔ tek di spia ɛn wata jɔg we de oba Sɔl in ed ɛn mek dɛn kɔmɔt de.
So Devid go wit Sɔl in spia ɛn in wata jɔg we bin de oba in ed. Nɔbɔdi nɔ si dɛn ɔ no bɔt wetin apin. Ɔlman bin de slip bikɔs PAPA GƆD mek dɛn slip lɛk udat chak.
Dɛn Devid go tinap fawe na di ɔda say, pantap di il so dat big big spes bin de midul dɛn.
I ala kɔl di sojaman dɛn ɛn Abna we na Nain bɔypikin, ɛn aks dɛn if dɛn nɔ de ansa am. Nain Abna aks udat de kɔl di kiŋ.
Devid ansa am bɔt aks am se if in nɔto man. Devid se nɔbɔdi nɔ de na Izrɛl we tɔf lɛk am bɔt aks wetin mek i nɔ gyad di kiŋ gud wan. Devid tɛl am se sɔmbɔdi bin go insay di kamp fɔ dɔnawe wit di kiŋ.

Devid tɛl Abna se i nɔ tray atɔl. I swɛ se wans PAPA GƆD nɔ de day Abna ɛn in man dɛn fɔ day bikɔs dɛn nɔ gyad di kiŋ gud, we PAPA GƆD dɔn pik. I tɛl dɛn se mek dɛn luk rawnd dɛn if dɛn go si di kiŋ in spia ɛn wata jɔg oba in ed. I se mek dɛn tɛl am usay dɛn de.
Sɔl fent pan Devid in vɔys, nain i aks if nɔto in bɔypikin Devid in vɔys i de yɛri so. Devid ansa am as kiŋ se nain.
I aks di kiŋ wetin i de biɛn am fɔ. I se wetin na dis tin we i du we bad.

I aks di kiŋ fɔ lisin to wetin in we nain bɔbɔ gɛt fɔ se. I se if na PAPA GƆD de mek i de biɛn am, dɛn mek PAPA GƆD gladi we Sɔl mek sakrifays to am, bɔt, if na mɔtalman de mek i de biɛn am lɛ swɛ de biɛn dɛn wan we de lɛ dat bi. I se dɛn dɔn drɛb am pan PAPA GƆD in prɔpati ɛn tɛl am fɔ go sav ɔda gɔd dɛn.
I se mek di kiŋ nɔ mek i day na ples we dɛn nɔ de wɔship PAPA GƆD. Devid tɛl di kiŋ se i de rɔnata anch lɛkɛ am lɛk we ɔntinman de go bush fɔ kech bif.

Da tɛm de, Sɔl mek lɛk pɛnitɛnt sina. I kɔl Devid in bɔypikin ɛn tɛl am fɔ kam bak. I se da de de, Devid dɔn sho am se in layf gɛt valyu so in nɔ go tray fɔ du Devid bad igen I se in biev lɛk fulman ɛn dɔn du bad bad tin.
Devid sho dɛn di kiŋ in spia we i bin tek go, ɛn tɛl dɛn fɔ sɛn wan yɔŋ man fɔ go oba go tek am usay i de.
Devid se PAPA GƆD de pe ɔlman fɔ wetin i wok fɔ, dat na if i de du wetin rayt ɛn if i tru to PAPA GƆD. I se da de de, PAPA GƆD sɛl Sɔl gi am bɔt in nɔ go ambɔg ɛnibɔdi we PAPA GƆD dɔn pik.
I se in op se lɛk aw i tek Sɔl in layf mek sɔntin, na so PAPA GƆD go tek in layf mek sɔntin ɛn pul in ed pan ɛni trɔbul.
Sɔl pre mek PAPA GƆD blɛs Devid in bɔypikin ɛn pre mek PAPA GƆD mek ɔl wetin i put in an pan bɛtɛ. Afta dat, Devid go in we saful ɛn Sɔl go bak nain os.

Bɔt Devid tɛl insɛf se if i nɔ tek tɛm, Sɔl go dɔnawe wit am ɛnitɛm, so di bɛst tin fɔ am na fɔ rɔnawe go to di Filistin dɛn dɔn Sɔl go lɛf fɔ de fɛn am ɔlsay insay Izrɛl ɛn na so i go tek kɔmɔt nain an saful.
Na so Devid ɛn di siks ɔndrɛd man wit am tek lɛf go to Ekish we na Maɔk in bɔypikin ɛn na kiŋ na Gath.

Devid ɛn in man dɛn bin tap na Gath wit Ekish. Dɛn ɔl bin de de wit ɔl dɛn fambul. Devid bin de de wit in tu wɛf dat na Ainoam we kɔmɔt Jɛzril ɛn Abigɛl we kɔmɔt Kamɛl ɛn in man na bin Nebal we bin dɔn day.
Wɛn Sɔl yɛri se Devid dɔn rɔnawe go Gath, i lɛf fɔ luk ɔlsay fɔ am.
Wande Devid tɛl Ekish se if i gladi wit am mek i gi am wan pan di siti dɛn na di kɔntri fɔ de as i nɔ fil se i fɔ tap paopa usay in di kiŋ tap na di big siti.
So da de de Ekish gi am Ziklag ɛn frɔm da tɛm de na di kiŋ dɛn na Juda gɛt am.
Devid tap na di Filistin dɛn ples fɔ wan ia ɛn fo mɔnt.
Wɛn Devid de na Ziklag in ɛn in man dɛn go ɔp go red di Gɛshɔrayt, di Gazayt ɛn di Amalɛkayt dɛn. Na dɛn pipul ya bin tap na di land we de midul Shɔ ɛn Ijipt frɔm tɛm.
Ɛnisay we Devid atak, i de kil ɔlman, man ɔ uman bɔt i kin tek dɛn ship, kaw, dɔŋki ɛn kamɛl ɛn klos dɛn tɔn bak go to Ekish.
Wɛn Ekish kin aks usay i red da de de, i kin se na di sawtɛn pat na Juda, ɔ di ples we dɛn pipul na Jɛramil de ɔ usay di Kɛnayt dɛn tap.
I nɔba briŋ ɛni man ɔ uman kam bak layv wan na Gath. I kin tɛl insɛf se dɛn go tɛl ɔlman bɔt am ɛn wetin i de du. Na dis Devid bin de du ɔl di tɛm we i de na di Filistin dɛn ples.
Ekish bin so trɔs Devid dat i bigin tink se di Izrɛlayt dɛn nɔ go wan si Devid igen so i go bɛtɛ lɛ i lɛf to am as in wokman te go.
Leta ɔn, di Filistin dɛn mek gɛŋ wit dɛn sojaman dɛn fɔ go fɛt Izrɛl. Ekish tɛl Devid se in op se Devid ɛn in man dɛn ɔndastand se dɛn gɛt fɔ jɔyn in sojaman dɛn fɔ fɛt.
Devid insɛf tɛl am se i go ebul fɔ si fɔ insɛf wetin in bɔbɔ Devid kin du. Ekish gladi ɛn tɛl am se in go mek am in bɔdigad fɔ layf.
Samiɛl bin dɔn day, ɔl Izrɛl dɔn kray fɔ am ɛn dɛn dɔn bɛr am nain siti na Rama. Sɔl bin dɔn drɛb dɛn pipul we de tɔk to dayman ɛn ɔl dɛn mɛrɛsin-man dɛn kɔmɔt na Izrɛl.
Di Filistin dɛn gɛda ɛn kamp na Shunɛm ɛn Sɔl in gɛda ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɛn kamp na Gilboa.
Wɛn Sɔl si di Filistin ami, in at kɔt dɔn i bigin fred.
I aks PAPA GƆD wetin go bi bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ ansa am. I nɔ yɛri PAPA GƆD in ansa na drim, we i yuz di Yurim ɛn Thumim ɛn di prɔfɛt dɛnsɛf nɔ se natin to am.
Na dat mek Sɔl tɛl di man dɛn we de rawnd am fɔ fɛn wan uman fɔ am we de tɔk to dayman lɛ i go aks am. Dɛn tɛl am se wande na Ɛndɔ.
So Sɔl drɛs insɛf wit ɔda klos fɔ mek dɛn nɔ no se nain, dɔn na nɛt, in ɛn tu pan in man dɛn go to di uman. I tɛl di uman se mek i kɔl wan gost kam ɔp fɔ am. I se i go tɛl am udat in gost i fɔ wek.

Di uman tɛl am se i wan gi am trɔbul as i no wetin Sɔl dɔn du. Aw i dɔn se ɔl dɛn wan we de tɔk to dayman ɛn dɛn mɛrɛsin-man dɛn fɔ kɔmɔt na di kɔntri. I se wetin mek i wan gi am trɔbul we go mek i day sɛf.
Sɔl swɛ to PAPA GƆD se wans PAPA GƆD nɔ day, di uman nɔ go sɔfa fɔ wetin i go du.
Nain di uman aks am udat in gost i fɔ wek. Sɔl ansa am se lɛ i wek Samiɛl in gost.
Wɛn di uman si Samiɛl, i ala big big wan ɛn aks Sɔl wetin mek i kam mek am ful se in na ɔda pɔsin ɛn biol, biol in na Sɔl.
Di kiŋ tɛl am se mek i nɔ fred, bɔt mek i tɛl am wetin i de si. Di uman tɛl Sɔl se in de si wan gost de grap na grɔn.
Sɔl aks di uman aw di gost tan. Di uman se na olpa we wɛr lɔŋ klos. Sɔl no wantɛm se na Samiɛl in gost ɛn baw wit in fes na grɔn ɛn lidɔm frɔnt am.

Samiɛl aks Sɔl wetindu i gɛt fɔ ambɔg am ɛn mek dɛn wek in gost. Sɔl tɛl am se in at nɔ swit ɛn dat di Filistin dɛn de fɛt am dɔn PAPA GƆD dɔn lɛf am to insɛf ɛn nɔ de ansa am bay drim ɔ bay wɔd frɔm dɛn prɔfɛt dɛn. I se na dat mek i lɛ dɛn wek am mek i go tɛl am wetin fɔ du.
Samiɛl aks Sɔl se wetin mek i fɔ wek am naw we PAPA GƆD dɔn lɛf am to insɛf ɛn bi in ɛnimi.
I tɛl Sɔl se PAPA GƆD dɔn du wetin i bin dɔn tɛl am se i go du. I mɛmba am se PAPA GƆD dɔn rut di kindɔm nain an ɛn gi am to wan pan in neba dat na to Devid.
I tɛl Sɔl se na bikɔs i nɔ bin du wetin PAPA GƆD se ɛn dɔnawe wit di Amalɛkayt dɛn, lɛ PAPA GƆD de du am so naw.

I tɛl am se, PAPA GƆD nɔ go tap de, i go an Sɔl ɛn Izrɛl to di Filistin dɛn ɛn di nɛks de Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn go jɔyn am usay i de, dat na di grev yad. I se PAPA GƆD go mek di Filistin dɛn tek ova di ami na Izrɛl.
Wantɛm nain Sɔl fɔdɔm flat na grɔn wit fred fɔ wetin Samiɛl se. I jɛs wik as i nɔ bin it natin frɔm di de bifo dat.
Wɛn di uman kam bak ɛn si di fred pan Sɔl, i mɛmba am se i risk in layf fɔ du wetin Sɔl want, so na obe nɔmɔ i obe am.
I beg Sɔl fɔ lisin to wetin i wan se ɛn tɛl Sɔl se i wan mek sɔntin fɔ am fɔ it mek i go fɛn rod fɔ go.
Sɔl nɔ gri. I se in nɔ de it. Bɔt di man dɛn we i go wit ɛn di uman kɔntinyu fɔ beg am te i gri. I grap na grɔn, sidɔm na di bed.
Di uman bin gɛt wan lili kaw we fat pas ɔl, we i mek dɛn kil wantɛm fɔ Kiŋ Sɔl. I tek sɔm flawa, mol am ɛn bek bred we nɔ gɛt yist.
I le tebul fɔ Kiŋ Sɔl ɛn in man dɛn ɛn dɛn it. Da sem nɛt de nain dɛn grap fɔ tɔn bak.
Di Filistin dɛn gɛda ɔl dɛn sojaman dɛn na Efɛk dɔn Izrɛl dɛn kamp na Jɛzril to usay wata de bɔs na grɔn.
As di bigman dɛn na di Filistin ami de mach wit dɛn bach dɛn, udat gɛt fifti ɛn udat gɛt wan tawzin, Devid ɛn in man dɛn bin de mach biɛn wit Ekish.

Di Filistin bigman dɛn aks wetin dɛn Ibru dɛn de de du wit dɛn. Ekish se if dɛn nɔ no se na Devid we na bin bigman na Sɔl, di kiŋ na Izrɛl in ami. I tɛl dɛn se i dɔn de wit am fɔ pas wan ia ɛn frɔm di de we i lɛf Sɔl te da de de, i nɔ fɛn fɔlt wit am.

Bɔt di Filistin bigman dɛn vɛks pan am ɛn se i fɔ sɛn Devid go bak na di say we i gi am. Dɛn se Devid nɔ fɔ go wit dɛn fɔ fɛt bikɔs i go tɔn pan dɛn as di fɛt de go ɔn. Dɛn se, i go kɔt dɛn man dɛn ed dɛn fɔ pliz in fɔstɛm bɔs.
Dɛn se if nɔto in na di sem wan, we dɛn bin siŋ bɔt se Devid kil tɛn tawzin pipul bɔt Sɔl in kil wan tawzin nɔmɔ.

So Ekish kɔl Devid se wans PAPA GƆD nɔ day, i dɔn si se Devid nɔ miks pan bɛnbɛn ɛn i bin fɔ gladi fɔ mek Devid de nain ami. I se frɔm di de we Devid go to am te da tɛm de, in nɔ fɛn fɔlt pan am bɔt in man dɛn nɔ gri mek i jɔyn dɛn fɔ go fɛt.
I tɛl Devid fɔ tɔn bak wit kolat ɛn nɔ du natin we go mek di Filistin bigman dɛn vɛks.
Devid aks wetin i du. Devid se us fɔlt i si pan am frɔm di de we i go de te da tɛm de. Devid se i fil fɔ go fɛt fɔ in lɔd ɛn kiŋ in ɛnimi dɛn.
Ekish se, in no se Devid dɔn bi in yon pɔsin lɛk in na enjɛl we PAPA GƆD sɛn bɔt di bigman dɛn na di Filistin ami se i nɔ fɔ go fɛt wit dɛn.
So, mek i grap ali mɔnin wit di man dɛn we kam wit am ɛn lɛf wantɛm fɔ go we do klin.
So Devid ɛn in man dɛn lɛf ali mɔnin ɛn go bak na di Filistin dɛn land dɔn di Filistin dɛn go ɔp na Jɛzril.
Devid ɛn in man dɛn rich Ziklag di de we mek tri. Dɛn mit di Amalɛkayt dɛn dɔn wutuwutu di ples. Dɛn atak Ziklag ɛn bɔn am,
ɛn kapchɔ di uman dɛn ɛn ɔl udat de de wɛda dɛn yɔŋ ɔ dɛn ol. Dɛn nɔ kil nɔbɔdi bɔt dɛn tot dɛn go we dɛn de go.
Wɛn Devid ɛn in man dɛn rich Ziklag bak, dɛn mit faya dɔn bɔn ɔltin ɛn dɛn dɔn kech dɛn wɛf dɛn, bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn ɔl go.
So nɔto kɔmɔn kray Devid ɛn in man dɛn kray. Na so dɛn de ala te dɛn bɛlful ɛn nɔ ebul kray igen
Devid in tu wɛf, dat na Ainoam we kɔmɔt Jɛzril ɛn Abigɛl we in man Nebal bin dɔn day ɛn i kɔmɔt Kamɛl sɛf bin de wit di wan dɛn we dɛn kɛr go.

Devid in at nɔ bin swit bikɔs in yon man dɛn bin dɔn bigin tɔk bɔt fɔ ston am mek i day; dɛn ɔl bin dɔn vɛks bad as dɛn bin kɛr ɔl dɛn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn go. Bɔt Devid kɔntinyu fɔ luk ɔp to PAPA GƆD we nain PAPA GƆD.
Devid tɛl Abiata we na di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn na Abimɛlɛk in bɔypikin fɔ briŋ di ifɔd. Abiata kɛr am go gi am,

ɛn Devid aks PAPA GƆD if i fɔ rɔnata di pipul dɛn we wutuwutu di ples ɛn if i go ebul fɔ kech dɛn. PAPA GƆD ansa am se lɛ i rɔnata dɛn ɛn mek am fɔ no se fɔ tru, i go kech dɛn ɛn ebul fɔ pul di wan dɛn we dɛn kech na dɛn an.
Devid wit in siks ɔndrɛd man go te rich wan smɔl watasay na Bɛsɔ, usay sɔm pan dɛn lɛf,
as tu ɔndrɛd pan dɛn nɔ bin ebul kɔntinyu sins dɛn bin tu taya. Bɔt Devid ɛn di fo ɔndrɛd go.
As di fo ɔndrɛd de go, dɛn mit wan Ijipshian na wan fil we dɛn ol ɛn kɛr go to Devid. Dɛn mek shɔ se dɛn gi am wata fɔ drink ɛn it fɔ it,
dat na sɔm pan di kek we dɛn mek wit fig we dɛn kwis fɔ travul ɛn tu ɔda kek we dɛn mek wit kɔrant. We i it am dɔn i luk bɛtɛ as i nɔ bin it natin fɔ tri de ɛn tri nɛt.
Devid, aks am udat i bi ɛn usay i kɔmɔt. Di man tɛl Devid se in na Ijipshian we na slev to wan Amalɛkayt. I se in masta lɛf am to insɛf we i sik, tri de bifo da de de.
I se na dɛn wutuwutu usay dɛn Kɛrɛthayt dɛn de na di sawtɛn pat na Juda ɛn di ples usay Kelɛb in pipul dɛn de. I se dɛn bɔn Ziklag bak.
Devid, naw, aks am if i go kɛr am go usay di ɔda wande. I se if dɛn swɛ to PAPA GƆD se dɛn nɔ go kil am ɔ gi am to in masta bak, i go kɛr am go dɔŋ usay dɛn de.
So i kɛr Devid go de. Dɛn mit di man dɛn de, skata ɔlɔbɔt de it ɛn drink, de ɛnjɔy di tin dɛn we dɛn lut to di Filistin dɛn ɛn Juda dɛn land.
Devid fɛt dɛn frɔm da ivintɛm de te di ivintɛm di nɛks de, so dɛn nɔ ebul rɔnawe. Na fo ɔndrɛd yɔŋman nɔmɔ kɔmɔt de wit kamɛl dɛn.
Devid tek ɔl wetin di Amalɛkayt dɛn bin dɔn tek wit in tu wɛf.
Natin nɔ lɔs yɔŋ, ol, bɔbɔ ɛn titi. Ɔl wetin dɛn bin lut, Devid briŋ dɛn ɔl kam bak.
Devid tek ɔl di animal dɛn we bin de de, dɔn in man dɛn kɛr dɛn go bifo di ɔda animal dɛn ɛn dɛn se na Devid in pe.
Wɛn Devid rich na di watasay na Bɛsɔ usay dɛn tu ɔndrɛd man we nɔ bin ebul go wit am dɛn ɔl wit sɔm ɔda pipul dɛn go mit am. So as Devid de pas, na so i de tɛl dɛn adu.

Bɔt di man dɛn we de wit Devid ɛn lɛk kɔnfyushɔn bigin tɔk se sins di tu ɔndrɛd man nɔ fala dɛn go fɛt, dɛn nɔ fɔ gɛt natin pan di tin dɛn we dɛn briŋ bak. Dɛn se di tu ɔndrɛd man fɔ jɛs tek dɛn wɛf ɛn pikin dɛn go.
Bɔt Devid kɔl dɛn in brɔda dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn se nɔto so fɔ du wit wetin PAPA GƆD dɔn gi dɛn. I tɛl dɛn se na PAPA GƆD kɔba dɛn ɛn put di wan dɛn we kam fɔ pwɛl dɛn na dɛn an.
I se nɔbɔdi nɔ go lisin to dɛnsɛf. I se, di wan we lɛf na di watasay na Bɛsɔ ɛn di wan we go fɛt go gɛt di sem tin we dɛn de sheb.
So Devid mek dat lɔ frɔm da de de te dɛn de tɛl di stori so.
Wɛn Devid rich Ziklag, i sɛn sɔm pan di tin dɛn we i kɛr go to di bigman dɛn na Juda as dɛn nain padi. I tɛl dɛn se di tin dɛn na prɛzɛnt pan wetin PAPA GƆD in ɛnimi dɛn bin gɛt.
I sɛn sɔm to di pipul dɛn na Bɛthɛl, di wan dɛn we bin de de na di sawtɛn pat na Ramɔt ɛn to di pipul dɛn na Jata.
I sɛn go to di wan dɛn na Aroa, Sifmɔt, Ɛshtɛmoa ɛn Rakal;
i sɛn to usay di Jɛramilayt ɛn Kɛnayt dɛn de;
to dɛn wan na Oma, Borashan, Athach
ɛn Ɛbrɔn ɛn to ɔl udat de na dɛn ɔda ples usay Devid ɛn in man dɛn bin dɔn pas.
Di Filistin dɛn fɛt Izrɛl ɛn bɔku pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn day na Mawnt Gilboa.
Di Filistin dɛn rɔnata Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn kil di bɔypikin dɛn, dat na Jonɛthan, Abinadab ɛn Malkishua.
Di fɛt bin dɔn de tɛns usay Sɔl bin de ɛn wɛn di man dɛn we bin de shut bo ɛn aro kech am, dɛn wund am bad.

Sɔl tɛl in bɔbɔ we bin tot di tin dɛn we i de tek fɛt fɔ chuk am wit in sɔd so dat dɛn Filistin dɛn de we nɔ no PAPA GƆD nɔ go kam provok am ɛn kil am. Bɔt di bɔbɔ bin de fred tumɔs fɔ du wetin Sɔl se, so Sɔl ib insɛf pantap in yon sɔd ɛn day de.
We di bɔbɔ si se Sɔl dɔn day, i ib insɛf pan insɛf yon sɔd ɛn day wit Sɔl.
So Sɔl, di bɔbɔ we de tot in tin dɛn fɔ fɛt, in tri bɔypikin ɛn ɔl in man dɛn day di sem de.

Wɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn we tap nia di vali ɛn oba say na Riva Jɔdan si se di Izrɛlayt ami dɔn lɔs ɛn dat Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn dɔn day, dɛnsɛf lɛf dɛn ples ɛn rɔnawe go. Di Filistin dɛn naw go na dɛn siti dɛn de go tap de.
Di nɛks de, wɛn di Filistin dɛn go fɔ sach ɛn tek ɔl wetin de pan di dedebɔdi dɛn, nain dɛn mit Sɔl ɛn in tri bɔypikin dɛnsɛf day wan na Mawnt Gilboa.
Dɛn kɔt in ed kɔmɔt, pul di tin dɛn we i kin wɛr fɔ fɛt pan am, ɛn sɛn mɛsenja dɛn wit di nyuz go ɔlɔbɔt usay di Filistin dɛn de, to dɛn gɔd dɛn os ɛn ɔl dɛn pipul dɛn.
Dɛn put di tin dɛn we i bin wɛr fɔ fɛt na dɛn Ashtarɔt dɛn os ɛn fasin in dedebɔdi pan di wɔl na Bɛth Shan.
Wɛn di pipul dɛn na Jebɛsh Giliad yɛri wetin di Filistin dɛn du Sɔl in bɔdi,
ɔl dɛn man dɛn we ebul fɔ fɛt go na Bɛth Shan na nɛt. Dɛn pul Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn dedebɔdi na di wɔl ɛn kɛr dɛn go Jebɛsh bak usay dɛn go bɔn dɛn.
Dɔn dɛn tek dɛn bonbon dɛn ɛn bɛr dɛn ɔnda di tamarisk tik na Jebɛsh ɛn dɛn fast fɔ sɛvin de.
Devid go bak na Ziklag afta we i bin dɔn bit di Amalɛkayt dɛn. I kam bi se Sɔl bin dɔn day. I de Ziklag fɔ tu mɔ de.
Di de we mek tri nain wan man we kɔmɔt na Sɔl in kamp, kam de wit chɛr chɛr klos ɛn dɔti nain ed fɔ sho se i de munin. We i rich usay Devid de, i dɔbalɛ fɔ sho se i rɛspɛkt am.
Devid aks am usay i kɔmɔt, I tɛl Devid se i rɔnawe na di Izrɛlayt dɛn kamp.
So Devid aks am fɔ tɛl am wetin apin. I se man dɛn rɔnawe na di wɔfrɔnt ɛn bɔku day. Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin Jonɛthan dɛnsɛf day.
Dɛn Devid aks di yɔŋ man we tɔk, aw i no se Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin Jonɛthan day.
Di yɔŋ man tɛl am se we in bin de pantap Mawnt Gilboa, di tɛm we di ɛnimi dɛn bin dɔn de kech Sɔl, in si we Sɔl wan ib insɛf pantap in sɔd,
we Sɔl tɔn rawnd ɛn si am i kɔl am ɛn in aks Sɔl wetin i want am fɔ du.
I se Sɔl aks am udat i bi ɛn wɛn i tɛl am se in na Amalɛkayt,
Sɔl beg am fɔ go mit am ɛn ɛp am fɔ day bikɔs i de sɔfa. I se Sɔl se i nɔ lɛf fɔ blo yet bɔt i tan lɛk i dɔn day wit di kayn sɔfa we i de sɔfa.
I tɛl Devid se so insɛf go tinap oba Sɔl ɛn kil am bikɔs in no se i nɔ go ebul fɔ grap usay i de. I se afta in dɔn kil Sɔl, i pul in krawn nain ed ɛn di tin we i bin wɛr nain an kam mit Devid.
Dɛn Devid ɛn ɔl di man dɛn we de wit am chɛr dɛn klos fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri fɔ yɛri da kayn nyuz de.
Da da de nɔto kɔmɔn kray dɛn kray ɛn nɔ ebul it bikɔs dɛn sɔri fɔ Sɔl, in bɔypikin Jonɛthan, PAPA GƆD in ami ɛn ɔl udat we na Izrɛlayt we day na di wa. Na te ivintɛm dɛn ebul it.
Devid aks di yɔŋ man usay i kɔmɔt. Di yɔŋ man ansa se in na Amalɛkayt we tap insay Izrɛl.
Dat mek Devid aks am if i nɔ fred fɔ dɔnawe wit pɔsin we na PAPA GƆD insɛf pik.
So Devid kɔl wan pan in man dɛn ɛn tɛl am fɔ kil di yɔŋ man we briŋ di nyuz. Na de dɛn wap am we i day.
Bifo i day. Devid tɛl am se nain tek in an bay in day as nainsɛf tɔk se i kil pɔsin we PAPA GƆD pik fɔ bi kiŋ.
We Devid de kray fɔ Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin we na Jonɛthan, i siŋ wan bɛrin siŋ.
Leta ɔn i gi ɔda se ɔlman na Juda fɔ lan dis siŋ ɛn so dɛn put am na wan buk. Di siŋ se,
“E Izrɛl, di tin we yu de blɔf wit, lidɔm day wan naw! Hmm! We tɔf sojaman day na wɔfrɔnt na sɔri tin!
“Nɔ fɔ tɔk am na Gath ɛn nɔ skata am na Ashkɛlɔn, ɔ nɔ so dɛn Filistin uman dɛn go gladi ɛn dɛn ɔn-to-um dɛn de go jomp wit gladi.

“A wish nɔn ren nɔ go fɔdɔm pantap Mawnt Gilboa ɛn dyu nɔ go kam de so dat natin nɔ go gro de igen Na de man dɛn lɛk Sɔl ɛn Jonɛthan nɔ ebul yuz dɛn big shild igen; na de Sɔl in big shild gɛt blɔd instɛd ɔf ɔyl pan am.
Bifo naw Jonɛthan kin de kil bɔku pipul wit in bo dɛn Sɔl kin de yuz in sɔd fɔ kil pipul we mek wɛn i de tɔn bak, i kin satisfay.
“Sɔl ɛn Jonɛthan na pipul we ɔlman bin lɛk ɛn day nɔ ebul pat dɛn. Dɛn ɔltu bin fast lɛk laytin ɛn trɔŋ lɛk babu bon.
Uman dɛn na Izrɛl, una kray fɔ Sɔl. Una mɛmba aw i kin mek una chen chen chɛ wit ɔl di aŋins an shekins, ɛn wit fayn klos we gɛt gold pan am.
“Hmm! We tɔf sojaman day na wɔfrɔnt na sɔri tin! Na Jonɛthan lidɔm day wan so.
E, Jonɛthan, mi brɔda, a sɔri fɔ yu; yu bin so klos to mi; di lɛk we yu bin lɛk mi bin wɔndaful, i pas aw uman de lɛk i man ɔ in pikin.
“Hmm! We tɔf sojaman day na wɔfrɔnt na sɔri tin. Dɛn ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn de tek fɛt ɔl dɔn lɛf de.
As di tɛm de go, Devid fɛnɔt frɔm PAPA GƆD if i fɔ go na wan pan di siti dɛn we de insay Juda. PAPA GƆD se yes, i fɔ go. Devid aks am uswan. PAPA GƆD ansa am se, i fɔ go na Ɛbrɔn.
So Devid tek in tu wɛf dat na Ainoam we kɔmɔt Jɛzril ɛn Abigɛl we in man Nebal bin dɔn day ɛn we kɔmɔt kamɛl, ɛn dɛn ɔl go tap na Ɛbrɔn.
Devid go wit in man dɛn we bin de wit am ɛn dɛn yon difrɛn difrɛn famili dɛn, ɛn dɛn ɔl sɛtul na Ɛbrɔn ɛn in ɔda smɔl smɔl siti dɛn.
Dɛn di big wan dɛn na Juda go mit Devid na Ɛbrɔn usay dɛn mek am kiŋ fɔ ɔl udat de na Juda in fambul layn. Wɛn Devid yɛri se na di pipul na Jebɛsh-Giliad dɛn bɛr Sɔl,
i sɛn pipul to dɛn fɔ go tɛl dɛn tɛnki fɔ wetin dɛn du. I se “PAPA GƆD go blɛs una fɔ we una trit una masta Sɔl wit rɛspɛkt we una bɛr am.
Mek PAPA GƆD insɛf sho una aw i gud ɔltɛm ɛn nɔ de lɛf una to unasɛf ɛn misɛf go trit una fayn fɔ dis tin we una du.”
I tɛl dɛn se naw we Sɔl dɛn masta dɔn day, dɛn fɔ olɔp dɛnsɛf bikɔs di Juda fambul dɔn mek am kiŋ fɔ dɛn.
Da sem tɛm de, Abna we na Nain bɔypikin ɛn na bin kɔmanda na Sɔl in ami, bin dɔn kɛr Ishboshɛth we na Sɔl in bɔypikin go na Maanaim
usay dɛn go mek am kiŋ fɔ Giliad, Ashɔri, Asha ɛn Jɛzril. Dɛn mek am kiŋ fɔ Ifrem, Bɛnjamin ɛn di wanol Izrɛl bak.
Ishboshɛth we na Sɔl in bɔypikin bin ol foti ia we dɛn mek am kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl ɛn i rul fɔ tu ia. Bɔt di Juda fambul dɛn bin de traŋa wan wit Devid.
Di tɛm we Devid bi kiŋ na Ɛbrɔn fɔ di Juda fambul na sɛvin ia, siks mɔnt
Abna we na Nain bɔypikin ɛn Ishboshɛth we na Sɔl in bɔypikin in man dɛn kɔmɔt Maanaim go Gibiɔn.
Joab we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin ɛn Devid in yon man dɛnsɛf go brakɛt dɛn na wan ples we wata de kɔmɔt insay ston na Gibiɔn. Di rayval grup dɛn sidɔm na tu difrɛn ples.
Nain Abna tɛl Joab se lɛ sɔm ɔf dɛn yɔŋ man dɛn kam tray bon bifo dɛm. Joab gri.
So dɛn ɔltu kɔnt twɛlv man kɔmɔt pan Bɛnjamin ɛn Ishboshɛth we na Sɔl in bɔypikin in man dɛn ɛn twɛlv frɔm Devid in yon man dɛn. Dat mek dɛn twɛnti-fo.

Ɔlman bin gɛt wan pɔsin pan di rayval grup fɔ fɛt. Dɛn grip dɛn kɔmpin, ol dɛn ia ɛn chuk dɛn wit dɛn daga na dɛn sayd, we mek dɛn ɔl fɔdɔm togɛda. Na dat mek dɛn kɔl da ples de na Gibiɔn, Fild ɔf Sɔds
Lɛkɛ ple, na so siriɔs fɛt fɔdɔm, ɛn Devid in man dɛn bit Abna ɛn di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Izrɛl da de de.
Zɛruaya in tri bɔypikin na Joab, Abishay ɛn Asaɛl. Asaɛl in yon fut bin fast na grɔn lɛk wetin.
I rɔnata Abna ɛn nɔ gi am wan blo blo te, nain
we Abna tɔn biɛn, i aks if nain Asaɛl de biɛn am so. I ansa se nain.
Dɛn Abna tɛl am se lɛ i lɛf am ɛn rɔnata ɛni ɔda yɔŋman we de nain lɛf an ɔ na raytan ɛn ɔf lod am, bɔt usay! Asaɛl bin stil de biɛn am tigi tigi wan.
Abna tɔn bak ɛn wɔn Asaɛl fɔ lɛf fɔ rɔnata am. I tɛl am se i nɔ go lɛk fɔ kil am bikɔs if i du so i nɔ go ebul fɔ luk in brɔda Joab nain yay.

Bɔt Asaɛl stil mek traŋayes ɛn kɔntinyu fɔ rɔnata Abna. So Abnainsɛf nɔ du wan, i nɔ du tu, i jɛs sɛn in spia wit di say we nɔ shap. Dis wan ya naw go insay Asaɛl in bɛlɛ ɛn kɔmɔt nain bak. I fɔdɔm de wantɛm wantɛm ɛn day ɔn di spɔt. So ɛnibɔdi we pas usay i fɔdɔm day kin jɛs tinap de wɔnda.
Bɔt Joab ɛn Abishay naw bigin fɔ rɔnata Abna, ɛn as san bin de go dɔŋ we dɛn rich na Ama Il nia Gia lɛkɛ se yu de go na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Gibiɔn,
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt na Bɛnjamin fambul jɔyn Abna ɛn so dɛn ɔl fɔm wan grup ɛn tek pozishɔn pantap di il.

Abna bigin ala to Joab se wetin dɛn de pan nɔ mek sɛns. I se if dɛn go jɛs de kil dɛnsɛf te go. I tɛl Joab fɔ no se wetin dɛn de pan nɔ go bɔn gud pikin. I se Joab fɔ tɛl in man dɛn fɔ lɛf fɔ rɔnata in yon man dɛn as dɛn ɔl na fambul.
Joab ansa se if nɔto we i tɔk wans PAPA GƆD nɔ de day in man dɛn bin fɔ rɔnata dɛn te do klin.
So Joab blo in trɔmpɛt fɔ lɛ ɔl in man dɛn lɛf fɔ fɛt. So dɛn lɛf fɔ rɔnata dɛn kɔmpin dɛn na Izrɛl ɛn lɛf fɔ fɛt ɔltogɛda.
Abna ɛn in man dɛn waka ol nɛt insay di Jɔdan Vali. Dɛn krɔs Riva Jɔdan ɛn kɔntinyu fɔ waka di ol mɔnin te dɛn rich Maanaim.
Joab tɔn bak afta i dɔn lɛf fɔ rɔnata Abna ɛn gɛda ɔl in man dɛn. Apat frɔm Asaɛl, na nayntin pan Devid in man dɛn lɔs.
Bɔt Devid in yon man dɛn kil tri ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti Bɛnjaminayt we bin de wit Abna.
Dɛn kɛr Asaɛl in dedebɔdi go bɛr am nain papa in grev na Bɛtliɛm. Dɔn Joab ɛn in man dɛn travul ol nɛt ɛn rich Ɛbrɔn bay do klin.
Di plaba bitwin Sɔl in fambul dɛn ɛn Devid in fambul tek lɔŋ. Devid in bin de tɔf mɔ ɛn mɔ bɔt Sɔl in yon fambul dɛn bin jɛs de go dɔŋ.
Na di bɔypikin dɛn dis we dɛn bɔn fɔ Devid na Ɛbrɔn: di fɔs wan nem Amɔn ɛn na Ainoam we kɔmɔt Jɛzril bɔn am,
Kileab na di sɛkɛn wan ɛn na Abigɛl we in man Nebal bin dɔn day ɛn i kɔmɔt kamɛl, bɔn am; Maaka we na di kiŋ na Gɛshɔ in gyal pikin bɔn di tɔd wan we na Absalɔm;
Agit bɔn Adonayja nɔmba fɔ; Abital bɔn Shefataya nɔmba fayv ɛn
Ɛgla we nain ɔda wɛf bɔn Ithriam nɔmba siks. Na di bɔypikin dɛn wan ya we dɛn bɔn fɔ Devid na Ɛbrɔn.
Di tɛm we di plaba bitwin Sɔl ɛn Devid dɛn fambul dɛn de go ɔn, Abna bin bizi de mek shɔ se nain de kɔntrol Sɔl in fambul dɛn.
Sɔl bin gɛt wan smɔl wɛf we nem Rizpa ɛn na bin Eya in gyal pikin. Wande Ishboshɛth aks Abna wetindu i fɔ kip in papa in smɔl wɛf.

Abnain at wam. I aks Ishboshɛth if i tink se in na dɔg. I se wit ɔl wetin i dɔn du fɔ Ishboshɛth in papa Sɔl in fambul dɛn ɛn in padi dɛn, if na di pe dat i fɔ gɛt, fɔ mek i fil se in kip uman ivin we i de du ɔlkayn tin fɔ mek Devid nɔ ebul dɛn.
I se mek PAPA GƆD lɛ i alaki if in nɔ go go ɛp Devid fɔ bi wetin PAPA GƆD bin dɔn swɛ se i go bi.
I se in go ɛp Devid fɔ bi kiŋ ɛn Devid go bi kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl ɛn Juda frɔm Dan na di Nɔth te Biashiba na di Sawt.
Ishboshɛth nɔ bɔda fɔ se ɛnitin bikɔs i bin de fred Abna.
Abna naw kam sɛn pipul to Devid fɔ go tɛl am se if i gri fɔ mek wanwɔd wit am, i go ɛp am fɔ bi kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl. I se afta ɔl na Devid fɔ kɔntrol ɔl di land dɛn na Izrɛl.
Devid se, dat fayn, bɔt se in de aks fɔ wan tin nɔmɔ: Abna nɔ fɔ mek dɛn tu yay mek fo if i nɔ de go mit am wit Mikal dat na Sɔl in gyal pikin Devid bin dɔn mared.
Dɔn Devid sɛn go aks Ishboshɛth we na Sɔl in bɔypikin fɔ gi am in wɛf Mikal as i kil wan ɔndrɛd Filistin, sakɔmsayz dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn kanda dɛn go to Sɔl, we sho se i kil dɛn, bifo i mared am.
So Ishboshɛth gi ɔda fɔ mek man dɛn go pul am kɔmɔt nain man Paltiɛl we na Laish in bɔypikin in os.
In man de biɛn am de kray te dɛn rich Baurim. Abna tɛl am fɔ tɔn bak ɛn i tɔn bak.
Da tɛm de, Abna bin dɔn gɛt tɔk wit di big wan dɛn na Izrɛl. I tɛl dɛn se i dɔn te we dɛn bin dɔn want Devid fɔ bi dɛn kiŋ so na da tɛm de
dɛn fɔ mek am kiŋ. I se PAPA GƆD bin dɔn prɔmis Devid se nain i go yuz fɔ pul Izrɛl na di Filistin dɛn ɛn ɔl dɛn ɔda ɛnimi dɛn an.
Abna go tɔk to di Bɛnjaminayt dɛn fes to fes. We i dɔn, i go mit Devid na Ɛbrɔn ɛn tɛl am ɔl wetin Izrɛl ɛn Bɛnjamin fambul mekɔp fɔ du.
Abna bin go wit twɛnti man ɛn wɛn dɛn rich to Devid na Ɛbrɔn, i mek pati fɔ Abna ɛn in man dɛn.

Wɛn Abna dɔn it dɔn, i aks Devid fɔ lɛf am lɛ i go wantɛm go gɛda ɔlman na Izrɛl fɔ kam sho Devid se dɛn gri fɔ mek i bi dɛn kiŋ. I se dɛn go mek bagin wit Devid ɛn Devid go ebul du wetin i fil fɔ du. So Devid gri fɔ lɛ i go ɛn i go saful wan.
I nɔ tu te afta dat, nain Devid in man dɛn ɛn Joab tɔn bak afta wan atak. Dɛn bin briŋ bɔku tin dɛn we dɛn siz. Bɔt da tɛm de Abna nɔ bin de na Ɛbrɔn igen bikɔs Devid bin dɔn mek i go bak saful.
Wɛn Joab ɛn ɔl di sojaman dɛn we de wit am rich Ɛbrɔn, i yɛri se, Abna we na Nain bɔypikin bin de de bɔt di kiŋ dɔn mek i go saful wan.
So Joab go mit di kiŋ ɛn aks am wetin i du so. I tɛl di kiŋ se i yɛri se Abna bin kam to am bɔt i dɔn lɛf am fɔ go bak saful ɛn naw na go i dɔn go so.
I tɛl di kiŋ se i fɔ no aw Abna tan. I se Abna kam mek di kiŋ ful so dat i go wach ɔl wetin i de du ɛn aw i de du dɛn.
Wɛn Joab dɔn tɔk to Devid dɔn i lɛf am ɛn sɛn pipul fɔ go briŋ Abna kam bak bɔt Devid nɔ no natin. Dɛn mit am na di watasay na Sera.
Wɛn Abna rich na Ɛbrɔn, Joab kɛr am go na kɔna bay di domɔt lɛkɛ se i wan tɔk sikrit to am. We dɛn de de, Joab chuk am nain bɛlɛ fɔ we i bin kil in brɔda Asaɛl. Na de i fɔdɔm day.
Leta ɔn we Devid yɛri wetin bi, i se PAPA GƆD nɔ go ɛva blem in ɛn in pipul fɔ di day we Abna day so.

I swɛ Joab. I se mek Joab ɛn in fambul dɛn pe fɔ di kil we i kil Abna; ɛn mek sɔmbɔdi de nain os we go gɛt sik nain bɔdi ɛn mek sɔmbɔdi de de we go de yuz krɔch, ɔ we dɛn go kil na wɔfrɔnt ɔ we nɔ go de gɛt tin fɔ it.
Na so Joab ɛn in brɔda Abishay tek kil Abna bak fɔ we i bin kil dɛn ɔda brɔda Asaɛl, di tɛm we dɛn bin de fɛt na Gibiɔn.
Devid tɛl Joab ɛn ɔl di sojaman dɛn wit am fɔ chɛr chɛr dɛn klos ɛn wɛr saklɔth waka bifo di dedebɔdi we dɛn de go bɛr am fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri. Kiŋ Devid insɛf bin de biɛn di bɛrin.
Dɛn bɛr Abna na Ɛbrɔn ɛn di kiŋ kray bita wan na Abnain grev. Na so ɔlman we de de de kray.
Di kiŋ siŋ dis bɛrin siŋ fɔ Abna: “Na so yu fɔ day lɛkɛ se yu na fulman?
Nɔbɔdi nɔ tay yu an, Nɔbɔdi nɔ chen yu fut dɛn Yu day lɛk na tif man atak yu.” We i dɔn, ɔlman bigin kray bak frɛsh wan.
Ɔlman kam fɔ koks Devid fɔ put sɔntin nain bɛlɛ bɔt Devid swɛ se in nɔ go it natin te ivintɛm. I se if i it ɛnitin, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek i alaki.
Di sojaman dɛn gri wit wetin di kiŋ se ɛn gladi we i du so. Dɛn kin gladi ɔltɛm wit wetin di kiŋ de du.
Dat mek dɛn ɔl biliv se di kiŋ nɔ gɛt an pan di kil we dɛn kil Abna.
Dɔn di kiŋ aks di wan dɛn we i de wok wit if dɛn nɔ no se na big bigman dɛn dɔn lɔs na Izrɛl so.
Devid se pan ɔl we nain na kiŋ, in nɔ ebul Zɛruaya in bɔypikin dɛn biznɛs. I se dɛn tu yaŋe yaŋe fɔ am bɔt pre se mek PAPA GƆD pe dɛn fɔ wetin dɛn de du.
Wɛn Ishboshɛth we na Sɔl in bɔypikin yɛri se Abna dɔn day na Ɛbrɔn, i pwɛl at ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn shɔk.

Ishboshɛth bin gɛt tu man wit am we bin de lid gɛŋ dɛn fɔ go red. Wan pan dɛn bin nem Baana ɛn di ɔda wan nem Rekab. Dɛn ɔltu na Rimɔn in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn dɛn kɔmɔt na Biarɔt. Ɔlman de luk se Biarɔt na pat na Bɛnjamin,
bikɔs di pipul na Biarɔt bin rɔnawe go Gitaim usay dɛn dɔn de as fɔrina te da tɛm de.

Sɔl in ɔda bɔypikin we na Jonɛthan bin gɛt in yon bɔypikin we nɔ ebul fɔ waka fayn. I bin ol fayv we nyuz rich dɛn bɔt Sɔl ɛn Jonɛthan dɛn day wan. In nani jɛs kapu am ɛn rɔn, bɔt di mekes we di nani de mekes mek i fɔdɔm ɛn frɔm da tɛm de i nɔ ebul waka. I nem Mɛfiboshɛth.
Wande, Rekab ɛn Baana we na Rimɔn di Birathayt in bɔypikin dɛn lɛf fɔ go na Ishboshɛth in os. Dɛn rich de we san de ɔp ɛn da tɛm de i bin de slip in aftanun slip.
Di sikyɔriti we bin de na di domɔt bin de shifta wit bifo slip kech am, so dɛn go insay di os saful.
Wɛn dɛn go insay di os, Ishboshɛth bin lidɔm nain bed. Dɛn chuk am nain bɛlɛ. Afta dɛn dɔn chuk am, dɛn kɔt in ed kɛr am go. Dɛn travul wit di ed ol nɛt te rich di Jɔdan Vali.

Dɛn kɛr di ed go mit Devid na Ɛbrɔn ɛn tɛl di kiŋ se dɛn dɔn briŋ Ishboshɛth we na Sɔl in bɔypikin in ed. Dɛn tɛl am se Sɔl we na bin in ɛnimi bin de tray fɔ kil am bɔt PAPA GƆD dɔn fɛt Sɔl ɛn in jɛnareshɔn dɛn fɔ Devid.
Bɔt Devid tɛl Rekab ɛn in brɔda Baana se wans PAPA GƆD we dɔn pul in ed pan ɔlkayn waala nɔ de day i nɔ go lɛf dɛn so.
I se wɛn wan man go mit am na Ziklag ɛn fil se i go gladi fɔ yɛri se Sɔl day, na de i mek dɛn kil am. I se dat na bin di pe we i pe am fɔ di nyuz we i kɛr.
I se if i du da man de so wetindu i nɔ fɔ kil dɛn fɔ dɛn wikɛdnɛs we dɛn go mit da po man nain bed insay in os ɛn kil am fɔ natin.
So Devid insɛf ɔda in man dɛn fɔ kil Rekab ɛn Baana. Dɛn kɔt dɛn an ɛn fut dɛn ɛn ɛŋ dɛn na di ples we wata de kɔmɔt na Ɛbrɔn. Bɔt dɛn bɛr Ishboshɛth in ed na Abnain grev na Ɛbrɔn.
Ɔl di fambul dɛn na Izrɛl go mit Devid na Ɛbrɔn ɛn tɛl am se in na dɛn yon flɛsh ɛn blɔd.
Dɛn se ivin we Sɔl na bin dɛn kiŋ, na Devid bin de lid dɛn sojaman dɛn fɔ go fɛt ɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl am se nain go gɛt fɔ lid di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɛn bi dɛn kiŋ.
So as dɛn ɔl de de na Ɛbrɔn, Kiŋ Devid mek dɛn swɛ se dɛn want am fɔ bi dɛn kiŋ ɛn na bifo PAPA GƆD dɛn ɔl gri. Na so Devid tek bi kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl.
Devid bin ol tati ia we i bi kiŋ ɛn i rul fɔ foti ia.
We i bin de Ɛbrɔn, i rul Juda fɔ sɛvin ia, siks mɔnt, ɛn kam Jerusɛlɛm we i rul ɔl Izrɛl ɛn Juda fɔ tati-tri ia.

Di kiŋ ɛn in man dɛn go Jerusɛlɛm fɔ go atak di Jɛbyusayt dɛn we bin tap de. Di Jɛbyusayt dɛn tɛl Devid se i nɔ go ebul ɛnta ɛn dat di blɛn yay man dɛn ɛn dɛn wan we nɔ ebul waka sɛf ebul tap am mek i nɔ ɛnta di siti. Dɛn nɔ bin biliv se Devid go ebul ɛnta.
Ɛniwe, Devid ɛnta ɛn kapchɔ Zayɔn we dɛn kil kɔl di siti ɔf Devid.

Da de de Devid se if ɛnibɔdi pan in sojaman dɛn fɔ ebul di Jɛbyusayt, i fɔ klem di say we wata de pas, go mit di wan dɛn we dɛn se blɛn ɛn nɔ de waka we nain ɛnimi dɛn. Na dat mek pipul kin se udat blɛn ɛn udat nɔ de waka nɔ go go na di kiŋ in os.
Na so Devid kam tek tap na dɛn bes ɛn kɔl am di siti ɔf Devid. I mek di eria rawnd am fayn ɛn trɔŋ te rich usay i tap.
Na so i bin jɛs de tɔf pan ɔltin bikɔs PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti bin de wit am.
Dɛn Iram we na di kiŋ na Taya, sɛn pipul to Devid wit big big ɛn trɔŋ trɔŋ sida wud dɛn, kapinta dɛn ɛn mesna dɛn we go bil os fɔ Devid fɔ de as kiŋ.
Dat mek Devid biliv se fɔ tru tru PAPA GƆD dɔn mek i sidɔm as kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl ɛn dɔn mek i de rul fayn fɔseka PAPA GƆD yon pipul we na di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
We Devid kɔmɔt na Ɛbrɔn, i mared mɔ wɛf, gɛt mɔ smɔl wɛf dɛn ɛn bɔn mɔ bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm.
Na di pikin dɛn we dɛn bɔn fɔ am dɛn nem dɛn dis: Shamua, Shobab, Nethan, Sɔlɔmɔn,
Iba, Ɛlishua, Nɛfɛg,
Ilaysham, Iliada, ɛn Ɛlifɛlɛt
Wɛn di Filistin dɛn yɛri se dɛn dɔn mek Devid kiŋ fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn, dɛn ɔl tot rod fulbo fɔ go ɔp go fɛn Devid fɔ kapchɔ am. Bɔt i yɛri bɔt dat so insɛf go nain bes.
Da tɛm de di Filistin dɛn bin dɔn skata ɔlɔbɔt na di Refaim Vali;
So Devid aks PAPA GƆD if i fɔ go atak di Filistin dɛn. I fɛnɔt if PAPA GƆD go mek lɛ i win dɛn. PAPA GƆD ansa am se lɛ i go. PAPA GƆD se in mɔs mek Devid win di Filistin dɛn.
So Devid go na Beal Pɛrazim ɛn na de i win di Filistin dɛn. I se PAPA GƆD dɔn mek mi ɛnimi dɛn fɔdɔm na mi fut lɛk aw wata de bɔs kɔmɔt na ples. So dɛn kɔl da ples de Beal Pɛrazim.
Di Filistin dɛn rɔnawe lɛf dɛn smɔl smɔl gɔd dɛn de so Devid ɛn in man dɛn tot ɔl go.
Dat nɔ du fɔ dɛn, di Filistin dɛn kam bak na di Refaim Vali ɛn skata ɔlɔbɔt de,

so Devid fɛnɔt bak frɔm PAPA GƆD if i fɔ atak dɛn bɔt dis tɛm PAPA GƆD ansa am se dis tɛm ya i nɔ fɔ go mit dɛn fes to fes. PAPA GƆD se i fɔ go rawnd dɛn ɛn atak dɛn nia di balsam tik dɛn usay dɛn de.
PAPA GƆD se as sun as i yɛri di briz de blo pantap di tik dɛn, lɛ i atak wantɛm bikɔs dat min se PAPA GƆD dɔn go bifo go fɛt di Filistin dɛn fɔ am.
So Devid insɛf du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ du ɛn i atak di Filistin dɛn gud ɛn prɔpa frɔm Gibiɔn te rich Gɛza.
Devid pik tati tawzin man na Izrɛl ɛn kɔl dɛn ɔl na wan ples.
In ɛn di man dɛn go Baala we de na Juda fɔ go to PAPA GƆD in ak we gɛt PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in nem. PAPA GƆD we sidɔm ay ay wan midul di tu chɛryubim we de pantap di ak.
Dɛn put PAPA GƆD in ak pantap wan nyu ɔmɔlanke ɛn briŋ am na Abinadab in os we de pantap il. Na Uza ɛn Aio we na Abinadab in tu bɔypikin. Na dɛn tu bin de gyad
di nyu ɔmɔlanke. Aio in bin de waka bifo am.
Na so Devid ɛn ɔl di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn gladi. Dɛn bin de siŋ ɛn dans wit ɔl dɛn at. Dɛn bin de ple difrɛn Instrumɛnt dɛn lɛk ap, laya, tamborin ɛn simbɔl.
Wɛn dɛn rich na di os we dɛn kin mil na Nakɔn, di kaw dɛn we bin tot di ɔmɔlanke we dɛn put di ak staga, Uza tɔch PAPA GƆD in ak lɛkɛ se i wan kech am.
PAPA GƆD vɛks bad bad wan pan Uza fɔ we i mistek tɔch di ak so PAPA GƆD mek i day wantɛm wantɛm de nia di ak.
Dat mek Devid insɛf vɛks bikɔs PAPA GƆD pɔnish Uza, sote tide, dɛn de kɔl da ples de Pɛrɛz Uza
Frɔm da de de, Devid bigin fred PAPA GƆD bad bad wan. I aks insɛf if in go ebul fɔ luk afta PAPA GƆD in ak.
So dat mek Devid skyad fɔ mek PAPA GƆD in ak go de usay in de na di siti ɔf Devid. Bifo dat i mek di ak go na Obɛd Idɔm in os. Obɛd Idɔm kɔmɔt na Gath.
Obɛd Idɔm kip di ak nain os fɔ tri gud mɔnt ɛn PAPA GƆD blɛs ɔlman nain os.
Wɛn Kiŋ Devid yɛri se na bikɔs PAPA GƆD in ak de na Obɛd Idɔm in os mek PAPA GƆD de blɛs ɔlman nain os, i go dɔŋ to am fɔ go pul di ak kɔmɔt na Obɛd Idɔm in os kam ɔp na di siti ɔf Devid gladi wan.
Wɛn di man dɛn we tot di ak kin tek siks stɛp go bifo, i kin mek dɛn stɔp ɛn gi wan man kaw ɛn wan smɔl- pikin kaw as sakrifays.
Na so Devid bin de dans wit ɔl in at fɔ PAPA GƆD. I bin wɛr di Ifɔd we i de dans,
we in ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn de kɛr PAPA GƆD in ak go ɔp na Jerusɛlɛm. Noto pikin nɔys dɛn bin de mek as dɛn bin de blo trɔmpɛt.
We dɛn bin de go insay di siti ɔf Devid wit PAPA GƆD in ak, Mikal we na Sɔl in gyal pikin, wach oba winda ɛn wɛn i si aw kiŋ Devid bin de dans ɛn jomp fɔ PAPA GƆD, i sɔktit pan am.
Dɛn kɛr di ak go put nain ples insay di Tɛnt we Devid bin dɔn mek fɔ am. Afta dat Devid bɔn animal as bɔn sakrifays ɛn mek pis ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD.
Afta i dɔn mek di sakrifays dɛn dɔn, i aks PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti fɔ blɛs di pipul.
Dɔn i gi ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn de wan wan lof bred, wan wandet we big lɛk kek ɛn sɔm kɔrant dɛn ɔlman, go na dɛn difrɛn os dɛn.

Leta ɔn we Devid go na os fɔ go tɛl di pipul nain os adu, Mikal we na Sɔl in gyal pikin bigin tɔk pan am. I se Devid kɔl insɛf kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl bɔt i biɛv lɛk aw ɛni rifraf go biev bay aw i bin de dans bifo in ɔfisa ɛn savant-gyal dɛn te i nekɛd insɛf bifo dɛn.
Devid ansa am se i du so fɔ PAPA GƆD. I se ɛn i go du so bikɔs PAPA GƆD si se i bɛtɛ fɔ mek am kiŋ fɔ PAPA GƆD in pipul dat na di Izrɛlayt dɛn pas fɔ mek Sɔl ɔ ɛni in fambul bi kiŋ.
Devid se in go biev so ɛnitɛm ɛn nɔ maynd fɔ mek Mikal luk am se i fulish bɔt di savant - gyal dɛn we Mikal de tɔk bɔt go rɛspɛkt am.
So Mikal we na Sɔl in gyal pikin nɔ ɛva bɔn te i day.
Wɛn Kiŋ Devid dɔn sidɔm fayn nain Pales ɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn mek i gɛt kolat bikɔs di ɛnimi dɛn rawnd am nɔ de ambɔg am igen,
i tɛl Nethan di prɔfɛt se in sidɔm saful insay siriɔs os we dɛn bil wit trɔŋ trɔŋ bod dɔn PAPA GƆD in ak in sidɔm na Tɛnt.
Nethan ansa am se mek i jɛs du wetin i fil fɔ du as PAPA GƆD de wit am.
Bɔt da sem nɛt de PAPA GƆD tɔk to Nethan.
I se “Go to mi pikin Devid ɛn tɛl am se mi se fɔ aks am if nain go bil os fɔ mi.
Tɛl am se frɔm we a pul di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt te naw we a de tɔk to yu so, a nɔ tap insay os.
Tɛl am se frɔm we a de muf muf wit di Izrɛlayt dɛn, a nɔ wande aks dɛn lida dɛn we a se fɔ rul dɛn wetindu dɛn nɔ bil os wit trɔŋ bod fɔ mi.”
I se Nethan fɔ go tɛl in pikin Devid se in PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, i mek i lɛf fɔ mɛn ship ɛn mek i bi rula fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn. I se Nethan fɔ tɛl Devid se,
in dɔn de wit am ɔl di tɛm ɛn dɔn ivin dɔnawe wit Devid in ɛnimi dɛn fɔ am. I se i go mek Devid femɔs lɛk ɛni ɔda femɔs pɔsin na di wɔl.
I se in go mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn sidɔm gud na di land we i gi dɛn fɔ bi dɛn yon, so dat nɔbɔdi ɛn natin nɔ go ambɔg dɛn. I se bad pipul nɔ go buli dɛn igen lɛk aw dɛn bi de du fɔs
di tɛm we i mek jɔj dɛn fɔ de rul di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɛn i go mek in ɛnimi dɛn nɔ ambɔg am igen

I tɛl Nethan fɔ tɛl Devid se nainsɛf PAPA GƆD de tɛl am se, in, PAPA GƆD se in go mek Devid in os bi kiŋ os. I se wɛn Devid in tɛm go dɔn dɔn ɛn i dɔn day, i go mek shɔ se na Devid in blɔd go bi kiŋ ɛn na so Devid in jɛnareshɔn dɛn go bi kiŋ te go.
I se na da in blɔd de go bil os fɔ am ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go fɛt am fɔ bi kiŋ. I go bi kiŋ sote go.
I se in go tan lɛk papa to am ɛn tek am fɔ in bɔypikin. I se if i ambɔg am, i go bit am lɛk aw papa de bit in pikin
bɔt i nɔ go lɛf am to insɛf lɛk aw i bin du Sɔl we i pul fɔ mek Devid bi kiŋ.
I se Devid go mɔs gɛt wan pɔsin fɔ bi kiŋ pan ɔl in jɛnareshɔn ɛn in famili go rul sote go.
Nethan insɛf go tɛl Devid ɔl wetin i yɛri.
Wɛn Devid yɛri dis, i go sidɔm na di Tɛnt usay di ak de ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD. I se: “Udat na mi PAPA GƆD? Ɛn udat na mi famili we yu dɔn du ɔl dis fɔ wi?
PAPA GƆD, i tan lɛk wetin yu dɔn du nɔ du fɔ yu, yu tɔk bɔt tin dɛn we yu go gɛt fɔ du bambay. PAPA GƆD, yu go trit ɔdinari mɔtalman so?
E PAPA GƆD wetin igen poman lɛk Devid fɔ se. Yu no mi gud gud wan.
As na wetin yu wan du ɛn we yu dɔn tɔk se yu go du am, yu du wetin yu want ɛn lɛ a no wetin yu wan du.
E PAPA GƆD, yu big! Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we tan lɛk yu ɛn na yu na di waŋren PAPA GƆD we wi no.

Us ɔda pipul tan lɛk di Izrɛlayt dɛn to yu? Na udat dɛn yu bay bak fɔ bi yu yon pipul? Na dɛn de mek ɔlman de fred ɛn rɛspɛkt yu naw we yu ple bɔku wɔnda ɛn pul dɛn neshɔn dɛn ɛn dɛn gɔd dɛn na dɛn an wɛn yu bin dɔn pul dɛn na Ijipt.
Yu dɔn tek di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ bi yu yon pipul sote go ɛn PAPA GƆD, dɛnsɛf dɔn tek yu fɔ bi dɛn PAPA GƆD.
“E PAPA GƆD du wetin yu dɔn se yu go du fɔ mi ɛn mi famili. Na yu dɔn se so, so du am mek pipul kɔle pan yu sote go.
Dat go mek dɛn se PAPA GƆD we na GƆD Ɔlmayti na GƆD fɔ Izrɛl ɛn yu pikin Devid ɛn ɔl udat de fala am nɔ gɛt natin fɔ wɔri bɔt.
E PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti di GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship, yu dɔn tɛl yu pikin Devid se yu go mek in ɛn in pipul bi kiŋ, na dat mek a gɛt maynd fɔ pre dis kayn we to yu.
E PAPA GƆD, yu na GƆD! Yu de du wetin yu se ɛn na yu dɔn prɔmis mi ɔl dɛn gud tin ya.
So duya blɛs mi pipul so dat dɛn go de du wetin yu want ɔltɛm bikɔs na yu PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk ɛn na yu go blɛs ɔlman na mi famili.”
As di tɛm de go, Devid atak di Filistin dɛn igen ɛn win dɛn dɔn i tek Mɛthɛg Ama kɔmɔt na di Filistin dɛn an.
Devid win di Moabayt dɛnsɛf. I mek di Moabayt dɛn lidɔm bay layn dɔn i kil tu pam tri na di layn te i dɔn. Leta ɔn, ɔl di Moabayt dɛn we Devid nɔ kil tɔn bɔy fɔ am ɛn de gi am ɛnitin we i aks fɔ.
Dɔn igen, we Adadeza bin wan sho se i gɛt pawa na di Riva Yufretis, Devid go fɛt wit am de ɛn win am. Adadeza na Riɔb in bɔypikin ɛn na kiŋ fɔ di Sirian Stet na Zoba.
Devid kapchɔ wan tawzin sɛvin ɔndrɛd man we de rayd ɔs ɛn karej ɛn twɛnti tawzin ɔdinari sojaman. I disloket ɔl in ɔs dɛn bɔt lɛf wan ɔndrɛd fɔ am.
Wɛn di Sirian dɛn na Damaskɔs kam fɔ ɛp Adadeza we na kiŋ na Zoba, Devid kil dɛn twɛnti-tu tawzin.
I mek barik dɛn usay di Sirian dɛn de na Damaskɔs dɔn dɛnsɛf tɔn lɛk bɔy to am ɛn de gi am ɛnitin we i aks fɔ. PAPA GƆD mek Devid de win ɛnisay we i go.
Devid siz Adadeza in ɔfisa dɛn big shild dɛn we dɛn mek wit gold ɛn kɛr dɛn go Jerusɛlɛm.
I tek bɔku bras kɔmɔt na Teba ɛn Berothay we na tu pan di siti dɛn we Adadeza gɛt.
Wɛn Tow we na kiŋ na Ɛmath yɛri bɔt di win we Devid win Adadeza in wanol ami,
i sɛn in bɔypikin we na Joram fɔ go tɛl Kiŋ Devid adu ɛn kɔŋratyulet am fɔ we i bit Adadeza bikɔs dɛn tu bin dɔn de fɛt. Joram go gi prɛzɛnt wit tin dɛn we dɛn mek wit gold, silva ɛn bras.
Kiŋ Devid dɛdiket di tin dɛn to PAPA GƆD so dat i kin yuz dɛn fɔ PAPA GƆD in biznɛs. Na so i bin du wit ɔl di gold ɛn silva tin dɛn we i kin siz wɛn i bit ɛni neshɔn lɛkɛ,
Idɔm ɛn Moab, di Amonayt ɛn Filistin dɛn ɛn Amalɛk. I ivin dɛdiket ɔl di tin dɛn we i siz na Adadeza we na Riɔb in bɔypikin in an we na di kiŋ na Zoba.
Devid kam femɔs mɔ bikɔs afta dat nain i kil etin tawzin Idɔmayt na di Sɔl Vali.
I put barik dɛn bak na Idɔm ɛn ɔl di Idɔmayt dɛn tɔn in bɔy. PAPA GƆD mek Devid bit ɛnisay we i go.
Devid rul ɔl Izrɛl ɛn i bin de du wetin fia ɛn rayt fɔ ɔlman de.
Joab we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin na bin kɔmanda fɔ in ami dɔn na Jɛoshafat we na Ailud in bɔypikin na bin di kiŋ in spoksman;
Zedɔk we na Aitɔb in bɔypikin ɛn Aimelɛk we na Abiata in bɔypikin na bin de man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin; Seraya na bin di sɛktri;
Bɛnaya we na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin bin de inchaj ɔf di Kɛrɛthayt ɛn Pɛlɛtayt dɛn; ɛn Devid in bɔypikin dɛn na bin man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
Wande, Devid jɛs grap aks if ɛnibɔdi lɛf pan Sɔl in famili we i kin du gud to fɔseka Jonɛthan.
I kam bi se wan bɔy bin de na Sɔl in famili os we nem Ziba. Dɛn tɛl am se Devid wan si am. We i go, Devid aks am if in na Ziba. I ansa se yɛs, in na Ziba.
Di kiŋ naw aks am if nɔbɔdi nɔ de na Sɔl in famili we i go du gud to, lɛk aw i dɔn tɛl PAPA GƆD. Ziba tɛl am se, Jonɛthan gɛt wan bɔypikin na dɛn os we in tu fut ambɔg.
Di kiŋ aks usay i de. Ziba ansa se i tap to Maka we na Amiɛl in bɔypikin na Lodɛba
So Devid sɛn go tek am na Maka we na Amiɛl in os na Lodɛba
Wɛn Mɛfiboshɛth we na Jonɛthan in bɔypikin, dat na Sɔl in grampikin kam to Devid, Mɛfiboshɛth baw fɔ sho se in de fɔ Devid.

Devid tɛl am fɔ fil fri ɛn nɔ fred. I tɛl Mɛfiboshɛth se bikɔs ɔf in papa we na Jonɛthan, in go du gud to Mɛfiboshɛth. I tɛl Mɛfiboshɛth bak se ɔl di land we Sɔl we nain grampa bin gɛt go bi in yon ɛn in go de it na tebul wit am ɔltɛm.
Mɛfiboshɛth nɔ biliv in yes. I baw bak to di kiŋ ɛn aks am wetin mek i fɔ bisin bɔt am so we in no se i nɔ min natin lɛk day dɔg.
Dɛn di kiŋ kɔl Ziba we na bin Sɔl in bɔy fɔ tɛl am se i dɔn gi in masta in grampikin bak ɔl wetin na bin Sɔl ɛn in famili dɛn yon.

I tɛl Ziba se in, in bɔypikin, dɛn ɛn dɛn wokman dɛn fɔ mek fam na di land ɛn briŋ di tin dɛn we dɛn avɛst kam to Mɛfiboshɛth so dat Mɛfiboshɛth go gɛt tin fɔ it. I se as fɔ Mɛfiboshɛth we nain masta in grampikin in go de it na tebul wit am ɔltɛm. I bi se Ziba bin gɛt fiftin bɔypikin ɛn twɛnti wokman.
Ziba ansa di kiŋ se i go du ɛnitin we di kiŋ ɔda am fɔ du. So frɔm da tɛm de Mɛfiboshɛth bin de it wit di Devid nain tebul lɛkɛ se in na wan pan di kiŋ in bɔypikin.
Mɛfiboshɛth bin gɛt wan smɔl bɔypikin we nem Mayka. Ziba in wanol os bin de wok fɔ Mɛfiboshɛth.
Na so Mɛfiboshɛth tek tap na Jerusɛlɛm bikɔs i bin de it wit Kiŋ Devid na tebul ɔltɛm ɛn i tu fut bin ambɔg.
Afta sɔm tɛm di Amonayt dɛn kiŋ day ɛn nain bɔypikin we na Enɔn kam bi kiŋ.
Devid tink se i fayn fɔ lɛ i du gud to Enɔn we na Neash in pikin lɛk aw in papa bin de du gud to am. Dat mek Devid sɛn pipul fɔ go tɛl Enɔn ɔsh fɔ in papa we day. Wɛn di man dɛn we Devid sɛn rich de,
di Amonayt bigman dɛn aks Enɔn if i tink se na bikɔs Devid rɛspɛkt in papa mek i sɛn pipul fɔ kam tɛl ɔsh. Dɛn tɛl am se Devid sɛn di man dɛn fɔ kam wach aw di land tan so dat i go ovathro am.
So Enɔn insɛf grip Devid in man dɛn, shev af pat pan dɛn biabia, kɔt dɛn klos dɛn midul te rich di wes ɛn lɛf dɛn fɔ go bak.
Wɛn Devid yɛri dis, i sɛn ɔda man dɛn fɔ go mit dɛn fɔs wan dɛn bikɔs dɛn trit dɛn lɛk fulman. Di kiŋ se dɛn fɔ tap na Jɛriko te dɛn biabia dɔn gro bak bifo dɛn kam bak na Jerusɛlɛm.
Wɛn di Amonayt dɛn si se dɛn dɔn krach Devid in krɔkrɔ, dɛn aya twɛnti tawzin ɔdinari Sirian sojaman kɔmɔt na Bɛth Riɔb ɛn Zoba, di kiŋ na Meaka wit wan tawzin man ɛn twɛlv tawzin man bak frɔm Tab.
Wɛn Devid yɛri dat insɛf sɛn Joab ɛn ɔl in man dɛn we kin fɛt fɔ go mit dɛn.

Di Amonayt dɛn arenj dɛnsɛf ɛn go mit di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ fɛt na di siti in get dɔn di Sirian dɛn we kɔmɔt Bɛth Riɔb ɛn Zoba wit di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Tab ɛn di man dɛn wit Meaka dɛn lɛf to dɛnsɛf na di fil.
Joab notis se sɔm pan dɛn bin de bifo dɛn ɛn sɔm de biɛn dɛn; so i pik sɔm pan in bɛst fɛt man dɛn ɛn arenj dɛn fɔ fɛt di Sirian dɛn.
I mek Abishay in brɔda de inchaj ɔf di ɔda wan dɛn ɛn arenj dɛn fɔ fɛt di Amonayt dɛn.
Joab tɛl Abishay se if i tan lɛk di Sirian dɛn wan win dɛn, Abishay fɔ go ɛp am fɛt bɔt if in si se di Amonayt dɛn wan win Abishay, in go go ɛp am.
Dɛn kɔrej dɛnsɛf nɔ fɔ giv ɔp bɔt lɛ dɛn fɛt lɛk man fɔ dɛn pipul ɛn fɔ PAPA GƆD. I pre se mek PAPA GƆD du wetin i want fɔ du.
So Joab ɛn di man dɛn we de wit am go fɛt di Sirian dɛn ɛn dɛn mek di Sirian dɛn rɔnawe.
Wɛn di Amonayt dɛn si se di Sirian dɛn de rɔnawe, dɛnsɛf chuk spid lɛf Abishay dɛn ɛn go bak insay di siti. So Joab ɛn in man dɛn tɔn bak go na Jerusɛlɛm.
Pan ɔl we di Sirian dɛn si se di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn win dɛn, i nɔ du fɔ dɛn, dɛn go gɛda bak.
Dis tɛm ya, Adadeza sɛn fɔ mɔ Sirian dɛn we de biɛn Riva Yufretis; dɛn gɛda na Elam ɛn na Shobak we na di kɔmanda na Adadeza in ami bin de lid dɛn.
Wɛn Devid yɛri dat, insɛf gɛda ɔl in fɛt man dɛn na Izrɛl, krɔs Riva Jɔdan ɛn go mit dɛn na Elam. Di Sirian dɛn arenj dɛnsɛf fɔ go fɛt wit Devid.
Bɔt aw dɛn gɛda na so dɛn skata. Devid ɛn in man dɛn kil sɛvin ɔndrɛd man wit dɛn ɔs ɛn karej ɛn foti tawzin pan di man dɛn we kin rayd ɔs. I kil Shobak we na dɛn ami kɔmanda ɛn na de i day.
Wɛn ɔl di kiŋ dɛn we bin tek Adadeza fɔ bi dɛn bra si aw Izrɛl win dɛn, dɛn go mek pis wantɛm wit di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɛn bigin du wetin dɛn want. Frɔm da tɛm de di Sirian dɛn nɔ ɛp di Amonayt dɛn igen
Wan tɛm we dɛn kiŋ kin go fɛt, Devid sɛn Joab, in yon man dɛn ɛn di wanol Izrɛlayt ami fɔ go fɛt. Dɛn fɛt wit di Amonayt dɛn, masaka dɛn ɛn tek Raba na dɛn an. Bɔt Devid in lɛf na Jerusɛlɛm.
Wan ivintɛm, Devid grap na bed ɛn bigin waka pantap in os in ruf. We i de pantap de, i si wan uman de was. Na so di uman fayn.
So Devid sɛn fɔ go fɛnɔt udat i bi. So di man we i sɛn tɛl am se i fil se di uman na Bathshiba we na Iliam in gyal pikin ɛn we na Yuraya in wɛf.
Devid sɛn pipul fɔ go fɔ am ɛn wɛn i kam dɛn tu lidɔm da nɛt de. Bathshiba bin jɛs dɔn di spɛshal was we i fɔ was afta in piriɔd. We in ɛn Devid dɔn, i go bak usay i de slip.
Leta ɔn di uman fɛnɔt se i gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn i sɛn go tɛl Devid.
Devid naw kam sɛn tɛl Joab fɔ sɛn Yuraya we na Itayt kam to am. Joab du wetin i se ɛn sɛn Yuraya to Devid.
Wɛn Yuraya rich, Devid aks bɔt di fɛt ɛn aw ɔlman de du.
Dɔn i tɛl Yuraya fɔ go nain os ɛn rilaks smɔl. As Yuraya de go, di kiŋ sɛn prɛzɛnt biɛn am.
Bɔt Yuraya nɔ go nain os. I slip na di kiŋ in os domɔt wit ɔl di kiŋ in wokman dɛn.
Wɛn Devid yɛri se Yuraya nɔ go nain os, i aks am wetindu ɛn se i bin min to se i go wan go nain os afta i dɔn lɛf de fɔ lɔŋ.
Yuraya se aw in go go nain os go it ɛn drink ɛn lidɔm wit in wɛf we di ak, in bɔs Joab ɛn di ɔda sojaman dɛn na Izrɛl ɛn Juda de na kamp na kol. I swɛ to Devid se in nɔ go ɛva du dat.
Dɛn Devid tɛl am se lɛ i wet te di nɛks de bifo i tɔn bak. So Yuraya lɛf na Jerusɛlɛm da de de te di nɛks de.
Devid invayt am fɔ it ɛn drink wit am ɛn mek shɔ se i chak. Bɔt ivintɛm Yuraya go lidɔm nain mata to di kiŋ in wokman dɛn ɛn nɔ gri fɔ go nain os.
Na mɔnin, Devid rayt lɛta we i gi Yuraya fɔ kɛr go gi Joab.
Insay di lɛta i se: “Put Yuraya frɔnt usay di fɛt wam. Lɛf am de mek dɛn kil am.”
So as Joab de wach usay di fɛt wam, i jɛs sɛn Yuraya de.
Ɛn as di man dɛn we bin de fɛt brakɛt Joab in man dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn nɔ tek di siti, dɛn kil sɔm pan Devid in man dɛn ɛn Yuraya na bin wan pan dɛn.
Joab sɛn go tɛl Devid aw di fɛt bi.
Bɔt i tɛl di man we i sɛn se we i dɔn tɔk, bɔt aw di fɛt bi,
di kiŋ go vɛks ɛn aks wetin mek dɛn go nia di siti so fɔ fɛt. Joab se i go mɔs aks if dɛn nɔ bin no se dɛn go shut dɛn oba di wɔl.

Joab se i go aks if dɛn nɔ bin mɛmba aw da uman na Thibɛz bin sɛn big ston oba wɔl we kil Abimɛlɛk we na Gidiɔn in bɔypikin we mek i day na Thibɛz. Joab se we i dɔn blez dɔn, di mɛsenja fɔ tɛl am naw se Yuraya di Itayt man insɛf day.
Di man lɛf fɔ go ɛn wɛn i rich i tɛl Devid ɔl wetin Joab tɛl am fɔ tɔk.
Di mɛsenja tɛl Devid se di Amonayt dɛn bin dɔn de win dɛn so dɛn push dɛn bak te rich di siti get in domɔt.
I se dɔn dɛn sɛn aro pan dɛn oba di wɔl we mek sɔm pan di kiŋ in man dɛn day. Di mɛsenja tɛl Devid se Yuraya di Itayt man insɛf day.
Devid sɛn di man fɔ tɛl Joab se dat nɔ fɔ mek in at pwɛl bikɔs ɛnibɔdi kin day na wa. Devid se i fɔ tɛl Joab se mek i tray fɔ pwɛl di siti. I tɛl di mɛsenja se fɔ tɔk so mek Joab nɔ giv ɔp.
Wɛn Yuraya in wɛf yɛri se in man day, i kray bɔku ɛn munin fɔ am.
Wɛn i pul munin, Devid sɛn go tek am kam nain os ɛn i bi in wɛf ɛn bɔn bɔypikin fɔ am. Bɔt dat mek PAPA GƆD vɛks bad fɔ wetin Devid du.
PAPA GƆD sɛn Nethan to Devid. Wɛn i rich to Devid i pul wan stori bɔt wan jɛntri man ɛn wan poman fɔ am.
I se di jɛntri man bin gɛt bɔku ship ɛn kaw,

bɔt di poman nɔ bin gɛt bɛtɛ tin pas wan smɔl uman ship we i bin bay. Bɔt dis poman mɛn am fayn ɛn mek i gro ɔp wit in yon pikin dɛn. I se di poman bin de sheb di smɔl it we i gɛt wit am ɛn bin de mek dɛn ɔltu de drink na di sem kɔp, i bin ivin de mek i lidɔm nain an fɔ slip. I bin de trit am lɛk se nain gyal pikin.
Nethan se wande we di jɛntriman gɛt trenja, i nɔ tek pan in yon ship ɔ kaw fɔ kuk fɔ di trenja, i sɛn go tek dis poman in waŋren uman ship ɛn kuk am fɔ di trenja.
We Devid yɛri di stori, i vɛks pan di jɛntriman. I tɛl Nethan se wans PAPA GƆD de, di jɛntriman fit fɔ day.
I se di jɛntri man fɔ pe fo tɛm mɔ fɔ di poman i uman ship bikɔs i nɔ sɔri fɔ di poman sɛf.
As i tɔk dɔn so nain Nethan tɛl am se nain na di sem wan we biev so. I tɛl am se PAPA GƆD, di GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship se fɔ tɛl am se i mek am kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn pul am kɔmɔt na Sɔl in an.
I mek i tɔn bɔs nain masta in os ɛn lɛf ɔl in wɛf dɛn gi am. I gi am wanol Izrɛl ɛn Juda fɔ rul ɛn if ɔl dat nɔ bin du fɔ am sɛf, i bin fɔ gi am mɔ.

Nethan se PAPA GƆD se fɔ aks Devid wetindu i lɛf fɔ du wetin in tɛl am fɔ du bifo dat i du bad frɔnt PAPA GƆD in fes. I kil Yuraya we na Itayt ɛn tek in wɛf nain an. I mek di Amonayt dɛn kil am fɔ am.
So, bikɔs ɔf wetin i du, pipul go de day wɔwɔ nain os sins i fɔgɛt bɔt PAPA GƆD ɛn tek Yuraya we na Itayt in wɛf fɔ bi in yon.
Nethan se PAPA GƆD se fɔ tɛl am se frɔm insay in os na de i go bigin gɛt waala. I se i go de luk korokoro wan we pɔsin we klos to am go tek in wɛf dɛn lidɔm wit dɛn frɔnt in fes san, santɛm.
PAPA GƆD se ɛnti na kɔnain du in yon. In naw go du am gbagbaode usay ɔlman na Izrɛl go de si.
We Devid yɛri ɔl dis, i se in dɔn sin to PAPA GƆD. Nethan ansa am se PAPA GƆD dɔn fɔgiv am ɛn nɔ go mek i day.
Bɔt bikɔs i du so, i dɔn mek PAPA GƆD in ɛnimi dɛn nɔ de luk am wit bɛtɛ yay ɛn di pikin we Bathshiba go bɔn go day.
We Nethan dɔn tɔk dɔn, i go na os. We Nethan dɔn go nain os, PAPA GƆD mek di pikin we Yuraya in wɛf bɔn sik bad bad wan.
Devid fast ɛn kray de beg PAPA GƆD mek di pikin wɛl. I bin ivin de lidɔm na grɔn insay in os wɛn i kin de beg PAPA GƆD.
Di big wan dɛn nain os kin go tɔk to am mek i grap na grɔn bɔt i nɔba du am ɛn it sɛf i nɔ bin de it.

Afta sɛvin de, di pikin day. Devid in wokman dɛn bin de fred fɔ tɛl am se di pikin dɔn day. Dɛn tɛl dɛnsɛf se di wan we di pikin nɔ day yet we dɛn de tɔk to Devid i nɔ yɛri, nɔto we di pikin dɔn day i go lisin to dɛn. Dɛn fred se Devid go du sɔntin we dɛn nɔ go lɛk.
Devid fent se in wokman dɛn de tɔk, tɔk kwayɛt wan to dɛnsɛf ɛn gɛs se di pikin dɔn day. So i aks dɛn if di pikin dɔn day. Dɛn ansa am se yɛs, i dɔn day.
As dɛn tɔk so, nain Devid grap na grɔn. I was insɛf, put pafyum, chenj in klos ɛn go insay PAPA GƆD in os ɛn go wɔship am. We i dɔn, i go nain yon os ɛn aks dɛn fɔ gi am it fɔ it.
In wokman dɛn aks am wetindu i de biev so. Dɛn se di tɛm we di pikin de, i bin de fast ɛn kray bɔt da tɛm de we di pikin dɔn day, i grap it.
Devid ansa se di tɛm we di pikin nɔ day yet, i bin de fast ɛn kray as i bin de tink to insɛf se sɔntɛm PAPA GƆD go sɔri fɔ am ɛn nɔ mek di pikin nɔ day.
Devid se we di pikin dɔn day wetin i fɔ fast fɔ. I aks in wokman dɛn if i ebul briŋ am bak. I se in go day go mit di pikin bɔt di pikin kant kam bak to am.
Devid lidɔm wit Bathshiba bak fɔ koks am. I tek in ɛn bɔn bɔbɔ we dɛn gi nem, Sɔlɔmɔn. PAPA GƆD bin lɛk am;
ɛn bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin lɛk am, i sɛn wɔd to Nethan se dɛn fɔ gi am nem Jɛdidaya.
Da sem tɛm de, nain Joab fɛt wit di Amonayt dɛn na Raba ɛn kapchɔ usay di kiŋ bin de.
Joab sɛn mɛsenja dɛn fɔ go tɛl Devid se in dɔn fɛt na Raba ɛn dɔn kɔt dɛn wata,
so Devid fɔ gɛda di balans trup ɛn dɛn fɔ go sɔrawnd di siti ɛn kapchɔ am. Joab se if Devid nɔ du so, in go kapchɔ di siti ɛn gi am in nem.
So Devid gɛda di wanol ami, sɛn dɛn na Raba usay dɛn ebul atak ɛn kapchɔ am.
I pul di kiŋ in krawn nain ed ɛn da krawn de bin we bɔt sɔm tati-fo kilo gold ɛn i bin gɛt fayn fayn miniral ston dɛn pan am. I wɛr am nain ed ɛn tek bɔku ɔda tin dɛn kɔmɔt na di siti.
I pul ɔl di pipul we bin de de ɛn mek dɛn lebra wit so ɛn pikaks ɛn fɔ mek dɛn de le blɔk fɔ am. Na so i du na ɔl di Amonayt siti dɛn dɔn Devid wit di wanol ami tɔn bak na Jerusɛlɛm.
As tɛm de go, Amɔn we na wan pan Devid in bɔypikin fɔl fɔ in stɛpsista we so fayn ɛn na Absalɔm we na Devid in ɔda bɔypikin in yon bɛlɛ bɔn sista.
Amɔn bin de fɔl fɔ dis in sista bad bad wan te i sik. Tama na bin vajin ɛn i tan lɛk se Amɔn nɔ go ebul fɔ du wetin in wan du.
Amɔn bin gɛt wan padi we nem Jonadab we na Shimea dat na Devid in brɔda, in bɔypikin. Jonadab bin gɛt sɛns ɛn sabi aw fɔ dil wit dɛn kayn kes de.
I aks Amɔn fɔ tɛl am wetin mek in we na kiŋ pikin fɔ de fiba dedewek ɛvri mɔnin. Amɔn tɛl am se i de fɔl bad fɔ Tama we na Absalɔm in bɛlɛ bɔn sista bɔt nɔ no wetin fɔ du.

Jonadab tɛl Amɔn se i fɔ go lidɔm na bed ɛn fɔm sik dɔn we in papa kam luk am i fɔ tɛl am se i want mek in sista we na Tama kuk kam gi am fɔ it. Jonadab se Amɔn fɔ tɛl in papa se i want Tama fɔ kam kuk di it bifo am mek i de wach aw i de du am ɛn mek i go fid am we i dɔn.
Amɔn insɛf du wetin Jonadab se ɛn go lidɔm de fɔm sik. Wɛn di kiŋ kam luk am, i tɛl am ɔl wetin Jonadab se i fɔ tɛl am dat na fɔ mek Tama mek it fɔ am fɔ it frɔnt in fes ɛn fid am we i dɔn.
Devid sɛn wɔd to Tama we bin de nain yon os. I se Tama fɔ go nain brɔda Amɔn in os so dat i go go mek tin fɔ am fɔ it.
Tama insɛf go nain brɔda Amɔn in os fɔ go mek it fɔ am bɔt Amɔn in lidɔm nɔmɔ. Tama miks di flawa fɔ mek bred bifo Amɔn bifo i bek di bred.
Bɔt wɛn di bred dɔn bek dɔn we Tama sav am, i nɔ gri it. I se Tama fɔ mek ɔlman go na do so ɔlman go na do lɛf dɛn.
Na da tɛm de Amɔn tɛl Tama fɔ kɛr di it insay in rum so dat i go fid am. Tama insɛf kɛr di bred we i bek to in brɔda Amɔn insay in rum.
Bɔt as i wan gi am fɔ it nain i grip am ɛn se mek dɛn lidɔm.
Tama beg am se mek in we nain brɔda nɔ du dat. I se mek i nɔ fɔs am as na bad tin dat we dɛn nɔ fɔ yɛri se bi na Izrɛl.
I se in nɔ go gɛt fes sɛf fɔ waka na trit ɛn ɔlman nɔ go luk Amɔn wit wan bɛtɛ yay na Izrɛl. I se duya mek Amɔn go aks di kiŋ ɛn i go mek dɛn ɔltu mared.
Bɔt ɔl di tɛm we Tama de tɔk na fɔ natin. Sins Amɔn gɛt trɛnk pas am, i jomp pan am ɛn rep am.
Afta dat, Amɔn et Tama bad bad wan. In fakt sɛf i kam et am pas aw i bin lɛk am so i ala pan am fɔ grap ɛn go na do.
Tama nɔ ɔndastand so i tɛl am se if i de drɛb am lɛk dɔg, i go de du wɔs tin pas wetin i dɔn du to am. Bɔt usay! I nɔ lisin am sɛf.
I kɔl in bɔdigad ɛn tɛl am fɔ put di uman na do ɛn bɔlt in do.
So di bɔdigad insɛf put di uman na do ɛn bɔlt di do. Tama bin wɛr fayn gawn we dɛn wok lɛk aw kiŋ pikin we nɔ no man yet kin drɛs.
Afta Amɔn dɔn pliz insɛf, Tama rɔb ashis nain ed ɛn chɛr di gawn we i bin wɛr dɔn i put in an nain ed, kɔmɔt na di os de kray as i de go.
As in bɛlɛ bɔn brɔda si am i aks am if nain stɛpbrɔda Amɔn dɔn vajinet am. I koks Tama ɛn tɛl am nɔ fɔ kip dat nain at as dɛn na brɔda ɛn sista. I mek Tama tap nain os lɛkɛ udat ɔltin dɔn fɔ.
Wɛn Kiŋ Devid yɛri ɔl wetin bi, i vɛks bad.
Absalɔm nɔ se fiŋ to Amɔn. I et Amɔn bikɔs i trit Tama lɛk rare gyal.
Afta tu ia, we Absalɔm in wokman dɛn we kin pul in ship dɛn wul go na Beal Ezɔ nia di bɔda na Ifrem, i invayt ɔl di kiŋ in bɔypikin dɛn fɔ go de.
I go aks di kiŋ insɛf fɔ kam wit in ɔfisa dɛn as in wokman dɛn we de kɔt di ship dɛn wul go de de.
Bɔt di kiŋ nɔ gri go. I se if dɛn ɔl go, na mɔ yagba fɔ Absalɔm. Pan ɔl we Absalɔm koks am fɔ go, i nɔ gri bɔt pre mek PAPA GƆD blɛs am.
Absalɔm gri wit am bɔt aks di kiŋ se if in nɔ de go, mek in brɔda Amɔn in go wit dɛn. Di kiŋ aks am wetindu.
Absalɔm koks am te i gri mek Amɔn go wit in ɔda bɔypikin dɛn.
Absalɔm gi in wokman dɛn ɔda se wɛn Amɔn dɔn drink bɔku wayn ɛn de fil fayn, dɛn fɔ wap am ɛn kil am. I se dɛn nɔ fɔ skyad, dɛn fɔ mek maynd as nain gi dɛn ɔda.
So Absalɔm in wokman dɛnsɛf kil Amɔn lɛkɛ aw Absalɔm ɔda dɛn. Dat mek ɔl di kiŋ in ɔda bɔypikin dɛn jomp pantap dɛn myul dɛn ɛn rɔnawe.
We dɛn de na rod de go nain Devid yɛri se Absalɔm dɔn kil ɔl in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn nɔn pan dɛn nɔ lɛf.
Di kiŋ insɛf grap chɛr in klos fɔ sho aw i sɔri ɛn lidɔm na grɔn. In wokman dɛnsɛf fala am ɛn chɛr dɛn klos fɔ sho aw dɛnsɛf sɔri.

Bɔt Jonadab we na Shimea dat na Devid in brɔda in bɔypikin tɛl di kiŋ se lɛ i nɔ wɔri nɔto ɔl in bɔypikin dɛn dɛn kil. I se na Amɔn nɔmɔ day as Absalɔm bin dɔn de tɔk am frɔm di de we Amɔn rep in sista we na Tama.
I se lɛ kiŋ Devid nɔ lisin we dɛn se ɔl in bɔypikin dɛn day as na lay. Na Amɔn in waŋren day.

Da tɛm de we dɛn de tɔk, Absalɔm insɛf bin dɔn rɔnawe. Na di tɔk dɛn de tɔk we di sikyɔriti we bin de dyuti es in ed ɔp ɛn si bɔku pipul na di rod we de wɛst frɔm usay i tinap de go dɔŋ di il in sayd. Di sikyɔriti go tɛl di kiŋ se in si pipul to usay Oronaim de na di il in sayd.
Jonadab tɛl di kiŋ se nain bɔypikin dɛn de kam so jɛs lɛkɛ aw i bin tɛl am.
Bay di tɛm we dɛn de tɔk dɔn, di kiŋ in bɔypikin dɛn bɔs. Na so dɛn de kray lawd lawd wan. Di kiŋ insɛf ɛn ɔl in wokman dɛn jɔyn dɛn fɔ kray bita bita wan.
Kiŋ Devid munin fɔ Amɔn fɔ lɔŋ. Bɔt Absalɔm in rɔnawe go to Talmay we na Amiɔd in bɔypikin. Talmay na bin di kiŋ na Gɛshɔ.
We Absalɔm rɔnawe, i go na Gɛshɔ ɛn tap de fɔ tri ia.
Bay da tɛm de di kiŋ bin dɔn de mis Absalɔm naw as i bin dɔn de tek kɔrej afta Amɔn day.
Joab we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin no bɔt aw di kiŋ bin dɔn de mis Absalɔm.
So i sɛn sɔmbɔdi go briŋ wan uman we gɛt sɛns we de na Tɛkoa kam. Wɛn di uman kam, i tɛl di uman fɔ wɛr munin, nɔ kom in ia ɛn nɔ rɔb ɔyl lɛkɛ udat dɔn te we i de munin.
Joab tɛl am wetin i fɔ go tɛl di kiŋ.
Wɛn di uman we kɔmɔt Tɛkoa rich to di kiŋ i butu in fes na grɔn fɔ sho se i rɛspɛkt di kiŋ ɛn aks am fɔ ɛp am.
Di kiŋ aks am wetin nain prɔblɛm. Nain i tɛl di kiŋ se i nɔ gɛt man, in man dɔn day.
Bɔt dɛn ɔltu bin bɔn tu bɔypikin we bin de fɛt dɛnsɛf wande na fil ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de fɔ pat dɛn so di wan wap in kɔmpin ɛn kil am.

I se ɔl in fambul dɔn grap se i fɔ gi dɛn di wan we kil in brɔda mek dɛnsɛf kil am fɔ we i kil in brɔda ɛn na so dɛn go kil di wan we lɛf fɔ gɛt di prɔpati. I se dɛn go ɔt in faya ɛn dat go min se in man nɔ go gɛt nɔbɔdi na wɔl fɔ mɛmba am.
Di kiŋ se mek i go na os ɛn dat in go si to in stren.
Bɔt di uman we kɔmɔt Tɛkoa tɛl di kiŋ se in ɛn in papa in pipul go tek di blem fɔ we i nɔ gri mek in fambul dɛn kil di waŋren bɔbɔ we lɛf bɔt di kiŋ in famili nɔ go gɛt wan blem.
Di kiŋ ansa am se i fɔ kɛr ɛnibɔdi we ambɔg am to di kiŋ ɛn i nɔ go ambɔg am igen

Di uman tɛl di kiŋ se i fɔ tek PAPA GƆD we nain GƆD in nem fɔ swɛ se i nɔ go mek di pɔsin we fɔ kil in pikin fɔ we i kil in brɔda kil am bak. Di kiŋ swɛ se wans PAPA GƆD de, pin nɔ go krach di uman in bɔypikin.
Na da tɛm de naw, di uman beg am fɔ tɔk ɔda tin to am. Ɛn i gri. I tɛl di uman fɔ tɔk.
Di uman tɛl di kiŋ se na dat i wan du PAPA GƆD in pipul. I se di kiŋ dɔn tay insɛf bikɔs i nɔ gri fɔ mek in bɔypikin we bin rɔnawe kam bak.

I se mɔtalman tan lɛk we wata trowe na grɔn we i nɔ de gɛda bak na so ɔlman gɛt fɔ day bɔt PAPA GƆD in nɔ de lɛf nɔbɔdi fɔ day so. I se wans di pɔsin no se PAPA GƆD de, i de fɛn we fɔ drɔ da pɔsin we bin dɔn rɔnawe kam bak to am.
I se na dat mek in go tɛl di kiŋ bikɔs in fambul dɛn dɔn mek i fred bɔt in de op se we in dɔn tɛl di kiŋ so dat go mek di kiŋ si to in stren ɛn ɛp am.
I se sɔntɛm i go lisin to am ɛn pul in ɛn in bɔypikin na di man, we nɔ want dɛn fɔ gɛt dɛn prɔpati, in an ɛn mek dɛn lɔs PAPA GƆD insɛf yon prɔpati.
I pre se lɛ wetin di kiŋ dɔn tɛl am mek in at kol as di kiŋ na lɛkɛ PAPA GƆD in enjɛl we no wetin gud ɛn wetin bad, i pre bak mek PAPA GƆD we na di GƆD we Kiŋ Devid de wɔship de wit di kiŋ.
Di kiŋ tɛl di uman se i wan aks am wan kwɛshɔn we i go lɛk am fɔ ansa tru wan. Di uman se mek i aks am ɛnitin, dɔn insɛf aks am.

Di kiŋ aks am if nɔto Joab de biɛn ɔl wetin i de du so. Di uman ansa se wans in na kiŋ ɛn nɔ day yet, nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul mek am ful. I se di kiŋ rayt fɔ se Joab de biɛn ɔl wetin i de du. I tɛl di kiŋ se na Joab tɛl am fɔ tɔk ɔl wetin i tɔk.
Ɛn na bikɔs i want fɔ mek tin chenj mek i du am. I se bɔt Kiŋ Devid gɛt sɛns lɛk PAPA GƆD in enjɛl so i no ɔl wetin de bi insay di kɔntri.
Devid gri. Afta sɔm tɛm, i sɛn kɔl Joab ɛn tɛl am fɔ go briŋ in bɔypikin we na Absalɔm kam bak.
