Joab fɔdɔm bifo di kiŋ fɔ sho se i rɛspɛkt am ɛn aks PAPA GƆD fɔ blɛs di kiŋ. I se in no se di kiŋ gladi wit am bikɔs di kiŋ de du wetin i want.
So Joab go na Gɛshɔ go briŋ Absalɔm kam bak na Jerusɛlɛm.
We dɛn go na Jerusɛlɛm, Kiŋ Devid nɔ gri mek Absalɔm si am, i se mek i go nain yon os ɛn i nɔ fɔ go usay in di kiŋ de. So Absalɔm go nain os saful ɛn nɔ bɔda fɔ si di kiŋ.
Absalɔm bin fayn pas ɔlman na Izrɛl lɛk tin fɔ it. I nɔ bin gɛt wan mak nain bɔdi.
Wɛn in ia nain ed kin dɔn bɔku, i kin kɔt am wan tɛm fɔ ia ɛn wɛn i kɔt am, di ia we kɔt in wet kin bi bɔt sɔm fayv pawns bay di wet we di kiŋ se fɔ yuz.
Dɛn bin bɔn tri bɔbɔ ɛn wan titi fɔ Absalɔm. Di titi bin fayn ɛn nem Tama.
Absalɔm de na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ tu gud ia bɔt in papa we na di kiŋ nɔ gri mek i si am.
Wan tɛm naw, Absalɔm sɛn kɔl Joab mek i go sɛn am to di kiŋ bɔt Joab nɔ gri kam. Bɔt i stil sɛn kɔl am bak ɛn Joab stil nɔ gri fɔ kam.
Absalɔm nɔ du wan i nɔ du tu, i tɛl in wokman dɛn se sins Joab gɛt bali fam nia in yon fil, dɛn fɔ go put faya de. So Absalɔm in wokman dɛnsɛf go put faya na di fil.
Dat mek Joab go na Absalɔm in os fɔ go aks am wetindu in wokman dɛn go put faya nain fil.

Absalɔm se i bin sɛn kɔl Joab mek i go sɛn am to Kiŋ Devid. I se i wan mek Joab go aks di kiŋ wetindu i sɛn go pul am usay i bin de na Gɛshɔ. Absalɔm se i bin fɔ bɛtɛ if i lɛf de. I tɛl Joab se in wan si di kiŋ. I se if in dɔn du bad mek di kiŋ kil am.
Joab insɛf go to di kiŋ ɛn tɛl am wetin Absalɔm se. Di kiŋ sɛn kɔl Absalɔm. Insɛf kam fɔdɔm na grɔn bifo di kiŋ. We i grap, dɛn grip dɛnsɛf ɛn di kiŋ kis am.
Afta sɔm tɛm, Absalɔm bigin waka wit ɔs ɛn karej dɔn i kin gɛt fifti man fɔ de bifo am fɔ klia di rod.

I grap kwik wan mɔnin go tinap na di rod we fɔ waka go na di siti in get. Ɛnibɔdi we kam fɔ le kɔmplen to di kiŋ, i go aks am usay i kɔmɔt ɛn di pɔsin in go ansa Absalɔm se i kɔmɔt na wan pan di Izrɛl fambul dɛn,
dɔn Absalɔm go tɛl am se i rayt, bɔt di kiŋ nɔ put nɔbɔdi we go lisin to in kes.
Dɔn i go ad se if in na bin jɔj na Izrɛl, in bin fɔ gɛt tɛm fɔ lisin ɔlman in kes ɛn mek shɔ se i gɛt in rayt.
We ɛnibɔdi we go nia am ɛn want fɔ butu fɔ sho se i rɛspɛkt am, i go ol di pɔsin in an, es am ɔp ɛn kis am so dat i go ebul gɛt am.
Na so i bin de biev to ɔl udat kam to di kiŋ wit in prɔblɛm so dat i go win dɛn at.
We Absalɔm dɔn tek fo ia afta i kam bak na Jerusɛlɛm, i beg in papa fɔ lɛf am fɔ go Ɛbrɔn so dat i go kip di prɔmis we i bin mek to PAPA GƆD.
I tɛl in papa se we i bin de Gɛshɔ na Eram i tɛl PAPA GƆD se if i mek i kam bak na Jerusɛlɛm, in go go bak na Ɛbrɔn fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD.
Di kiŋ gri ɛn tɛl am mek i go saful. So i lɛf go Ɛbrɔn.
Da sem tɛm de Absalɔm sɛn man dɛn, sikrit wan, fɔ go ɔl rawnd Izrɛl ɛn Juda ɛn tɛl di Izrɛl fambul dɛn fɔ ala se, “Na Absalɔm na kiŋ na Ɛbrɔn”, wɛn dɛn yɛri trɔmpɛt dɛn de blo.
Absalɔm bin dɔn invayt tu ɔndrɛd man frɔm Jerusɛlɛm fɔ go wit am bɔt dɛn nɔ bin no wetin i bin wan du.
We Absalɔm de rɛdi fɔ mek di sakrifays, i sɛn kɔl Aitofɛl we na Devid in advaysa kɔmɔt nain siti na Gaylo. So dat mek mɔ ɛn mɔ pipul tay bagin fɔ mek Absalɔm bi kiŋ.
Sɔmbɔdi go tɛl Devid se di Izrɛlayt dɛn at dɔn kɔmɔt to am ɛn dat na Absalɔm naw dɛn at de to.

So Devid tɛl ɔl di ɔfisa dɛn we de wit am na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ lɛ dɛn rɔnawe. I se if dɛn lɛf de, dɛn nɔn nɔ go ebul kɔmɔt na Absalɔm in an bikɔs i go kil dɛn ɔl, so dɛn nɔ fɔ westɛm bɔt dɛn fɔ lɛf de wantɛm.
Di ɔfisa dɛn gri ɛn tɛl di kiŋ se dɛn rɛdi fɔ du wetin i want.
Di kiŋ ɛn in wanol os lɛf fɔ go bɔt i lɛf tɛn pan in smɔl wɛf fɔ de luk in os.
Di kiŋ ɛn in pipul lɛf fɔ go. Wɛn dɛn dɔn rich fa usay di las os de na di siti, Devid tinap mek in man dɛn pas go bifo.
Ɔl in man dɛn waka go bifo am wit dɛn Kɛrɛthayt ɛn Pɛlɛtayt ɛn siks ɔndrɛd Gitayt we bin fala am frɔm Gath.
Di kiŋ tɛl wan Gitayt we nem Itay se mek i tɔn bak go Jerusɛlɛm fɔ de wit Kiŋ Absalɔm as in na fɔrina ɛn nɔ bawn fɔ de wit Kiŋ Devid sins i de ɛgzayl.

Devid tɛl am se na di de bifo da de de nɔmɔ nain i kam so i nɔ go fia fɔ lɛ in pas ɔp ɛn dɔŋ wit dɛn we in nɔ no usay i de go, so i go bɛtɛ if i tɔn bak na Jerusɛlɛm. Devid pre mek PAPA GƆD de wit am ɛn sho am aw i gud ɛn fethful.
Bɔt Itay se wans PAPA GƆD de ɛn Kiŋ Devid nɔ day yet, in go de wit Devid ivin if i min se i gɛt fɔ day fɔ dat.
Devid gri ɛn tɛl am fɔ pas bifo am wit in ami. So Itay di Gitayt ɛn ɔl in man dɛn wit dɛn famili dɛn mach go bifo Devid.
Na so di wan ol kɔntri de kray bita wan we Devid ɛn di pipul we de wit am de pas. Di kiŋ ɛn di pipul krɔs Kidrɔn Vali go bay di land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.

Zedɔk ɛn Abiata we na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, dɛnsɛf bin de wit Devid. Di Livayt dɛn we bin de wit dɛn bin tot di ak ɔf di Kɔvinant. Dɛn put di ak dɔŋ ɛn Abiata mek sakrifays. Dɔn dɛn tot di ak bak we ɔlman dɔn pas kɔmɔt insay Jerusɛlɛm.
Bɔt di kiŋ tɛl Zedɔk mek i lɛ dɛn kɛr di ak go bak na Jerusɛlɛm. I se, if PAPA GƆD gladi wit am, i go briŋ am kam bak so dat i go si di ak ɛn usay dɛn kip am.
I se, if PAPA GƆD se i nɔ gladi wit am dɛn in rɛdi fɔ mek i du wetin i wan du wit am.
Di kiŋ tɛl Zedɔk ɛn Abiata we na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ tek dɛn bɔypikin dɛn dat na Aimaaz we na Zedɔk in pikin ɛn Jonɛthan we na Abiata in yon pikin ɛn tɔn bak go na Jerusɛlɛm.
I se in go wet na di rod we pipul de krɔs di riva fɔ go na di land usay pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, te in gɛt wɔd frɔm dɛn bɔt aw di go de go.
So Zedɔk ɛn Abiata kɛr di ak go bak na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn lɛf de.
So Devid klem go ɔp Mawnt Ɔliv de kray as i de go; i kɔba in ed ɛn nak in tɛn to. Ɔl di pipul we bin de wit am kɔba dɛnsɛf yon fes ɛn bin de kray as dɛnsɛf de go fɔ sho aw dɛn fil am.
Devid bin dɔn yɛri se Aitofɛl jɔyn Absalɔm pan di kuskas so i pre mek PAPA GƆD mek i gi Absalɔm fulish advays.
Wɛn Devid rich rayt ɔp Mawnt Ɔliv, usay pipul kin go fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD, Ushay we na Akayt go mit am de. I bin dɔn chɛr in klos ɛn put dɔti nain ed.
Devid tɛl Ushay se i nɔ go mek i fala am bikɔs Ushay nɔ go ɛp am wan.

Devid tɛl am se di onli we we i go ɛp am na if i tɔn bak go na di siti to Absalɔm. I se Ushay fɔ tɛl Absalɔm se i bin dɔn wok fɔ in papa bɔt rɛdi fɔ wok fɔ am as kiŋ. Devid se na so i go ebul fɔ ɛp am bikɔs if i de de i go de mek shɔ se Absalɔm nɔ tek Aitofɛl in tɔk mek natin.
Devid tɛl Ushay se Zedɔk ɛn Abiata we na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go de insay Jerusɛlɛm so i kin tɛl dɛn ɛnitin we i yɛri frɔm di pipul na di kiŋ in os.
Devid se Aimaaz we na Zedɔk in bɔypikin ɛn Jonɛthan we na Abiata in yon bɔypikin, dɛnsɛf go de na Jerusɛlɛm so dɛn go kam tɛl am ɛnitin we i fɔ no.
So na di de we Absalɔm go insay Jerusɛlɛm, nain Devid in padi we na Ushay insɛf rich de.

Wɛn Devid dɔn kɔmɔt rayt ɔp di mawnten de go smɔl, i mit Ziba we de wok fɔ Mɛfiboshɛth de wet fɔ am. Ziba bin kɛr sɔm dɔŋki dɛn we i lod wit tu ɔndrɛd lof bred, wan ɔndrɛd kek wit kɔrant, wan ɔndrɛd fig kek ɛn wan jɔg wayn go mit Devid.

Di kiŋ aks Ziba wetin i kɛr dɛn fɔ. Ziba tɛl am se di dɔŋki dɛn na fɔ di kiŋ ɛn ɔlman nain os fɔ rayd pan, di bred ɛn frut na fɔ di man dɛn fɔ it ɛn di wayn na fɔ gi ɛnibɔdi we taya na di rod usay pipul nɔ go ebul tap.
We i tɔk dɔn, di kiŋ aks am fɔ in masta, dat na Sɔl in grampikin. Ziba se i lɛf am na Jerusɛlɛm bikɔs i de fil se wetin bi go mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn mek am kiŋ as nain papa bin fɔ bi kiŋ.
Di kiŋ tɛl Ziba se frɔm da de de, ɔl wetin na bin Mɛfiboshɛth in yon, dɔn bi Ziba in yon. Dat mek Ziba baw ɛn tɛl di kiŋ se in go rɛspɛkt am ɛn pre se di kiŋ go gladi wit am ɔltɛm.
As Kiŋ Devid de go nia Baurim, wan man we kɔmɔt na di sem siti lɛk Sɔl jɛs kɔmɔt na do. I bin nem Shimɛay ɛn na Gira in bɔypikin. Na so i bin de kɔs Devid we i de kɔmɔt na do.
I bin ivin de vim Devid ɛn in ɔfisa dɛn wit ston pan ɔl we di man dɛn bin de na Devid in lɛfan ɛn in raytan.
As Shimɛay de kɔs na so i de ala se lɛ Devid kɔmɔt bifo am we i dɔn kil bɔku pipul ɛn i nɔ gud fɔ natin.

I se na PAPA GƆD dɔn pe Devid so fɔ ɔl di pipul we i dɔn kil na Sɔl in famili ɛn fɔ we i pul Sɔl na di chia we i bin sidɔm as kiŋ. I se PAPA GƆD dɔn mek Devid in bɔypikin we na Absalɔm bi kiŋ ɛn na dɔn i dɔn fɔ am so bikɔs i dɔn kil bɔku.
Dɛn Abishay we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin aks di kiŋ wetin mek i fɔ lɛf pɔsin lɛk Shimɛay we yuslɛs lɛk day dɔg fɔ tɔk wetin i fil fɔ tɔk. I se di kiŋ fɔ lɛf am fɔ dil wit Shimɛay lɛ i kɔt in ed kɔmɔt.
Bɔt di kiŋ tɛl Abishay se in ɛn Zɛruaya in bɔypikin dɛn difrɛn so mek i lɛf am. I se if PAPA GƆD tɛl Shimɛay fɔ kɔs am, udat nain fɔ se Shimɛay nɔ fɔ du dat.
Dɛn Devid tɛl Abishay ɛn di ɔda ɔfisa dɛn se if in bɔypikin we nain flɛsh ɛn blɔd de tray fɔ kil am wetin di Bɛnjaminayt nɔ go du. I se lɛ dɛn lɛf am lɛ i kɔs bikɔs na so PAPA GƆD se.
I se sɔntɛm sɛf na dat go mek PAPA GƆD du gud to am fɔseka di kɔs we Shimɛay de kɔs am.
So Devid ɛn in man dɛn go dɛn we bɔt ɔl da tɛm de Shimɛay de ɔpozit na di rod, jɛs de kɔs gbay ɛn de sɛn ston ɛn dɔti pan Devid as dɛn de waka go.
Di kiŋ ɛn ɔl di pipul wit am rich usay dɛn bin de go taya wan so. Na de naw dɛn blo smɔl.
Na da sem tɛm de Absalɔm ɛn ɔl in man dɛn rich na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Aitofɛl bin de wit am.
Ushay we na Akayt ɛn Devid in padi go mit Absalɔm fɔ bato am. I se “Mek di kiŋ nɔ day yet! Mek i gɛt lɔŋ layf!”
Absalɔm aks Ushay if na so padi de sho se i lɛk padi. I tɛl am se i sɔprayz fɔ si se Ushay nɔ fala Devid go.
So Ushay tɛl am se in go de wit di pɔsin we PAPA GƆD ɛn ɔl di pipul se fɔ bi kiŋ.
Ɛn igen, in dɔn rɛdi fo wok fɔ di pikin jɛs lɛk aw i wok fɔ di dadi.
Afta dat, Absalɔm tɔn to Aitofɛl ɛn aks am fɔ advays.

Aitofɛl ansa Absalɔm se i fɔ lidɔm wit ɔl in papa in smɔl wɛf dɛn we i lɛf fɔ de wach di kiŋ os. I se da tɛm de ɔlman go no aw i nɔ want i papa in biznɛs ɛn ɔl udat de wit am go gɛt mɔ pawa fɔ du wetin dɛn wan du.
So dɛn bil tɛnt fɔ Absalɔm pantap di os in ruf usay Absalɔm lidɔm wit in papa in smɔl wɛf dɛn na say we ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn go no wetin apin.
Dɛn tɛm de, Devid ɛn Absalɔm bin de tek wetin Aitofɛl se lɛk wetin PAPA GƆD se.
Aitofɛl tɛl Absalɔm se da nɛt de in go pik twɛlv tawzin man we i go sɛn fɔ go kech Devid.
I se da nɛt de Devid go dɔn taya so fɔ bɔs pan am ɛn kil am dɔn ɔl di man dɛn we de wit am go fred ɛn rɔnawe. I se na di kiŋ nɔmɔ in go kil
bɔt in go briŋ ɔl di pipul we de wit Devid kam bak to Absalɔm as na Devid nɔmɔ i want fɔ mek day ɛn we i day, dat min se ɔl di pipul go kam bak to am.
Absalɔm gladi fɔ dis advays ɛn di big wan dɛn na Izrɛl sɛf bin gladi.
Bɔt Absalɔm se fɔ kɔl Ushay we na Akayt insɛf fɔ yɛri wetin in go se.
Wɛn Ushay kam, Absalɔm tɛl am wetin Aitofɛl se bɔt se dɛn want fɔ no if fɔ du wetin i se ɔ if Ushay gɛt ɔda tin fɔ tɛl am.
Ushay tɛl Absalɔm se Aitofɛl in advays nɔto gud advays da tɛm de.

I se Absalɔm fɔ no se i papa ɛn in man dɛn sabi fɛt ɛn da tɛm de dɛn at nɔ swit, dɛn go vɛks lɛk aw wayl animal go vɛks we i nɔ no usay dɛn tek in pikin dɛn go. I se Absalɔm fɔ no se in papa bin dɔn de pan da kayn layf de fɔ lɔŋ so i nɔ go ivin slip wit di ɔda fɛt man dɛn.
I se da tɛm de we dɛn de tɔk so sɛf, i go dɔn ayd insay wan kev ɔ ɔda say sɛf ɛn if nain fɔs atak di trup, udat yɛri bɔt dat go se bɔku pipul dɔn day pan Absalɔm in trup,
dɛn di sojaman we tɔf pas dɛn ɔl sɛf in at go pwɛl ivin we i nɔ de fred natin bikɔs ɔlman na Izrɛl no se in papa sabi fɛt ɛn ɔl udat de wit am nɔ de fred natin.
I se in de advays Absalɔm mek i lid di fɛt ɛn lɛ di wanol Izrɛl frɔm Dan te rich Biashiba we bɔku lɛk sansan na bich go wit am fɔ go fɛt Devid.
I se na da tɛm de dɛn go ebul Devid ɛn dɛn go atak am usay dɛn mit am lɛk aw ɔni de bɔs pan pɔsin ɛn dɛn go kil am ɛn ɔl in man dɛn.
I tɛl Absalɔm se if Devid rɔnawe go insay di siti we wɔl de, di wanol Izrɛl go yuz rop ɛn ib di siti wɔl dɔŋ na di vali we nain grabul-grabul nɔmɔ dɛn go si.
Absalɔm ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt se Ushay we na Akayt in advays bɛtɛ pas Aitofɛl yon bikɔs PAPA GƆD insɛf bin want fɔ mek di gud advays we Aitofɛl gi tɔn bad as na dat go lɛ Absalɔm de pan trɔbul.
Ushay tɛl Zedɔk ɛn Abiata we na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, wetin apin, dat na wetin Aitofɛl se ɛn wetin in se.
I tɛl dɛn fɔ sɛn wɔd to Devid wantɛm mek i nɔ de na di riva nia usay pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap da nɛt de. I se Devid fɔ mek shɔ se i krɔs go oba ɔ nɔ so Absalɔm in pipul go kil in ɛn in pipul dɛn.
Jonɛthan ɛn Aimaaz bin tap na Ɛnrogɛl da tɛm de, so dɛn sɛn wan savant-gyal fɔ go tɛl dɛn so dat dɛn go go tɛl kiŋ Devid bikɔs if dɛn si dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm, dɛn go de pan trɔbul.
Bɔt wan yɔŋ man si dɛn de ɛn go tɛl Absalɔm. So dɛn ɔltu kɔmɔt de kwik ɛn go to wan man na Baurim in os. Dis man bin gɛt wɛl nain kɔmpawnd, so, dɛn jomp insay de.
Di man in wɛf prɛd blankit oba di wɛl in mɔt ɛn put sid dɛn de so nɔbɔdi nɔ no se dɛn de de.

Wɛn Absalɔm in man dɛn rich de, dɛn aks di uman usay Jonɛthan ɛn Aimaaz de. Di uman ansa dɛn se Jonɛthan ɛn Aimaaz dɔn krɔs di watasay go. Dɛn sach di wanol os bɔt dɛn nɔ fɛn nɔbɔdi so dɛn tɔn bak go na Jerusɛlɛm.
Afta Absalɔm in man dɛn dɔn tɔn bak, di tu man kɔmɔt insay di wɛl ɛn go tɛl Devid. Dɛn se mek i krɔs go oba di wata wantɛm bikɔs Aitofɛl dɔn gi advays bɔt aw dɛn go gɛt am.
So Devid ɛn ɔl udat de wit am krɔs Riva Jɔdan ol nɛt so bay do klin, dɛn ɔl bin dɔn krɔs oba.

Wɛn Aitofɛl si se dɛn nɔ tek in advays, i jomp pantap in dɔŋki fɔ go nain os nain om siti. I mek shɔ se i tɛl in fambul dɛn wetin ɛn wetin fɔ du afta i day, dɔn i go ɛŋ insɛf. Na so i tek day ɛn dɛn bɛr am insay in papa in grev.
Devid go Maanaim dɔn Absalɔm ɛn ɔl in man dɛn krɔs Riva Jɔdan.

Da tɛm de Absalɔm dɔn mek Amasa kɔmanda na di ami fɔ tek Joab in ples. Amasa na bin wan man we nem Jɛtha in bɔypikin. Jɛtha na Ishmɛlayt we bin mared to Abigɛl we na Neash in gyal pikin. Na Zɛruaya we na Joab in mama in sista nain bɔn am.
Absalɔm ɛn di fɛt man dɛn na Izrɛl kamp na Giliad.
Wɛn Devid rich Maanaim, Shobay we na Neash we kɔmɔt na Raba to dɛn Amonayt dɛn ɛn Maka dat na Amiɛl frɔm Lodɛba in bɔypikin wit Bazilay dat na da Giliadayt we kɔmɔt Rogɛlim,
kɛr bedshit, bol ɛn tin dɛn we dɛn tek kle mek go gi am. Dɛn kɛr wit ɛn bali, flawa ɛn ros sid, difrɛn kayn binch,
ɔni, yogɔt ɛn ɔda tin dɛn we dɛn kin mek wit kaw milk ɛn ship fɔ Devid ɛn in pipul fɔ it. Dɛn se ɔl di pipul go taya, aŋri ɛn tɔsti we dɛn bin de na ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Devid gɛda ɔl di man dɛn we bin de wit am ɛn pik kɔmanda dɛn. Sɔm i gi dɛn tawzin tawzin pipul ɛn sɔm na ɔndrɛd ɔndrɛd nɔmɔ.

Devid sheb ɔl in man dɛn na tri grup. I gi Joab wan fɔ bi kɔmanda, Joab in brɔda we na Abishay gɛt wan ɔda grup fɔ kɔmand ɛn Itay we na Gitayt bi kɔmanda fɔ di tɔd grup. Di kiŋ tɛl in fɛt man dɛn se insɛf go mɔs go fɛt wit dɛn.

Bɔt di man dɛn tɛl am se i nɔ fɔ go bikɔs if dɛn gɛt fɔ rɔnawe nɔbɔdi nɔ go bisin bɔt dɛn. Dɛn se if in day na wɔfrɔnt dat go bɛtɛ fɔ di ɛnimi dɛn pas if na dɛn bɔku day sins in layf pas dɛn tɛn tawzin. Dɛn tɛl Devid se i go bɛtɛ fɔ lɛ in lɛf usay i de ɛn bato dɛn na wɔfrɔnt.
Di kiŋ ansa dɛn se in go du wetin dɛn want. So di kiŋ tinap kɔna di get de wach aw di man dɛn de go bay grup.
Di kiŋ ala wɔn Joab, Abishay ɛn Itay se fɔseka am lɛ dɛn tek tɛm wit Absalɔm lɛ natin nɔ du am. So ɔlman yɛri wetin di kiŋ tɛl di kɔmanda dɛn.
Devid in man dɛn ɛn di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Izrɛl mitɔp na di fil ɛn dɛn fɛt na Ifrem Fɔrɛst.
Devid in man dɛn win di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Izrɛl. Dɛn bit dɛn bad ɛn na twɛnti tawzin sojaman day pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Di eria we dɛn de fɛt kam big pas wetin dɛn bin min te go insay insay di bush. Di pipul we day na di bush pas di wan dɛn we dɛn kil.
I kam bi se Absalɔm insɛf sɛf mitɔp wit Devid in man dɛn bɔt as di myul we i bin de rayd pan pas ɔnda wan tik nain in ed fasin pan di tik bɔt di myul kɔntinyu fɔ go we in ɛŋ na di tik.
Wɛn wan pan di man dɛn si wetin apin, i tɛl Joab se i si Absalɔm ɛŋ pan wan Ok tik.
Joab aks di man se if i si dat wetindu i nɔ kil am de wantɛm. I se da tɛm de i bin fɔ gi di man tɛn pis silva ɛn bɛlt as prɔpa fɛtman.

Bɔt di man ansa Joab se if na wan tawzin pis silva dɛn put sɛf nain an, in nɔ go tɔch di kiŋ in bɔypikin. I se dɛn yɛri gud wan we di kiŋ de ɔda Joab, Abishay ɛn Itay se lɛ dɛn sɔri fɔ Absalɔm ɛn nɔ du am natin fɔseka di kiŋ.
I tɛl Joab se if in bin risk in layf kil Absalɔm, di kiŋ bin fɔ no ɛn nain wan bin fɔ tot in waala as ivin Joab sɛf go kɔmɔt biɛn am.
Nain Joab se in nɔ de wes mɔ tɛm fɔ tɔk wit di man. So i tek tri shap wɛpɔn we i chuk Absalɔm wit nain at di tɛm we Absalɔm bin ɛŋ pan di Ok tik we i nɔ day yet.
Dɛn tɛn pan Joab in yon man dɛn gɛda rawnd am ɛn dɔn am wantɛm. Dɛn chuk chuk am te i day.
So Joab blo di trɔmpɛt fɔ lɛ dɛn lɛf fɔ fɛt so dɛn lɛf fɔ rɔnata Izrɛl.
Dɛn tek Absalɔm, ib am na wan big ol insay di bush ɛn pak big big ston dɛn pan am. Bay da tɛm de ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn rɔnawe go na dɛn os dɛn.

Bifo Absalɔm day, i bin dɔn mek sɔntin wit ston we i put na di kiŋ in vali se nain fɔ de tek mɛmba am bikɔs i nɔ gɛt bɔypikin we i go lɛf wit in nem. I kɔl am Absalɔm in Mɔnyumɛnt ɛn na so i nem te tide.
Aimaaz we na Zedɔk in bɔypikin wit in rɔnmɔt se lɛ i rɔn go tɛl di kiŋ se PAPA GƆD dɔn pul am nain ɛnimi dɛn an.
Joab tɛl am se nɔto in fɔ go tɔk da nyuz de bikɔs di kiŋ in bɔypikin dɔn day. Joab se i go du dat ɔda tɛm bɔt nɔto da de de.
Joab tɔn to wan Itiopian man ɛn tɛl am fɔ go tɔk wetin i si. Di man baw to Joab ɛn rɔn go.
Aimaaz we na Zedɔk in bɔypikin beg Joab se in wan go i lɛk wetin go bi. Joab aks am wetin mek paopa i wan go. I se Aimaaz nɔ gɛt nyuz we dɛn go pe am fɔ.
Bɔt i stil se paopa i wan go. So Joab insɛf lɛf am fɔ rɔn go. Dɛn Aimaaz rɔn pas insay di Jɔdan Vali na shɔt kɔt ɛn rɔn go bifo di Itiopian man.
As Devid sidɔm midul di get we de insay ɛn di wan na do, di wachman go ɔp na di ruf nia di get to di wɔl. I wach oba nain i si wan man in wande rɔn.
Di wachman ala tɛl di kiŋ. Di kiŋ se wans nain wan, na nyuz i de kam wit. Di man de rɔn kam nia dɛn.
We di wachman luk bak, i si ɔda man de rɔn nain i ala tɛl di get man se wan ɔda man de rɔn in wan. Di kiŋ se na nyuz insɛf go de kam wit.
Di wachman se i tan lɛk di fɔs man we de kam de rɔn lɛk Aimaaz we na Zedɔk in bɔypikin Di kiŋ se na gud man so i go dɔn briŋ gud nyuz kam.
Dɛn Aimaaz ala tɛl di kiŋ se ɔltin ɔrayt. I baw wit in fes na grɔn to di kiŋ ɛn se, “Lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD we na yu GƆD! I dɔn mek mi kiŋ ebul di wan dɛn we nɔ bin wan si am.”
Di kiŋ aks if Absalɔm ɔrayt. Aimaaz ansa se di tɛm we Joab de sɛn in we na di kiŋ in wokman, sɔm kɔnfyushɔn bin de so in nɔ no wetin apin.
Di kiŋ jɛs tɛl am se lɛ i tinap na kɔna wet fɔs. So insɛf push na kɔna ɛn tinap de.
Na da tɛm de di Itiopian man bin dɔn rich ɛn se di kiŋ fɔ yɛri de gud nyuz we i kam wit. I se da de de PAPA GƆD dɔn pul am kɔmɔt na dɛn wan we nɔ wan si am dɛn an.
Di kiŋ aks di Itiopian man if ɔltin ɔrayt wit Absalɔm. Di man se mek PAPA GƆD mek wetin bi to Absalɔm bi to ɔl di kiŋ in ɛnimi dɛn.
Dat shek di kiŋ. I go ɔp na di rum we de to di get ɛn kray. As i de go, na so i de se “E mi pikin, Absalɔm, a wish na mi bin fɔ day! Noto yu fɔ day, mi pikin, Absalɔm.”
Dɛn go tɛl Joab se di kiŋ de kray ɛn munin fɔ Absalɔm.
Dat mek di wanol Izrɛl ami lɛf fɔ gladi fɔ we dɛn win bikɔs da de de dɛn yɛri se di kiŋ de kray fɔ in bɔypikin.
Dis mek di sojaman dɛn tɔn bak go kwayɛt wan insay di siti lɛk se dɛn de rɔnawe pan fɛt wit shem.
Na so di kiŋ de kray bita bita wan. I kɔba in fes ɛn de se “E mi pikin Absalɔm! Na day yu day so mayn!”

Dɛn Joab go mit di kiŋ ɛn tɛl am se we i de kray, dat de mek ɔl di sojaman dɛn shem fɔ wetin dɛn du. I se dɛn fɛt fɔ in, in pikin dɛn, in wɛf ɛn smɔl wɛf dɛn layf, dɔn naw Kiŋ Devid de mek dɛn fil se dɛn nɔ du natin.

I tɛl Devid se na di wan dɛn we et am i lɛk dɔn di wan dɛn we lɛk am, na dɛn i et, so, da de de i dɔn mek di ami kɔmanda dɛn ɛn dɛn man dɛn no naw se dɛn nɔ min natin to am. I se Devid lɛ i fil naw se i bin fɔ gladi if dɛn ɔl bin day wans Absalɔm de.

I tɛl Devid se lɛ i grap go mit di man dɛn ɛn tɔk to dɛn fayn. I swɛ to PAPA GƆD se if i nɔ du am, dɛn ɔl go lɛf am go bay di tɛm we nɛt de kam; ɛn dat go bad fɔ am pas ɔl di difrɛn waala we dɔn mit am.

So di kiŋ grap go sidɔm nain chia bay di get. Wɛn di sojaman dɛn yɛri se di kiŋ de to di get, dɛn ɔl gɛda go tinap bifo am. Bay da tɛm de, ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn we bin de biɛn Absalɔm dɔn rɔn go bak go na dɛn os dɛn.
Da sem tɛm de di pipul we kɔmɔt na ɔl di Izrɛl fambul bin de agyu. Dɛn se na Kiŋ Devid pul dɛn na dɛn ɛnimi dɛn an ɛn fri dɛn frɔm di Filistin dɛn bɔt Absalɔm dɔn mek i rɔnawe
ɛn naw in Absalɔm we dɛn pik se fɔ bi kiŋ, dɔn go day na wa, so wetin mek dɛn nɔn nɔ de tɔk bɔt aw fɔ go briŋ Kiŋ Devid bak.

Kiŋ Devid sɛn wɔd to Zedɔk ɛn Abiata we na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. I se dɛn fɔ aks di big wan dɛn na Juda if dɛn fɔ bi di las grup na Izrɛl we fɔ aks di kiŋ fɔ kam bak nain os sins di kiŋ dɔn yɛri wetin ɔl di ɔda wan dɛn de se.
Di kiŋ se dɛn fɔ tɛl di big wan dɛn na Juda se if dɛn we nain brɔda dɛn, in yon flɛsh ɛn blɔd fɔ wet te dɛn bi di las wan dɛn fɔ aks am fɔ kam nain os.
Dɛn bak Devid tɛl dɛn fɔ tɛl Amasa se dɛn ɔltu na fambul ɛn se mek PAPA GƆD lɛ i alaki if i nɔ lɛ Amasa tek Joab in ples as kɔmanda nain ami.
Di wɔd we Devid sɛn so tɔch di pipul dat dɛn mek wanwɔd ɛn sɛn wɔd bak to am se mek in ɛn in man dɛn kam wantɛm.
So di kiŋ ɛn in man dɛn kam te rich Riva Jɔdan. Da tɛm de di man dɛn na Juda dɔn go fɔ go mit di kiŋ na Gilgal so dɛn mek i krɔs Riva Jɔdan.
Shimɛay dat na Gira in bɔypikin, da Bɛnjaminayt we kɔmɔt Baurim ɔri jɔyn di man dɛn na Juda fɔ go mit Kiŋ Devid
Wan tawzin Bɛnjaminayt, Ziba we bin de wok fɔ Sɔl ɛn in fiftin pikin wit in yon twɛnti wokman ɔl go na Riva Jɔdan fɔ go mit di kiŋ.
Dɛn krɔs di riva go briŋ di kiŋ ɛn ɔl in fambul dɛn wit am ɛn dɛn bin rɛdi fɔ du ɛnitin we Devid aks dɛn fɔ du. Wɛn Shimɛay we na Gira in bɔypikin krɔs di Riva Jɔdan go oba, i fɔdɔm na di kiŋ in fut
ɛn beg am fɔ padin am. I se lɛ di kiŋ nɔ mɛmba wetin i bin du am di tɛm we i bin kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm.
I se in no se in du bad na dat mek nain fɔs na Josɛf in fambul go dɔŋ go mit di kiŋ.
Wantɛm, wantɛm, nain Abishay we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin se na fɔ kil am fɔ wetin i du. I se i nɔ skyad sɛf fɔ kɔs di wan we PAPA GƆD pik fɔ bi kiŋ.
Devid aks Zɛruaya in bɔypikin dɛn wetindu dɛn wan gbara-kes. I se dɛn de biev lɛk pipul we nɔ wan si in bɛtɛ wan bikɔs dɛn fɔ no se nain na kiŋ na Izrɛl so nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ day da de de.
So di kiŋ swɛ ɛn tɛl Shimɛay se lɛ i nɔ wɔri, i nɔ go day.
Mɛfiboshɛth we na Sɔl in grampikin insɛf go dɔŋ go mit di kiŋ. Frɔm we di kiŋ lɛf Jerusɛlɛm i nɔ sibɔt in fut, i nɔ shev ɔ was in klos te da de de we di kiŋ tɔn bak sef wan.
Wɛn i kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm go mit di kiŋ, di kiŋ aks am wetindu i nɔ bin fala am go.
I tɛl di kiŋ se as i nɔ ebul waka, i bin de abop se Ziba, dat nain wokman, go rɛdi in dɔŋki fɔ am so dat i go rayd pan am bɔt Ziba kɔmɔt biɛn am.
I se Ziba go to di kiŋ go pwɛl in nem. I se in no se di kiŋ gɛt sɛns lɛk PAPA GƆD in enjɛl so lɛ i du wetin rayt fɔ am.

I se in no se ɔl in grampa in fambul dɛn fit fɔ day bɔt di kiŋ luk am pin, sɔri fɔ am ɛn mek i de wit di pipul we de sidɔm na tebul fɔ it wit di kiŋ. I se mek i nɔ lay, i nɔ gɛt di mɔt fɔ aks di kiŋ fɔ natin.
Di kiŋ tɛl am se i nɔ gɛt natin nɔ fɔ se pas nɔmɔ i aks Ziba ɛn Mɛfiboshɛth fɔ sheb di land dɛn we Sɔl bin gɛt.
Mɛfiboshɛth tɛl di kiŋ se lɛ i gi ɔl di land to Ziba. I se in satisfay fɔ si se di kiŋ dɔn kam bak ɛn natin nɔ du am.
Bazilay we na wan Giliadayt na Rogɛlim krɔs go dɔŋ Riva Jɔdan wit di kiŋ ɛn lɛf am fɔ go bak na Jerusɛlɛm.
Bazilay na bin olpa we ol eti ia. I bin jɛntri so i gi di kiŋ ɔl wetin i want, di tɛm we i bin de na Maanaim.
Di kiŋ tɛl Bazilay se lɛ i krɔs go na Jerusɛlɛm wit am ɛn in go gi am ɔl wetin i go want.
Bɔt Bazilay tɛl di kiŋ se i nɔ gɛt lɔŋ fɔ liv so i nɔ fɔ go Jerusɛlɛm wit di kiŋ.
I se na eti ia i ol so in nɔ go no wetin gud ɔ wetin bad, in nɔ go ɛnjɔy it lɛk fɔs ɛn i nɔ go ivin yɛri bɛtɛ we pipul de siŋ, so in nɔ go lɛk fɔ put yagba pan di kiŋ.
I tɛl di kiŋ se in go krɔs Riva Jɔdan wit am ɛn fala am go af we bɔt dat nɔ min se di kiŋ fɔ pe am fɔ dat.
I beg di kiŋ lɛ i lɛf am fɔ tɔn bak go nain os go day de so dɛn go bɛr am nain mama ɛn papa dɛn grev. I se lɛ in bɔypikin Kimam go wit am ɛn bi in bɔbɔ dɔn i kin mek i du wetin i want fɔ du.
Di kiŋ gri fɔ lɛ Kimam go wit am ɛn tɛl Bazilay se i go du wetin go mek Bazilay gladi fɔ am ɛn dɛn rɛdi fɔ du ɛnitin we Bazilay want fɔ insɛf.
So di kiŋ ɛn ɔl di pipul krɔs Riva Jɔdan. Bazilay ɛn di kiŋ grip dɛnsɛf fɔ se gudbay dɔn di kiŋ aks PAPA GƆD fɔ blɛs am ɛn lɛf am fɔ tɔn bak go nain os.
Kiŋ Devid go te rich Gilgal ɛn Kimam bin de wit am. Di sojaman dɛn we kɔmɔt na Juda ɛn af pan di sojaman dɛn we kɔmɔt Izrɛl bin de wit di kiŋ fɔ krɔs di riva.

I nɔ tu te nain di sojaman dɛn we kɔmɔt Izrɛl we bin de de bigin kɔmplen se, di sojaman dɛn we kɔmɔt na Juda, dɔn tek di kiŋ na dɛn an. Dɛn tɛl di kiŋ se dɛn no se dɛn na brɔda bɔt i dɔn mek dɛn pul am na di Izrɛlayt dɛn an; in ɛn in famili wit ɔl di man dɛn we de wit am.
Di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Juda ansa se dɛn de biɛn di kiŋ bikɔs na dɛn brɔda. Dɛn se di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt Izrɛl nɔ fɔ vɛks bikɔs dɛn nɔ tek in natin wande.

Di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Izrɛl ansa se bay rayt dɛn gɛt tɛn fambul na Izrɛl so na dɛn fɔ tɔk mɔ bɔt Devid as dɛn brɔda. Dɛn bigin mek plaba ɛn tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ de luk dɛn lo afta ɔl na dɛn fɔs tɔk se fɔ go briŋ Devid kam bak. So di man dɛn na Juda dɛnsɛf ala fɔ ansa dɛn.

Wan fɛn plaba man bin de de we nem Shiba ɛn na bin Bikray in bɔypikin dɔn insɛf na Bɛnjaminayt. Wantɛm i jɛs grap blo trɔmpɛt ɛn se ɔlman we kɔmɔt na Izrɛl fɔ go bak nain yon os. I se dɛn nɔ ivin fambul to Devid we na Jɛsi in bɔypikin so dɛn nɔ fɔ miks pan wetin i de du.
So di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Izrɛl jɛs lɛf Devid ɛn fala Shiba we na Bikray in bɔypikin bɔt di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Juda nɔ kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn kiŋ. Dɛn de wit am frɔm Riva Jɔdan te rich Jerusɛlɛm.

Wɛn Devid rich nain os na Jerusɛlɛm i put dɛn in tɛn smɔl wɛf we i bin lɛf fɔ de luk in os na wan os ɛn lɛf sikyɔriti fɔ de wach dɛn. I bin de gi dɛn ɔl wetin dɛn want bɔt nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du wit dɛn igen. Na de i lɛf dɛn te dɛn day. Dɛn bin de de lɛk uman dɛn we dɛn man bin dɔn day.
Wande di kiŋ tɛl Amasa se i de gi am tri de fɔ lɛ i gɛda ɔl di man dɛn na Juda fɔ mit wit am ɛn in di Amasa sɛf fɔ de de.
Bɔt Amasa tek pas tri de fɔ gɛda di man dɛn.

So Devid tɛl Abishay se if dɛn sidɔm so, Shiba we na Bikray in bɔypikin go fɛn trɔbul fɔ dɛn pas wetin Absalɔm bin du. Devid se Abishay fɔ rɔnata Shiba wit sɔm pan in yon sojaman dɛn ɔ nɔ so i go go fɛn siti we gɛt wɔl we i go go ayd pan dɛn.
So Joab in man dɛn, dɛn Kɛrɛthayt, dɛn Pɛlɛtayt ɛn ɔl dɛn tɔf tɔf sojaman rɔn afta Shiba ɛn dɛn bin go wit Abishay. Dɛn ɔl kɔmɔt na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ go kech Shiba we na Bikray in bɔypikin.

As dɛn de go Amasa mit dɛn bay di big ston we de na Gibiɔn. Joab bin drɛs prɔpa wan fɔ go fɛt wa wit in bɛlt rawnd in wes ɛn in daga insay di klos fɔ daga. As i waka go bifo smɔl di daga fɔdɔm kɔmɔt na di klos we i bin wɛr.
Joab kɔl Amasa in brɔda ɛn aks am if i ɔrayt. So Joab grip Amasa nain biabia wit in raytan lɛk aw dɛn kin du fɔ tɛl am adu ɛn kis am.

Amasa nɔ bin de drim sɛf se na ɛnitin, so i nɔ bin gɛt natin fɔ protɛkt am. So Joab chuk in bɛlɛ wit in daga dɔn ɔl in gɔt kɔmɔt fɔdɔm na grɔn we mek Joab nɔ bin gɛt fɔ chuk am tu tɛm sɛf. Na so i tek day. Dɛn Joab ɛn in brɔda Abishay rɔnata Shiba we na Bikray in bɔypikin.
Wan pan Joab in man dɛn tinap bay Amasa in bɔdi ɛn se udat de fɔ Devid ɛn rɛdi fɔ wok wit Joab fɔ fala Joab go.

Amasa bin lidɔm day wan wit in blɔd ɔl ova in bɔdi so we di sojaman dɛn de pas, dɛn kin tinap de smɔl as i bin de midul rod. Wɛn wan man si wetin de apin, i drɛg di dedebɔdi go na bush mek i kɔmɔt na rod ɛn kɔba am wit lapa.
Afta di man dɔn pul Amasa in dedebɔdi kɔmɔt na rod, ɔl di man dɛn jɛs fala Joab fɔ rɔnata Shiba we na Bikray in bɔypikin.
Joab pas to ɔl di fambul dɛn na Izrɛl te rich Ebɛl Bɛth Maaka ɛn insay ɔl di eria we di Bɛrayt de ɛn dɛn ɔl gɛda fɔ fala am.
Dɛn sɔrawnd Shiba we i de na Ebɛl Bɛth Maaka. Dɛn pak ston dɛn nia di siti in wɔl ɛn bin dɔn bigin bit bit di wɔl fɔ ib am dɔŋ.
Wɛn dɛn de tray fɔ ib di wɔl dɔŋ, wan sɛnsuman ala se lɛ dɛn tɛl Joab fɔ go to am bikɔs i wan tɔk to am.
We Joab go mit am i aks am if in na Joab. Joab ansa se yɛs nain. Di uman tɛl am fɔ lisin to wetin i wan tɛl am. Joab se i de lisin.
Di uman se fɔstɛm pipul bin de se we yu want gud advays fɔ ɛnitin, go na Ebɛl, yu go gɛt am. Na so dɛn tek tɔk di tɔk.
I se dɛn lɛk pis ɛn nɔ gɛt wan prɔblɛm pan ɔl di siti dɛn na Izrɛl ɛn aks Joab wetindu i wan pwɛl dɛn siti we na di mama fɔ Izrɛl. I se wetindu Joab wan fɔ ambɔg PAPA GƆD in prɔpati ɛn pwɛl am.
Joab se mek PAPA GƆD nɔ gri fɔ lɛ in pwɛl ɛnitin.

I se nɔto tru se dɛn wan pwɛl di ples. I se if dɛn kin an ova Shiba we na Bikray in bɔypikin ɛn wan man we kɔmɔt na ɔplayn na Ifrem, ɔltin go dɔn as na dis man ya wan tɔn bon na trot fɔ Kiŋ Devid. Di uman se dɛn go sɛn in ed oba di wɔl gi Joab.

So di uman go rawnd to ɔl di pipul na di siti ɛn tɛl dɛn bɔt di sɛns we i pul. Dɛn ɔl gri, so dɛn kɔt Shiba in ed ɛn sɛn am oba di wɔl to Joab. Dat mek i blo di trɔmpɛt dɔn ɔl in man dɛn lɛf fɔ fɛt. Dɛn ɔl skata ɛn tɔn bak go na dɛn os dɛn. Bɔt Joab in go bak to di kiŋ na Jerusɛlɛm.
Na Joab bin de inchaj ɔf di wanol Izrɛlayt ami; Bɛnaya we na Jeoyada in bɔypikin in bin de inchaj ɔf dɛn Kɛlɛthayt ɛn dɛn Pɛlɛtayt dɛn;
Adoniram bin de inchaj ɔf dɛn wan we dɛn de fos fɔ wok; dɔn Jɛoshafat we na Ailud in bɔypikin na bin di kiŋ in spoksman.
Shiva na bin di sɛktri, Zedɔk ɛn Abiata na bin man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin
ɛn Ayra sɛf we na Jeirayt na bin wan pan di man dɛn we Devid bin pik fɔ bin in yon man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.

Di tɛm we Devid na bin kiŋ, bad bad aŋri fɔdɔm na Izrɛl fɔ tri gud ia; dis mɔna Devid so i pre ɛn aks PAPA GƆD wetindu. PAPA GƆD tɛl am se na bikɔs Sɔl bin kil bɔku Gibiɔnayt so in ɛn in fambul dɛn de sɔfa fɔ dat.

Di kiŋ sɛn kɔl di Gibiɔnayt dɛn we bin lɛf. Di Gibiɔnayt dɛn bay rayt nɔto pat ɔf Izrɛl. Dɛn na bin di Amɔrayt pipul we nɔ bin day di tɛm we Izrɛl tek di land. Di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin dɔn swɛ se dɛn nɔ go du di Gibiɔnayt dɛn natin, bɔt we Sɔl bin wan sho wetin i kin du na Izrɛl ɛn Juda, i tray fɔ kil dɛn ɔl.
Devid aks di Gibiɔnayt dɛn wetin i fɔ du fɔ dɛn fɔ kol dɛn at so dat dɛn ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn we na PAPA GƆD in pipul go de lɛk wan.
Di Gibiɔnayt dɛn ansa se Sɔl in fambul dɛn nɔ go ebul pe dɛn ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt rayt fɔ kil ɛnibɔdi na Izrɛl. Devid aks dɛn wetin dɛn want am fɔ du.
Dɛn ansa di kiŋ se Sɔl pwɛl dɛn kpatakpata. Dɛn se i bin want fɔ mek dɛn ɔl day ɛn nɔ gɛt pan di prɔpati lɛkɛ di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn,
so di kiŋ fɔ gi dɛn sɛvin man nɔmɔ pan Sɔl in fambul dɛn we dɛn go kil usay dɛn de go wɔship PAPA GƆD na Gibia. So di kiŋ tɛl dɛn se in go gi dɛn di sɛvin man.
Di kiŋ nɔ mek Mɛfiboshɛth we na Jonɛthan in pikin ɛn Sɔl in grampikin de de bikɔs in ɛn Jonɛthan we na Sɔl in bɔypikin bin dɔn swɛ bifo PAPA GƆD.

Di kiŋ tek Amɔni ɛn Mɛfiboshɛth dat na di tu bɔypikin we Rizpa we na Eya in gyal pikin bɔn fɔ Sɔl, wit Mirab we na Sɔl in gyal pikin in yon fayv bɔypikin we i bin bɔn fɔ Adriɛl we na da Mɛolathayt we nem Bazilay in bɔypikin.
I gi di Gibiɔnayt dɛn we kil dɛn usay dɛn de wɔship PAPA GƆD. Na di sem tɛm dɛn ɔl sɛvin day ɛn na di tɛm we di bali avɛst de bigin nain dɛn kil dɛn.
Rizpa we na Eya in gyal pikin tek munin lapa kɔba di dedebɔdi dɛn. Frɔm di tɛm we di avɛst bigin te ren bigin kam i nɔ gri lɛ ɛni bɔd ɔ wayl animal go nia di bɔdi dɛn, ol de ɛn ol nɛt, i de wit dɛn.
Wɛn Devid yɛri wetin Rizpa dat na Eya in gyal pikin ɛn we na Sɔl in smɔl wɛf du,

i gi am zil fɔ go aks di pipul na Jebɛsh Giliad fɔ Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin we na Jonɛthan dɛn bonbon. Di pipul na Jebɛsh Giliad bin ayd tek dɛn dedebɔdi kɔmɔt na Bɛth Shan usay di Filistin dɛn bin ɛŋ dɛn fɔ mek ɔlman si dɛn afta dɛn bin dɔn kil Sɔl.
Devid pul Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin we na Jonɛthan dɛn bonbon kɔmɔt de ɛn gɛda di sɛvin man we dɛn bin ɛŋ dɛn yon bonbon.

Devid in man dɛn bɛr dɛn wit Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin we na Jonɛthan dɛn bon na Sɔl in papa we na Kish in grev na Zila insay Bɛtliɛm ɛn du ɛnitin we di kiŋ se fɔ du. Afta dat PAPA GƆD ansa dɛn prea ɛn sɔri fɔ di land.
Bak igen di Filistin dɛn ɛn Izrɛl go fɛt wa ɛn i bi se Devid bin taya bad wan tɛm.
Wan pan di Filistin dɛn we nem Ishbibenɔb, na bin wan jayant. In spia in ed we lɛkɛ sɛvin ɛn af pawns bras ɛn i bin gɛt nyu sɔd ɛn i bin de tray fɔ kil Devid.

Abishay we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin notis dat ɛn go ɛp Devid. I bin ebul kil di Filistin. Dat mek Devid in man dɛn tɛl Devid se i nɔ go ɛva go fɛt wit dɛn igen. Dɛn se if dɛn kil Devid na wa na di lamp na Izrɛl dɛn ɔt so, as nain ɔlman abop pan.
As tɛm de go, di Filistin dɛn fɛt wit Izrɛl bak na Gɔb. Da tɛm de na Sibɛkay we na Ushatayt kil Saf dat na wan ɔda jayant.

Wan ɔda tɛm bak we di Filistin dɛn fɛt wit Izrɛl bak na Gɔb, na Ɛlenan we na Jarɛoregim, da Bɛtliɛmayt in bɔypikin kil Golayath di Gitayt we in spia bin tan lɛk da big tik we dɛn de tek mek kɔntri klos.

Ɔda fɛt we di Filistin dɛn fɛt Izrɛl bin bi na Gath. Wan big, ay man bin de de we na siks siks fiŋa ɛn siks siks to i bin gɛt nain an ɛn fut dɛn ɔl. So i bin gɛt twɛlv fiŋa ɛn twɛlv to. Insɛf na bin wan pan ɔda jayant.
I bin jɛs de fɔ de kɔs Izrɛl so na Devid in brɔda we na Jonɛthan dat na Shimɛay in bɔypikin kil am.
Dɛn fo man ya na bin jayant bɔt Devid ɛn in man dɛn kil dɛn ɔl.
Na dis siŋ Devid siŋ to PAPA GƆD fɔ we PAPA GƆD pul am nain ɛnimi dɛn an patikla we i pul am na Sɔl in an.
I se “PAPA GƆD yu na mi Seviɔ we a de to yu a de fil sef.
Yu dɔn pul mi na mi ɛnimi dɛn an, ɛn yu na mi bakbon. Yu na mi ɔltin, yu pul mi na bad pipul an.
A pre to PAPA GƆD bikɔs i fit fɔ prez ɛn i pul mi na mi ɛnimi dɛn an.
Day bin tan lɛk wata ɔl rawnd mi i tan lɛk i wan swɛla mi.
Day bin de luk mi korokoro wan i tan lɛk dɛn tay tay mi wit rop dɛn fɔ kil mi.
Wɛn a bin de pan trɔbul, a pre mek PAPA GƆD ɛp mi, i yɛri mi na ɛvin ɛn ansa mi prea.
Ɔlsay de trimbul we yu vɛks di ath de shek ɛn di mawnten dɛnsɛf de trimbul.
Fɔ sho se yu vɛks fɔ tru smok de kɔmɔt na yu nos, ɔt, ɔt kɔl we de bɔn ɛn faya we de pwɛl tin dɛn de kɔmɔt na yu mɔt.
I chɛr di klawd kam dɔŋ fɔ sev mi ɛn put daknɛs bitwin wi tu.
I yuz in chɛryubim ɛn flay go usay di briz de kɛr am go.
I mek di daknɛs kɔba am we i ayd insɛf insay di tik klawd we tan lɛk we ren dɔn dak,
dɔn di laytin bifo am de mek lɛk na faya.
We PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti de tɔk in vɔys tan lɛk we tɛnda de rol ɔp klawd.
I dɔnawe wit di ɛnimi dɛn wit bo ɛn aro ɛn ivin lɛ laytin fɔdɔm ɛn skata dɛn.
Wɛn PAPA GƆD de tɔk we i vɛks, i de blo traŋa wan ɛn di vɛri grɔn we di wɔl tinap pan de shek dɔn di wata sɛf de dray.
I pul mi kɔmɔt pan siriɔs waala we tan lɛk we pɔsin de midul wata.
I pul mi na mi ɛnimi dɛn an; mi ɛnimi dɛn we bin tu pawaful fɔ mi.
We dɛn sɛt gud wan fɔ kech mi na dɛn trap, na PAPA GƆD jɛs pul mi de saful.
I sev mi bikɔs i gladi wit mi.
PAPA GƆD dɔn gi mi di pe we a fɔ gɛt bikɔs mi an klin, a de du wetin i want.
A de du wetin PAPA GƆD se, a nɔ sin bikɔs a nɔ tɔn mi bak pan PAPA GƆD.
A de du ɔl wetin i se fɔ du. A nɔ disobe am pan natin.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ go pɔynt fiŋa pan mi as a de mek sho se a nɔ sin.
PAPA GƆD sɛf dɔn gi mi wetin a wok fɔ, bay aw mi an klin bifo in yay.
Yu nɔ de lɛf udat de fala yu ɔltɛm ɛn udat de du wetin yu want.
Udat du gud, yu gud to am bɔt udat wan sho se in gɛt sɛns pas yu, go brakɛt yu.
Yu rɛdi fɔ ɛp udat nɔ prawd bɔt de brok udat de mek gbiŋbin in fɛda dɔŋ.
Yu, PAPA GƆD, na di wan we gi mi layf; PAPA GƆD de sho mi in layt ɛn mek mi we klia na layf.
Na yu de mek a ebul mi ɛnimi dɛn i lɛk aw dɛn plɛnti. A go ivin ebul fɔ klem ay wɔl we dɛn bil fɔ dɛn sikyɔriti wans yu de wit mi.
As fɔ di PAPA GƆD we a de wɔship, na GƆD we nɔ gɛt bɔt. Yu kin biliv wetin i se bikɔs i de kip to in wɔd. In na wan ɔl kɔba klos fɔ udat go to am.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we tan lɛk PAPA GƆD, di GƆD we wi de wɔship. In na GƆD we tan lɛk big ston we nɔ de muf.
Na PAPA GƆD na di wan we de gi mi trɛnk fɔ du ɔlkayn tin ɛn mek mi we klia.
I de mek a nɔ yagba fɔ natin lɛk aw dia nɔ de yagba fɔ rɔn bikɔs in fut traŋa na grɔn; dɔn i de ebul mek a tinap lɛk man i lɛk usay a de.
I de sho mi aw fɔ fɛt ɛn gi mi trɛnk fɔ bɛn ayɛn.
Yu kɔba mi ɛn pul mi pan trɔbul yu ansa mi prea ɛn mek mi ed big.
Yu mek a waka fri ɛn mi ɛnimi dɛn nɔ ebul mi sɛf as a nɔ bɔk mi fut.
A rɔnata mi ɛnimi dɛn te a kech dɛn bit dɛn. A nɔ tɔn bak sɛf te a nyamanyama dɛn ɔl.
Wɛn a dɔn dɔn wit dɛn, dɛn nɔ ebul grap sɛf Na mi fut dɛn day.
Yu gi mi di trɛnk we a nid fɔ fɛt ɛn mek mi ɛnimi dɛn day na mi fut.
Di wan dɛn we nɔ day, rɔnawe bɔt a kil di wan dɛn we et mi.
Dɛn ala mek pɔsin ɛp dɛn bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ de. Dɛn pre mek PAPA GƆD ɛp dɛn bɔt i nɔ ansa dɛn prea.
A nyamanyama dɛn kpatakpata te dɛn tan lɛk dɔti na grɔn we nɔ fit natin pas fɔ waka pantap am.
Yu dɔn mek dɛn wan we nɔ bin wan si mi, luk mi lɛk sɔmbɔdi naw. Na mi de rul dɛn ɛn fɔrina dɛn ɔl de ɔnda mi.
Dɛn nɔ de gi mi chans; dɛn ɔl de trimbul fɔ pliz mi ɛn de rawnd mi ɔltɛm.
Dɛn ɔl dɔn giv ɔp; dɛn dɔn kɔmɔt insay dɛn shɛl wit shem ɛn disgres.
PAPA GƆD de! Lɛ wi prez am. Lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD we na wi kɔba klos, nain de sev wi.
In na PAPA GƆD we de fɛt fɔ mi we ebul put wanol neshɔn ɔnda mi fut,
we de pul mi ɛnimi dɛn kɔmɔt biɛn mi; i mek a bi sɔmbɔdi oba dɛn wan we nɔ wan si mi, ɛn pul dɛn wan we kin kil pɔsin fɔ natin kɔmɔt biɛn mi saful.
PAPA GƆD, na dat mek a go prez yu ɛnisay we a de. A go tɔk yu gud nem ɔlsay.
I de lɛ di wan we i pik fɔ bi kiŋ win in ɛnimi ɛn in lɔv fɔ Devid ɛn in jɛnareshɔn nɔ go chenj. Nain pik Devid so i go lɛk am sote go.
Na Devid in las wɔd dɛn dis. Devid de se di las tin dɛn to una. Devid we na Jɛsi in bɔypikin, we PAPA GƆD we na di GƆD we Jekɔb bin de wɔship mek bi kiŋ. Devid we sabi siŋ dɛn fayn fayn siŋ fɔ Izrɛl.
Na PAPA GƆD de mek a tɔk ɔl wetin a gɛt fɔ se.
Di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship, a min, di PAPA GƆD we de kɔba Izrɛl tɛl mi se: “Ɛni kiŋ we de fred PAPA GƆD ɛn de du wetin rayt,
tan lɛk aw san kiŋ brayt we ren kɔt ɔ lɛk aw ren kin mek di gras luk frɛsh.”
Na tru se PAPA GƆD dɔn blɛs mi ɛn mi pipul. Nain bin dɔn mek Kɔvinant we go kip sote go wit mi ɛn i de kip in wɔd sote go. Na dat nɔmɔ a want as i go mɔs du wetin i se.
Bɔt bad pɔsin tan lɛk chukchuk we nɔ gud fɔ natin pɔsin de fred sɛf fɔ ol am wit in ɛmti an.
If ɛnibɔdi tink se i gɛt fɔ ol am, i go fɛn sɔntin lɛk ayɛn ɔ nɔ so, i go jɛs mek dɛn trowe dɛn na faya fɔ bɔn.

Na di sojaman dɛn dis we Devid bin gɛt. Joshɛb Bashɛbɛth we na bin Takɛmonayt na bin di edman fɔ ɔl di sojaman dɛn we nain di kiŋ de tɛl wetin dɛn wetin fɔ du. Wans ɔf tɛm, in wan yuz in spia ɛn kil et ɔndrɛd man we i go fɛt.
Di ɔda sojaman we tɔf na Ɛlieza, dat na Doday we na Aao in bɔypikin. I bin de wit Devid di tɛm we di Filistin dɛn bin gɛda fɔ fɛt di man dɛn na Izrɛl we dɛn ɛnd-ɔp fɔ rɔnawe.

In waŋren kil bɔku pan di Filistin dɛn we i tinap fɔ fɛt. I bin so tɛns pan di sɔd dat i tan lɛk in an fasin de. PAPA GƆD mek dɛn win ɛn na aftawɔds di ɔda sojaman dɛn kam tek ɔl di dayman dɛn wɛpɔn dɛn.
Di ɔda tɔf sojaman na bin Shama dat na Agi we na Ararayt in bɔypikin. Di Filistin dɛn gɛda fɔ fɛt na Lɛi usay dɛn bin dɔn bay wan gadin we sɔntin lɛkɛ binch de gro ɛn di Filistin dɛn rɔnawe
bɔt Shama in tek in stand fɔ fɛt fɔ di Izrɛlayt ɛn PAPA GƆD mek dɛn win.
I kam bi se wande insay di avɛst Sizin, di tri tan di tati tɔf man go mit Devid na di Kev we i bin de na Adulam. Da tɛm de sɔm pan di Filistin dɛn dɔn gɛda na di Refaim Vali.
Da tɛm de Devid in bin de nain ayd-awt bɔt di Filistin dɛn bin de na dɛn bes na Jerusɛlɛm.
Devid bin fil fɔ drink di wata na Bɛtliɛm bad so i se in wish pɔsin de we kin go na di wɛl we de nia di get na Mɛthliɛm go briŋ di wata kam fɔ am.
So di tri tɔf man pas usay di Filistin dɛn de, go na di wɛl we de nia di gɛt na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn tot wata go bak fɔ Devid. Bɔt i nɔ gri drink am. Bifo dat i tɔn am na grɔn as sakrifays to PAPA GƆD.
I se, “mek PAPA GƆD nɔ mek mi drink wata we pipul risk dɛn layf fɔ go gɛt fɔ mi” So Devid nɔ gri drink di wata. Na dɛn kayn tin de dɛn tri tɔf man du.
Abishay we na Joab in brɔda ɛn Zɛruaya in bɔypikin nain na bin di kakatua pan dɛn tri. I yuz in spia fɔ kil tri ɔndrɛd man. Na so bɔku pipul tek no am.
Nain bin tɔf pas di ɔda wan dɛn so nain tɔn dɛn kɔmanda pan ɔl we nɔto dɛn ɔl bin de di sem gɛŋ.

Bɛnaya we na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin na bin wan ɔda tɔf man we kɔmɔt Kabzil ɛn insɛf du sɔm wɔndaful tin dɛn. I kil tu pan di tɔf man dɛn na Moab. Dɔn i go dɔŋ wanol tɛm we sno I de fɔdɔm ɛn di ples kol ɛn kil wan layɔn de.
Wan ɔda tɛm i kil wan Ijipshian we fayn lɛk tin fɔ it pan ɔl we i bin ol in spia. Bɛnaya in ol koboko fɔ go mit am, jɔg in spia nain an ɛn kil am wit in yon spia.
Na di tin dɛn dis we Bɛnaya dat na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin du; insɛf bin femɔs lɛk di tri tɔf man.
Infakt mɔ pipul bin no am pas di tri tɔf man bɔt nɔto dɛn ol ɔl bin de di sem gɛŋ. So Devid bin mek am de inchaj ɔf in bɔdi gad dɛn.
Na dɛn wan ya i bin pik pan di tati tɔf man: Asaɛl we na Joab in brɔda Ɛlana we na Dodo we kɔmɔt Bɛtliɛm in bɔypikin
Shama ɛn Ilika we kɔmɔt na Arɔd
Ilɛz we kɔmɔt na Pelɛt Ira we Ikɛsh we kɔmɔt Tɛkoa in bɔypikin
Abieza we kɔmɔt Anatɔt Mɛbunay we kɔmɔt na Usha
Zalmɔn we kɔmɔt na Ao Maaray we kɔmɔt na Nɛtofa
Ɛlɛb we na Baana we kɔmɔt na Nɛtofa in bɔypikin Itay we na Ribay we kɔmɔt na Gibia na Bɛnjamin in bɔypikin
Bɛnaya we kɔmɔt na Pirathɔn Iday we kɔmɔt midul usay dɛn mawnten de na Geash
Abialbɔn we kɔmɔt na Araba Azmavɛth we kɔmɔt na Baurim
Ɛlayaba we kɔmɔt na Shaalbɔn Jashɛn in bɔypikin dɛn
we na Jonɛthan ɛn Shama ɛn we kɔmɔt na Ara Ayiam we na Sharar we kɔmɔt na Ara in bɔypikin
Ɛlifɛlɛt we na Aazbay we kɔmɔt na Maaka Iliam we na Aitofɛl we kɔmɔt na Gilo in bɔypikin
Ɛzro we kɔmɔt na Kamɛl Paaray we kɔmɔt na Arab
Igal we na Nethan we kɔmɔt Zoba in bɔypikin Bani we kɔmɔt Gad
Zɛlɛk we na Amɔn Naaray we na Biarɔt we nain bin de tot Joab we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin in tin dɛn we i kin tek fɛt.
Ira ɛn Garɛb we kɔmɔt Jatir
ɛn Yuraya we na Itayt. Bay rayt dɛn na bin tati-sɛvin.
PAPA GƆD vɛks pan di pipul bak so i mek Devid kɔnt ɔmɔs man ebul fɛt na Izrɛl ɛn na Juda.
So di kiŋ tɛl Joab ɛn di ɔda kɔmanda dɛn wit am fɔ kɔnt ɔl di man dɛn we ebul fɛt frɔm ɔp na Dan te rich dɔŋ na Biashiba, so dat i go no ɔmɔs de.
Bɔt Joab pan ɔl we i kɔl di kiŋ, “Di Pa” se lɛ PAPA GƆD mek Devid si we i de mek di sojaman dɛn bɔku dɔn i aks di kiŋ wetin mek i want am fɔ du tin lɛk dat.
Ɛniwe, Joab ɛn di ɔda kɔmanda dɛn du wetin di kiŋ se ɛn dɛn kɔmɔt bifo am go kɔnt ɔl di sojaman dɛn na Izrɛl.
We dɛn dɔn krɔs Riva Jɔdan, dɛn kamp nia Aroa we de na di sawtɛn pat na di siti to usay stip na di vali ɛn pas insay Gad go na Jezɛ.
Dɛn go na Giliad ɛn dɛn eria na Tatim Hodshi ɛn dɛn go na Gad Jaan ɛn go rawnd fɔ go na Saydɔn.
Dɛn go nia Taya usay gɛt traŋa wɔl, ɔl di siti dɛn we di Ivayt ɛn Kenanayt dɛn de. Dɛn rich na Biashiba we de na di Nɛgɛv na Juda.
Afta dɛn dɔn kɔnt na di wanol ples, dɛn tɔn bak go Jerusɛlɛm. Na nayn mɔnt ɛn twɛnti de, dɛn tek fɔ kɔnt ɔl di sojaman dɛn.
Joab go tɛl di kiŋ ɔmɔs sojaman dɛn kɔnt. Insay Izrɛl na et ɔndrɛd tawzin de we kin ol sɔd fɔ fɛt ɛn na Juda na fayv ɔndrɛd tawzin.

Devid fil bad we i mek dɛn kɔnt ɔmɔs man ebul fɛt so i beg PAPA GƆD fɔ fɔgiv am fɔ di fulish we we i biev. I se, “PAPA GƆD, a dɔn sin bad we a mek dɛn kɔnt di sojaman dɛn. Duya, a de beg, fɔgiv mi ɛn nɔ mek a de fil bad fɔ wetin a du so.”
Bifo Devid de grap di nɛks mɔnin, PAPA GƆD dɔn tɛl Gad we na prɔfɛt ɛn we de wit am ɔltɛm nain os,
fɔ go tɛl Devid se, in de tɛl am tri tin, bɔt nain fɔ pik wetin i want PAPA GƆD fɔ du am.

So Gad go to Devid go tɛl am wetin PAPA GƆD se, dat na fɔ lɛ i mek aŋri fɔdɔm na di land fɔ tri ia ɔ lɛ i mek Devid in ɛnimi dɛn de biɛn am fɔ tri mɔnt ɔ lɛ i mek sik we go kil pipul de na di land fɔ tri de. Gad tɛl am fɔ tink gud ɛn tɛl am wetin i fɔ gi as ansa to di wan we sɛn am.
Devid tɛl Gad se in riali de fil bad ɛn nɔ no wetin fɔ du. Devid se in go lɛk PAPA GƆD fɔ tɔk aw i go pɔnish am bikɔs PAPA GƆD at list go sɔri fɔ am. I se in nɔ want mɔtalman an de atɔl.
So PAPA GƆD mek sik we kin kil pipul de na di land frɔm da mɔnin de te di tɛm we i bin dɔn se i go dɔn: na sɛvinti tawzin pipul day insay ɔp na Dan te rich dɔŋ na Biashiba.
Wɛn di enjɛl want fɔ bigin kil di pipul na Jerusɛlɛm, PAPA GƆD sɔri fɔ dɛn ɛn se i du so. Bay da tɛm de di trɔbul bin dɔn bigin pan Arauna we na Jɛbyusayt.
Wɛn Devid si di enjɛl we bin de kil di pipul, i tɛl PAPA GƆD se lɛ in ɛn in famili sɔfa bikɔs nain sin. I se, “Dɛn pipul ya nɔ du natin we fɔ mek dɛn de sɔfa so.”
Da de de Gad go tɛl Devid se i fɔ go usay Arauna we na Jɛbyusayt in mil os de ɛn bil ɔlta fɔ PAPA GƆD.
So Devid insɛf go de go bil di ɔlta lɛk aw Gad se.
Wɛn Arauna ɛn in man dɛn si di kiŋ ɛn in man dɛn de kam nain ples, i go baw bifo am wit in fes na grɔn fɔ sho se i rɛspɛkt am.
Arauna aks am wetin i kam du. Devid tɛl am se i go fɔ go bay in mil os so dat i kin bil ɔlta fɔ PAPA GƆD we go mek di sik we de kil pipul tap.
Arauna tɛl Devid se lɛ i jɛs tek ɛnitin we i want. I gi am man kaw dɛn fɔ bɔn as sakrifays wit di bod dɛn we i kin yuz fɔ mil ɛn ɔl ɔda tin we na bod fɔ wud.
Arauna tɛl di kiŋ se in de gi am ɔltin ɛn pre mek PAPA GƆD in at gladi wit di kiŋ.

Bɔt di kiŋ tɛl Arauna se paopa in fɔ pe fɔ am bikɔs in nɔ go mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD wit ɛnitin we i nɔ pe fɔ. So Devid bay di mil os ɛn di man kaw dɛn. I pe lɛkɛ wan ɛn kwata pawns wet silva fɔ dɛn.
Devid bil di ɔlta fɔ PAPA GƆD de ɛn bɔn animal dɛn as sakrifays ɛn mek pis sakrifays. Dɛn PAPA GƆD ansa in prea fɔ di land ɛn mek di sik we de kil pipul na Izrɛl tap.
Kiŋ Devid bin dɔn ol naw. We dɛn kin kɔba am wit blankit i kin stil fil kol.
So in savant dɛn tɛl am se lɛ dɛn go fɛn wan yɔŋ vajin gyal fɔ am we go tek kia ɔf am. Dɛn se di titi go de lidɔm nia am fɔ lɛ i go de kɔt kol.
Dɛn wirɔn ɔlɔbɔt na Izrɛl de fɛn dis fayn yɔŋ ledi na de dɛn go si wan we nem Abishag we kɔmɔt Shunam ɛn briŋ am to di kiŋ.
Di ledi bin fayn ɛn i bin tan lɛk in nɔsi we bin de du ɔltin fɔ di kiŋ, bɔt di kiŋ nɔ bin lidɔm wit am.
Naw, Adonayja, we in yon mami na Agit put insɛf ɔp se nain fɔ bi kiŋ. I rɛdi ɔs ɛn karej dɛn ɛn fifti man fɔ de lid am.
Na bɔbɔ we wande in dadi nɔ vɛks pan am se i ambɔgin, na man wit gud trenin. Na bin fayn yɔŋman ɛn dɛn bɔn am afta Absalɔm.
Adonayja ɛŋed wit Joab, dat na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin, ɛn wit Abiata, di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. Dɛn bato am.
Bɔt Zedɔk we insɛf na man we de sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn, Bɛnaya we na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin, Prɔfɛt Nethan, Shimɛay wit Rɛy ɛn Devid in raytan man dɛn nɔ bin jɔyn kabudu wit Adonayja.

Adonayja mek ship, got ɛn dɛn fat kaw sakrifays, pantap Snek Rɔk nia Ɛnrogɛl. I invayt ɔl in brɔda dɛn we na di kiŋ in ɔda bɔypikin dɛn, ɛn ɔl di ɔda bigman dɛn na Juda we bin de na di kiŋ in gɔvmɛnt;
bɔt i nɔ invayt Prɔfɛt Nethan ɔ Bɛnaya, ɔ di kiŋ in sikyɔriti ɔ in ɔda brɔda we na Sɔlɔmɔn.
Nethan go mit Sɔlɔmɔn in mama we na Bathshiba ɛn aks if i nɔ yɛri se Agit in bɔypikin we na Adonayja dɔn bi kiŋ ɛn Kiŋ Devid insɛf sɛf nɔ no natin.
I advays am se if i wan sev in yon layf ɛn in bɔypikin Sɔlɔmɔn in layf,
lɛ i go to kiŋ Devid ɛn aks am se if i nɔ bin dɔn swɛ to am se nain bɔypikin Sɔlɔmɔn go sidɔm nain chia ɛn bi kiŋ afta am, ɛn if na so, wetin mek Adonayja dɔn bi kiŋ.
Nethan se we in di Bathshiba go de tɔk to di kiŋ, in go go insay de go mit dɛn ɛn tɔk se na so di tin bin bi.
Bathshiba insɛf go mit di kiŋ na di rum usay Abishag we kɔmɔt na Shuma bin de atɛnd to am. Di kiŋ bin dɔn ol.
Bathshiba nildɔŋ to di kiŋ fɔ sho rɛspɛkt, nain di kiŋ aks am wetin i want.
I ansa di kiŋ se, “Mi lɔd, yu bin dɔn prɔmis mi ɛn swɛ to PAPA GƆD we na yu PAPA GƆD se na yu bɔypikin Sɔlɔmɔn nain go tek yu ples go rul afta yu.
Naw, Adonayja dɔn mek insɛf kiŋ, ɛn kiŋ, yu we na kiŋ nɔ no natin sɛf.
I dɔn sakrifays bɔku bɔku fat ship, got ɛn kaw dɛn, dɔn i invayt ɔl yu bɔypikin dɛn wit Abiata we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn Joab sɛf we na di ami kɔmanda, bɔt i nɔ invayt Sɔlɔmɔn.
Kiŋ, di wanol Izrɛl de luk ɔp to yu fɔ lɛ yu tɛl dɛn udat go bi kiŋ afta yu.
If yu nɔ du dat naw dɔn yu day, dɛn go trit mi ɛn mi bɔypikin Sɔlɔmɔn lɛkɛ ɛnimi.”
Wɛn Bathshiba bin de tɔk to di kiŋ, nain Prɔfɛt Nethan rich de.
Wɛn dɛn anawns Nethan to di kiŋ, i go insay ɛn baw to am fɔ sho rɛspɛkt.
Nethan aks di kiŋ se if i bin dɔn tɔk ɛnitɛm se na Adonayja fɔ sidɔm nain chia ɛn bi kiŋ afta am.

I se da vɛri de de Adonayja dɔn mek big sakrifays; i se i kil bɔku bɔku fat kaw, got ɛn ship, dɔn i invayt di kiŋ in bɔypikin dɛn wit Joab we na kɔmanda fɔ di ami ɛn Abiata we na man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. I se da momɛnt de sɛf we in de tɔk so, na big big pati Adonayja ɛn in kabudu dɛn de pan, ɛn ɔlman de ala se, “Lɛ Kiŋ Adonayja gɛt lɔŋ layf.”
I se dɛn nɔ invayt in di Nethan, Zedɔk we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, Bɛnaya we na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin ɛn Sɔlɔmɔn sɛf.
I aks di kiŋ if na so i mekɔp fɔ du we in nɔ tɛl dɛn udat go sidɔm nain chia.
Kiŋ Devid gi ɔda se lɛ dɛn kɔl Bathshiba fɔ am, so dɛn kɔl Bathshiba. Ɛn i go tinap bifo di kiŋ.
Di kiŋ mek prɔmis to ɔlman. I se, “A swɛ to PAPA GƆD we de oba mi we nain dɔn sev mi pan ɔlkayn trɔbul.
Wetin a bin prɔmis yu Bathshiba trade, we a bin swɛ to PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl se na yu pikin Sɔlɔmɔn go bi kiŋ afta mi, tide, da prɔmis de we a bin mek a de du am.”
Bathshiba nildɔŋ bifo di kiŋ ɛn butu in fes na grɔn ɛn se, “Lɛ di kiŋ we na mi lɔd gɛt lɔŋ layf!”
Kiŋ Devid se lɛ dɛn kɔl Zedɔk we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, Prɔfɛt Nethan ɛn Bɛnaya we na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin. Wɛn dɛn ɔl kam tinap bifo am,
i tɛl dɛn se, “Una put mi bɔysɔn Sɔlɔmɔn pantap mi yon myul ɛn lɛ i rayd am te go dɔŋ na Giɔn.
Na Giɔn, Zedɔk we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn Prɔfɛt Nethan fɔ anɔynt am as kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl. Una blo lawd lawd trɔmpɛt ɛn ala se, ‘Lɛ Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn gɛt lɔŋ layf!’
Dɔn una briŋ am kam bak na ya lɛ i kam sidɔm na mi chia fɔ rul as kiŋ na mi ples. Nain a dɔn pik fɔ bi kiŋ fɔ Juda ɛn Izrɛl.”
Bɛnaya, dat na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin ansa di kiŋ se in go du wetin i se. I se mek PAPA GƆD we na di kiŋ in PAPA GƆD ansa wetin i dɔn se so.
I se in de pre se lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin dɔn de wit di kiŋ, na so i go de wit Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn mek i femɔs pas in papa Kiŋ Devid.

So Zedɔk we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, Prɔfɛt Nethan, Bɛnaya we na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin, dɛn Kɛritayt ɛn dɛn Pɛlɛtayt, dɛn ɔl go wit Sɔlɔmɔn. Dɛn put am pantap Kiŋ Devid in myul ɛn go wit am na Giɔn.
Zedɔk we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, go na di Tɛnt we oli ɛn tek di ɔn we di ɔyl de pan fɔ anɔynt Sɔlɔmɔn wit am. Dɔn dɛn blo trɔmpɛt ɛn ɔlman ala se “Lɛ Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn gɛt lɔŋ layf!”
Ɔl di pipul dɛn go biɛn Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn fala am; dɛn ple flut ɛn bigin gladi. Di nɔys bin so bɔku dat di grɔn shek.
As Adonayja ɛn ɔl in pipul dɛn we i invayt nain pati de dɔn dɛn pati, dɛn yɛri di nɔys. Wɛn Joab yɛri di trɔmpɛt, i aks wetin mek dɛn de mek nɔys so na di siti.

I nɔ tɔk dɔn nain Jonɛtan bɔs pan dɛn. Jonɛtan na Abiata, dat na di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin in bɔypikin. Adonayja kɔl am insay ɛn tɛl am se in na gud man ɛn in no se i mɔs gɛt gud nyuz fɔ dɛn.
Jonɛtan ansa am se in nɔ gɛt nɔn gud nyuz fɔ am. I se Kiŋ Devid dɔn mek Sɔlɔmɔn bi kiŋ.

I se infakt sɛf, di kiŋ dɔn sɛn am wit Zedɔk we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, Prɔfɛt Nethan, Bɛnaya we na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin, dɛn Chɛrɛtayt ɛn dɛn Pɛlɛtayt dɛn, ɛn se dɛn fɔ put am fɔ mek i rayd pantap in yon myul.
I se Zedɔk we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn Prɔfɛt Nethan dɔn anɔynt Sɔlɔmɔn na Giɔn fɔ bi kiŋ. I se di pipul dɛn gladi fɔ am ɛn di wanol siti de sɛlibret, so na di nɔys dat dɛn bin de yɛri.
I se fɔ mek tin swit, Sɔlɔmɔn dɔn sidɔm na di chia usay kiŋ fɔ sidɔm.

I se di kiŋ in wokman dɛn ɔl dɔn go kɔŋratyulet Kiŋ Devid ɛn tɛl am se lɛ PAPA GƆD mek Sɔlɔmɔn in nem go ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl ɛn femɔs pas in di Devid. Di kiŋ sidɔm nain bed ɛn baw in ed ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD. I se,
“Lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship, nain mek am pɔsibul fɔ mi fɔ si di wan we de tek mi ples na di chia tide.”
Wɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn we Adonayja invayt yɛri di stori, dɛn ɔl fred, ɛn grap ɛn tɔn dɛn bak.
Adonayja insɛf bigin fred Sɔlɔmɔn, so i grap go na di ɔlta ɛn go grip di ɔn dɛn we de, de.
Pipul dɛn go tɛl Sɔlɔmɔn se Adonayja de fred so i dɔn go na di ɔlta go grip di ɔn dɛn we de, de. Dɛn se i de ala se Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn fɔ swɛ se i nɔ go kil am.
Sɔlɔmɔn sɛn wɔd go gi am se if i biev insɛf, wan pin nɔ go krach am; bɔt if i de pan yuki yuki, i go day.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn sɛn man dɛn fɔ go pul am kɔmɔt na di ɔlta. Adonayja go to am ɛn baw to am fɔ sho rɛspɛkt. Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn tɛl am lɛ i go nain os saful.
Wɛn Devid in tɛm bin dɔn de rich fɔ day, i kɔl in bɔypikin Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn gi am in las advays.
I se, “Mi tɛm dɔn de rich fɔ go to mi pipul dɛn. Gɛt kɔrej, ɛn sho yusɛf to ɔlman se yu na bɔypikin,
ɛn du wetin yu PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD tɛl yu fɔ du. Kiaful fɔ obe ɔl in lɔ ɛn kɔmandmɛnt we rayt na di lɔ we Mozis gi, so dat ɛnisay we yu go, bɛtɛ go fala yu pan wetin yu de du.
If yu obe PAPA GƆD, i go kip to di prɔmis we i mek to mi se ‘na mi jɛnareshɔn nɔmɔ go de rul Izrɛl if dɛn kip to wetin in se ɛn obe am wit ɔl dɛn at ɛn sol.’

Wan ɔda tin igen, nɔ fɔgɛt wetin Joab du mi we i kil dɛn tu Izrɛl kɔmanda dɛn, dat na Abna, we na Nain bɔypikin ɛn Amasa, Jɛtha in yon bɔypikin. I kil dɛn di tɛm we pis de we wi se nɔn fɛt nɔ fɔ de, dɔn i se in rivɛnj bikɔs dɛn bin kil di tɛm we wi bin de fɛt wa. I kil inosɛnt pipul dɛn dɔn naw na mi tot di trɔbul ɛn mek a de sɔfa fɔ dat.
Nɔ lɛf am so, dil wit am gud ɛn prɔpa; lɛ i nɔ de te i ol.
Bɔt nɔ ambɔgin Bazilay, da Giliadayt in bɔypikin dɛn, lɛ dɛn de nia yu, lɛ dɛn de it wit yu na tebul ɔltɛm; wɛn a bin de rɔnawe pan yu brɔda Absalɔm, na dɛn bin ɛp mi.

Nɔ lɛ Shimɛay, dat na Gera, da Bɛnjamin in fambul we kɔmɔt Baurim in bɔypikin go fri. I bin kɔs mi bad, bad kɔs di tɛm we a bin de go Maanaim. Wɛn i kam mit mi na Riva Jɔdan, a bin swɛ to am bifo PAPA GƆD se a nɔ go kil am.
Bɔt naw, nɔ luk se i nɔ du natin; yu na man we gɛt sɛns; yu no wetin fɔ du wit am so lɛ in wet ia nɔ te nain ed, lɛ i day.”
Devid day ɛn dɛn bɛr am na Devid in siti.
“I rul Izrɛl fɔ fɔti ia; sɛvin ia na Ɛbrɔn ɛn tati-tri ia na Jerusɛlɛm.
Sɔlɔmɔn sidɔm nain papa Devid in chia fɔ rul, ɛn pawa nɔ wande lɛf am.
Adonayja, Agit in bɔypikin go fɛn Bathshiba, dat na Sɔlɔmɔn in mama. So Bathshiba aks am if na fayn fɛn i go fɛn am. I ansa se yɛs,
bɔt se in gɛt sɔntin fɔ tɛl am. So Bathshiba tɛl am lɛ i tɔk wetin i go fɛn am fɔ.

Adonayja tɛl Bathshiba se in di Bathshiba no se nain di Adonayja fɔ de rul as kiŋ, bikɔs nain di wanol Izrɛl bin de luk ɔp to, bɔt tiŋs dɔn chenj ɛn nain brɔda naw de rul, bikɔs na so PAPA GƆD want am fɔ bi.
I se in want am fɔ du wan tin fɔ am bɔt lɛ i nɔ se nɔ So Bathshiba se lɛ i tɔk wetin i want.
I tɛl Bathshiba se lɛ i aks Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn lɛ i gi am Abishag, da Shunamayt uman fɔ bi in wɛf; i se in no se if nain aks Sɔlɔmɔn i nɔ go se nɔ.
Bathshiba ansa am se oke, in go tɔk to di kiŋ fɔ am.
Bathshiba go to Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn fɔ go tɔk to am fɔ Adonayja. Wɛn di kiŋ si in mama, i grap nain chia baw to am ɛn sidɔm bak; dɔn i mek dɛn briŋ ɔda ay chia fɔ am fɔ lɛ i sidɔm nain raytan.
Bathshiba tɛl am se in gɛt wan smɔl tin we in want lɛ i du fɔ am, ɛn i nɔ want am fɔ se nɔ. Di kiŋ se lɛ i tɔk nɔmɔ in go du wetin i se.
So i tɛl am se in want lɛ i gi Abishag, da Shunamayt titi to in brɔda Adonayja fɔ mared.

Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn tɛl in mama se if i kin aks am fɔ lɛ i mek Abishag mared to Adonayja, i fɔ jɛs aks am wantɛm fɔ mek Adonayja bi kiŋ sins nain na di big wan ɛn Abiata we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin wit Joab we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin dɛn ɔl go de biɛn am.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn swɛ to PAPA GƆD se if in nɔ dil wit Adonayja gud ɛn prɔpa wan ɛn kil am, lɛ PAPA GƆD mek i alaki.
I se in swɛ to PAPA GƆD we put am nain papa Devid in chia, ɛn dɔn se na de i go de te i day, in mɔs mek shɔ se Adonayja day da de de.
So Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn gi ɔda to Bɛnaya, Jɛoyada in bɔypikin se Adonayja fɔ day; ɛn dɛn kil am da de de.

Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn drɛb Abiata we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ lɛf di siti ɛn go bak na Anatɔt usay i kɔmɔt. I se in bin fɔ kil am bɔt na we nɔmɔ nain bin de wit in papa Devid wɛn i bin gɛt ɔl in prɔblɛm, ɛn na we bak nain bin de tot PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD in Kɔvinant Bɔks ɛnisay we in papa bin de go.

Sɔlɔmɔn sak Abiata pan di wok as man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. Ɔl dis bi fɔ lɛ wetin PAPA GƆD bin se kam tru. I bin tɔk na Shaylo to Ilaɛl se in jɛnareshɔn nɔ go wok fɔ am igen as man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.

Wɛn Joab yɛri wetin Sɔlɔmɔn dɔn du to Abiata ɛn insɛf na bin wan we jɔyn wit Adonayja pan di ku, i rɔn go na PAPA GƆD in Tɛnt go grip di ɔn dɛn na di ɔlta. Bɔt in nɔ bin jɔyn wit Absalɔm pan da fɔs ku.
Dɛn tɛl Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn se Joab dɔn go na di ɔlta na PAPA GƆD in Tɛnt. Sɔlɔmɔn insɛf gi Bɛnaya, Jɛoyada in bɔypikin ɔda se lɛ i go kil am de.
Bɛnaya go mit Joab de ɛn tɛl am se di kiŋ se lɛ i kɔmɔt de. Bɔt Joab nɔ gri, i se na de i go day. Bɛnaya insɛf go tɛl di kiŋ wetin i se.
So di kiŋ tɛl am se lɛ i du wetin Joab tɛl am, dat na fɔ kil am de, dɔn i bɛr am; so dat in di kiŋ ɛn in famili nɔ go rɛspɔnsibul fɔ di inosɛnt pipul dɛn we Joab bin kil.

Di kiŋ se PAPA GƆD go pe Joab fɔ we i shɛd inosɛnt blɔd, bikɔs in papa Devid insɛf nɔ bin no se Joab go gɛt maynd fɔ atak tu ami kɔmanda dɛn ɛn kil dɛn, dat na Abna we na Nain bɔypikin we na bin kɔmanda fɔ di Izrɛl ami; ɛn Amasa we in na Jɛtha in yon bɔypikin, we insɛf na bin di kɔmanda fɔ Juda ami. I se dɛn bin bɛtɛ pas in di Joab.
I se Abna ɛn Amasa dɛn sin go fɔdɔm na Joab in ed ɛn in jɛnareshɔn dɛn sote go. Bɔt as fɔ Devid ɛn in yon jɛnareshɔn ɛn in wanol famili, PAPA GƆD go mek pis de de sote go.
So Benaya, Jɛoyada in bɔypikin go de go kil Joab. Dɛn bɛr am nain yon grev na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Di kiŋ put Bɛnaya na Joab in ples na di ami, dɔn i put Zedɔk we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na Abiata in ples.
Di kiŋ sɛn kɔl Shimɛay ɛn tɛl am se lɛ i bil os fɔ insɛf na Jɛrusɛlɛm ɛn tap de, ɛn lɛ i nɔ muf in fut kɔmɔt de.
I se if i muf wan inch krɔs Kidrɔn Vali i go day, ɛn da tɛm de nainsɛf i go gɛt fɔ blem.
Shimɛay ansa di kiŋ se dat na fayn aydia, ɛn in go du wetin i se. So i tap na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ lɔŋ.
Bɔt afta tri ia, tu pan Shimɛay in slev dɛn rɔnawe go to Ekish. Ekish na Kiŋ Maaka na Gath in bɔypikin. Shimɛay yɛri se in slev dɛn de na Gath.
Shimɛay insɛf tek dɔŋki go to Ekish na Gath fɔ go fɛn in slev dɛn. Wɛn i si dɛn i briŋ dɛn kam bak.
Bɔt dɛn go koŋosa to Sɔlɔmɔn se Shimɛay dɔn lɛf Jerusɛlɛm go na Gath ɛn dɔn tɔn bak.
Di kiŋ sɛn kɔl Shimɛay ɛn aks am se if i nɔ bin dɔn wɔn am ɛn mek i swɛ to PAPA GƆD se di de we i lɛf di siti go ɛnisay i go day; ɛn if in di Shimɛay nɔ bin ansa am se dat na gud aydia.
I aks am wetin mek i nɔ kip to di kɔmand we i gi am ɛn di swɛ we i bin dɔn swɛ.
I se in di Shimɛay no nain at ɔl wetin i bin du to in papa Devid, ɛn naw PAPA GƆD go pe am fɔ ɔl di bad we i du.
Bɔt in di kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn go de gɛt blɛsin mɔ ɛn mɔ, ɛn Devid in kindɔm go de sote go bifo PAPA GƆD.
Di kiŋ gi ɔda to Bɛnaya we na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin fɔ kil Shimɛay, so Bɛnaya insɛf kɛr am go na do go kil am. Frɔm da tɛm de naw, Sɔlɔmɔn kam sidɔm gud na di kindɔm ɛn nɔ gɛt wan ambɔgin.
Sɔlɔmɔn mek padi wit di kiŋ na Ijipt ɛn mared in gyal pikin. I briŋ di uman kam na Devid in siti ɛn na de i de te i bil in kiŋ os ɛn PAPA GƆD in os dɔn, ɛn bil wɔl rawnd Jerusɛlɛm.
Da tɛm de na difrɛn difrɛn say di pipul dɛn bin de mek dɛn sakrifays bikɔs dɛn nɔ bin bil os fɔ PAPA GƆD yet.
Sɔlɔmɔn sho PAPA GƆD se in lɛk am bay aw i bin de go bay wetin in papa Devid bin dɔn tɛl am, bɔt na difrɛn difrɛn say nɔmɔ i bin de ɔfa in sakrifays to PAPA GƆD ɛn bɔn insɛns.
Wan tɛm i go na Gibiɔn we impɔtant pas ɔl di ɔda ples dɛn fɔ ɔfa sakrifays ɛn ɔfa wan tawzin animal de.
Na Gibiɔn i bin de wan nɛt we PAPA GƆD tɔk to am na drim se lɛ i aks am fɔ ɛnitin we i want, in go gi am.

Sɔlɔmɔn ansa PAPA GƆD se, “Yu dɔn du bɔku gud fɔ mi papa Devid we na yu savant, bikɔs i bin de fred yu ɛn raychɔs, ɛn i bin gɛt gud at. Yu kɔntinyu yu gudnɛs to am ɛn gi am bɔypikin we dɔn sidɔm nain chia tide.
“E PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD! Yu dɔn mek yu savant bi kiŋ nain papa Devid in ples. Bɔt mi na smɔl pikin ɛn a nɔ sabi aw fɔ du di wok.
Yu savant de wit di pipul dɛn we yu dɔn pik. Ɛn dɛn bɔku, dɛn so bɔku dat i at fɔ kɔnt dɛn.
Gi mi sɛns ɛn di kayn at fɔ rul yu pipul dɛn, ɛn fɔ no wetin rayt frɔm wetin rɔŋ. Nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul bay insɛf fɔ rul dɛn pipul ya gud”
PAPA GƆD bin gladi bad we Sɔlɔmɔn aks fɔ dis kayn tin,
so i tɛl am se, “Bikɔs na dis kayn tin yu aks fɔ, yu nɔ aks fɔ lɔŋ layf ɔ jɛntri fɔ yusɛf, yu nɔ aks fɔ lɛ yu ɛnimi dɛn day, bɔt yu aks fɔ lɛ yu gɛt sɛns fɔ de rul fayn,
a go gi yu wetin yu want. A go mek yu gɛt sɛns ɛn no wetin rayt ɛn wetin rɔŋ; sɛns we nɔbɔdi na wɔl nɔ ɛva gɛt ɛn nɔ go ɛva gɛt.
Dɔn igen, a go gi yu wetin yu nɔ aks fɔ sɛf, dat na jɛntri ɛn ɔna, so dat te yu day nɔn kiŋ nɔ go ɛva tan lɛk yu.
Ɛn if yu obe mi ɛn kip mi lɔ lɛkɛ aw yu papa Devid bin de du, a go gi yu lɔŋ layf.”
Wɛn Sɔlɔmɔn wek na da tɛm de i no se na drim i bin de drim. I go na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn tinap bifo PAPA GƆD in Kɔvinant Bɔks ɛn mek animal ɛn pis sakrifays; dɔn i mek pati fɔ ɔl in ɔfisa dɛn.
Wande, tu rare gyal dɛn go tinap bifo Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn.
Di wan se nain ɛn di ɔda uman tap na di sem os ɛn in bɔn in pikin bifo am.
I se tri de afta we in bɔn, nain di ɔda wan insɛf bɔn, ɛn na dɛn tu nɔmɔ de na di os.
I se di ɔda uman in yon pikin day na nɛt bikɔs i lidɔm pan am.
I se wɛn in de slip nain di uman grap midul nɛt go tif in pikin, dɔn i lɛf in yon day pikin gi am.
I se wɛn in grap na mɔnin fɔ sibɔt in pikin i si se na day pikin. Bɔt wɛn i tek tɛm luk am gud wɛn di ples brayt, i si se nɔto di pikin dat we i bɔn.

Di sɛkɛn uman ansa am se na lay, nain di sɛkɛn wan gɛt di layf pikin ɛn in di fɔs wan gɛt di day wan. Bɔt di fɔs uman nɔ gri, i se nɔ, nain di fɔs wan gɛt di pikin dɔn di day wan nain di sɛkɛn wan gɛt am. Dɛn bigin agyu bifo di kiŋ.
Nain di kiŋ ansa dɛn se wan pɔsin de tɔk se nain gɛt di pikin we gɛt layf dɔn na di ɔda wan gɛt di day wan; dɔn di ɔda pɔsin insɛf de tɔk di sem tin,
so lɛ dɛn gi am sɔd. We dɛn briŋ di sɔd kam,
di kiŋ gi ɔda se, lɛ dɛn kɔt di pikin we gɛt layf midul: wan go gɛt af, dɔn di ɔda wan go gɛt di ɔda af.

Di uman we nain bɔn di pikin fɔ tru, tru sɔri fɔ in pikin ɛn tɛl di kiŋ se lɛ i nɔ kil di pikin. I se bifo dat lɛ i gi di ɔda uman dɔn in go bia. Bɔt di ɔda wan in se nɔ, lɛ dɛn kil di pikin lɛ ɔlman fɔfit.
Nain di kiŋ gi jɔjmɛnt lɛ dɛn gi di pikin we gɛt layf to di fɔs uman lɛ dɛn nɔ kil am, bikɔs nain na di mami fɔ tru, tru.
Wɛn ɔlman na Izrɛl yɛri di kiŋ in jɔjmɛnt, dɛn ɔl fred ɛn rɛspɛkt am bikɔs dɛn no se na PAPA GƆD gi am da sɛns de fɔ jɔj da kayn we de.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn na bin kiŋ fɔ di wanol Izrɛl.
Na dɛn man yaso na bin di bigman dɛn nain gɔvmɛnt: Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na Azaraya we na Zedɔk in bɔypikin;
di sɛktri dɛn na Ɛliorɛf ɛn Aija, dɛn na Shisha in bɔypikin dɛn; di klak na Jɛoshafat we na Ailud in bɔypikin.
Di chif kɔmanda fɔ di ami na Bɛnaya, we na Jɛoyada in bɔypikin. Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na Zedɔk ɛn Abiata.
Di bɔsman fɔ di distrikt ɔfisa dɛn na Azaraya we na Nethan in bɔypikin; Zabud we na Nethan in ɔda bɔypikin na bin man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di kiŋ in advaysa.
Di man we de inchaj ɔf di wokman dɛn na di kiŋ in kiŋ os na Aisha; di man inchaj ɔf dɛn man we de wok bay fos na Adoniram we na Abda in bɔypikin.
Sɔlɔmɔn pik twɛlv man dɛn as distrikt ɔfisa dɛn na Izrɛl, ɛn na dɛn bin rɛspɔnsibul fɔ sɔplay ɔl wetin di kiŋ ɛn in kiŋ os want. Dɛn bin de tek am bay tɔn fɔ de sɔplay bay mɔnt te di ia dɔn.
Na di man dɛn dɛn wan ya: Bɛnɔ in rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Ifrem we de ɔp di il;
Bɛndɛka in rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Makaz Shaalbim, Bɛtshɛmɛsh ɛn Ɛlɔn Bɛthanan;
Bɛnɛsɛd in rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Arubɔth. Sɔkɔ ɛn Ɛfɛr bin de insay Arubɔth.
Bɛnabinadab in rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Nafɔth Dɔ; nain bin mared Sɔlɔmɔn in gyal pikin we nem Tafath.
Baana, Ailud in bɔypikin in bin rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Taanak, Mɛgido te rich na Bɛth Shan nia Zarɛthan te go dɔŋ to Jɛzril. In bawndri de frɔm Bɛth Shan to Ebɛl Mɛola te go oba to Jokmeam.
Bɛn Gɛbɛr in rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Ramɔt Giliad ɛn ɔl dɛn vilej we Manasɛ in bɔypikin Jair gɛt na Giliad. Nain gɛt Agɔb Distrikt na Beshan wit ɔl di siksti siti dɛn we gɛt ayɛn get.
Ainadab, Ido in bɔypikin rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Maanaim.
Aimaaz rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Naftali, ɛn nain bin mared Sɔlɔmɔn in ɔda gyal pikin we nem Basimath.
Baana we na, Ushay in bɔypikin rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Asha ɛn Bialɔth.
Jɛoshafat we na, Parva in bɔypikin rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Isaka.
Shimɛay we na, Ila in bɔypikin rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Bɛnjamin.

Gɛbɛr we na, Yuri in bɔypikin rɛspɔnsibul fɔ Giliad; nain gɛt di Amɔrayt dɛn kɔntri usay Siɔn bin de rul as kiŋ ɛn Beshan usay Ɔg insɛf na bin kiŋ. Nain nɔmɔ na bin di onli gɔvna we de inchaj ɔf wanol distrikt.
Di pipul dɛn na Juda ɛn Izrɛl bin bɔku lɛkɛ sansan na bich; dɛn bin gɛt ɔltin fɔ it ɛn drink ɛn ɔlman bin gladi.
Sɔlɔmɔn rul ɔl di kindɔm dɛn frɔm Riva Yufretis, to Filistia te rich na di bɔda fɔ go Ijipt. Ɔl dɛn kɔntri ya bin de ɔnda Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn bin de pe taks to am ɔl di tɛm we i bin de rul.
Di sɔplay we Sɔlɔmɔn bin de gɛt ɛvride na wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti bushɛl fayn flawa;
tɛn kaw we de it spɛshal it, twɛnti kaw we de it gras, wan ɔndrɛd ship, wit dia, antilop, fritambo ɛn fɔl.
Sɔlɔmɔn bin de rul ɔl di kindɔm frɔm di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis to Tifsa to Gaza, ɛn pis bin de na di wanol kindɔm.
Di tɛm we Sɔlɔmɔn bin de rul Juda ɛn Izrɛl frɔm ɔp na Dan te go dɔŋ na Biashiba bin gɛt pis, ɔlman bin de ɛnjɔy fɔ sidɔm ɔnda in vayn ɛn fig tik dɛn.
Sɔlɔmɔn bin gɛt fɔti tawzin ples fɔ kip in ɔs dɛn we gɛt karej ɛn twɛlv tawzin ɔs dɛn fɔ fɛt wa.
Di twɛlv gɔvna dɛn we i gɛt na di twɛlv distrikt bin de tek am bay tɔn fɔ de sɔplay in ɛn in trenja dɛn provishɔn fɔ wan wan mɔnt. Dɛn nɔ wande fel pan dɛn dyuti.
Dɛn bin de sɔplay bali ɛn strɔ fɔ di ɔs dɛn we de drɔ karej ɛn di ɔda ɔs dɛn.
PAPA GƆD gi Sɔlɔmɔn sɛns we nɔbɔdi nɔ wande gɛt. I mek i no ɛn sabi bɔku tin we pas sansan sɛf na bich.
Sɔlɔmɔn bin gɛt sɛns pas di sɛnsman dɛn na di Ist ɛn di sɛnsman dɛn na Ijipt.
I bin gɛt sɛns pas ɔlman na wɔl; i gɛt sɛns pas Ithan di Ɛzrayt, pas Ɛman, Kalkɔl, ɛn Dada we dɛn na Maɔl in bɔypikin dɛn. Dɛn bin de tɔk bɔt am na ɔl dɛn ɔda kɔntri dɛn.
Sɔlɔmɔn pul tri tawzin parebul ɛn rayt pas wan tawzin ɛn fayv siŋ dɛn.
I tɔk bɔt dɛn plant dɛn layf, bɔt dɛn sida tik dɛn na Libanɔn, ɛn dɛn isɔp plant we de gro na dɛn wɔl. I tɔk bɔt dɛn animal we de waka wit dɛn bɛlɛ na grɔn, di ɔda animal dɛn, dɛn bɔd ɛn dɛn fish.
Kiŋ dɛn na difrɛn pat na di wɔl yɛri bɔt Sɔlɔmɔn in sɛns ɛn dɛn sɛn pipul dɛn fɔ go lisin to am we i de tɔk.
Kiŋ Ayrɛm na Taya na bin Devid in gud, gud padi. Wɛn i yɛri se dɛn dɔn anɔynt Sɔlɔmɔn fɔ tek in papa Devid in ples as kiŋ, i sɛn in ambasedɔ dɛn to am.
Na dis riplay Sɔlɔmɔn insɛf bin sɛn to Ayrɛm:
“Yu no se mi papa Devid nɔ bin ebul fɔ bil os fɔ de wɔship in PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD bikɔs in bin de fɛt bɔku wa wit in neba kɔntri dɛn, bɔt PAPA GƆD mek i kɔnka dɛn.
Naw, PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD, dɔn gi mi pis ɔlɔbɔt, a nɔ gɛt nɔn ɛnimi ɛn nɔ prɔblɛm nɔ de igen
PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl mi papa Devid se nain pikin we i go mek rul afta am go bil os fɔ am. A dɔn mekɔp mi maynd naw fɔ bil di os fɔ de wɔship mi PAPA GƆD, we na PAPA GƆD.

Yu no se mi wokman dɛn nɔ sabi kɔt timba lɛk yu yon wokman dɛn so duya, sɛn sɔm pan yu wokman dɛn fɔ go kɔt timba fɔ mi na Libanɔn. Misɛf yon wokman dɛn go jɔyn dɛn ɛn a go pe ɛni amawnt fɔ di wok we yu go aks fɔ.”
Wɛn Ayrɛm yɛri Sɔlɔmɔn in mɛsej, i gladi bad ɛn prez PAPA GƆD se nain dɔn gi Devid pikin we gɛt sɛns fɔ rul da big big kɔntri de.
Ayrɛm insɛf ansa Sɔlɔmɔn se i dɔn gɛt in mɛsej ɛn i go gi am wetin i aks fɔ. I se i go sɛn di sida ɛn di payn timba.

I se in wokman dɛn go go kɔt dɛn na Libanɔn, dɔn dɛn go kɛr dɛn go na di si usay dɛn go tay tay dɛn fɔ lɛ dɛn go flot pantap di si ɛn krɔs dɛn go oba to am. I se wɛn dɛn rich oba usay i want dɛn, dɛn go lus am ɛn an dɛn ova to in yon man dɛn. I se wetin in want fɔ di pe na it fɔ ɔl udat de nain os.
Ayrɛm sɔplay Sɔlɔmɔn ɔl di sida ɛn payn timba we i want;
Sɔlɔmɔn insɛf gi am wan ɔndrɛd tawzin bushɛl wit ɛn wan ɔndrɛd ɛn tɛn tawzin galɔn piɔ ɔliv ɔyl. Sɔlɔmɔn bin de gi Ayrɛm dis kota ɛvri ia.
PAPA GƆD gi Sɔlɔmɔn sɛns jɛs lɛkɛ aw i bin dɔn tɔk nɔmɔ. Di padi biznɛs bitwin Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn Ayrɛm bin fayn ɛn dɛn tu bin gɛt wanwɔd.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn gɛda tati tawzin man na di wanol Izrɛl fɔ wok bay fos pan di os we i de bil fɔ PAPA GƆD,
dɔn i put Adoniram inchaj ɔf dɛn ɔl. I mek di wokman dɛn sheb to tri grup, tɛn tawzin na wan grup. Wan grup de go wan mɔnt na Libanɔn ɛn kam bak kam tek tu mɔnt na os.
Sɔlɔmɔn gɛt eti tawzin man we de kɔt ston ɔp il, dɔn i gɛt sɛvinti tawzin we de tot ston.
I put tri tawzin, tri ɔndrɛd fɔman dɛn fɔ de supavays di wok.
Di kiŋ gi ɔda fɔ lɛ dɛn kɔt fayn big ston dɛn fɔ di os we i de bil fɔ PAPA GƆD, in fawndeshɔn.
Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn Ayrɛm dɛn wokman dɛn, ɛn di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Gebal kɔt ston ɛn timba fɔ bil di os fɔ PAPA GƆD.

Sɔlɔmɔn bigin bil di os fɔ PAPA GƆD fo ia afta we i bi kiŋ. I bigin di wok insay Ziv mɔnt, dat na di sɛkɛn mɔnt na di ia. Ɔl dis yaso bi fo ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti-et ia frɔm di tɛm we di Izrɛlayt dɛn lɛf Ijipt.
Di os fɔ PAPA GƆD lɔŋ naynti fut; i wayd tati fut, dɔn in ayt na fɔti-fayv fut.
Di frɔnt viranda lɔŋ fiftin fut ɛn wayd tati fut; i wayd lɛkɛ aw di os fɔ PAPA GƆD insɛf tan.
Di winda dɛn gɛt ol dɛn we de na di wɔl. Di ol in mɔt na do smɔl dɔn di wan insay big.
Di wɔl dɛn na di tu sayd ɛn biɛn gɛt apatmɛnt dɛn;

na tri stori dɛn bil na di apatmɛnt. Wan stori in ayt pan di apatmɛnt na sɛvin ɛn af fut. Wan rum in mɛzhɔmɛnt na di fɔs flɔ na sɛvin ɛn af fut wayd, di sɛkɛn flɔ in nayn fut wayd dɔn di tɔd flɔ na tɛn ɛn af fut wayd. Di wɔl dɛn na di fɔs flɔ tik pas di wan dɛn we de pantap am dɔn di wan dɛn na di sɛkɛn flɔ tik pas di wan dɛn na di tɔd flɔ; dɛn du dis fɔ lɛ dɛn nɔ go gɛt fɔ bɔs ol fɔ put tik dɛn insay fɔ sɔpɔt di wɔl dɛn.
Bikɔs na kwari dɛn bin dɔn kɔt kɔt ɔl di ston dɛn fɔ bil di tɛmpul, dɛn nɔ bin gɛt wan kɔz fɔ yuz ama, chisul ɔ ɛni ayɛn tul wɛn dɛn de bil di os fɔ PAPA GƆD. Nɔn nɔys nɔ bin de de.
Di stɛp fɔ go insay di apatmɛnt na di os fɔ PAPA GƆD bin de na di lɛfan say ɛn na de ɔlman de pas te go na di sɛkɛn ɛn tɔd flɔ.
Na so Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn tek bil di os fɔ PAPA GƆD dɔn. Na tik tik sida bod dɛn put ɛn krɔs krɔs di ɔda layt sida bod pan dɛn fɔ mek di silin.
As fɔ di tri stori apatmɛnt, ich flɔ in ayt na sɛvin ɛn af fut. I yuz tik tik sida bod dɛn fɔ jɔyn di apatmɛnt in wɔl to di os fɔ PAPA GƆD in yon wɔl.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to Sɔlɔmɔn. I se,
“Lɛkɛ we yu de bil dis os so, if nɔmɔ yu obe mi ɛn du ɔl wetin a tɛl yu, a go gi yu ɔl wetin a prɔmis yu papa Devid.
A go tap wit di Izrɛlayt dɛn; dɛn na mi pipul dɛn ɛn a nɔ go lɛf dɛn.”
So Sɔlɔmɔn bil PAPA GƆD in os dɔn.
Sɔlɔmɔn kɔba di insay wɔl dɛn wit sida bod frɔm di grɔn te go ɔp di silin, dɔn i yuz payn bod fɔ mek di flɔ.
I kɔt wan rum insay de we i se na de fɔ oli pas ɔl. Di rum in mɛzhɔmɛnt na tati fut. Na sida bod i yuz fɔ patishɔn am frɔm di grɔn te go ɔp di silin.
Di opin spes we de bifo di rum we fɔ oli pas ɔl lɔŋ siksti fut.
Dɛn kav kalbas ɛn flawa dɛn pan di sida bod dɛn na di wɔl; dɛn kɔba ɔl di wɔl dɛn insay wit sida bod fɔ lɛ nɔn ston nɔ sho.
I rɛdi di rum we nainsay de i se dɛn fɔ de kip PAPA GƆD in Kɔvinant Bɔks.
Dis rum lɔŋ tati fut wayd tati fut ɛn ay tati fut i kɔba ɔlsay wit piɔ gold. Na sida bɔd i yuz fɔ mek di ɔlta ɛn kɔba insɛf wit piɔ gold.
I yuz gold fɔ kɔba insay PAPA GƆD in os; dɔn i blɔk di rum we oli pas ɔl in domɔt wit tik tik gold chen.
I kɔba insay di wanol ples wit gold, ɛn di ɔlta insɛf na di say we oli pas ɔl.
I yuz ɔliv bɔd kav tu chɛryubim. Dɛn bin de na di ples we oli pas ɔl. Wan in ayt na fiftin fut.
Wan chɛryubim in fɛda sɛvin ɛn af fut ɛn na tu, tu fɛda dɛn ɔl gɛt. Di spes bitwin dɛn ɔltu na fiftin fut.
Di sɛkɛn chɛryubim na di sem wit di fɔs wan.
Wan chɛryubim in ayt na fiftin fut.
I put di chɛryubim dɛn insay di rum we oli pas ɔl, dɛn ɔltu de sayd bay sayd, dɔn dɛn fɛda dɛn opin te tɔch di wɔl ɛn tɔch dɛnsɛf.
I kɔba di chɛryubim dɛnsɛf wit gold.
I kav chɛryubim dɛn, pam tri dɛn ɛn opin flawa dɛn insay na di wɔl dɛn insay ɔl di rum dɛn.
I kɔba ɔl di rum dɛn grɔn wit gold.
Na di domɔt fɔ go insay di rum we oli pas ɔl, tu af do de we na ɔliv bod i yuz fɔ mek dɛn dɔn i gi di domɔt fayv sayd we gɛt tɔnoba v pantap.
I kav chɛryubim dɛn, pam tri dɛn ɛn opin flawa dɛn pan di tu af do, dɔn i kɔba di chɛryubim dɛn ɛn di pam tri dɛn wit gold.
I gi di frem fɔ di men domɔt fɔ go insay di men ɔl fo kɔna. I mek am wit ɔliv bod.
I mek tu af do wit payn bod we de fol na ɔltu di sayd dɛn.
I kav chɛryubim dɛn, pam tri dɛn ɛn opin flawa pan dɛn do ya ɛn kɔba ɔl wit gold.
I bil ay wɔl rawnd di kɔmpawnd. Fɔ ɛni tri ston blɔk we i put, i de put wan big sida bod midul dɛn.
Sɔlɔmɔn le di fawandeshɔn fɔ PAPA GƆD in os insay Ziv mɔnt, fo ia afta we i dɔn bi kiŋ.
I bil am dɔn insay Bul mɔnt, di ia we mek am ilɛvin ia we i bi kiŋ. I put ɔl wetin i bin mekɔp fɔ put de, ɛn na sɛvin ia i tek fɔ bil am.
Sɔlɔmɔn tek tɔtin ia fɔ bil ples we i fɔ tap as kiŋ.
I bil di ɔl we dɛn de kɔl ‘Libanɔn Fɔrɛst’ insay in kɔmpawnd. Di ɔl in mɛzhɔmɛnt na wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti fut lɔŋ, sɛvinti-fayv fut wayd ɛn fɔti-fayv fut ay.
In ruf rɛst pantap fɔti-fayv sida pila dɛn, wit fiftin pila na wan ro.
Di tu men wɔl dɛn gɛt tri, tri winda bay ro. Winda de ɔpozit in kɔmpin.
Na tri domɔt i put na di frɔnt pat ɛn dɛn ɔl bin gɛt rɛktaŋul shep.
I mek ston pila dɛn fɔ sɔpɔt di ruf na di viranda. Di viranda in mɛnzhɔmɛnt na sɛvinti fayv fut lɔŋ ɛn fɔti-fayv fut wayd, ɛn di ruf lɔŋ te i kɔba di wanol viranda wit pila dɛn ɔl rawnd am.
I bil di ɔl usay di chia de we na usay i go sidɔm fɔ jɔj kes ɛn kɔba di wanol ples wit sida bod frɔm di grɔn te rich ɔp di silin.

Lɛkɛ aw Sɔlɔmɔn bil di ples we i de sidɔm fɔ jɔj kes na so i bil di kwata we na de in fɔ tap, ɛn na biɛn di say we i de sidɔm fɔ jɔj kes i bil am. Sɔlɔmɔn bil dis sem kayn os fɔ in wɛf, dat na di kiŋ na Ijipt in pikin.
Dɛn tek gud ston blɔk dɛn mek di bildin dɛn insay di kɔmpawnd, frɔm di fawndeshɔn te go ɔp di ruf; dɛn tek tɛm chisul di blɔk dɛn lɛ ɔl di sayd dɛn smut.
Na gud kwaliti ston dɛn yuz le di fawndeshɔn, sɔm na twɛlv fut lɔŋ, sɔm na fiftin.
Dɛn le ɔda ay kwaliti blɔk dɛn pantap dɛn wan ya ɛn put sida bod midul dɛn.
Dɛn dizayn di wɔl na di kɔmpawnd wit tri ston blɔk, wan sida bod; tri ston blɔk, wan sida bod te go rawnd am so dat insay am fiba jɛs lɛk di wɔl dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn di frɔnt pɔch nain os.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn sɛn kɔl wan man we nem Uram na Taya.

In mama kɔmɔt na Naftali fambul bɔt in man bin dɔn day, ɛn in papa in kɔmɔt Taya, ɛn na man we bin sabi mek tin dɛn wit bras. Uram sɛf bin gɛt di sɛns ɛn skil fɔ mek ɔlkayn tin wit bras. Nain du ɔl di bras wok fɔ Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn.
Uram mek tu bras pila ɛn put dɛn na di men domɔt fɔ pas go insay PAPA GƆD in os. Dɛn ayt na twɛnti-sɛvin fut, dɔn rawnd na etin fut.
I kav tu fayn fayn dizayn pantap di ston pila dɛn. Wan in ayt na sɛvin ɛn af fut.
I mek fotin chen ɛn rap dɛn sɛvin, sɛvin rawnd di pila dɛn pan di tin dɛn we i kav.
I tek bras mek tu ro pomigranet shep ɛn yuz dɛn fɔ dɛkɔret rawnd di tin dɛn we i kav. I mek am pan di tu pila.
Di tin dɛn we i mek pantap di pila dɛn shep lɛkɛ da Lili flawa ɛn dɛn ayt na siks fut.
I mek tu tu ɔndrɛd pomigranet shep tin dɛn ɛn arenj dɛn bay ro pantap di pila dɛn. Wan pila gɛt tu ɔndrɛd ɛn i put dɛn to di say we shep lɛk bol nia to di chen dɛn.
Wɛn i dɔn mek ɔltin dɔn, i put di pila dɛn na di frɔnt viranda na PAPA GƆD in os. Di pila we i put na di sawt pat i gi am nem Jakin dɔn di wan na di nɔth i gi am nem Boaz
Di tin dɛn ɔl bin shep lɛkɛ da flawa we nem Lili. Na so i tek dɔn da wok de.
Uram mek rawnd wata tank wit bras. Di insay dip sɛvin ɛn af fut, rawnd na fɔti-fayv fut, dɔn pantap na fiftin fut. Dɛn bin de kɔl am di si.
I dizayn kalbas rayt rawnd di tank. Dɛn bin de na tu ro ɛn di sem tɛm we i mek di tank, nain i mek dɛn.
I mek twɛlv bras kaw we na pan dɛn di tank sidɔm. Di kaw dɛn tinap tri, tri; tri tɔn dɛn fes to di nɔth; tri to di sawt, tri to di ist ɛn tri to di wɛst; dɔn dɛn ɔl wes tɔn insay ɔnda di tank.
Di tank in bɔdi tri inchis tik. In rim rawnd lɛkɛ kɔp ɛn ɛŋ ɛn kɔv lɛk da Lili flawa. I nɔ gɛt shap ɛj, ɛn na tɛn tawzin galɔn wata i de tek.
Uram mek tɛn bras ɔmɔlanke: wan lɔŋ siks fut, di ayt na fo ɛn af fut, dɔn i wayd siks fut.
Di ayɛn dɛn we i yuz gɛt skwaya frem.
I put layɔn, kaw ɛn chɛryubim dɛn midul di ayɛn dɛn, dɔn i mek flawa dɛn pantap ɛn ɔnda di layɔn ɛn kaw dɛn.
Di ɔmɔlanke dɛn ɔl gɛt bras wil dɛn ɛn bras ayɛn dɛn fɔ ol dɛn wil. I put stand dɛn na di fo kɔna fɔ de ol bol; i mek flawa dɛn pan di stand dɛn.

Di stand dɛn ɔl gɛt rawnd frem pantap fɔ ol di bol dɛn; wɛn dɛn sidɔm pan dɛn frem, dɛn ayt na etin inchis ɔp dɔn i wayd twɛnti-sɛvin inchis na di ɔmɔlanke. I kav tin dɛn rawnd di bol dɛn. Di ayɛn dɛn ɔl na skwaya shep dɛn gɛt, dɛn nɔ rawnd.
Di ɔmɔlanke in wil dɛn na twɛnti-sɛvin inchis. Di ayɛn we ol di wil fasin pan di ɔda ayɛn dɛn.
Di wil dɛn tan lɛkɛ karej wil. Na ayɛn dɛn tek mek di wil, in rim, in spoks ɛn di ɔb dɛn.
Di ɔmɔlanke dɛn ɔl gɛt fo fo andul na dɛn fo kɔna fɔ ol dɛn. Na di sem ayɛn dɛn tek mek dɛn.
Dɛn ɔl gɛt nayn inchis rop pan dɛn. Ɔl di ayɛn dɛn pan di ɔmɔlanke dɛn ɔl jɔyn pan dɛn kɔmpin. Nɔn bolt ɛn nɔt nɔ de pan dɛn.
Uram kav chɛryubim, layɔn ɛn pamtri dɛn pan di fut ɛn di sayd dɛn pan di ɔmɔlanke dɛn, ɛn mek flawa ɔl rawnd. Ɛnisay we i si spes i de kav sɔntin de.
Na so i mek ɔl tɛn di ɔmɔlanke ɛn dɛn ɔl na bin wankayn.
Uram mek tɛn bras baf pan fɔ di tɛn ɔmɔlanke. Wan baf pan wayd siks fut ɛn na tu ɔndrɛd galɔn wata i de tek.
I put fayv ɔmɔlanke na di Sawt pat na PAPA GƆD in os, dɔn di ɔda fayv i put dɛn na di Nɔt pat; i put di big tank midul di Sawt-Ist pat na PAPA GƆD in os.
Uram mek pɔt, shɔbul ɛn pan dɛn. I mek shɔ se i dɔn ɔl di wok fɔ Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn na PAPA GƆD in os. Na di tin dɛn dis we i mek:
di tu pila; di tu fayn fayn dizayn we shep lɛk bolpantap di pila dɛn; di tu chen we de pan di fayn fayn dizayn dɛn;
di fo ɔndrɛd pomigranet shep dizayn fɔ di chen dɛn, di pomigranet shep dɛn de na tu ro we ɛŋ pan di fayn fayn dizayn dɛn pantap di pila dɛn;
di tɛn ɔmɔlanke wit dɛn tɛn baf pan;
di wata tank wit di twɛlv kaw ɔnda am;
di pɔt, shɔbul ɛn pan dɛn. Na bras Uram yuz fɔ mek ɔl dɛn tiŋs ya fɔ Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn fɔ de na PAPA GƆD in os.
Di kiŋ mek i mek ɔl dɛn tiŋs ya na di say we dɛn blaksmith de wok na Jɔdan Vali bitwin Sɔkɔt ɛn Zarɛthan.
Bikɔs di tiŋs dɛn bin tu bɔku, Sɔlɔmɔn nɔ we dɛn. I nɔ ivin we di bras.
Sɔlɔmɔn mek ɔl di fɔnichɔ fɔ di tɛmpul: di gold ɔlta, di gold tebul we na de dɛn de put di bred we dɛn de ɔfa to PAPA GƆD;
di piɔ gold stand dɛn fɔ di lamp dɛn, fayv na di raytan ɛn fayv na di lɛfan bifo di rum we oli pas ɔl; di flawa dɛn, di lamp dɛn ɛn di fɔk fɔ pul ɔt kol na faya;
di piɔ gold bol dɛn, di sizɔs fɔ trim lamp wik, kɔp, insɛns pɔt, di gold inchis fɔ di do dɛn we de na di rum we oli pas ɔl ɛn fɔ di ɔda do dɛn. Na gold i tek mek ɔl dɛn tiŋs ya.
Wɛn Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn dɔn du ɔl di wok we i fɔ du na PAPA GƆD in os, i kɛr di tiŋs dɛn we in Papa Devid bin dɔn gi fɔ de de, dat na di silva; gold ɛn ɔda fɔnichɔ dɛn, ɛn put ɔl insay de.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn sɛn kɔl ɔl dɛn agbagba dɛn na Izrɛl, di edman dɛn fɔ di fambul dɛn ɛn ɔl di ɔda bigman dɛn. I se dɛn fɔ kam wit di Kɔvinant Bɔks na PAPA GƆD in os we de na Zayɔn, we na Devid in siti.
Ɔl di man dɛn na Izrɛl gɛda kam to Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn di tɛm we dɛn bin de sɛlibret di ɔlide fɔ slip na bafa; dat na bin Ɛthanim mɔnt, we na di mɔnt we mek sɛvin na di ia.
Wɛn dɛn rich, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin tek di Kɔvinant Bɔks,
di tɛnt we dɛn kin de mit wit PAPA GƆD ɛn ɔl di ɔda Oli tiŋs dɛn we bin de de ɛn kɛr dɛn go na PAPA GƆD in os.
Ɔl di pipul dɛn gɛda rawnd Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn bifo di Kɔvinant Bɔks. I kil bɔku bɔku ship ɛn kaw we nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul kɔnt.
Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin put di Kɔvinant Bɔks insay PAPA GƆD in os na di say we oli pas ɔl, midul di chɛryubim dɛn fɛda.
Di chɛryubim dɛn fɛda bin opin usay di Kɔvinant Bɔks de wit di pol dɛn fɔ tot am.
Dɛn pol dɛn ya bin so lɔŋ dat pɔsin kin tinap na di oli ples in domɔt ɛn si dɛn, bɔt yu nɔ go si dɛn we yu de na do. Dɛn de de te tide.
Di onli tin we bin de insay di Kɔvinant Bɔks na di tu ston tablɛt we Mozis bin put de di tɛm we i bin de na Mawnt Ɔrɛb usay PAPA GƆD bin mek Kɔvinant wit di Izrɛlayt dɛn wɛn dɛn lɛf Ijipt.
Wɛn di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin kɔmɔt insay di oli ples, klawd kɔba PAPA GƆD in wanol os,
