dat mek di man dɛn nɔ ebul fɔ du dɛn wok. PAPA GƆD in glori ful-ɔp di wanol os.
Sɔlɔmɔn tɔk se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn put di san ɔp di klawd, bɔt i se na usay tik tik daknɛs de i go de.
A dɔn bil wan big ɛn fayn os we yu go de sote go.”
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɔl tinap de luk di kiŋ. I tɔn rawnd, luk dɛn ɛn blɛs dɛn.
Dɔn i se, “Prez PAPA GƆD Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD, we nain yon an i dɔn tek fɔ du wetin i prɔmis mi Papa Devid, we i se,

frɔm di de we i pul in yon pipul dɛn we na di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt, i nɔ bin pik nɔn siti pan dɛn fambul dɛn na Izrɛl we na de dɛn fɔ bil os fɔ am; bɔt in pik Devid fɔ de rul di Izrɛlayt dɛn we nain yon pipul dɛn.
I bin de na mi Papa Devid in at fɔ bil os fɔ PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD so dat dɛn go rɛspɛkt an mɔ.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD tɛl mi Papa Devid se, bikɔs nain bin dɔn mekɔp am nain at se in go bil os fɔ am so dat dɛn go rɛspɛkt an, na gud tin da wande we i mekɔp,
bɔt nɔto in go bil di tɛmpul; nain bɔypikin we nain yon flɛsh ɛn blɔd go bil am.
PAPA GƆD dɔn kip to di prɔmis we i mek: i bin se na mi go sidɔm na mi Papa Devid in ples, naw na mi dɔn sidɔm so na di chia na Izrɛl, ɛn na mi sem wan dɔn bil os fɔ PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD.
A dɔn mek ples we di Kɔvinant Bɔks fɔ de, we nainsay de di Kɔvinant we i mek wit wi papa dɛn we i pul kɔmɔt na Ijipt de.”
Sɔlɔmɔn tinap bifo di ɔlta usay ɔlman bin de si am ɛn es in an ɔp ɛn pre se,
“PAPA GƆD, we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, nɔn Gɔd nɔ de na ɛvin ɔ ath we tan lɛk yu - na yu waŋren kin kip yu Kɔvinant ɛn sho lɔv to yu savant dɛn we de waka tret wit yu;
yu kip yu prɔmis to yu savant, Devid mi papa, ɛn ɔl wetin yu bin tɔk nain yu dɔn du so tide.

Ɛn naw PAPA GƆD, yu we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, a de beg yu lɛ yu kip to di ɔda prɔmis we yu mek to mi papa Devid we yu se nain jɛnareshɔn nɔmɔ go de rul na Izrɛl if dɛn waka tret wit yu ɛn kip to yu lɔ lɛkɛ aw insɛf bin de du;
Duya PAPA GƆD, kip da prɔmis we yu mek to mi papa Devid.
“Bɔt fɔ tru tru se PAPA GƆD yu go kam tap dɔŋ na di wɔl? Di klawd sɛf te rich ɔp ɔp di skay nɔ ebul ol yu bifo a se dis lili abule we a dɔn bil!
E PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD, mi na yu savant, duya ansa dis prea we a de pre to yu tide.
Mek yu yay de pan dis os de ɛn nɛt, bikɔs na de yu dɔn pik se fɔ de wɔship yu; ɛnitɛm we a kam ya fɔ pre to yu, duya ansa mi.
“Duya ansa mi prea, ɛn di pipul dɛnsɛf yon prea wɛn dɛn kam na dis os fɔ pre. Usay yu de na yu os na ɛvin, ansa wi prea ɛn fɔgiv wi.
“If dɛn briŋ ɛnibɔdi na yaso se i du bad, dɔn i nildɔŋ bifo dis ɔlta na di os fɔ swɛ se in nɔ du natin,
duya PAPA GƆD, ansa di prea na ɛvin ɛn gi jɔjmɛnt. Pɔnish di wan we rɔŋ ɛn fri di wan we nɔ gilti lɛ ɔlman no se i inosɛnt.
“If yu pipul we na di Izrɛlayt dɛn lɔs wa bikɔs dɛn bin dɔn sin, if dɛn tɔn to yu ɛn kam na dis os ɛn ɔmbul dɛnsɛf ɛn pre to yu fɔ masi,
ansa dɛn prea na ɛvin. Fɔgiv dɛn fɔ dɛn sin ɛn briŋ dɛn kam bak na di land we yu bin gi dɛn papa dɛn.
“If yu ol di ren fɔ lɛ i nɔ kam bikɔs dɛn sin, if dɛn kam na dis os ɛn ɔmbul dɛnsɛf, kɔnfɛs dɛn sin ɛn beg yu fɔ masi,
yɛri dɛn prea na ɛvin. Fɔgiv di kiŋ ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn sin ɛn sho dɛn fɔ du wetin rayt. Dɔn PAPA GƆD, mek ren kam na dis land we yu gi yu pipul dɛn se na dɛn yon prɔpati.
“If wi plant dɛn ɔl pwɛl dɔn it nɔ de fɔ it, ɔ, if lokɔs it ɔl wetin wi plant, ɔ if ɛnimi atak yu pipul, ɔ, if ɛni bad bad sik sɛf bɔsawt fɔ kil ɔlman,
if ɛnibɔdi pre to yu ɛn kɔnshɔs se in dɔn du bad, dɔn i tɔn to yu os ɛn es in an ɔp to yu,
duya ansa dɛn prea na yu os na ɛvin. Fɔgiv dɛn ɛn ɛp dɛn. Na yu waŋren nɔmɔ no wetin de na mɔtalman at. Dil wit ɔlman akɔdin to
lɛ dɛn go de fred yu na dis land we yu gi wi papa dɛn.
“Fɔrina dɛn go de kɔmɔt na fa kɔntri kam na ya bikɔs ɔf wetin dɛn yɛri bɔt yu;
dɛn go de yɛri bɔt yu wok ɛn di wɔndaful tin dɛn we yu de du; if dɛn kam na dis os fɔ wɔship yu,

duya ansa dɛn prea. Ansa dɛn prea na ɛvin ɛn gi dɛn wetin dɛn aks fɔ, so dat ɔlman na wɔl go no bɔt yu ɛn ɔna yu lɛkɛ aw wi di Izrɛlayt dɛn de du; lɛ dɛn go no se yu de na dis os we a dɔn bil fɔ dɛn rɛspɛkt.
“Wɛn yu pipul dɛn de go fɛt wa agens dɛn ɛnimi ɔ ɛnisay we dɛn de, if dɛn tɔn dɛn fes to dis siti we nain yusɛf sɛf dɔn pik, ɛn tɔn dɛn fes to dis yu os we a dɔn bil mek dɛn go rɛspɛkt yu, ɛn pre,
ansa dɛn prea. Ansa dɛn na ɛvin ɛn gi dɛn viktri.
“Yu no se nɔbɔdi nɔ de we nɔ de kɔmit sin, so if dɛn sin ɛn dɛn mek yu vɛks pan dɛn, yu mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn kapchɔ dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn go as slev na ɔda kɔntri, i lɛk na fa fawe kɔntri sɛf;
if wɛn dɛn de de dɛn chenj dɛn atityud, dɛn kɔnfɛs ɛn pre to yu se dɛn du bad;
if dɛn tɔn bak to yu fɔ tru tru wɛn dɛn de de, ɛn kɔnfɛs dɛn sin; dɔn dɛn tɔn dɛn fes to dis land we yu gi wi papa dɛn, to dis siti we yu bin dɔn pik, ɛn dis os we a bil fɔ de prez yu nem;
duya ansa dɛn prea usay yu de na ɛvin.
Fɔgiv yu pipul fɔ we dɛn sin agens yu; fɔgiv dɛn fɔ ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we dɛn go dɔn du to yu ɛn mek di pipul dɛn we kapchɔ dɛn sho dɛn masi,
bikɔs dɛn na yu pipul dɛn we yu pul kɔmɔt na Ijipt pan ɔt ɔt faya.
“Duya go de luk to di beg we yu savant de beg ɛn di beg we yu yon pipul dɛn de beg yu, ɛn ansa dɛn ɛnitɛm we dɛn kray to yu.
PAPA GƆD, wɛn yu bin pul wi papa dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt, yu bin tɛl yu savant Mozis se, na dɛn yu dɔn pik pan dɛn ɔda kɔntri dɛn na wɔl se dɛn na yu yon bɔlyay.
Wɛn Sɔlɔmɔn dɔn tɔk ɔl wetin de nain bɛlɛ ɛn pre dɔn to PAPA GƆD, i grap bifo di ɔlta we i bin nildɔŋ wit in an ɔp.
I tinap ɛn bigin blɛs ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn lawd lawd wan. I se,
“Lɛ wi Prez PAPA GƆD we dɔn gi kol at to in yon pipul dɛn we na di Izrɛlayt dɛn lɛkɛ aw i bin prɔmis. I nɔ fel pan natin pan ɔl di prɔmis dɛn we i bin mek to Mozis.
Mek PAPA GƆD wi PAPA GƆD de wit wi lɛkɛ aw i bin de wit wi papa dɛn, lɛ i nɔ ɛva lɛf wi ɔ fɔsek wi.
Lɛ PAPA GƆD mek wi ɔl at tɔn to am, fɔ de du wetin i se ɛn kip to ɔl di kɔmandmɛnt dɛn we i gi wi papa dɛn.
Mek PAPA GƆD ansa to ɔl dɛn prea yaso we a dɔn pre to am de ɛn nɛt, ɛn mek PAPA GƆD gi mi wetin a want, ɛn wetin unasɛf want ɛvride,
lɛ ɔlman na wɔl go no se PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD fɔ tru ɛn nɔn ɔda gɔd nɔ de.
Bɔt ɔlman at fɔ de to PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd, fɔ du wetin in kɔmandmɛnt dɛn se.”
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɔl jɔyn di kiŋ fɔ ɔfa sakrifays to PAPA GƆD.
Di pis sakrifays we Sɔlɔmɔn ɔfa to PAPA GƆD na twɛnti-tu tawzin kaw wit wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti tawzin ship. Di kiŋ ɛn di pipul dɛn ɔl dɛdiket PAPA GƆD in os.

Da sem de de, di kiŋ kɔnsikret di frɔnt pat na PAPA GƆD in os. I bɔn animal as bɔn sakrifays, gi di it we fɔ gi ɛn bɔn animal fat bak as sakrifays na da frɔnt ples de bikɔs, di bras ɔlta we bin de bifo usay PAPA GƆD de, bin tu smɔl fɔ tek ɔl dɛn tin dɛn de we di kiŋ bin sakrifays.

Sɔlɔmɔn mek big big sɛlibreshɔn da tɛm de, ɛn di wanol Izrɛl bin jɔyn am. Pipul kɔmɔ Amath Pas na di nɔth ɛn di siti dɛn na di bɔda na Ijipt na di sawt kam jɔyn di sɛlibreshɔn. Dis sɛlibreshɔn las fɔ sɛvin de, dɔn dɛn ad ɔda sɛvin de bak; ɔl ɛn ɔl na fɔtin de dɛn sɛlibret bifo PAPA GƆD.
Wɛn ɔltin dɔn dɔn, Sɔlɔmɔn mek ɔlman go bak nain os. Na so ɔlman bin de blɛs di kiŋ we dɛn de go, ɛn na so dɛn ɔl bin gladi fɔ am fɔ di gud tin we PAPA GƆD dɔn du fɔ in ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Wɛn Sɔlɔmɔn dɔn bil di os fɔ PAPA GƆD ɛn in kiŋ os dɔn ɛn dɔn gɛt ɔl wetin i want,
PAPA GƆD apia to am di sɛkɛn tɛm lɛkɛ aw i bin apia to am na Gibiɔn.
I se, “A dɔn yɛri yu prea ɛn ɔl wetin yu dɔn tɛl mi; a dɔn kɔnsikret di os we yu bil ɛn na de una go de wɔship mi. Mi at de de ɛn a go de wach am.
As fɔ yu yon say, if yu waka tret wit mi ɛn du wetin rayt lɛkɛ yu papa Devid, ɛn du ɔl wetin a tɛl yu ɛn kip mi kɔmandmɛnt,
a go mek yu ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn bi kiŋ na Izrɛl sote go, lɛkɛ aw nɔmɔ a bin prɔmis yu papa Devid we a se nain sid go de rul na Izrɛl sote go.
“Bɔt if yu ɔ yu bɔypikin dɛn tɔn una bak pan mi, dɔn una nɔ obe mi kɔmandmɛnt ɛn de fala ɔda gɔd dɛn ɛn wɔship dɛn,
a go pul ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn na di land we a dɔn gi dɛn, dɔn a go lɛf di os we a dɔn kɔnsikret fɔ de wɔship mi. Izrɛl go tɔn to rederaun ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go luk una wit bɛtɛ yay.
Dis os go tɔn to ɔdinari dɔti. Ɛnibɔdi we si am go sɔprayz ɛn sɔktit: dɛn go de wɔnda wetindu PAPA GƆD du dis kanaba tin to di kɔntri ɛn di os.
Pipul dɛn go de tɔk se na we una tɔn pan PAPA GƆD we na una PAPA GƆD we pul una papa dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt, dɔn una bigin wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn, na ɔl dat mek i put disgres ɛn trɔbul pan una.”
Sɔlɔmɔn tek twɛnti ia fɔ bil os fɔ PAPA GƆD ɛn kiŋ os fɔ insɛf.
Na kiŋ Iram na Taya gi am ɔl di sida ɛn payn timba ɛn gold fɔ mek i bil. Wɛn di wok dɔn dɔn, Sɔlɔmɔn gi Iram twɛnti siti dɛn na Galili as di pe.
Wɛn Iram go luk di siti dɛn we Sɔlɔmɔn gi am, i nɔ bin lɛk dɛn.
So i aks am if na dɛn Kanaba siti de i de gi am; Iram gi di ples nem Kabul, ɛn na dis nem di ples gɛt te tide.
Ɛn na fo tawzin kilo gold Iram bin dɔn gi Sɔlɔmɔn.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn bin yuz wokman dɛn bay fos fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os ɛn in kiŋ os, dɛn ful-ɔp di land na di ist pat na di siti ɛn bil di wɔl rawnd Jerusɛlɛm. Ɛn i bin bil Ezɔ, Mɛgido ɛn Gɛza siti dɛn bak.
Gɛza na di siti we di kiŋ na Ijipt bin atak ɛn kapchɔ, bɔn am ɛn kil ɔlman we de de. Wɛn in gyal pikin mared to Sɔlɔmɔn, i gi in pikin dis siti as mared prɛzɛnt.
Sɔlɔmɔn insɛf bil dis siti ya bak wit dɛn wokman dɛn we bin de wok bay fos. I bil di dɔŋ pat na Bɛth Orɔn,
wit Baalath ɛn Tadmɔl we de na di ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Sɔlɔmɔn bil siti dɛn fɔ de kip in ɔs ɛn karej dɛn ɛn siti dɛn fɔ in sɔplay dɛn. Sɔlɔmɔn bil ɔl wetin i want na Jerusɛlɛm, Libanɔn ɛn ɔlsay nain kindɔm.
Ɔl di pipul dɛn we bin lɛf pan dɛn Amɔrayt, dɛn Itayt, dɛn Pɛrizayt, dɛn Ivayt ɛn dɛn Jɛbyusayt we nɔto bin Izrɛlayt,
dat na di wan dɛn we bin lɛf na Kenan we di Izrɛlayt dɛn nɔ bin kil. Na dɛn Sɔlɔmɔn gɛda fɔ de wok fɔ am bay fos, ɛn te tide dɛn de wok.

Bɔt i nɔ mek nɔn Izrɛlayt bi slev fɔ am fɔ wok; bifo dat na dɛn i mek de nain ami, in gɔvmɛnt, sɔm na bigman na ɔfis, sɔm na kapten fɔ in ami, sɔm na kɔmanda fɔ in ɔs ɛn karej dɛn ɛn sɔm bin de rayd di ɔs dɛn.
Sɔm pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn na bin edman pan in projɛkt dɛn. Na fayv ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti Izrɛlayt dɛn bin de supavays di man dɛn we de wok.
We Sɔlɔmɔn in wɛf we na di kiŋ na Ijipt in gyal pikin, lɛf Devid in siti go na di kiŋ os we Sɔlɔmɔn bil fɔ am, Sɔlɔmɔn ful-ɔp di land na di ist pat na di siti.
Sɔlɔmɔn bin de ɔfa bɔn sakrifays ɛn pis sakrifays tri tɛm insay di ia na di ɔlta we i bil fɔ PAPA GƆD, ɛn na so i kin de bɔn insɛns de bak. I mek shɔ se i de du ɔl wetin i fɔ de du na PAPA GƆD in os.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn bil ship dɛn na Iziɔn Gɛba, we de nia to Ilath na Idɔm bay di Akaba Gɔlf.
Iram sɛn in man dɛn we sabi bɔt bot ɛn wata biznɛs gud gud wan fɔ wok na di ship wit Sɔlɔmɔn in yon man dɛn.
Di ship bin de go na Ofir; na fɔtin tawzin kilo gold dɛn briŋ kam to Sɔlɔmɔn.
Wɛn di kwin na Shiba yɛri bɔt wetin Sɔlɔmɔn de du ɛn aw in ɛn PAPA GƆD de tayt wan, i go fɛn am ɛn tɛst am wit at at kwɛshɔn dɛn.
I rich Jerusɛlɛm wit bɔku pipul dɛn, we go wit kamɛl dɛn. Di kamɛl dɛn tot lod wit ɔlkayn tiŋs lɛkɛ spays, gold ɛn miniral ston dɛn. I tɛl Sɔlɔmɔn ɔl wetin i bin mekɔp fɔ tɛl am.
Sɔlɔmɔn ansa ɔl in kwɛshɔn dɛn ɛn nɔn nɔ bin traŋa fɔ am fɔ ansa.
Wɛn di kwin si aw Sɔlɔmɔn sho in sɛns ɛn di os we i bil,
di difrɛn kayn it na di tebul, di we aw in ɔfisa dɛn sidɔm na tebul, di wokman dɛn insay dɛn yunifɔm, di man dɛn we de sav wayn, di we aw di kiŋ de ɔfa bɔn sakrifays, in mɔt ful.
Nain i tɛl di kiŋ se ɔl wetin in bin de yɛri bɔt am nain kɔntri,, bɔt wetin i dɔn du ɛn wetin i dɔn gɛt, na tru.
I se in nɔ bin biliv pas we in dɔn si fɔ insɛf wit in yon yay. I se ɔl wetin in yɛri nɔ du sɛf bikɔs wetin in dɔn si so pas ɔl wetin i dɔn yɛri.
I se in no se in ɔfisa dɛn ɛn wokman dɛn ɔl go de gladi fɔ sidɔm wit am fɔ de yɛri wetin de kɔmɔt nain mɔt nɔmɔ.

I prez PAPA GƆD se, “Lɛ wi Prez PAPA GƆD, we na yu PAPA GƆD we sho yu se i lɛk yu ɛn dɔn mek yu kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl. Bikɔs PAPA GƆD in lɔv nɔ de dɔn fɔ Izrɛl, na dat mek i mek yu bi kiŋ fɔ lɛ jɔstis, fia ple ɛn tret biznɛs go de.”
I gi Sɔlɔmɔn fo tawzin kilo gold, bɔku bɔku spays ɛn miniral ston dɛn. Wande nɔbɔdi nɔ kɛr bɔku spays lɛkɛ di wan we di kwin na Shiba gi kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn.
Iram in ship dɛn pul bɔku gold kɔmɔt na Ofir; dɛn briŋ almɔg bod ɛn miniral ston dɛn.
Sɔlɔmɔn yuz di ɔlmɔg bod fɔ mek relin na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn in yon kiŋ os we i bil fɔ insɛf; ɛn yuz am bak fɔ mek ap ɛn laya fɔ di myuzishian dɛn. Dɛn nɔ pul da kayn fayn almɔg bod de te tide.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn gi di kwin we kɔmɔt Shiba ɔl wetin i aks fɔ. Dat nɔ miks pan di ɔda tiŋs dɛn we in as kiŋ fɔ gi am. Di kwin ɛn ɔl in pipul dɛn we fala am tɔn bak go na dɛn kɔntri.
Ɛvri ia Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn kin gɛt lɛkɛ twɛnti-tri tawzin kilo gold.
Dat nɔ miks pan di taks we dɛn biznɛsman dɛn de pe, ɛn di ɔda taks we dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Arebia ɛn dɛn gɔvna na dɛn ɔda distrikt dɛn de pe.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn mek tu ɔndrɛd big big shild ɛn kɔba ich wan wit sɛvin kilo gold.
I mek tri ɔndrɛd ɔda smɔl shild dɛn ɛn kɔba ich wan wit bɔt sɔm tu kilo gold. I put ɔl na Libanɔn Fɔrɛst Ɔl.
Di kiŋ mek in chia wit ayvri ɛn kɔba sɔm pat wit gold.
Di chia gɛt siks stɛp, dɔn i mek pantap di bak rɛst, rawnd. Di tu sayd dɛn gɛt say fɔ rɛst an, dɔn i kav tu layɔn ɛn put dɛn fɔ tinap na di tu sayd.
Di stɛp dɛn ɔl gɛt tu tu layɔn; wan na lɛft an wan na raytan. Dɛn nɔ mek dis kayn chia ya wande fɔ ɛni ɔda kiŋ.
Ɔl di kiŋ in kɔp dɛn we i de drink pan na gold, ɛn ɔl di plet ɛn kɔp dɛn na Libanɔn Fɔrɛst Ɔl na piɔ gold. Nɔn silva nɔ bin de de bikɔs silva nɔ bin gɛt wan bɛtɛ valyu Sɔlɔmɔn in tɛm.
Di kiŋ gɛt ship dɛn we de go si wit Iram insɛf yon ship dɛn. Dɛn kin kam ɛvri tri ia wit gold, silva, ayvri, ep ɛn babu dɛn.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn bin pas ɔl di kiŋ dɛn na di wɔl pan sɛns ɛn jɛntri.
Ɔlman na wɔl bin de kam fɔ tɔk wit am fɔ yɛri nɔmɔ di kayn sɛns we PAPA GƆD gi am.
Ɛvri ia wɛn pipul dɛn go fɛn am dɛn kin kɛr gold, silva, klos, spays, ɔs ɛn myul.
Sɔlɔmɔn gɛda bɔku bɔku ɔs ɛn karej. I gɛt wan tawzin fo ɔndrɛd karej ɛn twɛlv tawzin ɔs we i kip na di siti dɛn we i bil fɔ dɛn. I kip sɔm sɛf na Jerusɛlɛm.
I mek silva de ɔlɔbɔt na Jerusɛlɛm lɛk ston ɛn lɛ sida tik bɔku ɔlsay lɛkɛ aw sikamɔ tik bɔku na Juda.
Na Kyu ɛn Ijipt Sɔlɔmɔn bay ɔl in ɔs dɛn ɛn nain biznɛsman dɛn bay dɛn fɔ am.
I bay wan karej siks ɔndrɛd silva kɔpɔ ɛn wan ɔs wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti. Na to dɛn man we bin de sɛl ɔs gi dɛn Itayt ɛn Sirian kiŋ dɛn Sɔlɔmɔn bin bay.
Sɔlɔmɔn bin lɛk fɔrina uman dɛn bad ɛn apat frɔm di kiŋ na Ijipt in pikin we i bin mared, i bin mared ɔda uman dɛn we na bin Moabayt, Amonayt, Idɔmayt, Sidonian ɛn Itayt uman dɛn.
Ɔl dɛn uman yaso na dɛn PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ mared bikɔs, dɛn go tɔn dɛn at fɔ de wɔship dɛn yon gɔd dɛn. Bɔt Sɔlɔmɔn nɔ bin bisin, bifo dat na dɛn i bin de mek lɔv wit.
I mared sɛvin ɔndrɛd wɛf ɛn dɛn ɔl na bin kiŋ pikin dɛn, ɛn i bin gɛt tri ɔndrɛd smɔl wɛf; Ɔl dɛn uman dɛn yaso bin lid am astre.
Aw Sɔlɔmɔn bin de ol na so in wɛf dɛn bin de tɔn in at fɔ wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn; in at nɔ kam de to PAPA GƆD igen lɛkɛ aw in papa Devid in at bin de to PAPA GƆD.
I bigin wɔship Ashtorɛt, di Sidonian dɛn gɔd, dɔn i wɔship Molɛk, di Amonayt dɛn gɔd we PAPA GƆD et bad bad wan.
Na so Sɔlɔmɔn tek du bad na PAPA GƆD yay. I nɔ biev lɛkɛ in papa Devid we put ɔl in at pan PAPA GƆD.

Na pantap wan il na Jerusɛlɛm Sɔlɔmɔn bil ples fɔ de wɔship Kɛmɔsh, dat na di Moabayt dɛn yon gɔd, di ɔda gɔd we PAPA GƆD et bad bad wan. I bin bil ples bak fɔ di ɔda gɔd we nem Molɛk, di Amonayt dɛn gɔd we PAPA GƆD bin et insɛf bad bad wan.
I bil bɔku ples dɛn fɔ in ɔda wɛf dɛn gɔd dɛn fɔ lɛ dɛnsɛf go de bɔn insɛns ɛn ɔfa sakrifays to dɛn.
PAPA GƆD vɛks bad bad wan pan Sɔlɔmɔn we i tɔn in bak pan in we na di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship ɛn mɔ so we i bin dɔn apia to am tu tɛm.
Ivin we i bin dɔn wɔn Sɔlɔmɔn nɔ fɔ wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn i nɔ yɛri in wɔd.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Sɔlɔmɔn se fɔ we i dɔn biev da we de ɛn nɔ kip to in Kɔvinant ɛn nɔ du ɔl wetin i tɛl am, in go tek di kindɔm nain an ɛn gi am to wan pan in ɔfisa dɛn.
I se na fɔseka in papa Devid nɔmɔ mek in nɔ go du dat da tɛm de, bɔt na wɛn in pikin go de rul in go du dat.
PAPA GƆD se in nɔ go tek di wanol kindɔm nain an, bɔt in go lɛf wan pan di fambul dɛn na Izrɛl fɔ an fɔ de rul, ɛn na fɔ in savant Devid in sek ɛn bikɔs i bin dɔn pik Jerusɛlɛm fɔ insɛf.
PAPA GƆD mek Adad tɔn pan Sɔlɔmɔn. Adad na di kiŋ na Idɔm in bɔypikin.
Di tɛm we Devid bin de fɛt wit Idɔm, na Joab we na di ami kɔmanda bin go Idɔm fɔ go bɛr di man dɛn we day, dɔn in kil ɔl di man dɛn we bin de na Idɔm.
Dɛn tek siks mɔnt na Idɔm de kil ɔl di man dɛn.
Bɔt da tɛm de Adad na bin smɔl bɔbɔ so i rɔnawe go Ijipt wit sɔm ɔfisa dɛn na Idɔm we bin de wok fɔ in papa.
Dɛn waka frɔm Midian te go Paran, dɔn dɛn tek sɔm man dɛn na Paran fɔ fala dɛn go Ijipt te dɛn rich to di kiŋ. Di kiŋ gi Adad os ɛn land fɔ tap wit tin fɔ it.
Di kiŋ bin so lɛk Adad dat i gi am in wɛf we na Kwin Tapiniz in sista fɔ mared.
Tapiniz in sista bɔn wan bɔypikin fɔ am we nem Gɛnubath. Na Tapiniz insɛf sɛf mɛn di bɔbɔ na di kiŋ in kiŋ os ɛn i gro wit di kiŋ in yon bɔypikin dɛn.
Wɛn Adad de na Ijipt nain i yɛri se Devid dɔn day ɛn Joab we na bin kɔmanda na di ami insɛf dɔn day. Nain i tɛl di kiŋ se in want fɔ go bak nain kɔntri.
Di kiŋ aks am wetin i want so we i nɔ gɛt we mek i want fɔ go bak. Adad ansa am se natin ɛn beg am se lɛ i lɛf am fɔ go.
PAPA GƆD mek ɔda ɛnimi tinap pan Sɔlɔmɔn. Dis wan na Rezɔn, Ɛlayada in pikin we bin dɔn rɔnawe kɔmɔt to in masta Kiŋ Adadeza na Zoba.
Rezɔn gɛda man dɛn fɔ de wit am ɛn fɔ fɔm rebɛl grup. Dis grup yaso fɔm wɛn Devid bin dɔnawe wit di ami na Zoba, Dɛn go tap na Damaskɔs ɛn bin kam bi kiŋ.
Rezɔn na bin wan man we bin de mɔna Izrɛl di tɛm we Sɔlɔmɔn na bin kiŋ, ɛn insɛf bin ad to di prɛzhɔ we Adad bin de gi Sɔlɔmɔn. Rezɔn bin de rul Eram ɛn i nɔ bin lɛk Izrɛl.
Di ɔda pɔsin we bin de mɔna Sɔlɔmɔn na Jɛroboam. In papa na Nebat bɔt in bin dɔn day, In mama nem Pɛrua. Jɛroboam na bin wan pan Sɔlɔmɔn in ɔfisa dɛn, ɛn na Zɛrida in kɔmɔt to Ifrem fambul.
Na dis kayn we i bin de mɔna Sɔlɔmɔn: Sɔlɔmɔn bin de mek wan ples na di ist pat na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn de bil di wɔl rawnd in papa Devid in siti bak.
Jɛroboam na bin gud wokman, ɛn wɛn Sɔlɔmɔn si se i de wok fayn, i put am fɔ de inchaj ɔf di wokman dɛn we dɛn bin fos fɔ wok we kɔmɔt na Ifrem ɛn Manasɛ dɛn famili eria.
Wande Jɛroboam bin de travul kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm wɛn in ɛn prɔfɛt Aija we kɔmɔt Shaylo mitɔp na rod. Aija bin wɛr nyu klos ɛn na dɛn tu nɔmɔ bin de de.
Aija chɛr di nyu klos we i bin wɛr to twɛlv pis,
dɔn i tɛl Jɛroboam fɔ tek tɛn pan di twɛlv pis. I tɛl am se PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD fɔ Izrɛl se in go skata di kindɔm na Sɔlɔmɔn in an ɛn gi in di Jɛroboam tɛn pan di fambul dɛn na Izrɛl fɔ de rul.
Bɔt fɔseka in savant Devid ɛn Jerusɛlɛm we na de in dɔn pik, in go mek Sɔlɔmɔn gɛt wan fambul nɔmɔ fɔ rul.

I se wetin mek in de du dat na bikɔs dɛn dɔn kɔmɔt to am ɛn go wɔship Ashtorɛt, dɛn Sidonian dɛn gɔd wit Kɛmɔsh, dɛn Moabayt yon gɔd, ɛn Molɛk, dɛn Amonayt dɛnsɛf yon gɔd. I se dɛn nɔ du wetin i tɛl dɛn, ɛn sɛf nɔ obe in lɔ we Sɔlɔmɔn in papa Devid bin de obe.
I se in nɔ go pul di wanol kindɔm na Sɔlɔmɔn in an. I se in go lɛf am fɔ bi kiŋ te i day bikɔs ɔf in savant Devid we bin de obe am.
I se in go tek di kindɔm na Sɔlɔmɔn in bɔypikin in an ɛn gi in di Jɛroboam tɛn pan di Izrɛl fambul dɛn fɔ rul.
I se na wan fambul nɔmɔ in go gi to Sɔlɔmɔn in bɔypikin fɔ rul; ɛn in de du dat bikɔs in nɔ want in savant Devid in nem fɔ ɔt ɛn fɔseka Jerusɛlɛm we na de in dɔn pik lɛ dɛn de wɔship am
I se in go mek Jɛroboam rul di wanol Izrɛl ɛn ɔl usay i want,
ɛn if i obe am ɛn du ɔl wetin i tɛl am fɔ du lɛkɛ aw Devid bin de du, in PAPA GƆD go de wit am ɛn mek in Jɛnareshɔn dɛnsɛf rul afta am.
I se in go pɔnish Devid in jɛnareshɔn bikɔs ɔf Sɔlɔmɔn in sin, bɔt i nɔ go bi fɔ ɛva.
Sɔlɔmɔn tray fɔ kil Jɛroboam bɔt i nɔ ebul bikɔs Jɛroboam rɔnawe go Ijipt to kiŋ Shishak. I de de te Sɔlɔmɔn day.
Ɔl di ɔda tin dɛn we Sɔlɔmɔn du lɛkɛ di wok we i du ɛn di sɛns sɛf we i gɛt, ɔl rayt na di istri buk we dɛn rayt bɔt Sɔlɔmɔn.
Sɔlɔmɔn rul Izrɛl fɔ fɔti ia,
dɔn i day ɛn dɛn bɛr am nain papa Devid in siti. Nain bɔypikin Rɛoboam bigin rul afta am as kiŋ.
Rɛoboam go na Shɛkɛm ɛn na de ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin dɔn gɛda fɔ mek am kiŋ.
Wɛn Nebat in bɔypikin, Jɛroboam yɛri bɔt dat, bikɔs in bin de na Ijipt we i rɔnawe pan Sɔlɔmɔn, i tɔn bak.
Di pipul dɛn sɛn kɔl am so i fala dɛn go to Rɛoboam.
Dɛn tɛl Rɛoboam se in papa bin mek dɛn de wok lɛk slev, bɔt if in pul da lod de na dɛn ed, dɛn go wok wit am.
Rɛoboam ansa dɛn se lɛ dɛn go fɔs ɛn kam bak to am afta tri de, da tɛm de in go dɔn gɛt ansa fɔ dɛn.
Kiŋ Rɛoboam gɛda ɔl di bigman dɛn we bin de wok ɔnda in papa Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn aks dɛn se uskayn advays dɛn go gi am fɔ di pipul dɛn.
Dɛn advays am se if nɔmɔ i put insɛf dɔŋ, tɔk to di pipul dɛn fayn ɛn wok lɛkɛ savant fɔ dɛn, dɛn go de sav am ɔltɛm.
Bɔt Rɛoboam nɔ yɛri di bigman dɛn advays; bifo dat i go ɛŋed wit in kamaranks dɛn bikɔs na dɛn bin de ɛŋ biɛn am.
I aks dɛn lɛ dɛn advays am bɔt aw in fɔ ansa dɛn pipul we se in fɔ pul di lɔd we in papa bin dɔn put na dɛn ed.

In padi dɛn we na dɛn ɔl de rakpala advays am se lɛ i ansa di pipul dɛn se, ɛnti dɛn de se in papa gi dɛn ebi lod fɔ tot bɔt dɛn want in fɔ pul di lod kɔmɔt, wɛl in de tɛl dɛn se wetin in papa bin du na bin smɔl wan.
I se ɛnti in papa gi dɛn ebi lod fɔ tot, in go gi dɛn di wan we pas dat; ɛn if na ken in papa bin de tek flag dɛn, na tik in go tek wok dɛn.
Afta tri de, Jɛroboam ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn go bak to Rɛoboam lɛkɛ aw i bin tɛl dɛn nɔmɔ.
I fityay dɛn gud fashin, ɛn nɔ yɛri di advays we di bigman dɛn gi am.

Bifo dat, di advays we in kamaranks dɛn gi am se, in papa bin gi pipul dɛn ebi lod fɔ tot, bɔt in go gi dɛn di wan we pas dat; in papa bin de flag dɛn wit ratlan in go tek tik wok dɛn, na da advays de i fala.

Di kiŋ nɔ lisin to wetin di pipul dɛn se. Ɔl dis yaso we bi na PAPA GƆD bin dɔn mak am fɔ bi so lɛk aw prɔfɛt Aija we kɔmɔt Shaylo, tɔk to Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin se na so PAPA GƆD go mek tin bi.

Wɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn si se di kiŋ fityay dɛn ɛn nɔ lisin to dɛn, dɛn ansa am se, afta ɔl dɛn nɔ gɛt nɔn biznɛs wit Devid in sid, lɛ ɔlman go nain os, lɛ dɛn lɛf Rɛoboam to insɛf. Na so ɔlman tek kɔmɔt biɛn am.
Bɔt as fɔ dɛn Izrɛlayt we bin tap na di siti dɛn na Juda, na Rɛoboam bin stil de rul dɛn.
Kiŋ Rɛoboam sɛn Adoniram we bin de mek pipul wok bay fos to di Izrɛlayt dɛn, bɔt dɛn kech am ston am te i day. Wɛn dis bi, Kiŋ Rɛoboam mekes jomp nain ɔs ɛn karej ɛn rɔnawe go Jerusɛlɛm.
Frɔm da de de, nain di Izrɛlayt dɛn bigin barɔf pan Devid in pikin dɛn.
Wɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn yɛri se Jɛroboam dɔn tɔn bak, dɛn sɛn kɔl am ɛn mek am kiŋ na Izrɛl. Na Juda fambul nɔmɔ bin de biɛn Devid in pikin.
Wɛn Rɛoboam rich na Jerusɛlɛm, i gɛda wan ɔndrɛd ɛn eti tawzin soja man dɛn na Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin fɔ go fɛt wa na di nɔth pat na Izrɛl fɔ lɛ i go rul bak.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD tɔk to Prɔfɛt Shɛmaya.
I se, “Go tɛl Rɛoboam, Sɔlɔmɔn in bɔypikin, ɛn ɔl di Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin fambul dɛn se,
mi PAPA GƆD se, dɛn nɔ fɔ mistek fɔ go fɛt dɛn brɔda dɛn. Lɛ dɛn ɔl go om bikɔs nain mek ɔl wetin de bi so bi.” Ɔlman yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD se ɛn tɔn bak go na dɛn os.
Kiŋ Jɛroboam bil militri bes na Shɛkɛm we de ɔp di il na Ifrem bikɔs na de i bin tap. Wɛn i lɛf de i go na Pɛniɛl ɛn go bil ɔda bes de.
Jɛroboam bigin de tink to insɛf se di kindɔm go go bak to Devid in pikin dɛn,
nɔ lɛk we if di pipul dɛn de go na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ go ɔfa sakrifays na PAPA GƆD in os. I bigin skyad se dɛn go bigin go bak to kiŋ Rɛoboam, dɔn dɛn go kil am.
Wɛn i dɔn aks advays dɔn, i mek tu gold kaw, dɔn i tɛl di pipul dɛn se Jɛrusɛlɛm tu fa fɔ dɛn fɔ de go wɔship. I se in dɔn mek di gɔd dɛn we pul dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt.
I put wan pan di kaw dɛn na Bɛthɛl dɔn i put di ɔda wan na Dan.
Dis na bin bad bad tin bikɔs di pipul dɛn bin de go te rich Dan fɔ go wɔship di kaw we de de.
Jɛroboam bil ples dɛn fɔ de wɔship pantap dɛn il, dɔn i pik man dɛn we nɔto Livay fambul dɛn kɔmɔt fɔ de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.

Jɛroboam mek dɛn bigin fɔ mek fɛstival di fiftin de insay di et mɔnt lɛkɛ di kayn we aw dɛn kin du na Juda, dɔn i mek dɛn de ɔfa sakrifays na di ɔlta. I mek sakrifays to di lay lay gɔd dɛn we dɛn mek na Bɛthɛl, dɔn i pik man dɛn fɔ de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɔp di il dɛn.

I du ɔl dis di de we mek fiftin de insay di et mɔnt, ɛn nain fiks di det. I mek shɔ se i ɔfa sakrifays na di ɔlta we i bil na Bɛthɛl. Nain bigin dis fɛstival fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɛn nain fɔs go ɔp na di ɔlta fɔ ɔfa sakrifays.
As Jɛroboam de ɔfa di sakrifays, PAPA GƆD tɛl wan prɔfɛt na Juda fɔ go na Bɛthɛl.

I yuz PAPA GƆD in nem ala pan di ɔlta. I se, “Yu ɔlta, yu ɔlta! PAPA GƆD se wan bɔbɔ go bɔn na Devid in layn we go nem Josaya, ɛn na pantap yu i go sakrifays ɔl dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na dɛn il, ɛn i go bɔn mɔtalman bon dɛn pan yu.”
Da sem de de di prɔfɛt gi wan sayn. I se PAPA GƆD go mek di ɔlta plit tu dɔn ɔl di ashis pan am go skata.
Wɛn kiŋ Jɛroboam yɛri di prɔfɛt de ala pan di ɔlta na Bɛthɛl, i pɔynt to am ɛn gi ɔda se lɛ dɛn kech am. As i du dat so nain in an day ɛn nɔ gri muf igen
Dɔn di ɔlta insɛf plit tu ɛn ɔl di ashis skata jɛs lɛkɛ aw di prɔfɛt bin se PAPA GƆD tɛl am.
Nain di kiŋ beg di prɔfɛt lɛ i pre fɔ am to PAPA GƆD mek di an gɛt layf bak.
I beg di prɔfɛt fɔ fala am go nain os go it ɛn se in gɛt gift fɔ am.
Bɔt i ansa am se i lɛk sɛf i se in go gi am af pan ɔl wetin i gɛt, i nɔ go go wit am, ɛn i nɔ go it ɔ drink wata de sɛf.
PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl am se i nɔ fɔ it ɔ drink wata de, ɛn i nɔ fɔ yuz di sem rod we i yuz fɔ go de tɔn bak.
Di prɔfɛt yuz ɔda rod fɔ go na Bɛthɛl.
Wan olpa prɔfɛt bin de na Bɛthɛl da tɛm de. In bɔypikin dɛn go tɛl am aw di prɔfɛt ɛn di kiŋ pas da de de ɛn ɔl wetin i tɛl di kiŋ.
Dɛn papa aks dɛn usay dis prɔfɛt yaso pas, nain dɛn sho di rod we i yuz.
I tɛl in bɔypikin dɛn se lɛ dɛn rɛdi in dɔŋki fɔ am. I jomp pantap di dɔŋki,
ɛn fala di rod usay di prɔfɛt pas te i kech am. I mit am sidɔm ɔnda wan ok tik, nain i aks am if nain na di prɔfɛt we kɔmɔt Juda. Di prɔfɛt insɛf ansa se yɛs nain.
Di olpa prɔfɛt tɛl am se lɛ i fala am go nain os lɛ dɛn go it.
I ansa am se in nɔ de go, ɛn i nɔ go it ɔ drink wata de sɛf.
I se PAPA GƆD bin dɔn wɔn am se lɛ i nɔ it ɔ drink wata de, ɛn i nɔ fɔ yuz di sem rod fɔ go bak.
Di olpa prɔfɛt tɛl am se in na prɔfɛt lɛkɛ insɛf, ɛn na PAPA GƆD in enjɛl tɛl am se lɛ i go mit am na rod ɛn kɔl am fɔ go it bred ɛn drink smɔl wata. Bɔt na lay dis olpa prɔfɛt bin de lay.
Di prɔfɛt insɛf gri fɔ go wit am, ɛn i it ɛn drink.
As dɛn sidɔm na tebul de it, PAPA GƆD tɔk to di olpa prɔfɛt we kɔnvins am fɔ tɔn bak.
I ala tɔk to di prɔfɛt we kɔmɔt Juda se PAPA GƆD tɛl am se fɔ we i dɔn du wetin PAPA GƆD se nɔ fɔ du,
bɔt tɔn bak go it bred ɛn drink wata na di ples we i tɛl am se nɔ fɔ it ɛn drink; fɔseka dat dɛn nɔ go bɛr in dedebɔdi usay dɛn bɛr in pipul dɛn.
Wɛn di prɔfɛt we kɔmɔt Juda dɔn it ɛn drink dɔn, di olpa prɔfɛt we mek am ful rɛdi in dɔŋki fɔ am fɔ mek i go.
As i de na rod de go so nain wan layɔn atak am na di rod ɛn kil am. Dɔn di layɔn ɛn di dɔŋki tinap de wach di dedebɔdi na grɔn.
Dɛn wan dɛn we bin de pas si in dedebɔdi lidɔm na di grɔn wit di layɔn nia am. Dɛn rɔn go na siti go tɛl di olpa prɔfɛt.
Wɛn di olpa prɔfɛt we nain mek i tɔn bak yɛri di nyuz, i se na di prɔfɛt dat we nɔ yɛri PAPA GƆD wɔd, so PAPA GƆD mek layɔn kech am ɛn kil am bikɔs i bin dɔn wɔn am.
Di olpa prɔfɛt tɛl in bɔypikin dɛn lɛ dɛn rɛdi in dɔŋki fɔ am ɛn dɛn du dat.
Insɛf go na di rod ɛn fɛn di dedebɔdi lidɔm na grɔn wit di layɔn ɛn di dɔŋki nia am. Di layɔn nɔ it in bɔdi ɛn nɔ du di dɔŋki natin,
di olpa prɔfɛt pik di dedebɔdi na grɔn, put am pan in yon dɔŋki, kɛr am go bɛr am ɛn munin fɔ am.
I bɛr am nain yon grev ɛn kray pan am se “E mi brɔda! E mi brɔda!”
Wɛn i dɔn bɛr am dɔn, i tɛl in bɔypikin dɛn se wɛn in day, nainsay da sem grev de dɛn fɔ bɛr am, dat na usay i bɛr di prɔfɛt. I se dɛn fɔ le in dedebɔdi nia di man in yon.
I se di mɛsej we PAPA GƆD gi am na Bɛthɛl bɔt dɛn ɔlta ɛn dɛn say dɛn we dɛn de wɔship lay lay gɔd na Sameria mɔs bi.

Pan ɔl we ɔl dis dɔn bi, kiŋ Jɛroboam nɔ stil nɔ lɛf fɔ du dɛn bad bad tin dɛn, bifo dat i stil de pik ɔlkanaba mɔtalman fɔ de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. Ɛnibɔdi we wan fɔ, i rɛdi fɔ mek am man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
Na ɔl dɛn bad bad tin ya we Jɛroboam du mek i fɔdɔm we mek in ɛn in fambul dɛn sɔfa ɛn day.
Da sem tɛm de, Jɛroboam in bɔypikin we nem Abija sik;
na de Jɛroboam tɛl in wɛf se lɛ i go na Shaylo to prɔfɛt Aija ɛn mek lɛk fɔ se in nɔto in wɛf. I se na da prɔfɛt de bin tɛl am se in go bi kiŋ.
I se lɛ i kɛr tɛn lof bred, kek ɛn wan bɔtul ɔni fɔ di prɔfɛt fɔ lɛ i go tɛl am wetin go apin to di bɔbɔ we sik.
Di uman insɛf du wetin Jɛroboam se ɛn go na Shaylo to Aija. Aija nɔ bin de si igen, in yay bin dɔn go bifo go wet am.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl am se Jɛroboam in wɛf de kam mit am fɔ aks am bɔt in bɔypikin we nɔ wɛl. I se i go mek lɛk fɔ se in nɔto Jɛroboam in wɛf ɛn i fɔ gi am di rayt ansa.
So wɛn Aija yɛri di uman na di domɔt, nain i se, “Jɛroboam in wɛf kam insay nɔ; wetin mek yu de mek lɛk fɔ se yu nɔto yu? A gɛt bad nyuz fɔ yu.
Go tɛl Jɛroboam se, PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship se, nain i pik pan ɔl di pipul dɛn fɔ lid di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Dɔn i pul di kindɔm na Devid in an ɛn gi am fɔ rul, bɔt i nɔ biev insɛf lɛkɛ in savant Devid we bin de du ɔl wetin i tɛl am ɛn bin de sav am wit ɔl in at ɛn du wetin rayt.
Di kayn bad tin we i dɔn du nɔbɔdi nɔ wande du am bifo am. I grap go mek gɔd fɔ insɛf wit ayɛn. Sɛf i dɔn ambɔgin PAPA GƆD bad bad wan.

I se Jɛroboam go sɔfa fɔ wetin i du. Na big big dombolo i go put nain os. I se in go kil ɔl di bɔypikin dɛn na Izrɛl ɛn nɔ kia if di pɔsin na slev ɔ fribɔn. I se in go bɔn Jɛroboam in os lɛkɛ aw dɛn de bɔn dɔti te i dɔn kpatakpata.
Dɛn wan we day pan Jɛroboam in famili na siti, na dɔg go it dɛn dedebɔdi, dɔn dɛn wan we day ɔp dɛn il na yuba go it dɛn yon dedebɔdi.” I se na so PAPA GƆD se.
I tɛl di uman, fɔ jɛs tɔn bak go om bikɔs as i de rich so di bɔbɔ de day.
I se ɔlman na Izrɛl go kray ɛn munin fɔ am ɛn gi am fayn bɛrin bikɔs nain na di waŋren pɔsin na Jɛroboam in famili we bin de waka tret na PAPA GƆD yay.
I se PAPA GƆD insɛf go fɛn kiŋ we go rul Izrɛl ɛn kil ɔlman na Jɛroboam in famili, ɛn dat go bi da vɛri de, de.

I se PAPA GƆD go pɔnish Izrɛl; dɛn go fiba dɛn plant we de flot na wata. I se in go pul dɛn kɔmɔt na di land we i bin dɔn gi dɛn papa dɛn ɛn skata dɛn ɔl te go biɛn Riva Yufretis bikɔs dɛn bil ples fɔ de wɔship Ashɛra.
I se in go pul Izrɛl kɔmɔt nain bɛlɛ bikɔs ɔf di sin we Jɛroboam kɔmit ɛn di sin we i mek Izrɛl insɛf kɔmit.
Jɛroboam in wɛf grap ɛn tɔn bak go na Tiza. A i de mas in fut so na di stɛp nain di bɔbɔ day.
Dɛn kray fɔ am ɛn bɛr am jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl prɔfɛt Aija.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Jɛroboam du wɛn i bin de rul, lɛkɛ di wa we i fɛt dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Jɛroboam rul fɔ twɛnti-tu ia bifo i day. Dɛn bɛr am dɔn in bɔypikin Nadab tek in ples ɛn bi di kiŋ.

Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn in ɔda bɔypikin we nem Rɛoboam bin ol fɔti-wan ia we i bigin rul as kiŋ na Juda, ɛn na sɛvintin ia i rul insay Jerusɛlɛm we na di siti we PAPA GƆD bin dɔn se na de in go de. In mama nem Naama ɛn na bin Amonayt.
Di pipul dɛn na Juda du bad bad tin we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk. Infakt dɛn mek PAPA GƆD vɛks pan dɛn mɔ pas aw i bin vɛks pan dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn.
Dɛn bil ples fɔ de wɔship lay lay gɔd, dɛn mek ɔlta fɔ de mek sakrifays to Ashɛra, dɔn dɛn mek ples fɔ de wɔship am pantap ɔl dɛn il dɛn ɔnda ɔl dɛn tik.
Wetin wɔs na dat dɛn bin ivin de mek rare gyal ɛn ple bɔy dɛn de na di ples we dɛn de wɔship. Dɛn du ɔl dɛn bad bad tin we dɛn pipul we PAPA GƆD bin drɛb na di land bin de du.
Wɛn kiŋ Rɛoboam dɔn rul fɔ fayv ia, Shishak di kiŋ na Ijipt go atak Jerusɛlɛm.
I gɛda ɔl di dia tiŋs dɛn we bin de na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn di kiŋ in os. I tek ɔltin wit di gold big shild dɛn we Sɔlɔmɔn mek.
Kiŋ Rɛoboam mek ɔda gold big shild dɛn ɛn put sikyɔriti dɛn nain os in get fɔ de gyad dɛn.
Ɛnitɛm we di kiŋ de go na PAPA GƆD in os, di sikyɔriti dɛn kin pul di big shild dɛn ɛn wɛn i de tɔn bak, dɛn kin put dɛn bak usay dɛn fɔ de.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Rɛoboam du wɛn i bin de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
Ɔltɛm fɛt bin de de bitwin Rɛoboam ɛn Jɛroboam.
Wɛn Rɛoboam day, dɛn bɛr am usay dɛn bɛr in pipul dɛn na Devid in siti. In mama na Naama we ɛn na bin Amonayt. Na Abija tek in papa Rɛoboam in ples as kiŋ.
Di ia we mek Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin etin ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da sem ia de Abija bi kiŋ na Juda,
ɛn i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ tri ia. In mama na Maaka, Absalɔm in gyal pikin.
Ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we Abija in papa bin de du, nain insɛf falamakata; in at nɔ bin de to in Gɔd we na PAPA GƆD atɔl lɛkɛ aw in grampa Devid in yon at bin de to am.
Bɔt pan ɔl dat, in GƆD we na in Gɔd sɔri fɔ am fɔseka Devid nɔmɔ ɛn gi am bɔypikin fɔ tek in ples ɛn fɔ gyad Jerusɛlɛm.
Wɛn Devid in bin de, i bin de du ɔl wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay, ɛn kip to ɔl in lɔ dɛn; na we nɔmɔ i kil Yuraya da Itayt ɛn tek in wɛf.
Di tɛm we Abija bin de, bɔku fɛt bin de bitwin Jɛroboam ɛn Rɛoboam.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Abija du we i bin de rul as kiŋ, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Juda. Wa sɛf bin de bitwin Abija ɛn Jɛroboam.
Abija day ɛn dɛn bɛr am usay dɛn bɛr in papa dɛn na Devid in siti. In bɔypikin Asa tek in ples as kiŋ.
Di ia we mek Jɛroboam twɛnti ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da sem ia de Asa bi kiŋ na Juda,
ɛn i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ fɔti-wan ia. In grani na Maaka, Absalɔm in gyal pikin.
Asa in du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay jɛs lɛkɛ aw in grampa Devid bin du.
I drɛb ɔl dɛn rare gyal ɛn ple bɔy dɛn na dɛn say we in papa mek fɔ wɔship lay lay gɔd ɛn trowe ɔl di lay lay gɔd dɛn.
I ivin pul in grani Maaka kɔmɔt nain chia as Mami Kwin bikɔs insɛf bin de mek lay lay gɔd fɔ wɔship Ashɛra. Asa brok di lay lay gɔd ɛn bɔn am dɔŋ Kidrɔn Vali.
Ivin we i nɔ bin pwɛl dɛn ples ɔp dɛn il we dɛn mek fɔ wɔship lay lay gɔd, i mek shɔ se ɔl in at de wit PAPA GƆD te i day.
Dɛn gold, silva ɛn ɔda tiŋs dɛn we in ɛn in papa bin dɔn kɔnsikret, i mek shɔ se i kɛr ɔl go bak na PAPA GƆD in os.
Wa bin de bitwin Asa ɛn Kiŋ Baasha na Izrɛl ɔl di tɛm we dɛn tu bin de rul as kiŋ.
Baasha we na kiŋ na Izrɛl go fɛt wa agens Juda. I mek gud sikyɔriti na Rama fɔ lɛ nɔbɔdi nɔ go go insay usay Asa de rul na Juda ɔ kɔmɔt de.
Asa insɛf tek ɔl di silva ɛn gold we bin lɛf na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn in insɛf yon os ɛn gi in ɔfisa dɛn fɔ go gi kiŋ Bɛnadad na Eram we bin de rul Damaskɔs na Tabrimɔn.

I sɛn mɛsej to Bɛnadad se lɛ wanwɔd de bitwin dɛn tu lɛkɛ aw wanwɔd bin de bitwin dɛn papa dɛn. I se in dɔn sɛn gold ɛn silva fɔ am, ɛn in want am fɔ brok di wanwɔd we de bitwin in di Bɛnadad ɛn Baasha we na kiŋ na Izrɛl fɔ lɛ i go blo fɔ de atak am.
Bɛnadad du wetin Kiŋ Asa se; i sɛn di kɔmanda dɛn nain ami fɔ go fɛt Izrɛl. I fɛt Ijɔn, Dan, Ebɛl Bɛth Maaka, Kinɛrɛth te rich Naftali.
Wɛn Baasha yɛri wetin Bɛnadad dɔn du, i tap fɔ bil di sikyɔriti wɔl i bin de bil na Rama ɛn go bak na Tiza.
Nain Kiŋ Asa gi ɔda se ɔlman fɔ go na Rama fɔ go pul di ston ɛn bod we Baasha bin de yuz de, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ balans. Kiŋ Asa yuz di ston ɛn bod fɔ bil Giba, Bɛnjamin ɛn Mizpa.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Asa du we i bin de rul, lɛkɛ dɛn siti dɛn we i bil ɛn ɔl wetin i gɛt, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Juda. Wɛn i dɔn ol, bad bad sik ol in fut dɛn.
Asa day dɔn dɛn bɛr am na di siti usay dɛn bɛr Devid. In bɔypikin Jɛoshafat tek in ples fɔ rul as kiŋ.
Di ia we mek kiŋ Asa tu ia we i de rul Juda, na da sem ia de Nadab we na Jɛroboam in bɔypikin bi kiŋ na Izrɛl, ɛn i rul fɔ tu ia.
Insɛf falamakata in papa pan di bad ɛn sin to PAPA GƆD. I mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD.
Aija in bɔypikin we nem Baasha we kɔmɔt to Isaka fambul mek ku pan am ɛn kil am na Gibɛthɔn we na wan siti na Filistia. Dat bi di tɛm we Nadab gɛda di wanol Izrɛl fɔ atak Gibɛthɔn ɛn kapchɔ am.
Baasha kil Nadab di ia we mek tri ia we Asa bin de rul Juda, dɔn in tek ova fɔ de rul.
As Baasha bigin rul so, i kil ɔlman na Jɛroboam in famili. I nɔ lɛf wan sol sɛf. Ɔl dis bi fɔ mek wetin PAPA GƆD bin tɛl prɔfɛt Aija we kɔmɔt Shaylo bi;
bikɔs Jɛroboam in sin bin dɔn pasmak, ɛn i nɔ tap de, i mek di wanol Izrɛl kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD, ɛn dat mek PAPA GƆD vɛks bad, bad wan.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Nadab du we i bin de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl.
Di tɛm we Asa ɛn kiŋ Baasha fɔ Izrɛl bin de rul, na soso fɛt bin de bitwin dɛn tu.
Di ia we mek kiŋ Asa na Juda tri ia we i de rul, na da sem ia de Aija in bɔypikin we na Baasha bigin rul Izrɛl, bɔt na Tiza in bin tap ɛn rul fɔ twɛnti-fo ia.
Insɛf du bad bad tin na PAPA GƆD yay; i fala Jɛroboam in futstɛp we mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to prɔfɛt Jeu we na Anani in bɔypikin ɛn gi am dis mɛsej ya fɔ Baasha. I se,
“Tɛl Baasha se, a pul am na gɔta ɛn tɔn am to mɔtalman fɔ lid mi pipul Izrɛl, bɔt bifo dat na soso Jɛroboam in bad trik i falamakata ɛn mek mi pipul Izrɛl kɔmit sin we mek a vɛks bad bad wan pan dɛn.
Na naw a de kam skata in os, ɛn jɛs lɛkɛ aw a dil wit Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin, na so a go dil wit insɛf.
Na dɔg dɛn go it di dedebɔdi ɔf dɛn wan dɛn nain os we day na di siti, dɔn di wan dɛn we day na trit na bod go it dɛn.”
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Baasha du we i bin de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk dɛn bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Baasha day ɛn dɛn bɛr am na Tiza. In bɔypikin Ɛla tek in ples fɔ de rul.

Na prɔfɛt Jeu we na Anani in bɔypikin bin gi Baasha PAPA GƆD in mɛsej fɔ in ɛn in famili bikɔs ɔf di bad we i du na PAPA GƆD in yay we mek PAPA GƆD vɛks bad wan pan am; fɔ we i biev lɛk Jɛroboam ɛn kil ɔlman na Jɛroboam in os.
Di ia we mek Kiŋ Asa twɛnti-siks ia we i de rul Juda as kiŋ, na da sem ia de Baasha in bɔypikin we na Ɛla bigin rul Izrɛl, ɛn na Tiza i bin de. I rul fɔ tu ia.
Na wan pan in ɔfisa dɛn we nem Zimray we bin de inchaj ɔf in ɔs ɛn karej nain mek ku pan am. Da de de, Ɛla bin de to Arza in os na Tiza de drink drɔnk. Na Arza bin de inchaj ɔf di kiŋ in os na Tiza.
Zimray go insay di os ɛn chuk Ɛla ɛn kil am, dɔn i tek in ples fɔ de rul. Dis bi di ia we mek Kiŋ Asa twɛnti-sɛvin ia we i de rul.
As Zimray no se in dɔn sidɔm gud as kiŋ na di chia, i kil ɔl udat de na Baasha in famili. I nɔ lɛf wan man fɔ liv, i lɛk sɛf na fambul ɔ padi.
Na so Zimray tek dɔnawe wit ɔlman na Baasha in famili fɔ lɛ wetin PAPA GƆD bin tɛl Prɔfɛt Jeu bi;
bikɔs Baasha ɛn in bɔypikin we na Ɛla bin dɔn kɔmit bad bad sin to PAPA GƆD; dɔn dɛn mek di wanol Izrɛl insɛf kɔmit sin fɔ de wɔship lay lay gɔd.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Ɛla du wɛn i bin de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl.
Di ia we mek kiŋ Asa twɛnti-sɛvin ia we i de rul as kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Zimray bigin rul na Tiza ɛn i rul fɔ sɛvin de. Di ami bin mek in kamp nia Gibɛthɔn, wan siti we de na Filistia.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn we de na di kamp yɛri se Zimray mek ku pan di kiŋ ɛn kil am, dɛn mek Omri we na kɔmanda fɔ di ami, kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Omri ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn lɛf Gibɛthɔn go atak Tiza ɛn kapchɔ am.
Wɛn Zimray si se dɛn dɔn kapchɔ di siti, i rɔn go ayd midul di kiŋ in os usay nɔbɔdi nɔ go kech am; i put faya de so in ɛn di ples ɔl bɔn.
Ɔl dis bi bikɔs ɔf in sin; i du ɔlkayn bad tin ɛn falamakata Jɛroboam in bad ɛgzampul we mek Izrɛl sɛf sin to PAPA GƆD.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Zimray du we i bin de rul, we i bin de biev lɛk rebɛl, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin kam gɛt tu gɛŋ: af bin de sɔpɔt Ginath in bɔypikin we na Tibni fɔ bi kiŋ, dɔn di ɔda af bin de fɔ Omri.
Di wan dɛn we bin de fɔ Omri kɔnka Ginath in bɔypikin we na Tibni. So Tibni day dɔn Omri bi kiŋ.
Di ia we mek Asa tati-wan ia we i bi kiŋ na Juda, na da sem ia de Omri bi kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn i rul fɔ twɛlv ia. I tek siks pan da twɛlv ia de na Tiza.
Omri bay wan il na Sameria to Shɛma fɔ wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti pawns silva kɔpɔ. I bil big siti ɔp di il ɛn gi di siti nem Sameria. I gi di siti da nem de bikɔs di man we bin gɛt de nem Shɛma.
Omri insɛf du bad bad tin to PAPA GƆD. In yon bad pas dɛn wan we bin de bifo am.
I falamakata ɔl Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin in bad trik we mek Izrɛl sin bad bad wan to PAPA GƆD we dɛn wɔship lay lay gɔd.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Omri du wɛn i bin de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Omri day dɔn dɛn bɛr am na Sameria. Nain bɔypikin we na Eab tek in ples.
Di ia we mek kiŋ Asa tati-et ia we i bi kiŋ na Juda, na da sem ia de Eab we na Omri in bɔypikin bi kiŋ na Izrɛl. I rul Izrɛl fɔ twɛnti-tu ia ɛn na Sameria in bin tap.
As fɔ Omri in bɔypikin Eab, in wɔs pas di wan dɛn we bin de bifo am pan di bad.
Di bad tin dɛn we Nebat in bɔypikin we na Jɛroboam bin du na smɔl tin fɔ am; in bit in rɛkɔd ɛn mared Jezibɛl, dat na kiŋ Ɛthbeal na Saydɔn in gyal pikin, ɛn bigin fɔ fala am fɔ de wɔship Beal.
I nɔ tap de, i bil ɔlta sɛf na di os we i bil fɔ wɔship Beal na Sameria.
Dɔn igen i mek Ashɛra di ɔda gɔd fɔ de wɔship am. I mek PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD fɔ Izrɛl vɛks bad bad wan pan am. Nɔn kiŋ bifo am nɔ wande du wetin Eab du.

Na di tɛm we Eab bin de rul nain Ayɛl na Bɛthɛl bil Jɛriko bak. Wɛn Ayɛl de le di fawndeshɔn, in fɔs-bɔy-pikin Abiram day, dɔn wɛn i de bil di get nain in las bɔbɔ Segub day. Ɔl dis bi fɔ mek wetin PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl Jɔshwa we na Nɔn in bɔypikin bi.

Wan Tishbayt we nem Ilayja we kɔmɔt Tishbɛ na Giliad go to kiŋ Eab ɛn tɛl am se, “As lɔŋ as PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD fɔ Izrɛl we nain a de sav de alayv, wan drɔp ren ɔ dyu nɔ go fɔdɔm na ya fɔ di nɛks tu-tri ia te a se so.”
Nain PAPA GƆD tɔk to Ilayja. I se,
“Kɔmɔt na ya. Go na di ist pat na Kɛrith Bruk nia Riva Jɔdan,
na di wata we de de yu go de drink. A dɔn tɛl dɛn revɛn fɔ de kɛr it go de fɔ yu.”
Ilayja insɛf du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ du. I go na di ist pat na Kɛrith Bruk go tap nia Riva Jɔdan.
Di revɛn dɛn bin de kɛr bred ɛn bif go fɔ am ɛvri mɔnin ɛn ivin, ɛn na di wata na di watasay i bin de drink.
Bikɔs ren nɔ bin de kam, di wata na di watasay dray.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to Ilayja. I se,
“Kɔmɔt na ya ɛn go na Zarɛfat na Saydɔn go tap de. A dɔn tɛl wan uman we in man dɔn day fɔ de fid yu.”
Ilayja insɛf go na Zarɛfat. Wɛn i rich na di get fɔ go insay di siti, i si wan uman de gɛda faya wud. I beg di uman fɔ gi am wata fɔ drink.
As di uman de go briŋ di wata, i kɔl am bak ɛn beg am fɔ briŋ bred fɔ am fɔ it.
Di uman swɛ to PAPA GƆD se in nɔ gɛt natin fɔ it, pas lili flawa ɛn kenkeni ɔyl. Ɛn na dat mek in de gɛda wud fɔ go mek smɔl tin fɔ it, so dat in ɛn in bɔypikin kin day we dɛn dɔn it dɔn.
Ilayja tɛl am se lɛ i nɔ fred, lɛ i go du wetin i mekɔp fɔ du; bɔt nɔmɔ wetin in want na fɔ lɛ i bek if na lili bred sɛf fɔ am fɔ it, dɔn i kin mek fɔ in ɛn in bɔypikin.
I se PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD fɔ Izrɛl se, di flawa ɛn di ɔyl nɔ go ɛva dɔn te in di PAPA GƆD mekɔp fɔ sɛn ren kam bak na wɔl.
Di uman du wetin Ilayja tɛl am ɛn bikɔs ɔf dat it nɔ ɛva dɔn fɔ in, in bɔypikin ɛn Ilayja.
Di flawa nɔ dɔn, di ɔyl sɛf nɔ dɔn, jɛs lɛkɛ aw Ilayja bin tɔk nɔmɔ.
Wande, di uman we gɛt di os in bɔypikin sik. Di sik mɔna am te i day.
Na de i aks Ilayja se, “Prɔfɛt, duya, uskayn bad a dɔn du so? Tinkya yu kam fɔ tɛl mi aw a tan ɛn kil mi pikin?”
Ilayja tɛl am lɛ i gi am di pikin. I tek di pikin na di uman in an, kɛr am go ɔp nain yon rum ɛn le am nain bed.
Dɔn i bigin pre to PAPA GƆD se, “E papa GƆD mi PAPA GƆD, yu dɔn briŋ trɔbul kam na dis uman we a tap wit in layf we yu mek in pikin day.”
I tret in bɔdi pan di pikin tri tɛm ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD se, “E PAPA GƆD mi PAPA GƆD, lɛ dis bɔbɔ in layf kam bak pan am!”
PAPA GƆD ansa Ilayja in prea; di bɔbɔ in layf kam bak.
Ilayja es am kɛr am go dɔŋ bak ɛn an am ova to in mama, ɛn tɛl am se in pikin dɔn gɛt layf bak.
Di uman tɛl am se na naw in no fɔ tru tru se in na man ɔf PAPA GƆD, ɛn wetin kɔmɔt nain mɔt na PAPA GƆD put am de.
Afta sɔm tɛm dɔn pas, dat na tri ia frɔm we ren lɛf fɔ kam, PAPA GƆD tɔk to Ilayja. I se, “Go sho yusɛf to Eab, a go mek ren bigin kam bak.”
Ilayja insɛf go sho insɛf to Eab. It biznɛs bin dɔn traŋa bad, bad wan na Sameria,
so Eab sɛn kɔl Obadaya bikɔs nain bin de inchaj ɔf di kiŋ in sto. Obadaya na man we bin biliv PAPA GƆD.
Di tɛm we Jɛzibɛl bin de kil PAPA GƆD in prɔfɛt dɛn, Obadaya na wan man we bin ayd wan ɔndrɛd pan dɛn na kev. I mek dɛn de fifti, fifti na wan kev ɛn bin de gi dɛn it ɛn wata.
Eab tɛl Obadaya se lɛ i waka ɔlɔbɔt na di kɔntri fɔ fɛn usay spriŋ wata de bɔs. I se sɔntɛm dɛn go fɛn gras fɔ gi dɛn ɔs ɛn myul dɛn fɔ it fɔ lɛ dɛn nɔ day bikɔs dɛn nɔ want kil dɛn.
Dɛn pik di say we dɛn fɔ go: Eab go wan say, Obadaya in go di ɔda say.
As Obadaya in de go, Ilayja mit am na rod. As i si Ilayja so i baw bifo am ɛn aks am se. “Masta, fɔ tru tru se na yu Ilayja a si so?”
Ilayja ansa am se nain, ɛn tɛl am se lɛ i go tɛl in masta se Ilayja dɔn kam.
Obadaya aks Ilayja uskayn bad in dɔn du so we fɔ mek in an am to Eab fɔ kil am.
I swɛ to PAPA GƆD se nɔn say nɔ de na di wɔl we Eab nɔ dɔn sɛn fɔ go luk fɔ am, ɛn ɛnisay we i sɛn we dɛn se i nɔ de de, Eab kin mek dɛn swɛ se na tru dɛn de tɔk.
Dɔn in de kam tɛl am fɔ go tɛl in masta se Ilayja dɔn kam.
I se in nɔ no usay PAPA GƆD in Spirit go kɛr am go i lɛf am, bikɔs, if in go tɛl Eab se Ilayja dɔn kam, dɔn Eab nɔ ebul fɛn am, Eab go kil am; ɛn i dɔn de wɔship PAPA GƆD frɔm we in smɔl.
I aks Ilayja if i nɔ yɛri se wɛn Jɛzibɛl bin de kil PAPA GƆD in prɔfɛt dɛn, nain go ayd wan ɔndrɛd na tu kev; fifti, fifti, ɛn in bin de sɔplay dɛn it ɛn wata;
we naw in de kam tɛl am fɔ go tɛl Eab se Ilayja dɔn kam; i se in nɔ de go bikɔs, Eab go kil am.
Nain Ilayja tɛl am se wans PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we in de sav de alayv, in de go sho insɛf to Eab da de de.
Obadaya go mit Eab ɛn tɛl am, nain Eab go mit Ilayja.
Wɛn Eab si Ilayja, i aks am if nain na di man we de ambɔgin Izrɛl.
Ilayja ansa am se nɔto in de ambɔgin Izrɛl, bɔt nain di vɛri Eab ɛn in papa in ɔda pikin dɛn. I se dɛn lɛf fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD ɛn du wetin i se, bifo dat na Beal dɛn de wɔship.
I se lɛ i gɛda ɔlman na Izrɛl fɔ mit am na Mawnt Kamɛl, dɔn lɛ i kɛr di fo ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti prɔfɛt dɛn we de wɔship Beal ɛn di fo ɔndrɛd prɔfɛt dɛn we de wɔship Ashɛra we kin de it wit Jɛzibɛl.
Eab insɛf sɛn wɔd rawnd Izrɛl ɛn mek ɔlman go gɛda na Mawnt Kamɛl.

Ilayja go tinap bifo di krawd ɛn tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ go de ya, dɛn de yanda; if dɛn fil se na PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD, lɛ dɛn wɔship am; bɔt if na Beal na PAPA GƆD, lɛ dɛn wɔship am. Bɔt di pipul dɛn nɔ ansa am wan wɔd.
So i tɛl dɛn se nain waŋren nɔmɔ dɔn lɛf pan PAPA GƆD in prɔfɛt dɛn, bɔt Beal in gɛt bɔku, fo ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti.

So, lɛ dɛn go fɛn tu kaw. I se lɛ dɛn pik wan fɔ dɛnsɛf, kil am, kɔt, kɔt am ɛn put am pan wud, bɔt dɛn nɔ fɔ put faya pan di wud. I se insɛf go kil in yon ɛn put am pan wud bɔt insɛf nɔ go put faya pan am.
I se dɔn lɛ dɛn pre to dɛn gɔd, dɔn in go pre to PAPA GƆD. I se di gɔd we go ansa ɛn mek faya, bɔn di tin dɛn, nain na PAPA GƆD. Di pipul dɛn gri, dɛn se wetin i se fayn.
Ilayja tɛl Beal in prɔfɛt dɛn se, lɛ dɛn fɔs pik dɛn yon kaw sins dɛn bɔku. I se lɛ dɛn pre to dɛn gɔd bɔt dɛn nɔ fɔ layt nɔn faya.

Dɛn tek di kaw, kil am ɛn rɛdi am. Dɛn pre to Beal frɔm mɔnin te santɛm. Dɛn bin de ala se, “E Beal, ansa wi!” Dɛn ala te dɛn trot wan bɔs, bɔt fiŋ dɛn nɔ yɛri. Dɛn dans, dans rawnd di ɔlta we dɛn mek.
We santɛm rich, Ilayja bigin provok dɛn se, “Una ala lawd, lawd wan! Bo na gɔd! Sɔntɛm i de mɛditet, sɔntɛm i de slip ɔ i de du sɔntin, ɔ sɔntɛm i dɔn travul sɛf.”
Dɛn ala mɔ ɛn mɔ ɛn bigin kɔt, kɔt dɛn bɔdi wit sɔd ɛn spia lɛkɛ aw dɛn kin de du te blɔd kɔmɔt.
Dɛn ala te san go dɔŋ, te ivin tɛm rich fɔ mek di ivintɛm sakrifays. Nɔn fiŋ, nɔ fɛ dɛn nɔ yɛri.
Na de Ilayja kɔl ɔl di pipul dɛn se lɛ dɛn ɔl go nia to am. Dɛn go nia am. Ilayja bil di ɔlta we dɛn bin dɔn brok bak.
I tek twɛlv ston; wan ston tinap fɔ wan pan Jekɔb in pikin dɛn Jekɔb, we nain PAPA GƆD bin dɔn se go nem Izrɛl.
I bil ɔlta wit di twɛlv ston fɔ PAPA GƆD. I dig ol rawnd di ɔlta we go tek lɛkɛ fo galɔn wata.
I fiks fiks di wud, dɔn i kɔt, kɔt di kaw pis pis, ɛn put am pan di wud. I se lɛ dɛn gɛt fo jɔg wata tɔn am pan di bif ɛn di wud. Dɛn du dat.
I se lɛ dɛn go gɛt ɔda fo kam tɔn am, dɛn du dat. I se lɛ dɛn go gɛt fo bak mek tri tɛm mɔ; dɛn du dat.
Di wata rɔn dɔŋ di ɔlta, sok di wud ɛn ful-ɔp di ol.

Wɛn di tɛm rich fɔ ɔfa di sakrifays, Prɔfɛt Ilayja muf go bifo ɛn bigin pre se, “E PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD fɔ Ebraam, Ayzak ɛn Jekɔb, lɛ dɛn pipul yaso no tide se yu na PAPA GƆD na Izrɛl ɛn mi na yu savant, ɛn wetin a de du so na wetin yu tɛl mi fɔ du.
Ansa mi PAPA GƆD, ansa mi, fɔ lɛ dɛn go no se fɔ tru, tru yu PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD, ɛn yu dɔn rɛdi fɔ tɔn dɛn at bak to yu.”
PAPA GƆD in faya fɔdɔm kam dɔŋ ɛn bɔn di sakrifays, di wud, di ston dɛn ɛn di grɔn, ɛn dray ɔl di wata we bin de na di ol.
Wɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn si wetin bi, dɛn fɔdɔm flat na grɔn ɛn tɔk se, “Na PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD! Na PAPA GƆD, na PAPA GƆD!”
Ilayja gi ɔda se lɛ dɛn kech ɔl Beal in prɔfɛt dɛn lɛ wan pan dɛnsɛf nɔ rɔnawe. Dɛn kech dɛn ɛn Ilayja mek dɛn kɛr dɛn go dɔŋ na Kishɔn Vali ɛn kil dɛn de.
Dɔn Ilayja tɛl Eab se lɛ i go it ɛn drink bikɔs in yɛri lɛk ren wan kam.
Wɛn Eab lɛf fɔ go it ɛn drink Ilayja go ɔp Mawnt Kamɛl, butu in ed na grɔn ɛn put in ed midul in tu ni dɛn.
Dɔn i tɛl in wokman se lɛ i go luk to di si if i si ɛnitin. Di wokman go ɛn kam bak se in nɔ si natin. Ilayja mek i go luk de sɛvin tɛm.

Wɛn i go de di las tɛm we mek sɛvin, i se in si sɔntin lɛkɛ klawd we smɔl lɛk mɔtalman an de grap kɔmɔt na di si. Ilayja tɛl am se lɛ i rɔn go tɛl Eab se lɛ i go insay in karej ɛn rɔn go om bifo di ren mit am na rod.
Da tɛm de di ples dɔn bigin dak ɛn big, big tinada bin dɔn bigin de blo; wan tɛm nain ebi ren fɔdɔm. Eab go insay in karej ɛn go bak na Jɛzril.
PAPA GƆD in pawa kam pan Ilayja ɛn dat mek i bɛlt in klos ɛn rɔn go bifo Eab te rich Jɛzril.
Eab go tɛl Jɛzibɛl ɔl wetin Ilayja du ɛn aw i dɔn kil ɔl in prɔfɛt dɛn.
Jɛzibɛl sɛn mɛsej to Ilayja se in swɛ to in gɔd dɛn lɛ in alaki if in nɔ dil wit am ɛn mek in layf tan lɛkɛ dɛn prɔfɛt dɛn we i kil, di nɛks de.
Ilayja fred ɛn rɔn fɔ in layf. Wɛn i rich na Biashiba na Juda, i mek in wokman wet am de,

dɔn in waŋren travul fɔ wanol de go na di land we pɔsin nɔ de tap. Wɛn i rich ɔnda wan tik we dɛn kin pul brum pan, i sidɔm ɔnda de ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD se in dɔn taya, in dɔn si bɔku trɔbul so lɛ in day wantɛm bikɔs in nɔ bɛtɛ pas in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn.
I lidɔm slip ɔnda di tik. Nain wan enjɛl kam mit am, i tɔch am, ɛn tɛl am se lɛ i grap ɔn it.
Wɛn i luk i si ɔt bred we dɛn jɛs bek ɛn wata de nia in ed. I it ɛn drink ɛn lidɔm bak.
PAPA GƆD in enjɛl mit am di sɛkɛn tɛm ɛn wek am se lɛ i grap ɛn it, ɔ nɔ so di rod go mɔna am.
I grap bak, i it ɛn drink; na da it de de nain bɛlɛ we gi am trɛnk fɔ fɔti de ɛn fɔti nɛt te i rich Saynay we na PAPA GƆD in mawnten.
I go insay wan kev ɛn slip de da nɛt de. PAPA GƆD kɔl Ilayja ɛn aks am wetin i de du de.

I ansa se in bin gɛt bɔku zil fɔ PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in wok. I se di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn brok di Kɔvinant wit PAPA GƆD ɛn di ɔlta, ɛn kil in prɔfɛt dɛn; dɔn in waŋren lɛf ɛn dɛn de fɛt fɔ kil insɛf.

PAPA GƆD tɛl am se lɛ i go na do go tinap bifo am bikɔs i gɛt fɔ pas da say de Wantɛm nain big big tinada blo ɛn skata di mawnten ɛn dɛn rɔk dɛn bifo PAPA GƆD, bɔt in nɔ bin de na di tinada. Afta di tinada di grɔn shek te i plit, bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ bin de de.
Afta dat faya kech, bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ bin de na di faya. Afta di faya nain wan smɔl fayn vɔys bigin tɔk.
We Ilayja yɛri di vɔys, i kɔba in fes wit in klos ɛn go tinap na di kev in domɔt, nain wan vɔys aks am se wetin i de du de.

I ansa se in bin gɛt bɔku zil fɔ PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in wok. I se di Izrɛlayt dɛn dɔn brok di Kɔvinant wit PAPA GƆD ɛn di ɔlta, ɛn kil in prɔfɛt dɛn, dɔn in waŋren we lɛf dɛn de fɛt fɔ kil insɛf.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, “Yuz di sem rod we yu yuz kam go bak na di land na Damaskɔs we pɔsin nɔ de tap, ɛn wɛn yu rich de, anɔynt Azaɛl kiŋ fɔ Eram.
Anɔynt Jeu we na Nimshi in bɔypikin, kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl; Ilaɛlsha we na Shafat in bɔypikin we kɔmɔt Ebɛl Mɛola fɔ tek yu ples.
Jeu go kil ɛnibɔdi we rɔnawe na Azaɛl in an, dɔn Ilaɛlsha go kil ɛniwan we rɔnawe na Jeu in an.
A dɔn kip sɛvin tawzin pipul dɛn na Izrɛl we nɔ wande wɔship Beal ɔ kis in lay lay gɔd.”

Wɛn Ilayja kɔmɔt de, i mit Ilaɛlsha we na Shafat in bɔypikin de wok in fam wit twɛnti fo kaw we dɛn jɔyn tu tu fɔ dig ɛn nain bin de kɔntrol di las tu. Ilayja go mit am ɛn ib di matirial we i kin ɛŋ rawnd in sholda pan am.
Ilaɛlsha lɛf in wok ɛn rɔnata Ilayja, ɛn tɛl am se i wan go tɛl in mama ɛn papa se in de go dɔn i go fala am go. Ilayja ansa am se lɛ i go bak in nɔ du am natin.
So Ilaɛlsha tɔn bak. I kil di kaw dɛn ɛn yuz di bod we i bin de tek dig mek wud fɔ kuk di bif, dɔn i sheb sheb gi ɔlman fɔ it. Afta dat i go wit am ɛn bi in asistant.
Kiŋ Bɛnadad na Eram gɛda in wanol ami fɔ atak Sameria. I kɔl tati-tu ɔda kiŋ dɛn wit dɛn ɔs ɛn karej fɔ jɔyn am. I sɔrawnd Sameria ɛn atak am.
Dɔn i sɛn mɛsej to kiŋ Eab na di siti na Izrɛl se,
di silva, di gold ɛn ɔl di gud uman dɛn ɛn pikin dɛn nain yon.
Eab sɛn mɛsej bak to am se in di Bɛnadad na di masta, ɛn in di Eab wit ɔl wetin i gɛt na Bɛnadad yon.
Di mɛsenja dɛn go bak to Eab go tɛl am se Bɛnadad se in bin dɔn sɛn to am fɔ in silva, gold, in wɛf dɛn ɛn pikin dɛn.
So da sem awa de di nɛks de, in de sɛn in ɔfisa dɛn fɔ sach in os ɛn ɔl in ɔfisa dɛn os. Dɛn go siz ɔl wetin gɛt valyu ɛn kɛr am go.
Di kiŋ na Izrɛl sɛn kɔl ɔl dɛn bigman dɛn na di kɔntri ɛn tɛl dɛn se Bɛnadad de fɛn plaba. I se wɛn Bɛnadad sɛn to am se nain gɛt ɔl in wɛf dɛn, pikin dɛn, gold wit in silva, in nɔ se nɔ.
Di bigman dɛn tɛl di kiŋ se lɛ i nɔ lisin to wetin Bɛnadad de se, ɔ du wetin i want.
So di kiŋ gi Bɛnadad in mɛsenja mɛsej fɔ go tɛl am se, di fɔs tɛm in bin gri fɔ du wetin i se, bɔt dis wan ya in nɔ go du am. Dɛnsɛf kɛr di mɛsej go.
Na de Bɛnadad sɛn ɔda mɛsej to am se lɛ in gɔd dɛn pɔnish am bad bad wan if in lɛf dɔti na di grɔn sɛf na Sameria.
Di kiŋ sɛn riplay bak to Bɛnadad se tru soja na we i dɔn fɛt dɔn i de blɔf, nɔto bifo i fɛt.
Dis mɛsej mit Bɛnadad di tɛm we in ɛn di ɔda kiŋ dɛn bin de drink na dɛn tɛnt. Wantɛm nain i gi ɔda to in man dɛn se dɛn fɔ rɛdi fɔ atak Sameria. Dɛnsɛf rɛdi fɔ di atak.

We ɔl dat de bi, wan prɔfɛt go to Kiŋ Eab na Izrɛl ɛn tɛl am se, PAPA GƆD se lɛ i nɔ fred ɔl dɛn bɔku, bɔku sojaman dɛn de we i si. I se in go mek i kɔnka dɛn ɔl da vɛri de de; ɛn na da tɛm de in di Eab go no se in na PAPA GƆD we na Gɔd.

Eab aks di prɔfɛt se udat go lid di atak. Di prɔfɛt ansa am se PAPA GƆD se na di yɔŋ sojaman dɛn we de ɔnda di distrikt ɔfisa dɛn kɔmand. I aks am bak se udat go stat di fɛt. Di prɔfɛt ansa am se nain di Eab.
Eab gɛda ɔl di yɔŋ soja ɔfisa dɛn we de ɔnda di distrikt ɔfisa dɛn kɔmand. Na bin dɛn tu ɔndrɛd ɛn tati-tu. Dɔn i gɛda ɔl di ɔda Izrɛlayt man dɛn; na bin dɛn sɛvin tawzin.
Dɛn lɛf santɛm, di tɛm we Bɛnadad ɛn di ɔda tati-tu kiŋ dɛn we jɔyn gɛŋ wit am bin de na dɛn tɛnt de drink ɛn drɔnk.
Na di yɔŋ soja ɔfisa dɛn we de ɔnda di distrikt ɔfisa dɛn fɔs lɛf. Bɛnadad sɛn man dɛn fɔ go wach wetin de apin. Dɛn go ripɔt bak to am se dɛn si man dɛn de kɔmɔt na Sameria.
So i tɛl dɛn se wɛda na pis ɔ wa dɛn kam fɔ, nɔ fɔ lɛf dɛn so, na fɔ kech dɛn layf wan.
Di yɔŋ soja ɔfisa dɛn we de ɔnda di distrikt ɔfisa dɛn mach go bifo wit ɔl di ɔda sojaman dɛn biɛn dɛn.

As dɛn de go na so dɛn de kil di ɛnimi. Wɛn di Aramean dɛn si se di Izrɛlayt dɛn de kil, kil dɛn, dɛn rɔnawe bɔt di Izrɛlayt dɛn rɔnata dɛn. As fɔ Bɛnadad we na kiŋ na Eram, in ɛn sɔm pan in man dɛn jomp pantap ɔs ɛn rɔnawe.
Di kiŋ na Izrɛl rɔnata dɛn, kech dɛn wit dɛn ɔs ɛn karej ɛn kil bɔku pan dɛn. Nɔto kɔmɔn day di Aramean dɛn day da de de.
Afta dat di prɔfɛt go to di kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn tɛl am se lɛ i gɛda insɛf bak bikɔs di nɛks spriŋ sizin di kiŋ na Eram go atak am bak.

Na de di kiŋ na Eram in yon ɔfisa dɛn go tɛl am se di Izrɛlayt dɛn gɔd dɛn na di gɔd dɛn we de inchaj ɔf dɛn il. So na dat mek dɛn nɔ bin ebul di Izrɛlayt dɛn. Dɛn se if dɛn fɛt dɛn na lɛvul grɔn, dɛn go kɔnka dɛn.
Dɛn advays am se lɛ i pul ɔl di kiŋ dɛn kɔmɔt na dɛn post ɛn put ɔda ɔfisa dɛn de;

dɔn i fɔ bil ɔda ami lɛkɛ di wan we i dɔn lɔs; nyu ɔs fɔ tek di wan we dɔn day in ples ɛn nyu karej fɔ tek di wan we dɔn pwɛl in ples, so dat dɛn go ebul fɛt di Izrɛlayt dɛn na lɛvul grɔn da tɛm de naw dɛn go ebul dɛn. Di kiŋ gri wit ɔl wetin dɛn se ɛn du am.
Di nɛks spriŋ sizin, Bɛnadad gɛda ɔl di Aramean dɛn go ɔp na Efɛk fɔ fɛt di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛnsɛf gɛda dɛnsɛf prɔpa wan wit ɔl dɛn provishɔn fɔ brakɛt dɛn. Di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin fiba lɛk yɔni bifo di Aramean dɛn. Di Aramean dɛn bin prɛd ɔlɔbɔt na di kɔntri.

Di prɔfɛt go mit di kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn tɛl am se PAPA GƆD se bikɔs di Aramean dɛn de tink se in na PAPA GƆD fɔ di il bɔt nɔto PAPA GƆD fɔ di vali, in go mek shɔ se dɛn bit dɛn gud fashin, dɔn na da tɛm de in di kiŋ go no se in na PAPA GƆD.

Di Aramean ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn de na dɛn kamp fɔ sɛvin de, ɔlman de ɔpozit in kɔmpin, dɔn di de we mek sɛvin dɛn bigin fɛt. Na wan ɔndrɛd tawzin man dɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn kil pan di Aramean dɛn insay waŋren de;
di balans dɛn rɔnawe go na Efɛk ɛn di wɔl na Efɛk fɔdɔm pan twɛnti-sɛvin tawzin pan dɛn ɛn kil dɛn. Bɛnadad rɔnawe go na di siti go ayd na wan biɛn rum na wan os.

Na de i de we in ɔfisa dɛn tɛl am se dɛn yɛri se di kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl na pipul dɛn we gɛt sɔri at, so lɛ dɛn wɛr saklɔth Dɛn kin wɛr am fɔ munin; fɔ we pɔsin sɔri fɔ in sin; fɔ pre fɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ sev pɔsin rawnd dɛn wes ɛn tay rop na dɛn ed se sɔntɛm di kiŋ go sɔri fɔ dɛn.

Di man dɛn wɛr saklɔth rawnd dɛn wes ɛn tay rop na dɛn ed go mit di kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn tɛl am se in savant Bɛnadad de beg am se lɛ i spia in layf. Di kiŋ aks dɛn se if Bɛnadad stil de alayv bikɔs nain brɔda.
As di kiŋ tɔk se nain brɔda dɛn rid ɔp kwik ɛn ansa am bak kwik wan se Bɛnadad nain brɔda. Di kiŋ se lɛ dɛn go briŋ am kam. Wɛn Bɛnadad kɔmɔt na do, di kiŋ mek i klem ɔp in karej.

Bɛnadad tɛl am se in go gi am bak dɛn siti dɛn we in papa bin siz nain yon papa in an, dɔn if Eab want sɛf i kin bil in yon makit na Damaskɔs lɛkɛ aw in di Bɛnadad in papa bin du na Sameria. Eab tɛl am se if dɛn tu gri pan dat in go lɛf am lɛ i go fri. I tay bagin wit am.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to wan prɔfɛt, so i go mit in kɔmpin prɔfɛt ɛn tɛl am se lɛ i slap am, bɔt i nɔ gri;
so i tɛl am se bikɔs i nɔ yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd, as i lɛf am so layɔn go mit am na rod ɛn kil am. Ɛn as di man lɛf fɔ go so, layɔn mit am na rod ɛn kil am.
Di prɔfɛt go mit ɔda pɔsin ɛn tɛl am se lɛ i slap am, so di pɔsin insɛf slap am ɛn wund am.
Dɔn di prɔfɛt go tinap na rod de wet fɔ di kiŋ. I tek di tin we i de wɛr nain ed kɔba in fes fɔ lɛ dɛn nɔ go no udat i bi.

As di kiŋ de pas, nain i ala am se, “kiŋ, yu savant bin de fɛt na wɔfrɔnt, wantɛm nain wan man kam mit mi wit wan man we i kech se lɛ a kip am na tayt ples te i kam. I se if di man lɔs, insɛf go lɔs mi layf ɔ a pe tati-fo kil silva kɔpɔ.
We a bin de ɔp ɛn dɔŋ nɔmɔ nain di man lɔs.” Di kiŋ ansa am se na dat fɔ bi in pe bikɔs nain yon mɔt dɔn tɔk am.
Di prɔfɛt kwik, kwik wan pul di tin we i tek kɔba in fes; dɔn di kiŋ no wantɛm se in na wan pan di prɔfɛt dɛn.
I tɛl di kiŋ se PAPA GƆD se i dɔn fri pɔsin we in PAPA GƆD bin dɔn se fɔ day; so nain go day fɔ di man, dɔn in pipul dɛn go day bikɔs i mek di man in yon pipul dɛn rɔnawe.
Di kiŋ swɛl ɛn vɛks bad, bad wan ɛn go bak nain os na Sameria.
Wan tɛm bin de we wan Jɛzrilayt we nem Nebɔth gɛt wan vayn fam. Dis bin de na Jɛzril nia to Kiŋ Eab we na kiŋ na Sameria in os.
Eab tɛl Nebɔth se lɛ i gi am di vayn frut fam fɔ de plant vɛjitebul bikɔs i de neba to in yon kiŋ os, dɔn in go gi am ɔda wan we bɛtɛ pas da wande, ɔ if i nɔ want am, in kin pe am ɛnitin we i aks fɔ.
Bɔt Nebɔth ansa am se PAPA GƆD sɛf nɔ go gri fɔ lɛ i gi am in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn prɔpati.
Dat mek Eab go om swɛl wit vɛksteshɔn we Nebɔth tɛl am se mek PAPA GƆD nɔ gri sɛf fɔ mek i gi am in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn prɔpati. I lidɔm kwayɛt wan nain bed ɛn tɔn in fes to di wɔl, ɛn nɔ gri it natin.
In wɛf Jɛzibɛl go mit am ɛn aks am wetin mek i vɛks we mek i nɔ gri it sɛf.
I ansa am se in beg Nebɔth da Jɛzrilayt fɔ lɛ i sɛl in vayn fam gi am, i nɔ gri; i se pan ɔl we i se in go gi am ɔda vayn frut fam fɔ da wande, Nebɔth stil nɔ gri.
Jɛzibɛl aks am if in nɔto kiŋ na Izrɛl we i de biev so; i se lɛ i it ɛn lɛ i nɔ wɔri insɛf bikɔs in go mek shɔ se in gi am Nebɔth da Jɛzrilayt in vayn fam.
Jɛzibɛl yuz Eab in nem rayt lɛta dɛn ɛn yuz Eab in yon nem stamp, sɛn dɛn to di bigman dɛn na di siti we Nebɔth de.
Di lɛta se dɛn fɔ mek di wanol siti fast, dɔn lɛ dɛn put Nebɔth na ay pozishɔn lɛk fɔ se dɛn wan ɔna am.
Dɔn lɛ dɛn fɛn tu bad man dɛn we go lay pan Nebɔth se i tɔk bad bɔt PAPA GƆD ɛn di kiŋ, dɔn lɛ dɛn pul am kɔmɔt de ɛn ston am te i day.
Di bigman dɛn na di siti we Nebɔth de, du wetin Jɛzibɛl se.
Dɛn tɛl ɔlman fɔ fast, dɔn dɛn put Nebɔth na ay pozishɔn lɛk fɔ se dɛn wan ɔna am.
Di tu badman dɛnsɛf go sidɔm bifo Nebɔth ɛn lay pan am se dɛn yɛri we i de tɔk bad bɔt PAPA GƆD ɛn di kiŋ. Di pipul dɛn pul Nebɔth kɔmɔt na di siti ɛn ston am te i day.
Dɔn dɛn sɛn to Jɛzibɛl se dɛn dɔn ston Nebɔth ɛn i dɔn day.
As Jɛzibɛl yɛri se dɛn dɔn ston Nebɔth ɛn i dɔn day, i tɛl Eab se lɛ i go tek Nebɔth da Jɛzrilayt in vayn fam we i nɔ bin gri fɔ sɛl gi am. I se Nebɔth dɔn day.
As Eab insɛf yɛri se Nebɔth dɔn day, insɛf grap go tek in vayn frut fam.
Nain PAPA GƆD tɔk to Ilayja da Tishbayt se,
“Grap, go dɔŋ na Sameria go mit Eab we na kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl, i dɔn go naw naw na Nebɔth in vayn frut fam fɔ go tek am.
Tɛl am se mi PAPA GƆD se, i dɔn grap i dɔn kil mɔtalman, dɔn naw i go kapu di pɔsin in prɔpati; so da sem ples usay dɔg lik Nebɔth in blɔd, na di vɛri ples dɔg go lik insɛf yon blɔd.”
Wɛn Eab si Ilayja, i tɛl am se “E bo mi ɛnimi! Yu kam fɛn mi na yaso bak!?” Ilayja ansa am se yɛs, in go fɛn am bikɔs i jɛs mekɔp in maynd fɔ de du bad bifo PAPA GƆD in yay.
Ilayja tɛl am se PAPA GƆD se in go briŋ big big waala nain layf. I se wɛn in dɔn dɔn wit Eab, wan sid pan di man dɛn nɔ go lɛf biɛn am, i lɛk sɛf di pɔsin na slev ɔ fribɔn na Izrɛl.
I se in go mek Eab in os tan lɛk let Jɛroboam, Nebat in bɔypikin in os; dɔn i mek am lɛk Baasha, Aija insɛf yon bɔypikin in os, bikɔs i dɔn ambɔgin am bad, bad wan ɛn mek Izrɛl sɛf kɔmit sin.
Ilayja se as fɔ Jɛzibɛl in yon say, PAPA GƆD se na dɔg dɛn go it in dedebɔdi midul di siti na Jɛzril.
I se ɛnibɔdi we de na Eab in os we day na di siti, na dɔg go it in dedebɔdi; dɔn di wan dɛn we day na bush, na dɛn bɔd dɛn go it am.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de we pas Eab fɔ du bad bifo PAPA GƆD in yay bikɔs nain wɛf Jɛzibɛl bin de push am.
I du ɔlkayn bad bad tin we nɔ fɔ du; i wɔship lay lay gɔd dɛn lɛkɛ dɛn Amɔrayt we PAPA GƆD bin drɛb kɔmɔt bifo di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Wɛn Eab yɛri wetin Ilayja tɔk, i chɛr in klos, wɛr saklɔth ɛn fast. Na di saklɔth in bin de slip wit. Wɛn i kin de waka na so i kin luk ɔmbul.
Na de PAPA GƆD tɔk to Ilayja da Tishbayt bak se,

“Yu nɔ si aw Eab dɔn ɔmbul insɛf to mi? Wɛl, bikɔs i dɔn ɔmbul insɛf so, ɔl wetin a dɔn tɔk se a go du, a nɔ go du am we i de alayv; nain pikin dɛn naw a go mek sɔfa ɛn na wɛn in bɔypikin de rul a go du dat.”
I tek tri ia nɔn fɛt nɔ bi bitwin Izrɛl ɛn Eram.
Bɔt insay di tɔd ia Jɛoshafat we na kiŋ na Juda go fɛn di kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Nain di kiŋ na Izrɛl aks in ɔfisa dɛn if dɛn nɔ no se na dɛn gɛt Ramɔt Giliad we dɛn jɛs fol an fol fut ɛn nɔ tek am bak na di kiŋ na Eram in an.
Na de i aks Jɛoshafat if i go jɔyn am fɔ go fɛt Ramɔt Giliad. Jɛoshafat ansa di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl se, “Bo, mi ɛn yu na wan, mi pipul dɛn na yu yon pipul dɛn, mi ɔs dɛn na yu yon ɔs dɛn.
Bɔt fɛnɔt fɔs frɔm PAPA GƆD fɔ no in maynd.”
Di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl sɛn kɔl ɔl di fo ɔndrɛd prɔfɛt dɛn ɛn aks dɛn if i fɔ go fɛt Ramɔt Giliad ɔ lɛ i nɔ go. Di prɔfɛt dɛn ɔl ansa am se lɛ i go, PAPA GƆD go mek i win.
Na de Jɛoshafat aks if PAPA GƆD nɔ gɛt nɔn prɔfɛt de we dɛn kin aks.

Di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl ansa Jɛoshafat se wan mɔ prɔfɛt stil de we kin aks PAPA GƆD, we nem Maykaya we na Imla in bɔypikin; i se bɔt in et Maykaya bikɔs wande i nɔ de tɛl am gud tin, pas bad tin. Jɛoshafat tɛl di kiŋ se lɛ i nɔ tɔk so.
So di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl sɛn wan ɔfisa fɔ go briŋ Maykaya kam.

Da tɛm de, di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl ɛn Jɛoshafat we na kiŋ fɔ Juda bin wɛr dɛn kiŋ klos sidɔm na dɛn chia na di ples we dɛn de mas Wit we dɛn dɔn avɛst am. Dis ples yaso bin de na di get fɔ go insay Sameria ɛn ɔl di prɔfɛt dɛn bin tinap bifo di kiŋ dɛn de tɛl dɛn fɔ go fɛt.
Na de Zɛdikaya we na Kenaanain bɔypikin mek ayɛn ɔn dɛn ɛn tɔk se PAPA GƆD se na di ɔn dɛn di kiŋ go yuz fɔ buk buk di Aramean dɛn te i dɔnawe wit dɛn.
Ɔl di ɔda prɔfɛt dɛnsɛf tɔk di sem tin. Dɛn se lɛ di kiŋ atak Ramɔt Giliad, PAPA GƆD go mek i win.
Di mɛsenja we go kɔl Maykaya tɛl am se ɔl di ɔda prɔfɛt dɛn tɔk gud wɔd to di kiŋ ɛn na di sem tin dɛn ɔl tɔk; so in de advays am se wɛn i go to di kiŋ na wetin di ɔda prɔfɛt dɛn dɔn se insɛf fɔ se.
Bɔt Maykaya tɛl am se wans PAPA GƆD de alayv, na wetin i tɛl am fɔ tɔk in go tɔk.
Wɛn Maykaya rich to di kiŋ, di kiŋ aks am se if lɛ i go fɛt Ramɔt Giliad ɔ lɛ i nɔ go. Maykaya ansa am se lɛ i go, PAPA GƆD go mek i win.
Bɔt di kiŋ tɛl am se ɔmɔs tɛm in nɔ dɔn tɛl am se i nɔ fɔ de tɛl am natin bɔt di tru tin we PAPA GƆD tɛl am.
Maykaya ansa di kiŋ se in si ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn skata skata pantap dɛn mawnten lɛkɛ ship we nɔ gɛt pɔsin fɔ gayd dɛn; na de PAPA GƆD tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ gɛt gud lida so lɛ ɔlman go bak nain os.
Na de di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl aks Jɛoshafat se if in nɔ bin dɔn tɛl am se Maykaya nɔ gɛt nɔn gud wɔd fɔ tɛl am.
Maykaya tɛl di kiŋ se lɛ i lisin naw to wetin PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ se; i se in si PAPA GƆD sidɔm nain chia wit ɔl dɛn enjɛl dɛn de rawnd am; sɔm de nain lɛfan, sɔm nain raytan; dɔn i aks se,
udat go go mek Eab ful so dat i go mit in Watalo na Ramɔt Giliad. I se di enjɛl dɛn ɔl bigin de tɔk; dis de se dis, da wande de se dat.
Na de wan enjɛl go tinap bifo PAPA GƆD ɛn tɔk se
in go kɔnvins am. So PAPA GƆD aks am aw i go du am. So i ansa se in go go dɔŋ ɛn put laylay mɛsej na di prɔfɛt dɛn mɔt. So PAPA GƆD tɛl am se yɛs, dat go kɔnvins am, so lɛ i go.
Maykaya tɛl am se na PAPA GƆD insɛf sɛf put laylay spirit na di prɔfɛt dɛn mɔt, ɛn i dɔn tɔk se i nɔ gɛt fɔ ɛnd fayn.
Na de Zɛdikaya, dat na Kenaanain bɔypikin go nia Maykaya ɛn gi am payn nain fes ɛn aks am se usay PAPA GƆD in spirit pas we i lɛf in go to am go tɔk to am.
Maykaya ansa am se na di de we i go si insɛf de go fɛn rum fɔ ayd fɔ in layf nain i go no.
Na de di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl gi ɔda se lɛ dɛn kech Maykaya kɛr am go to Emɔn we na di gɔvna fɔ di siti ɛn Joash we na di kiŋ in bɔypikin ɛn tɛl dɛn se,
di kiŋ se dɛn fɔ put am na jel ɛn fid am wit ɛmti bred ɛn wata te i kam bak.
Maykaya ansa di kiŋ se if i tɔn bak wit in layf dɛn nɔto PAPA GƆD tɔk to am. Maykaya tɛl ɔl di pipul dɛn se lɛ dɛn mak wetin in dɔn tɔk.
Di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl wit Jɛoshafat we na kiŋ fɔ Juda go na Ramɔt Giliad.
Di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl tɛl Jɛoshafat se in go disgays insɛf fɔ go fɛt, bɔt lɛ Jɛoshafat in wɛr in kiŋ klos. So di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl disgays insɛf, dɔn Jɛoshafat wɛr in kiŋ klos.
Di kiŋ fɔ Eram gi kɔmand to in tati-tu karej kɔmanda dɛn se lɛ dɛn nɔ fɛt nɔbɔdi pas di kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Wɛn di kɔmanda dɛn si Jɛoshafat, dɛn se na di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl, so dɛn rɔnata am fɔ fɛt am, bɔt wɛn Jɛoshafat ala, dɛn si se nɔto in;
so wɛn dɛn fɛnɔt se nɔto in, dɛn lɛf fɔ rɔnata am.

Bɔt wan man drɔ in bo ɛn aro ɛn jɛs shut lɛkɛ dat. Di aro pas tru di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl in klos we i wɛr fɔ protɛkt insɛf ɛn chuk am. So i tɛl di man we bin de drayv in karej se lɛ i tɔn bak, lɛ dɛn kɔmɔt pan di fɛt bikɔs in dɔn wund.

Da tɛm de naw di wa bin de tɛns mɔ ɛn mɔ; dɛn es di kiŋ ɛn ol am fɔ lɛ i go ebul sidɔm na di karej, bifo di Aramean dɛn. Da ivin tɛm de i day, dɔn in blɔd bigin flo kɔmɔt pan di wund te go dɔŋ di karej.
Di vɛri ivintɛm dɛn sɛn wɔd go rawnd se lɛ ɔlman go bak nain kɔntri ɛn in siti.
Na so di kiŋ tek day. Dɛn kɛr am go Sameria ɛn bɛr am de.
Dɛn kɛr di karej go na wan watasay na Sameria usay dɛn rare gyal dɛn kin was fɔ go was am de. Dɔg dɛn go de go lik in blɔd. Ɔl dis bi lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɔk.
Ɔl di ɔda wok dɛn we Eab du; di ayvri os dɛn we i bil o, di siti dɛn we i bil o, dɛn ɔl rayt na dɛn istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl.
Dɛn bɛr Eab usay dɛn bɛr in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn, dɔn in bɔypikin Aazaya tek in ples fɔ rul as kiŋ.
Asa in bɔypikin we nem Jɛoshafat bigin fɔ rul na Juda di ia we mek Eab fo ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Jɛoshafat bin ol tati-fayv ia we i bigin rul ɛn i rul fɔ twɛnti-fayv ia na Jerusɛlɛm. In mama nem Azuba ɛn na Shili in gyal pikin.
Jɛoshafat du ɔl wetin in papa Asa bin de du, ɛn na wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay i bin de du; bɔt stil di pipul dɛn bin de mek sakrifays na dɛn il.
Jɛoshafat mek pis wit di kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Ɔl di ɔda tin dɛn we Jɛoshafat du, di we aw i rul, di wa dɛn we i fɛt, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
I drɛb ɔl di ple bɔy dɛn we in papa Asa bin lɛf we bin de mek sakrifays to lay lay gɔd.
Da tɛm de nɔn kiŋ nɔ bin de na Idɔm, na wan asistant bin de rul.
Jɛoshafat bil ship dɛn fɔ de go bay gold na Ofir, bɔt di ship dɛn nɔ ɛva rich de bikɔs dɛn go rɛk na Ɛziɔn Gɛba.
So na de Eab in bɔypikin Aazaya tɛl am se lɛ i mek in yon siman dɛn jɔyn in di Aazaya in yon dɛn, bɔt Jɛoshafat nɔ gri.
Jɛoshafat day dɔn dɛn bɛr am nain Papa Devid in siti. Nain bɔypikin Jɛoram bigin rul afta am.
Eab in bɔypikin Aazaya bigin fɔ rul na Izrɛl insay Sameria di ia we mek Jɛoshafat sɛvintin ia as kiŋ na Juda. Ɛn i rul Izrɛl fɔ tu ia.
Na wetin nɔ rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay in bin de du jɛs lɛkɛ in mami ɛn dadi, ɛn wit Nebat in bɔypikin Jɛroboam we mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin.
Aazaya wɔship Beal ɛn mek PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl in PAPA GƆD vɛks bad, bad wan lɛkɛ aw i bin vɛks pan in papa.
We Kiŋ Eab dɔn day, Moab bigin barɔf pan Izrɛl.
Kiŋ Aazaya bin kɔt awt wande pantap in ruf fɔdɔm kam dɔŋ nain os na Sameria ɛn wund insɛf bad bad wan. So i sɛn in mɛsenja dɛn to Bealzibɔb we na gɔd na Ɛkrɔn se lɛ dɛn go aks am if i go wɛl.

PAPA GƆD in enjɛl tɔk to Ilayja da Tishbayt. I se, “Grap go mit di kiŋ na Sameria in mɛsenja dɛn na rod ɛn aks dɛn se if PAPA GƆD nɔ de na Izrɛl we mek i de sɛn fɔ go fɛnɔt to Bealzibɔb da gɔd na Ɛkrɔn.
Tɛl dɛn se PAPA GƆD se, in fut nɔ go kam dɔŋ da bed de, na de i go day.” Ilayja insɛf go mit di mɛsenja dɛn na rod.
Wɛn di mɛsenja dɛn tɔn bak go to di kiŋ, i aks dɛn wetin mek dɛn tɔn bak.

Dɛn ansa am se wan man mit dɛn na rod ɛn tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn tɔn bak to in di kiŋ ɛn tɛl am se if na bikɔs PAPA GƆD nɔ de na Izrɛl mek i de sɛn fɔ go fɛnɔt to Bealzibɔb da gɔd na Ɛkrɔn. Dɛn se di man tɛl dɛn fɔ tɛl am se in fut nɔ go kam dɔŋ di bed, na de i go day.
Di kiŋ aks dɛn uskayn man da wande we mit dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn dɛn kaynaba wɔd de.
Dɛn ansa am se na ia dɛn tek mek di klos we i wɛr, ɛn i tay lɛda bɛlt rawnd in wes. Na de di kiŋ tɛl dɛn se nɔto nɔbɔdi pas Ilayja da Tishbayt.
Dɛn di kiŋ sɛn wan ami kapten wit fifti sojaman dɛn fɔ go briŋ Ilayja kam. I go mit Ilayja sidɔm ɔp wan il ɛn tɛl am se, “Yu man ɔf PAPA GƆD, di kiŋ se lɛ yu kam dɔŋ.”

Bɔt Ilayja ansa di kapten ɛn in fifti man dɛn se, “If mi na man ɔf PAPA GƆD, lɛ faya kɔmɔt ɔp na ɛvin kam bɔn ɛn kil yu ɛn yu fifti man dɛn.” Wantɛm nain faya kɔmɔt na ɛvin kam bɔn ɛn kil in ɛn in fifti man dɛn.
We di kin yɛri dis, i sɛn ɔda kapten wit fifti man dɛn. Di kapten go mit Ilayja ɛn tɛl am se, “Yu man ɔf PAP A GƆD, di kiŋ se yu fɔ kam dɔŋ wantɛm.”
Bɔt Ilayja ansa am bak se, “If mi na man ɔf PAPA GƆD, lɛ faya kɔmɔt ɔp na ɛvin kam bɔn ɛn kil yu ɛn yu fifti man dɛn.” Dɔn faya kɔmɔt na ɛvin kam dɔŋ, bɔn ɛn kil in ɛn in fifti man dɛn.

So di kiŋ sɛn di tɔd sɛt wit wan kapten ɛn fifti man dɛn. Dis kapten in naw go ɔp di il ɛn nildɔŋ bifo Ilayja ɛn beg am se, “E man ɔf PAPA GƆD, duya a de beg, nɔ kil mi wit dɛn fifti man yaso. Wi na yu savant. Sɔri fɔ wi, nɔ kil wi.
Yu dɔn mek faya kɔmɔt na ɛvin kam kil dɛn tu kapten wit dɛn fifti, fifti man dɛn. Duya sɔri fɔ mi.”
Na de PAPA GƆD in enjɛl tɔk to Ilayja se, “Nɔ fred am; go wit am.” Ilayja insɛf grap ɛn go dɔŋ wit am to di kiŋ.

I tɛl di kiŋ se, PAPA GƆD se if PAPA GƆD nɔ de na Izrɛl we mek i sɛn mɛsenja dɛn to Bealzibɔb, di gɔd na Ɛkrɔn fɔ no wetin go apin to am. I se fɔ wetin i dɔn du, in fut nɔ go kam dɔn di bed, na de i go day.
Di kiŋ day, lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin tɛl Ilayja, Aazaya nɔ bin gɛt bɔypikin so in brɔda Joram tek in ples. Dis bi di ia we mek Jɛoshafat in bɔypikin we na Jɛoram tu ia we i bi kiŋ na Juda.
Di ɔda tin dɛn we Aazaya du wɛn i bin de rul as kiŋ, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Di tɛm we PAPA GƆD bin rɛdi fɔ tek Ilayja go ɔp na ɛvin wit wan big briz we de tɔn rawnd ɛn rawnd, Ilayja ɛn Ilaɛlsha bin de waka de kɔmɔt na Gilgal.
Ilayja tɛl Ilaɛlsha se lɛ i wet am na da ples de bikɔs PAPA GƆD sɛn am na Bɛthɛl. Bɔt Ilaɛlsha nɔ gri, i se wans PAPA GƆD de alayv ɛn in di Ilayja insɛf nɔ day yet, i nɔ go lɛf am.
So dɛn ɔltu go dɔŋ na Bɛthɛl. Sɔm prɔfɛt dɛn we bin de na Bɛthɛl aks Ilaɛlsha if in nɔ no se PAPA GƆD de tek in masta nain an da de de. Ilaɛlsha ansa dɛn se in no, so lɛ dɛn sɛt dɛn mɔt.
Ilayja tɛl Ilaɛlsha se lɛ i wet am na Bɛthɛl bikɔs PAPA GƆD sɛn am na Jɛriko. Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se wans PAPA GƆD de alayv ɛn in di Ilayja insɛf nɔ day yet, in nɔ go lɛf am. So dɛn ɔltu go na Jɛriko.
Di prɔfɛt dɛn we de na Jɛriko dɛnsɛf go mit Ilaɛlsha ɛn aks am if i nɔ no se PAPA GƆD de tek in masta nain an da de de. Ilaɛlsha ansa dɛn se in no, so lɛ dɛn sɛt dɛn mɔt.
Ilayja tɛl Ilaɛlsha se lɛ i wet am na Jɛriko bikɔs PAPA GƆD sɛn am na Jɔdan. Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se wans PAPA GƆD de alayv ɛn in di Ilayja insɛf nɔ day yet, in nɔ go lɛf am. So dɛn ɔltu go na Jɔdan.
Wɛn dɛn rich nia di riva, fifti pan di prɔfɛt dɛn go tinap fawe lilibit de wach dɛn usay dɛn tinap nia Riva Jɔdan.
Ilayja tek di matirial we i wɛr rawnd in sholda, fol am ɛn nak di wata wit am. Di wata plit tu: af na lɛft, af na rayt, dɔn dɛn tu pas midul go na di ɔda say.
Wɛn dɛn rich oba say, Ilayja tɛl Ilaɛlsha se lɛ i aks am wetin in want am fɔ du fɔ am bifo i lɛf am. Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se in want dɔbul di spirit we i gɛt.
Nain Ilayja tɛl am se na at at tin i dɔn aks am fɔ so; bɔt if i si am, we i de go, i go gɛt am, if i nɔ si am i nɔ go gɛt am.
As dɛn de waka de tɔk de go, na de wantɛm wan karej we gɛt faya kam midul dɛn tu, dɔn Ilayja go ɔp na ɛvin wit big briz we de tɔn rawnd ɛn rawnd.
We Ilaɛlsha si di ɔs ɛn karej, i ala se “Mi Papa! Mi Papa! A si di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɔs ɛn karej.” Ilayja lɔs nain yay i nɔ si am igen Ilaɛlsha chɛr in klos tu.
I tek di matirial we fɔdɔm na Ilayja in an ɛn tɔn bak go na Riva Jɔdan.
I tek di matirial nak di wata ɛn se, “We PAPA GƆD, Ilayja in PAPA GƆD?” Wɛn i nak di wata i plit midul, af go lɛft, af go rayt; dɔn Ilaɛlsha krɔs go oba bak.
Di prɔfɛt dɛn we kɔmɔt Jɛriko bin de wach; wɛn dɛn si Ilaɛlsha, dɛn ɔl bigin tɔk se na Ilayja in spirit dɔn kam pan Ilaɛlsha; dɔn dɛn ɔl go mit am baw to am,

ɛn tɛl am se, na fifti pan dɛn de de, so lɛ i gi dɛn pamishɔn fɔ go fɛn in masta; dɛn se sɔntɛm na PAPA GƆD in spirit dɔn kech am kɛr am go pantap wan mawnten ɔ dɔn ib am na wan vali. Bɔt Ilaɛlsha se nɔ.
Bɔt dɛn mɔna am te i shem, so insɛf gri lɛ dɛn kɛri ɔn. Dɛn sɛn fifti man dɛn fɔ go fɛn Ilayja; dɛn tek tri de de luk fɔ am bɔt dɛn nɔ si am.
Ilaɛlsha bin de na Jɛriko ɛn wet dɛn te dɛn kam. Nain i tɛl dɛn se if i nɔ bin tɛl dɛn nɔ fɔ go.
Di man dɛn na Jɛriko tɛl Ilaɛlsha se di siti na fayn ples fɔ tap bɔt nɔmɔ di wata nɔ fayn ɛn dat mek natin nɔ de bɔs na di grɔn.
Ilaɛlsha tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn put sɔl insay nyu bol gi am. Dɛn put di sɔl na di bol ɛn gi am.
I go dɔŋ di watasay ɛn trowe di sɔl na di wata ɛn se, “Dis na wetin PAPA GƆD tɔk, a dɔn mek dis wata piɔ; no mɔ pɔsin nɔ go drink am ɛn day ɔ mek plant nɔ bɔs na di grɔn.”
Ɛn frɔm da de de di wata piɔ jɛs lɛkɛ aw Ilaɛlsha tɔk nɔmɔ.
Ilaɛlsha lɛf da siti de go na Bɛthɛl. As i de na rod de go, sɔm bɔbɔ dɛn we bin de na di siti bigin provok am se, “Bɔl ed! Bɔl ed! Go nɔ, go nɔ! Bɔl ed, bɔl ed! Go nɔ, go nɔ!”
Ilaɛlsha tɔn wach dɛn ɛn yuz PAPA GƆD in nem swɛ dɛn. Na de tu wayl animal kɔmɔt na bush kil fɔti-tu pan dɛn.
Ilaɛlsha kɔmɔt de go Mawnt Kamɛl, dɔn i tɔn bak go Sameria.
Di ia we mek Jɛoshafat etin ia we i bi kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Eab in bɔypikin we na Joram bi kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn na Sameria i bin bes. I rul fɔ twɛlv ia.
Insɛf du wetin nɔ rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay, bɔt nɔmɔ i nɔ bin rich in mama ɛn papa, bikɔs in brok di lay lay gɔd we nem Beal we in papa bin mek fɔ de wɔship.
Bɔt pan ɔl dat i kɔpi Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin in bad trik; na dis Jɛroboam bin mek di wanol Izrɛl kɔmit sin. Jɛoram nɔ tɔn in bak pan dɛn bad tin ya.
Kiŋ Misha na Moab na man we bin de mɛn ship, ɛn ɛvri tɛm i kin gɛt fɔ de sɔplay di kiŋ na Izrɛl wan ɔndrɛd tawzin yɔŋ ship ɛn wul we kɔmɔt pan wan ɔndrɛd tawzin man ship.
Bɔt wɛn Eab day, di kiŋ na Moab bigin barɔf pan di kiŋ na Izrɛl.
So Kiŋ Joram mach kɔmɔt na Sameria wit ɔl in trup na Izrɛl.

I sɛn mɛsej to Kiŋ Jɛoshafat na Juda se di kiŋ na Moab dɔn barɔf pan am, so lɛ i jɔyn am fɔ fɛt Moab. Jɛoshafat ansa am se in go go wit am, bikɔs in pipul nain yon pipul dɛn, ɛn in ɔs nain yon ɔs dɛn.
Kiŋ Jɛoshafat aks Kiŋ Joram us rod dɛn fɔ yuz fɔ atak. Joram ansa am se lɛ dɛn yuz di land we pɔsin nɔ de tap na Idɔm.
So di kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn di kiŋ na Juda go wit di kiŋ na Idɔm. Afta dɛn dɔn waka fɔ sɛvin de, wata dɔn na dɛn an; dɛn animal dɛnsɛf nɔ bin gɛt wata.
Na de di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl se, “Wɛl na de naw! Fɔ se PAPA GƆD go briŋ wi ɔl tri kam dɔn i jɛs an wi oba to Moab lɛk dat?”

Na de Jɛoshafat aks if nɔn PAPA GƆD in prɔfɛt nɔ de de we dɛn kin aks fɔ tɔk to PAPA GƆD. Wan pan di kiŋ na Izrɛl in ɔfisa dɛn ansa se Shafat in bɔypikin we na Ilaɛlsha de de, ɛn in na bin Ilayja in asistant.
Na de Jɛoshafat se ɛnitin we Ilaɛlsha tɔk na wetin PAPA GƆD se, so dɛn ɔl tri, dat na Jɛoshafat, di kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn di kiŋ na Moab go mit Ilaɛlsha.
Ilaɛlsha aks di kiŋ na Izrɛl us biznɛs dɛn gɛt we i de kam to am. I se lɛ i go to in mami ɛn dadi dɛn prɔfɛt. Bɔt di kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl se nɔ, i se na PAPA GƆD dɔn gɛda dɛn tri fɔ an dɛn oba to Moab.
Ilaɛlsha swɛ to PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we i de sav se na we nɔmɔ i bi se in gɛt rɛspɛkt fɔ Kiŋ Jɛoshafat na Juda, if nɔto so in nɔ bin fɔ maks am sɛf. I se lɛ dɛn fɛn wan myuzishian we sabi ple ap.
As di myuzishian bigin fɔ ple di ap so, nain PAPA GƆD in spirit kam pan Ilaɛlsha,
dɔn i bigin tɔk. I se, “Dis na PAPA GƆD de tɔk; una dig wɛl dɛn usay wata dɔn dray so.
PAPA GƆD se una nɔ go si briz una nɔ si ren, bɔt dɛn ol yaso go ful-ɔp wit wata, dɔn una kaw ɛn ɔda animal dɛn go gɛt wata fɔ drink.
Dis na izi tin fɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ du; i go mek una dil wit Moab.
Una go kapchɔ ɔl di siti dɛn we dɛn bil wɔl rawnd dɛn ɛn dɛn big siti dɛn. Una go kɔt ɔl dɛn gud tik ɛn mek ɔl dɛn wata tap fɔ flo, dɔn una go pak ston ston na ɔl dɛn planteshɔn.”
Wɛn do klin di nɛks de, as dɛn de rɛdi fɔ mek sakrifays so nain wata bɔs kɔmɔt na Idɔm te di wanol kɔntri ful-ɔp wit wata.
Wɛn di Moabayt dɛn yɛri se ɔda kiŋ dɛn dɔn ɛng-ed fɔ fɛt dɛn, ɔl di man dɛn we du fɔ fɛt wa frɔm smɔl to big gɛda dɛnsɛf ɛn tambay na di bawndri.
Dɛn grap ali mɔnin bɔt dɛn si se di san bin de shayn pan di wata we mek i rɛd, so dɛn fil se na blɔd.
Nain dɛn bigin de tɛl dɛn kɔmpin se na di kiŋ dɛn go dɔn dɛn fɛt dɛnsɛf ɛn kil dɛn kɔmpin we mek blɔd de ɔlsay na di ples. So lɛ ɔl di Moabayt dɛn dɔnawe wit di balans we lɛf.
Bɔt wɛn dɛn rich na di Izrɛlayt dɛn kamp, di Izrɛlayt atak dɛn te dɛn rɔnawe; di Izrɛlayt dɛn bigin fala dɛn de kil dɛn.

Dɛn kapchɔ ɔl di siti dɛn ɛn ful-ɔp ɔlsay wit ston. Dɛn blɔk blɔk ɔl dɛn wata we de flo ɛn kɔt kɔt ɔl di gud tik dɛn. Na Kir Arɛsɛth nɔmɔ bin lɛf we dɛn nɔ pwɛl, bɔt sɔm man dɛn we bin gɛt sliŋ atak de.
Wɛn di kiŋ na Moab si se in de lɔs di batul, i tek sɛvin ɔndrɛd man dɛn we sabi fɛt wit sɔd fɔ go fɛt Idɔm, bɔt dɛn nɔ ebul.
So i tek in big bɔypikin we fɔ tek in ples we i day ɛn bɔn am as sakrifays na di wɔl. Dat mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn fred ɛn tɔn bak go na dɛn kɔntri.

Wande, wan prɔfɛt in wɛf go kray to Ilaɛlsha fɔ lɛ i ɛp am. I tɛl am se in man dɔn day ɛn i no se na man we bin de rɛspɛkt ɛn ɔna PAPA GƆD, bɔt i bin o dɛt; i se di man we i o de kam fɔ kɛr in tu bɔypikin dɛn go fɔ go tɔn dɛn to slev.
Ilaɛlsha aks di uman wetin in want am fɔ du fɔ am; i aks am bak wetin i gɛt nain os. Di uman ansa am se in nɔ gɛt natin pas wan smɔl bɔtul ɔyl.
Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se lɛ i go lɛnt bɔku ɛmti kɔntena dɛn to in neba dɛn.
Dɔn lɛ i go insay in os wit in bɔypikin dɛn, lɔk di do, tek di ɔyl we i gɛt ɛn bigin tɔn am insay di kɔntena dɛn. Wɛn wan dɔn ful i fɔ put am na kɔna.
Di uman go fɛn di kɔntena dɛn ɛn lɔk insay in os wit in bɔypikin dɛn. As i de tɔn di ɔyl na so dɛn de briŋ mɔ kɔntena to am.
