Wɛn ɔl di kɔntena dɛn dɔn ful, i tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn go briŋ mɔ kam, bɔt dɛn se mɔ nɔ de. Na da tɛm de di ɔyl tap fɔ flo.
I go tɛl di prɔfɛt wetin apin, so i tɛl am se lɛ i go sɛl di ɔyl ɛn pe in dɛt, dɔn di balans mɔni, in ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn kin manej layf wit am.
Wande Ilaɛlsha go na Shunɛm. Wan jɛntri uman bin de de we kin de mɔna am ɔltɛm fɔ de it to am bifo i go in we. Ɛnitɛm we i de pas da say de, i kin de bɛn de fɔ it.
Di uman tɛl in man wande se in si se dis man we kin de pas frɔnt to dɛn na prɔfɛt,
so lɛ dɛn mek wan smɔl rum ɔp dɛn os fɔ am ɛn put bed, tebul, chia ɛn lamp, so dat ɛnitɛm we i bɛn to dɛn, i go de lidɔm de.
Wande wɛn Ilaɛlsha bɛn de, i go ɔp di rum go lidɔm,
dɔn i sɛn in wokman Gɛazi fɔ go kɔl di uman. Wɛn di uman kam i tinap bifo am;

i tɛl Gɛazi fɔ tɛl di uman se in si se i dɔn du bɔku tin fɔ dɛn, so lɛ i tɔk wetin i want. I se if na fɔ lɛ i tɔk to di kiŋ ɔ di ami kɔmanda, in go tɔk to dɛn fɔ am. Di uman ansa se nain yon pipul dɛn i de wit.
Ilaɛlsha aks wetin fɔ du fɔ am. Gɛazi ansa se di uman nɔ gɛt pikin ɛn in man dɔn ol.
Ilaɛlsha tɛl Gɛazi fɔ kɔl di uman, ɛn wɛn i kam i tinap na di domɔt.
Dɔn Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se da sem tɛm de di nɛks ia i go bɔn bɔypikin. Di uman ansa se lɛ di prɔfɛt nɔ lay to am.
Di uman gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn bɔypikin di sem tɛm we Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se i go bɔn am.
Wɛn di pikin dɔn big, i go fɛn in papa wande usay in ɛn in wokman dɛn bin de avɛst.
Wantɛm nain i kɔmplen to in papa se in ed, in ed. Na de in papa se lɛ dɛn kɛr am go to in mama.
Wan pan di wokman dɛn tot am kɛr am go to in mama. Di pikin sidɔm nain lap te aftanun, dɔn i day.
Di uman kɛr am go ɔp, le am na di prɔfɛt in bed, lɔk di do ɛn kɔmɔt de.
Dɔn i sɛn mɛsej to in man se lɛ i sɛn wan wokman wit dɔŋki fɔ am, in wan go ɛn kam kwik to di prɔfɛt.
Bɔt in man aks wetin mek i wan go to am da de de we nɔto di de fɔ pre ɛn blo ɛn nɔto di nyu mun ɔlide. Di uman ansa am se lɛ i nɔ wɔri bɔt dat.
So i jomp pantap di dɔŋki ɛn tɛl di wokman se lɛ i go wit spid lɛ i nɔ slo, pas if in tɛl am fɔ slo.
I go te i kech di prɔfɛt na Mawnt Kamɛl. Wɛn di prɔfɛt si am de kam,
i sɛn in wokman Gɛazi fɔ go mit am na rod ɛn aks am if ɔltin ɔlrayt wit in, in man ɛn in pikin. Di uman ansa am se ɔltin ɔlrayt.

Wɛn di uman rich ɔp di mawnten to di prɔfɛt, i ol di prɔfɛt in fut, bɔt Gɛazi tray fɔ push am, so Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se lɛ i lɛf am bikɔs i gɛt tin we de mɔna am. I se PAPA GƆD ayd di tin pan in we na prɔfɛt.
Di uman aks Ilaɛlsha if in bin aks am fɔ pikin ɛn if in nɔ bin dɔn tɛl am se lɛ i nɔ lay to am.
Ilaɛlsha tɛl Gɛazi se lɛ i rɛdi wantɛm fɔ go dɔŋ wit in wɔkinstik. I se if i mit ɛnibɔdi na rod, lɛ i nɔ tɛl am adu, ɛn if ɛnibɔdi tɛl am adu lɛ i nɔ ansa; lɛ i put in wɔkinstik pan di pikin in fes.
Na de di uman tɛl am se wans PAPA GƆD de alayv ɛn in di Ilaɛlsha insɛf de alayv, in nɔ go lɛf am; so Ilaɛlsha insɛf grap fala am go.
Na Gɛazi in fɔs rich ɛn put di tik pan di pikin in fes bɔt wan layf nɔ bin de pan am, so i tɔn bak go tɛl Ilaɛlsha se di pikin nɔ wek.
Wɛn Ilaɛlsha rich na di os, i mit di pikin lidɔm day wan nain bed;
so i go insay ɛn lɔk di do lɛ dɛn tu de insay ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD.
I klem pantap di bed ɛn lidɔm pan di bɔbɔ. I put in mɔt to di bɔbɔ in mɔt, in yay to in yay, ɛn in an dɛn pan in yon dɛn; ɛn as i bigin tret insɛf pan am so, di bɔbɔ in bɔdi bigin wam.
I grap pan am ɛn bigin waka ɔp ɛn dɔŋ insay di os, dɔn i klem pantap di bed ɛn tret insɛf bak pan am; di bɔbɔ sniz sɛvin tɛm dɔn i opin in yay.
Na de Ilaɛlsha tɛl Gɛazi fɔ kɔl di uman. Wɛn i kam insay,
i tɛl am se lɛ i tek in pikin. Di uman fɔdɔm nain fut ɛn butu na grɔn. Dɔn i tek in pikin ɛn kɔmɔt na do.
Ilaɛlsha go bak na Gilgal ɛn mit it biznɛs traŋa de. Wɛn i bin de ol mitin wit di ɔda prɔfɛt dɛn, i tɛl in asistant fɔ put di big pɔt na faya fɔ kuk styu fɔ dɛn fɔ it.
Wan pan di prɔfɛt dɛn go na gadin fɔ go fɛn vɛjitebul bɔt i pik sɔm frut we dɛn nɔ kin put na it, put nain pɔkit, kɛr am go, kɔt kɔt am ɛn put am na di pɔt; bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ no wetin i put de.
Di pɔt bwɛl ɛn wɛn i pul di it fɔ it, ɔlman it. As dɛn de it nain dɛn bigin ala Ilaɛlsha se di it gɛt pɔyzin.
So dɛn nɔ ebul it di it igen. Na de Ilaɛlsha tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn gi am sɔm wit flawa. I tek di flawa put am insay di pɔt, dɔn i se lɛ dɛn sheb di it. Dɛn du dat ɛn natin nɔ du di it igen
Wan man we kɔmɔt na Beal Shalisha kɛr twɛnti lof bred we dɛn bek wit kɔn flawa we dɛn jɛs avɛst wit frɛsh kɔn to Ilaɛlsha. Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se lɛ i gi di pipul dɛn lɛ dɛn it.

Ilaɛlsha in wokman aks am aw fɔ sheb di it to wan ɔndrɛd mɔtalman. Bɔt Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se lɛ i jɛs gi di pipul dɛn nɔmɔ lɛ dɛn it, bikɔs PAPA GƆD se dɛn go it ɛn wɛrɛ go lɛf. Di wokman insɛf sheb di it.
Ɔlman it ɛn wɛrɛ lɛf jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD se.

Wan man we nem Neman na bin di ami kɔmanda fɔ di kiŋ na Siria. Neman na bin impɔtant man to in masta, ɛn in masta bin lɛk am bikɔs nain mek PAPA GƆD bin de lɛ dɛn win wa. Neman na bin gud sojaman, bɔt i bin gɛt bad sik nain bɔdi.
Wan tɛm we di Sirian dɛn bin go red Izrɛl, dɛn bin kech wan titi ɛn kɛr am go fɔ go wok fɔ Neman in wɛf.
Wande di titi tɛl in misis se if nɔmɔ in masta go go to di prɔfɛt na Sameria, i go mɛn ɔl di bad sik nain bɔdi.
Neman insɛf go tɛl di kiŋ wetin dis titi we kɔmɔt Izrɛl se.
Di kiŋ gi am pamishɔn fɔ go ɛn gi am lɛta fɔ di kiŋ na Izrɛl. Neman ol rod fɔ go ɛn i kɛr bɔt sɔm tri ɔndrɛd ɛn fɔti kilo silva, sɛvinti kilo gold ɛn tɛn sɛt fayn klos.
I kɛr di lɛta to di kiŋ na Izrɛl. Dis na wetin bin rayt na di lɛta: “Wɛn yu gɛt dis lɛta, yu fɔ no se na mi sɛn mi wokman Neman to yu fɔ lɛ yu mɛn am. I gɛt bad sik nain bɔdi.”

Wɛn di kiŋ na Izrɛl rid di lɛta, i chɛr in klos ɛn se if in na PAPA GƆD we de kil ɛn gi layf bak we mek dis man de sɛn to am se in fɔ mɛn bad sik na bɔdi; I se na we nɔmɔ di man de fɛn fɔ mek plaba wit am.
Wɛn Prɔfɛt Ilaɛlsha yɛri se di kiŋ na Izrɛl chɛr in klos, i sɛn go aks am wetin mek i du dat; i se mek i sɛn di man go mit am fɔ lɛ i go no se prɔfɛt de na Izrɛl fɔ tru, tru.
Neman go wit in ɔs ɛn karej na Ilaɛlsha in os ɛn brek;
Ilaɛlsha sɛn mɛsej to am se lɛ i go was na Riva Jɔdan sɛvin tɛm, dɔn i go wɛl.
Bɔt Neman vɛks ɛn tɔn bak go se in bin fil se di prɔfɛt go kɔmɔt na do kam mit am, tinap bifo am ɛn kɔl in Gɔd we na PAPA GƆD in nem, dɔn i paspas in an na di say we di sik de, dɔn i wɛl.
I se if Riva Abana ɛn Riva Fapa na Damaskɔs nɔ bɛtɛ pas dɛn riva dɛn na Izrɛl we in bin fɔ dɔn was de ɛn wɛl. I tɔn go bak wit vɛksteshɔn.
Bɔt in wokman dɛn koks am se if di prɔfɛt bin tɛl am fɔ du big tin, i bin fɔ du am; so naw we i tɛl am fɔ go was fɔ lɛ i wɛl, lɛ i du am.
So Neman insɛf go dɔŋ na Riva Jɔdan ɛn ib insɛf sɛvin tɛm lɛkɛ aw di prɔfɛt tɛl am fɔ du; nain i wɛl; in bɔdi smut so lɛkɛ dɛn smɔl pikin.
Neman ɛn ɔl in trup tɔn bak go mit di prɔfɛt ɛn tɛl am se na naw in no se PAPA GƆD nɔ de nɔn we na di wɔl pas Izrɛl, so in de beg am lɛ i tek di prɛzɛnt we i briŋ fɔ am.
Bɔt Ilaɛlsha ansa am se wans PAPA GƆD we in de sav de alayv, in nɔ go tek natin nain an. Neman beg am lɛ i tek sɔntin bɔt i nɔ gri.
Na de Neman tɛl am se if i nɔ de gri, in de beg lɛ i gi am sɔm di dɔti na di grɔn we tu pan in myul dɛn go tot, so dat in nɔ go de mek sakrifays to ɛni ɔda PAPA GƆD bɔt to PAPA GƆD.

I se in de aks PAPA GƆD fɔ fɔgiv am fɔ wan patikla tin; dat na, wɛn in yon kiŋ we in de sav go na Rimɔn in os fɔ go wɔship in gɔd, dɔn i liŋ nain an fɔ lɛ i baw wit am, wɛn in baw to Rimɔn, lɛ PAPA GƆD fɔgiv am fɔ dat.
Ilaɛlsha se oke, lɛ i go saful. Bɔt wɛn Neman dɔn go fawe lilibit,

Ilaɛlsha in wokman Gɛazi tɔk nain at se in masta nɔ no wetin i de pan na dat lɛ i lɛf Neman da Sirian man ɛn nɔ tek wetin di man briŋ. I swɛ to PAPA GƆD se in de go mit am na rod ɛn pul sɔntin nain an.
So i bigin fala Neman. Wɛn Neman tɔn biɛn ɛn si se sɔmbɔdi de fala am, i kam dɔŋ di karej go mit am ɛn aks am if ɔltin ɔlrayt.
I ansa am se ɔltin ɔlrayt bɔt nɔmɔ in masta sɛn am to am fɔ tɛl am se in gɛt tu trenja prɔfɛt dɛn we kɔmɔt Ifrem kam fɛn am, so lɛ i sɛn tati-fo kilo silva ɛn tu sɛt klos fɔ dɛn.
Neman tɛl am se lɛ i tek siksti-et kilo silva. I gi am di silva insay tu bag ɛn di tu klos. I tɛl tu pan in wokman dɛn fɔ tot di tiŋs dɛn ɛn waka bifo Gɛazi.
Wɛn dɛn rich ɔp di il, i tek di lod na dɛn an ɛn put dɛn insay di os, dɔn i mek di man dɛn go.
As i go insay di os so i si Ilaɛlsha, na de Ilaɛlsha aks am usay i kɔmɔt; i ansa am se in nɔ go nɔn say.

Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se if i nɔ bin no se in spirit bin de fala am te di man kam dɔŋ in karej go mit am; i aks am se if dat na bin di tɛm fɔ tek mɔni, klos, ɔliv gadin ɛn vayn gadin, ship, kaw, wokman ɛn wokuman dɛn;
Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se fɔ wetin i dɔn du, Neman in bad sik nain bɔdi go transfa pan in ɛn in jɛnareshɔn dɛn sote go. Frɔm da momɛnt de nain di sik kam pan Gɛazi, in bɔdi ɔl kam chenj ɛn wayt lɛk shatin.
Di prɔfɛt dɛn tɛl Ilaɛlsha se di ples we dɛn tap we na de i de mit wit dɛn tu smɔl fɔ dɛn,
so dɛn want fɔ go kɔt tik dɔŋ Riva Jɔdan we dɛn go tek mek abule. I ansa dɛn se lɛ dɛn go.
Wan pan dɛn aks am se lɛ i go wit dɛn so i gri,
ɛn go wit dɛn. Wɛn dɛn rich dɔŋ Riva Jɔdan, dɛn bigin fɔ kɔt di tik.
Bɔt as wan pan dɛn de kɔt wan big tik, in aks fɔdɔm na di wata dɔn i bigin ala se “Masta, Masta, na lɛnt a lɛnt am!”
Ilaɛlsha aks am usay di aks fɔdɔm; wɛn i sho am di ples, i kɔt tik ib am de pantap di wata: wantɛm nain di aks flot kam ɔp.
Ilaɛlsha tɛl am lɛ i tek am, so insɛf tret in an na di wata ɛn tek am.
Wan tɛm di kiŋ na Siria bin de go fɛt wa wit di kiŋ na Izrɛl. Ɛn di kiŋ ɛng-ed wit in man dɛn se na soso ples in go bil in kamp.
Di prɔfɛt insɛf kin sɛn wɔnin to di kiŋ na Izrɛl se lɛ i kiaful, lɛ i nɔ pas dis rod ɔ da rod de bikɔs di Sirian dɛn de de.
Di kiŋ na Izrɛl insɛf kin sɛn go chɛk wit wetin di prɔfɛt se. Na so di prɔfɛt kin de du we i kin sev di kiŋ in layf bɔku tɛm.
Di kiŋ na Siria kam wɔri bikɔs ɔf wetin kin de apin, so i aks in wokman dɛn lɛ dɛn sho am uswan pan dɛn de fɔ di kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Wan pan dɛn ansa am se nɔn pan dɛn nɔ de fɔ am; i se na Prɔfɛt Ilaɛlsha we de na Izrɛl de tɛl di kiŋ na Izrɛl ɔl wetin in de tɔk insay in rum.
Di kiŋ sɛn in man dɛn se lɛ dɛn go fɛnɔt usay Ilaɛlsha de fɔ lɛ i go kech am. Dɛn go fɛnɔt ɛn ripɔt bak to am se Ilaɛlsha de na Dotan.
Di kiŋ sɛn bɔku bɔku sojaman dɛn wit ɔs ɛn karej: dɛn sɔrawnd di siti na nɛt.
Wɛn Ilaɛlsha in wokman grap ali mɔnin go na do, na bɔku bɔku sojaman dɛn i si se dɔn sɔrawnd di siti; so i aks in masta se wetin dɛn fɔ du.
Na de Ilaɛlsha ansa am se lɛ i nɔ fred bikɔs di wan dɛn we de wit am bɔku pas di wan dɛn we de wit dɛn.
So Ilaɛlsha pre se, “E PAPA GƆD, duya opin in yay lɛ i si.” PAPA GƆD opin di man in yay fɔ lɛ i si, ɛn wetin i si na soso ɔs ɛn karej dɛn wit faya rawnd di mawnten pan Ilaɛlsha.
Wɛn di Sirian dɛn kam fɔ Ilaɛlsha, i pre to PAPA GƆD fɔ mek dɛn blɛn. PAPA GƆD ansa Ilaɛlsha in prea ɛn mek dɛn ɔl blɛn.
Ilaɛlsha tɛl dɛn se nɔto di rod da wande ɛn nɔto di siti sɛf da wande we dɛn de fɛn; i tɛl dɛn fɔ fala am go to di man we dɛn de fɛn. I kɛr dɛn go rayt insay Sameria.
As dɛn rich insay Sameria so Ilaɛlsha pre to PAPA GƆD fɔ opin dɛn yay. PAPA GƆD opin dɛn yay fɔ si; na da tɛm de dɛn si se nainsay, insay Sameria dɛn de.
Wɛn di kiŋ na Izrɛl si dɛn, i aks Ilaɛlsha if lɛ in kil, kil dɛn.
Ilaɛlsha se nɔ ɛn aks am if i go lɛk fɔ kil pɔsin we in dɔn kapchɔ wit in sɔd ɛn bo. I se lɛ i gi dɛn it ɛn wata, dɔn lɛ i lɛf dɛn lɛ dɛn go bak to dɛn masta.
Di kiŋ insɛf mek big pati fɔ dɛn; wɛn dɛn dɔn it ɛn drink dɔn, i mek dɛn go bak to dɛn masta. Frɔm da de de, di Sirian dɛn nɔ ɛva go bak fɔ go mɔna Izrɛl.
Sɔm tɛm afta dat, Kiŋ Bɛnadad na Siria gɛda in sojaman dɛn ɛn sɔrawnd Sameria.
Da tɛm de, bad bad aŋri bin de na Sameria. Di aŋri bin so mɔna dat dɛn bin de sɛl wan dɔŋki ed eti silva kɔpɔ ɛn smɔl vɛjitebul fayv silva kɔpɔ.
Wande di kiŋ na Izrɛl bin de waka pantap di wɔl na di siti we i yɛri wan uman de ala se, “Woyo! Kiŋ, duya ɛp mi!”
Nain di kiŋ ansa am se if PAPA GƆD nɔ ebul ɛp am aw in go ebul, ɛn if in tink se in gɛt wit ɔ wayn.
I aks am wetin nain prɔblɛm. Di uman ansa am se di ɔda uman we tinap nia am tɛl am se lɛ dɛn it in yon pikin, dɔn di nɛks de nain yon dɛn go it.
I se in gri ɛn kil in yon pikin dɔn dɛn it am; wɛn di ɔda uman in yon tɔn rich fɔ it insɛf yon pikin, i ayd am.
Wɛn di kiŋ yɛri dat i chɛr in klos. Da tɛm de di kiŋ bin stil de waka pantap di wɔl, ɛn ɛnibɔdi we bin de pas we luk am bin de si se na saklɔth i wɛr ɔnda in klos.
So i swɛ se lɛ PAPA GƆD kil am if in nɔ kɔt Shafat in bɔypikin we na Ilaɛlsha in ed kɔmɔt da de de.

Da tɛm de Ilaɛlsha bin gɛt sɔm bigman dɛn we bin de wit am nain os. Di kiŋ sɛn mɛsenja go bifo am, bɔt bifo di mɛsenja de rich, Ilaɛlsha dɔn tɛl di man dɛn se da kilman dɔn sɛn sɔmbɔdi fɔ kam kɔt in ed. I tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn de luk fɔ am; ɛn wɛn i kam lɛ dɛn lɔk di do pan am. I se infakt in masta de biɛn am fut-to-fut.
Ilaɛlsha nɔ tɔk dɔn nain di mɛsenja rich de. Di kiŋ tɛl Ilaɛlsha se di dombolo we dɔn mit dɛn so na PAPA GƆD sɛn am, so nid nɔ de fɔ wet igen
Bɔt Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se lɛ i opin in yes lisin to wetin PAPA GƆD se. I se papa GƆD se da sem awa de di nɛks de, dɛn go sɛl tɛn pawns wit ɔ twɛnti pawns bali fɔ wan silva kɔpɔ na di gɛt na Sameria.
Na de di kiŋ in pasɔnal asistant tɛl di prɔfɛt se i lɛk sɛf PAPA GƆD opin ɛvin lɛ ren kam, dat nɔ go bi. Ilaɛlsha ansa am se i go si am so wit in yay bɔt in mɔt nɔ go tes am.
Fo man dɛn bin de na di get na Sameria. Dɛn ɔl bin gɛt bad sik na dɛn bɔdi. Dɛn bigin de aks dɛnsɛf se wetin mek dɛn fɔ de na da ples de te dɛn day.

Dɛn se if dɛn disayd fɔ go bak na di siti, aŋri de de ɛn na de dɛn go day; igen if dɛn disayd fɔ de na di sem ples, dɛn go day de igen So dɛn advays dɛnsɛf se lɛ dɛn go na di Sirian dɛn kamp. Dɛn se if di Sirian dɛn sɔri fɔ dɛn dɛn go liv, bɔt if dɛn kil dɛn igen, lɛ dɛn day wantɛm.
So ivintɛm dɛn go na di Sirian dɛn kamp. Wɛn dɛn rich na di kamp domɔt, dɛn nɔ si nɔbɔdi,

bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin dɔn mek di Sirian sojaman dɛn yɛri sawnd lɛkɛ ɔs ɛn karej wit bɔku bɔku sojaman dɛn de waka we mek dɛn tɛl dɛn kɔmpin se di kiŋ na Izrɛl dɔn go aya dɛn Itayt ɛn dɛn Ijipshian masinari fɔ atak dɛn.
Dɛn ɔl rɔnawe di nɛt lɛf dɛn tɛnt, dɛn ɔs ɛn dɔŋki ɛn lɛf di kamp lɛkɛ aw i bin de; ɔlman rɔn fɔ in layf.
Wɛn dɛn man dɛn yaso rich na di kamp domɔt, dɛn go insay wan tɛnt, dɛn it ɛn drink, dɛn tek silva, gold ɛn klos go ayd dɛn; dɔn, dɛn go insay ɔda tɛnt, ɛn tek tiŋs dɛn de go ayd bak.
Na de dɛn bigin advays dɛnsɛf se wetin dɛn de du nɔ fayn bikɔs da de de na de we dɛn gɛt gudnyuz, dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ sɛt mɔt wet te mɔnin ɔ nɔ so dɛn go sɔfa fɔ dat, so lɛ dɛn go tɛl di kiŋ.

Dɛn go mit di getman dɛn na di siti ɛn tɛl dɛn se dɛn go na di Sirian dɛn kamp bɔt dɛn nɔ mit nɔbɔdi de; dɛn se di wangren tin we dɛn mit na di ɔs ɛn dɔŋki dɛn we tay, dɔn di tɛnt dɛn de as di pipul dɛn lɛf dɛn.
Di getman dɛn sɛn di nyuz go ɔlɔbɔt te di wɔd rich to di kiŋ.

Di kiŋ grap na nɛt ɛn kɔl in wokman dɛn; i tɛl dɛn se in wan tɛl dɛn wetin di Sirian dɛn dɔn du. I se di Sirian dɛn no se aŋri de na Izrɛl, so dɛn go ayd na bush de wet se we dɛn kɔmɔt, dɛn go kech dɛn ɛn atak di siti.
Wan pan di ɔfisa dɛn tɛl di kiŋ se lɛ i sɛn sɔm man dɛn wit fayv pan di ɔs dɛn we lɛf na di siti. I se if ɛnitin apin to dɛn, na dɛn ɔl go fil am. I se dɛn man dɛn de fɔ go fɛnɔt wetin apin.
So dɛn pik tu man wit ɔs ɛn karej. Di kiŋ sɛn dɛn fɔ go fɛnɔt wetin dɔn apin to di Sirian dɛn.
Di man dɛn go te rich Riva Jɔdan; wetin dɛn fɛn na soso klos ɛn tin dɛn na grɔn we di Sirian dɛn ib we dɛn bin de rɔnawe. Dɛn tɔn bak go tɛl di kiŋ wetin dɛn si.
Ɔl di pipul dɛn tɔn naw go na di Sirian dɛn kamp; dɛn tek ɔl wetin dɛn mit de. Dɛn sɛl tɛn pawns wit ɔ twɛnti pawns bali fɔ wan silva kɔpɔ jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin se.
Di kiŋ bin dɔn pik in pasɔnal asistant fɔ de inchaj ɔf di get; bɔt di pipul dɛn bin so bɔku dat dɛn mas mas am te i day lɛk aw di prɔfɛt bin tɛl am we i go mit am.
We di prɔfɛt bin tɛl di kiŋ se dɛn go sɛl tɛn pawns wit ɔ twɛnti pawns bali fɔ wan silva kɔpɔ na di gɛt na Sameria di nɛks de,
na dis vɛri pasɔnal asistant bin dinay se i lɛk sɛf PAPA GƆD opin ɛvin lɛ ren kam, dat nɔ go bi. Ɛn di prɔfɛt bin ansa am se i go si am so wit in yay, bɔt in mɔt nɔ go tes am.
Lɛk aw di prɔfɛt tɔk na so i bi; di pipul dɛn mas mas am na di get te i day.
Wande, Ilaɛlsha tɛl da uman we i bin mek in bɔypikin gɛt layf bak se lɛ in ɛn in famili lɛf dɛn os ɛn go ɛnisay we dɛn fil fɔ go; bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn se it nɔ go de fɔ it fɔ sɛvin ia.
Di uman insɛf du wetin di prɔfɛt se. In ɛn ɔlman nain os go tap na dɛn Filistin dɛn kɔntri fɔ sɛvin ia.
We di sɛvin ia dɔn, i tɔn bak nain kɔntri ɛn go mit di kiŋ ɛn beg am se lɛ i gi am bak in os ɛn in land bak.
Da tɛm de di kiŋ bin de tɔk wit Gɛazi we na Ilaɛlsha in asistant, ɛn i bin de aks am fɔ tɛl am ɔl di wɔndaful tin dɛn we Ilaɛlsha dɔn du.

Gɛazi bin de ɛksplen to am naw aw Ilaɛlsha mek dayman wek; i nɔ tɔk dɔn nain di uman we nain bɔypikin Ilaɛlsha bin wek bɔs pan dɛn ɛn beg di kiŋ fɔ gi am in os ɛn land bak. Na de Gɛazi tɛl di kiŋ se na di uman dat we Ilaɛlsha bin wek in pikin we day.
Di kiŋ aks di uman if na so i bi, i ansa se yɛs. So i gi wan in ɔfisa ɔda se i fɔ mek shɔ se di uman gɛt ɔl wetin blant am wit wetin dɛn avɛst nain fam.
Ilaɛlsha go na Damaskɔs wande, ɛn da tɛm de Kiŋ Bɛnadad na Damaskɔs bin sik. Wɛn dɛn tɛl di kiŋ se di prɔfɛt dɔn kam ɔl da we de,
i tɛl Azaɛl lɛ i kɛr sɔm prɛzɛnt fɔ am ɛn aks am lɛ i fɛnɔt fɔ am frɔm PAPA GƆD if i go wɛl.

Azaɛl insɛf kɛr bɔku bɔku tiŋs go fɔ Ilaɛlsha. I lod fɔti kamɛl wit fayn fayn tiŋs dɛn we de na Damaskɔs. Wɛn i rich to Ilaɛlsha, i tɛl am se nain bɔypikin Bɛnadad na Damaskɔs sɛn am to am fɔ aks am if i go wɛl.
Ilaɛlsha ansa am se lɛ i go tɛl am se i go wɛl; bɔt PAPA GƆD dɔn sho am se i go day.
Ilaɛlsha luk am nain yay te i shem, dɔn i bigin kray.

Na de Azaɛl aks am wetin mek i de kray. Ilaɛlsha ansa am se in no di avɔk we in di Azaɛl gɛt fɔ kɔz na Izrɛl. I se i gɛt fɔ bɔn ɔl dɛn siti we dɛn dɔn mek, ɛn kil di yɔŋ man dɛn, ɛn nyakanyaka dɛn pikin ɛn plit bɛlɛ uman dɛn bɛlɛ.
Azaɛl tɛl am se in nɔto nɔbɔdi na di ples, so aw wetin dat go bi. Ilaɛlsha ansa am se PAPA GƆD dɔn sho am se nain gɛt fɔ bi kiŋ na Damaskɔs.
Azaɛl tɔn bak go to in masta. Wɛn Bɛnadad aks am wetin Ilaɛlsha se, Azaɛl tɛl am se i se i go wɛl.
Bɔt di nɛks de Azaɛl tek di blankit sok am na wata, dɔn i kɔba di kiŋ in ed wit am ɛn sɔfɔket am te i day dɔn i tek in ples fɔ rul as kiŋ.
Di ia we mek Joram we na, Eab in bɔypikin fayv ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da ia de Jɛoram, we na Jɛoshafat in bɔypikin bi kiŋ na Juda.
I ol tati-tu ia we i bi kiŋ ɛn i rul fɔ et ia na Jerusɛlɛm.
Lɛkɛ aw nɔmɔ di ɔda kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl bin de biev, na so insɛf biev. I falamakata Eab in famili dɛn bad ɛgzampul ɛn mared in gyal pikin. I du ɔlkayn bad tin na PAPA GƆD in yay.
Pan ɔl dat, PAPA GƆD nɔ pwɛl Juda bikɔs i bin dɔn prɔmis Devid se in go mek in jɛnareshɔn de rul sote go.
Wɛn Jɛoram bin de rul, Idɔm barɔf pan Juda ɛn fɛn dɛn yon kiŋ.
Jɛoram insɛf gɛda in karej dɛn go na Zair, bɔt di Idɔmayt dɛn sɔrawnd in kɔmanda dɛn; Jɛoram bin fɛt te i fri insɛf ɛn rɔnawe na nɛt. Ɔl in sojaman dɛn rɔnawe.
Frɔm da tɛm de nain Idɔm kɔmɔt ɔnda Juda. Libnainsɛf barɔf di sem we ɛn kɔmɔt ɔnda Juda.
Ɔl di ɔda tin dɛn we Jɛoram du, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Juda.
Jɛoram day ɛn dɛn bɛr am usay dɛn bɛr in fɔstɛm grampapa dɛn na Devid in siti. Nain bɔypikin Aazaya bigin rul as kiŋ nain ples.
Di ia we mek Joram we na Eab in bɔypikin twɛlv ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da ia de Aazaya we na Jɛoram in bɔypikin bi kiŋ na Juda.
Aazaya bin ol twɛnti-tu ia we i bigin rul, ɛn na wan ia nɔmɔ i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ. In mama nem Athalaya, we na Kiŋ Omri we bin de na Izrɛl in grampikin.
Aazaya insɛf biev lɛkɛ aw Eab in jɛnareshɔn dɛn biev ɛn du wetin nɔ rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay. Na wan pan Eab in fambul i bin mared.
Aazaya jɔyn an wit Joram we na Eab in bɔypikin fɔ fɛt wa wit Azaɛl we na Kiŋ na Siria na Ramɔt Giliad. Di Sirian dɛn wund Joram;
dat mek i go na Jɛzril fɔ go mɛn di wund we dɛn wund am we i bin de fɛt di Sirian dɛn na Ramɔt Giliad. Kiŋ Aazaya we na Jɛoram in bɔypikin go fɛn Joram we i wund.
Ilaɛlsha kɔl wan pan di prɔfɛt dɛn ɛn tɛl am se lɛ i rɛdi fɔ go Ramɔt Giliad. I se lɛ i tek di flaks ɔyl,
ɛn wɛn i rich de lɛ i luk fɔ Jeu we na Jɛoshafat in bɔypikin ɛn na Nimshi in grampikin; dɔn lɛ i kɔl Jeu in wangren go na wan biɛn rum,
tɔn di ɔyl nain ed ɛn tɛl am se PAPA GƆD se in dɔn pik am fɔ bi kiŋ na Izrɛl. I se wɛn i dɔn dɔn, lɛ i opin di do ɛn rɔn go; lɛ i mekes.
Dis yɔŋ prɔfɛt insɛf go na Ramɔt Giliad.
I mit ɔl di ami ɔfisa dɛn sidɔm na wan ples, nain i se in gɛt mɛsej fɔ di kɔmanda. Jeu aks am se fɔ uswan, i ansa am se nain di Jeu.
So insɛf grap go wit am insay di os. Di prɔfɛt tɔn di ɔyl nain ed ɛn tɛl am se PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD fɔ Izrɛl se in dɔn pik am fɔ bi kiŋ fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn we nain pipul.
I se Jeu fɔ kil ɔl udat de nain masta Eab in os fɔ we Jɛzibɛl kil dɛn prɔfɛt dɛn ɛn PAPA GƆD in ɔda savant dɛn.
I se in go dɔnawe wit ɔlman na Eab in os; di las bɔypikin dɛn o, slev o, fribɔn o, ɛn ɛniwan na Izrɛl.
Dɔn in go mek Eab in os tan lɛkɛ Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin in yon; dɔn lɛkɛ Baasha we na Aayja in bɔypikin sɛf yon.
I se dɔg dɛn go it Jɛzibɛl in dedebɔdi na Jɛzril ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go bɛr am. Wɛn di prɔfɛt dɔn tɔk dɔn, i opin di do ɛn rɔn go.
Wɛn Jeu go na do go mit in kɔmpin ɔfisa dɛn, dɛn aks am if ɔltin ɔrayt ɛn wetin mek da kresman de kam si am. I jɛs ansa dɛn se dɛn no di man ɛn di kanaba tin we i kin tɔk.
Dɛn mɔna am se nɔto tru i de tɔk, so lɛ i tɛl dɛn di tru, so insɛf tɔk. I se di prɔfɛt se PAPA GƆD dɔn pik am fɔ bi kiŋ na Izrɛl.
As i se so ɔlman pul in jakɛt put am na di ɛmti stɛp fɔ lɛ i waka pan am, dɔn dɛn blo trɔmpɛt ɛn ala se Jeu na kiŋ.
Jeu we na Jɛoshafat in bɔypikin mek ku pan Joram. Jɛoshafat na Nimshi in bɔypikin. Joram ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin de gyad Ramɔt Giliad agens Azaɛl we na kiŋ na Siria;

bɔt Kiŋ Joram in bin de Jɛzril usay i bin de mɛn di wund we i bin gɛt na Siria we i bin de fɛt kiŋ Azaɛl. Joram tɛl di man dɛn we bin de wit am se if dɛn no se dɛn de wit am nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ lɛf Ramɔt go na Jɛzril go tɛl di pipul dɛn ɛnitin.
Jeu tek in karej go Jɛzril bikɔs Joram bin de de. Kiŋ Aazaya na Juda sɛf bin go fɛn am de.

Di wachman na Jɛzril bin de pantap di tawa de wach, wɛn i si Jeu ɛn in bataliɔn de kam. So insɛf tɛl Joram se in si pipul dɛn de kam. Joram tɛl am se lɛ i sɛn wan man wit ɔs fɔ go aks am aw i kam, if na pis i kam fɔ.

So wan man go wit ɔs go mit Jeu na rod ɛn tɛl am se di kiŋ se fɔ go aks am aw i kam, ɛn if na pis i kam fɔ. Jeu aks am se uskayn pis dat; i tɛl am lɛ i de rayd biɛn am. Di wachman tɔn bak go tɛl Joram se di man we i sɛn go bɔt i nɔ tɔn bak.
So Joram sɛn ɔda man wit ɔs. We di sɛkɛn wan go, insɛf go tɛl Jeu se di kiŋ se fɔ aks am aw i kam, ɛn if na pis i kam fɔ. Jeu ansa insɛf se uskayn pis dat. Lɛ i de rayd biɛn am.
Di wachman go tɛl Joram bak se di sɛkɛn wan insɛf nɔ kam. I tɛl am se di pɔsin de drayv lɛk Jeu we na Nimshi in bɔypikin, bikɔs i de drayv lɛkɛ kresman.
Joram tɛl am se lɛ i rɛdi in karej. Wɛn i dɔn rɛdi am i jomp insay, dɔn Aazaya jomp nainsɛf yon, dɛn ɔltu ol rod fɔ go mit Jeu. Dɛn go mitɔp na Nebɔth da Jɛzrilayt in land.
Wɛn Joram si Jeu i aks am aw i si am so, if na pis i kam fɔ. Jeu ansa am se uskayn pis we na soso wich ɛn lay lay gɔd wɔship in mama Jɛzibɛl de pan.
Na de Joram pik spid ɛn de ala se, “Dis na ku, dis na ku! E Aazaya!”
Jeu tek in bo ɛn shut Joram nain chɛst wit ɔl in trɛnk. Di bo bɔs in at dɔn i fɔdɔm insay in karej.
Na de i tɛl in drayva Bidka se lɛ i tek in dedebɔdi ib am na Nebɔth da Jɛzrilayt in grɔn; i aks am if i mɛmba di tɛm we dɛn tu bin de biɛn Joram in Papa we na Eab we PAPA GƆD bin se,
wans in si Nebɔth ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn blɔd da de de, na so in papa go mek Eab pe fɔ dat na di vɛri grɔn. I tɛl Baka fɔ tek Joram in dedebɔdi ib am na di grɔn de bikɔs na so PAPA GƆD bin se.

Wɛn Kiŋ Aazaya na Juda si wetin apin, i rɔn fɔ go na Bɛth Agan bɔt Jeu rɔn biɛn am de ala se lɛ dɛn shut am; dɛn shut am nain karej we i de na rod de go ɔp na Gur nia Iblim, bɔt i manej rɔn go na Mɛgido ɛn go day de.
In wokman dɛn tek in dedebɔdi, put am na karej ɛn kɛr am go Jerusɛlɛm go bɛr am nain grampapa dɛn grev na Devid in siti.
Di ia we mek Joram we na Eab in bɔypikin ilɛvin ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da ia de Aazaya bi kiŋ na Juda.
Jeu go na Jɛzril. Wɛn Jɛzibɛl yɛri se Jeu de de, i mekɔp in fes ɛn mek in ia fayn wan, dɔn i sidɔm de luk winda.
As Jeu bɔs na di get fɔ go insay di siti Jɛzibɛl aks am se in we dɔn kil in masta, aw in si am so, if na pis i kam bak fɔ.
Jeu es in yay luk ɔp di winda ɛn ala se “Udat dɛn de fɔ mi, na udat dɛn?” Sɔm man dɛn we bin de wok na di uman dɛn kwata na di kiŋ in os luk oba winda, ɛn Jeu si dɛn;
so i tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn fliŋ Jɛzibɛl oba di winda. Dɛnsɛf fliŋ am oba di winda. We i fɔdɔm in blɔd ɔl skata na di wɔl ɛn pan di ɔs dɛn we dɛn bin de mas mas am.
Jeu go insay di os ɛn it ɛn drink. Afta dat i tɛl in man dɛn se lɛ dɛn go tek di swɛ uman in dedebɔdi go bɛr am bikɔs na kiŋ pikin,
bɔt wɛn di man dɛn go fɔ go tek in bɔdi, nain skɔl, in fut ɛn in an, nɔmɔ dɛn mit de,
so dɛn go bak go tɛl Jeu, nain i se na wetin PAPA GƆD bin tɛl Ilayja da Tishbayt nain bi we i se na dɔg dɛn go it Jɛzibɛl in dedebɔdi na Jɛzril;
ɛn in bɔdi go tan lɛk dɔti na grɔn we nɔbɔdi nɔ go no se na Jɛzibɛl in bɔdi dat.
Eab bin gɛt sɛvinti bɔypikin dɛn na Sameria. Jeu rayt lɛta sɛn am go na Sameria: i rayt to in ɔfisa dɛn na Jɛzril, di bigman dɛn ɛn di man dɛn we de tek kia ɔf Eab in pikin dɛn.
I rayt se as dɛn gɛt in lɛta so, sins dɛn masta in bɔypikin dɛn de wit dɛn ɛn dɛn gɛt ɔs ɛn karej dɛn, ɛn di siti gɛt gud sikyɔriti ɛn dɛn gɛt wɛpɔn,
lɛ dɛn pik di bɔypikin we soba pas ɔl ɛn put am nain papa in chia, dɔn lɛ dɛn fɛt ɛnibɔdi we go se nɔ.
Bɔt di man dɛn fred ɛn advays dɛnsɛf se if tu kiŋ dɛn nɔ ebul fɛt Jeu udat na dɛn we go ebul fɛt am.

So di man we bin de inchaj ɔf di kiŋ in os, di gɔvna dɛn, di bigman dɛn ɛn ɔl di ɔda agbagba dɛn sɛn mɛsej to Jeu se dɛn nain bɔbɔ dɛn, ɛn dɛn rɛdi fɔ du ɛnitin we i se; bɔt dɛn nɔ go mek nɔbɔdi kiŋ, so lɛ in du wetin i want.

So Jeu rayt ɔda lɛta bak to dɛn se if dɛn no se dɛn de nain say, ɛn dɛn rɛdi fɔ du wetin i se, lɛ dɛn kɔt dɛn masta in bɔypikin dɛn ed, ɛn kɛr dɛn go mit am na Jɛzril da sem awa de di nɛks de. Na sɛvinti bɔypikin dɛn di kiŋ bin gɛt, ɛn dɛn ɔl bin de to di bigman dɛn fɔ mɛn.
Wɛn dɛn gɛt Jeu in lɛta, dɛn kech di kiŋ in bɔypikin dɛn kil dɛn ɔl, dɛn sɛvinti; dɛn kɔt kɔt dɛn ed put dɛn na baskit ɛn kɛr dɛn go to Jeu na Jɛzril.
Wɛn di mɛsenja go mit Jeu ɛn tɛl am se dɛn dɔn briŋ di kiŋ in bɔypikin dɛn ed kam, i se lɛ i payl dɛn tu say lɛkɛ ip bifo di siti get te do klin.
Wɛn do klin, Jeu go tinap na do ɛn tɛl di pipul dɛn se dɛn ɔl inosɛnt bikɔs nain di vɛri wan mek ku pan in masta ɛn kil am; bɔt i aks dɛn udat kil ɔl dɛn mɔtalman de.
I tɛl dɛn se in want dɛn fɔ no da de de se nɔn pan wetin PAPA GƆD se bɔt Eab in famili go fɔdɔm na grɔn; i se PAPA GƆD dɔn du wetin i bin tɛl Ilayja.
Jeu kil ɔl udat bin lɛf pan Eab in fambul na Jɛzril. I kil ɔl Eab in men man dɛn, in tayt padi dɛn, ɛn in man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin; wan pan dɛn sef i nɔ lɛf.
Jeu chuk ed go ɔp Sameria. Wɛn i rich na Bɛth Ɛkɛd usay dɛn de mɛn ship ɛn got,
i si sɔm pan Kiŋ Aazaya na Juda in fambul dɛn ɛn aks dɛn udat na dɛn. Dɛn ansa am se dɛn na Aazaya in fambul dɛn, dɛn de go waka to Kwin Jɛzibɛl fɔ tɛl in ɛn in famili adu.
Jeu gi ɔda se lɛ dɛn kech dɛn ɔl, so dɛn kech dɛn ɔl ɛn kil dɛn nia wan ol na Bɛth Ɛkɛd, dɛn fɔti-tu; wan pan dɛn nɔ lɛf.

Wɛn Jeu lɛf Bɛth Ɛkɛd, in ɛn Jɛonadab we na Rekab in bɔypikin mitɔp na rod; Jɛonadab bin de go fɔ go mit am. Jeu tɛl am adu ɛn aks am if i de wit am lɛkɛ aw insɛf de wit am. Jɛonadab ansa am se yɛs, na de Jeu tɛl am se if na so lɛ i gi am in an. Jɛonadab tret in an to Jeu so Jeu ɛp am fɔ klem ɔp in karej.
Jeu tɛl am se lɛ i de waka wit am fɔ lɛ i go si aw i de magomago fɔ PAPA GƆD. So dɛn ɔltu rayd na Jeu in karej.
Wɛn Jeu rich na Sameria, i kil ɔl di balans pipul dɛn we bin lɛf na Eab in famili; wan sɛf i nɔ lɛf, ɛn ɔl dat bi fɔ lɛ wetin PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl Ilayja, bi.
Jeu gɛda ɔl di pipul dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn se, Eab nɔ bin de sav Beal bɛtɛ, bɔt in rɛdi fɔ sav Beal bɛtɛ bɛtɛ wan,

so, lɛ ɔl Beal in prɔfɛt dɛn, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays to Beal ɛn ɔl dɛn wan we de wɔship am gɛda na wan ples; i se dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se nɔbɔdi nɔ lɛf biɛn bikɔs na big big sakrifays in wan ɔfa to am, ɛn udat nɔ de de go day. Na kɔni Jeu ple fɔ kil ɔl dɛn wan we bin de wɔship Beal.
Jeu gi ɔda se lɛ dɛn mek anawnsmɛnt se na big big okezhɔn dɛn de mek fɔ ɔna Beal. Dɛnsɛf du dat.
Jeu sɛn wɔd go ɔlɔbɔt na Izrɛl; ɛn ɔl di wan dɛn we bin de wɔship Beal go, wan pɔsin sɛf nɔ lɛf biɛn. Dɛn ɔl go pak insay Beal in os we dɛn de wɔship am; na so di ples bin chok frɔm domɔt to domɔt.
Jeu tɛl di man we bin de inchaj ɔf di wɔdrob se lɛ i pul ɔl di rob dɛn fɔ di wan dɛn we de wɔship Beal. Di man insɛf pul ɔl di rob dɛn.

Jeu ɛn Jɛonadab we na Rekab in bɔypikin go insay di os; i tɛl di pipul dɛn we de wɔship Beal se lɛ dɛn mek shɔ se nɔbɔdi nɔ de insay de we de wɔship PAPA GƆD, if ɛnibɔdi de insay de lɛ dɛn put am na do.
So i go insay fɔ ɔfa sakrifays ɛn mek bɔn animal sakrifays. Wetin Jeu du, i put eti man dɛn na do ɛn tɛl dɛn se ɛnibɔdi we go mek ɛniwan pan dɛn rɔnawe, da pɔsin de go lɔs in layf.

As Jeu dɔn mek di sakrifays dɔn so, i tɛl di sikyɔriti dɛn ɛn di ɔfisa dɛn se lɛ dɛn go insay Beal in os ɛn kil ɔlman, lɛ wan pɔsin sɛf nɔ rɔnawe. Aw dɛn de kil dɛn na so dɛn de ib dɛn na do; dɛn go insay di sikrit rum na Beal in os,
pul di imej we bin de insay de ɛn bɔn am.
Dɛn brok Beal insɛf yon imej, brok di os ɛn tɔn am to latrin. Na so di ples de te tide.
Na so Jeu tek klia ɔlkayn Beal biznɛs na Izrɛl.
Bɔt in di Jeu nɔ tap fɔ du di bad tin we Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin bin de du, we i mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin ɛn mek gold kaw lay lay gɔd na Bɛthɛl ɛn Dan.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Jeu se bikɔs i dɔn du ɔl wetin i want am fɔ du ɛn dɔn nyakanyaka Eab in famili kpatakpata lɛkɛ aw in di PAPA GƆD want, in pikin dɛn go rul Izrɛl te rich in gret grampikin.
Bɔt Jeu insɛf nɔ bin bisin fɔ de du wetin PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD fɔ Izrɛl want wit ɔl in at. I nɔ tap fɔ du di bad tin we Jɛroboam bin de du we i mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin.
Dɛn tɛm dɛn de, PAPA GƆD bin dɔn bigin fɔ sheb Izrɛl ɛn ridyus dɛn land. Azaɛl ib fɛt na Izrɛl ɛn kapchɔ dɛn;
i bigin kapchɔ frɔm di ist pat na Riva Jɔdan te rich Giliad usay Gad, Rubɛn ɛn Manasɛ fambul dɛn tap; i kapchɔ, Aroa nia Riva Anɔn krɔs go oba Giliad te rich Beshan.
Ɔl di ɔda tin dɛn we Jeu du, di wan dɛn we i kapchɔ o, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Jeu day ɛn dɛn bɛr am na Sameria. Nain bɔypikin Jɛoaaz tek in ples as kiŋ.
Ɔl ɛn ɔl Jeu rul Izrɛl na Sameria twɛnti-et ia.
Wɛn Kwin Athalaya we na Aazaya in mama yɛri se dɛn dɔn kil in bɔypikin i kil ɔlman na di kiŋ in famili,

bɔt Kiŋ Joram in gyal pikin we na Jɛoshiba, we na Aazaya in sista pul Aazaya in bɔypikin we nem Joash kɔmɔt usay di kiŋ in ɔda bɔypikin dɛn de, put in ɛn in nɔs na wan rum, fɔ lɛ Athalaya nɔ go kil am, so dɛn nɔ kil am.
Di nɔsi ayd wit Joash fɔ siks ia na PAPA GƆD in os we Athalaya bin de rul as kwin.

Di ia we mek Athalaya sɛvin ia as kwin, Jɛoyada we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin sɛn kɔl di ɔfisa dɛn we de supavays di kwin in spɛshal bɔdi gad ɛn di ɔda bɔdi gad fɔ mit am na PAPA GƆD in os. I tay bigin wit dɛn ɛn mek dɛn swɛ na PAPA GƆD in os, dɔn i sho dɛn di kiŋ in bɔypikin.
I tɛl dɛn se wetin di wan dɛn we de wok di de fɔ pre ɛn blo fɔ sheb dɛnsɛf to tri grup; i se wan grup fɔ gyad di kiŋ in os,
wan grup na Sur Get, dɔn di ɔda grup fɔ de biɛn di get usay di sikyɔriti dɛn we de gyad PAPA GƆD in os de.
I se di wan dɛnsɛf we nɔ de wok di de fɔ pre ɛn blo, fɔ de rawnd di kiŋ fɔ de gyad PAPA GƆD in os.
I se ɔlman fɔ de rawnd di kiŋ wit in wɛpɔn nain an we i de go ɔp ɛn dɔŋ, ɛn if ɛnibɔdi go nia dɛn, dɛn fɔ kil am. I se dɛn fɔ de nia di kiŋ ɛnisay we i de go.

Di ɔfisa dɛn du ɔl wetin Jɛoyada we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin tɛl dɛn; dɛn ɔl kɛr di sikyɔriti dɛn we de wok ɔnda dɛn to Jɛoyada dat na di wan dɛn we de wok di de fɔ pre ɛn blo ɛn di wan dɛn we gɛt de ɔf.
Jɛoyada gi di ɔfisa dɛn Kiŋ Devid in spia ɛn big shild dɛn we bin de na PAPA GƆD in os;
ɔl di sikyɔriti dɛn tek dɛn pozishɔn wit dɛn wɛpɔn na dɛn an rawnd di kiŋ; sɔm de nia di ɔlta ɔp say insay PAPA GƆD in os, dɔn sɔm de dɔŋ say.

Jɛoyada i briŋ di kiŋ in pikin kam na do, wɛr di krawn nain ed ɛn gi am di lɔ kɔnsanin aw kiŋ fɔ rul, dɔn dɛn anawns se nain na kiŋ; dɛn tɔn ɔyl nain ed, dɔn ɔlman klap ɛn ala se, “Lɛ di kiŋ gɛt lɔŋ layf!”
Wɛn Kwin Athalaya yɛri di sikyɔriti ɔfisa dɛn ɛn di pipul dɛn de ala, i go mit dɛn insay PAPA GƆD in os.

Wɛn i pip, i si di kiŋ tinap nia di pila lɛkɛ aw kiŋ dɛn kin tinap de. Di ɔfisa dɛn ɛn di man dɛn we de blo trɔmpɛt dɛn ɔl bin tinap nia di kiŋ, ɛn ɔl di ɔda pipul dɛn bin de rawnd am de blo trɔmpɛt. Wɛn Kwin Athalaya si dis, i fil am, i chɛr in klos ɛn bigin ala se “Dɛn dɔn mek ku! Dɛn dɔn mek ku!”
Jɛoyada we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin tɛl di ami kapten dɛn se fɔ pul am na do bikɔs dɛn nɔ fɔ kil am na PAPA GƆD in os. I se dɛn fɔ kil ɔl di pipul dɛn we bin de biɛn am.
As i de go usay dɛn ɔs kin de, nain dɛn kech am ɛn kil am.
Jɛoyada mek Kɔvinant bitwin di kiŋ ɛn PAPA GƆD, ɛn di pipul dɛn; dɛn se dɛn go bi PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn. I mek di kiŋ ɛn di pipul dɛn tay bagin.

Ɔl di pipul dɛn na di land go na Beal in os ɛn brok am kam dɔŋ: dɛn brok di ɔlta ɛn di lay lay gɔd dɛn pispis, dɔn dɛn kil Matan we nain bin de mek sakrifays fɔ di pipul dɛn to Beal. Dɔn Jɛoyada put sikyɔriti dɛn fɔ de gyad PAPA GƆD in os.

I kɔl di kapten dɛn, di kiŋ in sikyɔriti dɛn, di sikyɔriti dɛn na di kiŋ in os ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn na di land; i mek dɛn ɛskɔt di kiŋ kɔmɔt na PAPA GƆD in os te go nain yon os. Wɛn di kiŋ rich i tek in sit nain chia.
Ɔl di pipul dɛn bin gladi; ɛn di wanol siti bin kwayɛt afta we dɛn bin dɔn kil Athalaya.
Joash bin ol sɛvin ia we bigin fɔ rul.
Di ia we mek Jeu sɛvin ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da ia de Joash bigin rul na Juda, ɛn i rul fɔ fɔti ia na Jerusɛlɛm. In mama nem Zibia ɛn na Biashiba i kɔmɔt.
Joash du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay bikɔs Jɛoyada we na bin di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin bin de gayd am.
Bɔt pan ɔl dat dɛn nɔ pwɛl di ples dɛn we dɛn bin de wɔship lay lay gɔd; di pipul dɛn bin stil de bɔn insɛns ɛn ɔfa sakrifays na dɛn ples de.

Joash tɛl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin se, lɛ dɛn gɛda ɔl di mɔni we pipul dɛn de kɛr as kɔlɛkshɔn na PAPA GƆD in os, di taks we dɛn de pe, di mɔni we dɛn de gi fɔ pe vaw ɛn di ɔda mɔni we dɛn kin jɛs gi nɔmɔ fɔ natin;
i se lɛ ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin gɛda ɔl dɛn mɔni ya to di pipul dɛn we de kam to dɛn, fɔ ripia PAPA GƆD in os.
Bɔt te Joash de rul fɔ twɛnti-tri ia, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ du wan ripia na PAPA GƆD in os.

So Kiŋ Joash sɛn kɔl Jɛoyada ɛn in kɔmpin dɛn we na dɛn ɔl de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn aks dɛn wetin mek dɛn nɔ de ripia PAPA GƆD in os. I tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ ol wan sɛnt igen na dɛn an, ɛn dɛn fɔ an ova ɛni mɔni we dɛn kɔlɛkt.
Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin gri se dɛn nɔ go tek mɔni na pɔsin an igen ɛn dɛn nɔ go put an pan PAPA GƆD in os we dɛn de ripia wan igen.

Na de Jɛoyada tek wan bɔks, bɔs olpan am ɛn mek am kash bɔks put am na di raytan say nia di ɔlta usay pipul dɛn de pas fɔ go insay PAPA GƆD in os; di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de gyad di os bin de put ɔl di mɔni we dɛn bin de gɛda insay di kash bɔks.
Ɛnitɛm we di kash bɔks kin ful, di kiŋ in sɛktri ɛn di edman fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, kin go kɔnt di mɔni we dɛn kɛr na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn put am na bag.
Wɛn dɛn dɔn kɔnt di mɔni dɔn, dɛn kin gi di man dɛn we de supavays di wok na PAPA GƆD in os. Na di mɔni dɛn kin yuz fɔ pe di kapinta dɛn ɛn di bilda dɛn we de wok na di PAPA GƆD in os;
dɔn dɛn kin pe di mesna dɛn ɛn di man dɛn we de kɔt ston. Na pan di sem mɔni dɛn kin tek bay bod ɛn dɛn fayn ston fɔ ripia PAPA GƆD in os, ɛn du ɔda smɔl smɔl ripia dɛn na di os.
Dɛn nɔ yuz di mɔni fɔ mek dɛn silva bol, sizɔs fɔ trim wik, kɔp, trɔmpɛt, ɔ ɛni ɔda gold ɔ silva tiŋs dɛn fɔ PAPA GƆD in os.
Dɛn yuz di mɔni fɔ pe di wokman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os.
Dɛn nɔ bin nid fɔ de chɛk di man dɛn we na dɛn an dɛn bin de put mɔni bikɔs dɛn ɔl bin ɔnɛs.
Di mɔni we dɛn bin de gɛda to dɛn wan we de go mek sakrifays fɔ dɛn sin nɔ bin de go insay di bɔks, i bin de go to di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
Da tɛm de Kiŋ Azaɛl na Siria bin go fɛt wa wit Gath ɛn kapchɔ di siti; dɔn i go bak fɔ go atak Jerusɛlɛm.

Bɔt Kiŋ Joash na Juda pul ɔl di tiŋs dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os we in grampapa dɛn we na Jɛoshafat, Jɛoram ɛn Aazaya we dɛn na bin kiŋ na Juda bin dɔn gi fɔ PAPA GƆD in os, wit in yon tiŋs dɛn nain os go gi Kiŋ Azaɛl na Siria. Kiŋ Joash gi Kiŋ Azaɛl ɔl di gold tiŋs dɛn we i mit na PAPA GƆD in os, ɛn di wan we insɛf put de. Dat mek Kiŋ Azaɛl nɔ atak Jerusɛlɛm igen
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Joash du, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
Wande Joash in ɔfisa dɛn mek ku pan am ɛn kil am na Bɛth Milo, na di rod fɔ go dɔŋ na Sila.

Di ɔfisa dɛn we kil am na Jozabad we insɛf na Shimeat in bɔypikin wit Jɛozabad we na Shoma in bɔypikin. We Joash day dɛn bɛr am usay dɛn bɛr in grampapa dɛn na Devid in siti, dɔn in bɔypikin we nem Amazaya bigin fɔ rul as kiŋ.
Di ia we mek Kiŋ Joash na Juda we na Aazaya in bɔypikin twɛnti-tri ia as kiŋ, na da ia de Jɛoaaz we na Jeu in bɔypikin bi kiŋ na Izrɛl. Na Sameria i bin tap, ɛn i rul fɔ sɛvintin ia.
Insɛf nɔ du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay; i falamakata Nebat in bɔypikin we nem Jɛroboam in bad trik we mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin.
Dat mek PAPA GƆD vɛks bad wan pan Izrɛl ɛn an dɛn ova to Kiŋ Azaɛl na Siria, ɛn in bɔypikin Bɛnadad fɔ pas am pan dɛn.
Jɛoaaz pre to PAPA GƆD ɛn i ansa am. PAPA GƆD si se di kiŋ na Siria bin de mɔna Izrɛl tumɔs,
so i mek sɔmbɔdi pul Izrɛl kɔmɔt na Siria in an, dɔn Izrɛl rɔnawe. Di Izrɛlayt dɛn go tap bak usay dɛn bin de ɛn liv dɛn layf.
Bɔt pan ɔl dat dɛn nɔ tap fɔ de du di bad tin we Jɛroboam bin de du we i mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin; dɔn igen da gɔd we nem Ashɛra in lay lay gɔd bin stil de na Sameria.
Di wan dɛn nɔmɔ we bin lɛf pan Kiŋ Jɛoaaz in ami man dɛn na fifti man dɛn we de rayd ɔs, tɛn karej wit tɛn tawzin sojaman dɛn, bikɔs di kiŋ na Siria bin dɔn nyamanyama dɛn lɛk dɔti na grɔn.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Jɛoaaz du we i bin de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt na di Istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Jɛoaaz day, ɛn dɛn bɛr am usay dɛn bɛr in grampapa dɛn na Sameria. In bɔypikin Jɛoash tek in ples as kiŋ.
Di ia we mek Joash tati-sɛvin ia as kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Jɛoash we na Jɛoaaz in bɔypikin bi kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn na Sameria i bin de rul. I rul fɔ sikstin ia.
Insɛf nɔ du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay ɛn falamakata Nebat in bɔypikin we na Jɛroboam we mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Jɛoash du, wetin ɛn wetin i du ɛn di wa we i fɛt wit Kiŋ Amazaya na Juda, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Jɛoash day ɛn dɛn bɛr am na Sameria usay dɛn bɛr dɛn ɔda kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl. Na Jɛroboam tek in ples fɔ de rul as kiŋ.
Prɔfɛt Ilaɛlsha kam sik bad wan ɛn bin wan fɔ day; so Kiŋ Joash na Izrɛl go mit am ɛn kray pan am se “E mi papa! E mi papa! Na yu bin de kɔba Izrɛl!”
Ilaɛlsha tɛl am lɛ i go fɛn bo ɛn aro ɛn kam bak to am, so insɛf go fɛn dɛn kam.
Ilaɛlsha tɛl am lɛ i fiks di aro pan di bo, wɛn di kiŋ dɔn du dat, Ilaɛlsha put in an pan di kiŋ in yon an,
ɛn tɛl am se lɛ i opin di winda we tɔn to Siria ɛn shut; insɛf opin di winda ɛn shut. Na de Ilaɛlsha tɛl am se PAPA GƆD go mek i win ɛn kɔnka Siria, ɛn i go dɔnawe wit dɛn na Efɛk.
Ilaɛlsha tɛl am bak se lɛ i tek di aro dɛn ɛn shut di grɔn. I shut di grɔn tri tɛm nɔmɔ,
nain Ilaɛlsha vɛks pan am se i bin fɔ dɔn shut fayv ɔ siks tɛm, ɛn if i bin du dat, i bin fɔ ebul nyakanyaka di Sirian dɛn kpatakpata; bɔt na tri tɛm nɔmɔ i go ebul dil wit dɛn.
Ilaɛlsha day dɛn bɛr am. Ɛnitɛm we nyu ia de bigin na da tɛm de dɛn Moabayt dɛn kin go red di Izrɛlayt dɛn.

Wan de di Izrɛlayt dɛn go bɛr wan man, na de dɛn si sɔm man dɛn we kam red dɛn eria so dɛnsɛf fliŋ di dedebɔdi insay di grev we dɛn bɛr Ilaɛlsha. Wɛn di dedebɔdi tɔch Ilaɛlsha in bon dɛn, di day man wek ɛn tinap deŋ.
Kiŋ Azaɛl na Siria bin de mɔna Izrɛl ɔl di tɛm we Jɛoaaz bin de rul de.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD bin de sɔri fɔ Izrɛl ɛn bin de ɛp dɛn bikɔs ɔf di Kɔvinant we i bin dɔn sayn wit Ebraam, Ayzak ɛn Jekɔb. Ɔp to da tɛm de, i nɔ bin mekɔp fɔ dɔnawe wit di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
We Kiŋ Azaɛl na Siria day, in bɔypikin Bɛnadad tek in ples ɛn bigin rul as kiŋ.

Dɔn Jɛodaaz in bɔypikin we na Jɛoash go kapchɔ bak dɛn siti dɛn we Bɛnadad in papa Azaɛl bin tek na Jɛoaaz in an we dɛn bin de fɛt wa. Na tri tɛm Jɛoash bit Bɛnadad pan wa we i tek ɔl di Izrɛl siti dɛn bak nain an.
Di ia we mek Jɛoaaz in bɔypikin we nem Jɛoash tu ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da sem ia de Joash in bɔypikin we nem Amazaya bigin fɔ rul na Juda.
Na twɛnti-fayv ia i bin ol we i bi kiŋ, ɛn i rul fɔ twɛnti-nayn ia na Jerusɛlɛm. In mama nem Jɛoadin ɛn na Jerusɛlɛm i kɔmɔt.
In bin du wetin PAPA GƆD want bɔt nɔmɔ in nɔ bin rich Kiŋ Devid. Na wetin in papa Joash bin de du insɛf du.
I nɔ brok dɛn ay ples we dɛn bin de wɔship lay lay gɔd, ɛn lɛf di pipul dɛn fɔ de mek sakrifays ɛn bɔn insɛns de.
Wɛn i dɔn sidɔm fayn na pawa, i kil ɔl dɛn ɔfisa dɛn we bin kil in papa di tɛm we i bin bi kiŋ,
bɔt i nɔ kil dɛn pikin dɛn bikɔs i bin de go akɔdin to di Lɔ we PAPA GƆD gi Mozis se, “Papa nɔ fɔ day fɔ pikin, ɛn pikin nɔ fɔ day fɔ papa; ɔlman fɔ day fɔ in yon sin.”
Na Amazaya bin kil tɛn tawzin Idɔmayt dɛn na Sɔl Vali, ɛn kapchɔ wan siti we nem Sila, ɛn gi am nem Jokthil, we na dis nem ya di ples gɛt te tide.
Dɔn Amazaya sɛn mɛsej to Jɛoash we na Jɛoaaz in bɔypikin ɛn grampikin to Jeu se in de chalenj am fes to fes fɔ fɛt. Jɛoash na bin di kiŋ na Izrɛl.

Bɔt Kiŋ Jɛoash na Izrɛl sɛn riplay to Kiŋ Amazaya na Juda se, “Wande, wan smɔl winji winji plant na Libanɔn sɛn mɛsej to wan big sida tik insay di vɛri Libanɔn se i fɔ gi in gyal pikin to in bɔypikin fɔ mared. Na de wan wayl animal kɔmɔt na bush kam mas, mas di lili plant.
Na tru se yu dɔn dɔnawe wit Idɔm bɔt dat nɔ min se yu fɔ de mek prawd ɛn mek rudnɛs. If yu dɔn win, sidɔm saful, bɔt nɔ fɛn plaba ɛn mek yu ɛn Juda sɔri.”
Bɔt Amazaya nɔ yɛri wɔd, i stil mek traŋayes, so Kiŋ Jɛoash na Izrɛl atak am. Dɛn mitɔp fes to fes na Bɛth Shemɛsh na Juda.
Jɛoash in sojaman dɛn dɔnawe wit Amazaya in yon dɛn kpatakpata te ɔlman rɔnawe go om.

Kiŋ Jɛoash kapchɔ Kiŋ Amazaya we na Joash in bɔypikin we semweso na Aazaya in grampikin na Bɛth Shemɛsh. Dɔn Jɛoash go dɔŋ na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn brok di wɔl fɛnch frɔm Ifrem Get te rich to di Kɔna Get, di distans na bin lɛk siks ɔndrɛd fut lɔŋ.
I tek ɔl di gold ɛn silva tiŋs dɛn we de na PAPA GƆD os, wit ɔl di ɔda dia tiŋs dɛn na di kiŋ in os. Dɔn pantap dat i kech pipul dɛn kɛr dɛn go Sameria.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Jɛoash du, ɛn ɔl wetin ɛn wetin i gɛt wit di wa we i fɛt wit Kiŋ Amazaya na Juda, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Wɛn Jɛoash day dɛn bɛr am na Sameria usay dɛn bɛr in grampapa dɛn na Izrɛl; dɔn in bɔypikin Jɛroboam tek in ples as Kiŋ.
Kiŋ Amazaya na Juda we na Joash in bɔypikin liv fɔ fiftin ia afta we Kiŋ Jɛoash na Izrɛl we na Jɛoaaz in bɔypikin day.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Amazaya du we i bin de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Juda.
Dɛn mek ku pan Amazaya na Jerusɛlɛm, nain i rɔnawe go Lakish; bɔt de sɛf dɛn fala am go de ɛn kil am de.
Na ɔs dɛn tek go pul in dedebɔdi kɔmɔt de. Dɛn bɛr am usay dɛn bɛr in grampapa dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm na Devid in siti.
Ɔl di pipul dɛn na Juda tek Amazaya in bɔypikin we nem Azaraya we ol sikstin ia ɛn mek am kiŋ.
Na dis Azaraya kam bil Ilath bak ɛn mek i bi pat ɔf Juda.
Di ia we mek Amazaya we na Joash in bɔypikin fiftin ia as kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Joash in bɔypikin we nem Jɛroboam bi kiŋ na Izrɛl, ɛn i rul fɔ fɔti-wan ia.
Insɛf nɔ du wetin rayt bifo PAPA GƆD in yay, na soso Nebat in bɔypikin we na Jɛroboam in bad abit i falamakata we i bin mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin.

Jɛroboam tek ɔl dɛn land we dɛn bin dɔn kapchɔ na di Izrɛlayt dɛn an. I tek frɔm Lɛbo Amath te rich to di Arab Si. Dis bi fɔ lɛ wetin PAPA GƆD in Prɔfɛt we nem Jona we kɔmɔt na Gath Ifɛr we na Amitay in bɔypikin bin dɔn tɔk, bi.
PAPA GƆD bin dɔn si se di pipul dɛn na Izrɛl wɛda na fribɔn ɔ slev bin de sɔfa bad bad wan ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de fɔ ɛp dɛn;
ɛn bikɔs i nɔ bin dɔn tɔk se in go wep Izrɛl kɔmɔt na di wɔl kpatakpata, dat mek i yuz Jɛoash in bɔypikin Jɛroboam fɔ sev dɛn.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Jɛroboam du, lɛkɛ di we we i win batul, we i tek Damaskɔs ɛn Amath bak we bin de insay Juda bawndri, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl.
Jɛroboam day ɛn dɛn bɛr am usay dɛn bɛr dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl, dɔn in bɔypikin Zɛkaraya tek in ples.
Di ia we mek Jɛroboam twɛnti-sɛvin ia we i bi kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da ia de Amazaya in bɔypikin we na Azaraya bi kiŋ na Juda.
Na sikstin ia i bin ol we i bi kiŋ ɛn i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ fifti-tu ia. In mama nem Jɛkolaya ɛn na Jerusɛlɛm i kɔmɔt.
Azaraya fala in papa Amazaya in gud ɛgzampul ɛn du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay.
Bɔt nɔmɔ i nɔ brok dɛn ɔlta we dɛn bin bil fɔ de mek sakrifays to lay lay gɔd; di pipul dɛn bin stil de bɔn insɛns ɛn ɔfa sakrifays de.
PAPA GƆD ib bad sik na Azaraya in bɔdi ɛn na da sik de de pan am te i day. I muf go tap na ɔda ples ɛn lɛf in bɔypikin Jotham fɔ de rul di kɔntri fɔ am.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Azaraya du, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
We Azaraya day, dɛn bɛr am usay dɛn bɛr in grampapa dɛn na Devid in siti, dɔn in bɔypikin Jotham tek ova as kiŋ.
Di ia we mek Azaraya tati-et ia as kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Jɛroboam in bɔypikin we nem Zɛkaraya bi kiŋ na Izrɛl; na siks mɔnt nɔmɔ i rul fɔ na Sameria.
Insɛf kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD lɛkɛ in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn. Da Jɛroboam we bin mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin, na soso in bad abit insɛf falamakata.
Jebɛsh in bɔypikin we nem Shalum mek ku pan Zɛkaraya sansantɛm we ɔlman de si ɛn chuk am kil am; dɔn i tek in ples as kiŋ.
Di ɔda tin dɛn we Zɛkaraya du rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl.
Na so wetin PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl Jeu kam tek bi. PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl Jeu se in go mek in jɛnareshɔn dɛn rul te rich in gret grampikin.
Di ia we mek Uzaya tati-nayn ia as kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Shalum we na Jebɛsh in bɔypikin bi kiŋ na Izrɛl. Na wan mɔnt insɛf rul fɔ nɔmɔ na Sameria.
Naim Gadi in bɔypikin we nem Mɛnaɛm kɔmɔt na Tiza go ɔp na Sameria go atak am ɛn kil am, ɛn tek in ples as kiŋ.
Di ɔda tin dɛn we Shalum du, lɛkɛ di ku we i mek, ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Na dis sem tɛm ya Mɛnaɛm kɔmɔt Tiza ɛn bigin kil pipul dɛn. I atak Tifsa ɛn bigin kil fitifata na di siti. I plit ɔl di bɛlɛ uman dɛn bɛlɛ, bikɔs i se dɛn nɔ gri mek i tek ova di siti.
Di ia we mek Azaraya tati-nayn ia as kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Gadi in bɔypikin we na Mɛnaɛm bi kiŋ na Izrɛl, ɛn i rul na Sameria fɔ tɛn ia.
Insɛf nɔ du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay. I fala Jɛroboam we bin mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD. Dis Jɛroboam yaso na Nebat in bɔypikin.
Kiŋ Pul na Asiria atak di kɔntri, so Mɛnaɛm gi am tati-fo tawzin kilo silva fɔ lɛ i go sɔpɔt am fɔ mek i go sidɔm fayn na pawa na Izrɛl.
Mɛnaɛm mek shɔ se ɔlman na Izrɛl pe to Pul. I mek ɔl di jɛntri man dɛn pe fifti fifti silva kɔpɔ. Wɛn Kiŋ Pul gɛt di mɔni i tɔn bak go nain kɔntri ɛn nɔ ambɔgin dɛn igen
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Mɛnaɛm du, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn Kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl.
Wɛn Mɛnaɛm day, nain bɔypikin Pekaya bi kiŋ.
Di ia we mek Kiŋ Azaraya fifti ia as kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Mɛnaɛm in bɔypikin we na Pekaya bi kiŋ na Izrɛl. Na Sameria i bin de rul ɛn i rul fɔ tu ia.
Pekaya insɛf nɔ du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay. I falamakata Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin we mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD.

Na wan pan in chif ɔfisa dɛn we na Peka, dat na Rɛmalaya in bɔypikin mek ku pan am. Peka tek fifti man na Giliad ɛn yuz dɛn fɔ atak Pekaya, Agɔb ɛn Ariɛ insay di kiŋ in os na Sameria ɛn kil dɛn ɔl. Wɛn Peka dɔn kil Pekaya, i tek in ples ɛn bi di kiŋ.
Di ɔda tin dɛn we Pekaya du wɛn i de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Di ia we mek Azaraya fifti-tu ia as kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Rɛmalaya in bɔypikin we na Peka bi kiŋ na Izrɛl, ɛn i rul na Sameria fɔ twɛnti ia.
Peka insɛf nɔ du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay; i falamakata Nebat in bɔypikin we na Jɛroboam pan di bad we i mek Izrɛl kɔmit to PAPA GƆD.

Di tɛm we Peka bin de rul, Kiŋ Tiglat Pilɛsa na Asiria go kapchɔ Ijɔn, Ebɛl Bɛth Maaka, Janoa, Kedɛsh ɛn Ezɔ. I kapchɔ ɔda ples dɛn lɛkɛ Giliad, Galili ɛn ɔl di ɔda ples na Naftali, ɛn kech ɔl di pipul kɛr dɛn go Asiria.
Na de Ila in bɔypikin we nem Oshia mek ku pan Peka ɛn kil am, dɔn i tek in ples ɛn bi di kiŋ. Ɔl dis bi di ia we mek Jotham in bɔypikin we na Uzaya twɛnti ia as kiŋ na Juda.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Peka du, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Di ia we mek Rɛmalaya in bɔypikin we na Peka tu ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da ia de Uzaya in bɔypikin we na Jotham bi kiŋ na Juda.
Na twɛnti fayv ia i bin ol we i bi kiŋ ɛn i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ sikstin ia. In mama na Zedɔk in gyal pikin we nem Jɛrusha.
Jotham du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay lɛkɛ in papa Uzaya.
Bɔt nɔmɔ i nɔ bin brok dɛn ɔlta we dɛn bin dɔn bil fɔ de mek sakrifays to lay lay gɔd; di pipul dɛn bin stil de bɔn insɛns, ɛn mek sakrifays de. Na Jotham bil di Nɔth Get na PAPA GƆD in os bak.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Jotham du dɛn ɔl rayt dɔŋ na di istri buk, bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
Na di tɛm we Jotham bi kiŋ, PAPA GƆD bigin fɔ sɛn Kiŋ Rizin na Aram ɛn Kiŋ Peka na Izrɛl fɔ atak Juda.
Wɛn Jotham day dɛn bɛr am na usay dɛn bɛr in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn na Kiŋ Devid in siti. Nain bɔypikin Eaz bi di kiŋ afta am.
Di ia we mek Rɛmalaya in bɔypikin we na Peka sɛvintin ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da ia de Jotham in bɔypikin we na Eaz bi kiŋ na Juda.
Eaz bin ol twɛnti ia we i bi kiŋ ɛn i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ sikstin ia. Lɛkɛ aw Devid bin de rul, in nɔ rul so; bifo dat i du wetin nɔ rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay;

Eaz fala dɛn ɔda kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl dɛn bad trik ɛn ivin tek in bɔypikin mek sara na faya; dɔn na soso dɛn bad bad tin we dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn bin de du we mek PAPA GƆD drɛb dɛn kɔmɔt bifo di Izrɛlayt dɛn, insɛf du.
I bɔn insɛns ɛn mek sakrifays na dɛn ay ples we dɛn mek fɔ wɔship lay lay gɔd, i mek sakrifays pantap dɛn il ɛn ɔnda dɛn tik.
Kiŋ Rizin na Siria ɛn Kiŋ Peka na Izrɛl we na Rɛmalaya in bɔypikin tay bagin ɛn atak Jerusɛlɛm. Dɛn le ambush fɔ Eaz bɔt dɛn nɔ ebul am.
So Kiŋ Rizin kapchɔ Ilath ɛn drɛb di man dɛn na Juda kɔmɔt de; na de di Idɔmayt dɛn muf go tap na Ilath ɛn na dɛn de de te tide.
Eaz sɛn mɛsej to Kiŋ Tiglat Pilɛsa na Asiria se in nain bɔbɔ ɛn i no se i de fɔ am, so in de beg am lɛ i kam ɛp am fɔ fɛt di kiŋ dɛn na Siria ɛn Izrɛl we dɔn atak am.
Eaz tek di gold ɛn silva we de na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn in yon os ɛn sɛn ɔl as prɛzɛnt fɔ di kiŋ na Asiria.
Di kiŋ na Asiria insɛf gri fɔ bato am; i atak Damaskɔs ɛn kapchɔ di siti. I mek ɔlman go bak na Kir, dɔn i kil Kiŋ Rizin.
Kiŋ Eaz go na Damaskɔs go mit Kiŋ Tiglat Pilɛsa. I si wan ɔlta de we i lɛk, so i drɔ di plan ɛn sɛn am to Yuraya we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ bil di sem kayn ɔlta.
Yuraya insɛf bil di ɔlta we Kiŋ Eaz se fɔ bil. I bil am dɔn bifo di kiŋ tɔn bak na Juda.
Wɛn di kiŋ kɔmɔt Damaskɔs ɛn si di ɔlta, i go mek sakrifays de wantɛm.
I bɔn animal sakrifays de, dɔn i mek dɛn ɔda sakrifays wit it, wayn, ɛn blɔd.
I pul di bras ɔlta we dɛn bin dɔn dɛdiket to PAPA GƆD kɔmɔt frɔnt di os usay i bin de midul di nyu ɔlta ɛn PAPA GƆD in os ɛn put am na di nɔth pat to di nyu ɔlta.

Kiŋ Eaz gi ɔda to Yuraya we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin se na pan di nyu big ɔlta i fɔ de ɔfa di mɔnin animal sakrifays ɛn di ivin it sakrifays, wit di kiŋ in yon animal ɛn it sakrifays, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn na di kɔntri dɛn yon animal, it ɛn wayn sakrifays. Di kiŋ se i fɔ tɔn ɔl di blɔd fɔ sakrifays pan di ɔlta bɔt in go yuz di bras ɔlta fɔ de aks fɔ advays.
Yuraya we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin du ɔl wetin di kiŋ tɛl am fɔ du.
Kiŋ Eaz pul di bras ɔmɔlanke dɛn we bin de na PAPA GƆD in os wit di bol dɛn we bin de pan dɛn; i put di bras tank we bin de pantap di bras kaw dɛn ɛn put am pantap ston.
Dɔn igen fɔ pliz di kiŋ we kɔmɔt Asiria, i pul di stand kɔmɔt insay PAPA GƆD in os usay kiŋ in chia bin de tinap ɛn batin di domɔt we na de di kiŋ fɔ pas go insay PAPA GƆD in os.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Eaz du we i bin de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
Eaz day dɔn dɛn bɛr am usay dɛn bɛr in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn na Devid in siti; dɔn in bɔypikin Ɛzikaya bi di kiŋ.
Di ia we mek Eaz twɛlv ia as kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Oshia we na Ila in bɔypikin bi kiŋ na Izrɛl, ɛn na Sameria i bin de. I rul fɔ nayn ia.
Insɛf nɔ du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay bɔt in nɔ bin tan lɛk di ɔda kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl we bin de bifo am.
Kiŋ Shalmanɛsa na Asiria go fɔ atak Oshia we bin de pe taks to am.
Bɔt i kam fɛnɔt se Oshia kɔmɔt biɛn am bikɔs i sɛn man dɛn to Kiŋ So na Ijipt fɔ mek Kiŋ So sɔpɔt am ɛn i lɛf fɔ pe taks to Kiŋ Shalmanɛsa so i kech Oshia ɛn lɔk am na jel.
Kiŋ Shalmanɛsa na Asiria atak Izrɛl; i le ambush rawnd Sameria fɔ tri ia.
Di ia we mek Oshia nayn ia as kiŋ, na da ia de Shalmanɛsa kapchɔ Sameria ɛn sɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn go na Asiria. I mek dɛn tap na Ala ɛn Gozan we de nia Riva Abɔ, wit dɛn ɔda siti dɛn na Mɛdis
Ɔl dis waala yaso mit Izrɛl bikɔs dɛn kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD dɛn PAPA GƆD we pul dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt na di kiŋ na Ijipt in an. Dɛn bin de wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn
ɛn du wetin dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn we PAPA GƆD drɛb kɔmɔt bifo dɛn bin de du; dɔn dɛn bin de du dɛn bad bad tin we di kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl bin de du.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin de ayd de du tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk. Dɛn bil ples fɔ de wɔship lay lay gɔd na dɛn siti ɛn dɛn smɔl siti.
Dɛn bil ples fɔ wɔship Ashɛra na ɔl dɛn il ɛn ɔnda dɛn tik.
Ɛn na so dɛn bin jɛs de bil ɔlta ɛn bɔn insɛns de gbay, de falamakata dɛn neshɔn dɛn we PAPA GƆD drɛb kɔmɔt bifo dɛn; dɛn du bad tin we mek PAPA GƆD vɛks bad bad wan pan dɛn.
Dɛn bin de wɔship lay lay gɔd, ivin we PAPA GƆD bin dɔn wɔn dɛn nɔ fɔ du dat.
PAPA GƆD tɛl in prɔfɛt dɛn fɔ wɔn Izrɛl ɛn Juda fɔ lɛf dɛn bad trik ɛn fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD in lɔ we i gi dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn ɛn ɔl di lɔ dɛn we i gi di prɔfɛt dɛn fɔ de tɛl dɛn.
Bɔt usay, dɛn nɔ yɛri; na soso di bad abit we dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn bin gɛt we dɛn nɔ de lisin to papa GƆD, nain dɛnsɛf gɛt.

Dɛn nɔ gri fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se, ɛn nɔ kip di Kɔvinant we i sayn wit dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn; bifo dat dɛn bigin de wɔship lay lay gɔd dɛn we nɔ min natin ɛn na so dɛnsɛf kam fiba mɔtalman dɛn we nɔ fit natin. Dɛn falamakata dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn we PAPA GƆD bin dɔn wɔn dɛn bɔt, ɛn du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl dɛn nɔ fɔ du.

Dɛn lɛf fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl dɛn fɔ du, bifo dat dɛn mek tu kaw lay lay gɔd ɛn wan ɔda wan lay lay gɔd we nem Ashɛra. Dɛn bigin fɔ wɔship ɔl dɛn lay lay gɔd ya ɛn dɛn sta wit Beal insɛf, dɛn se na dɛn gɔd dat.
Dɔn igen, dɛn kil dɛn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn, ɛn bɔn dɛn na faya as sakrifays; dɛn de go to mɔreman, dɛn de lukgrɔn, ɔlkanaba bad tin nain dɛn du fɔ mek PAPA GƆD vɛks.
So PAPA GƆD vɛks bad bad pan Izrɛl ɛn dɔnawe wit dɛn kpatakpata. Na Juda nɔmɔ bin lɛf.
Juda we lɛf sɛf nɔ bin de du wetin PAPA GƆD se. Dɛnsɛf falamakata Izrɛl pan dɛn bad abit.
Dat mek PAPA GƆD tɔn in bak pan ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn, i pɔnish dɛn mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn skata skata dɛn ɛn nyamanyama dɛn te wan pan dɛnsɛf nɔ lɛf.

Afta we PAPA GƆD dɔn pul di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmɔt to di Juda pipul dɛn, di Izrɛlayt dɛn mek Nebat in bɔypikin we na Jɛroboam Kiŋ. Jɛroboam tek tɛm pul di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmɔt ɛn nɔ mek dɛn du wetin PAPA GƆD want.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn du ɔl di bad tin dɛn we Jɛroboam se fɔ du,
na dat dɛn bin de pan te PAPA GƆD drɛb dɛn kɔmɔt bifo am; ɛn i bin dɔn tɛl in prɔfɛt dɛn fɔ wɔn dɛn. Na so di Izrɛlayt dɛn tek kɔmɔt go Ɛgzayl na Asiria ɛn na de dɛn de te tide.

Di kiŋ na Asiria pul pipul dɛn kɔmɔt na Babilɔn, Kutha, Ava, Amath ɛn Sɛfavaim ɛn kɛr dɛn go na di difrɛn siti dɛn na Sameria fɔ go tek di Izrɛlayt dɛn ples de. Na dɛn bin tap na ɔl di siti dɛn na Sameria.
Wɛn dɛn jɛs go tap de, dɛn nɔ bin de wɔship PAPA GƆD, so i mek layɔn dɛn atak ɛn kil sɔm pan dɛn.
Wɔd rich di kiŋ na Asiria se di pipul dɛn we i mek go tap na Sameria nɔ ɔndastand di gɔd we de de, ɛn nɔ no wetin i want, so i dɔn mek layɔn dɛn go skata dɛn ɛn kil sɔm pan dɛn.
Di kiŋ gi ɔda se lɛ dɛn tek wan pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we dɛn kapchɔ na Sameria kɛr am go de lɛ i go tap de fɔ de lan di pipul dɛn wetin di gɔd we gɛt di land want.
So wan pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we bin tap na Sameria go bak na Bɛthɛl ɛn bigin fɔ lan di pipul dɛn aw fɔ de wɔship PAPA GƆD.

Bɔt nɔ mɛn o, di pipul dɛn bin stil de wɔship smɔl smɔl gɔd dɛn na di siti we dɛn tap; ɛn na usay di pipul dɛn na Sameria bin dɔn bil fɔ de kip dɛn yon smɔl smɔl gɔd dɛn, na de dɛnsɛf bin de kip dɛn yon gɔd dɛn.
Ɔlman bin mek in yon gɔd, di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt Babilɔn mek Sɔkɔt Bɛnɔt; di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt Kutha mek Nagal; di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt Amath mek Ashima we na dɛn di Sɛfavaim dɛn bin de wɔship,
di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt Ava mek Nibaz ɛn Tatak; dɔn di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt Sɛfavaim bin de bɔn dɛn pikin na faya as sakrifays to dɛn gɔd dɛn we nem Adramɛlɛk ɛn Anamɛlɛk.
Dɛn bin de wɔship PAPA GƆD o, bɔt dɛn bin pik sɔm pan dɛnsɛf fɔ wok as man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ de na dɛn ay ples we dɛn de wɔship.
Ivin we dɛn bin de wɔship PAPA GƆD, dɛn bin stil de wɔship dɛn yon gɔd dɛn we dɛn pul kɔmɔt na dɛn kɔntri lɛkɛ aw dɛn bin de du we dɛn de, de.

Ɔl wetin dɛn bin de du trade nain dɛn de du te tide. Dɛn nɔ de wɔship PAPA GƆD, ɛn dɛn nɔ bisin fɔ du wetin di kɔmandmɛnt ɛn lɔ dɛn we i gi dɛn se, dat na wetin i bin gi Jekɔb we i gi nem Izrɛl in Jɛnareshɔn dɛn.
Wɛn PAPA GƆD bin mek Kɔvinant wit di Izrɛlayt dɛn, i gi dɛn lɔ se, dɛn nɔ fɔ wɔship nɔn ɔda gɔd dɛn ɔ mek sakrifays to dɛn.
I se na PAPA GƆD we pul dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt wit in mayti pawa dɛn. I se nain dɛn fɔ wɔship. I se nain dɛn fɔ baw to ɛn ɔfa sakrifays to,
ɛn dɛn fɔ tek tɛm du wetin ɔl in kɔmandmɛnt ɛn lɔ dɛn we i dɔn rayt gi dɛn. I se dɛn nɔ fɔ wɔship nɔn ɔda gɔd.
Dɛn nɔ fɔ fɔgɛt di Kɔvinant we i bin mek wit dɛn, ɛn dɛn nɔ fɔ wɔship nɔn ɔda gɔd.
Bifo dat nain PAPA GƆD dɛn PAPA GƆD dɛn fɔ wɔship, nain go pul dɛn na dɛn ɛnimi dɛn an.
Bɔt usay, di pipul dɛn nɔ yɛri, dɛn bin jɛs de du wetin dɛn fil fɔ du.
Ivin we dɛn bin de wɔship PAPA GƆD, dɛn bin de wɔship lay lay gɔd bak. Te tide dɛn pikin dɛn ɛn grampikin dɛn stil de wɔship lay lay gɔd lɛkɛ dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn.
Di ia we mek Ila in bɔypikin we na Oshia tri ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, na da ia de Eaz in bɔypikin Ɛzikaya bi kiŋ na Juda.
Na twɛnti-fayv ia i bin ol we i bi kiŋ ɛn i rul fɔ twɛnti-nayn ia na Jerusɛlɛm. In mama na Zɛkaraya in gyal pikin we na Abija.
Ɛzikaya du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay lɛkɛ aw nɔmɔ Devid insɛf bin du.

I pwɛl pwɛl ɔl dɛn ay ples we dɛn mek fɔ de wɔship lay lay gɔd, ɛn brok da gɔd we nem Ashɛra in lay lay gɔd. I brok da bras snek we Mozis bin mek bikɔs pipul dɛn bin de bɔn insɛns to am. Dɛn bin de kɔl di snek Nɛshutan
Ɛzikaya in bin put in op ɛn trɔs pan PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl in PAPA GƆD. Nɔn kiŋ nɔ ɛva rul Juda we tan lɛk Ɛzikaya; dɛn wan we bin de bifo am o, ɔ dɛn wan sɛf we kam afta am.
I bin de wit PAPA GƆD tigi tigi wan; i bin de fala di lɔ we PAPA GƆD gi Mozis;
ɛn na so PAPA GƆD insɛf bin de wit am. Ɛnitin we i put an pan bin de bɛtɛ. I barɔf pan di kiŋ na Asiria ɛn nɔ gri pe taks to am.
I fɛt ɔl di Filistin dɛn frɔm di Wɔch Tawa te rich to di siti we dɛn bil wɔl rawnd, te rich to di bawndri fɔ go Gaza ɛn di siti dɛn we de rawnd am.
Di ia we mek Ɛzikaya fo ia as kiŋ, we na da sem ia de mek Oshia insɛf sɛvin ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl, Kiŋ Shalmanɛsa na Asiria mach go na Sameria ɛn le ambush de.
Na we tri ia dɔn di Asirian dɛn kapchɔ di siti. Dɛn kapchɔ Sameria di ia we mek Ɛzikaya siks ia we i bi kiŋ na Juda, ɛn Oshia nayn ia as kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Di kiŋ na Asiria kech di pipul dɛn na Izrɛl kɛr dɛn go na Ala, Gozan we de nia Riva Abɔ, wit dɛn siti dɛn we de na Mɛdia.
Ɔl dis bin bi bikɔs di pipul dɛn nɔ obe PAPA GƆD ɛn brok di Kɔvinant we de bitwin in ɛn dɛn, ɛn nɔ gri du ɔl wetin Mozis tɛl dɛn fɔ du. Wan wɔd dɛn nɔ yɛri.
Di ia we mek Kiŋ Ɛzikaya fotin ia we i bin rul as kiŋ, na da ia de Kiŋ Sɛnakarib na Asiria atak ɔl di siti dɛn we gɛt wɔl na Juda ɛn kapchɔ dɛn.

So Ɛzikaya sɛn mɛsej to di kiŋ na Asiria na Lakish se in dɔn du rɔŋ, so lɛ i sɔri fɔ am, in go pe ɛnitin we i aks fɔ. Di kiŋ na Asiria aks Ɛzikaya fɔ gi am tɛn tawzin kilo silva ɛn wan tawzin kilo gold.
Ɛzikaya gi am ɔl di gold ɛn silva dɛn we bin de na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn insɛf yon os.
Dɔn igen Ɛzikaya pul ɔl di gold we i bin dɔn put na di do dɛn ɛn dɛn frem na PAPA GƆD in os, ɛn gi ɔl to di kiŋ na Asiria.

Di kiŋ na Asiria tɛl in ami kɔmanda wit di chif ɔfisa ɛn di fil kɔmanda se lɛ dɛn lɛf Lakish wit wan bataliɔn fɔ go na Jerusɛlɛm to Kiŋ Ɛzikaya. Dɛn ɔl lɛf fɔ go. Wɛn dɛn rich, dɛn telem na di jɔnkshɔn usay dɛn wan we de mek klos de wok, nia usay wata kin de gɛda.
Dɛn sɛn kɔl di kiŋ, na Ikayakim we na Ilkaya di administretɔ in bɔypikin wit Shɛbna we na di sɛktri ɛn Esaf in bɔypikin we na Joa we na klak, na dɛn go mit dɛn.
Di fil kɔmanda gi dɛn mɛsej fɔ di kiŋ. I se, “Dis na wɔd we kɔmɔt frɔm di gret kiŋ, di kiŋ na Asiria. Na wetin una gɛt we de lift una ɔp we mek una de blɔf so?
Una de blɔf se una gɛt ɔlkayn militri tatiks ɛn wɛpɔn; na big tɔk nɔmɔ una gɛt. Na udat una abop pan ba we mek una tɔn rebɛl pan mi?

Una luk nɔ, una se una abop pan Ijipt fɔ ɛp una, we a go se dɛn fiba brumtik, we if una nɔ kiaful i go brok na una an ɛn chuk una. Di kiŋ na Ijipt nɔ bɛtɛ, i tan lɛk una. Ɔl udat abop pan am na brumtik.
Ɛn if una tɛl mi sɛf se na PAPA GƆD una PAPA GƆD una abop pan, nɔto in ɔlta dɛn ɛn dɛn ay ples fɔ wɔship am na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm Ɛzikaya pwɛl, pwɛl?”
“Una kam mek agrimɛnt wit mi masta, we na di kiŋ na Asiria: a go gi una tu tawzin ɔs dɛn if una gɛt pipul dɛn fɔ rayd dɛn.
Una ɔl nɔ du sɛf fɔ chalenj wangren ɔfisa na Asiria bikɔs, na Ijipt una abop pan fɔ gi una karej ɛn di man dɛn we de rayd ɔs.
Dɔn igen una min se a go jɛs kam nɔmɔ fɔ kam pwɛl ya if nɔto PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se fɔ du dat? Na PAPA GƆD insɛf sɛf tɛl mi se lɛ a mach kam insay dis siti ɛn pwɛl am.”

Na de Ilayakim we na Ilkaya in bɔypikin ɛn Shɛbna ɛn Joa tɛl di fil kɔmanda se lɛ i tɔk to dɛn na Arameik bikɔs dɛn de ɔndastand da laŋwej de; dɛn se lɛ i nɔ tɔk to dɛn na Ibru bikɔs di pipul dɛn we tap oba di wɔl de yɛri wetin dɛn de tɔk.

Bɔt di kɔmanda aks dɛn se if dɛn fil se na to dɛn ɛn dɛn masta nɔmɔ di kiŋ sɛn am wit da mɛsej de. I se if dɛn nɔ fil se di mɛsej na fɔ dɛn ɔl wit di ɔda man dɛn we sidɔm pantap di wɔl we na dɛn ɔl go gɛt fɔ it dɛn shit ɛn drink dɛn pis.
Na de di kɔmanda tinap ɛn tɔk lawd wan na Ibru se, “Una lisin to di gret kiŋ, di kiŋ na Asiria!
“Dis na di kiŋ na Asiria de tɔk: Una nɔ mek Ɛzikaya ful una. I nɔ go ebul pul una na mi an.
Una nɔ lɛ Ɛzikaya mek una chenj una maynd fɔ trɔs pan PAPA GƆD we i de tɛl una se PAPA GƆD go mɔs pul una na di kiŋ in an, i nɔ go mek di kiŋ na Asiria kapchɔ di siti.
Una nɔ lisin to Ɛzikaya o! Mi di kiŋ na Asiria de tɛl una naw se mek una mek pis wit mi ɛn jɔyn mi. If una du dat ɔlman go it di frut we in vayn tik ɛn fig tik de bia ɛn drink wata nain yon wɛl,

te a go kam kam pul una kɔmɔt de kɛr una na land we tan lɛk una yon, land we gɛt bɔku it, nyu wayn, bred, vayn gadin, land we gɛt ɔliv tik dɛn ɛn ɔni. Una pik layf, una nɔ pik fɔ day!” “Una nɔ lisin to Ɛzikaya bikɔs na ful i de mek una we i de tɛl una se PAPA GƆD go sev una.
Ɛni kɔntri de na wɔl we in gɔd dɔn sev da kɔntri de na di kiŋ na Asiria in an?
We di gɔd dɛn we na dɛn Amath ɛn Apad de wɔship? We di gɔd dɛn we na dɛn Sɛfavaim, Ena ɛn Iva de wɔship? Dɛn bin ebul pul Sameria kɔmɔt na mi an we a ɔndaswɛt dɛn?
Uswan pan ɔl dɛn gɔd dɛn na dɛn kɔntri dɛn de dɔn ebul fɔ pul in kɔntri na mi an? Wetin mek una tink se PAPA GƆD go ebul pul Jerusɛlɛm kɔmɔt na mi an?”
Kiŋ Ɛzikaya bin dɔn tɛl di pipul dɛn se lɛ dɛn nɔ ansa wan wɔd, so dɛnsɛf nɔ se fiŋ.

Ilkaya in bɔypikin we na di administretɔ na di kiŋ in os in bɔypikin we na Ilayakim wit Shɛbna we na sɛktri ɛn Joa we na Esaf we de rayt in bɔypikin go to Kiŋ Ɛzikaya wit chɛr-chɛr klos ɛn tɛl am ɔl wetin di fil kɔmanda na Asiria se.
Wɛn Kiŋ Ɛzikaya yɛri wetin di man dɛn se, i chɛr in klos ɛn wɛr saklɔth, dɔn i go insay PAPA GƆD in os.
I mek Ilayakim we na di kiŋ in administretɔ wit Shɛbna we na sɛktri ɛn di bigman dɛn pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin wɛr saklɔth, ɛn sɛn dɛn to Prɔfɛt Ayzaya we na Emɔz in bɔypikin.
Dɛn tɛl Ayzaya se Ɛzikaya se da de de na de wit waala, shem ɛn disgres, we tan lɛk we uman wan bɔn, dɔn i nɔ ebul fɔ bɔn.

Dɛn se sɔntɛm Ayzaya in Gɔd, we na PAPA GƆD dɔn yɛri ɔl di wɔd we di kiŋ na Asiria in fil kɔmanda dɔn wes pan PAPA GƆD ɛn provok am, ɛn so PAPA GƆD go dil wit am fɔ dat, dɔn lɛ i pre fɔ di wan dɛn we lɛf naw pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Wɛn Kiŋ Ɛzikaya in ɔfisa dɛn rich to Ayzaya,
i tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn tɛl di kiŋ se PAPA GƆD se lɛ i nɔ fred, lɛ i nɔ yɛk sɛf, pan ɔl we di kiŋ na Asiria in bɔbɔ dɔn tɔk bad bɔt am.
I se PAPA GƆD se in go put wan kanaba spirit pan am we go mek di wantɛm nyuz we i go yɛri, na dat go mek i rɔn go bak nain kɔntri we na de dɛn de go kil am.
Wɛn di fil kɔmanda yɛri se di kiŋ na Asiria dɔn kɔmɔt na Lakish ɛn de fɛt Libna, i go mit am de.
Wɔd rich Sɛnakarib se Kiŋ Tiraka da Kushayt kiŋ na Ijipt dɔn mach in ami fɔ go fɛt am. Wɛn i yɛri dis kayn mɛsej, i sɛn go bak to Kiŋ Ɛzikaya na Juda se,
lɛ i nɔ abop pan di gɔd we de mek am ful se Jerusɛlɛm nɔ go fɔdɔm na di kiŋ na Asiria in trap bikɔs in no se
Ɛzikaya fɔ dɔn yɛri bɔt ɔl wetin dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Asiria dɔn de du to ɔl dɛn ɔda kɔntri dɛn, we dɛn dɔn nyamanyama dɛn kpatakpata; ɛn if in fil se in go ebul kɔmɔt nain an.
I se if di gɔd dɛn we dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn de sav bin ebul fɔ pul di kɔntri dɛn nain fɔstɛm-papa dɛn an dat na di gɔd dɛn na Gozan, Aran, Rɛzɛf ɛn dɛn pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt Idɛn we bin de na Tɛl Asa.
I se usay di kiŋ dɛn fɔ Amath, Apad, Sɛfavaim, Ɛna ɛn Iva dɛn bin de.
We Ɛzikaya gɛt di kiŋ in lɛta, i rid am dɔn i kɛr am go na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn le am bifo PAPA GƆD.
Dɔn i pre to PAPA GƆD se, “E PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl in PAPA GƆD, yu de ay wan midul dɛn Chɛryubim. Na yu wangren na PAPA GƆD pantap ɔl dɛn kindɔm na wɔl, na yu mek ɛvin ɛn ath.
PAPA GƆD duya opin yu yes ɛn lisin; PAPA GƆD duya, opin yu yay lɛ yu si; luk wetin Sɛnakarib dɔn rayt we i kɔs yu, yu we na PAPA GƆD we gɛt layf.
PAPA GƆD, na tru se di Asirian dɛn dɔn dɔnawe kpatakpata wit dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn,
dɛn dɔn trowe dɛn gɔd dɛn na faya ɛn bɔn dɛn, bɔt infakt sɛf nɔto gɔd dɛn na ɛmti tik ɛn ston we na mɔtalman an dɛn tek mek dɛn.
Duya PAPA GƆD, yu na wi PAPA GƆD, pul wi nain an fɔ lɛ ɔl dɛn kindɔm na wɔl go no se na yu wangren nɔmɔ PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD.”
Emɔz in bɔypikin we na Ayzaya sɛn mɛsej to Ɛzikaya. I se, “Dis na wetin PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl in PAPA GƆD se. I se in dɔn yɛri yu prea kɔnsanin Kiŋ Sɛnakarib na Asiria,
so na dis i gɛt fɔ se bɔt am; Sɛnakarib, di yɔŋgyal dɛn na Zayɔn de laf yu ɛn provok yu, di uman dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm de laf yu we yu de rɔn.
Na udat yu tink se yu de kɔs ɛn fityay? Na udat yu tink se yu de tɔk bad bɔt ɛn de kak pan? Na pan mi we na Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD?

Yu sɛn mɛsenja dɛn fɔ fityay mi, dɔn yu de blɔf se yu dɔn yuz yu karej dɛn fɔ go ɔp ɔp dɛn ay ay mawnten dɛn fa fa insay Libanɔn; A dɔn kɔt ɔl dɛn laŋa timba tik dɛn di fayn fayn sayprɛs dɛn; A go insay insay di tik tik fɔrɛst.
Yu de se yu dɔn dig wɛl dɛn, ɛn drink di wata we de de, yu ami dɔn mas mas di wata dɛn na Ijipt ɛn mek ɔl di wata de dray.”
Yu nɔ bin dɔn yɛri yet ɛn? Lɔntɛm nain a dɔn plan dat fɔ bi. Na mi se na so i fɔ bi, fɔ lɛ yu nyakanyaka di kɔntri to grabul ɛn na so i bi.
Di pipul dɛn nɔ ebul shek; dɛn bin jɛs damu ɛn mumu. Dɛn bin tan lɛk gras we de gro na bush, ɔ dɛn gras we de gro pantap ruf we san kin bɔn am bifo i de bigin fɔ gro.
“Natin nɔ de we a nɔ no bɔt yu, aw yu de go ɛn kam, a no se yu de agens mi.
Fɔseka we yu dɔn tɔn pan mi, ɛn de kak pantap dat, a go put uk na yu nos ɛn rop na yu mɔt lɛkɛ aw dɛn kin du ɔs, ɛn mek yu go bak usay yu kɔmɔt.”

Na de Ayzaya tɛl Kiŋ Ɛzikaya se i gɛt fɔ si wan sayn. Di sayn na da ia de i go it wetin bɔs na grɔn fɔ insɛf di nɛks ia na wetin lɛf pan di tin dɛn we bin bɔs i go it; dɔn di ɔda ia i go plant ɛn avɛst kɔn, vayn ɛn grep we i go it.
I se di pipul dɛn we lɛf na Juda go frɛsh lɛkɛ nyu plant we in rut de go dɔŋ ɛn bia frut.
I se PAPA GƆD go mek pipul dɛn de na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Mawnt Zayɔn.
Ayzaya se PAPA GƆD se, as fɔ di Kiŋ na Asiria, i nɔ go mas in fut sɛf na di siti ɔ shut wan aro de. I se nɔn sojaman sɛf we gɛt big shild nɔ go go nia de ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go le ambush rawnd am.
PAPA GƆD se di kiŋ na Asiria go yuz di sem rod we i tek kam go bak, ɛn i nɔ go nia di siti. I se wetin in dɔn tɔk go bi.
PAPA GƆD se fɔ in yon sek ɛn fɔseka in savant Devid, in go fɛt fɔ di siti ɛn protɛkt am.
Da vɛri nɛt de PAPA GƆD in enjɛl go na di Asirian dɛn kamp ɛn kil wan ɔndrɛd ɛn eti-fayv tawzin man dɛn. Wɛn pipul dɛn wek na mɔnin, na soso dedebɔdi dɛn dɛn si.
So Kiŋ Sɛnakarib na Asiria tɔn bak go na Ninivɛ ɛn tap de.

Wande we i de nain gɔd Nisrɔk in os de wɔship am, in bɔypikin dɛn dat na Adramɛlɛk ɛn Sharɛza go mit am de kil am wit sɔd, dɔn dɛn rɔnawe go na Ararat. In ɔda bɔypikin we nem Ɛzaadɔn tek in ples ɛn bi kiŋ.
Da tɛm de Kiŋ Ɛzikaya sik bad bad wan ɛn want fɔ day. Prɔfɛt Ayzaya we na Emɔz in bɔypikin go mit am ɛn tɛl am se PAPA GƆD se lɛ i mek shɔ se i du ɔl wetin i fɔ du wantɛm bikɔs i nɔ go wɛl, i go day.
Ɛzikaya tɔn in fes to di wɔl ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD se,
“E PAPA GƆD, duya mɛmba ɔl wetin a dɔn du ɛn aw a dɔn waka tret wit yu wit ɔl mi at ɛn na wetin rayt bifo yu yay a bin de du.” Ɛzikaya kray bita bita wan.
Bifo Ayzaya de lɛf di kiŋ in os, PAPA GƆD kɔl am bak ɛn tɔk to am se,

“Go bak go tɛl Ɛzikaya we de lid mi pipul dɛn se, mi PAPA GƆD we nain Papa Devid in PAPA GƆD se, a dɔn yɛri in prea ɛn si di kray we i kray, so a go mek i wɛl. Tri de frɔm tide, lɛ i grap go ɔp na mi os.
A go gi am fiftin ia mɔ fɔ liv. A go sev in ɛn dis siti. Di kiŋ na Asiria nɔ go ebul du am natin. Na fɔ Devid in sek ɛn mi yon sek mek a de protɛkt di siti.”
Ayzaya tɛl di wokman dɛn we bin de atɛnd to di kiŋ se lɛ dɛn tek fig lif, rɔb rɔb am ɛn put am pan di kiŋ in bwɛl fɔ lɛ i go wɛl.
Ɛzikaya bin dɔn aks Ayzaya fɔ tɛl am uskayn sayn in go si fɔ lɛ i no se PAPA GƆD go mek i wɛl ɛn dat tri de frɔm da de de i go ebul fɔ go ɔp na PAPA GƆD in os.
Ayzaya tɛl am se na dis kayn sayn i go si we PAPA GƆD go sho am fɔ lɛ i no se i go du wetin i dɔn prɔmis: “I se if Ɛzikaya want di shado fɔ go bifo tɛn stɛp ɔ go biɛn tɛn stɛp.
Ɛzikaya ansa se i izi fɔ lɛ shado go bifo tɛn stɛp, so lɛ i go biɛn tɛn stɛp.
So Ayzaya pre to PAPA GƆD, ɛn papa GƆD mek di shado go biɛn tɛn stɛp na di stɛp we Kiŋ Eaz bin bil.
Da sem tɛm de Kiŋ Mɛlodak Baladan na Babilɔn, we na Baladan in bɔypikin sɛn lɛta ɛn prɛzɛnt to Ɛzikaya we i yɛri se i nɔ wɛl.
Ɛzikaya gladi fɔ di trenja dɛn ɛn sho dɛn ɔl wetin i gɛt nain sto: di silva, gold, spays, pafyum wit ɔl in ams ɛn amyunishɔn. Natin nɔ de we Ɛzikaya gɛt we i nɔ sho dɛn.
Na de Prɔfɛt Ayzaya go mit Kiŋ Ɛzikaya ɛn aks am usay di man dɛn kɔmɔt ɛn wetin dɛn kam fɔ. Ɛzikaya ansa am se dɛn kɔmɔt fa ples na Babilɔn.
I aks am bak se we dɛn kam wetin dɛn si. I ansa am se dɛn si ɔltin nain os, ɛn natin nɔ de pan in jɛntri we i nɔ sho dɛn.
Na de Ayzaya tɛl Ɛzikaya se, lɛ i lisin naw to wetin PAPA GƆD de tɔk.
I se tɛm go kam we dɛn go kɛr ɔl wetin de nain os ɛn ɔl wetin in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn bin dɔn kip go Babilɔn. I se PAPA GƆD se wan pin sɛf nɔ go lɛf.
I se dɛn go kech sɔm pan in fambul dɛn, dɛn pikin ɛn grampikin dɛn kɛr dɛn go Babilɔn. Dɛn go kastret di man dɛn ɛn mek dɛn de wok na di kiŋ in os na Babilɔn.
Ɛzikaya ansa am se wetin PAPA GƆD tɔk so fayn. I tink se wans in nɔ day yet dat nɔ go apin.

As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Ɛzikaya du, di wɔndaful tin dɛn we i du o, di rɛzɔvua we i mek fɔ kip wata, di tɔnɛl we i mek fɔ mek wata pas go insay di siti, ɔl rayt dɔŋ na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
Wɛn Ɛzikaya day nain bɔypikin Manasɛ bi di kiŋ.
Manasɛ bin ol twɛlv ia we i bi kiŋ na Juda ɛn i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ fifti-fayv ia. In mama nem Ɛpziba.
Na bad tin dɛn in du bifo PAPA GƆD in yay; i bin de falamakata dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn we PAPA GƆD bin drɛb kɔmɔt bifo di Izrɛlayt dɛn pan di bad we dɛn bin de du.

Dɛn ples dɛn we in papa Ɛzikaya bin brok we na de dɛn bin de wɔship lay lay gɔd, na dɛn in bil bak; i bil ɔlta fɔ de mek sakrifays to Beal, dɔn i mek da gɔd we nem Ashɛra in imej, jɛs lɛkɛ aw Kiŋ Eab na Izrɛl bin du. Pantap dat, i bin de wɔship di sta dɛn.
I bil ɔlta dɛn insay PAPA GƆD in os fɔ de wɔship lay lay gɔd, di ples we i dɔn se na de fɔ de wɔship am.
I bil ɔlta dɛn fɔ de wɔship di sta dɛn insay di kɔmpawnd na PAPA GƆD in os;
i tek in bɔypikin sakrifays am na faya, i bigin fɔ de lukgrɔn ple majik ɛn de ple wit ɔlkayn dɛbul. Di bad we i du so bɔku dat i mek PAPA GƆD vɛks bad bad wan.

I tek di Ashɛra pol we i mek put am insay Papa in os, ɛn PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɛl Devid ɛn in bɔypikin Sɔlɔmɔn se nainsay da os de na Jerusɛlɛm we in dɔn pik pan ɔl dɛn fambul dɛn na Izrɛl na de dɛn go de wɔship am sote go.

PAPA GƆD bin dɔn se in nɔ go mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn de wirɔn wirɔn igen ɛn kɔmɔt na di land we i dɔn gi dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn, if nɔmɔ dɛn tek tɛm du ɔl wetin i tɛl dɛn ɛn go akɔdin to di lɔ we in savant Mozis gi dɛn.
Di pipul dɛn nɔ lisin, bifo dat dɛn fala Manasɛ fɔ de du dɛn bad bad tin dɛn te dɛn du wetin pas di ɔda neshɔn dɛnsɛf bin dɔn du we mek PAPA GƆD drɛb dɛn kɔmɔt bifo di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
PAPA GƆD bin tɛl dɛn prɔfɛt we nain savant dɛn se,
Kiŋ Manasɛ na Juda dɔn du ɔl dɛn bad bad tin ya, ɛn i dɔn kɔmit sin pas di Amɔrayt dɛn we bin de bifo am, ɛn i dɔn mek Juda jɔyn am pan di bad we i mek di wanol kɔntri wɔship lay lay gɔd.
So, PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD fɔ Izrɛl se in go mek big big dombolo fɔdɔm na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda so dat ɛnibɔdi we yɛri in bɔtɔm bɛlɛ go bwɛl.

PAPA GƆD se in go dil wit Jerusɛlɛm lɛkɛ aw i dil wit Sameria we i pwɛl di siti kpatakpata wit Eab ɛn ɔl in jɛnareshɔn. I se wan pɔsin nɔ go lɛf na Jerusɛlɛm, in go klin Jerusɛlɛm lɛkɛ aw pɔsin de shayn plet ɛn tɔn am oba.
I se di wan dɛn we nɔ day in go mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn kech dɛn ɛn tek ɔl wetin dɛn gɛt,
bikɔs dɛn dɔn du bad bad tin; ɛn dɛn dɔn de fɛn in plaba frɔm di de we dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn lɛf Ijipt.
Fɔ ad pan di bad tin dɛn we Manasɛ bin de du, i shɛd inosɛnt blɔd ɛn de kil mɔtalman fitifata. I mek di wanol Jerusɛlɛm bin de smɛl blɔd, ɛn mek di kɔntri kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Manasɛ du, we i bin de rul, miks wit di bad bad tin dɛn we i du, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
Manasɛ day dɔn dɛn bɛr am na di gadin nain os, we Uza bin mek nain os. Dɔn in bɔypikin Emɔn bi di kiŋ.
Emɔn bin ol twɛnti-tu ia we i bi kiŋ, ɛn i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ tu ia. In mama nem Mɛshulɛmɛth we na Aruz in gyal pikin, ɛn na Jotba i kɔmɔt.
Emɔn insɛf du bad tin na PAPA GƆD in yay jɛs lɛkɛ aw in papa Manasɛ bin du.
Na soso in papa in futstɛp i fala; i wɔship di lay lay gɔd dɛn we in papa bin de wɔship.
I nɔ braskitul PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we i fɔstɛm-papa dɛn bin de wɔship, ɛn nɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se.
Emɔn in ɔfisa dɛn mek ku pan am ɛn kil am nain os.
Dɔn di pipul dɛnsɛf kil ɔl dɛn wan we bin mek ku pan Kiŋ Emɔn ɛn mek in bɔypikin Josaya kiŋ.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Emɔn du wɛn i bin de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
Dɛn bɛr am nain grev na di gadin we Uza bin mek. In pikin Josaya tek in ples ɛn bi di kiŋ.
Josaya bin ol et ia we i bi kiŋ ɛn i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ tati-wan ia. In mama nem Jɛdida, Adaya in gyal pikin, ɛn na Bozkath i kɔmɔt.
Josaya in du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay, ɛn du wetin in papa Devid bin de du; i nɔ bɛnbɛn pan natin.
Di ia we mek Josaya etin ia we i bi kiŋ, i sɛn in sɛktri we na Shafan, dat na Azalaya in bɔypikin, we Semweso na Mɛshulam in grampikin go na PAPA GƆD in os.
Josaya sɛn Shafan to Ilkaya we na di bigman pan dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na PAPA GƆD in os se, mek i rɛdi di mɔni we di getman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os gɛda na di pipul dɛn an,
ɛn an am ova to di man dɛn we dɛn bin dɔn pik fɔ supavays di wok na PAPA GƆD in os fɔ mek dɛn pe di wokman dɛn we de bil PAPA GƆD in os bak;
dat na di kapinta dɛn, di bilda dɛn ɛn di mesna dɛn. I se mek dɛn yuz di mɔni fɔ bay bod ɛn di ston dɛn we dɛn de yuz fɔ du di wok.
I se di supavaysɔ dɛn na ɔnɛs pipul dɛn so dɛn nɔ go nid fɔ tɔk bɔt aw dɛn yuz di mɔni.
Ilkaya tɛl Shafan se in fɛn di Buk we di Lɔ rayt pan insay PAPA GƆD in os. I gi Shafan di buk ɛn i rid am.
Dɔn Shafan go bak to di kiŋ go tɛl am se di ɔfisa dɛn dɔn gi di supavaysɔ dɛn ɛn di wokman dɛn di mɔni fɔ wok na PAPA GƆD in os.
I tɛl di kiŋ bak se Ilkaya we nain na di edman fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin gi am buk; so i rid wetin rayt na di buk to di kiŋ.
We di kiŋ yɛri wetin rayt na di Buk, i chɛr chɛr in klos.
I gi ɔda to Ilkaya we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, Aikam we na Shafan in bɔypikin, Akbɔ we na Maykaya in bɔypikin, Shafan we na sɛktri ɛn Asaya we nain de atɛnd to di kiŋ se,

lɛ dɛn go fɛnɔt to PAPA GƆD fɔ in ɛn di pipul dɛn ɛn ɔlman na Juda bɔt wetin rayt na di buk we dɛn fɛn. I se PAPA GƆD dɔn vɛks bad bad wan pan dɛn bikɔs dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn nɔ du wetin di buk se; i se dɛn nɔ de du wetin di buk se dɛn fɔ du.

So Ilkaya we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, Aikam, Akbɔ, Shafan ɛn Asaya go mit Prɔfɛtɛs Ɔlda we na Shalum in wɛf. Shalum na Tikva in bɔypikin, dɔn Tikva na Aras in bɔypikin. Na Aras bin de inchaj ɔf di rob dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os. Na di sɛkɛn distrikt na Jerusɛlɛm Ɔlda bin tap.
Ɔlda tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn tɛl di kiŋ se,
PAPA GƆD se in go briŋ dombolo kam na di ples ɛn pan ɔl di pipul dɛn we tap de, lɛkɛ aw i rayt na di buk we di kiŋ na Juda dɔn rid.
I se PAPA GƆD se bikɔs dɛn dɔn tɔn dɛn bak pan am ɛn bɔn insɛns to ɔda gɔd dɛn we na mɔtalman mek dɛn, in go vɛks pan dɛn ɛn da vɛks de nɔ go dɔn.
I se PAPA GƆD se lɛ dɛn tɛl di kiŋ na Juda we sɛn dɛn fɔ go fɛnɔt to am se, in PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship se,

bikɔs i put insɛf dɔŋ ɛn fil sɔri fɔ wetin bi we i yɛri ɔl wetin in di PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk bɔt di kɔntri ɛn di pipul dɛn, we i se i dɔn swɛ dɛn ɛn dɛn nɔ go bɛtɛ, ɛn fɔ we in di kiŋ chɛr chɛr in klos ɛn kray bifo am, in dɔn yɛri in prea.
I se wɛn i day na usay dɛn bɛr in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn dɛn go bɛr am ɛn dɛn go bɛr am fayn. I se i nɔ go si ɔl di dombolo we i dɔn se i go ib na di ples. Di man dɛn kɛr di prɔfɛtɛs in ansa go gi di kiŋ.
Kiŋ Josaya kɔl ɔl di lida dɛn na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm.

I gɛda ɔl di bigman dɛn na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin wit di prɔfɛt dɛn ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn big ɛn smɔl, ɛn kɛr dɛn ɔl go na PAPA GƆD in os. Na bifo dɛn yay i tinap rid lawd wan ɔl wetin rayt na di Kɔvinant Buk we dɛn fɛn na PAPA GƆD in os.

Di kiŋ tinap usay kiŋ fɔ tinap ɛn mek di Kɔvinant we bin de bitwin dɛn ɛn PAPA GƆD - dat na fɔ du wetin i se ɛn go akɔdin to ɔl wetin rayt na di buk wit dɛn at ɛn sol. Ɔlman gri se dɛn go go akɔdin to di Kɔvinant.

So Josaya gi ɔda to Ilkaya we na di edman fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di man dɛn we de nɛks to am wit di getman dɛn fɔ pul ɔl di tiŋs dɛn we dɛn mek fɔ wɔship Beal, Ashɛra ɛn di sta dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os. I gɛda ɔltin ɛn kɛr dɛn go biɛn di siti na Kidrɔn Vali ɛn bɔn dɛn de; dɔn i kɛr di ashis go na Bɛthɛl.
I sak ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays to lay lay gɔd we di fɔs kiŋ dɛn bin pik na Juda ɛn Jɛrusɛlɛm - dɛn wan dɛn we bin de bɔn insɛns to Beal, to di san, di mun, di planɛt ɛn di sta dɛn.
I pul di Ashɛra pol kɔmɔt na PAPA GƆD in os, kɛr am go dɔŋ na Kidrɔn Vali, bɔn am to ashis ɛn skata di ashis na di bɛriŋrɔn usay dɛn de bɛr dɛn ɔdinari mɔtalman.
I brok di kwata dɛn we dɛn plebɔy bin de; na dɛn kwata de dɛn uman bin de mek di klos we dɛn de yuz fɔ wɔship Ashɛra.

Josaya gɛda ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays to lay lay gɔd na Juda, briŋ dɛn kam na Jerusɛlɛm; i gɛda dɛn ɔda wan dɛn we bin de bɔn insɛns na Geba ɛn Biashiba ɛn pwɛl dɛn ɔlta dɛn we na de dɛn de mek sakrifays to dɛn gɔd dɛn nia da get we Gɔvna Jɔshwa bil, we de to di lɛfan pat fɔ go to di men get fɔ go insay di siti.
