Ivin we di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays to lay lay gɔd nɔ bin de wok na di ɔlta na Jerusɛlɛm, dɛn bin de it bred we nɔ gɛt yist wit dɛn ɔda man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
Josaya pwɛl pwɛl Tɔfɛt we na de dɛn bin de wɔship lay lay gɔd na Inɔm Vali fɔ lɛ nɔbɔdi nɔ go de sakrifays in pikin de igen na faya to Molɛk.

I pul ɔl dɛn ɔs we de na di domɔt fɔ go insay PAPA GƆD in os we dɛn fɔs kiŋ dɛn na Juda bin put de se, na fɔ wɔship di san, mek dɛn put dɛn de. I bɔn di karej dɛn we dɛn bin de yuz fɔ wɔship. Dɛn tiŋs ya bin de nia wan ɔfis we wan ɔfisa we nem Nethan Mɛlɛk de.

Josaya pul di ɔlta dɛn we di kiŋ dɛn na Juda bin dɔn bil pantap di ruf na Kiŋ Eab in kwata ɛn brok brok dɛn, dɔn i pul di ɔda ɔlta dɛn we Kiŋ Manasɛ bil na PAPA GƆD in os; i smash dɛn ɔl pispis ɛn trowe dɛn na Kidrɔn Vali.

Josaya pwɛl di ɔlta dɛn we Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn bin bil na di ist pat na Jerusɛlɛm na Mawnt Ɔliv fɔ de wɔship da dɔti Ashtorɛt we dɛn Sidonian dɛn de wɔship ɛn da dɔti Kɛmɔsh we dɛn Moabayt dɛn de wɔship ɛn di ɔda dɔti Molɛk we dɛn Amonayt dɛn de wɔship.
I brok brok ɔl dɛn ston pila ɛn dɛn imej we dɛn bil fɔ Ashɛra. I kɔba ɔl dɛn tin we i dɔn pwɛl wit mɔtalman bonbon.

Josaya pwɛl di ɔlta na Bɛthɛl we Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin bil fɔ de wɔship lay lay gɔd; na dis Jɛroboam bin mek Izrɛl kɔmit sin. I brok brok ɔltin pispis ɛn gren am to pawda. I bɔn Ashɛra in imej.

Wɛn i tɔn rawnd luk ɛn si se sɔm grev dɛn bin de pantap di il, i pul di bon dɛn we de insay de ɛn bɔn dɛn na di ɔlta fɔ mek di ɔlta insɛf dɔti. Ɔl dis bi lɛkɛ aw nɔmɔ di prɔfɛt bin dɔn tɔk se i go bi.
I si ɔda grev so i aks udat grev da wande bi. Dɛn ansa am se na di prɔfɛt we bin kɔmɔt Juda kam tɔk pan di ɔlta na Bɛthɛl ɛn ɔl wetin i dɔn du to di vɛri ɔlta.
I tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn nɔ tampa wit di prɔfɛt in bon dɛn, so di man dɛnsɛf lɛf di bon dɛn de; wan ɔda prɔfɛt we bin kɔmɔt Sameria insɛf yon bon dɛn bin de de.
Josaya pwɛl pwɛl ɔl di ɔda ples dɛn fɔ wɔship lay lay gɔd we dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl bin dɔn bil na di siti dɛn na Sameria lɛkɛ aw i du na Bɛthɛl, we na dɛn tin dɛn de bin mek PAPA GƆD vɛks bad bad wan.
Josaya kil ɔl di man dɛn we bin de mek sakrifays to lay lay gɔd pantap di ɔlta dɛn ɛn bɔn mɔtalman bon dɛn pantap dɛn, dɔn i tɔn bak go na Jerusɛlɛm.
Kiŋ Josaya gi ɔda to di pipul dɛn se lɛ dɛn sɛlibret di fɛstival fɔ mɛmba di tɛm we di enjɛl pas oba fɔ ɔna PAPA GƆD lɛkɛ aw dɛn rayt na di Kɔvinant Buk.
Di kayn fɛstival we dɛn sɛlibret, nɔn Kiŋ na Izrɛl ɔ Juda wande nɔ mek in kayn yet, ivin frɔm di tɛm we na dɛn jɔj dɛn bin de rul di kɔntri.
Na we Josaya dɔn etin ia na di chia dɛn sɛlibret di fɛstival fɔ mɛmba di tɛm we di enjɛl pas oba, ɛn na Jerusɛlɛm dɛn sɛlibret am.

Josaya, fɔ mek shɔ se in go akɔdin to wetin rayt na di Buk we di lɔ rayt pan we Ilkaya fɛn na PAPA GƆD in os, i pul ɔl dɛn wan we de lukgrɔn, we de ple wit mɛrɛsin ɛn majik ɛn mek dayman grap, dɛn wan we de tɔk bɔt wetin go gɛt fɔ bi, dɛn smɔl smɔl gɔd na os ɛn lay lay gɔd dɛn ɛn ɔl dɛn tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz fɔ wɔship lay lay gɔd. I mek shɔ se i klin di wanol Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda.
Nɔn kiŋ nɔ ɛva de we tan lɛk Josaya fɔ sav PAPA GƆD wit ɔl in at, sol ɛn trɛnk ɛn du wetin rayt na di Lɔ we PAPA GƆD gi Mozis, ɛn kiŋ nɔ ɛva kam afta am we tan lɛk am.
Pan ɔl wetin Josaya du PAPA GƆD bin stil vɛks bad bad wan pan Juda bikɔs ɔf wetin Manasɛ du;

so i se in go mɔs mek shɔ se in pul Juda kɔmɔt nain pozishɔn lɛ i nɔ de de igen lɛkɛ aw i du Izrɛl. PAPA GƆD se in nɔ go gɛt natin fɔ du wit Jerusɛlɛm ɛn di os we i dɔn pik se na de dɛn go de wɔship am.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Josaya du we i bin de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt dɔŋ na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
Di tɛm we Josaya bin stil bi kiŋ, Kiŋ Nɛko na Ijipt go na Riva Yufretis fɔ go ɛp di kiŋ na Asiria. Josaya mach go mit am fɔ fɛt bɔt Nɛko atak am ɛn kil am na Mɛgido.
Josaya in wokman dɛn put in dedebɔdi na karej kɛr am go Jerusɛlɛm ɛn bɛr am de nain yon grev. Di pipul dɛn mek Josaya in bɔypikin Jɛoaaz kiŋ nain papa in ples.
Jɛoaaz bin ol twɛnti-tri ia we i bin kiŋ ɛn i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ tri mɔnt. In mama na Amotal we na Jɛrimaya in gyal pikin, ɛn na Libna i kɔmɔt.
Jɛoaaz du wetin nɔ rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay jɛs lɛkɛ aw in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn bin du.
Kiŋ Nɛko put am na jel na Ribla na Amath fɔ lɛ i nɔ go rul na Jerusɛlɛm, dɔn i mek di siti de pe taks to am wit tri ɛn af tɔn silva ɛn sɛvinti-fayv pawns gold.
Kiŋ Nɛko mek Ilayakim, we na Josaya in bɔypikin kiŋ nain papa in ples, dɔn i chenj Ilayakim in nem to Jɛoyakim. I kɛr Jɛoaaz na Ijipt ɛn na de i go day.
Jɛoyakim bin de pe di gold ɛn silva taks we Kiŋ Nɛko aks fɔ. Fɔ lɛ i ebul pe dis taks, i mek ɔlman de pe taks fɔ in land, wit gold ɛn silva. Ɔlman bin gɛt in yon amawnt we i de pe.
Jɛoyakim bin ol twɛnti-fayv ia we i bi kiŋ ɛn i rul fɔ ilɛvin ia. In mama na Zɛbida we na Pɛdaya in gyal pikin, ɛn na Ruma i kɔmɔt.
Jɛoyakim insɛf du wetin nɔ rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay jɛs lɛkɛ in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn.
Di tɛm we Jɛoyakim bin de rul as kiŋ, Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza na Babilɔn go atak in kɔntri, ɛn mek Jɛoyakim de pe taks to am fɔ tri ia. Bɔt wande Jɛoyakim chenj in maynd ɛn nɔ gri pe.
PAPA GƆD sɛn di Babilonian dɛn, di Moabayt dɛn ɛn di Amonayt dɛn fɔ atak Juda ɛn pwɛl di siti. Ɔl dis bi fɔ lɛ wetin PAPA GƆD in prɔfɛt dɛn bin dɔn tɔk bi.
PAPA GƆD du ɔl dis to Juda bikɔs i bin dɔn tɔk se in go du dat bikɔs ɔf wetin Manasɛ du,
mɔ lɛk we i bin de shɛd inosɛnt blɔd. Manasɛ bin jɛs de kil pipul dɛn fitifata ɛn mek di wanol Jerusɛlɛm ful-ɔp wit blɔd; dat mek PAPA GƆD nɔ gri fɔgiv am.
As fɔ di ɔda tin dɛn we Jɛoyakim du we i de rul, dɛn ɔl rayt dɔŋ na di istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ na Juda.
Jɛoyakim day ɛn dɛn bɛr am, dɔn in bɔypikin Jɛoiakim tek in ples ɛn bi di kiŋ.

Di Kiŋ na Ijipt ɛn in sojaman dɛn nɔ kɔmɔt na Ijipt igen bikɔs na di kiŋ na Babilɔn naw bin de kɔntrol ɔl di eria we na Ijipt bin gɛt fɔs, dat na frɔm Riva Yufretis te rich di bɔda na di nɔth pat na Ijipt.
Jɛoiakim bin ol etin ia we i bi kiŋ ɛn na tri mɔnt i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ. In mama na Nɛshuta we na Ɛlnetan in gyal pikin, ɛn na Jerusɛlɛm i kɔmɔt.
Jɛoiakim insɛf du wetin nɔ rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay jɛs lɛkɛ in papa.
Na da tɛm de Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza na Babilɔn in sojaman dɛn sɔrawnd di siti,
ɛn na Nɛbyukadnɛza insɛf sɛf mach go insay di siti we in sojaman dɛn dɔn sɔrawnd am.
Kiŋ Jɛoiakim o, in mama o, in wokman dɛn o, in bigman dɛn o, ɛn ɔl in ɔfisa dɛn an dɛnsɛf oba to Nɛbyukadnɛza. Di ia we mek Nɛbyukadnɛza etin ia we i bi kiŋ na Babilɔn, na da ia de i kapchɔ Jɛoiakim.
Lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin dɔn se nɔmɔ, na so Nɛbyukadnɛza klia ɔl di dia tin dɛn we bin de na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn di kiŋ in os na Juda. I klia ɔl di gold we Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn bin put na PAPA GƆD in os.

Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza kech ɔlman na Jerusɛlɛm kɛr dɛn go na Babilɔn, di ɔfisa dɛn o, di sojaman dɛn o, wit di man dɛnsɛf we sabi mek ats ɛn kraft, na dɛn ɔl i kɛr go na Babilɔn. Na tɛn tawzin man i kɛr. Na dɛn po po wan dɛn nɔmɔ i lɛf na Jerusɛlɛm.
Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza arɛst Jɛoiakim ɛn mek am go as prizina na Babilɔn. I kɛr Jɛoiakim in mama, in wɛf dɛn, in ɔfisa dɛn ɛn di bigman dɛn na di kɔntri.
I kɛr sɛvin tawzin man dɛn we fit fɔ fɛt wa, ɛn wan tawzin man dɛn we sabi mek ats ɛn kraft.
Dɔn i mek Jɛoiakim in ɔnkul we nem Matanaya bi kiŋ na Juda. I chenj Matanaya in nem to Zɛdikaya.
Zɛdikaya bin ol twɛnti-wan ia we i bi kiŋ na Juda, ɛn i rul na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ ilɛvin ia. In mama na Amutal we na Jɛrimaya in gyal pikin ɛn na Libna i kɔmɔt.
Insɛf du wetin nɔ rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay lɛkɛ aw Jɛoyakim biev.
Na bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin vɛks mek i put dombolo na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda, dɔn faynali i push dɛn kɔmɔt nia am.

Zɛdikaya tɔn pan di Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza na Babilɔn. Wɛn Zɛdikaya dɔn bi kiŋ fɔ nayn ia, nain Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza mach in ami go insay Jerusɛlɛm. Dat bi di tɛn de na di tɛn mɔnt I sɔrawnd di wanol siti ɛn bil militri bes rawnd am.
Dis militri bes we Nɛbyukadnɛza mek rawnd Jerusɛlɛm bin de rawnd di siti te di ia we mek Zɛdikaya ilɛvin ia we i bi kiŋ.
Bay di tɛm we i de rich di nayn na di mɔnt we mek fɔ mɔnt na di ia, bad bad aŋri bin dɔn bigin mɔna di pipul dɛn ɛn natin nɔ bin de igen fɔ it.

So di sojaman dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm brok di wɔl rawnd di siti ɛn rɔnawe na nɛt pas tru di get we de midul di tu wɔl dɛn nia di kiŋ in gadin, ivin we di Babilonian dɛn bin dɔn sɔrawnd di siti. Dɛn rɔnawe go dɔŋ Araba,
bɔt di Babilonian dɛn rɔnata di kiŋ ɛn kech am nia Jɛriko; da tɛm de naw in sojaman dɛn ɔl bin dɔn rɔnawe lɛf am.
Dɛn kɛr am go to Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza na Ribla ɛn na de dɛn go sɛntɛns am.
Dɛn kil ɔl in bɔypikin dɛn korokoro wan bifo in yay. Dɛn pul in tu yay kɔmɔt, tay am wit chen ɛn kɛr am go Babilɔn.
Di de we mek sɛvin, insay di fayv mɔnt, na di ia we mek Nɛbyukadnɛza nayntin ia we i bi kiŋ na Babilɔn, na da de de Nɛbyuzaradan we na advaysa to di kiŋ ɛn kɔmanda fɔ di ami go Jerusɛlɛm.
I bɔn PAPA GƆD in os, di kiŋ in os ɛn ɔl di os dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm. I bɔn ɔl dɛn impɔtant bildin dɛn.
Kɔmanda Nɛbyuzaradan gi ɔda to di Babilɔn ami man dɛn fɔ brok di wɔl rawnd Jerusɛlɛm,
dɔn i kech ɔl di pipul dɛn we bin lɛf kɛr dɛn go Babilɔn. I kɛr ɔl dɛn ɔda wan dɛn we bin dɔn krɔs go fɔs oba to usay di kiŋ bin de.
Na di wan dɛn we yu go se na di popoliopo nɔmɔ, na dɛn i lɛf na Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn i lɛf dɛn wan dɛn de fɔ de plant greps ɛn de dig di grɔn fɔ plant.
Di Babilonian dɛn brok di bras pila dɛn, di stand we de muf ɛn di big bras tank we de insay PAPA GƆD in os ɛn kɛr ɔl di bras go Babilɔn.
Dɛn tek di pɔt dɛn, shɔbul, sizɔs fɔ trim wik, di dish dɛn ɛn ɔl di bras tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz na PAPA GƆD in os.
Di kɔmanda tek di insɛns pɔt dɛn ɛn di bol dɛn; ɛn ɔl di gold ɛn silva tiŋs dɛn;
di bras we bin de pan di tu pila dɛn, wit di bras stand ɛn bras tank dɛn we Sɔlɔmɔn bin mek fɔ PAPA GƆD in os. Di bras bin so bɔku dat nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul we dɛn.

Ich pila in ayt na twɛnti-sɛvin fut, ɛn di bras dizayn we bin de pantap wan pila, in ayt na fo ɛn af fut, dɔn dɛn dɛkɔret am wit bras pomigranet frut dizayn ɔl rawnd. Na di sem tin dɛn du to di ɔda wan.
Di kɔmanda kech Sɛraya we na di edman fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin wit in asistant we na Zaɛfinaya ɛn di tri getman dɛn.

Pan di wan dɛn we lɛf na di siti, i kech di ɔfisa we de inchaj ɔf di sojaman dɛn ɛn di fayv man dɛn we na advaysa to di kiŋ. I kech di sɛktri we nain na di chif ɔfisa we rɛspɔnsibul fɔ de kip rɛkɔd bɔt di militri ɛn siksti ɔda man dɛn.
Kɔmanda Nɛbyuzaradan kech ɔl dɛn pipul ya kɛr dɛn go to Nɛbyukadnɛza na Ribla.
Na Ribla we de na Amath di kiŋ gi ɔda se fɔ kil dɛn ɔl. Na so di pipul dɛn na Juda tek kɔmɔt na dɛn kɔntri go Ɛgzayl na Babilɔn.
Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza na Babilɔn pik Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin we semweso na Shafan in grampikin fɔ bi gɔvna fɔ di balans pipul dɛn we i lɛf na Juda.

Wɛn ɔl di ami ɔfisa ɛn dɛn man dɛn yɛri se na Gɛdalaya di kiŋ na Babilɔn dɔn mek bi gɔvna, dɛn gɛda go mit am na Mizpa. Di wan dɛn we go na Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin, Joanan we na Karia in bɔypikin, Sɛraya we na Tanumɛt in bɔypikin we na Nɛtofatayt, Jaazanaya we na Maakatayt, wit sɔm ɔda man dɛn.
Gɛdalaya swɛ to di man dɛn se nɔn rizin nɔ de fɔ lɛ dɛn fred di ɔfisa dɛn we kɔmɔt Babilɔn, ɛn if dɛn biev dɛnsɛf na di land ɛn du wetin di kiŋ na Babilɔn se, ɔltin go go fayn wit dɛn.

Bɔt insay di mɔnt we mek sɛvin mɔnt da vɛri ia de, Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin we semweso na Ilayshama in grampikin we kɔmɔt na kiŋ layn gɛda tɛn man dɛn ɛn mek ku. Dɛn kil Gɛdalaya wit di man dɛn we bin de na Juda ɛn di Babilonian dɛn we bin de na Mizpa.
Dis mek di balans pipul dɛn we lɛf frɔm big to smɔl fred di Babilonian dɛn ɛn rɔnawe wit di ɔda sojaman dɛn go Ijipt.

Di ia we mek Jɛoiakim tati-sɛvin ia we dɛn pul am as kiŋ na Juda, na da ia de Bad-Mɛrodak bi kiŋ na Babilɔn ɛn as i bi kiŋ so i pul Jɛoiakim kɔmɔt na Jel. Dis bi di de we mek twɛnti-sɛvin insay di mɔnt we mek twɛlv na di ia.
Bad-Mɛrodak tɔk fayn to Jɛoiakim ɛn ɔna am pas dɛn ɔda kiŋ we bin de jel wit am na Babilɔn.
Jɛoiakim chenj in jelman klos ɛn wɛr fayn klos. Di kiŋ mek i de it wit am te i day,
ɛn ɛvride i bin de gi am alawans fɔ lɛ i ebul bay in yon smɔl kpɛkpɛkpɛ.
Adam, Sɛt, Inɔsh;
Kenan, Maalalɛl, Jarɛd;
Ɛnɔk, Mɛtusila, Lamɛk;
Noa, Shɛm, Am ɛn Jafɛt.
Jafɛt in bɔypikin dɛm: Goma, Magɔg, Maday, Javan, Tubal, Mɛshɛk ɛn Tiras.
Goma in bɔypikin dɛm: Ashkɛnaz, Rifat ɛn Togama.
Javan in bɔypikin dɛm: Ilaysha, Spen, Sayprɔs ɛn Rods.
Am in bɔypikin dɛm: Kush, Ijipt, Libia ɛn Kenan.
Kush in bɔypikin dɛm: Sɛba, Avila, Sabta, Raama ɛn Sabtɛka. Raama in bɔypikin dɛm: Shiba ɛn Dedan.
Kush na bin Nimrɔd in papa; Nimrɔd na bin di fɔs traŋa sojaman na di wɔl.
Ijipt na bin papa fɔ Lidia, Anam, Lɛab, Naftɔ.
Patrɔs, Kaslɛɔ (we na de di Filistin dɛn kɔmɔt) ɛn Krit.
Kenan na bin Saydɔn in Papa; na bin in fɔs-bɔy-pikin. Di Ɔda wan dɛn na Et,
di Jɛbyusayt dɛm, di Amorayt dɛm, di Gagashayt dɛn,
di Ivayt dɛm, di Akayt dɛm, di Sinayt dɛn,
di Avadayt dɛm, di Zimarayt dɛm ɛn di Amatayt dɛm.
Shɛm in bɔy Pikin dɛm: Elam, Ashur Apakshad, Lud, Aram, Ɔz, Ɔl, Gɛta ɛn Mɛshɛk.
Apakshad na Shila in papa; ɛn Shila na bin Eba in papa.
Eba bin bɔn tu bɔypikin: di wan nem Pelɛg (bikɔs da tɛm de di wɔl bin sheb), ɛn in brɔda nem Joktan.
Na Joktna bin bɔn Almodad, Shɛlɛf, Azamavɛth, Jɛra,
Adoram, Uzal, Dikla
Ebal, Abimaɛl, Shiba,
Ofir, Avila ɛn Jobab; ɔl dɛn wan ya na bin Joktan in bɔypikin dɛm.
Shɛm, Apakshad, Shila;
Eba, Pelɛg, Reu;
Sɛrug, Naɔ, Tɛra; Ebram dat na,
Ebram, dat na Ebraam.
Ebraam in bɔypikin dɛm: Ayzak ɛn Ishmɛl.
Dis na dɛn nem bay aw dɛn bɔn. Ishmɛl in fɔs pikin na Nebayɔt; dɛn Keda, Adbeɛl, Midsam,
Mishma, Duma, Masa, Adad, Tɛma,
Jetɔ, Nafish ɛn Kɛdɛma. Na Ishmɛl in bɔypikin dɛn dɛnwanya.
Ketyura, we na Ebraam in kɔnkyubayn, in bɔypikin dɛm: I bɔn Zimran, Jokshan, Mɛdan, Midian, Ishbak ɛn Shua. Jokshan in bɔypikin dɛm: Shiba Dedan.
Midyan in bɔypikin dɛn: Efa, Ifa, Anɔk, Abida ɛn Ɛldaa. Na ɔl dɛn wan ya na Ketyura in jɛnareshɔn.
Ebraam na bin Ayzak in papa. Ayzak in bɔypikin dɛm: Isɔ ɛn Jekɔb.
Isɔ in bɔypikin dɛm: Ɛlifaz, Reuɛl, Jeush, Jalam ɛn Kora.
Ɛlifaz in bɔypikin dɛm: Teman, Oma, Zɛfi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna ɛn Amalɛk.
Reuɛl in bɔypikin dɛm: Naath, Zɛra, Shama ɛn Miza.
Sɛir in bɔypikin dɛn: Lotan, Shobal, Zibiɔn, Ana, Dishɔn, Ɛzea ɛn Dishan.
Lotan in bɔypikin dɛm: Ori ɛn Omam; ɛn Lotan in sista na Timna
Shobal in bɔypikin dɛm: Alvan, Manaat, Ebal, Shɛfi ɛn Onam. Zibiɔn in bɔypikin dɛm: Aia ɛn Ana.
Anain bɔypikin dɛm: Dishɔn. Dishɔn in bɔypikin dɛm: Amran, Ɛshban, Itran ɛn Chɛran.
Ɛza in bɔypikin dɛm: Bilan, Zaavan ɛn Jaakan. Dishan in bɔypikin dɛn: Ɛz ɛn Aran.
Dɛn wan ya na di kiŋ dɛm we bin rul na Idɔm bifo ɛni kiŋ rul di Izrɛlayt dɛm: Bɛla we na Biɔr in bɔypikin, we in yon siti nem Dinaba.
We Bɛla day, na Jobab we na Zira in bɔypikin we kɔmɔt Bozra, bin tek in ples
We Jobab day, na Usham we kɔmɔt na di Timanayt land, bin tek in ples.
We Usham day, na Adad we na Bedad in bɔypikin we bin bit Midian insay Moab, bin tek in ples. In yon siti bin nem Avit.
We Adad day, na Samla we kɔmɔt Masrɛka bin tek in ples.
We Samla day, na Shaul we kɔmɔt Rɛobɔt to di Yufretis, bin tek in ples.
We Shaul day, na Baal Anan, we na Akbɔ in bɔypikin, bin tek in ples
We Baal Anan day, na Adad bin tek in ples. In yon siti na bin Pawa ɛn in wɛf bin nem Mɛɛtabɛl. In mama na bin Matrɛd. In grani na bin Mezaab.
So Adad day. Idɔm dɛm chif dɛn na bin chif. Di chif dɛn na Idɔm na bin, Chif Timna, Chif Alia, Chif Jɛtɛh,
Chif Oholibama, Chif Ila, Chif Pinɔn,
Chif Kenz, Chif Teman, Chif Mibza,
Chif Magdiyɛl ɛn Chif Iram; na dɛm na di chif dɛm na Idɔm.
Dɛn wan ya na Izrɛl in bɔypikin dɛm: Rubɛn, Simiɔn; Livay, Juda, Isaka, Zɛbyulɔn,
Dan, Josɛf, Bɛnjamin, Naftali, Gad ɛn Asha.
Juda in bɔypikin dɛm: A, Onan ɛn Shila; na dɛn tri Batshua, we na wan Kenanayt uman, bin bɔn fɔ am. A, we na Juda in fɔst bɔypikin, bin wikɛd na PAPA GƆD in yay, so i kil am.
In dɔtɛnlɔ Tama insɛf bin bɔn Pɛrɛz ɛn Zera fɔ am. Juda gɛt fayv bɔypikin ɔltogɛda.
Pɛrɛz in bɔypikin dɛn: Ɛzrɔn ɛn Amul.
Zera in bɔypikin dɛm: Zimri, Itan; Ɛman, Kalkɔl ɛn Dada. Na bin dɛn fayv.
Kami in bɔypikin dɛn: Ekan we na di pɔsin we briŋ trɔbul na Izrɛl, we i bin tek di tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD bin se fɔ bɔn.
Ɛtan in bɔypikin na Azaraya.
Ɛzrɔn in bɔypikin dɛn we i bɔn: Jɛramil, Ram ɛn Kelɛb.
Ram na bin Aminadab in papa ɛn Aminadad na bin Nashɔn we na bin di bigman na Juda, in papa.
Nashɔn na Salmɔn in papa. Salmɔn na Boaz in yon papa.
Boaz na Obɛd in yon papa. Obɛd na Jɛsi yon papa.
Jɛsi na Ɛliab in papa ɛn Ɛliab nain fɔs pikin. Abinadab na di sɛkɛn wan. Shama na di tɔd wan.
Netanɛl na di nɔmba fo pikin ɛn Radai na bin di nɔmba fayv.
Ozɛm na di nɔmba siks ɛn Devid, di nɔmba sɛvin.
Dɛn sista dɛm na Zeruaya ɛn Abigɛl. Zeruaya in bɔypikin dɛm na Abishay, Joab ɛn Asaɛl; na bin dɛn tri.
Abigɛl bɔn Amasa ɛn Amasa in papa na bin Jɛta we na bin Ishmɛlayt.
Kelɛb we na Ɛzrɔn in bɔypikin bin gɛt pikin dɛn wit in wɛf we nem Azuba ɛn wit Jɛriɔt; Azuba in bɔypikin dɛn na Jɛsha, Shobab ɛn Adɔn.
We Azuba day Kelɛb mared Efrat we bɔn Ɔ fɔr am.
Ɔ na Yuri in papa ɛn Yuri na Bɛzalɛl in papa.
Afta sɔntɛm, Ezrɔn lidɔm wit Maki we na Giliad in papa, in gyal pikin, we i bin mared wɛn i bin ol siksti ia; ɛn i bɔn Segub fɔ am.
Segub na na bin Jair in papa we bin gɛt twɛnti tri siti na Giliad.
Bɔt Geshɔ ɛn Aram tek Avɔt jair, kɛnat ɛn ɔl in vilej dɛm ɛn siksti siti. Ɔl dɛn wan ya na Maki we na Giliad in papa, in Jenareshɔn.
We Ɛzrɔn day, Kelɛb lidɔm wit Efrata we na bin in Papa Ɛzrɔn in wɛf, ɛn i bɔn Ashur, we na Tekoa in papa.
Jɛramil we na Ɛzrɔn in fɔs-bɔy-pikin, in yon bɔypikin dɛm: Ram na di fɔs wan, dɛn Buna, Ɔrɛn, Ɔzɛm ɛn Aija.
Jɛramil bin gɛt ɔda wɛf we nem Atara; na im na Onam in mama
Ram we na Jɛramil in fɔs-bɔy-pikin, in yon bɔypikin dɛm: Maaz, Jamin ɛn Ɛke.
Onam in bɔypikin dɛm: Shamay ɛn Jada. Shamay in bɔypikin dɛn: Nadab ɛn Abishɔ.
Abishɔ in wɛf bin nem Abiail ɛn i bɔn Aban ɛn Molid fɔ am.
Nadab in bɔypikin dɛn: Sɛlɛd ɛn Apaim; Sɛlɛd day I nɔ bɔn pikin.
Apayim in bɔypikin dɛm: Ishi. Ishi in bɔypikin dɛn: Shɛshan. Shɛshan in bɔypikin dɛn: Alai
Jada we na Shamay in brɔda in bɔypikin dɛm: Jɛta ɛn Jonɛthan: ɛn Jɛta day i nɔ bɔn pikin.
Jonɛthan in bɔypikin dɛm: Pɛlɛt ɛn Zaza. Na dɛn wan ya na Jɛramil in Jenareshɔn.
Naw Sheshan nɔ gɛt bɔypikin; na so so gyal pikin i bɔn. Bɔt Shɛshan bin gɛt wan slev we na bin Ijipshian. I bin nem Jara.
So Sheshan gi in gyal pikin to Jara we nain slev, mek i go mared am; i bɔn Atai fɔ am.
Atai na bin Netan in papa ɛn Netan na bin Zabad in yon papa.
Zabad na bin Eflal in papa ɛn Ɛflal na bin Obɛd yon papa.
Obɛd na bin Jɛu in papa ɛn Jɛu na bin Azaraya yon.
Azaraya na bin Ɛlɛz in papa ɛn Ɛlɛz na bin Ɛliesa yon papa.
Ɛliesa na bin Sismai in papa ɛn Sismai na bin Shalum yon papa.
Shalum na bin Jɛkamia in papa ɛn Jɛkamia na bin Ilayshama yon papa.
Kelɛb we na Jɛramil in brɔda in bɔypikin dɛm: Mɛsha we na Zif in papa na di fɔs bɔn. Marɛsha in bɔypikin dɛm: Ɛbrɔn.
Ɛbrɔn in bɔypikin dɛm: Kora, Tapua, Rɛkɛm ɛn Shɛma.
Shɛma, na bin Raam we na Jɔkɛam in yon papa, in Papa.
Shamay in bɔypikin. Maɔn; ɛn Maɔn na bin Bɛtzɔ in Papa.
Ɛfa sɛf we na Kelɛb in switat bin bɔn Aran, Moza ɛn Gazɛz; ɛn Ɛran na bin Gazɛz in papa.
Jadai in bɔypikin dɛn: Rɛgɛm, Jotam, Geshan, Pɛlɛt, Ɛfa ɛn Shaaf.
Maka we na Kelɛb in kɔnkyubayn bɔn Shiba ɛn Tirana.
Igen i bɔn Shaaf we na Madmanain papa, Shiva we na Makbɛna ɛn Gibɛa dɛn papa. Kelɛb in gyal pikin na bin Aksa.
Na Kelɛb in Jɛnareshɔn dɛn wan ya. Ɔ we na Ɛfrata in fɔs pikin: Shobal we na Kriat Jiarim in papa.
Salma we na Bɛtliɛm in papa, ɛn Araf we na Bɛtgada in papa.
Shobal we na Kiriat Jɛarim in papa bin gɛt ɔda bɔypikin dɛm: Aroɛ ɛn af pan di pipul dɛn na Mɛnuɔt.
Kiriat Jiarim in fambul dɛm: Di Itrayt dɛm, di Pushayt dɛm, di Shunamayt dɛm ɛn di Mishrayt dɛm; Na pan dɛn wan ya yu gɛt di Zoratayt dɛm ɛn Ɛshtaolayt dɛm.
Salma in bɔypikin dɛm: Bɛtliɛm, di Nɛtofatayt dɛm, Atrɔ Bɛt Joab, ɛn af pan di Mantayt ɛn di Zorayt dɛm.
Di wan dɛn we bin de rayt, dɛn yon fambul dɛn we tap na Jabɛz: De Tiratayt dɛm, di Shimɛatayt dɛm ɛn di Sukatayt dɛm. Dɛnwanya na di Kenayt dɛm we kɔmɔt Hamat we na di papa fɔ di Rekab fambul.
Dɛn wan ya na Devid in bɔypikin dɛn we i bɔn na Ɛbrɔn: di fɔs wan na Amnɔn we Ainoam we kɔmɔt Jɛzril bɔn. Di Sɛkɛn wan na Daniɛl we Abigɛl we kɔmɔt Kamɛl bɔn.
Di tɔd wan na Absalɔm; in yon mama na Maaka we na Talmay, kiŋ na Geshur in gyal pikin. Di nɔmba fo pikin na Adonayja we in yon mama na Agit.
Di nɔmba fayv pikin na shefataya we Abital bɔn; di nɔmba siks pikin na Itrɛam we nain wɛf, Ɛgla bɔn.
I bɔn siks pikin na Ɛbrɔn usay i bi kiŋ fɔ sɛvin ia ɛn siks mɔnt. I bi kiŋ na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ tati tri ia.
Na dɛn wan ya i bɔn na Jerusɛlɛm: Shimɛa, Shobab, Netan ɛn Sɔlɔmɔn; na Batshiba we na Amiɛl in gyal pikin, bɔn dɛn fo ya.
Dɔn yu gɛt, Iba, Elishua, Elpɛlɛt,
Nɔga, Nɛfɛg, Jafia,
Elishama, Eliada ɛn Elifɛlɛt; nayn pikin.
Ɔl dɛn wan ya na Devid in bɔypikin dɛn apat frɔm di bɔypikin dɛm we in kɔnkyubayn dɛn bɔn. Tama na bin dɛn sista.
Sɔlɔmɔn in Jɛnareshɔn: Rɛoboam, in bɔypikin Abija, in bɔypikin Asa, in bɔypikin Jɛoshafat,
in bɔypikin Jɛoram, in bɔypikin Aazia, in bɔypikin Joash,
in bɔypikin Amazaya, in bɔypikin Yuraya, in bɔypikin Jotam,
in bɔypikin Eaz, in bɔypikin Ɛzikaya, in bɔypikin Manasɛ,
in bɔypikin Amɔn, in bɔypikin Josaya.
Josaya in bɔypikin dɛm: Joanan we na di fɔs pikin, Jɛoiakim di sɛkɛn wan Zɛdikaya di tɔd wan ɛn Joaaz we na di nɔmba fo.
Jɛoiakim in Jɛnareshɔn: in bɔypikin Jɛoiachin ɛn in bɔypikin Zɛdikaya.
Jɛoiachin we dɛn kapchɔ in bɔypikin dɛm: In bɔypikin Shɛaltiɛl,
Malchiram, Pɛdaya, Shɛnaza, Jekamaya, Oshama ɛn Nɛdabia;
Pɛdaya in yon bɔypikin dɛm: Zerubabɛl ɛn Shimɛi; ɛn Zerubabɛl in bɔypikin dɛm: Meshulam ɛn Ananaya, ɛn Shelomit na bin dɛn sista;
Ɛn Ashuba, Oɛl, Bɛrɛchia, Asadia ɛn Jushab Ɛsɛd; na dɛn fayv.
Ananaya in bɔypikin dɛm: Pɛlataya ɛn Jɛshaia. Jɛshaia in bɔypikin na Refaya. Refaya in bɔypikin na Anan. Anan in bɔypikin na Obadaya. Obadaya in yon bɔypikin na Shɛkanaya.
Shɛkanaya in bɔypikin dɛm: Shemaya. Ɛn Shemaya in bɔypikin dɛm na: Atush, Igal, Baria, Nɛaria ɛn Shafat; na dɛn siks.
Nɛaria in bɔypikin dɛm: Ɛlioenay, Izkia, ɛn Azrikam; na dɛn tri.
Ɛlioenay in bɔypikin dɛn: Odavia, Ɛliashib, Pɛlaya, Akub, Joanan Dilayla ɛn Anani; na dɛn sɛvin.
Juda in bɔypikin dɛm: Pɛrɛz, Ɛzrɔn, Kami, Ɔ ɛn Shobal.
Rɛaia we na bin Shobal in bɔypikin na bin Jeat in papa. Jeat in na bin Aumai ɛn Land dɛn yon papa. Na di Zora fambul dɛn dɛn wan ya.
Dɛn wan ya na Itam in bɔypikin dɛm: Jɛzril, Ishma, ɛn Idbash; dɛn sista bin nem Azɛlɛlponi,
ɛn Pɛnyuɛl na bin Gɛdɔ in papa, ɛn Ɛza na Usha yon papa. Dɛn wan ya na bin Ɔ in bɔypikin dɛn. Ɔ na Efrata we na Bɛtliɛm in papa, in yon fɔs pikin.
Ashur we na Tɛkoa in Papa bin gɛt tu wɛf Ɛla ɛn Naara.
Naara bɔn Auzam, Ɛfa, Tɛmɛni ɛn Aaashtari fɔ am. Dɛn wan ya na bin Naara in bɔypikin pikin dɛm.
Ɛla in bɔypikin dɛm: Zɛrɛt, Iza ɛn Ɛthan.
Kɔz na bin Anub ɛn Zobɛba dɛn papa. Na frɔm kɔz, Aarɛl we na Arum in bɔypikin, dɛn fambul dɛn ɔl kɔmɔt.
Jebɛz bin gɛt rɛspɛkt pas ɔl in brɔda dɛn; ɛn in mama bin gi am nem Jebɛz, we min se, “a bɔn am insay pen.”
Jebɛz bin pre to Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se “Duya blɛs mi, gi mi mɔ land ɛn kɔba mi mek natin bad nɔ mit mi” Ɛn PAPA GƆD bin gi am wetin i pre fɔ.
Kelɛb we na Shua in brɔda, na bin Meir we na Ɛshtin in papa, in yon Papa.
Ɛshtin na bin Bɛthrafa, Pasɛa ɛn Tɛina dɛn papa. Tɛinain na bin Naash in yon papa. Na di man dɛn dɛn wan ya we kɔmɔt Reka.
Kenaz in bɔypikin dɛm: Othniɛl ɛn Seraya; Othniyɛl in yon bɔypikin dɛm na Atat ɛn Mɛonotai.
Mɛonotai na bin Opra in Papa; Seraya in na bin Joab we na Gɛarashim in papa, in yon papa. Dɛn gi dɛn nem Gɛarashin we min ples we masta sabi wokman dɛn plɛnti, bikɔs dɛn sabi wok wit dɛn an.
Na Kelɛb we na Jɛfunɛ in bɔypikin, in yon bɔypikin dɛm dɛn wan ya: Iru, Ɛla ɛn Naam; Ɛla na bin Kɛnaz in yon papa.
Jɛalɛlɛl in bɔypikin dɛm: Zif, Zifa, Tiria ɛn Asarɛl.
Ɛzra in bɔypikin dɛm: Jɛta, Mɛrɛd, Ɛfa ɛn Jalɔn. Dɛn wan ya na Bitia we na Fero in gyal we bin mared to Mɛrɛd in yon bɔypikin dɛn. I gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn Miriam, Shamay ɛn Ishba we na Ɛshtɛmoa in papa.
Nain wɛf we na ju bin bɔn Jɛrɛd we na Gɛdɔpapai, Eba we na Sɔkɔ in papa ɛn Jɛkutiɛl we na Zanoa in yon papa.
Odaia in wɛf we na Naam in sista, in bɔypikin dɛm na papa dɛn fɔ Kɛila we na Gadayt ɛn Ɛshtɛmoa we na Maakatayt.
Shimɔn in bɔypikin dɛm: Amnɔn, Rina, Bɛnanan ɛn Tilɔn. Ishi in bɔypikin dɛm: Zoɛt ɛn Bɛnzoɛt.
Shela we Juda in bɔypikin, in yon bɔypikin dɛm: Ɛr we na Lɛka in papa, Land we na Marɛsha in papa ɛn di fambul dɛn we dɛn wok na fɔ mek linin na Bɛth Ashbɛa;
ɛn Jokim, ɛn di man dɛm na Kozɛba, ɛn Joash ɛn Saraf we bin de rul Moan ɛn bin tɔn bak go Bɛtliɛm.
Dɛn wan ya na di wan dɛn we de wok wit kle ɛn di wan dɛn we tap na Nɛtaim ɛn Gɛdɛra; dɛn bin tap de wit di kiŋ fɔseka in wok.
Simiɔn in bɔypikin dɛm: Nɛmuɛl, Jamin, Jarib, Zɛra ɛn Shaul.
Shalum na bin Shaul in bɔypikin, Mibsam na bin Salum in bɔypikin, Mishma na bin Mibsam in yon bɔypikin.
Mishma in bɔypikin dɛm: Amuɛl, Amuɛl in bɔypikin we na Zakɔ ɛn Shimɛi we na Zakɔ in bɔypikin.
Shimɛi bin gɛt sikstin bɔypikin ɛn siks gyal pikin, bɔt in brɔda dɛn nɔ bin gɛt plɛnti pikin dɛm, ɛn nɔto ɔl dɛn fambul dɛm bin bɔn lɛk di man dɛn na Juda.
Dɛn wan ya bin tap na Biashiba, Molada, Azashual,
Bila, Ezɛm, Tolad,
Bɛthuɛl, Ɔma, Ziklag,
Bɛth Makabɔth, Azasusim, Bɛthbiri ɛn Shaaraim. Na bin dɛn siti dɛn dɛn wan ya te Devid kam na pawa.
Ɛn dɛn siti dɛm na bin, Ɛtam, Ain, Rimɔn, Tochɛn ɛn Ashan. Na bin fayv siti dɛn,
wit dɛn vilej dɛn we bin de rawnd di siti dɛn te rich Beal. Na di say dɛn we dɛn sɛtul ɛn dɛn bin kip rɛkɔd bɔt ɔl udat bɔn ɛn udat bɔn dɛm.
Mɛshɔb, Jamlɛk, Jɔsha we na Amazaya in bɔypikin,
Joɛl, Jɛu we na Jɔshibaya in bɔypikin, we na Seraya in bɔypikin, we na Asiɛl in bɔypikin,
Elioɛnai, Jaakoba, Jeshoaia, Asaia, Adiɛl, Jɛshimiɛl, Bɛnaya,
Ziza we na Shifi in bɔypikin, we na Alɔn in bɔypikin, we na Jɛdaya in bɔypikin, we na Shimri in bɔypikin, we na Shɛmaya in bɔypikin-
Dɛn wan ya we dɛn nem dɛn de ya na bin bigman dɛm na dɛn fambul dɛm, ɛn dɛn Papa dɛn os dɛm bin jɛs de bɛtɛ.
Dɛn travul go na di get fɔ go insay Gedɔ, we de na di ist say na di vali, fo fɛn gras fɔ dɛn animal dɛm fɔ it.
Na de dɛn fɛn fayn swet gras ɛn di land bi big, kwayɛt ɛn gɛt kol at; bikɔs di wan dɛn we bin tap de fɔs, na bin Am in pipul dɛn.

Dɛn wan ya we dɛn bin rɛjista dɛn nem bin kam da tɛm we Ɛzikaya na bin kiŋ na Juda ɛn pwɛl dɛn tɛn tɛnt dɛn ɛn kil ɔl di Meunim dɛm we bin de de kpata kpata sote tide, ɛn sidɔm na dɛn ples, bikɔs fayn gras bin lib de fɔ dɛn ship ɛn got.
Ɛn sɔm pan dɛm, bɔt sɔm fayv ɔndrɛd Simiɔnayt man dɛm go na Mawnt Sɛir, dɛn lida dɛm na bin Pɛlataya, Nɛaria, Refaya ɛn Yuziɛl, we na Ishi in bɔypikin dɛm.
Dɛn kil kil ɔl di balans Amalɛkayt dɛn we bin dɔn slayd, ɛn dɛn tap de te tide.

Rubɛn we na Izrɛl in fɔs pikin, in yon pikin dɛn. Nain na di fɔs pikin; (bɔt fɔseka we i lidɔm wit wan pan in papa in wɛf, dɛn bin gi in bath rayt as big wan to Josɛf we na Izrɛl in pikin, in yon pikin dɛm. Na dat mek we dɛn kin rayt dɛn ɔl nem bay aw dɛn bɔn, nɔto in nem kin de fɔs.
Pan ɔlwe Juda kam bɛtɛ pas ɔl in brɔda dɛn ɛn bigman bin kam kɔmɔt nain layn, di rayt as big wan blant Josɛf.)
Rubɛn we na Izrɛl in fɔs pikin, in yon pikin dɛm: Anɔk, Palu, Ɛzrɔn ɛn Kami.
Joɛl in bɔypikin dɛm: In bɔypikin na Shemaya. Shemaya in bɔypikin na Gɔg. Gɔg in bɔypikin na Shimɛi.
Shimɛi in bɔypikin na Mayka. Mayka in bɔypikin na Rɛaia. Rɛaia in bɔypikin na Beal.
Beal in yon pikin na Bira we Tiglat Pilɛsa we na bin kiŋ na Asiria, bin kɛr go ɛgzayl; in na bin di bigman fɔ di Rubɛnayt dɛm.
Dɛn wan ya nain kɔntriman dɛn ɛn na di tɛm we dɛn bin gri wit dɛn se dɛn fɔ rayt dɛn ɔl nem bay aw dɛn bɔn bay dɛn famili. Di bigman dɛn na Jɛiɛl ɛn Zɛkaraya.
Dɔn yu gɛt Bɛla we na Azaz in bɔypikin. Azaz na Shɛma in bɔypikin. Shɛma na Joɛl we bin tap na Aroɛa te rich Nɛbɔ ɛn Bal Mɛɔn, in yon bɔypikin.
Igen, i bin tap na di ist say ɔp to di say we di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap bigin na dis pat na Riva Yufretis, bikɔs dɛn kaw dɛn dɔn plɛnti na Giliad.
Di tɛm we Sɔl na bin kiŋ, dɛn bin mek wa pan di Agrayt pipul we dɛn bin kil kil; dɔn dɛn tap na dɛn tɛnt dɛm ɔlsay da pat de we na di ist pat na Giliad
Gad in bɔypikin dɛn bin tap na Beshan, ɔpsay to dɛn kɔmpin dɛn te rich Salɛka.
Joɛl na bin di bigman, Shafam na bin di sɛkɛn wan, dɔn yu gɛt Janai ɛn Shafat na Beshan.
Naw fɔ dɛn brɔda dɛn bay dɛn difrɛn akɔdin to dɛn papa os os: Maykɛl, Mɛshulam, Shiba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia ɛn Eba; Na dɛn sɛvin.

Dɛn wan ya na Abiail we na Yuri in bɔypikin, in pikin dɛn. Yuri na Jaroa in bɔypikin. Jaroa na Giliad in bɔypikin. Giliad na Maykɛl in bɔypikin. Maykɛl na Jɛshishai in bɔypikin. Jɛshishai na Jado in bɔypikin. Jado na Buz in bɔypikin.
Ai, we na Abdeɛl we Guni bɔn, in yon bɔypikin, na bin di edman na dɛn papa dɛm os dɛn:
Ɛn dɛn bin tap na Giliad, na Beshan ɛn di siti dɛm we de de, ɛn ɔl di land we bɔku gras de gro na Sharɔn fɔ fid ship ɛn got te usay di land tap.
Dɛn bin rayt ɔl dɛn wan ya bay aw dɛn bɔn di tɛn we Jotam na bin kiŋ dɛn nem dɛn bay dɛn jɛnareshɔn di tɛm we Sotam na bin kiŋ na Juda ɛn di tɛm we Jɛroboam na bin kiŋ na Izrɛl.

Di Rubɛnayt, di Gadayt ɛn di af Manasɛ fambul bin gɛt man dɛm we nɔ de fred natin, man dɛn we de fɛt wit big shild ɛn sɔd, bo ɛn aros ɛn dɛn na mastasabi man dɛm pan wa. Na bin dɛn fɔti fo tawzin, sɛvin ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti, bin de rɛdi fɔ fɛt.
Dɛn bin fɛt di Agrayt dɛm, di Jetɔ, di Nafish ɛn Nɔdab dɛm;
ɛn wɛn dɛn bin gɛt pipul dɛn fɔ ɛp dɛn fɔ fɛt, dɛn bin kapchɔ di Agrayt ɛn ɔl di wan dɛn we bin de wit dɛn, bikɔs dɛn bin pre to PAPA GƆD we dɛn de fɛt. I gi dɛn wetin dɛn aks fɔ bikɔs dɛn biliv am.
Dɛn kɛr ɔl dɛn kaw, got ɛn ship go: fifti tawzin pan dɛn kamɛl, tu ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti tawzin ship, tu tawzin dɔŋki ɛn wan ɔndrɛd tawzin man dɛm layf wan.
Plɛnti pipul bin day bikɔs na PAPA GƆD bin gɛt di wa. Dɛn bin tap na dɛn ples sote di tɛm we dɛn bin kɛr dɛn go ɛgzayl.
Na di pipul dɛn na af di Manasɛ fambul bin tap na di land; dɛn bin de bɔku bɔku wan frɔm Beshan te rich Beal Amɔn, Sɛnir ɛn Mawnt Amɔn.
Dɛn wan ya na di edman dɛm fɔ dɛn papa dɛn os: Ɛfa, Ishi, Ilaɛl, Azriɛl, Jɛrimaya, Odavaya ɛn Jadiɛl; dɛn na bin pawaful fɛt man dɛm, femɔns man dɛm ɛn Edman dɛm fɔ dɛn Papa dɛn os dɛm.
Bɔt dɛn brok PAPA GƆD we na dɛn papa dɛn Gɔd in lɔ ɛn bigin rare biɛn di pipul we de na di land dɛn yon gɔd dɛn, we PAPA GƆD bin dɔn kil bifo dɛm kam.

So Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd mek Pul we na kiŋ na Asiria ɛn Tiglat Pilɛsa we na kiŋ na Asiria vɛks, fɛt ɛn drɛb di Rubɛnayt, di Gadayt ɛn di Manasɛ fambul dɛn kɔmɔt de ɛn kɛr dɛn go Ala, Abɔ, Ara, ɛn di Riva Gozan. Dɛn de de te tide.
Livay in bɔypikin dɛm: Gashɔn, Koat ɛn Mɛrari.
Koat in bɔypikin dɛm na Amram, Izar, Ɛbrɔn ɛn Yuziɛl.
Amram in pikin dɛm: Erɔn, Mozis ɛn Miriam. Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛm: Nadab, Abiu, Ɛlɛza ɛn Itama.
Ɛlieza na bin Finɛas in Papa. Phinɛas na bin Abishua yon papa.
Abishua na bin Buki in Papa. Buki na bin Uzi yon papa.
Uzi na bin Zeraya in Papa. Zeraya na bin Mɛraiɔt yon papa.
Mɛraiɔt na bin Amaraya in Papa. Amaraya na bin Aitɔb yon papa.
Aitɔb na bin Zedɔk in Papa. Zedɔk na bin Aimaaz yon papa.
Aimaaz na bin Azaraya in Papa. Azaraya na bin Joanan yon papa,
ɛn Joanan na Azaraya in Papa (nain na bin di ma we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na di os we Sɔlɔmɔn bil na Jerusɛlɛm.)
Azaraya na bin Amaraya in Papa. Amaraya na bin Aitɔb yon papa.
Aitɔb na bin Zedɔk in Papa. Zedɔk na bin Shalum yon papa.
Shalum na bin Ilkaya in Papa, Ilkaya na bin Azaraya yon papa.
Azaraya na bin Sɛraya in papa. Sɛraya na bin Jɛozadak yon papa,
ɛn Jɛozadak bin go ɛgzayl wɛn PAPA GƆD bin mek Nɛbyukadnɛza sɛn Juda ɛn Jɛrusɛlɛm go ɛgzayl.
Livay in bɔypikin dɛm: Gashɔn, Koat ɛn Merari
Dɛn wan ya na Gashɔm in bɔypikin dɛn nem dɛm: Libni ɛn Shimɛi.
Koat in bɔypikin dɛm: Amram, Iza, Ɛbrɔn ɛn Uziɛl.
Mɛrari in bɔypikin dɛm: Mali ɛn Mushi. Dɛn wan ya na di livayt fambul dɛn bay dɛn papa os.
Di Gashɔm fambul: Libni na Gashɔn in bɔypikin. Jeat na Libni in bɔypikin. Zima na Jeat in bɔypikin.
Joa na Zima in bɔypikin. Ido na Joa in bɔypikin. Zɛra na Ido in bɔypikin. Jɛathɛrai na Zɛra in bɔypikin.
Koath in bɔypikin dɛm: Aminadab na Koat in bɔypikin. Kora na bin Aminadab in bɔypikin. Asir na bin Kora in bɔypikin.
Ɛlkena bin Asir in bɔypikin. Ebiasaf na bin Ɛlkenain bɔypikin. Asir na bin Ebiasaf in bɔypikin.
Taat na bin Asir in bɔypikin. Yuriɛl na bin Taat in yon bɔypikin. Uzaya na bin Yuriɛl in bɔypikin ɛn Shaul na bin Uzaya in yon bɔypikin.
Ɛlkenain bɔypikin dɛm: Amasai ɛn Aimɔth.
Ɛlkena na Aimɔth in bɔypikin. Zofay na Ɛlkenain bɔypikin. Naat na Zofay in bɔypikin.
Ɛliab na Naat in yon bɔypikin. Jeroam na Ɛliab in bɔypikin. Ɛlkena na Jɛroam in bɔypikin.
Samiɛl in bɔypikin dɛm: Di fɔs wan na Joɛl ɛn di sɛkɛn Abija.
Mɛrari in bɔypikin dɛm: Mali, Libni na Mali in bɔypikin. Shimɛi na Libni in bɔypikin. Uza na Shimɛi in bɔypikin.
Shimɛa na Uza in bɔypikin. Agia na Shimɛa in bɔypikin, ɛn Asaia na Agia in bɔypikin.
Na dɛn man dɛn ya Devid bin put inchaj ɔf di siŋ biznɛs na PAPA GƆD in os afta dɛn bin dɔn put di Ak ɔf Gɔd de.
Dɛn bin de sav PAPA GƆD de wit siŋ bifo di Tabanakul na di tɛnt we dɛn de mit wit PAPA GƆD, sote Sɔlɔmɔn bil PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm dɔn; ɛn dɛn bin de sav bay tɔn ɛn bay aw PAPA GƆD se.
Na di man dɛn dɛn wan ya ɛn dɛn bɔypikin dɛn we bin de sav. Pan di Koathayt dɛn bɔypikin dɛm, yu gɛt, Ɛman we na siŋman ɛn na Joɛl we na Samiɛl in bɔypikin bɔn am.
Samiɛl na Ɛlkenain bɔypikin. Ɛlkena na Jɛroam in bɔypikin. Jɛroam na Ilaɛl in bɔypikin. Ilaɛl na Toa in bɔypikin.
Toa na Zuf in bɔypikin. Ɛlkena na Maat. Maath na Amasai in bɔypikin.
Amasai na Ɛlkenain bɔypikin. Ɛlkena na Joɛl in bɔypikin. Joɛl na Azaraya in bɔypikin. Azaraya na Zɛfinaya in bɔypikin pikin.
Zɛfinaya na Taat in bɔypikin. Taat na Asir in bɔypikin. Asir na Ebiasaf in bɔypikin. Ebiasaf na Kora in bɔypikin.
Kora na Izar in bɔypikin. Iza na Koat in bɔypikin. Koat na Livay in bɔypikin. Livay na Jekɔb in bɔypikin.
Ɛn in brɔda Esaf we bin de tinap nain raytan, dat na Esaf we na Bɛrɛkaya, Shimea in bɔypikin, bɔn.
Shimea na Maykɛl in bɔypikin. Maykɛl nan Baasɛia in bɔypikin. Barasɛia na Malchija in bɔypikin.
Malshija na Ɛtni in bɔypikin. Ɛtni na Zɛra in bɔypikin. Zɛra na Adaya in bɔypikin. Adaya
na Ɛtan in bɔypikin. Ɛtan na Zima in bɔypikin. Zima na Shimɛi in bɔypikin.
Shimɛi na Jeat in bɔypikin. Jeat na Gashɔn in bɔypikin. Gashɔm na Livay in bɔypikin.
Na di lɛf an dɛn dɛn brɔda dɛm we na Merari in bɔypikin dɛm bin de. Dɛn na: Ɛtan we na Kishi in bɔypikin. Kishi we na Abdi in bɔypikin. Abdi we na Maluch in bɔypikin.
Malluk we na Ashabia in bɔypikin. Ashabia na Amazaya in yon bɔypikin. Amazia we na Ilkaya in bɔypikin.
Ilkaya we na Amzi in bɔypikin. Amzi we na Bani in bɔypikin. Bani we na Shɛma in bɔypikin.
Shema we na Mail in bɔypikin. Mail we na Mushi in bɔypikin. Mushi we na Merari in bɔypikin. Merari we na Livay in bɔypikin.
Na dɛn brɔda dɛn we na di Livayt dɛn, dɛn bin pik fɔ dɛn fɔ do ɔl di wok na di Tabanakul na PAPA GƆD in os.

Earɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛm bin de mek bɔn sakrifays ɛn na di ɔlta we dɛn bin de bɔn insɛns fɔ ɔl di wok na di ples we oli pas ɔl, ɛn fɔ beg PAPA GƆD fɔ dɛn sin jɛs lɛk ɔl wetin Mozis we na bin PAPA GƆD in wokman, bin tɛl dɛn fɔ du.
Dɛn wan ya na Erɔn bɔypikin dɛm. Ɛlieza we nain bɔypikin. Finias na Ɛliaza in bɔypikin. Abishua na Finias yon bɔypikin.
Buki na Abishua yon bɔypikin. Uzi na Buki yon bɔypikin. Zɛraya na Uzi in bɔypikin.
Mɛra iɔt na Zɛraya in bɔypikin. Amaraya na Mɛraiɔt in bɔypikin. Aitɔb na Amaraya in bɔypikin.
Zedɔk na Aitɔb yon bɔypikin. Aimeaaz na Zedɔk in bɔypikin.
Na dɛn ples dɛn ya dɛn bin tap bay aw dɛn sheb sheb di difrɛn lɔt dɛn: Erɔn in pikin dɛn we kɔmɔt na di Koratayt famili, bikɔs na dɛn bin gɛt di land,
dɛn bin gi dɛn Ɛbrɔn we de insay Juda ɛn ɔl di land ɛn we bɔku gras de gro fɔ fid got ɛn ship we de rawnd de,
bɔt Kelɛb we na Jɛfunɛ in bɔypikin, dɛn gi am di land dɛn fɔ plant we de na di siti ɛn di vilej.

Dɛn bin gi Erɔn ɛn in bɔypikin dɛm dɛn siti dɛn fɔ ayd we pɔsin mistek kil pɔsin; Ɛbrɔn, Libna ɛn ɔl in land we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Jatir, Ɛshtɛmoa ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
Ilɛn ɛn in land we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Dɛbir wit ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
Ashan ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we gras de gro fɔ fid animal ɛn Bɛtshɛmɛsh ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,

ɛn di Bɛnjamin fambul dɛn bin gi dɛn Gɛba ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Alɛmɛt ɛn ɔl di land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal ɛn Anatɔt ɛn ɔl in land we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal. Na bin tɔtin siti di wanol famili bin gɛt.
Dɛn bin gi di balans pan di Koathayt dɛm tɛn siti pan di af fambul, di af Mansɛ fambul dɛn land, lɔt bay lɔt, famili bay famili.
Dɛn bin gi Gashɔayt fambul, famili bay famili, tɔtin siti we na bin di Isaka fambul, di Asha fambul, di Naftali fambul ɛn di Manasɛ fambul na Beshan, dɛn land.
Dɛn bin gi di Mɛrarites dɛn, famili bay famili, twɛlv siti we na bin di Rubɛn, Gad ɛn Zɛbyulɔn fambul dɛn bin gɛt dɛn.
So di pipul dɛn na Izrɛlayt gi di Livayt dɛm siti dɛm ɛn dɛn land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal.
Egen, dɛn gi dɛn lɔt bay lɔt, dɛn siti dɛn ya we na di Juda, Simiɔn, ɛn Bɛnjamin fambul dɛn bin gɛt dɛn.
Sɔm pan di famili dɛm pan Koath in bɔypikin dɛn, bin gɛt siti dɛn we na di Ifreim fambul bin gɛt dɛn.

Dɛn gi dɛm di siti dɛn we pɔsin we kil pɔsin fɔ ayd; Shɛkɛm ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, we de na di il dɛn na Ifrem, Gɛza ɛn ɔl in lan dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
Jokmɛam ɛn ɔl in lan dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Bɛt Ɔrɔn ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
Aijalɔn ɛn ɔl in lan dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Gat Rimɔn ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
ɛn pan af di na Manasɛ fambul, Ana ɛn ɔl in lan dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, ɛn Bilɛam ɛn ɔl in lan dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, fɔ di balans pan di Koratayt famili.

Dɛn bin gi di Gashɔmnayt dɛn siti dɛn insay di af Manasɛ fambul land: Golan we de na Beshan ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, ɛn Ashtarɔt ɛn ɔl in lan dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
pan di Isaka fambul dɛn land, dɛn tek: Kedɛsh ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Dabarat ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
Ramɔt ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, ɛn Anɛm ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
Pan di Asha fambul dɛn yon: Mashal ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Abdɔn ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal.
Ukɔk ɛn ɔl in lan dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, ɛn Rɛɔb ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,

Pan di Naftali fambul dɛn yon: Kedɛsh we de na Galili ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Amɔn ɛn ɔl in lan dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, ɛn Kiriathaim ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
Dɛn gi di balans pan Mɛrari pipul dɛm pan di Zɛbyulɔn fambul dɛn land: Rimono ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Tabɔ ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,

Ɛn Jeriko oba Jɔdan na di ist pat na Jɔdan, pan di Rubɛn fambul dɛn land: Bɛza we de na di flat land we gɛt plɛnti gras bɔt nɔ gɛt bɛtɛ tik dɛn, ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Jeza ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
Kɛndɛmɔt ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal ɛn Mɛfaat ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
Pan di Gad fambul dɛn yon: Ramɔt we de na na Giliad ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, Maanaim ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
Ɛshbɔn ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal, ɛn Jeza ɛn ɔl in land dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal.
Isaka in bɔypikin dɛm: Tola Pua, Jashub ɛn Shimrɔn. Na dɛn fo.

Tola in bɔypikin dɛm: Uzi, Refaia, Jɛriɛl, Jamai, Ibsam ɛn Shɛmuɛl. Dɛn na bin edman dɛn na dɛm papa dɛn os dɛm; dɛn na bin di Tola famili. Dɛn jɛnareshɔn na bin traŋa traŋa sojaman dɛn. Di tɛm we Devid bin de na pawa, na bin dɛn twɛnti tu tawzin siks ɔndrɛd bin de..
Uzi in bɔypikin dɛm: Izraya. Ɛn Izraya in yon pikin dɛm na: Maykɛl, Obidaya, Joɛl ɛn Ishia. Na bin dɛn fayv. Dɛn ɔl na bin edman dɛm;
insay dɛn jɛnareshɔn, bay dɛn papa dɛn os dɛm, dɛn bin ebul gɛt tati siks tawzin sojaman dɛn fɔ fɛt wa bataliɔn dɛn na di ami de fɔ fɛt wa, bikɔs dɛn bin gɛt plɛnti wɛf ɛn bɔypikin.
Ɔl in ɔl, di brɔda dɛn we blant di Isaka fambul na bin eti sɛvin tawzin traŋa traŋa fɛtman dɛm we dɛn rayt nem bay aw dɛn bɔn.
Bɛnjamin in bɔypikin dɛm: Bɛla, Bɛka ɛn Jɛdiaɛl. Na bin dɛn tri.

Bɛla in bɔypikin dɛm: Ɛzbɔn, Uzi, Uziɛl, Jɛrimɔt ɛn Iri. Na bin dɛn fayv ɛn dɛn na bin edman dɛn na dɛn Papa dɛn os ɛn dɛn na bin traŋa traŋa sojaman dɛm: We dɛn rayt dɛn ɔl nem bay aw dɛn bɔn, na bin dɛn twɛnti tu tawzin ɛn tati fɔ.
Bɛka in bɔypikin dɛm: Zɛmira, Joash, Eliɛza, Ɛlioɛnai, Omri, Jɛrɛmoth, Abija, Anatɔt ɛn Alɛmɛt. Na ɔl Bɛka in bɔypikin dɛn wan ya;
ɛn we dɛn rayt dɛn nem dɛn bay aw dɛn bɔn ɛn bay dɛn jɛnareshɔn, ɛn as edman dɛm na dɛn papa dɛn os, ɛn traŋa traŋa sojaman dɛm, na bin dɛn twɛnti tawzin, tu ɔndrɛd.
Jediaɛl in bɔypikin dɛm: Bilan, ɛn Bilan in bɔypikin dɛm na, Jɛush, Bɛnjamin, Eud; Chɛnaana, Zɛtan, Tashish ɛn Ashishaa.
Ɔl dɛn wan ya na Jediaɛl in bɔypikin dɛm, bay dɛn bin bi edman dɛn na dɛn papa dɛn os dɛn ɛn traŋa traŋa sojaman dɛn, ɔl in ɔl, na bin dɛn sɛvintin tawzin, tu ɔndrɛd bin tambay fɔ wa.
Ɛn Shupim ɛn Upim na bin Ir in bɔypikin dɛm. Ushim na Aa in bɔypikin.
Naflalay in bɔypikin dɛm: Jaziɛl, Guni, Jɛza ɛn Shalum we Bila bɔn.
Manasɛ in bɔypikin dɛm: Asriɛl we nain Araminian kɔnkyubayn bɔn fɔ am; dis uman bɔn Makir we na Giliad in Papa.
Makir fɛn wɛf dɛn fɔ Hupim ɛn Shupim. In sista bin nem Maaka. Di sɛkɛn sista bin nem Zɛlofɛad; Zɛlofɛad bin gɛt gyal pikin dɛm.
Ɛn Maaka we na Makir in wɛf, bin bɔn bɔypikin we I gi di nem, Perɛsh; ɛn i bin gi in brɔda we i bin bɔn bak nem Shɛrɛsh. Pɛrɛsh in yon bɔypikin dɛm bin nem Ulam ɛn Rakɛm.
Ulam in bɔypikin dɛm: Bedan. Dɛn wan ya, na bin Giliad we na Makir we Manasɛ bɔn, in bɔypikin, in yon bɔypikin dɛn:
Ɛn in sista Amɔlɛkɛt bin bɔn Ishɔd, Abieza ɛn Mala.
Shɛmida in bɔypikin dɛm na bin Aiam, Shɛkɛm Liki ɛn Aniam.
Ifrem in bɔypikin dɛm: Shutela ɛn in bɔypikin Bɛrɛd, in bɔypikin Taat, in bɔypikin Ɛlead, in bɔypikin Taat,
in bɔypikin Zabad, in bɔypikin Shutɛla, ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn Ɛza ɛn Ɛlead, we di man dɛn we bɔn na Gat bin kil bikɔs dɛn bin kam dɔŋ fɔ go tif dɛn kaw dɛm.
Dat bin mek dɛn papa Ifrem munin fɔ lɔŋ tɛm ɛn Ifrem in brɔda dɛn bin kan tɛl am as ɛn koks am.
So Ifrem lidɔm wit in wɛf ɛn di uman gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn bɔypikin ɛn in gi am nem Bɛria bikɔs waala bin dɔn mit in os.
In gyal pikin na Shira we bin bil bɔtɔm say ɛn ɔp say na Bɛtorɔn ɛn Uzɛn Shira.
In bɔypikin na bin Rɛfa. Rɛfa in bɔypikin Rɛshɛf, in bɔypikin Tɛla, in bɔypikin Taan,
in bɔypikin Ledan, in bɔypikin, Amiud, in bɔypikin Ilayshama,
in bɔypikin Nun, in bɔypikin Joshua.
Dɛn prɔpati ɛn usay dɛn bin sɛtul na Bɛtɛl ɛn in in siti dɛn, Naaran we yu go ist, Gɛza ɛn in siti dɛn we yu de go di wɛst, Shɛkɛm ɛn in siti dɛm, ɛn Aya ɛn in siti dɛm.

Igen, we yu de go bay di Manasayt bɔda, dɛn gɛt Bɛt Shan ɛn in siti dɛm, Taanak ɛn in siti dɛn, Mɛgido ɛn in siti dɛn, Dɔ ɛn in siti dɛm. Na dɛn ples dɛn ya Josɛf we na Jekɔb, in bɔypikin, in yon bɔypikin dɛm bin tap.
Asha in bɔypikin dɛm: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi, Bɛria ɛn dɛn sista, Sera.
Bɛraya in bɔypikin dɛm. Eba ɛn Malkiɛl we na bin Bizait in Papa.
Eba na Jaflɛt, Shoma, ɛn Otan dɛn Papa, ɛn dɛn sista Shua.
Jaflɛt in bɔypikin dɛm: Pasak, Bimal ɛn Ashvat. Na dɛn wan ya na Jaflɛt in bɔypikin dɛm.
In brɔda Shoma in bɔypikin dɛm: Roga, Jeuba ɛn Eram.
In brɔda Ɔtam in bɔypikin dɛm: Zofa, Imna, Shelɛh ɛn Amal.
Zofa in bɔypikin dɛm: Sua, Anɛfa, Shual, Beri ɛn Imra,
Beza, Ɔd, Shama, Shilsha, Itran, ɛn Bɛɛra.
Jɛta in bɔypikin dɛm: Jɛfunɛ, Pispa ɛn Ara.
Ula in bɔypikin dɛm: Ara, Aniɛl ɛn Rizia.

Ɔl dɛn wan ya na man dɛn we kɔmɔt na di Asha fambul; dɛn na bin edman dɛn na dɛn papa dɛn os dɛm, traŋa traŋa sojaman dɛm we ɔlman gri fɔ, Edman dɛn pan di bigman dɛm. We dɛn rayt dɛn nem dɛm bay aw dɛn bɔn dɛn fɔ fɛt wa, na bin twɛnti siks tawzin man dɛn.
Bɛnjamin na bin Bɛla in Papa ɛn nain na bin in fɔs pikin. Ashbɛl na bin di sɛkɛn wan ɛn na Aara na bin di tɔd wan.
Noa di bin nɔmba fo pikin ɛn Rafa di nɔmba fayv.
Bɛla bin gɛt bɔypikin dɛn: Ada, Gɛra, Abiud,
Abishua, Neman, Aoa
Gɛra, Shefufan ɛn Uram.
Dɛn wan ya na Eud in bɔypikin dɛm (dɛn na bin edman dɛn na dɛn Papa dɛn os dɛn fɔ di wan dɛn we tap na Giba, ɛn dɛn kɛr dɛn go ɛgzayl to Manaat):
Neman, Aija ɛn Gɛra, we na Ɛglam we na Uza ɛn Aiud dɛn Papa, kɛr dɛn go ɛgzayl.
Shaaraim bin bɔn bɔypikin dɛn na Moab afta we i bin dɔn drɛb Ushim ɛn Baara, we na bin in wɛf dɛm.
I ɔda wɛf Odɛsh bin bɔn bɔypikin dɛn fɔ am. Dɛn na: Jobab, Zibia, Mɛsha, Malkam,
Jɛuz, Sakia, ɛn Mima. Dɛn wan ya nain bɔypikin dɛm, we na bin edman na dɛn papa in os dɛm.
I bin gɛt bɔypikin dɛm wit Ushim: Abitɔb ɛn Ɛlpaal.
Ɛlpaal in bɔypikin dɛm: Eba, Misham, ɛn Shɛmɛd we bil Ono ɛn Lɔd ɛn dɛn siti dɛn,
Ɛn Bɛraya ɛn Shɛma (dɛn na Edman dɛn fɔ dɛn papa os dɛm fɔ di pipul dɛn we tap na Aijalɔn, we mek di pipul dɛn we bin tap na Gat rɔnawe.)
Ɛn Aio, Shashak ɛn Jɛrimɔt.
Zebadaya, Arad, Ɛda,
Maykɛl, Ishpa ɛn Joa we na bin Bɛria in bɔypikin dɛn.
Zebadaya, Meshulam, Izki, Eba,
Ismɛrai, Izlia ɛn Jobab na bin Ɛlpaal in bɔypikin dɛm.
Jakim, Zikray, Zabdi
Ɛliɛnai, Zilɛtay, Ilaɛl,
Adaya, Bɛraia ɛn Shimrat na bin Shimɛi in bɔypikin dɛn.
Ishpan, Eba, Ilaɛl,
Abdɔn, Zikray, Anan,
Ananaya, Ɛlam, Antitija,
Ifdɛia ɛn Pɛnyuɛl na bin Shashak in bɔypikin dɛm.
Shamshɛray, Shɛaria, Atalia.
Jaarɛshia, Ilayja ɛn Zikray na bin Jeroam in bɔypikin dɛm.
Dɛn wan ya na bin edman dɛn fɔ dɛn Papa dɛn os dɛm bay dɛn jɛnareshɔn; dɛn na bin edman dɛn. Dɛn bin tap na Jerusɛlɛm.
Jɛiɛl we na Gibɛɔn in papa bin tap na Gibɛɔn ɛn in wɛf bin nem Maaka.
In fɔs-bɔy-pikin na bin Abdɔn, dɔn Zɔ, Kish, Beal, Nadab,
Gɛdɔ, Aiɔ, Zɛkaraya,
ɛn Miklot (Nain na bin Shimɛa in Papa) Dɛn wan ya sɛf bin tap ɔpozit dɛn brɔda dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm, wit dɛn fambul dɛn.
Nɛr na bin Kish in Papa, Kish na bin Sɔl yon papa, Sɔl na bin Jonɛthan, Malkishua, Abinadab ɛn Ɛshbeal dɛn yon;
ɛn Jonɛthan in bɔypikin na bin na Meribeal, ɛn Meribeal na bin Mayka in Papa.
Mayka in bɔypikin dɛn: Pitɔn, Melɛk, Tarɛa ɛn Eaz.
Eaz na bin Jɛoada in Papa; ɛn Jɛoada na bin Alɛmɛt, Azmavɛt ɛn Zimri dɛn yon Papa. Zimri na bin Moza in Papa.
Moza na bin Binɛa in Papa; Rafa na bin Binɛe in bɔypikin, Ɛliesa na bin Rafa in bɔypikin, Ɛzɛl na bin Ɛliesa in yon bɔypikin.
Ɛzɛl bin gɛt siks bɔypikin dɛm, ɛn na dɛn nem dɛn dɛn wan ya: Azrikam, Bokɛru, Ishmɛl, Shɛaria, Obidaya ɛn Anan. Ɔl dɛn wan ya na bin Ezɛl in bɔypikin dɛm.
Eshɛk we na Ezɛl in brɔda in yon bɔypikin dɛm: Ulam na bin in fɔs pikin, Jeush na bin di sɛkɛn wan, ɛn Elifɛlɛt na bin di tɔd wan.

Ulam in bɔypikin dɛm na bin traŋa traŋa sojaman dɛm; dɛn bin sabi faya bo ɛn aro, dɛn bin gɛt plɛnti plɛnti bɔypikin dɛn ɛn geranpikin dɛn we na bɔypikin dɛn we kɔnt ɔp to wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti. Dɛn ɔl na bin Bɛnjaminayt dɛn.

Dɛn bin rayt ɔlman na Izrɛl dɛn nem bay aw dɛn bɔn ɛn udat bɔn dɛm; dɛn rayt dɛn na di buk we dɛn rayt bɔt di kiŋ dɛn we rul Izrɛl. Dɛn bin kɛr di pipul dɛn na Juda go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn fɔ seka we dɛn nɔ bin de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD.
Di fɔs pipul dɛn fɔ tɔn bak go tap na dɛn prɔpati dɛn na dɛn siti na bin di Izrɛlayt dɛn, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, di Livayt dɛm ɛn di man dɛn we de wok na di tɛmpul.
Sɔm pan di pipul dɛm na Juda, Bɛnjamin, Ifrem ɛn Manasɛ bin tap na Jerusɛlɛm;
Utay, Amiud in bɔypikin we na Omri in bɔypikin, we na Imri in bɔypikin, we na Bani in bɔypikin, ɛn pan Pɛrɛz we na Juda in bɔypikin in yon bɔypikin dɛm.
Pan di Shilonayt dɛm, yu gɛt Asaia we na di fɔs-bɔy-pikin ɛn in yon bɔypikin dɛm.
Pan Zera in yon bɔypikin dɛm, yu gɛt Jɛuɛl ɛn dɛn fambul dɛm we bi se na dɛn siks ɔndrɛd ɛn naynti.
Pan di Bɛnjaminayt dɛm, Salu we in papa na Meshulan, ɛn Mɛshulam in papa na Ɔdavia ɛn Ɔdavia yon papa na Aasɛnua.
Ibnɛia we na Jɛroam in bɔypikin, Mikri in bɔypikin Uzi, in yon bɔypikin Ɛla, ɛn Meshulam Shefataya in bɔypikin, Reuɛl in bɔypikin, Ibnayja in bɔypikin;
ɛn dɛn fambul dɛm bay dɛn jɛnareshɔn na bin nayn ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti siks. Dɛn ɔl na bin edman dɛm na dɛn papa dɛn os, bay dɛn difrɛn papa dɛn os dɛm.
Pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin yu gɛt: Jedaia, Jɛoiarib, Jachin,

ɛn Azaraya na Ilkaya in bɔypikin. Ilkila na Mɛsulam in yon bɔypikin ɛn Meshulam in na Zedɔk yon bɔypikin. Zedɔk in na Mɛraiɔt in bɔypikin ɛn Mɛrayɔt in na Aitɔb we na di big edman na PAPA GƆD in os, yon bɔypikin;

ɛn Adaya we na Jɛroam in bɔypikin. Jɛroam na Pashɔ in bɔypikin. Pashɔ in na Malchija yon bɔypikin ɛn Maasai we na Adiɛl in bɔypikin. Adiɛl na Jazɛra yon bɔypikin. Jazɛra in na Mɛshulam in bɔypikin. Meshulam in na Mɛshɛlɛmit in yon bɔypikin ɛn Mɛshilɛmit in na Ima yon bɔypikin.
Apat frɔm dɛn fambul dɛm ɛn di edman dɛm na dɛm papa dɛn os dɛm, na wan tawzin, sɛvin ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti traŋa traŋa man bin de fɔ wok na PAPA GƆD in Os.
Pan di Livayt dɛm, yu gɛt: Shemaya we na Ashub in bɔypikin. Ashub in na Azrikam in bɔypikin ɛn Azrikam in na Ashabia we kɔmɔt pan Merari in bɔypikin dɛn;
ɛn Bakbaka, Ɛrɛsh, Galal ɛn Matanaya we na Mika in bɔypikin. Mika na Zikray in bɔypikin ɛn Zikray na Asaf yon bɔypikin;

ɛn Obidaya we na Shemaya in bɔypikin. Shemaya na Galal in bɔypikin ɛn Galal we na Jedutun in yon bɔypikin ɛn Bɛrɛchiawe na Asa in bɔypikin. Asa in na Ɛlkena we bin tap na dɛn Nɛtofatayt dɛm vilej dɛm.
Di getman dɛm na bin: Shalum, Akub, Talmɔn, Aiman ɛd man fambul dɛm (Shalum na bin di edman pan dɛn).
Dɛm bin na di kiŋ in get na di ist say. Na dɛn wan ya na bin di wachman dɛn na di Livayt kamp:

Na Shalum we na Kɔrɛ in bɔypikin, Kɔrɛ we na Ebiasaf in bɔypikin, ɛn Ebiasaf we na Kora in yon bɔypikin, ɛn in fambul dɛm we dɛn ɔl kɔmɔt nain Papa os, dat na di Koraayt dɛm, bin de inchaj ɔf ɔl di wokman dɛn, di domɔt dɛn fɔ go insay di tɛnt, jɛs lɛk aw dɛn papa dɛnsɛf bin de inchaj ɔf PAPA GƆD in getman dɛn kamp.
Na Finias we na Ɛlieza in bɔypikin, na bin dɛn fɔstɛm kɔmand; PAPA GƆD bin de wit am.
Na Zɛkaraya we na Mɛshɛlɛmia in bɔypikin na bin di getman na di domɔt fɔ go insay di tɛn we dɛn kin mit wit PAPA GƆD.

Ɔl dɛn wan ya we dɛn bin pik fɔ bi getman dɛn na di domɔt dɛn, na bin tu ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛlv. Dɛn bin rejista dɛn dɛn bay aw dɛn bɔn ɛn bay udat bɔn dɛn, na dɛn vilej dɛn. Na Devid ɛn Samiɛl we na bin prɔfɛt, bin gi dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn Rɛspɔnsibiliti dɛn de.
So na dɛn ɛn bɔypikin bin de inchaj na di get dɛm na PAPA GƆD in os; dat na di tɛnt os we dɛn na bin wachman dɛn.
Di getman dɛm bin de ɔlsay, ist, wɛst, nɔt ɛn sawt;
ɛn dɛn fambul dɛn we bin de na dɛn vilej dɛn, bin gɛt lɔ se dɛn fɔ kam ɛvri sɛvin de, frɔm tɛn to tɛm, fɔ kam de wit dɛn;
bikɔs di fo edman pan di getman dɛm we na Livayt dɛn, bin de inchaj ɔf di rum dɛm ɛn di valyuebul prɔpati dɛm we bin de na PAPA GƆD in os.
Dɛn bin de ɔlrawnd PAPA GƆD in os; bikɔs na dɛn bin gɛt di wok fɔ wach, ɛn na dɛn bin de opin de ɛvri mɔnin.
Na sɔm ɔf dɛm bin de inchaj ɔf di tin dɛn we dɛn bin de yuz na di tɛmpul, bikɔs na dɛn de ikɔnt dɛn we dɛn briŋ dɛn kam insay ɛn we dɛn de kɛr dɛn go na do.
Ɔda wan dɛn bin de we dɛn pik fɔ tek kia ɔf di fɔnichɔ, di oli tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz na di tɛmpul, ɛn sɛf fɔ de wach di fayn flawa, di wayn, di ɔyl, di insɛns ɛn di spays dɛm.
Sɔm ɔda wan dɛm pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn bɔypikin dɛm, bin de fɔ miks di spays dɛm.
Ɛn na Matitaya we na wan pan di Livayt dɛm, we na Shalum we na da Koraayt in fɔs pikin, bin de inchaj fɔ mek di flat kek dɛn.
Igen, na sɔm pan dɛn Koaatayt fambul dɛm wok fɔ mek di oli bred ɛvri de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst de.
Na dɛn wan ya na di Siŋman dɛm, we na edman dɛn na dɛn na dɛn Papa dɛn os dɛn na di Livayt fambul, we tap na di rum dɛn na di tɛmpul, ɛn nɔ gɛt nɔn ɔda wok fɔ du pas fɔ de siŋ de ɛn nɛt.
Na di edman dɛn na dɛn papa dɛn os dɛn na di Livayt fambul, bay dɛn jɛnareshɔn we bin tap na Jerusɛlɛm.
Jɛiɛl, we na Gibiɔn in papa, bin tap na Gibiɔn ɛn in wɛf bin nem Maka,
ɛn in fɔs-bɔy-pikin na bi Abdɔn, dɛn yu gɛt Zur, Kish, Beal, Nɛr, Nadab,
Gɛdɔr, Aio, Zɛkaraya ɛn Miklot;
ɛn Miklot na bin Shimɛa in Papa, ɛn dɛn wan ya so bin tap ɔpozit dɛn brɔda dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm wit dɛn fambu dɛn.
Nɛr na Kish in Papa. Kish na Sɔl yon, Sɔl na Jonɛthan, Malkishua, Abinadab ɛn Ɛshbeal yon papa;
ɛn Jonɛthan in bɔypikin na bin Meribeal, ɛn Meribeal na bin Mayka in Papa.
Mayka in bɔypikin dɛm: Pitɔn, Mɛlɛk, Tarɛa ɛn Eaz;
ɛn Ɛaz na bin Jara in Papa, ɛn Jara na Alimɛt, Azmavɛt ɛn Zimri yon papa Zimri na bin Moza in papa.
Moza na bin Binɛa in papa; ɛn Refaia na bin Binɛa in bɔypikin. Ɛliasa na bin Refaya in bɔypikin, ɛn Azɛl na bin Ɛliasa yon bɔypikin.
Ezɛl bin gɛt siks bɔypikin ɛn na dɛn nem dɛn dɛn wan ya: Azrikam, Bochɛru, Ismɛl, Shɛaria, Obidaya ɛn Anan. Na Ezɛl in bɔypikin dɛn wan ya.
Di filistin dɛn fɛt Izrɛl; ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn rɔnawe pan di Filistin dɛm, ɛn dɛn kil bɔku pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn na Mawnt Gilboa.
Ɛn di Filistin dɛm kech Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn; di Filistin dɛn kil Jonɛthan, Abinadab ɛn Malkishua we na Sɔl in bɔypikin dɛm.
Di fɛt bin traŋa bad bad fɔ Sɔl ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we de shut aro fɛn am, shut am ɛn wund am.

Nain Sɔl tɛl di man we de tot di ayɛn klos we i de wɛr fɛt se, “tek yu sɔd ɛn chuk mi wit am lɛ a day, mek dɛn ɔnsakɔmsayz pipul nɔ kan tek mi mek fɔn.” Bɔt di man we de tot di ayɛn klos we i de wɛr fɛt nɔ gri, bikɔs i fred bad bad. So Sɔl tek in yon sɔd ɛn fɔdɔm pan am.
We di man we de tot di ayɛn klos si se Sɔl dɔn day, insɛf fɔdɔm pan in yon sɔd ɛn day.
Na so Sɔl day; In ɛn in tri bɔypikin dɛm ɛn ɔl udat de nain os.
We di Izrɛlayt dɛm we de na di vali si se di sojaman dɛn dɔn rɔnawe, ɛn Sɔl ɛn in bɔy dɛn ɔl dɔn day, dɛn rɔnawe lɛf dɛn siti dɛn ɛn di Filistin dɛn go tap de.
Di nɛks de, we di Filistin dɛn go fɔ go sach di wan dɛn we day, dɛn fɛn Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin day wan na Mawnt Gilboa.
Dɛn tek ɔl wetin i gɛt, kɔt in ed ɛn tek in ayɛn klos we i de tek fɛt. Dɔn dɛn mɛsenja dɛn go ɔl bɔt na di Filistin kɔntri fɔ go tɛl dɛn laylay gɔd dɛn ɛn dɛn pipul dɛn wi gladi, wetin dɔn bi.
Dɛn put in ayɛn klos we i de tek fɛt klos na dɛn laylay gɔd dɛn tɛmpul ɛn fasin in ed na Degɔn in tɛmpul.
Bɔt we ɔl Jebɛsh-Giliad yɛri ɔl wetin di Filistin dɛn du Sɔl,
ɔl di man dɛn we gɛt maynd grap go tek Sɔl ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn bɔdi kɛr go Jebɛsh. Dɛn bɛr dɛn ɔnda di kɔtin tri na Jebɛsh ɛn fast sɛvin day.
So Sɔl day bikɔs i nɔ bin de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD; dat na we i nɔ bin de du wetin PAPA GƆD se. Pantap dat, i go luk- grɔn mek i go no wetin fɔ du,
ɛn nɔ bin aks PAPA GƆD wetin fɔ du. Na dat mek PAPA GƆD kil am ɛn tek di kindɔm gi Devid we na Jɛsi in bɔypikin.
Ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn gɛda to Devid na Ɛbrɔn, ɛn tɛl am se, mɛmba se wi na yu flɛsh ɛn blɔd.
Fɔstɛm, ɔl we na Sɔl na bin kiŋ, na yu bin tinap bifo Izrɛl fɔ go fɛt ɛn kam bak; ɛn PAPA GƆD bin tɛl yu se, na yu go lid mi pipul dɛn ɛn yu go bi dɛn kiŋ.”
So ɔl di bigman dɛm na Izrɛl go to di kiŋ na Ɛbrɔn; Devid mek wan wɔd wit dɛm bifo PAPA GƆD ɛn dɛn anɔynt Devid ɛn mek Devid fɔ bi kiŋ na Izrɛl, bay wetin Samiɛl se tɔk PAPA GƆD se.
So Devid ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn go na Jerusɛlɛm, dat na Jebus, usay di Jɛbyusayt dɛn bin tap na di land.
Di pipul dɛn we tap na Jebus tɛl Devid se “yu nɔ go kam na ya” pan ɔl dat Devid, kapchɔ di say we dɛn abop pan na Zayɔn; dat na Devid in Siti.
Devid se, “di fɔs pɔsin we go kil wan pan di Jebyusayt dɛn, go bi chif ɛn kɔmanda. Na Joab we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin, nain fɔs kil, so dɛn mek am kɔmanda.
Ɛn Devid tap na di say we dɛn abop pan; na da mek dɛn kɔl am Devid in siti.
Ɛn i bil di siti rawnd am frɔm usay dɛn kɔl Milo te go rawnd; so Joab mek di balans say na di siti we bin dɔn pwɛl.
Devid kam bi pawaful mɔ ɛn mɔ bikɔs PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti bin de wit am.
Na dɛn wan ya na di kɔmanda dɛn pan Devid in pawaful sojaman dɛm we sɔpɔt am traŋa traŋa wan nain kindɔm, togɛda wit di Izrɛlayt dɛn, fɔ mek am kiŋ, bay wetin PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɔk se go bi na Izrɛl.
Dis na wetin dɛn rayt bɔt Devid in pawaful fɛtman dɛm. Jashobiam we na Amonayt na bin di edman pan dɛn tri; In fɛt wit in spia na wan batul nɔmɔ ɛn kil tri ɔndrɛd man.
Di wan we bin de nɛks to am pan dɛn tri mayti man dɛn ya, na Ɛlieza we na Dodo, da Aoayt, in bɔypikin.
I bin de wit Devid na, Pas Damim di tɛm we di Filistin dɛn bin gɛda de fɔ fɛt wa. Wan plɔt bin de de we ful ɔp wit bɔlgɔ, ɛn di man dɛn rɔnawe pan di Filistin dɛm.
Bɔt in tinap traŋa wan lɛk man midul di plɔt, fɛt ɛn kil di Filistin dɛm; PAPA GƆD sev dɛm ɛn mek dɛn win we ɔlman gladi bad bad wan.
Tri pan di tati bigman dɛm go dɔŋ na di bi big ston go mit Devid na di kev na Adulam di tɛm we di Filistin ami bin kamp na Refaim vali.
Devid bin de na di barik ɛn di Filistin dɛn bin de na dɛn yon barik na Bɛtliɛm.
Nain Devid tɔk se “e ya, a wish sɔmbɔdi kin gi mi wata fɔ drink we kɔmɔt na di wɛl we de nia di get na Bɛtliɛm.”
So, di tri pawaful sojaman dɛn, go insay di Filistin dɛn kamp, drɔ di wata na di wɛl na Bɛtliɛm we de nia di get, ɛn kɛr am go to Devid. Bɔt Devid nɔ gri drink; i tɔn am na grɔn gi PAPA GƆD,
ɛn tɔk se “mek Gɔd nɔ gri lɛ mi du dis kayn tin. Mi fɔ drink dɛn man dɛn blɔd? Na dɛn layf dɛn risk we dɛn briŋ am.” Fɔseka dat i nɔ gri drink am. Na dɛn kayn tin ya di tri pawaful sojaman dɛm du.
Abishay we na Joab in brɔda, na bin di lida pan tati man dɛn. In swiŋ in spia rawnd ɛn kil tri ɔndrɛd man wantɛm ɛn mek nem lɛk di Tri pawaful sojaman dɛn.
Naim bin femɔs pas femɔs pas ɔl di tati man dɛn ɛn i bi dɛn kɔmanda, bɔt i nɔ bin femɔs rich di tri pawaful sojaman dɛn.

Bɛnaya we na Jɛoiada in bɔypikin we kɔmɔt Kabzil, na bin man we nɔ de fred natin ɛn i bin de du pawaful tin; i kil tu pawaful Moabayt sojaman dɛn. Pantap dat, i kil wan layɔn insay ol ɛn na de we sno bin dɔn fɔdɔm.

Ɛn i kil wan big ay Ijipshian we in ayt na bin sɛvin ɛn af fut. Di Ijipshian in spia we i bin ol bin tik lɛk mata pɛnsul; bɔt Bɛnaya go dɔŋ go mit am wit tik we tan lɛk fufu tik ɛn jɔg di spia kɔmɔt na di Ijipshian in an, ɛn kil am wit in yon spia.
Na dɛn tin ya Benaya, we na Jeoayda in bɔypikin bin du we i mek nem lɛk di tri pawaful sojaman dɛn.
Insɛf mek nem insay di tati, bɔt in ɔ bin rich di tri. Devid mek am kɔmanda fɔ in bɔdi gad dɛm.
Di pawaful sojaman dɛn na di ami dɛn na bin Asaɛl we na Joab in brɔda, Ɛlanan we na Dodo we kɔmɔt Bɛtliɛm in bɔypikin,
Shamɔt we kɔmɔt Arɔd, Ɛlɛz we na Pɛlonayt,
Ira we na Ikɛsh we kɔmɔt Tɛkoa in bɔypikin, Abieza we kɔmɔt Anatɔt,
Sibɛkay we na Ushatayt, Ilaɛl we na Aoayt.
Maaray we kɔmɔt Nɛtofa, Ɛlɛd we na Beana we kɔmɔt Netofa in bɔypikin.
Itay we na Ribay we kɔmɔt Gibɛa we blant di Bɛnjamin fambul, in bɔypikin. Benaya we kɔmɔt Piratɔn,
Uray we kɔmɔt usay na Gaash watasay dɛn de, Abiɛl we na Abatayt.
Azmavɛt we kɔmɔt Baurɔm, Ɛliaza we kɔmɔt Shaalbɔn
Ashɛm we na Gizonayt, Jonɛthan we na Shagi we na Ararayt in bɔypikin.
Aiam we na Saka we na Ararayt in bɔypikin, Elifal we na Ɔ in bɔypikin,
Efa we na Mekeratayt, Aayja we na pɛlonayt.
Ezro we kɔmɔt kamɛl, Naaray we na Ezibay in bɔypikin,
Joɛl we na Netan in brɔda, Miba we na Gri in bɔypikin,
Zilɛk we na Amonayt, Naaray we kɔmɔt Biarɔt, we na di man we de tot Joab, we na Zɛruaya in bɔypikin, in ayɛn klos fɔ fɛt
Ira we na Itrayt, Garɛb we na Itrayt,
Yuraya we na Itayt, Zebad we na Alay in bɔypikin,
Adina we na Shiza we na Rubɛnayt, ɛn lida fɔ di Rubɛnayt we gɛt tati fɛt man wit am, in bɔypikin,
Anan we na Maaka ɛn Joshafat we na Mitnayt.
Uzaya we na Ashtɛratayt, Shema ɛn Jɛiɛl we na Otam we na Aroɛrayt in bɔypikin dɛn
Jediaɛl we na Shimri in bɔypikin, ɛn Joa ɛn Joa we na Tizayt, in brɔda.
Ilaɛl we na Meavayt, ɛn Jɛribay ɛn Joshavia we na Ɛlnaam in bɔypikin dɛn, ɛn Itma we na Moabayt,
Ilaɛl ɛn Obɛd ɛn Jeasiɛl we kɔmɔt Zobab.
Na di man dɛn dɛn wan ya we bin go to Devid na Ziklag we i nɔ bin ebul waka fri wan bikɔs i bin de fred Sɔl we na Kish in bɔypikin; dɛn bin de pan di pawaful sojaman dɛn we bin ɛp am fɛt wa.
Na man dɛn we kin faya bo ɛn aro ɛn kin sɛn sliŋ wit raytan ɛn lɛf an; dɛn na Bɛnjaminayt dɛm we na Sɔl in fambul dɛm.
Di lida na bin Aiɛza dɛn, nɛks tɛm na Joash. Dɛn tu na bin Shimaa we kɔmɔt Gibia in bɔypikin dɛm. Dɔn yu gɛt Jeziɛl ɛn Pɛlɛt we na Azmavɛt in bɔypikin dɛn; Bɛraka, Jeu we kɔmɔt Anatɔt.
Ishmaya we kɔmɔt Gibɛɔn we3 na pawaful sojaman pan di di tati, ɛn na lida fɔ di tati; Jɛrimaya, Jaeziɛl, Joanan. Jozabad we kɔmɔt Gɛdɛra,
Ɛluzay, Jɛrimɔt, Bealia, Shɛmaraya, Shefataya we na Arufayt.
Ɛlkena, Isaya, Azarɛl, Joɛza ɛn Jashobem we dɛn na Koraayt;
ɛn Joɛla ɛn Zɛbadaya we na Jeroam we kɔmɔt Gɛdɔ, in bɔypikin dɛn.

Insay di Gadayt fambul, pawaful sojaman dɛm we dɔn fɛt fɔ lɔŋ, man dɛn we sabi fɛt wit big shild ɛn spia bad bad wan, kɔmɔt go mit Devid na di barik na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap. Dɛn fes dɛn bin tan lɛk layɔn fes dɛn ɛn dɛn gɛt spid lɛk dɛn fritambo na dɛn mawnten.
Ɛza di lida, Obidaya di nɔmba tu man, Eliab di nɔmba tri,
Mishmana fo, Jɛrimaya fayv,
Atay siks, Ilaɛl sɛvin,
Joenan et, Ɛlzabad nayn,
Jɛrimaya tɛn ɛn Machbanay, nɔmba Ilɛvin.
Dɛn Gadayt ya na ofisa dɛm na di ami. Di juniɔ ɔfisa dɛn bi gɛt wan ɔndrɛd man ɔnda dɛn, ɛn di sinyɔ wan dɛn bin gɛt wan tawzin
Na di man dɛn dɛn wan ya we krɔs Riva Jɔdan insay di fɔs mɔnt we i bin rɔn oba kam na land, ɛn mek ɔl di wan dɛn we de na di ist ɛn wɛst say na di vali dɛn, rɔnawe.
Sɔm pan di man dɛn na di Bɛnjamin ɛn Juda Fambul bin kam na di barik to Devid.
Dɛvid kɔmɔt go mit dɛm ɛn tɛl dɛn se, “If una kam to mi wit gud at fɔ ɛp mi, misɛf go gladi fɔ una; bɔt if una kam fɔ sɛl mi gi mi ɛnimi dɛm, ɔl we mi an klin, mek wi Papa dɛn Gɔd si ɛn pɔnish una.”

Nain di Spirit kam pan Amasay we na lida fɔ di tati fɛtman, ɛn i tɔk se: Devid, wi na yu yon; Jɛsi in bɔypikin, wi de wit yu, gɛt kol at, mek Gɔd gi yu kol at, ɛn mek Gɔd gi di wan dɛn we de ɛp yu kol at! Bikɔs yu Gɔd de ɛp yu. Nain Devid gri fɔ mek dɛn wok wit am, ɛn i mek dɛn ofisa nain ami.

Sɔm pan di man dɛn na di Manasɛ fambul lɛf kan jɔyn Devid we i bin kam wit di Filistin dɛm fɔ kan fɛt Sɔl (Bɔt in nɔ bin ɛp dɛm bikɔs, di Filistin rula dɛm ɛŋ ed ed ɛn drɛb am, se “I go sɛl wi ed chenj kamp go bak to in masta Sɔl.”)
We i bin de go Ziklag, dɛn man ya na di Manasɛ fambul chenj kamp go to am: Adna, Jɔzabad, Jɛdiaɛl, Maykɛl, Jɔzabad, Ilaɛlu, ɛn Zilɛtay, lida dɛn fɔ tawzin tawzin dɛm na di Manasɛ fambul.
Dɛn ɛp Devid fɔ fɛt di pipul we kam red am bikɔs dɛn ɔl na pawaful sojaman dɛn ɛn dɛn na kɔmanda dɛm na di ami.
Frɔm da de de, man dɛn jɔs de kam to Devid fɔ ɛp an, sote i tɔn bi bi big ami lɛk PAPA GƆD in ami.
Na di nɔmba dɛn dis fɔ di difrɛn difrɛn grup na di ami we go to Devid na Ɛbrɔn fɔ tek Sɔl in kindɔm gi am bay aw PAPA GƆD in wɔd se.
Di man dɛn na di Juda fambul we bin de fɛt wit big shild ɛn spia na siks tawzin et ɔndrɛd man dɛm wit wɛpɔn.
Pan di Simiɔnayt fambul dɛm pawaful sojaman dɛm we gɛt maynd fɔ fɛt wa, na bin sɛvin tawzin wan ɔndrɛd.
Pan di Livayt fambul, na fo tawzin siks ɔndrɛd
Prins Jɛoiada we kɔmɔt na Earɔn in os bin gɛt tri tawzin sɛvin ɔndrɛd man.
Zedɔk, wan yɔŋ pawaful sojaman ɛn twɛnti tu kɔmanda we kɔmɔt nain yon Papa os.
Pan di Bɛnjamin fambul we na Sɔl in kɔntri man dɛn, na bin tri tawzin, we plɛnti pan dɛn bin stil de fɔ Sɔl.
Pan di Ifrem fambul, na bin twɛnti tawzin et ɔndrɛd pawaful sojaman dɛm we gɛt maynd fɔ fɛt we kɔmɔt na dɛn papa dɛn os.
Pan di af trayb pan di Manasɛ fambul na etin tawzin, we na dɛn dɛn pik fɔ kam mek Devid kiŋ.
Pan di Isaka fambul, man dɛn we no wetin gɛt fɔ bi we dɛn luk di wɛda, we bin no wetin Izrɛl sɔpoz fɔ du, na bin tu ɔndrɛd edman, ɛn ɔl dɛn fambul dɛm we de ɔnda dɛm.
Pan Zɛbyulɔn fambul, na bgin fifti tawzin soba sojaman dɛm we rɛdi fɔ fɛt wit ɔl di wɛpɔn dɛm fɔ wa fɔ ɛp Devid wit wan at ɛn wan maynd.
Pan Naftali fambul, na bin wan tawzin kɔmanda ɛn tati sɛvin tawzin sojaman dɛm de fɛt wit big shild ɛn spia.
Pan di Dan fambul na bin twɛnti et tawzin siks ɔndrɛd sojaman dɛm wit ɔlkayn wɛpɔn fɔ fɛt.
Pan di Asha fambul, na bin fɔti tawzin soba soja dɛm rɛdi fɔ fɛt.
Pan di Rubɛn ɛn Gadayt Fambul, ɛn haf di Manasɛ Fambul we de Oba di ɔda say na Jɔdan, na bin wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti tawzin man wit ɔl kayn wɛpɔn fɔ fɛt wa.

Ɔl dɛn sojaman dɛm ya bin layn ɔp bay aw dɛn kin tinap fɔ fɛt go na Ɛbrɔn we dɛn bin dɔn mek ɔp dɛn maynd fɔ mek Devid kiŋ oba Izrɛl; semweso, ɔl di pipul dɛn na Izrɛl bin gɛt wan wɔd fɔ mek Devid kiŋ.
Ɛn dɛn bin de wit Devid tri de, de it ɛn drink bikɔs dɛn brɔda dɛm bin dɔn rɛdi ɔltin fɔ dɛn fɔ dɛm.

Ɛn dɛn neba dɛnsɛf, sote go Isaka, Zɛbyulɔn ɛn Naftali, briŋ it kam pantap dɔŋki, kamɛl, yɔŋ dɔŋki ɛn kaw; bɔku bɔku tin fɔ it lɛk kek, dray grɛps ɛn wayn ɛn ɔyl, ɛn kaw ɛn ship, bikɔs gladi gladi bin de na Izrɛl.
Devid ɛŋed wit di kɔmanda dɛm fɔ dɛn wan dɛn we de oba tawzin man ɛn ɔndrɛd man wit ɔl di ɔda lida dɛm.

Devid tɛl ɔl di Izrɛlayt we gɛda se ‘If una tink se dis na gud tin fɔ du, ɛn if na wetin PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd want, lɛ we sɛn to wi brɔda dɛn we lɛf ɔlsay na Izrɛl, ɛn to di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn na di siti dɛn we gɛt land we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal so dat dɛn go kam tap wit wi na ya.
Dɔn mek we briŋ wi PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant kam bak; bikɔs Sɔl in tɛm, we nɔ bin bisin bɔt am.”
Dɛn ɔl we gɛda bin gri fɔ dat, bikɔs dɛn ɔl si se dat na di rayt tin.
Devid gɛda di wanol Izrɛl frɔm Shiɔ na Ijipt te rich di ples fɔ pas go insay Amat, fɔ briŋ PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant kɔmɔt Kiriat Jearim, kam bak.
Ɛn Devid ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn go Beala, dat na Kiriat Jearim we blant Juda fɔ go tek di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant kɔmɔt de, we na PAPA GƆD we sidɔm nain tron oba di Chɛryubim
Dɛn put di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant pan nyu ɔmɔlanke, kɔmɔt na Abinadab in os. Na Uza ɛn Aio bin de kɔntrol di ɔmɔlanke.
Devid ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin de mek gladi gladi bifo PAPA GƆD wit ɔl dɛn trɛnk, de siŋ ɛn de ple gita, tamborin, simbɔl ɛn blo gita ɛn trɔmpɛt.
Ɛn we dɛn rich da say de mas rɛs ɛn klin am na Chidɔn, Uza tret in an fɔ kech di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant bikɔs di kaw dɛn we bin de drɔ di ɔmɔlanke fɔdɔm.
Nain PAPA GƆD vɛks pan Uza; I kil am, bikɔs in put in an fɔ kech di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant; i day de bifo PAPA GƆD.
Devid bin vɛks bikɔs PAPA GƆD vɛks kil Uza, ɛn kɛn kɔl da ples de Pɛrɛz Uaz te tide.
Dat mek Devid fred PAPA GƆD da de de; ɛn i se “Aw a go manej briŋ PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant kam om to mi?
So Devid nɔ tek di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant go om na Devid in siti o! Bɔt bɛn kɛr am go na Obɛd Idɔm we na Gitayt, in os.
PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant de wit Obɛd Idɔm ɛn in pipul dɛn nain os, fɔ tri mɔnt; lɛf wit Obɛdidɔm in famili nain os tri mɔnt; PAPA GƆD blɛs Obɛd Idɔm ɛn ɔl udat de nain os, ɛn ɔl wetin i gɛt.
Iram we na kin na Taya sɛn mɛsenja dɛn to Devid, wit sida tik ɛn mesna ɛn kapinta dɛm fɔ bil os fɔ am.
Devid si se PAPA GƆD dɔn mek am kiŋ oba Izrɛl, ɛn in kindɔm bin gɛt ay rɛspɛkt fɔseka in pipul, Izrɛl.
Devid mared mɔ wɛf na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn bɔn mɔ bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛm.
Nain pikin dɛn nem dɛn dɛn wan ya we i bɔn na Jerusɛlɛm: Shamua, Shobab. Netan, Sɔlɔmɔn,
Iba, Ɛlishua, Ɛlipɛlɛt.
Nɔga, Nɛfɛg, Jafia,
Elishama. Biliada ɛn Ɛlifɛlɛt.
Wɛn di filistin dɛm yɛri se dɛn dɔn anɔynt Devid kiŋ fɔ di wanol Izrɛl, ɔl di Filistin dɛm go ɔp fɔ go luk fɔ Devid; we Devid yɛri bɔt dat, i kɔmɔt go fɔ go mit dɛm.
Di Filistin dɛm bin dɔn kam tif ɛn lut na di Rafayim vali.
So Devid aks PAPA GƆD se, “Mek a go fɛt di Filistin dɛm? Yu go mek a ebul bit dɛn?” Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl am se “Go mit dɛn; a go mek yu ebul bit dɛn.”
So Devid go ɔp Beal Pɛrazim ɛn bit dɛn de; nain Devid se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn yuz mi fɔ bata mi ɛnimi wit mi an lɛk we wata de bɔs.” Fɔseka dat, dɛn gi da ples de nem, Beal Pɛrazim.
Dɛn bin lɛf dɛn gɔd dɛm de. So Devid gi ɔda lɛ dɛn bɔn dɛn, ɛn dɛn bɔn dɛm.
Di Filistin dɛn go bak go tif ɛn lut na di vali.
We Devid aks PAPA GƆD bak wetin in fɔ du, PAPA GƆD tɛl am se “nɔ rɔnata dɛn go rawnd go mit dɛn oposit di sɛnt tik.
We yu yɛri sawnd lɛk dɛn de mach pantap di sɛnt tik dɛm, go fɛt dɛn da tɛm de; bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn go bifo yu fɔ go kil di Filistin dɛn.
Devid du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am traŋa wan fɔ du am ɛn dɛn kil di Filistin ami man dɛn frɔm Gibɛɔn to Gɛza.
Yus bɔt Devid go na ɔl di difrɛn kɔntri dɛn ɛn PAPA GƆD mek ɔl di neshɔn dɛn fred am.
Devid bil os dɛn fɔ insɛf na di siti ɔf Devid; dɔn i rɛdi ples fɔ PAPA GƆD in Ak ɛn pich tɛnt fɔ am.
Dɔn Devid tɔk se “Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ tot di Ak pas di Livayt dɛm, bikɔs na PAPA GƆD dɔn pik dɛm fɔ tot PAPA GƆD in Ak ɛn fɔ wok fɔ am sote go.
So Devid gɛda di wanol Izrɛl na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ kɛr PAPA GƆD in Ak go nain ples we i dɔn mek fɔ am.
So Devid gɛda Earɔn in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn di Livayt dɛn:
pan Koat in bɔypikin dɛn, yu gɛt Yuriɛl we na di lida, wit ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti pan in brɔda dɛm;
pan Mɛrari in bɔypikin dɛn, yu gɛt Asaya we na di lida, wit tu ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti pan in brɔda dɛn;
an Gashɔm in bɔypikin dɛm, yu gɛt Joɛl we3 na di lida wit ɔndrɛd ɛn tati pan in brɔda dɛm;
pan Elizafan in bɔypikin dɛm, yu gɛt Shɛmaya we na di lida, wit tu ɔndrɛd pan in brɔda dɛm;
pan Ɛbrɔn in bɔypikin dɛm yu gɛt Ilaɛl we na di lida, wit eti pan in brɔda dɛm;
pan Uziɛl in yon bɔypikin dɛm, yu gɛt Aminadab we na di lida, wit ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛlv pan in brɔda dɛm.
So Devid sɛn kɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, dat na Zedɔk ɛn Abiata, ɛn di Livayt dɛm, we na Yuriɛl, Asaya, Joɛl, Shɛmaya, Ilaɛl ɛn Aminadab,

ɛn tɛl dɛn se, “na una na na edman dɛn fɔ di Livayt dɛn papa os dɛm; una ɛn una brɔda dɛn fɔ mek unasɛf klin na PAPA GƆD in yay, so dat una kin ebul briŋ PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, in Ak kam na di ples we a dɔn mek fɔ am.
Bikɔs una nɔ bin tot am di fɔs tɛm, PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd bin vɛks kil pɔsin, bikɔs wi nɔ bin bisin fɔ du am di we we PAPA GƆD in lɔ se wi fɔ du am.”
So di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn mek dɛnsɛf klin na PAPA GƆD yay fɔ go briŋ PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, in Ak kam.
So di Livayt dɛn tot PAPA GƆD in Ak na dɛn sholda wit di pol dɛn, lɛk aw Mozis bin tɛl dɛn traŋa se PAPA GƆD in lɔ se dɛn fɔ du.
Devid bin tɛl di Livayt lida dɛm traŋa wan dɛn fɔ pik dɛn brɔda dɛm fɔ bi di man dɛn we de siŋ, we go ple muzik instrumɛnt, lɛk gita, flut ɛn simbɔl lawd lawd wan fɔ mek gladi gladi.
So di Livayt dɛn pik Iman we na Joɛl in bɔypikin; pan in brɔda dɛn yu gɛt Esaf, we na Bɛrɛkaya in bɔypikin, ɛn pan Merari in bɔypikin dɛm, dɛn brɔda Ɛtan we na Kushaya in bɔypikin;

togɛda wit dɛm, dɛn brɔda dɛn we fɔ ɛp dɛn, we na Zɛkaraya, Jaeziɛl, Shemiramɔt, Jeayɛl, Uni, Ɛliab, Benaya, Maasɛya, Matitaya, Ɛlifɛlɛu ɛn Miknɛia, ɛn di getman dɛn na di get we na Obɛd Idɔm ɛn Jɛiɛl.
Di man dɛn we de siŋ na Iman, Esaf ɛn Ɛtan, fɔ ple di bras simbɔl dɛm;
Zɛkaraya, Eziɛl, Shɛmiramɔt, Jeayɛl, Uni, Eliab, Maasɛia ɛn Benaaya fɔ ple di ap bay aw Alamɔt dayrɛkt;
Bɔt Matitaya, Ɛlifɛlɛu, Mikneia, Obɛd Idɔm, Jeayɛl, ɛn Azazaya fɔ lid wit gita bay aw Sheminit dayrɛkt.
Na Chɛnanaya, we na di myuzik lida fɔ di Livayt dɛn, fɔ dayrɛkt di muzik bikɔs nain ɔndastand.
Na Bɛrɛkaya ɛn Ɛlkena fɔ bi getman dɛm fɔ di Ak.

Shɛbanaya, Joshafat, Netanɛl, Amasay, Zɛkaraya, Bɛnaya ɛn Ɛlieza, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, fɔ blo di trɔmpɛt dɛm bifo PAPA GƆD in Ak. Obɛdidɔm ɛn Jɛia sɛf fɔ bi getman dɛn fɔ di Ak.
So Devid ɛn di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl, ɛn di lida dɛn we de oba tawzin tawzin, bin siŋ ɛn dans go briŋ PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant kɔmɔt na Obɛd Idɔm in os.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD ɛp di Livayt dɛn we bin tot di PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, dɛn sakrifays sɛvin man kaw ɛn ɛn sɛvin man ship.

Devid bin wɛr wan fayn fayn linin gawn, ɛn na so ɔl di Livayt dɛm we bin tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, di man dɛn we de siŋ, ɛn Chɛnanaya we na di lida pan man dɛn we de siŋ, bin drɛs. Devid bin wɛr linin Ifɔd.
So di wanol Izrɛl kɛr PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant go wit lawd gladi nɔys, we di ɔn, di trɔmpɛt ɛn di simbɔl dɛn de ple, ɛn dɛn bin de ple di apɛn gita lawd lawd wan.

PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant bin rich na di siti ɔf Devid. Mikal we na Sɔl in gyal, bɔks de kam na Devid in siti, Maykalwe na Sɔl in gyal pikin bin luk oba di winda ɛn bin si kiŋ Devid de dans ɛn mek gladi gladi; dat mek i lɔs rɛspɛkt fɔ am.
So dɛn kɛr PAPA GƆD in Ak ɛn put am insay di tɛnt we Devid bin dɔn pich fɔ am; ɛn dɛn mek sakrifays we de bɔn na faya ɛn pis ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD.
Wɛn Devid mek di sakrifays we de bɔn ɔfrin ɛn di pis ɔfrin dɔn, i blɛs di pipul dɛm insay PAPA GƆD in nem,
ɛn sheb wan lof bred, smɔl bif ɛn wan kek dray greps gi ɔl uman ɛn man na Izrɛl.
Pantap dat, i pik sɔm pan di Livayt dɛm fɔ bi PAPA GƆD in wokman bifo PAPA GƆD in Ak, fɔ kɔl am, tɛl am tɛnki ɛn fɔ prez PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd.
Esaf na di lida, ɛn nɛks to am na bin Zɛkaraya, Jeayɛl, Shɛmiramɔt, Jɛiɛl, Matitaya, Ɛliab, Bɛnaya, Obɛd Idɔm, ɛn Jeayɛl, we fɔ ple apɛn gita; na Esaf fɔ nak di simbɔl,
ɛn na Bɛnaya ɛn Jaeziɛl we na di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ jɛs de blo di trɔmpɛt dɛm bifo PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant.
Na di de dat Devid fɔs mak am lɔ se Esaf ɛn in brɔda dɛm fɔ siŋ tanksgivin to PAPA GƆD.
Tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki, kɔl in nem mek di pipul dɛn no wetin i de du;
Siŋ to am, siŋ bɔku prez to am tɔk bɔt ɔl in wɔndaful wok.
Gi in Oli nem gud nem; lɛ dɛn wan dɛm we dɛn at det o PAPA GƆD gladi.
Fɛn PAPA GƆD ɛn in trɛnk, Fɛn usay i de ɔltɛm.
Mɛmba di wɔndaful wok dɛm we i dɔn du, di wɔnda dɛm we dɔn wok, di jɔjmɛnt dɛm we i dɔn pul nain mɔt.
Una we na Ebraam PAPA GƆD in wokman, in bɛlɛ bɔn dɛm Jekob in bɔypikin dɛm, di wandɛn we i dɔn pik!
Naim na PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd; In jɔjmɛnt dɛn de ɔl say na wɔl.
I de mɛmba in Kɔvinant sote go, di tin dɛn we i dɔn tɔk traŋa wan se dɛn fɔ du, fɔ wan tawzin jɛnareshɔn.
Di Kɔvinant we i mek wit Ebraam; di swɛ we i swɛ to Ayzak,
i gri se na lɔ to Jekɔb we go bi wan wɔd wit Izrɛl sote go
we i se “A go gi una kenan land nain go bi una yon prɔpati.”
We dɛn nɔ bin plɛnti yet, ɛn dɛn nɔ du natin bɛtɛ yet, ɛn dɛn na trenja na di land,
Dɛn de waka frɔm neshɔn to neshɔn, frɔm wan kindɔm to to ɔdawan,
I nɔ gri nɔbɔdi tɔmɛnt dɛn layf, i tɛlɔf kiŋ dɛn fɔ seka dɛn
se, “Nɔ tɔch di wan dɛm we a dɔn anɔynt, nɔ du mi prɔfɛt bad!”
Lɛ ɔlman na wɔl siŋ to PAPA GƆD! Tɛl ɔlman ɛvri de bɔt aw i de fri mɔtalman sol!
Tɔk bɔt in gud nem to di neshɔn dɛm, tɔk bɔt di pawaful tin dɛn we i dɔn du we pipul dɛn kɔle!
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD na gret Gɔd, ɛn nɔto bebi prez fɔ prez am, ɛn dɛn fɔ fred am pas ɔl dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛm.
Bikɔs ɔl di pipul dɛn gɔd dɛm na laylay gɔd; bɔt na PAPA GƆD mek di skay ɛn ɔl wetin de ɔp
Nain gɛt ɔl ɔna ɛn pawa; trɛnk ɛn gladi de usay i de.
Una gri se na PAPA GƆD, una dɛn difrɛn difrɛn famili dɛn, una gri se na PAPA GƆD gɛt ɔna we nɔbɔdi nɔ ɛva gɛt, ɛn trɛnk.
Una gri se na PAPA GƆD in nem fɔ gɛt di ɔna we nɔbɔdi nɔ ɛva gɛt; nɔ kam bifo am ɛmti am! Wɔship PAPA GƆD wit oli klos;
lɛ di wanol wɔl trimbul bifo am; yɛs, di wɔl tinap traŋa wan, di wɔl nɔ go ɛva muf.
Lɛ ɛvin gladi, ɛn lɛ dis wɔl sɛf gladi, ɛn mek dɛn tɛl dɛnsɛf na di neshɔn dɛm se, “Na PAPA GƆD de na pawa”
Mek di si ɛn ɔl wetin ful am ala, mek di fam ɛn ɔl de de wetin es in nem ɔp!
Da tɛm de di tik dɛm we de na bush go siŋ wit gladi, bifo PAPA GƆD, bikɔs i de kam fɔ jɔj dis wɔl.
Tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki, bikɔs i gud; bikɔs in lɔv we nɔ de shek go de sote go.
Tɔk igen se “Pul wi pan trɔbul, duya, PAPA GƆD we sev wi, ɛn gɛda wi ɛn pul wi kɔmɔt na di neshɔn dɛn na; so dat we go tɛl yu oli nem tɛnki; tɔk bɔt6 in gud nem we yu de prez am.
Lɛ wi blɛs PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, sote go to sote go!” Dɔn ɔl di pipul dɛn se, “Emɛn! Ɛn prez PAPA GƆD.
So Devid lɛf Esaf ɛn in brɔda dɛm bifo PAPA GƆD in Ak ɛvride de du wetin dɛn sɔpoz fɔ du,
wit Obɛd Idɔm ɛn in siksti-et brɔda dɛm; da tɛm de, Obɛd Idɔm we na Jɛdutum in bɔypikin, ɛn Osa fɔ bi di getman dɛn..
Ɛn i lɛf Zedɔk ɛn in brɔda dɛn we dɛn na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, bifo PAPA GƆD in Oli tɛnt na di ay ples we bin de Gibiɔn,
fɔ de mek sakrifays we de bɔn na faya to PAPA GƆD ɔltɛm, mɔnin ɛn ivin, bay wetin rayt na di lɔ we PAPA GƆD dɔn tɛl Izrɛl traŋa wan se, dɛn fɔ du.
Iman ɛn Jɛdutun bin de wit dɛm, ɛn di balans pan di wan dɛm we dɛn bin pik ɛn bin kɔl dɛn nem fɔ de tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki, fɔ in lɔv we nɔ de chenj ɛn de sote go.
Iman ɛn Jɛdutun bin gɛt trɔmpɛt dɛn ɛn simbɔl dɛm fɔ ple di myuzik, ɛn bin instrumɛnt dɛm fɔ siŋ oli siŋ. Dɛn pik Jɛdutun in bɔypikin dɛm fɔ gyad di get.
So ɔl di pipul dɛn go, lman go nain yon os, ɛn Devid sɛf go om go blɛs in yon pipul dɛn nain os.
Wɛn Devid bin dɔn go tap nain os, Devid tɛl Netan we na prɔfɛt se, “Luk ya, na sida tik os mi tap, bɔt PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant de ɔnda tɛnt.”
Nain Netan tɛl Devid se, “Du ɔl wetin de na yu at, bikɔs PAPA GƆD de wit yu.”
Bɔt da sem nɛt de PAPA GƆD tɔk to Netan se,
“Go tɛl mi wokman Devid se, na so PAPA GƆD se: Yu nɔ go bil os fɔ mi fɔ tap.
Bikɔs a nɔ tap na os wande frɔm di de we a ol Izrɛl an kɔmɔt Ijipt te tide de, bɔt a jɛs de pas frɔm tɛnt to tɛnt ɛn frɔm os to os.

Pan ɔl di say dɛm ples we a dɔn waka wit di wanol Izrɛl, wande a dɔn tɔk to ɛni pan di jɔj dɛn na Izrɛl we a bin tɛl traŋa wan se dɛn fɔ mɛn ɛn gyad mi pipul dɛm, se, “wetin mek yu nɔ bil sida tik os fɔ mi?” ’

So, yu fɔ go tɛl Devid we na mi wokman se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, a pul yu kɔmɔt usay gras de gro plɛnti fɔ animal fɔ it, lɛ yu lɛf fɔ de biɛn ship so dat yu go lida fɔ Izrɛl we na mi pipul dɛn;
ɛn a dɔn de wit yu ɛnisay we yu bin de go, ɛn a dɔn pul ɔl yu ɛnimi dɛn kɔmɔt biɛn yu; ɛn mi go mek nem fɔ yu lɛk di nem we dɛn bigman dɛm gɛt na wɔl.
A go pik ples fɔ mi pipul Izrɛl, ɛn a go put dɛn so dɛn go tap na dɛn yon ples ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ambɔg dɛn igen; ɛn dɛn pipul dɛn we lɛk fɛt nɔ go aras dɛn igen lɛk fɔstɛm,
frɔm di tɛm we a pik jɔj dɛm oba mi pipul Izrɛl; ɛn a go put ɔl yu ɛnimi dɛn ɔnda yu fut. Pantap dat, mi de tɛl yu se PAPA GƆD go bil os fɔ yu.
Wɛn di tɛm go rich fɔ yu fɔ go mit di wan dɛn we dɔn go bifo, a go mek wan yu yon bɛlɛ bɔn, dat na wan pan yu bɔypikin, tek yu ples, ɛn a go put an mek in kindɔm tinap trɔŋ.
In go bil os fɔ mi ɛn a go put an mek in kindɔm tinap traŋa wan sote go.
A go bi in papa ɛn in go bi mi bɔypikin; a nɔ go pul mi lɔv we nɔ de chenj kɔmɔt to am lɛk we a bin tek am kɔmɔt to di wan we bin de bifo yu,
bɔt a go gri fɔ am na mi os ɛn na mi kindɔm sote go, ɛn nain layn kiŋ go kɔmɔt sote go.”
Bay ɔl wetin i yɛri ɛn ɔl wetin i si na dis vishɔn, Netan bin go tɔk to tɔk to Devid.
Nain kiŋ Devid go insay go sidɔm bifo PAPA GƆD ɛn tɔk se, “Udat na mi o, PAPA GƆD, ɛn udat na mi pipul dɛn we yu dɔn es mi ɔp so?
Ɛn dis na bin smɔl tin na yu yay, PAPA GƆD; yu dɔn de tɔk igen bɔt yu wokman in jɛnareshɔn bambay, ɛn yu dɔn sho mi mi jɛnareshɔn dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet PAPA GƆD.
Wetin mɔ mi Devid go se fɔ di ɔna we yu dɔn ɔna yu wokman? Bikɔs yu no yu wokman,
fɔseka yu wokman, PAPA GƆD, ɛn bay wetin de na yu at, yu dɔn du ɔl dɛn bi big wok ya so dat pipul dɛn go no ɔn bɔt dɛn wɔndaful tin dɛn ya.
Bay ɔl wetin wi dɔn yɛri wit wi yes, nɔbɔdi nɔ tan lɛk yu PAPA GƆD ɛn nɔn ɔda Gɔd no de pas yu wan.

Us ɔda neshɔn na wɔl we tan lɛk Izrɛl we na yu pipul dɛn, we papa Gɔd bin go fri fɔ bi in pipul dɛn, ɛn mek nem fɔ yusɛf fɔ big ɛn fiaful tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD go fɔ sev fɔ bi in pipul, yu mek nem fɔ yusɛf fɔ pawaful ɛn fiaful tin dɛm, we yu drɛb pipul dɛn ɛn put yu yon pipul dɛn we yu fri kɔmɔt Ijipt.
Ɛn yu mek Izrɛl we na yu pipul dɛn, fɔ bi yu pipul dɛn sote go; ɛn na yu, PAPA GƆD, dɔn bi dɛn PAPA GƆD.
So duya PAPA GƆD, mek di wɔd we yu dɔn tɔk bɔt yu wokman ɛn bɔt in jɛnareshɔn, bi lɛk aw yu dɔn se sote go, ɛn du wetin yu bin dɔn se;
ɛn yu nem go prɛd ɔlɔbɔt ɛn go gɛt ay rɛspɛkt, sote go, we dɛn go de tɔk se, “PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, na Gɔd na Izrɛl, ɛn yu go de pan yu wokman Devid in os traŋa wan.
Bikɔs yu we na mi Gɔd dɔn tɛl yu wokman se yu go bil os fɔ am; na dat mek yu wokman gɛt kɔrej fɔ pre to yu.
So, PAPA GƆD, na yu na Gɔd, ɛn yu dɔn prɔmis dis gud tin ya to yu wokman,
fɔseka dat, du ya, lɛ yu gladi fɔ blɛs yu wokman in os, mek i go de wok fɔ yu sote go; bikɔs ɛnitin we yu PAPA GƆD blɛs, dɔn blɛs sote go.”
Afta dat Devid bit di Filistin dɛm ɛn put dɛn ɔnda in fut, ɛn tek Gat ɛn in vilej dɛm kɔmɔt na di Filistin dɛn an.
Ɛn i bit Moab, ɛn di Moabayt dɛm tɔn Devid in slev dɛn, ɛn dɛm ɛn pe taks to am.
Devid bin igen bit Adadeza we na kiŋ na Zoba we de nia Amat, we Adadeza bin de go fɔ go mek in imej na di riva Yufretis.
