Ɛn Devid tek wan tawzin chariɔt ɛn sɛvin tawzin man dɛn we de rayd ɔs, wit twɛnti tawzin sojaman dɛn we de waka bay fut nain an; ɛn Devid kɔt kɔt ɔl di ɔs dɛn we de drɔ chariɔt, dɛn mɔsul biɛn dɛn fut, bɔt i lɛf wan ɔndrɛd ɔs we go du fɔ drɔ wan ɔndrɛd chariɔt.
Wɛn di Sirian dɛn na Damaskɔs kam fɔ ɛp Adadeza, we na kiŋ na Zoba, Devid kil twɛnti tu tawzin pan di Sirian man dɛm.
Nain Devid bil barik na Siria we de na Damaskɔs; ɛn di Sirian dɛn tɔn Devid in slev dɛm ɛn dɛn bin de pe taks to am. PAPA GƆD bin de mek Devid win ɛnisay we i go.
Devid tek di gold big shild dɛm we Adadeza in savant dɛn bin de tot, ɛn kɛr dɛm go Jerusɛlɛm.
Devid tek bɔku bɔku bras kɔmɔt na Tibat ɛn Kɔn we na Adadeza in siti dɛn; na im Sɔlɔmɔn yuz fɔ mek di bras si, di pila dɛn ɛn di bras tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz na PAPA GƆD in os.
We Tɔy we na kin na Amat yɛri se Devid dɔn bit Adadeza we na kiŋ na Zoba in wanol ami,

i sɛn in bɔypikin we nem Adoram to kiŋ Devid fɔ tɛl am adu, ɛn fɔ prez am bikɔs i dɔn fɛt Adadeza ɛn bit am; bikɔs Adadeza kin de fɛt Tɔy plɛnti tɛm. Ɛn i sɛn ɔl kayn gold, silva ɛn bras tiŋs dɛn fɔ am.
Devid gi PAPA GƆD dɛn tin dɛn de, togɛda wit di silva ɛn gold we i tek kɔmɔt na ɔl dɛn difrɛn kɔntri dɛn lɛk Idɔm, Moab, Amon, Filistia dɛm ɛn Amalɛk.
Ɛn Abishay we na Zeruaya in bɔypikin kil etin tawzin Idomayt dɛn na di sɔl vali.
Ɛn i bil barik dɛn na Idɔm; so ɔl di Idɔmayt dɛn tɔn Devid in slev. Ɛn PAPA GƆD mek Devid de win ɛnisay we i go fɛt wa.
Devid ren oba di wanol Izrɛl; i gi ɔlman in rayt ɛn ɔlman na bin wan to am.
Na Joab we na Zeruaya in bɔypikin, na bin di kɔmanda fɔ di ami, ɛn Jeoshafat Ailud in bɔypikin na bin di sɛktri.
Ɛn Zedɔk we na Aitɔb in bɔypikin wit Amilɛk we na Abiata in bɔypikin, na bin di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin; ɛn Shavsha na bin lɔya
ɛn na Bɛnaya we na Jeoayda in bɔypikin, bin de oba di Chɛrɛtayt ɛn di Pɛlɛtayt dɛm, ɛn na Devid in bɔypikin dɛm na bin di siniɔ ɔfisa dɛm na di kiŋ in savis.
Naw afta dat Naash we na di Amonayt dɛn kiŋ day, ɛn nain bɔypikin bi kiŋ nain ples.

Devid tɔk se “A go waka tret wit Anun we na Naash in bɔypikin, bikɔs in Papa bin waka tret wit mi.” So Devid sɛn mɛsenja dɛm to am fɔ go tɛl am as fɔ in Dadi we day ɛn fɔ am. So Devid in wokman dɛn go to Anun na di kɔrej i Amonayt dɛn kɔntri fɔ go tɛl am as fɔ- bɛrin.
Bɔt di Amonayt bigman dɛn aks Anun se, “Yu tink se bikɔs Devid sɛn pipul dɛn fɔ tɛl yu as min se i gi yu Papa rɛspɛkt. Nɔto kam in wokman dɛn kam fɔ kam sach yu, ovatro yu ɛn spay di land?”
So Anun kech Devid in wokman dɛn ɛn shev dɛn ɛn kɔt dɛn klos kɔmɔt midul say to dɛn wes say, ɛn drɛb dɛn;

ɛn dɛn bin go. Wɛn dɛn tɛl Devid wetin apin to di man dɛn, i sɛn go mit dɛm, bikɔs di man dɛm bin shem bad bad wan. Di kiŋ tɛl dɛn se, “Una tap na Jeriko sote una bia bia dɛn gro bak, dɛn una kin kam bak.”
Wɛn di Amonayt dɛn si se dɛn dɔn mek dɛnsɛf ɛnimi to Devid, Anun ɛn di Amonayt dɛn sɛn wan tawzin kɔpɔ silva fɔ aya chariɔt ɛn man dɛn we de rayd ɔs na Mɛsopotemia to Aramaka ɛn to Zoba.
Dɛn aya tati tu tawzin chariɔt ɛn di kiŋ na Mayaka wit in ami, we kam kamp bifo Mɛdeba. Dɔn dɛn gɛda ɔl di Amonayt dɛn kɔmɔt na dɛn siti dɛn fɔ kam fɛt.
We Devid yɛri bɔt dat, i sɛn Joab ɛn ɔl di ami we gɛt di pawaful fɛtman dɛm.
Di Amonayt dɛn kam, ɛn arenj dɛnsɛf fɔ fɛt na di siti domɔt, ɛn di kiŋ dɛm we bin kam, bin de to dɛnsɛf na di opin say na di kɔntri.
We Joab si se di fɛt bin de frɔnt am ɛn biɛn am, i pik sɔm pan di bɛst fɛtman dɛm na Izrɛl ɛn rɛdi dɛn fɔ fɛt dɛm fɔ fɛt di Sirian dɛm.
I put Abishay we nain brɔda, oba di man balans man dɛm, ɛn dɛn bin rɛdi dɛn fɔ fɛt di Amonayt dɛn.
Nain i tɛl am se, “If di Sirian dɛn tu traŋa fɔ mi, yu go ɛp mi, bɔt if di Amonayt dɛm tu mɔs fɔ yu, dɛn mi go ɛp yu.
Tinap lɛk man ɛn lɛ wi sho wisɛf lɛk man fɔ wi pipul dɛn, ɛn fɔ wi Gɔd in siti dɛm; mek PAPA GƆD du wetin i tink se gud.”
So Joab ɛn di pipul dɛn we bin de wit am go nia ɛn fes di Sirian dɛn fɔ fɛt; nain dɛn rɔnawe.
We di Amonayt dɛn si se di Sirian dɛm de rɔnawe, dɛnsɛf chuk spid kɔmɔt bifo Abishay we na Joab in brɔda, ɛn go insay di siti. Nain Joab go na Jerusɛlɛm.
Bɔt we di Sirian dɛn si se Izrɛl dɔn bit dɛm, dɛn sɛn mɛsenja dɛn go pul di Sirian dɛm we de biɛn Riva Yufretis, ɛn na Shopak we na di kɔmanda fɔ Adadeza in Amin, bin de lid dɛm.
Wɛn dɛn tɛl Devid, i gɛda di wan o Irsɛl ɛn krɔs di Jɔdan riva go mit dɛm ɛn put in ami fɔ fɛt dɛm. Wɛn Devid rɛdi fɔ fɛt di Sirian dɛm, dɛn fɛt wit am.
Di Sirian dɛm rɔnawe pan Izrɛl; ɛn Devid kil sɛvin tawzin Sirian fɛtman dɛn we bin de rayd chariɔt, wit fɔti tawzin sojaman dɛn we de waka bay fut, ɛn i kil Shopak sɛf we na di kɔmanda fɔ dɛn ami.
We Adadeza in wokman dɛn si se Izrɛl dɔn bit dɛn, i mek pis wit Devid ɛn go ɔda in pawa. So di Sirian dɛm nɔ gri fɔ ɛp di Amonayt dɛm igen

Insay di tɛm we plant dɛn kin bɔs we dɛn kɔl spriŋ, di tɛm we dɛn kiŋ dɛn kin go fɛt wa, Joab lid di ami ɛn dɛn go wutuwutu di Amonayt dɛn kɔntri ɛn kam le ambush Raba. Bɔt Devid in bin lɛf na Jerusɛlɛm. Joab kil ɔl di pipul dɛn na Raba ɛn kapchɔ am.

So Devid tek dɛn kiŋ in krawn kɔmɔt na i ed; dɛn fɛnɔt se i we bɔt sɔm tati fo kilogram ɛn wan dayamɔn insay am; so dɛn put am na Devid in ed. Dɛn pul bɔku bɔku tin dɛn kɔmɔt na di siti we dɛn briŋ kam.

Igen i briŋ di pipul we bin de na di siti kam ɛn mek dɛn de wok lɛk lebra fɔ am wit sɔ, pik aks ɛn aks. Na di sem tin i du na ɔl di Amonayt dɛn siti dɛn. Dɔn Devid ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn tɔn bak go na Jerusɛlɛm.
Afta dat, wa fɔdɔm bak wit di Filistin dɛm na Geza; nain Sibɛkay we na Ushatayt kil Sipay we na wan pan di gayant dɛn granpikin; dat mek di Filistin dɛn fɛda kan dɔŋ.
Wa fɔdɔm bak wit di Filistin dɛm; so Ɛlanan we na Jair in bɔypikin kil Lami we na Golayat we na Gitayt, in brɔda, di lɔŋ pat pan in spia bin tan lɛk mata pɛnsul
Wa bin fɔdɔm bak na Gat, usay wan man bin de we gɛt ayt ɛn bɔdi, we gɛt siks finga nain an dɛm, ɛn siks to nain fut dɛn, we ɔl bi twɛnti fo; ɛn insɛf na bin gayant dɛn sid.
We i provok Izrɛl, Jonɛthan we na Shimea we na Devid in brɔda, in bɔypikin, bin kil am.
Dɛn wan ya na dɛn gayant dɛn na Gat dɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛm; na Devid ɛn in wokman dɛn kil dɛn.
Setan tinap fɔ fɛt Izrɛl ɛn tɛmt Devid fɔ kɔnt di pipul dɛn na Izrɛl.
So Devid tɛl Joab ɛn di kɔmanda dɛm na di ami se, “Una go kɔnt di pipul dɛn na Izrɛl, frɔm Biashiba to Dan, ɛn kam gi mi di ripɔt, so a go no ɔmɔs pipul de na Izrɛl”
Bɔt Joab tɛl am se, “Mek PAPA GƆD mek in pipul dɛn plɛnti ɔndrɛd tɛm mɔ! Mi kiŋ ɛn mi masta, dɛn ɔl nɔto mi masta in wokman dɛm? Wetin mek mi masta want fɔ du dat? Wetindu i wan mek Izrɛl fil gilti?”
Bɔt di kiŋ in wɔd tinap pas Joab yon. So Joab lɛf ɛn go ɔlsay na Izrɛl ɛn kam bak na Jerusɛlɛm.
Ɛn Joab gi Devid di total nɔmba we i kɔnt di pipul dɛm. Insay di wanol Izrɛl, na wan miliɔn wan ɔndrɛd tawzin man we de fɛt wit sɔd, ɛn insay Juda, fo ɔndrɛd ɛn sɛvinti tawzin we de fɛt wit sɔd.
Bɔt Joab nɔ miks di Livay ɛn Bɛnjamin fambul pan di kɔnt bikɔs i et di kiŋ in kɔmand.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD bin vɛks fɔ dat ɛn i pɔnish Izrɛl.
So Devid tɛl PAPA GƆD se,” A dɔn sin bad bad wan we a du dis tin. Bɔt du yu, a de beg yu, mek di bad tin we yu wokman dɔn du, kɔmɔt nain ed; bɔkɔs a dɔn du fulish tin.”
So PAPA GƆD tɔk to Gad we na Devid in prɔfɛt se,
“Go tɛl Devid se, “PAPA GƆD se, a de gi yu tri tin; pik wan pan dɛm we a go du yu.”
So Gad kam mit Devid ɛn tɛl am se, “Na dis PAPA GƆD se, ‘Tek us wan yu want,

ayda lɛ aŋri fɔdɔm na di land fɔ tri ia, ɔ lɛ i mek Devid in ɛnimi dɛn de biɛn am wit sɔd fɔ tri mɔnt ɔ tri de we PAPA GƆD in sɔd go kil pipul, ɛn bad bad siknɛs we de kil pipul kwik kwik wan, ɛn PAPA GƆD in enjɛl de pas ɛn pipul ɔlsay na Izrɛl.’ So, mek ɔp yu maynd us ansa a go kɛr go gi di wan we sɛn mi”
Nain Devid tɛl Gad se, “Dis tin ya mɔna mi; mek a fɔdɔm na PAPA GƆD an, bikɔs i gɛt ebi ebi sɔri at; bɔt mek a nɔ fɔdɔm na mɔtalman an.
So PAPA GƆD sɛn bad bad siknɛs we de kil pipul kwik kwik pan Izrɛl, ɛn na sɛvinti tawzin pipul day.

Ɛn PAPA GƆD sɛn di enjɛl go Jerusɛlɛm fɔ go pwɛl pwɛl am, bɔt as i wan pwɛl am so, nain PAPA GƆD fil sɔri ɛn i chenj in maynd fɔ di bad we i dɔn mek ɔp; nain i tɛl di enjɛl we de pwɛl se “I du so; tap wetin yu de du.” PAPA GƆD in enjɛl bin tinap nia wan Jɛbu sayt we nem Araunain ples we dɛn de mas mas ɛn pul rɛs.
Devid es in yay ɛn in i si PAPA GƆD in enjɛl tinap midul di skay, ɛn i bin ol wan sɔd nain an we i tret oba Jerusɛlɛm. Nain Devid ɛn di bigman dɛn we bin wɛr saklɔth ɛn butu dɛn fes na grɔn.

So Devid tɛl PAPA GƆD se, “Nɔ to mi gi ɔda fɔ kɔnt di pipul dɛm? Na mi dɔn sin ɛn dɔn du di bad bad tin. Bɔt dɛn ship ya, wetin dɛn du? Du ya PAPA GƆD we na mi mi Gɔd, a de beg yu, pɔnish mi ɛn mi papa in os, bɔt nɔ mek dis sik kam pan yu pipul dɛn.”
Nain PAPA GƆD in enjɛl tɛl Gad traŋa wan fɔ tɛl Devid se mek Devid go ɔp go bil wan ɔlta to PAPA GƆD na Arauna we na Jɛbyusayt in ples we dɛn de mas mas ɛn pul rɛs.
So Devid go ɔp lɛk aw Gad tɛl am, we i bin tɔk insay PAPA GƆD in nem.
Arauna bin de bit bɔlgɔ; i tɔn ɛn si di enjɛl; in fo bɔypikin dɛn we bin de wit am ayd dɛnsɛf.
We Devid de kam to Arauna, Arauna luk ɛn i si Devid, so i kɔmɔt usay i bin de bit bɔlgɔ, go mit Devid ɛn i tɛl am adu.
Devid tɛl Arauna se, “Gi mi dis ples we yu de mas mas ɛn pul rɛs so dat a go bil PAPA GƆD in ɔlta de - go mi fɔ di ful prayz – so dat di siknɛs go kɔmɔt pan di pipul dɛm.”

Nain Arauna tɛl Devid “Tek am; ɛn mek mi masta we na di kiŋ du wetin i fil se gud; luk am, a de gi di man kaw dɛn fɔ bɔn sakrifays, ɛn di bɔd dɛn we dɛm de man mas mas rɛs pan fɔ di wud ɛn di bɔlgɔ fɔ di sid ɔfrin. A gi yu ɔltin”
Bɔt kiŋ Devid tɛl Arauna se,” Nɔ o, a go pe di ful prayz; A nɔ go tek wetin na yu yon gi PAPA GƆD, ɛn a nɔ go mek bɔn sakrifays we a nɔ pe natin fɔ.”
So Devid pe Arauna siks pɔynt et kilogram gold fɔ di wanol ples.
So Devid bil wan ɔlta de fɔ PAPA GƆD ɛn mek bɔn sakrifays ɛn pis ɔfrin dɛm ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD, ɛn I ansa am wit faya we kɔmɔt ɛvin pan di ɔlta we gɛt di bɔn sakrifays.
Nain PAPA GƆD gi di enjɛl ɔda, nain di enjɛn put di sɔd bak nain kes.
Da tɛm de, we Devid si se PAPA GƆD dɔn ansa am na Arauna we na Jebyusayt in grɔn fɔ mas mas ɛn pul rɛs, i mek in sakrifays dɛm de.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD in tabanakul we Mozis bin mek na di dray ples we pipul nɔ tap, ɛn di ɔlta fɔ bɔn ɔfrin datɛnde bin de di ay ples na Gibɛɔn;
bɔt Devid nɔ bin ebul do go de fɔ go aks PAPA GƆD ɛnitin, bikɔs i de fred PAPA GƆD in enjɛl in sɔd.
Nain Devid se, “Na ya Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd in os go de ɛn na ya di ɔlta go de fɔ bɔn Izrɛl dɛn ɔfrin dɛm to PAPA GƆD.”
So Devid gi ɔda mek dɛn gɛda ɔl di fɔrina dɛn we bin de na di Izrɛl, ɛn i put pipul dɛn we sabi shep ston fɔ shep di ston dɛn fayn fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os.
Pantap dat dat, Devid bin rɛdi bɔku bɔku ayɛn fɔ mek nel fɔ di do fɔ di get dɛm ɛn fɔ mek di klamp dɛn, ɛn sɛf bɔku bɔku bras we dɛn nɔ ebul we,
ɛn nɔto kɔmɔn sida bod bin de de; bikɔs di Sidonian ɛn di Tayrian dɛn briŋ bɔku bɔku sida bod fɔ Devid.

Bikɔs Devid bin se, “Sɔlɔmɔn we na mi bɔypikin yɔŋ ɛn nɔ gɛt ɛkspiriɛns, ɛn di os we fɔ bil fɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ fayn bad bad wan, ɛn dɛn fɔ de tɔk bɔt aw i fayn ɔlsay na di wɔl; so a go pripia fɔ bil am. So Devid rɛdi di tin dɛn fɔ bil di tɛmpul bɔku bɔku wan fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os bifo i day.
Dɛn i sɛn kɔl Sɔlɔmɔn we nain bɔypikin, ɛn put am pan am se na im fɔ bil PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd.
Devid tɛl Sɔlɔmɔn se, “Mi bɔypikin a bin gɛt am na mi at fɔ bil os fɔ PAPA GƆD we na mi Gɔd fɔ ɔnain nem.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi, se “Yu dɔn shɛd plɛnti blɔd ɛn yu dɔn fɛt big big wa dɛm; yu nɔ fo bil os fɔ ɔna mi nem, bikɔs yu dɔn shɛd bɔku blɔd bifo mi na dis wɔl.
Wande, dɛn go bɔn bɔypikin fɔ yu; I go bi man we lɛk pis. A go gi am alafia to ɔl in ɛnimi we de rawnd am; i go nem Sɔlɔmɔn, ɛn ɔl di tɛm we i bi kiŋ, a go Izrɛl alafia.
I go bil os fɔ ɔna mi nem. I go bi mi bɔypikin, ɛn a go bi in papa, ɛn a go mek in kiŋ ɔfis tinap traŋa wan na Izrɛl sote go.
So, mi pikin, lɛ PAPA GƆD de wit yu, so dat yu go ebul fɔ bil PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd in os jɛs lɛk aw i dɔn tɔk bɔt yu.
Di wantin we a de pre fɔ, na fɔ mek i gi yu sɛns fɔ disayd ɛn ɔndastandin so wɛn i gi yu pawa oba Izrɛl, yu go ebul du wetin PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd se yu fɔ de du.
Datɛnde bɛtɛ go fala yu if yu tek tɛm du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd bin tɛl Mozis se Izrɛl fɔ de du. Tinap lɛk man ɛn nɔ fred. Nɔ fred natin; nɔ mek natin pwɛl yu at.

A dɔn swɛt fɔ gɛda tin dɛn fɔ bin PAPA GƆD in os: 3,400 mɛtrik tɔn gold, 34,000 mɛtrik tɔn silva, ɛn bras ɛn ayɛn we dɛn nɔ ebul we bikɔs i bɔku tumɔs; a dɔn rɛdi bod ɛn ston. Yu go ad to dɛn wande de.
Yu gɛt bɔku bɔku wokman dɛm; man dɛn we sabi shep ston, mesna, kapinta ɛn bɔku bɔku wokman we sabi mek difrɛn difrɛn tin dɛn wit dɛn an, lɛk di wan dɛn we sabi wok wit,
gold, silva, bras, ɛn ayɛn. Grap go lɛ yu go du di wok! PAPA GƆD go ɛp yu!”
Igen, Devid tɛl ɔl di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl traŋa wan fɔ ɛp in bɔypikin Sɔlɔmɔn we i se,
“PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd nɔ de wit una? I nɔ dɔn gi una pis ɔl say? I dɔn put di wan dɛn we tap na di land ɔnda mi; ɛn di land de na PAPA GƆD ɛn in pipul dɛm an.

Naw una mekɔp una at ɛn maynd fɔ de wit PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd ɔltɛm. Una grap ɛn bil os fɔ PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd so dat dɛn go kɛr PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant ɛn di oli tin dɛn we dɛn kin yuz fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD, go insay os we dɛn bil fɔ Ɔna PAPA GƆD in nem.
We Devid dɔn ol ɛn dɔn te na wɔl, i mek Sɔlɔmɔn we nain bɔypikin, kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Devid gɛda ɔl di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl ɛn di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn.
Dɛn kɔnt ɔl di Livayt dɛn we ol frɔm tati ia go ɔp, ɛn ɔl ɛn ɔl, na bin tati-et tawzin man.
Devid se, “Twɛnti fo tawzin pan dɛn wan dɛn de, fɔ si dat di wok na PAPA GƆD du, siks tawzin go bi klak ɛn jɔj dɛn,
fo tawzin getman, ɛn fo tawzin go de prez PAPA GƆD wit di instrumɛnt dɛm we a dɔn mek fɔ prez PAPA GƆD.’
So Devid sheb dɛn ɛn put dɛn bay dɛn papa dɛn os we na Gashɔm, Koat ɛn Mɛrari, dat na Livay in bɔypikin dɛn.
Gashɔm in bɔypikin dɛn na Ledan ɛn Shimɛi.
Ledan in bɔypikin dɛn na Jeayɛl we na bin di big wan, Zitam ɛn Joɛl. Na bin dɛn tri.
Shimɛi in bɔypikin dɛm na Shelomɔt, Aziɛl ɛn Ɛrari. Na dɛn tri. Na dɛn na bin di big wan dɛn na dɛn papa dɛn os dɛn na Ledan in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn os.
Shimɛi in bɔypikin dɛm na Jeat, Zina, Jeush ɛn Bɛraya. Na dɛn fo ya na Shimɛi in bɔypikin dɛm.
Jeat na di big wan ɛn Zina di sɛkɛn wan; bɔt Jeush ɛn Bɛraya nɔ bin gɛt bɔku bɔypikin dɛm, so wɛn dɛm de kɔnt, dɛn kin kɔnt dɛn tu os as wan papa os.
Koat in bɔypikin dɛm na Amram, Iza, Ɛbrɔn ɛn Uziɛl. Na bin dɛn fo.

Amram in bɔypikin dɛm na bin Earɔn ɛn Mozis. PAPA GƆD bin pik Erɔn fɔ de kɔnsikret di tin dɛn we oli pas ɔl, ɛn in ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn fɔ de bɔn insɛns ɛn minista to PAPA GƆD ɛn tek in nem de blɛs sote go.
Bɔt dɛn bin put Mozis we na Man ɔf Gɔd, in bɔypikin dɛm dɛn nem wit di Livay fambul.
Mozis in bɔypikin dɛm na Gashɔm ɛn Ɛlieza.
Gashɔm in yon bɔypikin dɛn na Shɛbuɛl we na di big wan.
Ɛlieza in bɔypikin dɛm na Riabaya we na di big wan; Ɛlieza nɔ bin gɛt ɛni ɔda bɔypikin, bɔt Riabaya in bin bɔn bɔku bɔku bɔypikin dɛm!
Iza in bɔypikin dɛn na Shelomit we na di big wan.
Ɛbrɔn in bɔypikin dɛm na Jɛraya we na di big wan, Amaraya we na di sɛkɛn wan, Jaeziɛl we na di tɔd wan ɛn Jɛkamiam we na di nɔmba fo.
Uziɛl in bɔypikin dɛm na Mayka we na di big wan ɛn Ishaya we na di sɛkɛn wan.
Merari in bɔypikin dɛm na Mali ɛn Mushi. Mali in yon bɔypikin dɛm na Ɛlieza ɛn Kish.
Ɛlieza day i nɔ bɔn bɔypikin, pas gyal pikin dɛm; na dɛn fambul dɛm we na Kish in bɔypikin dɛn, mared dɛm.
Mushi in bɔypikin dɛm na Mali, Ɛda ɛn Jɛrimɔt. Na bin dɛn tri.

Na Livay in bɔypikin dɛn, dɛn wan ya bay dɛn papa dɛn os dɛn, ɛn bay di big wan dɛn na dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛn os dɛn, na dɛn dɛn bin rɛjista bay dɛn nem ɛn bay dɛn ɔmɔs we de na di famili, frɔm twɛnti ia go ɔp, we bin ebul du PAPA GƆD in wok nain os.
Bikɔs Devid bin se, “PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn gi in pipul dɛn pis; ɛn i tap na Jerusɛlɛm sote go.
So, di Livayt dɛm nɔ go gɛt fɔ de tot di tabanakul igen ɔ ɛni pan di tin dɛm we dɛn de yuz de”-
bay wetin Devid bin se bifo i day, na bin ɔl di Livayt dɛn dɛn wan ya we bin ol twɛnti ia go ɔp-
“dɛn yon wok na fɔ ɛp Earɔn in bɔypikin dɛm fɔ wok fɔ PAPA GƆD nain Os, fɔ de tek kia ɔf insay ɛn na do, fɔ de klin ɔl di oli tin dɛm we dɛn de yuz, ɛn ɛni ɔda wok we de na PAPA GƆD in os fɔ du;

fɔ ɛp fɔ de mek di oli bred, fɔ ɛp bit di flawa fɔ di sid ɔfrin, fɔ ɛp mek di bred we nɔ gɛt yist, di ɔfrin we dɛn de bek ɛn di ɔfrin dɛn we miks wit, ɛn fɔ de mɛnshɔ tin dɛn bay dɛn kwantiti, wet ɛn sayz.
Dɛn go tinap ɛvri mɔnin de tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki ɛn de prez am, semweso ivintɛm,

ɛn ɛnitɛm we dɛn de ɔfa bɔn sakrifays to PAPA GƆD, di oli de we dɛn kɔl de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst, dɛn nyu mun fɛstival ɛn di de dɛn we dɛn kin mek dɛn fist dɛn, bay ɔmɔs pipul dɛn go want, ɔltɛm bifo PAPA GƆD.
Na so dɛn fɔ tek kia ɔf di tɛnt we dɛn de mit wit PAPA GƆD, ɛn di oli ples, ɛn dɛn go de ɛp Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛn fɔ du di wok na PAPA GƆD in os.
Na so dɛn bin divayd Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛm: Nadab, Abiu, Ɛlieza ɛn Itama.
Bɔt Nadab ɛn Abiu day bifo dɛn Papa ɛn dɛn nɔ bin gɛt pikin dɛm so na Ɛlieza ɛn Itama bin kam bi di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
We Zedɔk we na wan pan Ɛlieza in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn Aimɛlɛk we na wan pan Ithama yon bɔypikin dɛn ɛp Devid, i bin ebul put dɛn usay dɛn fɔ de bay di kayn wok we dɛn bin gɛt fɔ du.

Bikɔs big wan dɛn na dɛn famili dɛn bin de pan Ɛlieza in bɔypikin dɛm pas Ithama yon, dɛn bin put dɛn ɔnda sikstin big wan dɛn na dɛn papa dɛn os pan Ɛlieza in bɔypikin dɛn, ɛn ɔnda et big wan dɛn na dɛn papa dɛn os pan Ithama in yon bɔypikin dɛm.
Dɛn bin fɛnɔt to PAPA GƆD aw ɛn us pozishɔn fɔ put ɔlman, bikɔs ɔfisa dɛn de fɔ di oli ples ɛn ɔfisa dɛn de fɔ PAPA GƆD pan Ɛlieza ɛn Itham dɛn pikin dɛn.

Na Shɛmaya we na di sɛktri ɛn na Netanɛl we na Livayt in bɔypikin, bin rɛjista dɛn bifo di kiŋ usay di bigman dɛn Zedɔk we na di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, Aimɛlɛk we na Abiata in bɔypikin, ɛn di big wan dɛn na di big wan dɛn na dɛn papa dɛn os dɛn pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn papa os dɛn, dɛn pik wan papa os fɔ Ɛlieza ɛn wan papa os fɔ Itama.
Di fɔs days fɔdɔm fɔ Jeoiarib, di sɛkɛn wan fɔ Jedaya,
di tɔd wan fɔ Arim di nɔmba fo fɔ Sɛorim,
di nɔmba fayv fɔ Malkija, di siks fɔ Mijamin,
di nɔmba sɛvin fɔdɔm fɔ Akɔz, di nɔmba et fɔ Abija,
di nɔmba nayn fɔ Jeshua, di nɔmba tɛn fɔ Shɛkanaya.
Di nɔmba livin fɔ Eliashib
Di nɔmba twɛlv fɔ Jakim, di nɔmba tɔtin fɔ Upa, di nɔmba fotin fɔ Jɛshɛbeab
Di nɔmba fiftin fɔdɔm fɔ Bilga, di nɔmba sikstin fɔ Ima,
Di nɔmba sɛvintin fɔ Ezir, di nɔmba etin fɔ Apizɛz
Di nɔmba nayntin fɔdɔm fɔ Petaia, di nɔmba twɛnti fɔ Jeɛzkɛl,
di nɔmba twɛnti wan fɔ Jachin, di nɔmba twɛnti tu fɔ Gamul,
Di nɔmba twɛnti tri fɔdɔm fɔ Dlaya, di nɔmba twɛnti fo fɔ Maazaya.
Dɛn wan ya dɛn ɔl gɛt di wok we dɛn gi dɛm aw fɔ du insay PAPA GƆD in Os akɔdin to di ɔda we Erɔn dɛn papa bin dɔn sɛt fɔ dɛm bay aw PAPA GƆD fɔ Izrɛl kɔmand am.
Ɛn fɔ di balans pan Livay in bɔypikin dɛm. Pan Amram in pikin dɛm Shubaɛl; pan Shubaɛl in bɔypikin dɛm, Jedeya.
Pan Rɛabia: Pan Riabaya in bɔypikin dɛm Ishaya di nɔmba wan;
Pan di Izarayt dɛm Shelomɔt, pan Shelomɔt in bɔypikin dɛm Ja-at;
Ɛbrɔn in bɔypikin dɛm: Jeria di lida, Amaraya sɛkɛn, Ja-aziyɛl tɔd, Jekamiam fo.
Uziɛl in bɔypikin dɛm, Mayka; pan Mayka in bɔypikin dɛm Shair.
Mayka in brɔda Ishaya; pan Ishaya in bɔypikin dɛm: Zɛkaraya
Merari in bɔypikin dɛm: Mali ɛn Mushi, Ja-ezia in bɔypikin Bɛno.
Merari in bɔypikin dɛm to Jaezia, Bɛno, Shoam, Zakɔ ɛn Ibri
Fɔ Mali: Ɛlieza we nɔ gɛt bɔypikin
Fɔ Kish, Kish in bɔypikin dɛm, Jeramil
Mushi in bɔypikin dɛm: Mali, Eda ɛn Jɛnmɔt. Dɛn wan ya na di Livayt dɛn bɔypikin dɛm akɔdin to dɛn dadi dɛn os dɛm.

Dɛn wan ya sɛf di man fɔ ɛn: Papa os ɛn in smɔl brɔda ɔl wan ib days fɔ pik lɛkɛ dɛn brɔda dɛm Earɔn in bɔypikin dɛm, frɔnt Devid, Zedɔk, Aimɛlɛk ɛn di edman dɛn fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn Livayt dɛn papa os dɛm.

Devid ɛn di lida dɛm fɔ di wɔship savis put sɔm dɛn sɛpret fɔ di wɔship, we na Ɛsa, Iman ɛn Jɛdutun dɛn bɔypikin dɛm, fɔ prɔfisay wit di laya ɛn wit di trɛbul ap ɛn wit simbɔl dɛm na di list dis fɔ di wan dɛm we du di wok ɛn wetin na dɛn wok.
Pan Esaf in bɔypikin dɛm: Zakɔ, Josɛf, Netanaya ɛn Asharela Esaf in bɔypikin dɛm ɔnda Esaf in dayrɛkshɔn, we insɛf bin de prɔfisay ɔnda di kin in dayrɛkshɔn.

Fɔ Jedutun, Jedulun in bɔypikin dɛm Gɛdalaya, Zeri, Jesha-ia, Shimɛi, Ashabia ɛn Matitiga, siks ɔnda dɛn papa Jedutun in dayrɛkshɔn, we insɛf bin prɔfisay wit di laya fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki ɛn fɔ prez am.
Fɔ Imam, Imam in bɔypikin dɛm, Bukaya, Matanaya, Uziɛl, Shebuɛl ɛn Jerimɔt, Ananaya, Annani, Eliatha, Gidalti ɛn Romamtieza, Joshbekasha, Maloti, Otir Ma-aziɔt.
Ɔl dɛn wan ya na Imam in bɔypikin dɛn di kin in prɔfɛt akɔdin to PAPA GƆD in prɔmis fɔ es am ɔp; bikɔ PAPA GƆD gi am Fotin bɔypikin ɛn tri gyal pikin.
Dɛn ɔl bin de ɔnda dɛn papa in dayrɛkshɔn fɔ myuzik na PAPA GƆD nain os wit simbɔl, trɛbul ap ɛn bes ap dɛm fɔ wɔship na PAPA GƆD in os. Esaf, Jedutun ɛn Iman de ansa to kiŋ.
Dɛn nɔmba, togɛda wit dɛn brɔda dɛm we tren pan siŋ biznɛs ɛn gɛt skil na tu ɔndrɛd ɛn eti-et.
Ɛn dɛn ib days fɔ sheb di wok, big ɛn smɔl, ticha ɛn pyupil di sem.
Di fɔs ib fɔdɔm to di Josɛf fambul fɔ di Esaf famili; di sɛkɛn wan to Gɛdalaya to in ɛn in brɔda dɛm ɛn in bɔypikin dɛm, dɛn twɛlv,
Di tɔd wan go to Zakɔ in bɔypikin ɛn in brɔda dɛm; twɛlv;
Di nɔmba fo go to Izri in pikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm.
Di nɔmba fayv go to Netanaya in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba siks go to Bukaya in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba sɛvin go to Jesharela in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba et go to Jesha-iay in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm, twɛlv.
Di nɔmba nayn go to Matanaya in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba tɛn go to Shimɛi, in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba ilɛvin go to Azarɛl in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba twɛlv go to Ashabia in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba tɔtin go to Shubaɛl in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba fotin go to Matitaya in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba fiftin go to Jɛrimɔt in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba siks go to Ananaya in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba sɛvin tin go to Joshbɛkasha in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba et in go to Anani in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba nayn tin go to Maloti in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba twɛnti go to Eliatha in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba twɛnti wan go to Otir in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba twɛnti tu go to Gidalti in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Di nɔmba twɛnti tri go to Ma-aziɔt in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda twɛlv.
Di nɔmba twɛnti fo go to Romamtieza in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn in brɔda dɛm twɛlv.
Fɔ aw dɛn divayd di get kipa dɛm: pan di Koraayt dɛm. Mɛshɛlɛmaya. Kore in bɔypikin, wan pan Pzsaf in bɔypikin dɛm.
Ɛn Mɛshɛlɛm maya bin gɛt bɔypikin dɛm Zekaraya in fɔs wan we in bɔn, Jediayɛl di sɛkɛn wan, Zebadaya, Tre, Jalhnɛl di fɔth, Elama fayv.
Jɛoanan: siks, Elidonai di sɛvin.
Ɛn Obɛdidɔm gɛt bɔypikin dɛm, Shɛmaya nɔmba wan. Jeozabad tu Jo a tri, Saka fo, Netanɛl fayv.
Amiyɛl siks, Isaka sɛvin, ɛn Pɛyulɛtay et bikɔs PAPA GƆD did blɛs am.
Fɔ Shɛmaya bin gɛt bɔypikin dɛm we dɛm bɔn fɔm, we na rula dɛm na dɛn Papa os dɛm bikɔs dɛn na man dɛm we gɛt sabi.
Shɛmaya in bɔypikin dɛm: Otni, Refayɛl, Obɛd ɛn Ɛlzabad we dɛn brɔda dɛnsɛf na soba man dɛm, Eliu ɛn Semakaya.
Ɔl dɛn wan ya na Obɛdidɔm in bɔypikin dɛm wit dɛn yon bɔypikin dɛm ɛn dɛn brɔda dɛm. Soba man dɛm fit fɔ di savis wok. Dɛn siksti-tu fɔ Obɛdidɔm.
Ɛn Meshalɛmaya gɛt bɔypikin dɛm ɛn brɔda dɛm soba man dɛm. Dɛn etin.
Ɛn Osa wan pan Merari in bɔypikin dɛm gɛt bɔypikin dɛm: Shimri di nɔmba wan (bɔt no to in fɔs bɔn o nain Papa mek am nɔmba wan.)
Ilkaya nɔmba tu, Tebalia tri Zekaraya fo: Ɔl di bɔypikin dɛm ɛn brɔda dɛm fɔ Osa na tɔtin.
Di divayd we dɛn divayd di get man dɛm na akɔdin to dɛn ed man dɛm; dɛn gɛt dɛn wok dɛm lɛk aw dɛn brɔda dɛnsɛf gɛt dɛn yon fɔ sav na PAPA GƆD in Os.
Ɛn dɛn ib days bay Papa Os, fɔ dɛn get dɛm, smɔl wan o big wan o ɔl.
Ist fɔdɔm to Shelamia, dɛn ib fɔ in pikin Zɛkaraya, we na kɔni advaysa in yon fɔdɔm na nɔt.
Obɛdidɔm yon kɔmɔt fɔ sawt ɛn dɛn put in yon bɔypikin dɛm to sto.
Fɔ Shupim ɛn Osa i kɔmɔt na Wɛst to di Shalɛkɛt get na di rod we de go ɔp. Wan wachman shift de fala si ɔda wachman shift.
Na di ist na siks ɛvride, na di nɔt na fo ɛvride, na di sawt na fo ɛvride, fo wit tu mɔ ɛn tu na di sto;
Ɛn as fɔ di pavilyɔn, fo bin de na wɛst na di rod ɛn tu bin de na di pavilyɔn.
Na so dɛn divayd di get kipa dɛm pan di Koraayt dɛm ɛn Merari bɔypikin dɛm.
Ɛn pan di Livayt dɛm Aija na rɛspɔnsibul fɔ di prɛshɔs tin dɛm ɛn kɔpɔ dɛm na PAPA GƆD in os. Na i rɛspɔnsibul bak fɔ di gift dɛn we dɛn dɛdikate to PAPA GƆD.
Ledan in bɔypikin dɛm: Di Gashɔnayt dɛn bɔypikin dɛm we blant Ledan. Di Papa os edman dɛn we blant Ledan di Gashɔ.
Jeayɛli in bɔypikin dɛm: Zefam ɛn Joɛl in brɔda na dɛn bin rɛspɔnsibul fɔ di prɛshɔs tin dɛm ɛn di kɔpɔ biznɛs nain PAPA GƆD os.
Pan di Amramayt dɛm, di Izarayt dɛm di Ɛbrɔnayt dɛm ɛn di Uziɛlayt dɛm.
Ɛn Shebuɛl, Gashɔm bɔypikin, Mozis bɔypikin nain na di bɔs fɔ dɛn wan we rɛspɔnsibul fɔ di prɛshɔs tiŋs dɛm ɛn di kɔpɔ biznɛs.
In brɔda dɛm. Frɔm Ɛlieza in bɔypikin Reabia ɛn in bɔypikin Jeshaya, in bɔypikin Joram, in bɔypikin Zikray ɛn in bɔypikin Shelomit.
Dis Shelomit ɛn in brɔda dɛm bin rɛspɔnsibul fɔ ɔl di prɛshɔs tin dɛm we na gift we dɛdiket to PAPA GƆD, we kiŋ Devid ɛn di Ami ɔfisa dɛm fɔ tawzin ɛn fɔ ɔndrɛd ɛn di Ami kɔmanda dɛm bi dɛdiket.
Dɛn tek pan dɛn tin dɛn we dɛn gɛt na dɛn wa we dɛn fɛt ɛn win, ɛn dɛdiket dɛm as gift fɔ mɛntenans PAPA GƆD in os.

Igen ɔl wetin Samiɛl we de si vishɔn, ɛn Sɔl we na Kish in bɔypikin, ɛn Abna we na Nɛr in bɔypikin ɛn Joab we na Zeruaya bɔypikin, bin dɔn dɛdiket. - Ɔl di gift dɛn we dɛn dɛdiket bin de na Shelomɔt ɛn in brɔda dɛn kia.
Pan di Izarayt dɛm Chɛnanaya ɛn in bɔypikin dɛm nain dɛn pik fɔ du ɔda awtsayd wok fɔ Izrɛl fɔ bi gɔvmɛnt ɔfisa ɛn jɔj dɛm.
Pan di ɛbrɔnayt dɛm, Ashabia ɛn in brɔda dɛn wan tawzin sɛvin ɔndrɛd man dɛm we ebul na dɛn na supavaysɔ fɔ Izrɛl to di wɛst say to Jɔdan fɔ ɔl in wok ɛn di kiŋ in savis.

Pan di Ɛbrɔnayt dɛm, Jerayja nain na di na di lida fɔ di Ɛbrɔnayt dɛm, lɛk us layn ɔ papa os. (Di ia we mek fɔti we Devid bi kiŋ nain dɛn mek sach fɔ man dɛn we ebul ɛn na masta sabi man dɛm ɛn dɛn fɛn Jeza na Gulayad.)

Kiŋ Devid pik am ɛn in brɔda dɛm, tu tawzin sɛvin ɔndrɛd man dɛm we ebu Papa os edman dɛm fɔ bi supavaysɔ to di Rubɛnayt dɛm, di Gadayt dɛm, ɛn di Manasɛ af trayb fɔ ɛnitin we kɔnsan PAPA GƆD ɔ fɔ di kiŋ biznɛs.

Na di list dis fɔ di Izrɛl pipul dɛm, di Papa os edman dɛm, di kɔmand dɛm fɔ wan tawzin ɛn wan ɔndrɛd ɛn dɛn ɔfisa dɛm we sav di kiŋ pan ɔl kayn tin we na fɔ di difrɛn sɛkshɔn dɛm we de kam ɛn go mɔnt bay mɔnt te di ia dɔn, ɛni sɛkshɔn in nɔmba na twɛnti fo tawzin.
Jashobiam Zabdiɛl in bɔypikin nain rɛspɔnsibul fɔ di fɔ grup ɛn di fo tawzin.
Na Pɛrɛz in layn in kɔmɔt ɛn nain na di lida fɔ ɔl di kɔmanda dɛm na di ami fɔ di fɔs mɔnt.
Doday di Ao-ayt nain rɛspɔnsibul fɔ di grup di sɛkɛn mɔnt, Insay in sɛkshɔn na twɛnti fo tawzin.
Di tɔd kɔmanda fɔ di tɔd mɔnt na bin Bɛnaya, we na Jeodia di Man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin bɔypikin ɛn ɔnda in kɔmand i bin gɛt twɛnti fo tawzin man.
Dis na Bɛnaya we na bin mayti man pan tati man, ɛn bin de kɔntrol dɛn ɔl. Na Amizabad we nain bɔypikin nain rɛspɔnsibul fɔ da sɛkshɔn de.
As ɛl Joab in brɔda na nɔmba to fɔ di mɔnt we mek fo. Ɛn in bɔypikin Zebadaya bin de nɛks to am; nain Sɛkshɔn na dɛn twɛnti fo tawzin.
Di nɔmba fayv kɔmanda fɔ di nɔmba fayv mɔnt na Shamut di Izrayt; nain sɛkshɔn na dɛn twɛnti fo tawzin; nain sɛkshɔn na dɛn twɛnti fo tawzin.
Siks, fɔ di nɔmba siks mɔnt na Ira, Ikɛsh di Tekoayt in bɔypikin. Nain sɛkshɔn na twɛnti fo tawzin de de.
Sɛvin fɔ di sɛvin mɔnt na Elɛz di Pɛlanayt wan pan Ifrem in bɔypikin dɛm in sɛkshɔn na twɛnti fo tawzin de de.
Et, fɔ di et mɔnt na sibɛkay di Ushatayt wan pan di Zeraayt dɛm in sɛkshɔn na twɛnti fo tawzin de de.
Nayn fɔ di nɔmba nayn mɔnt na Abieza fɔ Anatɔt wan Bɛnjaminayt; in sɛkshɔn na twɛnti fo tawzin de de.
Tɛn fɔ di nɔmba tɛn mɔnt na Na-aray fɔ Nefofa wan pan di Zeraayt dɛm, in sɛkshɔn na twɛnti fo tawzin de de.
Ilɛvin fɔ di ilɛvin mɔnt na Benaya we kɔmɔt Piratɔn wan pan Ifrem in bɔypikin dɛm in sɛkshɔn na twɛnti-fo tawzin de de.
Twɛlv fɔ di nɔmba twɛlv mɔnt na Ɛlday di Nefofatayt-na Otniɛl in layn i kɔmɔt in sɛkshɔn na twɛnti fo tawzin de de.
Fɔ di Rubɛnayt dɛm, Ɛlieza Zikray in bɔypikin nain na di chif supavaysɔ fo di Simiɔnayt dɛm na Shefataya Mayaka in bɔypikin.
Fɔ Livay na Ashabia Kemwɛl in bɔypikin fɔ Erɔn na Zedɔk.
Fɔ Juda, Eli-yu wan pan Devid in brɔda dɛm fɔ Isaka Omri Naykɛl in bɔypikin
Fɔ Ɛbyulɔn Ismaya, Obadaya in bɔypikin fɔ Naflalay, Jɛremɔt Azriɛl in bɔypikin
fɔ di Ifremayt dɛm: Oshia Azazaya in bɔypikin fɔ di af pan di Manasɛ fambul, na bin Joɛl we na Pedaya in bɔypikin.
Fɔ di ɔda af pan di trayb we de Giliad, Ido Zekaraya in bɔypikin fɔ Bɛnjamin Ja-asiɛl Abnain bɔypikin;
fɔ Dan, Azarɛl Jɛroam in bɔypikin. Na dɛn wan ya na di lida dɛm fɔ Izrɛl dɛn trayb dɛm.
Dɛn wan we de ɔnda twɛnti Devid nɔ kɔnt dɛm bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin dɔn gi in wɔd se in go mek Izrɛl bɔku lɛk di sta dɛn na ɛvin.
Joab Zenia in bɔypikin bin begin fɔ kɔnt bɔt inɔ dɔn; stil vɛksteshɔn kam pan Izrɛl fɔ seka dis ɛn dɛn nɔ ɛnta di nɔmba usay Kiŋ Devid kin mek rɛkɔd.
Di finans minista na bin Azmavɛt, Adiɛl in bɔypikin ɛn nain di Finans ɔfisa fɔ di kɔntri ɛn di siti dɛm ɛn di vilej dɛm na Jonɛthan Uzaya in bɔypikin.
Fɔ dɛn wan we de wok fam na Ɛzri we na Chelub in bɔypikin.
Fɔ supavays di grepvayn fam dɛm na Shimɛi di Ramatayt ɛn di wan we de supavays di tin we de kɔmɔt na di grepvayn fam dɛm fɔ di wayn faktri dɛm na Zabdi di Shifmayt.
Di supavaysɔ fɔ di ɔliv ɛn di sikamɔ tik dɛm na di Shɛfɛla na Bealana di Gɛdarayt ɛn di wan we de kɔntrol usay dɛn de gɛda ɛn kip ɔyl na Joash.
Di pɔsin we de fɔ di kaw dɛm we de mɛm na Sharɔn na Shitray di Sharonayt fɔ di wan dɛm we de na di vali dɛm na Shafat Adlay in bɔypikin.
Di supavaysɔ fɔ di kamɛl dɛm na Obil di Ishɛlayt ɛn fɔ di uman dɔŋki dɛm na Jedaya di Mɛronotay fɔ disiv ɛn got dɛm na Jaziz di Agrayt.
Ɔl dɛn wan ya na stiwɔd dɛm fɔ kiŋ Devid in prɔpati dɛm.
Jonɛthan we na Devid in ɔnkul, na bin advaysa, we i bi se na man we gɛt ɔndastandin ɛn de rid ɛn rayt. Nain ɛn Jeayɛl we na Achimoni in bɔypikin, bin de tren di kiŋ in bɔypikin dɛm fɔ bi kiŋ.
Aitofɛl na di kiŋ in advaysa ɛn Ushay di Arkayt nain padi
Jɛ-odia, Bɛnaya in bɔypikin ɛn Abiata na dɛn tek Aitofɛl in ples. Joab na bin di kɔmanda fɔ di kiŋ in ami.

Devid gɛda ɔl di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl, insay Jerusɛlɛm; di wan dɛm we de fɔ di difrɛn fambul dɛm, di bigman dɛm fɔ di difrɛn sɛkshɔn dɛm we de sav di kiŋ, di kɔmanda dɛm fɔ tawzin, di kɔmanda dɛn fɔ ɔndrɛd, di man dɛm we de tek kia ɔf di kiŋ in prɔpati, in kaw dɛm ɛn i bɔypikin dɛm, wit di pipul dɛn we de wok na di kiŋ in os, di pawaful fɛtman dɛm, ɛn fɛtman dɛn we dɔn fɛt fɔ lɔŋ.

Nain Kiŋ Devid tinap ɛn tɔk se, “Mi brɔda ɛn mi pipul dɛn, una lisin wetin a de se. I bin de na mi at fɔ bil os usay PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant go de, ɛn usay wi Gɔd insɛf go tap; ɛn a dɔn rɛdi ɔltin fɔ di bildin.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “yu nɔ go bil os fɔ ɔna mi nem bikɔs yu na fɛtman ɛn yu dɔn shɛd blɔd.”

Pan ɔl dat, PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, pik mi pan ɔl mi papa in pikin dɛn fɔ bi kiŋ na Izrɛl sote go; bikɔs i pik Juda fɔ bi lida, ɛn insay Juda in os we na mi papa in os, ɛn pan ɔl mi papa in bɔypikin dɛn, i gladi fɔ mek mi kiŋ oba di wanol Izrɛl.
Ɛn pan ɔl mi bɔypikin dɛm (bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn gi mi bɔku bɔypikin dɛm) i dɔn pik Sɔlɔmɔn we na mi bɔypikin fɔ sidɔm na di kiŋ chia na PAPA GƆD kindɔm oba Izrɛl.
I tɛl mi se, “Na Sɔlɔmɔn we na yu bɔypikin go bil mi os ɛn mek mi yad, bikɔs a dɔn pik am fɔ bi mi yon bɔypikin ɛn a go bi in Papa.
A go mek in kidɔm tinap traŋa wan sote go if i mekɔp in maynd fɔ de du ɔl wetin a bin tɛl dɛn se dɛn fɔ de du, jɛs lɛk aw i de so tide.”

Fɔ seka dat, bifo ɔlman na Izrɛl, PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn we dɔn gɛda na ya, we wi Gɔd sɛf de yɛri, una fɛn ɛn du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD tɔk traŋa wan se una fɔ de du; so dat una go gɛt dis gud land ɛn day lɛf am fɔ una pikin dɛn, so te go.

“Ɛn yu, Sɔlɔmɔn mi bɔypikin, sabi yu Papa in Gɔd, ɛn sav am wit ɔl yu at ɛn sol; bikɔs PAPA GƆD de luk ɔl man at ɛn i no ɔlman plan ɛn wetin i de tink bɔt. If yu luk fɔ am, yu go ebul fɛn am; bɔt if yu tɔn yu bak pan am, i go trowe yu sote go.
Tek tɛm o, bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn pik yu fɔ bil os we fɔ de wɔship am; tinap lɛk man.
Nain Devid gi Sɔlɔmɔn we nain bɔypikin di plan fɔ di men pɔch na di tɛmpul, ɛn fɔ in os dɛm, di vɛstri, di rum dɛm we de ɔp, di insay rum dɛm ɛn di rum we go gɛt di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant;
ɛn ɔl di plan fɔ ɔl wetin bin gɛt nain maynd fɔ di yad dɛm fɔ PAPA GƆD in os, ɛn ɔl di rum dɛm we de rawnd, di sto rum fɔ bi valyuebul tin dɛn, ɛn di rum fɔ kip di tin dɛn we dɛn dɔn gi PAPA GƆD;
fɔ di say dɛn we dɛn sheb fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn fɔ di Livayt dɛm, ɛn ɔl di difrɛn wok fɔ wok fɔ PAPA GƆD nain os; fɔ ɔl di tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz na PAPA GƆD in os,
ɔmɔs gold fɔ ɔl di gold tin dɛn fɔ yuz na PAPA GƆD in os; Ɔmɔs silva fɔ yuz na PAPA GƆD in os,
di gold lamp stand dɛn ɛn dɛn gold lamp dɛm wet, di wet fɔ wan gold lamp stand ɛn in gold lamp, di wet fɔ wan silva lamp stand ɛn in silva lamp dɛn, bay aw dɛn de yuz di lamp na PAPA GƆD in os.
Ɔmɔs gold fɔ wan tebul fɔ shobred, di silva fɔ di silva tebul dɛm,
ɛn piɔ gold fɔ di fɔk dɛm, di besin dɛm ɛn di kɔp dɛm; fɔ di gold bol dɛm ɛn ɔmɔs wan in wet bi, fɔ di silva bol dɛm ɛn ɔmɔs wan in wet go bi;
fɔ di ɔlta we na piɔ gold dɛn go tek mek am ɛn in wet, fɔ de bɔn insɛns; ɛn in plan sɛf fɔ di chɛryubim dɛn we de opin dɛn wiŋs ɛn kɔba PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant.
I mek ɔl dɛn tin ya klia, bay wetin PAPA GƆD se bɔt dɛn, se dɛn fɔ du ɔl di wok akɔdin to plan.

Nain Devid tɛl Sɔlɔmɔn we nain bɔypikin se, “tinap lɛk man, tek kɔrej ɛn du am. Nɔ fred natin ɛn nɔ pwɛl at; bikɔs PAPA GƆD we na mi yon Gɔd de wit yu. I nɔ go fel yu, i nɔ go kɔmɔt biɛn yu, sote ɔl di wok we de fɔ du na PAPA GƆD in os, go dɔn.

Luk di difrɛn difrɛn sɛkshɔn dɛm pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn di Livayt dɛm, fɔ ɔl di wok na PAPA GƆD in os; ɛn we na yu de bifo pan di wok, ɔlman we sabi difrɛn difrɛn wok go gladi fɔ du ɛni kayn wok na PAPA GƆD in os; ɛn ɔl di bigman dɛn ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn go du ɛnitin we yu tɛl dɛn.

Devid we na di kiŋ tɛl dɛn ɔl di wan dɛn we gɛda de se, “Sɔlɔmɔn mi bɔypikin, we nain wangren PAPA GƆD dɔn pik, yɔŋ ɛn in nɔ gɛt ɛkspiriɛns, ɛn di wok big; bikɔs di kiŋ os nɔto fɔ mɔtalman, bɔt na fɔ Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd.

So a dɔn gɛda ɔltin fɔ mi Gɔd in os, to usay mi an ebul rich; di gold fɔ di gold tin dɛm, di silva fɔ di silva tin dɛm ɛn di bras fɔ di bras tin dɛm, bras fɔ di bras tin dɛm, ayɛn fɔ di ayɛn tin dɛm ɛn bod fɔ di bod tin dɛm, apat frɔm di ɔniks ɛn fayn fayn ston dɛm fɔ dɛkɔret, silva ɛn wayt mɛtal, difrɛn difrɛn kɔla ston dɛm, ɛn ɔl kayn valyuebul ston dɛm, ɛn mabul.
Pantap ɔl wetin a dɔn gɛda fɔ di oli os, a gɛt misɛf yon gold ɛn silva tin dɛn we a kip, fɔseka we a gi misɛf fɔ PAPA GƆD in os, a de gi dɛn fɔ mi Gɔd in os:
wan ɔndrɛd mɛtrik tɔn piɔ gold, ɛn tu ɔndrɛd ɛn fɔti mɛtrik tɔn silva fɔ dɛkɔret di os in wɔl,
ɛn fɔ ɔl di wok we pipul dɛn we de wok wit dɛn an fɔ du, gold fɔ di gold tin dɛn ɛn silva fɔ di silva tin dɛn. Udat go gi in at to PAPA GƆD tide we dɛn nɔ fos am?”

So di big wan dɛn na dɛn papa dɛn os dɛn bin dɔn gi wetin dɛnsɛf fil na dɛn at fɔ gi, semweso di wan dɛn we de fɔ di difrɛn fambul fambul dɛn, di kɔmanda dɛn fɔ tawzin tawzin ɛn fɔ ɔndrɛd, ɛn di bigman dɛn na di kiŋ in os.
Dɛn gi, wan ɔndrɛd ɛn sɛvinti mɛtrik tɔn gold, tri ɔndrɛd ɛn fɔti mɛtrik tɔn silva, siks ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti mɛtrik tɔn bras ɛn tri tawzin fo ɔndrɛd mɛtrik tɔn ayɛn.
Ɛn ɛnibɔdi we gɛt dɛn valyuebul ston, go gi na di sto we dɛn de kip di valyuebul tin dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os we na na Jeayɛl we na Gashonayt de inchaj.
Di pipul dɛn gladi bikɔs dɛn dɔn gi wit ɔl dɛn at, ɛn na wit ɔl dɛn at dɛn gi fri wan to PAPA GƆD; Devid we na di kiŋ insɛf bin gladi bad bad wan.
So Devid blɛs PAPA GƆD bifo dɛn ɔl we gɛda de; ɛn Devid tɔk se, “Yu gɛt blɛsin PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, we na wi Papa, sote go ɛn sote go.

PAPA GƆD yu gret, yu gɛt pawa, na yu dɛn de kɔle pan, yu de win ɔltɛm, ɛn di ɔna we pas ɔl ɔna, bikɔs ɔl wetin de na ɛvin ɛn dis wɔl na yu yon. Di kindɔm na yu yon, PAPA GƆD, ɛn na yu de pantap ɔltin.
Na yu de gi Jɛntri ɛn ɔna, ɛn na yu de rul oba ɔl. Pawa ɛn trɛnk de de na yu an; ɛn yu an na fɔ mek pɔsin pawaful ɛn fɔ gi ɔlman trɛnk.
So, wi Gɔd, wi tɛl yu tɛnki ɛn prez yu nem we dɛn de kɔle pan.
“Bɔt udat na mi, ɛn udat na mi pipul dɛm we wi fɔ ebul gi wit ɔl wi at? Bikɔs ɔltin kɔmɔt to yu ɛn na pan wetin yu gi wi, we dɔn gi yu so.
Bikɔs win na trenja dɛn to yu; pipul dɛn we kam tap jɛs lɛk wi fɔstɛm-papa dɛn; wi tɛm na dis wɔl na lɛk shado ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap ya sote go.
PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd, ɔl dɛn bɔku bɔku tin ya we wi dɔn gɛda fɔ bil os fɔ yu, fɔ yu oli nem, kɔmɔt na yu an ɛn ɔl na yu yon.
Mi Gɔd, a no se yu de tɛst mɔtalman maynd kin gladi wit udat de waka tret; na wit klin at a dɔn gi yu ɔl dɛn tin ya, wit ɔl mi at ɛn wit gladi.
PAPA GƆD we na Ebram, Ayzak ɛn Jekɔb we na wi papa dɛn, dɛn Gɔd, bin dɔn mek dɛn pipul ya gri sote go fɔ dɛn kayn tin ya na dɛn at, ɛn mek dɛn at de to yu.
Gi Sɔlɔmɔn we na mi bɔypikin di pawa fɔ du ɔl wetin yu tɔk traŋa wan se wi fɔ de du, kip in tɛstimoni ɛn di lɔ dɛn, so dat i go ebul bil di kiŋ os we a dɔn gɛda ɔltin fɔ bil.
Nain Devid tɛl dɛn ɔl we gɛda de se, “Blɛs PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd.” Nain dɛn ɔl we gɛda de blɛs PAPA GƆD we na dɛn papa dɛn Gɔd, ɛn butu dɛn ed na grɔn ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD, ɛn baw to di kiŋ.

Ɛn dɛn mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD, ɛn di ɔda de dɛn mek bɔn sakrifays to PAPA GƆD, wit wan tawzin man kaw, wan tawzin man ship ɛn wan tawzin ship pikin wit dɛn drink ɔfrin ɛn bɔku bɔku sakrifays dɛm fɔ di wanol Izrɛl;

ɛn dɛn itɛn drink da de de bifo PAPA GƆD wit bɔku gladi gladi. Ɛn dɛn mek Sɔlɔmɔn we na Devid in bɔypikin, kiŋ, di sɛkɛn tɛm, ɛn dɛn anɔynt am as di bigman fɔ PAPA GƆD in biznɛs ɛn dɛn anɔynt Zedɔk as di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
So Sɔlɔmɔn sidɔm na PAPA GƆD in kiŋ in chia nain papa Devid in ples, ɛn bɛtɛ fala am ɛn ɔl man na Izrɛl obe am.
Ɔl di lida dɛm ɛn di pawaful man dɛm, ɛn sɛf ɔl kiŋ Devid in bɔypikin dɛm, gri fɔ put dɛnsɛf ɔnda Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn.
So PAPA GƆD gi Sɔlɔmɔn ay ay rɛspɛkt na di wanol Izrɛl dɛn yay, ɛn gi am bi big ɔna we nɔn kiŋ bifo am na Izrɛl nɔ gɛt.
Na so Devid we na Jɛsi in bɔypikin bin rul ɔloba Izrɛl.
Di tɛm we i rul as kiŋ na Izrɛl na fɔti ia; i rul na Ɛbrɔn fɔ sɛvin ia, ɛn na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ tati tri ia.
Afta dat, i day we i bin dɔn ol bad bad, i bin liv lɔŋ, i bin jɛntri ɛn bin gɛt rɛspɛkt; ɛn na Sɔlɔmɔn we nain bɔypikin bin tek in ples as kiŋ.
Di tin dɛn we kiŋ Devid du, frɔm fɔs to las, rayt na di buk dɛm we dɛn kɔl Di Kronikul ɔf Samiɛl we de si vishɔn, Di Kronikul ɔf Netan we na prɔfɛt, ɛn Di Kronikul ɔf Gad we insɛf de si vishɔn,
ɛn ɔl aw rul, ɛn in pawa, ɛn di tin dɛn we apin in ɛn Izrɛl, ɛn ɔl di ɔda kɔntri dɛn kindɔm dɛm na di ɔda kɔntri dɛn.
Sɔlɔmɔn we na Devid in bɔypikin, sidɔm traŋa nain kindɔm, ɛn PAPA GƆD we in Gɔd bin de wit am, ɛn I mek am pawaful bad bad wan.
Sɔlɔmɔn tɔk to di wanol Izrɛl, to di kɔmanda dɛm fɔ tawzin tawzin ɛn ɔndrɛd, to di jɔj dɛm ɛn to ɔl di bigman dɛm na Izrɛl, ɛn di big wan dɛn na dɛn papa dɛn os dɛm.

Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn na Izrɛl go na di ay ples we bin de na Gibiɔn; bikɔs na de di tɛnt we dɛn de mit wit PAPA GƆD we Mozis we na PAPA GƆD in wokman bin mek na di ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, bin de.
(Bɔt Devid bin dɔn briŋ PAPA GƆD In Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant kɔmɔt Kriat Jearim na di ples we Devid bin dɔn mek ples fɔ am, dat na we i bin pich tɛnt fɔ am na Jerusɛlɛm.)
Pantap dat, di bras ɔlta we Bɛzalɛl we na Yuri, we na Ɔ in bɔypikin, in yon bɔypikin, bin mek, bin dɔn de de bifo PAPA GƆD in tabanakul. So Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn di ɔl di pipul dɛm na Izrɛl, pre to PAPA GƆD.
So Sɔlɔmɔn go ɔp to di bras ɔlta bifo PAPA GƆD we bin de na di tɛnt we dɛn bin de mit wit PAPA GƆD, ɛn mek wan tawzin bɔn sakrifays pan am.
Da nɛt de, PAPA GƆD apia to Sɔlɔmɔn, ɛn tɛl am se,” Tɛl mi wetin yu want mek a gi yu.”
Nain Sɔlɔmɔn tɛl PAPA GƆD se, “Yu dɔn sho tumɔs lɔv we nɔ de chenj to mi Papa Devid, ɛn yu mek mi kiŋ nain ples.
Duya PAPA GƆD, mek wetin yu bin prɔmis mi papa Devid, bi naw, bikɔs yu dɔn mek mi kiŋ fɔ pipul dɛn we bɔku lɛk sansan.
Gi mi sɛns ɛn sabi fɔ rul dɛn pipul ya, bikɔs udat go ebul rul dɛn yu pipul we plɛnti so wit in yon sɛns nɔmɔ?”

Nain PAPA GƆD ansa Sɔlɔmɔn se, “Bikɔs na dat de na yu at, ɛn nɔ aks fɔ prɔpati, jɛntri, ɔna ɔ fɔ yu ɛnimi dɛn layf, ɛn yu nɔ ivin aks fɔ lɔŋ layf, bɔt yu aks fɔ sɛns ɛn sabi fɔ yusɛf mek yu go ebul rul mi pipul dɛn we a dɔn mek yu kiŋ oba dɛn,

a de gi yu di sɛn ɛn sabi we yu aks fɔ. Pantap dat, a go gi yu jɛntri, bɔku bɔku prɔpati ɛn ɔna we nɔn pan di kiŋ dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo yu nɔ gɛt wande, ɛn nɔn pan di wan dɛn we go kam afta yu, nɔ go ɛva gɛt.
So Sɔlɔmɔn kɔmɔt na di ay ples na Gibiɔnn na di tɛn we dɛn de mi wit PAPA GƆD, kam Jerusɛlɛm. I rul Izrɛl.

Sɔlɔmɔn gɛda wan ples, chariɔt dɛm ɛn man dɛn we de rayd ɔs; i bin gɛt wan tawzin fo ɔndrɛd chariɔt, ɛn twɛlv tawzin man dɛm we de rayd ɔs, we i steshɔn na chariɔt siti dɛm, ɛn wit di kiŋ na Jerusɛlɛm.
Di kiŋ mek silva ɛn gold plɛnti lɛk ston na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn, i mek sida tik bɔku lɛk di sikamɔ tik dɛm na Shɛfɛla.
Sɔlɔmɔn bin de bay ɔs kɔmɔt Musri ɛn Silishia, ɛn di kiŋ in biznɛsman dɛn bin de bay dɛn dia wan.
Dɛn bay wan chariɔt siks ɔndrɛd silva kɔpɔ kɔmɔt Ijipt, ɛn wan ɔs fɔ wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti silva kɔpɔ; semweso, dɛn bin de sɛl gi di Itayt kiŋ dɛm ɛn di kiŋ dɛm na Siria, tru di kiŋ in biznɛsman dɛm.
Naw Sɔlɔmɔn mek ɔp fɔ bil tɛmpul fɔ PAPA GƆD in nem ɛn rɔyal kiŋ os fɔ insɛf.
Ɛn Sɔlɔmɔn sɛt sɛvinti tawzin man dɛm fɔ tot lod ɛn eti tawzin fɔ brok ɛn kɔt ston na di it kɔntri ɛn tri tawzin siks ɔndrɛd fɔ de wach dɛm.
Ɛn Sɔlɔmɔn sɛn wɔd to Uram di kiŋ na Taya, Lɛk aw yu du fɔ mi papa ɛn sɛn sida tik fɔ am fɔ bil os fɔ insɛf fɔ tap insay, du so to mi.”

Una lisin, a de kam bil os fɔ ɔna PAPA GƆD we na mi Gɔd, in nem, ɛn dɛdiket am to am fɔ de bɔn insɛns dɛn we gɛt fayn sɛnt to am, ɛn fɔ de ɔfa bred we fɔ ɔfa to am, ɛn fɔ de mek bɔn sakrifays mɔnin ɛn ivin, di sabat de dɛm ɛn di nyu mun fɛstival dɛm, ɛn di fist dɛn we PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd dɔn pik, fɔ Izrɛl fɔ de mek, sote go.
Di os we a de kam bil go big bad bad wan, bikɔs wi Gɔd pawaful pas ɔl ɔda gɔd dɛm.
Bɔt udat go ebul bil os fɔ am, we ɛvin we na ɛvin we ay pas ɔl nɔ du fɔ am? Udat na mi fɔ bil os fɔ am, pas nɔmɔ ples fɔ de bɔn insɛns to am.

So sɛn wan masta sabi wokman we sabi wok gold, silva, bras, ɛn ayɛn, ɛn wit pɔpul, rɛd ɛn blu matirial dɛm to mi, pɔsin we sabi kav, wok fɔ kan de wit di man dɛm we sabi wok wit dɛn an, we de wi mi na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm; we mi Papa Devid bin dɔn gi mi.
Sɛn sida tik, sayprɛs ɛn algɔm timba we kɔmɔt Libanɔn, fɔ mi, bikɔs a no se yu wokman dɛn sabi kɔt timba na Libanɔn. Mi wokman dɛm go de wit yu yon wokman dɛm,
fɔ rɛdi bɔku timba fɔ mi, bikɔs di os we a de kam bil go big ɛn fayn bad bad wan.
A go gi yu wokman dɛn we de kɔt di timba, tu tawzin mɛtrik tɔn fayn wit, tu tawzin mɛtrik tɔn bɔlgɔ, fo ɔndrɛd tawzin lita wayn ɛn fo ɔndrɛd tawzin ɔyl.
Nain Uram we na di kiŋ na Taya ansa am na wan lɛta we i sɛn to Sɔlɔmɔn se, “Bikɔs PAPA GƆD lɛk in pipul dɛn, i dɔn mek yu kin oba dɛm.”

Uram tɛl am igen se,” Mek PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd we mek ɛvin ɛn dis wɔl, gɛt blɛsin, in we dɔn gi Kiŋ Devid in bɔypikin we gɛt sɛns, we ebul mekɔp in maynd, we go bil PAPA GƆD in os ɛn bil kiŋ os fɔ insɛf.
“A dɔn sɛn wan masta sabi wokman we gɛt sɛns fɔ wok. I nem Uram;

in na wan pan Dan in gyal pikin dɛn yon bɔypikin, ɛn in papa na man we kɔmɔt Taya. I sabi wok wit gold, silva, bras, ayɛn, ston ɛn bod, ɛn wit mov, blu ɛn rɛd matirial ɛn fayn linin, ɛn sabi du ɔl kayn kavin wok ɛn mek ɛni dizayn we dɛn aks am fɔ mek, ɛn go wok wit una wokman dɛm, we na mi masta Devid we na yu papa, in wokman dɛm.
So, kɔnsanin di wit ɛn bɔlgɔ, ɛn di ɔyl ɛn wayn we mi masta dɔn tɔk bɔt, lɛ i sɛn dɛn to in wokman dɛn;
ɛn wi go kɔt ɔmɔs timba we yu want na Libanɔn, ɛn wi go lod am na raft kɛr go Jopa bay si, so dat yu kin kɛr am go ɔp na Jerusɛlɛm.
So Sɔlɔmɔn kɔnt ɔl di fɔrina dɛn na Izrɛl, afta di kɔnt we in papa Devid bin dɔn kɔnt pipul dɛn na Izrɛl; na bin wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti tri tawzin, siks ɔndrɛd fɔrina.
Dɛn bin pik sɛvinti tawzin pan dɛn put fɔ de fot lod, eti tawzin fɔ brok ɛn kɔt ston na di il kɔntri, ɛn tri tawzin siks ɔndrɛd fɔ supavays dɛn mek di pipul dɛm do di wok.

Nain Sɔlɔmɔn bigin bil PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm na Mawnt Moraya usay PAPA GƆD bin apia to Devid we nain papa, na di ples we Devid bin dɔn pik na Arauna we na Jɛbyusayt in ples we dɛn de mas ɛn pul rɛs.
I begin bil na di sɛkɛn mɔnt insay di fo ia we i bin bigin rul.
Na di mɛzɔmɛnt dɛn dis we Sɔlɔmɔn mek fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os; di lɛnt na bin twɛnti sɛvin mita ɛn i bin nayn mita wayd.
Di pɔch na di ɛntrans na bin nayn mita lɔŋ we na semweso di os wayd, ɛn fifti fo mita ay. I plasta insay wit piɔ gold.
Dɛn mek ɔloba di men rum wit Sayprɛs bod ɛn plasta am wit fayn gold ɛn mek pam ɛn chen dizayn pam am.
I dɛkɔret di os wit difrɛn difrɛn valyuebul ston dɛn. Di gold na Pavaim gold.
So i plasta di os wit gold; di bim dɛm, di domɔt ɛn do post, in wɔl dɛm ɛn di do dɛnsɛf sɛf; ɛn i kav chɛryubim dɛn na di wɔl.
I bin mek di ples we oli pas ɔl; i lɔŋ lɛk aw di os wayd ɛn i bin nayn mita wayd. I plasta am wit oba twɛnti mɛtrik tɔn gold.
Di nel dɛn na bin we frɔm ilɛvin gram to fayv ɔndrɛd ɛn sɛvinti gram gold. I bin plasta di rum dɛn ɔp, wit gold.
I mek tu bod chɛryubim insay di ples we oli pas ɔl, ɛn plasta dɛm wit gold.

We yu jɔyn di Chɛryubim fo fɛda dɛn we dɛn opin dɛn, na bin fo pɔynt fo mita. Wan na bin wan pɔynt wan mita we i tɔch di wɔl, ɛn di ɔda wan na bin wan pɔynt mita we i tɔch di ɔda chɛryubim in yon fɛda;
di ɔda chɛryubim insɛf insɛf yon fɛda we i tɔch di wɔl na bin wan pɔynt mita, ɛn in ɔda fɛda we opin tɔch di fɔs wan in yon fɛda na bin wan pɔynt mita.
We yu jɔyn dɛn chɛryubim dɛn ya opin dɛn fɛda dɛn we dɛn opin, na bin nayn mita; dɛn mek di Chɛryubim tinap fesin di men ɔl.
Di vel we i mek na wit blu, mov ɛn rɛd matirial dɛm ɛn fayn linin dɛn; i drɔ Chɛryubim pan am.
I mek tu pila dɛn we na fiftin ɛn af mita ay, ɛn ɔltu bin gɛt di brɔd pat pantap we dɛn kɔl di kapital, ɛn wan na bin tu pɔynt tu mita ay.
I mek chen lɛk dɛn uman chen fɔ nɛk, ɛn put dɛn pantap di pila dɛm, ɛn i mek wan ɔndrɛd pomigranet frut ɛn ɛŋ dɛm pan di chen dɛm.
I mek di pila dɛm frɔnt di tɛmpul, we wande na di sawt ɛnd di ɔda wan na di nɔt; i kɔl di wan na sawt nem Jachin ɛn kɔl di wan na di nɔt, Boaz.
I mek wan bras ɔlta we na nayn mita lɔŋ, nayn mita wayd, ɛn fo ɛn af mita ay.

Dɔn i mek wan big rawnd bras wata tank we na bin tu pɔynt tu mita dip. Wan ɛj to di ɔda ɛj na bin fo pɔynt fo mita, ɛn we dɛn mɛzhɔ am go rawnd, na bin tɔtin pɔynt tu mita. I dizayn kalbas rayt rawnd di tank. Dɛn bin de na tu ro ɛn di sem tɛm we i mek di tank, nain i mek dɛm.
Ɔnda di tank in mɔt te go rawnd, i dizayn kalbas dɛn we na tɔtin ɛn af mita. Dɛn bin de na tu ro. Dɛm mek dɛn we dɛn bin de mek di tank insɛf.
I tinap pan twɛlv man kaw we tri de luk nɔt, tri put dɛn fes wɛst, tri de luk sawt ɛn tri de luk ist. Di tank bin de pantap dɛm, ɛn ɔl dɛn wes bin tɔn insay.
Di tank bin et sɛntimita tik; ɛn di mɔt bin tan lɛk kɔp yon, we tan lɛk Lili flawa; I de tek siksti tawzin lita wata.

Pantap dat i mek tɛn baf pan fɔ de was, ɛn i tɔn fayv to di sawt ɛn ɛn fayv to di nɔt. Na isay insay dɛn baf pan ya dɛn fɔ de fɔ de rench wetin dɛn dɔn yuz fo di bɔn sakrifays, ɛn di tank na fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ de was.
Dɔn i mek tɛn gold lampstand dɛn lɛk aw dɛn bin dɔn se, ɛn put dɛn insay di tɛmpul; i put fayv na di sawt ɛn fayv na di nɔt.
Pantap dat, i mek tɛn tebul ɛn put dɛn insay di tɛmpul; i put fayv no di sawt ɛn fayv na di nɔt. Dɔn i mek wan ɔndrɛd gold besin.
I mek di Kɔt yad fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn di big big Kɔt yad, ɛn di domɔt dɛm fɔ di Kɔt yad we i plasta wit bras;
dɔn i put di tank na di sawt ist kɔnainsay di os.
Uram mek di pɔt dɛn, di shɔbul dɛn ɛn di besin dɛn. Na so Uram dɔn di wok we i du fɔ kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn na PAPA GƆD in os:
di tu pila dɛn, di bol dɛn, di tu brɔd pat pantap we dɛn kɔl di Kapital dɛm ɛn di tu chen dɛn we i dizayn fɔ kɔba di tu bol na di Kapital dɛm we bin de ɔntɔp pila dɛm;
ɛn di fo ɔndrɛd pomigranet fɔ di tu chen, sɛt dɛm fɔ wan chen to tu ro pomigranet fɔ kɔba di tu bol we de pantap di Kapital dɛn we de pantap di pila dɛm.
I mek di stand dɛn ɛn di besin dɛn we de pantap di stand dɛn,
ɛn di wan big tank ɛn di twɛlv man kaw dɛn we dɛn mek ɔnda am.
Uram bin mek di pɔt dɛn, di shɔbul, di fɔk ɛn ɔl di tin dɛn fɔ yuz fɔ dɛnwanya, wit shayn bras, fɔ Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn fɔ PAPA GƆD in os.
Na di flat grɔn na Jɔdan Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn bin mek dɛn, na di kle grɔn we de bitwin Sɔkɔt ɛn Zɛrɛda.
Sɔlɔmɔn bin so mek dɛn tin ya plɛnti wan, dat nɔbɔdi nɔ bin ebul no ɔmɔs bras dɛn yuz.
Na do Sɔlɔmɔn mek ɔl di tin dɛm we bin de insay PAPA GƆD in os: di gold ɔlta, di tebul dɛm fɔ di bred we nɔ gɛt yist,
di lamp stand dɛn ɛn dɛn lamp dɛn we na piɔ gold, fɔ de bɔn bifo di insay di ples we oli pas ɔl, jɛs lɛk aw dɛn bin dɔn se;
di flawa dɛm, di lamp dɛm, di faya spun dɛm we dɛn mek wit gold we piɔ pas ɔl;

di kɔp we dɛn de tek ɔt lamp, di besin dɛm, di dish dɛm fɔ insɛns, ɛn di faya pan dɛm, ɔl na bin piɔ gold; ɛn di inchis na di do fɔ go insay di tɛmpul, ɛn di domɔt dɛn we de insay na di ples we oli pas ɔl, ɛn fɔ di domɔt fɔ di men ɔl, na bin gold.

Na so Sɔlɔmɔn dɔn ɔl di wok we i du fɔ PAPA GƆD in os. So Sɔlɔmɔn briŋ ɔl di tin dɛm we in papa Devid bin dɔn dɛdiket to PAPA GƆD, ɛn kip di silva, di gold ɛn ɔl di tin dɛn we dɛn fɔ yuz na PAPA GƆD in os, insay di sto we dɛn de kip di valyuebul tin dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os.
Nain Sɔlɔmɔn gɛda di bigman dɛn dɛm na Izrɛl ɛn ɔl di big wam dɛn pan di fambul dɛn, di lida dɛm fɔ Izrɛl in Jerusɛlɛm, fɔ briŋ PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant kɔmɔt na Devid in siti, we na Zayɔn.
So ɔl di man dɛm na Izrɛl gɛda bifo di kiŋ na di fɛstival we dɛn kin mek na di mɔnt we mek sɛvin.
So ɔl di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl go de ɛn di Livayt dɛn tot di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant.

Nain dɛn kɛr di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant, di tɛnt we dɛn de mit wit PAPA GƆD, ɛn ɔl di oli tin dɛn we bin de insay di tɛnt; na di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛm, bin kɛr dɛn go ɔp.
So Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn di wanol Izrɛl we bin dɔn gɛda bifo am, bin de bifo di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant de sakrifays bɔku bɔku ship ɛn kaw, sote dɛn nɔ ebul kɔnt igen
So di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin kɛr PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant go nain ples insay insay di ples we oli pas ɔl, ɔnda di Chɛryubim wiŋ dɛn.
Di Chɛryubim prɛd dɛn wiŋ dɛm oba di say we di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant dɛn, we mek di Chɛryubim dɛm kɔba di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant ɛn in pol dɛn.
Di pol dɛn bin so lɔŋ yu kin si di pol dɛn ɛndin we yu de insay di oli ples bifo di ples we oli pas ɔl; bɔt yu nɔ go ebul si am we yu de na do; ɛn dɛn de de te tide.
Natin nɔ bin de insay di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant pas tu tebul dɛm we Mozis bin put de na Ɔrɛb, usay PAPA GƆD bin mek Kɔvinant wit Izrɛl, wɛn dɛn bin kɔmɔt na Ijipt.
We di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin kɔmɔt insay di oli ples (bikɔs ɔl di di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn we bin de de, bin dɔn klin dɛnsɛf ɛn nɔ bin luk usay dɛn fɔ de;

ɛn ɔl di Livayt dɛn we bin de siŋ, Esaf, Iman, ɛn Jɛdutum, ɛn dɛn bɔypikin dɛn ɛn dɛn fambul dɛn, drɛs wit fayn linin, wit simbɔl dɛn, gita ɛn flut, tinap na di ist pat na di ɔlta wit wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul we na man dɛn we de blo trɔmpɛt;

ɛn na di man dɛm we de blo trɔmpɛt ɛn di wan dɛn we de siŋ de dyuti fɔ mek dɛn yɛri dɛn wit di ɔda wan dɛn we dɛn de prez ɛn tɛl tɛnk to PAPA GƆD), ɛn wɛn dɛn bigin siŋ wit trɔmpɛt dɛn ɛn simbɔl dɛm ɛn ɔda myuzik instrumɛnt dɛm, de prez PAPA GƆD se, “Bikɔs i gud, bikɔs in lɔv we nɔ de chenj so te go,” di os, PAPA GƆD in os fulɔp wit smok,”
we mek di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ bin ebul tinap fɔ du dɛn wok, fɔseka di klawd; bikɔs PAPA GƆD in glori ful PAPA GƆD in os.
Nain Sɔlɔmɔn se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk se in go tap insay tik tik daknɛs.
I dɔn bil mayti mayti os fɔ yu, ples we yu go tap sote go.”
Nain di kiŋ tɔn rawnd ɛn blɛs di wanol Izrɛl, we di wanol Izrɛl bin tinap.
I se, “PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, wi blɛs yu, yu we dɔn tek yu an du wetin yu prɔmis Devid we na mi papa, wit yu mɔt, we yu bin se,
From di de we a pul mi pipul dɛm kɔmɔt na Ijipt, a nɔ pik nɔn siti pan ɔl di fambul dɛn na Izrɛl we go bil os, so dat mi nem go de de, ɛn a nɔ pik nɔbɔdi fɔ bi bigman oba Izrɛl we na mi pipul dɛn;
bɔt a dɔn pik Jerusɛlɛm so dat mi nem go de de, ɛn na Devid a dɔn pik fɔ de oba Izrɛl, we na mi pipul dɛn.’
I bin dɔn de na mi papa Devid in at fɔ bil os fɔ PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd fɔ ɔnain nem.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD tɛl mi papa Devid se, ‘ɔlwe i bin dɔn de na yu at fɔ bil os fɔ ɔna mi nem, yu du wɛl we i bin de na yu at;
pan ɔl dat, yu nɔ go bil di os, bɔt na yu bɔypikin we dɛn go bɔn fɔ yu, go bil di os fɔ ɔna mi nem.’

Naw PAPA GƆD dɔn du wetin i prɔmis se i go du; bikɔs mi dɔn tinap na mi papa Devid in ples, ɛn dɔn sidɔm na di tron na Izrɛl lɛk aw PAPA GƆD prɔmis, ɛn a dɔn bil di os fɔ ɔna PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, in nem.
Na de a dɔn put di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant we nainsay di Kɔvinant we PAPA GƆD mek wit di pipul dɛn na Izrɛl.”
Sɔlɔmɔn tinap bifo di ɔlta usay ɔlman bin de si am ɛn es in an ɔp ɛn pre se,

Sɔlɔmɔn bin dɔn mek wan bras stej we na tu ɛn di af mita lɔŋ ɛn tu ɛn di af mita wayd, ɛn i bin wan pɔynt tri mita ay, ɛn i bin put am na di Kɔt yad ɛn tinap pan am. Dɔn i nildɔŋ bifo di wanol Izrɛl n opin in an ɔp to ɛvin;
“PAPA GƆD, we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, nɔn Gɔd nɔ de na ɛvin ɔ ath we tan lɛk yu - na yu waŋren kin kip yu Kɔvinant ɛn sho lɔv to yu savant dɛn we de waka tret wit yu;
yu kip yu prɔmis to yu savant, Devid mi papa, ɛn ɔl wetin yu bin tɔk nain yu dɔn du so tide.

So PAPA GƆD, yu we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, a de beg yu lɛ yu kip to di ɔda prɔmis we yu mek to mi papa Devid we yu se nain jɛnareshɔn nɔmɔ go de rul na Izrɛl if dɛn waka tret wit yu ɛn kip to yu lɔ lɛkɛ aw insɛf bin de du;
So duya PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, kip da prɔmis we yu mek to yu wokman Devid.
“Bɔt fɔ tru tru se PAPA GƆD yu go kam tap dɔŋ na di wɔl? Di klawd sɛf te rich ɔp ɔp di skay nɔ ebul ol yu bifo a se dis lili abule we a dɔn bil!
Duya PAPA GƆD we na mi Gɔd, mi na yu savant, duya ansa dis prea we a de pre to yu tide;
so dat yu yay de pan dis os de ɛn nɛt, bikɔs na de yu dɔn pik se fɔ de wɔship yu; ɛnitɛm we a kam ya fɔ pre to yu, duya ansa mi.
Duya ansa mi prea, ɛn di pipul dɛnsɛf yon prea wɛn dɛn kam na dis os fɔ pre. Usay yu de na yu os na ɛvin, ansa wi prea ɛn fɔgiv wi.
“If dɛn briŋ ɛnibɔdi na yaso se i du bad, dɔn i nildɔŋ bifo dis ɔlta na di os fɔ swɛ se in nɔ du natin,
duya PAPA GƆD, ansa di prea na ɛvin ɛn gi jɔjmɛnt. Pɔnish di wan we rɔŋ ɛn fri di wan we nɔ gilti lɛ ɔlman no se i inosɛnt.
“If yu pipul we na di Izrɛlayt dɛn lɔs wa bikɔs dɛn bin dɔn sin, if dɛn tɔn to yu ɛn kam na dis os ɛn ɔmbul dɛnsɛf ɛn pre to yu fɔ masi,
ansa dɛn prea na ɛvin. Fɔgiv dɛn fɔ dɛn sin ɛn briŋ dɛn kam bak na di land we yu bin gi dɛn papa dɛn.
“If yu ol di ren fɔ lɛ i nɔ kam bikɔs dɛn sin, if dɛn tɔn to dis os ɛn ɔmbul dɛnsɛf, kɔnfɛs dɛn sin ɛn beg yu fɔ masi,
duya yɛri dɛn prea na ɛvin. Fɔgiv di kiŋ ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn sin ɛn sho dɛn fɔ du wetin rayt. Dɔn PAPA GƆD, mek ren kam na dis land we yu gi yu pipul dɛn se na dɛn yon prɔpati.
“If wi plant dɛn ɔl pwɛl dɔn it nɔ de fɔ it, ɔ, if lokɔs it ɔl wetin we plant, ɔ if ɛnimi atak yu pipul, ɔ, if ɛni bad bad sik sɛf bɔsawt fɔ kil ɔlman,
if ɛnibɔdi pre to yu ɛn kɔnshɔs se in dɔn du bad, dɔn i tɔn to yu os ɛn es in an ɔp to yu,
duya ansa dɛn prea na yu os na ɛvin. Fɔgiv dɛn ɛn ɛp dɛn. Na yu waŋren nɔmɔ no wetin de na mɔtalman at. Dil wit ɔlman akɔdin to
lɛ dɛn go de fred yu na dis land we yu gi wi papa dɛn.
“Fɔrina dɛn go de kɔmɔt na fa kɔntri kam na ya bikɔs ɔf wetin dɛn yɛri bɔt yu; dɛn go de yɛri bɔt yu wok ɛn di wɔndaful tin dɛn we yu de du; if dɛn kam na dis os fɔ wɔship yu,

duya ansa dɛn prea. Ansa dɛn prea na ɛvin ɛn gi dɛn wetin dɛn aks fɔ, so dat ɔlman na wɔl go no bɔt yu ɛn ɔna yu lɛkɛ aw wi di Izrɛlayt dɛn de du; lɛ dɛn go no se yu de na dis os we a dɔn bil fɔ dɛn rɛspɛkt.
“Wɛn yu pipul dɛn de go fɛt wa agens dɛn ɛnimi ɔ ɛnisay we dɛn de, if dɛn tɔn dɛn fes to dis siti we nain yusɛf sɛf dɔn pik, ɛn tɔn dɛn fes to dis yu os we a dɔn bil mek dɛn go rɛspɛkt yu, ɛn pre,
ansa dɛn prea. Ansa dɛn na ɛvin ɛn gi dɛn viktri.
“Yu no se nɔbɔdi nɔ de we nɔ de kɔmit sin, so if dɛn sin ɛn dɛn mek yu vɛks pan dɛn, yu mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn kapchɔ dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn go as slev na ɔda kɔntri, i lɛk na fa fawe kɔntri sɛf;
if wɛn dɛn de de dɛn chenj dɛn atityud, dɛn kɔnfɛs ɛn pre to yu se dɛn du bad;
if dɛn tɔn bak to yu fɔ tru tru wɛn dɛn de de, ɛn kɔnfɛs dɛn sin; dɔn dɛn tɔn dɛn fes to dis land we yu gi wi papa dɛn, to dis siti we yu bin dɔn pik, ɛn dis os we a bil fɔ de prez yu nem;
duya ansa dɛn prea usay yu tap na ɛvin, ɛn ɛp dɛn pan wetin dɛn de du, ɛn fɔgiv yu pipul dɛn we dɔn kɔmit sin to yu.
Duya mi Gɔd, mek yu yay ɛn yu yes opin to di prea we dɛn de pre na ya.

“So duya, Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd, tinap ɛn go na yu rɛstin ples, yu ɛn di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant we na yu pawa de de. Duya PAPA GƆD mek di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin drɛs wit salveshɔn, ɛn lɛ yu oli pipul dɛn gladi insay di gud we yu gud.
Duya Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd, nɔ tɔn yu fes pan di wan we yu dɔn anɔynt! Mɛmba di lɛk we nɔ de chenj we yu8 yu bin gɛt fɔ Devid we na yu wokman.”
We Sɔlɔmɔn dɔn pre dɔn, faya kɔmɔt ɛvin kam dɔŋ ɛn bɔn di bɔn sakrifays ɛn di ɔda sakrifays dɛm, ɛn PAPA GƆD in glori bin ful insay PAPA GƆD in tɛmpul.
Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ ebul go insay PAPA GƆD in os, bikɔs PAPA GƆD in glori bin ful insay PAPA GƆD in os.

We di Izrɛlayt dɛn si di faya de kan dɔŋ, ɛn PAPA GƆD in glori pan di tɛmpul, dɛn butu na grɔn na di pevmɛnt ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD ɛn tɛl am tɛnki se, “Bɔkɔs i gud, bikɔs in lɔv we nɔ de chenj de sote go.”
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɔl jɔyn di kiŋ fɔ mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD.
Di pis sakrifays we Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn mek to PAPA GƆD, na twɛnti-tu tawzin kaw wit wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti tawzin ship. Di kiŋ ɛn di pipul dɛn ɔl dɛdiket PAPA GƆD in os.

Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin tinap na dɛn post dɛm, di Livayt dɛnsɛf, wit di instrumɛnt dɛn we Kiŋ Devid bin mek fɔ de ple we dɛn de tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki, bin tinap na dɛnsɛf yon post – fɔ seka in lɔv we nɔ de chenj sote go - ɛni tɛm we Devid prez de PAPA GƆD we dɛn de ple- di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, we de ɔpozit dɛn kin blo dɛn trɔmpɛt dɛn; ɛn di wanol Izrɛl kin tinap.

Sɔlɔmɔn bin kɔnsikret di midul say na di Kɔt yad we de bifo PAPA GƆD in os; bikɔs na de i bin mek di bɔn sakrifays ɛn di fat pan di pis ɔfrin dɛm, bikɔs di bras ɔlta we Sɔlɔmɔn bin dɔn mek nɔ du fɔ di bɔn sakrifays, di sid ɔfrin ɛn di fat.
Da tɛm de, Sɔlɔmɔn mek big big pati fɔ sɛvin de ɛn di wanol Izrɛl bin de de, we na bin bɔku bɔku pipul dɛn, frɔm usay fɔ go insay Amat, te go Ijipt watasay.
Di de we mek et, dɛn mek savis fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD; bikɔs dɛn tek sɛvin de dɛdiket di ɔlta ɛn sɛvin de fɔ mek pati.
Di de mek twɛnti tri insay di sɛvin mɔnt, Sɔlɔmɔn se lɛ ɔlman go na dɛn os. Di pipul dɛn bin gladi na dɛn at fɔ di gud we PAPA GƆD sho to Devid ɛn to Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn to Izrɛl we nain pipul dɛn.
We Sɔlɔmɔn dɔn bil PAPA GƆD in os, ɛn di kiŋ in os dɔn; i sɔksid fɔ du ɔl wetin i bin plan fɔ du na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn nain yon os.
Nain PAPA GƆD apia to Sɔlɔmɔn na nɛt ɛn tɛl am se, “A dɔn yɛri yu prea ɛn a dɔn pik dis ples fɔ misɛf se na os fɔ mek sakrifays.
Wɛn a lɔk ɔp di skay fɔ mek ren nɔ kam, ɔ tɛl di lokɔs dɛn traŋa wan fɔ it ɔltin na di land, ɔ a sɛn dɛn bad bad sik pan mi pipul dɛm,
if mi pipul dɛm we gɛt mi nem, put dɛnsɛf dɔŋ ɛn pre ɛn ripɛnt, ɛn lɛf dɛn wikɛd we, datɛnde, a go yɛri na ɛvin, ɛn a go fɔgiv dɛn sin, ɛn il dɛn land.
Datɛnde, mi yay ɛn mi yes go opin to di prea we dɛn de pre na dis ples.
Bikɔs a dɔn pik dis os ɛn dɔn kɔnsikret am, so dat mi nem go de de sote go; mi yay ɛn mi at go de de sote go.
As fɔ yu yon say, if yu waka tret wit mi ɛn du wetin rayt lɛkɛ yu papa Devid, ɛn du ɔl wetin a tɛl yu ɛn kip mi kɔmandmɛnt,
datɛnde, a go mek yu ɛn yu jɛnareshɔn bi kiŋ na Izrɛl sote go, lɛkɛ aw nɔmɔ a bin prɔmis yu papa Devid we a se nain sid go de rul na Izrɛl sote go.
“Bɔt if yu tɔn yu bak pan mi, ɛn nɔ obe mi kɔmandmɛnt we a dɔn se una fɔ de obe, ɛn go fala ɔda gɔd dɛm ɛn wɔship dɛm,
a go rut yu kɔmɔt na di land we a dɔn gi yu; ɛn dis os we a dɔn kɔnsikret fɔseka mi nem, a go trowe am kɔmɔt bifo mi, ɛn a go tɔn am to tin fɔ tɔk bɔt, ɛn fɔ laf na ɔl dɛn neshɔn dɛn.

Dis os we una de es ɔp so, ɔlman we de pas go de se, ‘Wetindu PAPA GƆD du dis kayn tin to dɛn pipul dɛn ya ɛn to dis os?’ Ɛni bɔdi we de pas go shɔk ɛn se ‘Wetin mek PAPA GƆD du so to dis land ɛn to dis os?’

Datɛnde, pipul dɛn go tɛl dɛn se, na bikɔs dɛn kɔmɔt biɛn PAPA GƆD we na dɛn papa dɛn Gɔd we pul dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt, ɛn put an pan ɔda gɔd dɛm, ɛn wɔship ɛn sav dɛm; na dat mek i dɔn mek ɔl dɛn bad bad tin dɛn ya apin to dɛn.’”
Wɛn di ia we mek twɛnti dɔn, insay di tɛm we Sɔlɔmɔn bin de bil PAPA GƆD in os ɛn insɛf yon os,
Sɔlɔmɔn bil di siti dɛm bak we Kiŋ Iram bin dɔn gi am ɛn put di Izrɛlayt dɛn de.
Afta dat, Sɔlɔmɔn go kapchɔ Amat ɛn Zoba.
I bil Pamira na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap ɛn ɔl di siti dɛm fɔ kip tin dɛn we i bil na Amat.
I bil ɔpa Bɛt Ɔrɔn ɛn loa Bɛt Ɔrɔn, siti dɛn we i protɛkt wit wɔl, get ɛn ayɛn ba,

ɛn Bealat ɛn ɔl di siti dɛn fɔ kip tin dɛn we Sɔlɔmɔn bin gɛt, ɛn ɔl di siti dɛm fɔ in chariɔt dɛm, ɛn di siti dɛm fɔ in man dɛn we de rayd ɔs, ɛn ɛnitin we Sɔlɔmɔn bin wan bil na Jerusɛlɛm, na Libanɔn ɛn ɔl di land dɛm we de nain pawa.
Ɔl di wan dɛm we lɛf pan di Itayt dɛm, di Amorayt dɛm, di Pɛrizayt dɛm, di Ivayt dɛm ɛn di Jebyuzayt dɛm we nɔ blant Izrɛl,
pan dɛn pikin dɛm we lɛf da di land we di Izrɛlayt dɛm nɔ bin kil – na dɛn Sɔlɔmɔn mek slev, ɛn dɛn na slev te tide.
Bɔt Sɔlɔmɔn nɔ mek nɔn pan Izrɛlayt pipul slev fɔ du di wok; dɛn na bin sojaman dɛm, ɔfishal, dɛm di kɔmanda dɛm fɔ in chariɔt dɛm ɛn in man dɛn we de rayd ɔs.
Na dɛnwanya na bin Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn in bigman dɛn we bin de supavays di pipul dɛn; tu ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti.

Sɔlɔmɔn briŋ Fero in gyal pikin kɔmɔt Devid siti go na di os we i bin dɔn bil fɔ am, bikɔs i se, “Mi wɛf nɔ go tap na Devid we na kiŋ na Izrɛl in os, bikɔs i se, di say dɛn we di Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant kin de, na oli ples dɛm.”
Dɔn Sɔlɔmɔn mek bɔn sakrifays to PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD in ɔlta we i bil bifo di pɔch,

bay aw ɛvride dyuti kɔlfɔ, fɔ de mek sakrifays as aw Mozis bin dɔn tɛl dɛn traŋa wan fɔ de du fɔ di de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst, di nyu mun, ɛn di tri ebri ia fɛstival,- di Pasova fɛstival, di Avɛst fɛstival ɛn di Bafa fɛstival.

Bay wetin in papa Devid bin dɔn pul se dɛn fɔ de du, i di sho di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn difrɛn difrɛn wok ɛn di Livayt dɛm fɔ dɛnsɛf yon wok we na fɔ prez ɛn ɛp di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin bay aw dɛn fɔ wok ɛvride, ɛn di getman dɛn na di difrɛn difrɛn get dɛn; bikɔs na os Devid we na Man ɔf Gɔd tɔk traŋa wan se dɛn fɔ du.

Ɛn dɛm nɔ lɛf natin pan wetin di kiŋ bin dɔn tɛl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn traŋa wan kɔnsanin ɛnitin ɛn di ples we dɛn de kip di valyuebul tin dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os.
Na so ɔl Sɔlɔmɔn in wok dɛn bin du, frɔm di de we dɛn le PAPA GƆD in os in fawndeshɔn, te i dɔn. So dɛn bin bil PAPA dɔn.
Nain Sɔlɔmɔn go Ɛzin Giba ɛn Ɛlat na di sho na Idɔm.
Kin Iram sɛn in wokman dɛn go gi am ship dɛn ɛn shipman dɛn we sabi wata, ɛn dɛn go na Ofir wit Sɔlɔmɔn in yon wokman dɛn go tek fiftin tawzin kilogram gold, kɛr go gi Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn

We di kwin na Shiba yɛri bɔt aw Sɔlɔmɔn femɔs, i kam na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ kam tɛst am wit at at kwɛshɔn dɛm. I kam wit big big kɔnvɔy ɛn kamɛl dɛm we tot spays, bɔku gold ɛn valyuebul ston dɛm. Wɛn i rich to Sɔlɔmɔn, i tɛl am ɔl tin we de nain maynd.
Sɔlɔmɔn ansa ɔl in kwɛshɔn dɛm; natin nɔ de we ayd pan Sɔlɔmɔn we i nɔ ebul ɛksplen to am.
We di kwin na Shiba si Sɔlɔmɔn in sɛns, di os we i bil,

di kayn it nain tebul, di we we in ɔfisa dɛn de sidɔm; ɛn aw di wokman dɛn de wok ɛn dɛn unifɔm, di wan dɛn we de sav di kiŋ wayn ɛn dɛn unifɔm, ɛn di we we di kiŋ de mek bɔn sakrifays, ɔl mek in mɔt ful.
Nain i tɛl di kiŋ se, ɔl wetin in bin de yɛri bɔt am nain kɔntri,, bɔt wetin i dɔn du ɛn wetin i dɔn gɛt, na tru.
I se in nɔ bin biliv pas we in dɔn si fɔ insɛf wit in yon yay. I se ɔl wetin in yɛri nɔ du sɛf bikɔs wetin in dɔn si so pas ɔl wetin i dɔn yɛri.
I se in no se in wɛf dɛn ɛn ɔfisa dɛn ɛn wokman dɛn ɔl go de gladi fɔ sidɔm wit am fɔ de yɛri wetin de kɔmɔt nain mɔt nɔmɔ.

I prez PAPA GƆD se, “Lɛ we blɛs PAPA GƆD, we na yu PAPA GƆD we sho yu se i lɛk yu ɛn dɔn mek yu kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl. Bikɔs PAPA GƆD in lɔv nɔ de dɔn fɔ Izrɛl, na dat mek i mek yu bi kiŋ fɔ lɛ jɔstis, fia ple ɛn tret biznɛs go de.”
Nain i gi Sɔlɔmɔn fo tawzin kilo gold, bɔku bɔku spays ɛn miniral ston dɛn. Wande nɔbɔdi nɔ kɛr bɔku spays lɛkɛ di wan we di kwin na Shiba gi Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn.
Pantap dat, Iram in ship dɛn pul bɔku gold kɔmɔt na Ofir; dɛn briŋ almɔg bod ɛn miniral ston dɛn.
Sɔlɔmɔn yuz di ɔlmɔg bod fɔ mek stɛp na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn in yon os we i bil fɔ insɛf; ɛn yuz am bak fɔ mek ap ɛn laya fɔ di myuzishian dɛn. Dɛn nɔ pul da kayn fayn almɔg bod de te tide.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn gi di kwin we kɔmɔt Shiba ɔl wetin i aks fɔ. Dat nɔ miks pan di ɔda tiŋs dɛn we in as kiŋ fɔ gi am. Di kwin ɛn ɔl in pipul dɛn we fala am tɔn bak go na dɛn kɔntri.
Ɛvri ia Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn kin gɛt lɛkɛ twɛnti-tri tawzin kilo gold.
Dat nɔ miks pan di taks we dɛn biznɛsman dɛn de pe, ɛn di ɔda taks we dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Arebia ɛn dɛn gɔvna na dɛn ɔda distrikt dɛn de pe.
Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn mek tu ɔndrɛd big big shild ɛn kɔba ich wan wit sɛvin kilo gold.
I mek tri ɔndrɛd ɔda smɔl shild dɛn ɛn kɔba ich wan wit bɔt sɔm tu kilo gold. I put ɔl na Libanɔn Fɔrɛst Os.
Di kiŋ mek in tron wit ayvri ɛn kɔba sɔm pat wit gold.
Di chia gɛt siks stɛp, dɔn i mek pantap di bak rɛst, rawnd. Di tu sayd dɛn gɛt say fɔ rɛst an, dɔn i kav tu layɔn ɛn put dɛn fɔ tinap na di tu sayd.
Na twɛlv layɔn bin de de; di stɛp dɛn ɔl gɛt tu tu layɔn; wan na lɛft an wan na raytan. Dɛn nɔ mek dis kayn chia ya wande fɔ ɛni ɔda kiŋ.
Ɔl di kiŋ in kɔp dɛn we i de drink pan na gold, ɛn ɔl di plet ɛn kɔp dɛn na Libanɔn Fɔrɛst Os na piɔ gold. Nɔn silva nɔ bin de de bikɔs i nɔ bin gɛt wan valyu Sɔlɔmɔn in tɛm.
Di kiŋ gɛt ship dɛm we de go si wit Iram insɛf yon ship dɛm. Dɛn kin kam ɛvri tri ia wit gold, silva, ayvri, ep ɛn babu dɛm.
Na so Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn bin pas ɔl di kiŋ dɛn na di wɔl pan sɛns ɛn jɛntri.
Ɔlman na wɔl bin de kam fɔ tɔk wit am fɔ yɛri nɔmɔ di kayn sɛns we PAPA GƆD gi am.
Ɛvri ia wɛn pipul dɛn go fɛn am dɛn kin kɛr prɛzɛnt dɛn lɛk gold, silva, klos, spays, ɔs ɛn myul.
Ɛn Sɔlɔmɔn gɛt fo tawzin shɛd fɔ in ɔs ɛn chariɔt dɛm, ɛn twɛlv tawzin man dɛn we de rayd ɔs, we i steshɔn na di chariɔt siti dɛm ɛn wit di kiŋ na Jerusɛlɛm.
Ɛn i rul oba di kiŋ dɛm we de frɔm Yufretis rich di Filistin dɛn kɔntri ɛn di bɔda na Ijipt.
Di kiŋ mek silva plɛnti bɔku na Jerusɛlɛn lɛk ston ɛn sida tik bɔku lɛk di Sikamɔ tik dɛn na di rɔndɔŋ dɛn na Juda.
Dɛn bin de impɔt os dɛm fɔ Sɔlɔmɔn kɔmɔt na Musri ɛn ɔl ɔda kɔntri dɛm.

Naw di balans pan Sɔlɔmɔn in wok frɔm fɔs to las, nɔ de na di buk we Netan di prɔfɛt rayt, ɛn di wetin Aija we na Shilonayt bin se go bi, ɛn di tin dɛn we Ido we na prɔfɛt bin si nain vishɔn bɔt Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin?
Sɔlɔmɔn bi kiŋ na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ di wanol Izrɛl fɔ fɔti ia.
Sɔlɔmɔn day ɛn dɛn bɛr am nain papa Devid, in siti. Na Rɛoboam we nain bɔypikin bin bi kiŋ nain ples.
Rɛoboam go na Shɛkɛm ɛn na de ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin dɔn gɛda fɔ mek am kiŋ.
Wɛn Nebat in bɔypikin, Jɛroboam yɛri bɔt dat, bikɔs in bin de na Ijipt we i rɔnawe pan Sɔlɔmɔn, i tɔn bak.
Di pipul dɛn sɛn kɔl am so i fala dɛn go to Rɛoboam.
Dɛn tɛl Rɛoboam se in papa bin mek dɛn de wok lɛk slev, bɔt if in pul da lod de na dɛn ed, dɛn go wok wit am.
Rɛoboam ansa dɛn se lɛ dɛn go fɔs ɛn kam bak to am afta tri de, da tɛm de in go dɔn gɛt ansa fɔ dɛm.
Kiŋ Rɛoboam gɛda ɔl di bigman dɛn we bin de wok ɔnda in papa Sɔlɔmɔn ɛn aks dɛn se uskayn advays dɛn go gi am fɔ di pipul dɛn.
Dɛn advays am se if nɔmɔ i put insɛf dɔŋ, tɔk to di pipul dɛn fayn ɛn wok lɛkɛ savant fɔ dɛn, dɛn go de sav am ɔltɛm.
Bɔt Rɛoboam nɔ yɛri di bigman dɛn advays; bifo dat i go ɛŋed wit in kamaranks dɛn bikɔs na dɛn bin de ɛŋ biɛn am.
I aks dɛn lɛ dɛn advays am bɔt aw in fɔ ansa dɛn pipul we se in fɔ pul di lɔd we in papa bin dɔn put na dɛn ed.

In padi dɛn we na dɛn ɔl de rakpala advays am se, lɛ i ansa di pipul dɛn se, ɛnti dɛn de se in papa gi dɛn ebi lod fɔ tot, bɔt dɛn want in fɔ pul di lod kɔmɔt, wɛl in de tɛl dɛn se, ‘mi las fiŋa tik pas in papa in trɔsis.”
I se ɛnti in papa gi dɛn ebi lod fɔ tot, in go gi dɛm di wan we pas dat; ɛn if na ken in papa bin de tek flag dɛn, na tik in go tek wok dɛm.
Afta tri de, Jɛroboam ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn go bak to Rɛoboam lɛkɛ aw i bin tɛl dɛn nɔmɔ.
I fityay dɛn gud fashin, ɛn nɔ yɛri di advays we di bigman dɛn gi am.

Bifo dat, di advays we in kamaranks dɛn gi am se, in papa bin gi pipul dɛn ebi lod fɔ tot, bɔt in go gi dɛn di wan we pas dat; in papa bin de flag dɛn wit ratlan in go tek tik wok dɛn, na da advays de i fala.

Di kiŋ nɔ lisin to wetin di pipul dɛn se. Ɔl dis yaso we bi na PAPA GƆD bin dɔn mak am fɔ bi so lɛk aw prɔfɛt Aija we kɔmɔt Shaylo, tɔk to Jɛroboam we na Nebat in bɔypikin se na so PAPA GƆD go mek tin bi.

Wɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn si se di kiŋ fityay dɛm ɛn nɔ lisin to dɛm, dɛn ansa am se, Us biznɛs wi gɛt wit Devid? Wi nɔ gɛt nɔn biznɛs wit Jɛsi in pikin. Pipul dɛn na Izrɛl, lɛ ɔlman go nain os. Ɔlman put in at pan in yon os. So ɔlman go nain os.
Bɔt as fɔ dɛn Izrɛlayt we bin tap na di siti dɛn na Juda, na Rɛoboam bin stil de rul dɛn.
Kiŋ Rɛoboam sɛn Adoniram we bin de mek pipul wok bay fos to di Izrɛlayt dɛn, bɔt dɛn kech am ston am te i day. Wɛn dis bi, Kiŋ Rɛoboam mekes jomp nain ɔs ɛn karej ɛn rɔnawe go Jerusɛlɛm.
Frɔm da de de, nain di Izrɛlayt dɛn bigin barɔf pan Devid in pikin dɛn te tide.
Wɛn Rɛoboam kam bak na Jerusɛlɛm, i gɛda di Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin fambul dɛn, we na bin wan ɔndrɛd ɛn eti tawzin sas fɛtman dɛm, fɔ go fɛt Izrɛl ɛn tek di kindɔm gi Rɛoboam
Bɔt PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to Shɛmaya we na man ɔf Gɔd se.
“Tɛl Rɛoboam we na Sɔlɔmɔn in bɔypikin, ɛn na di kiŋ na Juda, ɛn ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn we tap na Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin se,
‘Na dis PAPA GƆD se, una nɔ fɔ go to una brɔda dɛn ɔ go fɛt una dɛm. Mɛk ɔlman tɔn bak go nain os, bikɔs na mi du dis tin we bi so.” So dɛn yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd ɛn tɔn bak ɛn nɔ go fɛt Jɛroboam.
Rɛoboam tap na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn bil siti dɛn fɔ protɛkt Juda.
I bil Bɛtliɛm. Etam, Tɛkoa,
Bɛtzur, Soko, Adulam,
Gat, Marɛsha, Zif.
Adoraim, Lakish, Azɛka,
Zora, Aijalɔn ɛn Ɛbrɔn. Dɛn na di siti dɛn we i bin protɛkt na Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin.
I mek di baraks dɛn traŋa wan ɛn put kɔmanda dɛn de, ɛn ples dɛn we i kip kip bɔku bɔku it, ɔyl ɛn wayn de.
I put big shild ɛn spia dɛn na ɔl di siti dɛn ɛn mek dɛn traŋa bad bad wan. Na so i bin ol Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin.
Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn di Livayt dɛm we bin de ɔloba Izrɛl, bin kam tap to Rɛoboam kɔmɔt na ɔl di say dɛm we dɛn bin de.

Di Livayt dɛm lɛf di land we na dɛn ɔl bin gɛt ɛn dɛn prɔpati dɛm ɛn kam na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm, bikɔs Jɛroboam ɛn in bɔypikin drɛb dɛn se dɛn nɔ go bi man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ PAPA GƆD igen
Ɛn i pik in yon man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ de na di ay ples laylay gɔd dɛn, ɛn di pikin kaw imej dɛn we i bin dɔn mek.
Ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we bin dɔn mekɔp dɛn maynd fɔ de wit PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, kɔmɔt pan ɔl di fambul dɛn na Izrɛl, go Jerusɛlɛm fɔ go mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn papa dɛn Gɔd.
Dɛn mek di Juda kindɔm tinap traŋa wan, ɛn protɛkt Rɛoboam we na Sɔlɔmɔn in bɔypikin fɔ tri ia, bikɔs da tri ia de, dɛn bin de du wetin Devid ɛn Sɔlɔmɔn bin de du.
Rɛoboam mared Maalat we na Jɛrimɔt, dat na Devid in bɔypikin, in yon gyal pikin we in Mama na bin Abiail, we na Ɛliab, dat na Jɛsi in bɔypikin, in yon gyal pikin
ɛn i bɔn bɔy pikin dɛn fɔ am we na Jeush, Shemaraya ɛn Zaam.
Afta Maalat, i mared Maaka we na Absalɔm in gyal pikin, ɛn i bɔn fo bɔypikin dɛn fɔ am we na Abija, Atay, Zayza, ɛn Shelomit.
Rɛoboam bin lɛk Maaka we na Absalɔm in gyal pikin pas ɔl in wɛf ɛn switat dɛn (I mared etin wɛf bin gɛt siksti switat, ɛn i bin gɛt twɛnti et bɔypikin ɛn siksti gyal pikin);
ɛn Rɛoboam pik Abija we na Maaka in bɔypikin fɔ bi di nɔmba wan prins pan ɔl in brɔda dɛm, bikɔs i mek ɔp fɔ mek i bi kiŋ.
I du ɔltin wit sɛns ɛn sheb in bɔypikin dɛm na ɔl di distrikt dɛm na Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin, ɛn na di siti dɛm we gɛt protɛkshɔn, ɛn i gi dɛn bɔku provishɔn ɛn mared wɛf dɛm fɔ dɛm.
Wɛn Rɛoboam in gɔvmɛnt bin dɔn tinap traŋa wan ɛn bin de du wɛl, i tɔn in bak pan PAPA GƆD in lɔ ɛn di wanol Izrɛl fala am.
Insay di ia we mek fayv we Rɛoboam na bin kiŋ, bikɔs Izrɛl nɔ bin de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD, Shishak we na di kiŋ na Ijipt atak Jerusɛlɛm
wit wan tawzin, tu ɔndrɛd chariɔt ɛn siksti tawzin man dɛn we de rayd ɔs. Di pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt Ijipt, Libia, Sukim ɛn Itiopia kam wit am, bin so plɛnti dat nɔbɔdi nɔ bin ebul kɔnt dɛn.
I kapchɔ di siti dɛn we dɛn bin protɛkt na Juda ɛn go as fa as Jerusɛlɛm.

Nain Shɛmaya we na di prɔfɛt go mit Rɛoboam ɛn di bigman dɛn na Juda we bin gɛda na Jerusɛlɛm fɔseka we Shishak atak dɛn ɛn tɛl se, “Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Una tɔn una bak pan mi so misɛf dɔn tɔn bak ban una ɛn lɛf una gi Shishak an.”
Nain di bigman dɛn na na Izrɛl ɛn di kiŋ put dɛnsɛf dɔŋ “PAPA GƆD raychɔs.”

We PAPA GƆD si se dɛn dɔn put dɛnsɛf dɔŋ, PAPA GƆD tɔk to Shɛmaya se, “Dɛn dɔn put dɛnsɛf dɔŋ so a nɔ go nyakanyaka dɛm igen, bɔt a go sɔri smɔl a go diliva dɛn lili bit ɛn a nɔ go yuz Shishak fɔ put mi vɛksteshɔn pan Jerusɛlɛm.
Bɔt dɛn go bi wokman dɛn to am mek dɛn go no di difrɛns bitwin we dɛn wok fɔ mi ɛn we dɛn wok fɔ di kiŋ dɛn na dɛn difrɛn kɔntri dɛn de.

So Shishak we na di kiŋ na Ijipt, atak Jerusɛlɛm; i tek ɔl di valyuebul tin dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn di valyuebul tin dɛn na di kiŋ in os go; i tek ɔltin; I kɛr ɔltin go. I kɛr di gold big shild dɛnsɛf we sɔlɔmɔn bin mek;
Nain Kiŋ Rɛoboam mek bras big shild fɔseka dɛn gold big shild dɛn ɛn put dɛn na di bigman dɛn pan di gyadman dɛn an we bin de wach di kiŋ in domɔt.
Ɛnitɛm we de kiŋ go insay PAPA GƆD in os, di gyadman dɛn kin tot dɛn go insay de ɛn tot dɛn go bak na dɛn ɔfis.
We Kiŋ Rɛoboam put insɛf dɔŋ, PAPA GƆD lɛf fɔ vɛks pan am so dat in nɔ go nyakanyaka am kpatakpata, pantap tin bin fayn na Juda.

Kiŋ Rɛoboam sidɔm traŋa wan as kiŋ na Jerusɛlɛm. Rɛoboam bin fɔti wan ia we i bi kiŋ, ɛn i bi kiŋ fɔ sɛvintin ia na Jerusɛlɛm, di siti we PAPA GƆD bin dɔn pik pan ɔl di fambul dɛm na Izrɛl, fɔ put in nem. In mama bin nem ɛn na bin Naema ɛn na Amonaytɛs.
Ɛn i du bad bad tin dɛn, bikɔs i nɔ bin de to PAPA GƆD.
Di tin dɛn we Rɛoboam du, frɔm fɔs to las, nɔ rayt na di buk we Shɛmaya we na prɔfɛt ɛn Ido sɛf we na prɔfɛt bin rayt? Rɛoboam ɛn Jɛroboam bin de fɛt fɛt dɛnsɛf ɔltɛm.
So Rɛoboam bin day go mit in ansɛstɔ dɛn, ɛn dɛn bɛr am na Devid in siti. Na Abija we nain bɔypikin, bi kiŋ nain ples.
Na di ia we mɛk Jɛroboam etin ia na pawa, Abija bi kiŋ na Juda.
I ren fɔ tri ia na Jerusɛlɛm. In mama bin nem Mikaya we na Yuriɛl we kɔmɔt Gibia, in gyal pikin. Wa bin de bitwin Abija ɛn Jɛroboam.
Abija go na di batul fil wit pawaful fɛtman dɛm we nɔ de fred, we na bin fo ɔndrɛd tawzin masta sabi fɛtman; Jɛroboam in rɛdi et ɔndrɛd tawzin masta sabi fɛtman dɛn fɔ fɛt Abija.
Nain Abija tinap pan Mawnt Zɛmaraim we de na di il kɔntri na Ifrem, ɛn tɔk se, “Lisin o yu, Jɛroboam ɛn ɔlman na Izrɛl!
Una nɔ no se PAPA GƆD wa na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd bin dɔn gi di Izrɛl tron to Devid ɛn in bɔypikin dɛm insay wan sɔl Kɔvinant so te go?
Bɔt Jɛroboam, we na Nebat in bɔypikin, we na Sɔlɔmɔn, dat na Devid in bɔypikin in wokman, baranta pan in masta.
Nain sɔm wɔltɛs rareman dɛm jɔyn am ɛn nɔ gri yɛri Rɛoboam we na Sɔlɔmɔn in bɔypikin in wɔd. I bin Yɔŋ ɛn nɔ bin dɔn tinap traŋa wan, so i nɔ bin ebul tap dɛm.
Naw una de plan fɔ fɛt PAPA GƆD in kindɔm we de na Devid in bɔypikin dɛn an, bikɔs una bɔku lɛk yɔni ɛn di pikin kaw we Jɛroboam mek wit gold fɔ lɛ una de wɔship.

Una nɔ dɔn drɛb PAPA GƆD in man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we na Erɔn in pikin dɛn ɛn di Livayt dɛn, ɛn mek man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pɔpul sin fɔ una sɛf lɛk di pipul dɛm na ɔda kɔntri dɛn? Ɛnibɔdi we kam kɔnsikret insɛf wit wan yɔŋ man kaw or sɛvin man ship, yu de mek am man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ tin dɛn we nɔto gɔd.
Bɔt as fɔ wi, PAPA GƆD na wi Gɔd ɛn wi nɔ go kɔmɔt biɛn am. Wi gɛt man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we na Erɔn in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn Livayt dɛn we de wok fɔ PAPA GƆD.

Dɛn de mek mek bɔn sakrifays ɛn bɔn insɛns dɛn we de smɛl swit fɔ PAPA GƆD, put put di sho bred na di tebul we dɛn tek piɔ gold ɛn sibɔt di gold lamp stand so dat in lamp dɛm go de dɔn ɛvri ivin; wi de du wetin PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd se, bɔt una dɔn tɔn una bak pan am.

So, PAPA GƆD de wit wi ɛn nain na wi lida, ɛn in man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin de wit dɛn batul trɔmpɛt dɛn fɔ blo fɔ kɔl wi fɔ fɛt una. Duya Izrɛl in bɔypikin dɛm, una nɔ fɛt PAPA GƆD we na una papa dɛn Gɔd, bikɔs una nɔ go ebul.”
Jɛroboam bin dɔn sɛn dɛn rawnd go le ambush biɛn dɛn; so in yon man dɛn bin de frɔnt Juda ɛn di ambush bin de biɛn dɛm.
Ɛn we Juda go wach, di fɛt bin de bifo ɛn biɛn dɛm, ɛn dɛn kray to PAPA GƆD ɛn di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin blo di trɔmpɛt dɛm.
Nain di man dɛn na Juda ala fɔ lɛ di fɛt bigin. We di man dɛn na Juda ala, PAPA GƆD bit Jɛroboam ɛn di wanol Izrɛl bifo Abija ɛn Juda dɛn yay.
Di man dɛn na Izrɛl rɔnawe pan di man dɛn na Juda ɛn PAPA GƆD put dɛm na dɛn an.
Abija ɛn in pipul dɛn kil dɛn bɔku bɔku wan; ɛn na fayv ɔndrɛd tawzin masta sabi fɛtman dɛm day.
Na so di man dɛn na Izrɛl dɛn fɛda brok, bɔt di man dɛn na Juda bin win bikɔs dɛn bin liŋ pan PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd.
Nain Abija rɔnata Jɛroboam ɛn kapchɔ in siti dɛn. Dɛn kapchɔ Bɛthɛl ɛn in vilej dɛn dɛn nain an, Bɛtɛl ɛn in vilej dɛn ɛn Jɛshana ɛn insɛf yon vilej dɛm, ɛn Ɛfrɔn wit in vilej dɛm.
Jɛroboam nɔ bin ebul gɛt in pawa bak igen we Abija bin de na pawa; ɛn PAPA GƆD nak am dɔŋ ɛn i day.
Bɔt Abija in bin de gɛt pawa mɔ ɛn mɔ, so i mared fotin wɛf, ɛn bin gɛt twɛnti tu bɔypikin ɛn sikstin gyal pikin.
Di balans tin dɛn we Abija du, aw i bin tan wetin i bin de se, ɔl rayt na di stori bɔt prɔfɛt Ido.
So Abija day go mit in fɔstɛm-papa dɛn, ɛn dɛn bɛr am na Devid in siti; nain bɔypikin we nem Ɛsa bin bi kiŋ nain ples. Di tɛm we i bin de rul, di land bin gɛt pis tɛn ia.
Esa bin du wetin gud ɛn rayt na PAPA GƆD we nain Gɔd, in yay.
I pul pul dɛn fɔrin ɔlta dɛn ɛn dɛn ay ples dɛm, ɛn brok di pila dɛn ɛn chap chap di Asherim,
ɛn i tɛl Juda traŋa wan fɔ pre to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn papa dɛn Gɔd ɛn fɛnɔt wetin i want, obe di lɔ, ɛn du ɔl wetin i tɛl dɛn traŋa wan se, dɛn fɔ de du.
Igen, i pul ɔl di ay ples dɛn ɛn di insɛns ɔlta dɛn kɔmɔt na di siti dɛn na Juda. So di kindɔm bin gɛt alafia ɔnda am.
I bil siti dɛn we gɛt protɛkshɔn na Juda bikɔs di land bin gɛt alafia. I nɔ bin fɛt nɔn wa dɛn ia dɛn de, bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin gi am pis.

Nain i tɛl Juda se, “Lɛ wi bil dɛn siti dɛn ya ɛn put wɔl rawnd dɛn wit tawa, ɛn get wit ayɛn ba; na wi stil gɛt di grɔn bikɔs we dɔn pre to PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd ɛn fɛnɔt wetin I want; we dɔn pre to am ɛn fɛnɔt wetin I want, so I dɔn gi wi kolat ɔloba.” So dɛn bil am ɛn bɛtɛ bin de fala dɛn.

Esa bin gɛt tri ɔndrɛd tawzin fɛtman we kɔmɔt Juda, ɛn dɛn bin de yuz big shild ɛn spia fɔ fɛt, ɛn tu ɔndrɛd ɛn eti tawzin fɛtman we kɔmɔt Bɛnjamin, ɛn dɛn bin de yuz big shild ɛn bo ɛn aro fɔ fɛt; dɛn ɔl na bin pawaful fɛtman dɛn.
Zera we kɔmɔt Itiopia, kɔmɔt kam wit in ami we na wan miliɔn man ɛn tri ɔndrɛd tawzin chariɔt, fɔ kam fɛt am. Dɛn go ɔp to rich Marɛsha.
