Bɔt Josaya nɔ gri tɔn kɔmɔt to am i disgays insɛf mek i go fɛt am. I nɔ yɛri Neko in wɔd dɛm we kɔmɔt na Gɔd in mɔt I jɔyn di fɛt na di opin grɔn na Negido.
Di wan dɛn we de faya aro shut kiŋ Josaya ɛn di kiŋ tɛl in savant dɛn se kɛr mi go bikɔs a dɔn wund bad.”
So in savant dɛn pul am nain chariɔt ɛn put am nain sɛkɛn chariɔt ɛn briŋ am kam Jerusɛlɛm. Ɛn i day ɛn dɛn bɛr am nain papa dɛn tumb dɛm. Ɔlman na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm kray fɔ Josaya.
Jɛrimaya sɛf siŋ bɛrin siŋ fɔ Josaya ɛn ɔl di siŋuman ɛn di siŋman dɛm de tɔk bɔt Josaya na dɛn bɛrin siŋ dɛm te tide. Dɛn mek am lɔ sɛf na Izrɛl ɛn naw dɛn rayt na di bɛrin siŋ buk dɛm.
Naw di balans pan di tin dɛm we Josaya du ɛn in gud wok akɔdin to wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in Lɔ.
Ɛn wetin i du frɔm fɔs to las, luk am dɛn rayt am na di buk bɔt kiŋ dɛm na Izrɛl ɛn Juda.
Di pipul dɛm na di kɔntri tek Jɛoeaz we na Josaya in bɔy pikin ɛn mek am kiŋ nain papa in ples na Jerusɛlɛm.
Na twɛnti tri ia Jeoeaz ol wɛn i bi kiŋ; ɛn i rul tri mɔnt na Jerusɛlɛm.
Naim di kiŋ na Ijipt pul am na pawa na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn mek di kɔntri fɔ pe taks to Ijipt 3,400 kilo silva ɛn tati fo kilo gold.
Ɛn di Ijipshian kiŋ Eliakim in brɔda kiŋ na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm ɛn chenj in nem to Jehoyakim, bɔt Neko tek Jeoeaz in brɔda an kɛr am go Ijipt.
Jehoyakim bin ol twɛnti fayv ia wɛn i bin kiŋ ɛn i rul ilɛvin ia na Jerusɛlɛm. I du wetin bad na PAPA GƆD in yay.
Nebyukadnɛza di kiŋ na Babilɔn kam fɛt am ɛn tay am wit ayɛn chen fɔ kɛr am go Babilɔn.
Nebyukadnɛza tek bak sɔm pan di besin dɛm fɔ PAPA GƆD in os ɛn put dɛm nain kiŋ os na Babilɔn.

Naw di balans pan di tin dɛm we Jeoyakin du ɛn di nasti tin dɛm we i du ɛn wetin na di tin we Gɔd fɛn insay am we de agens am. Luk am dɛn rayt am na di buk bɔt di kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl ɛn Juda ɛn Jeoyachin in bɔypikin bi kin nain ples.
Jɛɔyachin bin ol eti ia wɛn i bi kiŋ ɛn in rul tri mɔnt ɛn tɛn de na Jerusɛlɛm. I du wetin bad na PAPA GƆD in yay.
Insay di oli pat pan di ia kiŋ Nebyukadnɛza sɛn fɔ briŋ am kam Jerusɛlɛm wit di prɛshɔs besin dɛm we de na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn mek in brɔda Zɛdikaya kiŋ na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm.
Zɛdikaya bin ol twɛnti wan ia we i bi kiŋ ɛn i rul ilɛvin ia na Jerusɛlɛm.
I du wetin bad na PAPA GƆD in Gɔd in yay. I nɔ ɔmbul insɛf bifo Jɛrimaya di prɔfɛt, we tɔk wetin de kɔmɔt na PAPA GƆD in mɔt.
I baranta pan kiŋ Nebyukadɛza we bin mek i swɛ to Gɔd (fɔ sav am); I bin traŋayes ɛn bin traŋa in at se i nɔ go ripɛnt ɛn go bak to PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd.

Ɔl di man dɛn we de bifo pan di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di pipul dɛn semweso, nɔ bin de waka tret na Papa Gɔd atɔl atɔl at ɔl at ɔl, bay aw dɛn bin de falamakata ɔda neshɔn dɛn we dɛn bin de du dɛn tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk; ɛn dɛn bin dɔti PAPA GƆD in os nain yay, we in bin dɔn mek oli na Jerusɛlɛm.
PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Papa fasin fɔ sɛn to dɛm bay in mɛsenja dɛm bikɔs i gɛt sɔri at fɔ in pipul dɛm ɛn in dwɛlin ples.
Bɔt dɛn de mek moko pan PAPA GƆD in mɛsenja dɛm, luk dawn pan in wɔd dɛm, ɛn Shumɔ pan in prɔfɛt dɛm, sote PAPA GƆD in at wam te fuk fuk grap fɔ in pipul dɛn we tɔnin bak nɔ de igen
Fɔ seka dat i mek di Babilonian dɛn kiŋ kam fɛt dɛm. I kil dɛn yɔŋman dɛm wit sɔd insay dɛn oli ples. Ɛn i nɔ gɛt sɔri pan yɔŋ wan, ɔ vajin olpa i put dɛn ɔl nain an.
Ɛn ɔl di besin dɛm na PAPA GƆD in os big ɛn smɔl di prɛshɔs ɛn dia tin dɛm na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn di prɛshɔs ɛn dia tin dɛm na di kiŋ ɛn di prins dɛn os dɛm ɔl dɛm wande i briŋ kam Babilɔn.
Ɛn dɛn dɔn PAPA GƆD in os brok Jerusɛlɛm in wɔl kam dɔŋ ɛn bɔn ɔl in kiŋ os dɛm wit faya ɛn distrɔy ɔl in prɛshɔs besin dɛm.
I kɛr dɛn go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn; dat na dɛn wan we di sɔd mis ɛn dɛn tɔn savant to am ɛn to in bɔypikin dɛm te di Pashia kindɔm tinap
fɔ mek di tin we PAPA GƆD tɔk na Jɛrimaya in mɔt bi sote di land ɛn jɔy in de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst dɛm. Ɔl di tɛm we i lɛf ɛmti ɛn sɔri i kip de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst fɔ mek ɔp sɛvinti ia.

Naw insay di fɔs ia we Sayrɔs bi kiŋ na Pashia mek PAPA GƆD in wɔd go bi we i tɔk wit Jɛrimaya in mɔt. I push di spirit pan Sayrɔs di Pashia kiŋ fɔ mek i mek anawnsmɛnt ɔlsay nain kindɔm ɛn rayt am se,

“Na dis Sayrɔs kiŋ na Pashia se, “PAPA GƆD di Gɔd we gɛt ɛvin dɔn gi mi ɔl di kindɔm dɛn na wɔl ɛn i dɔn put am to mi se a fɔ bil os fɔ am na Jerusɛlɛm. Ɛni wan pan una pan ɔl in pipul dɛm, mek in Gɔd de wit am. Lɛ i go.”
Di fɔs ia we Kiŋ Sayrɔs bi kiŋ na Pashia, fɔ lɛ wetin PAPA GƆD bin mek Prɔfɛt Jɛrimaya bin tɔk bi, PAPA GƆD mek Kiŋ Sayrɔs mek lɔ, ɛn mek dɛn rayt am dɔŋ na pepa sɛn am go ɔlɔbɔt nain kindɔm.
“Dis na wetin Kiŋ Sayrɔs na Pashia tɔk: ‘PAPA GƆD we na GƆD na ɛvin dɔn gi mi ɔl di kindɔm dɛn na di wɔl fɔ rul, ɛn i dɔn gi mi ɔda fɔ bil os fɔ am insay Jerusɛlɛm na Juda.
Mek PAPA GƆD de wit una we nain pipul dɛn; una fɔ go na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ go bil PAPA GƆD in os, PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn GƆD we de na Jerusɛlɛm.
Ɔl dɛn pipul dɛn we tap usay dɛn Ju pipul dɛn we dɛn bin kech briŋ kam na ya fɔ kɔntribyut; dɛn fɔ gi gold, silva, provishɔn fɔ di patrol, animal ɛn prɛzɛnt dɛn fɔ PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm.’”
Dɛn PAPA GƆD tɔch di edman dɛn fɔ Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin fambul dɛn at, ɛn di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛnsɛf yon at fɔ lɛ dɛn go go na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ go bil in os.
Di Ju dɛn neba we nɔto Ju gi dɛnsɛf yon kɔntribyushɔn; dɛn gi gold, silva tiŋs dɛn, provishɔn fɔ di patrol ɛn animal dɛn.
Kiŋ Sayrɔs gi di Ju dɛn bak ɔl wetin Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza bin dɔn pul kɔmɔt na PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm we i kɛr go put nain yon gɔd dɛn os.
Di Kiŋ an ova ɔltin gi Mithrɛdath we na bin di trɛzhɔra, dɔn Mithrɛdath ol wetin dɛn gi am ɛn rayt am dɔŋ na pepa so dat Shɛshbaza, di man we fɔ bi gɔvna na Juda go si am.
Na dɛn tin dɛn yaso Kiŋ Sayrɔs bin an ova gi Mithrɛdath: gold dish 30 silva dish 1,000 ɔda kayn dish dɛn 29
gold bol 30 silva bol 410 ɔda tiŋs dɛn 1,000
Ɔl ɛn ɔl na fayv tawzin, fo ɔndrɛd (5,400) gold ɛn silva tiŋs dɛn Shɛshbaza bin kɛr go na Jerusɛlɛm we i bin de go wit dɛn Ju we dɛn bin kech kɛr go na Babilɔn.
Na dɛn wan ya na di pipul dɛn we bin de na Babilɔn usay Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza bin kech dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn go we kam bak na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda. Bɔt ɔlman go nain yon siti usay i bin kɔmɔt.
Di edman dɛn na Zɛrubabɛl, Jɛshwa, Nɛimaya, Sɛraya, Rilaya, Mɔdikay, Bilshan, Mispa, Bigvay, Reum ɛn Baana. Dɛn wan yaso kɔmɔt Izrɛl.

Dɛn wan dɛn we na bin Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn in wokman dɛn we tɔn bak go Jerusɛlɛm, na dɛn jɛnareshɔn we dɛn bin kapchɔ we tɔn dis: Sotay, Asofɛrɛth, Pɛruda,
Jaala, Dakɔn, Gidɛl;
Shefataya, Atil, Pokɛrɛth Azɛbaim ɛn Ami.
Ɔl ɛn ɔl, di wokman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os, ɛn Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn in wokman dɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛn na 392
Na dɛn pipul yaso kɔmɔt na dɛn siti ya: Tɛl Mɛla, Tɛl Asha, Kɛrub, Adan ɛn Ima. Bɔt natin nɔ bin de fɔ sho se dɛn fambul kɔmɔt na Izrɛl.
Di pipul dɛn we bin de na dis grup yaso na Dilayla, Tobaya ɛn Nɛkoda dɛn Jɛnareshɔn; ɔl ɛn ɔl dɛn na bin 652.

Na dɛn tri man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn yaso dɛn jɛnareshɔn bin tɔn bak go na Jerusɛlɛm: Oba ya, Akɔz ɛn Bazilay. Dis Bazilay na wan man we mared to da Bazilay we kɔmɔt Giliad in gyal pikin, ɛn insɛf nem Bazilay.
Dɛn nɔ bin ebul fɔ fɛnɔt bɔt dɛn yon famili so dɛn nɔ mek dɛn miks wit dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. Dɛn se dɛn nɔ fit.
So di gɔvna tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ it pan di sakrifays te wan ɔda man de we de sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. In go yuz di Yurim ɛn Thumim, dat na di tin we dɛn kin yuz lɛkɛ yu de luk grɔn.
Di wanol grup na bin 42,360,
wit 7,337 wokman ɛn uman dɛn ɛn 200 man ɛn uman dɛn we de siŋ.
Dɛn kɛr 736 ɔs, 245 myul,
435 kamɛl ɛn 6,720 dɔŋki.
We ɔl dɛn pipul yaso rich na PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm, sɔm pan di bigman dɛn na dɛn famili gi bɔku tiŋs fɔ lɛ dɛn bil PAPA GƆD in os bak na di fɔs say we i bin de,
ɛn ɔlman bin gi wetin i ebul. We dɛn dɔn gɛda ɔltin dɔn, i kam to 1,030 pawns gold, 5,740 pawns silva, ɛn 100 rob fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays.

So di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays, di Livayt dɛn ɛn sɔm ɔda pipul dɛn tap na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn di siti dɛn we de nia; dɔn di wan dɛn we de siŋ, di getman dɛn ɛn di wokman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os go tap na dɛn yon siti.
Insay di mɔnt we mek sɛvin na di ia, ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin dɔn sɛtul dɔŋ. Dɛn ɔl go gɛda lɛkɛ wan pɔsin na Jerusɛlɛm.

Nain Jozadak in bɔypikin Jɛshwa wit in kɔmpin man dɛn we de mek sakrifays ɛn Shialtiɛl in bɔypikin Zɛrubabɛl ɛn in famili bigin fɔ bil Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD in ɔlta fɔ lɛ dɛn go de bɔn animal as sakrifays to PAPA GƆD de, jɛs lɛkɛ aw di lɔ we PAPA GƆD gi Mozis bin se.

Ivin we di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin de fred di ɔda pipul dɛn we bin dɔn de na di eria, dat nɔ tap dɛn fɔ bil di ɔlta na di say we i bin de fɔs. As dɛn bil di ɔlta dɔn so, dɛn bigin fɔ mek dɛn sakrifays to PAPA GƆD mɔnin ɛn ivin.

Dɔn dɛn bigin fɔ sɛlibret di ‘Tabanakul Fɛstival’ Dɛn bin gɛt di nɔmba ɔf animal we dɛn bin de bɔn ɛvri de fɔ sakrifays bay wetin di lɔ we PAPA GƆD gi Mozis se. Dɛn fɔ du dis ɛvri de te di fɛstival dɔn.

Dɔn igen dɛn mek di yuzhwal sakrifays we dɛn kin mek, dat na fɔ bɔn animal as sakrifays na faya ɛn di nyu mun fɛstival in yon sakrifays. Bak igen dɛn bin mek di ɔda sakrifays dɛn we dɛn bin de du ɛvri ia. Tɛm kin de we dɛn kin jɛs gi sakrifays to PAPA GƆD ɛnitɛm we dɛn fil fɔ.
Di pipul dɛn bigin mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD di fɔs de insay di sɛvin mɔnt na di ia, ivin we dɛn nɔ bin bigin le PAPA GƆD in os in fawndeshɔn yet.

Di pipul dɛn aya mesna ɛn kapinta dɛn fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os; ɛn dɛn pe di pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt Taya ɛn Saydɔn wit it, wayn ɛn ɔliv ɔyl fɔ kɔt sida timba na Libanɔn. Dɛn travul wit di timba we dɛn kɔt na di si te rich Jopa, ɛn na Kiŋ Sayrɔs na Pashia bin gi dɛn di ɔda fɔ du dat.

Dɛn bigin fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os tu ia afta we dɛn bin dɔn tɔn bak na Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn nainsay di sɛkɛn mɔnt dɛn bigin fɔ bil am. Na Zɛrubabɛl, Shialtiɛl in bɔypikin, ɛn Jɛshwa, Jozadak in bɔypikin wit dɛn brɔda dɛn bigin fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os. Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛnsɛf, ɛn ɔl dɛn wan we dɛn bin kapchɔ we tɔn bak na Jerusɛlɛm, dɛn ɔl put an fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os. Dɛn mek ɔl dɛn Livayt we bin dɔn ol twɛnti ia ɛn dɛn wan we pas da ej de fɔ bi fɔman.

Jɛshwa wit in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn in fambul dɛn; Kadmiɛl ɛn insɛf yon bɔypikin dɛn ɛn in fambul dɛn ɔl bin de supavays fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os. Ɔl dɛn pipul yaso na Odavaya in jɛnareshɔn dɛn. Ɛnadad insɛf ɛn in yon fambul dɛn we na Livayt bin jɔyn an fɔ supavays di wok.

We di bilda dɛn dɔn le PAPA GƆD in os in fawndeshɔn dɔn, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn wɛr dɛn rob ɛn tek dɛn pozishɔn fɔ blo dɛn trɔmpɛt. Dɔn di Livayt dɛn, dat na Esaf in jɛnareshɔn dɛn tek dɛn simbɔl. Dɛn ɔl ple myuzik fɔ prez PAPA GƆD fɔ dis sɛrimɔni lɛkɛ aw Kiŋ Devid bin se fɔ de du.

Dɛn prez PAPA GƆD ɛn tɛl am tɛnki wit dis siŋ yaso: “PAPA GƆD gud, in lɔv fɔ Izrɛl go las sote go!” Ɔl di pipul dɛn ala lawd wande prez PAPA GƆD bikɔs na dɛn dɔn le di fawndeshɔn fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os.

Bɔt bɔku pan dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we na olpa, ɛn dɛn Livayt dɛnsɛf we na opla, wit dɛn bigman dɛn we bin dɔn si di fɔs os bɔs big big kray we dɛn si dɛn le fawndeshɔn bak, bɔt di ɔda pipul dɛn bin gladi ɛn na so dɛn bin de ala.
Di nɔys bin so plɛnti dat pipul dɛn nɔ bin ebul fɔ tɛl udat de kray frɔm udat gladi. Dɛn wan dɛn we bin de fawe sɛf yɛri di nɔys.
We di pipul dɛn na Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin dɛn ɛnimi dɛn yɛri se dɛn wan we dɛn bin kapchɔ dɔn kam bak ɛn de bil Izrɛl dɛn GƆD we na PAPA GƆD in os bak,

dɛn go mit Zɛrubabɛl ɛn di big wan dɛn na di famili edman ɛn tɛl dɛn se, dɛnsɛf want jɔyn dɛn fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os, bikɔs dɛn de wɔship Izrɛl dɛn GƆD lɛkɛ aw dɛnsɛf we na Izrɛlayt de wɔship am. Dɛn se na di sem GƆD dɛn bin de mek sakrifays to frɔm di tɛm we Kiŋ Ɛsaadɔn na Asiria bin kɛr dɛn go.

Bɔt Zɛrubabɛl, Jɛshwa ɛn di big wan dɛn na di famili ansa dɛn se dɛn nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du pan di wok. Dɛn se dɛn nɔ gɛt nɔn say we dɛn go mitɔp. Dɛn tɛl dɛn se na dɛn nɔmɔ go bil os fɔ PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl dɛn GƆD, jɛs lɛkɛ aw nɔmɔ Kiŋ Sayrɔs na Pashia bin tɛl dɛn fɔ du.
So di pipul dɛnsɛf bigin ambɔg di Juda pipul dɛn as dɛn de du dɛn wok.
Dɛn aya masinari fɔ ɔndamayn di wok ɛn diskɔrej dɛn. Ɔl dis bi we Kiŋ Sayrɔs bin de rul Pashia, ɛn sɛf we Kiŋ Dariɔs in tek ova as kiŋ na Pashia, di sem tin kɔntinyu.
We Kiŋ Zaksis bigin fɔ rul, Juda dɛn ɛnimi rayt am lɛta ɛn tɔk bad tin bɔt di pipul dɛn na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm.

Ɛn afta da tɛm de sɛf we Kiŋ Atazaksis bigin rul na Pashia, di Juda pipul dɛn ɛnimi rayt ɔda bad lɛta to am bɔt di Ju dɛn, ɛn na Bishlam, Mithrɛdath, Tabil ɛn dɛn wan we de nain kabudu na bin di kakatua. Dɛn rayt lɛta to Atazaksis na Arameik laŋwej ɛn dɛn ɛksplen am we dɛn de rid am to am.
Gɔvna Reum ɛn di sɛktri Shimshay dɛnsɛf rayt bad lɛta bɔt Jerusɛlɛm to Kiŋ Atazaksis. Dɛn rayt se,
“Frɔm Reum di gɔvna ɛn Shimshay, di sɛktri ɛn dɛn ɔfisa dɛn; frɔm di jɔj dɛn ɛn ɔl di ɔda bigman dɛn na Irɛk, Babilɔn ɛn Susa na Ilam,
ɛn frɔm di pipul dɛn we di gret ɛn pawaful Ashɔbanipal pul kɔmɔt na dɛn om ɛn kɛr dɛn go na Sameria ɛn di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis”.
Na di akchwal lɛta dis: “Wi de rayt dis lɛta to Kiŋ Atazaksis as yu obidiɛnt pipul dɛn we yu de rul na di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis.

Wi want di kiŋ fɔ no se di Ju dɛn we kɔmɔt Babilɔn we kam tap ya na Jerusɛlɛm dɔn bigin fɔ bil di siti. Mɛmba se dɛn pipul ya de biev lɛkɛ rebɛl ɛn na soso bad tin dɛn de du. Infakt dɛn bin dɔn le fawndeshɔn fɔ bil di siti wɔl ɛn i lɛf smɔl mɔ fɔ bil an dɔn.
Kiŋ, if dɛn pipul yaso bil dis siti dɔn ɛn bil ɔl di wɔl dɛn sa, dɛn go tap fɔ pe taks to yu, dɛn nɔ go pe dyuti ɛn di ɔda mɔni dɛn we yu fɔ gɛt yu nɔ go gɛt an, dɔn na yu go lɔsis.
Sins wi de ɔnda yu sa, ɛn na yu swɛt wi de it, wi nɔ want shem ɛn disgres fɔ kam pan yu, na dat mek wi disayd fɔ tɛl yu dis wantɛm.

Duya, gi ɔda fɔ lɛ dɛn go luk usay di kiŋ dɛn bifo yu bin de kip rɛkɔd fɔ ɔl wetin bin de apin trade. If yu du so, yu go fɛnɔt se di pipul dɛn na dis siti bin gɛt bad bad traŋayes ɛn bin dɔn de gi prɔblɛm lɔntɛm. Infakt sɛf, dɛn gɛt bad rɛkɔd fɔ traŋayes ɛn na we dɛn nɔ want tek kɔntrol to ɔda kiŋ ɛn kɔntri dɛn mek dɛn pwɛl di siti kpatakpata.
Wi de tɛl yu se, if yu alaw di pipul dɛn fɔ mek dɛn bil dis siti wit ɔl in wɔl dɔn, yu go lɔs di wanol eria te rich to di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis.”
Di kiŋ sɛn dis riplay to Gɔvna Reum, Shimshay di sɛktri, ɛn dɛn ɔfisa dɛn we de na Sameria ɛn di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis.
I rayt se, “A de tɛl una ɔl adu. A gɛt una lɛta. Dɛn rid am ɛn translet am fɔ mi.

A bin gi ɔda fɔ lɛ dɛn luk na di rɛkɔd usay dɛn rayt ɔl wetin bin de apin trade, ɛn dɛn fɛnɔt se fɔ tru di pipul dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm nɔ bin de tek ɔda ɛn ɔltɛm dɛn bin de biev lɛkɛ rebɛl to dɛn kiŋ dɛn we bin de oba dɛn. Infakt na gbosgbos dɛn tek mek krid.
Jerusɛlɛm bin dɔn gɛt pawaful kiŋ dɛn we bin de rul te rich to di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis, ɛn dɛn bin de pe taks, dyuti ɛn ɔda mɔni dɛn to am.
So, una gi ɔda fɔ lɛ dɛn pipul ya tap di wok, ɛn dɛn nɔ fɔ bil da siti de te a gi ɔda fɔ du so.
Una mek shɔ se una go du wetin di lɔ se. Wetin fɔ mek a alaw dis kayn tin fɔ bi te i de kam ambɔg mi kindɔm?”
We dɛn rid Kiŋ Atazaksis in lɛta to Reum, Shimshay ɛn i kɔmpin dɛn, dɛn rɔn go Jerusɛlɛm ɛn fos di Ju pipul dɛn fɔ tap fɔ bil di siti.
Di wok pan PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm bin tap fɔs, ɛn dɛn nɔ du nɔn wok pan am te di sɛkɛn ia we Dariɔs bi Kiŋ na Pashia.
Di tɛm we Prɔfɛt Agay ɛn prɔfɛt Zɛkaraya we na Ido in bɔypikin bigin fɔ prɔfisay to di Ju pipul dɛn na Juda ɛn Jɛrusɛlɛm insay PAPA GƆD in nem;

Zɛrubabɛl, dat na Shialtiɛl in bɔypikin ɛn Jɛshwa, dat na Jozadak in yon bɔypikin, bin lisin to wetin di prɔfɛt dɛn bin de se, so dɛn bigin fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os bak na Jerusɛlɛm. PAPA GƆD in prɔfɛt dɛn bin de wit dɛn fɔ de ɛp dɛn.
Da tɛm de, Gɔvna Tatɛnay we na gɔvna fɔ di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis ɛn Shɛta-bozɛnay ɛn di ɔda ɔfisa dɛn rich na Jɛrusɛlɛm ɛn aks udat gi dɛn pamishɔn fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os,
ɛn udat na di bilda dɛn.
Bɔt bikɔs PAPA GƆD in yay bin de oba dɛn, dat nɔ bin tap di Ju lida dɛn fɔ kɛri ɔn wit di wok na PAPA GƆD in os. So di pipul dɛn go ripɔt to Kiŋ Dariɔs, ɛn Dariɔs insɛf sɛn in riplay.
Dis na di lɛta we Gɔvna Tatɛnay, Shɛta-bozɛnay ɛn di ɔda ɔfisa dɛn na di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis rayt to Kiŋ Dariɔs:
“Kiŋ Dariɔs, wi de tɛl yu adu sa.

“Wi de ripɔt to yu se we wi go na Juda, wi mit di pipul dɛn de bil di Gret PAPA GƆD in os wit big big ston dɛn ɛn na timba dɛn dɛn bin de put insay di wɔl. Dis wok yaso sa, de go ɔn fast ɛn di pipul dɛn de du am wit ɔl dɛn trɛnk ɛn sabi.
We wi aks di bigman dɛn udat gi dɛn pamishɔn fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os,
ɛn lɛ dɛn tɛl wi udat na di pipul dɛn we de du di wok fɔ lɛ wi go tɛl yu sa.
Dɛn tɛl wi se, dɛn na di wokman dɛn fɔ di GƆD fɔ ɛvin ɛn ath, ɛn dɛn de bil PAPA GƆD in os we bin de trade. Dɛn se, na wan pawaful Kiŋ na Izrɛl bin bil am da tɛm de.
Bɔt bikɔs dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn bin ambɔg di GƆD fɔ ɛvin, i sɛl dɛn gi Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza, di kiŋ in advaysa dɛn na Babilɔn. I bin brok PAPA GƆD in os ɛn kɛr di pipul dɛn go na Babilɔn.
Dɛn se di fɔs ia we Sayrɔs bi Kiŋ na Babilɔn, Kiŋ Sayrɔs gi ɔda fɔ lɛ dɛn bil PAPA GƆD in os bak.

Kiŋ Sayrɔs bin tek ɔl di gold ɛn silva tiŋs dɛn we bin de na Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza in os na Babilɔn, kɛr dɛn go bak na PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm, bikɔs na de Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza bin pul dɛn. Kiŋ Sayrɔs an ova ɔl dɛn tiŋs yaso to Shɛshbaza fɔ kip, dat na di man we i mek gɔvna na Juda.
Di Kiŋ gi am ɔda se i fɔ mek shɔ se i kɛr ɔl di tiŋs dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm go bak ɛn mek shɔ se dɛn bil PAPA GƆD in os nain rayt ples.
So Shɛshbaza insɛf go Jerusɛlɛm ɛn le di fawndeshɔn fɔ PAPA GƆD in os. Frɔm di tɛm we di pipul dɛn bigin di wok te di tɛm we dɛn de gi wi ansa, di wok nɔ dɔn yet.

So if i want sa, lɛ i gi ɔda mek dɛn luk na Babilɔn na di say we dɛn de kip dɛn istri buk bɔt dɛn kiŋ ɛn dɛn wok, fɔ fɛnɔt wɛda Kiŋ Sayrɔs bin ɛva pas lɔ se dɛn fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os bak na Jerusɛlɛm. Afta dat tɛl wi wetin yu mekɔp fɔ du.
Kiŋ Dariɔs gi ɔda fɔ mek dɛn luk na di say we dɛn de kip dɛn istri buk dɛn ɛn dɛn impɔtant tin dɛn na Babilɔn.
Na Ɛkbatana we de na di Mɛdia Prɔvins na de dɛn go fɛn wan skrol we dɛn bin rayt pan, we se: Mɛmorandɔm:

“Di fɔs ia we Kiŋ Sayrɔs bigin fɔ rul as Kiŋ, i mek wan lɔ we tɔk bɔt PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm. I se lɛ dɛn bil PAPA GƆD in os bak fɔ lɛ pipul dɛn go de ɔfa dɛn sakrifays de, ɛn lɛ dɛn bil am na di say we PAPA GƆD in os bin de fɔs. I fɔ bi naynti fut ay, naynti fut wayd.
Fɔ ɛvri tri blɔk we dɛn put fɔ mek di wɔl, dɛn fɔ put wan bod pantap de, ɛn na di gɔvmɛnt mɔni dɛn fɔ yuz fɔ du dis.
Ɔl di gold ɛn silva tiŋs dɛn we Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza bin pul kɔmɔt na PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn briŋ kam na Babilɔn, fɔ go bak na Jerusɛlɛm na PAPA GƆD in os.”
“Tatɛnay, yu we na, gɔvna fɔ di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis, ɛn Shɛta-bozɛnay ɛn di ɔda ɔfisa dɛn na Riva Yufretis eria. Una nɔ fɔ ambɔg di wok.
Una nɔ intafia pan di wok we dɛn de du na PAPA GƆD in os. Lɛ di Ju gɔvna ɛn dɛn lida dɛn bil PAPA GƆD in os bak usay i bin de fɔs.

Wit ɔl dis, a de tɛl una wetin una fɔ du fɔ di Ju bigman we dɛn de bil PAPA GƆD in os. Ɔl di mɔni fɔ di wok we dɛn de du fɔ kɔmɔt pan di taks mɔni we dɛn de kɔlɛkt na di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis so di wok nɔ go stɔp.

Ɛvri de una fɔ gi di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na Jerusɛlɛm wetin dɛn aks fɔ lɛkɛ yɔŋ man kaw, man ship ɔ dɛn yɔŋ ship fɔ bɔn as sakrifays to PAPA GƆD na ɛvin; wit, sɔl, wayn ɛn ɔyl fɔ lɛ in at go de kol.
Ɔl dis na fɔ lɛ dɛn go mek sakrifays to di GƆD na ɛvin we go mek i gladi ɛn dɛn go pre fɔ mi ɛn mi bɔypikin dɛn to di GƆD na ɛvin.
Dɛn igen a de tɛl una se if ɛnibɔdi chenj wetin a dɔn se so, dɛn fɔ pul wan bod kɔmɔt pan in os, shap am lɛkɛ nɛf ɛn chuk chuk in bɔdi wit am. Dɔn dɛn fɔ brok in os.

Mek PAPA GƆD we dɔn pik Jerusɛlɛm fɔ bi di ples we dɛn fɔ de kɔl in nem ovatro ɛni kiŋ ɔ kɔntri we go chenj dis lɔ ɔ pwɛl PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm. Na mi Dariɔs de sayn mi nem ɛn ɔlman fɔ mek shɔ se i go bay am.”
Gɔvna Tatɛnay, gɔvna fɔ di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis, ɛn Shɛta-bozɛnay wit di ɔda ɔfisa dɛn du wetin Kiŋ Dariɔs se.

Di Ju bigman dɛn kɔntinyu fɔ du di wok lɛkɛ aw prɔfɛt Agay ɛn prɔfɛt Zɛkaraya, Ido in bɔypikin dɛn advays dɛn. Dɛn bil PAPA GƆD in os dɔn jɛs lɛkɛ aw Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD bin se fɔ bil am ɛn aw Kiŋ Sayrɔs, Kiŋ Dariɔs ɛn Kiŋ Atazaksis, di kiŋ dɛn na Pashia bin se.
Dɛn bil PAPA GƆD in os dɔn di tɔd de insay Ada mɔnt, di tɛm we Kiŋ Dariɔs bin dɔn bi Kiŋ fɔ siks ia.
Dɔn di Izrɛlayt dɛn, di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn, di Livayt dɛn, ɛn ɔl di ɔda pipul dɛn we bin dɔn tɔn bak we kɔmɔt na Babilɔn dɛdiket PAPA GƆD in os, ɛn na so dɛn bin gladi.
Fɔ di dɛdikeshɔn sɛrimɔni, dɛn kil wan ɔndrɛd man kaw, tu ɔndrɛd man ship ɛn fo ɔndrɛd yɔŋ man ship. Dɔn dɛn kil twɛlv man got fɔ mek sakrifays fɔ dɛn sin, wan got fɔ ich fambul na Izrɛl.

Dɔn dɛn put di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn na difrɛn difrɛn grup ɛn tɛl dɛn ustɛm fɔ du dɛn wok na PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm. Dɛn du ɔl dɛn tin ya lɛkɛ to wetin rayt insay Mozis in buk.
Di pipul dɛn sɛlibret pasova di de we mek fotin na di fɔs mɔnt di ɔda ia.

Da tɛm de di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn bin dɔn pyurifay dɛnsɛf, dɛn ɔl bin klin bay wetin di lɔ se. Na di Livayt dɛn kil di ship fɔ di pasova fɔ ɔl dɛn wan we kɔmɔt Babilɔn kam bak, dɛn brɔda dɛn we na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn fɔ dɛnsɛf.
Di wan dɛn we it pan di pasova sakrifays na di Izrɛlayt dɛn we tɔn bak ɛn di ɔda wan dɛn we bin dɔn de na di siti we bin dɔn chenj dɛn atityud, ɛn we bin want fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl dɛn GƆD.

Di pipul dɛn bin sɛlibret di pasova fɛstival fɔ sɛvin de ɛn it bred we nɔ gɛt yist. Di wanol siti bin mek big big sɛlibreshɔn bikɔs PAPA GƆD chenj di Kiŋ na Asiria in atityud ɛn mek i ɛp dɛn pan di wok na PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl dɛn GƆD in os.

Naw, lɔŋ afta ɔl dɛn tin ya dɔn pas, di tɛm we Atazaksis na bin Kiŋ na Pashia, wan man bin de we nem Ɛzra. I tres in jɛnareshɔn dɛn go bak to Erɔn, di bigman we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. Na Sɛraya bɔn Ɛzra, dɔn Azaraya in bɔn Sɛraya, dɔn Ilkaya bɔn Azaraya,
Shalum bɔn Ilkaya, Zedɔk bɔn Shalum, Aitɔb bɔn Zedɔk,
Amaraya bɔn Aitɔb, Azaraya bɔn Amaraya, Mɛrayɔth bɔn Azaraya,
Zɛraaya bɔn Mɛrayɔth, Uzi bɔn Zɛraaya, Buki bɔn Uzi,
Abishua bɔn Buki, Finɛas bɔn Abishua, Ɛliaza bɔn Finɛas, dɔn Erɔn in bɔn Ɛliaza. Erɔn na bin di edman fɔ dɛn man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.

Dis Ɛzra na bin gud bukman. I sabi Mozis in lɔ gud gud wan, dat na di lɔ we PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl dɛn GƆD bin gi di Izrɛlayt dɛn. Ɛzra kɔmɔt Babilɔn go Jerusɛlɛm. Bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin de wit Ɛzra, ɛnitin we i tɛl di kiŋ fɔ du nain i kin du.

Sɔm pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn bin fala Ɛzra go Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn dɛn pipul ya na bin dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn, di kwaya, getman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn ɔda wokman dɛn. Ɔl dɛn pipul yaso lɛf Babilɔn fɔ go Jerusɛlɛm wit Ɛzra di ia we mek Kiŋ Atazaksis sɛvin ia we i bin dɔn de rul as Kiŋ.
Ɛzra rich na Jerusɛlɛm di mɔnt we mek fayv da sem ia de.
I lɛf Babilɔn di fɔs de insay di fɔs mɔnt ɛn rich Jerusɛlɛm di fɔs de na di mɔnt we mek fayv, ɛn PAPA GƆD bin de wit am.
Ɛzra bin de sɔksid bikɔs i bin mekɔp in maynd fɔ stɔdi PAPA GƆD in lɔ ɛn go bay wetin i se; i bin de tich di lɔ dɛn ɛn wetin dɛn min to di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Dis na di lɛta we Kiŋ Atazaksis gi Ɛzra, da man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn bukman, man we sabi wetin di lɔ ɛn kɔmand we PAPA GƆD gi Izrɛl se:
“Frɔm Kiŋ Atazaksis, di kiŋ fɔ dɛn ɔda kiŋ dɛn. To Ɛzra di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ticha fɔ di GƆD na ɛvin in Lɔ. A de tɛl yu adu.
A de gi ɔda naw se ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn na mi kindɔm, ɛn dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn Livayt dɛn, we want fɔ go Jerusɛlɛm wit yu, kin go.
Mi ɛn mi sɛvin advaysa gi yu ɔda fɔ fɛnɔt aw tiŋs de kɛri ɔn na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda, ɛn aw di pipul dɛn de obe yu GƆD in lɔ we i gi yu.
Yu fɔ kɛr di gold ɛn di silva we di kiŋ ɛn in advaysa dɛn gi fri wan to Izrɛl dɛn GƆD we de na Jerusɛlɛm.

Dɛn igen yu fɔ kɛr ɛni silva ɛn gold we yu kɔlɛkt na di Izrɛlayt dɛn an na Babilɔn wit di tiŋs dɛn we di pipul ɛn di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn gi fri wan fɔ dɛn GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm.
Yu fɔ yuz dis mɔni fɔ bay man kaw, man ship, yɔŋ man ship, it ɛn wayn ɛn tek dɛn mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD na di ɔlta na una GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm.
Yu ɛn yu brɔda Ju man brɔda dɛn kin du ɛnitin we una fil fɔ du wit di balans silva ɛn gold, lɛkɛ aw una GƆD se nɔmɔ fɔ du.
Di tiŋs dɛn we wi gi yu we fɔ de na PAPA GƆD in os, mɔs gi ɔl to una GƆD nain os na Jerusɛlɛm.
Ɛn ɛnitin we yu go want fɔ yu PAPA GƆD in os we yu nɔ gɛt, go na di gɔvmɛnt in amawnt go tek mɔni de.

Mi, Kiŋ Atazaksis de gi ɔda to ɔl di trɛzhɔra dɛn na di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis fɔ sɔplay ɛnitin we Ɛzra di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn bukman, we no PAPA GƆD na ɛvin in Lɔ, want witawt dile.
Una fɔ gi am ɔp to sɛvin tawzin, fayv ɔndrɛd pawns silva, fayv ɔndrɛd bushɛl wit, fayv ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti galɔn wayn, fayv ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti galɔn ɔliv ɔyl ɛn ɔmɔs sɔl nɔmɔ i want.
Una mek shɔ se una provayd ɛnitin we di GƆD na ɛvin want fɔ in os, bikɔs nɔn rizin nɔ de fɔ mek PAPA GƆD vɛks pan di kiŋ we de rul ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn.
A de gi ɔda bak se, nɔn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, dɛn Livayt, dɛn wan we de siŋ, dɛn os getman na PAPA GƆD in os ɔ ɛni ɔda wokman na PAPA GƆD in os nɔ fɔ pe taks.

Ɛn yusɛf Ɛzra fɔ yuz di sɛns we PAPA GƆD gi yu fɔ pik magistret ɛn jɔj dɛn; man dɛn we sabi PAPA GƆD in lɔ fɔ de jɔj kes ɛn rul di pipul dɛn na di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis. If ɛnibɔdi de we nɔ sabi di lɔ yu fɔ tich am.
Ɛnibɔdi we nɔ gri fɔ obe yu PAPA GƆD in lɔ ɛn di kiŋ in lɔ fɔ day, ɔ dɛn fɔ ban am lɛ in nɔ tap na di kɔntri, ɔ dɛn siz ɔl in prɔpati ɔ dɛn jel am.”
Ɛzra prez PAPA GƆD. I se, “Prez PAPA GƆD, wi papa dɛn GƆD we mek di kiŋ mek PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm luk fayn!

A de prez PAPA GƆD fɔ we i mek di kiŋ lɛk mi, ɛn ɔl di kiŋ in advaysa dɛn ɛn in pawaful wokman dɛnsɛf lɛk mi. PAPA GƆD, mi GƆD gi mi kɔrej bikɔs i de wit mi. I mek a ebul fɔ gɛda sɔm pan di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl ɛn koks dɛn mek dɛn fala mi go Jerusɛlɛm.”
Dɛn pipul yaso na di big wan dɛn na dɛn famili ɛn di wan dɛn we rɛjista wit dɛn, we lɛf Babilɔn wit mi, di tɛm we Atazaksis na bin Kiŋ:
Finɛas in famili: na Gashɔm. Ithama in famili: na Daniɛl.
Devid in famili: na Atush, Shɛkanaya in bɔypikin. Parɔsh in famili: na Zɛkaraya ɛn wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti ɔda man.
Paath Moab in famili: na Zɛkaraya in bɔypikin Ɛlionay ɛn tu ɔndrɛd ɔda man.
Zatu in famili na Jaeziɛl in bɔypikin Shɛkanaya ɛn tri ɔndrɛd ɔda man.
Adin in famili: na Jonɛthan in bɔypikin Ɛbɛd ɛn fifti ɔda man.
Ilam in famili: na Athalaya in bɔypikin Jɛshaya ɛn sɛvinti ɔda man.
Shefataya in famili: na Maykɛl in bɔypikin Zɛbadaya ɛn eti ɔda man.
Joab in famili: na Jɛiɛl in bɔypikin Obadaya ɛn tu ɔndrɛd ɛn etin ɔda man.
Bani in famili: na Josifaya in bɔypikin Shelomit ɛn wan ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti ɔda man.
Bibay in famili: na Bibay in bɔypikin Zɛkaraya ɛn twɛnti-et ɔda man.
Azgad in famili: na Akatan in bɔypikin Joanan ɛn wan ɔndrɛd ɛn tɛn ɔda man.
Adonikam in famili: dat na di wan dɛn we las kam: dɛn na Ɛlifɛlɛt, Jeuɛl, Shɛmaya ɛn siksti ɔda man.
Bigvay in famili: dɛn na Utay, Zakɔ ɛn sɛvinti ɔda man

A mek di pipul dɛn gɛda nia di riva we de flo go na Aava, ɛn wi bin de de fɔ tri de. Wɛn a bigin chɛk di pipul dɛn bak, a fɛnɔt se di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn bin de wit dɛn, bɔt nɔn Livayt nɔ bin de wit dɛn.
So a sɛn kɔl di Livayt dɛn. Dat na Ɛlieza, Eriɛl, Shɛmaya, Ɛlnetan, Jarib, Ɛlnetan, Nethan, Zɛkaraya ɛn Mɛshulam. Dɔn a kɔl tu ɔda man we gɛt sɛns; dɛn na Jɔyarib ɛn Ɛlnetan.
A sɛn ɔl dɛn man ya to Ido, di edman na Kasifia fɔ tɛl in ɛn in fambul dɛn ɛn wokman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os se, lɛ dɛn sɛn pipul dɛn fɔ wok na PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm.

Sins PAPA GƆD in gud an bin de wit wi, dɛn sɛn wan man we nem Shɛrɛbaya, ɛn na man we fit fɔ di wok. Shɛrɛbaya na Livayt we kɔmɔt na di Mali famili. I de na Izrɛl in layn tru in pikin Livay. I kam wit etin pan in bɔypikin ɛn brɔda.
Di pipul dɛn sɛn Ashabaya ɛn Jɛshaya we kɔmɔt na di Mɛrari famili wit ɔda man ɛn twɛnti frɔm di famili.

Fɔ ad to dis nɔmba a bin gɛt tu ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti mɔ pipul fɔ wok na PAPA GƆD in os. Na dɛn bin de ɛp di Livayt dɛn ɛn na Kiŋ Devid bin pik dɛn famili fɔ de sav na PAPA GƆD in os. A gɛt dɛn ɔl nem dɔŋ.
We wi de nia di riva na Aava, a tɛl di pipul dɛn se lɛ wi fast ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD ɛn lɛ ɔlman ɔmbul insɛf to am fɔ lɛ i go gayd wi ɛn kɔba wi pikin dɛn ɛn wi prɔpati dɛn.

A bin want aks di kiŋ fɔ gi wi sojaman dɛn wit ɔs ɛn ɔs ɛn karej fɔ de wit wi fɔ de gyad wi na rod frɔm dɛn bad pipul dɛn, bɔt we a mɛmba se a bin dɔn tɛl am se wi PAPA GƆD de kɔba ɔl udat kɔl am, ɛn kin put vɛksteshɔn ɛn pɔnish dɛn wan we kin tɔn dɛn bak pan am, a shem fɔ tɔk.
So wi fast ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD fɔ protɛkt wi, ɛn i ansa wi prea.
A pik twɛlv lida pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. Dɛn na Shɛrɛbaya, Ashabaya ɛn tɛn ɔda man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin,
dɔn a we di silva ɛn di gold ɛn di ɔda tiŋs dɛn we di Kiŋ wit in advaysa ɛn in ɔfisa dɛn ɛn ɔl di ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn gi fɔ yuz na PAPA GƆD in os, ɛn gi ɔl to dɛn man ya fɔ kɛr dɛn go na PAPA GƆD in os.
Ɔl ɛn ɔl ɔltin kam to: twɛnti-fo tɔn silva, sɛvin tawzin fayv ɔndrɛd pawns silva plet, kɔp ɛn ɔda tiŋs dɛn, sɛvin tawzin fayv ɔndrɛd pawns gold,
twɛnti gold bol dɛn, bɔt dɛn valyu na wan ɔndrɛd gold kɔpɔ. Tu fayn tin dɛn we na bras dɛn tek mek dɛn, bɔt dɛn valyu lɛkɛ gold.

A tɛl di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin se, lɛkɛ we dɛn dɔn kɔnsikret dɛn ɛn dɛn tiŋs dɛn so, na fɔ lɛ dɛn de fɔ PAPA GƆD. A tɛl dɛn se di silva ɛn gold na tiŋs dɛn we dɛn gi PAPA GƆD bikɔs dɛn fil fɔ gi an de. PAPA GƆD we na dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn GƆD.

Dɛn fɔ gyad dɛn tiŋs de fayn te dɛn an dɛn ova to di lida dɛn fɔ dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn, di Livayt dɛn ɛn di lida dɛn na Izrɛl. A tɛl dɛn se dɛn fɔ put ɔl na di sto na PAPA GƆD in os. Wan pin nɔ fɔ lɔs pan dɛn.
Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛnsɛf gri fɔ kɛr ɔl di tin dɛn we bin de na PAPA GƆD in os go bak na Jerusɛlɛm.
Wi lɛf di say we wi bin de nia di Aava Riva di de we mek twɛlv na di fɔs mɔnt fɔ go Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn PAPA GƆD bin de wit wi. I protɛkt wi na rod frɔm wi ɛnimi dɛn ɛn ambush.
Faynali wi rich Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn wɛn wi rich wi blo fɔ tri de.

Di de we mek fo afta wi rich, wi we ɛn kɔnt ɔl di silva, ɛn gold ɛn di ɔda dia tiŋs dɛn, ɛn an dɛn ova to Mɛrɛmɔth, di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin in bɔypikin; Ɛliaza, Finɛas in bɔypikin, ɛn to Jozabad, Jɛshwa in bɔypikin. Ɛn Noadaya, Binyui in bɔypikin dɛnsɛf bin de, de. Noadaya ɛn Jozabad dɛn na Livayt.
We dɛn dɔn kɔnt ɔltin dɔn, dɛn rayt am na pepa ɛn kip am.

Di pipul dɛn we tɔn bak mek bɔn animal dɛn as sakrifays to Izrɛl dɛn GƆD. Dɛn kil twɛlv man kaw fɔ di wanol kɔntri Izrɛl, naynti-siks bigman ship ɛn sɛvinti-sɛvin yɔŋ man ship, ɛn twɛlv man got fɔ bɔn as sakrifays fɔ dɛn sin.
Dɛn gi di pepa we di kiŋ rayt to di gɔvna ɛn in ɔfisa dɛn na di wɛst pat na Riva Yufretis, ɛn dɛnsɛf gri fɔ sɔpɔt di ritɔni dɛn ɛn di wok na PAPA GƆD in os.

We wi dɔn du ɔltin dɔn, di Ju lida dɛn kam to mi kam tɛl mi se di Izrɛlayt dɛn, ɛn ivin di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin wit di Livayt dɛn nɔ de kip to dɛnsɛf. Dɛn se dɛn de miks wit di ɔda pipul dɛn we tap na di siti. Dɛn dɔn kɔpi di bad abit we di Kenanayt dɛn, di Itayt dɛn, di Pɛrizayt dɛn, di Jɛbyusayt dɛn, di Amonayt dɛn, di Moabayt dɛn, di Ijipshian dɛn ɛn di Amɔrayt dɛn gɛt.

Dɛn se di Ju pipul dɛn de mared dɛn fɔrina ya dɛn gyal pikin dɛn, ɛn sɛf dɛn de mek dɛn bɔypikin dɛnsɛf mared di fɔrina dɛn gyal pikin dɛn. Dɛn we se dɛn gɔdli ɛn oli na dɛn dɔn miksɔp ɛn dɔti dɛnsɛf wit dɛn kaynaba tin ya. Infakt fɔ mek tin wɔs na di lida dɛn ɛn di bigman dɛn de bifo pan dis kaynaba dɔti gem.
We a yɛri dis kayn tin, a chɛr chɛr mi klos na mi bɔdi ɛn drɔ mi ia na mi ed ɛn mi biabia wit shem ɛn pwɛl at.
Usay a yɛri di wɔd na de a sidɔm wit pwɛl at te ivintɛm rich fɔ mek sakrifays. Ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we fred PAPA GƆD ɛn wetin I se kam gɛda rawnd mi bikɔs ɔf wetin di pipul dɛn we kam bak bin de du.
We di tɛm rich fɔ mek di ivintɛm sakrifays, a grap na di say we a bin sidɔm wit pwɛl at ɛn mi chɛr chɛr klos, nildɔŋ na grɔn, es mi an ɔp ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD.
A pre se, “E mi GƆD, a de shem pan yu. A nɔ fit fɔ luk ɔp usay yu de bikɔs wi sin bɔku. I ay pas wi ed te rich ɔp usay yu de.

Frɔm di tɛm we wi grampa dɛn de na wɔl te tide, wi we se wi na yu pipul dɛn jɛs de du bad nɔmɔ. Ɛn bikɔs ɔf wi sin, wi o, wi kiŋ dɛn o, ɛn wi man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn fɔdɔm na dɛn pegan kiŋ dɛn trap. Dɛn kil wi, dɛn tif wi, dɛn kapchɔ wi, ɛn kɛr wi go trit wi lɛkɛ jelman. Dɛn disgres wi ɛn na da disgres de de pan wi te tide.
Fɔ dis shɔt tɛm nɔmɔ PAPA GƆD, yu dɔn sho wi se yu gud we yu mek sɔm pan wi kɔmɔt pan da slev layf de kam na ya na dis oli ples usay wan kɔt at nɔ de. Yu dɔn mek wi stat wi layf bak igen

We wi na bin slev, yu nɔ bin fɔgɛt wi da tɛm de. Yu mek di kiŋ dɛn na Pashia trit wi fayn. Yu gi wi nyu zil fɔ bil yu os ɛn fɔ mek ɔl wetin bin dɔn pwɛl bak. Yu gi wi wɔl rawnd Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm fɔ protɛkt wi.
PAPA GƆD, wetin wi go tɔk naw afta we ɔl dɛn tin yaso dɔn bi to wi? Wi dɔn brok di Lɔ dɛn.

Dɛn prɔfɛt dɛn we na bin yu savant dɛn bin de wɔn wi trade se, yu se, di land we wi de go fɔ go tek fɔ bi wi yon, ful wit soso kɔrɔpshɔn: di pipul dɛn we de de, de du ɔlkayn bad tin we nɔ fit fɔ lɛ mɔtalman si ɔ yɛri. Ɔlɔbɔt di wanol ples, na soso wikɛdnɛs ɛn bad tin de apin de. Dɛn dɔn nasti di ples.

So, wi nɔ fɔ mek dɛn mared wi gyal pikin dɛn, ɛn wisɛf yon bɔypikin dɛn nɔ fɔ mared dɛn yon gyal pikin dɛn; ɛn wi nɔ fɔ ɛp dɛn pan natin. Dɛn se yu bin dɔn prɔmis se if wi avɔyd dɛn pipul ya ɛn du wetin yu se, bɛtɛ go fala wi ɛn wi go ɛnjɔy di gud tin dɛn we de kɔmɔt na di land. Dɛn se, yu se, wi pikin dɛnsɛf go lɛf biɛn de ɛnjɔy.
Naw wi de sɔfa bikɔs ɔf wi wikɛdnɛs ɛn wi dɔn sin. Di pɔnishmɛnt we wi de gɛt smɔl pas di bad we wi dɔn du, bɔt pan ɔl dat PAPA GƆD, yu mek we fɔ sɔm pan wi fɔ tɔn bak.
Yu nɔ want lɛ wi tɔn bak go brok yu lɔ igen ɛn mared dɛn pipul ya we de du ɔlkayn bad tin ɛn. Yu go vɛks pan wi if wi du dat ɛn dɔnawe wit wi we nɔn pan wi nɔ go lɛf.
E PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl dɛn GƆD, yu raychɔs! Wi ɔl de bifo yu naw gilti gilti wan, ɛn if nɔto fɔ yu masi, nɔn pan wi nɔ fit fɔ tinap bifo yu.”
We Ɛzra lidɔm na grɔn bifo PAPA GƆD in os de pre to PAPA GƆD wit kray ɛn de kɔnfɛs dɛn sin, big big krawd frɔm di Izrɛlayt dɛn kam gɛda pan am - man, uman ɛn pikin, dɛn ɔl bin de kray bita bita wan.

Nain Shɛkanaya, Jeayɛl in bɔypikin we na wan pan dɛn Ilam fambul dɛn tɛl am se, dɛn nɔ dɔn de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD we dɛn de mared dɛn uman we na fɔrina, bɔt dɛn no se pan ɔl dis, op stil de fɔ Izrɛl.

I beg am, lɛ dɛn mek Kɔvinant wit PAPA GƆD se dɛn go lɛf dɛn uman dɛn de, ɛn drɛb dɛn wit dɛn pikin dɛn, dɔn wetin in di Ɛzra ɛn di ɔda man dɛn we de du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl dɛn fɔ du, nain dɛn go du. I se wetin PAPA GƆD in lɔ se fɔ du na dat dɛn go du.
I se lɛ Ɛzra grap bikɔs, nain de bifo pan di biznɛs ɛn dɛn rɛdi fɔ sɔpɔt am, so i nɔ fɔ pwɛl at. I se dɛn de biɛn am.
So Ɛzra insɛf grap ɛn mek di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn ɛn ɔl di ɔda pipul dɛn swɛ se dɛn go du wetin Shɛkanaya dɔn se. Dɔn dɛn swɛ.

Afta dat, i kɔmɔt bifo PAPA GƆD in os ɛn go na Ilaɛlashib in bɔypikin Jɛoanan in os ɛn slip de da nɛt de. Ol nɛt i de kray fɔ Izrɛl we dɛn nɔ de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD. I nɔ it ɔ drink wata sɛf bikɔs i bin sɔri fɔ ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn du.
Dɛn sɛn mɛsej ɔlɔbɔt na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm se ɔl dɛn wan we na ritɔni we kɔmɔt Babilɔn fɔ go gɛda na Jerusɛlɛm;
ɛn ɛnibɔdi we nɔ rich de insay tri de go fɔfit ɔl in prɔpati; ɛn nɔto dat nɔmɔ, dɛn go drɛb am kɔmɔt usay in pipul dɛn de. Na so di lida dɛn se.

Insay tri de, ɔl di pipul dɛn na Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin dɔn gɛda na Jerusɛlɛm. Dis apin di de we mek twɛnti insay di mɔnt we mek nayn. Ɔlman bin sidɔm na di skwaya bifo PAPA GƆD in os. Dɛn ɔl bin wɔri ɛn sawa dɛn fes bikɔs di kes siriɔs ɛn pantap dat ren bin de kam.
Ɛzra grap ɛn tɔk to di pipul dɛn. I tɛl dɛn se dɛn dɔn du bad we dɛn mared fɔrina we mek Izrɛl dɔn sin pasmak,

so wetin dɛn fɔ du, naw na fɔ mek dɛn kɔnfɛs dɛn sin to PAPA GƆD, we na dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn GƆD ɛn du wetin i se. I se dɛn nɔ fɔ miks wit di fɔrina dɛn we tap usay dɛn de ɛn dɛn fɔ lɛf di fɔrina dɛn we dɛn mared.
Ɔl di pipul dɛn ansa wit wan vɔys se dɛn go du ɔl wetin Ɛzra se.
Dɔn dɛn tɔk bak se, dɛn tu bɔku, ɛn ren de kam, so dɛn nɔ go kɔntinyu fɔ tinap ɔnda da kayn ren de. Dɛn se dɛn nɔ go tek wan ɔ tu de fɔ dil wit di mata bikɔs dɛn sin dɛn tu bɔku.

Dɛn se lɛ dɛn lida dɛn tinap bifo fɔ dɛn, ɛn lɛ ɔl udat we mared fɔrin uman kam di tɛm we dɛn go fiks. Ɛn ich siti fɔ gɛt in yon jɔj fɔ sɛtul dis mata, so dat dɛn go tɔk dis tɔk fɔ lɛ PAPA GƆD in at go kol.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ bin ɔpoz dis plan pas Jonɛthan, Asaɛl in bɔypikin ɛn Jazɛya, Tikva in yon bɔypikin; ɛn dɛn bin gɛt Mɛshulam ɛn Shabetay da Livayt fɔ bato dɛn.

Ɛniwe, ɔlman bin gri to wetin dɛn ɔl se. So, Ɛzra di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, pik man dɛn frɔm di famili dɛn; i pik wan man frɔm ich famili ɛn rayt dɛn nem dɔŋ. Dɛn bigin du dɛn wok fɔ invɛstiget di mata di fɔs de insay di mɔnt we mek tɛn da ia de.
Bay di fɔs de na di fɔs mɔnt di ɔda ia, dɛn dɔn di tɔk wit ɔl dɛn man we bin mared fɔrin uman dɛn.
Na dɛn man dɛn yaso bin mared fɔrina dɛn: Pan di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn yon layn yu gɛt Jɛshwa, Jozadak in bɔypikin ɛn in brɔda dɛn: Maasɛya, Ɛliaza, Jarib ɛn Gɛdalaya.
Dɛn prɔmis se dɔn go lɛf dɛn wɛf dɛn ɛn mek man ship sakrifays fɔ dɛn sin.
Pan Ima in yon famili layn yu gɛt Anani ɛn Zɛbadaya.
Pan Arim in yon famili layn yu gɛt Maasɛya, Ilayja, Shɛmaya, Jeayɛl ɛn Uzaya.
Pan Pashɔ in yon famili layn yu gɛt Ɛlionay, Maasɛya, Ishmɛl, Netanɛl, Jozabad, ɛn Ɛlasa.
Na dɛn Livayt dɛn yaso bin mared fɔrina dɛn: Jozabad, Shimɛay, Kelaya (we dɛn kin kɔl Kɛlita), Pɛtaya, Juda, ɛn Ɛliaza.
Pan di siŋa dɛm yu gɛt Ilaɛlashib Pan di getman dɛn yu gɛt Shalum, Telem ɛn Yuri.
Dɛn wan yaso kɔmɔt na Pan Parɔsh in yon famili layn we yu gɛt Ramaya, Izaya, Malkija, Mijamin, Ɛliaza, Malkija ɛn Bɛnaya.
Pan Ilam in yon famili layn yu gɛt Matanaya, Zɛkaraya, Jeayɛl, Abdi, Jɛrimɔth ɛn Ilayja.
Pan Zatu in yon famili layn yu gɛt Ɛlionay, Ilaɛlashib, Matanaya, Jɛrimɔth, Zabad ɛn Aziza.
Pan Bibay in yon famili layn yu gɛt Jɛoaran, Ananaya, Zabay ɛn Athlay.
Pan Bani in yon famili layn yu gɛt Mɛshulam, Maluk, Adaya, Jashub, Sheal ɛn Jɛrimɔth.
Pan Paath Moab in famili layn yu gɛt Adna, Kɛlal, Bɛnaya, Matanaya, Bɛzalɛl, Binyui ɛn Manasɛ.
Pan Arim in famili layn yu gɛt Ɛliaza, Ishija, Malkija, Shɛmaya, Simiɔn,
Bɛnjamin, Maluk, ɛn Shɛmaraya.
Pan Ashum in yon famili layn yu gɛt Matɛnay, Matata, Zabad, Ɛlifɛlɛt, Jɛrimaya, Manasɛ ɛn Shimɛi.
Pan Bani in famili layn yu gɛt Maaday, Amram, ɛn Yuɛl,
Bɛnaya, Bidɛya, Kɛlui,
Vanaya, Mɛrimɔth, Ilaɛlashib,
Matanaya, Matɛnay ɛn Jaaso.
Pan Binyui in famili layn yu gɛt Shimɛay,
Shelɛmaya, Nethan, Adaya,
Maknadibay, Shashay, Sharay,
Azarɛl, Shelɛmaya, Shɛmaraya,
Shalum, Amaraya ɛn Josɛf.
Pan Nɛbo in yon famili layn yu gɛt Jeayɛl, Matitaya, Zabad, Zɛbina, Jaday, Joɛl ɛn Bɛnaya.
Ɔl dɛn man dɛn yaso bin mared fɔrina dɛn ɛn sɔm pan dɛnsɛf bin bɔn pikin wit dɛn.
Dis na di stori bɔt Nɛimaya, Akalaya in bɔypikin we misɛf rayt: Twɛnti ia afta we Kiŋ Atazaksis bin dɔn bigin rul Pashia, insay di mɔnt we dɛn kɔl Kislɛv, da sem ia de, a bin tap nia di wɔl na Susa.
We a de de, wan pan mi brɔda dɛn we nem Anani ɛn sɔm ɔda man dɛn kɔmɔt Juda kam. A aks dɛn bɔt dɛn Ju we nɔ bin go ɛgzayl. A aks dɛn bak aw di go de go na Jerusɛlɛm.

Dɛn se ɔltin nɔ fayn fɔ di wan dɛn we nɔ bin de ɛgzayl. Dɛn se dɛn de pan trɔbul ɛn dɛn trenja dɛn de laf dɛn ɛn fityay dɛn. Dɛn tɔk bak se, dɛn brok di wɔl rawnd Jerusɛlɛm ɛn bɔn di get dɛn kpatakpata.
We a yɛri dis, a sidɔm ɛn kray. Infakt sɛf fɔ sɔntɛm mi at nɔ swit. A fast ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD.
A se, “E PAPA GƆD we de na ɛvin! Yu big ɛn du fɔ fred. Yu de kip yu wɔd na yu Kɔvinant to ɔl udat lɛk yu ɛn de du wetin yu want.

Duya, yɛri mi prea. Nɔ lɔk yu yes ɛn yay pan mi. Ol de ɛn nɛt a de pre fɔ yu pipul di Izrɛlayt dɛn. Wi na yu pikin dɛn, wi sɔri fɔ ɔl di bad tin dɛn we wi dɔn du. Mi, mi fambul dɛn ɛn ɔlman dɔn kɔmit sin.
Wi kɔrɔpt ɛn wi nɔ de du wetin yu rayt na yu lɔ gi Mozis.
“Mɛmba wetin yu tɛl yu savant Mozis. Yu se if wi nɔ du wetin yu want wi fɔ du, yu go skata wi ɔlɔbɔt,

bɔt if wi kam bak to yu ɛn rɛdi fɔ de du wetin yu want, ivin we wi go de ɔlɔbɔt, yu go gɛda wi ɔl ɛn briŋ wi bak na wan ples. Da ples de go bi di say we yu bin dɔn pik fɔ wi fɔ de ɛn yusɛf go de de wit wi.
“PAPA GƆD, wi na yu pikin dɛn we yu yuz ɔl yu pawa ɛn trɛnk fɔ pul pan trɔbul.
PAPA GƆD duya yɛri mi prea. Lisin ɔl udat rɛdi fɔ du wetin yu want. Mek bɛtɛ fala mi as a de go tɔk to di Kiŋ.” Na mi bin de sav wayn to di kiŋ.

Twɛnti ia afta Kiŋ Atazaksis bin dɔn bigin rul, insay di mɔnt we dɛn kɔl Nisan, da sem ia de a go fɔ sav di kiŋ wayn wande. A nɔ dɔn yus fɔ sawa mi fes bifo di kiŋ. Bɔt i kam bi se, a sawa mi fes da de de.
So di kiŋ aks mi wetin mek a mek mi fes so we a nɔ sik. I se, “I mɔs bi se yu at nɔ swit.” A skyad,
bɔt a tɛl di kiŋ se, “Pa, mek yu gɛt lɔŋ layf! Aw mi at go swit we di siti we dɛn bɛr mi pipul dɛn dɔn pwɛl kpatakpata ɛn faya sɛf dɔn bɔn di get dɛn?”
Di kiŋ aks mi wetin a want. Dɛn a jɛs pre kwik wan to PAPA GƆD na ɛvin ɛn
ansa di Kiŋ se, “If yu gladi wit wetin a de du ɛn want fɔ ɛp mi, gi mi pamishɔn fɔ go Juda usay di grev dɛn we dɛn bɛr mi pipul dɛn de. Mek a go si if a kin go bil di siti bak.”
Di kiŋ in wɛf bin sidɔm nia am. So di kiŋ aks mi aw lɔŋ a de go fɔ ɛn ustɛm a plan fɔ kam bak. A tɛl am. Di kiŋ gladi fɔ mek a go ɛn a fiks tɛm we a go lɛf.
A tɛl di kiŋ se, if i gladi fɔ ɛp mi, mek i gi mi lɛta dɛn we a go sho di edman dɛn na di wɛstɛn say na Riva Yufretis so dat dɛn nɔ go ambɔg mi we a de pas insay dɛn siti dɛn we a de go Juda.

A aks bak fɔ ɔda lɛta fɔ gi Esaf, di man we de luk afta di kiŋ in fɔrɛst, so dat i go gi mi bod fɔ di get dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os, bod fɔ di wɔl na di siti ɛn bod fɔ tek bil di os we a fɔ tap. Di kiŋ gri fɔ du ɔl wetin a aks am bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin de wit mi.
I ivin mek a go wit sɔm ami ɔfisa dɛn ɛn sɔm man dɛn we bin de rayd ɔs. We a rich di wɛstɛn say na Riva Yufretis, a gi di edman dɛn di lɛta dɛn we di kiŋ bin gi mi.
We Sanbalat, di man we kɔmɔt na Orɔn ɛn Tobaya we na ɔfisa na Amɔn eria, yɛri se a dɔn kam, dɛn vɛks bad fɔ no se sɔmbɔdi dɔn kam fɔ ɛp di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
A go Jerusɛlɛm ɛn we a dɔn de de fɔ tri de,
a kɔmɔt midul nɛt wit sɔm man dɛn. Da tɛm de a nɔ bin tɛl nɔbɔdi yet bɔt wetin PAPA GƆD bin dɔn put na mi at fɔ du fɔ Jerusɛlɛm. Nɔn ɔda animal nɔ bin de pas di wan nɔmɔ we a bin de rayd pan.
Na nɛt a go inspɛkt di wɔl we fɔdɔm na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn di get dɛn we faya bɔn. A pas na di Vali Get bay Jakal Wɛl nia di Dɔŋ Get.
Dɛn a go to di Fawnten Get ɛn di ples we dɛn kɔl Kiŋ's Pul bɔt di rod bin so bad dat mi dɔŋki nɔ bin ebul fɔ waka de. So na nɛt, a pas bay di vali fɔ go inspɛkt di wɔl,
dɔn a yuz di Vali Get fɔ tɔn bak.

Di bigman dɛn nɔ bin no usay ɛn usay a dɔn go ɛn wetin a bin de du, bikɔs, da tɛm de, a nɔ bin tɛl di Ju man dɛn, dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, dɛn aristo dɛn ɔ ɛni bigman ɛn ɛnibɔdi sɛf we gɛt fɔ ɛp du di wok.

We a dɔn dɔn di inspɛkshɔn, a tɛl dɛn se, “Una si di kayn waala we wi de pan: Jerusɛlɛm dɔn pwɛl, kpatakpata, faya dɔn bɔn in get dɛn. Una kam mek wi jɔyn an fɔ bil di wɔl rawnd Jerusɛlɛm bak, mek pipul dɛn lɛf fɔ laf wi.”
A tɛl dɛn bak aw PAPA GƆD dɔn de ɛp mi ɛn wetin ɛn wetin mi ɛn di kiŋ tɔk. Dɛn ansa se, “Mek wi bigin di wok wantɛm.” So dɛn pik zil ɛn bigin du di gud wok.
Bɔt as Sanbalat, Tobaya ɛn Gishɛm we na Arab man, yɛri so bɔt dat dɛn bigin provok dɛn ɛn aks se, “Na wetin una de bil? Na ku una want mek pan di kiŋ ɛ?”

Nain a tɛl dɛn se, “Di GƆD we de ɔp na ɛvin go gi wi viktri. Wi, we nain pikin dɛn go bigin bil bak, una nɔ gɛt biznɛs de bikɔs i nɔ gɛt fɔ bɛnifit una as una nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du wit wetin bi na Jerusɛlɛm.”

Ilaɛlashib, di bigman fɔ ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul dɛn sin, ɛn di ɔda man dɛn we kin mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin jɔyn an fɔ wok. Dɛn bil di Ship Get. Dɛn dɛdiket am. Dɛn put di do dɛn usay dɛn fɔ de ɛn dɛdiket am. Dɛn bil ɛn dɛdiket di wɔl te rich Tawa ɔf di Ɔndrɛd ɛn te rich Ananɛl Tawa.
Di pipul we kɔmɔt Jɛriko bin de bil nɛks to dɛn, dɛn Zakɔ, Imri in bɔypikin bin de nia di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt Jɛriko.
Asɛnaa in pikin dɛn, na dɛn bil di Fish Get bak. Dɛn put ɔl di ebi ebi bod dɛn we dɛn go yuz, fiks di do dɛn, di bolt dɛn ɛn di krɔs ba dɛn.

Nɛks to dɛn na Mɛrimɔth we na Yuraya in bɔypikin ɛn Akɔz na bin in grampa. In bin de wok nain yon sɛkshɔn na di wɔl. Nia am na Mɛshulam, we in papa na Bɛrɛkaya ɛn in grampa na Mɛshɛzabɛl, bin de wok. Nɛks to Mɛshulam na de Zedɔk, Baanain bɔypikin bin de.
Nɛks to Zedɔk, na di pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt Tɛkoa bin de. Di aristo dɛn we kɔmɔt Tɛkoa nɔ bin gri du natin bikɔs dɛn nɔ bin want fɔ tek ɔda frɔm udat dɛn bin de supavays dɛn.
Jɔyada, Pasɛa in bɔypikin ɛn Mɛshulam, Bɛsodeaya in bɔypikin mek Jɛshana Get Bak dɛn put di ebi ebi do dɛn, di bolt dɛn ɛn krɔs di ba dɛn usay dɛn fɔ de.

Nɛks to dɛn nain man dɛn we kɔmɔt Gibiɔn ɛn Mizpa bin de wok. Dɛn na bin man dɛn we na di bigman dɛn na di wɛstɛn say na Riva Yufretis bin de supavays. Mɛlataya kɔmɔt Gibiɔn dɛn Jadɔn in kɔmɔt Mɛrɔnɔth.
Nɛks to dɛn na Uziɛl. Uziɛl na bin Araya in bɔypikin ɛn na bin goldsmit. Afta am nain Ananaya we bin de mek ɛn sɛl pafyum bin de wok. Dɛn ebul bil di wɔl na Jerusɛlɛm bak te rich Brɔd Wɔl.
Ɔ in bɔypikin, Refaya, we de rul af pat na Jerusɛlɛm nain bil di nɛks sɛkshɔn, nia Ananaya bak.
Jɛdaya we na bin Arumaf in bɔypikin jɛs wok pan di ajɔni we de ɔpozit in os. Nɛks to am, na de Atush we na Ashabnia in bɔypikin wok.
Malkija we na Arim in bɔypikin, ɛn Ashɔb we na Paath-Moab in yon bɔypikin na dɛn mek Tawa ɔf di Ovin dɛn bak, we bin de nia usay Refaya bil plɔs wan ɔda sɛkshɔn pan di wɔl.
Shalɔm, we na Aloɛsh in bɔypikin ɛn de rul di ɔda af pat pan Jerusɛlɛm, bil di nɛks sɛkshɔn. Nain gyal pikin dɛn ɛp am wok.

Enɔn ɛn di ɔda pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt Zanoa, na dɛn mek di nɛks sɛkshɔn, we na di Vali Get bak. Dɛn bil am bak ɛn put di do dɛn, di bolt dɛn ɛn di krɔs ba dɛn usay dɛn fɔ de. Dɔn dɛn ɛp mek pat pan di wɔl te rich Dɔŋ Get. Na bin wan tawzin fayv ɔndrɛd fut lɔŋ.
Na Malkija, we na Rekab in bɔypikin mek di Dɔŋ Get bak. Malkija nain bin de rul na Bɛth Akerɛm. I put di do dɛn, di bolt dɛn ɛn di krɔs ba dɛn usay dɛn fɔ de.

Shalɔm we na Kolozɛ in bɔypikin we de rul na Mizpa, nain mek di Fawnten Get bak. I bil am bak, put ruf pan am ɛn fiks di do dɛn, di bolt dɛn ɛn di krɔs ba dɛn usay dɛn fɔ de. Nain mek di wɔl we de rawnd di pul na Siloam we bin de nia di kiŋ in gadin te rich usay di stɛp dɛn de we yu de kɔmɔt na Devid in siti.

Nia am, Nɛimaya we na Azbɔk in bɔypikin we bin de rul af pat pan Bɛth Zɔ distrikt, mek te rich wan pɔynt we de ɔpozit Kiŋ Devid in famili grev te rich di ples we dɛn mek lɛkɛ pul fɔ kip wata ɛn di barik we dɛn bin mek fɔ dɛn tɔf sojaman dɛn.

Nia Nɛimaya, sɔm Livayt dɛn bil da say de pan di wɔl ɛn na Rium we na Bani in bɔypikin bin de supavays dɛn. Dɛn Ashabaya bin de nia dɛn. In bin de supavays di wok fɔseka di distrikt we i kɔmɔt. Ashabaya bin de rul af pat pan Kiila distrikt.
Sɔm ɔda man dɛn we kɔmɔt na di ɔda af pat na Kiila distrikt, usay Binyui in bin de rul, mek di say we de nia usay Ashabaya bin de.
Ɛza, Jɛshwa in bɔypikin, nain bin de nɛks ɛn in bin de wok pan di sɛkshɔn na di wɔl we de ɔpozit usay dɛn bin de kip dɛn wɛpɔn dɛn te go ɔp to usay mek lɛkɛ aŋul.

Afta am, Barak bin de wok. Barak na Zabay in bɔypikin ɛn in bin de wok pan wan ɔda sɛkshɔn we na frɔm di aŋul we Ɛza tap te rich di say na di wɔl we de to Ilaɛlashib in domɔt. Ilaɛlashib na bin bigman fɔ dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
Mɛrimɔth, Yuraya in bɔypikin ɛn Akɔz in grampikin, nain bin de nɛks to am. In bin de wok pan di ɔda sɛkshɔn we bigin na Ilaɛlashib in domɔt te i du di wanol ples usay Ilaɛlashib in os de.
Dɛn man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de na di eria, na dɛn wok nia Mɛrimɔth.
Afta am, Bɛnjamin, Ashɔbɛn, Azaraya we na Maasia in bɔypikin ɛn Anania in grampikin, wok pan di pat na di wɔl we de ɔpozit dɛn os dɛn.
Afta dɛn, Binyui we na Ɛnadad in bɔypikin bil di ɔda sɛkshɔn frɔm Azaraya in os te rich di ɔda aŋul bay di kɔna.

Palal, Uzay in bɔypikin in wok pan di say na di wɔl we de na do frɔm di kiŋ in os nia di kɔmpawnd usay di sikyɔriti de. Nɛks to am na Pɛdaya we na Parɔsh in bɔypikin ɛn dɛn man we bin de wok na PAPA GƆD in os wok de.
Di wokman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os bin tap na Ofɛl Il ɛn dɛn wok te rich di pɔynt we de ɔpozit Wata Get we yu de go na di ist ɛn di tawa we kɔmɔt na do.
Di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Tɛkoa, na dɛn mek di nɛks sɛkshɔn. Da wande na frɔm di wɔndaful tawa we kɔmɔt na do te rich di wɔl na Ofɛl.
Di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin wok frɔm di Ɔs Get te de go ɔp. Dɛn ɔl bin de bil na di sɛkshɔn na di wɔl we de ɔpozit dɛn os dɛn.
Zedɔk, Ima in bɔypikin insɛf bil nɛks to dɛn, na di say we de ɔpozit in os. Shɛmaya, we na Shɛkanaya in bɔypikin ɛn sikyɔriti na di Ist Get insɛf wok pan di wɔl.

Dɔn Ananaya bin de nɛks to am. Ananaya na Shelɛmaya in bɔypikin. In ɛn Anɔn we na Zalaf in nɔmba siks bɔypikin wok na da ɔda sɛkshɔn de. Mɛshulam bin de nɛks ɛn in wok na di say we de ɔpozit usay i bin tap. Mɛshulam na Bɛrɛkaya in bɔypikin.

Nia am na Malkija, wan pan di goldsmit dɛn wok de. In bil di pat pan di wɔl te rich usay di wokman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn treda dɛn os we de ɔpozit di Inspɛkshɔn Get te rich di rum we de bay di kɔna.
Di ɔda goldsmit dɛn ɛn treda dɛn wok frɔm da kɔna de te rich usay dɛn kɔl Ship Get.
We Sanbalat yɛri se wi de bil di wɔl bak, i vɛks bad te in fukfuk ɔl grap dɔn i bigin provok di Ju man dɛn.

Usay ɔl in kɔmpin ɛn di sojaman dɛn we kɔmɔt Sameria de, nain i se “Wetin dɛn daydo Ju man tink se dɛn de du? Dɛn go ebul bil di wɔl bak? Dɛn go ebul mek sakrifays? Dɛn go tek wangren de fɔ dɔn di wok? Dɛn ston de we dɔn bɔn ɛn nyamanyama, wetin dɛn go ebul du wit dɛn?”
Tobaya, da Amonayt man bin de nia am, so in se, “If fɔks sɛf vɛks i go ib di wɔl dɔŋ.”
A pre se, “PAPA GƆD, duya yɛri we dɛn de provok wi. Mek ɔl wetin dɛn se, tɔn bak pan dɛn ɛn mek dɛn kech dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn go na ɔda kɔntri bay fos.
Mek dɛn nɔ go skɔchfri, pɔnish dɛn fɔ di sin we dɛn kɔmit bay aw dɛn de provok yu we dɛn de provok dɛn wan dɛn we de bil.”
So wi bil di wɔl bak te i rich af di ayt we i bin gɛt bikɔs di pipul dɛn bin de wok wit ɔl dɛn at.
Bɔt we Sanbalat, Tobaya, dɛn Arab man dɛn ɛn Amonayt dɛn wit di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Ashdɔd dɛn yɛri se wi kɔntinyu fɔ bil di wɔl bak ɛn lɔk lɔk ɔl usay bin opin, dɛn vɛks bad, bad wan.
Dɛn bigin mek plan fɔ kam togɛda kam atak Jerusɛlɛm, fɛt ɛn kɔz trɔbul.
So wisɛf pre to PAPA GƆD ɛn put sikyɔriti fɔ de de, de ɛn nɛt fɔ brakɛt dɛn.
Da sem tɛm de, di pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt Juda bigin kɔmplen se dɛn nɔ go ebul du di wok bikɔs di dɔti tu bɔku ɛn dɛn dɔn de taya.
Wi ɛnimi dɛnsɛf se, bifo wi de mekɔp, dɛn go dɔn dil wit wi dɔn kil wi ɛn tap di wok
Di Juman dɛn we bin de nia di ɛnimi dɛn kam tɛl wi bɔt sɔm tɛn tɛm se ɛnisay wi tɔn, di ɛnimi dɛn go atak wi.
Dat mek a taytin di sikyɔriti. A put sɔm pipul fɔ de to di say dɛn we lo na di wɔl usay ɛnibɔdi kin si. A put dɛn bay famili ɛn ɔlman bin gɛt in sɔd, spia ɛn bo rɛdi fɔ fɛt.
A sidɔm luk pin nain a tɛl dɛn se, “Una nɔ fred nɔbɔdi. Una mɛmba se PAPA GƆD big ɛn wɔndaful. I gɛt pawa ɛn du fɔ fred so una fɛt fɔ una brɔda, pikin, wɛf ɛn ɔlman na una os dɛn.”
Wɛn wi ɛnimi dɛn no se wi dɔn fent pan dɛn plan ɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn, wi ɔl jɛs go bak ɛn kɔntinyu di wok we wi bin de du na di wɔl.
Frɔm da de de, af mi man dɛn de wok, dɔn di ɔda af dɛn ol sɔd, spia ɛn bo fɔ fɛt ɛn big shild ɛn fɛt klos we sɔd nɔ de pas. Di ɔfisa dɛn bin de biɛn di pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt Juda as dɛn
bin de bil di wɔl. Di man dɛn we bin de tot di difrɛn matirial dɛn bin de wok wit wan an, dɔn dɛn ol dɛn wɛpɔn na di ɔda an.
Dɔn di wan dɛn we bin de bil, wɛr dɛn sɔd pan dɛnsɛf na dɛn sayd dɛn as dɛn de wok. Di man we bin de fɔ blo di trɔmpɛt in kes ɔf eniɔla, in lɛf wit mi.
So a tɛl di aristo dɛn, di ɔfisa dɛn ɛn ɔl di balans pipul se, “Di wok de muv fast, wi de wok ɔlsay na di wɔl na difrɛn difrɛn say we nɔ de nia,
so ɛnitɛm una yɛri di trɔmpɛt, una fɔ go usay di sawnd kɔmɔt. Na PAPA GƆD go fɛt fɔ wi.”
Wi kɔntinyu fɔ wok wit wan af pan di man dɛn wit dɛn spia fɔ fɛt. Dɛn kin ol dɛn spia frɔm do klin na mɔnin te do dak.
Da sem tɛm de a tɛl di wokman dɛn se ɔlman, wɛda yu na bɔs ɔ na ɛp yu de ɛp, fɔ lɛf insay Jerusɛlɛm we nɛt kam so dat dɛn go bi nayt sikyɔriti ɛn du dɛn wok dɛn santɛm.
Misɛf, mi brɔda dɛn ɛn mi yon wokman dɛn ɛn di sikyɔriti dɛn we bin de wit mi nɔ pul klos sɛf da tɛm de. Ivin we dɛn kin go gɛt wata, dɛn de ol dɛn wɛpɔn na dɛn an.
Sɔm pan di man dɛn ɛn dɛn wɛf dɛn bigin grɔmbul bɔt dɛn kɔmpin Juman dɛn.
Sɔm se dɛn ɛn dɛn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn bɔku so dɛn fɔ gi dɛn mɔ it fɔ it fɔ mek dɛn nɔ day.
Sɔm ɔda wan dɛn se dɛn dɔn de sɛl dɛn land, dɛn fam ɛn dɛn os dɛn smɔl smɔl so dat dɛn go ebul bay tin fɔ it we aŋri de na di siti so.
Ɔda sɛt se na lɛnt dɛn lɛnt mɔni fɔ pe taks fɔ dɛn fam dɛn to di kiŋ.

Dɛn se, pan ɔl we na dɛn flɛsh ɛn blɔd ɛn dɛn kɔmpin kɔntriman dɛn pikin nɔ difrɛn frɔm dɛn yon pikin, dɛn stil tek dɛn yon pikin dɛn, bɔbɔ ɛn titi, fɔ mek dɛn fɔ wok lɛkɛ slev. Dɛn se, sɔm pan dɛn gyal pikin dɔn tɔn to prɔpa slev naw ɛn ɔl dis na bikɔs na ɔda pipul dɛn gɛt dɛn fam dɛn naw.
Wɛn a yɛri ɔl wetin dɛn de grɔmbul se, a vɛks bad.

A bigin tink bɔt ɔl wetin dɛn se. Dat mek a go tɔk pan dɛn aristo ɛn dɛn bigman dɛn. A se, “Na tif una de tif una yon yon flɛsh ɛn blɔd so we una de buli dɛn fɔ pe pasmak fɔ it.” Dɔn a kɔl dɛn pan wan big big bare.

We dɛn ɔl kam, a tɛl dɛn se, “Wi dɔn de du ɔl wetin wi ebul fɔ pul ɔl wi Juman fambul we na bin slev to dɛn pegan kɔmɔt de. Bɔt naw una de put di sem waala pan dɛn we dɛn bin de pan, pan ɔl we dɛn na una yon flɛsh ɛn blɔd, dɔn una de mek dɛn bi slev bak to una.” We i dɔn tɔk dɔn, dɛn nɔ se fiŋ bikɔs dɛn nɔ bin gɛt natin fɔ se.
A tɛl dɛn igen se, wetin dɛn de du nɔ fayn. A aks dɛn se if i nɔ bɛtɛ fɔ biev lɛkɛ udat gɛt fred fɔ PAPA GƆD ɛn avɔyd fɔ mek dɛn pegan dɛn laf dɛn.
A tɛl dɛn se misɛf, mi brɔda ɛn mi wokman dɛn dɔn de lɛnt di pipul dɛn mɔni ɛn gi dɛn tin fɔ it, bɔt dat a want dɛn fɔ tap wetin dɛn de du we dɛn de tek pasmak mɔni na di pipul dɛn an.

A tɛl dɛn fɔ gi di pipul dɛn bak wantɛm wantɛm, ɔl wetin dɛn bin dɔn olɔp na dɛn an: dɛn fam dɛn, dɛn greps ɛn ɔliv fam ɛn dɛn os dɛn. A tɛl dɛn igen se dɛn fɔ gi di pipul dɛn ɔl di pasmak mɔni we dɛn dɔn tek na dɛn an fɔ tin fɔ it, fɔ wayn ɛn fɔ ɔyl.
Dɛn ɔl ansa wit wan vɔys se, “Wi go gi dɛn ɔl wetin wi fɔ gi dɛn bak. Wi nɔ go tek ɛnitin na dɛn an igen Wi go du ɔl wetin yu se.”

We dɛn tɔk so, a sɛn kɔl ɔl dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn mek ɔl di aristo ɛn bigman dɛn swɛ se dɛn go du ɔl wetin dɛn prɔmis. A ol di ples we fol fol na mi gawn ɛn shek shek am dɔn a tɛl dɛn se if ɛnibɔdi nɔ kip in prɔmis, na so PAPA GƆD go shek insay in os wit ɔl in prɔpati dɛn. We a tɔk so, ɔl di pipul dɛn se, “Emɛn” ɛn prez PAPA GƆD. Dɛn ɔl du wetin dɛn bin prɔmis.

Wan tin igen, fɔ twɛlv ia naw a dɔn bi gɔvna na Juda, dat na frɔm we kiŋ Atazaksis bin dɔn de rul fɔ twɛnti ia, te naw we i dɔn rul fɔ tati-tu ia. Mi ɛn mi brɔda dɛn nɔ wande it di it we wi fɔ it bikɔs mi na gɔvna.

Bɔt di wan dɛn we na bin gɔvna bifo mi bin de pas am pan di pipul dɛn bad bad wan. Apat frɔm di it ɛn di wayn we dɛn bin de tek, dɛn bin de mek dɛn gi dɛn lɛkɛ wan pawn wet silva. Ivin di man dɛn we na bin dɛn asistant bin de tek advantej pan di pipul dɛn. Bɔt, mi, nɔ biev so bikɔs a de fred PAPA GƆD.
Bifo dat, a put ɔl mi at pan di wok we a bin de du fɔ bil dis wɔl. Ɔl mi wokman dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt natin pas di wok; wi nɔn nɔ bay land sɛf.
Dat nɔ dɔn, wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti, Ju bigman ɛn dɛn trenja we kin kɔmɔt na ɔda kɔntri kam, kin de it to mi.

Ɛvri de na wan man kaw, siks pan di bɛst ship dɛn wit sɔm chikin, nain wi ɔl de it. Dɔn afta ɛvri tɛn de a kin gi dɛn difrɛn difrɛn kayn wayn. Na so dɛn kin bɔku. Pan ɔl dis, a nɔ wande se dɛn fɔ gi mi di it we dɛn dɔn se gɔvna fɔ gɛt bikɔs tin bin dɔn ɔlrɛdi traŋa fɔ di pipul dɛn.
Nɛimaya pre. I se, “PAPA GƆD duya mek bɛtɛ fala mi fɔ ɔl wetin a dɔn du fɔ dɛn pipul ya.”
Sanbalat, Tobaya, Gishɛm da Arabman ɛn ɔl wi ɛnimi dɛn yɛri se a dɔn bil di wɔl dɔn. Dɛn yɛri bak se nɔn ol nɔ lɛf we dɛn nɔ mek na di wɔl bɔt wi nɔ bin ebul fɔ put di do dɛn pan di get yet.
Sanbalat ɛn Gishɛm sɛn kɔl mi. Dɛn se mi fɔ mit dɛn na wan vilej we de na wan pat we flat. Dɛn kɔl am Ono. Bɔt dɛn bin de mek plan bɔt aw fɔ du mi bad.
So a sɛn pipul dɛn fɔ tɛl dɛn se a gɛt wan impɔtant projɛkt we a de du so a nɔ go lɛf am go dɔŋ go mit dɛn. A aks dɛn se, “Wetin du a fɔ lɛf di wok we a de du fɔ go dɔŋ go mit una?”
Fɔ fo difrɛn tɛm, dɛn bin de sɛn di sem sem mɛsej to mi ɛn ɛnitɛm di mɛsej kam, na di sem ansa misɛf de sɛn bak.
Di nɔmba fayv tɛm we Sanbalat sɛn in asistant wit di sem mɛsej i bin ol wan lɛta we nɔ stamp nain an.
Dɛn rayt na dis lɛta se: “Gishɛm se di tɔk we dɛn de tɔk ɔlɔbɔt na tru se yu ɛn dɛn Juman dɛn de plan fɔ mek ku na dat mek una de bil di wɔl. Fɔ ad to dis, dɛn se yu want bi kiŋ ɛn

dɔn pik sɔm pan dɛn man we de tɔk to PAPA GƆD fɔ di pipul dɛn fɔ wirɔn wit yu ɛn ala se yu na kiŋ ɔl rawnd Jerusɛlɛm. Dɛn go se Juda gɛt kiŋ. So if yu nɔ kam mek wi ɛŋ ed fɔ sɛtul dis tin ya di kiŋ go yɛri bɔt dat.”
Misɛf sɛn go tɛl am se na mek i de mek ɔp stori, natin lɛkɛ dat nɔ de apin.
Dɛn bin de tray fɔ skyad wi. Dɛn bin tink se dɛn go ebul fɔ mek wi fɛdɔp ɛn nɔ dɔn di wok we wi bin de du. So a pre mek PAPA GƆD gi mi kɔrej ɛn mɔ trɛnk.

Wande a go to Shɛmaya nain os. Shɛmaya na Dɛlaya in bɔypikin ɛn na Mɛitabɛl in grampikin. We a go mit am as in bin lɔk insay in os, i tɛl mi se mek wi go ayd insay PAPA GƆD in os ɛn lɔk wisɛf insay de bikɔs dɛn de kam fɔ kil mi. I se na nɛt dɛn go kam fɔ kil mi.
Nain a aks am se if man lɛkɛ mi fɔ rɔnawe ɔ rɔn go lɔk misɛf insay PAPA GƆD in os mek a nɔ day. A tɛl am se, “A nɔ go go.”
A bin dɔn kechɔp se nɔto PAPA GƆD sɛn am. I tɔk so bikɔs Tobaya ɛn Sanbalat aya am.
Dɛn bin aya am fɔ skyad mi so dat a go gɛt bad nem fɔ we a sin, dɔn pipul nɔ go tek mi siriɔs igen ɛn a go lɛf wit shem.
Nɛimaya pre. I se, “Mek PAPA GƆD pe Tobaya ɛn Sanbalat fɔ wetin dɛn du. Mek PAPA GƆD pe Noadaya di uman we de tɔk to PAPA GƆD fɔ di pipul dɛn, fɔ we i de tray fɔ skyad mi.”
So wi tek fifti-tu de fɔ dɔn di wɔl. Wi dɔn di wok di twɛnti-fayv de na Ɛlul.
We ɔl wi ɛnimi dɛn yɛri dis, ɔl udat tap na di kɔntri dɛn rawnd Jerusɛlɛm fred. Dɛn giv ɔp bikɔs dɛn kechɔp se na bay PAPA GƆD in pawa mek wi ebul du di wok.
Dɔn igen, da tɛm de di aristo dɛn na Juda bin de sɛn bɔku lɛta to Tobaya ɛn insɛf bin de riplay.

Bɔku pan di pipul dɛn na Juda bin dɔn swɛ se dɛn go de fɔ am sins in na bin Shɛkanaya we na Ara in bɔypikin in sɔnɛnlɔ, ɛn in yon bɔypikin Jɛoanan bin mared Mɛshulam we na Bɛrɛkaya in bɔypikin, in gyal pikin.
Dɛn bin jɛs de tɛl mi bɔt aw i gud, dɔn dɛn kin go tɛl am wetin a se, insɛf bin jɛs de sɛn lɛta pan lɛta to mi fɔ skyad mi.
We wi dɔn bil di wɔl bak ɛn put ɔl di do dɛn usay dɛn fɔ de, wi tɛl di getman dɛn, di wan dɛn we go de siŋ ɛn di Livayt dɛn wetin dɛn fɔ du.

A put Ananaya we na bin kɔmanda fɔ di ples we pɔsin kin rɔn go ayd ɛn mi brɔda we na Anani inchaj ɔf Jerusɛlɛm. Ananaya na man we nɔ gɛt bɛnbɛn, i no wetin i de du ɛn i de fred PAPA GƆD pas bɔku ɔda man dɛn.

A tɛl dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ de opin di men get na Jerusɛlɛm te di san de ɔp. Dɔn igen we di getman dɛn de dyuti dɛn fɔ lɛ dɛn lɔk di do dɛn tayt wan ɛn put di krɔs ba dɛn. A tɛl dɛn igen se dɛn fɔ pik pipul dɛn we tap insay Jerusɛlɛm fɔ bi sikyɔriti. Sɔm pan di sikyɔriti dɛn fɔ de na spɛshal pɔynt dɔn sɔm fɔ de nia dɛn yon os dɛn.
Jerusɛlɛm na bin wan big siti we gɛt opin spes bɔt bɛtɛ pipul nɔ bin tap de ɛn dɛn nɔ bin bigin bil di os dɛn bak yet.

So PAPA GƆD mek a tink se a fɔ kɔl ɔlman - aristo, bigman ɛn di ɔdinari man dɛn fɔ rɛjista dɛn bay famili. A bin ebul fɛn usay dɛn rayt di famili nem dɛn fɔ dɛn fɔs wan we bin kam bak. Dɛn rayt de se,
“Dɛn wan ya na di pipul dɛn we bin de Babilɔn usay kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza bin kech dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn go we kam bak na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda, bɔt ɔlman go nain yon siti usay i bin kɔmɔt.
Di edman dɛn na Zɛrubabɛl, Jɛshwa, Nɛimaya, Azaraya, Raamaya, Naamani, Mɔdikay, Bilshan, Mispɛrɛth, Bigvay, Neɔm ɛn Baana. Na dɛnwanyaso kɔmɔt Izrɛl:
Na Parɔsh in famili layn 2 172
na Shefataya in famili layn 372
na Ara in famili layn 652
na Paath-Moab in famili layn 2 818 (na yaso Jɛshwa ɛn Joab dɛnsɛf kɔmɔt)
na Ilam in famili layn 1 254
na Zatu in famili layn 845
na Zakay in famili layn 760
na Binyui in famili layn 648
na Bibay in famili layn 628
na Azgad in famili layn 2 322
na 667 kɔmɔt na Adɔnikam in famili layn,
na 2 067 kɔmɔt na Bigvay in famili layn,
na 655 kɔmɔt na Adin in famili layn,
na 98 kɔmɔt na Ata in famili layn (na yaso Ɛzikaya insɛf kɔmɔt),
na 328 kɔmɔt na Ashɔm in famili layn,
na 324 kɔmɔt na Bɛzay in famili layn,
na 112 kɔmɔt na Arif in famili layn,
na 95 kɔmɔt na Gibiɔn in famili layn.
Di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Bɛtliɛm ɛn Nɛtofa na 188
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Anatɔt na 128
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Bɛth Azmavɛth na 42
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Kiriath Jiarim, Kɛfira ɛn Biarɔt na 743
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Rama ɛn Giba na 621
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Mikmash na 122
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Bɛthɛl ɛn Ayi na 123
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt na di ɔda Nibo na 52
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt na di ɔda Ilam na 1,254
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Arim na 320
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Jɛriko na 345
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Lɔd, Adid ɛn Ono na 721
di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Sɛna na 3,930.
Di wan dɛn we na bin man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na: na 973 frɔm Jɛdaya in famili layn (dat na frɔm Jɛshwa in jɛnareshɔn),
Na 1,052 frɔm Ima in famili layn,
na 1,247 frɔm Pashɔ in famili layn,
na 1,017 frɔm Arim in famili layn.
Di Livayt dɛn we kɔmɔt na Jɛshwa in famili layn na 74 ɛn na bay Kadmiɛl ɛn Odavaya dɛn kɔmɔt.
Dɛn wan dɛn we de siŋ na Esaf in Jɛnareshɔn na bin dɛn 148.
Di getman dɛn na Shalɔm, Ata, Talmɔn, Akɔb, Atita ɛn Shobay dɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛn ɛn na bin dɛn 138.
Di wokman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os kɔmɔt na dɛn jɛnareshɔn ya
Zia, Asufa, Tabaɔth, Kerɔs, Sia, Padɔn,
Lɛbana, Agaba, Shalmay,
Anan, Gidɛl, Gaa,
Reaya, Rizin, Nɛkoda,
Gazam, Uza, Pasɛa,
Bisay, Meunim, Nɛfusim,
Bakbɔk, Akufa, Aɔ,
Bazlɔth, Mɛida, Asha,
Bakɔs, Sisɛra, Tema,
Nɛzia ɛn Atifa.
Dɛn wan dɛn we na bin Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn in wokman dɛn fambul we tɔn bak go Jerusɛlɛm, na dɛn dis: Sotay, Sofɛrɛt, Pɛrida,
Jaala, Dakɔn, Gidɛl
Shefataya, Atil, Pokɛrɛth Azabaim ɛn Amɔn dɛn jɛnareshɔn.
Ɔl ɛn ɔl, di wokman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn in wokman dɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛn na bin 392.
Dɛn pipul yaso kɔmɔt na dɛn siti ya: Tɛl Mɛla, Tɛl Asha, Kɛrub, Adɔn ɛn Ima bɔt natin nɔ bin de fɔ sho se dɛn fambul dɛn bin kɔmɔt Izrɛl:
Dɛlaya, Tobaya ɛn Nɛkoda dɛn jɛnareshɔn na bin 642.
Oba ya, Akɔz ɛn Bazilay dɛn jɛnareshɔn na bin dɛn wan we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin (Dis Bazilay na bin wan man we mared to da Bazilay we kɔmɔt Giliad in gyal pikin, so insɛf tek di nem Bazilay).
Dɛn nɔ bin ebul fɔ fɛnɔt bɔt dɛn yon famili so dɛn nɔ mek dɛn miks wit dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. Dɛn se dɛn nɔ fit.

So di gɔvna tɛl dɛn se, dɛn nɔ fɔ it pan di sakrifays te wan ɔda man we de sakrifays fɔ pipul sin de, dɛn in go yuz di Yurim ɛn Thumim, dat na di tin dɛn we dɛn go yuz lɛkɛ udat de luk grɔn fɔ no wetin PAPA GƆD se bɔt dɛn.
Di wanol grup na bin 42,360,
wit 7,337 wokman ɛn uman dɛn, 245 man ɛn uman dɛn we de siŋ.
Dɛn kɛr 736 ɔs dɛn, 245 myul
435 kamɛl ɛn 6,720 dɔŋki.
Sɔm pan di big wan dɛn na di famili dɛn gi tiŋs dɛn fɔ ɛp du di wok. Di gɔvna put 1,000 gold kɔpɔ na trɛzhri ɛn gi 50 bol ɛn 530 klos fɔ dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
Sɔm ɔda famili ɛd dɛnsɛf put 20,000 gold kɔpɔ ɛn 2,200 silva kɔpɔ na di trɛzhri fɔ di wok.
Di total we di balans pipul dɛn gi na 20,000 gold kɔpɔ, 2,000 silva kɔpɔ ɛn 67 klos fɔ dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.

Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, di Livayt dɛn, di get kipa dɛn, dɛn wan we de siŋ, wokman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os wit sɔm ɔda pipul ɛn di balans Izrɛlayt dɛn sɛtul dɔŋ na dɛn yon siti dɛn.”

Bay di tɛm we di mɔnt we mek sɛvin de kam ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɔn sɛtul na dɛn difrɛn siti dɛn, ɔl di pipul dɛn gɛda wan ples, lɛkɛ wan pɔsin, na di bare we de bifo di Wata Get. Dɛn tɛl Ɛzra, di Ju Lɔ ticha fɔ pul di buk we dɛn rayt di lɔ we PAPA GƆD gi Mɔzis fɔ Izrɛl kɔmɔt na do.
So Ɛzra briŋ di buk we di lɔ rayt kam na do to di pipul dɛn, di fɔs de na di mɔnt we mek sɛvin. Man dɛn, uman dɛn ɛn ɔl udat we ebul fɔ ɔndastand wetin Ɛzra de rid bin de de.

I rid lawd lawd wan na di bare frɔm do klin te santɛm bifo di Wata Get usay di man dɛn, di uman dɛn ɛn ɔl udat kin ɔndastand de. Na so ɔlman we de de, de pe atɛnshɔn to wetin rayt insay di buk we di lɔ rayt.

Ɛzra, bin tinap na wan ay stej we dɛn bil spɛshali fɔ da biznɛs de. Matitaya, Shema, Anaya, Yuraya, Ilkaya, ɛn Maasia bin tinap nia am nain raytan; dɔn Pɛdaya, Mishaɛl, Milkaja, Ashɔm, Ashbanada, Zɛkaraya ɛn Mɛshulam dɛn tinap nia am nain lɛfan.
Ɛzra opin di buk. Ɔlman yay bin de pan am bikɔs di stej bin ay, so as i opin am, dɛn ɔl tinap.
Ɛzra prez PAPA GƆD, di big big PAPA GƆD; dɔn ɔl di pipul dɛn es dɛn an ɔp ɛn ansa ‘Emɛn! Emɛn!’ Dɛn ɔl butu ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD wit dɛn fes na grɔn.
Jɛshwa, Bani, Sherɛbaya, Jamin, Akɔb, Shabetay, Odaya, Maasia, Kɛlita, Azaraya, Jozabad, Anan ɛn Pɛlalay we na Livayt dɛn, bin de go rawnd fɔ ɛksplen di lɔ to di pipul dɛn we bin tinap de.
Dɛn bin de rid frɔm di buk we PAPA GƆD in lɔ rayt ɛn ɛksplen di minin so dat di pipul dɛn go ɔndastand wetin dɛn de rid.

Di gɔvna, Nɛimaya ɛn Ɛzra, we na di Ju Lɔ ticha ɛn na wan pan di man dɛn we kin mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn bin de ɛksplen tɛl di pipul mek dɛn nɔ fil bad. Dɛn bin wan kray we dɛn yɛri wetin di lɔ se. Dɛn tɛl di pipul dɛn se, “Tide na de we Oli to PAPA GƆD, wi GƆD. Una nɔ fɔ fil bad ɛn kray.”

Nɛimaya tɛl dɛn fɔ go om ɛn it fayn tin. I se dɛn fɔ ɛnjɔy spɛshal it ɛn swit drink. I se fɔ sɛn sɔm pan di it go gi ɔda pɔsin we nɔ gɛt natin. I tɛl dɛn se da de de na de we dɛn nɔ fɔ sɔri. Na de we oli to PAPA GƆD ɛn na PAPA GƆD de mek dɛn gladi ɛn gi dɛn trɛnk.
Di Livayt dɛnsɛf ɛp fɔ koks di pipul dɛn. Dɛn tɛl di pipul se dɛn nɔ fɔ wɔri ɔ sɔri bikɔs da de de na Oli de to PAPA GƆD.
So di pipul dɛn skata go fɛn gud it fɔ it ɛn drink ɛn ivin sɛn sɔm go gi udat nɔ gɛt. Dɛn ɔl gladi ɛn sɛlibret bikɔs bay da tɛm de dɛn bin dɔn ebul fɔ ɔndastand ɔl wetin dɛn bin de tɛl dɛn.

Di nɛks de, dat na di sɛkɛn de, na da sem mɔnt de, ɔl di big wan dɛn na di famili dɛn wit dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn dɛn Livayt dɛn gɛda to Ɛzra fɔ stɔdi wetin rayt na di lɔ, gud gud wan.
Dɛn fɛnɔt se, dɛn rayt na di lɔ we PAPA GƆD gi Mozis se, di tɛm fɔ da fɛstival we dɛn kin de mek na di mɔnt we mek sɛvin, ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ go tap na kamp,

ɛn dɛn sɛn wɔd go rawnd na ɔl di siti dɛn ɛn na Jerusɛlɛm se ɔlman fɔ go ɔp di il na bush go kɔt tik. Dɛn se dɛn fɔ briŋ am kam so dat dɛn go mek kamp, lɛkɛ aw i rayt na di lɔ. Dɛn se di pipul dɛn fɔ kɔt difrɛn kayn tik dɛn lɛkɛ ɔliv tik, wayl ɔliv tik, matul tik we gɛt chukchuk, pam tik ɛn dɛn tik dɛn we dɛn kin yuz fɔ shed.

So di pipul dɛn go fɛn di tik dɛn, briŋ dɛn kam ɛn mek kamp pantap dɛn ruf, na dɛn os in kɔmpawnd, na di kɔmpawnd na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn na di bare we de nia di Wata Get. Dɔn dɛn bil wan bay di Ifrem Get.
Di wanol grup we bin kam bak mek kamp ɛn tap de. Frɔm we Jɔshwa, Nɔn in bɔypikin day. Di Izrɛlayt dɛn nɔ bin ebul fɔ sɛlibret dis fɛstival lɛkɛ so. Dɛn ɛnjɔy am bad bad wan ɛn na so dɛn gladi.
Dɛn sɛlibret di fɛstival fɔ sɛvin de ɛn frɔm de wan te de sɛvin, Ɛzra bin de rid wetin rayt insay di buk we PAPA GƆD in lɔ rayt. Dɔn, dɛn ɔl gɛda wan ples, di de we mek et, fɔ go wit wetin di lɔ se.
Di de we mek twɛnti-fo, na di sem mɔnt, di pipul dɛn gɛda bak. Dis tɛm, dɛn bin de fast ɛn wɛr saklɔth ɛn kɔba dɛnsɛf wit dɔst.
Di wan dɛn we dɛn na bɔn Izrɛlayt sɛpret dɛnsɛf frɔm di ɔda wan dɛn. Dɛn tinap usay dɛn bin de ɛn kɔnfɛs dɛn sin ɛn di sin dɛn we dɛn pipul bin dɔn kɔmit.
Dɛn tinap fɔ tri awa we Ɛzra bin de rid na di buk we PAPA GƆD dɛn GƆD in lɔ rayt. Di ɔda tri awa dɛn yuz am fɔ kɔnfɛs ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD dɛn GƆD.
Di Livayt dɛn, Jɛshwa, Bani, Kadmiɛl, Shibanaya, Buni, Sherɛbaya, Bani ɛn Kɛnani bin tinap na di stɛp ɛn pre lawd wan to PAPA GƆD dɛn GƆD.

Di Livayt dɛn we na Jɛshwa, Kadmiɛl, Bani, Ashabnia, Sherɛbaya, Odaya, Shibanaya ɛn Pɛtaya se mek ɔlman tinap ɛn prez PAPA GƆD, di GƆD we go de sote go. Dɛn se, “Mek wi blɛs PAPA GƆD in nem. Di nem we pas ɔl ɔda nem we wi kin prez.

PAPA GƆD, na yu waŋren na GƆD. Yu mek di ɛvin, ivin insay insay di ɛvin ɛn ɔl di sta dɛn, di wɔl ɛn ɔl wetin de insay am, di si dɛn ɛn ɔl wetin de insay dɛn. Na yu gi layf to ɔltin ɛn di bɔku bɔku tin dɛn na ɛvin de wɔship yu.
Yu na PAPA GƆD di GƆD we pik Ebram, pul am kɔmɔt na Ɔ usay dɛn kiŋ in advaysa dɛn dɛn de ɛn gi am nem Ebraam.

Yu fɛnɔt se i tret wit yu so yu mek Kɔvinant wit am se yu go gi di land we di Kenanayt, di Itayt, di Amɔrayt, di Pɛrizayt, di Jɛbyusayt ɛn di Gagashayt dɛn de to in jɛnareshɔn. Yu dɔn de kip yu prɔmis bikɔs yu nɔ miks pan bɛnbɛn.
“Yu bin si di sɔfa we wi pipul dɛn bifo wi, sɔfa na Ijipt; yu yɛri we dɛn de ala midul di Rɛd Si.
We yu no se di Kiŋ, in ɔfisa dɛn ɛn ɔl in pipul dɛn na Ijipt de trit dɛn bad yu ple wɔnda ɛn ple mirekul pan dɛn. Yu mek nem fɔ yusɛf we de te tide.

We dɛn wan pas bay di Rɛd Si, yu sheb di wata midul so dat dɛn kin waka na dray land dɔn yu kɔba di wata bak pan dɛn Ijipshian dɛn we bin de rɔnata dɛn. Di wata swɛla dɛn lɛkɛ se dɛn na big big ston dɛn we dɛn ib midul wata.
Yu kin apia lɛkɛ klawd fɔ lid dɛn de tɛm ɛn lɛkɛ faya fɔ sho usay dɛn fɔ go we nɛt kam.
Yu kɔmɔt na ɛvin kam dɔŋ na Mawnt Saynay kam tɔk to dɛn. Yu gi dɛn lɔ ɛn kɔmand dɛn we gud ɛn dɛn nɔ pashal.
Yu tɛl dɛn bɔt di de we yu mek oli ɛn spɛshal ɛn gi di lɔ dɛn to yu pikin Mozis fɔ dɛn.
“We dɛn aŋri, yu sɛn bred kɔmɔt na ɛvin fɔ dɛn ɛn we dɛn tɔsti, yu mek wata kɔmɔt na rɔk fɔ dɛn fɔ drink; yu tɛl dɛn se mek dɛn go insay ɛn tek kɔntrol na di land we yu bin dɔn swɛ se yu go gi dɛn.
Bɔt usay, wi fɔstɛm pipul dɛn bin ambɔgin ɛn traŋayes so dɛn nɔ obe di kɔmand we yu gi dɛn.

Dɛn nɔ gri fɔ yɛri wɔd, dɛn fɔgɛt bɔt di mirekul dɛn we yu ple fɔ dɛn. Dɛn bin so traŋayes dat dɛn fɛn rebɛl lida fɔ kɛr dɛn go bak go bi slev usay dɛn kɔmɔt. Bɔt yu na PAPA GƆD we gɛt sɔri at; Yu gud ɛn rɛdi fɔ fɔgiv. Yu nɔ gɛt shɔtat ɛn di lɛk we yu kin lɛk pɔsin kin tumɔs. Dat mek yu nɔ jɛs lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf.
Ivin we dɛn mek kaw pikin ɛn tɛl dɛnsɛf se nain na di gɔd we pul dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt ɔ wɛn dɛn kin du ɔlkayn bad ɛn tɔk bad bɔt yu.

Bikɔs yu gɛt sɔm kayn bad bad sɔri at, yu nɔ jɛs lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf di tɛm we dɛn de na di di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap. Yu nɔ giv ɔp pan dɛn. Ɛvride yu bin de yuz klawd fɔ gayd dɛn de tɛm ɛn faya fɔ gayd dɛn fɔ sho dɛn rod we nɛt kam.
Yu gɛt klin at fɔ dɛn so yu bin de tɛl dɛn wetin fɔ du ɔltɛm. Yu nɔ se yu nɔ go sɛn mana, di bred we dɛn bin de it frɔm ɛvin, ɛn yu nɔ go gi dɛn wata fɔ drink we dɛn tɔsti.
Yu luk afta dɛn fɔ di foti ia we dɛn de na di ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap; natin nɔ de we dɛn want, we dɛn nɔ gɛt; dɛn klos nɔ pwɛl ɛn dɛn fut nɔ swɛl.
“Yu gi dɛn ɔl dɛn kɔntri ɛn kindɔm dɛn ɛn mek dɛn fɔ de na ivin dɛn kɔna kɔna dɛn. Dɛn ebul fɔ tek Ɛshbɔn, Kiŋ Sayɔn, in kɔntri ɛn Beshan, Kiŋ Ɔg, yon kɔntri na dɛn an.
Yu mek dɛn bɔypikin dɛn fɔ bɔku lɛkɛ sta dɛn ɔp klawd ɛn briŋ dɛn kam na di land we yu bin dɔn tɛl dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn se, yu go gi dɛn fɔ bi dɛn yon.

Dɛn bɔypikin dɛnsɛf go insay go tek kɔntrol ɔf di land. Yu lili di Kenanayt dɛn we bin tap na di land bifo dɛn, yu an ova di Kenanayt wit dɛn Kiŋ dɛn ɛn di pipul dɛn we bin tap na di land, gi dɛn fɔ du wetin dɛn want.

Dɛn siz siti dɛn we gɛt tɔf sikyɔriti ɛn rich land dɛn; dɛn tek ova os dɛn we ful wit ɔlkayn gud tin, wɛl dɛn we dɛn dɔn dig, fam dɛn we kin pul wayn frɔm di greps, tik dɛn wit ɔliv ɛn ɔda frut de wɔp. Dɛn it te dɛn bɛlful. Dɛn it gud it dɛn we mek dɛn bɔdi fayn so dɛn bin jɛs de ɛnjɔy dɛnsɛf wit yu blɛsin.

“Bɔt dɛn nɔ bin de du wetin yu want ɛn dɛn tɔn rebɛl pan yu; dɛn nɔ bin bisin bɔt wetin yu lɔ se. Dɛn kil yu prɔfɛt dɛn we bin de tɛl dɛn wetin yu want, we bin de advays dɛn fɔ mek dɛn tek yu siriɔs. Dɛn tɔk bɔku bad bad tin dɛn bɔt yu.

So yusɛf an dɛn ova to dɛn ɛnimi mek dɛn pas am pan dɛn smɔl bit. Bɔt we dɛn ɛnimi dɛn pasmak dɛn bigin beg yu. Yu yɛri dɛn na ɛvin ɛn tek beg ɛn bikɔs yu na PAPA GƆD we gɛt sɔri at bad bad wan, yu sɛn pipul dɛn we go pul dɛn na dɛn ɛnimi dɛn an.

Bɔt as dɛn fil se dɛn dɔn fri, dɛn bigin du di sem tin dɛn we yu nɔ want bak. Yusɛf lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn rul dɛn. Bɔt wɛn dɛn kin taya dɛn kin beg yu dɔn yusɛf go tek beg na ɛvin ɛn bikɔs ɔf yu sɔri at, yu kin pul dɛn na dɛn ɛnimi dɛn an ɛvritɛm we dɛn ɛnimi atak dɛn.

Yu wɔn dɛn mek dɛn go bak ɛn du wetin de na di lɔ we yu gi dɛn, bɔt usay, dɛn traŋayes ɛn nɔ gri fɔ du wetin yu se. Dɛn sin ɛn nɔ gri biev lɛkɛ aw yu se. Yu se if mɔtalman biev lɛkɛ aw yu want, i go gɛt lɔŋ layf. Dɛn bin de mek traŋa at pan yu so dɛn nɔ ivin lisin we yu de tɔk to dɛn.
Yu peshɛnt wit dɛn fɔ lɔŋ. Wit yu klin at yu bin de yuz di prɔfɛt dɛn fɔ advays dɛn. Pan ɔl dat, dɛn nɔ yɛri wɔd, so yu an dɛn bak to di neba kɔntri dɛn.
Bɔt yu nɔ kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn ɔ lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf, bikɔs yu na gud PAPA GƆD ɛn yu de sho masi ɔltɛm.

“PAPA GƆD, yu na big big GƆD ɛn yu du fɔ fred. Yu na GƆD we de kip yu Kɔvinant wit wi ɛn yu nɔ de chenj yu lɔv fɔ wi. Nɔ mek lɛkɛ se di sɔfa we wi de sɔfa so nɔ min natin to yu. Dis sɔfa ya we wi Kiŋ ɛn bigman dɛn, dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ wi sin dɛn, di prɔfɛt dɛn we na wi midul man dɛn to yu, wi papa dɛn ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn de sɔfa bin dɔn de frɔm dɛn Asiria Kiŋ dɛn tɛm te tide.
Ɔl wetin dɔn apin to wi bin rayt bikɔs yu bin dɔn fethful to wi wayls wi de du rɔŋ ɛn yu na pɔsin we de gi wi wetindu fɔ wi.
Wi kiŋ dɛn, wi bigman dɛn, dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ wi sin dɛn, wi papa dɛn ɔl nɔ obe yu lɔ. Dɛn nɔn nɔ bin bisin bɔt yu kɔmand ɔ di wɔn we yu bin de wɔn dɛn.
Di tɛm dɛnsɛf we dɛn bin gɛt dɛn yon kiŋ, ɛn de ɛnjɔy yu blɛsin na di big, fri ɛn gud land we yu gi dɛn, dɛn nɔ bin bisin bɔt yu. Dɛn lɛf fɔ sav yu ɛn nɔ lɛf di bad bad tin dɛn we dɛn bin de du.
Luk naw, wi na lɛkɛ slev. Wi na lɛkɛ slev na di land we yu bin dɔn gi wi fɔstɛm pipul dɛn fɔ it in frut ɛn ɛnjɔy ɔlkayn gud tin we kɔmɔt de.
Na we wi sin mek ɔl di bɔku bɔku avɛst we wi de gɛt de go to di kiŋ dɛn we de oba wi fɔ rul wi. Dɛn ivin de rul wi bɔdi ɛn wi animal dɛn we wi de mɛn lɛkɛ aw dɛn want. Na siriɔs trɔbul wi de pan so.”
“Wit ɔl wetin dɔn bi, wi de mek pepa fɔ sho se wi gri ɛn wi bigman dɛn, wi Livayt dɛn ɛn dɛn man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ wi sin dɛn ɔl go put dɛn stamp dɛn na di pepa.”
Nɛimaya, we na gɔvna ɛn na Akalaya in bɔypikin, stamp di pepa. Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we stamp am na Zɛdikaya,
Seraya, Azaraya, Jɛrimaya,
Pashɔ, Amaraya, Malkija
Atush, Shibanaya, Malɔk,
Arim, Mɛrimɔth, Obadaya,
Daniɛl, Ginɛthɔn, Barak,
Mɛshulam, Abija, Mijamin,
Maazia, Bilgay ɛn Shɛmaya.
Di Livayt dɛn we stamp am na: Jɛshwa we na Azania in bɔypikin, Binyui wan pan Ɛnadad in bɔypikin dɛn, Kadmiɛl,
ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we de wok wit dɛn: Shibanaya, Odaya, Kɛkita, Pɛlaya, Anan,
Mika, Reɔb, Ashabia,
Zakɔ, Sherɛbaya, Shɛrɛbaya,
Odaya, Bani ɛn Bɛninu.
Di pipul dɛn lida dɛn we stamp am na: Parɔsh, Paath-Moab, Ilam, Zatu, Bani,
Buni, Azgad, Bibay,
Adonayja, Bigvay, Adin,
Ata, Ɛzikaya, Ezɔ,
Odaya, Ashɔm, Bizay,
Arif, Anatɔt, Nibay,
Magpiash, Mɛshulam, Ɛzir,
Mɛshɛzabɛl, Zedɔk, Jadwa,
Pɛlataya, Anan, Anaya,
Oshia, Ananaya, Ashɔb,
Aloɛsh, Pila, Shobɛk,
Rium, Ashabna, Maasia,
Aya, Anan, Enan,
Malɔk, Arim ɛn Baana

Di balans pipul dɛn, dat na sɔm pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn, sɔm Livayt dɛn, di getman dɛn, dɛn wan dɛn we de siŋ, dɛn wokman na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn ɔl udat bin sɛpret dɛnsɛf frɔm di fɔrina dɛn bikɔs ɔf wetin PAPA GƆD in lɔ se, dɛn wɛf ɛn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn, we ebul ɔndastand,

ɔl jɔyn dɛn aristo. Dɔn dɛn ɔl tay dɛnsɛf ɛn se swɛ go de pan dɛn if dɛn nɔ fala wetin PAPA GƆD in lɔ, we i bin gi in savant Mozis, se. Dɛn se dɛn go mek shɔ se dɛn go biev aw dɛn fɔ biev ɛn du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd dɔn se na da lɔ de.
Dɛn se, “Wi prɔmis se, wi nɔ go lɛ wi gyal pikin dɛn mared to fɔrina ɛn wi nɔ go mek wi bɔypikin dɛnsɛf mared fɔrin uman dɛn.

“Wɛn dɛn treda frɔm ɔda kɔntri briŋ tin fɔ sɛl di de we mek sɛvin we na blo, wi nɔ go bay bikɔs na de de wi fɔ blo ɛn nɔ du natin. If ivin dɛn kam ɛni ɔda de we wi se na oli de, wi nɔ go bay. We wi dɔn wok na wi fam dɛn fɔ siks ia wi nɔ go wok de fɔ ɛni ia we mek sɛvin. Da ia de wi go lɛf ɔl udat o wi.
“Wi de prɔmis se wi go du ɔl wetin yu ɔda wi fɔ du, dat na fɔ mek wi gi smɔl tin lɛkɛ wan pat pam tri shɛkɛl ɛvri ia to PAPA GƆD in os,

dis go mek bred de na di tebul; dɛn go ebul mek dɛn sakrifays we dɛn de pul gren ɛn dɛn sakrifays we na fɔ bɔn, fɔ dɛn sakrifays we dɛn kin mek di de we mek sɛvin we na fɔ blo, di Nyu Mun Fɛstival ɛn dɛn ɔda de dɛn we dɛn dɔn pik, fɔ dɛn sin sakrifays we na fɔ beg fɔ Izrɛl ɛn fɔ ɔl di ɔda tin dɛn we dɛn go gɛt fɔ de du na PAPA GƆD in os.

“Wi, di man dɛn we kin mek sakrifays fɔ di pipul dɛn sin, di Livayt dɛn ɛn ɔl di ɔda pipul dɛn, dɔn balɔt fɔ no ustɛm di difrɛn difrɛn famili go briŋ wud, as dɛn yon kɔntribyushɔn, na wan patikla tɛm insay di ia we go de bɔn na PAPA GƆD in ɔlta lɛkɛ aw i rayt na di lɔ.
“Wi de tinap bak se, wi go de briŋ ɛvri ia, di vɛri fɔs tin we wi de avɛst pan di tin dɛn we wi plant ɛn pan ɔl dɛn tik we de bia frut kam na PAPA GƆD in os.

“As dɛn rayt na PAPA GƆD in lɔ bak, wi go mɔs briŋ di fɔs-bɔy-pikin ɛn di fɔs wan pan wi ship, got, kaw ɛn ɔda animal dɛn we wi de mɛn, kam na PAPA GƆD in os fɔ gi PAPA GƆD fɔ di man dɛn we go de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.

“Pantap dat, we go kip sɔm tin dɛn na di sto we de na PAPA GƆD in os. Wi go briŋ flawa, sɔm gren fɔ ɔfrin, frut dɛn we kɔmɔt pan ɔl dɛn tik, nyu wayn ɛn ɔyl. Wi go de gi wi tayth pan di tin dɛn we wi plant to di Livayt dɛn as na dɛn rɛspɔnsibul fɔ gɛda am no ɔl di siti dɛn we wi de wok.”

Wan pan dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, we kɔmɔt na Erɔn in famili layn gɛt fɔ de wit di Livayt dɛn we dɛn de tek di tayth dɛn. Di Livayt dɛnsɛf fɔ gi wan pat pan tɛn pat pan di tayth we dɛn gɛda fɔ kip na di sto, na di trɛzhri, na PAPA GƆD in os.

Ɔl di Izrɛlayt dɛn wit di Livayt dɛnsɛf miks fɔ briŋ ɔl wetin dɛn de kɔntribyut, dat na gren, nyu wayn ɛn ɔyl, kam kip am na di sto usay dɛn kip dɛn ɔda tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn usay di man dɛn we na dɛn tɔn fɔ mek sakrifays, di getman dɛn ɛn dɛn wan we di siŋ de. “Wi nɔ go fɔgɛt bɔt PAPA GƆD in os.”
Di bigman dɛn sɛtul na Jerusɛlɛm dɔn di balans pipul dɛn aks PAPA GƆD fɔ sho dɛn us famili pan ɛvri tɛn famili fɔ tap insay Jerusɛlɛm, di oli siti, wayls di ɔda nayn fɔ go tap na dɛn yon siti dɛn.
Di pipul dɛn pre fɔ lɛ PAPA GƆD blɛs ɔl di man dɛn we dɛn nɔ fos fɔ tap na Jerusɛlɛm bɔt dɛn disayd fɔ tap na Jerusɛlɛm bay dɛn yon fri wil.

Na di pipul dɛn dis we na bin bigman lɛkɛ D.O. na dɛn ɔplayn we dɛn sɛtul na Jerusɛlɛm. Sɔm ɔdinari pipul, sɔm man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, sɔm Livayt, sɔm wokman na PAPA GƆD in os, sɔm pan Sɔlɔmɔn in wokman dɛn jɛnareshɔn we bin tap na di siti dɛn na Juda, ɔlman go nain yon prɔpati na di difrɛn siti dɛn

we ɔda pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt to Juda ɛn Bɛnjamin fambul dɛn tap insay Jerusɛlɛm. Di wan dɛn we na Juda in jɛnareshɔn: Athaya we na Uzaya in bɔypikin, Uzaya na Zɛkaraya in bɔypikin, Zɛkaraya na Amaraya in bɔypikin, Amaraya na Shefataya in bɔypikin we na Maalalɛl in yon bɔypikin ɛn in na wan pan Pɛrɛz in yon jɛnareshɔn.

Dɛn Maasia we na Barak in bɔypikin, Barak na Kol Ozɛ in bɔypikin, Kol Ozɛ na Aazaya in bɔypikin, Aazaya na Adaya in bɔypikin, Adaya na Jɔyarib in bɔypikin we na Zɛkaraya, wan pan Shila in jɛnareshɔn in yon bɔypikin.
Pɛrɛz in jɛnareshɔn we bin tap insay Jerusɛlɛm, ɔl ɛn ɔl na bin fo ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti-et man dɛn we gɛt maynd.

Di wan dɛn we na Bɛnjamin in jɛnareshɔn: Salu we na Mɛshulam in bɔypikin, Mɛshulam na Joɛd in bɔypikin, Joɛd na Pɛdaya in bɔypikin, Pɛdaya na Kolaya in bɔypikin, Kodaya na Maasia in bɔypikin, Maasia na Ithiɛl in bɔypikin, Ithiɛl na bin Jɛshaya in bɔypikin.
