Salu bin gɛt pipul dɛn we bin de biɛn am. Dɛn na Gabay ɛn Salay ɛn nayn ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti-et ɔda man dɛn.
Joɛl we na Zikray in bɔypikin, nain na bin dɛn agbagba dɛn Juda we Asɛnwa in yon bɔypikin bin de inchaj ɔf di wanol sɛkɛn distrikt na di siti.
Di wan dɛn we na bin sɔm pan dɛn man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin: Jɛdaya; Jɔyarib in bɔypikin; Jakin;
Seraya we na Ilkaya in bɔypikin ɛn Ilkaya in na bin Mɛshulam in bɔypikin we na bin Zedɔk in yon bɔypikin we in papa na bin Mɛrayɔth, Ayitɔb in bɔypikin. Ayitɔb na bin supavaysɔ na PAPA GƆD in os.

Dɛn ɛn dɛn wan we bin de nia dɛn fɔ wok na PAPA GƆD in os na et ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti tu man dɛn, ɔl ɛn ɔl; Adaya we na Jɛroam in bɔypikin ɛn Jɛroam in na bin Pɛlalay in bɔypikin we na bin Amzi in yon bɔypikin we in papa na bin Zɛkaraya, we na Pashɔ in bɔypikin dɛn, Pashɔ in yon papa na bin Malkija,

ɛn in yon pipul dɛn we bin de nia am. Dɛn pipul de na bin di big wan dɛn na dɛn famili dɛn. Dat na tu ɔndrɛd ɛn foti-tu man dɛn; Amashay we na Azarɛl in bɔypikin, Azarɛl na bin Mɛshilɛmɔth in bɔypikin we na bin Ima in yon bɔypikin,
ɛn in yon man dɛn we bin de nia am. Dɛn na bin man dɛn we gɛt maynd ɛn na bin dɛn wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti-et. Dɛn yon agbagba na Zabdiɛl we na Agedolim in bɔypikin.
Dɛn wan dɛn we na Livay in jɛnareshɔn: Shɛmaya na Ashɔb in bɔypikin, ɛn Ashɔb na bin Azrikam in bɔypikin we Ashabaya nain papa ɛn Buni nain grampa.
Shabetay ɛn Jozabad, na bin tu pan di Livayt edman dɛn, we bin de inchaj ɔf di wok we dɛn bin de du na do na PAPA GƆD in os;

Matanaya na Mika in bɔypikin ɛn Mika na Zabdi in bɔypikin we Esaf nain papa. Esaf na di dayrɛktɔ we kin lid dɛn tɛm fɔ pre ɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki Bakbukaya, di man we de sɛkɛn pan di man dɛn we de nia am; Abda we na Shamua in bɔypikin ɛn Galal in grampikin Galal in papa na Jɛduthɔn,
Di Livayt dɛn we bin di na di oli siti na tu ɔndrɛd ɛn eti-fo, ɔl ɛn ɔl.
Dɛn wan we na getman dɛn na: Akɔb, Talmɔn ɛn di man dɛn we de nia dɛn we bin de wach di get lɛkɛ sikyɔriti na bin dɛn wan ɔndrɛd ɛn sɛvinti-tu.
Sɔm pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn sɔm Livayt bin tap na di siti dɛn na Juda wit ɔda Izrɛlayt dɛn, ɛn dɛn ɔl bin go na dɛn yon prɔpati.
Di wokman dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os dɛn tap na di il na Ofɛl. Na Zia ɛn Gishpa bin de inchaj ɔf dɛn.

Di Livayt dɛn agbagba we bin de insay Jerusɛlɛm na Uzi we na Bani in bɔypikin. Bani na bin Ashabaya in bɔypikin ɛn Matanaya in grampikin. Matanaya in na bin Mika in bɔypikin. Uzi na wan pan Esaf in jɛnareshɔn dɛn we fɔ de siŋ ɛn na dɛn rɛspɔnsibul fɔ di myuzik na PAPA GƆD in os.
Di man dɛn we bin de siŋ bin de tek ɔda frɔm di kiŋ we bin de tɛl dɛn wetin fɔ du ɛvride.
Pɛtaya we na Mɛshizabɛl in bɔypikin na wan pan Zɛra we na Juda in bɔypikin in jɛnareshɔn. Nain na bin di pɔsin we bin de tɔk fɔ di kiŋ pan ɔltin we gɛt fɔ du wit di pipul dɛn.
We i kam pan di vilej wit dɛn fam dɛn, sɔm pan di pipul dɛn na Juda tap na Kiriath Aba ɛn di eria, na Dibɔn ɛn in eria, na Jɛkabziɛl ɛn in vilej dɛn,
na Jɛshwa, na Molada, na Bɛth Pelɛt,
na Aza Shual, na Biashiba ɛn in eria,
na Ziklag, na Mɛkona ɛn in eria,
na Ɛn Rimɔn, na Zora, na Jamɔth,
Zanoa, Adulam ɛn dɛn vilej dɛn na Lakish ɛn in fam dɛn, ɛn na Azika ɛn in eria. So dɛn bin tap ɔlsay frɔm Biashiba te rich di Inɔm vali.
Bɛnjamin in jɛnareshɔn dɛn we kɔmɔt Giba bin tap na Mikmash, Aija, Bɛthɛl ɛn in eria,
na Anatɔt, Nɔb, Anania,
na Ezɔ, Rama ɛn Gitaim,
na Adid, Zɛboim ɛn Nibalat,
na Lɔd ɛn Ono ɛn na di vali usay dɛn at-man dɛn de.
Sɔm pan di Livayt dɛn we kɔmɔt Juda bin tap usay Bɛnjamin in fambul dɛn bin de.
Dis na di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn dɛn Livayt we tɔn bak wit Zɛrubabɛl we na Oyialtiɛl in bɔypikin ɛn wit Jɛshwa: Seraya, Jɛrimaya, Ɛzra,
Amaraya, Malɔk, Atush,
Shɛkanaya, Rium, Mɛrimɔth,
Ido, Ginɛthɔn, Abija,
Mijamin, Maadaya, Bilga,
Shɛmaya, Jɔyarib, Jɛdaya,
Salu, Amɔk, Ilkaya ɛn Jɛdaya. Dɛn na bin di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn lida dɛn ɛn dɛn wan we bin de wok nia dɛn Jɛshwa, in yon tɛm.
Di Livayt dɛn na Jɛshwa, Binyui, Kadmiɛl, Shɛrɛbaya, Juda ɛn Matanaya sɛf we in ɛn in yon pipul dɛn we bin de nia am, bin de inchaj ɔf di siŋ dɛn we dɛn de siŋ fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki.
Bakbukaya ɛn Yuni dɛn wan dɛn we bin de nia dɛn tinap ɔpozit dɛn we dɛn de du dɛn wok.
Jɛshwa na Jɔyakim in papa, Jɔyakim na Ilaɛlashib in papa, Ilaɛlashib na Jɔyada in papa,
Jɔyada na Jonɛtan in papa dɔn Jonɛtan in na Jadwa in papa

Dyurin Jɔyakim in tɛm, na dɛn pipul ya bin de ɛd dɛn famili ya we na dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn famili dɛn: na Seraya in famili, yu gɛt Mɛraya as ɛd; na Jɛrimaya in famili, yu gɛt Ananaya as ɛd;
na Ɛzra in famili, yu gɛt Mɛshulam as ɛd; na Amaraya in famili, yu gɛt Jɛoanan as ɛd;
na Malɔk in famili, yu gɛt Jonɛtan as ɛd; na Shɛkanaya in famili, yu gɛt Josɛf as ɛd;
na Arim in famili, yu gɛt Adna as ɛd; na Mɛrimɔth in famili, yu gɛt Ɛlkay as ɛd;
na Ido in famili, yu gɛt Zɛkaraya as ɛd; na Ginɛthɔn in famili, yu gɛt Mɛshulam as ɛd;
na Abija in famili, yu gɛt Zikray as ɛd; na Miniamin ɛn Modaya dɛn famili, yu gɛt Piltay as ɛd;
na Bilga in famili, yu gɛt Shamua as ɛd; na Shɛmaya in famili, yu gɛt Jɛonathan as ɛd;
Jɔyarib nain famili, yu gɛt Matɛnayas as ɛd; na Jɛdaya in famili, yu gɛt Uzi as ɛd;
na Salu in famili, yu gɛt Kalay as ɛd; na Amɔk in famili, yu gɛt Eba as ɛd;
na Ilkaya in famili, yu gɛt Ashabaya as ɛd; na Jɛdaya in famili, yu gɛt Netanɛl as ɛd;

Di tɛm we Kiŋ Dariɔs we na Pashia de rul, na da tɛm de dɛn rayt di nem dɛn dɔŋ ɔf ɔl dɛn wan we na bin di Livayt dɛn famili ɛd dyurin Ilaɛlashib, Jɔyada, Joanan ɛn Jadwa dɛn yon tɛm. Na da sem tɛm de dɛn rayt dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn nem dɛn dɔŋ.
Dɛn pipul we na famili ɛd na Livay in jɛnareshɔn te rich Joanan we na Ilaɛlashib in bɔypikin in tɛm, dɛn nem rayt dɔŋ insay di ɔfishal istri buk we dɛn de kɔl “di buk ɔf di anals.”

Di Livayt dɛn bigman dɛn na Ashabaya, Sherɛbaya, Jɛshwa we na Kadmiɛl in bɔypikin ɛn di wan dɛn we kin de nia dɛn. Dɛn man dɛn ya kin tinap ɔpozit dɛn fɔ de prez ɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki. Wan sɛt kin de ansa di ɔda sɛt, lɛkɛ aw dɛn kin de rid rɛspɔnsorial Sam, jɛs lɛkɛ aw Devid, PAPA GƆD in man bin dɔn se.
Matanaya, Bakbukaya, Obadaya, Mɛshulam, Talmɔn ɛn Akɔb na bin di getman dɛn fɔ di sto dɛn get dɛn.

Dɛn bin de de Jɔyakim, Nɛimaya di gɔvna ɛn Ɛzra we na Ju Lɔ ticha ɛn na wan pan di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn dɛn yon tɛm Jɔyakim na bin Jɛshwa in bɔypikin dɔn Jɛshwa in na bin Jozadak in bɔypikin.

We di tɛm rich fɔ dɛdiket di wɔl, dɛn go fɛn ɔl di Livayt dɛn, pul dɛn usay dɛn tap ɛn briŋ dɛn kam na Jerusɛlɛm. Dɛn gɛt fɔ sɛlibret ɛn fɔ mek di gladi soba, dɛn gɛt fɔ yuz ɔlkayn tin we de mek myuzik as dɛn go de siŋ dɛn siŋ we na fɔ prez ɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki.
Dɛn briŋ dɛn wan dɛnsɛf we de siŋ kam insay Jerusɛlɛm. Dɛn bin dɔn bil vilej fɔ dɛnsɛf na di Nɛtofatayt dɛn vilej ɛn
Bɛth Gilgal we de rawnd Jerusɛlɛm. Na frɔm dɛn vilej dɛn de ɛn di Giba ɛn Azmavɛth eria dɛn go pul dɛn.
We dɛn man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn dɔn mek dɛnsɛf klin bifo PAPA GƆD, dɛn du di sem tin dɛn to di ɔda pipul dɛn, di get dɛn ɛn di wɔl.
A mek di bigman dɛn na Juda go pantap di wɔl. Dɔn a gɛt tu big kwaya fɔ de tɛl tɛnk. Wan pan dɛn go pantap di wɔl ɛn bigin waka go na di rayt usay di dɔtibɔks de.
Oshaya ɛn sɔm pan di Juda bigman dɛn fala dɛn,
Azaraya, Ɛzra, Mɛshulam,
Juda, Bɛnjamin, Shɛmaya ɛn Jɛrimaya bin go wit dɛn;

sɔm pan dɛn man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin sɛf go wit dɛn bɔt dɛn bin ol trɔmpɛt we na myuzikal instrumɛnt; dɔn wit Zɛkaraya we na Jonɛtan in bɔypikin bɔt Jonɛtan na bin Shɛmaya in yon bɔypikin ɛn Matanaya in grampikin dɔn Matanaya na Mikaya in bɔypikin, Mikaya na Zakɔ in bɔypikin ɛn Esaf in grampikin.

In ɛn di wan dɛn we de wok nia am, Shɛmaya, Azarɛl, Milalay, Gilalay, Maaya, Netanɛl, Juda ɛn Anani wit dɛn yon myuzikal instrumɛnt dɛn lɛkɛ aw Devid, PAPA GƆD in man se, bin de wit da grup de. Na Ɛzra we na dɛn Ju Lɔ ticha lid di machpas.
We dɛn rich di Fawnten Get dɛn go ɔp dayrɛkt to di stɛp dɛn na Devid in siti bay di ɔp pat na di wɔl we pas pantap Devid in os go to di Wata Get we de na di ist.
Di sɛkɛn kwaya in waka go na di ɔpozit dayrɛkshɔn, dat na di lɛft. A fala dɛn go pantap di wɔl wit af pan di pipul dɛn. Wi pas di Ovin Dɛn Tawa go to di Brɔd Wɔl
oba di Ifrem Get, di Jɛshana Get, di Fish Get, di Ananɛl Tawa ɛn di Tawa ɔf di Ɔndrɛd te rich di Ship Get. We dɛn rich di Sikyɔriti Get nain dɛn tinap.
Di tu kwaya dɛn we bin de tɛl tɛnki go usay dɛn sɔpoz fɔ de insay PAPA GƆD in os. Misɛf ɛn sɔm pan di bigman dɛnsɛf du so;
Ɛliakim, Maasia, Miniamin, Mikaya, Ɛlioenay, Zɛkaraya ɛn Ananaya we na man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, dɛnsɛf go usay dɛn fɔ de fɔ blo dɛn trɔmpɛt;
Maasia, Shɛmaya, Ɛlieza, Uzi, Jɛoanan, Malkija, Ilam ɛn Ɛza dɛnsɛf jɔyn dɛn. Di kwaya dɛn siŋ ɛn na Jɛzraaya na bin dɛn kɔndɔktɔ.

Da de de, dɛn gladi bad as PAPA GƆD mek dɛn kɔmɔt bush. Dɛn mek bɔku difrɛn difrɛn sakrifays dɛn to PAPA GƆD. Di uman dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛnsɛf jɔyn dɛn fɔ gladi. If yu de fawe frɔm Jerusɛlɛm sɛf, yu go yɛri di nɔys we dɛn de mek we dɛn de gladi.

Da sem tɛm de, dɛn pik man dɛn we go de inchaj ɔf di sto dɛn we dɛn kip di kɔntribyushɔn dɛn, dɛn fɔs tin dɛn we dɛn avɛst ɛn dɛn tayth dɛn. Dɛn bin sɔpoz fɔ de briŋ di pat we dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn dɛn Livayt dɛn fɔ gɛt. Na so di lɔ se. Juda in fambul dɛn bin gladi wit dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn dɛn Livayt dɛn.
Dɛn pas ɔl di sɛrimɔni we PAPA GƆD want ɛn di wan we go mek dɛn klin bifo PAPA GƆD we dɛn man dɛn we de siŋ ɛn di getman dɛn bin dɔn du jɛs lɛkɛ aw Devid ɛn in bɔypikin Sɔlɔmɔn bin dɔn ɔda dɛn.
Frɔm we Devid ɛn Esaf bin de lɔntɛm nain dɛn bin gɛt kɔndɔktɔ dɛn fɔ di kwaya ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we de siŋ as dɛn de siŋ dɛn siŋ we na fɔ prez ɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki.

So, naw, we Zɛrubabɛl ɛn Nɛimaya de, ɔlman na Izrɛl de kɔntribyut fɔ lɛ di wan dɛn we de siŋ ɛn di getman dɛn gɛt wetin dɛn de it ɛvride. Dɛn kin kip sɔm fɔ di Livayt dɛn, na kɔna, dɔn di Livayt dɛn kin kip Erɔn in jɛnareshɔn dɛn yon na kɔna.
Da de de dɛn rid wetin rayt na di Buk ɔf Mozis lawd wan fɔ ɔlman fɔ yɛri. Nain dɛn fɛnɔt se, dɛn rayt de se, dɛn nɔ fɔ mek ɛni Amonayt ɔ Moabayt kam usay PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn de,
bikɔs dɛn nɔ bin gi dɛn Izrɛlayt tin fɔ it ɔ wata fɔ drink, bifo dat dɛn aya Belam fɔ swɛ dɛn. Bɔt PAPA GƆD tɔn di swɛ to blɛsin.
Wɛn di pipul dɛn yɛri dis, dɛnsɛf tɛl di fɔrina dɛn fɔ kɔmɔt de.
Bifo ɔl dis, Ilaɛlashib, wan pan dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, bin de inchaj ɔf di sto dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os. In ɛn Tobaya bin tayt

so i bin dɔn gi am wan pan di big rum dɛn we dɛn bin de kip gren we pipul kin gi as ɔfrin ɛn insɛns ɛn dɛn tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn dɛn gren, nyu wayn ɛn ɔyl we dɛn tayth lɛkɛ aw dɛn fɔ du fɔ dɛn Livayt, dɛn wan dɛn we de siŋ ɛn di gɛt man dɛn, plɔs di kɔntribyushɔn dɛn fɔ dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
Bɔt wɛn ɔl dis de go ɔn, a nɔ bin de na Jerusɛlɛm bikɔs di ia we mek Kiŋ Atazaksis, di kiŋ na Babilɔn, tati-tu ia as kiŋ, a bin dɔn go bak to am. Afta sɔm tɛm, a tek pamishɔn
ɛn kam bak na Jerusɛlɛm. We a kam bak, na da tɛm de a no bɔt di bad bad tin we Ilaɛlashib du we i gi wan rum na di kɔmpawnd na PAPA GƆD in os to Tobaya.
A nɔ bin lɛk dat atɔl so a ib ɔl Tobaya in tiŋs dɛn na do.
Dɛn a gi ɔda to pipul dɛn fɔ mek di rum klin bifo PAPA GƆD, dɔn a put ɔl wetin fɔ de na PAPA GƆD in os, di gren ɔfrin ɛn insɛns dɛn de bak.
A yɛri igen se, dɛn nɔ gi di tin dɛn we dɛn bin fɔ de gi to di Livayt dɛn ɛn dat ɔl mek di Livayt ɛn dɛn wan we de siŋ na PAPA GƆD in os, dɛn go bak na dɛn fam dɛn.

So a tɔk pan di bigman dɛn ɛn aks dɛn wetindu dɛn fɔ fɔgɛt fɔ tek kia ɔf PAPA GƆD in os. Dɔn a sɛn kɔl ɔl di Livayt ɛn dɛn wan we de siŋ fɔ kam bak ɛn a mek sho se dɛn ɔl go na di pɔynt dɛn we dɛn fɔ de.
Ɔlman na Juda briŋ in tayth kam fɔ kip na di sto dɛn. Sɔm na gren, sɔm na nyu wayn dɔn sɔm na ɔyl.

A put Shelɛmaya, wan pan dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, Zedɔk wan ɔda Ju Lɔ ticha, ɛn Pɛdaya, wan Livayt fɔ de inchaj ɔf di sto. Dɔn a mek Anan, Zakɔ in bɔypikin ɛn Matanaya in grampikin fɔ ɛp dɛn bikɔs dɛn ɔl na man dɛn we ɛnibɔdi kin trɔst. Na dɛn bin rɛspɔnsibul fɔ sheb di sɔplay dɛn to dɛn brɔda dɛn.
PAPA GƆD, duya nɔ fɔgɛt ɔl wetin a de du fethful wan fɔ yu os ɛn in wok.

Da sem tɛm de, nain a si di man dɛn na Juda de mas greps fɔ mek wayn de di de we mek sɛvin we fɔ blo. Dɛn bin ivin de briŋ gren, wayn, greps, fig ɛn ɔda tin dɛn we dɛn lod na dɛn dɔŋki kam de. Dɛn bin de briŋ ɔl dis kam insay Jerusɛlɛm, di de we mek sɛvin we fɔ blo. Dat mek a wɔn dɛn nɔ fɔ sɛl tin fɔ it da de de.
Di man dɛn we kɔmɔt Taya, we tap na Jerusɛlɛm sɛf bin de briŋ fish ɛn ɔlkayn tin fɔ sɛl gi dɛn pipul we kɔmɔt Juda insay Jerusɛlɛm, da de de.
A tɔk pan di aristo dɛn we kɔmɔt Juda ɛn aks dɛn wetindu dɛn de tɔlaret dis kayn wikɛdnɛs.

A se “Una go se una nɔ no se na pwɛl una de pwɛl di de? Noto dis sem kayn we una fɔstɛm pipul dɛn biev we mek PAPA GƆD mek wi de pan prɔblɛm naw? Wi ɛn wi siti? Naw unasɛf want PAPA GƆD fɔ vɛks pan wi we una de pwɛl di de we mek sɛvin we fɔ blo.”

We di ples kin dɔn de dak, di de bifo di de we mek sɛvin we fɔ blo, a kin gi ɔda fɔ mek dɛn lɔk ɔl di get dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn se, dɛn nɔ fɔ opin dɛn te di de we mek sɛvin we fɔ blo dɔn. A mek shɔ se a put sɔm pan mi yon man dɛn fɔ tan gyad oba di get dɛn so dat dɛn nɔ go briŋ nɔn lod kam insay Jerusɛlɛm, da de de.
Wan ɔ tu tɛm, dɛn treda ɛn dɛn ɔda wan dɛn we de sɛl ɔlkayn tin kin slip na do na Jerusɛlɛm.
Bɔt a wɔn dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn se if a kech dɛn de slip nia di wɔl igen dɛn go no. Frɔm da tɛm de, dɛn nɔ kam de igen we na di de we mek sɛvin we fɔ blo.

Afta ɔltin a tɛl di Livayt dɛn fɔ mek dɛnsɛf klin bifo PAPA GƆD, go ɛn tan gyad oba di get dɛn fɔ kip di fɔ pre ɛn blo oli. PAPA GƆD, duya nɔ fɔgɛt mi bak fɔ dis. Sho mi yu masi we bɔku lɛkɛ aw di lɛk we yu lɛk wi bɔku.
Pan ɔl dis, da tɛm de, a si man dɛn we kɔmɔt Juda we dɔn mared uman dɛn we kɔmɔt Ashdɔd, Amɔn ɛn Moab.
Bɔku pan dɛn pikin dɛn bin de tɔk di laŋwej na Ashdɔd ɔ dɛn ɔda laŋwej bɔt dɛn nɔ bin sabi tɔk di laŋwej na Juda.

A tɔk pan dɛn ɛn swɛ dɛn. A bit sɔm pan di man dɛn ɛn rut dɛn ia. A mek dɛn fɔ swɛ na PAPA GƆD in nem se, dɛn nɔ go mek dɛn gyal pikin dɛn mared fɔrina ɛn dɛnsɛf ɔ dɛn bɔypikin dɛn, nɔ go mared fɔrina. A aks dɛn se,

“Noto dat mek Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn we na bin kiŋ na Izrɛl sin?” A se, “Pan ɔl dɛn kiŋ dɛn we bin de, nɔn nɔ bin tan lɛkɛ am. PAPA GƆD bin lɛk am ɛn mek am Kiŋ na Izrɛl bɔt na uman dɛn we na fɔrina dɛn mek i sin.
Wi nɔ fɔ yɛri se una de du dis sem tin we de mek una ɔnfetful to PAPA GƆD we una de go mared uman dɛn we na fɔrina.”
Wan pan Jɔyada in bɔypikin ɛn Ilaɛlashib we na di bigman fɔ ɔl dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, na bin Sanbalat, da Oronayt in sɔnɛnlɔ, so a drɛb am kɔmɔt nia mi.
PAPA GƆD, duya, mɔs mɛmba se na dɛn man ya we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin pwɛl wetin dɛn bin dɔn swɛ se dɛn go du, dɛn wok ɛn dɛn Livayt dɛn.

So a mek shɔ se di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di Livayt dɛn nɔ gɛt natin we fɔrin, a mek dɛn klin bifo PAPA GƆD ɛn put ɔlman usay dɛn fɔ de ɛn gi ɔlman wetin i fɔ du. Ɔlman bin gɛt in yon wok.
A igen mek shɔ bak se di wan dɛn we fɔ kɔntribyut wud dɛn du am di tɛm we dɛn fɔ du am ɛn di wan dɛn we fɔ gi di fɔs frut dɛn we dɛn avɛst de du am. PAPA GƆD, duya, gi mi fevɔ.
Di tɛm we Kiŋ Zaksis we dɛn kin kɔl Aesuerɔs, bin de rul frɔm India te rich Ithiopia, i bin gɛt wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti-sɛvin prɔvins ɔnda am,
ɛn da tɛm de, i bin tap na Susa, we na di kapital
Na bin di tɛm we i bin dɔn bi kiŋ fɔ tri ia, i mek pati fɔ in bigman dɛn, wokman dɛn ɛn di ami chif dɛn we de na Pashia ɛn Mɛdia, wit di aristo dɛn ɛn di gɔvna dɛn we de usay i de rul.
I bin de sho ɔlman in jɛntri we i gɛt bikɔs in na kiŋ, ɛn di fayn fayn we we in de wit kiŋ rɛspɛkt, fɔ lɔŋ tɛm. Dat na wan ɔndrɛd ɛn eti de.
We dɛn dɔn da wande, di kiŋ mek ɔda pati fɔ sɛvin de fɔ ɔl udat tap insay Susa we na di kapital; bigman ɛn ɔdinari pɔsin dɛn, na di kɔmpawnd usay i tap.

Dɛn drɛs di ples wit wayt kɔtin winda blayn ɛn blu kep we gɛt kɔd we dɛn ɛŋ pan silva riŋ wit fayn linin ɛn pɔpul, ɛn put sɛti we dɛn tek gold ɛn silva mek pan mabul tayl we tek difrɛn difrɛn kayn ston mek. Dɛn fiks af af pɔfiri, mabul, mɔta-ɔf-pal ɛn ɔda dia miniral ston dɛn, na di pevmɛnt usay dɛn put di sɛti dɛn.
Dɛn sav drink na gold wayn kɔp ɛn ɔda wayn kɔp we dɛn tek difrɛn tin dɛn mek, ɛn di kiŋ in wayn bin de bɔku fɔ drink.
Lɔ nɔ bin de pan di rɔm; di kiŋ tɛl in wokman dɛn na di kiŋ os se ɔlman fri fɔ drink ɔmɔs i ebul.
Kwin Vashti insɛf mek pati fɔ di uman dɛn insay Kiŋ Zaksis in os.
Di de we mek sɛvin, we di kiŋ in at layt bikɔs i dɔn drink bɔku wayn, i tɛl Mɛuman, Biztha, Abona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zitha ɛn Kakas, di sɛvin okobo we de fɔ de wach wetin de apin na di kiŋ in os,
fɔ kɔl Kwin Vashti ɛn i fɔ wɛr in krawn so dat i kin sho ɔlman aw i fayn, bikɔs na uman we fayn fɔ luk.
Bɔt Kwin Vashti nɔ gri go we di kiŋ sɛn di okobo dɛn fɔ kɔl am. Dis mek di kiŋ vɛks bad ɛn in fukfuk grap.
Di kiŋ naw aks di bukman dɛn lɛk aw i kin du bikɔs dɛn no bɔt di lɔ ɛn fia ple.

Dɛn bin sidɔm nia am. Dɛn na Kashena, Shita, Admata, Tashish, Merɛs, Masɛna, ɛn Mɛmukan. Na dɛn sɛvin de inchaj ɔf di prɔvins dɛn na Pashia ɛn Mɛdia, ɛn na dɛn di kiŋ kin de tɔk wit. Na dɛn de nɛks to am.
I se, “Wetin di lɔ se fɔ du to Kwin Vashti we i nɔ gri kam we Kiŋ Zaksis sɛn in man dɛn fɔ go kɔl am?”
Usay di kiŋ ɛn ɔl di bigman dɛn de, nain Mɛmukan tɛl di kiŋ se nɔto in nɔmɔ Kwin Vashti fityay. I se Kwin Vashti dɔn fityay ɔl di man dɛn we tap usay Kiŋ Zaksis de.
I se if ɔl dɛn uman yɛri bɔt wetin di kwin du, dɛn go de fityay dɛn man dɛn ɛn se afta ɔl Kiŋ Zaksis bin sɛn kɔl Kwin Vashti ɛn i nɔ gri go.
I se da de de, di bigman dɛn na Pashia ɛn Mɛdia dɛn wɛf we go dɔn yɛri bɔt wetin di kwin du, go de yuz di stori fɔ fityay dɛn man.

I se, if di kiŋ lɛk i fɔ sɛn tɛl ɔlman se Vashti nɔto Kwin igen ɛn dat i nɔ fɔ ɛva kam bifo am igen I se di kiŋ fɔ rayt di lɔ insay usay di Mɛdis ɛn di Pashian dɛn lɔ de so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go chenj am. I se di kiŋ fɔ fɛn ɔda pɔsin we sabi biev pas Vashti.
I se wɛn di uman dɛn ɔlɔbɔt na di kindɔm yɛri di lɔ dat go mek ɔl di uman dɛn rɛspɛkt dɛn man i lɛk udat i bi.
Di kiŋ ɛn ɔl di bigman dɛn we yɛri wetin Mɛmukan se gladi ɛn di kiŋ du wetin i se.
I sɛn lɛta go to ɔl di prɔvins we i de rul ɛn i mek shɔ se di lɛta we de go ɛnisay dɛn rayt am na di laŋwej we di pipul dɛn de de tɔk.
Afta ɔl wetin dɔn bi ɛn di kiŋ in at dɔn kol, i bin de tink bɔt Vashti, aw i biev ɛn wetin in dɔn mek lɔ bɔt am.
So di kiŋ in wokman dɛn we de nia am tɛl am se, “Lɛ wi fɛn yɔŋgyal we na vajin fɔ di kiŋ.

Lɛ di kiŋ mek ɔfisa dɛn na di difrɛn prɔvins dɛn aks ɔl di yɔŋgyal dɛn we na vajin we tap insay Susa we na di kapital, fɔ go na di say we dɛn uman kin go, dɔn i fɔ put Egay inchaj ɔf dɛn as nain na di okobo we kin de inchaj ɔf di uman dɛn; fɔ gi dɛn ɔyl fɔ dɛn bɔdi so dɛn go luk frɛsh.
Di wan we di kiŋ go lɛk fɔ bi kwin fɔ tek Vashti in ples.” Di kiŋ gladi fɔ di advays ɛn du wetin dɛn se.
Wan Ju we nem Mɔdikay bin tap na Susa. Na bin Jeir we na Shimɛay in bɔypikin, in yon bɔypikin. Kish we na Bɛnjaminayt, na bin Jeir in grampa.
Di tɛm we Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza bin kech Jɛoiakim we na bin kiŋ na Juda ɛn kɛr am go ɛgzayl kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm, Mɔdikay na bin wan pan di wan dɛn we dɛn kech.
In ɔnkul in gyal pikin we bin nem Adasa bin de to am fɔ mɛn bikɔs in mama ɛn papa bin dɔn day. I nem Ɛsta bɔt in Ibru nem na Adasa. Mɔdikay bin tek am lɛk in yon pikin.
Wɛn di lɔ we di kiŋ pas kɔmɔt na do fɔ mek dɛn yɔŋgyal dɛn gɛda na Susa to Egay, Ɛsta sɛf na bin wan pan dɛn ɛn dɛn bin lɛ Egay de inchaj ɔf am bikɔs nain bin de inchaj ɔf di uman dɛn.

Egay kam lɛk in biznɛs ɛn na so i kin de magomago fɔ gi am di ɔyl we fɔ mek in bɔdi fayn, ɛn di it we i fɔ it, ɛn pik di sɛvin atɛndant we fɔ de wit am. I gi am di bɛst ples fɔ tap, usay di uman dɛn kin tap na di kiŋ in os.
Ɛsta nɔ bin mek dɛn no udat in ɔ in pipul dɛn bi bikɔs Mɔdikay bin dɔn tɛl am nɔ fɔ tɔk.
Ɛvride Mɔdikay kin kam pas bifo usay i tap so dat i go no if i ɔrayt.

Di uman dɛn go de fɔ twɛlv mɔnt de mek dɛnsɛf luk fayn lɛkɛ aw di kiŋ want; dɛn go tek siks mɔnt de rɔb ɔyl na dɛn bɔdi ɛn siks mɔnt de rɔb dɛn ɔda krim dɛn we kin pul fayn sɛnt. Bay da tɛm de dɛn fɔ dɔn rɛdi fɔ go insay to Kiŋ Zaksis bay tɔn.
Da tɛm de we ɛniwan pan di uman dɛn de go insay to di kiŋ, dɛn kin gi am ɛnitin we in want frɔm di wɔdrob fɔ go to di kiŋ.

Na ivintɛm i de go insay to di kiŋ bɔt i de kɔmɔt de na mɔnin go na di sɛkɛn ples ɛn dis tɛm na Sheashgaz, wan ɔda okobo, we bin de inchaj ɔf di kiŋ in switat dɛn, de inchaj ɔf dɛn. Afta dat, i nɔ fɔ go insay to di kiŋ igen pas i sɛn kɔl am bay in nem.

Wɛn Ɛsta, dat na Abiail we na Mɔdikay in ɔnkul in pikin, we Mɔdikay tek lɛk in yon pikin, in tɔn rich fɔ go insay to di kiŋ, i nɔ aks fɔ ɛnitin pas wetin Egay, da okobo we bin de inchaj ɔf di uman dɛn, se. Ɔlman we si Ɛsta lɛk in biznɛs.
Na di mɔnt we mek tɛn we nem Tebɛt, afta we Kiŋ Zaksis dɔn rul fɔ sɛvin ia,
nain di kiŋ fɔl fɔ Ɛsta. I bin lɛk am pas ɔl di uman dɛn ɛn kin gladi we i si am pas ɔl di vajin dɛn, so di kiŋ wɛr di krawn na Ɛsta in ed ɛn mek am di kwin ɛn fɔgɛt bɔt Vashti.
Di kiŋ mek pati fɔ Ɛsta ɛn kɔl ɔl di bigman dɛn ɛn in wokman dɛn. I mek ɔlide de na ɔl di prɔvins ɛn sheb prɛzɛnt we na kiŋ nɔmɔ kin sheb.
Wɛn di vajin dɛn gɛda bak, Mɔdikay in bin sidɔm na di kiŋ in get.
Ɛsta stil nɔ bin tɔk udat in pipul dɛn bi jɛs lɛkɛ aw Mɔdikay bin dɔn se, bikɔs Ɛsta bin de du ɔl wetin Mɔdikay se lɛkɛ aw i bin de du we i de mɛn am.
Wande we Mɔdikay sidɔm na di kiŋ in get, Bigthan ɛn Terɛsh we na ɔda okobo dɛn ɛn na di kiŋ in sikyɔriti dɛn nain os, bin vɛks bad ɛn plan fɔ kil Kiŋ Zaksis.
We Mɔdikay yɛri bɔt dɛn plan i tɛl Kwin Ɛsta ɛn Ɛsta tɛl di kiŋ se na Mɔdikay tɛl am.
Wɛn dɛn fɛnɔt se na tru, dɛn ɛŋ di tu man na galos ɛn rayt wetin apin fɔ di kiŋ insay di buk we dɛn kɔl Kronikuls.
Leta ɔn Kiŋ Zaksis promot Eman, di Agagayt man we na Amadetha in bɔypikin. I mek am bɔs fɔ ɔl di ɔda bigman dɛn we de wit am.
Ɔl di kiŋ in wokman dɛn we bin de de na di kiŋ in get kin baw we dɛn si Eman fɔ sho rɛspɛkt; bikɔs na so di kiŋ se. Bɔt Mɔdikay in nɔ gri baw.
Di kiŋ in wokman dɛn we bin de na di get aks Mɔdikay wetindu i nɔ de du wetin di kiŋ se.
Dɛn kin de tɛl am ɔltɛm fɔ baw bɔt i nɔba lisin. Dɛn le in kɔmplen to Eman fɔ si if dat go lɛ i chenj in maynd bikɔs i bin dɔn tɛl dɛn se in na Ju.
So wɛn Eman notis se Mɔdikay stil nɔ de baw to am, dat mek in fukfuk grap.
Dis mek i plan nɔ fɔ dil wit Mɔdikay in wan we i bin dɔn no se na Ju. I disayd se in go dɔnawe wit ɔl di Ju ɛn uman dɛn we na Mɔdikay in pipul dɛn, we tap na Pashia.
Insay di fɔs mɔnt we nem Nisan, afta we Kiŋ Zaksis dɔn rul fɔ twɛlv ia, dɛn bin de mek Pur, dat na lukgrɔn bifo Eman ɛvride, ɛvri mɔnt fɔ twɛlv mɔnt, te di nɔmba twɛlv mɔnt we nem Ada.
Wande, Eman tɛl di kiŋ se sɔm rɛfyuji dɛn de ɔlɔbɔt nain kindɔm; i se dɛn difrɛn pas ɔl di pipul de ɛn dɛn nɔ de du wetin di kiŋ se, so di kiŋ nɔ go gen natin if i tɔlaret dɛn.
I se, if di kiŋ want, i fɔ gi ɔda se dɛn fɔ dɔnawe wit dɛn. I se in go pe tɛn tawzin silva kɔpɔ to di wan dɛn we de du biznɛs fɔ di kiŋ, mek dɛn go kip am usay dɛn kin kip mɔni.
So di kiŋ pul di riŋ nain fiŋa ɛn gi Eman we na Amadetha in bɔypikin we na di Ju dɛn ɛnimi.
Di kiŋ tɛl Eman se lɛ i tek di mɔni bɔt i kin du wetin in want wit di pipul dɛn we i se.

Na di de we mek tɔtin insay di fɔs mɔnt, dɛn kɔl ɔl di kiŋ in sɛktri dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn fɔ rayt ɔl wetin Eman se fɔ du. Dɛn rayt am to kiŋ in minista dɛn ɛn sɛn am to ɔl di gɔvna ɛn ɔda bigman dɛn na di difrɛn difrɛn prɔvins dɛn. Ɔl prɔvins gɛt in yon lɛta nain yon laŋwej. Dɛn put am de se na Kiŋ Zaksis rayt am ɛn dɛn yuz in riŋ fɔ stamp am.

Na spɛshal pipul dɛn kɛr di lɛta dɛn go na di difrɛn ples we se dɛn fɔ kil ɛn dɔnawe wit ɔl di Ju dɛn wɛda dɛn yɔŋ ɔ dɛn ol, dɛn na uman ɔ dɛn na pikin, dɛn ɔl fɔ day di sem de na di mɔnt we mek twɛlv in tɔtin de dɔn dɛn fɔ tek ɔl wetin dɛn gɛt.
Dɛn fɔ sɛn dis ɔda go ɔlsay na di kindɔm so dat dɛn ɔl go rɛdi fɔ da sem de de.

Na so di pipul dɛn we de kɛr di ɔda go rawnd de ɔri bikɔs na so di kiŋ se, ɛn nainsay Susa we na di kapital di kiŋ bin gi di ɔda. Di kiŋ ɛn Eman sidɔm de drink bɔt dɛn bin dɔn gi ɔlman na di siti dɛn siriɔs kɔtat.
Wɛn Mɔdikay yɛri bɔt ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn du, i chɛr in klos fɔ sho se i nɔ gladi, wɛr saklɔth ɛn rɔb ashis pan insɛf de waka ɔlɔbɔt di siti de kray bita bita wan;
i waka te i rich to di domɔt fɔ go to di kiŋ in get bikɔs nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ wɛr saklɔth fɔ go insay di kiŋ in get.
Nainsay ɔl di prɔvins we yɛri bɔt di kiŋ in ɔda, na soso kray di Ju dɛn de kray ɛn fast, dɔn bɔku pan dɛn wɛr saklɔth fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri.
Wɛn di uman dɛn ɛn di ɔda okobo dɛn we bin de de wit Ɛsta tɛl am bɔt aw dɛn si Mɔdikay, Ɛsta in at pwɛl; i sɛn klos go gi Mɔdikay so dat i kin chenj bɔt Mɔdikay nɔ gri tek di klos dɛn.
Dɛn Ɛsta kɔl Atak we na wan pan di man dɛn we de wok wit di kiŋ, we nain di kiŋ pik fɔ de de wit Ɛsta, ɛn tɛl am fɔ go tɔk to Mɔdikay ɛn fɛnɔt wetindu i de biev so.
Atak go mit Mɔdikay na wan big ɛmti spes we de bifo di kiŋ in get,
ɛn Mɔdikay tɛl am ɔl wetin dɔn bi ɛn di mɔni we Eman se i go put na di say we di kiŋ de kip in mɔni so dat di kiŋ go gri fɔ mek dɛn dɔnawe wit ɔl di Ju dɛn.
Mɔdikay gi am wan pan di lɛta we di kiŋ rayt gi di ɔda na Susa, fɔ mek dɛn dɔnawe wit ɔl di Ju dɛn, mek i go go sho Ɛsta, dɔn i se Ɛsta fɔ go beg di kiŋ fɔ in pipul dɛn.
So Atak go tɛl Ɛsta ɔl wetin Mɔdikay se.
Dɛn Ɛsta gi am mɛsej bak fɔ go gi Mɔdikay.

I se, ɔlman we de wok fɔ di kiŋ no se nɔn man ɔ uman nɔ fɔ go insay usay di kiŋ de, pas if insɛf kɔl am ɔ nɔ so i go day. I se di kiŋ gɛt fɔ pɔynt di tik we dɛn mek wit gold fɔ sho se i gɛt pawa, bifo di pɔsin go insay usay i de. Na dat nɔmɔ go mek di pɔsin nɔ day. Ɛsta se na tati de naw we di kiŋ nɔ sɛn fɔ am.
Wɛn dɛn go tɛl Mɔdikay ɔl wetin Ɛsta se,
Mɔdikay sɛn dɛn bak go tɛl Ɛsta se lɛ i nɔ fil se bikɔs in de na di kiŋ in os, natin nɔ go du am de.

I se, if Ɛsta sɛt in mɔt ɛn nɔ du natin, na ɔda pɔsin go fɛt fɔ di Ju dɛn, bɔt as fɔ in ɛn ɔl udat de nain papa in os dɛn ɔl go day. I se, sɔntɛm na bikɔs i go gɛt fɔ pul di Ju dɛn pan trɔbul mek i bi kwin da tɛm de.
Ɛsta sɛn dɛn bak to Mɔdikay. I se,

Mɔdikay fɔ go gɛda ɔl di Ju dɛn na Susa ɛn dɛn fɔ fast ɛn pre fɔ am. I se dɛn nɔ fɔ it ɛn drink fɔ tri de ɛn tri nɛt ɛn insɛf wit in wokuman dɛnsɛf go fast. Dɔn i go mek drayay ɛn go insay go tɔk to di kiŋ pan ɔl we bay di lɔ i nɔ fɔ du dat; i se if i fɔ day, i go day.
So Mɔdikay, go du ɔl wetin Ɛsta se fɔ du.

Wɛn i dɔn fast fɔ tri de, Ɛsta wɛr di klos we i kin wɛr fɔ drɛs lɛk kwin. I go tinap na di kɔmpawnd in domɔt ɔpozit di ɔl we di kiŋ kin sidɔm. Di kiŋ in bin sidɔm na di chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm insay in os ɔpozit di domɔt;
wɛn di kiŋ si Kwin Ɛsta tinap na di kɔmpawnd, i mek di kiŋ in at swit, so i pɔynt di gold tik nain an. Dɛn Ɛsta waka lɛkɛ kwin go insay ɛn tɔch pantap di tik.
Di kiŋ se, “Wetin du yu Kwin Ɛsta? Wetin yu want? I lɛk na af di kindɔm we a de rul, a go gi yu.”
Ɛsta se, “Kiŋ, if yu gri, mek yu ɛn Eman kam it to mi tide bikɔs a dɔn kuk fɔ una”.
Di kiŋ sɛn go kɔl Eman kwik so dat dɛn go du wetin Ɛsta want dɔn dɛn ɔltu go to Ɛsta fɔ go it di it we i kuk.
As dɛn sidɔm de drink wayn, di kiŋ aks Ɛsta wetin i want. I prɔmis am se i go gɛt wetin i want so mek i jɛs tɛl am. I se if ivin i want af in kindɔm, i go gi am.
Bɔt Ɛsta tɛl am se, “Wetin a de beg yu fɔ du na:
If di kiŋ gladi wit mi, ɛn if yu want fɔ du wetin a want ɛn mek mi at swit, lɛ di kiŋ ɛn Eman kam bak tumara de we a go kuk fɔ dɛn fɔ it ɛn na da tɛm de a go aks di kiŋ wetin a wan aks am.”
Wɛn Eman kɔmɔt to Ɛsta i bin gladi ɛn in at layt, bɔt wɛn i si Mɔdikay na di get ɛn we Mɔdikay nɔ baw ɔ mek lɛk i si am, in fukfuk grap bak ɛn i vɛks bad pan Mɔdikay.
Ɛniwe, i bia ɛn go nain os saful. Dɛn i sɛn kɔl in padi dɛn ɛn aks in wɛf we na Zirɛsh insɛf fɔ kam de wit dɛn.
We dɛn ɔl de de, i bigin blɔf bɔt aw i jɛntri, ɔmɔs bɔypikin i gɛt, aw di kiŋ dɔn promot am ɛn gi am big post, ɛn aw i impɔtant pas ɔl di ɔda bigman dɛn we de wok wit di kiŋ.
Dɛn i tɔk bak se, ivin Kwin Ɛsta, we i wan pɔsin fɔ go wit di kiŋ fɔ it wetin i kuk, i nɔ kɔl nɔbɔdi pas in di vɛri wan ɛn dat i dɔn kɔl dɛn bak di nɛks de.
I se ɔl dat nɔ de mek in at swit, bikɔs i de si Mɔdikay sidɔm na di kiŋ in get ɛvride.

Dɛn in wɛf ɛn ɔl in padi dɛn de, se i fɔ bil wan galos we sɛvinti-fayv fut ay so dat na mɔnin, i go tɛl di kiŋ fɔ ɛŋ Mɔdikay de dɔn da tɛm de, dɛn kin go it to Ɛsta wit kolat. Eman gladi fɔ yɛri wetin dɛn se, ɛn i gi ɔda fɔ mek dɛn bil di galos.
Da sem nɛt de, di kiŋ nɔ ebul slip; i ɔda in wokman dɛn fɔ briŋ di buk we nainsay de dɛn kin rayt ɔl wetin de bi insay di kindɔm, kam rid wetin de de to am.
As dɛn de rid, dɛn si se na Mɔdikay bin pot we i yɛri Bigthana ɛn Terɛsh, dɛn okobo dɛn we na bin in sikyɔriti se dɛn de plan fɔ kil Kiŋ Zaksis.
So di kiŋ aks wetin dɛn dɔn du fɔ Mɔdikay. Dɛn ansa am se dɛn nɔ du natin yet.
Di kiŋ aks udat de na do na di kɔmpawnd. Da tɛm de Eman jɛs go insay di kɔmpawnd fɔ go tɛl di kiŋ fɔ ɛŋ Mɔdikay na di galos we i dɔn bil fɔ am.
Di kiŋ in wokman dɛn tɛl am se Eman de de. Dɛn se i tinap na di kɔmpawnd. Di kiŋ se mek dɛn mek i go insay.
Eman go insay to di kiŋ ɛn di kiŋ aks am wetin fɔ du fɔ man we in di kiŋ wan sho ɔlman se i rɛspɛkt. Eman tɔk nain at se di kiŋ nɔ go wan sho ɛni ɔda pɔsin se i rɛspɛkt am, pas insɛf di Eman.
So Eman tɛl di kiŋ se if i wan sho di man aw i rɛspɛkt am,
i fɔ mek dɛn briŋ wan pan in kiŋ klos dɛn we i dɔn wɛr wit di ɔs we i dɔn rayd we wɛr krawn nain ed fɔ sho se na kiŋ de rayd am;

ɛn i fɔ lɛ dɛn gi di klos dɛn ɛn di ɔs to di wan pan di kiŋ in aristo bigman dɛn lɛ i wɛr am pan di man we i wan sho se i rɛspɛkt, ɛn lɛ i mek di man rayd di ɔs go rawnd di siti, bɔt di aristo fɔ de bifo di man de ala se, “Na so di kiŋ kin du fɔ pɔsin we i wan sho ɔlman se i rɛspɛkt!”
So di kiŋ tɛl Eman, lɛ i mekes tek di klos dɛn ɛn di ɔs ɛn du wetin i se to Mɔdikay we na di Ju we kin de sidɔm na di kiŋ in get. I se Eman fɔ du ɔl wetin i se. I nɔ fɔ lɛf natin pan wetin i se.
So Eman tek di klos dɛn ɛn di ɔs ɛn drɛs Mɔdikay dɔn i mek i rayd ɔlɔbɔt di siti de ala bifo am se, “Una si di man we di kiŋ wan sho aw i rɛspɛkt!”
Afta dat, Mɔdikay go bak go sidɔm na di kiŋ in get bɔt Eman in put in an nain ed de kray ɛn go nain yon os.
We i rich nain os i tɛl in wɛf we na Zerɛsh ɛn in padi dɛn ɔl wetin apin da de de. Nain dɛn tɛl am se wans Mɔdikay na Ju i nɔ go ebul du am natin bifo dat nain disgres wan i go de fɛn.
As dɛn de tɔk di tɔk, nain tu pan di wokman dɛn we na okobo na di kiŋ in os kam kwik kwik wan fɔ kam tek Eman go to Ɛsta fɔ go it.
Na so di kiŋ ɛn Eman go it to Kwin Ɛsta.
Da de de na bin di sɛkɛn de ɛn as dɛn sidɔm de drink, di kiŋ aks Ɛsta bak, i se, “Kwin Ɛsta na wetin yu want mek a du fɔ yu? A dɔn tɛl yu fɔ aks mi nɔmɔ, if ivin na af mi kindɔm, yu go gɛt am.”
Dɛn Kwin Ɛsta ansa am se, “Kiŋ sa, if yu gladi wit mi, a de aks mek dɛn nɔ kil mi ɛn mi pipul dɛn.

Dɛn dɔn sɛl mi ɛn mi pipul dɛn ɛn se, dɛn fɔ dɔnawe wit wi kpatakpata. If na sɛl dɛn bin sɛl wi man ɛn uman dɛnsɛf as slev, a nɔ bin fɔ se fiŋ, bikɔs di sɔfa we wi bin fɔ sɔfa nɔ bin fɔ rich di lɔsis we yu bin fɔ gɛt if dɛn sɛl wi.”
Kiŋ Zaksis aks Kwin Ɛsta se, “Udat gɛt maynd fɔ du da kayn tin de? Usay i de?”
Nain Ɛsta se, “Di pɔsin na ɛnimi! Na dis bad Eman!” Dɛn Eman in at pwɛl as i sidɔm wit fred frɔnt di kiŋ ɛn kwin.
Di kiŋ grap de blez lɛk faya go na do na di os in gadin; bɔt Eman in lɛf insay de beg Kwin Ɛsta mek i nɔ day, as i notis se di kiŋ wan pɔnish am.

Di kiŋ kɔmɔt na di os in gadin go insay usay dɛn bin de drink, i mit Eman butu na Ɛsta in fut fɔ beg am, bɔt da tɛm de, Ɛsta bin lidɔm na di sɛti. So di kiŋ se, “Yuwant fɔ rabish di kwin sɛf usay a de, na mi yon os?” Di wɔd nɔ kɔmɔt gud nain mɔt, dɛn dɔn kɔndɛm Eman.
Abona we na wan pan di okobo dɛn we kin wok fɔ di kiŋ tɛl am se di galos, we Eman bin dɔn bil fɔ Mɔdikay we bin mek dɛn nɔ kil di kiŋ de na Eman in os. I se i ay sɛvinti-fayv fut.
Di kiŋ se na fɔ kɛr Eman go ɛŋ am de. So dɛn kɛr am go ɛŋ am na di galos we i bin mek fɔ Mɔdikay. Dat mek di kiŋ in at kol.
Da de de, Kiŋ Zaksis gi Kwin Ɛsta, Eman we na di Ju dɛn ɛnimi, in os. So Mɔdikay go si di kiŋ bikɔs bay da tɛm de, Ɛsta bin dɔn tɛl di kiŋ udat Mɔdikay bi to am;
ɛn di kiŋ tek di riŋ we i pul na Eman in fiŋa gi Mɔdikay. Dɔn Ɛsta mek Mɔdikay de inchaj ɔf ɔl wetin Eman bin gɛt.
Dɛn Ɛsta fɔdɔm na di kiŋ in fut de kray ɛn beg am fɔ du sɔntin we go mek di plan we Eman we na Agagayt bin dɔn mek fɔ kil di Ju dɛn nɔ go rayt.
Di kiŋ es di tik we dɛn mek wit gold fɔ sho se i gɛt pawa to Ɛsta,

Ɛsta grap ɛn tinap bifo di kiŋ ɛn aks di kiŋ se, “If di kiŋ gladi wit mi, ɛn i wan fɔ du wetin a want, ɛn if i fil se na di rayt tin a de aks fɔ, lɛ i rayt ɔda lɛta dɛn we go chenj wetin de na di wan dɛn we Eman we na Agagayt dat na Amadetha in bɔypikin, bin rayt se dɛn fɔ dɔnawe wit ɔl di Ju dɛn na di prɔvins dɛn we di kiŋ de rul.
Aw a go sidɔm de luk wetin de bi to mi pipul dɛn? Ɛn uskayn bia a go bia fɔ si we mi pipul dɛn de day?”
Kiŋ Zaksis tɛl Kwin Ɛsta ɛn Mɔdikay we na Ju se, “Una si we a dɔn gi Ɛsta, Eman in os ɛn a dɔn mek dɛn ɛŋ am na di galos bikɔs i want fɔ dɔnawe di Ju dɛn.
Una kin rayt wetin una want fɔ bi to di Ju dɛn in mi nem, yuz di kiŋ in riŋ fɔ stamp am; bikɔs ɛnitin we dɛn mi nem rayt ɛn yuz mi riŋ fɔ stamp am, nɔ de chenj.

Dɛn kɔl di kiŋ in sɛktri dɛn insay di twɛnti-tri de na di tɔd mɔnt we nem Sivan ɛn dɛn rayt di mɛsej we Mɔdikay se bɔt di Ju dɛn, fɔ di gɔvna ɛn ɔda bigman dɛn frɔm India te rich Ithiopia dat na wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti-sɛvin prɔvins. Ɔl di prɔvins dɛn gɛt dɛn yon lɛta na di laŋwej we di pipul go ɔndastand ɛn di Ju dɛnsɛf gɛt dɛn yon lɛta na dɛn laŋwej.

Dɛn bin rayt ɔl wit Kiŋ Zaksis in nem ɛn yuz di kiŋ in riŋ fɔ stamp dɛn ɛn mek dɛn sɛn di lɛta dɛn wit di kiŋ in mɛsenja dɛn ɛn mek dɛn rayd fast pan di kiŋ in ɔs dɛn we dɛn kin yuz fɔ du biznɛs fɔ di kiŋ. Na to di kiŋ dɛn de kip dɛn ɔs de ɛn dɛn de fid dɛn gud.
Insay di lɛta, di kiŋ gri se di Ju dɛn ɔlsay fɔ fɛt fɔ dɛn layf so dɛn kin kil ɛni ɔda pɔsin we atak dɛn fɔ kil dɛn. Dɛnsɛf kin kil dɛn wit dɛn pikin ɛn uman dɛn ɛn ivin tek dɛn tin dɛn na dɛn an,
wans dɛn du am di sem de we na di nɔmba twɛlv de na di twɛlv mɔnt we nem Ada.
Dɛn mek wetin dɛn rayt lɔ na ɔl di prɔvins dɛn so dat dɛn go tɛl ɔlman mek di Ju dɛn go rɛdi da de de fɔ fɛt fɔ dɛn layf ɛn kil dɛn ɛnimi.
So di mɛsenja dɛn jomp pantap di ɔs dɛn we de rɔn fast, we dɛn kin yuz fɔ du biznɛs fɔ di kiŋ ɛn di kiŋ insɛf ɔda dɛn fɔ go kwik. So dɛn pas am as lɔ na ɔlsay na Susa we na di kapital.

Dɛn Mɔdikay kɔmɔt usay di kiŋ de wit in blu ɛn wayt klos lɛkɛ di wan we kiŋ kin wɛr, wit gold krawn ɛn kot we dɛn tek fayn linin ɛn pɔpul matirial mek. Da tɛm de, na so ɔlman insay Susa de ala wit gladi.
Ɔl di Ju dɛn bɔdi bin layt. Dɛn bin gladi. Ɔlman fred ɛn rɛspɛkt dɛn.
Ɔlɔbɔt we dɛn yɛri di lɔ, di Ju dɛn gladi. Dɛn mek ɔlide ɛn sɛlibret. Bɔku pan di ɔda pipul bigin se dɛnsɛf na Ju, bikɔs dɛn bin de fred de Ju dɛn.

Na di de we mek tɔtin na di Ada mɔnt we na di nɔmba twɛlv mɔnt, we di Ju dɛn ɛnimi dɛn bin dɔn min se dɛn go ebul kil dɛn, bay wetin di fɔs lɔ in dɔn se, bɔt we dɛn chenj se di Ju dɛn kin fɛt fɔ dɛn layf,
ɔl di Ju dɛn insay Kiŋ Zaksis in kindɔm gɛda de rɛdi fɔ fɛt udat go mistek wan kil dɛn. Nɔbɔdi nɔ kres tɔch dɛn bikɔs dɛn ɔl bin de fred di Ju dɛn.
Di bigman dɛn, di gɔvna dɛn ɛn ɔl udat bin de wok fɔ di kiŋ, ɔl bin ɛp di Ju dɛn bikɔs dɛn bin de fred Mɔdikay.
Mɔdikay bin dɔn tɔn bigman na di kiŋ in os ɛn ɔlman bin dɔn no bɔt am ɔlɔbɔt na di prɔvins dɛn; bikɔs i bin jɛs de tɔf mɔ ɛn mɔ.
So di Ju dɛn kil ɔl dɛn ɛnimi dɛn, chap chap dɛn wit sɔd ɛn dɔnawe wit dɛn kpatakpata, ɛn du wetin dɛn fil fɔ du wit dɛn wan dɛn we nɔ lɛk dɛn.
Insay Susa insɛf we na di kapital, di Ju dɛn kil fayv ɔndrɛd man,
dɔn dɛn kil Pashandatha, Dalfɔn, Aspatha,
Poratha, Adalia Aridatha,
Pamashta, Arisay, Ariday ɛn Varizatha,
we na Eman we na Amadetha in bɔypikin ɛn we na di Ju dɛn ɛnimi in tɛn bɔypikin; bɔt dɛn nɔ tek natin pan wetin dɛn gɛt.
Da sem de de, dɛn tɛl di kiŋ ɔmɔs pɔsin dɛn kil na di kapital we na Susa.

Di kiŋ tɛl Kwin Ɛsta se, “Insay Susa we na di kapital, dɛn dɔn kil fayv ɔndrɛd man wit Eman in tɛn bɔypikin. A wɔnda wetin dɛn go dɔn du na di ɔda ples dɛn! So tɛl mi wetin yu want? A go du am fɔ yu. Wetin igen yu want mi fɔ du? A go du am.”
Ɛsta tɛl di kiŋ se, if di kiŋ gladi mek i gi pamishɔn to di Ju dɛn lɛ dɛn du di sem tin bak di nɛks de ɛn mek dɛn ɛŋ Eman in tɛn bɔypikin na di galos.
So di kiŋ gi di pamishɔn ɛn mek dɛn mek am lɔ dɔn i mek dɛn ɛŋ Eman in tɛn bɔypikin.
Di Ju dɛn we bin de na Susa gɛda bak di nɛks de we na di de we mek fotin na Ada mɔnt ɛn kil ɔda tri ɔndrɛd man insay Susa bɔt dɛn no tek dɛn natin.
Di ɔda Ju dɛn na di ɔda prɔvins dɛn, dɛnsɛf gɛda fɔ fɛt fɔ dɛn layf ɛn mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn lɛf fɔ mɔna dɛn, ɛn dɛn kil sɛvinti-fayv tawzin pan dɛn wan we et dɛn; bɔt dɛnsɛf nɔ tek dɛn natin.
Dɛn du dat na di de we mek tɔtin na Ada mɔnt, dɔn di fotin de, dɛn blo ɛn sɛlibret wit gladi.
Bɔt di wan dɛn we bin de na Susa, dɛn gɛda di tɔtin ɛn fotin de, blo di de we mek fiftin ɛn mek da de de, de fɔ sɛlibret ɛn gladi.
Na dat mek di Ju dɛn we tap na di smɔl siti dɛn de mek di fotin de na Ada mɔnt ɔlide we dɛn fɔ gladi ɛn sɛlibret. Da de de, dɛn fɔ sɛn fayn prɛzɛnt fɔ dɛn kɔmpin.
Mɔdikay rayt ɔl wetin apin dɔŋ ɛn sɛn lɛta to ɔl di Ju dɛn we tap na di prɔvins dɛn we Kiŋ Zaksis de rul, wɛda dɛn de nia ɔ dɛn de fawe,
de aks dɛn fɔ mek di fotin ɛn fiftin pan Ada mɔnt ɛvri ia bi ɔlide,

bikɔs dat na di de dɛn we di Ju dɛn ɛnimi dɛn blo biɛn dɛm ɛn as mɔnt we tin chenj frɔm sɔri to gladi fɔ dɛn ɛn frɔm tɛm we dɛn go kray to ɔlide. I se, dɛn fɔ mek dɛn de dɛn de bi tɛm fɔ gladi ɛn sɛlibret we dɛn go de gi dɛn kɔmpin prɛzɛnt.
So di Ju dɛn disayd fɔ kɛriɔn wit wetin dɛn bigin ɛn fala wetin Mɔdikay rayt to dɛn se.
Na da de de, Eman we na Agagayt ɛn na Amadetha in bɔypikin bin dɔn plan se dɛn go dɔnawe wit ɔl di Ju dɛn ɛn dɛn bin lukgrɔn fɔ pik ustɛm dɛn de du am;
bɔt wɛn Ɛsta beg di kiŋ, i bin gi ɔda fɔ lɛ ɔl wetin Eman bin plan fɔ du tɔn bak pan am ɛn dat in ɛn in bɔypikin dɛn fɔ ɛŋ na galos.
Na dat mek dɛn kɔl dɛn de dɛn de, Purim bikɔs ɔf di tɛmpul, ɛn bikɔs ɔf wetin Mɔdikay bin rayt nain lɛta we i tɔk bɔt wetin fɔ bi to dɛn.
Di Ju dɛn mek shɔ se dɛn ɔl ɛn ɔl udat de wit dɛn jɔyn dɛn fɔ mɛmba dis de lɛkɛ aw dɛn bin dɔn se ɛn di tɛm we dɛn bin dɔn se,
ɛn dɛn fɔ mɛmba dis de na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn, insay ɔl di famili dɛn, ɔl di prɔvins ɛn na di siti. Dɛn se dɛn nɔn nɔ fɔ ɛva lɛf fɔ mɛmba dɛn de dɛn de we dɛn kɔl Purim na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn dɛn.
Dɛn Kwin Ɛsta we na Abiail in gyal pikin ɛn Mɔdikay da Ju gi siriɔs ɔda bɔt wetin fɔ du fɔ Purim insay di sɛkɛn lɛta.
Di lɛta dɛn go to ɔl di Ju pipul dɛn na di wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti- sɛvin prɔvins we Kiŋ Zaksis de inchaj ɔf. Di lɛta dɛn na bin lɛta dɛn we tɔk bɔt pis ɛn dɛn tɔk tru tin,

we de tɔk se di de dɛn we na fɔ Purim, dɛn fɔ du dɛn di rayt tɛm we Mɔdikay da Ju ɛn Kwin Ɛsta bin dɔn tɛl di Ju pipul dɛn se dɛn fɔ du wit dɛn jɛnareshɔn kɔnsanin di fast we dɛn fɔ fast ɛn di sɔri we dɛn fɔ sɔri.
Na Kwin Ɛsta tɔk ɔl wetin fɔ bi fɔ di Purim ɛn dɛn rayt am dɔŋ.
Kiŋ Zaksis fos ɔlman na di land ɛn di wan dɛn we de na di shɔ dɛn nia di si fɔ pe taks.
Dɛn rayt bɔt ɔl wetin i du fɔ sho se i gɛt pawa ɛn dɛn tɔk mɔ bɔt aw di kiŋ gi Mɔdikay big post, insay di buk we dɛn kɔl Kronikul, we na de dɛn kin rayt bɔt di kiŋ na Mɛdia ɛn Pashia.
Na Mɔdikay, da Ju kam bi di pɔsin we de nɛks to Kiŋ Zaksis. Ɔl in Ju brɔda dɛn lɛk in biznɛs bikɔs nain bin de fɛt fɔ mek dɛn liv fayn wit pis ɛn sikyɔriti.
Wan man bin de we nem Job, ɛn i bin tap na Ɔz. Job na bin gud man ɛn i bin de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD. In fred ɛn rɛspɛkt fɔ PAPA GƆD, ɛn in layf nɔ bin gɛt wan bɔt.
I bin bɔn sɛvin bɔypikin ɛn tri gyal pikin.

I bin gɛt sɛvin tawzin ship, tri tawzin kamɛl, wan tawzin man kaw we i kin yuz fɔ wok na fam, ɛn fayv ɔndrɛd uman dɔŋki wit bɔku bɔku wokman dɛn, so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de we tap na di ist, we jɛntri pas am.
In bɔypikin dɛn kin mek pati na dɛn difrɛn os dɛn bay tɔn; ɛn dɛn kin kɔl dɛn tri sista fɔ go it ɛn drink wit dɛn.

Ɛvri mɔnin afta di pati kin dɔn, Job kin mek shɔ se i sɛn go was dɛn; spɛshal was fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn klin na PAPA GƆD yay; i kin grap ali mɔnin mek bɔn ɔfrin fɔseka dɛn ɔl. I kin tink se sɔntɛm we dɛn de na di pati, dɛn dɔn du ɔ se sɔntin we go dɔn mek PAPA GƆD vɛks pan dɛn. Na so Job bin de du ɔltɛm.
Wande, we PAPA GƆD in pikin dɛn go sho dɛnsɛf to am, Setan sɛf bin de de.
PAPA GƆD aks Setan se, usay i kɔmɔt. I tɛl PAPA GƆD se in bin jɛs de waka ɔp ɛn dɔŋ de paspas na wɔl.
PAPA GƆD aks am if i dɔn tink bɔt Job we nain wokman. PAPA GƆD tɛl Setan se nɔbɔdi nɔ de na wɔl lɛk Job bikɔs na gud man ɛn i de waka tret wit am. I fred ɛn rɛspɛkt in PAPA GƆD ɛn nɔ miks pan bad.
Nain Setan ansa PAPA GƆD se, nɔto fɔ natin mek Job tan aw i tan.
I se PAPA GƆD dɔn mek i nɔ ebul du in, in famili ɛn ɔl wetin i gɛt natin. I se PAPA GƆD dɔn mek bɛtɛ de fala Job pan ɔl wetin i de du ɛn dɔn gi am animal dɛn ɔlɔbɔt na di land.
Setan se, if PAPA GƆD go jɛs tret in an ɛn tek ɔl wetin i bin dɔn gi Job, i go mɔs tɔk bad bɔt am bifo in fes.
So PAPA GƆD tɛl Setan se, i de lɛf Job gi am mek i nyakanyaka ɔl wetin Job gɛt, bɔt mek i nɔ mek natin du insɛf. So Setan jɛs kɔmɔt bifo PAPA GƆD.
Wande, we Job in pikin dɛn bin de it ɛn drink na di brɔda we big pas dɛn ɔl in os,
wan mɛsenja rɔn kam tɛl Job se, we di man kaw we i kin yuz fɔ wok na fam de dig di grɔn fɔ plant ɛn di uman dɔŋki dɛn de de de it,
sɔm tifman dɛn we na Sabian dɛn, atak dɛn ɛn tif ɔltin go; dɛn kil ɔl di wokman dɛn na di fil pas in wangren we ebul rɔnawe fɔ kam tɛl am.
I nɔ tɔk di tɔk dɔn, nain wan ɔda mɛsenja kam tɛl Job se, laytin flash ɛn kil ɔl di ship dɛn ɛn di man dɛn we de luk dɛn; bɔt nain wangren ebul rɔnawe kam tɛl an.

Insɛf nɔ tɔk di tɔk dɔn nain wan ɔda mɛsenja kam tɛl Job se, tri grup tifman dɛn we na di kiŋ in advaysa dɛn, bɔs pan di kamɛl dɛn, tek dɛn ɔl go, ɛn kil ɔl di wokman dɛn, pas in wangren we ebul rɔnawe kam tɛl am.
Insɛf nɔ tɔk di tɔk dɔn nain wan ɔda mɛsenja kam tɛl Job se, Job in pikin dɛn bin de it ɛn drink na di brɔda we big pas dɛn ɔl in os;
na de big big tinada bigin blo te i ib di os dɔŋ pan dɛn ɔl ɛn dɛn day, pas in wangren we ebul rɔnawe kam tɛl am.
Wɛn Job dɔn lisin to ɔl wetin dɛn gɛt fɔ se, i grap, chɛr in klos, krep in ed, nildɔŋ wit in ed na grɔn ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD.
I se, ‘we a bɔn, a nɔ kam wit natin, semweso we a day, a nɔ gɛt fɔ kɛr natin go; na PAPA GƆD gi mi ɔl wetin a gɛt ɛn na PAPA GƆD dɔn tek dɛn na mi an bak; mek ɔlman prez in nem.’
Pan ɔl wetin bi, Job nɔ sin ɛn i nɔ blem PAPA GƆD.
Wan ɔda de, PAPA GƆD in pikin dɛn go sho dɛnsɛf to am. Setan insɛf bin de de.
PAPA GƆD aks Setan usay i kɔmɔt. I tɛl PAPA GƆD se in bin jɛs de waka ɔp ɛn dɔŋ de paspas na wɔl.

PAPA GƆD aks am if i dɔn tink bɔt Job we nain wokman. PAPA GƆD tɛl Setan se, nɔbɔdi nɔ de na wɔl lɛk Job, bikɔs na gud man ɛn i de waka tret wit in PAPA GƆD. I fred ɛn rɛspɛkt in PAPA GƆD ɛn in layf nɔ gɛt wan bɔt. PAPA GƆD se pan ɔl we Setan mek in gri mek i atak Job fɔ natin, Job stil de waka tret wit in PAPA GƆD.
Setan se pɔsin kin du ɛnitin fɔ mek i nɔ day.
I se if PAPA GƆD go jɛs tret in an ɛn mek i sik, i mɔs kɔs am nain fes.
PAPA GƆD tɛl an se, i kin du wetin i want bɔt i nɔ fɔ kil Job.
So Setan kɔmɔt bifo PAPA GƆD ɛn go ib sik pan Job; sofut kɔba in wanol bɔdi frɔm ed to fut.
Job tek broko kle pɔt fɔ de krep in bɔdi ɛn i sidɔm na ashis.
In wɛf aks am se, wit ɔl wetin dɔn bi, i stil de mek se in de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD. I se if Job nɔ go kɔs PAPA GƆD wantɛm ɛn day.
Job tɛl am se i de tɔk lɛk udat nɔ no PAPA GƆD. I se if dɛn fɔ gladi we PAPA GƆD du gud fɔ dɛn bɔt kɔmplen we bad tin bi to dɛn.

Ɛlifaz we na Timanayt, Bildad we na Shuayt ɛn Zofa we na Neamathayt we na Job in tri padi, yɛri wetin bi ɛn kɔmɔt na dɛn difrɛn siti dɛn fɔ kam fɛn am. Dɛn mek bagin fɔ mit de di sem tɛm fɔ go kɔrej am.
We dɛn si am wɛn dɛn bin de fa, dɛn nɔ bin no se na im; bɔt wɛn dɛn luk am gud we dɛn rich nia am, dɛnsɛf bigin ala de kray; dɛnsɛf chɛr dɛn klos ɛn ib dɔti na dɛn ed.
Dɔn, dɛn sidɔm na grɔn wit am fɔ sɛvin de ɛn sɛvin nɛt, bɔt nɔ se natin to am bikɔs dɛn si aw i bin de sɔfa.
Afta Job in padi dɛn dɔn sidɔm wit am fɔ sɛvin de ɛn sɛvin nɛt ɛn nɔ se natin, Job disayd fɔ tɔk ɛn i kɔs di de we i bin bɔn.
I se:
a wish a nɔ bin bɔn, ɛn di nɛt we se, bɔypikin dɔn kam na yu bɛlɛ.
Lɛ da de de dak lɛk nɛt! Lɛ PAPA GƆD nɔ mɛmba da de de igen, ɛn lɛ i nɔ mek layt shayn da de de.
Lɛ da de de tɔn to daknɛt. Lɛ klawd kɔba am; lɛ di dak we i dak mek pipul fred am.
Lɛ tik tik daknɛs kɔba am! Lɛ i nɔ gladi se in na wan pan di de dɛn na di ia, lɛ dɛn nɔ kɔnt am sɛf pan di de dɛn na di mɔnt.
Lɛ ɔda pɔsin nɔ bɔn da sem de de; lɛ dɛn nɔ gi ɛnibɔdi jɔy da de de.
Lɛ udat wan swɛ da de de, swɛ am, dɛn wan dɛn we ebul mek Lɛviatan grap fɔ kɔz avɔk.
Lɛ di sta dɛn we kin shayn na mɔnin lɔs; lɛ di abop we i de abop se do de klin, bi fɔ natin,
bikɔs na di nɛt mi mama tek mi bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn mi fɔ si trɔbul.
Wetin mek a nɔ day as dɛn bɔn mi?
A wish nɔbɔdi nɔ bin tot mi nain fut ɔ gi mi bɔbi fɔ sɔk.
Da tɛm de aw a kam, na so a bin fɔ go bak; a bin fɔ day kwayɛt wan ɛn gɛt bloblo,
wit kiŋ dɛn ɛn ɔda bigman dɛn we bin de na wɔl, we bin dɔn bil big big os fɔ dɛnsɛf,
ɔ a bin fɔ de wit dɛn bigman dɛn we bin gɛt gold, ɛn ful os wit silva.
Ɔ wetindu a nɔ bin day na mi mama in bɛlɛ lɛk bebi we nɔ si di wɔl wande?
Na di grev, badman nɔ de du bad igen, ɛn udat taya de blo fɔ wok.
Na de ivin dɛn jelman go gɛt pis; dɛn wɔda nɔ go de ala pan dɛn igen fɔ wok.
Na de yu go fɛn di wan we femɔs ɛn di wan we nɔbɔdi nɔ no, di slev nɔ go gɛt pɔsin fɔ bi bɔs oba am igen
Wetin mek PAPA GƆD fɔ lɛ pipul liv ɛn sɔfa ɛn ivin dɛn layf nɔ swit,
we de pre fɔ day bɔt day nɔ de kam, na so dɛn kin de fɛn di day lɛk tri kɔpɔ silva;
na so dɛn kin gladi we dɛn fɛn day ɛn kin smayl na dɛn kɔfin
Wetin mek man de bɔn kam na wɔl we i nɔ no wetin de bi to am, we na PAPA GƆD de du wetin in wan du?
Na pini dɔn tɔn mi it ɛn di kray we a de kray kin ful ɔmɔs bokit wata.
Di tin we a de fred, nain dɔn bi to mi so, ɛn na di tin we a de fred pas di day we go kil mi, dɔn bi so to mi.
Mi at ebi ɛn a nɔ ebul bia; a nɔ gɛt kolat ɛn na soso waala de mit mi.”
Ɛlifaz we na Timanayt ansa:
A op se yu nɔ go vɛks if a tɔk tu-tri tin. A nɔ go ebul fɔ de a nɔ tɔk natin.
Na tru se yu dɔn de tɛl pipul wetin fɔ du, Yu na pɔsin we gɛt ajo.
Di wɔd dɛn we yu de tɔk de mek udat wan giv ɔp, olɔp insɛf.
Naw we trɔbul mit yu, yu nɔ ebul bia; we na yu i mit, yu wan giv ɔp.
PAPA GƆD we yu de wɔship ɛn de biɛn tigi tigi wan, ɛn aw yu lib lɛk gud pɔsin ɔl di tɛm, du fɔ mek yu abop.
Tink gud, PAPA GƆD go mek udat de waka tret wit am sɔfa? Ɔ yu dɔn no pɔsin we gud dɔn trɔbul mek i rɔndɔŋ?
As a dɔn si, na udat bad we de fɔ mek trɔbul, trɔbul de mit
We PAPA GƆD blo nɔmɔ, dɛn de day, ɛn we i vɛks, i de dɔnawe wit dɛn kwik.
Dɛn kin tɔf lɛk we layɔn de mek nɔys bɔt PAPA GƆD de brok brok di yɔŋ wan dɛn tit.
Di big layɔn de day bikɔs i nɔ gɛt ɔda animal fɔ kil it, di yɔŋ wan dɛn skata ɔlɔbɔt.
“Wan wɔd pas na mi yes, i pas na mi yes kwayɛt wan.
We a kin tink bɔt di drim we a kin drim na nɛt we mɔtalman kin slip dip,
a fred ɛn kol kech mi tret, we mek a trimbul.
A fil briz de blo na mi fes mi ia tinap na mi bɔdi.
Sɔntin tinap ɛn nɔ de muf, bɔt a nɔ ebul si wetin. Sɔntin tinap frɔnt mi so ɛn di ples mek yeŋ, wantɛm a yɛri vɔys.
I nɔ pɔsibul fɔ ɔdinari mɔtalman fɔ klin na PAPA GƆD in yay? Ɔ lɛ in layf nɔ gɛt bɔt na PAPA GƆD in yay?
In wokman dɛnsɛf i nɔ trɔs, ɛn i kin si fɔlt pan in enjɛl dɛn;
bifo a se ɔdinari mɔtalman we na dɔti i tek mek am, we na dɔti i pul am, we PAPA GƆD kin kil lɛkɛ flay.
I kin ɔrayt na mɔnin, bɔt bay ivintɛm, i dɔn day; bifo yu mekɔp, i dɔn day.
Na ɔda pɔsin go gɛt dɛn jɛntri we dɛn day ɛn wɛn dɛn day sɛf, dɛn stil nɔba ɔndastand wetin PAPA GƆD de du.
Ala nɔ! Ɛnibɔdi de we go ansa yu? Us enjɛl de we go ansa yu?
Vɛksteshɔn de kil fulman, ɛn jɛlɔsi de kil pɔsin we nɔ gɛt bɛtɛ sɛns.
A dɔn si we fulman jɛntri, i nɔ tu te, a bigin tɔk bad bɔt in os.
In pikin dɛn de pan trɔbul ɔltɛm. If dɛn go kot, dɛn de lɔs dɛn kes; dɛn nɔba gɛt pɔsin fɔ tɔk fɔ dɛn.
Dɛn wan we aŋri kin it wetin fulman plant ɔlwe dɛn de midul chukchuk, ɛn di wan we gridi go tek in jɛntri.
Pen ɛn sɔfrin nɔ de gro na dɔti, ɛn trɔbul nɔ de bɔs na grɔn;
jɛs lɛk aw spak we kɔmɔt na faya de go ɔp, na so mɔtalman bɔn fɔ gɛt trɔbul.
“Fɔ mi yon say, na PAPA GƆD a go de luk ɔp to, na PAPA GƆD a go kɔmplen to;
we kin du big tin dɛn we pɔsin nɔ ɔndastand, wɔndaful tin dɛn we pɔsin nɔ ebul kɔnt;
nain de mek ren fɔdɔm na wɔl ɛn de wata dɛn bush;
nain de mek udat ɔmbul gɛt pozishɔn, ɛn mek udat gɛt bɛrin, in at kol.
I de mek bad pipul plan nɔ wok so dat dɛn nɔ go gɛt wetin dɛn plan.
I de mek di wan dɛn we dig ol fɔ ɔda pɔsin, fɔdɔm insay di ol; ɛn wetin dɛn plan nɔ ol wata.
We ples brayt, dɛn stil de waka na dak, santɛm, dɛn go jam dɛnsɛf lɛk na nɛt.
I de pul pikin dɛn we dɛn papa dɔn day na wulf mɔt, i nɔ de mek dɛn buli poman.
Dat de mek di poman gɛt op ɛn lɔk bad pipul dɛn mɔt.
Na tru se i go fayn fɔ di man we PAPA GƆD de kɔrɛkt, so pɔsin nɔ fɔ vɛks pan PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti if i de kɔrɛkt am.
We PAPA GƆD wund yu, i go mɛn di wund; we i mek yu sik, i go mek yu wɛl.
I go pul yu pan siks trɔbul, ivin pan di wan we mek sɛvin, i go pul yu de bak.
If aŋri de na siti, i nɔ go mek yu day wit aŋri, ɛn i nɔ go mek dɛn kil yu we wa de.
I nɔ go mek pipul tek dɛn mɔt kil yu, ɛn nɔ go mek yu fred we trɔbul de na siti.
Trɔbul ɛn aŋri nɔ go min natin to yu, ɛn yu nɔ go de fred wayl animal.
Ston ston nɔ go ambɔg yu plant, ɛn wayl animal sɛf nɔ go ambɔg yu.
Yu go slip wit kol at, ɛn yu go kɔnt di animal dɛn we yu de mɛn, bɔt nɔn nɔ go lɔs.
Yu jɛnareshɔn go bɔku, ɛn dɛn go tan lɛk gras we de gro ɔlsay.
Na we yu dɔn ol gud, yu go day, lɛkɛ aw na we plant dɔn ful, dɛn de pik am.
Lisin o, ɔl wetin wi fɛnɔt, na tru. Yusɛf tray fɔ lan dɛn. I go gud fɔ yu.
Dɛn Job ansa se:
If pɔsin bin ebul we mi trɔbul, if i put ɔl mi wahala na skel!
I bin fɔ ebi pas ɔl di sansan na bich; na dat mek a de mek shɔtat.
PAPA GƆD in aro dɔn chuk mi; di pɔyzin dɔn sok insay mi bɔdi; PAPA GƆD dɔn rɛdi fɔ sho mi pɛpɛ.
Wayl dɔŋki de kray we i gɛt gras fɔ it, ɔ man kaw de kray we i de it?
We it nɔ gɛt tes, pɔsin nɔ go ebul it am if i nɔ put sɔl, ɛn na so di wayt pat pan eg sɛf nɔ gɛt tes.
Mi mɔt nɔ de tes dɛn kayn it de na dɛn kayn it de a et.
A wish a kin aks PAPA GƆD fɔ sɔntin, ɛn i du wetin a want;
dat na fɔ mek i go jɛs kwis mi mek a day, na fɔ mek i jɛs tek in an ɛn kɔt mi layf!
Mi at go kol; A go prez am ɔl we pen de na mi bɔdi; bikɔs a nɔ dinay PAPA GƆD we oli, in wɔd, wande.
A nɔ gɛt trɛnk fɔ liv igen A nɔ ebul bia sɛf igen
Noto ston dɛn tek mek mi, ɛn mi nɔto ayɛn.
Fɔ tru tru, a nɔ ebul ɛp misɛf, ɛn pɔsin nɔ de fɔ ɛp mi.
Pɔsin we nɔ ɛp in padi na pɔsin we nɔ gɛt fred ɛn rɛspɛkt fɔ PAPA GƆD.
Mi padi dɛn de mek lɛk aw sɔm watasay kin mek, I kin gɛt wata wande, di ɔda de i dray,
Di watasay dɛn kin dak ɛn kin kol.
We san wam, di wata kin dray; di ɔt ɔt san kin dray di wata.
Dɛn wan we de travul wit kamɛl bay grup, kin gɛt fɔ go ɔda say fɔ fɛn wata fɔ drink; dɛn kin go na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, ɛn day de.
Sɔm pan dɛn kɔmɔt Tima de luk fɔ wata, ɔda wan dɛn we kɔmɔt Shiba, de abop se dɛn go gɛt.
Dɛn pwɛl at bikɔs dɛn bin shɔ se dɛn go gɛt; we dɛn rich de, dɛn kɔnfyus.
Una dɔn tan lɛk di watasay dɛn to mi, we una si di mɔnɛ we mit mi, una fred.
A bin tɛl una se gi mi prɛzɛnt? Ɛn a nɔ se una fɔ brayb pɔsin fɔ mi.
A nɔ ivin aks una fɔ pul mi na mi ɛnimi an; ɔ fɔ pe mɔni mek di wan dɛn we de ambɔg mi, fri mi.
A go sɛt mi mɔt ɛn lisin we una de tich mi; una mek a ɔndastand usay a go rɔŋ.
Tɛl frɛn tru nɔ pwɛl frɛn! Bɔt us gud yu tɔk du?
Yu tink se yu ebul kɔrɛkt mi we yu fil se a de tɔk wetin a de tɔk fɔ jɛs pul briz na mi bɛlɛ?
Yu go ivin gyambul fɔ gɛt pikin we nɔ gɛt mama ɛn papa, ɛn yɔwo fɔ sɛl yu padi.
Bɔt duya, una luk mi na mi yay; a nɔ go lay to una.
A beg, una tink gud ɛn lɛf fɔ jɔj mi. Gri se a nɔ du rɔŋ.
Lay de na mi mɔt? A nɔ no rayt frɔm rɔŋ?
Wans mɔtalman de na wɔl, in layf tan lɛk we dɛn de fos pɔsin fɔ wok na ami, i gɛt fɔ de wok lɛk lebra.
Lɛk we slev de luk fɔ shed, ɛn lɛk wokman we de abop fɔ in pe,
na so a dɔn de mɔnt afta mɔnt nɔ de du natin bɛtɛ, semweso, na so a de sɔfa ɛvri nɛt.
We a go slip na nɛt, a de wɔnda ustɛm a go grap. Bɔt di nɛt kin lɔŋ, ɛn na tɔn tɔn a de tɔn tɔn te do klin.
I tan lɛk mi bɔdi ɔl rɔtin; na soso sofut kɔba mi bɔdi lɛk klos; i kin mek lɛk i de dray bɔt tɔf de kɔmɔt de.
Ɛvride de pas kwik pas aw pɔsin we de mek kɔntriklos kin de paspas trɛd kwik kwik, ɛn bay di tɛm we di de de dɔn, yu nɔ bɛtɛ igen
Nɔ fɔgɛt se mi layf tan lɛk briz; i tan lɛk na dɔn mi yon ɛnjɔymɛnt dɔn so.
Yu de si mi naw, bɔt yu nɔ go gɛt fɔ si mi igen; yu go de luk mi so, a go dɔn day.
Lɛk aw klawd de lɔs, na so we mɔtalman day, i nɔ de kam bak;
i nɔ go go nain os, ɛn in pipul de fɔgɛt bɔt am.
A nɔ ebul sɛt mi mɔt; a mɔs tɔk aw a de fil; a mɔs tɔk wetin de at mi.
Mi nɔto watasay ɔ watasay dɛbul, we fɔ de wach wetin a de du ɔltɛm.
Wɛn a kin go lidɔm, a kin min se a go blo,
bɔt yu kin mek a drim bad drim ɛn sho mi tin dɛn we de mek a fred,
bifo dat, mek pɔsin kwis mi trot, mek a day; i bɛtɛ pas fɔ lɛf wit bonbon.
A et mi layf: a dɔn taya wit dis layf. Jɛs lɛf mi saful bikɔs a go day jisnɔ.
Wetin na mɔtalman we yu fɔ tek in biznɛs siriɔs so ɔ de gi am di kayn atɛnshɔn we yu de gi am,
we mek yu de wach wetin i de du na mɔnin, ɛn tɛst am ɔl tɛm.
Pul yay smɔl kɔmɔt pan mi, mek a gɛt bloblo.
If a sin, i nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du wit yu. Yu dɔn mek mi tagɛt. I tan lɛk se mi na ebi lod fɔ yu.
Yu fɔ mek lɛk se a nɔ sin ɛn fɔgiv mi sin. A go day jisnɔ; yu go de fɛn mi, bɔt da tɛm de, a go de insay mi grev.
Bildad we na Shuayt ansa se:
I du so pan bɔku tɔk naw, ɛn di tɔk we yu de tɔk tan lɛk we pɔsin de pul briz nain bɛlɛ.
PAPA GƆD nɔ miks pan bɛnbɛn ɛn in we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, nɔ de rɔb Pita fɔ pe Pɔl.
If yu pikin dɛn dɔn du wetin PAPA GƆD nɔ want, na dɛn fɛn dɛn day fɔ dɛnsɛf.
If yu de aks PAPA GƆD fɔ ɛp yu ɛn pre mek PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti sɔri fɔ yu,
wans yu de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD ɛn yu an klin, dɛn i go mɔs tinap fɔ yu ɛn gi yu ɔl wetin yu lɔs bak.
Wetin yu bin gɛt fɔs go smɔl, pas wetin yu go gɛt bambay.
A beg, aks dɛn fɔstɛm pipul, ɛn tink gud bɔt wetin yu fɔstɛm-papa dɛn bin fɛnɔt;
wi nɔ de liv lɔŋ, so wi nɔ no natin, bikɔs wi layf tan lɛk we shado kin lɔs.
Dɛn go tɛl yu bɔt di sɛns ɛn sabi we dɛn gɛt, ɛn na wetin dɛn dɔn lan, dɛn go tɔk bɔt.
Na usay swamp de, swamp rɛs de gro; ɛn watasay gras nɔ kin gro usay wata nɔ de.
If wata nɔ de, dɛn go day, ɛn dɛn wan we nɔ du fɔ kɔt, na dɛn fɔs go day.
Na dat kin apin to pɔsin we nɔ bisin bɔt PAPA GƆD; wetin di man we nɔ no PAPA GƆD abop pan, nɔ kin bɛtɛ.
Wetin i abop pan, nɔ kin las; i tan lɛk we man abop pan spayda wɛb we kin brok ɛni tɛm.
Na lɛk spayda wɛb; i liŋ pan am, i pwɛl, i ol am bɔt i nɔ bɛtɛ.
Dɛn tan lɛk plant we dɛn de wata bifo san kɔmɔt, ɛn so dɛn rut de gro ɔlsay.
In rut dɛn de rap pan di ston dɛn; ɛn na de i tap
If pɔsin rut am, nɔbɔdi nɔ go no se i bin de gro de.
Na so pɔsin we bad nɔ de ɛnjɔy fɔ lɔŋ; ɔda bad pɔsin go tek in ples.
PAPA GƆD nɔ de lɛf gud pɔsin to insɛf, ɛn i nɔ de ɛp bad pɔsin.
I go mek yu laf bak, ɛn ala wit gladi.
Di wan dɛn we nɔ lɛk yu go shem ɛn PAPA GƆD go nyamanyama di os dɛn we bad pipul tap.
Job ansa se:
Na tru yu de tɔk: Pɔsin nɔ go ebul tɛl PAPA GƆD se in an klin.
If pɔsin se i wan agyu wit PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD go aks am wan tawzin kwɛshɔn we nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul ansa.
PAPA GƆD sabi ɔltin ɛn i pawaful. Nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul chalenj am.
Nain de mek mawnten dɛn shek ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ no wɛn dat de bi, wɛn i de sho se in vɛks;
we mek di wɔl kin shek kɔmɔt nain ples ɛn mek di pila dɛn we i tinap pan, trimbul;
we de gi ɔda mek san nɔ shayn, ɛn di sta dɛnsɛf nɔ shayn;
we nain wangren mek di klawd tan aw i tan, we de tap di swɛlin dɛn na si;
udat mek di Bia ɛn di Oriɔn sta dɛn, di sta dɛn we de na di skay;
we de du tin we mɔtalman nɔ de ɔndastand, di bɔku wɔndaful tin dɛn we pɔsin nɔ go ebul kɔnt.
Fɔ tru, i kin pas nia mi, bɔt a nɔ de si am; i kin de kɛriɔn in biznɛs, bɔt a nɔba no se i de de.
I de tek wetin i want ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul tap am; Nɔbɔdi nɔ go aks am wetin i de du sɛf;
We PAPA GƆD vɛks, i vɛks; di wan dɛn we de ɛp watasay dɛbul, de butu to am.
Mi go ebul agyu PAPA GƆD? Mɔt sɛf nain a nɔ gɛt.
Pan ɔl we a nɔ du natin, a nɔ gɛt mɔt fɔ tɔk to am; pas a beg am fɔ sɔri fɔ mi.
If a kin kɔl am, ɛn i ansa mi, a nɔ go biliv se i go lisin to mi sɛf.
I de bit mi nɔmɔ ɛn mek a sɔfa fɔ natin;
i nɔ de gi mi bloblo, na sɔfa nɔmɔ a de sɔfa.
If na kɔmpitishɔn fɔ udat gɛt trɛnk, nɔbɔdi nɔ pas am! If na fɔ tɔk na kot, udat go sɛn kɔl am?
Pan ɔl we a nɔ du natin, mi bɔku tɔk go mek a lɔs mi kes; pan ɔl we a nɔ du natin, i go tek wetin a tɔk fɔ fɛn fɔlt pan mi.
Mi na gud man, bɔt a nɔ bisin igen; na gens a dɔn gens sɛf wit layf.
A nɔ bisin bɔt natin igen, udat gud ɛn udat bad, ɔl de day.
Wɛn tin lɛkɛ wa, ɔ flɔd mek gud pɔsin day, di watasay dɛbul de gladi we inosɛnt pipul de sɔfa.
PAPA GƆD de mek bad pipul du wetin dɛn wan du na wɔl; i de mek di jɔj dɛn mek se dɛn nɔ de si. If nɔto PAPA GƆD na udat?
Tɛm de flay bɔt natin bɛtɛ nɔ de apin to mi.
Di de dɛn kin flay lɛk aw bot kin pas kwik kwik na wata; ɔ lɛk aw ak kin flay kam dɔŋ we i si fɔl pikin.
If a tɛl PAPA GƆD se a nɔ de se natin igen, a go smayl ɛn mek lɛk natin nɔ bi,
a de fred se ɔda tin dɛn go bi to mi, bikɔs i go se a dɔn du sɔntin bad.
Yu we na PAPA GƆD go stil se a du rɔŋ; wetindu a fɔ de fos se a de agyu.
If a was na ɛni wata, ɔ was mi an wit karozin,
yu go stil ib mi insay dip ol, ɛn mi yon klos sɛf nɔ go wan si mi.
If PAPA GƆD na bin mɔtalman lɛk mi fɔ agyu wit, wi bin fɔ go kot mek dɛn jɔj wi kes.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ go de fɔ jɔj bitwin wi tu, we fit fɔ tɔk dis kes.
A de beg PAPA GƆD fɔ lɛf fɔ pɔnish mi, ɛn lɛf fɔ mek a fred so.
Datɛnde, a nɔ go fred we a de tɔk, bikɔs nɔto so a tan.
A dɔn taya wit layf; a go lɛ PAPA GƆD no wetin de na mi at fɔ am; lɛ i no aw mi at de blid.
A go tɛl PAPA GƆD se, mek i nɔ se a gilti; lɛ i mek a no wetin a du rɔŋ.
Us bɛnifit yu de gɛt fɔ trit pɔsin bad, fɔ pwɛl yu yon wok ɛn lɛf bad pipul fɔ du wetin dɛn wan du?
Yu de luk tin naw lɛk aw mɔtalman de luk tin? Ɔ na aw mɔtalman de ɔndastand, yu de ɔndastand naw?
Yu layf shɔt naw lɛk mɔtalman, ɔ yu nɔ de liv lɔŋ lɛk mɔtalman,
we mek yu de fɛn fɔlt pan mi ɛn se a dɔn sin,
ivin we yu no se a nɔ du natin rɔŋ, ɛn pɔsin nɔ de we go pul mi na yu an?
Na yu mek mi aw a tan; bɔt naw, yu wan tɔn bak ɛn dɔnawe wit mi.
Nɔ fɔgɛt se na dɔti yu tek mek mi, Yuwan mek a tɔn dɔti bak?
Noto yu tɔn mi insay mi mama bɛlɛ lɛk milk, ɛn mek a tɔn lɛk chiz?
Yu kɔba mi bon wit flɛsh ɛn kanda afta yu dɔn mek mi bon ɛn mɔsul go usay dɛn fɔ de.
Yu gi mi layf ɛn sho mi lɔv we nɔ de chenj; ɛn na dis lɔv mek a de te tide.
Bɔt yu nɔ mek a no wetin de na yu at; a bin no se yu de plan difrɛn tin dɛn fɔ mi.
Yu bin de wach mi mek a nɔ sin, so dat if a sin, yu go se a gilti.
If a de du bad, mek a alaki! If a du wetin rayt sɛf, a de shem fɔ dat, bikɔs na soso disgres de mit mi, ɛn a de tink bɔt aw a de sɔfa.
If a du ɛnitin we fɔ mek a gladi, yu de fɛn mi lɛk layɔn fɔ dɔnawe wit mi, ɛn ivin de pafɔm mirekul we kin mek a sɔfa;
yu de fɛn difrɛn we fɔ atak mi, ɛn de vɛks vɛks pan mi; ɛn plan nyu we fɔ atak mi.
Wetin mek yu mek a bɔn? A wish a bin dɔn day bifo ɛnibɔdi si mi,
lɛ i bi lɛk a nɔ bɔn kam na wɔl sɛf, bikɔs dɛn bɛr mi as a bɔn so.
Na shɔt tɛm nɔmɔ a gɛt fɔ liv. Lɛf mi to misɛf mek a gɛt alafia
bifo a go na di land we na soso daknɛs ful de ɛn nɔ kam bak,
di land we nɔ gɛt ɔda, usay layt nɔ de, na dak di ples dak nɔmɔ.
Dɛn Zofa we na Neamathayt ansa se:
Noto fɔ lɛf yu fɔ de tɔk bɔku mɔnɔmɔnɔ, ɛn dat nɔ go mek yu rayt.
Noto di bɔku tɔk we yu de pan, go mek wi nɔ tɔk, ɛn if yu de provok wi, wi go ansa yu.
Yu de tɔk se yu nɔ du natin ɛn yu an klin bifo PAPA GƆD.
A wish PAPA GƆD insɛf kin kam tɔk to yu, ɛn lɛ insɛf opin in mɔt ɛn tɔk to yu,
so dat in go tɛl yu ɔl wetin ayd bɔt am we yu nɔ no! Bikɔs PAPA GƆD gɛt difrɛn we aw i de wok. Yu fɔ no se, PAPA GƆD nɔ de pɔnish yu lɛk aw i fɔ pɔnish yu.
Pɔsin nɔ ebul fɔ ɔndastand PAPA GƆD. Yu nɔ go ebul fɔ no aw PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti de wok.
PAPA GƆD in sɛns pas usay ɛvin de, wi nɔ go ɛva ebul ɔndastand am. PAPA GƆD in sɛns dip lɛk di say we dayman de go, wi nɔ go no de te wi day.
If wi wan mɛzhɔ am, i big pas di wanol wɔl, ɛn ivin wayd pas aw di si wayd.
If PAPA GƆD disayd fɔ arɛst pɔsin, ɛn mek kes fɔ am, udat go ebul tap am?
I no udat de lay; i de no wɛn pɔsin de mek am ful ɛn du wetin bad.
Fulman go gɛt sɛns wɛn wayl dɔŋki bigin biev lɛk mɔtalman.
If yu, Job, mek yu at rayt wit PAPA GƆD, opin yu an to am ɛn pre,
If yu de sin, disayd se yu go lɛf fɔ sin, ɛn nɔ tɔlaret pɔsin we de na yu os sɛf fɔ sin,
dɛn yu go gɛt op fɔ di bambay; ɛn yu nɔ go gɛt natin we yu de fred.
Da tɛm de, yu go fɔgɛt bɔt yu waala; i go tan lɛk we briz blo ɛn kɛr am go.
Datɛnde, na so yu go de shayn; daknɛt go tan lɛk santɛm fɔ yu.
Yu go gɛt kɔnfidɛns fɔ liv wit op; PAPA GƆD go mek natin nɔ du yu ɛn yu go rɛst wit kol at..
Yu go de wit kolat ɛn natin nɔ go mek yu fred; bɔku pipul go want mek yu ɛp dɛn.
Bad pipul nɔ go ɔndastand wetin de apin; dɛn nɔ go si rod fɔ kɔmɔt pan dɛn yon trɔbul, di op nɔmɔ we dɛn gɛt datɛnde, na fɔ mek dɛn day.
Job ansa se:
Na tru se na una sabi tɔk fɔ pipul, na una sabi ɔltin; wɛn una day, sɛns go day go wit una.
Misɛf gɛt sɛns lɛk una; a de tink lɛk aw una de tink. Ɔlman no ɔl wetin una dɔn tɔk.
Mi padi dɛn ɔl dɔn tek mi mek rederaun; mi we bin de pre to PAPA GƆD ɛn i de ansa, mi we na bin gud man, na mi ɔlman de laf naw so.
Na we una nɔ gɛt wetin de mɔna una mek una de laf mi; una jɛs de mek tin wɔs fɔ mi.
Tifman we de fɔ atak ɔda pipul de na dɛn os wit kolat, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de ambɔg pɔsin we PAPA GƆD de vɛks pan ɔltɛm, dɛn kin fil se dɛn trɛnk nain na dɛn gɔd.
Aks di bist dɛn fɔ tich yu bɔt PAPA GƆD; aks dɛn bɔd sɛf we de flay, ɛn dɛnsɛf go tɛl yu;
if yu tɔk to di plant dɛn we de gro na grɔn sɛf, dɛn go tich yu; ɛn di fish dɛn na wata sɛf go tɔk bɔt PAPA GƆD to yu.
Us wan pan dɛn nɔ no se, na PAPA GƆD du ɔl dat?
Nain de kɔntrol layf ɛn di blo we mɔtalman de blo.
Aw pɔsin de tes it fɔ no if i gud ɔ bad, na so i de lisin fɔs fɔ no wetin na tru.
Ol pipul gɛt sɛns ɛn ɛkspiriɛns dɔn mek dɛn ɔndastand bɔku tin.
PAPA GƆD no ɔltin ɛn i gɛt pawa, i no wetin i de du ɛn ɔndastand ɔltin.
If i pwɛl sɔntin, nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul mek am bak; ɛn we i lɔk ɛni do, nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul opin am.
If i se ren nɔ de kam, ɔltin go dray; if i want di ples fɔ flɔd igen, i go pwɛl di land.
PAPA GƆD pawaful ɛn i de dɔnawe wit in ɛnimi; i de kɔntrol di wan we de rog ɛn di wan we dɛn de rog.
I de lɛ bigman waka ɛmti fut, ɛn mek dɛn biev lɛk fulman.
I de mek kiŋ dɛn pul di tin dɛn we de sho se dɛn gɛt pawa, ɛn wɛr krubɔmbɔ na dɛn wes lɛk jelman.
I de pul di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na dɛn pozishɔn, i de pul pawa na di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa dɛn an.
I de mek di wan dɛn we kin tɔk tru nɔ ebul fɔ tɔk, ɛn mek ol pipul nɔ no wetin rayt frɔm rɔŋ.
I de provok udat na aristo, ɛn mek trɛnkman dɛn trɛnk dɔn.
I de mek tin dɛn we pipul nɔ no se de bi, kam na layt.
I de mek neshɔn gro, ɛn i de dɔnawe wit dɛn: i de mek di neshɔn dɛn big ɛn mek dɛn skata bak.
I de mek di wan dɛn we de rul tɔn fulman, ɛn mek dɛn de wirɔn ɔlɔbɔt.
Dɛn jɛs de pas pas lɛk udat blɛn we nɔ de si; ɛn dɛn de staga lɛk drɔnkɔman.
Bo, a dɔn si ɔl wetin de bi so bifo, ɛn a dɔn yɛri ɛn ɔndastand ɔl wetin una dɔn se.
A no ɔl wetin una no. Una nɔ pas mi o.
Bɔt a go tɔk to di Ɔlmayti, A wan agyu mi kes wit PAPA GƆD
As fɔ una, una jɛs de kɔba tin we una nɔ ɔndastand wit bɔku bɔku lay; una na lɛk dɔkta we de gi mɛrɛsin we nɔ de mɛn.
If una sɛt una mɔt, pipul dɛn go fil se una na pipul dɛn we gɛt bɔku sɛns.
Una lisin mi agyumɛnt ɛn wetin mi de aks se fɔ bi.
Wetindu una de lay fɔ PAPA GƆD ɛn wetindu una de lay gi mi?
Una de tray fɔ tɔk fɔ PAPA GƆD? Una go ebul tɔk fɔ PAPA GƆD?
Una fil se una go fri if PAPA GƆD chɛk una layf, ɔ una fil se una go lay gi am lɛk we una kin lay gi mɔtalman?
I lɛk una ayd una badat PAPA GƆD go mɔs pɔnish una fɔ wetin una dɔn du.
Una go fred am bikɔs i gret ɛn pawaful.
Una parebul dɛn jɛs tan lɛk asis, ɛn una agyumɛnt wik lɛk kle.
Una sɛt mɔt mek a tɔk; ɛnitin we gɛt fɔ bi to mi, mek i bi.
A rɛdi fɔ ɛnitin, ivin if a gɛt fɔ risk mi layf.
A nɔ bisin bɔt natin igen na dis wɔl, bikɔs a no se PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ kil mi, bɔt a go tɛl am wetin de na mi at.
Na we a gɛt maynd fɔ tɔk to am mek i go sev mi, bikɔs bad pipul nɔ go gɛt maynd fɔ tinap bifo am.
Una lisin gud wetin a de se, ɛn lɛ i de na una ed.
A dɔn rɛdi fɔ tɔk fɔ misɛf ɛn a no se a go klia mi nem.
Udat go go tinap agens mi pan dis kes, na yu PAPA GƆD? If na yu, a go jɛs fɔgɛt bɔt ɔltin ɛn day saful.
A wan lɛ yu du tu tin fɔ mi, If yu du dɛn fɔ mi, a go rɛdi fɔ go tinap bifo yu fɔ yɛri wetin yu gɛt agens mi.
Wan, yu fɔ lɛf fɔ pɔnish mi, ɛn tu, nɔ mek a fred yu bikɔs yu fiaful.
So yu fɔs tɔk to mi ɛn a go ansa ɔ mek mi fɔs tɔk lɛ yu ansa.
Wetin ɛn wetin na di bad tin dɛn we a dɔn du ɛn a wan no if mi sin dɛn bɔku; lɛ a no mi sin dɛn we a dɔn kɔmit ɛn di bad tin dɛn we a dɔn du.
Wetindu yu de push mi kɔmɔt nia yu, ɛn wetindu yu de trit mi lɛk se mi ɛn yu na ɛnimi?
Yu de tray fɔ mek a fred yu, mi we tan jɛs lɛk lif bifo yu? If yu atak mi, i go jɛs tan lɛk we yu atak brumtik.
Di bad tin dɛn we yu tɔk se a du, mɔna mi; yu ivin tɔk bɔt di bad tin dɛn we a bin du we mi na bin yɔŋbɔy.
Yu chen mi fut ɛn de wach ɔl usay a de go, ɛn ivin de wach wetin a de du ɛn aw a de du an.
Na dat mek mɔtalman de wes lɛk tin we rɔtin, lɛk kot we mɔth kin dɔn it.
Ɔl mɔtalman we uman bɔn kam na dis wɔl in layf nɔ lɔŋ ɛn gɛt bɔku bɔku waala.
I kin bigin layf frɛsh wan lɛk flawa, bɔt kin wida leta; I kin jɛs lɔs lɛk shado ɛn yu nɔ si am igen
Na da kayn pɔsin de yu go luk yu fala am fɔ agyu?
Udat go ebul pul klin tin kɔmɔt pan tin we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD in yay? Nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul
Bikɔs in layf gɛt tɛm fɔ dɔn ɛn di tɛm we i fɔ liv fɔ, de na yu an, ɛn na yu dɔn pik di tɛm we in layf nɔ fɔ pas, we i fɔ day,
nɔ luk am ɛn nɔ notis am, so dat i go ɛnjɔy lɛk wokman we gɛt shɔt tɛm fɔ ɛnjɔy.
“Lɛk tik so, in abop, if yu kɔt am, i go gro bak, ɛn in rut nɔ de day.
Ɔl we in rut dɔn te na grɔn, ɛn di af we lɛf na grɔn dɔn day,
na fɔ lɛ smɔl wata mit am nɔmɔ, i go pul bɔd ɛn pul branch lɛk yɔŋ plant.
Bɔt mɔtalman de day ɛn dɛn mɔs bɛr am; we yu si mɔtalman blo in las blo, usay yu go si am igen?
Lɛk aw dɛn smɔl watasay dɛn wata kin dɔn, ɛn dɛn riva dɛn wata kin wes ɛn dray,
na so mɔtalman de day ɛn nɔ grap igen; te dis wɔl dɔn, i nɔ go wek, ɔ nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul wek am.
If yu kin ayd mi usay dɛn dayman dɛn de wet fɔ jɔjmɛnt, yu go dɔn ayd mi te yu at kol, ɛn yu go put yu yon tɛm we yu go mɛmba bɔt mi.
If mɔtalman day, i go kam bak na dis wɔl? A go bia di sɔfa te di tɛm we di sɔfa we a de sɔfa, go dɔn.
Yu go kɔl mi, ɛn a go ansa yu; yu go dɔn aŋri fɔ si di wan we na yu mek.
Na da tɛm de yu go waka wit mi na layf ɛn fɔgiv mi fɔ mi sin dɛn;
yu nɔ go si mi sin dɛn igen, ɛn yu go kɔba ɔl di bad tin dɛn we a dɔn du.
‘Bɔt dɛn il dɛn go fɔdɔm ɛn skata, ɛn dɛn big big ston dɛn rol kɔmɔt usay dɛn de;
di wata go was di ston te i dɔn, dɔn di wata in kɔrɛnt go was di dɔti go; na da kayn we de yu de mek mɔtalman in at pwɛl na layf.
Yu de yuz yu pawa pan am, ɛn i nɔ go de igen; i go chenj in fes ɛn day.
Ivin if in pikin dɛn gɛt big rɛspɛkt na layf, i nɔ go no natin; if na disgres sɛf mit dɛn, i nɔ go no natin bɔt dat.
Na di pen nɔmɔ nain bɔdi i go fil, ɛn nainsɛf nɔmɔ i go sɔri fɔ.”
Nain Ɛlifaz we na Timanayt ansa am se;
Pɔsin we gɛt sɛns go ansa tɔk we nɔ mek sɛns? I nɔ go opin in mɔt de tɔk fɔ natin.
I fɔ agyu fɔ tɔk we nɔ mek sɛns, ɔ tɔk tɔk we nɔ go min natin?
Yu de fɔgɛt bɔt di fred we yu fɔ fred PAPA GƆD, ɛn de pwɛl ɔl di pre we pipul de pre to PAPA GƆD.
Na di bad tin dɛn we de insay yu de kɔmɔt na yu mɔt, ɛn yu de tek sɛns tɔk dɛn.
Nɔto mi kɔndɛm yu o, na yu yon mɔt kɔndɛm yu; di wɔd we de kɔmɔt na yu mɔt sho se yu gilti.
Na yu na di fɔs pɔsin we PAPA GƆD put na dis wɔl? Adinɔ yu bin dɔn de ya bifo dɛn il dɛn.
Yu dɔn yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd? Adinɔ yu min se yu gɛt sɛns pas ɔlman.
Wetin de we yu no we wi nɔ no? Wetin de we yu ɔndastand we nɔ klia to wi?
Wi gɛt pipul dɛn we gɛt sɛns ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we dɔn ol, wit wi; dɛn olpas yu papa.
Di koks we PAPA GƆD de koks yu nɔ du fɔ yu? Adinɔ di fayn we, we wi de tɔk to yu, nɔ du fɔ yu?
Wetindu yu de mek yu at lay gi yu, ɛn wetindu yu de mek yu fes so,
we mek yu de vɛks pan PAPA GƆD te wɔd lɛkɛ dɛnwandɛnde, de kɔmɔt na yu mɔt?
Udat na mɔtalman we yu go se klin na PAPA GƆD yay, ɔ udat we uman bɔn kam na dis wɔl, we yu go se nɔ de du bad?
PAPA GƆD nɔ biliv nɔn pan di wan dɛn we de wok fɔ am, di wan dɛnsɛf we de na di ɛvin dɛn, nɔ klin nain yay;
bifo a se di wan dɛn we dɛn no fɔ wikɛdnɛs ɛn kɔrɔpshɔn, we de du bad lɛk we pɔsin de drink wata.
“A go sho yu, lisin mi, ɛn a go tɛl yu ɔl wetin a no bɔt layf,
(wetin dɛn pipul we gɛt bɔku sɛns bin de se we dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛn nɔ ayd pan dɛn,
We na dɛn nɔmɔ dɛn gi di land ɛn nɔn trenja nɔ de wit dɛn).
Wikɛd pipul dɛn de rol wit pen ol de, ɔl dɛn layf, te di tɛm rich we pɔsin we nɔ de fred fɔ du bad, fɔ day.
I de yɛri tin dɛn we de mek i fred bad bad wan; we i de ɛnjɔy insɛf, nain tifman dɛn go go atak am.
I nɔ biliv se in go ebul kɔmɔt pan da kayn layf de igen, ɛn de fred se dɛn go kil am.
I de waka ɔp ɛn dɔŋ de fɛn it, ɛn de aks se lɛ dɛn gi am. I no se in layf nɔ lɔŋ igen;
pwɛl at ɛn brok at de mek i fred; dɛn de mɔna am lɛk wan pawaful kiŋ we de rɛdi fɔ go fɛt.
Bikɔs i nɔ de wit PAPA GƆD, ɛn nɔ yɛri di Ɔlmayti in wɔd,
i sidɔm de mek prawd ɛn stɔbɔn agens PAPA GƆD, ɛn ol big shild nain an,
bikɔs in fes dɔn frɛsh ɛn i dɔn pul flɛsh nain sayd dɛn,
ɛn i dɔn de na siti we nɔbɔdi nɔ de, insay os dɛn we nɔ fit fɔ pɔsin fɔ tap, we i dɔn mak se dɛn go nyakanyaka;
i nɔ go gɛt fɔ lɔŋ, in jɛntri nɔ go las ɛn in jɛntri nɔ go go ɔlsay na di land;
i nɔ go ebul kɔmɔt na daknɛs ɛn ɔl wetin i abop pan nɔ go bɛtɛ, ɛn ɔl wetin i gɛda, go kɔmɔt nain an go fufafu.
Lɛ i nɔ put in at pan tin we nɔ go bɛnifit am; i go de lay gi insɛf; bikɔs dat nɔ go bɛnifit am.
PAPA GƆD go pe am we di tɛm rich; i go so bɔku dat ɔlsay nain layf go gɛt.
Dɛn go tan lɛk branch we ɔl in frut dɛn de fɔdɔm, ɛn lɛk ɔliv tik we ɔl in flawa dɔn fɔdɔm.
Bikɔs, usay pipul dɛn we nɔ no PAPA GƆD gɛda, natin bɛtɛ nɔ kin kɔmɔt insay de, ɛn na faya go bɔn di pipul dɛn we de tek brayb, dɛn os.
Na dɛn de tink bɔt bad na dɛn at, ɛn kin du bad bad tin; na dakadeke trik nɔmɔ de na dɛn at.
Job ansa se:
“A dɔn yɛri dɛn kayn tɔk de plɛnti plɛnti; una nɔn nɔ sabi koks pɔsin.
Dis mɔnɔmɔnɔ tɔk nɔ go dɔn naw? Wetin de push una fɔ tɔk dɛn kayn we ya?
Misɛf sabi tɔk so lɛk una, if na una bin de di we we a de so; misɛf ebul fɛn fɔlt pan una, ɛn shek mi ed se a de sɔri fɔ una.
A ebul tɔk to una mek una fil fayn, ɛn wetin a go tɛl una, go mek una fil se una nɔ de sɔfa igen
I lɛk a tɔk te, tɔk nɔ go mek di sɔfa we a de sɔfa dɔn, ɛn if a se a de bia, dat sɛf nɔ go ɛp mi.
Fɔ tru, PAPA GƆD dɔn mek a fil yuslɛs: I dɔn kil mi wanol famili.
Ɛn i dɔn mek a dɔn twis twis, we de sho se mi na sina; I mek a ridyus to bon bon, dat sɛf de sho na mi fes.
I chɛr chɛr mi lɛk aw dɛn wayl animal kin chɛr chɛr bif we dɛn kin kech, i et mi; i de luk mi lɛk i et mi; i de luk mi at at wan.
Pipul dɛn dɔn opin mɔt wit wɔnda we dɛn si mi, ɛn slap mi jɔ fɔ provok mi, ɛn gɛda rawnd mi fɔ atak mi.
PAPA GƆD gi mi to dɛn bad pipul dɛn, ɛn shub mi gi dɛn wikɛd pipul dɛn.
A bin de fayn fayn wan, nain PAPA GƆD kam nyakanyaka mi; I ol mi bay mi nɛk ɛn wap mi mek a skata; I tek mi mek tagɛt fɔ shut,
In man dɛn we de shut bo ɛn aro de rawnd mi, I chɛr mi kidni dɛn opin, ɛn nɔ sɔri fɔ mi; ɔl mi bita bita kɔmɔt insay mi bɛlɛ go na grɔn.
I wund wund mi bɔdi; I atak mi lɛk sojaman we dɔn vɛks pan in ɛnimi.
Na munin klos go bi mi sɛkɛn bɔdi, a dɔn giv ɔp ɛn nɔ ebul du natin igen
A dɔn kray te mi fes dɔn rɛd, mi yay kɔba ɛn a nɔ de si bɛtɛ;
ɔl we a nɔ du natin we go pwɛl mi prea.
Lɛ ɔl wetin a de sɔfa so nɔ ayd, ɛn mek a nɔ taya fɔ de kɔmplen.
We a de tɔk so, mi witnɛs de na Ɛvin, ɛn di wan we de tɔk fɔ mi de ɔp de.
Mi padi dɛn de laf mi ɛn na so a de kray to PAPA GƆD,
lɛ i gi mɔtalman in rayt fɔ de wit PAPA GƆD jɛs lɛk aw neba de to neba.
Bikɔs i nɔ go te igen, a go go bak usay a kɔmɔt.
Mi at dɔn pwɛl na dis wɔl, mi layf nɔ lɔŋ igen, mi grev de wet fɔ mi.
Fɔ tru, pipul dɛn de rawnd mi de provok mi, na so a kin de wach dɛn we dɛn de provok mi.
Apat frɔm yu, udat igen go bel mi, udat go bi mi shɔti?
Ɛnti na yu dɔn mek mi padi dɛn nɔ de ebul ɔndastand wetin de apin to mi, yu nɔ go gri mek dɛn win mi.
Da pɔsin we go pul in padi in sikrit mek in go gɛt pan in prɔpati, nain yon pikin dɛn go sɔfa.
I dɔn mek mi lɛk pipul dɛn chɔstik, ɛn dɛn nɔ want mi nia dɛn.
A dɔn kray tete a nɔ ebul si bɛtɛ igen, ɛn mi wanol bɔdi, nɔto mi yon.
Ɔnɛst pipul dɛn de shɔk ɛn wɔnda wetin de apin, ɛn di inosɛnt pipul dɛn nɔ de ɛnkɔrej dɛn pipul dɛn we nɔ no PAPA GƆD.
Di wan dɛn we de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD, stil de du dat, ɛn di wan dɛn we nɔ de du bad, de gud mɔ ɛvride.
I lɛk una ɔl kam bak, a nɔ go si wan pan una we gɛt sɛns.
Mi yon dɔn dɔn, mi plan dɛn ɔl dɔn kɔmɔt na mi at.
We nɛt kam, mi padi dɛn se na mɔnin, we mɔnin kam, dɛn se na nɛt.
If a tek usay dayman dɛn de wet jɔjmɛnt fɔ bi mi os, if a day go,
if a tɛl di grev se in na mi papa, ɛn kɔl di tumbu dɛn mi mama ɛn sista dɛn,
bɛtɛ go de fɔ mi tumara? Udat go si bɛtɛ fɔ mi tumara?
I pɔsibul lɛ mi tumara go wit mi we a day? Na mi ɛn mi tumara dɛn go bɛr?
Bildad we na Shuayt ansa Job se:
Ustɛm yu go lɛf fɔ tɔk tɔk? We yu lɛf fɔ tɔk tɔk, datɛnde wi go tɔk.
Wetindu yu de trit wi lɛk wi ful lɛk kaw? Wetindu yu de si wi lɛk fulman dɛn?
Na we yu vɛks te yu ambɔg yusɛf pipul dɛn fɔ kɔmɔt lɛf di wɔl fɔ seka yu, adinɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ brok ɔl dɛn il fɔ mek yu at kol?
I lɛk wetin yu tink, wikɛd pipul dɛn kyandul kin ɔt, ɛn dɛn layt nɔ go shayn.
I go tan lɛk os we layt nɔ de, ɛn di lamp we yu de tek rid ɔl go ɔt.
I go lɔs kɔnfidɛns na layf ɛn nain yon plan dɛn kin kɔz in dawnfɔl.
Nain yon fut i go tek waka go insay trap, ɛn di trap go ol am tayt.
Di trap go ol in bak fut ɛn di trap go ol am tayt.
Dɛn go tay slipul nɔt wit rop put na grɔn fɔ am, dɛn go put trap na rod fɔ am.
Ɔltɛm bad bad tin dɛn de skyad am, dɛn de rɔnata am ɛnisay i go.
Aŋri dɔn dɔn ɔl in trɛnk, ɛn wahala rɛdi fɔ mit am ɛni tɛm.
Na sik go pwɛl in bɔdi, ɛn na bad bad infɛkshɔn go it ɔl in an ɛn fut.
Day go pul am kɔmɔt nain os we i bin biliv, ɛn kɛr am go na grev.
Ɛnibɔdi kin tap nain os; dɛn sprinkul sɔlfa nain os fɔ pul di infɛkshɔn kɔmɔt de.
I go tan lɛk tik we in rut ɔl dray ɔnda am, ɛn in branch dɛn ɔl wida wida.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ go mɛmba am igen na dis wɔl, ɛn in nem sɛf dɛn nɔ go kɔl na trit.
Dɛn gɛda am kɔmɔt na layt ɛn ib am na dak ɛn drɛb am kɔmɔt na dis wɔl.
I nɔ bɔn nɔn pikin ɛn nɔ gɛt nɔn in blɔd we i day lɛf, ɛn i nɔ day lɛf nɔbɔdi usay i bin de.
Di pipul dɛn na di wɛst fred, ɛn di pipul dɛn na di ist trimbul we dɛn yɛri bɔt am.
Fɔ tru, na so i kin bi wit pipul dɛn we nɔ biliv PAPA GƆD, na so pipul dɛn we nɔ no PAPA GƆD kin ɛnd.
Job ansa am se:
Aw lɔŋ una go tɔmɛnt mi ɛn nyakanyaka mi wit wetin una de se?
Una jɛs sidɔm de kɔs kɔs mi frɔm aw lɔŋ; una nɔ de shem fɔ jɛs de kɔs mi?
Ivin if na tru se a du sɔntin bad, na misɛf a du.
If de lɛk tide, una de mek big pan mi, ɛn de agyu wit mi se na mi kɔz mi disgres,
no se na PAPA GƆD mek ɔl dis de apin; i dɔn kech mi nain trap.
Ɔl we a de ala se dɛn de kil mi, nɔbɔdi nɔ ansa mi; a ala te, bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ fɛt fɔ mi.
I dɔn blɔk mi so dat a nɔ go ebul du natin, i dɔn mek ɔlsay blɔk pan mi.
I dɔn mek a dɔn lɔs ɔl di jɛntri we a bin gɛt; ɔl mi rɛspɛkt dɔn dɔn.
I dɔn mi kpatakpata; ɔltin we a abop pan dɔn rut kɔmɔt lɛk we dɛn kin rut tik.
I dɔn mek wamat pan mi ɛn na mi i tek mek ɛnimi.
I sɛn in sojaman dɛn fɔ kam atak mi; dɛn dig gɔta fɔ ebul pas kam mit mi, ɛn le ambush rawnd mi os.
I dɔn mek mi brɔda dɛn ɔl dɔn shub fa frɔm mi, ɛn mi padi dɛn nɔ want mi biznɛs igen
Di wan dɛn we mi ɛn dɛn kɔmɔt di sem fambul, dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn mi;
di trenja dɛn we de na mi os dɔn fɔgɛt bɔt mi; mi wokuman dɛn na mi os de trit mi lɛk trenja; dɛn si mi lɛk pɔsin we dɛn nɔ no wande
Mi yon wokman nɔ gri ansa mi we a kɔl am; pas a opin mɔt beg am.
Mi wɛf nɔ ebul bia mi stɛnch mi yon bɛlɛ bɔn brɔda dɛn nɔ ebul bia mi.
Ivin dɛn lili pikin dɛn de laf mi; ɛnisay a go, dɛn de drɛb mi.
Mi tayt padi dɛn nɔ want natin fɔ du wit mi, di wan dɛn we a bin lɛk dɔn tɔn pan mi.
Mi bon dɛn dɔn fasin na mi kanda ɛn mi flɛsh, ɛn lilibit mɔ, a bin fɔ day.
Una sɔri fɔ mi, mi padi dɛn, una sɔri fɔ mi, bikɔs na PAPA GƆD in an dɔn wap mi dɔŋ.
Wetindu una de biev lɛk PAPA GƆD fɔ de fasin mi? I nɔ du we una provok mi?
A wish pɔsin bin de rayt ɔl wetin a de tɔk so! A wish dɛn bin de rayt am na buk!
A wish dɛn bin tek chisul de rayt am na ston we go de sote go.
Bikɔs a no se di wan we go pe fɔ mi, de; i nɔ day, a no se di de go kam we i go tinap fɔ mi na dis wɔl;
ɛn we mi kanda go dɔn pwɛl, a go si PAPA GƆD insay dis bɔdi,
we go tinap fɔ mi ɛn na im semwan a go si, nɔto ɔda wan. A dɔn fred!
If yu se aw wi go ebul du am bad! Ɛn nainsɛf kɔz in prɔblɛm!
Una rɛdi fɔ di sɔd, bikɔs sin de mek PAPA GƆD vɛks ɛn pɔnish pɔsin, so dat yu go no se, pɔnishmɛnt de fɔ sin.
Nain Zofa we na Neamathayt ansa se:
Wetin yu se dɔn mek mi fuk fuk grap, so mek a ansa yu wantɛm.
A yɛri yu se sɔm fityay tin dɛn, bɔt a go ebul ansa yu bikɔs mi na man we gɛt sɛns.
Yu nɔ no se frɔm we di wɔl bigin, frɔm di tɛm we mɔtalman kam na dis wɔl,
bad pɔsin at nɔ kin swit fɔ lɔŋ, ɛn pɔsin we nɔ no PAPA GƆD sɛf na fɔ lili tɛm nɔmɔ?
I lɛk sɛf i gɛt pawa te rich ɔp di skay ɛn in ed de tɔch di klawd dɛn,
briz go blo am go lɛk dɔst, di wan dɛn we bin no am go aks usay i go.
Dɛn go fɔgɛt bɔt am lɛk drim: i go lɔs lɛk tin dɛn we pɔsin kin si we i de slip.
Ɔl di wan dɛn we bin de si am, nɔ go si am igen, in wɛf ɛn pikin dɛnsɛf nɔ go si am igen
In pikin dɛn go go fɛn gudnem to di po pipul dɛn, ɛn gi dɛn ɔl wetin dɛn papa bin dɔn tif na dɛn an.
I go yɔŋ ɛn traŋa so, bɔt i go day go nain grev wit ɔl in trɛnk.
Ɔlwe we wikɛdnɛs swit lɛk shuga nain mɔt, ɔlwe we i ayd am ɔnda in siti,
ɔlwe we i nɔ gri pit am, i kip am nain mɔt,
di it we i de it kin bita nain bɛlɛ; i kin tan lɛk bita bita pɔyzin insay am.
I kin swɛla jɛntri ɛn vɔmit am bak; na PAPA GƆD kin pul am kɔmɔt nain bɛlɛ.
Di tin dɛn we dɛn kin swɛla, kin tɔn snek pɔyzin, i go kil am lɛk we snek bɛt kin kil pɔsin.
I nɔ go tes pan di plɛnti plɛnti blɛsin we PAPA GƆD de gi; blɛsin we de kam lɛk we big watasay de rɔn.
I go gi bak ɔl wetin i dɔn wok fɔ, i nɔ go ɛnjɔy natin; pan di prɔfit we i gɛt pan in biznɛs, i nɔ go ɛnjɔy natin.
Bikɔs i dɔn nyakanyaka po man ɛn fɔgɛt bɔt am, i dɔn siz os we nɔto in bil.
Bikɔs in nɔ de satisfay, i nɔ ivin ebul kip wetin i want.
I awaŋɔt, so in jɛntri nɔ go las.
I lɛk uskayn jɛntri i gɛt, in at nɔ go ɛva swit; i go sɔfa ɔl kayn mɔnɛ.
Fɔ lɛ i bɛlful gud, PAPA GƆD go vɛks pɔnish am ɛn na dat go bi in it.
I go rɔnawe lɛ ayɛn wɛpɔn nɔ kil am, bɔt bras aro go kil am.
Aro go bɔs in bɔdi, Di shap pat we de shayn bɔs kɔmɔt nain bita bita; i go trimbul wit fred.
Dɛn go pul ɔl in prɔpati nain an ɛn pwɛl am kpata kpata; na faya we nɔto mɔtalman de blo, go kil am; i go bɔn ɔl di pipul ɛn tin dɛn we i lɛf nain os.
We di bad bad tin dɛn we i bin de du sho na di klawd di pipul dɛn na wɔl go grap ɛn kɔndɛm am.
Dɛn go tek ɔl wetin i gɛt, dɛn go drɛg ɔltin go di de we PAPA GƆD go vɛks.
Na so PAPA GƆD kin trit wikɛd pɔsin, na so i dɔn se fɔ trit dɛn.
Job ansa se;
Una tek tɛm lisin wetin a de se, ɛn na dɛn kayn we ya una fɔ koks mi.
Una peshɛnt wet lɛ a tɔk dɔn, datɛnde, una kin kɔntinyu de provok mi.
Na mɔtalman a de kɔmplen bɔt? A gɛt rayt fɔ vɛks?
Tink bɔt di we we PAPA GƆD trit mi, datɛnde, una go jɛs sɛt una mɔt.
We a kin mɛmba, mi at kin pwɛl, a kin bigin trimbul.
Wetindu wikɛd pipul dɛn kin te na wɔl? Gɛt lɔŋ layf ɛn pawa.
Dɛn kin liv lɔŋ fɔ si dɛn pikin dɛn tɔn bigman ɛn uman, dɛn kin si dɛn grampikin dɛn ɔl.
Dɛn nɔ gɛt natin fɔ fred we dɛn de na dɛn os dɛn, ɛn PAPA GƆD nɔ de pɔnish dɛn.
We di man kaw dɛn trɛd di kaw dɛm, dɛn de bɔn; dɛn nɔ de miskari.
