Dɛn pikin dɛn ɔl kin de togɛda, ɛn dɛn kin ɛnjɔy dɛnsɛf.
Dɛn kin bit bata ɛn ple ap we dɛn de siŋ ɛn kin gladi mɔ we dɛn kin yɛri trɔmpɛt.
Dɛn kin gɛt ɔltin we dɛn want te dɛn day, ɛn kin day wit kolat go usay dɛn dayman de wet jɔjmɛnt.
Dɛn kin tɛl PAPA GƆD se lɛ i lɛf dɛn aw dɛn de so, dɛn nɔ wan no bɔt am.
Udat na PAPA GƆD we wi fɔ sav am? Wetin wi go prɔfit if wi pre to am.
Dɛn biliv se ɔlman in bɛtɛ wande nain an. Mi nɔ biliv da kayn tin de we wikɛd pipul dɛn biliv.
Ɔmɔs tɛm yu dɔn yɛri se wikɛd pɔsin jɛs day so? Ɔ wahala mit dɛn? Ɔ PAPA GƆD vɛks pɔnish wikɛd pɔsin?
Dɛn tan lɛk brumtik na briz, ɛn lɛk chaf chaf we big briz kin blo kɛr go.
Una se PAPA GƆD go pɔnish dɛn pikin dɛn fɔ wetin dɛn du. Lɛ i pɔnish dɛnsɛf lɛ dɛn no se nain pɔnish dɛn.
Lɛ dɛnsɛf sɔfa dɛn pɔnishmɛnt ɛn lɛ dɛn tes wetin kin bi we PAPA GƆD vɛks.
Wans pɔsin dɔn day, i nɔ no natin bɔt in famili igen; dɛn it o, dɛn nɔ it o, i nɔ go no.
Ɛnibɔdi go ebul tich PAPA GƆD, in we de jɔj dɛn big ɛn pawaful pipul dɛn?
Sɔm pipul dɛn de day wit wɛl bɔdi bikɔs dɛn bin gɛt kol at,
dɛn bɔdi kin fat so, di bif we de insay in bon kin gɛt ɔyl.
Ɔda wan dɛn kin day wit brok at; dɛn nɔ ɛva ɛnjɔy na layf.
Na dɔti dɛn ɔl kin go ɛn na di sem tumbu kin it dɛn.
A no wetin una de tink, ɛn a no di plan we una gɛt fɔ du mi bad.
Bikɔs una de aks se usay dɛn pipul we gɛt pawa de? Dɛn wikɛd pipul dɛn.
Una nɔ dɔn aks pipul dɛn we de travul bay rod ɛn una nɔ biliv wetin dɛn tɛl una,
se, natin nɔ kin du wikɛd pɔsin we trɔbul kin fɔdɔm ɛn PAPA GƆD kin kɔba dɛn we i vɛks pɔnish pipul dɛn?
Udat gɛt maynd fɔ tɛl am bɔt wetin i du ɛn udat gɛt maynd fɔ tɔn am gi am bak.
We dɛn bɛr wikɛd pɔsin nain grev, pipul dɛn kin de gyad am.
Di dɔti we dɛn tek kɔba am kin swit to am; ɔlman gɛt fɔ day lɛk am, ɛn di wan dɛn we dɔn day bifo am, plɛnti te yu nɔ go ebul kɔnt.
Aw naw una de kam koks mi wit ɛmti nɔnsɛns tɔk? Nɔn we nɔ de we una go ansa mi pas una lay.
Nain Ɛlifaz we na Timanayt ansa se:
Aw mɔtalman go ebul ɛp PAPA GƆD? Fɔ tru, pɔsin we gɛt sɛns go bɛnifit insɛf.
Ɔlmayti PAPA GƆD go gladi if yu de waka tret, ɔ i go bɛnifit PAPA GƆD if yu tap fɔ sin sin?
Yu tink se na bikɔs yu de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD mek i de pɔnish yu, ɛn ivin kɛr yu go kot?
Yu nɔ dɔn du bɔku bɔku bad tin? Yu na bad bad sina.
Yu dɔn fos yu brɔda dɛn fɔ plɛj dɛn klos to yu fɔ natin, ɛn mek dɛn waka nekɛd.
Yu nɔ bin de gi pipul dɛn we taya wata, ɛn nɔ bin de gi aŋri pipul it.
Di man we gɛt pawa go tek di land ɛn na di wan dɛn we i lɛk, go tap de.
We dɛn uman dɛn we dɛn man dɔn day go to yu, yu nɔ gi dɛn natin, ɛn yu tif ɔltin na dɛn pikin we dɛn papa dɔn day, dɛn an.
Na dat mek yu gɛt waala, na dat mek yu de fred bad bad wan.
Di ples so dak dat yu nɔ ebul si, ɛn wata dɔn kɔba yu.
Nɔto ɔp na ɛvin PAPA GƆD tap? Jɛs luk aw fa di sta dɛn de.
So yu de se PAPA GƆD nɔ de si yu; Yu de se aw i go ebul si wetin yu de du insay ɔl da dak klawd de we i de.
Ɔl rawnd am na tik tik klawd, so i nɔ de si natin. I de waka ɔp na di klawd.
Yu dɔn mek ɔp yu maynd fɔ de lɛk dɛn fɔstɛm wikɛd pipul?
Dɛn day bifo tɛm; dɛn nɔ gɛt chans fɔ sidɔm na dis wɔl.
Dɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD se mek i kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn, ɛn wetin Ɔlmayti PAPA GƆD ebul du dɛn.
Pan ɔl dat, i gi dɛn ɔltin- bɔt a nɔ ebul ɔndastand aw wikɛd pipul dɛn de tink.
Gud pipul dɛn kin gladi we PAPA GƆD kin pɔnish wikɛd pipul; inosɛnt pipul dɛn kin ridikul dɛn to nɔnsɛns..
Dɛn kin se PAPA GƆD dɔn mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn day ɛn faya dɔn bɔn ɔl wetin dɛn day lɛf.
Gri wit PAPA GƆD mek yu at kol; yu go si di gud tin dɛn we go bi to yu.
Du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD se ɛn kip in wɔd na yu at.
If yu put yusɛf dɔŋ ɛn go bak to PAPA GƆD, if yu mek yu os klin na PAPA GƆD yay,
if yu fɔgɛt bɔt yu jɛntri, yu gold ɛn dayamɔn we dɛn de fɛn ɔnda wata,
ɛn if PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti bi yu gold, ɛn yu silva we yu lɛk;
datɛnde yu go put ɔl yu maynd to PAPA GƆD we gɛt pawa pas ɔlman, ɛn i go mek yu layf swit ɛn yu at go klin fɔ am.
We yu pre to am, i go yɛri yu; datɛnde yu go du wetin yu prɔmis am se yu go du.
Ɛnitin we yu plan fɔ du go bɛtɛ, ɛn dɛn go si PAPA GƆD pan yu ɛnisay yu go.
PAPA GƆD kin put prawd pɔsin dɔŋ, bɔt i kin sev di wan dɛn we nɔ prawd.
I nɔ de gri lɛ inosɛnt man gɛt trɔbul, ɛn if yu an klin, i go sev yu.
Job ansa Se:
Tide igen, a gɛt bita bita kɔmplen; pan ɔl we a de kɔmplen bɔt PAPA GƆD, i stil de pɔnish mi bad bad wan.
Eya, if a bin no usay fɔ fɛn am, mek a go tinap bifo am nain kot os.
A go le mi kes bifo am, ɛn a go tɔk fɔ misɛf.
A go yɛri wetin i gɛt fɔ se so a go ɔndastand wetin apin.
I go tek advantej pan mi bikɔs i gɛt pawa pas mi? A nɔ tink so; i go mɔs lisin to mi.
A biliv se tret pɔsin go ebul tɔk wit am lɛ i si rizin, ɛn in we na mi jɔj go fri mi sote go.
A dɔn luk na di ist, i nɔ de de; a go na di wɛst, a nɔ si am;
a luk fɔ am na mi lɛfan, a nɔ ebul si am; a tɔn to mi raytan, a nɔ ebul si am.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD no usay a go ebul fɛn am; we i dɔn tɛst mi dɔn, i go si se a klin lɛk gold.
Naim a biliv na layf ɛn a dɔn waka tret wit am ɔl mi layf.
A de du ɔl wetin i se fɔ du, ɛn in wɔd de insay mi at.
Bɔt i nɔ de chenj; udat ebul chenj am? Na wetin i wan du i de du.
I go du ɔl wetin i plan fɔ du na mi layf, ɛn ɔl di ɔda tin dɛn we i plan fɔ du.
So a go fred fɔ tinap bifo am; we a luk insay de, a de fred am.
PAPA GƆD dɔn mek a wida; di Ɔlmayti dɔn mek a trimbul wit fred;
di ples ɔl dak rawnd mi ɛn a stil de kray.
Wetindu PAPA GƆD nɔ go pik tɛm fɔ jɔj wikɛd pipul, ɛn wetin mek i nɔ go mek di wan dɛn we de sav am, si we i de jɔj dɛn?
Pipul dɛn de shub bekin na land; dɛn de tif dɛn kɔmpin ship ɛn mɛn dɛn.
Dɛn de tif pikin we in papa dɔn day, in dɔŋki; ɛn de tek uman we in man dɔn day in kaw, fɔ lɛn am mɔni.
Dɛn push poman kɔmɔt na rod; ɔl di poman dɛn na di wɔl de ayd.
Lɛk dɛn bush dɔŋki dɛn na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, di poman de go fɛn dɛn an-to-mɔt, dɛn de luk fɔ tin fɔ it na di dray ples, tin we dɛn pikin dɛn go it.
Adship mek dɛn de fɛn tin fɔ it na pipul fam ɛn de pik di af af tin dɛn we kin lɛf we wikɛd pipul dɛn dɔn avɛst.
Dɛn de slip nekɛd bikɔs dɛn nɔ gɛt klos.
Kol mawnten ren de bit dɛn, ɛn dɛn kin grip bi big ston fɔ wam dɛn bɔdi bikɔs dɛn nɔ gɛ os.
(Di wan dɛn de we de siz pikin na bɔbi we dɛn papa dɔn day, ɛn de ol pikin fɔ lɛnt dɛn pipul dɛn mɔni.)
Dɛn de wɔndrin ɔp ɛn dɔŋ nekɛd skin; dɛn de tot pipul dɛn rɛs wit aŋri bɛlɛ;
dɛn de nia di wikɛd pipul dɛn ɔliv tik dɛn de kwis ɔyl kɔmɔ pan di frut; dɛn de kwis wayn kɔmɔt pan greps, bɔt tɔsti de kil dɛn.
Insay di siti, pipul dɛn we wund ɛn de day, de pini, di wan we wund de kray mek dɛn ɛp am, bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ de braskitul dɛn.
Pipul dɛn de we et di layt, we nɔ no wetin i tinap fɔ ɛn nɔ de waka nain rod.
Di mɔdra de grap na nɛt so dat i go go kil po pipul we nɔ gɛt natin; dɛn na lɛk tifman na nɛt.
Di pɔsin we de lɛf in man ɔ wɛf go to ɔda pɔsin, kin wet fɔ nɛt, ɛn kin se nɔbɔdi nɔ de si am; i kin kɔba in fes mek dɛn nɔ no se na im.
Na nɛt, dɛn de bɔs pipul os go insay; santɛm, dɛn kin ayd na os; dɛn nɔ no aw santɛm tan.
Na nɛt na dɛn yon santɛm; bikɔs dɛn ɛn nɛt na padi. Dɛn nɔ de fred natin.
Yu se we sɔntin apin, i izi lɛ wikɛd pipul sɔfa; PAPA GƆD dɔn swɛ dɛn land; treda dɛn nɔ de go bay na dɛn fam.
Lɛk we ɔt ples kin swɛla ren wata, na so di ples we pipul kin wet fɔ jɔjmɛnt kin swɛla dɛn sina dɛn.
Dɛn mama dɛnsɛf we bɔn dɛn, dɔn fɔgɛt bɔt dɛn; dɛn nɔ de mɛmba dɛn nem dɛnsɛf; so wikɛdnɛs kin nyamanyama lɛk we tik brok.
Dɛn kin tek tin dɛn na uman we nɔ de bɔn, in an, ɛn nɔ de du gud to uman we i man dɔn day.
Pan ɔl dat, PAPA GƆD de gi pipul dɛn we gɛt pawa, lɔŋ layf; ɛn kin tinap fɔ dɛn we dɛn at pwɛl na layf.
I de kɔba dɛn ɛn sɔpɔt dɛn, ɛn de si ɔl wetin dɛn de du.
Dɛn kin shek tel fɔ shɔt tɛm nɔmɔ, dɔn dɛn day; dɛn kin day go lɛk gras, lɛk rɛs ed we dɛn kɔt put dɔŋ.
If nɔto tru a tɔk, lɛ sɔmbɔdi tɛl mi se na lay a lay; lɛ i pruv se na nɔnsɛns tɔk a tɔk.
Bildad we na shuayt ansa se:
“Ɔl di pawa ɛn rɛspɛkt na dis wɔl, de na PAPA GƆD in an. I mek shɔ se pis de na ɛvin.
Ɛnibɔdi ebul kɔnt PAPA GƆD in sojaman dɛn? Udat de we PAPA GƆD in layt nɔ de shayn pan?
Aw naw yu go se mɔtalman gud bifo PAPA GƆD? Aw yu go se mɔtalman we uman bɔn, klin na PAPA GƆD in yay?
Di mun we na di mun nɔ brayt, ɛn di sta dɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD in yay;
aw bɔt mɔtalman we na tumbu, ɛn di wan dɛn we mɔtalman bɔn we na rɔrɔm!”
Job ansa se:
E padi, yu dɔn ɛp pɔsin we nɔ gɛt pawa! Yu dɔn ɛp pɔsin we nɔ ebul du natin!
Yu dɔn gi pɔsin we nɔ gɛt sɛns gud advays, ɛn yu dɔn gi bɔku bɔku sɛns!
Udat gi yu ɔl da sɛns de ɛn udat mek yu tɔk ɔl dɛn tɔk de?
Dɛn dayman dɛn spirit trimbul, ivin di si dɛn ɛn di wan dɛn we tap de.
PAPA GƆD no ɔltin bɔt usay dayman de go, i de si ɔltin.
I strɛch di skay go na di nɔth ɛn i nɔ ɛŋ di ath pan natin.
I put bɔku bɔku wata insay di klawd, bɔt di wet nɔ bɔs di klawd.
I ayd di mun biɛn di klawd, i prɛd klawd oba am.
I mek sakul pantap di wata dɛn, fɔ sheb layt ɛn daknɛs.
Di pila dɛn we ol di skay trimbul ɛn fred we PAPA GƆD vɛks de tɔk.
I yuz in pawa fɔ mek di si nɔ muf, i tek in sɛns kil Reab.
I blo wit in mɔt we mek di skay klia, ɛn yuz in an fɔ kil da snek we bin de rɔnawe.
E! Dɛn wan ya na lilibit pan di tin dɛn we i ebul du; wi nɔ yɛri natin yet bɔt wetin i dɔn du! Bɔt udat no fɔ tru tru aw PAPA GƆD in pawa ebi?
Job bigin tɔk bak. I se;
“Wans PAPA GƆD we dɔn tek mi rayt, de, di Ɔlmayti we dɔn mek mi layf bita;
wans mi blo blo de insay mi, ɛn PAPA GƆD in spirit de insay mi;
a nɔ go tɔk bad tin ɛn a nɔ go lay gi nɔbɔdi.
A nɔ go ɛva tɔk se una rayt; te a day, a nɔ go lɔs mi rɛspɛkt.
A go kɔntinyu de waka tret na layf ɛn natin nɔ go mek a chenj; natin nɔ de we a du na layf we a go gɛt fɔ se a sɔri.
“Lɛ wetin mit wikɛd pipul dɛn mit mi ɛnimi dɛn, ɛn lɛ wetin mit pipul dɛn we nɔ de waka tret, mit di wan dɛn we de fɛt mi.
Wetin pipul dɛn we nɔ no PAPA GƆD go abop pan we PAPA GƆD tek dɛn layf, we dɛn day?
PAPA GƆD go lisin am we i kray to am we trɔbul mit am?
I go de gladi bɔt di Ɔlmayti in biznɛs? I go de pre to PAPA GƆD ɔltɛm?
A go tɛl una bɔt PAPA GƆD in pawa, ɛn a go tɛl una wetin di Ɔlmayti plan.
Tɔk am go tɔk am kam, unasɛf no bɔt ɔl dat, so wetindu una ɔl de tɔk nɔnsɛns?
“Na dɛn tin ya PAPA GƆD kin mek mit wikɛd pipul, ɛn dɛn pipul we de mek dɛn kɔmpin nɔ ɛnjɔy dɛn layf:
If i gɛt plɛnti pikin, na wa dɛn ɔl go day, ɛn dɛn nɔ go de gɛt it fɔ it.
Di wan dɛn we wa ɛn aŋri nɔ kil, na siknɛs go kil dɛn, ɛn di uman dɛn we dɛn day lɛf sɛf, nɔ go munin fɔ dɛn.
I lɛk i gɛt bɔku kɔpɔ lɛk dɔti, ɛn payl plɛnti klos lɛk kle;
i go gɛt dɛn fɔ natin; na pipul we waka tret wit PAPA GƆD go wɛr dɛn, ɛn na pipul dɛn we dɛn an klin go sheb in kɔpɔ.
Di os we i bil tan lɛk spayda wɛb; i tan lɛk gyadpost we gyadman kin tinap.
Ɔl in mɔni go de we i de go slip, bɔt na fɔ di las tɛm; we i wek, ɔl in mɔni go dɔn go.
I go fred bad bad wan lɛk we ebi ebi wata kin rɔn; da briz we de wisul go kɛr am go na nɛt.
Da briz we de kɔmɔt na di ist go tot am ɛn i dɔn go; i swip am kɔmɔt nain os.
I nɔ sɔri fɔ am we i de tot am; i tray fɔ rɔnawe.
I grip am wit in tu an ɛn sɔktit pan am frɔm usay i de.
“Fɔ tru, ples de fɔ dig fɔ fɛn silva, ɛn ples de we dɛn kin klin gold.
Ayɛn de kɔmɔt ɔnda grɔn, ɛn dɛn kin mɛlt kɔpa kɔmɔt pan di ayɛn dɔti.
Mɔtalman sach di dak dak ples, ɛn luk bɔtɔm bɔtɔm di grɔn fɔ ayɛn dɔti na di dak dak ples bɔtɔm bɔtɔm di grɔn.
Dɛn mek ɔndamayn dɛn fafawe usay pipul dɛn nɔ tap; pipul dɛn we de travul na da rod de sɛf nɔ no se dɛn de ɔnda de, na rop dɛn kin tek go dɔŋ na da fa fa ples de.
Fɔ di grɔn yon, tin dɛn fɔ it de gro de; bɔt ɔnda de in tan lɛk we faya mek ɔltin tɔn ɔpsay dɔŋ.
Na di ston dɛn yu go fɛn dayamɔn, ɛn gold insay di dɔti.
“Nɔn bɔd we de it tin we gɛt layf nɔ no de de, ɛn nɔn falkɔn in yay nɔ si de yet.
Di prawd animal dɛn nɔ waka pantap de yet; layɔn sɛf nɔ waka pas de yet.
Mɔtalman de brok traŋa traŋa ston fɔ fɛn ayɛn dɔti, ɛn de dig go insay bɔtɔm dɛn il.
Dɛn de dig rod insay big big ston dɛn, ɛn kin fɛn dɛn gold ɛn dayamɔn.
Dɛn mek traŋa traŋa dam we nɔ de bɔs, ɛn mek ɔlman si ɔl wetin dɛn nɔ si wande.
“Usay pɔsin go ebul fɛn bɔku bɔku sɛns? Ɛn usay pɔsin go fɛn bɛtɛ lanin?
Mɔtalman nɔ no di rod fɔ go de, ɛn i nɔ de na dis wɔl.
Bɔtɔm bɔtɔm di si se, ‘i nɔ de insay mi,’ di si se, ‘i nɔ de to mi.’
Gold nɔ du fɔ pe fɔ am, ɛn nɔn amawnt ɔf silva nɔ du fɔ kɔmpia wit am.
Gold nɔ du fɔ tek kɔmpia wit am, dayamɔn sɛf nɔ du.
Gold ɛn glas nɔ nia am, ɛn di ay ay karat gold chen sɛf nɔ du fɔ gi fɔ gɛt am.
Nɔn mɛzhɔmɛnt nɔ de we dɛn go mɛzhɔ miniral ɔnda wata we go rich am; bikɔs di prayz fɔ bɔku sɛns pas dayamɔn.
Yu nɔ go kɔmpia am wit di Topaz we de na Itiopia, ɛn di valyu fɔ piɔ gold sɛf nɔ rich am.
“Wɛl, usay bɔku bɔku sɛns kɔmɔt? Ɛn usay bɔku bɔku lanin de?
Na tin we ayd pan ɔltin we gɛt layf, ɛn i ayd pan dɛn bɔd we de flay na di klawd.
Ɔndawɔl ɛn day se, ‘Wi dɔn yɛri yus bɔt am.’
“PAPA GƆD no di rod fɔ go de, ɛn i no usay i de.
Bikɔs i de si usay di ath tap, ɛn i de si ɔltin we de na dis wɔl.
We i gi di briz in trɛnk ɛn gi ɔl watasay ɔmɔs wata i fɔ gɛt;
we i tɔk se ren fɔ fɔdɔm ɛn mek rod fɔ tɛnda ɛn laytin,
nain i si ɔltin ɛn se ɔltin fayn; we i dɔn luk ɔltin dɔn, i si se i gud fɔ gɛt bɔku bɔku sɛns.
Nain i tɛl mɔtalman se, una no tide se, fɔ fred PAPA GƆD nain na bɔku bɔku sɛns, ɛn fɔ kɔmɔt biɛn setan biznɛs, na bɔku bɔku lanin.”
We Job bigin tɔk bak, i tɔk se;
Aya, a wish tin kin bi lɛk aw i bin bi fɔstɛm, dat na bin di tɛm we PAPA GƆD bin bisin bɔt mi;
we PAPA GƆD in lamp bin de shayn pan mi, ɛn nain layt a bin de tek waka na dak;
lɛk di tɛm dɛn we a bin jɛntri, di tɛm we PAPA GƆD bin lɛk mi ɛn bin de gyad mi famili;
di tɛm we Ɔlmayti PAPA GƆD bin de wit mi, ɛn mi pikin dɛn bin de rawnd mi;
Di tɛm we mi got ɛn kaw bin de pul bɔku bɔku milk, ɛn mi ɔliv tik dɛn bin de pul plɛnti plɛnti ɔyl!
We a bin de go na di get usay ɔl di bigman dɛn de mit, we a kin go fɔ go sidɔm,
we di yɔŋman dɛn kin si mi, dɛn ɔl kin gi mi rod ɛn di bigman dɛn kin tinap;
di lida dɛn kin lɛf fɔ tɔk ɛn kin tek an kɔba dɛn mɔt;
di pipul dɛn we gɛt rɛspɛkt pas ɔl kin lɛf fɔ tɔk, ɛn dɛn siti kin fasin na dɛn mɔt.
We pipul dɛn kin yɛri bɔt mi, dɛn kin tɔk gud bɔt mi, we dɛn si mi, dɛn kin kɔngratyulet mi;
bikɔs a kin ɛp po pipul dɛn we kin aks mi fɔ ɛp dɛn, ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn we dɛn papa dɛn dɔn day we nɔ gɛt nɔbɔdi fɔ ɛp dɛn.
Pipul dɛn we de sɔfa te dɛn wan day, we a kin ɛp, kin blɛs mi, ɛn a kin mek dɛn uman dɛn we dɛn man dɔn day, gladi.
Fɔ trit pipul dɛn di rayt we tan lɛk klos to mi; mi tret waka na lɛk we pɔsin wɛr gawn ɛn at.
A bin de ɛp blɛn pipul dɛn ɛn a ɛp pipul dɛn we nɔ de waka gud.
Mi na bin dɛn po man dɛn papa ɛn a kin tray fɔ no bɔt pipul dɛnsɛf we a nɔ no, dɛn prɔblɛm.
A kin brok bad pipul dɛn tit, ɛn mek i pit di pɔsin we i kin grip wit in tit.
A kin de tink na mi at se mi layf go lɔŋ ɛn a go day wit kolat na mi os,
Mi na bin lɛk tik we in rut de na watasay, ɛn dyu de fɔdɔm pan mi branch dɛn ol nɛt,
pipul dɛn nɔ de lɛf fɔ sho mi rɛspɛkt; ɛn mi trɛnk na layf nɔ de dɔn.’
We a de tɔk, pipul dɛn de wet, ɛn sɛt mɔt de lisin wetin a de se.
We a dɔn tɔk dɔn, nɔbɔdi nɔ de ad natin de; wetin a se kin tɔch dɛn at.
Dɛn kin wet fɔ mi lɛk we pipul dɛn kin de wet ren fɔ kam; dɛn na lɛk dɛn fama we nɔ ebul bia, we de wet fɔ ren sizin.
A kin smayl to dɛn we dɛn at kin pwɛl, ɛm mi smayl kin mek dɛn at gladi.
A de wit dɛn lɛk dɛn chif, ɛn a de lɛk kiŋ wit in sojaman dɛn; lɛk pɔsin we de koks pipul dɛn we gɛt bɛrin.
“Bɔt naw pipul dɛn de laf mi, pipul dɛn we a big pas, pipul dɛn we a nɔ go gri lɛ dɛn papa dɛn ɛp mi dɔg dɛn luk mi ship dɛn.
Us trɛnk dɛn gɛt fɔ wok we a go bɛnifit, man dɛn we dɔn ol ɛn wik so.
Bikɔs dɛn po ɛn aŋri dɛn de krep krep dray grɔn na di dray dray land;
dɛn pik lif we nɔ swit ɛn lif dɛn na bush de it, ɛn de kɔt brumtik rut fɔ wam dɛnsɛf.
Dɛn de drɛb dɛn ɔlsay; dɛn kin ala pan dɛn lɛk tifman.
Na dɛn ol we ren kin dig dɛn fɔ tap, ol dɛn we de na grɔn ɛn ɔnda dɛn big big ston.
Dɛn de kray lɛk dɛn animal na bush; dɛn de gɛda dɛnsɛf tayt togɛda ɔnda chuk chuk tik.
Na pipul dɛn we nɔ gɛt sɛns ɛn nɔ gɛt wan rɛspɛkt; dɛn dɔn bit dɛn drɛb dɛn kɔmɔt na di land.
Na mi nem dɛn tek mek chɔ stik, A dɔn tɔn tin fɔ laf to dɛn.
Dɛn tɔn dɛn bak pan mi ɛn sho mi se dɛn nɔ lɛk mi, ɛn dɛn nɔ kin fred fɔ pit we dɛn si mi.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD wikin mi, dɛn nɔ de fred fɔ du natin bifo mi.
Na mi raytan di rareman dɛn kɔmɔt, dɛn drɛb mi lɛ a go, dɛn atak mi ɛn tray fɔ kil mi.
Dɛn blɔk di rod so a nɔ go ebul ɛskep, na dɛn mek a de sɔfa so; nɔbɔdi nɔ de tap dɛn.
Dɛn atak mi lɛk we sojaman dɛn bɔs ol go insay pipul siti; dɛn de rɔsh ɔl we di ston dɛn na di wɔl stil de fɔdɔm.
Fred kɔba mi; mi rɛspɛkt go lɛk briz, mi jɛntri pas lɛk we klawd kin pas.
Layf nɔ min natin to mi igen, di sɔfa we a de sɔfa mek a wish fɔ day.
Na nɛt, mi bon dɛn kin at mi ɛn di pen we de mɔna mi pas ɔl, nɔ de gri tap.
Mi wanol bɔdi de at mi; i de drɔ lɛk we mi klos in kɔla kin grip mi.
PAPA GƆD dɔn trowe mi na pɔtɔpɔtɔ, ɛn a dɔn tɔn lɛk dɔst ɛn asis.
A kray to yu PAPA GƆD, bɔt yu nɔ ansa mi; a pre to yu, yu nɔ luk mi sɛf.
Yu dɔn chenj de trit mi bad; yu tek yu pawa de du mi bad.
Yu mek di briz blo mi go, yu mek a rayd pan am, dɔn yu mek di briz es mi ɔp ɛn wap mi dɔŋ.
Yɛs, a no se na kil yu wan kil mi, ɛn kɛr mi go usay mɔtalman dɛn kin mit we dɛn day.
“Pɔsin we gɛt prɔblɛm nɔ de aks lɛ dɛn ɛp am? We i nɔ gɛt nɔn abop igen, i nɔ de kɔl pipul dɛn lɛ dɛn ɛp am?
A nɔ bin kray fɔ pipul dɛn we tin bin traŋa fɔ? A nɔ bin de fil na mi at fɔ po pipul dɛn?
Bɔt we mi luk fɔ gud tin fɔ kam mi we, na bad tin mit mi; we a de wet fɔ swit, na bita kam.
A kɔnfyus, ɛn mi at nɔ de rɛst atɔl; a de sɔfa ɛvri de.
Mi bɔdi jɛs de blak, bɔt nɔto san de mek i de blak; a tinap usay ɔlman kin mit ɛn aks lɛ dɛn ɛp mi.
Mi brɔda dɛn na dɛn yuba, ɛn mi padi dɛn na pikɔk.
Mi bɔdi de blak ɛn de pil pil, ɛn mi bɔn dɛn wam.
Na bɛrin myuzik nɔmɔ de ple na mi gita, ɛn mi flut de ple myuzik we tan lɛk we pipul we gɛt bɛrin, de kray.
“Mi ɛn mi yay dɔn mek wanwɔd; aw a go se a de luk vajin gyal naw.
Aw PAPA GƆD we de ɔp go trit mi, ɛn wetin di Ɔlmayti we de ɔp go gi mi?
Nɔ to nambara kin mit pipul dɛn we nɔ no PAPA GƆD, ɛn nɔto wahala kin mit pipul dɛn we de du wetin PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk?
PAPA GƆD nɔ de si ɔl wetin a de du, ɛn no ɔlsay we a de go?
“If mi na bin tu fes pɔsin, ɛn if mi na bin dakadeke pɔsin;
(lɛ PAPA GƆD sach mi so i go no di kayn pɔsin we a bi.)
If a de waka bad wit PAPA GƆD, ɛn if na dis wɔl yon jɛntri a de fala, ɛn if mi an nɔ klin,
lɛ ɔda pɔsin it ɔl wetin a wok fɔ na layf; ɛn lɛ dɛn nyakanyaka mi fam.
“If mi at dɔn go to ɛni ɔda uman, ɛn if a dɔn ayd de luk dɛn wɛf dɛn,
lɛ mi wɛf tɔn bɔy bɔy de gren fɔ in kɔmpin uman, ɛn lɛ ɔda man sɛks wit am.
Bikɔs dat na bad bad sin; i go bi bad tin we di jɔj dɛn go pɔnish pɔsin bad bad wan fɔ;
bikɔs na faya dawande we go bɔn pɔsin te go nain grev, ɛn i go bɔn ɔl wetin i gɛt.
“If a nɔ bin de lisin mi uman ɛn man wokman dɛn, we dɛn de tɛl mi wetin a du dɛn we dɛn nɔ lɛk;
wetin a go du we a tinap bifo PAPA GƆD? We i go aks mi bɔt dat, wetin a go ansa am se?
Nɔto di sem PAPA GƆD mek mi ɛn dɛn put na wi mama dɛn bɛlɛ? Nɔto di sem PAPA GƆD kip wi te wi mama dɛn bɔn wi?
“If a dɔn tay mi at pan ɛni po man ɛn nɔ gi am wetin i want, ɔ a dɔn ɛva mek ɛni uman we in man dɔn day shem,
ɔ mi wan dɔn sidɔm it a nɔ gi nɔbɔdi, ɔ dɛn pikin dɛn we dɛn papa dɔn day nɔ it de,
(bikɔs frɔm we i smɔl, na mi de mɛn am lɛk se na mi nain papa, frɔm we in mama bɔn am, na mi mɛn am).
If mi dɔn ɛva si pɔsin we nɔ gɛt klos fɔ wɛr ɔ po man we nɔ gɛt kɔba klos;
if nɔto mi sev am we a gi am klos ɛn if nɔto klos we gɛt wul we kɔmɔt pan mi ship, wam in bɔdi,
if mi dɔn ɛva bit pikin we in papa dɔn day bikɔs a no se a go win am na kot;
lɛ mi sholda bled kɔmɔt nain kes, ɛn lɛ mi an kɔmɔt nain sɔkɛt fɔdɔm.
A bin de fred lɛ PAPA GƆD nɔ pɔnish mi, ɛn dat bin go mek a nɔ ebul tinap bifo am.
“If na mɔni a bin abop pan, ɔ na de mi kɔnfidɛns bin de;
if a bin sidɔm de gladi se a jɛntri bad bad wan, ɔ bikɔs mi na pɔsin we gɛt;
if a bin de luk di san ɔ di mun bikɔs i fayn fɔ si,
ɛn mi at tek dɛn sikrit wan te a de kis mi an de wɔship dɛn;
dat bin fɔ bi ɔda tin we di jɔj dɛn fɔ pɔnish mi fɔ, datɛnde, a nɔ bin fɔ bi tru to PAPA GƆD we de ɔp.
“If a bin de gladi bikɔs nambara mit pɔsin we et mi, ɔ gladi we waala mit am,
(a nɔ ɛva tek sin bay we a go swɛ se lɛ i day;)
if di man dɛn na mi os nɔ kin de aks se udat de we nɔ bɛlful?
(Di trenja dɛn nɔ slip na trit wande; mi os opin ɔltɛm to pipul dɛn we de travul;)
a nɔ ɛva ayd mi sin pan mɔtalman, bay we a nɔ go tɛl nɔbɔdi,
bikɔs a se a de fred wetin pipul dɛn go se, ɔ se a de fred wetin mi famili dɛn go du, so a go de insay os ɛn nɔ de go na do.
Eya! If pɔsin bin de we de lisin mi, i bin go gud, a de sayn se ɔl wetin a se na tru! Eya! A wish di lɔya pepa bin de we wetin mi ɛnimi se a du am, rayt!
Fɔ tru, a bin fɔ tot am na mi sholda; a bin fɔ wɛr am na mi ed lɛk krawn;
A bin fɔ ɛksplen tɛl am ɔl aw a pas; a bin fɔ waka lɛk bigman go to am.
“If na tif a tif di land we a de plant ɛn ɔl dɛn lili gɔta dɛn bin de kray togɛda;
if a dɔn it wetin de gro de we a nɔ pe fɔ di land, ɛn mek di pipul dɛn we gɛt am day;
lɛ ɔl mi rɛs na fam tɔn chuk chuk, ɛn lɛ mi funde tɔn gras.” Na ya Job in tɔk dɔn.
Di tri man dɛn bin lɛf fɔ ansa Job bikɔs Job bin si insɛf se, i de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD.
Nain Ilaɛlu, we na Barachɛl, da Buzayt we kɔmɔt na di Ram famili in pikin, vɛks. I vɛks pan Job bikɔs Job tɔk se in rayt, we min se PAPA GƆD rɔŋ;
i vɛks pan Job in tri padi dɛn bikɔs, ɔlwe dɛn se Job rɔŋ, dɛn nɔ ebul tɔk wetindu.
Ilaɛlu bin wet te ɔlman dɔn tɔk dɔn to Job bifo in tɔk, bikɔs, in bin smɔl pas dɛn ɔl.
So we i si se dɛn nɔ ebul tɔk wetin Job du, i vɛks.
Nain Ilaɛlu, we na da Buzayt we nem Barachɛl, in pikin ansa se: “una ɔl big pas mi, ɛn una dɔn ol; dat mek a bin de fred fɔ tɔk, fɔ tɛl una wetin mi tink.
A se, ‘lɛ una we big tɔk fɔs, ɛn una we dɔn ol, gi wi sɛns.
Bɔt na di spirit we de insay mɔtalman, dat na di Ɔlmayti in spirit, nain de mek i no tin prɔpa wan.
Nɔto te pɔsin ol i go gɛt sɛns, ɛn nɔto ol pipul dɛn nɔmɔ no wetin rayt.
So a de aks una fɔ lisin mi; mek misɛf tɛl una wetin a tink.’
“A bin de wet mek una tɔk dɔn, a bin de lisin ɔl di sɛns we una bin de pul, we una bin de tink wetin fɔ se.
Ɔl mi at bin de to una, ɛn a si se nɔn pan una nɔ ebul pruv se Job rɔŋ, ɔ ivin ansa am we i put in kes.
Una tek tɛm lɛ nɔn pan una nɔ fil se i gɛt sɛns; nɔto mɔtalman go ansa am o, na PAPA GƆD insɛf.
We Job bin de tɔk, i nɔ bin de tɔk to mi, ɛn mi nɔ bin fɔ ansa am di we we una ansa am.
“Dɛn nɔ de fil fayn ɛn dɛn nɔ no wetin fɔ se igen; dɛn nɔ ebul se wan wɔd.
So mi fɔ sidɔm de wet bikɔs dɛn nɔ gɛt wetin fɔ tɔk igen, bikɔs dɛn jɛs tinap de ɛn nɔ de se natin igen?
Misɛf go tɔk; a go se wetin a tink.
A gɛt plɛnti tin fɔ tɔk ɛn a nɔ ebul bia; pas a tɔk.
Una lisin, a dɔn rɛdi fɔ tɔk. Mi na lɛk wayn bag we nɔ ebul bia igen, bɔt dɔn rɛdi fɔ bɔs.
A fɔ tɔk so mi at go kol; A fɔ opin mi mɔt ansa.
A nɔ go de fɔ nɔbɔdi, ɛn a nɔ go mek ipokrit to nɔbɔdi.
Mi nɔ sabi mek ipokrit to nɔbɔdi, bikɔs if a du dat, PAPA GƆD go kil mi.
“Job, lisin wetin a gɛt fɔ se, ɛn lisin ɔltin wɔd fɔ wɔd.
A dɔn rɛdi fɔ opin mi mɔt; a dɔn rɛdi fɔ tɔk.
A de tɔk wit klin at, ɛn ɔl wetin a de se, na tru.
Na PAPA GƆD in spirit mek mi, ɛn na di blo blo we di Ɔlmayti blo insay mi, gi mi layf.
If yu ebul, yu ansa mi o; plan ɔl wetin fɔ se; yu rɛdi?
Mi ɛn yu na mɔtalman bifo PAPA GƆD; na di sem kle i tek mek wi.
So yu nɔ sɔpoz fɔ fred mi; nɔ fil se a go du yu bad.
“Yu tɔk we misɛf de na ya, ɛn a yɛri ɔl wetin yu se.
Yu se ‘a klin, a nɔ de du natin we PAPA GƆD go vɛks pan mi; a nɔ gɛt wan sin ɛn mi at klin.
PAPA GƆD jɛs fɛn we fɔ pɔnish mi nɔmɔ, i trit mi lɛk in ɛnimi;
I put chen na mi fut ɛn de wach ɔl wetin a de du’.
“Bo diswanya, yu nɔ rayt.. A go ansa da say de. PAPA GƆD ɛn mɔtalman nɔ ikwal; PAPA GƆD pas wi.
Wetindu yu de agyu wit am, se, “I nɔ go ansa mi?
PAPA GƆD de tɔk sɔntin, dɔn i tɔk am bak plɛnti tɛm mɔ, ɔlwe pipul dɛn nɔ de lisin.
Na drim ɔ vishɔn na nɛt, we mɔtalman dɔn slip dip, we dɛn de slip na dɛn bed,
na da tɛm de i kin opin mɔtalman dɛn yes ɛn mek dɛn fred bay di we we i de wɔn dɛn,
so mɔtalman go lɛf di bad we i de du, ɛn mek mɔtalman lɛf fɔ mek prawd;
i ɛp am mek in sol nɔ go ɛl, ɛn mek i nɔ go day gifa day.
PAPA GƆD kin put sik pan pɔsin fɔ kɔrɛkt am, ɛn mek i gɛt pen ɔloba in bɔdi;
so dat i nɔ kin ebul it natin; dɛn fayn fayn it sɛf i nɔ kin ebul it.
In bɔdi kin so dɔn dat i kin dray; na di bon we nɔ kin de sho, ɔlman de si naw.
In sol kin dɔn go nia grev, ɛn in layf in kin dɔn de to di wan dɛn we kin briŋ day.
If i bin gɛt enjɛl, enjɛl we go de tɔk fɔ pɔsin, wan pan di tawzin tawzin enjɛl dɛn, we go de tɛl mɔtalman wetin rayt ɛn wetin nɔ rayt fɔ du;
dɔn di enjɛl de sɔri fɔ am ɛn de tɛl PAPA GƆD se, ‘Duya nɔ mek i day, A dɔn fɛn we fɔ fri am;
Lɛ i yɔŋ bak, lɛ i chenj bak lɛk aw i bin yɔŋ ɛn trɔŋ’;
dɔn we mɔtalman de pre to PAPA GƆD, i de ansa am, dɛn go gladi fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD. PAPA GƆD go fri mɔtalman wantɛm mɔ,
mɔtalman go siŋ usay pipul dɛn de, se: a dɔn kɔmit sin ɛn dɔn du wetin nɔ rayt, bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ du mi natin.
I dɔn fri mi sol mek a nɔ go dɔŋ di grev ɛn mi layf dɔn fri.’
“PAPA GƆD de du ɔl dɛn kayn tin ya tu tri tɛm fɔ mɔtalman,
fɔ sev am lɛ i nɔ day, so i go liv lɔŋ.
Tek wetin a de tɛl yu Job, lisin we a de tɔk; sɛt yu mɔt so mi go tɔk.
If yu gɛt ɛnitin fɔ se, tɔk am; tɔk, bikɔs a wan lɛ yu gɛt gud nem.
If yu nɔ gɛt natin fɔ se, sɛt yu mɔt ɛn lisin we a de tɔk, ɛn a go gi yu sɛns.”
Nain Ilaɛlu se:
“Una lisin wetin mi de se, una dɛn sɛns man dɛn, una lisin mi, una we no;
na yes de tes wɔd lɛk we di tɔŋ de tes it.
Lɛ wi tek tɛm luk yu kes wit PAPA GƆD; lɛ wi mek ɔp wi maynd wetin go bi di bɛst tin fɔ du.
Bikɔs Job in se, “mi an klin, ɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn tinap pan mi rayt;
ɔl we a gɛt rayt, dɛn se na lay a de lay; dɛn dɔn wund mi wund we nɔ de wɛl, ɔl we a nɔ du natin.
Yu dɔn ɛva si ɛnibɔdi we tan lɛk Job we jɛs de tɔk fityay tɔk lɛk we pɔsin de drink wata,
we de waka wit pipul dɛn we de du bad ɛn de kip kɔmpin wit wikɛd pipul dɛm?
Bikɔs i se, ‘i nɔ go prɔfit mɔtalman natin fɔ mek i put in at pan PAPA GƆD.’
“So una lisin mi, una we na man dɛn we sabi buk, rɔb yu mɔt na grɔn bifo yu se PAPA GƆD go du bad, ɛn rɔb yu mɔt na grɔn bifo yu se di Ɔlmayti go du rɔŋ tin.
Bikɔs na bay di wok we mɔtalman du PAPA GƆD de pe am, ɛn na bay mɔtalman in we, PAPA GƆD go trit am.
Usay tru de fɔ tɔk, PAPA GƆD nɔ go du bad, ɛn i nɔ go tek pɔsin rayt.
Na pɔsin gi am pawa oba di ath ɛn na pɔsin put di wɔl nain an?
If PAPA GƆD tek in spirit bak, ɛn tek ɔl in blo blo bak,
ɔlman go day, ɛn mɔtalman go tɔn dɔti bak.
“If yu na pɔsin we lan, lisin; lisin wetin a de se.
I pɔsibul lɛ pɔsin we nɔ lɛk gi pipul dɛn rayt, rul pipul dɛn? Yu go kɔndɛm pɔsin we gɛt pawa ɛn de waka tret,
pɔsin we de tɛl kiŋ dɛn se, ‘yuslɛs man,’ ɛn de tɛl pipul dɛn we de nia kiŋ se, ‘Wikɛd man’;
pɔsin we nɔ de tek jɛntriman pat, ɛn de si jɛntriman ɛn poman di sem we, bikɔs nain mek dɛn ɔl?
Mɔtalman nɔ at fɔ day; midul nɛt, PAPA GƆD de nak dɛn nɔmɔ dɛn day, i de mek rula dɛn day we mɔtalman nɔ gɛt fɔ put an de.
“PAPA GƆD in yay de pan ɔl wetin mɔtalman de du, ɛn de si ɔl usay mɔtalman de go.
Nɔn kayn dak ples nɔ de we bad bad pipul dɛn go ayd dɛnsɛf.
Bikɔs i nɔ fiks tɛm yet fɔ nɔbɔdi fɔ go bifo am fɔ jɔjmɛnt.
I nɔ de aks sɛf we i wan nyakanyaka lida dɛn; afta dat, i put ɔda pɔsin nain ples.
I no ɔl wetin dɛn de du so na nɛt, i kin ovatro dɛn ɛn nyakanyaka dɛn.
I kin pɔnish dɛn lɛk kriminal na pɔblik usay ɔlman go si,
bikɔs dɛn dɔn tɔn dɛn bak gi am ɛn nɔ de obe nɔn in lɔ dɛn,
dat di po man dɛn de kray to PAPA GƆD, i de yɛri di pipul dɛn de kray.
We in nɔ kɔndɛm, udat fɔ kɔndɛm? We i ayd in fes, udat go si am, i lɛk na wanol neshɔn ɔ na wangren pɔsin?
So pɔsin we nɔ no PAPA GƆD nɔ fɔ rul, so dat i nɔ go trit di pipul dɛn bad.
“Job, yu dɔn tɛl PAPA GƆD se yu na sina ɛn yu nɔ go du am igen;
tɛl am se mek i tich yu wetin yu nɔ no, ɛn if yu dɔn du ɛnitin bad, yu nɔ go du am igen
I go jɛs fri yu fɔ pliz yu we yu nɔ gri ripɛnt? Na yu fɔ ripɛnt, nɔto mi, so ripɛnt naw fɔ ɔl wetin yu no se yu dɔn tɔk.
Una we na pipul dɛn we lan go se, ɛn pipul dɛn we gɛt plɛnti sɛns we yɛri mi go se:
Job nɔ tɔk wit sɛns, wetin i de se sho se i nɔ de tink gud.’
A wish dɛn bin tray Job to di las, bikɔs i de tɔk lɛk wikɛd pɔsin.
Pan ɔl we i dɔn kɔmit sin, i de barɔf pantap dat; i de tray mek wi dawt; i stil de tɔk bad bɔt PAPA GƆD.”
Ilaɛlu kɔntinyu di tɔk. I se:
“Yu tink se na rayt tin dat? Yu tink se i rayt bifo PAPA GƆD,’
fɔ de aks se, ‘us difrɛns i mek to PAPA GƆD if mi na sina? Aw i bɛnifit mi naw we a nɔ sin?
A go ansa yu ɛn a go ansa yu padi dɛn.
Luk ɔp di skay ɛn si, si di klawd dɛn we dɛn de ɔp ɔp pas yu.
If yu dɔn kɔmit sin, dat go pul wan trɛd pan PAPA GƆD in klos? Ɛn if yu de du bad bad tin ɔltɛm, dat go shek PAPA GƆD?
If yu na pɔsin we de waka tret, aw dat go ɛp PAPA GƆD, ɔ wetin PAPA GƆD de luk to yu fɔ gi am?
Na yu kɔmpin mɔtalman go sɔfa if yu du bad, ɛn nain semwan go ɛnjɔy if yu du gud.
Bikɔs pipul dɛn de sɔfa tumɔs, dɛn kin kɔl lɛ pipul ɛp dɛn, bikɔs, di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa de du dɛn bad.
Bɔt nɔn pan dɛn nɔ kin aks se, ‘we PAPA GƆD we mek mi, we ebul mek pipul siŋ ɔlwe dɛn gɛt trɔbul,
in we mek wi no pas dɛn animal dɛn na dis wɔl, ɛn gi wi sɛns pas di bɔd dɛn we de flay na di skay?
Dɛn de pre to am, bɔt i nɔ de ansa, bikɔs dɛn na prawd ɛn wikɛd pipul dɛn.
Na tru se PAPA GƆD nɔ de yɛri pipul we de pre bɛlful pre, i nɔ bisin bɔt dɛnsɛf.
Aw i go tan lɛk we na yu se yu nɔ de si am, we yu kes de bifo am ɛn yu de wet lɛ i ansa yu.
PAPA GƆD nɔ de pɔnish pɔsin we i vɛks ɛn nɔto ɔltin we pɔsin du i de luk.
Job bin jɛs opin in mɔt de tɔk bɔt tin dɛn we i nɔ no bɔt.”
Ilaɛlu stil kɔntinyu de tɔk. I se:
“Una bia wit mi lilibit mɔ mek a ɛksplen to una, bikɔs a gɛt sɔntin we a wan tɛl una fɔseka PAPA GƆD.
A go sho una aw a sabi plɛnti plɛnti tin, ɛn pruv to una se PAPA GƆD we mek mi, nɔ bɛn bɛn.
Una biliv mi se mi nɔto man we de lay: mi we una si so, a gɛt bɔku bɔku sɛns.
“Ɔlwe PAPA GƆD gɛt pawa so, i nɔ de luk nɔbɔdi lɛs; i gɛt pawa ɛn i no ɔltin.
I nɔ de mek bad pipul dɛn gɛt lɔŋ layf, bɔt i de mek shɔ se di po pipul dɛn gɛt dɛn rayt.
I bisin bɔt di wan dɛn we biliv am, i de trit dɛn lɛk se dɛn na kiŋ we sidɔm na tron, i de mek dɛn rɛspɛkt dɛn sote go.
If pipul dɛn we de jel de sɔfa fɔ wetin dɛn du,
i de sho dɛn wetin dɛn du, ɛn di we we dɛn kɔmit sin bikɔs dɛn prawd.
I de mek dɛn yɛri in wɔd usay i tɛl dɛn traŋa wan se, dɛn fɔ lɛf fɔ du bad.
If dɛn yɛri wɔd ɛn tɔn to am, dɛn kin ɛnjɔy dɛn balans layf we lɛf, ɛn dɛn layf go swit te dɛn day.
Bɔt if dɛn traŋayes, dɛn go day na wa, ɛn dɛn go day lɛk fulman.
“Na pɔsin we nɔ no PAPA GƆD lɛk fɔ de vɛks ɔltɛm; i lɛk i pɔnish dɛn, dɛn nɔ de ripɛnt.
Dɛn kin day yɔŋ, ɛn na shemful we dɛn kin day.
PAPA GƆD de mek pipul sɔfa so dɛn go lan sɛns, ɛn mek dɛn gɛt trɔbul so dat dɛn go lisin to am.
Igen, i de pul yu kɔmɔt pan trɔbul, ɛn kɛr yu go usay nɔbɔdi nɔ go ambɔg yu, usay yu go gɛt ɔl wetin yu want.
“Bɔt yu de gɛt di pɔnishmɛnt we wikɛd pipul dɛn kin gɛt, ɛn yu nɔ go ebul avɔyd di pɔnishmɛnt.
Tek tɛm lɛ mɔni nɔ mek yu fil se yu bɛtɛ pas ɔlman, ɛn nɔ mek braybri mek yu kɔrɔpt.
Yu mɔni go ebul pul yu kɔmɔt pan trɔbul? Yu trɛnk go ebul ɛp yu?
Nɔ pre fɔ nɛt fɔ kam, na di tɛm we dɛn kin nyakanyaka pipul.
Tek tɛm mek yu maynd nɔ tɔn to ivul biznɛs, bikɔs, i luk lɛk na dat yu de pan we mek yu de sɔfa.
PAPA GƆD gɛt pawa ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de we sabi tich pɔsin lɛsin lɛk am.
Udat dɔn ɛva tɛl PAPA GƆD wetin i fɔ du ɔ tɛl am se, ‘wetin yu du nɔ rayt’?
“Yu fɔ mɛmba fɔ prez am fɔ wetin i de du, we pipul dɛn kin siŋ de prez am fɔ.
Ɔlman dɔn si ɔl di tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn mek, bɔt na we dɛn de fa nɔmɔ, dɛn si am.
A de tɛl yu, PAPA GƆD na gret PAPA GƆD, bɔt wi nɔ gri biliv am; nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul no awlɔŋ i dɔn de.
PAPA GƆD de drɔ smɔl smɔl wata kɔmɔt na grɔn go ɔp ɛn tɔn am to ren,
we di klawd de sɛn kam dɔŋ pan mɔtalman, bɔku bɔku wan.
Ɛnibɔdi ebul ɛksplen aw di klawd de skata, ɛn aw tɛnda de krak usay PAPA GƆD de?
I de mek laytin de flash ɔl rawnd am, ɛn di si so ful, dat yu nɔ go ebul si ɔnda.
Na we ren de kam mek pipul gɛt tin fɔ it, i de gi dɛn plɛnti plɛnti it.
PAPA GƆD de ol di laytin insay in tu an ɛn di laytin de flash usay in tɛl am fɔ flash.
Di tɛnda in nɔys de mek yu no se PAPA GƆD de, PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD we nɔ lɛk sin.
We ren kin kam wit tɛnda ɛn laytin, a kin fred; mi at kin kɔmɔt nain atkes.
Yɛri we in vɔys de mek lɛk tɛnda we i de tɔk, we i opin in mɔt fɔ tɔk, i kin tan lɛk we layɔn de ala.
PAPA GƆD de mek laytin de flash ɔlsay na di klawd, ist to wɛst, nɔth to sawt.
Dɔn yu go yɛri in vɔys ebi ebi wan, in vɔys kin tan lɛk tɛnda, ɛn i kin kam wit laytin.
We PAPA GƆD de tɔk, in vɔys kin tan lɛk tɛnda, ɛn i fiaful fɔ yɛri; i de du tin dɛn we de mek wi wɔnda ɛn nɔ ɔndastand.
Fɔ sno yon, i jɛs kɔmand am se, ‘Fɔdɔm na di ath;’ fɔ ren yon, i kɔmand am se, ‘fɔdɔm sok ɔlsay.’
I tap ɔlman wok, so dat ɔlman go no wetin i kin du.
Dɔn dɛn animal dɛn na bush kin go insay usay dɛn tap, ɛn de de te di tinada pas.
Ebi briz de kɔmɔt na di sawt usay dɛn de, dɔn di ples kin kol we di briz skata.
We PAPA GƆD blo nain nos, wata de tɔn ays, dɛn big big watasay dɛn de tɔn ays kwik kwik wan.
I kin mek di tik klawd dɛn sok, ɛn na dɛn kin skata in laytin ɔlsay.
Di klawd dɛn de go rawnd ɛn rawnd di we we PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ go, so dat dɛn go du ɔl wetin i tɛl dɛn fɔ du na dis wɔl we mɔtalman de.
Na ayda fɔ pɔnish pipul, ɔ fɔ wata in land, ɔ fɔ sho pipul aw i lɛk dɛn, mek i de mek i bi.
“Job, lisin: sidɔm ɛn tink bɔt di wɔndaful tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD de du.
Yu no aw PAPA GƆD ebul mek dɛn du wetin i tɛl dɛn, ɛn aw i de mek laytin de flash na di klawd?
Yu no aw di klawd de ɛŋ ɛn nɔ de fɔdɔm, di wok we di wan we nɔ de mek mistek de du,
yu we kin de swɛt we di ples wam bikɔs ɔf di briz we de kɔmɔt na di sawt?
Yu ebul mek di skay, we traŋa lɛk glas we mɛlt?
Tich wi wetin wi fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD se; wi maynd ɛmti ɛn wi nɔ no wetin fɔ se.
Dɛn fɔ tɛl am se a wan tɔk to am? Ɛnibɔdi de we so fulish dat i go wan mek PAPA GƆD kil am?
“Mɔtalman nɔ go ebul luk laytin we i de na di skay, we briz dɔn blo di klawd go.
PAPA GƆD de kɔmɔt na di nɔth lɛk gold we de shayn, i so brayt na pɔsin yay dat ɔlman de fred fɔ luk am.
PAPA GƆD so gɛt pawa dat mɔtalman nɔ go ebul go nia am; i de waka tret ɛn nɔ de mɔna pipul,
So, mɔtalman de fred am; i nɔ bisin bɔt ɛnibɔdi we de mek se in gɛt sɛns.”
Nain Papa GƆD ansa insay briz se:
“Us rayt yu gɛt fɔ kwɛshɔn wetin a se a de du?
Rɛdi lɛk man, a de kam aks yu sɔm kwɛshɔn we a go lɛk lɛ yu ansa.
“Usay yu bin de we a bin mek di fawndeshɔn fɔ di wɔl? Tɛl mi, if yu na pɔsin we lan.
Udat bin disayd aw i fɔ big lɛk – yu mek lɛk yu no! Udat bin go put di bambu pol fɔ mek di ath go tret?
Wetin di bɔtɔm tinap pan we ol di pila dɛn we di ath tinap pan, ɔ udat le di fawndeshɔn ston,
we di mɔnin sta dɛn bin de siŋ togɛda, ɛn ɔl PAPA GƆD in pikin dɛn bin de ala wit gladi?
“Udat ol di si mek i nɔ ovaflo go na land we riva dɛn kin wan ovaflo;
we a kɔba di si wit klawd ɛn mek i dak,
ɛn gi am limit ɛn mek i nɔ de ovaflo go na land,
ɛn tɛl am se, “Na ya yu go tap, yu nɔ fɔ pas ya, ɛn na ya yu swɛlin dɛn fɔ tap?
“Frɔm we yu mama bɔn yu, yu dɔn ɛva kɔmand mɔnin fɔ kam, dɔn i kam,
ɛn mek layt shayn ɔlsay we de mek dɛn wikɛd pipul dɛn ayd?
We mɔnin kam, ɔlman de si di il ɛn di vali dɛn, yu go si di land klia wan lɛk klos we fol fol lɛk rozis.
We san kɔmɔt, wikɛd pipul nɔ ba gladi, bikɔs, dɛn kin lɔs di pawa we dɛn kin tek du pɔsin bad.
“Yu dɔn ɛva go bɔtɔm usay wata de bɔs ɔnda di si, go stɔdi de ɛn si aw bɔtɔm de tan?
Ɛnibɔdi dɔn sho yu di domɔt fɔ go usay dayman dɛn de, ɔ di dak domɔt fɔ go usay dayman de wet jɔjmɛnt?
Yu no aw di wɔl big lɛk? Tɛl mi if yu no.
“Yu no usay layt kɔmɔt, ɔ usay daknɛs kɔmɔt,
so dat yu go kɛr dɛn go usay dɛn fɔ go ɛn tek dɛn go bak usay yu pul dɛn?
Yu no ɛn, yu bin dɔn bɔn ɛn? Yɛs, yu na ol olpa ɛn?
Yu dɔn ɛva go na di sto we a de kip sno, ɔ di sto we a de kip lokɔs,
we a dɔn kip fɔ di de we trɔbul go kam, di de we fɛt go fɔdɔm?
Yu sabi di rod fɔ go usay layt de kɔmɔt go ɔlsay, usay di briz we de kɔmɔt na di ist de skata go na di wɔl?
“Udat mek di rod we ebi ren de pas fɔdɔm kam dɔŋ, ɛn di say we tɛnda in nɔys de pas,
di rod fɔ briŋ ren kam na land we mɔtalman nɔ de, na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, usay pipul dɛn nɔ de;
lɛ grɔn we dɛn nɔ de plant pan sɛf drink wata, so dat di gras dɛnsɛf go gro?
“Ren gɛt papa? Udat bɔn dyu?
Na us uman in bɛlɛ ays kɔmɔt, ɔ udat dɔn bɔn frɔst we de kɔmɔt ɔp di klawd?
Di si de traŋa lɛk ston ɛn pantap di wata de tɔn ays.
“Yu ebul tay Pliadis in chen, ɔ lus Orayɔn in kɔd dɛn?
Yu ebul mek di sta dɛn chenj bay tɔn na nɛt, ɔ yu go ebul gyad di big Bia ɛn di smɔl Bia sta dɛn?
Yu sabi di lɔ dɛn na ɛvin? Yu go ebul mek dɛn obe dɛn na ath?
“Yu ebul ala mek yu vɔys rich na di skay, so dat ren go kɔba yu?
Yu ebul sɛn laytin dɛn lɛ dɛn go ɛn kam bak kam tɛl yu se, ‘Wi dɔn kam’?
Udat de gi dɛn bɔd sɛns, ɔ sho dyu aw fɔ prɛd?
Udat gɛt da sɛns de fɔ kɔnt di klawd? Ɔ udat ebul tɔn di tapolin we de na di skay oba lɛ ren go kam,
we di dɔst dɛn gɛda, ɛn dɛn dɔn mek lɔmp?
“Yu ebul fɛn it fɔ layɔn na bush, ɔ ivin fid di pikin layɔn dɛn lɛ dɛn bɛlful,
we dɛn de insay dɛn ples we dɛn tap, ɔ we dɛn de ɔntin fɔ tin fɔ it?
Udat de gi da gridi bɔd we nem Revɛn tin fɔ kech it, we in pikin dɛn de kray ɛn in de flay ɔlɔbɔt de fɛn it?
“Yu no ustɛm got kin bɔn? Yu dɔn ɛva si we dia de bɔn?
Yu no ɔmɔs mɔnt dɛn kin gɛt bɛlɛ fɔ, ɛn yu no di tɛm we dɛn fɔ bɔn,
ustɛm dɛn kin butu dɔŋ, bɔn dɛn pikin, ɛn dɛn pen dɔn?
Dɛn pikin dɛn trɔŋ ɛn fri fɔ du wetin dɛn want, dɛn go de fɔ dɛnsɛf ɛn nɔ go to dɛn mama we bɔn dɛn igen
“Udat mek dɛn bush dɔŋki dɛn fri? Udat gi dɛn fridɔm,
dɛn we a gi di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, ɛn di say we sɔl de plɛnti wan, fɔ tap?
I nɔ de yɛri di nɔys we de na dɛn siti dɛn, ɛn i nɔ de yɛri nɔbɔdi de ala pan am fɔ wok.
I si di wanol mawnten as ples fɔ am fɔ it, ɛn de it ɔltin we na grin lif.
Bush kaw go gri fɔ wok fɔ yu? I go de ol nɛt usay yu kin gi yu animal dɛn it?
Yu go ebul tek rop tay wan to da ayɛn we yu de tek dig fam ɛn mek i wok fɔ yu?
Yu go se bikɔs i gɛt tumɔs trɛnk, yu lɛf yu ebi wok dɛn gi am?
Yu biliv se i go kam bak wit yu rɛs we yu dɔn kɔt na di ples we dɛn kin mas mas rɛs?
“Da big bɔd we nem ɔstrich kin nak in fɛda dɛn wit gladi, bɔt i nɔ go ebul flay lɛk da bɔd we dɛn kin kɔl, kaw enjɛl.
Bikɔs i de lɛf in eg ɔnda grɔn lɛ di grɔn wam dɛn fɔ am;
I de fɔgɛt se fut kin brok dɛn, ɛn dɛn wayl animal dɛn kin mas dɛn.
I kin trit in pikin dɛn bad, lɛk se nɔto in bɔn dɛn; ɛn i nɔ bisin wetin apin bikɔs i nɔ bisin if ɔl in lebɔ go fɔ natin;
bikɔs PAPA GƆD nɔ gi am sɛns, i nɔ gi am we fɔ tink fɔ du bɛtɛ.
We ɔstrich grap fɔ rɔn, i kin laf pɔsin ɛn di ɔs we di pɔsin de rayd.
“Na yu gi ɔs trɛnk ɛn pawa? Na yu gi am da lɔŋ ia nain nɛk we sho se i gɛt trɛnk?
Na yu mek i de jomp lɛk lokɔs? We i de blo nain nos sɛf kin mek pipul fred.
I de dig di grɔn wit in fut dɛn fɔ sho se i gɛt trɛnk; dɔn i rɔn wit spid go mit in ɛnimi dɛn na batul fil.
I nɔ de tink bɔt fred ɛn natin nɔ de pwɛl in at, so i nɔ de rɔnawe kɔmɔt na batul fil.
Na pan am di lɛda bag fɔ wɛpɔn kin de mek nɔys, na pan am di spia ɛn di javlin kin de de glita.
I kin de mago mago fɔ rɔn wit ful spid; as i yɛri di trɔmpɛt so, i kin jomp ɛn rɔn wit ful spid.
Wɛn dɛn kin blo di trɔmpɛt, i kin se, “Nain dat!” I de mɛmba we dɛn kin go fɛt. I de mɛmba we di kɔmanda dɛn kin ala de kɔmand di sojaman dɛn.
“Na yu sɛns mek ak de flay, de opin in fɛda dɛn we i de flay go na di sawt?
Na yu kin tɛl di igul fɔ go ɔp di mawnten go bil in os?
Na dɛn big big ston dɛn i tap, usay dɛn shap shap ay ston dɛn kin kɔba am.
Na de i kin de de luk fɔ tin fɔ it; i kin dɔn si am fawe.
In pikin dɛn de drink blɔd, ɛn na usay day tin de, i kin lɛk fɔ de.
PAPA GƆD tɛl Job se:
“Yu nɔ go lɛf fɔ agyu wit mi naw, mi we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti? Yu we de agyu wit PAPA GƆD, ansa.”
Nain Job ansa PAPA GƆD se:
“Mi na natin; wetin mi go ansa se? A nɔ go mistek se natin.
A bin dɔn tɔk wan tɛm, tu tɛm, so a nɔ go tɔk natin igen
Nain PAPA GƆD ansa Job insay briz se:
“Tinap lɛk man; a go aks yu sɔm kwɛshɔn dɛn we yu go ansa.
Yu go ɛva se mi rɔŋ? Yu go du dat so dat yu go sho se yu nɔ du natin?
Yu gɛt pawa lɛk PAPA GƆD, yu vɔys trɔŋ lɛk in yon?
“If na so i bi, lɛ a si di rɛspɛkt ɛn pawa we yu gɛt; drɛs wit dia dia klos dɛn we kiŋ dɛn kin wɛr.
Vɛks bad bad wan ɛn put ɔl dɛn prawd pipul dɛn dɔŋ na layf.
Mek ɔl dɛn prawd pipul kam dɔŋ na layf; ɛn kil ɔl dɛn wikɛd pipul dɛn.
Bɛr dɛn ɔl ɔnda grɔn ɛn mek dɛn go tap wit dɛn wan dɛn we dɔn day.
Datɛnde, a go se yu du wɛl, ɛn se na ɔl bay yusɛf yu du ɔl dat.
“Luk Biamɔth we a mek lɛk we a mek yu; i de it gras lɛk kaw.
Luk in trɛnk nain bɛlɛ ɛn in trɛnk nain mɔsul.
I mek in tel traŋa lɛk tik; di mɔsul dɛn nain lɛg traŋa.
In bon dɛn trɔŋ lɛk ayɛn, in lɛg tan lɛk ayɛn ba.
“Na wan pan di fɔs tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD mek; Udat no se na im mek am, lɛ i kam fɛt am.
Na dɛn mawnten i de it, usay ɔl dɛn bush animal dɛn de ple.
I lidɔm ɔnda chuk chuk bush, insay dɛn lɔŋ flawa na dɛn swamp.
Na dɛn tik dɛn kin gi am shed; dɛn lɔŋ tik dɛn we gɛt lɔŋ lif, we de na watasay, kin de rawnd am.
I lɛk di riva de tɔnɔbɔ, i nɔ de fred, i nɔ de shek sɛf i lɛk aw Riva Jɔdan wata de splash nain fes.
Yu go ebul kech am wit uk ɔ bɔs in nos wit trap?
Yu ebul kech Lɛviatan wit fish uk, ɔ tay in mɔt wit rop?
Yu ebul put rop insay in nos, ɔ bɔs in jɔ wit uk?
I go beg yu lɛ yu nɔ kil am? I go bɛl yu wit fayn fayn tɔk?
I go mek wanwɔd wit yu se in go wok fɔ yu sote go?
Yu go ple wit am di we we yu go ple wit bɔd ɔ yu go tay rop nain nɛk de waka so dat yu wokuman dɛn go ple wit am?
Treda dɛn go ebul tɔk prayz fɔ am? Dɛn go ebul sheb am?
Yu go ebul chuk chuk am wit da shap tin we dɛn de tek kech fish, ɔ in ed wit spia fɔ kech fish?
Tɔch am wit yu an; mɛmba di tin we i go pas yu; yu nɔ go du am igen!
A se, mɔtalman at pwɛl; we i si Lɛviatan, i fɔdɔm na grɔn wantɛm.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we wayl te i go se in de go chalenj am. Wɛl, udat naw go se in de chalenj mi.
Udat dɔn gi mi sɔntin we go se a fɔ pe am bak? Ɔl wetin de na dis wɔl, na mi gɛt am.
“A mɔs tɛl una bɔt in fut dɛn, ɔ in trɛnk, ɔ in bɔdi.
Udat go ebul pul in kanda? Udat go ebul bɔs in trɔŋ trɔŋ kanda?
Udat gɛt trɛnk fɔ mek i opin in mɔt? In tit dɛnsɛf go mek yu fred.
In bak kɔba wit skel dɛn we de na tret layn; dɛn de so nia, yu go min se na wanol tin.
Dɛn de so nia dɛn kɔmpin dat briz sɛf nɔ ebul pas bitwin dɛn
Dɛn ɔl jɔyn; dɛn so lidɔm lidɔm pantap dɛn kɔmpin, pɔsin nɔ go ebul pul dɛn.
We i sniz, faya de kɔmɔt, ɛn in yay rɛd lɛk we san de kɔmɔt.
Faya de kɔmɔt nain mɔt; na so spak dɛn de kɔmɔt.
Smok de kɔmɔt nain nosol dɛn, lɛk na gras de bɔn ɔnda pɔt na faya.
Di blo we i de blo nɔmɔ, kin mek kol kech, ɛn faya de kɔmɔ nain mɔt.
In nɛk so gɛt pawa dat we yu si am, yu mɔs fred.
Di bif pat nain bɔdi gɛda gɛda i traŋa lɛk ayɛn.
In at traŋa lɛk ston, lɛk di bɔtɔm grenin ston.
We i tinap, di gɔd dɛnsɛf kin fred; we i go dɔŋ, dɛn kin fred te dɛn rɔnawe.
I lɛk sɔd mit am, na fɔ natin, i lɛk na spia, javlin ɔ da shap tin lɛk nel we dɛn kin kɔl dat, ɔl na fɔ natin.
Ayɛn na lɛk brumtik to am ɛn bras na lɛk rɔtin tik.
I nɔ de fred aro; we dɛn sɛn ston pan am wit sliŋ, i kin tan lɛk brumtik.
Dɛn tik we dɛn kin mek fɔ bit pɔsin tan lɛk brumtik to am, i kin laf we dɛn kin sɛn spia pan am.
We i drɛg na pɔtɔpɔtɔ grɔn, di grɔn kin tan lɛk we katapila tit krep am.
I de mek di si de bwɛl lɛk pɔt na faya; i kin bwɛl lɛk we mɛrɛsin de na faya.
I kin mek di swɛlin dɛn shayn shayn biɛn am na di si; pɔsin go tink se na sop wata de na di si.
Natin nɔ de na dis wɔl we tan lɛk am, na krichɔ we nɔ de fred natin.
I tek am se natin nɔ de we pas am; in na di kiŋ fɔ ɔl di wayl animal dɛn.
Nain Job ansa PAPA GƆD se:
A no se natin nɔ de we yu nɔ ebul du, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul tap ɛnitin we yu wan du.
Yu aks mi se us rayt a gɛt fɔ aks yu we yu du sɔntin wit yu yon sɛns. Na dat bin mek a tɔk bɔt tin dɛn we a nɔ no natin bɔt, tin dɛn we a nɔ no bɔt wande.
Yu se mek a lisin we yu de tɔk ɛn ansa yu kwɛshɔn dɛn.
A bin no yu nɔmɔ bay wetin a yɛri pipul dɛn de se, bɔt naw a dɔn si yu wit mi yon yay.
Dat mek a dɔn shem, so a de rɔb dɔst ɛn asis beg yu, lɛ yu sɔri fɔ mi.
We PAPA GƆD ɛn Job dɔn tɔk dɔn, PAPA GƆD tɛl Ɛlifaz we na Timanayt se, in dɔn vɛks pan in ɛn dɛn tu padi dɛn. I se nɔto di rayt tin dɛn se bɔt in PAPA GƆD. I se na Job we nain wokman, se di rayt tin.

PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ kɛr sɛvin man kaw ɛn sɛvin man ship go to Job we nain wokman, ɛn go ɔfa sakrifays we dɛn de bɔn na faya, fɔ pul dɛn ed. I se Job go pre fɔ dɛn ɛn in go ansa di pre we Job go pre, lɛ in nɔ pɔnish dɛn fɔ di fulish tin we dɛn du; i se dat na we dɛn nɔ se di rayt tin bɔt am, bɔt Job in bin se di rayt tin.
So Ɛlifaz we na Timanayt ɛn Bildad we na Shuayt, ɛn Zofa we na Naamatayt, go du wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl dɛn fɔ du. PAPA GƆD bin ansa Job in prea.
PAPA GƆD gi Job bak ɔl wetin i bɔn dɔn lɔs, wɛn i bin dɔn pre fɔ in padi dɛn dɔn; i gi am tu tɛm wetin i bin gɛt fɔstɛm.

Nain in brɔda ɛn sista dɛn, ɛn ɔl di wan dɛn we bin no am fɔstɛm, go it ɛn drink nain os; dɛn sho am se dɛn sɔri fɔ am fɔ ɔl di bad tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD bin mek mit am. Ɔlman gi am wan wan kɔpɔ ɛn wan wan gold riŋ.
PAPA GƆD blɛs Job we i bin olpas we i bin yɔŋ; i bin gɛt fɔtin tawzin ship, siks tawzin kamɛl, tu tawzin kaw ɛn wan tawzin dɔŋki.
I bin gɛt sɛvin bɔypikin ɛn tri gyal pikin.
In fɔs pikin bin nem Jimayma, di sɛkɛn wan bin nem Kizaya, ɛn di tɔd wan bin nem Kerɛn Apuch.
Insay di wanol kɔntri, nɔn uman nɔ bin de we fayn lɛk Job in gyal pikin dɛn. Dɛn papa bin gi dɛnsɛf prɔpati we i bin de gi dɛn brɔda dɛn.
Afta ɔl dat dɔn bi, Job bin de fɔ wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fɔti ia mɔ, ɛn i si in bɔypikin dɛn, in bɔypikin dɛn bɔypikin dɛn, te rich di nɔmba fo jɛnareshɔn.
Job bin dɔn ol bad bad wan bifo i day.
I fayn fɔ di pɔsin we nɔ de fala wetin bad pipul se, we nɔ de kip bad kɔmpin ɛn du wetin dɛn de du, dɔn i nɔ de jɔyn bad gɛŋ fɔ mɔk PAPA GƆD.
I go fayn mɔ if i de ɛnjɔy fɔ rid PAPA GƆD in wɔd ɛn de tink bɔt PAPA GƆD in lɔ de ɛn nɛt.
Dis kayn man tan lɛkɛ we yu plant tik nia watasay, we de bia frut in rayt tɛm ɛn in lif dɛn nɔ de wida. I go bɛtɛ pan ɔl wetin i de du.
Noto so i go bi fɔ di bad man o! Di bad man in tan lɛkɛ chaf chaf we briz kin blo ɔlɔbɔt.
We PAPA GƆD go de jɔj di wikɛd man, i mɔs kɔndɛm am, dɔn i go mek i nɔ de usay dɛn wan we de du wetin rayt de.
PAPA GƆD nɔ de tek jok fɔ udat de waka tret bɔt di bad man go sɔfa fɔ ɔl wetin i dɔn du.
Wetin du di neshɔn dɛn de tay bagin ɛn di pipul de plan tin we nɔ go wok?
Di kiŋ dɛn we de rul grap wit wanwɔd ɛn mek bagin pan PAPA GƆD ɛn di kiŋ we i chuz.
Dɛn se dɛn fɔ fri dɛnsɛf so dat dɛn nɔ go de ɔnda PAPA GƆD ɛn in kiŋ dɛn kɔntrol.
PAPA GƆD, we sidɔm na di ay chia usay kiŋ kin sidɔm jɛs de laf dɛn; i shek in ed pan di nɔnsɛns we dɛn de pan.
Dɔn i ala ɛn tɔk pan dɛn vɛks wan we mek dɛn skyad.
I se in dɔn put udat i want as kiŋ na Zayɔn we nain oli ples.
Di kiŋ go tɔk wetin PAPA GƆD dɔn tɛl am. I se, PAPA GƆD tɛl am se in nain bɔypikin ɛn dat tide insɛf dɔn bi in papa.
I tɛl am se, i fɔ aks am dɔn in go gi am ɔl di neshɔn dɛn; i go gi am ɔl di neshɔn dɛn na di wɔl fɔ bi in yon.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, i go mek i ol dɛn wit traŋa an ɛn nyamanyama dɛn lɛkɛ we kle pɔt skata.
I se dɛn we na kiŋ biev lɛkɛ udat dɛn gɛt sɛns; ɛn tek tɛm fɔ rul dɛn kɔntri dɛn.
Fɔ gɛt fred we yu de sav PAPA GƆD ɛn we yu gladi sɛf du am wit fred.
Put yusɛf dɔŋ bifo PAPA GƆD in bɔypikin mek i nɔ vɛks ɛn dɔnawe wit yu, bikɔs i kin vɛks ɛnitɛm. I go fayn fɔ ɔl udat de go to am fɔ mek i kɔba dɛn.
E PAPA GƆD! Mi ɛnimi dɛn bɔku ɛn bɔku bɔku dɔn tɔn pan mi.
Dɛn ɔl de se “PAPA GƆD nɔ gɛt fɔ pul mi pan trɔbul.”
Bɔt na yu PAPA GƆD na di wan we de kɔba mi lɛkɛ we fɔl de kɔba in pikin; na yu nɔmɔ de pul mi pan shem we go mek a waka de es mi ed ɔp.
A de kray lawd wan to PAPA GƆD ɛn i de ansa mi frɔm in oli il
A lidɔm slip; a wek bak bikɔs PAPA GƆD mek a gɛt layf.
I lɛk pipul we bɔku lɛkɛ sansan mek gɛŋ fɔ fɛt mi, a nɔ go fred.
PAPA GƆD, grap nɔ! Du sɔntin! PAPA GƆD, pul mi pan dis trɔbul! Wap mi ɛnimi dɛn na dɛn jɔ; pul di bad man in tit dɛn.
Na PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ de pul pɔsin pan trɔbul. Lɛ PAPA GƆD blɛs in pipul.
Lisin to mi we a de aks yu fɔ ɛp mi, yu we na di PAPA GƆD, we de du rayt. Pul dis trɔbul ya kɔmɔt pan mi. Sɔri fɔ mi ɛn ansa mi prea.
Una dɛn mɔtalman ya! Aw lɔŋ una go de put mi pan shem? Aw lɔŋ una go de pan fɔls ɛn yuslɛs layf?
Una no vɛri wɛl se PAPA GƆD dɔn pik ɔl udat ɔl udat de du tin tret wan fɔ bi in yon, PAPA GƆD go mɔs ɛp mi wans a aks am fɔ ɛp mi.
Nɔ mek vɛks mek yu sin; so wɛn yu lidɔm na nɛt na yu bed ɔ wɛn yu wande, tink bɔt ɔl wetin a dɔn se bɔt nɔ se fiŋ!
Mek yu sakrifays to PAPA GƆD aw i want am ɛn put yu trɔs pan PAPA GƆD.
Bɔku pipul de aks se udat go du gud to dɛn; PAPA GƆD duya du gud to wi!
Yu dɔn mek mi at gladi pas di gladi we pɔsin kin gɛt we i avɛst plɛnti fɔ it ɔ we i gɛt nyu wayn fɔ drink.
We a lidɔm, a go slip fayn bikɔs na yu nɔmɔ PAPA GƆD de mek a fil sef.
E PAPA GƆD, lisin we a de tɔk to yu, yɛri sɛf we a de kray.
Yɛri we a de kray fɔ mek yu ɛp mi. Mi PAPA GƆD ɛn mi kiŋ, na yu a de pre to.
PAPA GƆD yu de yɛri mi vɔys na mɔnin ɛn we do klin a de put mi kes bifo yu ɛn wet fɔ yu ansa.
Yu na PAPA GƆD, we nɔ de tek rɔbish so bad pɔsin nɔ go de usay yu de.
Pipul we de kak nɔ go ebul fɔ wɔship yu; yu et ɔl udat bad.
PAPA GƆD, yu nɔ lɛk dɛn wan we gɛt bɛnbɛn ɔ we de lay ɔ we kin want fɔ kil pɔsin; yu go dɔnawe wit dɛn bikɔs yu et dɛn.
Bikɔs yu lɛk mi, a go go usay yu de. A go go na yu os, bɛn dɔŋ ɛn wɔship yu insay de.
PAPA GƆD, yu we de du ɔltin tret, mek am izi fɔ mi fɔ du wetin rayt. Bikɔs mi ɛnimi dɛn bɔku. Mek am izi fɔ mi fɔ du wetin yu want.
Pɔsin nɔ de biliv ɛnitin we dɛn de se, na soso bad tin dɛn de mɛmba. If yu fala dɛn switmɔt yu go de pan trɔbul. Dɛn swit tɔk kin mek yu fɛn yu yon day.
PAPA GƆD, se mi ɛnimi dɛn gilti! Mek dɛn fɔl bay dɛn yon wet. Pɔnish dɛn fɔ dɛn bɔku sin, bikɔs dɛn dɔn tɔn rebɛl pan yu.
Bɔt lɛ ɔl udat abop pan yu fɔ kɔba dɛn, gladi. Lɛ dɛn de siŋ ɔltɛm bikɔs dɛn gladi. Kɔntinyu fɔ kɔba dɛn lɛkɛ aw fɔl de kɔba in pikin dɛn, so dat dɛn go gladi ɔltɛm fɔ wetin yu de du.
PAPA GƆD, yu kin blɛs ɔl udat de du rayt; yu rɛdi fɔ kɔba dɛn frɔm dɛn ɛnimi.
E PAPA GƆD! Duya nɔ vɛks ala pan mi, ɛn nɔ pɔnish mi bikɔs yu vɛks.
Sɔri fɔ mi bikɔs a nɔ gɛt trɛnk igen; PAPA GƆD ɛp mi, mek a wɛl bikɔs mi bon dɛn ɔl de at.
Mi sol sɛf de fil wik. PAPA GƆD aw lɔŋ a gɛt fɔ de pan dis nambara?
PAPA GƆD, duya nɔ fɔgɛt mi; fɔseka di lɔv we yu gɛt fɔ mi, nɔ mek a day.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de mɛmba yu say we i dɔn day. Udat go prez yu we i de nain grev?
A dɔn taya fɔ kray; a de kray ol nɛt; mi pila sok so bikɔs a de kray ol nɛt.
Mi ɛnimi dɛn mek a dɔn kray te i tan lɛkɛ se mi yay want fɔ kɔmɔt.
Una, we de mɛmba bad, una kɔmɔt nia mi! PAPA GƆD dɔn yɛri we a de kray.
PAPA GƆD dɔn yɛri di pre we a de pre fɔ mek i ɛp mi; I dɔn ansa mi prea.
Ɔl mi ɛnimi dɛn go shem ɛn kɔle we PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn ɔl kɔmɔt biɛn mi. Dɛn go kɔmɔt biɛn mi wit shem ɛn disgres.
E PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD, na yu nɔmɔ a kin go to we go kɔba mi; sev mi ɛn pul mi ɛnimi dɛn kɔmɔt biɛn mi,
ɔ nɔ so dɛn go chɛr chɛr mi lɛkɛ aw layɔn de chɛr bif we i kech dɔn nɔbɔdi nɔ go pul mi na dɛn an.
E PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD, if a de du bad ɔ mɛmba bad fɔ mi kɔmpin,
if a gɛt bad at ɔ de pwɛl mi kɔmpin fɔ natin,
lɛ mi ɛnimi dɛn rɔnata mi, kech mi ɛn bit mi ɛn lɛ dɛn bit mi te a day.
E PAPA GƆD, tinap fɔ mi! Sho mi ɛnimi dɛn aw yu vɛks. PAPA GƆD grap wantɛm, mek ɔlman no se yu de jɔj rayt.
Mek ɔl udat dɔn gɛda kam rawnd yu mek yu rul dɛn frɔm ɔp usay yu de.
PAPA GƆD na yu na di jɔj fɔ ɔlman. PAPA GƆD bikɔs a de du wetin rayt, lɛ dɛn no se a inosɛnt.
E PAPA GƆD we de du tin tret wan, yu we no wetin de na wi at ɛn aw wi de fil. Tap bad pipul fɔ kɛriɔn dɛn wikɛdnɛs ɛn mek bɛtɛ fala udat de du gud.
Na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti de kɔba mi, in na PAPA GƆD we de sev udat de du gud
PAPA GƆD we de du tin tret wan. Na PAPA GƆD we nɔ de tɔlaret bad atɔl.
PAPA GƆD de rɛdi fɔ atak dɛn bad pipul ya if dɛn nɔ chenj.
I dɔn rɛdi ɔl in denja denja wɛpɔn dɛn fɔ atak dɛn.
Da pɔsin we na bad de nɔmɔ nain at, go de mɛmba bad ɔltɛm fɔ ɔda pipul, ɛn go de lay pan dɛn.
Udat dig ol fɔ pɔsin, nainsɛf go fɔdɔm insay de.
Di trɔbul we i de mɛmba fɔ ɔda pɔsin go tɔn bak pan am. Aw i de yagba fɔ du ɔda pɔsin bad, na so ɔda pɔsin go yagba fɔ du am bad.
A go tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki bikɔs i de du tin rayt. A go siŋ prez to in nem as PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl.
E PAPA GƆD, we na wi Gɔd, yu nem wɔndaful na di wanol wɔl! Di glori we yu gɛt ay pas ɛvin sɛf.
Yu dɔn se dɛn lili pikin ɛn dɛn bebi sɛf ɔl go prez yu, dat go mek dɛn wan we nɔ lɛk yu, we na yu ɛnimi dɛn, sɛt dɛn mɔt.
Wɛn a tink bɔt di tin dɛn ɔp klawd we yu tek yu an mek, di mun ɛn di sta dɛn we yu put na di skay,
i kin mek a tink se udat na mɔtalman we yu bisin bɔt am bifo a se mi we yu patikla bɔt.
Yu mek mɔtalman we na yu nɔmɔ de pantap am; yu mek am lɛk kiŋ ɛn gi am ɔna.
Yu mek am bɔsman fɔ wetin yu mek na wɔl; yu put ɔltin ɔnda am,
dɛn animal we dɛn de mɛn na os, dɛn wayl animal
dɛn bɔd we de flay, ɛn dɛn fish wit ɔl dɛn ɔda tin dɛn we kiŋ de swim na di si.
E PAPA GƆD, we na wi Gɔd, yu nem, wɔndaful na di wanol wɔl!
PAPA GƆD a go prez yu wit ɔl mi at; a go tɛl ɔlman bɔt di wɔndaful tin dɛn we yu de du.
E PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl na yu de mek a go gladi. A go siŋ ɛn prez yu nem.
Wɛn yu kin sho yusɛf to mi ɛnimi dɛn, dɛn kin rɔnawe, fɔdɔm ɛn day.
Yu dɔn tinap fɔ mi ɛn yu no se a rayt. Yu sidɔm ɔp yu tron ɛn yu de jɔj rayt.
Yu dɔn kɔndɛm ɔl dɛn neshɔn we de wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn ɛn pɔnish dɛn fɔ dɛn wikɛdnɛs; yu dɔn krach dɛn nem kɔmɔt ɔltogɛda.
Dɛn dɔn dɔn kpatakpata; yu dɔn pwɛl dɛn siti sɛf ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tink bɔt dɛn igen
PAPA GƆD de rul lɛkɛ kiŋ sote go; i dɔn sɛt fɔ jɔjmɛnt.
I go jɔj di wɔl tret wan; i nɔ go de pan bɛnbɛn we i de jɔj.
Na PAPA GƆD pɔsin go go to wɛn dɛn tek advantej pan am; in na lɛkɛ fɔl we de kɔba in pikin dɛn we i si trɔbul.
Bɔt udat no yu as PAPA GƆD go trɔs yu ɔltɛm; bikɔs yu na PAPA GƆD we nɔ de sɛt yay pan udat abop pan yu.
Siŋ ɛn prez PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD we na Kiŋ na Zayɔn! Tɛl ɔl dɛn neshɔn na wɔl, wetin i dɔn du.
PAPA GƆD we de fɛt fɔ udat dɛn kil, nɔ de mek blɔd kray fɔ natin i nɔ de mek dɛfyes pan udat de kray fɔ mek i ɛp am, ɛn i nɔ de sɛt yay pan udat de sɔfa.
E PAPA GƆD! Yu de si aw mi ɛnimi dɛn de biɛn mi! Sɔri fɔ mi ɛn pul mi kɔmɔt na dɛn an.
Mek a nɔ day so dat a go tɔk bɔt yu gudnɛs to ɔl udat de na Jerusɛlɛm. Dɔn a go gladi bikɔs yu sev mi.
Di ol we di ɛnimi dɛn dig nainsay de, dɛnsɛf dɔn fɔdɔm; di trap we dɛn bin sɛt, dɔn kech dɛn.
Ɔlman sabi se, wi PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD we de du tin tret wan ɔltɛm; di bad we di bad man de mɛmba fɔ ɔda pɔsin, nain de fala am.
Di bad man go day ɛn ɔl di neshɔn dɛn wan we nɔ tek PAPA GƆD mek natin, dɛnsɛf go day.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ de ɛva sɛt yay pan poman ɛn i go mek dɛn nɔ disapɔynt pan di abop we dɛn abop.
PAPA GƆD, grap nɔ, nɔ lɛ mɔtalman fil se i pas yu! Lɛ di neshɔn dɛn no se dɛn gɛt fɔ tinap bifo yu fɔ jɔjmɛnt.
PAPA GƆD mek di neshɔn dɛn fred yu. Mek lɛ dɛn no se, dɛn na ɔdinari mɔtalman.
PAPA GƆD, wetin mek yu de fa frɔm wi, PAPA GƆD? I tan lɛkɛ yu jɛs lɛf wi to wisɛf we trɔbul kam.
Di bad man we tink se in pas ɔlman de buli udat wik; lɛ di trap we i sɛt, kech am.
I de mek mɔt ɛn tek advantej pan pipul; i de blɛs dɛn wan we gridi lɛk insɛf bɔt de tɔk bad bɔt PAPA GƆD.
I fil se i gɛt ɔltin, i nɔ nid PAPA GƆD; i de biev lɛkɛ se PAPA GƆD nɔ de, as i nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du wit PAPA GƆD.
Ɔltin de go ɔn wɛl fɔ am I nɔ ebul fɔ ɔndastand aw PAPA GƆD kin jɔj pɔsin so i de pɔynt fiŋa pan in ɛnimi.
I de tɛl insɛf se natin nɔ de na di wɔl we de shek am. I gladi bikɔs ɔltin fayn fɔ am.
As i opin in mɔt so, na soso lay, bad wɔd ɛn trɛtin tɔk de kɔmɔt de; i gɛt sɔm kayn tɔk we go put yu insay trɔbul.

Di PAPA GƆD we a de wɔship na PAPA GƆD we nɔ gɛt bɔt. Yu kin biliv wetin i se bikɔs i de kip to in wɔd, In na wanol kɔba klos fɔ udat go to am fɔ kɔba.
Udat de we tan lɛk PAPA GƆD di PAPA GƆD we wi de wɔship? Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we tan lɛkɛ am. Na PAPA GƆD we tan lɛkɛ big ston we yu nɔ go muf.

Yu dɔn gi mi yu big shild we de sev mi ɛn de kip mi sɛf wit yu pawa; yu de yɛri mi prea, ansa mi ɛn gi mi di trɛnk we a nid.

PAPA GƆD de! Lɛ wi prez am! Lɛ we prez di PAPA GƆD we sev mi!
