E PAPA GƆD, a de pre se mek ɔl wetin de kɔmɔt na mi mɔt, ɛn ɔl wetin de na mi at, bi wetin yu go gladi fɔ tek na mi an. Yu na mi PAPA GƆD we de kɔba mi ɛn sev mi!
Lɛ PAPA GƆD ɛp yu ɛn pul yu pan trɔbul! Lɛ PAPA GƆD, we na Jekɔb in PAPA GƆD, kɔba yu!
Lɛ PAPA GƆD sɛn ɛp fɔ yu, ɛp we go kɔmɔt na Zayɔn usay in prea os de.
Lɛ PAPA GƆD mɛmba ɔl wetin yu dɔn gi am bɔt mɔ so, lɛ i gladi fɔ tek di animal dɛn we yu dɔn bɔn bifo am as sakrifays
Lɛ PAPA GƆD lɛ yu gɛt ɔl wetin yu want ɛn lɛ bɛtɛ fala yu pan ɔl wetin yu plan fɔ du.
Wi go sɛlibret we yu win di batul ɛn mek bɔku nɔys fɔ prez PAPA GƆD Lɛ PAPA GƆD gi yu ɔl wetin yu de aks fɔ.
Na naw a no se PAPA GƆD de sev udat in pik fɔ bi Kiŋ; i de ansa na ɛvin usay i de ɛn i de yuz in pawa fɔ ɛp am win batul.
Sɔm pipul abop pan dɛn ɔs ɛn karej fɔ fɛt batul, bɔt wi abop pan PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd.
Dɛn wan we abop pan wetin dɛn gɛt, go fɔdɔm bup; bɔt wi we abop pan PAPA GƆD go tinap, deŋ!
E PAPA GƆD! Ɛp di Kiŋ fɔ win di batul! Yɛri ɛn ansa we wi de pre!
E PAPA GƆD, di Kiŋ gladi bad we yu dɔn ɛp am fɔ win di batul
Yu dɔn mek i gɛt wetin i want ɛn gi am ɔl wetin i aks fɔ.
Yu blɛs am ɛn gi am ɔlkayn gud tin yu put gold krawn nain ed.
I aks yu fɔ layf, ɛn yu gi am lɔŋ layf we i go ɛnjɔy.
As yu de ɛp am win batul, na so in pipul de rɛspɛkt am; yu dɔn mek i gɛt ɛyɛ we i de rul in pipul.
Yu dɔn blɛs am ɛn dis blɛsin go de sote go so i gladi bikɔs yu de wit am.
Di kiŋ trɔs PAPA GƆD; ɛn i no se PAPA GƆD lɛk am bad so i shɔ se i de de fɔs.
Di kiŋ go no udat nain ɛnimi dɛn ɛn i go yuz in pawa fɔ dil wit udat et am.
Wɛn i go bɔs so, i go nyakanyaka dɛn lɛk aw faya de pwɛl tin. Wɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn vɛks, in go jɛs pwɛl dɛn kpatakpata na faya.
Yu go kil ɔl dɛn jɛnareshɔn; ɛn nɔn dɛn sid nɔ go lɛf na wɔl.
Pan ɔl we dɛn de plan fɔ du bad, ɛn dɛn de pan ɔlkayn rikishi gem, dɛn nɔ go shek yu,
bikɔs yu go mek dɛn put dɛn tel midul dɛn lɛg ɛn rɔn lɛkɛ dɔg we yu tek em fɔ dɛn.
E PAPA GƆD! Yu na PAPA GƆD we big; wi go siŋ ɛn prez yu bikɔs yu wɔndaful!
E PAPA GƆD, yu we na mi PAPA GƆD wetin mek yu nɔ de ansa mi igen? Wetin mek yu dɔn kɔmɔt nia mi? Wetin a de se nɔ min natin to yu igen? Yu dɔn push fawe so yu nɔ go sev mi?
E PAPA GƆD, a de beg yu de ɛn nɛt fɔ sev mi, bɔt pan ɔl we yu nɔ de ansa mi a stil nɔ de taya.
Yu de mek so nɔmɔ bɔt yu na di oli PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de pre to bikɔs yu de rul as Kiŋ.
Na yu wi fɔstɛm-papa dɛn bin biliv pan; dɛn trɔs yu ɛn yu pul dɛn pan trɔbul.
Dɛn aks yu fɔ sev dɛn ɛn yu sev dɛn; dɛn trɔs yu ɛn yu nɔ disapɔynt dɛn.
Pipul tek mi lɛkɛ tumbu dɛn ɔl de laf mi, dɛn nɔ wan si mi.
We dɛn ɔl si mi, dɛn de provok mi; ɛn tek mi mek rederaun dɛn de pul int pan mi ɛn shumɔ pan mi;
dɛn kin se “Luk am, i se i trɔs PAPA GƆD; Lɛ i sev am nɔ. Lɛ PAPA GƆD pul am pan trɔbul if nain i biliv pan fɔ tru.”
Na yu mek mi mama bɔn mi; yu dɔn mek a trɔs yu frɔm we mi na bebi de sɔk bɔbi.
Bifo a bɔn nain dɛn dɔn an mi ova to yu; yu dɔn de kia fɔ mi frɔm we a de na mi mama in bɛlɛ.
Trɔbul nɔ de fa frɔm mi, so nɔ lɛf mi bikɔs nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ ɛp mi.
Mi ɛnimi dɛn tan lɛkɛ dɛn bad dɔg dɛn rawnd mi, dɛn tan lɛk dɛn wayl kaw na Beshan Na so dɛn ɔl dɔn sɔrawnd mi.
Mi ɛnimi dɛn de mek lɛk layɔn we dɔn kech bif ɛn sidɔm de it am, we dɛn si mi na so dɛn kin opin dɛn big mɔt lɛk se dɛn wan it mi.
Dɛn mek a so wik mi jɔynt ɛn mi bon dɛn ɔl de at. A dɔn giv ɔp. A nɔ fit fɔ natin igen; A tan lɛk waks we de kɔmɔt pan kyandul we i de bɔn.
A nɔ gɛt nɔn trɛnk igen ɔl mi trɛnk dɔn dɔn, a jɛs tan lɛkɛ broko broko kɔntri pɔt we pɔsin nɔ go yuz igen; yu lɛf mi to misɛf mek a go day.
Di mɔtalman dɛn we dɔn sɛt fɔ mi tan lɛkɛ we bad dɔg kech tifman. Dɛn dɔn chɛr chɛr mi an ɛn fut.
A dɔn so dray, na soso bonbon lɛf pan mi. Mi ɛnimi dɛn ɔl de luk mi pin ɛn blɔf pan mi.
Dɛn sheb mi klos to dɛnsɛf dɛn ivin gyambul fɔ no aw fɔ sheb mi klos.
PAPA GƆD, yu we a abop pan nɔ lɛf mi to misɛf. Kam mek yu pul mi kɔmɔt pan trɔbul, kwik wan.
Nɔ lɛ mi ɛnimi dɛn kil mi; nɔ mek dɛn wikɛd dɔg ya tek mi layf.
Ansa mi ɛn pul mi kɔmɔt na wulf mɔt. Nɔ lɛf mi gi dɛn fɔ kil mi.
Na usay ɔlman gɛda fɔ wɔship yu, na de a go ala tɔk aw yu gud. A go prez yu usay ɔlman gɛda.
Ɔl udat gɛt fred fɔ PAPA GƆD, lɛ wi prez am! Ɔl udat gɛt Jekɔb as grampa fɔ tɔk gud bɔt PAPA GƆD! Ɔl udat gɛt Izrɛl as grampa fɔ sho se dɛn gɛt rɛspɛkt fɔ PAPA GƆD, bad!
PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD we nɔ de sɛt yay pan udat de sɔfa i nɔ de gi in bak to udat want am fɔ ɛp am, ɛn i nɔ de lɔk in yes pan udat de beg am fɔ ɛp am.
Yu gi mi rizin fɔ prez yu ɛn a go prez yu usay ɔlman de. Ɔl udat gɛt fred fɔ yu go si se a du wetin a se. A go mek di sakrifays dɛn to yu as a bin se.
Ɔl udat nɔ gɛt fɔ it go kam ɛn dɛn go it; ɔl udat want fɔ prez yu, go prez yu. Lɛ wi ɔl gɛt lɔŋ layf ɛn ɛnjɔy wi layf!
Ɔlman na wɔl go mɛmba se i fɔ prez PAPA GƆD ɛn nain go bi PAPA GƆD insay ɔl di os dɛn,
bikɔs nain na di PAPA GƆD we fɔ wɔship ɛn in pawa as kiŋ na fɔ di wanol wɔl.
Ɔl udat de kak, go gɛt pati bɔt dɛn go mɛmba fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki; dɛn ɔl, wans dɛn na mɔtalman we gɛt fɔ day. Dɛn go ala se in na PAPA GƆD!
Di pikin dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet go wɔship am Dɛn go tɛl dɛn ɔl aw PAPA GƆD de sev in pipul.
Dɛn ɔl go no se PAPA GƆD de du wetin rayt bikɔs in na PAPA GƆD we dɔn du am.
Mi PAPA GƆD na lɛkɛ man we de mɛn ship natin nɔ de we a nid, we a nɔ go gɛt.
I de kɛr mi go usay a nɔ go yagba fɔ natin, i de gi mi kol at.
I de mek a luk yɔŋ ɛn frɛsh ɛvride. I de sho mi aw fɔ waka tret na layf, bikɔs i gud ɛn want mek ɔlman no se i gud.
Pan ɔl we sɔntɛnde a kin de pan trɔbul we kin mek a skyad, I kin yuz in pawa fɔ mek a no se i de wit mi. A nɔ go fred wans a no se yu de wit mi. Na yu de kɔba pan ɔlkayn bad tin.

Yu de mek a sidɔm midul mi ɛnimi dɛn, a de it ɛn a nɔ de fred. Infakt sɛf di we we yu de rɔb ori na mi ed mek a fil impɔtant. We yu de sav mi, mi kɔp kin ful sote i rɔnoba, so a kin drink te a satisfay.
A no se bikɔs yu gud ɛn bikɔs yu lɛk mi yu go de wit mi sote a day, ɛn na PAPA GƆD in os go bi mi os sote go.
Na PAPA GƆD mek di wɔl, so nain gɛt di wɔl; ɔl wetin de na wɔl ɛn ivin di pipul na PAPA GƆD gɛt ɔl.
We PAPA GƆD mek di wɔl, i bil di fawndeshɔn insay dip dip wata.
Udat ebul fɔ klem Mawnt Zayɔn? Udat ebul fɔ tinap bifo PAPA GƆD?
Na udat in an dɛn klin we gɛt klinat, we nɔ gɛt ɔda gɔd na kɔna we i de wɔship ɛn nɔ de mek ipokrit se i de swɛ, we i nɔ min am.
Dis kayn pɔsin ya, go gɛt PAPA GƆD in blɛsin dɔn PAPA GƆD go kɔt kes fɔ am.
Na so i go bi fɔ udat de fala PAPA GƆD, udat biliv se in na di PAPA GƆD we Jekɔb bin de wɔship.
Lɛ di get dɛn opin wayd! Una opin di get dɛn wayd mek di Kiŋ we gɛt pawa pas ɔl pas kam insay.
Udat na dis kiŋ we gɛt pawa pas ɔl? In na PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD we pawaful, PAPA GƆD we de win ɔl in batul.
Lɛ di get dɛn opin wayd; Una opin di get dɛn wayd mek di Kiŋ we gɛt pawa pas ɔl, pas kam insay.
Udat na di Kiŋ we gɛt pawa pas ɔl? In na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nain na Kiŋ we in pawa pas ɔl.
PAPA GƆD, na yu a de tɔk to ɛn wɔship;
a put mi op pan yu, PAPA GƆD. Duya, nɔ mek a shem, nɔ mek mi ɛnimi dɛn laf mi.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we abop pan yu, we yu de mek shem, bɔt dɛn wan we gɛt tu mɔt biznɛs, yu go mek dɛn shem.
PAPA GƆD, sho mi usay fɔ waka ɛn aw fɔ waka na layf;
mek a du wetin nɔmɔ yu want mi fɔ du, bikɔs yu na mi PAPA GƆD ɛn mi Seviɔ ɛn na yu nɔmɔ a biliv pan.
Nɔ fɔgɛt aw yu bin dɔn de sho se yu gud, ɛn yu lɛk wi pipul we bin de lɔntɛm.
Fɔgiv mi sin dɛn we a kɔmit as yɔŋbɔy ɛn aw a bin de mek lɛk rebɛl pan yu, bikɔs yu lɛk mi ɛn yu gud, mɛmba mi ɛn fɔgiv mi fɔ ɔl mi dɔti trik dɛn.
PAPA GƆD gud ɛn i nɔ gɛt bɛnbɛn; so i de tich di sina aw fɔ biev.
Udat nɔ fil tu gud bɔt insɛf, i rɛdi fɔ tich am. I de gayd am aw fɔ du wetin rayt.
Ɔl udat de obe PAPA GƆD ɛn du wetin i want, in we go klia bikɔs we yu du tin PAPA GƆD in yon we, i de trit yu wit lɔv ɛn i nɔ go ɛva kɔmɔt biɛn yu.
PAPA GƆD mi sin dɛn bɔku, bɔt bikɔs yu gud, ɛn want ɔlman fɔ no aw yu gud, fɔgiv mi.
Di pɔsin we rɛdi fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD want, PAPA GƆD go mɔs sho am aw fɔ waka.
I go gɛt lɔŋ layf ɛn ɛnjɔy in jɛntri, dɔn in jɛnareshɔn sɛf go jɛntri ɛn go gɛt di land we i bin prɔmis dɛn.
Na udat gɛt rɛspɛkt fɔ PAPA GƆD i de tɛl in sikrit, ɛn mek dɛn no se i nɔ gɛt fɔ chenj in Kɔvinant.
Mi yay de pan PAPA GƆD, bikɔs nain nɔmɔ ebul pul mi na di trap we mi ɛnimi dɛn sɛt fɔ mi.
Duya luk mi ɛn sɔri fɔ mi, nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ ɛp mi ɛn dɛn de tek advantej pan mi.
Mi waala dɛn de bɔku; pul mi pan mɔnɛ.
Si di kayn trɔbul we a de pan ɛn fɔgiv mi sin dɛn.
Luk aw mi ɛnimi dɛn dɔn bɔku pan mi; ɛn aw dɛn et mi bad bad wan.
Kɔba mi ɛn pul mi pan waala; nɔ mek mi ɛnimi dɛn tɔn fɔ laf mi, na yu nɔmɔ a abop pan fɔ pul mi pan waala.
Mek di gudnɛs ɛn di waka we a de waka tret ɛp mi, bikɔs na yu a abop pan.
PAPA GƆD, sev yu pipul Izrɛl frɔm ɔl dɛn waala ya!
PAPA GƆD, tɔk fɔ mi nɔ, bikɔs a nɔ gɛt nɔn bɔt na mi layf. Na PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD a abop pan ɛn a nɔ de yɛk.
PAPA GƆD, tɛst mi ɛn tray mi luk insay mi at gud gud lɛ yu no wetin de na mi maynd;
bikɔs ɔltɛm a de mɛmba se yu lɛk mi ɛn tray ɔltɛm fɔ du wetin yu want.
A nɔ de kip kɔmpin wit udat de pan rikishi ɛn a nɔ de jɔyn gɛŋ wit udat ipokrit;
a nɔ lɛk fɔ de usay dɛn de plan bad so a nɔ de gri fɔ kip kɔmpin wit bad pipul.
A nɔ de du bad, mi an dɛn klin so a go jɔyn pipul fɔ wɔship yu.
A go siŋ lawd wan fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki dɔn a go tɔk bɔt ɔl di wɔndaful tin dɛn we yu de du.
PAPA GƆD a lɛk usay yu de, usay pipul kin si aw yu big ɛn wɔndaful.
Nɔ trit mi lɛk aw yu de trit udat na sina, ɛn mek a day lɛk udat de kil in kɔmpin,
we gɛt ɔl kayn skil fɔ du bad, ɛn we dɛn yuz mɔni fɔ blɛn in yay.
Mi a de waka tret; sɔri fɔ mi ɛn ansa mi.
A go tinap deŋ usay bɔku pipul de; A go prez PAPA GƆD usay bɔku pipul de.
Na PAPA GƆD di mek a si layt ɛn nain de sev mi; so a nɔ gɛt natin fɔ fred. Na PAPA GƆD de kɔba mi so a nɔ go fred natin.
Wɛn mi ɛnimi dɛn kin wan kil mi wit dɛn mɔt, wɛn dɛn ɛn ɔl udat gɛt bad at fɔ mi mek plan fɔ du mi bad, nɔn dɛn plan nɔ go wok.
If ivin wanol ami wan chalenj mi, a nɔ go yɛk sɛf; bifo a se dɛn wan mek wa pan mi, a nɔ go stil fred, a go trɔs PAPA GƆD.
Na wan tin nɔmɔ mi at de pan, ɛn nain a de beg PAPA GƆD fɔ; dat na sote a day, mek a go de wok nain os, so dat a go ɛnjɔy in gudnɛs ɛn a go du wetin i want.
We trɔbul kam, PAPA GƆD rɛdi fɔ mek sef ples fɔ mi; sef ples usay di trɔbul nɔ go mit mi.
Da tɛm de a go de mek babuyay pan mi ɛnimi dɛn, we a go dɔn win dɛn; dɔn a go go insay PAPA GƆD in os usay a go mek sakrifays ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD; ɛn mek siŋ dɛn fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki.
PAPA GƆD yɛri mi we a de kray to yu; fil fɔ mi ɛn ansa mi prea.
Yu dɔn tɛl mi se, na yu a fɔ put mi at pan; PAPA GƆD misɛf no se a fɔ put mi at pan yu.
Nɔ kɔmɔt biɛn mi. Nɔ lɛf mi to misɛf bikɔs yu vɛks; yu dɔn de wit mi ɔl dis tɛm, nɔ fɔsek mi naw. Nɔ lɛf mi to misɛf. Na yu na PAPA GƆD we fit fɔ sev mi.
Ivin if mi papa ɛn mi mama tɔn dɛn bak pan mi, PAPA GƆD go tek mi lɛk in yon pikin.
Bikɔs mi ɛnimi dɛn de wet fɔ laf mi, mek mi we klia. PAPA GƆD sho mi aw fɔ waka usay yu want nɔ.
Nɔ mek mi ɛnimi dɛn gɛt wetin dɛn want, bikɔs bɔku dɔn rɛdi fɔ lay pan mi lɛk a kɔmit kraym.
A biliv se; mi go ɛnjɔy PAPA GƆD in gudnɛs na ya so we a nɔ day yet.
Put yu trɔs pan PAPA GƆD. Nɔ giv ɔp put yu at dɔŋ. Put yu trɔs pan PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD, yu we dɔn de kɔba mi frɔm mi ɛnimi; nɔ mek dɛfyes pan mi we a de tɔk to yu. Bikɔs if yu du so, a go day.
Yɛri mi we a de pre, we a de kray fɔ mek yu ɛp mi, as a de es mi an ɔp de beg yu insay yu os.
Nɔ miks mi we yu de pɔnish bad pipul, dɛn wan dɛn we gɛt bad at, we de laf to dɛn neba dɔn dɛn chuk dɛn na dɛn bak.
Na lɛf dɛn fɔ go fri. Mek di bad we dɛn de du fala dɛn; pe dɛn fɔ di bad tin dɛn we dɛn dɔn du ɛn lɛ dɛn gɛt wetin dɛn wok fɔ.
As dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt PAPA GƆD ɛn wetin i de du, mek i lɛ dɛn alaki lɛ dɛn rɔndɔŋ ɛn nɔ grap bak.
Una lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD bikɔs i gud ɛn i dɔn yɛri we a de beg am fɔ av masi.
Na PAPA GƆD de gi mi trɛnk nain de kɔba mi; a go trɔs am wit ɔl mi at, ɛn i de ɛp mi ɛn mi at gladi so go siŋ ɛn tɛl am tɛnki.
Na PAPA GƆD mek in pipul gɛt trɛnk, nain de kɔba udat i dɔn pik fɔ bi in yon.
PAPA GƆD, sev yu pipul ɛn blɛs ɔl udat de biɛn dɛn; kɔntinyu fɔ kia fɔ ɛn kɔba dɛn sote go.
Enjɛl dɛn, una prez PAPA GƆD, una tɔk bɔt aw i wɔndaful! Una tɔk bɔt di big big pawa we i gɛt.
Una gi PAPA GƆD di prez we i fit fɔ gɛt; bikɔs in na big PAPA GƆD; mek una wɔship PAPA GƆD piɔ wan lɛkɛ insɛf.
Una kin yɛri we PAPA GƆD de tɔk, we di wata de splash na di si; dis wɔndaful PAPA GƆD in vɔys tan lɛk tɛnda yu kin yɛri PAPA GƆD in vɔys insay di dip dip si.
PAPA GƆD in vɔys pawaful; PAPA GƆD in vɔys de tɛl wi aw i wɔndaful.
PAPA GƆD in vɔys so pawaful dat wɛn i tɔk di sida tik, we trɔŋ pas ɔl de brok ivin sida tik we dɛn pul kɔmɔt Libanɔn.
In vɔys de mek di mawnten dɛn na Libanɔn jomp lɛk rabit dɔn Mawnt Amɔn in kin jomp lɛk kaŋaru.
PAPA GƆD in vɔys kin nak yu dɔŋ lɛk aw laytin de flash.
PAPA GƆD in vɔys de shek ɛni ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap; ivin di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap na Kedɛsh.
PAPA GƆD in vɔys de shek Ok tik ɛn twis twis am ɛn trip di tik dɛn na di bush nekɛd. Ɔl udat de insay PAPA GƆD in os de ala “Glori!”
PAPA GƆD sidɔm lɛk kiŋ de kɔmand di si; PAPA GƆD sidɔm lɛkɛ Kiŋ ɛn nain na Kiŋ sote go.
PAPA GƆD de gi trɛnk to in pipul; lɛ PAPA GƆD blɛs in pipul ɛn gi dɛn ɔl wetin dɛn want fɔ ɛnjɔy layf.
PAPA GƆD, a go tɔk bɔt aw yu wɔndaful, bikɔs yu pul mi pan trɔbul, ɛn nɔ mek a day we mek mi ɛnimi dɛn go laf mi.
PAPA GƆD, a aks yu fɔ ɛp mi ɛn yu mek a wɛl.
PAPA GƆD, yu gi mi layf bak; yu nɔ mek dɛn kɛr mi go siks fit.
Lɛ ɔlman we na PAPA GƆD in pipul siŋ to PAPA GƆD; siŋ ɛn prez PAPA GƆD, in na oli PAPA GƆD.
I nɔ de vɛks fɔ lɔŋ, bɔt i rɛdi fɔ blɛs yu fɔ layf; if sɔntin mek yu kray na nɛt, di kray nɔ go las te mɔnin. Bay mɔnin, na laf yu go de laf.
Wɛn tin bin fayn fɔ mi a mek mɔt se, “A nɔ de fred natin.”
PAPA GƆD, da tɛm de yu bin de fɔ mi, yu bin de kɔba mi; bɔt we yu kɔmɔt biɛn mi, a skayd.
A kray to PAPA GƆD. A beg PAPA GƆD fɔ av masi, a se,
“Us prɔfit yu go gɛt if a day? Us prɔfit yu go gɛt if a go siks fit? Dayman go ebul prez yu? Dayman go ebul tɔk bɔt yu gudnɛs we nɔ de fel?
PAPA GƆD, yɛri mi nɔ ɛn av masi pan mi. E PAPA GƆD, ɛp mi!”
Yu wep wata na mi yay ɛn mek a bigin siŋ ɛn dans; yu mek a pul munin ɛn wɛr ashɔbi,
we mek a ebul siŋ ɛn dans fɔ yu. A nɔ go sɛt mi mɔt. PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD, a nɔ go ɛva taya fɔ tɛl yu tɛnki.
PAPA GƆD na to yu a de luk fɔ kɔba mi; nɔ mek a shem; yu na Gɔd we de du tin tret wan ɔltɛm so sev mi.
Opin yu yes ɛn yɛri mi kam kwik ɛn pul mi kɔmɔt pan trɔbul; bi lɛk rɔk we pɔsin de rɔn to fɔ ayd ɛn sev mi. Kɔba mi mek mi ɛnimi dɛn nɔ kech mi.
Sins na to yu a de go ayd, fɔseka udat yu bi, lid mi ɛn gayd mi.
Nɔ mek a go usay mi ɛnimi dɛn sɛt trap fɔ mi, bikɔs na to yu a de go ayd.
PAPA GƆD, a de lɛf misɛf to yu sev mi, yu na PAPA GƆD we fɔ trɔs.
Yu nɔ lɛk pɔsin we de put in at pan wetin nɔ min natin, bɔt mi go trɔs PAPA GƆD.
A go gladi fɔ di lɛk we yu lɛk mi bikɔs yu de kia fɔ mi. Yu dɔn si di trɔbul we a de pan ɛn yu no aw a de sɔfa.
Yu nɔ mek mi ɛnimi dɛn ebul mi; yu dɔn gi mi alafia.
PAPA GƆD, duya, av masi pan mi a de pan siriɔs waala; a dɔn kray te mi yay dɛn ɔl de at ɛn i tan lɛk dɛn bit bit ɔl mi bɔdi.
Di trɔbul dɛn tan lɛkɛ bon na mi trot, di pen de kil mi; ɔl mi trɛnk dɔn dɔn ɛn mi bɔn dɛn ɔl de at.
Mi ɛnimi dɛn dɔn mek a tan lɛk lafin-stɔk to mi neba dɛn; dɛn nɔ tek mi mek natin. Mi padi dɛnsɛf nɔ wan si mi; udat dɛn si mi na trit de rɔnawe pan mi.
Dɛn tek mi lɛk udat dɔn day we na fɔ fɔgɛt bɔt am; broko kalbas sɛf tɛl lay.
A de yɛri dɛn lay ɛn koŋosa; a de fred fɔ kɔmɔt. Dɛn dɔn sɛt trap fɔ mi ɔlsay dɛn wan fɔ kil mi.
Bɔt mi de trɔs yu, PAPA GƆD a se, “Yu na mi PAPA GƆD.”
Na yu gɛt mi layf; sev mi frɔm mi ɛnimi dɛn ɛn ɔl dɛn wan we de mek a sɔfa.
Bikɔs ɔf di lɛk we yu lɛk mi du gud to mi we de sav yu; nɔ ayd yu fes pan mi.
PAPA GƆD nɔ mek a shem, bikɔs na yu a de aks fɔ ɛp mi; bɔt lɛ di bad man in mɔt lɔk ɛn lɛ i day.
Lɔk dɛn lay mɔt dɛn, bikɔs nain dɛn de tek mek mɔt ɛn blɔf yu pipul we de du tin tret wan.
Noto kɔmɔn gud tin, yu dɔn kip fɔ udat gɛt fred fɔ yu we de wɔship yu. Usay pipul bɔku, na de yu de gi gud tin to udat go to yu fɔ kɔba am.
Yu de ayd dɛn usay yu de we yu go kip dɛn sef wan ɛn mɔtalman nɔ go ebul ambɔg dɛn; Dɛn nɔ go ebul fɔ pɔynt fiŋa pan dɛnsɛf.
Lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD! I sho mi in wɔndaful lɔv we a de pan big big trɔbul. A bin tan lɛk siti we ɛnimi dɛn dɔn sɔrawnd ɛn i pul mi na dɛn an.
Wɛn dɛn mɔna mi, a fred ɛn se “I nɔ bisin bɔt mi igen” Pan ɔl dat, yu yɛri we a de kray fɔ masi we a de ala fɔ mek yu ɛp mi.
Ɔl udat de wɔship PAPA GƆD una lɛk am ɛn du wetin i tɛl una fɔ du! Wans yu fethful to am i nɔ de kɔmɔt biɛn yu, bɔt udat de mek gbiŋbin, de gɛt in pe PAPA GƆD go gi am bunya sɛf.
Una we abop pan PAPA GƆD, una nɔ giv ɔp o. Tek kɔrej, bikɔs PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD.
I fayn fɔ da pɔsin we PAPA GƆD dɔn fɔgiv in sin, PAPA GƆD dɔn fɔgiv am kpatakpata.
I fayn fɔ da pɔsin we nɔ miks pan bɛnbɛn PAPA GƆD nɔ de kip natin nain at fɔ am.
Wɛn a nɔ bin kɔnfɛs mi sin yet, i bin de mɔna mi; a bin jɛs de kray ol de, we a de pre.
Ol de ɛn nɛt PAPA GƆD nɔ bin de fil fɔ mi, pen de mɔna lɛk udat dɛn bit bad Di lili trɛnk we a bin gɛt sɛf, dɔn dɔn i tan lɛk we san de dray tin we sok, ɔl di trɛnk dɔn dɔn pan mi we san bit mi.
A gri se a bin de mek rebɛl pan PAPA GƆD ɛn kɔnfɛs mi sin. A mekɔp mi maynd ɛn se “A mɔs kɔnfɛs mi sin to PAPA GƆD.” Wɛn a du am, yu fɔgiv mi ɛn nɔ pɔnish mi igen
Na dis mek di wan dɛn we de wɔship yu, de wɔship yu, bikɔs we dɛn gɛt trɔbul, dɛn nɔ go ebul fɔ wɔship yu.
Na yu a tek mek telem; yu de rawnd mi fɔ kɔba mi we de mek pipul gladi ɛn siŋ bɔt aw yu pul mi pan trɔbul.
PAPA GƆD se, “A go tich yu ɛn tɛl yu wetin fɔ du mi yay go fala yu, ɛnisay we yu go.”
Nɔ mek bigful lɛk ɔs ɔ myul we yu gɛt fɔ put tin na dɛn mɔt fɔ gɛt dɛn fɔ du wetin yu want dɛn fɔ du, ɔ nɔ so dɛn nɔ go ɔndastand.
Udat nɔ bisin bɔt PAPA GƆD gɛt bɔku waala, bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ go ɛva kɔmɔt biɛn udat trɔs am.
Ɔl udat trɔs PAPA GƆD ɛn we de du tin tret wan fɔ gladi; dɛn fɔ siŋ bikɔs dɛn gladi.
Una we de du wetin PAPA GƆD want, mek nyu siŋ fɔ PAPA GƆD; Na gud tin fɔ mek udat de du wetin PAPA GƆD want, prez am.
Yuz ap fɔ mek myuzik ɛn prez PAPA GƆD.
Mek nyu siŋ fɔ am ple di instrumɛnt dɛn gud ɛn mek bɔku nɔys bikɔs yu gladi.
PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD we de kip to in wɔd i nɔ miks pan dabaru biznɛs; yu kin trɔs am fɔ du wetin i se ɔltɛm.
PAPA GƆD lɛk pɔsin we de du tin tret wan wit am ɛn nɔ miks pan bɛnbɛn; PAPA GƆD in lɔv fɔ mɔtalman nɔ de chenj.
Na tɔk nɔmɔ i tɔk fɔ mek di wɔl wit ɔl di sta ɛn mun ɛn san.
I gɛda ɔl di wata ɛn put dɛn wan ples; ivin dɛn dip dip wata lɛkɛ di oshɔn i mek sho se i kip dɛn lɛk aw mɔtalman de kip na sto.
Ɔl di pipul na wɔl fɔ wɔship ɛn fred PAPA GƆD, fɔ rɛspɛkt ɛn gɛt fred fɔ PAPA GƆD.
Bikɔs wetin i tɔk de bi; na kɔmand, nɔmɔ i gi ɔltin we de na wɔl, ɛn dɛn kam wantɛm.
PAPA GƆD nɔ de mek wetin pipul plan bi wans nɔto wetin in want dɛn fɔ du.
Bɔt wetin in se go bi, go mɔs bi wetin i mekɔp fɔ in pipul fɔ du, go de sote go.
Dɛn pipul we PAPA GƆD dɔn pik fɔ bi in yon gɛt in blɛsin; nain na di PAPA GƆD we dɛn fɔ wɔship.
We i de na ɛvin, usay i sidɔm fɔ rul i de si ɔlman;
na de i de de we i de wach ɔlman ɛn si wetin dɛn de du.
Nain gi mɔtalman sɛns fɔ ebul tink fɔ dɛnsɛf ɛn disayd wetin dɛn want, so i no ɔl wetin dɛn de du.
Ivin if wan kiŋ gɛt pawaful ami, dat nɔ min se i go win wa; ɔ if sojaman gɛt trɛnk, i nɔ min se i go bit di ɛnimi we fɛt am.
If bikɔs yu ɔs gɛt trɛnk, yu abop pan am fɔ pul yu pan trɔbul yu go disapɔynt.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD yay de pan ɔl udat abop pan am; ɛn i de wach dɛn wan we abop pan in lɔ we nɔ de chenj;
ɛn yu nɔ go day fɔ natin ivin if aŋri sɛf de.
Wi go put wi op pan PAPA GƆD; i de ɛp ɛn kɔba wi lɛkɛ aw sojaman de wɛr big shild fɔ protɛkt insɛf.
Wi go gladi bikɔs ɔf ɔl wetin i du, wi go trɔs am bikɔs i oli.
PAPA GƆD, nɔ disapɔynt wi, lɛ yu lɔv fɔ wi nɔ chenj lɛkɛ aw wi abop pan yu so.
A go prez PAPA GƆD ɔltɛm; a nɔ go taya fɔ tɔk aw i gud.
Wit ɔl mi at, a go blɔf fɔ wetin PAPA GƆD de du; lɛ udat de sɔfa, yɛri wetin a de se ɛn jɔyn mi fɔ prez PAPA GƆD.
Kam jɔyn mi, lɛ wi ɔl tɔk bɔt aw PAPA GƆD gud.
A pre to PAPA GƆD ɛn i yɛri mi; i pul de fred kɔmɔt pan mi.
Udat put in abop pan PAPA GƆD, go gladi; i nɔ de mek dɛn shem.
Dis poman we nɔ gɛt nɔbɔdi sɛf pre to PAPA GƆD, i yɛri am; i pul ɔl in trɔbul kɔmɔt pan am.
PAPA GƆD in enjɛl de rawnd udat rɛspɛkt ɛn dɛn wan we de fred am. I de pul am pan trɔbul.
Kam si fɔ yusɛf se PAPA GƆD na gud PAPA GƆD; I fayn fɔ di man, we de aks am fɔ kɔba am.
Una we de fred ɛn rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD, fɔ kɔntinyu fɔ du so, natin nɔ go de we una nid, we i nɔ go gi una.
Layɔn, we wi kin se trɔŋ, kin wik ɛn aŋri, bɔt ɔl udat de luk ɔp to PAPA GƆD go gɛt ɔl wetin dɛn nid.
Mi pikin dɛn, una kam yɛri wetin a de tɛl una; a go tich una aw fɔ fred PAPA GƆD.
Udat lɛk in layf ɛn want fɔ ɛnjɔy am?
I fɔ lɛf fɔ tɔk bad tɔk ɛn lɛf lay ɛn koŋosa.
I fɔ lɛf fɔ du bad ɔltogɛda ɛn bigin du gud; Du ɔl wetin yu ebul fɔ mek ɔlman gɛt kolat
PAPA GƆD de wach ɔl udat de du tin tret wan ɛn de yɛri we dɛn de kray;
PAPA GƆD et udat de du bad ɛn ivin we i dɔn day sɛf nɔbɔdi nɔ go mɛmba am.
Wɛn udat de du tin tret wan kray to PAPA GƆD, i de yɛri ɛn pul dɛn kɔmɔt pan trɔbul.
PAPA GƆD de nia ɔl udat fil se i dɔn dɔn fɔ am ɛn de ɛp udat fil se bɛtɛ nɔ de fɔ am igen
Pɔsin we de fala PAPA GƆD kin gɛt bɔku waala, bɔt na so PAPA GƆD de pul in ed pan dɛn ɔl;
i kin so kɔba am, dat pin sɛf nɔ go krach am.
Bad, nain go fala udat de du bad, PAPA GƆD go dɔnawe wit udat nɔ lɛk di wan we de du tin tret wan.
PAPA GƆD de sev in yon pipul ɔltɛm; i nɔ de kɔmɔt biɛn udat abop pan am.
PAPA GƆD dil wit dɛn wan we de fɔ mɛmba bad fɔ mi; fɛt dɛn wan we de fɔ fɛt mi.
Wɛr tin fɔ protɛkt yu grap ɛn kam ɛp mi.
Sɛn yu spia ɛn ɔda shap tik pan dɛn wan we de biɛn mi; Mek a no se yu kin sev mi.
Lɛ shem ɛn disgres mit ɔl dɛn wan we de biɛn mi; nɔ mek dɛn wan we de plan fɔ kil mi si dɛn we klia. Lɛ dɛn kɔnfyus pan wetin dɛn de du.
Lɛ yu enjɛl skata dɛn lɛk aw briz de skata chaf chaf;
lɛ i nɔ kɔmɔt biɛn dɛn ɛn lɛ dɛn nɔ si dɛn we klia.
Sins dɛn sɛt trap fɔ mi ɛn dig ol bak fɔ mek a fɔdɔm insay fɔ natin,
mek wetin dɛn bin tink bɔt lɛ di trap we dɛn bin dɔn sɛt, ol dɛn ɛn lɛ dɛn fɔdɔm insay di ol we dɛn bin dɔn dig.
Da tɛm de a go gladi se yu dɔn sev mi.
Wit ɔl mi at, a go tɔk se “Nɔbɔdi nɔ tan lɛk yu, PAPA GƆD.” Yu de pul pipul we nɔ ebul fɛt fɔ dɛnsɛf kɔmɔt na di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa dɛn an, yu nɔ de gri mek pipul tek advantej pan dɛn.
Pipul dɛn de luk mi korokoro wan ɛn lay pan mi, dɛn se dɛn na witnɛs; Tin dɛn we a nɔ no bɔt sɛf, nain dɛn de tɔk.
We a du dɛn gud, dɛn de tɔn am to bad dɔn i de lɛf pan mi.
Pan ɔl dis, we dɛn sik, a kin mek lɛk udat de munin; it sɛf a nɔba it, a kin de fast ɛn pre ɔltɛm Wɛn i tan lɛk PAPA GƆD nɔ de ansa mi prea,
a kin de pas de wɔndrin lɛk se na mi brɔda ɔ mi padi, a de wɔndrin fɔ. Dɔn a kin put mi an na mi ed de ala lɛk udat de kray we in mama day.
Bɔt if a fɔm pan ɛnitin, na so dɛn go gɛda fɔ laf mi, udat a nɔ no sɛf kin wan si mi dawnfɔl. Dɛn nɔ de taya wit mi nem na dɛn mɔt.
Dɛn de biev lɛk udat nɔ no PAPA GƆD; na so dɛn kin de cham mi nem ɛn provok mi.
PAPA GƆD, yu go jɛs de luk dɛn ɛn nɔ du natin? Aw lɔŋ yu go de pan dat? Pul mi prɛshɔs layf kɔmɔt na dɛn trap bikɔs dɛn fiba aŋri layɔn.
Da tɛm de, a go go usay bɔku pipul gɛda fɔ tɛl yu tɛnki. A go prez yu usay dɛn ɔl gɛda,
Nɔ mek mi ɛnimi dɛn gladi fɔ si mi dawnfɔl. Dɛn wan sɛf we nɔ gɛt rizin fɔ et mi bɔt et mi, nɔ mek dɛn fɛn rizin fɔ luk mi bad yay.
Noto pis de na dɛn at fɔ pipul we nɔ gɛt pɔsin dɛn tɛm na di land.
Dɛn de laf mi. Dɛn se la i la wisɛf dɔn si wit wi yon yay
PAPA GƆD, yu dɔn si dis; nɔ kip kwayɛt duya nɔ kɔmɔt nia mi
wek, grap lɛ yu kam ɛp mi E PAPA GƆD! Fɛt mi kes fɔ mi
As yu na PAPA GƆD we ɔlman nɔ se de du rayt, tɔk fɔ mi; Nɔ mek dɛn laf mi
Nɔ mek dɛn fil se dɛn dɔn gɛt wetin dɛn want lɛ dɛn nɔ se, “Wi dɔn nyamanyama am.”
Lɛ ɔl udat de laf mi we a gɛt waala shem ɛn kɔnfyus; lɛ shem ɛn disgres mit ɔl udat de mek gbagbati pan mi.

Lɛ ɔl udat want fɔ si we yu pul mi ed pan trɔbul, gladi ɛn siŋ fɔ jɔy; Lɛ dɛn prez yu nem ɛn se “Wi de lift PAPA GƆD ɔp In na PAPA GƆD we de gladi wɛn i si in pipul gladi.” A nɔ go taya fɔ de prez yu nem.
A nɔ go taya fɔ de tɔk aw yu gud.
Na sin de mek di bad man yɛri ɔlkayn bad tin insay in at. I nɔ de tink sɛf se i fɔ fred PAPA GƆD.
I tink se in na ɔl di go ɛn nɔ no sɛf se i de du rɔŋ
Na lay nɔmɔ ful in mɔt; i dɔn tɔn fulman ɛn nɔ no wetin i min fɔ du gud igen
We i de slip sɛf, na bad i de mɛmba; if yu kɔl am ɛnitɛm fɔ du bad, i rɛdi i nɔ de se “nɔ” wɛn tɛm rich fɔ du bad.
PAPA GƆD, wi nɔ ebul mɛzhɔ di lɛk we yu lɛk wi. Yu de du wetin yu se yu go du.
Yu nɔ miks pan bɛnbɛn wi kin trɔs yu jɔjmɛnt, as i tinap lɛk kɔtintri we briz nɔ de shek PAPA GƆD, yu de provayd fɔ wi mɔtalman ɛn di animal dɛn ɔl we yu mek.
Wi nɔ go gi prayz to yu lɔv! Yu de kɔba big ɛn smɔl wan lɛkɛ aw fɔl de kɔba in pikin.
Yu de mek dɛn frɛsh we yu de gi dɛn gud it ɛn drink lɛkɛ aw frɛsh wata kin de flo.
Na yu de gi layf ɛn nainsay yu wi de si wi we klia na layf.
Kɔntinyu fɔ sho yu lɔv to udat no yu ɛn de sav yu as PAPA GƆD, ɛn lɛ udat lɛk fɔ du wetin rayt gɛt di bɛnifit.
Nɔ mek dɛn wan we min se dɛn na ɔl di go mas mi, ɛn nɔ lɛ di bad wan dɛnsɛf buli ɛn drɛb mi.
Luk aw ɔl di bad wan dɛn dɔn fɔdɔm kpatakpata dɛn nɔ ebul grap igen
Nɔ mek wetin bad pipul de du wɔri yu ɛn nɔ jɛlɔs dɛn ɔ pre fɔ tan lɛkɛ dɛn!
Bikɔs dɛn go wida lɛk gras jisnɔ, ɛn lɛk dɛn grin plant.
Trɔs PAPA GƆD ɛn du gud; Tap na di land we PAPA GƆD prɔmis yu ɛn ɛnjɔy di kɔba we i dɛn kɔba yu.
Ɛnjɔy fɔ sav PAPA GƆD ɛn i go gi yu wetin yu want bad bad.
Lɛf yusɛf gi PAPA GƆD ɛn trɔs am; ɛn i go mɔs ɛp yu.
I go lɛ ɔlman si gbaragbara wan aw yu gud so ɔlman go no se yu nɔ de fɛt fɔ natin.
Sidɔm, luk wetin PAPA GƆD go du; nɔ wɔri yusɛf bikɔs bad pipul de si bɛtɛ pan ɔl di bad tin dɛn we dɛn de mek ɔp fɔ du.
Nɔ lɛ tin lɛk dat gi yu bɔn-at; dat go mek yu jɛs de vɛks ɛn i nɔ gud fɔ yu, i go mek yusɛf wan fɔ du bad.
Di bad pɔsin go day insay in bad, bɔt udat put in op pan PAPA GƆD, go gɛt di land we i prɔmis.
Smɔl bit mɔ, yu nɔ go si di bad man igen; yu go luk fɔ am so, bɔt yu nɔ go fɛn am.
Bɔt dɛn wan we nɔ tek dɛnsɛf mek natin go gɛt wetin PAPA GƆD prɔmis dɛn ɛn ɛnjɔy pis.
Di bad man de mek ɔp fɔ du bad to di man we de du rayt; dɛn de sɔktit pan dɛn ɛn luk dɛn bad yay
bɔt PAPA GƆD de laf dɛn, bikɔs i no se di tɛm de kam we dɛn go no.
Da tɛm de di bad man go drɔ in sɔd ɛn rɛdi in bo, dat na di wɛpɔn dɛn we dɛn wan tek kil udat nɔ ebul fɛt fɔ insɛf ɛn udat de du gud
bɔt ɔl wetin mekɔp fɔ du dɛn go tɔn bak pan dɛn. Dɛn go chuk dɛnsɛf wit dɛn sɔd ɛn dɛn bo dɛn ɔl go brok.
Di lilibit we di gud man gɛt bɛtɛ fawe pas di jɛntri we di man we de du bad gɛt;
bikɔs di pawa we di man we de du bad get, go dɔn, bɔt PAPA GƆD go kɔntinyu fɔ wata di wan we de waka tret.
PAPA GƆD bisin bɔt udat de du wetin in want, ɛn i go gi dɛn wetin i dɔn prɔmis sote go.
Wɛn tin bad, i nɔ go mek dɛn shem; dɛn go gɛt pas wetin dɛn want.
Lɛk aw briz de blo flawa na bush te natin nɔ lɛf, na so PAPA GƆD go skata in ɛnimi dɛn. I go skata dɛn lɛk smok.
Pan ɔl we dɛn de mek so, dɛn nɔba ebul pe dɛt bikɔs ɔf dɛn badlɔk, bɔt di wan dɛn we de du wetin PAPA GƆD want, i de blɛs dɛn ɛn so dɛn frian;
di wan dɛn we PAPA GƆD blɛs go gɛt di land we i prɔmis dɛn, bɔt di wan dɛn we i dɔn swɛ, go day.
We PAPA GƆD gladi wit pɔsin, i nɔ de kɔmɔt biɛn am;
if i bɔk in fut sɛf, i nɔ go fɔdɔm bikɔs na PAPA GƆD de ol in an waka.
Mi na olpa a dɔn liv fɔ lɔŋ na wɔl, a bin yɔŋ bɔt naw a dɔn ol bɔt a nɔ wande si PAPA GƆD lɛf gud pipul to dɛnsɛf lɛf dɛn ɔ in pikin dɛn de beg tin fɔ it.
Ɔltɛm dɛn de ɛp ɔda pipul; so dɛn pikin dɛn mɔs rip di blɛsin.
Lɛf fɔ du bad ɛn du gud; dɔn yusɛf go de na di land we PAPA GƆD prɔmis.
PAPA GƆD lɛk udat de du wetin rayt; ɛn nɔ go lɛf udat biliv pan am ɛn de du wetin i se to insɛf. I go kɔba dɛn sote go, bɔt di bad man in famili nɔ go gɛt lɔŋ layf;
udat dɛn de du wetin rayt go gɛt di land, ɛn dɛn go de de sote go
Pɔsin de ebul pik sɛns pan wetin di man we de du gud de se, ɛn na wetin tru nɔmɔ i de tɔk.
I no wetin PAPA GƆD se ɛn i de obe am; so i nɔ de yɛk pan wetin i de du.
Di bad man de wach di gud man, i de fɛn aw fɔ kil am; bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ go lɛf di gud man to insɛf i mɔs fɛt in kes we go mek dɛn nɔ kɔndɛm am sɛf na kot.
Abop pan PAPA GƆD ɛn du wetin i se. Gi PAPA GƆD chans ɛn du wetin i se
I go mek yu ed big we yu go go na di land; ɛn yu go si we i de dɔnawe wit di bad man.
A dɔn si we bad man de buli pɔsin; i de prɛd lɛk bɔlɔgi ɔ pɛtɛtɛ lif,
bɔt usay, aw i apia, na so i kin lɔs o ivin wɛn a luk fɔ am, a nɔ de si am.
Wach di man we gud ɛn we de du wetin rayt; na pɔsin we gɛt kol at ɛn bɛtɛ go fala am ɔltɛm.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD go dɔnawe wit di bad man; di bad man go gɛt in pe.
Na PAPA GƆD de sev udat de waka tret, nain nɔmɔ de ɛp am we trɔbul mit am.
PAPA GƆD de ɛp dɛn ɛn pul dɛn pan trɔbul; i de pul bad pipul biɛn dɛn, bikɔs na to in dɛn de rɔn go fɔ ayd.
PAPA GƆD, duya nɔ tek wamat fɔ pɔnish mi ɛn nɔ pul ɔl di vɛks we yu vɛks pan mi.
Di aro we yu shut dɔn mit mi, ɛn yu dɔn wap mi dɔŋ.
Mi sin dɔn mek mi bɔdi ɔl sik; ɛn we yu vɛks pan mi, i mek i bad-ɔf.
Mi sin dɛn so bɔku, dɛn tu ebi fɔ mi.
Bikɔs ɔf mi fulishnɛs, di wund dɛn we a dɔn gɛt de smɛl ɛn tɔmɛnt mi.
Di trɔbul we a gɛt so ebi dat i de mek a fiba udat gɛt ɔmbak; dɔn a de pas ɛn kray bita bita wan lɛk udat gɛt bɛrin.
Pen de ɔl oba mi bɔdi; a sik bad bad wan.
Mi bɔdi ɔl brok; a nɔ fiba misɛf igen A de pini ol de bikɔs mi at so ebi.
PAPA GƆD, yu no mi intoto; yu no aw dis pen de mɔna mi.
Mi at de kɔt, trɛnk sɛf a nɔ gɛt igen; ɛn ivin we mi yay opin a nɔ de si wetin a wan si. Mi yay ɔl dɔn dɔl.
Mi padi ɛn neba dɛnsɛf nɔ de kam nia mi; dɛn de fred se a go gi dɛn sik.
Mi ɛnimi dɛn de kak mi trap, dɛn de pwɛl mi nem ɛn plan aw dɛn go gɛt mi; ol de na dat dɛn de pan.
Naw, a fiba udat dɛf we nɔ de yɛri, ɔ mumu we nɔ ebul tɔk.
A dɔn bi dɛfyes man we nɔ de yɛri ɛn a nɔ ebul sɛf fɔ tɔk.
PAPA GƆD, na yu a de wet fɔ bikɔs yu gɛt fɔ ansa mi.
A se “Nɔ mek mi ɛnimi dɛn gladi fɔ si mi dawnfɔl ɔ tinap na mi ed we a bɔk mi fut.”
A dɔn rɛdi fɔ giv ɔp, di pen tumɔs fɔ mi, a nɔ ebul bia igen
Ivin we a dɔn kɔnfɛs mi sin; di sin dɛn de mek mi at ɛŋ.
Mi ɛnimi dɛn bɔku ɛn dɛn gɛt trɛnk pas mi; dɛn et mi pan ɔl we dɛn ivin nɔ gɛt rizin fɔ et mi.
Dɛn de tek mi gud tɔn bad; ɛn pwɛl mi usay a fɔ bɛtɛ.
E PAPA GƆD, duya nɔ lɛf mi to misɛf; ɛn nɔ kɔmɔt nia mi.
Kam naw naw mek yu kam ɛp mi Na yu na mi Masta ɛn mi Seviɔ.
A tɛl misɛf se, a go de wach wetin a de du ɛn nɔ tɔk wetin go mek a sin; A go mek shɔ se a nɔ se fiŋ usay bad mɔtalman dɛn de.
Pan ɔl we a sɛt mi mɔt ɛn a nɔ se natin fɔ mi yon gud, tin bin stil de mɔna mi.
Mi at nɔ rɛst, as a de tink, na so a de lɔs mi peshɛnt nain a tɔk wantɛm.
A se, “PAPA GƆD, mek a no aw lɔŋ a gɛt fɔ liv; so dat a go no se a kin day ɛnitɛm.
“Mi layf so shɔt, i nɔ tan lɛk i gɛt minin igen; mɔtalman jɛs tan lɛk briz to yu.
Mɔtalman in layf jɛs tan lɛkɛ shado, we san de ɔp, yu de si am, as san go dɔŋ so, i lɔs, ɔl in gbiŋbin na fɔ natin; di jɛntri sɛf we i de gɛda, i nɔ no udat go gɛt am we i day.
“Mi Masta, wetin a fɔ du naw? Na yu nɔmɔ a de luk ɔp to.
Pul mi pan mi waala, nɔ mek dɛn wan we nɔ no wetin dɛn de afta, tɔn fɔ laf mi.
A sɛt mi mɔt; A nɔ ebul kwɛshɔn yu as na mi fɛn am fɔ misɛf.
Sɔri fɔ mi, a nɔ ebul misɛf igen Di pɔnish we yu de pɔnish mi dɔn du fɔ kil mi.
Yu de tɔk pan mɔtalman ɛn pɔnish am fɔ in sin. Lɛkɛ bɔgbɔg, na so yu de pwɛl wetin i gɛt; mɔtalman jɛs tan lɛk briz.
“PAPA GƆD, yɛri mi prea, nɔ mek dɛfyes we a de kray to yu fɔ ɛp mi. Mi na yu trenja lɛkɛ aw mi fɔstɛm pipul bin bi trenja.
Nɔ sɛt yu yay pan mi, so dat a go gladi wantɛm mɔ bifo a day ɛn go ɔdɔun.
A wet wit peshɛnt fɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ ɛp mi; i yɛri mi ɛn kam ɛp mi.
I pul mi kɔmɔt insay di pɔtɔpɔtɔ we bin fɔ kil mi; ɛn mek a tinap pantap big ayɛn ston we go mek a waka ɛn a nɔ go fred.
I gi mi nyu siŋ fɔ siŋ, siŋ we de tɔk aw PAPA GƆD big. Bɔku pipul go fred ɛn rɛspɛkt am dat go mek dɛn ɔl trɔs am.
PAPA GƆD go blɛs di pɔsin we de trɔs am; i nɔ de si udat de mek se i bɛtɛ pas am, ɛn i nɔ de wɔship lay lay gɔd lɛk ɔda pɔsin.

PAPA GƆD, yu wɔndaful, nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul fɔ kɔnt wetin yu dɔn du. Infakt sɛf, di plan we yu gɛt fɔ wi, nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul tɔk bɔt dɛn so bɔku dat if a bin wan bin kɔnt a nɔ go ebul bikɔs dɛn tu bɔku fɔ kɔnt.
Noto sakrifays ɛn ɔda tin dɛn yu want bɔt yu gi mi yes fɔ yɛri yu wɔd ɛn obe am; yu nɔ want dɛn animal we wi de bɔn to yu na ɔlta, ɛn ivin dɛn animal we wi de kil gi yu fɔ pul wi pan sin.
Dɛn a se “A dɔn kam. Insay yu buk, i rayt de se
a de ɛnjɔy fɔ du wetin yu want a de kip yu lɔ na mi at so a go obe am.”
Yusɛf no se, usay yu pipul gɛda fɔ prez yu; a nɔ de sɛt mi mɔt. Na de a go tɔk aw yu lɛk yu pipul ɛn rɛdi fɔ ɛp dɛn ɔltɛm.
A go tɔk bɔt aw yu sev mi ɛn a nɔ go kip am to misɛf; a go tɛl ɔlman se yu de sev yu pipul; ɛn yu lɛk dɛn ɔltɛm, ɛn de du wetin yu se yu go du.
PAPA GƆD nɔ ɛva lɛf fɔ du mi gud; kip mi sef wit yu lɔv ɔltɛm ɛn nɔ ɛva kɔmɔt biɛn mi.
Di waala dɛn so bɔku pan mi dat ɛnisay a tɔn, na soso trɔbul. Mi sin dɛn dɔn so blɔk mi we, dat a nɔ de si usay a de go. A dɔn giv ɔp bikɔs dɛn plɛnti pas di ia na mi ed.
PAPA GƆD duya, sev mi; duya mekes kam ɛp mi.
Lɛ ɔl udat nɔ want fɔ si mi, kɔnfyus ɛn lɛ dɛn shem pan dɛnsɛf; lɛ dɛn wan we nɔ want fɔ si mi bɛtɛ wan disgres.
Lɛ ɔl dɛn wan we de opin dɛn mɔt fɔ laf mi kɔba dɛn fes wit shem.
Mek ɔl udat de tray fɔ pliz yu gladi bikɔs ɔf wetin yu dɔn du; Mek ɔl udat gladi fɔ we yu sev dɛn prez yu nem ɔltɛm.
Pan ɔl we mi na nɔnɛntiti, PAPA GƆD, nɔ fɔgɛt mi Na yu na di wan we de pul mi pan trɔbul ɛn ɛp mi; PAPA GƆD, duya nɔ westɛm.
Pɔsin we de sɔri fɔ udat nɔ ebul insɛf go go gɛt blɛsin. PAPA GƆD go pul in ed kɔmɔt pan trɔbul.
PAPA GƆD go gi am lɔŋ layf ɛn wɛlbɔdi; ɔlman na Izrɛl go si se i gɛt blɛsin ɛn PAPA GƆD go mek in ɛnimi dɛn nɔ laf am.
If i sik sɛf, PAPA GƆD go put an pan am ɛn mek i grap nain sik bed
A se PAPA GƆD, av masi; a dɔn sin bɔt mek a wɛl.
Mi ɛnimi dɛn wit dɛn bad at, de wɔnda ustɛm a go day so dat ɔlman go fɔgɛt bɔt mi.
Ɛnitɛm we dɛn kam fɛn mi, dɛn de mek fayn fes bɔt dɛn go fɛn tɔk fɔ tɔk we dɛn go skata ɔlɔbɔt.
Ɔl mi ɛnimi dɛn dɔn gɛda pan mi dɛn want mek ɔlkayn bad tin mit mi,
dɛn se mi dɔn kech bad sik so we a lidɔm, na day a de day so.
Di wan sɛf we a bin se na mi bɛst frɛn we a trɔs we wi tu kin it togɛda, insɛf dɔn tɔn pan mi.
PAPA GƆD, duya av masi; mek a grap na mi sik bed fɔ fɛt mi ɛnimi dɛn.
A no se yu gladi bikɔs mi ɛnimi dɛn nɔ ebul mi.
Yu de ɛp mi bikɔs a de du wetin yu want so a go de wit yu sote go.
Prez PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD, i de as PAPA GƆD sote go Emɛn! Emɛn!
Lɛkɛ aw dia kin tɔsti fɔ frɛsh wata, na so mi wanol bɔdi de majiji fɔ wɔship yu, PAPA GƆD.
A want PAPA GƆD bad bad wan. Usay a go go fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD lɛk aw a want?
Di wata we kɔmɔt na mi yay de go insay mi mɔt ɛn nain nɔmɔ na mi it, de ɛn nɛt, ɛn ɔltɛm mi ɛnimi dɛn de provok mi, dɛn de aks usay mi PAPA GƆD de we a de sɔfa so.
As a de blo mi maynd, a mɛmba we mi ɛn ɔda pipul kin de lid machpas fɔ go na PAPA GƆD in os na Jerusɛlɛm, na so we kin de ala we wi de siŋ ɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki as wi de sɛlibret.
Wetin fɔ mek a brok at so ɔ wetin fɔ mek mi at pwɛl? A fɔ put mi op pan PAPA GƆD, a fɔ stil de tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki, bikɔs nain na mi PAPA GƆD, we de pul mi pan trɔbul.
We a de ya, mi at kin pwɛl; bɔt a kin bigin tink bɔt PAPA GƆD, a kin tink bɔt Riva Jɔdan a kin tink bɔt di mawnten dɛn frɔm di big wan na Amɔn te rich di smɔl wan na Miza.
PAPA GƆD mek aw di wata dɛn kin de splash, i tan lɛk se dɛn de tɔk to dɛnsɛf; a kin lɛk fɔ yɛri aw di wata de splash we i kin kɔmɔt na di mawnten dɛn go na di Riva Jɔdan.
De ɛn nɛt PAPA GƆD de sho mi in lɔv we nɔ de ɛva chenj, so a kin siŋ to am as nain de gi mi layf.
A kin aks PAPA GƆD we dɔn yus fɔ kɔba mi lɛk aw fɔl de kɔba in pikin dɛn, Wetin a du we i tan lɛk i fɔgɛt bɔt mi we mek mi ɛnimi dɛn de sɔprɛs mi so?
Di provok we mi ɛnimi dɛn de provok mi de tɛl pan mi, dɛn ivin de aks mi usay mi PAPA GƆD de we a de sɔfa so.
Wetin fɔ mek a brokat so ɔ wetin fɔ mek mi at pwɛl? A fɔ put mi op pan PAPA GƆD; a fɔ stil de tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki bikɔs nain na mi PAPA GƆD, we de pul mi pan trɔbul.
PAPA GƆD, fɛt mi kes nɔ ɛn pul mi kɔmɔt na di pipul we nɔ no yu dɛn an; sev mi frɔm pipul we de pan lay ɛn de du bad bad tin.
Yu de lɛf mi to misɛf? Yu we na PAPA GƆD we fɔ kɔba mi? Wetin a du we i tan lɛk yu fɔgɛt bɔt mi we mek mi ɛnimi dɛn de tinap na mi ed so?
Sho mi di layt ɛn lɛ yu wɔd dɛn we na tru gayd mi; lɛ dɛn briŋ mi kam bak to Zayɔn, di oli Mawnten usay yu os de.
Dɛn a go go usay ɔlman de fɔ go wɔship yu, yu we na PAPA GƆD we de mek a gladi. A go yuz myuzikal instrumɛnt fɔ siŋ ɛn prez yu nem. Yu na di PAPA GƆD we a de wɔship.
Wetin fɔ mek a brokat so ɔ wetin fɔ mek mi at pwɛl? A fɔ put mi op pan PAPA GƆD; A fɔ stil de tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki bikɔs nain na di PAPA GƆD we de pul mi pan trɔbul.
PAPA GƆD, wi dɔn yɛri fɔ wisɛf; wi fɔstɛm pipul dɔn tɛl wi wetin yu bin du fɔ dɛn dɛn yon tɛm.
Bay yu pawa, yu drɛb ɔl dɛn neshɔn we bin tap na Kenan, dɛn pipul we bin de wɔship lay lay gɔd; ɛn mek wi papa dɛn sidɔm fayn wan na dɛn ples bɔt yu pɔnish di ɔda neshɔn dɛn.
Noto di tin dɛn we dɛn gɛt fɔ fɛt ɔ di fɛt we dɛn fɛt sɛf mek dɛn gɛt di land; na bikɔs yu bin de wit dɛn ɛn bikɔs yu lɛk dɛn.
Yu na mi PAPA GƆD ɛn kiŋ, we dɔn se yu go gi viktri to Jekɔb in pipul ɔltɛm.
Na bay yu pawa wi de ebul win wi ɛnimi dɛn; na bay yu pawa we de ivin ebul tinap na dɛn ed.
Noto mi wɛpɔn dɛn a abop pan we a de fɛt, dɛn nɔn nɔ ebul mek a win;
na bikɔs yu pawaful mek wi de win, yu de mek wi ɛnimi dɛn rɔnawe wit shem ɛn disgres.
Wi go bost ol de bɔt wetin PAPA GƆD dɔn du ɛn wi go prez in nem sote go.
Naw yu dɔn lɛf wi to wisɛf ɛn disgres wi; yu nɔ ivin de de wit wi sojaman dɛn we dɛn de go fɛt igen
Yu mek wi rɔn pan wi ɛnimi dɛn, ɛn mek wi ɛnimi dɛn tek wi tin dɛn na wi an.
Yu de mek dɛn kil wi lɛkɛ aw dɛn de kil ship. Wi skata ɔlɔbɔt.
Yu sɛl wi to wi ɛnimi dɛn pan ɔl we i nɔ gɛt fɔ bɛnifit yu fɔ natin.
Di ɔda trayb dɛn we liv rawnd wi nɔ rɛspɛkt wi igen Yu dɔn mek dɛn de provok wi ɛn nɔ luk wi wit ɛni bɛtɛ yay.
Yu dɔn gi pipul na ɔda kɔntri dɛn tɔk fɔ tɔk; we dɛn de pas, na shumɔ nɔmɔ dɛn de shumɔ pan wi.
Di shem ɛn disgres we de mit mi nɔ gud fɔ tɔk
a nɔ ebul waka ɛn es mi ed ɔp bikɔs di provok so bɔku ɛn mi ɛnimi dɛn de gladi pan dat.
Wi nɔ fɔgɛt yu ɛn wi nɔ brok yu Kɔvinant yet pan ɔl we dɛn kayn tin ya de bi to wi.
Wi nɔ chenj wi maynd bɔt yu yet ɛn wi nɔ go disobe yu.
Yu dɔn lɛf wi mek wayl animal atak wi ɛn lɛf wi fɔ day.
If wi bin lɛf di tru PAPA GƆD go wɔship lay lay gɔd lɛk dɛn ɔda neshɔn,
PAPA GƆD bin fɔ no. I no wetin de na wi at.
Bikɔs wi nɔ kɔmɔt biɛn yu, na dat mek dɛn de kil wi so; wi fiba ship dɛn we dɛn dɔn kɛr go fɔ kil.
PAPA GƆD wek nɔ, yu de mek lɛkɛ udat de slip. Grap. Tinap fɔ wi! Nɔ lɛf wi to wisɛf. Du sɔntin fɔ pul wi kɔmɔt na wi ɛnimi dɛn an.
Wetin mek yu de gi wi dɛfyes? Nɔ mek se yu nɔ de si aw wi de sɔfa.
Dɛn dɔn ib wi dɔŋ wi nɔ ebul grap igen
Kam lɛ yu kam ɛp wi bikɔs di lɔv we yu gɛt fɔ wi na di sem.
Lɛkɛ pɔsin we in wok na fɔ rayt, na so a de tink bɔt di fayn, fayn tin dɛn; we a go put insay di siŋ we a de mek fɔ di kiŋ.
Yu na man we fayn pas ɔl di ɔda man dɛn ɛn yu sabi tɔk to pɔsin, PAPA GƆD riali dɔn blɛs yu fɔ layf.
Yu na kiŋ, nɔ fɔgɛt fɔ ol yu wɛpɔn; bikɔs nain de sho se yu na tɔf man.
Mek PAPA GƆD go wit yu ɛn lɛ yu kɔntinyu fɔ win ɔl di wa dɛn we yu de fɛt fɔseka wetin tru ɛn fia; yuz yu trɛnk fɔ sho se yu kin du pawaful tin dɛn.
Yu go win yu ɛnimi dɛn; dɛn neshɔn dɛn ɔl go kam fɔdɔm bifo yu.
We PAPA GƆD dɔn put yu fɔ rul, i tan lɛk nainsɛf de rul na fɔ sote go; yu dɔn de rul yu pipul fia wan ɛn di tik sɛf we yu de ol de sho dat.
Yu lɛk udat de du rayt ɛn et udat de du bad; na dat mek PAPA GƆD insɛf dɔn pik yu ɛn mek yu de ɔp pas ɔl yu ɔda kɔmpin kiŋ dɛn i dɔn mek yu gladi pasmak.
Yu klos dɛn ɔl de smɛl swit wit pafyum dɛn we dɛn mek wit Ma, Alo ɛn Kasia; pipul we de na say we dɛkɔret wit ayvri de ple myuzik we de mek yu fil fayn.
Uman dɛn we na kiŋ pikin dɛn rɛdi fɔ wok fɔ yu; Na yu raytan, na de yu yawo de i drɛs wit di bɛst gold we kɔmɔt na Ofir.
Mi pikin, lisin to mi; naw we yu dɔn mared to di Kiŋ, na wi gɛt yu, yu nɔto yu papa ɛn yu pipul yon igen o.
Na di Kiŋ gɛt yu fayn fayn bɔdi naw; yu fɔ du wetin i se ɔltɛm.
Pipul dɛn frɔm Tay go briŋ prɛzɛnt fɔ yu; jɛntri man dɛn ɔl go tray fɔ gɛt yu.
Di yawo de mach go insay di kiŋ in os na so i fayn; dɛn mek in gawn wit soso gold
I wɛr fayn klos wit dizayn we dɛn de kɛr am go to di kiŋ; di uman dɛn we de wit am, we na vajin na dɛn de kɛr am go to di kiŋ.
Na so dɛn ɔl de siŋ ɛn dans; we dɛn de kɛr di yawo am go na di Kiŋ in os.
Yu go gɛt bɔku bɔypikin we go kam bi kiŋ lɛkɛ dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn; yu go mek dɛn fɔ rul di wanol wɔl.
Pipul go de tɔk bɔt udat yu bi ɔltɛm; dɛn nɔ go ɛva fɔgɛt yu.
PAPA GƆD na wi sikyɔriti, i rɛdi fɔ pul wi pan trɔbul ɔltɛm.
So wi nɔ gɛt natin fɔ fred, ivin if di wɔl skata ɔ athkwek bi we mek di mawnten dɛn fɛn dɛnsɛf midul di si,
ɔ di wata dɛn de grɔmbul lɛk wayl animal ɔ di il ɛn mawnten dɛn bigin shek bad wan.
Wan riva de we de mek PAPA GƆD in pipul we de nain siti, gladi, di siti we PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl ɔda gɔd dɛn de.
Wans PAPA GƆD de de, in sikyɔriti shɔ, i rɛdi fɔ ɛp am ɔltɛm.
Neshɔn dɛn tɔn oba wit kɔnfyushɔn ɛn fred, kindɔm dɛn skata, bɔt we PAPA GƆD tɔk wantɛm nɔmɔ wit in vɔys lɛk tɛnda, dɛn ɔl de go insay dɛn shɛl.
PAPA GƆD, we na wi ami kɔmanda de wit wi di PAPA GƆD we wi papa Jekɔb bin de wɔship nain na wi sikyɔriti.
Ɔlman kam luk wetin PAPA GƆD dɔn du, kam luk ɔmɔs wɔndaful tin i dɔn du na wɔl.
I de mek ɔl udat de fɛt na wɔl, lɛf fɔ fɛt; i de pwɛl pwɛl ɔl wetin dɛn de tek fɛt ɛn bɔn di big shild we dɛn wɛr fɔ protɛkt dɛnsɛf na faya.
“Una lɛf fɔ fɛt ɛn no se mi na PAPA GƆD na mi de rul ɔlsay; di neshɔn dɛn ɛn ɔl di pipul go prez mi ɛn se a de du big wok.”
PAPA GƆD, we na wi ami kɔmanda de wit wi di PAPA GƆD we wi papa Jekɔb bin de wɔship nain na wi sikyɔriti.
Ɔlman klap in an fɔ sho se i gladi; Siŋ ɛn prez PAPA GƆD lawd wan.
Wi PAPA GƆD, we pas ɔl ɔda gɔd du fɔ fred, nain na Kiŋ fɔ di wanol wɔl.
I mek wi win wi ɛnimi dɛn, ɛn mek di pipul kam ɔnda wi fut.
Nain chuz wi jɛntri fɔ wi ɛn wi gladi ɛn prawd as Jekɔb in pikin dɛn we i lɛk.
Ɔlman de mek nɔys bikɔs dɛn gladi we PAPA GƆD de tek in sit as kiŋ, dɛn de blo ɔn fɔ ple myuzik.
Lɛ wi siŋ ɛn prez PAPA GƆD; lɛ wi siŋ ɛn prez PAPA GƆD we na kiŋ.
PAPA GƆD na kiŋ na di wanol wɔl; lɛ wi mek fayn siŋ fɔ prez am.
Di say we PAPA GƆD de sidɔm rul, oli, i de rul di wanol wɔl.
Ɔl dɛn ɔda kiŋ de kam gɛda lɛkɛ se dɛnsɛf de wɔship di PAPA GƆD we Ebraam bin de wɔship, bikɔs ɔl di pawa we dɛn gɛt, na PAPA GƆD gi dɛn; PAPA GƆD riali wɔndaful.
PAPA GƆD wɔndaful ɛn ɔlman fɔ prez am, ɔlman we de na di siti usay PAPA GƆD de fɔ wɔship am.
Dis siti ya fayn ɛn ay, i de mek pipul na di wanol wɔl gladi. I tan lɛk Mawnt Zayɔn we insɛf na sekred mawnten we de na di nɔth ɛn i ay.
PAPA GƆD de sho ɔlman se in na dɛn sikyɔriti; so wans dɛn de wit am, dɛn gɛt sikyɔriti.
Wɛn dɛn ɔda kiŋ dɛn mek bagin, ɛn kam fɔ atak,
dɛn de sɔprayz fɔ si di sikyɔriti ɛn pawa we PAPA GƆD gɛt; dɛn de rɔnawe wit fred.
Na so dɛn kin de trimbul wit fred dɛn kin de mek lɛk we uman de pan pen fɔ bɔn.
Yu nyakanyaka dɛn lɛkɛ aw dɛn traŋa briz kin ambɔg dɛn big ship.
Wetin wi bin dɔn yɛri nain wi de si, se usay PAPA GƆD de we oli, i dɔn mek am sikyɔ sote go.
We wi de wɔship ɛn prez yu, PAPA GƆD insay yu os, wi de ebul fɔ mɛmba aw di lɛk we yu lɛk wi nɔ de ɛva chenj.
Lɛkɛ aw ɔlman na wɔl dɔn yɛri aw yu gud, na so dɛn ɔl de prez yu ɛnisay yu tɔn; Yu gɛt pawa ɛn sabi fɔ rul.
Di pipul na Zayɔn de gladi dɔn di difrɛn pipul na Juda gladi de se yu sabi fɔ jɔj fia wan.
Una kam si di tawa dɛn insay Zayɔn,
luk di traŋa wɔl dɛn, ɛn di ples we dɛn bil fɔ pipul fɔ go fɔ protɛkt dɛnsɛf, so dat yu go tɛl di smɔl wan dɛn aw PAPA GƆD bin de tek kia ɔf in pipul.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD we go de sote go ɛn nain go bi wi sikyɔriti te wi day.
Ɔlman lisin, wans yu de na dis wɔl fɔ yɛri dis,
I lɛk aw yu jɛntri, ɔ if yu na poman sɛf;
yu go kapu sɛns pan wetin a de tɔk; a go de tɔk wetin de na mi at.
Misɛf go mɛmba us parebul fɔ pul we a go de ple ap ɛn de ɛksplen am to una.
Wetin mek a fɔ skyad we tin traŋa ɛn i tan lɛkɛ se di wan dɛn we de mek tufes de buli mi?
Dɛn na pipul we abop pan dɛn jɛntri ɛn de mek nɔys fɔ di gɛt we dɛn gɛt.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul bay in kɔmpin in layf ɔ pe PAPA GƆD mɔni fɔ mek i gɛt layf we go de sote go.
Pɔsin nɔ go ɛva ebul fɔ bay layf as i nɔ go ɛva gɛt di mɔni,
fɔ pe we go mek i nɔ day atɔl bɔt liv sote go.
Day na fɔ ɔlman i lɛk sɛf yu gɛt sɛns udat fulish ɛn udat nɔ gɛt sɛns sɛf gɛt fɔ day ɛn lɛf dɛn jɛntri to ɔda man.
Pan ɔl we yu go se dɛn gɛt prɔpati, na usay dɛn bɛr dɛn, nain na dɛn yon. Di prɔpati dɛn lɛf fɔ dɛn fyuchɔ jɛnareshɔn pan ɔl we na dɛn nem i gɛt.
Bɔt mɔtalman na natin; pan ɔl in jɛntri, i go day lɛkɛ bif na bush.
Na so ɔl udat abop pan in jɛntri gɛt fɔ ɛnd, ɛn ivin udat de fala ɛn du wetin dɛn se.
Dɛn ɔl gɛt fɔ day, dɔn dɛn go bɛr dɛn. Wans dɛn bɛr dɛn, dɛn go rɔtin; ɛn nainsay dɛn grev dɛn os we dɛn bin dɔn bil fayn fayn wan go de.
Fɔ shɔ, PAPA GƆD go sev mi; i go tek mi go de wit am.
Nɔ yɛk we yu si ɔda man de jɛntri, we ɔlman nain os nɔ de krach ed fɔ natin;
bikɔs na ya i gɛt fɔ lɛf ɔltin we i day, i nɔ gɛt fɔ kɛr natin go.
We i liv, i bin tink se na blɛsin we ɔlman de tɔk bɔt aw i jɛntri
bɔt lɛk in pipul, insɛf go day ɛn nɔ si layt igen
Mɔtalman we jɛntri, ɛn abop pan in jɛntri, go day lɛkɛ bif we de day na bush.
PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD we gɛt pawa pas ɔl na di wanol wɔl, de kɔl ɔlman we de na wɔl,
PAPA GƆD, we de nain os na Zayɔn, de shayn lɛk san na di wanol wɔl.
Wi PAPA GƆD de kam bɔt nɔto kwayɛt wan; wayl faya go de kech bifo am, ɛn tinada go de blo rawnd am.
I de kɔl ɔl man na ɛvin ɛn ath fɔ kam si we i de jɔj in pipul.
I tɛl dɛn fɔ briŋ ɔl udat tru to am we bin mek sakrifays wɛn dɛn de mek Kɔvinant wit am fɔ kam.
Di tin dɛn na ɛvin sɛf de sho se PAPA GƆD raychɔs ɛn nainsɛf de jɔj di pipul.
“Una yɛri o, mi pipul! Na mi na di PAPA GƆD we una de wɔship ɛn na mi go tinap, tɔk bɔt wetin una dɔn du, we bad.
A nɔ se una rɔŋ fɔ de bɔn animal as sakrifays to mi,
a nɔ nid una man kaw ɔ got dɛn we una de mɛn,
as ɔl di animal dɛn na bush na mi yon ɛn ivin pas wan tawzin we de na ɔl di mawnten dɛn.
A no ɔl di wayl bɔd dɛn ɛn di wayl animal bikɔs na mi gɛt dɛn.
“If aŋri bin de kech mi, a nɔ bin fɔ gɛt fɔ tɛl una bikɔs di wanol wɔl ɛn ɔl wetin de na di wɔl na mi yon.
A nɔ nid una man kaw dɛn bif fɔ it, ɛn a nɔ nid una got blɔd fɔ drink.
Una fɔ de tɛl mi tɛnki, na dat fɔ bi una sakrifays to mi, we na PAPA GƆD we gɛt pawa pas ɔl,
dɔn da tɛm de we una aks mi fɔ pul una pan trɔbul, a nɔ go fɔgɛt una ɛn una go prez mi.”
Bɔt PAPA GƆD aks dɛn wan we de du bad, i se “Wetin mek una de tɔk bɔt di lɔ ɔ di kɔmandmɛnt dɛn we a dɔn gi?
Una et di tin dɛn we a de tɛl una fɔ du ɛn una nɔ tek mi wɔd mek natin.
Una de jɔyn gɛŋ wit tifman ɛn mek nɔ si udat kip switat.
“Una de yuz una mɔt fɔ pwɛl pipul ɛn na soso rikishi ɛn dabaru tɔk ful una mɔt.
Una nɔ jɛs de fɔ pwɛl ɔda pɔsin ɛn una yon yon bɛlɛ bɔn brɔda sɛf, una de mɛmba bad fɔ am.
We una de du ɔl dɛn tin ya, dɔn a de mek nɔ si dat mek una fil se, wi ɔl na wan. So naw a de tɔk pan una korokoro wan.
“Lisin gud, una we nɔ bisin bɔt PAPA GƆD ɔ nɔ so, a go chɛr chɛr una lɛkɛ aw layɔn de chɛr bif we i kech am; ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go pul una kɔmɔt na mi an.
Di pɔsin we lɛk fɔ tɛl mi tɛnki as in sakrifays to mi, na pɔsin we de du wetin a want, i de mek we fɔ mek a ɛp am pan wetin i de du ɛn sev am we trɔbul kam.”
PAPA GƆD av masi pan mi, bikɔs di lɔv we nɔ de ɛva chenj. Bikɔs yu gɛt sɔri-at, wep mi sin kɔmɔt pan mi.
Was mi sin kɔmɔt pan mi lɛk aw pɔsin de was dɔti kɔmɔt na plet, ɛn mek mi klin.
A no se a dɔn sin, ɛn ɔltɛm mi sin dɛn de fala mi.
A dɔn sin to yu ɛn yu gɛt rayt fɔ kɔndɛm mi.
Frɔm we mi mama gɛt mi bɛlɛ sɛf, mi na sina ɛn na so i bɔn mi.
Yu lɛk pɔsin we nɔ de mek ipokrit, ɛn yu go ebul fɔ tich am mɔ we go mek i gɛt mɔ sɛns.
Pul mi fɔlt pan mi ɛn was mi klin; mek a wayt lɛk shatin.
Tɛl mi se yu dɔn fɔgiv mi; mek a gladi ɛn nɔ pwɛl at igen
Pul mi sin kɔmɔt pan mi ɛn fɔgiv mi.
PAPA GƆD gi mi at we klin fɔ du yu wok, nyu at we go de du wetin yu want.
Nɔ lɛf mi to misɛf bikɔs a sin ɛn nɔ tek di Oli Spirit kɔmɔt pan mi.
Gi mi bak di jɔy we a fɔ gɛt we a no se yu go sev mi ɛn gi mi di kayn trɛnk we go mek a no se yu de wit mi.
Da tɛm de, a go ebul fɔ tich ɔda sina dɛn ɛn dɛnsɛf go kam bak to yu.
PAPA GƆD, yu na mi Seviɔ nɔ mek a day bikɔs a kil pɔsin, dɔn a go tɔk ɛn siŋ ɔlsay aw yu gud.
PAPA GƆD, gi mi chans fɔ prez yu, dɔn ɔlsay pan mi go jɔyn fɔ prez yu.
Yu nɔ lɛk we dɛn de bɔn ɛni kayn animal to yu as sakrifays, lɛk na dat a bin fɔ du; dɛn kayn tin de nɔ de muv yu.
Yu lɛk we wi gɛt rayt atityud fɔ sho se wi na natin bifo yu. PAPA GƆD yu go gladi fɔ ɛnibɔdi we nɔ de es insɛf ɔp, bɔt we de sɔri fɔ in sin ɛn beg yu fɔ fɔgiv am.
Mek Zayɔn bi wetin i bin bi bak; lɛ Jerusɛlɛm gɛt di sem kayn wɔl we i bin gɛt fɔ protɛkt am frɔm in ɛnimi dɛn.
Da tɛm de ɔlman go gi yu di kayn sakrifays, we yu lɛk, dɛn go ivin mek man kaw as sakrifays na yu ɔlta.
Yu we tink se yu na ɔltin, wetindu yu de blɔf pan yu wikɛdnɛs? Wetin du yu de mek mɔt ol de we yu no se di bad we yu de du nɔ nia di lɔv we PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ wi we de de sote go?
Yu de pwɛl ɔda pipul wit yu mɔt we shap lɛk pɛn nɛf ɛn ful wit soso lay ɛn koŋosa.
Yu lɛk fɔ pwɛl ɛn nɔ de mek yu lɛk fɔ lay pas fɔ tɔk tru.
Yu lɛk we yu de yuz yu mɔt fɔ pwɛl pipul.
Na so PAPA GƆD insɛf go pwɛl yu kpatakpata; i go mek dɛn drɔ yu kɔmɔt insay yu os; ɛn mek yu go day na trit.
Pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay go si PAPA GƆD wɔnda ɛn fred. Dɛn go laf am ɛn se.
“Luk di man we nɔ abop pan PAPA GƆD fɔ kɔba am, di man we abop pan in jɛntri ɛn we de yuz in pawa fɔ pwɛl pipul.”
Bɔt mi tan lɛkɛ ɔliv tik insay PAPA GƆD in os, na so misɛf go de rɔju; na pan PAPA GƆD in lɔv we traŋa ɛn we nɔ de ɛva chenj a abop.
A go prez yu sote go fɔ wetin yu dɔn du; a go de abop pan yu ɔltɛm bikɔs ɔf yu gud nem. Usay yu pipul gɛda, a go mɔs prez yu nem.
Fulman de tɔk nain at. I se PAPA GƆD nɔ de. Dɛn kɔrɔpt, ɛn na soso bad dɛn de tink; dɛn nɔ sabi fɔ du gud.
PAPA GƆD de na ɛvin de wach mɔtalman fɔ si if ɛniwande we de ɔndastand, we de tray fɔ no bɔt PAPA GƆD.
Bɔt oya! Ɔlman de go in yon we dɛn ɔl kɔrɔpt, Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we de bɔda fɔ du gud, wan sɛf nɔ de.
Dɛn pipul we de du bad nɔ go lan? Dɛn de pwɛl pipul lɛk we mɔtalman de cham bred ɛn dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt PAPA GƆD.

Dɛn go de fred ivin we fred nɔ mit dɛn. PAPA GƆD go mek in pipul ebul dɛn ɛnimi, dɛn go kil dɛn ɛn skata skata dɛn bon dɛn; di ɛnimi dɛn go shem ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn go win dɛn ɔltogɛda, PAPA GƆD dɔn pul at pan dɛn.
A de pre mek PAPA GƆD we de na Zayɔn sev di Izrɛlayt dɛn! Mek dɛn gɛt ɔl di jɛntri bak we dɛn bin dɔn tek na dɛn an, ɛn mek Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn gladi fɔ dat.
PAPA GƆD, yuz yu pawa fɔ sev mi, bikɔs yu nem big, tɔk mi kes fɔ mi.
PAPA GƆD, duya yɛri mi prea; lisin we a de tɔk to yu.
Trenja dɛn de atak mi; bad man dɛn de tray fɔ kil mi; man dɛn we nɔ bisin bɔt PAPA GƆD sɛf.
Na PAPA GƆD de ɛp mi; nain na mi layvwaya.
Lɛ di bad we dɛn wan we sidɔm fɔ pwɛl mi de mɛmba tɔn bak pan dɛn; PAPA GƆD duya, bikɔs yu na fethful PAPA GƆD, pwɛl dɛn bak.
A go gladi fɔ mek ɛni sakrifays to yu; a go prez yu ɛn tɔk yu gud nem.
Bikɔs yu dɔn tɔk mi kes fɔ mi ɛn pul mi pan trɔbul a go luk mi ɛnimi dɛn naw ɛn laf.
PAPA GƆD yɛri mi prea nɔ mek dɛf yes pan mi;
lisin to mi ɛn ansa mi prea. A nɔ ebul tink bɛtɛ sɛf igen ɛn mi at nɔ swit
