Yu de mek ren kam ɛn wata di grɔn we dɛn dig fɔ plant. Di grɔn de saf we de mek plant gro.
As yu na gud PAPA GƆD, yu de blɛs di plant dɛn ɛn dɛn de bia bɔku so dat di avɛst kin plɛnti.
Dɛn gras we de gro na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ ebul tap sɛf kin frɛsh ɛn di il dɛnsɛf kin gladi lɛk mɔtalman
Ɔl di animal dɛn we de it gras kin gɛt frɛsh gras fɔ it. Ɔltin go de wɔp dɔn di il ɛn vali dɛn go gladi lɛk mɔtalman.
Lɛ ɔlman na wɔl ala wit gladi to PAPA GƆD!
Siŋ siŋ dɛn we de tɔk aw PAPA GƆD wɔndaful ɛn tɔk gud bɔt PAPA GƆD!
Tɛl PAPA GƆD se “Di tin dɛn we yu de du, so wɔndaful dat yu ɛnimi dɛn ɔl de fred yu.
Ɔlman na wɔl de baw to yu Dɛn de siŋ fɔ prez yu dɛn de prez yu fɔ sho se dɛn rɛspɛkt yu.”
Una kam luk wetin PAPA GƆD dɔn du aw di wok we i du fɔ mɔtalman so wɔndaful!
I mek di wata na di si dray so dat di pipul waka na dray grɔn. Kam lɛ wi gladi fɔ wetin i dɔn du.
I de yuz in pawa fɔ rul sote go in yay nɔ de kɔmɔt pan ɔl di neshɔn dɛn lɛ dɛn nɔn nɔ tɔn pan am.
Lɛ ɔlman na dɛn neshɔn de prez PAPA GƆD! Lɛ ɔlman yɛri we dɛn de prez PAPA GƆD;
nain mek wi de, de lɛkɛ tide ɛn nɔn waala nɔ mek wi fɔdɔm.
Bikɔs yu we na PAPA GƆD dɔn de tɛst wi; yu de mek wi fiba piɔ gold we dɔn pas na faya.
Yu put wi na jel ɛn gi wi ebi lod fɔ tot.
Yu put man dɛn oba wi ed we mek wi trɔbul fish na banda sɛf tɛl lay bɔt yu dɔn briŋ wi kam usay ɔltin de wɔp.
A go mek sakrifays we a go bɔn na yu os ɛn a go du ɔl wetin a bin tɔk se a go du,
dat na di prɔmis dɛn we a mek wit mi mɔt we a bin de pan trɔbul.
A go mek sakrifays to yu wit dɛn fat animal dɛn. A go yuz ship, kaw ɛn got fɔ mek di sakrifays.
Ɔl udat de fred ɛn rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD, una kam lisin! Mek a tɛl una ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD dɔn du fɔ mi.
A pre lawd to am; ɛn prez am wit mi mɔt.
If a nɔ bin dɔn kɔnfɛs mi sin, PAPA GƆD nɔ bin fɔ ansa mi;
Bɔt PAPA GƆD yɛri mi prea ɛn i ansa mi.
Tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki, fɔ we i de yɛri mi prea ɛn nɔ de taya fɔ sho se i lɛk mi!
Lɛ PAPA GƆD sɔri fɔ wi ɛn blɛs wi ɛn lɛ i sho wi aw i gud,
mek ɔlman na wɔl go no aw yu gud, ɛn bɔt di pawa we yu gɛt fɔ sev dɛn.
PAPA GƆD, lɛ ɔlman prez Yu! Lɛ ɔlman na wɔl prez yu!
Lɛ ɔlman gladi ɛn siŋ bikɔs dɛn gladi, fɔ we yu de trit ɔlman wan ɛn sho dɛn wetin fɔ du.
PAPA GƆD lɛ ɔlman prez Yu! Lɛ ɔlman na wɔl prez yu!
Dɛn di fam dɛn go gɛt bɔku tin fɔ avɛst ɛn PAPA GƆD we na di PAPA GƆD we wi de wɔship go blɛs wi.
PAPA GƆD go blɛs wi ɛn ɔlman na wɔl go fred ɛn rɛspɛkt am.
Lɛ PAPA GƆD grap fɔ fɛt fɔ wi, ɛn lɛ wi ɛnimi we na PAPA GƆD insɛf yon ɛnimi dɛn rɔnawe; lɛ ɔl udat nɔ lɛk in biznɛs rɔnawe pan am.
Lɛk aw briz de blo smok ɛn skata am, mek PAPA GƆD skata dɛn lɛkɛ smok; lɛk aw kyandul go mɛlt we i tinap nia faya, mek PAPA GƆD lɛ bad pipul alaki bifo am.
Bɔt lɛ dɛn wan we de du we de du tin tret wan gladi fɔ wɔship am. Lɛ dɛn gladi ɛn sɛlibret nain os.
Lɛ wi siŋ to PAPA GƆD, wi fɔ siŋ ɛn prez PAPA GƆD fɔ udat i bi, Wi fɔ siŋ ɛn mek nɔys fɔ PAPA GƆD we de rayd pantap di klawd In nem na PAPA GƆD, so wi fɔ prez am.
Nain na papa to udat nɔ gɛt papa, ɛn i de fɛt fɔ poman. In na di PAPA GƆD na ɛvin.
I de fɛn fambul dɛn fɔ udat nɔ gɛt fambul i de mek di wan dɛnsɛf we de na jel siŋ bikɔs dɛn gladi bɔt i de mek dɛn wan we de mek rebɛl pan PAPA GƆD biznɛs tap na ples usay bɛtɛ nɔ de.
PAPA GƆD, wɛn yu bin de lid yu pipul na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap,
di wɔl trimbul bifo yu ɛn ren fɔdɔm bifo yu we na Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD we bin tɔk to dɛn na Mawnt Saynay,
PAPA GƆD, yu mek ren fɔdɔm bɔku bɔku wan we mek wi gɛt bɔku it.
Ɔlman ɛnjɔy am ɛn bikɔs yu gud yu mek shɔ se di poman sɛf gɛt wetin i want.
Wɛn di Masta tɔk, bɔku pipul kin kɛr di nyuz go.
Di Kiŋ dɛn ɛn dɛn amiman dɛn de rɔnawe: di uman dɛn we lɛf biɛn sheb wetin dɛn kapchɔ,
pan ɔl we sɔm nɔ de bɔda fɔ go na di wɔfrɔnt dɛnsɛf gɛt dɛn yon pan di jɛntri.
Wɛn PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti skata di kiŋ dɛn na di land, i tan lɛk we dyu fɔdɔm na Mawnt Zalmɔn.
Di mawnten dɛn na Beshan dɛn ay ay so; ɛn na so dɛn shap shap.
Wetin mek ay ay mawnten dɛn fɔ luk di mawnten we PAPA GƆD disayd fɔ de so lɛkɛ aw pɔsin de luk ɔda pɔsin we i jɛlɔs am? Na de PAPA GƆD go tap sote go.
Di chariɔt dɛn we PAPA GƆD tek so bɔku, pɔsin nɔ go ebul kɔnt dɛn; PAPA GƆD dɔn kɔmɔt na Mawnt Saynay naw i de nain os.
We i bin de go ɔp na ɛvin i kapchɔ pipul ɛn tek dɛn go wit am; pipul ɔl gi am prɛzɛnt, ɛn ivin dɛn wan we bin de mek rebɛl pan in di PAPA GƆD, bato am.
Lɛ wi prez di Masta! Nain de sev wi, nain de tek ɔp wi kes dɛn ɔltɛm.
Wi PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD we de sev pipul. Na PAPA GƆD. Na dis wɔndaful PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ kin mek pɔsin nɔ day we waala mit am.
PAPA GƆD mɔs nyamanyama in ɛnimi dɛn, we jɛs de kɔntinyu fɔ sin.
Di Masta se “A go briŋ una ɛnimi dɛn we de ɔp na Mawnt Beshan; ɛn dɛn wan we de dɔŋ insay di wata kam,
so dat una go yuz dɛn blɔd fɔ was una fut, ɛn una dɔg dɛn go ɛnjɔy dɛn yon.”
PAPA GƆD, a de si dɛn de mek viktri mach fɔ yu, viktri mach fɔ sho se mi PAPA GƆD we na mi kiŋ de go insay in os.
Na dɛn wan we de siŋ de bifo ɛn na afta dɛn di myuzishian dɛn de; dɛn yɔŋ uman dɛnsɛf bin de wit dɛn de nak tamborin.
Una prez PAPA GƆD na di grup we una de! Una prez PAPA GƆD usay ɔlman na Izrɛl gɛda.
Na di Bɛnjamin fambul dɛn we smɔl pas dɛn ɔl de lid, dɛn di krawd we kɔmɔt na Juda fambul ɛn Zɛbyulɔn fambul ɛn Naftali fambul.
Sho se yu na PAPA GƆD we gɛt pawa, sho se yu na PAPA GƆD we gɛt trɛnk, lɛk aw yu bin dɔn de du.
Bikɔs yu os de na Jerusɛlɛm, Kiŋ dɛn go gi yu prɛzɛnt,
Tɔk pan dɛn neshɔn we de mek gbagbati, lili dɛn wan dɛn we tek dɛn silva mek gɔd ɛn skata dɛn wan dɛn we de ɛnjɔy wɛn wa de.
Di gɔvmɛnt go sɛn pipul frɔm Ijipt; ɛn di pipul na Ithiopia go ɔri fɔ butu es dɛn an ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD.
Lɛ ɔlman na dis wɔl siŋ to PAPA GƆD, prez ɛn siŋ to PAPA GƆD,
we de rayd insay di klawd go fɛt fɔ wi we in vɔys fiba tɛnda.
Tɔk bɔt PAPA GƆD in pawa wi i gɛt as kiŋ oba Izrɛl ɛn aw di skay sɛf de sho aw i wɔndaful.
PAPA GƆD, yu wɔndaful! Yu du fɔ fred usay yu de. Yu we na Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD de gi pawa ɛn trɛnk to yu pipul. Una lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD!
PAPA GƆD, duya sev mi mi trɔbul dɛn de mek a fil lɛk we wata kam ɔp te rich mi nɛk.
I tan lɛkɛ se na pan kwik sand a tinap, we de na say we nɔ de tek mi wet. A dɔn rich midul di wata naw; usay di wevs dɛn dɔn swɛla mi.
A dɔn taya fɔ ala fɔ mek yu ɛp mi; mi trot dɔn dray. Mi yay wan kɔmɔt, as a de luk fɔ mek PAPA GƆD ɛp mi.

Dɛn wan dɛn we stil et mi pan ɔl we dɛn nɔ gɛt rizin fɔ et mi, bɔku pas di ia na mi ed; di pipul we jɛs luk mi, ɛn dɛn tek mi mek ɛnimi dɛn so bɔku ɛn dɛn de afta mi blɔd. Dɛn de lay pan mi ɛn fos mi fɔ sɔfa fɔ tin we a nɔ tif ɛn se a fɔ pe.
Yu no ɔl mi sin dɛn gud gud wan nɔn nɔ de we a ayd pan yu.
PAPA GƆD, yu we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nɔ mek dɛn wan we de luk ɔp to yu giv ɔp fɔseka mi ɛn nɔ mek dɛn wan we de sav yu shem fɔseka mi. Duya PAPA GƆD di PAPA GƆD we, Izrɛl de wɔship!
Na fɔ pliz yu mek a de bia ɔl dis nambara di shem ɛn disgres tumɔs fɔ mi.
A fiba trenja to mi fambul dɛn ɛn ivin to mi bɛlɛ bɔn brɔda dɛn, a stil fiba trenja.
Di lɛk we a lɛk yu os dɔn tɔn bon na mi trot ɛn ɔl di kɔs we dɛn de kɔs yu de tɔn pan mi.
We a de fast ɛn pre, dɛn de provok mi.
Wɛn a wɛr saklɔth, pipul de laf mi.
Dɛn wan dɛn we de kip kɔmpin na di siti in get tek mi mek rederaun, dɔn dɛn drɔnkɔman dɛn ɔl de tek mi mek siŋ.
E PAPA GƆD, a de pre to yu, ansa mi di tɛm we rayt fɔ yu; Yuz di lɔv we yu gɛt fɔ mi fɔ ansa mi as yu na di wan we go sev mi.
Pul mi kɔmɔt na di kwik sand, nɔ mek a go dɔŋ; pul mi na dɛn wan dɛn we et mi dɛn an pul mi kɔmɔt usay di swɛlin de swɛla mi.
Nɔ mek di swɛlin was mi go ɔ mek a drawn insay de ɔ lɛ di grev opin in mɔt fɔ swɛla mi.
PAPA GƆD bikɔs yu na PAPA GƆD we gud, yu lɛk mi bad ɛn gɛt sɔri-at, Duya PAPA GƆD, ansa mi.
Nɔ lɛf mi to misɛf; mekes ansa mi bikɔs a de pan trɔbul.
Fɔ mek mi ɛnimi dɛn kɔle, kam nia mi ɛn sev mi; pul di waala we a fɔ gɛt kɔmɔt pan mi
Yu no aw mi ɛnimi dɛn dɔn provok, shem ɛn disgres mi; yu de wach dɛn.
Dɛn dɔn provok mi te, a dɔn brok at ɛn giv ɔp. A luk fɔ udat a go go kray to, bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ de, pɔsin nɔ de sɛf fɔ tɛl mi “Ɔsh.”
Dɛn gi mi pɔyzin fɔ it dɔn we a tɔsti dɛn gi mi viniga fɔ drink.
We dɛn sɛt tebul fɔ sɛlibret to yu, lɛ i kɔmɔt bad pan dɛn lɛkɛ aw dɛn de sɛt trap fɔ mi.
Lɛ dɛn yay blɛn so dɛn nɔ go de si ɛn lɛ dɛn gɛt ɔmbak sote go.
Sho dɛn se yu vɛks bad pan dɛn; ɛn pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat.
Lɛ ɔlman na dɛn os rɔnawe; so dat pɔsin nɔ go de fɔ tap na di os.
Du so bikɔs dɛn de provok dɛn wan we PAPA GƆD de pɔnish. Dɛn de tɔk bɔt dɛn wan we tin bad fɔ.
Sho dɛn se dɛn sin dɛn pasmak; ɛn nɔ sev dɛn atɔl.
Pul dɛn nem dɛn kɔmɔt na di buk usay yu rayt dɛn pipul we de du wetin yu want dɛn nem; nɔ miks dɛn nem de.
A de pan pen ɛn mi at nɔ swit; PAPA GƆD, duya sev mi, kɔba mi.
A go mek siŋ fɔ prez PAPA GƆD ɛn a go tɔk lawd bɔt am ɛn tɛl am tɛnki
Dis go mek PAPA GƆD gladi pas we a go go bɔn animal se a de mek sakrifays to am.
Lɛ di poman sɛf si wetin yu de du fɔ mi ɛn gladi; Yu we de fala PAPA GƆD, nɔ giv ɔp o!
PAPA GƆD de yɛri di poman ɛn i nɔ de fɔgɛt udat de na prizin ɔ we de sɔfa lɛk udat de na prizin.
Lɛ di wanol wɔl prez PAPA GƆD, udat de na ɛvin, ath ɔ ɔnda wata,
bikɔs PAPA GƆD go sev Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn bil Juda bak. Da tɛm de pipul go tap de ɛn tek am fɔ bi dɛn yon;
dɛn wan we bin de sav PAPA GƆD, dɛn jɛnareshɔn go gɛt am as prɔpati, ɛn ɔl udat lɛk PAPA GƆD ɛn de fala am go de de.
Duya PAPA GƆD, sev mi! Mekes kam ɛp mi.
Lɛ ɔl udat nɔ want fɔ si mi kɔnfyus ɛn shem pan dɛnsɛf; dɛn wan we nɔ want si mi bɛtɛ wan mek dɛn disgres.
Lɛ ɔl dɛn wan we de opin dɛn mɔt fɔ laf mi kɔba dɛn fes wit shem.
Mek ɔl udat de tray fɔ pliz yu gladi bikɔs ɔf wetin yu dɔn du; mek ɔl udat gladi fɔ we yu sev dɛn prez yu nem ɔltɛm.
Pan ɔl we a nɔ min natin; PAPA GƆD, nɔ fɔgɛt mi. Na yu na di wan we de pul mi pan trɔbul ɛn ɛp mi; PAPA GƆD, duya nɔ westɛm.
PAPA GƆD, na to yu nɔmɔ a go go to fɔ mek yu kɔba mi nɔ mek a shem pan mi ɛnimi dɛn.
Bikɔs yu nɔ de du tin tret wan, pul mi pan trɔbul ɛn ɛp mi kɔmɔt na dɛn an; Lisin to mi ɛn sev mi.
Yu kin kɔba mi lɛk aw fɔl de kɔba in pikin so dat a go rɔn go to yu ɔltɛm. Tɛl mi se yu go sev mi bikɔs yu tan lɛkɛ os we dɛn bil wit trɔŋ wɔl fɔ protɛkt udat de de.
PAPA GƆD, duya pul mi na dɛn bad man dɛn an, we na bad nɔmɔ dɛn sidɔm fɔ.
Mi Masta, yu we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, na yu dɔn de gi mi op, na yu PAPA GƆD a dɔn put mi at traŋa wan pan frɔm we a smɔl.
Frɔm we mi mama bɔn mi, na yu a abop pan; na yu pul mi na mi mama in bɛlɛ, A go prez yu nem sote go.
Mi layf na ɛgzampul to bɔku pipul, ɛn na yu dɔn de kɔba mi.
Na soso prez de na mi mɔt fɔ yu, ɛn a go de tɔk aw yu wɔndaful ɛvride.
Nɔ ib mi oba bikɔs a dɔn ol; nɔ fɔsek mi bikɔs a nɔ gɛt bɛtɛ trɛnk naw.
Mi ɛnimi dɛn de tɔk bad bɔt mi; dɛn wan we de fɛn we fɔ kil mi.
Dɛn de se sins PAPA GƆD dɔn ib mi oba, nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ fɛt fɔ mi so dɛn fɔ rɔnata mi te dɛn kech mi.
PAPA GƆD, yu we na mi PAPA GƆD, nɔ kɔmɔt nia mi mekes kam mek yu ɛp mi.
Lɛ dɛn wan we want fɔ pwɛl mi nem kɔba dɛn fes wit shem; Lɛ dɛn wan we nɔ wan si mi bɛtɛ wan disgres ɛn alaki.
Fɔ mi yon say, a nɔ go ɛva giv ɔp; a go de prez yu mɔ ɛn mɔ.
A go tɔk bɔt ɔl di gud tin dɛn we yu de du ɛn aw yu de sev pipul de ɛn nɛt, pan ɔl we a nɔ no aw fɔ tɔk am as i bɔku.
PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, a go prez yu. A go tɔk aw yu gud, ɛn tɛl ɔlman se na yu nɔmɔ tret.
PAPA GƆD, frɔm we a smɔl, nain yu dɔn tich mi fɔ prez yu, ɛn te tide a de tɔk bɔt di wɔndaful wok we yu de du.
PAPA GƆD, duya, lɛkɛ aw a dɔn ol so ɛn mi ia ɔl dɔn wet nɔ ib mi oba, de wit mi lɛ a tɛl di nɛks jɛnareshɔn bɔt ɔl di wɔndaful tin we yu dɔn du ɛn tɔk bɔt aw yu gret to jɛnareshɔn we nɔ bɔn yet.
PAPA GƆD, wi nɔ ebul fɔ ɔndastand yu gudnɛs yu de du wɔndaful tin dɛn E PAPA GƆD udat de we tan lɛk yu!
Pan ɔl we yu gri mek bɔku waala mit mi we mek layf bita, yu go mek mi layf swit bak; yu nɔ go mek a day yet.
Yu go wata mi layf bak ɛn a go smayl igen
PAPA GƆD a go siŋ ɛn prez yu wit ap bikɔs yu tret; a go siŋ ɛn prez yu wit laya yu we na di oli PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship.
A go ala wɛn a de prez yu, bikɔs a gladi; ɛn bikɔs yu dɔn pul mi pan trɔbul.
Ol de ɛn nɛt, a go de tɔk bɔt yu gudnɛs as yu dɔn mek ɔl udat nɔ bin wan si mi bɛtɛ wan, shem ɛn alaki.
PAPA GƆD, mek di Kiŋ sabi fɔ tɔk kes fia wan, ɛn mek di Kiŋ gɛt yu yon gud at.
Mek i rul yu pipul wit dis gud at ya, ɛn trit yu po pipul fia wan.
Mek di wanol land bɛtɛ, ɛn mek di pipul avɛst bɔku ɛn lɛ ɔl dis bi bikɔs di pipul na di land de du tin tret wan.
Mek dis kiŋ ya so rɛdi fɔ fɛt fɔ di poman ɛn ɛp dɛn po pikin we dɛn pipul nɔ gɛt natin; ɛn pul dɛn kɔmɔt na di wan dɛn we de buli dɛn, dɛn an.
Mek di Kiŋ ɛn in jɛnareshɔn dɛn rul sote go, jɛs lɛkɛ aw di san ɛn di mun nɔ de lɛf fɔ shayn.
Mek di tɛm we i de rul bɛnifit in pipul lɛkɛ aw ren na bɛnifit to dɛn plant dɛn ɛnitɛm we i fɔdɔm.
We di Kiŋ de rul, lɛ di land ful wit yu gudnɛs ɛn lɛ di pipul gɛt kol at te di mun lɛf fɔ shayn;
Mek di say we i go rul so big dat i go bigin Ist ɛn ɛnd Wɛst ɔ frɔm Nɔth to Sawt.
Pipul dɛn we tap usay mɔtalman fɔ tap ɛn in ɛnimi dɛn ɔl go dɔbalɛ bifo am.
Dɛn ɔda Kiŋ dɛn go kɔmɔt Spen, Shiba ɛn Sɛba ɛn briŋ prɛzɛnt fɔ am fɔ sho se dɛn gri fɔ am.
Dɛn ɔl ɛn dɛn pipul na di wanol wɔl go kam baw to di Kiŋ ɛn rɛdi fɔ du wetin i want.
Di Kiŋ go sɔri fɔ udat go go kray to am we nɔ gɛt pɔsin fɔ ɛp am.
I go gɛt sɔri-at fɔ poman ɛn mek po nɔ kil dɛn.
I go mek dɛn nɔ de tek advantej pan dɛn ɔ buli dɛn, bikɔs dɛn layf min sɔntin to am.
Mek di Kiŋ gɛt lɔŋ layf! Mek di pipul na Shiba briŋ gold kam fɔ am. Mek di pipul de pre fɔ mek PAPA GƆD blɛs am ɔltɛm.
Lɛ it gro ɔlsay na di land; ɛn ivin pantap dɛn il ɛn mawnten. Lɛ i gro fayn lɛk aw it de gro fayn pantap di mawnten dɛn na Libanɔn. Ɛn lɛ dɛn nɔ day lɛk aw gras nɔba day.
Mek in nem nɔ day; mek i de lɛk di san we de de sote go. Ɔlman na wɔl go pre fɔ gɛt blɛsin lɛk am ɛn tɔk bɔt in yon blɛsin.
Una lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD! Nain nɔmɔ de du wɔndaful tin dɛn.
Lɛ wi prez in nem sote go in nem we big ɛn pawaful; lɛ di wanol wɔl ebul fɔ si ɔl di wɔndaful tin dɛn we i de du ɛn aw i lɛk ɛn bisin bɔt in pipul. Emɛn, Emɛn
Na yaso Devid, we na bin Jɛsi in bɔypikin in prea dɛn tap.
Fɔ tru, tru, PAPA GƆD gud to Izrɛl, ɛn ɔl udat de fala am wit ɔl in at.
Smɔl bit mɔ a bin fɔ lɔs mi balans; bikɔs a wan dawt PAPA GƆD,
we a si aw bɛtɛ de fala bad pipul dɔn a bigin jɛlɔs dɛn wan we de kak.
Dɛn nɔ gɛt wan yagba; dɛn bɔdi de luk frɛsh ɔltɛm.
Dɛn yay nɔ de si trɔbul lɛkɛ di ɔdinari mɔtalman; dɛn nɔ de sik sɛf lɛkɛ dɛn.
Na dat mek dɛn de kak so, dɛn de wɛr am lɛk chen; ɛn dɛn wikɛdnɛs lɛk klos fɔ mek ɔlman si.
Dɛn nɔ gɛt filin so dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt wetin dɛn de du; na bad nɔmɔ dɛn de mɛmba
Dɛn de mek blɔf ɛn tɔk bɔt dɛn bad; dɔn dɛn de trɛtin pipul.
Dɛn de tɔk bad bɔt PAPA GƆD dɔn dɛn de wirɔn de tɔk soso aydul tɔk.
Pan ɔl dat, pipul de biliv dɛn nɔshi-nɔshi ɛn tek wetin dɛn de se lɛk aw pɔsin de drink wata.
Bad pipul kin se PAPA GƆD nɔ de si wetin dɛn de du. PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nɔ ebul fɛnɔt sɛf.
Na so bad man tan fɛnɔt sɛf; i nɔ bisin bɔt natin, wans in ebul fɔ mek am.
Na fɔ natin a bin de mek gud bɔy; ɛn nɔ miks pan bad.
Ol de, a de sɔfa lɛk udat du bad. Ɛvri mɔnin, a de si trɔbul.
If misɛf bin de se PAPA GƆD nɔ no natin, a bin fɔ de gi yu pikin dɛn badnem.
Wɛn a tray fɔ tink bɔt aw yu no ɔltin; a nɔ ebul bikɔs i mek a fil bad.
Pas we a go insay PAPA GƆD in os nain a ebul fɔ ɔndastand aw di bad man gɛt fɔ ɛnd.
Yu put dɛn na slipul ples; ɛn mek dɛn fɔdɔm bad wan.
Ɔltin go dɔn fɔ dɛn kwik wan. I go bad fɔ dɛn we dɛn rich dɛn Watalo
Wetin bad pipul de du tan lɛk we pɔsin drim na nɛt dɔn bay mɔnin we i wek i dɔn fɔgɛt; PAPA GƆD pɔsin kin fɔgɛt bɔt dɛn bad pipul de wɛn yu kam fɔ ɛp mi.
Wɛn a gɛt brokat we i tan lɛk a wan day,
kin mek a biev lɛk animal bifo yu; a kin mek lɛk we ship de luk sɔl.
Pan ɔl dat a de wit yu ɔltɛm; ɛn yu nɔba fɔgɛt mi.
Yu de sho mi usay a fɔ go dɔn we a fala di rod, yu de gi mi ɔna. Na yu nɔmɔ we de na ɛvin a gɛt.
We a gɛt yu we de na ɛvin, a nɔ nid natin igen na wɔl.
Mi at kin pwɛl, mi bɔdi sik, bɔt na PAPA GƆD de gi mi trɛnk; ɛn nain na mi yon sote go.
Dɛn wan we nɔ bisin bɔt yu go alaki; yu go mek ɔl udat nɔ lɛk yu biznɛs, alaki.
Bɔt fɔ mi yon say, i fayn fɔ de nia PAPA GƆD. A dɔn de nia PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD, fɔ de kɔba mi; A go tɛl ɔlman wetin PAPA GƆD dɔn du.
PAPA GƆD, wetindu yu dɔn ib wi oba? Na fɔ sote go? Wetin mek yu de mek wamat pan wi we sɔpoz fɔ bi di ship dɛn we yu de mɛn?
Nɔ fɔgɛt se, wi na yu pipul we yu bin dɔn pik trade di pipul we yu sev fɔ bi yu yon, na Mawnt Zayɔn, usay yu bin de.
Kam mek yu kam si fɔ yusɛf; di pwɛl we di ɛnimi dɛn dɔn pwɛl yu os na Jerusɛlɛm.
Yu ɛnimi dɛn de gladi fɔ pwɛl di vɛri ples we yu de mit wit wi; dɔn dɛn de put mak de fɔ sho se dɛn dɔn win wi.
Dɛn mek lɛkɛ man dɛn we de pas na bush rod wit dɛn aks rɛdi fɔ kɔt ɛni tik we dɛn mit na rod.
Dɛn yuz dɛn aks ɛn kɔtlas dɛn fɔ smash ɔl di kavin dɛn.
Dɛn bɔn yu os kam rayt dɔŋ dɛn mek di ples lɛ i nɔ fit fɔ mek yu pipul go wɔship yu igen
Dɛn bin mekɔp fɔ pwɛl di ples kpatakpata dɛn bɔn ɔl usay pipul de gɛda fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD.
Yu nɔ de ple nɔn mirekul ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ tɔk fɔ yu fɔ mek wi no ustɛm wi trɔbul go dɔn. Nɔbɔdi nɔ no aw lɔŋ i gɛt fɔ tek.
PAPA GƆD, aw lɔŋ yu de lɛf wi ɛnimi dɛn fɔ laf yu? Yu go lɛf dɛn fɔ tɔk bad bɔt yu te go?
Yu nɔ go ɛp wi? Yu go jɛs fol an ɛn fut de luk?
Bɔt yu na mi PAPA GƆD ɛn Kiŋ fɔ lɔŋ yu dɔn win bɔku fɛt na wi land.
Na bay yu pawa, yu mek rod insay wata, yu masmas dɛn big animal dɛn we tap insay wata dɛn ed.
Ivin da dɛbul we nem Liviathan, yu mas in ed ɛn gi am to di animal dɛn na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap fɔ it.
Na yu de mek watasay gɛt wata ɛn wata bɔs na grɔn; ɛn na yu de mek ɔl usay kin pul wata, dray.
Na yu mek de ɛn nɛt, na yu mek di mun ɛn di san.
Yu put bawndri bitwin di kɔntri dɛn; dɔn yu mek ren sizin ɛn dray sizin.
PAPA GƆD mɔs mɛmba aw yu ɛnimi dɛn dɔn de provok yu, aw ivin di fulish pipul de laf yu nem.
Nɔ lɛf yu pipul gi dɛn ɛnimi, yu pipul we wik lɛk dɔv nɔ fɔ lɛf to dɛn ɛnimi dɛn we fiba dɛn wayl animal; de mɛmba di po pipul ɔltɛm.
Mɛmba di Kɔvinant we yu bin mek bikɔs pipul de we sidɔm na kɔna de plan bad ɔltɛm.
Nɔ lɛ di wan we dɛn de buli rɔnawe wit shem ɛn disgres; lɛ di poman de prez yu nem.
Grap nɔ PAPA GƆD, mek yu fɛt fɔ yusɛf; mɛmba aw dɛn wan we nɔ no dɛn lɛf frɔm dɛn rayt de laf yu ol de.
Nɔ lɛf yu ɛnimi dɛn fɔ go skɔchfri, dil wit dɛn ɔl we dɔn de mɔna yu.
PAPA GƆD, wi tɛl yu tɛnki o wi tɛl yu tɛnki! Wi no se yu nem big ɛn wi go tɔk bɔt ɔl di wɔndaful tin dɛn we yu de du.
PAPA GƆD se nain de fiks di tɛm; as i de jɔj rayt.
Ivin if ɔltin na di wɔl, skata; in, we na PAPA GƆD, go fiks di fawndeshɔn bak.
PAPA GƆD de tɛl udat de bost se nid nɔ de fɔ dat, dɔn i de tɛl udat bad se, lɛ i lɛf fɔ kak pan in kɔmpin dɛn.
I se mek dɛn lɛf fɔ kak; ɛn lɛf fɔ tɔk dɛn big big tɔk.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we ebul pul mɔtalman ɔp wɛda na frɔm di Ist, Wɛst, Nɔth ɔ Sawt.
Na PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ de jɔj rayt; nain de put yu ɔp ɔ i put yu dɔŋ.

PAPA GƆD gɛt wan kɔp we nainsay de i de put ɔl di vɛks we i dɔn vɛks, dis kɔp ya nain jɔjmɛnt. Di vɛks we i dɔn vɛks na di wayn insay di kɔp, i de gi di pɔsin we de du bad di wayn fɔ drink; i go mek i drink ɔl di kɛtɛkɛmu makoloŋ.
As fɔ mi, a go de tɔk am ɔltɛm se PAPA GƆD na jɔj. A go de siŋ ɛn prez di PAPA GƆD we Jekɔb bin de wɔship.
PAPA GƆD se, i go brok ɔl dɛn wan we de kak dɛn fɛda dɔŋ bɔt i go gi udat de waka tret wit am mɔ pawa.
Insay Juda ɔlman no PAPA GƆD; ɛn infakt sɛf di wanol Izrɛl rɛspɛkt am bad bad wan.
In os fɔ pre to am de, Jerusɛlɛm; na Mawnt Zayɔn i tap
Na de i pwɛl pwɛl di ɛnimi dɛn aro, dɛn big shild ɛn dɛn sɔd, ɛn ɔl dɛn wɛpɔn fɔ tek fɛt wa.
Yu de shayn lɛk layt, ɛn yu luk brayt pas di mawnten usay yu kil yu ɛnimi dɛn.
Di bad man dɛn wit trɛnk dɔn day. Dɛn dɔn tek ɔl wetin dɛn bin de tek fɛt kɔmɔt na dɛn an; ɔl dɛn trɛnk ɛn sabi nɔ min natin igen dɛn nɔ ebul fɛt sɛf.
PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD we Jekɔb bin de wɔship we yu tɔk pan dɛn nɔmɔ, di ɔs ɛn in masta de fɔdɔm day
Yu du fɔ mek ɔlman fred yu ɛn udat ebul fɔ tinap usay yu de jɔj pipul, we yu dɔn vɛks?
Yu sidɔm na ɛvin de jɔj udat rayt ɛn udat rɔŋ; ɔlman na wɔl de fred yu ɛn nɔ de se natin,
we yu grap fɔ jɔj ɛn fɔ fɛt fɔ di poman dɛn na wɔl.
Di vɛks we yu kin vɛks pan mɔtalman kin lɛ dɛn si wetin mek dɛn fɔ prez yu; ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we nɔba sɔfa we yu de jɔj kin lɛk fɔ prez yu mɔ.
Una nɔ jɛs mek prɔmis to PAPA GƆD bɔt du wetin una se; lɛ ɔl dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn briŋ prɛzɛnt fɔ am. Na PAPA GƆD we fɔ fred,
I ebul brok dɛn man we de rul dɛn fɛda dɔŋ, so ɔl dɛn kiŋ de fred am.
A kray to PAPA GƆD fɔ ɛp mi; a tɛl PAPA GƆD mi kɔmplen.
Wɛn tin de mɔna mi, a pre to PAPA GƆD; a nɔ de blo sɛf, ol nɛt a de kray to am bɔt usay, mi at nɔ de kol.
PAPA GƆD, wɛn a tink bɔt yu, a de fil am mɔ; wɛn a mɛmba mɔ a de giv ɔp.
Na yu mek a nɔ ebul fɔ slip; a kɔnfyus bikɔs a nɔ no wetin fɔ tɔk igen
A kin mɛmba fɔstɛm, ɛn wetin bin de apin lɔntɛm;
A de siŋ ol nɛt. A de tink ɛn aks misɛf ɔlkayn kwɛshɔn.
“Na ib PAPA GƆD dɔn ib wi oba so? I nɔ go ɛva trit wi fayn igen?
Na dɔn di lɔv we i gɛt fɔ wi dɔn so? I dɔn fɔgɛt bɔt di prɔmis sɛf we i bin prɔmis wi?
Fɔ se PAPA GƆD nɔ gɛt klin at fɔ wi igen? I so vɛks pan wi dat i nɔ de sɔri fɔ wisɛf?”
Dɛn a tink bak “Fɔ tru tru se PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nɔ de yuz in pawa fɔ sev wi igen?”
A mɛmba ɔl di wɔndaful tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD bin de du. A go mɛmba di mirekul dɛn we i bin ple lɔntɛm.
A de tink bɔt ɔl dɛn tin de we yu bin dɔn du ɛn wɔnda pan di wok we yu de du.
PAPA GƆD, ɔl wetin yu de du, oli. Us gɔd de we big lɛkɛ yu we na wi Gɔd?
Yu na di PAPA GƆD we de ple mirekul; ɛn ɔlman de si yu mirekul dɛn.
Na bay yu pawa, yu sev yu pipul, yu pipul we na Jekɔb ɛn Josɛf in Jɛnareshɔn dɛn.
Wɛn yu rich di wata, i skyad ɛn bigin trimbul lɛkɛ pɔsin ivin di bɔtɔm pat pan di wata.
Ren de kam, tɛnda de rol; dɔn laytin de flash lɛk aw aro kin de flay.
Yu tɛnda in sawnd bin de pan di ebi briz we de tɔn rawnd wit spid; ɛn we yu laytin layt di wanol wɔl; ɛn ath trimbul ɛn shek.
Yu waka wit yu pipul insay di wata yu krɔs wit dɛn bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul si yu fut in mak.
Yu lid yu pipul lɛk aw man we de mɛn ship kin lid in ship dɛn yu yuz Mozis ɛn Erɔn fɔ lid yu pipul.
Mi pipul, una lisin wetin a de kam tich una. Opin una yes fɔ yɛri wetin a de tɔk.
A go pul parebul we a de tɔk, a go tɛl una bɔt wetin una nɔ bin no we apin lɔntɛm
wetin wi dɔn yɛri ɛn wetin wi no; frɔm wetin wi pipul bin tɛl wi;
Wi nɔ go ayd dɛn pan wi pikin dɛn; wi go tɛl di nɛks jɛnareshɔn bɔt PAPA GƆD in wɔndaful wok. Wi go tɛl dɛn aw i gɛt pawa ɛn bɔt ɔl di mirekul dɛn we i dɔn du.
I mek lɔ fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn we na Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn dɛn, ɛn tɛl wi lɔntɛm pipul se dɛn fɔ tich dɛn pikin dɛn,
so dat di nɛks jɛnareshɔn go no dɛn ɛn dɛnsɛf go tich dɛn pikin dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet dɔn dɛnsɛf go tich dɛn yon pikin dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet.
Da tɛm de, dɛn go trɔs PAPA GƆD ɛn nɔ fɔgɛt ɔl wetin i dɔn du ɛn dɛn go obe am.
Dat go mek dɛn nɔ fiba dɛn lɔntɛm pipul, we bin traŋayes ɛn gɛt ambɔgin. Dɛn at nɔ bin de to PAPA GƆD, so dɛn nɔ bin bisin bɔt am.
Pan ɔl we di Ifremayt sojaman dɛn gɛt bo ɛn aro fɔ tek fɛt dɛn rɔnawe pan dɛn ɛnimi dɛn na di batul.
Dɛn Ifremayt sojaman dɛn ya nɔ bin kip PAPA GƆD in Kɔvinant ɛn dɛn nɔ bin gri fɔ obe in lɔ.
Dɛn nɔ ivin mɛmba wetin i bin dɔn du, ɔl di mirekul dɛn we i bin dɔn ple.
I ple mirekul dɛn frɔnt dɛn fes. Dɛn si dɛn korokoro wan na Ijipt na di Zoan rijɔn.
I divayd di Rɛd Si ɛn mek rod fɔ dɛn fɔ pas; I lɛ di wata tinap deŋ na di sayd dɛn lɛk wɔl.
I yuz klawd fɔ gayd dɛn de tɛm, dɔn na nɛt, i yuz faya fɔ gayd dɛn fɔ mek dɛn si rod.
I mek wata kɔmɔt insay ston na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap ɛn gi dɛn bɔku wata fɔ drink.
Nain de mek wata bɔs na rɔk ɛn di riva dɛn gɛt wata ɔltɛm.
Pan ɔl dis, dɛn kɔntinyu fɔ sin to PAPA GƆD, dɛn tɔn rebɛl pan PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl ɔda gɔd, we dɛn de na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Dɛn tɛst PAPA GƆD bay wilful ɛn aks am fɔ gi dɛn di it we dɛn want.
Dɛn tɔk bad bɔt PAPA GƆD ɛn se i nɔ ebul gi dɛn tin fɔ it we dɛn de na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Dɛn se “I ebul nak rɔk mek wata kɔmɔt insay de, bɔt i ebul gi wi bred fɔ it? I ebul gi in pipul bif fɔ it?”
Wɛn PAPA GƆD yɛri wetin dɛn de se, i vɛks bad so i dil wit di Izrɛlayt dɛn, we na Jekɔb in pikin dɛn,
fɔ we dɛn nɔ biliv am ɛn abop se i go sev dɛn.
Pan ɔl dat, i gi ɔda fɔ mek ɛvin opin lɛk domɔt;
ɛn sɛn mana kam dɔŋ fɔ di pipul fɔ it; i gi dɛn di it we de na ɛvin.
Mɔtalman it di sem kayn it lɛk di enjɛl dɛn i gi dɛn te i pasmak.
I mek di Ist wind blo oba di kamp ɛn bay in pawa di sawt wind insɛf blo.
I sɛn bɔku bif kam dɔŋ fɔ dɛn. Di bif dɛn na bin bɔd fɔ dɛn fɔ it, ɛn dɛn bin bɔku lɛk sansan na bich.
I mek dɛn fɔdɔm ɔl usay dɛn de usay dɛn bil tɛnt we dɛn kamp.
Dɛn it te dɛn bɛlful bikɔs PAPA GƆD did gi dɛn wetin dɛn want.
Bɔt as dɛn bin de it wetin dɛn aks fɔ, wɛn dɛn nɔ bin dɔn bɛlful yet,
na da tɛm de PAPA GƆD rɛdi fɔ sho dɛn aw i vɛks; i kil ɔl di man dɛn we yu go se ebul dɛnsɛf. Na so yɔŋ man dɛn tek nɔ de pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Pan ɔl we PAPA GƆD du so, dɛn stil kɔntinyu fɔ sin; wit ɔl di wɔndaful tin dɛn we i de du, dɛn stil nɔ biliv am.
So PAPA GƆD insɛf dɔnawe wit dɛn i mek dɛn ɔl day.
Ɛnitɛm we dɛn gɛt dɛn waala de, di wan dɛn we lɛf de rɔn to PAPA GƆD; dɛn de bigin majiji fɔ am ɛn du wetin i se.
Dɛn kin mɛmba se na PAPA GƆD dɔn de kɔba dɛn; in, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, nain dɔn de sev dɛn.
Bɔt ɔl dis na pantap tɔk, na lay nɔmɔ dɛn bin de pan;
dɛn at dɛn nɔ bin de to PAPA GƆD atɔl, dɛn nɔ bin rɛdi fɔ kip to di Kɔvinant.
Pan ɔl dat, PAPA GƆD sho dɛn masi; i fɔgiv dɛn fɔ dɛn sin ɛn nɔ fala dɛn fɔ pwɛl dɛn. Ɔl di tɛm i de bia wit dɛn ɛn nɔ de gri mek i vɛks pan dɛn pasmak.
I mɛmba se wi na ɔdinari mɔtalman we tan lɛkɛ briz we, wɛn i dɔn pas, i nɔ de kam biɛn bak.
Ɔmɔs tɛm dɛn nɔ dɔn tɔn pan am ɔ du tin fɔ mek i vɛks we dɛn de na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap!
Ɔl di tɛm, dɛn de tɛst PAPA GƆD; dɛn de mek di Oli PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl de wɔship, vɛks.
Dɛn nɔ mɛmba bɔt aw i yuz in pawa fɔ pul dɛn kɔmɔt na di wan we bin de mɔna dɛn, dɛn an,
dɛn nɔ mɛmba aw i yuz in pawa di de we i ple mirekul dɛn na Ijipt, dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt aw i yuz in pawa fɔ ple wɔndaz na di Zoan rijɔn.
I tɔn dɛn riva dɛn to blɔd; dɛn nɔ ebul drink na dɛn watasay.
I sɛn bɔku flay fɔ aras dɛn, ɛn frɔg dɛn fɔ pwɛl pwɛl di ples.
I gi dɛn plant dɛn to lokɔs ɛn dɛn pwɛl pwɛl ɔl dɛn it dɛn we bin dɔn du fɔ avɛst.
I lɛ ren we fiba grabul-grabul fɔdɔm ɛn pwɛl dɛn vayn dɛn ɛn dɛn sykamɔ tik.
I mek di ren we fiba grabul-grabul fɔdɔm ɛn kil dɛn kaw dɛnsɛf ɛn na so laytin kil di ship ɛn got dɛn.
I bin so vɛks pan dɛn, dat i sɛn in enjɛl dɛn we dɛn yon wok na fɔ distrɔy fɔ sho aw i vɛks.
I sho dɛn se i vɛks i sɛn sik we kil dɛn.
I kil ɔl di bɔypikin dɛn we bɔn fɔs na di Ijipshian famili dɛn.
I pul in pipul kɔmɔt de, saful lɛk aw pɔsin we de mɛn ship de pul dɛn pan trɔbul. I pul dɛn de ɛn lid dɛn lɛk ship insay di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
I gayd dɛn sef wan, so dɛn nɔ bin de fred natin; bɔt dɛn ɛnimi dɛn drawn na di si.
Na so i tek kɛr dɛn te rich na di bɔda na PAPA GƆD in yon land, bay di il say we i bin dɔn tek wit in yon pawa.
As dɛn de go insay di land na so PAPA GƆD de drɛb dɛn ɔda neshɔn we bin de de ɛn sheb sheb di land to di Izrɛlayt dɛn fɔ lɛ i bi dɛn yon; I mek dɛn ɔl sɛtul na dɛn os dɛn.
Bɔt dɛn tray PAPA GƆD bak ɛn mek rebɛl pan PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti; dɛn nɔ gri fɔ obe in lɔ.
Lɛk aw dɛn papa dɛn bifo dɛn bin tan na so dɛn tan. Dɛn ɔl at nɔ de pan PAPA GƆD ɛn dɛn nɔ biliv am.
Dɛn mek ples dɛn na il fɔ wɔship pegan gɔd, ɛn PAPA GƆD vɛks pan dat as na jɛlɔs PAPA GƆD.
Wɛn PAPA GƆD si ɔl dis, i vɛks pasmak; i nɔ gri fɔ gɛt natin fɔ du wit dɛn.
I kɔmɔt usay i de na Shaylɔ usay i bin dɔn tap di tɛm we i bin tap wit mɔtalman.
I gri fɔ lɛ dɛn kapchɔ di bɔks usay dɛn bin kip wetin i rayt ɛn mek Kɔvinant wit in pipul; di tin we de sho aw i gɛt pawa, i sɛl am to di ɛnimi dɛn.
I mek dɛn kil in pipul pan wa. I vɛks bad pan di pipul we i tek fɔ bi in yon.
Di yɔŋbɔy dɛn day na wa so bɔku. Man dɛn nɔ bin de fɔ mared dɛn yɔŋgyal dɛn.
Dɛn kil dɛn man we bin de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn dɔn dɛn wɛf dɛn nɔ gɛt tɛm fɔ munin fɔ dɛn.
Wantɛm, PAPA GƆD faynali grap lɛk we mɔtalman we bin de slip skyad wek, ɔ lɛk aw drɔnkɔman kin mek we i kam to.
I tɔn am gi in ɛnimi dɛn bak ɛn put dɛn pan ɛvalastin disgres
I fɔgɛt bɔt di Ifremayt dɛn we na Josɛf in jɛnareshɔn; i nɔ gri tap wit dɛn igen
I chuz Juda in pipul ples, as na de Mawnt Zayɔn we i lɛk, de.
I bil in os na ay ples, I mek am trɔŋ lɛk di wɔl we i mek fɔ de sote go.
I chuz Devid we bin de mɛn ship;
i tek am kɔmɔt usay i bin de de mɛn ship briŋ am fɔ mek i tek in pipul lɛk di ship we i bin de mɛn. In pipul we na Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn.
Devid insɛf mɛn di pipul lɛk aw i de mɛn ship wit ɔl in at. I bin de lid dɛn ɛn sho dɛn aw fɔ fala am.

PAPA GƆD, wi ɛnimi dɛn dat na di ithɛn dɛn, dɔn atak wi we na yu yon pipul; dɛn dɔn so pwɛl yu os we oli dat i nɔ fit fɔ pipul fɔ go wɔship igen, dɛn dɔn mek Jerusɛlɛm usay di os de, fiba we ston dɔti mek payl.
Dɛn lɛf yu pipul we day na do fɔ yuba dɛn fɔ it; ɛn wayl animal sɛf it dɛn bɔdi.
Dɛn mek di ples ful wit blɔd lɛk we wata de flo ɔlsay na Jerusɛlɛm, dɔn nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ bɛr di dayman dɛn.
Wi neba dɛn ɔl de shumɔ pan wi; dɛn de laf wi ɛn provok wi.
PAPA GƆD, aw lɔŋ? Yu go vɛks pan wi te go? Aw lɔŋ yu go mek di vɛks we yu vɛks ɛn di jɛlɔs, tan lɛk faya fɔ bɔn wi?
Put yu vɛksteshɔn pan di pipul na dɛn kɔntri we nɔ no yu ɔ we nɔ de pre to yu;
Bikɔs na dɛn dɔn kil yu pipul na Izrɛl ɛn dɛn bak dɛn dɔn pwɛl di kɔntri.
Nɔ pe wi fɔ di sin dɛn we wi papa dɛn kɔmit; wi nɔ no wetin fɔ du igen so duya av masi.
PAPA GƆD, yu we de sev, duya, ɛp wi fɔseka udat yu bi, sev wi ɛn fɔgiv wi sin dɛn so dat ɔlman go rɛspɛkt yu.
Nɔ mek di pipul na di ɔda neshɔn dɛn aks wi usay wi PAPA GƆD de. Lɛ wi si we yu de dil wit di ɔda neshɔn dɛn fɔ we dɛn kil yu savant dɛn.
Yɛri dɛn wan we dɛn ol we dɛn de kray yuz yu pawa fɔ sev dɛn wan dɛn we dɛn dɔn plan fɔ kil.
PAPA GƆD, mek wi neba dɛn sɔfa sɛvin tɛm mɔ fɔ ɔl di kɔs we dɛn dɔn kɔs yu.
Dɛn wi, yu pipul, we yu dɔn de mɛn lɛkɛ ship, go prez yu sote go; wi pikin dɛn go de prez yu ɔltɛm frɔm wan jɛnareshɔn te rich di ɔda wan.
Yu we dɔn de mɛn Izrɛl, lɛk aw yu de mɛn ship, yɛri wi, na yu dɔn de lid wi we na Josɛf in jɛnareshɔn lɛkɛ ship; yu na di wan we sidɔm midul di chɛryubim dɛn de rul as Kiŋ,
sho yusɛf to Ifrem, Bɛnjamin ɛn Manasɛ we kɔmɔt na di Izrɛlayt dɛn fambul layn. Grap sho yu trɛnk; kam sev wi.
PAPA GƆD, mek wi bi wetin wi bin bi fɔs av masi pan wi ɛn sev wi.
PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, aw lɔŋ yu go vɛks pan wi ɛn nɔ gri fɔ yɛri wi prea?
Yu dɔn gi wi trɔbul we tan lɛkɛ bred fɔ it ɛn wata fɔ drink.
Wi neba dɛn ɔl de fɛt fɔ tek wi land, ɛn wi ɛnimi dɛn de provok wi.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, mek wi bi wetin wi bin bi fɔs, Av masi pan wi ɛn sev wi.
Yu pul wi kɔmɔt na Ijipt ɛn briŋ wi ya; yu drɛb di orijinal neshɔn dɛn we bin tap de kɔmɔt dɔn yu gi wi di land as prɔpati.
Afta yu dɔn drɛb di ɔda neshɔn dɛn, wi ebul fɔ tap de, ɛn skata na di wanol ples.
Wi tek di wanol kɔntri fɔ bi wi yon, frɔm di sawt te rich nɔth bay di mawnten dɛn na Libanɔn.
Dat mek di kɔntri in bawndri bi frɔm di Mɛditarenian Si te rich Riva Yufretis.
Wetin mek yu lɛf ɛnimi dɛn fɔ atak di ples? Naw, ivin fɔrina dɛn de pas tif ɛn fɛn we fɔ ɛp pwɛl am.
Lɛkɛ bush ɔg na so dɛn de pwɛl ɔltin, dɔn ɔda wayl animal dɛn de it wetin de fɔ it.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, kam bak to wi! Luk yu pipul we yu kin si frɔm ɛvin! Ɛn kia fɔ wi.
Kam sev yu pipul we yu dɔn put na ya ɛn we yu dɔn lɛ bi big ɛn pawaful pipul.
Dɛn dɔn ruin wi lɛk aw pɔsin de bɔn sɔntin na faya; sho dɛn se yu vɛks ɛn jɔj dɛn fɔ wetin dɛn du.
Kɔba di wan dɛn we yu dɔn pik fɔ bi yu yon, di pipul we yu dɔn mek pawaful.
Da tɛm de, wi nɔ go kɔmɔt biɛn yu; gi wi layf ɛn wi go de prez ɛn wɔship yu ɔltɛm.
PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, mek wi bi wetin wi bin bi fɔs, Av masi pan wi ɛn sev wi.
Lɛ wi siŋ wit gladi to wi PAPA GƆD we wi de wɔship we de gi wi trɛnk; ala fɔ sho se yu gladi to wi PAPA GƆD we na di sem PAPA GƆD we Jekɔb bin de wɔship!
Ple di myuzik, nak di tamborin, yuz di ap ɛn laya fɔ gi wi swit myuzik.
Blo di trɔmpɛt we mun ful, fɔ sho se tɛm dɔn rich fɔ bigin di sɛlibreshɔn;
na lɔ we PAPA GƆD gi Izrɛl di PAPA GƆD we wi papa Jekɔb bin de wɔship.
Na lɔ we i gi to di Izrɛlayt dɛn wɛn i wutuwutu Ijipt fɔ dɛn. I yɛri pɔsin we i nɔ no de tɔk.
I se “A dɔn pul di lod kɔmɔt na una sholda; ɛn fri una an frɔm wok.
We una bin de pan trɔbul, una kɔl mi fɔ ɛp una ɛn a kam ɛp una. We a bin de insay insay tɛnda, a ebul ansa una a tɛst una nɔmɔ wit di wata na Mɛriba
“Izrɛl, mi pipul una lisin we a de wɔn una; if una lisin, una go tek mi wɔnin!
Una nɔ fɔ gɛt ɛni ɔda gɔd; una nɔ fɔ pre to ɛni dɛn gɔd de.
Mi na PAPA GƆD, di waŋren PAPA GƆD, we pul una kɔmɔt na Ijipt. If una du wetin a want, a go blɛs una.
“Bɔt o ya! Mi pipul nɔ gri lisin to mi; Izrɛl nɔ gri fɔ put insɛf dɔŋ fɔ du wetin a se.
So misɛf mek dɛn traŋayes fɔ du wetin dɛn want fɔ du.
If mi pipul bin lisin to mi nɔmɔ, If Izrɛl bin gri du wetin a se,
dɛn bin fɔ ebul fɛt dɛn ɛnimi ɛn bit dɛn dɛn bin fɔ gɛt mi fɔ fɛt dɛn ɛnimi fɔ dɛn.
Ɔl udat nɔ lɛk mi biznɛs go butu dɛn fes wit shem ɛn a go pɔnish dɛn sote go.
Bɔt a go gi una bɔta na una bred ɛn shuga we swit lɛk ɔni te una satisfay.”
PAPA GƆD sidɔm na di ay chia we Kiŋ kin sidɔm wit in enjɛl dɛn we de sav am fɔ jɔj dɛn.
“Aw lɔŋ yu go de fɛt fɔ bad man ɛn nɔ trit dɛnsɛf lɛk dɛn de du bad?
Fɛt fɔ udat nɔ ebul insɛf ɛn nɔ gɛt nɔbɔdi; mek di poman gɛt in rayt.
Fɛt fɔ di poman; pul am kɔmɔt na di bad man in an.
“Dɛn nɔ no natin ɛn dɛn nɔ ɔndastand natin. Dɛn de pas pas nɔmɔ fɔ du bad, gud trenin nɔ de igen”
“A tɛl dɛn se na dɛn na lɛkɛ PAPA GƆD dɛn fiba PAPA GƆD in pikin dɛn.
Bɔt dɛn go day lɛk ɔdinari mɔtalman; dɛn go day lɛk ɛni ɔda jɔj.”
PAPA GƆD, sho yu pawa ɛn jɔj di wɔl, bikɔs na yu gɛt ɔl di neshɔn dɛn.
PAPA GƆD nɔ sɛt mɔt pan wi, nɔ mek lɛk yu nɔ de tɔk ɛn nɔ sidɔm yu nɔ du natin.
Si aw yu ɛnimi dɛn sas ɛn dɛn de blɔf pan dat.
Dɛn de tek rikishi mek bagin ɛn sɛtfaya pan dɛn wan dɛn we yu de kɔba.
Dɛn se “Una kam mek wi pwɛl dɛn na Izrɛl, so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go ɛva mɛmba se dɛn bin de.”
Dɛn mek wanwɔd; wanwɔd fɔ atak yu,
di pipul na Idɔm ɛn di Ishmɛlayt dɛn, di pipul na Moab ɛn di Agrayt dɛn,
di pipul na Giba, Amɔn ɛn Amalɛk, Filistia, wit di pipul Taya.
Ivin di pipul na Asiria jɔyn dɛn so dat dɛn go sho se dɛn de bato Lɔt in jɛnareshɔn.
Du di sem tin we yu bin du na Midian to dɛn ɛn to Sisɛra ɛn to Jabin na di Riva Kishɔn.
Yu dɔnawe wit dɛn na Ɛndɔ yu mek dɛn fiba dɔti na grɔn.
Lɛ dɛn bigman dɛn we na aristo day lɛkɛ Orɛb ɛn Zib, ɛn dɛn Kiŋ dɛn day lɛkɛ Ziba ɛn Zalmuna,
we bin se dɛn wan tek PAPA GƆD in land na dɛn an.
Mek lɛ dɛn skata lɛk ashis lɛ dɛn fiba lɛk chaf chaf we briz de blo.
Lɛk aw faya de kech na bush ɔ de bɔn dɛn ol wud,
rɔnata dɛn lɛk yu na briz lɛk yu na tinada.
PAPA GƆD, mek lɛ dɛn kɔba dɛn fes wit shem so dat dɛn go want fɔ fala yu.
Lɛ dɛn alaki sote go; ɛn lɛ shem ɛn disgres mit dɛn.
Lɛ dɛn ɔl no se, yu na PAPA GƆD di PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti lɛ dɛn no se na yu waŋren na PAPA GƆD fɔ di wɔl.
PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, luk aw dɛn mek yu os fayn fayn wan!
A so de, magomago fɔ de usay PAPA GƆD de. A go gladi ɛn wit ɔl mi at a go siŋ to PAPA GƆD we nain nɔmɔ de gi layf.

Papa GƆD, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, yu we na mi Kiŋ ɛn di PAPA GƆD we a de wɔship, ivin dɛn bɔd we de mek ples fɔ slip insay os, ɛn gladi fɔ bil os insay yu os. Dɛn de bil dɛn os nia di ɔlta, we dɛn go kip di yɔŋ wan dɛn.
Dɛn wan dɛn we kin de na yu os ɔltɛm gladi ɛn gɛt blɛsin bikɔs dɛn go de prez yu ɔltɛm.
Dɛn wan dɛn we dɔn mekɔp dɛn maynd fɔ tek di rod go na mawnt Zayɔn, gladi ɛn gɛt blɛsin we yu de gi dɛn di trɛnk.
Wɛn dɛn de pas na di Baka Vali dɛn de mek i fiba ples we frɛsh bikɔs ɔf PAPA GƆD in blɛsin lɛk se ren bin dɔn kam we mek i sok.
As dɛn de waka, na so dɛn de gɛt trɛnk, te dɛn ɔl rich usay PAPA GƆD de na Zayɔn.
E PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, yɛri mi we a de pre; ansa mi yu we na PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD we Jekɔb bin de wɔship.
PAPA GƆD, blɛs wi Kiŋ we yu dɔn pik fɔ protɛkt wi.
Waŋren de insay PAPA GƆD in os bɛtɛ pas wan tawzin de na ɔda say; A go prifa fɔ kach to di domɔt na PAPA GƆD in os, pas fɔ tap fri wan usay bad pipul de.

Bikɔs PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd na san we de gi layt ɛn big shild we de protɛkt wi; i de sho wi in lɔv bay aw i de mek bɛtɛ fala wi; I nɔ go se i nɔ de gi wi gud tin dɛn wans i nɔ fɛn fɔlt pan wetin wi de du.
PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, pɔsin we put in trɔs pan yu gladi ɛn gɛt blɛsin.
E PAPA GƆD! Yu bin dɔn mek bɛtɛ de fala wi, yu bin dɔn gi wi bak, wi papa Jekɔb in jɛntri.
Yu bin dɔn fɔgiv wi sin dɛn. Yu bin dɔn padin dɛn ɔl.
Yu bin ivin nɔ vɛks da bad bad vɛks we yu bin vɛks pan wi igen
PAPA GƆD, yu we dɔn de sev wi, kol yu at ɛn lɛ wi bi wetin wi bin bi fɔs.
Yu go jɛs de vɛks pan wi te go? Dis vɛks nɔ go tap?
Mek wi bi wetin wi bin bi fɔs so wi go gladi bikɔs ɔf yu.
Sho wi aw yu lɔv fɔ wi nɔ de chenj ɛn pul wi pan trɔbul.
A go lisin to wetin PAPA GƆD, wi PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ se; i prɔmis fɔ gi wɛlbɔdi ɛn kolat to in pipul wans nɔmɔ dɛn nɔ go bak to dɛn fulishnɛs.
I go sev ɔl udat de du wetin in want, dɔn i go sho insɛf fɔ udat i bi na Izrɛl.
PAPA GƆD in lɔv ɛn in fethfulnɛs na lɛk tatu ɛn yawa; di want we di pipul want fɔ pliz PAPA GƆD, ɛn in yon pis we i de gi dɛn, go de lɛk aw tu pipul de kis.
Mɔtalman we tret to PAPA GƆD go go ɔp na ɛvin, dɛn PAPA GƆD we de du tin tret wande luk dɔŋ frɔm ɛvin.
PAPA GƆD go mɔs gi wi wetin gud ɛn wi go avɛst bɔku.
We pɔsin lɛk fɔ du wetin de pliz PAPA GƆD, i de mek we fɔ in blɛsin.
PAPA GƆD, yɛri mi ɛn ansa mi prea, bikɔs a nɔ no wetin fɔ du.
Nɔ mek a day bikɔs a abop pan yu. Yu na mi PAPA GƆD; sev yu savant we abop pan yu.
PAPA GƆD, av masi pan mi, as a nɔ de taya fɔ pre to yu.
PAPA GƆD, mek a gladi, bikɔs na yu a de pre to.
Yu na gud PAPA GƆD ɛn yu de fɔgiv yu de sho yu lɔv we nɔ de chenj to ɔl udat lɛk fɔ pre to yu.
PAPA GƆD, yɛri mi prea; ansa mi we a de beg yu fɔ masi.
Wɛn tin de mɔna mi, a go pre to yu, bikɔs yu go ansa mi.
PAPA GƆD, nɔn gɔd nɔ de we dɛn ɔda neshɔn de wɔship we tan lɛk yu; dɛn nɔ ivin ebul fɔ du wetin yu de du.
PAPA GƆD na yu mek ɔl dɛn neshɔn ɔl dɛn neshɔn de go kam wɔship yu; dɛn ɔl go jɔyn fɔ prez yu nem
PAPA GƆD, na yu nɔmɔ kin du wɔndaful tin dɛn na yu nɔmɔ na PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD, tich mi wetin yu want mi fɔ du, ɛn a go du am wit ɔl mi at; mek a sav yu wit ɔl mi at, so a go de prez yu nem.
PAPA GƆD, mi waŋren PAPA GƆD, a go prez yu nem wit ɔl mi at. A go tɛl ɔlman se yu na wɔndaful PAPA GƆD.
Yu lɛk mi tumɔs; na yu dɔn mek a nɔ day yet.
Trenja dɛn de atak mi bad man dɛn de tray fɔ kil mi man dɛn we nɔ bisin bɔt PAPA GƆD sɛf.
Bɔt yu PAPA GƆD, na PAPA GƆD we nays ɛn gɛt sɔri-at, yu nɔ gɛt wamat ɛn di beberebe lɔv we yu gɛt fɔ wi nɔ de chenj, dɔn bak, yu nɔ de kɔmɔt biɛn wi.
Luk to mi ɛn sɔri fɔ mi gi mi we na yu savant di trɛnk we a want. Mi na yu savant-gyal in pikin, sev mi.
PAPA GƆD du sɔntin fɔ sho se yu stil lɛk mi so dat mi ɛnimi dɛn go si ɛn kɔle. Lɛ dɛn shem ɛn disgres bikɔs yu PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn ɛp mi, yu dɔn koks mi.
PAPA GƆD dɔn bil in siti, ɛn i mek Mawnt Zayɔn in fawndeshɔn;
I lɛk ɔl usay Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn dɛn bin de, bɔt i lɛk Jerusɛlɛm pas dɛn ɔl.
Jerusɛlɛm, PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk fayn tin bɔt yu.
I se we i de tɔk bɔt udat dɛn de du wetin i want, i mɔs mɛnshɔn Ijipt ɛn Babilɔn dɛn nem. I go tɔk bak bɔt Filistia, Taya ɛn Ithiopia. A go se na Zayɔn dɛn bɔn dɛn ɔl.
Na tru se dɛn ɔl bɔn na Zayɔn, ɛn PAPA GƆD insɛf we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go kɔnfam dat.
Wɛn PAPA GƆD de mek rɛjista bɔt ɔl udat bɔn na Jerusɛlɛm, i go mɔs put dɛn nem de.
Dɛn wan dɛn we de mek siŋ go siŋ se na Zayɔn ɔl dɛn blɛsin de kɔmɔt.
E PAPA GƆD, mi PAPA GƆD we de sev mi, ol de ɛn nɛt a de kray to yu lɛkɛ udat gɛt bɛrin.
Yɛri di pre we a de pre to yu ɛn ansa mi.
Bikɔs bɔku tin de mɔna mi ɛn na day a de day so.
Pipul tink se a dɔn day; lɛk fɔ se a nɔ yusful igen
Dɛn nɔ gɛt mi tɛm sɛf igen a tan lɛk dedebɔdi we dɛn bɛr na masgrev dyurin wa. Lɛkɛ dayman nɔmɔ, yu nɔ bisin bɔt mi sins dayman nɔ nid yu fɔ kɔba am.
Yu dɔn put mi na di sem dak ples, usay ɔl dɛn dayman de.
Yu put yu vɛksteshɔn tumɔs pan mi: i tan lɛk we wata dɔn was pɔsin go.
Yu dɔn mek mi tayt padi dɛnsɛf dɔn lɛf mi to misɛf dɛn nɔ de luk mi wit bɛtɛ yay. A de pan siriɔs trɔbul ɛn nɔ ebul kɔmɔt de,
mi yay dɛn ɔl dɔn swɛl we a de kray to yu. PAPA GƆD ɛvride a de beg yu; a de opin mi an we a de beg yu.
Na we a dɔn day nain yu go want fɔ sho yu pawa? Pɔsin we dɔn day nɔ go grap kam prez yu.
Na we a de na dɔti usay dɛn bɛr mi, nain a go no se yu lɛk mi? Nɔbɔdi nɔ go tɔk bɔt yu fethfulnɛs da tɛm de we a de usay bɛtɛ nɔ de igen
Pɔsin we dɔn day go, nɔ go no bɔt di wɔndaz we yu de du, i nɔ go no sɛf se yu gud.
PAPA GƆD na yu a de kray to fɔ ɛp mi we a wek na mɔnin, na yu a de pre to.
Wetin mek yu ib mi oba, so ɛn nɔ want si mi sɛf?
Frɔm we mi na bɔbɔ, nain a dɔn de pas sɔntin; i tumɔs fɔ mi ɛn a nɔ ebul bia igen
Yu riali dɔn pas am pan mi we yu vɛks i tan lɛk se yu wan dɔnawe wit mi.
Di tin dɛn we yu de du to mi mek i tan lɛk na mi ɛnimi dɛn dɔn ovapawa mi.
Yu dɔn mek mi padi dɛn ɔl dɔn lɛf mi, na daknɛs nɔmɔ na mi padi naw.
A go siŋ ɛn tɔk bɔt di lɛk we PAPA GƆD lɛk in pipul pasmak; ɛn a go mek ɔlman no se yu fethful to yu pipul.
A go tɔk se di lɔv we yu gɛt fɔ wi trɔŋ ɛn i shɔ, i tan lɛk we pɔsin shɔ se i go si di klawd ɛnitɛm we i luk ɔp.
PAPA GƆD yu se, yu dɔn mek Kɔvinant wit yu savant, Devid, we yu bin dɔn pik ɛn swɛ se yu go de wit am te go.
Yu bin tɛl am se yu go de wit ɔl in jɛnareshɔn ɛn na pan dɛn Kiŋ go de kɔmɔt.
PAPA GƆD dɛn wan dɛn we de na ɛvin de tɔk yu gud nem usay dɛn kin gɛda ɛn se yu na PAPA GƆD we fethful.
Udat de ɔp na ɛvin we kin tinap nia PAPA GƆD? Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we tan lɛkɛ yu ɔp de.
We dɛnsɛf kin gɛda, dɛn de sho se dɛn de fred ɛn rɛspɛkt yu; na PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ kin de da we de pas ɔl di ɔda wan dɛn.
PAPA GƆD, yu we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, udat de we tan lɛk yu? Yu big ɛn ɔl wetin yu de du de sho aw yu big ɛn fethful.
Na yu na masta fɔ di si, wɛn di wata rɔf, yu mek i kwayɛt.
Yu nyamanyama Reab lɛk tin we dɛn kil ɛn yuz yu pawa fɔ pul yu ɛnimi dɛn kɔmɔt biɛn yu.
Na yu gɛt ɔltin na ɛvin ɛn na di wɔl. Ɔltin na di wɔl na yu mek dɛn.
Yu mek ɔl wetin de na di nɔth ɛn wetin de na di sawt. Di pipul na Mawnt Tabɔ ɛn Mawnt Amɔn de siŋ ɛn prez yu nem bikɔs dɛn gladi.
Yu gɛt pawa; yu riali pawaful.
Pipul no yu as udat gud ɛn de rul fia wan yu lɔv ɛn fethfulnɛs na lɛk yu mɛsenja dɛn.
PAPA GƆD, pɔsin we dɔn lan fɔ siŋ prez to yu gɛt blɛsin; dɛn pipul we de du wetin yu want, gɛt blɛsin.
Yu de mek dɛn at swit ɛvride; dɛn de gladi se yu na PAPA GƆD we gud to dɛn.
Na yu de gi dɛn trɛnk ɛn yu de mek dɛn ed big; ɛn yu de gi dɛn pawa fɔ bit dɛn ɛnimi.
Fɔ tru tru, na PAPA GƆD de kɔba pɔsin. In na wi Kiŋ, di wan we oli we Izrɛl de pre to.
Wan tɛm, PAPA GƆD apia na vishɔn to in pipul we de du wetin i se ɛn tɛl dɛn se, in dɔn gi wan yɔŋman we de fɛt, ɛkstra trɛnk, ɛn pik am fɔ de pantap in pipul.
I se, in fɛn Devid, in savant, ɛn anɔynt am fɔ bi Kiŋ.
I se, in go gi am mɔ trɛnk ɛn mek shɔ se i nɔ fel.
I se, nɔn pan Devid in ɛnimi dɛn go ebul am pan ɛnitin dɛn nɔ go ebul yuz di bad we dɛn de pan fɔ ambɔg Devid.
I se, Devid go de luk am so, korokoro wan we in PAPA GƆD de dɔnawe wit in ɛnimi dɛn.
I se, i go de sho Devid aw i lɛk am ɔltɛm ɛn i go ɛp am ɔltɛm mek i go bit in ɛnimi dɛn.
I se, in go mek Devid rul ɔl rawnd frɔm di Mɛditarenian Si te rich di Riva Yufretis.
I se, Devid go tek am lɛk in papa. Devid go kɔl am di PAPA GƆD we in de wɔship, we de kɔba am ɛn pul am nain ɛnimi dɛn an.
I se, in PAPA GƆD, go trit Devid lɛk in fɔs-bɔy-pikin we gɛt ɔlkayn rayt, i go mek am fɔ pas ɔl dɛn ɔda kiŋ na dis wɔl.
I se, in go mek shɔ se in lɔv fɔ am nɔ go ɛva chenj ɛn natin nɔ go pwɛl di Kɔvinant we i dɔn mek wit Devid.
I se, in go mek shɔ se wans ɛvin nɔ go ɛva lɔs, na so kiŋ dɛn nɔ go dɔn fɔ de na Devid in fambul layn.
Bɔt i se, “If Devid in jɛnareshɔn dɛn fɔsek mi ɛn nɔ du wetin a se,
if dɛn tɔn dɛn bak pan mi ɛn nɔ obe mi kɔmand dɛn,
a go flag dɛn wit ken we a de pɔnish dɛn fɔ dɛn sin; tap di lɔv we a gɛt fɔ Devid,
bɔt dat nɔ go mek a lɛf fɔ lɛk dɛn, ɛn dat nɔ go mek a nɔ kip to mi wɔd.”
I se, in nɔ go mek di Kɔvinant we i bin dɔn mek, pwɛl ɛn i nɔ go pit, i lik am.
I se in bin dɔn yuz in oli nem we i de prɔmis Devid ɛn i nɔ go lay to am.
I se, in bin dɔn tɛl Devid se lɛkɛ aw di san nɔ go ɛva lɛf fɔ shayn na so in jɛnareshɔn dɛn nɔ go ɛva lɛf fɔ bi Kiŋ; bɔt dɛn go de bi Kiŋ sote go.
Lɛkɛ aw di mun de kɔmɔt na di skay ɔltɛm, na so Kiŋ dɛn go de nain jɛnareshɔn ɔltɛm.
PAPA GƆD yu vɛks naw pan di pɔsin we yu bin dɔn pik fɔ bi Kiŋ, yu dɔn tɔn yu bak pan am ɛn nɔ want si am.
Yu dɔn brok di Kɔvinant naw; yu ivin dɔn tek in krawn ɛn ib am na grɔn.
Yu dɔn mek di wɔl dɛn we i bil rawnd in siti fɔdɔm; di tin we i mek fɔ sikyɔriti dɔn brok dɔŋ.
Ɔlman de pas naw ɛn tek wetin i want dɔn di pipul na di neba kɔntri dɛn de laf am.
Yu dɔn mek in ɛnimi dɛn ebul am; so dɛn ɔl de gladi lɛkɛ udat kres.
Yu mek in wɛpɔn dɛn fɔ tek fɛt nɔ wok ɛn lɛf am to insɛf we di tɛm rich fɔ fɛt.
Yu pul in staf we i kin yuz as Kiŋ nain an dɔn yu trowe di chia we i kin sidɔm bak na grɔn.
Yu dɔn mek i tɔn olpa kwik ɛn wɛr shem lɛkɛ se na klos.
PAPA GƆD, aw lɔŋ pɔsin go de pan dis kayn layf? Yu go tɔn yu bak pan wi? Yu go jɛs de vɛks pan wi sote go?
Mɛmba se, layf shɔt. Na so yu mek wi, mɔtalman.
Us mɔtalman go ebul fɔ liv sote go ɛn nɔ day we di tɛm rich?
PAPA GƆD, usay di kayn lɔv we yu bin gɛt fɔ Devid go, we mek yu bin swɛ fɔ kip to yu wɔd?
PAPA GƆD, mɛmba aw dɛn de provok yu savant, mɛmba aw i dɔn tot bad nem na ɔl dɛn neshɔn dɛn an,
PAPA GƆD mɛmba aw yu ɛnimi dɛnsɛf, ɔl, dɔn provok am pan ɛnitin we i de du. Dɛn de shumɔ pan di wan we yu dɔn pik.
Lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD sote go. Emɛn, ɛn Emɛn.
PAPA GƆD frɔm tɛm, na yu dɔn de kɔba wi.
Bifo yu mek di mawnten dɛn ɛn infakt sɛf bifo yu mek di wɔl, yu bin dɔn bi di PAPA GƆD we wi de wɔship, ɛn yu go stil bi wi PAPA GƆD sote go.
Yu mek mɔtalman tɔn dɔti yu se mɔtalman fɔ go bak na dɔti, as na de i bin kɔmɔt.
Fɔ yu, wan tawzin ia na lɛk wande ɔ lɛk we wachman tif slip na nɛt.
Yu mek mɔtalman layf shɔt lɛk drim: i fiba lɛkɛ gras we de grap na mɔnin,
we kin frɛsh so na mɔnin bɔt bay ivintɛm, i dɔn dray ɛn day.
Di vɛks we yu vɛks pan wi de pwɛl wi at ɛn kɔnfyus wi.
Wi sin dɛn de bifo yu. Yu de si dɛn ɛn ivin di wan dɛn we wi de tray fɔ ayd pan yu, yu de si dɛn ɔl.
We yu vɛks pan wi, wi layf de shɔt bifo yu mekɔp wi layf dɔn dɔn.
Mɔtalman fɔ liv fɔ sɛvinti ia bɔt if i gɛt trɛnk, i kin de fɔ eti, ɛn da tɛm de i go de sik bɔku ɛn gɛt ɔlkayn trɔbul, dɔn na so tɛm go de flay fɔ am.
Udat no wetin yu kin du we yu vɛks? Di vɛks we yu vɛks ɛn di fred we yu want fɔ mek wi fred yu na di sem.
Tich wi fɔ no se wi nɔ gɛt lɔŋ fɔ liv so dat we go gɛt PAPA GƆD in sɛns na wi at.
PAPA GƆD, aw lɔŋ yu go de vɛks pan wi nɔmɔ av masi pan wi naw.
Mek wi no yu lɔv we nɔ de chenj na mɔnin so dat wi go gladi ɛn siŋ fɔ dat sote go.
Mek lɛ wi gladi naw, mek di tɛm we wi de gladi bɔku lɛk di tɛm we wi bin sɔri, di tɛm we yu bin de pas am pan wi.
Sho yu savant dɛn di big wok we yu kin du ɛn dɛn pikin we gɛt fɔ bɔn, aw yu gud.
Lɛ wi Masta we na PAPA GƆD we wi de wɔship blɛs wi; lɛ di wok wi de du kɔmɔt fayn; yɛs, lɛ i kɔmɔt fayn fɔ wi.
Ɛnibɔdi we go to PAPA GƆD fɔ mek i kɔba am, udat PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti de fɔ,
go tɛl PAPA GƆD se nain de kɔba am ɛn fɛt fɔ am, in na di PAPA GƆD we i de wɔship so i go abop pan am.
I go sev am frɔm di trap we dɛn sɛt fɔ am ɛn mek i nɔ gɛt ɛni bad sik.
I go kɔba am lɛkɛ aw fɔl de kɔba in pikin; PAPA GƆD de kip in prɔmis dɛn ɛn go kɔba am ɔltɛm ɛn fɛt fɔ am.
Dat fɔ mek i nɔ fred dɛn bad spirit we de pas na nɛt, ɛn wetin mɔtalman go du gbagbaode santɛm fɔ pwɛl am.
I nɔ go fred se ɛni bad sik go mit am na nɛt; ɔ santɛm sɛf we go ambɔg am.
Wan tawzin pipul go day nain lɛfan dɔn tɛn tawzin nain raytan. I lɛk wetin kil dɛn, i nɔ go mit am.
I jɛs gɛt fɔ luk gud lɛ i si aw PAPA GƆD de pɔnish di bad man.
Wans na PAPA GƆD de kɔba am nain i de go ayd to;
natin nɔ de we go ambɔg am, trɔbul nɔ go go nia in os.
I mɔs gi ɔda to in enjɛl dɛn bɔt am dɛn go gyad am ɛnisay i go.
Dɛn go tot am go ɔlsay, i nɔ go bɔk mi fut sɛf pan ston.
I go waka midul layɔn dɛn ɛn ivin ɔlkayn bad snek; i go mas dɛn if dɛn want fɔ bɛt am.
PAPA GƆD se in nɔ go mek natin du am bikɔs i lɛk am i se in go kɔba am bikɔs i no am.
I go kɔl am fɔ sev am ɛn i go ansa; I se, i go pul am pan trɔbul, i go blɛs am ɛn mek in ed big.
I se, i go mek a gɛt lɔŋ layf ɛn no fɔ tru tru se nain nain Seviɔ.
Na fayn tin fɔ mek pipul tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki dɛn fɔ siŋ to PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti ɛn prez in nem.
Ɔlman fɔ tɔk ɛvri mɔnin se PAPA GƆD lɛk wi dɔn na nɛt dɛn fɔ se i de kip in wɔd.
Yuz myuzik we na dɛn big striŋ instrumɛnt lɛk laya ɛn ap go ple fɔ tɛl am tɛnki.
PAPA GƆD, di wɔndaful wok we yu de du de mek mi at swit. A de siŋ bikɔs a kin gladi we a luk wetin yu mek wit yu an dɛn.
PAPA GƆD, yu wok big! I at fɔ mek pɔsin ɔndastand aw yu de tink!
Fulman nɔ go no yu ɔ ɔndastand yu pawa fɔ no
se i lɛk usay pɔsin we de du bad dɔn rich, PAPA GƆD mɔs briŋ am kam dɔŋ we i nɔ go ɛva go ɔp,
bɔt PAPA GƆD yu na di wan we de rul ɔltin sote go.
PAPA GƆD wi no se yu ɛnimi dɛn go rɔndɔŋ; wi no se ɔl udat de mɛmba bad fɔ yu go rɔnawe we yu dɔn bit dɛn dɔn.
Yu mek mi pawaful lɛk udat gɛt babu bon; dɔn yu put frɛsh ɔyl pan mi fɔ anɔynt mi.
A dɔn si aw mi ɛnimi dɛn de rɔndɔŋ; a dɔn yɛri aw di bad wan dɛn de grɔmbul.
Udat de du tin tret wan go yusful lɛkɛ pam tri, lɛkɛ sida tik we at fɔ day we de gro na Libanɔn.
I go fiba lɛkɛ we dɛn plant dɛn tik ya na PAPA GƆD in os we go de rɔju nain yad.
Pan ɔl we dɛn dɔn ol dɛn go stil de bia, dɛn go luk frɛsh ɔltɛm.
Ɔl dis go sho se PAPA GƆD nɔ miks pan bɛnbɛn; nain de kɔba mi ɛn i nɔ de du bad.
PAPA GƆD na Kiŋ, i wɛr fayn klos lɛk kiŋ. I tɔf ɛn i gɛt trɛnk. I dɔn mek ɔltin na di wɔl ɛn natin nɔ go chenj am.
PAPA GƆD dɔn bi Kiŋ lɔntɛm; i bin dɔn de frɔm tɛm.
PAPA GƆD, di si de ala, di si de ala lawd; i de ala ɛn mek bɔku nɔys.
PAPA GƆD in pawa pas di nɔys we di wata de mek i pas di ebi swɛlin wev dɛn na di si.
PAPA GƆD, yu wɔd nɔ de chenj we yu oli, dat de mek yu os fayn fɔ de sote go.
E PAPA GƆD, yu we na PAPA GƆD we de pɔnish, yu sabi pɔnish, so sho yusɛf.
Grap, du sɔntin, yu we de jɔj ɔlman gi di man we de kak wetin i de fɛn.
PAPA GƆD ustɛm, ustɛm di bad man go lɛf fɔ blɔf wit in wikɛdnɛs?
Dɛn de mek gbiŋbin; dɛn de blɔf bɔt dɛn bad.
PAPA GƆD dɛn de lili yu pipul dɛn de pwɛl yu yon yon pipul.
Dɛn kil dɛn uman we dɛn man dɔn day ɛn di trenja dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin we nɔ gɛt papa.
Dɛn se “PAPA GƆD nɔ de si i nɔ ivin de luk wi yon say.”
Una bikiaful, una we de mek lɛk ɔdɔyɔ. Ustɛm una go gɛt sɛns?
PAPA GƆD we mek yes mɔs de yɛri ɛn in we mek yay, mɔs de si.
PAPA GƆD we ebul pɔnish wanol neshɔn, na ɔdinari mɔtalman i nɔ go ebul pɔnish? Ɔ in we de tich, yu go se i nɔ gɛt sɛns?
PAPA GƆD no aw wi de tink; di we aw wi de tink na lɛkɛ smok we nɔ de las lɔŋ.
PAPA GƆD, di pɔsin we yu de kɔrɛkt, gɛt blɛsin, in na pɔsin we de lan yu lɔ;
yu go pul am pan trɔbul, te yu rɛdi fɔ pɔnish di bad man
bikɔs PAPA GƆD nɔ de kɔmɔt biɛn in pipul; i nɔ go ɛva dison in yon, yon pipul.
Dɛn wan dɛn we de jɔj nɔ go de twis di lɔ igen; ɛn udat de du tin tret wan go gladi.
Na PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ go tinap fɔ mi wɛn mi ɛnimi dɛn de biɛn mi.
If nɔto we PAPA GƆD ɛp mi, lɛk a dɔn day lɔntɛm.
Wɛn a de ala se “A de day o!” PAPA GƆD, na yu lɔv nɔmɔ kin gi mi kɔrej.
Wɛn a kin ɛŋ-at na yu nɔmɔ ebul kɔrej mi dɔn a gladi.
Yu nɔ de miks wit kɔrɔpt jɔj dɛn jɔj dɛn we lɛk fɔ put pipul pan nambara.
Dɛn de gi rayt to udat gɛt rɔŋ, dɔn dɛn sɛntɛns pɔsin fɔ natin.
Bɔt na PAPA GƆD mi de go to fɔ kɔba mi nain na PAPA GƆD we ebul sev mi,
I go pe dɛn fɔ dɛn wikɛdnɛs; PAPA GƆD go dɔnawe wit dɛn. I go dɔn wit dɛn kpatakpata fɔ di bad we dɛn du.
Una kam mek wi gladi ɛn siŋ to PAPA GƆD lɛ wi ala ɛn mek nɔys to am nain na di wan we de kɔba wi ɛn pul wi pan trɔbul.
Lɛ wi go insay in os fɔ tɛl tɛnk ɛn siŋ wit myuzik fɔ wɔship am,
bikɔs wi PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD we big ɛn in na Kiŋ fɔ ɔl dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn.
Nain de kɔntrol di wanol wɔl so i lɛk aw di ples ay ɔ aw dip i dip nain gɛt ɔl.
Di si o, nain yon bikɔs nain mek am di dray grɔn insɛf nain yon bikɔs nain mek i tan so.
Una kam, lɛ wi wɔship, lɛ wi nildɔŋ bifo PAPA GƆD bikɔs nain mek wi;
in na wi PAPA GƆD ɛn wi na lɛk ship dɛn we i de mɛn. Na dat mek, tide, we yu de yɛri wetin i de se,
“nɔ mek traŋa at pan am lɛkɛ aw dɛn pipul na Mɛriba bin biev; ɔ lɛk aw dɛn bin biev we dɛn de na Masa
usay una fɔstɛm pipul bin tɛst am ivin we dɛn bin dɔn si wetin i kin du.
A bin vɛks wit da jɛnareshɔn de fɔ fɔti ia a se, Dɛn pipul ya, dɛn at nɔ de to mi ɛn dɛn nɔ de obe mi.”
So pan mi vɛksteshɔn a swɛ se dɛn nɔn nɔ go ɛnjɔy fɔ de usay a de.”
Lɛ wi mek nyu siŋ fɔ siŋ to PAPA GƆD! Lɛ di wanol wɔl siŋ to PAPA GƆD!
Lɛ wi siŋ fɔ prez PAPA GƆD fɔ we in na PAPA GƆD; tɛl ɔlman ɛvride se i gɛt pawa fɔ sev wi.
Tɛl di neshɔn dɛn bɔt di bɔku ɛn wɔndaful tin dɛn we i de du fɔ pipul na di wɔl.
PAPA GƆD na big PAPA GƆD ɛn i fit fɔ prez we wi fɔ fred pas dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn.
Ɔl ɔda gɔd na tin dɛn we mɔtalman mek fɔ pre to bɔt na PAPA GƆD mek di ɛvin ɛn ɔl wetin de de.
We yu luk PAPA GƆD, yu no se na Kiŋ da wande as yu si di tin dɛn nɔmɔ nain os, yu no se i gɛt trɛnk ɛn i fayn fɔ luk.
Una kam gi PAPA GƆD glori, una we i mek fɔ de ɔlsay na wɔl,
kam gi PAPA GƆD di glori bikɔs i fit fɔ gɛt am; kam wit wetin yu gɛt na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn prez am.
We yu de wɔship PAPA GƆD, yusɛf du am wit aje. Ɔlman na wɔl fɔ gɛt fred fɔ am.
Tɛl di wɔl se, “PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD!” I dɔn mek di wɔl ɛn natin go mek i chenj. I go jɔj ɔlman aw i fit fɔ mek i jɔj dɛn.
Lɛ di ɛvin gladi dɔn lɛ di ath sɛf gladi! Lɛ di si ɛn ɔl wetin de insay sɛf gladi;
lɛ di fil ɛn ɔl wetin de insay gladi ɛn mek dɛn tik na bush siŋ fɔ sho se dɛn gladi.
Dɛn ɔl di pipul go gladi bikɔs PAPA GƆD de kam fɔ jɔj di wɔl. We i de jɔj di wɔl, i go jɔj tret wan dɔn ɔl wetin na tru go kɔmɔt na do.
PAPA GƆD de rul ɔlsay so lɛ ɔl di pipul na wɔl gladi! Lɛ ivin di wan dɛn we de fa jɔyn fɔ gladi.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de si am; bɔt ɔlman no se wɛn i de rul, i de rul tret wan.
Faya de de bifo am fɔ klia di we ɛn bɔn ɔl in ɛnimi dɛn kɔmɔt na rod.
In laytin de gi layt to ɔlman na wɔl; dɛn we mɔtalman si am, i de trimbul wit fred.
We PAPA GƆD de de so, di mawnten sɛf de mɛlt lɛk kyandul, bifo di sem PAPA GƆD we mek di wanol wɔl.
Di ɛvin de sho aw PAPA GƆD de du tin tret wan, dɔn di pipul de si se PAPA GƆD riali gud.
Ɔl udat de wɔship dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn, go shem dɛn we de kak, bikɔs dɛn min se dɛn na sɔntin go shem as di ɔda gɔd dɛn go butu ɛn wɔship PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD di pipul na Zayɔn yɛri bɔt aw yu de jɔj ɛn gladi fɔ dat; dɛn wan dɛnsɛf we de na Juda ɔl gladi.
PAPA GƆD na yu na PAPA GƆD, di wan we de rul di wanol wɔl yu pas ɛni ɔda gɔd dɛn.
Lɛ ɔl udat se i lɛk PAPA GƆD, et bad i de sev udat lɛk am ɛn pul am nain ɛnimi dɛn an.
Ɔl udat lɛk PAPA GƆD ɛn de du tin tret wan go si dɛn we klia as PAPA GƆD in blɛsin go shayn lɛk layt pan dɛn.
Tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki; una we de du wetin rayt mɛmba wetin i dɔn du ɛn prez in nem.
Mek nyu siŋ fɔ siŋ to PAPA GƆD, bikɔs i dɔn du wɔndaful tin dɛn; na bay in pawa ɛn trɛnk i tek win in ɛnimi dɛn.
PAPA GƆD dɔn mek ɔlman no se in na PAPA GƆD we ebul fɔ sev, ɛn i tɛl ɔlman aw i dil wit in ɛnimi dɛn.
I mɛmba in lɔv ɛn aw i tru to di Izrɛlayt dɛn; Di wanol wɔl dɛn si aw PAPA GƆD de sev pipul.
Lɛ di wanol wɔl ala fɔ sho se dɛn gladi fɔ PAPA GƆD, mek siŋ dɛn ɛn ple myuzik;
una ple ap, ɛn siŋ wit am to PAPA GƆD.
Yuz trɔmpɛt ɛn ɔn sho se yu gladi bifo PAPA GƆD we na wi Kiŋ.
Lɛ wata splash na di si, wit ɔltin we de na wɔl.
Lɛ di riva klap dɛn an ɛn lɛ di mawnten siŋ fɔ sho se dɛn gladi.
Lɛ dɛn ɔl siŋ ɛn go to PAPA GƆD bikɔs i de kam fɔ jɔj di wɔl. I go jɔj di wɔl tret wan, ɛn i go trit ɔlman ikwal.
PAPA GƆD na Kiŋ so in pipul fɔ trimbul wit fred we dɛn de wit am; i sidɔm nain chia we Kiŋ kin sidɔm midul di Chɛryubim so di wanol wɔl sɛf bigin fɔ shek.
PAPA GƆD de na Zayɔn as Kiŋ; bɔt i de rul di wanol wɔl.
Ɔlman fɔ prez am i oli ɛn i de du tin big ɛn i du fɔ fred.
Dis kiŋ ya in wok big ɛn i de jɔj tret wan; i dɔn mek lɔ na Izrɛl fɔ sho se ɔlman na wan; ɛn mek dɛn no aw fɔ du tin dɛn we rayt.
Wɔship PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD na di say we i sidɔm as Kiŋ; in na oli PAPA GƆD.
Mozis ɛn Erɔn bin miks wit pipul we bin de mek sakrifays fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn sin, Samiɛl bin miks wit di wan dɛn we bin de pre fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn; Dɛn ɔl pre fɔ pipul ɛn PAPA GƆD ansa dɛn prea.
Wɛn Mozis ɛn Erɔn pre, PAPA GƆD tɔk to dɛn frɔm di klawd; dɛn kip in lɔ ɛn du ɔl wetin i tɛl dɛn fɔ du.
E PAPA GƆD, yu ansa dɛn ɔl prea yu na PAPA GƆD we de fɔgiv pan ɔl we yu de pɔnish dɛn wan we dɛn du bad.
Lɛ wi tɛl ɔlman se, PAPA GƆD wi PAPA GƆD na big PAPA GƆD. Lɛ wi wɔship am nain oli mawnten bikɔs in na oli PAPA GƆD.
Mek ɔlman we de na wɔl siŋ lawd wan to PAPA GƆD.
Gladi we yu de sav PAPA GƆD; ɛn go usay i de wit bɔku siŋ.
No fɔ tru tru se, PAPA GƆD nain waŋren na PAPA GƆD. Nain mek wi, so nɔto wi gɛt wisɛf; wi nain pipul we tan lɛk ship we i de mɛn.
Siŋ lawd ɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki we yu de pas fɔ go insay usay i de; we yu rich usay i de na fɔ prez am; de tɛl am tɛnki ɛn prez am ɔltɛm.
PAPA GƆD gud ɛn i nɔ de chenj in maynd we i lɛk yu. I fethful to in pipul ɛn ɔl dɛn jɛnareshɔn.
A go siŋ bɔt aw yu tru ɛn de jɔj rayt PAPA GƆD, a go siŋ to yu.
A go tray nɔ fɔ gɛt bɔt na mi layf. Ustɛm yu go sho yusɛf to mi? A go waka fri usay a de,
bikɔs a nɔ go du ɛnitin bad, we go mek a fil gilti. A et pipul we de tɔn dɛn bak pan PAPA GƆD; a nɔ ebul fɔ tɔlaret dɛn.
A nɔ miks wit bad pipul; so a nɔ go gɛt nɔn bad we a de du.
A go kil udat de go rawnd ɛn pwɛl in kɔmpin; dɔn i de kak, a nɔ go tɔlaret am.
Na udat ɔnɛs ɛn tret, a go wok wit; na udat nɔ gɛt bɔt go de na mi kabinɛt.
Nɔbɔdi we de mek rikishi nɔ go kam usay a de; pɔsin we miks pan lay nɔ go kam nia mi.
Ɛvride a go kil badman dɛn na di ples. Dɛn ɔl we de du bad nɔ go gɛt ples fɔ de na PAPA GƆD in siti.
PAPA GƆD yɛri mi prea; we a beg fɔ mek yu ɛp mi.
Nɔ lɛf mi to misɛf we a de pan trɔbul lisin to mi ɛn mekes ansa mi we a de pre.
A de day smɔl smɔl lɛk aw smok kin jɛs lɔs; a gɛt bad bad fiva, mi bɔn dɛn de bɔn lɛk pɛpɛ insay mi.
Mi at ɔl dɔn pwɛl a fiba dray gras we ɔlman de mas pas. Mi it ɔl nɔ gɛt bɛtɛ tes na mi mɔt.
Mi bɔdi ɔl dɔn dɔn we a de kray bikɔs ɔf mi pen.
A fiba bɔd we de usay pipul nɔ de.
A nɔ de slip na nɛt a kin de mi wande kray; lɛkɛ bɔd, na so a de pantap os.
Ol de mi ɛnimi dɛn de provok mi; dɛn de grɔmbul pan mi, ɛn sɛf dɛn de yuz mi nem fɔ swɛ ɔda pipul.
Na ashis a de it dɔn na di wata we de kɔmɔt na mi yay, a de drink,
fɔ sho aw a dɔn gens, we yu lɛf mi to misɛf.
Mi layf tan lɛk ivintɛm shado; na day a de day so; a go wida ɛn day lɛk gras.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD yu na PAPA GƆD we go bi kiŋ sote go; ɔl di jɛnareshɔn dɛn go tɔk bɔt yu.
Yu go tinap ɛn sɔri fɔ Zayɔn, di tɛm dɔn rich fɔ mek yu mek in at swit.
Yu pipul lɛk di siti pan ɔl we ɔltin dɔn pwɛl; dɛn de sɔri fɔ am as i tan lɛk bɛtɛ nɔ de so dɛn de fil am we in ston dɛn dɔn brok brok de na grɔn lɛk dɔti.
Ɔlman na wɔl fɔ fred yu ɛn di kiŋ dɛn ɔl go fred ɛn rɛspɛkt yu.
PAPA GƆD go mek Zayɔn bak ɛn sho di pipul aw i big.
Bikɔs i go yɛri di po pipul prea ɛn i nɔ go tɔn in bak pan dɛn.
Una rayt dis dɔŋ so dat di jɛnareshɔn dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet go prez PAPA GƆD.
“PAPA GƆD de na ɛvin ɛn luk dɔŋ i luk dɔŋ ɛn si di wɔl,
nain i yɛri we dɛn jelman de kray i sɔri fɔ dɛn ɛn fri dɛn kɔndɛm prizina.”
Da tɛm de ɔlman go tɔk bɔt yu na Zayɔn ɛn insay Jerusɛlɛm, dɛn go tɔk wetindu ɔlman fɔ prez yu,
di tɛm we ɔlman gɛda na difrɛn kɔntri fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD.
Di tɛm we mi na yɔŋbɔy, PAPA GƆD mek a fiba olpa; trɛnk nɔ de dɔn i mek a go day kwik.
Na dat mek a se “PAPA GƆD, duya nɔ mek a day kwik. “Yu na PAPA GƆD we go de sote go.
Na yu mek di wɔl bigin ɛn na yu mek ɛvin wit yu yon an.
Dɛn ɔl go dɔn wande, bɔt yu go de sote go. Dɛn go fiba klos we yu go chenj sote yu taya ɛn we yu taya, yu trowe ɔ yu giwe.
Bɔt yu nɔ gɛt fɔ chenj, ɛn yu nɔ go ɛva day ɔ dɔn.
Yu pipul pikin go sef ɔltɛm; yu mɔs kia fɔ dɛn jɛnareshɔn.”
A go prez PAPA GƆD wit ɔl mi at; a go prez di oli PAPA GƆD.
A go prez am wit ɔl mi at ɛn a nɔ go ɛva fɔgɛt aw i gud.
In na PAPA GƆD we de fɔgiv ɔl yu sin dɛn ɛn i de mɛn yu wɛn yu sik.
I nɔ go mek yu day ɛn i de gi yu gud tin dɛn fɔ sho aw i lɛk yu ɛn rɛdi fɔ du gud to yu,
i de gi yu tin dɛn we de mek yu fil gud so yu go fiba igul we nɔ de ol, we gɛt trɛnk ɔltɛm.
PAPA GƆD de fɛt fɔ udat nɔ gɛt pɔsin fɔ fɛt fɔ am. I de jɔj tret wan ɛn trit ɔlman fia wan.
I tɛl Mozis wetin i wan du, dɔn i ple wɔndaz fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
PAPA GƆD gɛt sɔri-at bad, i nɔ de vɛks kwik bɔt i rɛdi fɔ sho wi aw i lɛk wi.
PAPA GƆD nɔ de pɔnish pɔsin ɔltɛm, ɛn we i vɛks sɛf, i nɔ de vɛks sote go.
I nɔ de pɔnish wi lɛk aw i fɔ pɔnish wi ɛn nɔ de pe wi fɔ we wi du bad.
Lɛkɛ aw di spes bitwin ɛvin ɛn ath big, na so di lɔv we PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ udat de fred ɛn rɛspɛkt am tan;
lɛkɛ aw Ist de fa frɔm Wɛst, na so PAPA GƆD dɔn push wi sin fa frɔm wi.
Lɛkɛ aw papa kin sɔri fɔ in pikin, na so PAPA GƆD de sɔri fɔ pɔsin we gɛt fred ɛn rɛspɛkt fɔ am;
I no aw i mek wi; i nɔ de fɔgɛt se na dɔti i tek mek wi.
Wi mɔtalman, wi layf shɔt lɛkɛ gras, wi kin fiba wayl flawa we fayn fɔ luk na bush;
bɔt as briz blo so, i dɔn dray ɛn lɔs, natin nɔ de fɔ tek mɛmba se i bin de sɛf.
PAPA GƆD go lɛk ɔl udat gɛt fred ɛn rɛspɛkt fɔ am, dɔn i go du gud to dɛn ɛn dɛn jɛnareshɔn sote go,
ɔl dɛn wan we kip in Kɔvinant ɛn obe am go ɛnjɔy.
PAPA GƆD dɔn mek in ay chia usay kiŋ kin sidɔm de na ɛvin, ɛn na de i de de fɔ rul di wanol wɔl.
Una we na enjɛl dɛn, una we de du wetin i want, we de obe in wɔd, prez PAPA GƆD ya!
Una we na PAPA GƆD in sojaman dɛn na ɛvin we de wok fɔ am ɛn de du wetin i want, una prez PAPA GƆD ya!
Lɛ ɔlman ɛn ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD mek prez am. Lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD!
A go prez PAPA GƆD! PAPA GƆD, yu we na mi PAPA GƆD, yu big; ɔlman rɛspɛkt yu ɛn de trit yu lɛkɛ chif.
Yu kɔba yusɛf wit layt lɛkɛ se na klos yu wɛr; yu mek di klawd kɔba ɔlman lɛk we man tinap ɔnda ruf
ɛn mek di say we yu tap fayn bɔt ay pas di klawd sɛf. Yu de mek di briz kɛr yu usay yu want fɔ go as yu de tek di klawd mek yu karej.
Yu yuz di briz as yu mɛsenja ɛn laytin as yu savant.
Di we aw yu bil di ath in fawndeshɔn go mek natin nɔ de we go ambɔg am.
Wɛn yu bigin mek di wɔl, di oshɔn bin de oba di ath lɛkɛ klos; dɔn di mawnten dɛn bin de ɔnda.
Bɔt we yu tɔk nɔmɔ ɔltin rɔn go usay i fɔ de;
Di mawnten go pantap di wata dɔn di vali dɛn go dɔŋ, jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin want dɛn.
Yu mek usay di wata fɔ tap; mek i nɔ go kɔba di ath lɛkɛ aw i bin de bifo yu mek di wɔl.
PAPA GƆD mek wata de na di vali dɛn ɛn midul di mawnten dɛn.
Na da wata de ɔl dɛn wayl animal dɛn de drink; di wayl dɔŋki dɛnsɛf kin go drink.
Na de ɔl dɛn bɔd de bil dɛn os. Dɛn de pas ɛn siŋ na dɛn tik dɛn nia da wata de.
I de sɛn ren kam frɔm usay i de na ɛvin; dɔn we i wata di grɔn, di ath de satisfay bikɔs na dat de mek i gɛt gud tin fɔ it.
I de mek di gras gro fɔ dɛn animal, ɛn plant dɛn de fɔ mɔtalman as di plant dɛn de mek mɔtalman gɛt it fɔ it;
na frɔm di plant dɛn, dɛn de mek wayn we de mek man at swit, dɛn de mek ɔyl fɔ gris in fes, ɛn ɔda tin dɛn fɔ it fɔ mek dɛn nɔ day.
Di sida tik na Libanɔn, na PAPA GƆD insɛf plant am ɛn i de wata am gud.
Na pantap dɛn, dɛn bɔd dɛn lɛk pɛpɛ bɔd de bil os; da lɔŋ-nɛk bɔd sɛf kin go bil in os pantap tik dɛn.
Dɛn wayl got na bush, kin go ɔp di mawnten dɛn; na midul di ston dɛn, dɛn muskyat kin tap.
Yu, PAPA GƆD mek di mun fɔ mek di sizin dɛn fɔ wi ɛn di san fɔ go dɔŋ wɛn in tɛm rich.
Wɛn di ples dak we mek nɛt kam, na da tɛm de dɛn animal we tap na bush dɛn de kɔmɔt na do.
Di layɔn pikin sɛf de luk wetin PAPA GƆD de gi am fɔ it.
We do klin, dɛn ɔl de lɔs; dɛn de go bak go lidɔm na dɛn os.
Na da sem tɛm de mɔtalman in de grap fɔ wok, i de wok ol de te nɛt de kam bak.
PAPA GƆD, yu de du bɔku tin! Bikɔs yu gɛt sɛns yu mek ɔltin ɔl wetin de na wɔl, na yu mek am.
Luk di si aw i big ɛn di kaynaba animal dɛn we de de big wan o, smɔl wan o, na yu mek dɛn ɔl.
Na de ɔl dɛn ship de pas go ɛn kam ivin Liviathan, we na di dɛbul na wata de ple ple de.
Ɔl di tin dɛn we yu mek dɛn yay de pan yu ɛn abop se yu go gi dɛn tin fɔ it we dɛn want am.
Ɛnitɛm we yu gi dɛn, dɛn rɛdi fɔ tek am; wans yu de opin yu an to dɛn, dɛn satisfay.
Wɛn yu lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf, dɛn kin fred. If yu se yu nɔ de gi dɛn bloblo, dɛn go day ɛn go bak na di dɔti we yu tek mek dɛn.
Yu de gi bloblo, nyu wan dɛn de bɔn, na so layf de tek kɔntinyu.
Lɛ wi de si PAPA GƆD in pawa sote go, mek i gladi bikɔs ɔf ɔl wetin i mek.
Na luk nɔmɔ, i kin luk di ath, athkwek de tek ples, dɔn we i tɔch di mawnten, faya de bɔs de.
A go siŋ to PAPA GƆD ɔl mi layf a go prez di PAPA GƆD we a de wɔship wans a nɔ day.
Lɛ i gladi wit wetin a de tink bɔt am, ɛnitɛm we a de prez am.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD, a de pre mek yu dɔnawe wit dɛn wan we lɛk sin, kpatakpata. Mek dɛn kɔmɔt na wɔl. A go prez PAPA GƆD! Lɛ wi ɔl prez PAPA GƆD!
Tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki, wɔship am; ɛn mek ɔlman na wɔl no wetin i dɔn du.
Siŋ we yu de prez am; tɔk bɔt ɔl di wɔndaful tin dɛn we i de du.
Blɔf bɔt ɔl wetin wi PAPA GƆD we oli de du; lɛ ɔl udat de fala am, gladi.
Go to PAPA GƆD mek i ɛp yu de wɔship am ɔltɛm, i go de ɛp yu.
Mɛmba ɔl di wɔndaz we PAPA GƆD dɔn du, di mirekul dɛn we i dɔn ple, di jɔj we i jɔj wi ɛnimi dɛn fɔ wi.
Una we na Ebraam in jɛnareshɔn dɛn we na pan una i pik Jekɔb, una lisin.
In na PAPA GƆD, wi waŋren PAPA GƆD; nain de rul di wanol wɔl.
I go kip in Kɔvinant sote go, dɔn i nɔ go ɛva fɔgɛt di prɔmis dɛn we i mek to una.
Dat na di Kɔvinant we i mek wit Ebraam, ɛn di swɛ we i swɛ to Ayzak.
I tɔk am bak to Jekɔb ɛn mek am lɔ gi Izrɛl we go mek i de sote go.
I se, “A go gi una Kenan land fɔ bi una yon.”
Di tɛm we dɛn nɔ bin plɛnti, ɛn so smɔl, dat dɛn na bin trenja
we dɛn de muf muf frɔm kɔntri to kɔntri pila to post,
i nɔ gri mek ɛnibɔdi buli dɛn; i bin de tɔk pan Kiŋ dɛn fɔseka dɛn.
I kin se “Nɔ tɔch di Kiŋ ɔ di prɔfɛt we a pik fɔ tɔk fɔ mi; nɔ du bad to ɛniwan pan dɛn.”
PAPA GƆD mek bad bad aŋri fɔdɔm na Kenan we mek dɛn nɔ gɛt natin fɔ it;
dɔn i mek wan man, we dɛn sɛl as slev we nem Josɛf go bifo dɛn na Ijipt.
I bin de na jel usay dɛn chen in fut dɛn ɛn put ayɛn rawnd in nɛk.
I bin de de te wetin i tɔk bi, dat na wetin PAPA GƆD bin tɛl am fɔ tɔk.
Di kiŋ na Ijipt we bin de rul di pipul se fɔ fri Josɛf.
We i kɔmɔt jel, di kiŋ put am inchaj ɔf ɔl wetin i gɛt.
I gi am pawa fɔ tɛl ɔl di Ijipshian ɔfisa dɛn wetin fɔ du.
Na da sem tɛm de Izrɛl, we in ɔda nem na Jekɔb muf go tap na Am as fɔrina.
PAPA GƆD mek in pipul bɔn bɔku; dɛn pikin dɛn kam pawaful pas di Ijipshian dɛn.
Dat mek di Ijipshian dɛn et dɛn, ɛn bigin plan fɔ du dɛn bad.
I sɛn in savant Mozis, ɛn Erɔn we i pik go na Ijipt.
I ple ɔlkayn mirekul, ɛn ple wɔndaz na Ijipt.
I sɛn daknɛs we mek di wanol ples dak bɔt usay? Di Ijipshian dɛn nɔ yɛri da laŋwej de.
I ivin tɔn dɛn wata to blɔd, we mek ɔl dɛn fish day.
Frɔg sɛf bɔs na di ples we go te rich insay dɛn bigman dɛn rum dɛn.
I tɔk nɔmɔ, flay dɛn bɔs wit nat na di wanol kɔntri.
I mek ren fɔdɔm lɛk grabul-grabul, wit laytin fɔ de ɔlsay na di kɔntri;
Di ren we fɔdɔm lɛk grabul-grabul ɛn di laytin, pwɛl pwɛl ɔl di vayn ɛn fig planteshɔn ɛn ɔl di tik dɛn na di kɔntri.
We i tɔk, lokɔs bɔs, lokɔs we yu nɔ ebul kɔnt;
dɛn it it ɔl wetin grin na di kɔntri, ɛn it ɔl di lif na di plant dɛn.
Dɔn PAPA GƆD mek ɔl di fɔs pikin dɛn day na di kɔntri, na di fɔs pikin de sho se dɛn na man.
I pul di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmɔt de saful ɛn dɛn drɛs wit gold ɛn silva, ɛn nɔn pan dɛn nɔ sik sɛf.
Di Ijipshian dɛn gladi we dɛn bin de go bikɔs dɛn bin de fred di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
I prɛd di klawd pan dɛn fɔ kɔba dɛn ɛn mek faya fɔ de sho dɛn layt na nɛt.
Dɛn aks fɔ tin fɔ it, i gi dɛn kwel ɛn bred, dat na mana frɔm ɛvin.
I mek wata kɔmɔt insay ston; ɛn flo lɛk riva na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
I du ɔl dis bikɔs i mɛmba di prɔmis we i bin dɔn mek to Ebraam.
So i mek in pipul kɔmɔt Ijipt dɛn gladi wande siŋ;
i gi dɛn difrɛn difrɛn kɔntri dɛn fɔ bi dɛn yon. Dɛn avɛst frut we ɔda pipul bin dɔn plant.
Dat fɔ mek dɛn obe PAPA GƆD in lɔ ɛn du ɔl wetin i tɛl dɛn fɔ du. Una mek wi prez PAPA GƆD!
Una mek wi prez PAPA GƆD! Tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki bikɔs na gud PAPA GƆD; in lɔv fɔ mɔtalman nɔ de ɛva chenj.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul tɔk bɔt ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD de du; nɔbɔdi nɔ go ɛva prez PAPA GƆD aw i fɔ prez am.
I go fayn fɔ dɛn wan dɛn we de fɛt fɔ wetin rayt, ɛn we de du wetin rayt ɔltɛm.
PAPA GƆD, mɛmba mi we rɛdi fɔ du gud to yu pipul, nɔ fɔgɛt mi we yu de sev dɛn,
lɛ misɛf go ɛnjɔy pan di bɛtɛ we de fala di pipul we yu dɔn pik, so dat misɛf go jɔyn di neshɔn fɔ gladi ɛn di pipul we na yu yon fɔ prez yu.
Wi, lɛkɛ wi fɔstɛm pipul dɔn du bad; wi riali dɔn rɔŋ yu ɛn wi gilti.
Wɛn wi pipul bin de Ijipt, dɛn nɔ bin de tink sɛf bɔt yu mirekul dɛn; dɛn nɔ mɛmba ɔl di gud tin dɛn we yu dɔn du, ɛn dɛn barɔf we dɛn rich, di Rɛd Si.
Pan ɔl dat, PAPA GƆD sev dɛn bikɔs i nɔ wan pwɛl in gud nem, i wan mek ɔlman no se i gɛt pawa fɔ du ɔlkayn tin.
I gi ɔda to di Rɛd Si ɛn i dray wantɛm; dɔn i lɛ in pipul pas midul sote dɛn rich dray grɔn.
I pul dɛn kɔmɔt na dɛn ɛnimi dɛn an.
Dɛn ɛnimi dɛn drawn; wan pan dɛn nɔ lɛf fɔ tɛl di stori.
Dat mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn biliv wetin PAPA GƆD bin dɔn se i go du ɛn dɛn bigin siŋ fɔ prez am.
Bɔt i nɔ te sɛf, dɛn fɔgɛt bɔt wetin i dɔn du ɛn nɔ bɔda wet fɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ tɛl dɛn wetin fɔ du.
Na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, na de dɛn bigin aŋri fɔ it ɔda tin dɛn; na de dɛn chalenj PAPA GƆD.
So insɛf gi dɛn wetin dɛn aks fɔ, bɔt i mek i bɔn dɛn mɔt.
We dɛn de na kamp dɛn bigin jɛlɔs Mozis ɛn Erɔn we PAPA GƆD pik fɔ sav am.
Di grɔn opin ɛn swɛla Detan; dɔn i swɛla ɔl udat jɔyn gɛŋ wit Abiram.
PAPA GƆD sɛn faya kam dɔŋ we bɔn dɛn ɛn bɔn ɔl di bad wan dɛn.
We dɛn bin de na Mawnt Ɔrɛb, dɛn mek wan pikin kaw wit ayɛn ɛn bigin wɔship am.
Dɛn lɛf fɔ wɔship dis wɔndaful PAPA GƆD ɛn bigin wɔship di tin we dɛn mek lɛkɛ man kaw we na gras i de it.
Dɛn fɔgɛt aw PAPA GƆD dɔn sev dɛn, dɛn fɔgɛt ɔl di wɔndaful tin dɛn we i du na Ijipt,
di mirekul dɛn na Ijipt ɛn di tin we i du na di Rɛd Si we du fɔ mek pɔsin fred am.
So i se if nɔto we Mozis, di man we i bin dɔn pik, beg fɔ dɛn, lɛk i de dɔnawe wit dɛn. Na Mozis tap am nɔ fɔ kil dɛn ɔl we i vɛks.
Dat nɔ dɔn, dɛn nɔ gri go insay di land we i prɔmis se go bi dɛn yon; dɛn nɔ biliv wetin i se.
Dɛn grɔmbul bɔku usay dɛn de ɛn nɔ gri fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se.
We dɛn pasmak, i swɛ se i mɔs mek dɛn day na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
I go mek ɔda neshɔn dɛn kil dɛn dɔn udat nɔ day, i go skata dɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛn ɔlɔbɔt.
Dɛn put waala pan dɛnsɛf we dɛn grap go jɔyn di pegan dɛn gɔd Beal na Piɔ ɛn it di sakrifays it dɛn we dɛn de pul to dɛn gɔd dɛn we nɔ gɛt layf;
dɛn provok PAPA GƆD te i vɛks wit ɔl di bad, bad tin dɛn we dɛn de du so insɛf sɛn bad sik pan dɛn.
Bɔt we Finɛas du wetin fɔ mek PAPA GƆD in at kol, i lɛ di sik lɛf fɔ kil dɛn.
Pipul go de mɛmba dis tin ya we Finɛas du sote go.
We dɛn rich Mɛriba brij bak, dɛn mek PAPA GƆD vɛks, ɛn na dat mek Mozis gɛt in yon waala;
dɛn barɔf sɔm kayn barɔf, we mek Mozis vɛks ɛn tɔk wetin i nɔ fɔ tɔk.
Dɛn nɔ gri fɔ dɔnawe wit di ɔda pipul lɛk aw PAPA GƆD se,
bifo dat, dɛn miks fɔ du ɔlkayn tin wit dɛn sote dɛn bigin du ɔl wetin dɛn de du.
Dɛn wɔship dɛn tin dɛn we dɛn mek fɔ pre to, we kam tɔn bon na dɛn trot.
Dɛn pul dɛn bɔypikin dɛn sara ɛn gi dɛn gyal pikin dɛn to dɛbul.

Dɛn shɛd dɛn bɔypikin ɛn gyal pikin dɛn blɔd fɔ natin, we dɛn tek dɛn pul sara to dɛn tin we dɛn mek fɔ pre to na Kenan; dɛn mek di ples nɔ fit fɔ mek pɔsin wɔship PAPA GƆD de bikɔs ɔf di blɔd dɛn we wes.
Dɛn nɔnsɛns dɛnsɛf bay wetin dɛn du, dat mek dɛn biev lɛk rare gyal.
Dis mek PAPA GƆD vɛks pan in pipul ɛn nɔ want fɔ gɛt natin fɔ du wit dɛn.
I lɛf dɛn gi ɔda neshɔn dɛn ɛn lɛ dɛn ɛnimi dɛn mek bɔs pan dɛn.
PAPA GƆD mek di ɛnimi dɛn yuz dɛn pawa fɔ pas am pan dɛn.
PAPA GƆD bin dɔn de sev dɛn, bɔt dɛn bin dɔn min fɔ mek rebɛl pan PAPA GƆD ɛn pwɛl dɛnsɛf bikɔs ɔf sin.
Bɔt we dɛn pre ɛn kɔmplen i yɛri dɛn ɛn ansa dɛn prea;
bikɔs i wan ɛp dɛn, i mɛmba wetin i bin se nain Kɔvinant, ɛn bikɔs in lɔv nɔ de chenj, i chenj in maynd.
I mek ɔl udat bin dɔn kapchɔ dɛn sɔri fɔ dɛn.
E PAPA GƆD wi PAPA GƆD, kɛr wi go bak usay wi fɔ de so dat we go tɛl yu tɛnki ɛn blɔf we wi de prez yu oli nem.
Una lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD, di waŋren PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl gɛt in na di PAPA GƆD we go de sote go. Mek ɔlman ansa se “Emɛn.” Una lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD!
Lɛ wi tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnk bikɔs in na gud PAPA GƆD; in lɔv de de sote go.
Lɛ ɔl di wan dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn sev, di wan dɛn we i pul kɔmɔt na dɛn ɛnimi dɛn an, tɔk am
dɛn wan dɛn we bin skata ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl we i briŋ kam fɔ sidɔm wan ples.
Sɔm man dɛn bin jɛs de wirɔn na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, dɛn nɔ ebul fɛn say fɔ sɛtul.
Dɛn bin aŋri ɛn tɔsti ɛn dɛn layf dɛn bin jɛs de wes, dɛn bin fiba udat de day di nɛks momɛnt
bɔt dɛn ala beg PAPA GƆD fɔ pul dɛn pan dis waala, i ansa dɛn ɛn sev dɛn.
I kɛr dɛn tret go usay dɛn fɔ sɛtul.
Naw, lɛ dɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnk fɔ in lɔv we nɔ de chenj ɛn fɔ ɔl di wɔndaful tin dɛn we i de du fɔ mɔtalman,
bikɔs i de gi wata to udat tɔsti ɛn gi gud it to udat aŋri.
Sɔm man dɛn bin de na siriɔs trɔbul, sɔm na bin jelman dɛn we dɛn chen,
afta we dɛn bin dɔn tɔn dɛn bak pan wetin PAPA GƆD se ɛn nɔ bisin bɔt wetin PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti de tich.
So i mek dɛn gɛt traŋa traŋa wok fɔ du we mek dɛn wan giv ɔp, ɛn dɛn nɔ bin gɛt nɔbɔdi fɔ ɛp dɛn.
So dɛn ala beg PAPA GƆD fɔ pul dɛn pan dis waala, i ansa dɛn ɛn sev dɛn.
I pul dɛn kɔmɔt pan di siriɔs trɔbul we dɛn bin de pan ɛn brok di chen we bin de pan dɛn lɛkɛ jelman.
Naw, lɛ dɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnk fɔ in lɔv we nɔ de chenj, ɛn fɔ ɔl di wɔndaful tin dɛn we i de du fɔ mɔtalman,
bikɔs i ebul brok brok di ɛnimi dɛn do ɛn dɛn ayɛn get dɛn.
Sɔm man dɛn tɔn fulman we dɛn mek rebɛl pan PAPA GƆD so dɛn sɔfa nɔf fɔ dɛn sin dɛn.
Dɛn et ɔl di it we i gi dɛn fɔ it ɛn niali day.
Dɛn ala beg PAPA GƆD fɔ pul dɛn pan dis waala, i ansa dɛn ɛn sev dɛn.
I tɔk nɔmɔ, nain dɛn wɛl; i nɔ mek dɛn day.
Naw, lɛ dɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnk fɔ in lɔv we nɔ de chenj ɛn fɔ di wɔndaful tin dɛn we i de du fɔ mɔtalman.
Lɛ dɛn mek sakrifays fɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnk, gladi ɛn siŋ fɔ tɔk bɔt wetin i de du.
Sɔm ɔda wan dɛn go si ɛn dɛn gɛt dɛn ship we dɛn bin de du smɔl smɔl biznɛs de.
Dɛn bin de si PAPA GƆD in wok, ɛn in pawa midul di wata.
Na tɔk i de tɔk we de mek big briz blo dɔn di swɛlin dɛn bigin kam.
We di briz kin blo, dɔn di swɛlin kin es di ship ɔp ɛn briŋ am kam dɔŋ; di wata kin rɔf ɛn di siman dɛn kin giv ɔp.
Dɛn nɔ ebul kɔntrol dɛnsɛf, dɛn tan lɛk udat drɔnk ɛn nɔ no wetin dɛn fɔ du.
Dɛn ala beg PAPA GƆD fɔ pul dɛn kɔmɔt pan dis waala; i ansa dɛn ɛn pul dɛn kɔmɔt pan di waala.
I mek di big briz lɛf fɔ blo; ɛn tap di swɛlin sɛf na di si.
Dɛn gladi we ɔltin kwayɛt we mek dɛn rich usay dɛn bin de go.
Naw, lɛ dɛn tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnk fɔ in lɔv we nɔ de chenj ɛn fɔ di wɔndaful tin dɛn we i de du fɔ mɔtalman.
Lɛ dɛn tɔk gud bɔt am usay pipul gɛda ɛn prez am usay di big wan dɛn na di famili dɛn de.
I de mek watasay dɛn dray lɛkɛ ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap ɛn ivin mek dɛn wata we de bɔs ɔnda grɔn dray,
ɛn usay tik kin gro fayn, in mek natin nɔ bia de, bikɔs di pipul we tap rawnd de bad.
I de mek wata bɔs na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap ɛn mek wata bɔs ɔnda grɔn na say we dray keŋ;
i briŋ dɛn wan dɛn we aŋri fɔ kam tap de, ɛn mek ples fɔ dɛn fɔ sɛtul.
Dɛn plant bɔku tin dɛn ɛn mek gadin we mek dɛn gɛt gud avɛst,
i blɛs dɛn ɛn dɛn bɔn bɔku pikin, ɛn PAPA GƆD nɔ mek dɛn animal dɛn day.
We nambara mit dɛn ɛn brok dɛn dɔŋ,
PAPA GƆD lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf ɛn lɛ dɛn aristo dɛn bigin wirɔn yuslɛs wan.
Bɔt i pul di po wan dɛn kɔmɔt pan trɔbul ɛn mek dɛn bɔn bɔku pikin lɛkɛ aw animal dɛn kin bɔn.
Udat de du tin tret wan, kin si wetin PAPA GƆD de du, dɔn i gladi, bɔt di bad man nɔba ebul se fiŋ.
Udat no wetin bɛtɛ, fɔ de mɛmba ɔl dɛn tin dɛn ya ɛn tink bɔt di kayn lɔv we PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ mɔtalman.
PAPA GƆD, a nɔ go chenj mi maynd! A go mek siŋ ɛn yuz myuzik fɔ prez yu; a go rɛdi misɛf.
A go rɛdi misɛf wit mi ap ɛn laya fɔ ple myuzik; a go grap fɔs tin na mɔnin bifo san kɔmɔt.
PAPA GƆD, a go tɛl yu tɛnk na ɔl dɛn difrɛn neshɔn; a go siŋ bɔt aw yu gud usay ɔda pipul de.
Di lɔv we yu gɛt fɔ wi so bɔku dat i ivin pas usay ɛvin de if wi want fɔ mɛzhɔ am; yu fethfulnɛs in de te rich ɔp klawd.
PAPA GƆD, dɛn de prez yu na ɛvin, sho di wanol wɔl aw wɔndaful yu bi.
Yuz yu pawa fɔ sev wi ɛn ɛp wi so dat udat lɛk yu go kɔmɔt pan trɔbul.
PAPA GƆD bin de nain os ɛn tɔk se “Bikɔs a pawaful, a go sheb di siti we nem Shɛkɛm dɔn a go patishɔn ‘Sɔkɔt Vali.’
