Na so di Izrɛlayt fambul we de wɔship PAPA GƆD de jɔyn an fɔ prez am, lɛkɛ aw i bin tɛl pipul fɔ de tɛl am tɛnki.
Na de Kiŋ we kɔmɔt na Devid in famili layn kin sidɔm fɔ jɔj kes.
Pre fɔ pis na Jerusɛlɛm Fɔ se, “Lɛ ɔl udat lɛk Jerusɛlɛm gɛt pis.
Lɛ ɔl rawnd Jerusɛlɛm wit di bigman dɛn os gɛt sikyɔriti.”
A go se, “Mek pis de na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn lɛ gud fala ɔl udat de de.”
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD in os de de, ɔlman we tap de go wɔship am, ɛn a go pre mek PAPA GƆD lɛ ɔltin gud na Jerusɛlɛm.
PAPA GƆD wi de luk ɔp to yu, we sidɔm na ɛvin de jɔj di wɔl.
As mɔntbɔy de luk ɔp to in masta, ɛn as nɔsi de luk ɔp to in misis, na so wi de luk ɔp to PAPA GƆD, te i av masi pan wi.
E PAPA GƆD, av masi! Yu dɔn mek pipul nɔ tek wi mek natin igen, duya, av masi.
Wi dɔn bia bɔku na pipul we de buli wi dɛn an.
Lɛ di Izrɛlayt dɛn tɔk se If PAPA GƆD nɔ bin de wit wi?
If PAPA GƆD nɔ bin de wit wi, we wi ɛnimi dɛn bɔs pan wi,
dɛn bin fɔ swɛla wi layf wan;
dɛn bin fɔ mek wi drawn ɛn wata kɔba wi
dɔn dɛn swip wi go lɛk wata na samba gɔta.
Lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD we nɔ lɛ dɛn it wi rɔ lɛk bif.
Wi kɔmɔt na dɛn trap lɛkɛ bɔd we dɛn bin dɔn kech; PAPA GƆD mek di trap brok, dɔn i fri wi.
Na PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ we mek ɛvin ɛn ath de ɛp wi.
Udat abop pan PAPA GƆD go tinap deŋ lɛk Mawnt Zayɔn, we kant kɔmɔt usay i de, bɔt go de sote go.
Lɛkɛ aw di mawnten dɛn de rawnd Jerusɛlɛm, na so PAPA GƆD de kɔba in pikin dɛn naw ɛn sote go.
Bad pipul nɔ go kɔntinyu fɔ rul na di land we PAPA GƆD dɔn gi in pipul we de du tin tret wan; ɔ nɔ so PAPA GƆD in pipul sɛf go bigin du bad.
PAPA GƆD, blɛs di wan dɛn we de du gud di wan dɛn we de du wetin rayt.
Bɔt lɛ dɛn wan we de du wetin dɛn lɛk fɔ du, sɔfa, lɛkɛ aw bad pipul de sɔfa. Mek pis de na Izrɛl!
Wɛn PAPA GƆD briŋ wi kam bak na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn mek we liv lɛk aw wi bin liv, i tan lɛk na drim wi dɛn bin de drim.
Wi bin so gladi wi laf ɛn siŋ fɔ jɔy. Pipul na ɔda neshɔn bigin kɔle pan wi. Dɛn tɔk to dɛnsɛf se, “Na big big tin, PAPA GƆD dɔn du fɔ dɛn so.”
PAPA GƆD du big big tin fɔ wi, ɛn wi at gladi.
PAPA GƆD, gi wi di jɛntri we wi bin gɛt fɔstɛm, lɛkɛ aw yu de mek wata de na ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Pɔsin we kray we i de plant sid go gladi we di tɛm rich fɔ avɛst.
If i de kray wɛn i tot in sid dɛn fɔ go plant, i mɔs gladi di tɛm wɛn i go tot di avɛst.
If PAPA GƆD nɔ put an we yu de bil yu os, na fɔ natin yu de wok. If yu nɔ mek PAPA GƆD bi wachman fɔ di siti, yu go de pe yu wachman fɔ natin.
Na fɔ natin yu de grap kwik na mɔnin ɛn slip let na nɛt, se yu de wok fɔ gɛt tin fɔ it bikɔs di wan we abop pan PAPA GƆD, i go kia fɔ dɛn ivin wɛn dɛn de slip gud.
Pikin na blɛsin we PAPA GƆD de gi ɛn mɔ so if na yu bɔn am.
I fayn we yu bɔn pikin wɛn yu yɔŋ bikɔs nain gɛt fɔ fɛt fɔ yu wɛn yu ol.
Di pɔsin we gɛt dɛn bɔku go gladi bikɔs dɛn ɔl go fɛt fɔ am. Dɛn nɔ go mek i nɔ shem wɛn dɛn mit in ɛnimi fɔ kɔt kes.
I fayn fɔ di pɔsin we de fred ɛn rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD, we de du wetin i want.
Yu go ɛnjɔy yu lebɔ; dɔn yu go gɛt blɛsin ɛn bɛtɛ go fala yu.
Yu wɛf go fiba vayn tik we go bɔn pikin we go de na yu os, ɛn yu pikin dɛn go bɔku ɛn de rawnd yu.
Na so PAPA GƆD de blɛs man we de fred ɛn rɛspɛkt am.
Lɛ PAPA GƆD we de nain os na Zayɔn blɛs yu! Mek yu de fɔ si Jerusɛlɛm in bɛtɛ wan sote yu day.
Ɛn mek yu gɛt lɔŋ layf fɔ si yu gret grampikin dɛn. Mek pis de na Izrɛl!
Lɛ Izrɛl tɔk se, “I dɔn te we dɛn de biɛn mi, frɔm we a smɔl”.
“I dɔn te we dɛn de biɛn mi frɔm we a smɔl bɔt dɛn nɔ ebul mi.
Dɛn bit kanda rɛs na mi bak ɛn mek a sɔfa.”
Bɔt PAPA GƆD we de du tin tret wan, dɔn pul mi kɔmɔt na dɛn an.
Lɛ ɔl udat nɔ wan si Zayɔn in bɛtɛ wan tɔn bak wit shem ɛn disgres.
Lɛ dɛn fiba gras pantap ruf we bifo i wan fɔ gro, i dɔn day.
Dɛn wan dɛn we kin mek bɔndul wit gras nɔ go ebul fɔ du so.
Lɛ nɔbɔdi nɔ pas we go se “Mek PAPA GƆD blɛs yu, ya.” “Wi de yuz PAPA GƆD in nem fɔ blɛs yu.”
Nainsay siriɔs trɔbul a de we a de pre to yu so, PAPA GƆD, duya yɛri mi prea.
Lisin to wetin a de se ɛn av masi pan mi,
PAPA GƆD, if yu bin de kɔnt ɔl di bad we wi de du, PAPA GƆD, udat fit fɔ tinap bifo yu?
Bɔt yu rɛdi fɔ fɔgiv wi ɔltɛm; so i fayn fɔ mek wi fred yu.
A abop pan PAPA GƆD, bikɔs a no se i go du wetin i se.
A so abop pan PAPA GƆD pas aw wachman de abop fɔ lɛ do klin, na dat a se, pas aw wachman de abop fɔ lɛ do klin.
Izrɛl pipul una put una abop pan PAPA GƆD! In na PAPA GƆD we nɔ de gens fɔ lɛk pɔsin ɛn i rɛdi fɔ sev ɔltɛm.
Nain sem wan go sev Izrɛl ɛn pul di pipul sin kɔmɔt pan dɛn.
PAPA GƆD, mi nɔto pɔsin we de kak, ɛn a nɔ tink tu mɔch ɔf misɛf; natin nɔ ful mi yay, ɛn a nɔ de put misɛf usay a nɔ rich.
A nɔ de wɔri wan lɛkɛ aw smɔl pikin we dɛn dɔn win na bɔbi kin kwayɛt we i de nia in mama.
Una dɛn Izrɛlayt dɛn, una put una op pan PAPA GƆD tide ɛn sote go.
PAPA GƆD, mɛmba Devid ɛn ɔl wetin i dɔn pas.
I bin swɛ to PAPA GƆD di PAPA GƆD we Jekɔb bin de wɔship se,
“A nɔ go go insay mi os go lidɔm na mi bed,
a nɔ go bay fɔl sɛf,
te a mek ples usay PAPA GƆD fɔ de, te a mek ples usay PAPA GƆD we Jekɔb de wɔship, fɔ de.”
Wi yɛri am na Bɛtliɛm ɛn fɛn am na Jearim fil.
Wi se, “Lɛ wi go usay PAPA GƆD de; lɛ wi butu nain fut ɛn wɔship am.”
PAPA GƆD, grap mek yu go usay yu tap, yu ɛn di ak we de sho se yu gɛt pawa
Lɛ yu man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ di pipul sin, de du wetin rayt; ɛn lɛ di pipul de du wetin yu want ɛn ala wit gladi.
Fɔseka Devid, yu savant, nɔ fɔgɛt di kiŋ we yu dɔn pik.
PAPA GƆD bin dɔn swɛ to Devid ɛn i nɔ go chenj am se, “Wan pɔsin na yu jɛnareshɔn go bi kiŋ
wans dɛn du wetin a want ɛn obe di lɔ dɛn we a tich dɛn, dɛnsɛf yon jɛnareshɔn go mɔs bi kiŋ sote go.”
PAPA GƆD dɔn pik Zayɔn, na de i want fɔ tap.
I se, “Na ya so a go tap sote go; na ya so a wish fɔ de ɛn rul.
A go mek shɔ se i gɛt ɔltin; di po pipul we de de go gɛt tin fɔ it.
Dɛn man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go bi sef ɛn dɛn pipul we de du wetin PAPA GƆD se, go de ala ɔltɛm wit gladi.
Na ya so, a go mek Devid bɔn pikin we go bi kiŋ ɛn shayn lɛk lamp bikɔs a dɔn pik dɛn sote go.
A go mek shem ɛn disgres mit in ɛnimi dɛn, dɛn go wɛr am lɛkɛ klos na dɛn bɔdi bɔbs, na so in krawn go de shayn!”
I fayn ɛn i swit wɛn PAPA GƆD in pipul gɛda wit wan at fɔ wɔship am.
Dɛn kayn switnɛs de tan lɛk we yu tɔn dɛn swit dia dia ɔyl na yu ed, lɛk aw dɛn bin anɔynt Erɔn wit ɔliv ɔyl; di ɔyl rɔn dɔŋ to in biabia te rich in rob in kɔla.
Da switnɛs de na lɛkɛ ebi dyu we kin fɔdɔm na Mawnt Amɔn ɔ we de fɔdɔm na Mawnt Zayɔn. Na de PAPA GƆD dɔn prɔmis in blɛsin we na layf we go de sote go.
Una ɔl we na PAPA GƆD in savant dɛn, kam lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD, una dɛn wan dɛn we de na nɛt fɔ sav PAPA GƆD nain os.
Tɔn una fes to in os ɛn es una an ɔp we una de pre fɔ prez PAPA GƆD.
Lɛ PAPA GƆD we mek ɛvin ɛn ath blɛs una frɔm usay i de na Zayɔn.
Una lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD! Una ɔl we na PAPA GƆD in savant dɛn, una kam lɛ wi prez PAPA GƆD.
Una dɛn wan we de sav PAPA GƆD nain os lɛ wi prez am.
Prez PAPA GƆD bikɔs na gud PAPA GƆD; siŋ we yu de prez am, i de ɛnjɔy am.
Na PAPA GƆD dɔn pik Jekɔb fɔ bi in yon, ɛn in jɛnareshɔn dɛn fɔ bi in prayvet prɔpati.
A no se PAPA GƆD pawaful, ɛn i pas ɔl dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn.
PAPA GƆD de du wetin in want fɔ du, na ɛvin ɛn na ath, na di si ɛn insay insay di si.
I de mek klawd gɛda frɔm fa; ren de kam ɛn laytin de flash dɔn briz kin jɛs bɔsawt frɔm usay i bin kip am.
I mek di fɔs pikin dɛn we bɔn na Ijipt day di fɔs wan pan mɔtalman ɛn di fɔs wan pan animal.
I ple bɔku wɔndaz insay Ijipt, pan di kiŋ ɛn in ɔfisa dɛn.
I mek bɔku neshɔn dɛn rɔnawe, ɛn mek big big kiŋ dɛn day,
dɛn kiŋ de, na Sayɔn we na di Amɔrayt dɛn kiŋ, Ɔg we na bin kiŋ na Beshan wit ɔl dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Kenan
dɔn i gi dɛn land dɛn to di pipul na Izrɛl fɔ bi dɛn yon.
E PAPA GƆD! Ɔlman go no se yu na PAPA GƆD, ɔl dɛn jɛnareshɔn go de tɔk bɔt yu sote go.
PAPA GƆD go fɛt fɔ in pipul bikɔs i gɛt sɔri-at fɔ dɛn wan we de sav am.
Na silva ɛn gold dɛn tek fɔ mek dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn, infakt sɛf na mɔtalman dɛn mek dɛn.
Dɛn gi dɛn mɔt, bɔt dɛn nɔ de tɔk, dɛn gi dɛn yay, bɔt dɛn nɔ de si;
dɛn gi dɛn yes, bɔt dɛn nɔ de yɛri ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt layf.
Lɛ dɛn o, di wan dɛn we mek dɛn o, ɛn ɔl udat de fala dɛn jɛs tan lɛk dɛn.
Ɔlman na Izrɛl fɔ prez PAPA GƆD! Ɔl udat kɔmɔt na Erɔn in famili layn fɔ prez PAPA GƆD!
Ɔl udat kɔmɔt na Livay insɛf yon famili layn fɔ prez PAPA GƆD! Ɛn ɔl udat gɛt fred ɛn rɛspɛkt fɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ prez PAPA GƆD!
Lɛ ɔlman prez PAPA GƆD na Zayɔn. Na Jerusɛlɛm i tap. Lɛ wi ɔl prez PAPA GƆD.
Tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki bikɔs na gud PAPA GƆD, in lɔv de de sote go;
Tɛl PAPA GƆD di PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl ɔda gɔd dɛn tɛnki, in lɔv de de sote go.
Tɛl di PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl gɔd dɛn tɛnki, in lɔv de de sote go.
Nain nɔmɔ na di PAPA GƆD we de ple wɔndaz, in lɔv de de sote go.
I gɛt sɛns fɔ mek ɛvin ɛn ɔl wetin de de, in lɔv de de sote go;
I mek di wanol wɔl, in lɔv de de sote go.
I mek big big layt dɛn, in lɔv de de sote go;
dat na di san we de shayn de tɛm, in lɔv de de sote go
ɛn di mun ɛn sta dɛn fɔ kɔmɔt na nɛt, in lɔv de de sote go.
Nain bin mek dɛn Ijipshian dɛn fɔs pikin day, in lɔv de de sote go;
ɛn pul di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmɔt de saful, in lɔv de de sote go;
fɔ sho aw i gɛt pawa; in lɔv de de sote go.
Nain divayd di Rɛd Si, in lɔv de de sote go;
ɛn mek di Izrɛlayt dɛn pas midul, in lɔv de de sote go;
bɔt i mek di wata na di Rɛd Si kɛr Fero, di kiŋ na Ijipt ɛn in sojaman dɛn go; in lɔv de de sote go.
Nain lid in pipul we dɛn de pas na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, in lɔv de de sote go.
I kil big big Kiŋ dɛn, in lɔv de de sote go;
Kiŋ dɛn we gɛt fem in lɔv de de sote go.
Sayɔn we na bin kiŋ fɔ di Amɔrayt dɛn; in lɔv de de sote go;
ɛn Ɔg we na bin kiŋ na Beshan; in lɔv de de sote go;
dɔn i giwe dɛn land dɛn, in lɔv de de sote go,
i gi dɛn to di pipul na Izrɛl we de sav am; in lɔv de de sote go.
Nain na di wan we de mɛmba wi wɛn wi de dɔŋ, in lɔv de de sote go;
ɛn pul wi kɔmɔt na wi ɛnimi dɛn an, in lɔv de de sote go,
ɛn gi ɔltin we gɛt layf, tin fɔ it, in lɔv de de sote go.
Tɛl di PAPA GƆD na ɛvin tɛnki in lɔv de de sote go.
We wi kin sidɔm nia dɛn watasay dɛn na Babilɔn, we kin kray we wi kin mɛmba wetin bin bi we wi bin de Zayɔn.
We wi de de, wi mekɔp wi maynd nɔ fɔ ple igen,
bikɔs di wan dɛn we kech wi se mek wi siŋ fɔ dɛn, dɛn se lɛ wi siŋ siŋ dɛn we go mek dɛn gladi. Dɛn se, “Una siŋ wan pan una siŋ dɛn we una kin siŋ na Zayɔn.”
Bɔt wi nɔ go ebul fɔ siŋ ɛniwan pan wi siŋ dɛn we na fɔ PAPA GƆD, na strenj ples.
If a fɔgɛt yu Jerusɛlɛm, lɛ a fɔgɛt aw fɔ ple.
Lɛ a nɔ ebul fɔ siŋ igen if a nɔ de tink bɔt yu, dat na if a nɔ mɛmba se Jerusɛlɛm, na yu de mek mi at swit.
PAPA GƆD, nɔ fɔgɛt wetin di Idɔmayt dɛn du di de we dɛn kapchɔ Jerusɛlɛm, na so dɛn bin de ala “Una brok am! Na fɔ rut am kɔmɔt na grɔn!”
E Babilɔn! Yu dɔn alaki! Di wan we go pe yu bak fɔ wetin yu du wi, gɛt blɛsin!
I go tek yu bebi dɛn ɛn nak dɛn ed na wɔl.
PAPA GƆD, a go prez yu wit ɔl mi at. Usay dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn de, na de a go siŋ ɛn prez yu.
A go mek shɔ se a baw usay yu os de ɛn a go prez yu fɔ di kayn lɔv we yu gɛt fɔ wi we nɔ de ɛva chenj ɛn yu de sho wi ɔltɛm se yu lɛk wi, fɔ we yu mek yusɛf ɛn wetin yu se pas ɔltin we de na wɔl.
Wɛn a de pre, yu de ansa; yu dɔn mek a gɛt mɔ zil.
PAPA GƆD, mek ɔl dɛn Kiŋ na wɔl, prez yu, wɛn dɛn yɛri wetin yu se.
Mek dɛn siŋ ɛn tɔk bɔt di tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD de du, bikɔs i dɔn du wɔndaful tin.
Pan ɔl we PAPA GƆD big so ɛn i sidɔm ɔp na ɛvin, i bisin bɔt pɔsin we nɔ de kak ɛn udat de kak nɔ ebul ayd pan am.
Pan ɔl we a go de pan big big waala yu de pul mi ed de saful; yu yuz yu pawa fɔ fɛt mi ɛnimi dɛn fɔ mi, na yu pawa yu tek sev mi.
PAPA GƆD go du ɔl wetin i dɔn prɔmis. PAPA GƆD, yu lɔv de de sote go; nɔ lɛf wi to wisɛf bikɔs na yu mek wi.
PAPA GƆD, yu de si insay mi at ɛn yu no ɔltin bɔt mi.
Yu nɔ ɔl wetin a de du, if a sidɔm ɔ if a tinap; yu ivin no wetin a de tink bɔt pan ɔl we yu de ɔp ɔp yanda.
Na yu no wetin a de du, wɛn a de kɔmɔt ɛn wɛn a de slip; yu no mi pas aw a no misɛf.
PAPA GƆD, bifo a opin mi mɔt fɔ tɔk sɛf, yu no wetin a wan se.
Yu de rawnd mi; ɛn na yu de kɔba mi.
A nɔ ebul ɔndastand aw yu sabi mi so, a nɔ go drim fɔ rich ɔp de.
A nɔ go ebul rɔnawe frɔm yu bikɔs yu de ɔlsay.
If a go ɔp na ɛvin, yu de yu de; if ivin a day, dɔn dɛn bɛr mi, yu go de d.
If a flay go usay di san de grap na mɔnin, yu de de, if a flay kam usay di san de go dɔŋ, yu de de.
We a de de sɛf yu go de luk afta mi fɔ sho mi aw fɔ waka.
If a se, a go ebul ayd we di ples dak, ɔ mek di layt nɔ shayn pan mi,
di dak nɔto dak fɔ yu sɛf ɛn yu go mek di nɛt fiba de tɛm bikɔs di ples go brayt, as dak de brayt usay yu de.
Na yu mek mi, frɔm we a de na mi mama in bɛlɛ nain yu dɔn tek tɛm gi mi shep.
A go prez yu bikɔs aw yu mek mi na mirekul; a no gud gud wan se, ɔl wetin yu mek wɔndaful.
Yu no ɔl pat pan mi. Di tɛm we dɛn bin de tray fɔ mi na sikrit yu no dat, dɔn yu tek tɛm put mi na mi mama in bɛlɛ.
Yu bin dɔn si mi bifo a bɔn. Yu rayt dɔŋ na yu buk aw lɔŋ a gɛt fɔ liv bifo a bɔn.
PAPA GƆD, a lɛk aw yu de tink bɔt a nɔ ebul ɔndastand. Di tin dɛn we yu de tink bɔt mi, fayn.

Dɛn parebul ɛn advays ya go ɛp pɔsin fɔ tich ɛn gɛt sɛns, ɛn dɛn go mek i ɔndastand di dip, dip minin we dɛn gɛt.
If yu fala dɛn parebul ɛn advays ya, yu go sabi aw fɔ waka na layf, yu go bi pɔsin we de du tin tret wan, ɛn trit pipul fia wan.
Dɛn go mek pɔsin kapu sɛns, ɛn ɛp yɔŋ pɔsin sɛf we nɔ gɛt ɛkspiriɛns, fɔ tich ɛn no wetin i de pan.
Udat we dɔn gɛt sɛns go gɛt mɔ sɛns ɛn udat de si fa, in yay go opin mɔ
fɔ lɛ i go ɔndastand di parebul dɛn minin.
If yu want fɔ gɛt sɛns na layf, di fɔs tin we yu fɔ du na fɔ biliv PAPA GƆD ɛn fred am; fulman nɔ de tek advays ɛn kɔrɛkshɔn.
Mi pikin, pe atɛnshɔn to wetin yu papa de tɛl yu, nɔ fɔgɛt wetin yu mama de tel yu.
Wetin dɛn de tɛl yu go tan lɛkɛ fayn fɛda at na yu ed, ɛn fayn silva chen na yu nɛk.
Mi pikin, if bad pɔsin dɛn tɛmt yu, nɔ gri.
If dɛn se lɛ una le ambush fɔ kil, lɛ una jɛs kil inosɛnt pɔsin fɔ kil sek;
we di pɔsin de wit in wɛlbɔdi ɛn layf wan, dɛn se lɛ una sɛn am go ɔdɔun;
dɔn una go tif ɔl in prɔpati, ɛn ful-ɔp una os wit ɔl wetin una tif;
dɛn se lɛ yu jɔyn dɛn dɔn una ɔl go sheb.
Mi pikin, nɔ fala dɛn; lɛ yu fut sɛf nɔ mas usay dɛn de;
dɛn yon fut dɛn na fɔ de waka du bad, dɛn rɛdi fɔ kil ɔltɛm.
A nɔ si sɛns fɔ tray fɔ kech bɔd we i de wach yu;
di trap we dɛn sɛt nain de kech dɛn, dɛn de fɔdɔm insay de ɛn day.
Udat de tif, na so i de ɛnd; na shɔt layf i de gɛt.
Wisdɔm na lɛkɛ sɛnsman. I de ala lawd wan na dɛn trit ɛn dɛn makit;
i de tɔk lawd na dɛn kot os ɛn dɛn say we pipul kin gɛda. I se,
“Fulish pipul! Aw lɔŋ una go de pan fulishnɛs? Aw lɔŋ una nɔ go de tek natin mek natin? Una nɔ de lan sɛns?
Una lisin to wetin a de tɛl una; a go gi una gud advays ɛn tɛl una wetin a sabi.
A tɔk to una bɔt una nɔ yɛri; a kɔl una bɔt una nɔ kam,
una nɔ yɛri mi advays, ivin we a kɔrɛkt una, una nɔ tek;
wɛn trɔbul mit una a go laf una, a go dans we una de pan waala,
wɛn big tinada blo ɛn put una pan ɔp ɛn dɔŋ, dɔn di kɔt at bigin de mɔna una lɛkɛ ronsho briz, dɔn una de pan pen ɛn ɛŋ at, a go se i switi.
A go de yɛri we una de kɔl so, bɔt a nɔ go ansa; una go de fɛn fɛn mi, bɔt una nɔ go si mi.
Bikɔs una nɔ wan tich sɛns, biliv ɛn fred PAPA GƆD,
dɔn una nɔ lisin to mi advays ɛn nɔ yɛri we a de kɔrɛkt una,
wɛl aw una mek una bed, na so una go lidɔm de. Una go kɔlik wit una yon we.
Fulish pɔsin de day bikɔs ɔf in dɛf yes; fulman de day bikɔs i nɔ bisin bɔt insɛf,
udat lisin to mi nɔ gɛt natin fɔ fred, i go gɛt kol at ɛn nɔ gɛt wan yagba.”
Mi pikin, lisin to wetin a de tel yu ɛn du wetin a se.
Lisin to ɛni sɛns tɔk ɛn tray fɔ de ɔndastand,
aks fɔ lɛ yu go sabi; beg fɔ lɛ yu ɔndastand tin we gɛt dip dip minin.
Tray yu bɛst fɔ gɛt sɛns lɛkɛ aw nɔmɔ dɛn kin dig fɔ fɛn silva ɔ ɛnitin we gɛt valyu.
If yu du dat yu go no wetin i min fɔ fred PAPA GƆD, ɛn yu go no bɔt PAPA GƆD.
Na PAPA GƆD de gi sɛns; nain de mek pɔsin no bɔt sɔntin ɛn ɔndastand gud wan.
I de gi udat tret pawa fɔ gen viktri. I de kɔba dɛn wan we nɔ de pan bɛnbɛn.
I de kɔba dɛn wan we de trit dɛn kɔmpin fia wan, ɛn sev dɛn wan we biliv pan am ɛn de obe am.
If yu lisin to mi, yu go no aw fɔ du tin tret wan, wetin gud ɛn aw fɔ trit pɔsin fia wan. Yu go no wetin fɔ du.
Bikɔs sɛns go de insay yu ed, ɛn di pawa fɔ sabi sɔntin go mek yu gladi,
yu go gɛt pawa fɔ de si fa ɛn ɔndastand,
ɛn dat go mek yu nɔ du di rɔŋ tin. I go kɔba yu frɔm dɛn mɔtalman we na fɔ tɔk bad tin nɔmɔ dɛn sidɔm fɔ,
ɛn dɛn nɔ de waka na di rayt rod, na fɔ du bad nɔmɔ dɛn de fɔ.
Dɛn kin gladi fɔ du bad ɛn de ɛnjɔy di bad we dɛn de du.
Dɛn pipul ya, nɔ fɔ trɔs dɛn bikɔs dɛn gɛt bɛnbɛn.
If yu gɛt sɛns nɔn rare gyal nɔ go tɔn yu to rederaun. Nɔn lus gyal sɛf nɔ go tek in swit mɔt waka pan yu sɛns,
afta we i dɔn lɛf in man ɛn fɔgɛt se in bin dɔn mek vaw to PAPA GƆD.
If yu go nain os, na day rod yu de waka ɛn na ɔdɔun yu de fɛn.
Ɛnibɔdi we go to am nɔ wan bɛtɛ, infakt sɛf nain layf i nɔ de tɔn bak wit.
Na gud pipul yu fɔ de falamakata, ɛn yu go de du tin tret wan.
Na udat de waka tret go de na di land, wit di wan dɛn we de du di rayt tin,
bɔt as fɔ di bad wan dɛn, PAPA GƆD go pul dɛn kɔmɔt na di land, ɛn dɛn wan we nɔ bɛtɛ i go rut dɛn lɛkɛ plant.
Mi pikin, nɔ fɔgɛt wetin a de tich yu. Kip ɔl wetin a de tɛl yu so na yu at.
Dat go mek yu gɛt lɔŋ layf ɛn bɛtɛ go fala yu na wɔl.
Nɔ miks pan kalokalo ɛn bɛnbɛn; bɔt mek lɔv ɛn tret biznɛs nɔ kɔmɔt nia yu; lɛ dɛn tan lɛk chen na yu nɛk, ɛn lɛ dɛn de na yu at ɔltɛm.
Na dat go mek PAPA GƆD ɛn mɔtalman lɛk yu biznɛs ɛn du gud to yu ɔltɛm.
Trɔs PAPA GƆD wit ɔl yu at. Nɔ abop pan yu yon sɛns.
Mek i put an pan ɔl wetin yu de du, ɛn yu go si yu we klia.
Nɔ fil to se yu sabi ɔltin; jɛs fred PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ ɛn nɔ du bad.
If yu du dat, i go bi mɛrɛsin fɔ yu bɔdi ɛn ɔl dɛn pen sɛf go lɔs.
Sho PAPA GƆD se yu rɛspɛkt am ɛn gi am ɔl wetin yu gɛt wit di fɔs tin dɛn we yu de avɛst.
Dat go mek yu gɛt ɔl wetin yu want insay yu sto, dat ples sɛf nɔ go de fɔ kip yu wayn.
Mi pikin, nɔ mek traŋayes we PAPA GƆD de kɔrɛkt yu, ɛn nɔ se yu vɛks we i pɔnish yu fɔ we yu du rɔŋ.
PAPA GƆD de kɔrɛkt udat i lɛk, lɛkɛ aw papa de kɔrɛkt pikin we i lɛk nɔmɔ.
I fayn fɔ di pɔsin we de tray fɔ gɛt sɛns, ɛn we de tray fɔ ɔndastand tiŋs.
In bɛnifit pas silva, ɛn in prɔfit pas gold.
Sɛns pas dayamɔn, natin nɔ de we tan lɛk sɛns.
Sɛns de mek pɔsin gɛt lɔŋ layf, i de gi jɛntri ɛn ɔna.
Sɛns go mek layf fayn fɔ yu, ɛn sɛns go gayd yu sef wan.
Sɛns tan lɛkɛ tik we de gi lɔŋ layf to dɛn wan we gɛt am; i fayn fɔ udat gɛt sɛns.
PAPA GƆD yuz in sɛns fɔ mek di wɔl na di sabi we i gɛt i yuz fɔ put di skay usay i de;
nain sɛns de mek dɛn riva dɛn flo, dɔn ren kɔmɔt ɔp di klawd kam dɔŋ.
Mi pikin, gɛda yu sɛns ɛn tray fɔ si fa; mek shɔ se dɛn tu tin ya nɔ lɛf yu,
bikɔs dɛn go gi yu lɔŋ layf; lɔŋ layf we yusɛf go gladi fɔ.
Dat go mek yu tinap deŋ ɛn yu nɔ go staga.
Yu nɔ go fred sɛf we yu go lidɔm; ɛn na so yu go de drɔ slip.
Yu nɔ go fred sɛf wɛn yu yɛri “Lɔd a masi o, faya!” Lɛkɛ aw trɔbul kin mit bad mɔtalman.
PAPA GƆD go mek yu sef. Nɔn trap sɛf nɔ go kech yu.
Nɔ drɔ yu an pan pɔsin we want mek yu ɛp am.
Nɔ tɛl di pɔsin se lɛ i go ɛn kam tumara, wɛn yu no se yu kin ɛp am da momɛnt de.
Nɔ plan bad tin fɔ yu kɔmpin, mɔ so we i de nia yu, ɛn de abop pan yu.
Nɔ mek plaba wit pɔsin wɛn i nɔ du yu natin.
Nɔ jɛlɔs ɛni bad pɔsin ɛn nɔ falamakata ɛni wan pan wetin i de du.
PAPA GƆD et udat de du bad bɔt i lɛk pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay ɛn de mek am in padi.
PAPA GƆD de ib swɛ na bad pɔsin in os, ɛn udat raychɔs, na blɛs i de blɛs in os.
As fɔ dɛn wan we de laf dɛn kɔmpin, i de laf dɛn bak; bɔt i de sho fevɔ to dɛn wan we put dɛnsɛf dɔŋ.
Udat gɛt sɛns go gɛt ɔna, bɔt fulman go kɔlik wit disgres.
Pikin dɛn, una tek wetin una papa de tɛl una. Una pe atɛnshɔn fɔ lɛ una go ɔndastand.
Na gud tin a de tich una so; so, una nɔ fɔgɛt wetin a de tɛl una.
Wɛn misɛf na bin smɔl pikin to mi papa, ɛn di wangren pikin we mi mama bɔn,
mi papa bin de tich mi, ɛn i tɛl mi se lɛ a kip ɔl wetin i de tɛl mi na mi at; ɛn if a du wetin i tɛl mi, a go gɛt lɔŋ layf.
I se lɛ a nɔ fɔgɛt natin ɛn lɛ a nɔ tɔn mi bak pan wetin i de se. I se lɛ a gɛt sɛns ɛn tray fɔ si fa.
I se lɛ a kip mi sɛns ɔltɛm bikɔs na mi sɛns go gayd mi; ɛn if a lɛk di sɛns we a gɛt, i go kɔba mi.
Fɔ gɛt sɛns pas ɛni ɔda tin na wɔl; i lɛk wetin yu gɛt, tray fɔ si fa.
Mek sɛns bi di tin we yu want pas ɔltin na wɔl, i nɔ go fel yu; if yu ol am wit tu an, i go ɔna yu.
Sɛns go mek yu gɛt fayn fɛda at na yu ed ɛn fayn krawn fɔ wɛr.
Mi pikin, lisin to mi. Nɔ jok wit wetin a de tɛl yu, if yu yɛri mi wɔd yu go gɛt lɔŋ layf.
A dɔn sho yu di rayt rod fɔ waka, ɛn aw fɔ waka tret na layf.
Natin nɔ go blɔk yu we; ɛn if yu de rɔn sɛf yu nɔ go bɔk yu fut.
Ɔl di tɛm yu fɔ de mɛmba wetin yu dɔn lan. Ol am wit tu an. Nain na yu layf.
Nɔ falamakata bad pipul, nɔ pas na di rod sɛf we dɛn de waka.
Avɔyd de, nɔ go dɛn we, tɔn go pas ɔda say.
As fɔ dɛn, dɛn nɔ go slip pas dɛn dɔn du bad; slip nɔ go de na dɛn yay te dɛn dɔn du pɔsin bad.
Fɔ du bad na lɛk bred na dɛn mɔt. Fɔ dɛn, fɛt fɛt, na lɛk wayn fɔ drink.
Bɔt di rod we pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay de waka tan lɛk we san de grap, we i de shayn brayt brayt wan te di ples klia.
Di rod we bad pɔsin de waka tan lɛkɛ daknɛt; dɛn de fɔdɔm ɛn nɔ no wetin dɛn fɔdɔm pan.
Mi pikin, pe atɛnshɔn ɛn yɛri wetin a de tɔk. Opin yu yes to wetin a de se.
Lɛ wan pan dɛn wɔd ya nɔ kɔmɔt na yu yes; kip am na yu at.
Udat yɛri dɛn wɔd ya go gɛt lɔŋ layf, ɛn if i sik sɛf i go wɛl.
Tek tɛm aw yu de tink; bikɔs aw yu de tink na so yu de biev.
Nɔ tɔk nɔn bɛnbɛn tɔk; mek nɔn lay tɔk nɔ kɔmɔt na yu mɔt.
No usay yu de go, nɔ ɛva butu yu ed wit shem.
Tek tɛm plan wetin yu de du, fɔ lɛ ɛnitin we yu de du go kɔmɔt fayn.
Nɔ bigin de luk ya, luk yanda; nɔ fala fɔ du bad.
Mi pikin, pe atɛnshɔn ɛn lisin to di sɛns we a de tɔk fɔ lɛ yu go ɔndastand.
Dis go mek yu no aw fɔ biev yusɛf, ɛn di wɔd dɛnsɛf we go kɔmɔt na yu mɔt go sho se yu gɛt sɛns.
Pipul wɛf we gɛt swit mɔt tan lɛkɛ ɔni; in kis swit lɛk fayn ɔyl,
bɔt wɛn i chenj pan yu, i go bita lɛk rut ɔ shap lɛk nɛf we dɛn jɛs shap.
If yu fala am, yu go go ɔdɔun; di rod we i de waka na day rod,
i nɔ de waka na rod we de gi layf; i jɛs de drif de go, ɛn nɔ no usay i de go sɛf.
Una dɛn bɔypikin dɛn, una lisin to mi, ɛn una nɔ fɔgɛt wetin a de tɔk.
Una nɔ go nia dis kayn uman ya! Ɛn nɔ go nia in os sɛf!
Ɔ nɔ so yu go lɔs yu rɛspɛkt, ɛn day fɔ natin usay dɛn nɔ de sho masi.
Ɛn wɛn dat apin, na trenja dɛn go tek ɔl yu prɔpati, ɛn ɔl wetin yu dɔn lebɔ fɔ go go to trenja;
wɛn yu go si se yu dɔn dɔn, ɛn yu bɔdi nɔ ebul du natin igen,
na da tɛm de yu go se if a bin no. Yu aks yusɛf se, “Wetin mek a nɔ de lan lɛsin? Wetin mek a nɔ bin de yɛri wɔd?
A nɔ bin de pe atɛnshɔn to wetin mi ticha dɛn bin de tɛl mi mayn, a nɔ bin de yɛri wɔd.
Naw luk di kaynaba shem ɛn disgres we dɔn mit mi, ɔlman de laf mi.”
Lan fɔ drink wata na yu yon bokit, lɛ i kɔmɔt na yu yon wɛl.
Yuwant fɔ de skata yu sid ɔlɔbɔt na trit?
Nɔ! Lɛ i bi fɔ yu wangren nɔmɔ, nɔto fɔ trenja.
Yu fɔ liv api wan wit yu wɛf, ɛnjɔy di uman we yu mared wɛn una yɔŋ.
I fayn lɛk tin fɔ it, ɛn in bɔbi de mek yu gladi ɔltɛm; wans yu tes in lɔv yu nɔ go wan lɛf am.
Mi pikin, wetin fɔ mek yu put an pan uman we nɔto yu yon? Wetin mek yu fɔ lidɔm wit ɔda man wɛf?
PAPA GƆD de si ɔl wetin pɔsin de du, ɛn ɛnisay we i de go, i de wach am.
Di bad tin we pɔsin de du na trap, ɛn na da vɛri trap de de kech am.
I de day bikɔs i nɔ ebul kɔntrol insɛf. Nain ful de kɛr am go nain grev.
Mi pikin, if yu dɔn tinap fɔ pɔsin, ɔ trenja we o dɛt,
ɔ if yu mɔt put yu pan trɔbul, ɔ yu mek prɔmis we yu nɔ ebul kip,
wɛl, mi pikin, na dis yu fɔ du fɔ sev yusɛf na di pɔsin we yu o in an: rɔn kwik go mit am ɛn beg am fɔ lɛ i lɛf yu.
Nɔ slip o, ɛn nɔ westɛm.
Sev yusɛf lɛkɛ aw dia kin sev insɛf na ɔntinman in an, ɔ bɔd we dɛn wan kech am.
Yu lezi awns, go luk aw dɛn anch de liv ɛn falamakata dɛn.
Dɛn nɔ gɛt chif, dɛn nɔ gɛt ɔfisa, ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt edman,
bɔt dɛn de fɛn it ɛn kip am insay dray sizin fɔ ren sizin.
Yu lesman, aw lɔŋ yu go de lidɔm, lidɔm? Ustɛm yu go grap?
I se lɛ in jɛs gɛt smɔl slip nɔmɔ, lɛ i sɛt yay lilibit, lɛ i jɛs fol in an ɛn blo lilibit;
na so i tek tɔn popoliopo, bikɔs i de slip nɔmɔ; ɛn po go atak am lɛkɛ se na tifman klia in os.
Pɔsin we nɔ fit natin, bad mɔtalman, nain de pas ɛn tɔk lay tɔk.
Dɛn kin de wink dɛn yay fɔ sho se na lay dɛn de lay.
Dɛn kin de tink fas fas ɛn de pas fɔ kɔz trɔbul ɔltɛm.
Bɔt na big, big dombolo gɛt fɔ fɔdɔm pan dɛn we dɛn nɔ go mekɔp, ɛn dɛn go wund bad, bad wan.

Siks tin dɛn de we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk, infakt na sɛvin sɛf we i et bad, bad wan: Pɔsin we fil tu gud bɔt insɛf, pɔsin we lɛk fɔ lay, pɔsin we de kil fɔ natin, dɛn at we de plan bad tin, fut we de magomago fɔ du bad, witnɛs we de lay ɔlkayn lay ɛn koŋosa, ɛn we de briŋ plaba bitwin padi dɛn.
Mi pikin, du wetin yu papa tɛl yu fɔ du, ɛn nɔ fɔgɛt wetin yu mama dɔn tich yu.
Lɛ ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn tɛl yu de na yu at.
Wetin dɛn dɔn tɛl yu go de gayd yu we yu de waka na layf ɛn ivin wɛn yu de slip sɛf na nɛt, ɛn i go bi gud advays fɔ yu de tɛm.
Wetin dɛn dɔn tɛl yu go tan lɛkɛ layt to yu, ɛn ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn tich yu go sho yu aw fɔ liv,
fɔ lɛ yu nɔ go na bad uman in we, ɛn nɔ fala pipul wɛf in switmɔt.
Nɔ mek di uman in fayn kɔnfyus yu; nɔ mek in yay sɛf drɔ yu nain trap.
Man kin lidɔm wit rare gyal ɛn gi am mɔni we kin bay wan plet rɛs; bɔt if i lidɔm wit pipul wɛf, i go lɔs in layf.
Yu dɔn si man put faya insay in pɔkit dɔn i nɔ bɔn am?
Ɔ yu dɔn si man mas ɔt fayakol i nɔ bɔn in fut?
Wɛl, na so i go tan fɔ di man we kip in kɔmpin in wɛf; ɛnibɔdi we tɔch am nɔ de go fri.
Wɛn tifman aŋri ɛn go tif, dɛn nɔ de bit am?
Ɛn wɛn dɛn kech am, i de pe sɛvin tɛm mɔ pas di tin we i tif; ɛn na ɔl wetin i gɛt i go tek pe di dɛt.
Udat de kip pipul wɛf nɔ gɛt wan sɛns nain ed. Nainsɛf i de pwɛl.
Dɛn go bit am ɛn disgres am, ɛn da shem de nɔ go ɛva kɔmɔt pan am.
Wɛn man de jɛlɔs i de vɛks bad bad wan, ɛn i nɔ kin no wetin i de du.
I nɔ de tek nɔn pe, ɛn natin nɔ de na wɔl we yu go tek kol in at.
Mi pikin, mɛmba ɔl wetin a de tɛl yu ɛn nɔ fɔgɛt natin we a tɛl yu fɔ du.
Tek wetin a de tich yu ɛn yu go gɛt lɔŋ layf, ol am gud lɛkɛ se na eg.
Lɛ ɔl wetin a dɔn tɛl yu de wit yu ɔltɛm, lɛ i de na yu at.
Lɛ sɛns bi yu sista, ɛn lɛ di pawa fɔ si fa bi yu tayt padi,
fɔ mek yu nɔ si pipul wɛf, ɛn dɛn uman wit swit mɔt.
Wande a bin de luk winda,
nain a si bɔku yɔŋ pipul we nɔ gɛt wan ɛkspiriɛns; bɔt a notis wan patikla wan we in ful bad, bad wan.
I bin de waka kɔna na wan trit usay wan patikla uman in os bin de.
Da tɛm de na tɛm we lamp bin dɔn layt, infakt nɛt sɛf bin dɔn kam.
Nain di uman go mit am, i drɛs lɛk rare gyal; i bin de plan sɔntin.
Na uman we gɛt maynd ɛn nɔ gɛt wan shem. Ɔltɛm i de na trit.
Infakt wan minit i de na trit, wan minit i de na makit, ɔda minit i de na dɛn kɔna de ɛŋ de.
Wantɛm nain i grip dis bɔy ɛn kis am. Wit dray yay i luk di bɔy pin nain yay ɛn tɛl am se,
in mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD da de de fɔ du wetin i prɔmis ɛn bɔku tin de nain os fɔ it.
I se in bin de luk fɔ am ɔl di tɛm, ɛn in dɔn si am.
I se in dɔn prɛd fayn bedshit nain bed we i ɔda frɔm Ijipt,
ɛn in dɔn spre fayn, fayn ma, alo ɛn sinamɔn pafyum,
so, lɛ dɛn go mek lɔv ol nɛt te do klin, lɛ dɛn ɛnjɔy dɛnsɛf.
I se infakt sɛf in man nɔ de, i go patrol;
I se in man kɛr wan bag mɔni go, ɛn na tu wik i go fɔ.
I yuz in swit mɔt fɔ gɛt di bɔy, ɛn insɛf wɛr nain trap.
I nɔ tink sɛf, nain i fala am go lɛkɛ we dɛn de kɛr ship fɔ go kil am, jɛs lɛk aw dia kin fɔdɔm na trap
te dɛn chuk in gɔt wit aro; lɛk bɔd nɔmɔ we de fɔdɔm na trap, we nɔ no se nain layf i de risk.
Una dɛn bɔypikin, una lisin to mi, una yɛri wɔd.
Una nɔ mek dis kayn uman win una lɔv, una nɔ go in we.
Na biɛn am bɔku man dɔn alaki ɛn i dɔn mek bɔku dɔn lɔs dɛn layf.
If yu se nain yu de fasin, wɛl, na shɔt kɔt yu de fɛn fɔ go ɔdɔun.
Ɔlman lisin O! Sɛns de kɔl bak. I se if una nɔ de ɔndastand.
I tinap pantap dɛn ay, ay mawnten, i dɔn tek in stand na forod.
Usay ɔlman de pas na di siti, na de i go tinap de tɔk.
I se, “Na ɔlman we de na yaso a de tɔk to; a de kɔl ɔlman na wɔl fɔ lisin.
Una we nɔ gɛt wan ɛkspiriɛns, una tray gɛt sɛns, Una we ful, unasɛf tray gɛt sɛns.
Una lisin, na sɛns tɔk a de kam tɔk so, di wɔd dɛn we de kɔmɔt na mi mɔt na rayt tin.
Na di tru a de tɔk mi na pɔsin we et lay bad, bad.
Ɔl wetin a de tɔk na tru, nɔn bɛnbɛn ɔ twis twis nɔ de pan am.
Fɔ udat de ɔndastand, na tret tɔk to am; ɛn dɛn wan we no, ɔltin klia to dɛn.
Tek mi advays, i pas silva, pik sɛns, i pas piɔ gold.
“Bikɔs sɛns bɛtɛ pas dayamɔn, natin nɔ de we pas sɛns na wɔl.
Na mi dɛn de kɔl sɛnsman, ɛn a gɛt kɔmɔn sɛns, a no bɔku tin ɛn a no wetin rayt.
Fɔ fred PAPA GƆD na fɔ et fɔ du bad. A et yu de kak ɛn tink tumɔs ɔf insɛf ɛn lɛk fɔ du bad dɔn i gɛt tu siti.
A sabi gi gud advays ɛn sabi wok mi plan, a de si fa ɛn a trɔŋ.
Na mi de mek kiŋ dɛn rul gud ɛn mek gud lɔ dɛn.
Na mi de mek ɔl di rula dɛn na wɔl rul gud, big bigman dɛnsɛf want mi fɔ ɛp dɛn.
A lɛk dɛn wan we lɛk mi, udat de luk fɔ mi go si mi.
A kin gi pɔsin bɔku jɛntri ɛn ɔna, a de mek dɛn mɔni nɔ dɔn ɛn bɛtɛ go fala dɛn.
Ɛnitin we a gi yu bɛtɛ pas piɔ gold, i bɛtɛ pas piɔ silva.
A de du tin tret wan, a de trit pipul fia wan.
A de gi jɛntri to dɛn wan we lɛk mi, ɛn ful-ɔp dɛn sto wit ɔlkayn gud tin.
“We PAPA GƆD bigin du in wok, na mi fɔs i mek bifo i mek ɛnitin na mi fɔs i mek.
I dɔn te we a de, na mi fɔs de bifo di wɔl bigin.
A bin dɔn de bifo di oshɔn dɛn kam na wɔl, da tɛm de nɔn wata sɛf nɔ bin de flo.
A bin dɔn de bifo di mawnten dɛn kam na wɔl, bifo di il dɛn go na dɛn ples,
bifo PAPA GƆD mek di wɔl ɛn di bush dɛn, we nɔn grɔn nɔ bin de yet.
A bin dɔn de wɛn PAPA GƆD mek di skay, ɛn di si fɔ de brakɛt;
wɛn PAPA GƆD gɛda di klawd dɛn ɔp na di skay, ɛn wɛn i mek ɔl dɛn riva de flo go na di oshɔn;
wɛn i mek bawndri fɔ di oshɔn, fɔ lɛ di wata nɔ pas in mak wɛn i mek di grɔn sidɔm fayn nain ples.
A bin de nia PAPA GƆD lɛkɛ man we de drɔ plan, a bin de mek i gladi ɛvride, ɛn misɛf bin gladi fɔ de wit am,
a gladi fɔ di wɔl we PAPA GƆD mek, ɛn fɔ di pipul sɛf we i mek put de.
“Naw, una dɛn yɔŋ pipul, una lisin to mi, i go fayn fɔ udat du wetin a se.
If una lisin to wetin a se ɛn nɔ tɔn una bak pan mi, una go gɛt sɛns.
I go fayn fɔ udat de lisin to wetin a de se, we de wet na mi domɔt ɔltɛm ɛn de tinap na di rod we a de pas fɔ go na os.
Udat fɛn mi go gɛt lɔŋ layf, ɛn PAPA GƆD sɛf go blɛs am;
bɔt udat nɔ fɛn mi nainsɛf i de du; udat nɔ lɛk mi lɛk fɔ day.”
Sɛns tan lɛkɛ pɔsin we bil in os, dɔn i put sɛvin pila fɔ sɔpɔt am.
I kil animal fɔ mek pati, dɔn i mek gud pɔnch wayn ɛn le tebul.
I sɛn in uman savant dɛn na dɛn impɔtant say dɛn na di siti fɔ go tɔk se,
ɛnibɔdi we nɔ machɔ ɛn we nɔ gɛt sɛns, lɛ i go di pati,
fɔ go it di it ɛn drink di pɔnch wayn we i dɔn miks.
Dɛn se if dɛn want fɔ ɛnjɔy dɛn layf, lɛ dɛn lɛf fɔ kip kɔmpin wit dɛn wan we nɔ gɛt sɛns; ɛn lɛ dɛn tink gud.
Udat kɔrɛkt pɔsin we nɔ de tek natin mek natin de fɛn kɔs fɔ insɛf. We yu kɔrɛkt bad pɔsin, na bad nem yu de fɛn fɔ yusɛf.
Nɔ kɔrɛkt pɔsin we nɔ de tek natin mek natin; if yu du dat i go et yu; bɔt if yu kɔrɛkt yu gɛt sɛns, i go rɛspɛkt yu.
If yu tich pɔsin we gɛt sɛns, i go gɛt mɔ sɛns; if yu tich pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, i go no bɔt mɔ tin dɛm.
If yu want fɔ gɛt sɛns na layf, di fɔs tin we yu fɔ du na fɔ biliv PAPA GƆD ɛn fred am; if yu sabi PAPA GƆD, yu dɔn gɛt sɛns.
If yu gɛt sɛns yu go liv lɔŋ na wɔl, ɛn yu go de te yu ol.
Udat gɛt sɛns, gɛt sɛns fɔ insɛf; udat nɔ gri lan sɛns, nain nɔmɔ go sɔfa.
Ful na lɛk dɛn lawzi uman we nɔ gɛt wan shem.
I kin sidɔm nain domɔt, ɔ sidɔm na dɛn impɔtant ples na di siti,
de kɔl dɛn wan we de pas, we de go abawt dɛn biznɛs se,
“Una we nɔ machɔ ɛn we nɔ gɛt sɛns, una kam ya!
A no se una de ɛnjɔy fɔ it ɔda man it, tin we na tif tin kin swit.”
Bɔt di wan dɛn we de rɔnata am nɔ no se na trap we de kil dɛn de go, ɛn dat, dɛn wan we dɔn fɔdɔm nain trap, dɔn go ɔdɔun.
Dis na Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn in parebul dɛn: Pikin we gɛt sɛns de mek in papa in ed big; bɔt di wan we ful de pwɛl in mami in at.
Ɛni jɛntri we yu gɛt bay kruk nɔ de mek yu bɛtɛ, bɔt raychɔs layf de gi lɔŋ layf.
PAPA GƆD nɔ de mek pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay go slip aŋri, bɔt udat bad, i nɔ de mek i gɛt wetin i want.
If yu les, yu go po, bɔt if yu de wok traŋa, yu go jɛntri.
Pikin we gɛt sɛns de avɛst, avɛst tɛm; bɔt pikin we de slip avɛst tɛm de mek in famili shem.
Pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay de gɛt blɛsin, bad pɔsin de ayd wetin i mekɔp fɔ du bay wetin i de tɔk.
Ɔltɛm dɛn go de mɛmba di wan we raychɔs in gud nem, bɔt bad pɔsin in nem go rɔtin.
Udat gɛt sɛns de tek gud advays, bɔt yu gɛt big tɔk nɔmɔ nain mɔt nɔ de ɛnd fayn.
Udat de si fa de tek tɛm wit wetin i de du, bɔt dɛn go kech udat de pan dabaru.
Udat de ayd tru wɔd de briŋ kuskas, bɔt yu de tɔk tru gbangbaode de briŋ pis.
Wɔd we de kɔmɔt na pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay in mɔt na lɛkɛ spriŋ wata we de gi layf, bɔt bad pɔsin de ayd wetin i mekɔp fɔ du bay wetin i de tɔk.
Bad at de briŋ plaba, bɔt lɔv de mek pɔsin fɔgiv.
Pɔsin we gɛt sɛns nain de tɔk sɛns tɔk, bɔt styupid pɔsin na tik fɔ tek wok am.
Dɛn wan we gɛt sɛns nɔ de taya fɔ lan, bɔt wɛn fulman tɔk, yu no se trɔbul nɔ de fa frɔm am.
If yu gɛt kɔpɔ natin nɔ de ebul yu, bɔt if yu po, waala nɔ de kɔmɔt biɛn yu.
Pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay in pe na lɔŋ layf, bɔt bad pɔsin nɔ de ɛnd fayn.
Udat yɛri wɛn dɛn kɔrɛkt am de gɛt lɔŋ layf, bɔt yu nɔ yɛri go si am.
Udat de ayd in bad at na layman, ɛn yu de koŋosa na fulman.
Udat de tɔk tɔk bɔku de lay, bɔt yu de kɔntrol in mɔt gɛt sɛns.
Di wɔd we de kɔmɔt na pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay in mɔt tan lɛk piɔ silva; bɔt bad pɔsin nɔ de tink bɛtɛ tin.
Wɛn gud pɔsin de tɔk, plɛnti pipul de bɛnifit, bɔt fulman de day bifo in tɛm, fɔ in ful.
Na PAPA GƆD in gres de mek yu jɛntri, i lɛk yu wok traŋa te yu nɔ go jɛntri.
Na fulman de tek bad mek gem, bɔt yu gɛt sɛns de gladi fɔ in gud karakta.
Wetin bad pɔsin de fred pas ɔl nain go apin to am, bɔt wetin pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay want, PAPA GƆD go gi am.
Wɛn big tinada blo i nɔ de lɛf bad pɔsin, bɔt yu raychɔs de tinap deŋ!
Nɔ sɛn lesman fɔ du sɔntin fɔ yu, ɔ nɔ so, lɛkɛ aw viniga sawa na mɔt ɛn smok de bɔn yay, na so i go bi fɔ yu.
Udat fred PAPA GƆD yu go gɛt lɔŋ layf, bɔt yu bad na shɔt layf i de gɛt.
Di op we di pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay gɛt de mek i gladi, bɔt yu bad, in plan nɔ de ɛva wok.
PAPA GƆD de kɔba udat ɔnɛs, bɔt udat bad i de mek i alaki.
Pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay nɔ go ɛva staga, bɔt bad pɔsin nɔ go te na di land.
Pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay de tɔk sɛns tɔk, bɔt dɛn go lɔk yu de lay, in mɔt.
Wɛn pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay de tɔk na wetin pipul wan yɛri, bɔt as fɔ bad pɔsin, na lay nɔmɔ in de lay.
PAPA GƆD et udat de rog pan mɛzhɔmɛnt, bɔt i kin pliz wit yu de mɛzhɔ kɔrɛkt.
Udat de kak go de butu in ed na grɔn ɔltɛm, bɔt yu put insɛf dɔŋ gɛt sɛns.
Udat tret, nain tret wande gayd am na layf; bɔt yu bɛnbɛn, nain bɛnbɛn wande alaki am.
Mɔni nɔ de sev pɔsin wɛn in tɛm rich fɔ day, bɔt if i ɔnɛs, PAPA GƆD go sev am.
Udat de du tin tret wan, nain tret wande ɛp am na layf; bɔt yu bad, nain bad de mek i alaki.
Udat de du tin tret wan, nain tret wande sev am bɔt na di gridi we yu bɛnbɛn gridi de kech am.
Wɛn bad pɔsin day, ɔl wetin i abop pan de day go wit am, di jɛntri we i abop pan ɔl na natin.
PAPA GƆD de sev pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay pan trɔbul, bɔt udat bad, trɔbul nɔ de kɔmɔt biɛn am.
Na udat nɔ no PAPA GƆD de tek in mɔt pwɛl in kɔmpin, bɔt yu gɛt sɛns go sev am na dɛn an.
Wɛn bɛtɛ de fala gud pipul na siti, ɔlman de gladi, semweso wɛn bad pɔsin day, ɔlman de gladi.
PAPA GƆD de blɛs di siti we raychɔs pipul de, bɔt wetin bad pipul se kin pwɛl di siti.
Udat de lili in kɔmpin nɔ gɛt sɛns, bɔt udat gɛt sɛns de kip wetin i tink to insɛf.
Udat gɛt rɔnmɔt, nɔ de kip sikrit, bɔt yu de kɔntrol in mɔt kin sikrit.
Tɔŋ we pipul nɔ de fɔ gi advays, ɔlman de lɔs trak; bɔt usay advaysa dɛn de, di siti de bɛtɛ.
Udat tinap fɔ trenja go gɛt trɔbul; bɔt yu nɔ du dat, de sev insɛf.
Fayn uman we gɛt trenin de gɛt rɛspɛkt. Man we de wok traŋa wande jɛntri.
Yu du gud i du am fɔ insɛf, yu du bad i du am fɔ insɛf.
Bad nɔ de pe ɛnibɔdi gud tin bɔt yu du gud de gɛt gud pe.
Udat mekɔp in maynd fɔ du wetin rayt go gɛt lɔŋ layf, bɔt yu mekɔp fɔ de du bad go gɛt shɔt layf.
PAPA GƆD et bad at pɔsin, bɔt as fɔ dɛn wan dɛn we de du di tin tret wan, i lɛk dɛn.
Nɔn bad pɔsin nɔ de we nɔ de gɛt in pe, bɔt wan krach nɔ go tɔch gud pɔsin.
Ɛni fayn uman we nɔ gɛt sɛns tan lɛkɛ ɔg we dɛn put gold riŋ nain nos.
Ɛnitin we gud pɔsin de mekɔp kin kɔmɔt fayn bɔt wɛn bad pɔsin mekɔp sɔntin, ɔlman kin vɛks.
Udat gɛt fri an ɛn de du gud de gɛt mɔ; bɔt yu de mek nɔ gɛt nɔ go gɛt.
Udat nɔ de skyad fɔ du gud de payl jɛntri fɔ insɛf; ɛn yu de gi in kɔmpin fɔ drink, dɛn go gi insɛf bak fɔ drink.
Dɛn wan we de ayd rɛs fɔ big big prɔfit, ɔltɛm dɛn go de tɔk bad bɔt dɛn; bɔt dɛn wan we de put dɛn yon fɔ sɛl de gɛt prez.
Udat de du in bɛst fɔ du gud de gɛt rɛspɛkt; bɔt yu de fɛn trɔbul, trɔbul de fɛn am.
Udat put in yay pan in jɛntri go fɔdɔm lɛk dray lif; bɔt gud pɔsin go frɛsh lɛkɛ grin lif.
If yu briŋ trɔbul kam na yu os, yu nem nɔ de de na wil. Fulman go de bi jakas fɔ sɛnsman ɔltɛm.
Udat liv raychɔs layf de mek ɔda pipul bɛnifit; ɛn yu gɛt sɛns de mek pipul de rawnd am.
If udat raychɔs de gɛt in pe na ya; mɔs no uskayn pe bad pɔsin go gɛt.
Udat lɛk fɔ lɛ dɛn kɔrɛkt am lɛk fɔ lan, bɔt yu nɔ lɛk kɔrɛkshɔn, bigful.
PAPA GƆD de blɛs dɛn wan we gud, bɔt i go jɔj dɛn wan we de mekɔp bad tin.
Bad nɔ de pe nɔbɔdi gud tin, bɔt natin nɔ de shek pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay.
Gud wɛf de mek in man fil prawd, bɔt uman we de put shem pan in man tan lɛkɛ bad sik na bɔdi.
Pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay de mekɔp gud tin ɔltɛm, bɔt bad pɔsin nɔ de mɛmba gud fɔ in kɔmpin.
Di wɔd we de kɔmɔt na bad pɔsin mɔt, na fɔ pwɛl mɔtalman, bɔt di wan we de kɔmɔt na pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, in yon mɔt, na fɔ sev in kɔmpin.
Bad pɔsin in wok nɔ de ɛnd fayn, bɔt pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay in wok go de sote go.
If yu gɛt sɛns, dɛn go prez yu, bɔt if yu de mek ful, dɛn nɔ go luk yu wit bɛtɛ yay.
I bɛtɛ yu de ɔdinari wande wok fɔ yusɛf, pas fɔ yu de wok fɔ yu dɔn yu nɔ gɛt tin fɔ it.
Pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay de trit in animal dɛn gud, bɔt bad pɔsin nɔ de bisin bɔt in yon.
Udat wok gud go gɛt wetin i de it, bɔt udat de fala briz nɔ gɛt sɛns.
Ɔl wetin bad pɔsin lɛk na fɔ kapu kapu bad pɔsin in prɔpati, bɔt natin nɔ de shek pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay.
Pɔsin we bad nain yon mɔt de sɛl am, bɔt pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay nɔ de lɛf pan trɔbul.
Lɛkɛ aw man de bɛnifit frɔm di gud wɔd we de kɔmɔt nain mɔt, na so udat wok traŋa wan go gɛt di pe.
Fulman de tink se in kɔrɛkt ɔltɛm, bɔt yu gɛt sɛns de lisin to advays!

Mi pikin, yɛri wɔd ɛn biev yusɛf, nɔ mek natin kɔnfyus yu na layf.
Nɔ miks wit drɔnk kabudu, ɔ bigyay ɛn awaŋɔt mɔtalman dɛn,
drɔnkɔman o, bigyay man o, ɛn awaŋɔt man o, dɛn ɔl gɛt fɔ day po, ɛn udat de drɔŋɔ ɛn kɔlik, na pisis go lɛf nain bɔdi.
Lisin to yu papa we bɔn yu ɛn nɔ fɔgɛt fɔ mɛn yu mama we i ol.
Nɔ skyad fɔ spɛnd fɔ lɛ yu no di tru ɛn we yu gɛt am, nɔ mek bigful te yu lɔs am, ɛn tray fɔ lan, no wetin rayt frɔm rɔŋ, ɛn ɔndastand wetin yu de du.
Papa de ɔltɛm gladi wɛn in pikin liv raychɔs layf, ɛn if pɔsin bɔn pikin we gɛt sɛns, in ed de big.
Pikin fɔ de mek in mama ɛn papa gladi; nɔ fɔgɛt fɔ de mek yu mama we bɔn yu gladi.
Mi pikin, pe atɛnshɔn to wetin a de tɛl yu, tray fɔ de fala mi ɛgzampul.
Rare gyal fiba dip, dip ol, ɛn bambot mared uman tan lɛkɛ bad trap.
Dɛn kin de ayd na kɔna lɛkɛ am rɔba ɛn mek bɔku man tɔn plebɔy.
Na udat kin alaki ɛn gɛt bɔku yagba? Udat lɛk fɔ de sɛt gbosgbos ɛn agyu? Udat kin gɛt brusbrus nain bɔdi we nɔbɔdi nɔ fɛt am? Udat in yay kin rɛd lɛk faya?
Na dɛn wan we de drɔŋɔ ol nɛt; dɛn wan we de miksɔp ɔlkayn rɔm na dɛn bɛlɛ.
Nɔ put yu yay pan di rɛd we di wayn rɛd na di bɔtul lɛk aw i de bɔbul insay di glas, ɛn nɔ de bɔn di trot we i de go nɔ dɔŋ;
Wɛn i dɔn dɔn wit yu, i go tan lɛk fɔ se na bad snek bɛt yu, wit in pɔyzin.
Yu yay go bigin de dɔl, ɛn yu go de si tin tu, tu; yu nɔ go de tink kɔrɛkt wan, ɛn wetin yu nɔ want tɔk nain yu go de tɔk.
Yu go de fil ay lɛk fɔ se na tot dɛn tot yu; yu go jɛs de go rawnd ɛn rawnd;
yu go de tɔk se, “dɛn nak yu, bɔt yu nɔ fil am; dɛn bit yu, bɔt yu nɔ mɛmba natin. Infakt sɛf wɛn yu wek yu go drink mɔ.”
Nɔ jɛlɔs bad mɔtalman, ɛn nɔ jɔyn kɔmpin wit am.
Wetin i sidɔm fɔ gbɛt na fɔ du bad, ɛn ɛnitɛm we i opin in mɔt, na trɔbul.
Na sɛns pɔsin de yuz fɔ bil os, na sɛns i de yuz fɔ le gud fawndeshɔn.
Na sɛns i de yuz fɔ put ɔlkayn dia ɛn fayn dɛkɔreshɔn de.
Man we gɛt sɛns gɛt pawa pas man we gɛt trɛnk; pawa pas trɛnk,
bikɔs na yu sɛns yu de yuz fɔ plan fɔ go fɛt wa, ɛn di mɔ yu gɛt gud advays, na di mɔ chans yu gɛt fɔ win.
Tumɔs sɛns tɔk tu dip fɔ fulman fɔ ɔndastand. Usay sɛnsman dɛn de tɔk, fulman kin jɛs mumu.
Udat lɛk fɔ de plan bad, dɛn go se i ambɔgin.
Ɛnitin we fulman plan na sin ɛn udat nɔ de tek natin mek natin na pɔsin we nɔbɔdi nɔ want nia am.
If yu giv ɔp di tɛm we prɔblɛm mit yu, wɛl, yu nɔto bɛtɛ pɔsin.
Nɔ fred fɔ sev pɔsin we dɛn de go kil fɔ natin.
If yu se nɔto yu biznɛs, yu nɔ tink se PAPA GƆD de si yu? In we de kɔba yu ɛvride ɛn no wetin yu de tink, i nɔ go pe yu fɔ wetin yu du?
Mi pikin, de it ɔni bikɔs i gud fɔ yu. Lɛkɛ aw ɔni swit na mɔt,
na so sɛns gud fɔ yu layf; if yu gɛt sɛns, dat na yu abop fɔ di bambay, ɛn yu nɔ go ɛva disapɔynt.
Nɔ le ambush fɔ atak pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay nain os, nɔ ambɔg am atɔl;
i lɛk ɔmɔs tɛm pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay fɔdɔm i de grap bak, bɔt wɛn bad pɔsin fɔdɔm, i nɔ de ɛva grap.
Nɔ laf wɛn yu ɛnimi fɔdɔm, nɔ gladi we i staga ɛn fɔdɔm.
If yu du dat PAPA GƆD go vɛks pan yu dɔn i nɔ go pɔnish am igen
Nɔ wɔri yusɛf bikɔs ɔf bad mɔtalman; nɔ jɛlɔs dɛn,
bikɔs nɔn bɛtɛ tin nɔ de fɔ am tumara, i go day.
Mi pikin, ɔna ɛn rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD ɛn di kiŋ, nɔ fala nɔbɔdi fɔ biev lɛkɛ rebɛl pan dɛn,
bikɔs wɛn yu nɔ mekɔp nain dɛn go ib masibo pan yu, ɛn yu nɔ go ebul fɔ no aw fa di trɔbul go go.
Dɛn wan yaso sɛf na ɔda gud advays: I nɔ fayn we yu de jɔj kes yu tek wan pɔsin in pat.
Ɛnibɔdi we de jɔj kes we fri pɔsin we gilti, ɔlman go swɛ am ɛn bɔku kɔntri go was mɔt pan am,
bɔt di jɔj we sɛntɛns udat gilti go gɛt prez ɛn gud nem, i go gɛt blɛsin.
Ɛnibɔdi we tɔk tru de sho lɔv lɛkɛ we pɔsin kin kis in kɔmpin.
Mek yu plan gud, mek yu fam ɛn plant bifo yu de se yu de bil os.
Nɔ tinap as witnɛs fɔ yu kɔmpin we yu nɔ gɛt rizin, ɛn nɔ lay de.
Nɔ se yu de tɔn dɛt gi yu kɔmpin ɛn dil wit am fɔ wetin i du yu.
A bin de waka wande na wan lesman in fam, man we nɔ gɛt sɛns in greps gadin,
nain wantɛm a si soso chukchuk, na soso gras bin kɔba di wanol ples ɛn di wɔl sɛf bin dɔn brok.
A luk pin ɛn tink to misɛf ɛn pik sɛns.
I se lɛ in jɛs gɛt smɔl slip nɔmɔ, lɛ i nɔd lilibit, lɛ i jɛs fol in an ɛn blo lilibit;
na so i tek tɔn popoliopo bikɔs i de slip nɔmɔ. Ɛn na so po go atak am lɛkɛ am rɔba.
Dis na mɔ pan Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn in advays ɛn parebul dɛn we Kiŋ Ɛzikaya na Juda in sɛktri dɛn bin gɛda.
PAPA GƆD de gɛt ɔna pan di tin dɛn we i de ayd pan wi, bɔt kiŋ dɛn de gɛt ɔna pan di tin dɛn we dɛn sabi ɛn de ɛksplen bɔt.
Lɛkɛ aw ɛvin de fawe frɔm di ath, na so nɔbɔdi nɔ de ɛva no wetin de na kiŋ in at.
If yu pul ɔl di dɔti we de pan silva, di silvasmit go ebul fɔ mek fayn tin.
Na semweso if dɛn pul bad advaysa dɛn kɔmɔt nia kiŋ, i go du tin tret wan.
Nɔ magomago mek yusɛf impɔtant bifo kiŋ, ɔ put yusɛf usay yu nɔ rich usay bigman dɛn de,
i bɛtɛ lɛ dɛn invayt yu fɔ go bifo pas fɔ pul yu frɔnt go biɛn usay bigman dɛn de.
Wetin yu yay dɔn si, nɔ magomago go tɔk am na kot, bikɔs if ɔda pɔsin go gi witnɛs se na lay yu de lay, yu go put yusɛf pan shem.
If yu ɛn yu kɔmpin gɛt plaba, una tɔk am; bɔt nɔ bigin fɔ pul in sikrit na do,
lɛ ɔda pɔsin yɛri. If yu du dat, nɔbɔdi nɔ go biliv yu igen fɔ yu rɔnmɔt.
Ɛni wɔd we yu tɔk di rayt tɛm tan lɛk we yu tek gold mek fayn dizayn pan silva sɛtin.
Wɛn pɔsin we gɛt sɛns gi advays to pɔsin we rɛdi fɔ lan, i bɛtɛ pas piɔ gold riŋ ɔ gold chen.
Lɛkɛ aw kol wata kin satisfay wɛn dɛn de avɛst insay dray sizin, na so mɛsenja we tret de tan to udat sɛn am, i kin mek i blo kam dɔŋ.
Lɛkɛ aw klawd kin de gɛda ɛn briz blo fɔ lɛ ren kam bɔt i nɔ kam, na so man we gɛt big tɔk tan.
Udat gɛt peshɛnt de ebul kɔnvins bigman, ɛn if yu sabi tɔk, yu de mek pɔsin we in at trɔŋ gɛt saf-at.
If yu fɛn ɔni, lik wetindu fɔ yu. If yu mek bigyay yu go kɔlik ɛn vɔmit.
Lɛ yu fut nɔ de de na yu kɔmpin in domɔt ɛvride, ɔ nɔ so i go gens wit yu ɛn et yu biznɛs.
Pɔsin we de lay pan in kɔmpin kin kil, lɛk aw wɛpɔn de kil.
Wɛn yu abop pan pɔsin we nɔto bɛtɛ mɔtalman, i tan lɛkɛ we yu gɛt bad tit ɔ yu gɛt bad fut.
Wɛn yu de siŋ fɔ pɔsin we gɛt brokat, i tan lɛk we yu tek pɔsin in klos wɛn ples kol, ɔ wɛn yu put sɔl pan sofut.
If yu ɛnimi aŋri, gi am tin fɔ it; if i tɔsti, gi am wata;
wɛn yu du dat, na swɛ de pak nain ed ɛn PAPA GƆD go blɛs yu fɔ dat.
Lɛkɛ aw di briz we de kɔmɔt na di nɔth de kɔl ren, na so koŋosa de briŋ twis fes.
I bɛtɛ lɛ man tap na fɔl-os pas fɔ tap na os wit uman we lɛk plaba.
Lɛkɛ aw tɔsti pɔsin de fil we i drink kol wata, na so yu de fil we yu yɛri gud nyuz bɔt fawe fambul.
Lɛkɛ aw wɛl wata nɔba fayn fɔ drink we i kin dɔti, na so i nɔba fayn we pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay lɛf bad pɔsin fɔ du wetin i want.
Aw i nɔ fayn fɔ lik tumɔs ɔni, na so i nɔ fayn fɔ de fɛn tumɔs prez.
Pɔsin we nɔ ebul kɔntrol insɛf tan lɛkɛ siti we nɔ gɛt bawndri we ɛnibɔdi kin atak.
Lɛkɛ aw i nɔ fayn we ples de kol dray sizin ɔ ren kam tɛm fɔ avɛst, na so i nɔ fayn fɔ ɔna fulman.
Swɛ nɔ de ol pɔsin fɔ wɔwɔ, i kin tan nɔmɔ lɛkɛ we kres bɔd de flay, flay ɛn nɔ gɛt say fɔ sidɔm.
Yuz wip fɔ lɛ ɔs ɛn dɔŋki du wetin yu want, yuz ken pan fulman.
Nɔ fala fulman agyu, ɔ nɔ so yu go tan lɛk insɛf.
Gi fulman styupid ansa fɔ in ful, dat go mek wi se i nɔ gɛt sɛns.
If yu se na fulman yu want tek mek mɛsenja, na yusɛf yu de du.
Lɛkɛ aw day-fut man in fut kin de dans, dans ɛn nɔ gɛt wan layf, na so fulman in parebul nɔ kin mek sɛns.
If yu prez fulman, i tan lɛk we yu fak sɔntin ɛn i nɔ go fa; na fɔ natin.
Lɛkɛ aw drɔnkɔman go want yuz chukchuk fɔ chuk, na so fulman in parebul nɔ kin mek sɛns.
Ɛnibɔdi we de aya fulman fɔ wok jɛs de ambɔg di ɔda pipul we de wok.
Lɛkɛ aw dɔg kin de lik in vɔmit, na so fulman kin de mek ful ɔltɛm.
Man we no se in na fulman, bɛtɛ pas di man we tink se in no pas aw i no.
Lesman kin se if in kɔmɔt na do fɔ go wok, layɔn go kech am.
Lɛkɛ aw do kin de opin ɛn lɔk bɔt nɔ de go nɔn we, na so les man kin de tɔn, tɔn nain bed.
Sɔm man so les dat ivin wɛn i put in an na pan fɔ it, i nɔ ebul es am put nain mɔt.
Les man de fil to se in gɛt sɛns sɛf pas sɛvin man we kin gi gud rizin fɔ wetin dɛn de du.
Ɛni bizabɔdi we go gbara kes pan pipul tɔk tan lɛkɛ we pɔsin go fɔ ol kres dɔg.
Lɛkɛ aw kresman kin de tek faya wud sɛn pan pipul;
na so man kin de ple in kɔmpin gem, dɔn i se na jok i de jok.
Lɛkɛ aw fayasay nɔ de kech wɛn wud nɔ de, na so usay koŋosa nɔ de, plaba nɔ de de de.
Lɛkɛ aw kol de mek faya ɔt, wud de mek faya kech, na so pɔsin we ambɔgin kin mek plaba bi.
Lɛkɛ aw gud it swit to udat de it am, na so koŋosa tan to udat de lisin to am.
Wɛn pɔsin yuz fayn wɔd fɔ kɔba in bad at, i tan lɛkɛ we dɛn yuz sankamaru silva fɔ kɔba kle pɔt.
Ipokrit pɔsin kin de ayd in trik, bɔt nainsay in at di ipokrit de.
Wɛn i opin in mɔt, nɔ biliv am o, bikɔs na ɔlkayn bad tin kin de nain at.
I go de mek fayn-fayn fɔ kɔba in bad at, bɔt wan fayn de in wes go kɔmɔt na do.
Udat dig ol fɔ in kɔmpin, nainsɛf go fɔdɔm insay de; ɛn if i put ston na rod fɔ lɛ i fɔdɔm, nain sɛf go fɔdɔm pan am.
Na we yu et pɔsin mek yu de lay pan am, if yu mek ipokrit, na pwɛl yu de pwɛl am.
Nɔ bost bɔt tumara bikɔs yu nɔ no wetin go gɛt fɔ apin.
Sɔl nɔ de prez insɛf na sup, lɛ ɔda pɔsin prez yu, i lɛk sɛf na trenja.
Ston ɛn sansan ebi bɔt di trɔbul we fulman kin kɔz pas ɔltu.
Pɔsin we gɛt wamat ɛn lɛk plaba kin pwɛl in kɔmpin, bɔt jɛlɔs pɔsin wɔs pas am.
I bɛtɛ lɛ yu kɔrɛkt pɔsin opin wan pas fɔ de ayd se yu lɛk am.
We yu padi ɔpoz yu na we i lɛk yu, bɔt if yu ɛnimi kis yu mm! Yu fɔ fred.
Bɛlful man nɔ de luk ɔni sɛf se na it; bɔt udat aŋri, miliju farinya sɛf de tes swit nain mɔt.
Man we kin de lɛf in os go jɛs tan lɛkɛ bɔd we na so insɛf kin lɛf os go.
Pafyum ɛn krim de mek pɔsin fil gladi, bɔt wɛn padi tru to yu, i bɛtɛ pas fayn insɛns.
Nɔ fɔgɛt yu padi ɛn yu papa in padi; wɛn yu gɛt prɔblɛm nɔ se yu de go fɛn fambul fɔ ɛp yu; gud neba bɛtɛ pas fawe fambul.
Mi pikin, sho se yu gɛt sɛns ɛn mek a gladi, so a go ebul ansa ɛnibɔdi we briŋ fityay to mi.
Udat gɛt sɛns nain de si denja i ayd pan am, bɔt udat ful de waka go insay de ɛn sɔfa fɔ dat.
Ɛnibɔdi we so styupid fɔ go tinap se in de pe dɛt fɔ trenja, nain prɔpati dɛn go siz te i pe dɔn.
Nɔ wek ali mɔnin ɛn bigin ala tɛl yu neba adu dɛn go se yu de was mɔt pan am.
Uman we lɛk plaba tan lɛk ren we nɔ de kɔt;
fɔ kɔntrol am tan lɛkɛ we yu de tray fɔ kɔntrol briz, ɔ ol ɔyl wit yu ɛmti an.
Lɛkɛ aw ayɛn de kɔt ayɛn, na so pɔsin de kɔba pɔsin.
Yu we plant tik we de bia frut go it di frut, semweso da savant we wok fayn fɔ in masta go gɛt gud nem.
Wɛn yu luk na wata na yu fes yu de si, semweso wɛn yu luk yusɛf gud insay yu at, na yusɛf yu de si tru tru wan.
Lɛkɛ aw grev yad ɛn bɛriŋrɔn nɔ de bɛlful, na so mɔtalman sɛf nɔ de satisfay.
Lɛkɛ aw na faya dɛn de yuz fɔ tɛst gold ɛn silva, na so na bay aw yu biev we pipul prez yu, dɛn go no udat yu bi.
I lɛk aw yu bit fulman na mataodo lɛk kanda rɛs, di ful nɔ go kɔmɔt pan am.
Ɛnti yu we de mɛn ship ɛn got no aw dɛn tan, so, mɛn dɛn fayn;
bikɔs mɔni nɔ de de sote go, ɛn udat de rul sɛf nɔ de rul sote go.
Wɛn yu dɔn kɔt di gras fɔ di animal dɛn, dɔn nyu gras bigin gro,
yu go gɛt wul frɔm di ship fɔ mek klos dɔn di got go gi yu mɔni fɔ bay mɔ land;
yu go gɛt bɔku got milk fɔ drink, yu famili go gɛt bɔku tin fɔ it ɛn yu wokuman dɛnsɛf go gɛt dɛn yon.
Na bad pɔsin nɔmɔ kin de rɔn wɛn pɔsin nɔ kin de rɔnata am, bɔt pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay in de brev lɛkɛ layɔn.
Wɛn kɔntri nɔ du wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD yay, dɛn go de mek ku ɔltɛm bɔt kɔntri go tinap deŋ if i gɛt lida dɛn we gɛt sɛns.
Wɛn poman ol pozishɔn, dɔn i de aras di po wan pantap dat, i tan lɛkɛ ren we de was ɔltin kɔmɔt na grɔn we nɔn it sɛf nɔ de lɛf.
Dɛn wan we nɔ de obe lɔ de bato dɛn bad pɔsin, bɔt dɛn wan we de obe di lɔ de fɛt dɛn wan we nɔ de obe.
Bad pɔsin nɔ no wetin na fia ple, bɔt udat de wɔship PAPA GƆD no wetin dat min.
I bɛtɛ lɛ yu na poman we de waka tret pas we yu jɛntri pan aramu.
Ɛni yɔŋ pɔsin we obe di lɔ gɛt sɛns, bɔt udat tek awaŋɔt pɔsin mek padi de put udat bɔn am pan shem.
Udat gɛt in jɛntri bay aw i de tek sɔplɔs mɔni frɔm ɔda pipul de gɛda fɔ di pɔsin we de gi poman.
Udat nɔ obe PAPA GƆD in lɔ, PAPA GƆD et in prea ɛn nɔ go ansa dɛnsɛf we i de pre.
Udat put ɔnɛs pɔsin insay fɔ lɛ i du bad go fɔdɔm nain yon trap, bɔt udat waka tret go gɛt blɛsin.
Jɛntri man kin de tink se in gɛt sɛns, bɔt na poman sabi gud ɛn prɔpa aw i tan.
Wɛn pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay gɛt pawa, ɔlman de sɛlibret; bɔt wɛn bad pɔsin gɛt pawa, ɔlman de ayd.
Udat ayd in sin nɔ de mek am na layf; bɔt udat kɔnfɛs in sin ɛn lɛf fɔ du bad, PAPA GƆD go sho am masi.
I go fayn fɔ di pɔsin we de fred ɛn rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD, bɔt udat mek traŋayes go alaki.
Lɛkɛ aw layɔn ɛn bush kaw kin de siz advantej pan dɛn ɔda animal, na so bad rula tan to dɛn po wan we i de rul.
Ɛni rula we nɔ gɛt sɛns de mek di pipul sɔfa, bɔt udat nɔ miks pan kapu kapu ɛn awn awn de gɛt lɔŋ layf.
Pɔsin we dɔn kil, in kɔnshɛns kin de fɛt am, if i wan day, una lɛf am lɛ i day.
Udat de waka wit in ed ɔp nɔ de gɛt wan ambɔgin, bɔt udat bɛnbɛn de rɔndɔŋ.
Udat wok traŋa go gɛt wetin i de it, bɔt udat de rɔnata briz go tɔn to begaman.
Ɔnɛs pɔsin go gɛt blɛsin, bɔt udat de kapu-kapu fɔ gɛda jɛntri nɔ go bɛtɛ.
I nɔ fayn fɔ fevɔ wan pɔsin we yu de jɔj kes, sɔm jɔj kin sɛl in bathrayt fɔ kokoɛbɛ.
Na krabit man kin de rɔnata jɛntri ɛn nɔ de mɛmba sɛf se i kin po ɛnitɛm.
If yu kɔrɛkt yu kɔmpin, i go mɛmba yu tumara; yu bɛtɛ pas dɛn wan we de prez, prez am nɔmɔ.
Ɛnibɔdi we de tif in mami ɛn dadi ɛn se natin nɔ de pan dat tan lɛkɛ ɛni am rɔba.
Bigyay pɔsin de briŋ plaba na ples, bɔt bɛtɛ go fala udat trɔs PAPA GƆD.
Udat biliv pan in yon sɛns nɔmɔ na fulman, bɔt udat liv in layf bay wetin dɛn sɛnsman tich nɔ de gɛt prɔblɛm.
Udat de du gud to poman nɔ de po, bɔt udat tɔn in bak pan poman de fɛn swɛ fɔ insɛf.
Wɛn bad pɔsin gɛt pawa ɔlman de ayd, bɔt wɛn i kapsay, pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay kin tek kɔntrol.
Ɛnibɔdi we de mek traŋayes we dɛn kɔrɛkt am go gɛt trɔbul, ɛn we i nɔ mekɔp, na de i go fɛn in yon day.
Wɛn pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay de rul ɔlman de gladi, bɔt wɛn bad pɔsin de rul ɔlman de grɔmbul.
Pikin we de gladi fɔ du wetin rayt de mek in papa in ed big, bɔt udat kip rare gyal de wes in mɔni.
Kiŋ we ɔnɛs ɛn de rul fia wande mek in kɔntri tinap traŋa wan, bɔt di wan we de aks fɔ mɔni mɔni ɔltɛm de pwɛl di kɔntri.
Udat de mek switmɔt to in kɔmpin de sɛt trap fɔ insɛf.
If yu na bad pɔsin yu bad go kech yu lɛkɛ trap; bɔt pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay in go de siŋ ɛn gladi.
Gud man no poman in rayt, bɔt di bad pɔsin nɔ bisin sɛf.
Pɔsin we nɔ tek natin mek natin kin tɔnɔbɔ wanol siti, bɔt dɛn wan we gɛt sɛns de mek tiŋs kwayɛt.
Wɛn udat gɛt sɛns de agyu wit fulman, di fulman go jɛs de ala de mek nɔys, ɛn wan pis nɔ go de.
Pɔsin we lɛk fɔ kil nɔ lɛk pɔsin we tret, bɔt udat de du rayt de tray fɔ sev in layf.
Fulman kwik fɔ sho in tɛmpa gbangbaode, bɔt udat gɛt sɛns de peshɛnt ɛn kɔntrol insɛf.
Ɛni rula we de tek lay ɛn koŋosa mek in wokman dɛn, kɔrɔpt.
Wetin di poman ɛn di man we de tɔmɛnt am fiba pan, na dat na PAPA GƆD mek dɛn tu de si.
If kiŋ rul ɛn rul po pipul fayn ɛn fia wan, i go bi kiŋ te i day.
Fɔ bit pikin ɛn kɔrɛkt am de mek i lan, bɔt if i lɛf to insɛf, i go put in mami pan shem.
Wɛn bad pɔsin de na pawa, ɔlkayn bad tin de apin, bɔt pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay go opin yay si we i de kapsay.
Wɛn yu tren yu pikin, yu go de gladi fɔ am ɔltɛm, i nɔ go ɛva mek yu shem.
Usay PAPA GƆD nɔ de fɔ de gayd pipul, ɔlman go de du tiŋs adɔnkiadam, i fayn fɔ di pɔsin we de kip PAPA GƆD in lɔ!
Slev nɔ izi fɔ tek kɔrɛkshɔn we yu de tɔk to am, ivin wɛn i de ɔndastand yu sɛf i nɔ de yɛri wɔd.
Fulman bɛtɛ pas pɔsin we de tɔk bifo i tink.
If yu bayobayo yu mɔntbɔy frɔm we i smɔl te i big, i go ɛnd ɔp fɔ tek yu prɔpati tumara.
Pɔsin we gɛt wamat de sɛt big, big gbosgbos; ɛn pɔsin we tu krɔs de kɔz trɔbul.
Pɔsin we de kak, dɛn go brok in fɛda dɔŋ; bɔt udat put insɛf dɔŋ, dɛn go gi am rɛspɛkt.
Pɔsin we jɔyn tif gɛŋ nɔ de sɔri fɔ insɛf; i go yɛri we dɛn de swɛ so bɔt i nɔ go se fiŋ.
I nɔ fayn fɔ lɛ yu de mɛmba tumɔs bɔt wetin pipul de tink bɔt yu, wans yu put yu trɔs pan PAPA GƆD, yu sef.
Bɔku pipul lɛk fɔ mek gud fes to man we gɛt pawa, na PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ de mek fia ple.
Lɛkɛ aw bad pɔsin et gud pɔsin, na so gud pɔsin insɛf et bad pɔsin.
Na dɛn sɔri wɔd yaso Agɔ we na Jakɛ in bɔypikin tɔk: Agɔ tɔk to Ithiɛl ɛn Ukal se
“Fɔ tru, tru, a nɔ de biev lɛk mɔtalman, infakt sɛf, a nɔ gɛt di kayn sɛns we mɔtalman gɛt.
A nɔ lan sɛns, ɛn a nɔ no natin bɔt PAPA GƆD.

Ɛnibɔdi de we dɔn go ɛvin ɛn kam dɔŋ bak? Ɛnibɔdi de we dɔn ɛva kech briz? Ɛnibɔdi de we dɔn ɛva tek in klos tot wata? Ɛnibɔdi de we mek di ath in bawndri? Ɛnibɔdi no udat? Wetin nain bɔypikin in nem? Tɛl mi if yu no!
“Ɛnitin we PAPA GƆD tɔk i de du am, i de kɔba dɛn wan we aks am fɔ kɔba dɛn.
If yu ad to wetin i tɔk, i go se yu lay ɛn pɔnish yu fɔ dat.”
PAPA GƆD, na dɛn tu tin ya a want lɛ yu du fɔ mi bifo a day:
wan, nɔ mek a ɛva lay; tu nɔ mek a po da bad bad po ɔ jɛntri bad bad wan; gi mi wetin jɛs du nɔmɔ fɔ mi;
if a jɛntri tumɔs a go fɔgɛt bɔt yu ɛn bigin aks udat na PAPA GƆD if a po da bad po we go mek a tif a go gi yu bad nem.
Nɔ koŋosa wokman to in bɔs, if yu du dat i go swɛ yu ɛn di swɛ go kech yu.
Pipul dɛn de we de fityay dɛn papa, dɔn dɛn nɔ de blɛs dɛn mama.
Pipul de we de mek lɛk fɔ se dɛn klin we dɛn nɔ klin.
Pipul de we fil to se dɛn tu gud, dɛn fil se dɛn na enjɛl.
Pipul de we dɛn yon wok na fɔ kil ɛn pwɛl. Dɛn mɔt tan lɛkɛ nɛf ɛn sɔd fɔ dɔnawe wit poman ɛn lɛf am lɛ i day.
Sɔkinblɔd gɛt tu gyal pikin; dɛn tu nem “A want mɔ.” Tin dɛn de we nɔ de ɛva satisfay; infakt, fo pan dɛn de we nɔ de wande se, “i du so!”
Wan, bɛriŋrɔn, tu, uman we nɔ wande bɔn, tri, grɔn we yu plant we nɔ de se wata du so, fo, faya nɔ de se wud du.
Ɛnibɔdi we nɔ rɛspɛkt in papa, dɔn i nɔ luk in mama, na bɔd dɛn go it in dedebɔdi, na yuba bɛlɛ go tɔn in bɛriŋrɔn.
Tin dɛn de we tu wɔndaful fɔ mi; infakt fo de we a nɔ ebul ɔndastand sɛf aw dɛn tan:
Wan, na di we aw yuba de flay ɔp, ɔp di skay; tu, na di we aw snek de waka pantap rɔk; tri, na di we aw ship de waka na wata, fo, na di we aw man ɛn uman kin fɔl in lɔv.
Lɛ a tɛl una aw bambot wɛf kin biev: i de go it na kɔna saful, dɔn i wep in mɔt fayn, dɔn i kam naw ɛn se, “mi, mi an klin.”
Tin dɛn kin bi na di wɔl we kin mek di wɔl shek; infakt fo de we if dɛn bi, ɔlman kin tɔk bɔt dɛn:
wan, na wɛn slev tɔn to kiŋ; tu, na wɛn fulman gɛt ɔltin fɔ it;
tri, na wɛn uman we dɛn nɔ lɛk kam gɛt man fɔ mared am, fo, na wɛn nani tek in misis in ples na di os.
Fo animal dɛn de na di wɔl we smɔl, bɔt dɛn gɛt sɛns bad:
anch, dɛn nɔ gɛt trɛnk fɔ wok, bɔt nɔn ren nɔ de kam we dɛn nɔ de gɛt tin fɔ it;
Wan animal we tap insay rɔk; insɛf nɔ gɛt trɛnk, bɔt nainsay di rɔk i de dig in ol;
Lokɔs, dɛnsɛf nɔ gɛt bɔsman, bɔt wɛn dɛn de waka na bay rank lɛkɛ sojaman dɛn.
Ɔdinari os pikin we yu kin kech izi, izi wan, if yu go na kiŋ os yu go mit am de.
Tin dɛn de we wɛn dɛn de mach yu de ɛnjɔy dɛn; wɛn dɛn de spot so yu de kɔle pan dɛn:
wan, na di layɔn we gɛt trɛnk pas ɔl dɛn animal, wɛn i es in ed ɔp de waka, i nɔ de luk biɛn.
Tu, na kak we de es ed ɔp we i de waka in ed ɔp, tri, man got fo, kiŋ we in amiman dɛn ɔl de fɔ am.
If yu na pɔsin we nɔ gɛt sɛns, yu nɔ de biev, dɔn yu de kak, ɔ, if yu na pɔsin we kin de mekɔp fɔ du bad, tap, ɛn bigin tink wantɛm.
Bikɔs, kaw milk kin tɔn to bɔta; if yu baŋ yu nos blɔd go kɔmɔt de, yu ambɔgin pɔsin dɛn; yu go put yusɛf pan trɔbul.
Na dɛn sɔri wɔd yaso Kiŋ Lɛmuɛl in mama tɛl am wɛn i bin de advays am:
“Mi pikin, yu na mi bɛlɛbɔn pikin, na PAPA GƆD a pre to we mek a bɔn yu.
Nɔ wes ɔl yu trɛnk ɛn mɔni pan uman, na dɛn de rɔndɔŋ kiŋ.
Lɛmuɛl! I nɔ fayn o! I nɔ fayn fɔ lɛ kiŋ de drink wayn, i nɔ fayn fɔ lɛ kiŋ lɛk rɔm.
Wɛn i drɔnk, i de fɔgɛt di lɔ ɛn siz advantej pan pipul ɛn mas dɛn rayt.
Rɔm gud fɔ udat de day ɛn fɔ udat dɔn giv ɔp na layf.
Lɛ dɛn drink ɛn fɔgɛt dɛn prɔblɛm, lɛ dɛn nɔ mɛmba wetin de mɔna dɛn.
“Yu fɔ de tɔk fɔ dɛn wan we nɔ ebul tɔk fɔ dɛnsɛf. Fɛt fɔ dɛn wan we nɔ ebul fɛt fɔ dɛnsɛf.
Tɔk fɔ dɛn ɛn jɔj fia wan lɛ poman gɛt in rayt.”
I at fɔ fɛn gud wɛf, gud wɛf gɛt valyu pas gold ɛn dayamɔn.
Ɛni man we gɛt gud wɛf de biliv am, natin nɔ de we i want we i nɔ go gɛt.
I nɔ de taya fɔ du gud to di man ɛn nɔ de ambɔg am atɔl.
Ɔl di tɛm in an bizi de mek klos fɔ amatan ɛn dray sizin.
I de briŋ tiŋs dɛn kam nain os lɛkɛ we blu bot kin de briŋ tiŋs dɛn kam.
In de grap ali mɔnin mek it fɔ in famili, dɔn i sheb ɔda wok dɛn gi in savant gyal dɛn fɔ du.
I de luk fɔ land ɛn bay am dɔn i yuz di mɔni we i dɔn wok fɔ fɔ plant greps.
Na uman we kin tay in ɔja fɔ du ɛni kayn wok. I nɔba taya fɔ wok.
I no se in biznɛs de mek prɔfit ɛn i de wok te let na nɛt.
Nainsɛf sɛf de mek in yon trɛd ɛn matirial. I lɛk fɔ du in wok fɔ insɛf.
I de ɛp dɛn po pipul ɛn dɛn wan we kam to am fɔ mek i ɛp dɛn.
Wɛn ples kol, i nɔ de yagba sɛf bikɔs, in wanol famili de gɛt wam klos fɔ wɛr.
Nainsɛf de mek in yon bedshit ɛn na dia klos dɛn i de wɛr.
In man gɛt rɛspɛkt ɔlsay ɛn i de wit di big wan dɛn na di siti.
I de mek linin matirial ɛn sɛl; i ivin de sɔplay biznɛs man dɛn sash.
Na uman we ebul wok ɛn ɔlman rɛspɛkt am, i rɛdi fɔ ɛnitin we mit am.
Wɛn i opin in mɔt fɔ tɔk, yu no se na pɔsin de tɔk, i gɛt gud wɔd nain mɔt.
I nɔ tek in famili ple ɛn nɔ de miks pan aydulnɛs.
In pikin dɛn de tɔk gud bɔt am ɔltɛm ɛn na so in man sɛf de prez am.
In man kin de tɛl am se, “Bo, bɔku uman dɛn de we gud, bɔt yu pas dɛn ɔl.”
Fɔ bi fayn uman nɔto in na di tin o, nɔto fɔ bi uman we sabi tɔk sɛf; di men tin na uman we de fred PAPA GƆD ɛn ɔna am, na da kayn uman de fɔ prez.
Na fɔ gi am wetin i dɔn lebɔ fɔ, ɛn lɛ ɔlman na di siti tɔk in gud nem.
Na di tin dɛn dis we di Pricha, dat na Devid in bɔypikin we na kiŋ na Jerusɛlɛm se.
Di Pricha se di natin we pas ɔl natin na wɔl! Di natin we pas ɔl natin na wɔl! Ɔl na fufafu.
Wetin mɔtalman gɛt fɔ prɔfit pan ɔl di yagba we i de yagba na layf?
Pipul de bɔn ɛn pipul de day, bɔt di wɔl in de sote go.
San de kam ɔp ɛn san de go dɔŋ, i de rɔn go bak usay i bin bigin.
Briz de blo go na di Sawt, dɔn i kin blo go rawnd to di Nɔth; di briz de go rawnd ɛn rawnd ɛn tɔn bak kam na di sem rod we i bin pas go.
Ɔl dɛn watasay de rɔn go na di si, bɔt di si nɔ de ful; Na usay di wata de go ɔltɛm, na de i de go ɔltɛm.
Ɔltin na wɔl kin mek yu fɛdɔp; mɔtalman mɔt nɔ ebul fɔ tɔk am; yay nɔ de taya fɔ si, ɛn yes nɔ de taya fɔ yɛri.
Wetin dɔn bi go stil de bi ɛn na wetin pipul dɛn bin dɔn du, pipul dɛn go stil de du; ɛn natin nɔ de na wɔl we de bi we nɔ wande bi yet.
Ɛnitin de we pɔsin go se, “luk, dis na nyu tin” i bin dɔn bi, di tɛm we yu nɔ bɔn yet.
Wi nɔ go no wetin bin dɔn pas, semweso, dɛn wan we nɔ bɔn yet nɔ go no tin dɛn we de bi naw afta dɛn dɔn bi.
Mi we na di Pricha, we na bin kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl na Jerusɛlɛm,
bin tɛl misɛf se, a wan fɔ lan ɛn lan gud bɔt ɔl wetin de na wɔl; na wok we nɔ swit Papa PAPA GƆD dɔn put na mɔtalman ed so we de mek dɛn bizi.
A dɔn si ɔl wetin de bi na wɔl, bɔt usay, ɔltin na fɔ natin ɛn na lɛk fɔ rɔnata briz.
Wetin dɔn bɛn nɔ go tret igen, ɛn yu nɔ go ebul kɔnt wetin nɔ de.
A tɛl misɛf se, a gɛt sɛns pas ɔl udat dɔn ɛva bi kiŋ na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn a gɛt bɔku ɛkspiriɛns ɛn sɛns ɛn sabi pas dɛn.
A tray ɛn fɛnɔt wetin i min fɔ gɛt sɛns, fɔ kres ɛn fɔ fulish. A fɛnɔtt se ɔl dat sɛf na fɔ natin.
Bikɔs di mɔ sɛns yu gɛt, di mɔ yu at de wɔri, di mɔ yu no bɔt sɔntin, na di mɔ yu at de pwɛl.
A tɛl misɛf se a go ɛnjɔy misɛf si. Bɔt eya, dis wan sɛf nɔ gɛt bɛnifit.
A tɔk bɔt laf laf sɛf na kres biznɛs ɛn bɔt ɛnjɔymɛnt se us yus i gɛt?

A se mek a si aw i tan fɔ drink rɔm– bɔt a bin stil de yuz mi sɛns we bin de gyad mi. A bin wan no igen aw fulish pɔsin kin fil, so dat a go no wetin gud fɔ mɔtalman na dis wɔl we na shɔt tɛm nɔmɔ i gɛt na wɔl.
A du big tin dɛn; a bil os dɛn, a mek greps fam dɛn fɔ misɛf.
A mek gadin dɛn ɛn pak dɛn fɔ misɛf ɛn plant ɔlkayn frut tik dɛn de.
A mek ples fɔ gɛda wata fɔ wata di bɔku bɔku tik dɛn we de gro.
A bay man ɛn uman slev dɛn, ɛn bin ivin gɛt slev dɛn we bɔn na mi os; a bin gɛt bɔku bɔku kaw ship ɛn got pas ɔl udat dɔn ɛva tap na Jerusɛlɛm.
A gɛda jɛntri fɔ misɛf frɔm di ples we dɛn de kip kiŋ dɛn kɔpɔ na ɔl di land dɛn we a de rul; a gɛt man ɛn uman dɛn fɔ siŋ fɔ mi, ɛn bɔku switat, wetin mɔtalman lɛk.
Ɔl dat mek a tɔf pas ɔl udat bin de bifo mi na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn di sabi we a sabi bɔt di wɔl ɛn bɔt layf de na mi ed te naw.
Ɛnitin we a si ɛn want, a go mɔs gɛt am; a bin miks pan ɔlkayn ladida, a bin de ɛnjɔy ɔl wetin a de du, ɛn da ɛnjɔymɛnt de nain na bin mi yon bɛnifit.
Dɔn a bigin tink bɔt ɔl wetin a bin dɔn du ɛn aw a wok traŋa wan fɔ du dɛn, bɔt oya, ɔl na fɔ natin. I tan lɛk we pɔsin de rɔnata briz; i nɔ de prɔfit pɔsin natin na dis wɔl.
So a bigin tink bɔt wetin i min fɔ gɛt sɛns, fɔ kres ɛn fɔ fulish. Afta ɔl, wetin nyu kiŋ go du we di ol kiŋ nɔ du yet.
Na da tɛm de a si se fɔ gɛt sɛns bɛtɛ pas fɔ fulish; jɛs lɛk aw layt bɛtɛ fafawe pas daknɛs.
Pɔsin we gɛt sɛns no wetin i de du, bɔt fulman nɔ no. Bɔt a si se na di sem we dɛn ɔl de ɛnd.
A tɛl misɛf se, wetin de bi to di fulman go bi to misɛf, so wetin mek a gɛt ɔl dis sɛns? So a tɛl misɛf se dat sɛf na fɔ natin.
Dɛn de fɔgɛt bɔt di man we gɛt sɛns semweso lɛk di fulman. Dɛn nɔ de mɛmba dɛn sote go. Di man we gɛt sɛns de day jɛs lɛk di fulman!
So a gens wit layf, bikɔs man jɛs de yagba fɔ natin. Ɔl na fɔ natin. I tan lɛk we pɔsin de tray fɔ kech briz.
A kam si se a gɛt fɔ lɛf ɔl wetin a dɔn lebɔ fɔ, fɔ ɔda pɔsin ɛn dat mek mi at pwɛl;
ɛn yu no if i go bi sɛnsman ɔ fulman! Pan ɔl dat, i go kam bi masta fɔ ɔl wetin a dɔn swɛt ɛn yuz mi sɛns fɔ gɛt na dis wɔl. Ɔl na fɔ natin.
So a chenj mi maynd ɛn mi at pwɛl we a tink bɔt di tiŋs dɛn we a dɔn wok fɔ na dis wɔl,
bikɔs sɔntɛm kin de we pɔsin we kin dɔn yuz in sɛns ɛn lebɔ dɔn na wɔl, kin gɛt fɔ lɛf ɔltin fɔ ɔda pɔsin we nɔ wok fɔ am, fɔ ɛnjɔy am. Dat sɛf na fɔ natin ɛn dat na bad bad tin.
Wetin pɔsin gɛt fɔ bɛnifit pan ɔl di yagba we i de pan na dis wɔl?
Ɔl mɔtalman in layf na pen ɛn wɔri. Ivin na nɛt we i de slip, in at nɔ de rɛst. Dat sɛf na fɔ natin.
Di bɛst tin fɔ mɔtalman fɔ du, na fɔ it drink ɛn ɛnjɔy wetin i dɔn wok fɔ. A biliv se na so PAPA GƆD want am fɔ bi.
Nain nɔmɔ de mek mɔtalman it, drink ɛn ɛnjɔy insɛf.

Udat de wok fɔ pliz PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD de gi am mɔ sɛns ɛn mek i gladi; bɔt fɔ sina, PAPA GƆD de mek i wok ɛn kip bɔku tinks ɛn mɔni so dat i go ɛp di wan we de pliz PAPA GƆD. Dis insɛf na fɔ natin, ɛn i tan lɛk we pɔsin de tray fɔ kech briz.
Fɔ ɛnitin we pɔsin wan du, di rayt tɛm de; ɔltin gɛt in tɛm na dis wɔl:
tɛm de fɔ bɔn, ɛn tɛm de fɔ day; tɛm de fɔ plant, ɛn tɛm de fɔ pik wetin yu plant;
tɛm de fɔ kil, ɛn tɛm de fɔ mɛn; tɛm de fɔ brok, ɛn tɛm de fɔ bil;
tɛm de fɔ kray, ɛn tɛm de fɔ laf; tɛm de fɔ munin, ɛn tɛm de fɔ gladi;
tɛm de fɔ mek lɔv ɛn tɛm de we nɔ fɔ mek lɔv tɛm de fɔ gladi ɛn grip yu kɔmpin ɛn tɛm de we nɔ fɔ gladi ɛn grip yu kɔmpin;
tɛm de fɔ luk fɔ wetin lɔs, ɛn tɛm de fɔ lɔs sɔntin; tɛm de fɔ kip, ɛn tɛm de fɔ trowe tin dɛn;
tɛm de fɔ chɛr, ɛn tɛm de fɔ so; tɛm de fɔ sɛt mɔt, ɛn tɛm de fɔ tɔk;
tɛm de fɔ lɛk ɛn tɛm de fɔ et tɛm de fɔ wa, ɛn tɛm de fɔ pis.
Wetin pɔsin de gen fɔ ɔl di yagba we i de yagba?
A dɔn si wetin PAPA GƆD gi mɔtalman fɔ du we go kip am bizi.
I mek ɔltin fayn fɔ bi di tɛm we i fɔ bi, dɔn i mek mɔtalman de wɔndrin bɔt wetin gɛt fɔ apin nɛks wɔl, bɔt pan ɔl dat, wi nɔ ebul ɔndastand PAPA GƆD in wok.
A no se natin nɔ de we bɛtɛ pas fɔ de gladi ɛn ɛnjɔy yusɛf wans yu gɛt layf;
ɛn mɛmba se PAPA GƆD want ɔlman fɔ it, drink ɛn ɛnjɔy ɔl wetin i lebɔ fɔ.
A no se ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD de du go de sote go; nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul ad pan am ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul pul kɔmɔt de; na so PAPA GƆD want am so dat mɔtalman go fred am.
Wetin de bi naw bin dɔn bi ɛn wetin gɛt fɔ bi, insɛf bin dɔn bi, ɛn PAPA GƆD want wi fɔ tray fɔ no wetin de bi
Pantap dat, a si se na dis wɔl ya, usay pɔsin fɔ jɔj tret, na soso wikɛdnɛs de de, ɛn usay pipul fɔ de waka tret, na so so wikɛdnɛs.
A tɛl misɛf se PAPA GƆD go jɔj di raychɔs man ɛn di wikɛd man di tɛm we i dɔn pik fɔ ɔltin.
A tɛl misɛf se, we i kam pan mɔtalman, PAPA GƆD de tɛst am fɔ sho am se i nɔ pas animal.
Mɔtalman ɛn animal de ɛnd di sem we; na day wi dɛn gɛt fɔ day. Na di sem kayn layf ɔltu gɛt, ɛn mɔtalman nɔ bɛtɛ pas animal; ɔl na fɔ natin.
Na bɛr dɛn de bɛr dɛn ɔltu. Na dɔti dɛn tek mek dɛn ɛn na dɔti dɛn de go bak we dɛn day.
Udat no if mɔtalman in spirit de go ɔp we i day, ɔ if di animal in yon spirit na dɔŋ i de go?
So a si se natin nɔ bɛtɛ pas fɔ mek mɔtalman ɛnjɔy wetin i de du, bikɔs na dat PAPA GƆD se fɔ bi to am; nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul tɛl am wetin go bi wɛn i dɔn day.

A bin si ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we pipul dɛn de du to dɛn kɔmpin dɛn na wɔl. A si dɛn we dɛn de kray ɛn nɔ gɛt pɔsin fɔ tɛl dɛn ɔsh. Nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛt maynd fɔ ɛp dɛn bikɔs di wan dɛn we de du dɛn bad gɛt pawa.
A tink se di wan dɛn we dɔn day bɛtɛ pas di wan dɛn we stil de na wɔl,
bɔt di wan dɛn we bɛtɛ pas dɛn tu pipul dɛn de, na di wan we nɔ bɔn kam na wɔl yet ɛn nɔ si di bad bad tin dɛn we mɔtalman de du na wɔl.
A si se ɔl di wok ɛn sɛns we mɔtalman de sho pan in wok na bikɔs i wan tan lɛk ɔda pɔsin. Bɔt ɔl dat na fɔ natin. I tan lɛk we yu de tray fɔ kech briz.
Fulman les ɛn i nɔ wan wok, bɔt na so i go day wit aŋri insay in po.
Wan mɔndɔ kwayɛt layf bɛtɛ pas tu mɔndɔ yagba fɔ natin lɛk fɔ rɔnata briz.
We a luk gud a si se ɔltin na wɔl nɔ min natin.

Pɔsin we nɔ gɛt nɔbɔdi; we nɔ gɛt pikin ɔ ivin brɔda, bɔt de wok traŋa traŋa wan ɛn nɔ de satisfay wit wetin dɛn gɛt, nɔ de ɛva sidɔm ɛn aks insɛf se udat dɛn de wok ɔl da wok de fɔ, ɛn nɔ de ebul ɛnjɔy in layf. Dis sɛf na natin ɛn nɔ de mek pɔsin gladi.
I bɛtɛ fɔ tu pipul fɔ wok pas wan, bikɔs dɛn go gɛt bɛtɛ bɛnifit fɔ dɛn wok.
Bikɔs if wan pɔsin fɔdɔm, di ɔda wan go es am ɔp; bɔt trɔbul go mit di wan we in wangren de wok; we i go fɔdɔm, nɔbɔdi nɔ go de fɔ es am.
Ɛn if dɛn tu pipul lidɔm togɛda, kol nɔ go kech dɛn; bɔt i nɔ pɔsibul fɔ lidɔm yu wan ɛn kol nɔ kech yu.
If pɔsin atak wan pɔsin, i go ebul bit am. Bɔt if na dɛn tu di pɔsin atak, dɛn go ebul bit di wan we atak dɛn. Tri rop go at fɔ kɔt.
Yɔŋman we po ɛn gɛt sɛns bɛtɛ pas kiŋ we ol bɔt i fulish we nɔ de tek advays,
pan ɔl we na bin jelman bifo i bi kiŋ ɔ na bin poman na di say we i bin tap.
A de wach ɛn notis se ɔlman na wɔl de go ɔp ɛn dɔŋ pan dɛn yon biznɛs. Bɔt wan yɔŋman bin de we jɛs tinap saful ɛn nain go gɛt fɔ tek di kiŋ in ples.
We i bi kiŋ, i go gɛt fɔ rul ɔlman ɛn di wan dɛn we go bi kiŋ afta am nɔ go gladi wit wetin i du. Dis insɛf na fɔ natin ɛn i tan lɛk we pɔsin de tray fɔ kech briz.
Tek tɛm we yu de go na PAPA GƆD in os; fɔ de lisin PAPA GƆD in wɔd bɛtɛ pas we fulman mek sakrifays, bikɔs dɛn nɔ no se dɛn de du bad.
Nɔ kwik fɔ tɔk tin, ɛn nɔ mek yu at mek yu se sɔntin to PAPA GƆD, bikɔs PAPA GƆD de na ɛvin ɛn yu de dɔŋ na di wɔl; so nɔ tɔk bɔku bɔku tɔk to am.
Yu de drim bikɔs yu de tink bɔku, ɛn na fulman yu go yɛri de tɔk bɔku bɔku.
Wɛn yu prɔmis PAPA GƆD se yu go du sɔntin, nɔ westɛm fɔ du wetin yu se yu go du; i nɔ lɛk fulman. Du wetin yu se yu go du.
I bɛtɛ lɛ yu nɔ prɔmis dan fɔ prɔmis ɛn nɔ du wetin yu se.
Nɔ mek yu mɔt mek yu sin we yu go gɛt fɔ tɛl rɛvrɛn se na mistek yu mistek tɔk. Nɔ mek PAPA GƆD vɛks pan yu ɛn pwɛl wetin yu dɔn lebɔ fɔ.
We yu de tink plɛnti bɔt di tin dɛn na dis wɔl, yu de put at pan tin dɛn we nɔ de bɛnifit pɔsin ɛn dat go mek yu tɔk bɔku bɔku; bɔt mɔtalman fɔ fred PAPA GƆD.
Nɔ sɔprayz we yu go ɛnisay ɛn si se dɛn de buli poman ɛn nɔ gi am in rayt; bikɔs di bigman dɛnsɛf gɛt dɛn yon bigman dɛn, ɛn dɛnwandɛnde sɛf gɛt dɛn yon bigman dɛn we pas dɛn.
Na wetin dɛn kin plant na kɔntri, di kiŋ sɛf kin abop pan.
Pɔsin we lɛk mɔni nɔ de ɛva satisfay wit mɔni; ɛn udat lɛk jɛntri nɔ de satisfay wit in prɔfit: dis insɛf na fɔ natin.
Di mɔ yu gɛt, di mɔ mɔt yu gɛt fɔ fid. Us prɔfit yu gɛt naw, pas fɔ de si yu jɛntri wit yu yay we dɛn de it am..
Lebra dɛn kin slip swit swit slip ivin if na lili tin dɛn gɛt fɔ it; bɔt dɛn jɛntriman dɛn jɛntri de mek dɛn nɔ slip ol nɛt.
Wan bad tin de we de apin na dis wɔl, na dat jɛntriman de gɛda jɛntri te i mɔna dɛn,
ɛn di bad tin dɛn we dɛn kin put an pan kin mek dɛn lɔs ɔl dɛn jɛntri. Natin nɔ kin lɛf sɛf fɔ day lɛf gi dɛn pikin dɛn.
Aw dɛn mama bɔn dɛn nekɛd, na so dɛn go day go bak nekɛd aw dɛn bin kam; dɛn nɔ go ol natin na dɛn an go, pan ɔl di yagba we dɛn yagba.
Na ɔda tin dis we de mɔna mi; aw dɛn kam na wɔl, na so dɛn de go bak; so wetin pɔsin de fɛt fɛt fɔ na di wɔl?
We yu luk am bak, ɔl dɛn layf, dɛn nɔ ɔndastand wetin na layf, ɛn na kɔnfyushɔn ɛn siknɛs ɛn vɛksteshɔn dɛn bin de pan.
Wetin mi tink se rayt fɔ du, na fɔ it ɛn drink ɛn ɛnjɔy wetin yu de yagba fɔ di shɔt tɛm we yu gɛt fɔ de na wɔl; na so PAPA GƆD se i fɔ bi fɔ mɔtalman.
Bɔt igen, fɔ di wan dɛn we PAPA GƆD gi mɔni ɛn prɔpati ɛn mek dɛn ebul ɛnjɔy am, ɛn tek am so se na so PAPA GƆD se, ɛn dɛn ebul ɛnjɔy dɛn lebɔ– na PAPA GƆD blɛs dɛn.
I go at fɔ mek tin apin to dɛn we go mek dɛn wɔri, bikɔs PAPA GƆD kin mek dɛn gladi ɔltɛm.
Wan bad tin de we a dɔn si na wɔl we de apin to mɔtalman plɛnti:

PAPA GƆD kin gi sɔm pipul dɛn jɛntri, prɔpati ɛn rɛspɛkt, so dat dɛn nɔ kin krach dɛn ed fɔ natin. Bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ kin mek i ebul ɛnjɔy ɔl dɛn tin dɛn de; na trenja kin kam ɛnjɔy dɛn; dis na fɔ natin. Na tin we penful.
Pɔsin kin bɔn wan ɔndrɛd pikin ɛn de te i ol; bɔt i nɔ mata aw lɔŋ i liv, if i nɔ ɛnjɔy layf ɛn we i day dɛn nɔ mek soba bɛrin fɔ am, pikin we bɔn day wan sɛf bɛtɛ pas am.
Bikɔs di pikin we bɔn day wan kam na dis fɔ natin wɔl, day wan, so nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul fɔ tɔk bɔt am as i nɔ ivin gɛt nem;
we yu luk am gud, i nɔ si san wande ɛn nɔ no natin; bɔt i de rɛst wit kol at pas dɛn jɛntriman dɛn we nɔ de ɛnjɔy dɛn jɛntri.
I lɛk i de na wɔl fɔ tu tawzin ia ɛn nɔ ɛnjɔy natin, nɔto di sem ples dɛn ɔltu de go?
Ɔl wetin pɔsin de yagba fɔ, na fɔ mek i gɛt wetin fɔ it, bɔt pan ɔl dat, di bɛlɛ nɔ de satisfay.
Di sem bɛnifit we di man we gɛt sɛns gɛt, na di sem bɛnifit di fulman insɛf gɛt. Wetin di poman gɛt fɔ bɛnifit if i no aw fɔ waka na layf?
We yu si sɔntin, bɛtɛ pas we yu de swɛla pit fɔ tin we yu nɔ si; ɔl na fɔ natin ɛn i tan lɛk we pɔsin de tray fɔ kech briz.
Ɛnitin we de bi naw, bin dɔn bi ɛn i gɛt nem, ɛn ɔlman no se mɔtalman na mɔtalman ɛn dɛn nɔ go ebul fɔ agyu pɔsin we pas dɛn.
Di mɔ pɔsin de tɔk tɔk, na di mɔ yu de si se layf na fɔ natin; aw naw yu go se wan pɔsin bɛtɛ pas in kɔmpin.
Udat no wetin gud fɔ mɔtalman we na tu- tri de i gɛt na di fɔnatin-wɔl, ɛn in layf de pas lɛk shado? Udat de we go ebul tɛl pipul wetin go apin bambay?
Gudnem bɛtɛ pas dia dia pafyum; ɛn di de we pɔsin day bɛtɛ pas di de we i bɔn.
I bɛtɛ fɔ go na bɛrin os pas fɔ go na os we gɛt pati; bikɔs ɔl mɔtalman gɛt fɔ day ɛn di wan dɛn we nɔ day yet fɔ de mɛmba dat ɔltɛm.
Fɔ sɔri bɛtɛ pas fɔ gladi bikɔs sɔri de mek pɔsin at machɔ.
Pɔsin we gɛt sɛns kin de tink bɔt pipul we de munin; bɔt fulman in jɛs de mɛmba aw in go ɛnjɔy insɛf.
I bɛtɛ fɔ mek pɔsin lisin wɛn man we gɛt sɛns de tɔk pan am pas fɔ yɛri we fulman de siŋ.
Bikɔs we fulman laf, i kin tan lɛk we dray tik de spak ɔnda pɔt na faya; ɔl dis na fɔ natin, i nɔ min natin.
Na tru se we tin de mɔna pɔsin we gɛt sɛns, i kin mek i ful, ɛn braybri de mek pɔsin nɔ du wetin rayt.
Aw sɔntin tan we i dɔn dɔn, bɛtɛ pas aw i bin tan we i bin bigin; pɔsin we peshɛnt wit PAPA GƆD nain at, bɛtɛ pas di wan we prawd.
Nɔ kwik fɔ vɛks bikɔs na fulman gɛt soso vɛksteshɔn nain at.
Nɔ bigin aks se wetindu tin bin bɛtɛ fɔstɛm pas naw, bikɔs pɔsin we gɛt sɛns nɔ de aks dɛn kayn kwɛshɔn de.
Fɔ gɛt sɛns gud fashin tan lɛk we dɛn day lɛf prɔpati gi pɔsin, na advantej to pɔsin na wɔl.
We yu kip yu sɛns fɔ yu jab, i tan lɛk we yu kip mɔni fɔ bambay; ɛn di advantej we yu go gɛt we yu lan, na dat, sɛns kin mek yu layf lɔŋ.
Tink bɔt PAPA GƆD in wok; Udat go ebul tret wetin PAPA GƆD dɔn bɛn?

Di de we tin gud fɔ yu na fɔ gladi, bɔt di de we tin nɔ bi lɛk aw yu want am, na fɔ tink bɔt wetin de apin; na PAPA GƆD mek di gud tɛm ɛn nain sem wan mek di tɛm we tin nɔ gud, so dat mɔtalman nɔ go no wetin de apin to am.
Na dis mi layf we nɔ min natin, mi yay dɔn si ɔltin; man de we de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD kin day de waka tret, bɔt wikɛd man kin gɛt lɔŋ layf pan ɔl we dɛn de du bad.
Nɔ waka tret tumɔs ɛn nɔ fɔ mek se yu gɛt sɛns tumɔs. Wetin mek yu de kil yusɛf?
Nɔ biev lɛk fulman ɛn jɛs de du bad. Nɔ mek yu day bifo yu tɛm.
I gud fɔ ol wan say ɛn nɔ trowe di ɔda wan; bikɔs pɔsin we de fred PAPA GƆD go sɔksid wit dɛn tu.
Sɛns kin mek pɔsin gɛt pawa pas we tɛn pɔsin de rul wan siti.
Na tru se nɔbɔdi nɔ de na wɔl we de du wetin PAPA GƆD want ɔltɛm ɛn nɔ de ɛva sin.
Nɔ tray fɔ lisin ɔl wetin pipul dɛn de se, ɔ nɔso, wande, yu go yɛri we yu wokman de kɔs yu;
ɛn yusɛf no gud gud wan se yusɛf dɔn kɔs ɔda pipul dɛn plɛnti tɛm.
A dɔn tek tɛm wach ɔl dɛn tin dɛn ya gud wit sɛns. A tɛl misɛf se dat go mek a gɛt sɛns. Bɔt usay! Sɛns nɔ de nia mi sɛf.
We sɔntin de we pas yu, i pas yu. Pɔsin nɔ go no natin bɔt am.
A disayd fɔ stɔdi mek a go no mɔ tin dɛn ɛn ɔndastand aw i bad fɔ mek pɔsin jɛs de fulish, ɛn aw fulman tan lɛk udat kres.
Di tin we a fred pas day na uman we na trap, uman we in at na trap ɛn nɛt, ɛn de fɔ grip ɔltin. Na pɔsin we de du wetin PAPA GƆD want nɔmɔ, in trap nɔ go kech, bɔt i go kech sina izi wan.
Di Pricha se fɔ luk wetin in fɛn; i si se i tray fɔ ad wan to wan mek i go no di ansa.
I dɔn tɔn tɔn ɔltin oba nain maynd bɔt nɔ fɛnɔt natin. Na wangren tret man pan wan tawzin man a fɛn, bɔt i nɔ ebul fɛn nɔn nɔn uman.
Na dis nɔmɔ a ebul fɔ fɛnɔt; dat na we PAPA GƆD mek mɔtalman tret; bɔt na mɔtalman mekmek te in layf bɛnbɛn.
Udat tan lɛk pɔsin we gɛt sɛns? Udat no aw fɔ intaprit ɛnitin? Sɛns de mek pɔsin fes shayn ɛn di twis we i de twis in fes, chenj.
Du wetin di kiŋ se bikɔs na dat yu bin dɔn prɔmis PAPA GƆD.
Nɔ fred natin; kɔmɔt bifo am. Nɔ westɛm bifo kiŋ we di tin we mek yu go bifo am nɔto gud wan, bikɔs i kin du ɛnitin.
Bikɔs wetin di kiŋ se, nɛf kɔt. Udat go aks am se wetin i du so.
Pɔsin we de du wetin dɛn se fɔ du, nɔ de gɛt prɔblɛm, ɛn sɛnsman no wɛn ɛn aw fɔ du tin.
Ɔltin gɛt tɛm ɛn aw fɔ du am, ɔlwe mɔtalman gɛt plɛnti plɛnti trɔbul.
Fɔ tru, dɛn nɔ no wetin fɔ bi, bikɔs nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul tɔk aw i go bi.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛt pawa oba in layf, ɔ pawa fɔ tap day. Aw dɛn nɔ de sak soja na batul fil, na so wikɛdnɛs nɔ de sev wikɛd pɔsin.
Na ɔl dɛn tin ya a notis we a de lan bɔt dis wɔl; wɔl we pipul we gɛt pawa de sɔprɛs di wan we i gɛt pawa pas te dɛn ambɔg dɛnsɛf.
A si we dɛn de bɛr bad pipul dɛn; na so dɛn bin de go insay ɛn kɔmɔt na do na PAPA GƆD in os. Pipul bin de prez dɛn usay dɛn bin dɔn du bad tin dɛn. Dis sɛf na fɔ natin.
Na bikɔs we pɔsin du bad, dɛn nɔ de gi jɔjmɛnt kwik, na dat mek pipul de kɔntinyu fɔ du bad.
Ɔl we sina dɛn de du bad tin ɔndrɛd tɛm ɛn dɛn layf kin stil lɔŋ, mi no se ɔltin go go fayn fɔ di wan dɛn we de fred PAPA GƆD, bikɔs dɛn rɛspɛkt am,
bɔt i nɔ go bi fɔ di bad man. In layf go tan lɛk shado ɛn i mɔs day kwik, bikɔs i nɔ de fred PAPA GƆD.

Wan fɔnatin tin de bi na di wɔl; dat na dat, sɔm man dɛn de we de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD bɔt na wetin fɔ bi to di bad pipul, de bi to dɛn, ɛn bad pipul de we na wetin fɔ bi to udat de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD, de bi to dɛn. A bin tɔk se ɔl dis sɛf, na fɔ natin.

Na dat mek a se pɔsin fɔ ɛnjɔy insɛf, bikɔs natin nɔ de na dis wɔl we bɛtɛ fɔ mɔtalman pas fɔ it ɛn fɔ drink ɛn fɔ ɛnjɔy insɛf. Na so dɛn go de yagba na layf te di tɛm dɔn we PAPA GƆD gi dɛn na dis wɔl.
Wɛn a tray fɔ ɔndastand wetin de apin na wɔl, a si se a nɔ ebul fɔ slip santɛm, a nɔ ebul fɔ slip na nɛt;

na da tɛm de a ebul fɔ si ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD de du, we nɔbɔdi na dis wɔl nɔ go ebul ɔndastand. I lɛk aw dɛn tray fɔ fɛnɔt te, dɛn nɔ go ebul. Ɔl we dɛn sɛnsman dɛn de se dɛn gɛt sɛns, dɛn nɔ go ɛva ebul fɛnɔt PAPA GƆD in wok.

Na ɔl dis a sidɔm tink bɔt; a luk insay ɔltin. Aw di pɔsin we de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD ɛn di pɔsin we gɛt sɛns, ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn de du, de na PAPA GƆD in an; nɔbɔdi nɔ no if na lɛk PAPA GƆD lɛk dɛn ɔ na et i et dɛn fɔ wetin dɛn de du. Ɔltin we dɛn gɛt fɔ du

na fɔ natin. Na di sem tin de bi to dɛn ɔl; di wan we de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD ɛn di wan we nɔ de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD, di wan we gud ɛn to di wan we nɔ gud, di wan we klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn di wan we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay, di wan we de mek sakrifays ɛn di wan we nɔ de mek sakrifays. Na di sem tin we de bi to di wan we de kɔmit sin, de bi to di wan we nɔ de kɔmit sin; na di sem tin de apin to di wan we de swɛ ɛn di wan we nɔ de swɛ.

Wan bad bad tin de bi na di wɔl; dat na we na di sem kayn tin de apin to ɔlman. Wetin bad mɔ, na dat na so so bad bad tin de na dɛn at; na kres kres tin kin de na dɛn at we dɛn de na wɔl. Afta ɔl dat, dɛn kin day go.
Bɔt udat gɛt layf, gɛt op, bikɔs dɔg we gɛt layf bɛtɛ pas layɔn we dɔn day.
Di wan we nɔ day yet no se in gɛt fɔ day, bɔt dayman nɔ de no natin. Dɛn nɔ gɛt fɔ gɛt natin igen ɛn pipul nɔ gɛt tɛm fɔ mɛmba dɛn igen sɛf.
Di lɛk we dɛn lɛk ɔ di et we dɛn et ɛn di jɛlɔs we dɛn de jɛlɔs dɔn dɔn; dɛn nɔ go ɛva du tin na dis wɔl igen
So, ɛnjɔy yu it, ɛn drink yu wayn wit gladi; bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn gri lɔntɛm se na so yu go du.
Yu fɔ drɛs fayn ɔltɛm ɛn rɔb ɔyl na yu ed ɔltɛm.
Ɛnjɔy yusɛf wit di wɛf we yu lɛk, na dis fɔnatin layf we PAPA GƆD gi yu na dis wɔl, bikɔs na so PAPA GƆD se i fɔ bi fɔ yu, ɛn na pat di wok we yu de wok na dis wɔl.
Mek shɔ se we yu de du ɛnitin, yu du am gud wit ɔl yu at; bikɔs we yu day, yu nɔ go gɛt fɔ wok yanda. Yu nɔ gɛt fɔ tink ɔ sabi ɛnitin, ɛn sɛns biznɛs nɔ de usay yu de go.
