A fɛnɔt igen na dis wɔl se, i nɔ min se yu go win bikɔs yu kin rɔn fast, ɛn i nɔ min se pɔsin nɔ go bit yu bikɔs yu gɛt trɛnk. Semweso, nɔto sɛns de gi yu mɔni, yu nɔ de jɛntri bikɔs yu gɛt sɛns ɛn nɔto bikɔs yu sabi du tin, mek yu go gɛt wok; na lɔk nɔmɔ de mek bɛtɛ fala yu.
Mɔtalman nɔ no wetin go bi to am. Lɛk we nɛt kin kech fish, ɛn trap de kech bɔd, na so mɔtalman sɛf kin fɔdɔm insay bad trap we sɔntin kin jɛs apin to am so.
A dɔn si ɔda tin we de bi na wɔl we mek sɛns. I big na mi yay.
Wan smɔl siti bin de we di pipul dɛn we bin de de, nɔ bin plɛnti; Nain wan tɔf tɔf kiŋ go atak am ɛn sɔrawnd am, de bil tin dɛn rawnd di siti fɔ blɔk blɔk am.
Bɔt wan poman bin de de we gɛt sɛns, ɛn nain sɛns i yuz fɔ pul di siti pan waala. Pan ɔl dat, nɔbɔdi nɔ tink bɔt da po man de igen
Na dat mek a se sɛns bɛtɛ pas trɛnk, bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ fil se poman fɔ gɛt sɛns ɛn dɛn nɔ de lisin to am sɛf.
I bɛtɛ fɔ lisin to di saful saful we, we pɔsin we gɛt sɛns de tɔk, pas fɔ de yɛri we dɛn fulman dɛn bigman de ala.
Fɔ gɛt sɛns bɛtɛ pas fɔ gɛt tin dɛn fɔ tek fɛt, ɛn na wan rɔtin fish de pwɛl ɔl di ɔda wan dɛn.
Day flay de mek pafyum pul bad sɛnt; na semweso lili bigful kin pwɛl pɔsin in sɛns ɛn rɛspɛkt.
Pɔsin we gɛt sɛns want fɔ du wetin rayt ɔltɛm, bɔt na bad nɔmɔ de na fulman at.
Ivin we fulman dɛn de waka na trit, bikɔs dɛn nɔ gɛt sɛns, dɛn kin mek ɔlman no se dɛn na fulman.
We kiŋ vɛks pan yu, nɔ vɛks rizayn, bikɔs di vɛks we yu nɔ vɛks bak go mek in at kol.
Wan ɔda bad tin de we a dɔn si na wɔl, we bad lɛk we kiŋ kin mek mistek:
na fulish pɔsin de gɛt gud pozishɔn, ɛn di wan dɛn we jɛntri de sidɔm na lo ples.
A dɔn si slev dɛn de rayd ɔs we kiŋ pikin dɛn de waka lɛk slev.
Ɛnibɔdi we dig ol, nainsɛf go fɔdɔm de, ɛn ɛnibɔdi we brok wɔl go insay, na snek go bɛt am.
Ɛnibɔdi we de brok ston, ston go mɔs wund am; ɛn ɛnibɔdi we de plit wud, wud go mɔs nak an wande.
If nɛf dɔn dɔl ɛn dɛn nɔ shap am, pɔsin gɛt fɔ pul trɛnk fɔ kɔt wit am; bɔt sɛns de mek pɔsin sɔksid.
If snek bɛt pɔsin bifo di man we de kech snek, kech am, nid nɔ de fɔ gɛt pɔsin we de kech am.
Sɛnsman kin bɛnifit fɔ tin we i tɔk bɔt na trɔbul nɔmɔ fulman kin gɛt.
We i opin in mɔt na soso nɔnsɛns ful de ɛn bay di tɛm we i de tɔk dɔn, na so so wikɛdnɛs yu go si;
pan ɔl dat fulman stil de tɔk bɔku. Nɔbɔdi nɔ no wetin gɛt fɔ bi ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul tɔk wetin go apin bambay.
Fulman so de yagba dat i nɔba ebul insɛf ɛn dɛn nɔba sabi rod fɔ go na siti.
Na siriɔs alaki go mit da kɔntri we dɛn kiŋ na pikin, ɛn dɛn bigman dɛn de mek pati na mɔnin.
Una gɛt blɛsin, una we una kiŋ na aristo, ɛn una bigman dɛn sabi di tɛm fɔ mek pati ɛn kɔntrol dɛnsɛf mek dɛn nɔ drɔŋɔ.
Na lezinɛs kin pɔsin in os ruf bɛn go insay, ɛn slaknɛs kin mek di os lik.
Fɔ it na fɔ ɛnjɔy, wayn de mek yu at layt, ɛn mɔni de mek yu nɔ krach yu ed fɔ natin.
Nɔ kɔs di kiŋ, ivin insay yu at, ɔ kɔs jɛntriman, i lɛk yu de na yu rum; bikɔs bɔd we de flay ɔp kin kɛr yu vɔys go, ɔ krichɔ we de flay, kin go se na so yu bin se.
Trowe bred na wata, bikɔs afta sɔm tɛm, yu go gɛt am bak.
Put yu mɔni sɛvin ɔ et say, bikɔs yu nɔ no wetin go apin na wɔl bambay.
We di klawd dak, ren kin kam. Ɛnisay we tik fɔdɔm, na de i de lidɔm.
Ɛnibɔdi we na aw di briz de blo i de luk, nɔ go plant; if na di klawd nɔmɔ i de luk, i nɔ go pik wetin i plant.
Jɛs lɛk aw yu nɔ no aw pikin de gɛt layf insay in mama bɛlɛ, na so yu nɔ no aw PAPA GƆD, we mek ɔltin, de wok.
Na mɔnin, yu de plant yu sid, ivintɛm, yu stil de fɛn tin fɔ du; bikɔs yu nɔ no uswan go bɛnifit yu, di mɔnin yon ɔ di ivintɛm yon, ɔ sɔntɛnde, dɛn ɔltu.
Layt na swit tin, pɔsin de ɛnjɔy fɔ luk di san.
Pipul dɛn we gɛt lɔŋ layf fɔ ɛnjɔy dɛnsɛf ɔltɛm; bɔt lɛ dɛn mɛmba se di bita de dɛn go plɛnti. Ɔl dɛn tɛm dɛn de na fɔ natin.
Ɛnjɔy yusɛf, yɔŋman, we yu yɔŋ, ɛn lɛ yu at mek yu gladi we yu yɔŋ. Du wetin yu at tɛl yu ɛn tek wetin yu si we yu lɛk, bɔt no se fɔ ɔl dɛn tin dɛn de, PAPA GƆD go jɔj yu.
Pul vɛksteshɔn kɔmɔt na yu at ɔltogɛda, lɛ yu nɔ go gɛt pen; bikɔs we pɔsin yɔŋ ɛn we i jɛs bigin layf, na fɔ natin.
Mɛmba PAPA GƆD we mek yu, naw we yu yɔŋ, bifo di tɛm kam we di trɔbul na layf go mit yu, ɛn di tɛm kam we yu go se, “dɛn nɔ min natin to mi;”
bifo di san ɛn di layt ɛn di mun ɛn sta dɛn dak, ɛn di klawd dɛn kam bak afta di ren dɔn kɔt;
di tɛm we di pila dɛn we ol di os de trimbul, ɛn di trɔŋ man dɛn dɔn bɛn, ɛn di uman dɛn we de gren lɛf fɔ wok, bikɔs dɛn nɔ plɛnti igen, ɛn di wan dɛn we de luk na winda nɔ de si bɛtɛ igen;
we di domɔt dɛn we fɔ pas go na trit dɔn lɔk, ɛn bɛtɛ sawnd nɔ de kɔmɔt igen we i de gren, we bɔd sɛf siŋ i de wek, ɛn di gyal pikin dɛn fɔ siŋ, dɔn lo;

di tɛm we yu go de fred fɔ tinap na ay ples, ɛn fred di bad bad tin dɛn we kin apin na trit; we di almɔn tik go dɔn rɛp, ɛn di grasɔpa de drɛg we i de waka, ɛn in filin na layf dɔn dɔn; bikɔs ɔlman fɔ go usay i go de sote go, ɛn pipul dɛn go munin na trit;
bifo di silva rop go kɔt, ɔ di gold bowl go brok, ɔ di say we wata de pɔmp kɔmɔt go brok, ɔ di wil we de tɔn fɔ lɛ wata pɔmp sɛf, go brok,
ɛn dɔti go bak usay i kɔmɔt, dɔn di sol go bak to PAPA GƆD we bin gi yu am.
Di pricha se, di natin we pas ɔl natin na wɔl, ɔl na fufafu.
Apat frɔm we di pricha gɛt sɛns, i bin de tich pipul dɛn, ɛn de luk tin dɛn minin, ɛn de stɔdi ɛn de rayt plɛnti prɔvab dɛn.
Di pricha tray fɔ fɛn di rayt wɔd fɔ yuz ɛn rayt di tru, plen plen wan.
Wetin sɛnsman de se tan lɛk we yu fos pɔsin fɔ du sɔntin, ɛn ɔl wetin wan shɛpad dɔn se we dɛn put wan ples, tan lɛk nel we dɛn nak go insay prɔpa wan.
If yu wan no mɔ pas dis, mi pikin, tek tɛm. I lɛk dɛn mek plɛnti buk te, dɛn nɔ go ɛva se dɛn dɔn mek ɔl di buk dɛn dɔn, na wɔl, ɛn plɛnti lanin kin mek yu gens.
Tɔk am go, tɔk am kam, una dɔn yɛri ɔltin. Fred PAPA GƆD ɛn du wetin i se fɔ du; bikɔs na dat nɔmɔ mɔtalman gɛt fɔ de du.
PAPA GƆD go jɔj ɔltin we pipul du, we insay de yu gɛt di sikrit tin dɛn we pipul ayd du; di gud wan dɛn ɛn di bad wan dɛn.
Di Siŋ we pas Ɔl Siŋ we Sɔlɔmɔn rayt.
If nɔmɔ yu kin kis mi wit ɔl di kis dɛn na yu mɔt; Bikɔs yu lɔv swit pas wayn.
Yu sɛnt dɛn we yu de rɔb, gɛt swit smɛl; yu nem na lɛk we dɛn tɔn sɛnt; na dat mek di yɔŋ gyal dɛn lɛk yu.
Drɔ mi biɛn yu, lɛ wi mekes Di kiŋ dɔn briŋ mi kam insay in rum. Wi go gladi ɛn gladi pan yu wi go prez yu lɔv pas wayn dɛn nɔ mis we dɛn lɛk yu.
A blak o, bɔt a fayn, Jerusɛlɛm in gyal pikin dɛn, A blak lɛk Kida tɛnt lɛk Sɔlɔmɔn in winda blaynd dɛn.
Una nɔ wach mi bikɔs a blak o bikɔs san dɔn bɔn mi Mi mama in bɔypikin dɛn vɛks pan mi, dɛn mek mi edman fɔ di greps gadin dɛn, bɔt mi yon greps gadin a nɔ luk kam!
Tɛl mi, yu we mi sol lɛk, usay yu de fid yu ship dɛn, usay yu de mek dɛn lidɔm santɛm; a nɔ si wetin mek a fɔ tan lɛk udat de waka waka nia yu kɔmpin dɛn ship dɛn.
If yu nɔ sabi Uman we fayn pas ɔl uman, fala di ship dɛn mak ɛn fid yu yɔŋ got dɛn nia di shɛpad dɛn tɛnt dɛn.
Mi lɔv, a de si yu lɛk uman ɔs pan Fero in chariɔt dɛn.
Yu jɔ dɛn fayn wit trinkɛt, yu nɛk wit dɛn pal bid.
Wi go mek gold trinkɛt fɔ yu, dɛn go dɔt dɔt am wit silva.
Wɛn di kiŋ de nain kawch mi pafyum skata fayn sɛnt.
Mi bilɔvɛd tan to mi lɛk wan bag sɛnt we lidɔm midul mi bɔbi dɛn.
Mi bilɔvɛd to mi na lɛk wan bɔnch rɛd flawa we de bɔs na di greps gadin dɛn we de Ɛngɛday.
Bo yu fayn o mi lɔv; bo yu fayn; yu yay dɛn tan lɛk dɔv yay.
Luk we yu fayn, mi man we a lɛk fɔ tru, yu fayn fɔ luk. Wi kawch na grin kawch.
Di tik dɛn we ol wi ruf, na Sida tik, wi rafta dɛn na Payn tik.
Mi na di roz we de na Sharɔn, di Lili flawa we kin de na dɛn vali.
Lɛkɛ Lili flawa we de wit dɛn chuk chuk, na so mi daliŋ tan wit dɛn ɔda yɔŋ gyal.
Lɛkɛ apul tik na bush, na so mi man we a lɛk fɔ tru, kin tan we i de wit dɛn ɔda yɔŋman dɛn. I de swit mi we a sidɔm nain shado, ɛn in frut swit so na mi mɔt.
I dɔn briŋ mi kam na di os we i kin mek pati, di bana we i ɛŋ oba mi na lɔv.
Gi mi trɛnk wit dray grep dɛn, mek a frɛsh bak wit apul; bikɔs lɔv sik de pan mi.
Aya, a wish in lɛf an de ɔnda mi ed ɛn in raytan ol mi tayt.
Duya O Jerusɛlɛm in gyal pikin dɛn, a de tek di Fritambo dɛn ɔ uman dia we de na bush beg una, una nɔ provok ɔ wek lɔv te in tɛm rich.
Mi bilɔvɛd in vɔys! Luk am, i de kam. I de jomp pan di mawnten dɛn i de jomp oba di il dɛn.
Mi bilɔvɛd tan lɛk fritambo, ɔ lɛk dɛn yɔŋ man dia. Luk am, i tinap de biɛn wi wɔl, i de wach insay di winda, i de pip tru di trɛlis.
Mi bilɔvɛd de tɔk ɛn i tɛl mi se “Grap mi lɔv, mi fayn uman ɛn kam lɛ wi go.
Biklɔs yu si winta dɔn pas, di ren dɔn dɔn kpatakpata.
Di flawa dɛn dɔn bɔs na grɔn, di tɛm fɔ siŋ dɔn kam, ɛn di tɔtul dɔv in vɔys dɔn de sawnd na di land bak.
Di fig tik sɛf dɔn de pul fig, ɛn di greps dɛn dɔn de pul flawa; dɛn sɛnt de skata ɔlɔbɔt. Grap mi lɔv, mi fayn uman ɛn kam mek wi go.
E mi dɔv, usay di rɔk dɛn plit, insay di kev pat na dɛn shap mawnten, alaw mi lɛ a si yu fes, mek a yɛri yu vɔys, bikɔs yu vɔys swit, ɛn yu fes fayn.
Mek wi kech dɛn fɔks dɛn, di lili fɔks dɛn, we de pwɛl di greps gadin bikɔs wi greps gadin dɛn wan bia.”
Mi man we a lɛk na mi yon, ɛn mi nain yon, i de fid in ship usay dɛn Lili flawa de.
So te di mɔnin briz bigin blo ɛn do bigin klin, kam bak, mi man we a lɛk, mek lɛk fritambo, ɔ lɛkɛ dɛn yɔŋ man dia, we de na dɛn rɔf mawnten.
Na mi bed na nɛt, A luk fɔ am am, di wan we mi sol lɛk; A sach fɔ am, bɔt a nɔ fɛn am; A kɔl am, bɔt i nɔ ansa.
“A go grap naw ɛn go na di siti, insay di trit dɛn ɛn dɛn opin ples; A go luk fɔ di wan we mi sol lɛk.” A luk fɔ am, bɔt a nɔ fɛn am.
Dɛn wachman dɛn si mi we dɛn de patrol na di siti. “Duya, una si di wan we mi sol lɛk?”
I nɔ te sɛf we a pas dɛn, nain a fɛn di wan we mi sol lɛk. A ol am, a nɔ gri lɛf am te a briŋ am kam nan mi mama in os, ɛn insay di wan we bɔn mi in rum.
Duya o, Jerusɛlɛm in gyal pikin dɛn, a tek di fritambo ɔ uman dia we de na bush beg una, una nɔ provok ɔ wek lɔv, te in tɛm rich.
Wetin dat de kɔmɔt na di dɛzat lɛk smok, lɛkɛ pila, pafyum ɛn frankinsɛns smɛl pan am, wit ɔl dɛn fayn sɛnt pawda we dɛn treda de sɛl.
Na Sɔlɔmɔn dɛn tot nain tron! Na siksti trɛnk man dɛn pan di sojaman dɛn na Izrɛl.
Dɛn ɔl gɛt sɔd na dɛn wes Dɛn ɔl na masta sabi man dɛn pan wa ɔlman gɛt in sɔd nain lɛg fɔ ɛnitin we go apin na nɛt.
Sɔlɔmɔn mek in tron we i de tek waka wit dɛn wud we kɔmɔt Libanɔn.
Di pol dɛn le wit silva Di bak na gold, di sit na pɔpul; dɛn wok am fayn insay; na Jerusɛlɛm in gyal pikin dɛn du am.
Una go, Zayɔn in gyal pikin dɛn, ɛn luk Kiŋ Sɔlɔmɔn, Wit di krawn we in mama krawn am di de we i mared, di de we in at gladi.
Bo yu fayn mi lɔv! Luk we yu fayn yu yay dɛn na lɛkɛ dɔv biɛn yu vel. Yu ia tan lɛk we dɛn got gɛda de muf go dɔŋ Mawnt Giliad in sayd dɛn.
Yu tit tan lɛkɛ dɛn uman ship we dɛn kin dɔn shev dɛn ia, di tɛm we dɛn kin dɔn was dɛn, dɛn ɔl bɔn twin ɛn nɔn pan dɛn pikin nɔ day.
Yu lip dɛn na lɛk rɛd trɛd, yu mɔt fayn. Yu chik dɛn tan lɛk af af pomigranet biɛn yu vel.
Yu nɛk lɛk Devid in tawa we dɛn bil fɔ put wɛpɔn, dɛn ɛŋ wan-tawzin smɔl shild de, ɔl na sojaman big shild.
Yu tu bɔbi dɛn na lɛkɛ tu fritambo pikin, twin we fritambo bɔn, we de it usay Lili flawa de gro.
So te di mɔnin briz de blo, ɛn do de klin, A go tap na di pafyum mawnten ɛn di frankinsɛns il.
Yu fayn bad bad wan mi lɔv; wan bɔt nɔ de pan yu.
Mi yawo, kɔmɔt Libanɔn kam go wit mi, kam go wit mi kɔmɔt Libanɔn. Kɔmɔt na Amanain ed na Sɛnir ɛn Amɔn dɛn ed, kɔmɔt na di layɔn dɛn os, kɔmɔt na di lɛpɛt dɛn mawnten.
Yu dɔn kapchɔ mi at, mi sista, mi yawo, yu luk mi wantɛm nain a lɔs, yu kapchɔ mi wit wan juɛl pan yu chen.
Di we we yu lɔv swit, mi sista, mi yawo! Yu lɔv i bɛtɛ pas wayn, ɛn di fayn sɛnt we yu pafyum dɛn de pul pas spays.
Yu lip dɛn de mek swit tin lɛk flawa jus, mi yawo, ɔni ɛn milk de ɔnda yu siti, Yu klos dɛn sɛnt na lɛk Libanɔn in sɛnt.
Gadin we lɔk nain na mi sista, mi yawo, gadin we lɔk, ples we wata de kɔmɔt ɔnda grɔn we na wan pɔsin gɛt am.
Yu plant dɛn na fam we pomigranet tik de plɛnti wit ɔl dɛn fayn fayn frut, rɛd flawa ɛn pafyum,
pafyum ɛn safrɔn, kalamus ɛn sinamɔn, wit ɔl dɛn frankinsɛns tik pafyum ɛn alo dɛn, wit ɔl dɛn nɔmba wan spays.
Fawnten we de na gadin, wata wɛl we de gi layf, ɛn riva we de rɔndɔŋ kɔmɔt Libanɔn.

Wek o, yu briz we de blo kɔmɔt na di nɔth, ɛn kam, yu briz we de blo frɔm sawt blo pan mi gadin, lɛ in sɛnt bigin waka ɔlsay. Lɛ mi man we a lɛk kam nain gadin, ɛn it di frut we swit pas ɔl na di gadin.
A de kam insay mi gadin, mi sista, mi yawo, A de gɛda mi Ma wit mi spays, A de it mi ɔnikomb wit mi ɔni, A de drink mi wayn wit mi milk, It o padi dɛn ɛn drink; drink dip o, lɔva dɛn!
A slip bɔt mi at wek. Na wetin! Mi bilɔvɛd de nak. “Opin fɔ mi, mi sista, mi lɔvin, mi dɔv, mi yon we nɔ gɛt bɔt; mi ed sok wit dyu ɛn mi ia ɔl sok wit dyu.
A bin dɔn pul klos; Aw a go wɛr am bak? A dɔn was mi fut, aw a go dɔti am bak?
Mi lɔva put in an pan di andul, ɛn mi at gladi insay mi.
A grap fɔ opin fɔ mi man we a lɛk, ɛn mi an dɛn bin de drip wit pafyum, mi fiŋa dɛn gɛt wata pafyum, we a put an pan di bolt in andul.
A opin fɔ mi ma we a lɛk, bɔt mi lɔva bin dɔn tɔn ɛn go. Mi at pwɛl wɛn i tɔk. A luk fɔ am bɔt a nɔ si am; A kɔl am bɔt i nɔ ansa.
Di wachman dɛn fɛn mi, we dɛn de patrol na di siti; dɛn bit mi, dɛn wund mi, dɛn pul mi shɔl kɛr am go, dɛn wachman dɛn pantap di wɔl.
Duya O Jerusɛlɛm in gyal pikin dɛn, if una fɛn mi lɔva, du mek una tɛl am se, a gɛt lɔv sik.
Wetin na yu lɔva pas ɛni ɔda lɔva, uman we fayn pas ɔl uman dɛn? Wetin na yu lɔva pas ɛni ɔda lɔva, we mek yu de put wɔd pan wi so?
Ɔl say pan mi man we a lɛk de shayn ɛn frɛsh, insay tɛn tawzin man i nɔ de ayd.
In ed na fɔs klas gold; i gɛt kuli ia, we blak lɛk ta bebi.
In yay na lɛk dɔv dɛn we de to di say we wata de bɔs na grɔn, dɛn was am insay milk, i sɛt fayn.
In jɔ lɛk we dɛn mek ip na gadin fɔ plant ɔl ful wit spays dɛn, we de pul fayn fayn sɛnt. In lip dɛn na lɛk da Lili flawa, we wata pafyum de kɔmɔt pan.
In an dɛn fayn lɛk we dɛn mol gold, ɛn sɛt wit juɛl. In bɔdi tan lɛk ayvri, we dɛn ful wit fayn blu ston.
In lɛg dɛn na wayt mabul pila we dɛn fiks insay gold sɔkɛt dɛn. I fiba lɛk Libanɔn, i fayn lɛk dɛn soba sida tik.
In tɔk swit bad, ɛn insɛf yu mɔs want am. Na mi bilɔvɛd dat ɛn na mi padi dat, Jerusɛlɛm in gyal pikin dɛn.
Wɛl usay yu man we yu lɛk dɔn go naw, uman we fayn pas ɔl? Usay yu dɔn put ed, so dat wi kin ɛp yu luk fɔ am?
Mi daliŋ dɔn go dɔŋ nain gadin, usay dɛn plant spays, i go fid in ship dɛn na gadin ɛn gɛda Lili flawa dɛn.
Mi na mi daliŋ yon, ɛn mi daliŋ na mi yon, i de fid in ship dɛn usay dɛn Lili flawa de.
Yu fayn lɛk Tiza mi lɔv, fayn lɛk Jerusɛlɛm, fiaful lɛk ami we de mach wit bana.
Pul yu yay kɔmɔt pan mi i de tɔch mi. Yu ia na lɛk wɛn got dɛn gɛda, dɛn de waka go dɔŋ Mawnt Giliad
Yu tit lɛk we uman ship dɛn gɛda wansay, we dɛn kɔmɔt was, we dɛn ɔl bɔn twin, nɔn pan dɛn pikin nɔ day.
Yu chik dɛn tan lɛk af af pomigranet, biɛn yu vel.
Siksti kwin dɛn de, ɛn eti switat dɛn ɛn fɔ yɔŋ gyal dɛn, man nɔ fit kɔnt.
Mi dɔv, mi yon we nɔ gɛ bɔt, nain wangren, In mami bɔl yay, i nɔ si wan bɔt pan am. Di yɔŋ gyal dɛn luk am, dɛn gi am nem, Gladis, di kwin ɛn switat dɛnsɛf si am ɛn prez am.
“Udat dis we de shayn lɛk do klin, fayn lɛk mun, de shayn lɛk san, fiaful lɛk ami we de mach wit bana.
A go go dɔŋ na di fam we dɛn plant almɔnd tik, fɔ si if dɛn plant dɛn de bɔs na di vali, fɔ si if di greps dɛn dɔn bigin bia, ɛn if di pomigranet dɛn dɔn de kɔmɔt.
Bifo a kin kechɔp misɛf, di want we a want yu, mek a si misɛf lɛk a de insay chariɔt nia mi prins.
Kam bak, kam bak o, Shulamayt uman, kam bak lɛ wi go luk yu gud. Wetin mek una fɔ luk di Shulamayt lɛk yu de luk tu ami dɛn dans?
Luk we yu fut dɛn mol fayn insay sandal, yɔŋ gyal we tan lɛk kwin! Yu lɛg dɛn rawnd rawnd lɛk juɛl we dɔn pas na masta sabi wokman in an.
Yu nebul na lɛk rawnd bol, we ɔltɛm gɛt wayn we dɛn de miks. Yu bɛlɛ tan lɛk we dɛn kɔt nyu rɛs na fam, ɛn put Lili flawa dɛn rawnd am
Yu tu bɔbi dɛn tan lɛk tu fritambo pikin, twin dɛn we fritambo bɔn.
Yu nɛk tan lɛk ayvri tawa. Yu yay dɛn tan lɛk dɛn watasay na Ɛshbɔn, nia di get na Bat Rabim. Yu nos tan lɛk Libanɔn tawa, usay yu go tinap si Damaskɔs.
Yu ed ay lɛk Mawnt Kamɛl ɛn yu lɔŋ ia tan lɛk pɔpul klos; yu dɔn kapchɔ kiŋ insay yu ia.
Luk we yu fayn, luk we yu gud fɔ luk, Di wan we a lɛk, yɔŋgyal, yu tu swit
Lɛk pam tik na so yu tret ɛn ay, Yu bɔbi dɛn tan lɛk banga ed.
A se a go klem di pamtri ɛn ol di branch dɛn. Ey! Mek yu bɔbi dɛn tan lɛk bɔnch greps ɛn yu mɔt in sɛnt lɛk apul.
Ɛn mek yu kis dɛn, tan lɛk dɛn dia ɛn soba wayn, we de go dɔŋ di trot smut wan, de slayd fayn pan lip ɛn tit.
Mi na mi bilɔvɛd yon ɛn na mi i want.
Kam mi daliŋ, lɛ wi go na di fil dɛn, ɛn tap na di vilej dɛn.
Lɛ wi kɔmɔt ali go na di greps gadin dɛn fɔ luk if di greps dɛn flawa dɔn opin, ɛn if di pomigranet dɛnsɛf dɔn rɛdi. Na de a go gi yu mi lɔv.
Da bɔn-pikin flawa de pul fayn sɛnt, ɛn ɔlsay pan wi domɔt na dɛn fayn fayn frut, nyu wan ɛn ol wan we a bin dɔn kip fɔ yu mi daliŋ.
A wish yu bin bi lɛk brɔda to mi, we sɔk bɔbi to mi mama! Datɛnde if a mit yu na trit, a fɔ kis yu, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go luk mi lɛs fɔ seka dat.
A go ol yu ɛn kɛr yu go na mi mama in os, insay di wan we tekin fɔ mi in rum. A go gi yu wayn we gɛt spays, fɔ drink, ɛn a go kwis mi pomigranet fɔ yu.
Aya! A wish in lɛf an de ɔnda mi ed, ɛn in raytan grip mi.
Duya O Jerusɛlɛm in gyal pikin dɛn, una nɔ provok ɔ wek lɔv te in tɛm rich.
Udat dawande we de kɔmɔt na di dɛzat de liŋ pan in daliŋ? A wek yu ɔnda di apul tik. Da say we in mama in bɛlɛ at am fɔ bɔn yu, na de di wan we bɔn yu in bɛlɛ bin at am.
Fiks mi lɛkɛ lɔk na yu at lɛkɛ lɔk na yu an; bikɔs lɔv traŋa lɛk day, jɛlɔs wikɛd pas di grev. I de bɔs lɛk we faya de bɔs, di faya we wam tumɔs.
Bɔku wata nɔ go ebul ɔt lɔv, flɔd sɛf nɔ go ebul drawn am. If man gi ɔl di jɛntri nain os fɔ lɔv, dɛn nɔ go maks am sɛf.
Wi gɛt wan smɔl sista ɛn i nɔ gɛt bɔbi. Wetin wi go du fɔ wi sista wɛn dɛn go kam aks fɔ am.
If in na wɔl, wi go bil silva tawa pan am; bɔt if in na domɔt, wi go nak sayd bod pan am.
Mi na bin wɔl, ɛn mi bɔbi dɛn na lɛk tawa dɛn; datɛnde, a tan nain yay lɛk pɔsin we de briŋ kol at.
Sɔlɔmɔn bin gɛt greps gadin na Beal Amɔn; i rɛnt in greps gadin to gadina dɛn; dɛn ɔl fɔ pe am wan tawzin silva kɔpɔ fɔ di frut dɛn.
Mi greps gadin, mi yon yon na fɔ mi; yu Sɔlɔmɔn, yu gɛt lɛk dɛn wan tawzin, ɛn di wan dɛn we de kip di frut dɛn lɛkɛ dɛn tu ɔndrɛd.
Yu we tap na di gadin dɛn, mi kɔmpin dɛn de lisin fɔ yu vɔys, mek yu yɛri am.
Mekes mi daliŋ mek lɛk fritambo ɔ lɛkɛ dɛn yɔŋ man dia na di mawnten we spays de gro.
Ayzaya we na Emɔz in bɔypikin, in vishɔn dɛn we i si bɔt Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm, di tɛm dɛn we Uzaya, Jotam, Eaz ɛn Ɛzikaya bin bi kiŋ na Juda.
Di Ɛvin dɛn, una yɛri o! Ɛn lɛ di ath sɛf opin in yes! Bikɔs na PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk: “A dɔn men ɛn tren una mi bɔypikin dɛm, bɔt dɛn tɔn pan mi.
Man kaw no udat i blant, ɛn dɔŋki no di say we in masta put in it, bɔt Izrɛl nɔ no, mi pipul dɛn nɔ ɔndastand.”
E, neshɔn we gɛt sin, pipul we de du so so bad, pikin we bad pipul bɔn, bɔypikin dɛn we kɔrɔpt! Dɛn dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn PAPA GƆD, dɛn nɔ rɛspɛkt di Oli Wan na Izrɛl dɛn dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn am kpatakpata.
Wetindu una stil wan lɛ dɛn pɔnish una, we una fasin fɔ traŋayes? Di wanol ed sik ɛn di wanol at wik.
Frɔm bɔtɔm di fut te rich di ed, nɔn say nɔ de we bɛtɛ, pas so so brus brus ɛn sofut ɛn wund dɛn we de blid; dɛn nɔ kwis di tɔf kɔmɔt ɛn dɛn nɔ tay dɛn, ɔ ivin put mɛrɛsin de.
Una kɔntri lɛf ɛmti wan, faya dɔn bɔn di siti dɛm; bifo una yon yay, fɔrina dɛn pwɛl una land; i ɛmti lɛk aw di fɔrina dɛn bin lɛf am.
Dat mek Zayɔn in gyal pikin dɔn lɛf lɛk bafa na greps fam, i yuslɛs lɛk os na kɔkumba fam, lɛk siti we ɛnimi dɔn sɔrawnd.
If PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, nɔ bin lɛf tu-tri pan wi we nɔ day, wi bin fɔ dɔn tan lɛk Sɔdɔm, ɛn bi lɛk Gɔmɔra.
Una yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD se una we de rul Sɔdɔm! Opin yes to wetin wi Gɔd de tich, una di pipul dɛn na Gɔmɔra.

PAPA GƆD se, “Wetin ɔl dɛn bɔku bɔku sakrifays we una de mek min to mi? A dɔn gɛt tumɔs man ship ɔfrin we dɛn de bɔn na faya ɛn fat we kɔmɔt pan animal dɛn we dɛn fid gud gud wan; Man kaw blɔd o, ship pikin blɔd o, ɔ ivin man got blɔd, nɔ de mek a gladi.
“We una kam fɔ wɔship mi, udat se una fɔ de pas pas dis kayn pas pas na mi kɔtyad?
Una nɔ briŋ mɔ fɔnatin ɔfrin kam igen; Insɛns na tin we a et bad bad wan. Nyu mun o, de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst o, ɛn we una kin gɛda fɔ wɔship mi- A nɔ go ebul bia sin insay ɔl dɛn fɛstival dɛn de igen.
Mi sol et una nyu mun ɛn una fɛstival dɛn we una pik; dɛn dɔn tɔn ebi lod pan mi, A nɔ go ebul bia dɛm igen
We una tret una an dɛn to mi, A go kɔba mi yay lɛ a nɔ si, i lɛk we una pre bɔku bɔku prea A nɔ go lisin; na so so blɔd de na una an.
Una was una sɛf; una mek una sɛf klin na mi yay; una pul di bad bad dɛn pan wetin una de du kɔmɔt bifo mi; una tap fɔ du bad
una lan fɔ du gud; trit ɔlman di sem, nɔ gri lɛ dɛn trit pipul dɛn du bad; tinap fɔ di wan dɛn we dɛn papa dɔn day, tɔk fɔ uman we in man dɔn day.
PAPA Gɔd se, “Kam naw naw lɛ we ɛŋed togɛda, i lɛk una sin dɛn rɛd lɛk blɔd, dɛn go wayt lɛk shatin; i lɛk dɛn rɛd lɛk krimsin, dɛn go tan lɛk kɔtinwul.
If una gri fɔ du wetin a se ɛn obe mi, una go ɛnjɔy ɔl di gud tin dɛn na di land.
Bɔt if una nɔ gri ɛn tɔn una bak pan mi, na wa una go day; bikɔs na PAPA GƆD sɛf sɛf tɔk so.”
Da siti we bin de rɛspɛkt mi dɔn tɔn rare gyal, in we bin sabi trit ɔlman di sem! Nainsay am, fɔ waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, bin tap, bɔt naw, na mɔdra dɛn tap de.
Una silva nɔ gɛt valyu igen, una wayn dɔn miks wit wata.

Una bigman dɛn ɔl na rebɛl ɛn de waka wit tifman dɛm. Ɔlman lɛk fɔ tek brayb dɛn de rɔnata prɛzɛnt. Dɛn nɔ fɛt fɔ di wan dɛn we dɛn papa dɔn day, ɛn nɔ bisin bɔt dɛn uman dɛn we dɛn man dɔn day, dɛn kes.
Fɔseka dat PAPA GƆD se, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, di wan we de ay pas ɔlman na Izrɛl: “E! A go lus mi tɛmpa pan mi ɛnimi dɛn ɛn a go pe mi ɛnimi dɛn bak.
A go dil wit una A go mɛlt dɔti kɔmɔt pan una lɛk we dɛn mɛlt ayɛn ɛn pul ɔl wetin mek una nɔ piɔ igen.
Ɛn a go put una jɔj dɛn bak lɛk fɔstɛm, ɛn una advays dɛn, jɛs lɛk aw una bin bigin. Afta dat, dɛn go kɔl una di siti we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, siti we de kip Gɔd wɔd.”
Na rɛspɛkt fɔ yu kɔmpin mɔtalman go pul Zayɔn pan wahala ɛn na fɔ waka tret wit PAPA GƆD go pul di wan we de insay zayɔn, we ripɛnt.
Bɔt dɛn go nyakanyaka di rebɛl ɛn di sina dɛn togɛda, ɛn i go kil dɛn wan we tɔn dɛn bak pan Gɔd.
Una go shem bikɔs una bin de gladi fɔ go na dɛn kɔtintri de; dɛn gadin we una bin pik go mek una ayd una fes.
Bikɔs una go tan lɛkɛ kɔtintri we in lif dɛn dɔn wida ɛn lɛkɛ gadin we nɔ gɛt wata.
Ɛn di wan we gɛt trɛnk go tɔn wud chips, we in wok na fɔ mek spak, ɛn dɛn ɔltu go bɔn togɛda ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul ɔt dɛm.
Di wɔd we Ayzaya, we na Emɔz in bɔypikin bin si bɔt Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm.
Di tɛm go kam we di mawnten na PAPA GƆD in os go bi di mawnten we ay pas ɔl dɛn mawten dɛm ɛn go ay pas ɔl dɛn il dɛm, ɛn ɔlman go go de,

Bɔku pipul go kam ɛn tɔk se: ‘Kam, lɛ we go ɔp PAPA GƆD in mawnten, na Jekɔb in Gɔd in os; mek i go tich wi in we so wisɛf go waka aw i want wi fɔ waka.” Bikɔs na zayɔn di lɔ go kɔmɔt, ɛn PAPA GƆD in wɔd go kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm.
I go jɔj bitwin di neshɔn dɛm ɛn go disayd fɔ bɔku pipul dɛm; ɛn dɛn go tɔn dɛn sɔd dɛn to gɔgɔ, ɛn dɛn spia dɛn go tɔn gadin sizɔs wan kɔntri nɔ go tek sɔd fɔ in kɔmpin igen ɛn wa nɔ go de igen.
E Jekɔb in os, una kam lɛ wi waka na PAPA GƆD in layt.
Bikɔs yu dɔn pul an pan yu pipul, we na Jekɔb in os, bikɔs pan dɛn na mɛrɛsinman dɛm we kɔmɔt na di ist ɛn luk grɔn man dɛn, jɛs lɛk di Filistin dɛm, ɛn dɛn de mek padi wit fɔrina dɛm.
Dɛn grɔn ful wit silva ɛn gold, ɛn dɛn jɛntri nɔ de dɔn; Dɛn ples ful wit ɔs dɛm, ɛn dɛn chariɔt nɔ de dɔn.
Dɛn ples ful wit laylay gɔd; ɛn dɛn de butu to di tin we dɛn yon an mek, to di tin we dɛn yon finga mek.
Na so dɛn go ɔmbul mɔtalman, ɛn na so pipul dɛn kin fɔdɔm na layf- nɔ fɔgiv dɛm o!
Go insay di big ston dɛn, ɛn ayd ɔnda di dɔti pan di bad tin we PAPA GƆD go du, ɛn pan di wɔnda pan in pawa.
Di kak we mɔtalman de kak, go brok kan dɔŋ, ɛn prawd pɔsin in fɛda go brok kan dɔŋ; ɛn da de de, na PAPA GƆD wangren dɛn go es ɔp.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti gɛt in yon de fɔ dil wit ɔl dɛn prawd wan dɛn ɛn dɛn wan we tink tumɔs bɔt dɛnsɛf, ɛn ɔl di wan dɛn we de es dɛnsɛf ɔp ɛn de kak;
agens ɔl Libanɔn in ay ɛn mayti sida tik dɛn we pipul dɛn de kɔle pan, agens ɔl di ok dɛn na Beshan;
agens ɔl dɛn ay mawnten dɛn, ɛn dil wit ɔl dɛn ay il dɛn;
agens ɔl dɛn ay tawa ɛn ɔl dɛn wɔl we pipul abop pan fɔ protɛkshɔn;
agens ɔl dɛn ship we kɔmɔt Tashish, ɛn ɔl dɛn fayn fayn tin dɛn we dɛn de tek an mek.
Dɛn go brok prawd mɔtalman in fɛda dɔŋ, ɛn di kak we pipul dɛn de kak go kan dɔŋ; ɛn na PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ dɛn go es ɔp da de de.
Ɛn dɛn nɔ go si ɔl dɛn laylay gɔd dɛn igen
mɔtalman dɛn go go insay di kev dɛn na dɛn big big ston ɛn di ol dɛn na grɔn, fɔ ayd pan di bad bad tin we PAPA GƆD go du, ɛn pan di wɔnda pan in pawa, we i go grap fɔ mek di wɔl fred am.
Da tɛm de, pipul dɛn go trowe dɛn silva laylay gɔd ɛn gold laylay gɔd we dɛn mek fɔ dɛnsɛf fɔ wɔship, to dɛn grɔmpig ɛn dɛn bat,
fɔ rɔn go insay dɛn big kev na dɛn big big ston, ɛn dɛn ol na dɛn mawnten in ɛj, fɔ ayd pan di bad bad tin we PAPA GƆD go du ɛn pan di wɔnda pan in pawa, we i go grap fɔ mek di wɔl fred am.
Pul at pan mɔtalman we nain nos i de blo, aftawɔd, wetin na mɔtalman?
PAPA GƆD, we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, de pul kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda, dɛn sɔplay ɛn dɛn sɔpɔt, di it we dɛn fɔ it, ɛn di wata we dɛn fɔ drink,
di pawaful man ɛn di soja, di jɔj ɛn di prɔfɛt, di luk grɔn man ɛn di bigman,
di kapten fɔ fifti soja man, ɛn di man we gɛt ay rank, di advaysa ɛn di kɔni kɔni majikman ɛn di man we sabi ple wit mɛrɛsin.
Ɛn a go mek yɔŋ bɔbɔ dɛn tɔn di bigman dɛn, ɛn lili pikin go rul dɛm.
Ɛn pipul dɛn go tek advantej pan dɛn dɛnsɛf, ɛn pan dɛn kɔmpin ɛn pan dɛn neba; dɛn yɔŋ wan dɛm go fityay big wan dɛm ɛn di yuslɛs man go fityay di bigman.
We wan man go grip in brɔda nain papa os, se, “Yu gɛt kot fɔ wɛr; yu go bi wi lida, ɛn di broko os go de ɔnda yu pawa”;
da de de, i go tɔk se “A nɔ go mɛn una o: bred ɔ klos sɛf nɔ de na mi os; una nɔ go mek mi lida fɔ di pipul.”
Jerusɛlɛm dɔn bɔk in fut, ɛn Juda dɔn fɔdɔm; bikɔs di tin we dɛn de tɔk, ɛn di tin we dɛn de du, de agens PAPA GƆD, dɛn nɔ de rɛspɛkt di pawa pan in glori.
Di pashal we dɛn pashal go pul dɛn sikrit na do, dɛn de anawns dɛn sin lɛk Sɔdɔm, dɛn nɔ de ayd am sɛf. Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan dɛm! Bikɔs dɛn dɔn bay denja pak am pan dɛnsɛf.
Tɛl dɛn wan we de waka tret se ɔltin go fayn fɔ dɛn, bikɔs dɛn go it wetin dɛn plant
swɛ go fɔdɔm pan dɛm, dɛn wikɛd pipul. I go bad fɔ dɛm, bikɔs na wetin dɛn du dɛn go tɔn gi dɛm bak.
Mi pipul dɛn na pikin dɛn de mek mi pipul dɛn sɔfa so, ɛn na uman dɛn de rul dɛm. E mi pipul dɛm, na una lida dɛn de mislid una ɛn miks ɔp di rod we una fɔ pas na layf.
PAPA GƆD dɔn rɛdi fɔ di kes, I dɔn tinap fɔ jɔj in pipul dɛm.
PAPA GƆD go kot wit di edman dɛn ɛn di bigman dɛm fɔ in pipul; “Na una dɔn tif ɔltin na di greps gadin, di tin dɛn we una tif na di po pipul dɛn an, de na una os dɛn.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, wetin una min we una de mek mi pipul dɛn sɔfa so, ɛn we una de tek advantej pan po pipul?”
PAPA GƆD se: Bikɔs di uman dɛn na Zayɔn prawd ɛn de lɔŋ dɛn nɛk we dɛn de waka, de luk fɔ man fɔ lidɔm wit, dɛn de spot chɛp chɛp we dɛn de waka, ɛn di baŋuls dɛn de nak na dɛn fut;
PAPA GƆD go put siknɛs pan Zayɔn in gyal pikin dɛn ed, ɛn PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn nekɛd.
Da de de, PAPA GƆD go pul di fayn fayn baŋuls kɔmɔt na dɛn fut, di ɛdban we dɛn de put rawnd dɛn ed, ɛn di kɔrɔnɛt dɛm;
di chen dɛm, di breslɛt ɛn di skaf dɛn;
di ɛnkincha, di baŋuls we dɛn de wɛr ɔp dɛn an, di sash, di pafyum bɔks dɛn ɛn di tin dɛn we pɔsin kin wɛr ɔp in an fɔ protɛkshɔn;
riŋ we gɛt dizayn, ɛn nos riŋ dɛn,
di klos dɛn fɔ wɛr fɔ fɛstival, di gawn dɛm, di lɔŋ kot dɛm, ɛn di anbag dɛm;
klos dɛn we dɛn mek wit les, di klos dɛn we dɛn tek linin mek, di tɔban ɛn di vel dɛm.

Bifo una gɛt pafyum, na bad bad sɛnt una go de gɛt; bifo una gɛt gadul, na rop go de; bifo una gɛt ia we mek fayn fayn wan, na bɔled dɛn go gɛt bifo dɛn gɛt dɛn dia dia klos, na saklɔth dɛn go tay; bifo dɛn fayn, na shem dɛn go shem.
Na sɔd go kil una man dɛn ɛn una pawaful fɛtman dɛn go day na wa.
Ɛn in get dɛn go kray de munin; in go sidɔm na grɔn lɛk udat dɔn lɔs ɔltin na layf.
Tɛm go kam we sɛvin uman go grip wan man de tɛl am se, “Wi go fid wisɛf ɛn wi go bay klos fɔ wisɛf; jɛs gri nɔmɔ se yu na wi man lɛ yu pul shem pan wi.”
Da de de, PAPA GƆD in branch go fayn ɛn ɔlman go wan si am, ɛn na di frut we di grɔn go bia, di wan dɛn we lɛf na Izrɛl, go tek blɔf ɛn mek nem.
Dɛn go kɔl di wan dɛn we lɛf na Zayɔn ɛn di balans na Jerusɛlɛm oli pipul; dat na ɔlman insay Jerusɛlɛm we Gɔd dɔn rayt in nem se i go liv,
we PAPA GƆD go dɔn was Zayɔn in gyal pikin dɛn dɔti kɔmɔt ɛn dɛn blɔd sten kɔmɔt na Jerusɛlɛm dɛn kɔmɔt insay am wit jɔjmɛnt ɛn wit faya.
Datɛnde, PAPA GƆD go mek klawd de oba di wanol Mawnt Zayɔn ɛn oba ɔl di wan dɛn we gɛda de, de tɛm, ɛn smok ɛn brayt brayt faya na nɛt; PAPA GƆD in glori go tan lɛk shed ɛn pavilyɔn.
Santɛm, i go bi shed lɛ san nɔ go bɔn dɛn, ɛn ples fɔ ayd we big briz de blo ɔ ren de kam.
Mek a siŋ fɔ mi lɔva wan lɔv siŋ we tɔk bɔt in greps fam; Mi lɔva bin gɛt greps fam na wan il we di grɔn gud fɔ plant.

I dig am ɛn i klia ɔl di ston ston kɔmɔt, ɛn plant dɛn fɔs klas greps de; i bil wachman tawa midul de, dɛn i dig usay fɔ mas di greps fɔ pul di wayn; ɛn bin luk fɔ am fɔ bia greps, bɔt na sawa greps i bia.
Duya o, una we tap na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn una di man dɛn na Juda, a de beg una mek una kɔt dis kes bitwin mi ɛn mi greps fam.
Wetin mɔ a fɔ du fɔ mi grep fam we a nɔ du yet? Wɛn a de luk se i go bia greps, wetin mek i bia sawa grep?
Ɛn naw a go tɛl una wetin a go du to mi greps fam. A go pul di fɛnch we de rawnd am, datɛnde, dɛn go pwɛl pwɛl am; A go brok in wɔl dɛn kam dɔŋ ɛn dɛn go mas mas am.
A go mek i yuslɛs; dɛn nɔ go de trim am ɔ de put dɔti nain rut, so dat wayl bush ɛn chuk chuk go gro de; Dɔn a go kɔmand di klawd dɛm mek nɔn ren nɔ fɔdɔm pan an.

PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in greps fam na Izrɛl, ɛn di man dɛn na Juda na di fayn fayn plant dɛn we i plant; ɛn i luk fɔ jɔstis bɔt oya, soso blɔd; i luk fɔ di wan dɛn we de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD, bɔt oya, na kray!
Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan dɛm, dɛn wan we jɛs de gɛda os, ɛn jɛs de gɛda grɔn, sote nɔn say sɛf nɔ lɛf igen, ɛn na yu wangren dɛn go mek tap na di land.
A yɛri PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dɔn swɛ se; “fɔ tru tru, bɔku os dɛm go ɛmti, big ɛn fayn os dɛn, nɔbɔdi no go lib de.
Na et lita wayn nɔmɔ go kɔmɔt pan tɛn eka greps fam, tri ɛn af bag sid nɔ go bia rich af bag sɛf.”
Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan dɛm wan dɛn we de grap ali mɔnin go fɛn traŋa rɔm, ɛn de drink te nɛt kam so te dɛn drɔŋɔ.
Dɛn gɛt git ɛn ap, tamborin ɛn flut ɛn wayn na dɛn pati dɛn; Bɔt dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt wetin PAPA GƆD de du ɔ ivin si di wok we i de wok.
So mi pipul dɛn go ɛgzayl, bikɔs dɛn ful; di man dɛn we dɛn rɛspɛkt de day wit aŋri ɛn tɔsti de kil dɛn bɔku bɔku pipul dɛn.
Fɔseka dat, ɛl dɔn aŋri fɔ it bad bad wan ɛn i dɔn opin in mɔt pas aw i blant opin am, fɔ swɛla di aristo dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn in bɔku bɔku pipul dɛm, in krawd ɛn di wan dɛn we de prez am.
Mɔtalman dɛn de butu dɛn ed ɛn dɛn blɔf dɔn dɔn, ɛn di prawd pipul dɛn yay dɔn kan dɔŋ.
Bɔt dɛn de es PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti ɔp bikɔs i de trit ɔlman di sem, ɛn di oli Gɔd de sho insɛf se i oli bay we i de waka tret.
Da tɛm de, dɛn ship pikin go it usay fayn gras de gro, di animal dɛn we dɛn de mɛn fɔ mek dɛn fat ɛn dɛn got pikin go it na broko broko ples.
Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan wan dɛn we de kɔmit sin wit bɔku bɔku laylay, di wan dɛn we de waka wit sin biɛn dɛn lɛk we dɛn de drɔ ɔmɔlanke,
di wan dɛn we kin se, “lɛ I mekes lɛ I du in wok kwik kwik so dat we go si am; lɛ di tin we di Oli Wan na Izrɛl mekup, apin jisnɔ, ɛn lɛ i bi naw naw, so dat we go si am!”
Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan dɛm wan we de kɔl bad, gud ɛn gud, bad, we de si daknɛs, i se na layt ɛn layt, i se daknɛs, i si bita, i se na swit ɛn swit, i se na bita!
Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan dɛm wan we tink se dɛn gɛt sɛns ɛn fil se dɛn klɛva!
Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan dɛm wan we na champiɔn fɔ drink rɔm, ɛn dɛn man dɛn we nɔ de fred fɔ miks traŋa rɔm,
dɛn wan dɛn we de fri pɔsin we gilti fɔ seka brayb ɛn nɔ de gi di wan we nɔ gilti, in rayt.

Fɔseka dat, lɛk aw faya de bɔn di af af tik we kin lɛf na grɔn we dɛn kɔt rɛs, ɛn lɛk aw dray gras kin bɔn na faya, na so dɛn rut go tan lɛk tin we rɔtin di flawa we dɛn pul go flay go ɔp lɛk dɔst, bikɔs dɛn nɔ gri fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in lɔ se, ɛn nɔ gɛt rɛspɛkt fɔ di Oli Wan na Izrɛl in wɔd.

Fɔseka dat PAPA GƆD in at bin wam pan in pipul dɛn, so i tɔn pan dɛn ɛn kil dɛn, ɛn di mawnten dɛn trimbul; ɛn dɛn dedebɔdi dɛn skata lɛk dɔti na di trit dɛn. Pan ɔl dat in at stil nɔ kol, ɛn i stil wan pɔnish dɛn.
I go mek sayn fɔ wan neshɔn we de fawe, ɛn i go wisul kɔl am, frɔm di say we di wɔl tap; ɛn luk o! I de kam wit spid lɛk briz.
Nɔn nɔ taya, nɔ wan nɔ bɔk fut, nɔn nɔ bayfɔl ɔ slip, wan lapa nɔ lus, wan sandal rop nɔ kɔt;
dɛn aro dɛn shap, ɔl dɛn bo dɛn bɛn, dɛn ɔs dɛn sus tan lɛk shap ston, ɛn dɛn wil dɛn tan lɛk traŋa briz dɛn we de tɔn wan ples ɛn grap.
Dɛn de ala lɛk layɔn, lɛk we yɔŋ layɔn de ala; dɛn pul big vɔys ɛn kech dɛn it fɔ it, dɛn bɔn am go ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul pul am na dɛn an.
Dɛn go ala ala fɔ am da de de, lɛk we si rɔf. Ɛn as yu si di land so, na daknɛs ɛn brok at yu go si, ɛn klawd dɛn mek di layt dak.
Di ia we kiŋ Uzaya day, a si PAPA GƆD sidɔm na tron, ay wan ɛn i bin de pantap ɔltin; di lɔŋ pat pan in klos we de drɛg biɛn, fulɔp di wanol tɛmpul.
Dɛn sirafim bin de oba in ed. Dɛn ɔl bin gɛt siks siks wiŋ, i tek tu kɔba in fes, tu kɔba in fut, ɛn i de tek tu fɔ flay.
Wande tɔk to di ɔda wan se: “PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti oli, I oli, I oli; di wanol wɔl ful wit in glori.”
Di domɔt in fawndeshɔn shek we i yɛri di wan we de kɔl in vɔys, ɛn di os ful ɔp wit smok.

Naim a tɔk se, “trɔbul dɔn mit mi! A dɔn dɔn; bikɔs mi na man we mi mɔt nɔ klin na Gɔd yay, ɛn a tap midul pipul dɛn we dɛn mɔt nɔ klin na Gɔd yay; bikɔs a dɔn tek mi yay si di kiŋ, we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti.”
Nain wan pan di sirafim flay kam mit mi, wit fayakol we de kech nain an, we i pul na di ɔlta wit faya spun.
I tɔch mi mɔt ɛn tɔk se, “as dis dɔn tɔch yu mɔt so, ɔl wetin yu gilti bɔt dɔn dɔn, ɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn fɔgiv yu sin.”
Nain a yɛri PAPA GƆD in vɔys de tɔk se: “Udat a go sɛn, udat go go fɔ wi?” Nain a se, “Luk mi! Sɛn mi.”
Nain I se, “Go tɛl dɛn pipul ya se; “Una go de yɛri nɔmɔ, bɔt una nɔ go ɔndastand; una go de luk bɔt una nɔ go si.’
Mek dɛn pipul ya dɛn at traŋa, ɛn dɛn yes dɛf, ɛn dɛn yay blɛn; ɔ nɔ so dɛn go si wit dɛn yay ɛn yɛri wit dɛn yes ɛn ɔndastand wit dɛn at, ɛn tɔn lɛ a go mɛn dɛn.”
Nain a tɔk se, “E PAPA GƆD aw lɔŋ?” Nain I se, “sote di siti dɛn ɔl lɛf ɛmti ɛn pɔsin dɛn nɔ tap de, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ tap na di os dɛm, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ tap na di land,
ɛn PAPA GƆD mek pipul dɛn tap fawe, ɛn di say dɛn we pipul dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt, dɔn plɛnti na di land.
Ɔlwe na tɛn pasɛnt go stil tap de, dɛn go bɔn am bak, lɛk dɛn tɛrɛbin tik ɔ kɔtintri, we di af kin stil tinap de we dɛn kɔt di tik.” Na di oli sid nain stɔmp.

Di tɛm we Eaz we na bin Uzaya in bɔypikin Jotham, in yon bɔypikin, bi kiŋ na Juda, Rizin we na kiŋ na Siria ɛn Peka we na Rɛmalaya we na kiŋ na Izrɛl, in bɔypikin, bin kam ɔp na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ kam fɛt di pipul dɛn. Bɔt dɛn nɔ ebul fɔ kapchɔ am.
Wɛn wɔd rich Devid in os se, “Siria dɔn mek wan wɔd wit Ifrem,” in ɛn in pipul dɛn ɔl at shek lɛk aw dɛn tik na bush kin shek we briz de blo.
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl Ayzaya se, “yu ɛn yu bɔypikin Shia Jashub, kɔmɔt go mit Eaz, usay di gɔta tap we de briŋ wata kɔmɔt na di watasay we de ɔpsay na di men rod, we de go to Fula Fil,

ɛn tɛl am se, ‘tek tɛm, yu jɛs sɛt mɔt, nɔ fred ɛn no mek natin kɔnfyus yu, fɔseka dɛn tu af stɔmp dɛn ya we na smok nɔmɔ dɛn de pul. Nɔ fred di bad bad wamat we Rizin ɛn Siria ɛn Rɛmalaya in bɔypikin de mek.
Bikɔs Siria ɛn Ifrem ɛn Rɛmalaya in bɔypikin dɔn plan bad fɔ yu, de se,
“lɛ we go atak Juda ɛn mek dɛn fred wi, ɛn lɛ we kapchɔ am fɔ wisɛf ɛn mek Tebɛɛl in bɔypikin kiŋ de,”
Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd in se, “I nɔ go ol wata, ɛn i nɔ go ɛva bi.”
Bikɔs di ɛdkwata fɔ Siria na Damaskɔs, ɛn di edman fɔ Damaskɔs na Kiŋ Rizin. (Insay siksti fayv ia, dɛn go brok Ifrem pis pis, so dat i nɔ go bi neshɔn igen)
Di ɛdkwata fɔ Ifrem na Sameria ɛn di edman fɔ Sameria na Kiŋ Peka. If yu nɔ go ebul biliv, fɔ tru, yu nɔ go ebul tinap.’”
PAPA GƆD tɔk to Eaz bak se,
“Aks PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd fɔ gi yu sayn; i lɛk i dip lɛk ɛl ɔ ay lɛk ɛvin.”
Bɔt Eaz se, “a nɔ go aks, ɛn a nɔ go tɛst PAPA GƆD”
Nain i se, “Una lisin o, una we de na Devid in os. Di ambɔg we una de ambɔg mɔtalman nɔ du, pas una go ambɔg mi Gɔd insɛf?
Fɔseka dat, PAPA GƆD insɛf go gi una sayn. Wan yɔŋgyal go gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn go bɔn pikin, ɛn i go gi am nem, Imanyuɛl.
I go it chiz en ɔni wɛn i go dɔn no aw nɔ fɔ du bad ɛn pik gud.
Bikɔs, bifo di pikin no aw nɔ fɔ du bad ɛn pik gud, nɔbɔdi nɔ go de na di land we dɛn tu kiŋ we de trɛtin una de.
PAPA GƆD go mek una ɛn una pipul dɛn ɛn una fɔstɛmpapa dɛn os, si di kayn dez dɛn we dɛn nɔ ɛva si rɔm we Ifrem lɛf Juda – dat na di kiŋ na Asiria.
Da de de PAPA GƆD go wisul kɔl di flay we tap usay di watasay dɛn na Ijipt bigin, ɛn fɔ kɔl di ɔnibi we de na Asiria.
Dɛn ɔl go kam, ɛn dɛn go tap insay dɛn dip shap ɛn tayt vali ɛn usay plit na dɛn rɔk, ɛn pan ɔl dɛn chuk chuk bush dɛm, ɛn pan ɔl usay plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal.
Da de de PAPA GƆD go shev wit reza we i aya kɔmɔt oba di Riva – we de wit di kiŋ na Asiria– di ed ɛn di ia nain prayvet, ɛn i go krep di bia bia sɛf kɔmɔt.
Da de de, wan man go kip wan yɔŋ kaw ɛn tu ship;
ɛn fɔseka di bɔku milk we dɛn go gi am, i go it chiz, bikɔs ɔlman we lɛf na di land go it chiz ɛn ɔni.
Da tɛm de, ɔl dɛn say dɛn we wan tawzin greps tik kin de we bin go sɛl fɔ wan tawzin silva kɔpɔ, go tɔn wayl bush ɛn chuk chuk;
Na wit bo ɛn aro dɛn go kam de, bikɔs di wanol land go dɔn tɔn wayl bush ɛn chuk chuk;
ɛn as fɔ ɔl dɛn il, we dɛn kin dig wit o, una nɔ go kam de bikɔs una go fred di wayl bush ɛn chuk chuk; bɔt dɛn go tɔn ples we kaw de waka fri ɛn ship de pas pas.
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “Tek wan tablɛt ɛn rayt di laŋwej we ɔlman no. “Dis blant, Maa-shalal-ashbaz.”
Ɛn a bin gɛt witnɛs dɛn we kin tɔk tru, we na Yuraya we na man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn Zɛkaraya we na Jɛbɛrɛchia in bɔypikin, fɔ tɔk fɔ mi.
Nain a lidɔm wit mi wɛf we na di prɔfɛtɛs, ɛn i gɛt bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn bɔypikin. Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “Gi di pikin nem Maa-shalal-ashbaz;
bikɔs bifo di pikin bigin kɔl, ‘Papa’ ɔ ‘Mama,’ Asiria dɛn kiŋ in man dɛn go dɔn tek ɔl Damaskɔs in jɛntri ɛn Sameria in gud gud tin dɛn go.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to mi bak se;
“Bikɔs dɛn pipul ya nɔ gri tek Shiloa in wata we de rɔn saful saful, ɛn na bifo Rizin ɛn Rɛmalaya in bɔypikin dɛn de trimbul;
fɔseka dat, PAPA GƆD go mek da big ɛn pawaful Riva in wata kɔba dɛn, dat na di kiŋ na Asiria ɛn ɔl wetin i de tek blɔf ɛn mek nem. I go ovaflo ɔl dɛn gɔta ɛn ɔl dɛn sho dɛn,
ɛn i go rɔn oba go insay Juda, i go jɛs de ovaflo ɛn go swɛl te rich pipul dɛn nɛk; ɛn in wiŋ dɛm we i prɛd, go fulɔp di land frɔm kɔna to kɔna, E Imanyuɛl.”
Una put unasɛf dɔŋ, una dɛn pipul dɛn ya, ɛn mek una at pwɛl; una dɛn kɔntri dɛn we de fa, una yɛri o; tay una ɔja tayt fɔ di shɔk; tay una ɔja tayt fɔ di shɔk.
Una ɛŋed o, bɔt i nɔ go min natin; una tɔk wetin una fil, na fɔ natin, bikɔs PAPA GƆD de wit wi.
Na PAPA GƆD tɔk so to mi ɛn in an bin de traŋa wan pan mi, ɛn i wɔn mi se mek a nɔ biev di we we dɛn pipul dɛn ya de biev. I se,
“Nɔ kɔl ɔl wetin dɛn pipul ya kɔl, ‘sikrit plan fɔ du bad’ se na sikrit plan fɔ du bad, ɛn nɔ fred wetin dɛn de fred, ɛn lɛ natin nɔ shek una at.
Bɔt na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti una fɔ si se oli; lɛ i bi se na im una de fred ɛn na im nɔmɔ fɔ una trimbul.
Ɛn i go tɔn oli ples, ɛn di ston we go ɔfɛnd pipul dɛn, ɛn di big ston we go mek di tu os dɛn na Izrɛl bɔk dɛn fut ɛn fɔdɔm, ɛn go bi trap fɔ di pipul dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm.
Ɛn bɔku go bɔk dɛn fut pan am; dɛn go fɔdɔm ɛn dɛn prayd go dɔn; dɛn go sɛt trap fɔ dɛn ɛn kech dɛn.
Tay ɛn kip di mɛsej, ɛn tich mi lanin bɔy dɛn fɔ kip tayt wan na dɛn at.
A go wet fɔ PAPA GƆD we de ayd in fes pan Jekɔb in pipul, ɛn a go abop pan am.
So mi ɛn di pikin dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn gi mi, na sayn ɛn wɔnin na Izrɛl, we PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we tap na Mawnt Zayɔn, de gi.

Ɛn wɛn dɛn tɛl una se, “Go to dɛn lukgrɔn man ɛn dɛn majik man dɛn we de mek swit mɔt to una, de rid fasfas ɛn kwayɛt wan we yu nɔ de ɔndastand,” di pipul dɛn nɔ fɔ tɔk to dɛn Gɔd? Dɛm fɔ tɔk to dayman fɔseka pipul dɛn we gɛt layf?
Fɔ di wan dɛn we dɔn yɛri mi tichin ɛn mi mɛsej fɔ no wetin fɔ du! Fɔ tru, di wan dɛn we de tink fɔ tɔk to dayman, nɔ go si do klin.
Dɛn go pas insay di land wit bad bad pwɛl at ɛn aŋri; we dɛn aŋri, dɛn kin vɛks bad bad wan ɛn kin kɔs dɛn kiŋ dɛn ɛn dɛn Gɔd, ɛn dɛn kin es dɛn fes ɔp;
ɛn dɛn go luk na grɔn, bɔt na pwɛl at ɛn daknɛs dɛn go si, we na bad bad pen; we go put dɛn insay tik tik daknɛs.

Di uman we bin de sɔfa, in pen go dɔn. Fɔstɛm, i bin de briŋ fityay kam na di land ɔf Zɛbyulɔn ɛn di land ɔf Naftali, bɔt leta, i go mek ɔlman kɔle pan di say we di si de pas, di land oba Riva Jɔdan, ɛn Galili usay difrɛn pipul dɛn tap,
Di pipul dɛn we bin de waka na daknɛs dɔn si brayt brayt layt; na pan di wan dɛn we bin tap na di land we dak bad bad wan, layt dɔn shayn pan dɛm.
Yu dɔn mek di pipul dɛn dɔn bɔku mɔ, yu dɔn mek dɛn dɔn gladi mɔ; dɛn de gladi bifo yu lɛk we pipul dɛn kin gladi avɛst tɛm, ɛn lɛk we man dɛn kin gladi we dɛn briŋ tif tin dɛn kɔmɔt wa.
Bikɔs yu dɔn brok di tin we de gi am prɔblɛm, ɛn di ratlan kɔmɔt nain Sholda, di tik we dɛn de tek aras am, yu dɔn brok am lɛk aw yu du am di tɛm fɔ Midian.
Ɔl di but we di ɛnimi soja dɛn go wɛr fɔ kam fɛt, ɛn ɔl dɛn klos we sok wit blɔd go bɔn lɛk dray lif na faya.
Bikɔs dɛn dɔn bɔn wan pikin gi wi, dɛn dɔn gi wi bɔypikin ɛn nain ed di gɔvmɛnt go de, ɛn in nem we dɛn go kɔl am, na, “Wɔndaful Kanselɔ, Mayti Gɔd, Ɛvalastin Papa, Prins ɔf pis.”

Fɔ in gɔvamɛnt in bɛtɛ wan ɛn fɔ kol at, dat go de sote go, na Devid in tron ɛn nain kindɔm, fɔ bigin di kindɔm ɛn mek i tinap wit jɔstis ɛn fɔ waka tret wit PAPA GƆD, frɔm naw, sote go. Na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in pawa go du dat.
PAPA GƆD dɔn sɛn wɔd agens Jekɔb ɛn i go fɔdɔm pan Izrɛl;
ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn go no, Ifrem ɛn di pipul dɛn we tap na Sameria, we de tɔk prawd ɛn kɔki we, se:
“Di blɔk dɛn dɔn fɔdɔm bɔt wi gɔ bil bak wit dɛn fayn fayn ston; dɛn dɔn kɔt di sikamɔ tik dɛn, bɔt wi go yuz sida tik na dɛn ples.”
So PAPA GƆD dɔn gɛda pipul dɛn we de agens dɛn, ɛn dɔn wayn dɛn ɛnimi dɛn.
Di Sirian dɛn na di ist ɛn di Filistin dɛn na di wɛst dɔn opin mɔt fɔ swɛla Izrɛl. Pan ɔl dat, in at stil nɔ kol ɛn i stil wan pɔnish dɛn.
Di pipul dɛn nɔ gri tɔn to di wan we de pɔnish dɛn ɛn dɛn nɔ luk fɔ PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti.
So PAPA GƆD kɔtɔf Izrɛl dɛn lida dɛn ɛn di pipul dɛn, di gud wan dɛn ɛn di bad wan dɛn insay wande–
di ɛlda ɛn di man we dɛn rɛspɛkt na di ed, ɛn di prɔfɛt we de tich di pipul dɛn fɔ lay, na di tel;
bikɔs di wan dɛn we de lid di pipul de lid dɛn astre, ɛn di wan dɛn we de fala dɛn kin kɔnfyus.

Na dat mek PAPA GƆD nɔ de gladi fɔ dɛn yɔŋ bɔy dɛn, ɛn i nɔ de sɔri fɔ di pikin dɛn we dɛn papa dɔn day ɛn di uman dɛn we dɛn man dɔn day; bikɔs dɛn ɔl nɔ sabi Gɔd ɛn na so so bad dɛn de du, ɛn na soso rɔbish dɛn de tɔk. Fɔseka ɔl dɛn tin ya, in at stil nɔ kol ɛn i stil de pɔnish dɛn.
Wikɛdnɛs kin bɔn lɛk faya, i de bɔn wayl bush ɛn chuk chuk; i de mek faya kech pan dɛn bush we tay tay pan dɛnsɛf na fɔrɛst, ɛn sɛn smok go ɔp tret wan.
Fɔseka PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in vɛksteshɔn, di land dɔn bɔn, ɛn di pipul dɛn na lɛk dray lif fɔ di faya; nɔbɔdi nɔ de sɔri lɛf in brɔda sɛf.
Dɛn de jɔg tin dɛn ya, bɔt dɛn stil aŋri, yu tɔn yanda, dɛn de de de kapu kapu, bɔt dɛn stil nɔ de satisfay; ɔlman de it in neba pikin.
Manasɛ Ifrem, ɛn Ifrem Manasɛ, ɛn dɛn ɔl de agens Juda. Pan ɔl dat, in at nɔ stil kol ɛn stil de pɔnish una dɛn.
Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan una we de pas dɛn wikɛd lɔ fɔ sɔprɛs pipul, ɛn dɛn wan we dɛn wok na fɔ rayt wetin fɔ tek sɔprɛs pipul,

fɔ mek di wan dɛn nɔ gɛt, nɔ gɛt jɔstis, ɛn fɔ tif di wan dɛn we po pan mi pipul dɛn, dɛn rayt, so dat dɛn go du ɛnitin we dɛn wan du to uman dɛn we dɛn man dɛn dɔn day, ɛn tek advantej pan di pikin dɛn we dɛn papa dɛn dɔn day.
Wetin una go du di de we a go pɔnish una, we dombolo go kɔmɔt fawe kam? Udat una go rɔn go to fɔ ɛp una ɛn usay una go lɛf una jɛntri?
Natin nɔ lɛf, pas fɔ butu wit dɛn prizina ɔ day wit di wan dɛn we dɛn go kil. Na fɔseka ɔl dɛn tin ya mek in at nɔ stil kol, ɛn i stil de pɔnish una.
E Asiria we na mi wamat in ratlan, di tik fɔ mi bad bad vɛksteshɔn.
A de sɛn am to wan neshɔn we nɔ no Gɔd, ɛn a kɔmand am fɔ go fɛt di pipul dɛn we vɛks a pan, fɔ tek dɛn tiŋs dɛn ɛn tif dɛn bay pawa, fɔ mas dɛn lɛk pɔtɔ pɔtɔ na trit.
Bɔt nɔto so in mek ɔp, ɛn nɔto so i de tink; bɔt i de nain maynd fɔ pwɛl, ɛn fɔ distrɔy neshɔn dɛn ɛn nɔto tu tri nɔmɔ;
bikɔs i se: “Ɔl mi kɔmanda dɛn nɔto kiŋ?
Kalno nɔ tan lɛk Kakɛmish? Emat nɔ tan lɛk Apad? Sameria nɔ tan lɛk Damaskɔs?
Lɛk we mi an dɔn rich pan dɛn kindɔm dɛn we de wɔship dɛn laylay gɔd, we dɛn laylay gɔd dɛn bin plɛnti pas di wan dɛn we de Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Sameria,
so a nɔ fɔ du Jerusɛlɛm ɛn in laylay gɔd dɛn di sem tin we a du Sameria ɛn in laylay gɔd dɛn?”
We PAPA GƆD go dɔn dɔn ɔl in wok pan Mawnt Zayɔn ɛn pan Jerusɛlɛm, I go pɔnish di kiŋ na Asiria fɔ di blɔf tɔk dɛn we i de tɔk, ɛn fɔ di fulish prayd we i de mek.

Bikɔs i se, “na wit mi yon an a du am, ɛn na mi sɛns a yuz, bikɔs mi na man we klɛva: A dɔn pul pipul dɛn bawndri dɛn, ɛn a dɔn klia ɔl dɛn jɛntri; a dɔn pul ɔl dɛn wan we sidɔm na dɛn tron dɛn lɛk man kaw.
Lɛk aw dɛn de fɛn bɔd os, na so a dɔn fɛn di pipul dɛn jɛntri; ɛn lɛk aw pipul dɛn de gɛda eg we dɛn dɔn lɛf, na so a dɔn gɛda di wanol wɔl; ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ kres shek, ɔ tɔk ɛnitin ɔ grɔmbul.”

Di aks fɔ fil se in bɛtɛ pas di wan we de yuz am, ɔ di sɔ fɔ mek insɛf big pas di wan we de wok wit am? Lɛk se na di ratlan fɔ gɛt pawa pas di wan we ol am ɔ lɛk se na di waka tik fɔ es di wan we nɔto bod!
So, PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, go sɛn siknɛs we de kil, pan in tɔf tɔf sojaman dɛn, pan ɔl dɛn glori, i go bigin bɔn dɛn, lɛk aw faya kin bɔn.
Izrɛl in layt go tɔn to faya ɛn in Oli Wan go tɔn faya; ɛn i go bɔn ɛn pwɛl chuk chuk ɛn wayl bush waŋren de.
PAPA GƆD go pwɛl ɔl di fayn tin dɛn na di bush ɛn di land we de bia gud gud wan, kpatakpata, lɛk we sik man in bɔdi kin dɔn.
Wetin go lɛf pan di tik dɛn nain bush go so smɔl dat lili pikin go kɔnt am.
Da tɛm de, di pipul dɛn we lɛf pan Jekɔb in os nɔ go ɛva abop pan di wan dɛn we bin de pɔnish dɛn igen, bɔt dɛn go abop pan PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl in Oli Wan, wit ɔl dɛn at.
Di wan dɛn we lɛf go kam bak; di wan dɛn we lɛf pan Jekɔb in pikin dɛn, go kam bak to di mayti Gɔd.
Ɔl we una pipul dɛn we na Izrɛl, plɛnti lɛk sansan na si, na di wan dɛn we go lɛf pan dɛn go kam bak. I dɔn bi lɔ se dɛn fɔ nyakanyaka dɛm ɛn pasmak ɛvidɛns de se na so i fɔ bi.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go si dat ɔltin bi insay dis wɔl lɛk aw i bin dɔn se.
So na dis PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se: “E mi pipul dɛm we tap na Zayɔn, una nɔ fred di Asirian dɛn wɛn dɛn bit una wit dɛn ratlan ɛn wɛn dɛn pɔnish una lɛk aw di Ijipshian dɛn bin du.
Bikɔs, i nɔ go te igen, di vɛks we a vɛks fɔ tin we a si we nɔ rayt go dɔn, ɛn mi wamat go tɔn fɔ nyakanyaka dɛn.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go yuz in pawa fɔ dɛn wit koboko, lɛk aw i bin pɔnish Midian na di big ston na Ɔrɛb; in ratlan go de oba di si, ɛn i go es am lɛk aw i bin du na Ijipt.
Na da de de in lod go kɔmɔt na una ed ɛn dɛn go pwɛl di tin dɛn we ɛŋ na una nɛk.” I dɔn kɔmɔt Rimɔn,
I dɔn kam Ay; I dɔn pas insay Migrɔn, na Mikmash i kip in lod;
dɛn dɔn krɔs di lili rod, na Giba dɛn slip da nɛt de; Rama de trimbul, Gibɛa we na Sɔl in siti dɔn rɔnawe.
Kray lawd lawd wan! Yu Galim in gyal pikin! Lisin yu Leisha! Ansa am, yu Anatɔt.
Madmɛna dɔn rɔnawe, di pipul dɛn we tap na Gibim dɔn rɔn go ayd.
Na tide tide i go blo na Nɔb, i go flo blo shek shek am na Zayɔn in gyal pikin in mawnten, na di il na Jerusɛlɛm.
A de tɛl una, PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go kɔt di tik in big branch dɛn wit pawa we ɔlman go fred bad bad wan; i go kɔt di wan dɛn we ay pas ɔl, kam dɔŋ ɛn di ay ay wan dɛn go kam dɔŋ na grɔn.
I go kɔt dɛn bush we tay tay pan dɛnsɛf wit aks, ɛn Libanɔn we gɛt dɛn wit in ay ay tik dɛn, go fɔdɔm.
Smɔl plant go bɔs kɔmɔt na Jɛsi in af tik we lɛf na grɔn, ɛn branch go gro kɔmɔt nain rut.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD in Spirit go sidɔm pan am, di spirit fɔ sɛns ɛn fɔ ɔndastand, di spirit fɔ gi advays ɛn fɔ pawa, di spirit fɔ sabi tin ɛn fɔ fred PAPA GƆD.
Ɛn di tin we i go lɛk pas ɔl, na fɔ fred PAPA GƆD. I nɔ go jɔj bay wetin in yay de si, ɔ disayd bay wetin in yes de yɛri;

Bɔt na bay wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay, i go jɔj di po man, ɛn go disayd di sem we fɔ kwayɛt pipul na wɔl, ɛn i go pɔnish di wɔl wit traŋa wɔd dɛn we i de tɔk, ɛn na di briz we de kɔmɔt nain mɔt i go tek kil wikɛd pipul.
Na wetin rayt na PAPA GƆD in yay, i go tek tay in wes, ɛn na fɔ waka tret wit PAPA GƆD i go tek tay in trɔsis.
Wulf ɛn ship pikin to tap wan say, ɛn lɛpɛt go lidɔm wan say wit got pikin, ɛn kaw pikin ɛn layɔn, ɛn animal we dɛn kin fid fɔ mek i fat, go de togɛda, ɛn na lili pikin go de mɛn dɛm.
Di kaw ɛn di bia go it togɛda; dɛn pikin dɛn go lidɔm togɛda; ɛn layɔn go it dray gras lɛk man kaw.
Pikin we de sɔk bɔbi go ple oba dɛn bad bad snek dɛn ol, ɛn di pikin we dɛn dɔn pul na bɔbi go put an na di snek in ol.
Natin nɔ go ambɔg ɔ pwɛl ɛnisay na mi oli mawnten; bikɔs di wɔl go no bɔt PAPA GƆD bɛtɛ bɛtɛ wan, lɛk we si ful.
Da de de, Jɛsi in rut go bi sayn to di neshɔn dɛn; naim di neshɔn dɛn go luk fɔ, ɛn ɔlman go kɔle pan di say dɛn we i go tap.
Da de de, PAPA GƆD go ɛp sɛkɛn tɛm fɔ briŋ di balans pan in pipul dɛn we bin lɛf, kɔmɔt Asiria, Ijipt, Patrɔs, Itiopia, Ilam, Babilonia, Emat ɛn di land dɛn we de na di kost.
I go gi di neshɔn dɛm sayn, ɛn i go gɛda di Izrɛlayt dɛn we bin de na ɔda neshɔn dɛn, ɛn gɛda Juda in pipul dɛn we skata, kɔmɔt ɔlsay na di wɔl.
Di jɛlɔs we Ifrem de jɛlɔs go dɔn, ɛn dɛn wan we de tɔmɛnt Juda go day; Ifrem nɔ go jɛlɔs Juda, ɛn Juda nɔ go tɔmɛnt Ifrem.
Dɛn go atak di Filistin dɛn we tap na di wɛst, lɛk we bɔd de flay kan dɔŋ wit spid, ɛn dɛn go jɔyn an fɔ tif ɔl wetin di pipul dɛn na di ist gɛt. Dɛn go fɛt Idɔm ɛn Moab ɛn di Amonayt dɛn go obe dɛn.
PAPA GƆD go mek usay di wata de rɔn kɔmɔt go insay Ijipt pwɛl kpatakpata; ɛn I go pas in an oba di Riva wit in ɔt ɔt briz, ɛn tɔn am to sɛvin rod so dat pipul dɛn go wɛr dɛn sus waka krɔs.
Wan men rod go de we kɔmɔt Asiria fɔ di balans we lɛf pan in pipul dɛn, lɛk aw i bin bi fɔ Izrɛl wɛn dɛn bin kɔmɔt Ijipt.
Una go tɔk da de de se: “A go tɛl yu tɛnki PAPA GƆD, ɔldo yu bin vɛks pan mi yu at dɔn kol, ɛn yu bin koks mi.
“Na yu PAPA GƆD gi mi nyu layf; A go biliv yu ɛn nɔ go fred; bikɔs na PAPA GƆD we na mi Gɔd na mi trɛnk, ɛn nain a de siŋ bɔt, ɛn i dɔn bi di wan we gi mi nyu layf.”
Na wit gladi yu go ɛnjɔy yu nyu layf.
Ɛn una go tɔk da de de se: “Tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki, pre to am: mek ɔlman no bɔt di tin dɛn we i kin du, mek i bi lɔ fɔ rɛspɛkt in nem.
“Siŋ de prez PAPA GƆD, bikɔs ɔlman de kɔle pan di tin dɛn we i dɔn du; lɛ ɔlman na di wɔl no bɔt dat.
Una siŋ lawd lawd wan wit gladi gladi, una we tap na Zayɔn, bikɔs di Oli Wan na Izrɛl we tap wit una, gɛt big rɛspɛkt.”
Wetin PAPA GƆD se go apin to Babilɔn we Ayzaya, we na Amɔz in bɔypikin, bin si.
Put sayn na wan ɛmti il, ala kɔl dɛn; wev yu an to dɛn fɔ kam insay di get we dɛn bigman dɛn de pas.
Misɛf dɔn kɔmand mi yon dɛn we klin na mi yay, a dɔn sɛn kɔl mi pawaful man dɛn fɔ du di tin we a go du we a vɛks, dɛn mi prawd man dɛn we a de gladi fɔ.
Lisin, kɔnfyushɔn de na di mawnten dɛn we tan lɛk bɔku bɔku pipul vɔys! Lisin, kata kata de na di kindɔm dɛn, lɛk we difrɛn kɔntri dɛn gɛda wan say! PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti de gɛda sojaman dɛn fɔ go fɛt.
Dɛn kɔmɔt fawe kɔntri, usay di skay dɛn tap, PAPA GƆD ɛn di wɛpɔn dɛn fɔ in vɛksteshɔn, fɔ kam distrɔy di wanol wɔl.
Kray o! PAPA GƆD in de dɔn de rich, di de we go kam lɛk we di Ɔlmayti de distrɔy!
Fɔseka dat, ɔl dɛn an go fɛkɛ fɛkɛ, ɛn ɔlman go fred bad bad wan,
ɛn dɛn at go pwɛl. Dɛn go de fil ɔlkayn pen; dɛn go de fil pen lɛk we uman de sɔfa fɔ bɔn. Dɛn go lɛf mɔt de luk dɛn kɔmpin. Dɛn fes go rɛd lɛk we yu layt faya.
Biliv mi, PAPA GƆD in de, go kam, i go kruɛl, wit vɛksteshɔn, ɛn bad bad wamat fɔ mek di wɔl ɛmti ɛn fɔ distrɔy di sina dɛn kɔmɔt de.
Bikɔs di sta dɛn na ɛvin ɛn dɛn kɔmpin dɛn we kin de bay grup nɔ go sho layt; di san go dak we i kɔmɔt ɛn di mun nɔ go shayn.
A go pɔnish di wɔl fɔ in bad bad tin we dɛn de du, ɛn di wikɛd pipul dɛn fɔ dɛn sin; Di wan dɛn we prawd, a go brok dɛn fɛda dɔŋ, ɛn go mek di wan dɛn we gɛt maynd, dɛn prayd kan dɔŋ.
A go mek pipul at fɔ si pas piɔ gold, ɛn mɔtalman go at fɔ si pas gold we kɔmɔt Ofir.
Fɔseka dat a go mek di skay dɛn trimbul ɛn di wɔl go shek kɔmɔt nain ples we PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go vɛks di de we in at go wam bad bad wan.
Lɛk dia we dɛn de ɔntin, ɔ lɛk ship we nɔ gɛt udat fɔ gɛda dɛn, na so ɔlman go tɔn go bak to in yon pipul dɛn, ɛn ɔlman go rɔnawe go nain yon kɔntri.
Dɛn go chuk ɛnibɔdi we dɛn fɛn, wan say lɛ i bɔs di ɔda say, ɛn ɛnibɔdi we dɛn kech, dɛn go kil am wit sɔd.
Dɛn go smash dɛn bebi dɛn mek dɛn skata bifo dɛn fes; dɛn go tif ɔltin na dɛn os dɛn ɛn rabish dɛn wɛf dɛm.
A de tɛl una, a go mek dɛn Mɛdis, we nɔ tek silva mek natin ɛn nɔ tek gold mek natin, dɛn at wam pan dɛn.
Dɛn bo dɛn go kil di yɔŋnam dɛm; dɛn nɔ go ivin sɔri sɛf fɔ di bebi we de nain mama bɛlɛ; dɛn nɔ go sɔri fɔ pikin sɛf.
Babilɔn, we na di kindɔm dɛn glori, Di fayn fayn kɔntri we di Babilonian dɛn de mek mɔt fɔ, go tan lɛk Sɔdɔm ɛn Gɔmɔra we PAPA GƆD dɔn dɛm kpatakpata.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de igen ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go lib de te di wɔl dɔn; nɔn Arab nɔ go mek in tɛnt de, ɛn nɔn shɛpad nɔ go mek in ship dɛn lidɔm de.
Bɔt na dɛn wayl bist dɛn go lidɔm de, ɛn na dɛn animal dɛn we de kray sɔri wan lɛk dɔg, go ful na di os dɛn; na de ostrich dɛn go tap ɛn na de dɛn dɛbul we na af man, af bist, go dans.
Na aina dɛn go kray nain tawa dɛn, ɛn dɛn Jakal dɛn go kray nain fayn fayn kiŋ os dɛn; in tɛm dɔn rich nia ɛn dɛn nɔ go shub di tɛm go biɛn igen
PAPA GƆD go sɔri fɔ Jekɔb ɛn go pik Izrɛl bak, ɛn go put dɛn na dɛn yon land. Fɔrina dɛn go kam tap wit dɛn, ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn go ol dɛn tayt lɛk dɛnsɛf blant Jekɔb in os.

Difrɛn difrɛn pipul dɛn go tek dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn go na dɛn yon land, ɛn di Izrɛlayt dɛn go ol di pipul dɛn as dɛn man ɛn uman slev dɛn na PAPA GƆD in land; dɛn go kapchɔ di wan dɛn we bin kapchɔ dɛn, ɛn go rul di wan dɛn we bin de du dɛn bad ɔltɛm.
Wɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn gi una kol at ɛn mek una lɛf fɔ sɔfa ɛn fɔ wok dɛn ebi ebi wok we dɛn bin de fos una fɔ du,
una go bigin provok di kiŋ na Babilɔn se: “Di pɔsin we bin de du wi bad nɔ ebul du wi bad igen, di fɔ-natin wikɛd vɛksteshɔn dɔn dɔn.
PAPA GƆD dɔn tek di wikɛd pipul dɛn staf na dɛn an, ɛn tek di rula dɛn kiŋstaf,
dɛn we bin de bit di pipul dɛn wit bad bad wamat ɛn nɔ bin de tap fɔ blo dɛn, we bin de rul di neshɔn dɛn wit wamat ɛn nɔ bin de taya fɔ trit dɛn bad.
Di wanol wɔl de rɛst ɛn ɔltin kwayɛt; dɛn bɔs wit siŋ.
Dɛn sayprɛs tik de gladi fɔ yu, di sida dɛn na Libanɔn de se. “Frɔm we dɛn kɔt yu, nɔn man we de kɔt tik, nɔ kam fɔ kɔt wi.’

Ɛl we de ɔnda dɔn rɛdi de wet fɔ mit yu we yu go kam, i dɔn wek ɔl dɛn gost fɔ kan tɛl yu adu, ɔl dɛn wan we bin de rul na wɔl; I es dɛn kɔmɔt na dɛn chia dɛn, ɔl dɛn wan we na bin kiŋ fɔ di neshɔn dɛm.
Dɛn ɔl go tɔk ɛn go tɛl yu se ‘yusɛf dɔn yuslɛs lɛkɛ wi! Yu dɔn tan lɛk wi!’
Ɔl dɛn fayn fayn tin dɛn we yu bin gɛt ɛn de ɛnjɔy, dɔn kam dɔŋ na Ɛl, ɔl yu myuzik we yu gita bin de ple; na tumbu na di bed we de ɔnda yu ɛn wɔrɔm na yu kɔba klos.
“Luk we yu dɔn fɔdɔm kɔmɔt na ɛvin, Yu De tɛm sta, Doklin bɔypikin! Luk we yu fɔdam kan dɔŋ na grɔn, yu we bin nyama nyama di neshɔn dɛm!
Yu bin tɔk na yu at se, ‘A go klem go ɔp ɛvin; ay ay pas PAPA GƆD in sta dɛn. A go mek mi tron ɔp de; A go sidɔm na di mawnten we ɔlman kin mit fa fawe na di nɔt!
A go ɔp ɔp oba di klawd dɛn, A go mek misɛf lɛk di Most Ay.”
Bɔt dɛn dɔn briŋ yu kam dɔŋ na Ɛl, dɔŋ dɔŋ di dip dip ol.
Dɛn wan dɛn we si yu, go luk yu gud, ɛn tink dip pan yu: ‘Ni di man dis we bin mek di wɔl trimbul, we bin shek kindɔm dɛm,
we mek di wɔl lɛk di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap ɛn nyakanyaka in siti dɛn, we nɔ bin gri lɛ in prizina dɛn go om?’
Ɔl di kiŋ dɛn fɔ dɛn difrɛn neshɔn dɛn lidɔm wit rɛspɛkt, ɔlman de nain yon grev;

bɔt dɛn trowe yu kɔmɔt na yu yon grev, lɛkɛ aw dɛn et we pikin bɔn bifo tɛm, yu klos na di wan dɛn wan we yu kil, di we yu chuk wit sɔd, di wan dɛn we go dɔŋ to di ston ston dɛn na di dip dip ol, lɛk dedebɔdi we dɛn de mas.
Dɛn nɔ go bɛr yu usay dɛn bɛr dɛn, bikɔs yu dɔn pwɛl pwɛl yu land, yu dɔn kil yu pipul dɛn. “Lɛ dɛn nɔ ɛva kɔl dɛn wikɛd pipul dɛn pikin we dɔn ɛn we nɔ bɔn yet, dɛn nem!
Rɛdi fɔ kil in bɔypikin dɛn bikɔs ɔf di gilti we dɛn papa dɛn gilti lɛ dɛn nɔ go grap tek di wanol wɔl ɛn fulɔp ɔlsay na di wɔl wit siti dɛn.”
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, “A go tinap ɛn fɛt dɛn, ɛn a go kɔt kɔmɔt na Babilɔn, dɛn nem dɛn ɛn di balans we lɛf, pikin we dɔn bɔn ɛn di wan dɛn we nɔ bɔn yet.” Na so PAPA GƆD se.
A go mek i blant dɛn grɔn pig, ɛn smɔl smɔl wata dɛn we gɛda, ɛn a go swip am di brum ɔf distrɔkshɔn. Na so PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dɔn swɛ se: “Lɛk aw a dɔn plan, na so i go bi, ɛn lɛk aw a dɔn se i mɔs bi, na so i go bi,
so go distrɔy di Asinan na mi land ɛn mas mas am na mi mawnten dɛn; ɛn di slev wok we i bin de gi dɛn, go tap, ɛn in lod go kɔmɔt na dɛn sholda.”
Na di tin dis we a dɔn mekɔp fɔ du fɔ di wanol wɔl; ɛn na di an di we de ɔl oba di neshɔn dɛn.
Na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dɔn plan am so, udat go se nɔ? I dɔn tret in an, udat go tap am.
Na di ia we kiŋ Eaz day, nain dis PAPA GƆD in mɛsej kam:
Una nɔ gladi o, una ɔl we de na Filistia, se di tik we wap una dɔn brok, bikɔs na frɔm snek da pɔyzinɔs snek we nem Ada, de kɔmɔt, ɛn di tin we in go bɔn na snek we de flay.
Po man in fɔs pikin go it, ɛn di wan dɛn we nɔ gɛt go lidɔm saful; bɔt a go tek aŋri kil una rut ɛn go kil di balans we lɛf.
Yu get, ala woyo; yu siti kray; yu Filistia, una ɔl mek fred kil una! Bikɔs smok de kɔmɔt na di nɔt ɛn nɔn wik pɔsin nɔ de wit am.
Us ansa pɔsin go gi di neshɔn in mɛsenja? “PAPA GƆD dɔn bil Zayɔn, ɛn nainsay am in pipul dɛn we dɔn sɔf, go ayd dɛnsɛf.
Wetin PAPA GƆD se go apin to Moab. Bikɔs dɛn go ɛmti A go insay wan nɛt bɛtɛ nɔ go de fɔ Moab igen; bikɔs dɛn go ɛmti Kir insay wan nɛt bɛtɛ nɔ go de fɔ Moab igen
Daybɔn in gyal pikin dɔn go ɔp na di ay ples dɛn fɔ go kray; Moab de kray fɔ Nibo ɛn Mɛdiba. Ɔlman krep in ed, ɛn ɔlman shev in bia bia;
dɛn ɔl rap dɛnsɛf wit saklɔth na trit; pantap dɛn os, ɛn na dɛn say fɔ gɛda ɔlman de kray ɛn pul wata na yay.
Ɛshbɔn ɛn Ilɛelɛ bin ala, ɛn dɛn de yɛri dɛn vɔys sote rich Jeaz; so di Moab sojaman dɛn ala; in at trimbul.
Mi at de kray fɔ Moab; di wan dɛn we rɔnawe, runawe go Zoa, ɛn Ɛglat Shɛlishia. Bikɔ, na di rod fɔ klem go Luit, dɛn de kray we dɛn de go ɔp; na di rod fɔ go Orɔnaim dɛn de ala se, dɛn yon dɔn dɔn;
nɔbɔdi nɔ de go na Nimrim watasay; di gras dɔn wida, di wan we jɛs bɔs dɔn fɔdɔm, nɔn grin plant nɔ lɛf.
So ɔl di bɔku bɔku tin we dɛn bin dɔn gɛt ɛn wetin dɛn bin dɔn gɛda nain dɛn de kɛr go krɔs oba Wilo Watasay.
Bikɔs di kray dɔn go ɔl rawnd Moab; di kray dɔn rich Ɛglaim, di kray dɔn rich Bierilim.
Alwe riva Daybɔn ful wit blɔd; a go stil briŋ mɔ pan Daybɔn, layɔn fɔ di wan dɛn we rɔnawe kɔmɔt Moab, ɛn fɔ di wan dɛn we lɛf na di land.
Dɛn dɔn sɛn ship pikin dɛn to di wan we de rul di land, kɔmɔt Sila, pas insay di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap, go na Zayɔn in gyal pikin in mawnten.
Lɛk bɔd dɛn we de flay flay, lɛk we bɔd pikin dɛn we nɔ ebul flay yet, de difrɛn difrɛn say, na so Moab in gyal pikin dɛn de usay di wata shala na Riva Anɔn.
“Gi advays, trit ɔlman di sem we; mek una shed tan lɛk nɛt di tɛm we san de ɔp sansan tɛm; ayd di wan dɛn we pipul nɔ want nia dɛn, nɔ pul pɔsin we de rɔnawe, na do;

lɛ di wan dɛn we dɛn nɔ want na Moab tap wit una; una kɔba dɛn lɛ di wan we de distrɔy nɔ distrɔy dɛn. We di wan dɛn we de du dɛn bad nɔ de igen, ɛn nyakanyaka biznɛs dɔn tap, ɛn di wan we de mas pipul na grɔn dɔn kɔmɔt na di land kpata kpata;

datɛnde, dɛn go mek wan tron wit traŋa lɛknɛs ɛn di wan we de jɔj ɛn de si se dɛn trit ɔlman di sem, ɛn nɔ de wɛstɛn fɔ waka tret wit PAPA GƆD go sidɔm na di tron insay Devid in tɛnt, de du wetin rayt.
Wi dɔn yɛri bɔt Moab in prayd, di i bin prawd; bɔt aw i de fil se in bɛtɛ pas ɔda pipul, di kak we i de kak ɛn di fityay we i fityay- ɔl di bost we i de bost na laylay.
So lɛ Moab kray, lɛ ɔlman kray fɔ Moab. Fil sɔri, fil am bad bad wan, fɔ da kek dɛn we gɛt kɔrant na Kir Hɛrɛs.

Bikɔs di fam dɛn na Ɛshbɔn lɛf de pwɛl, ɛn di greps dɛn na Sibma de wes; di rula dɛn na di neshɔn dɛn dɔn brok in branch dɛn kan dɔŋ, we bin prɛd te rich Jeza te go na di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap; in branch dɛn prɛd ɛn pas go oba di si.
So a kray di kray we Jeza kin kray fɔ di greps tik na Sibma; A sok yu bad bad wan wit di wata we de kɔmɔt na mi yay, Yu Ɛshbɔn ɛn Ilielɛ; bikɔs na pan una frut ɛn una avɛst di wa dɔn fɔdɔm.

Ɛn dɛn dɔn pul jɔy ɛn gladi gladi kɔmɔt na di fam we de bia bɔku bɔku frut; ɛn dɛn nɔ de siŋ nɔn siŋ na di greps fam, nɔbɔdi nɔ go pul korɔs; di wan we de mas mas greps na di say fɔ mek wayn, nɔ de mas mas am igen; di drɔŋɔ gladi ala dɔn tap.
So mi sol de kray lɛk gita fɔseka Moab, ɛn mi at de kray fɔ kir Ɛrɛs.
Ɛn we Moab go sho insɛf, we i taya fɔ de usay dɛn kin pre na dɛn mawnten, wɛn i kam nain oli ples fɔ kam pre, i nɔ go si rod.
Na dɛn tin ya PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɔk bɔt Moab.

Bɔt naw PAPA GƆD se, “Insay tri ia, lɛk we dɛn de kɔnt fɔ wokman, Moab in tin dɛn we i de tek blɔf ɛn in jɛntri, go tɔn to disgres, pan ɔl we na bɔku bɔku pipul we de de, di wan dɛn we go lɛf nɔ go plɛnti, ɛn dɛn go wik.”
Wetin PAPA GƆD se go apin to Damaskɔs. A de tɛl una, Damaskɔs nɔ go bi siti igen, ɛn i go tan lɛk ples we broko broko tin dɛn pak.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap nain siti dɛn sote go, dɛn go tɔn ples fɔ dɛn ship ɛn got, we, we dɛn lidɔm, nɔbɔdi nɔ go mek dɛn fred.
Nɔn pan dɛn barik dɛn nɔ go lɛf na Ifrem, ɛn Damaskɔs kindɔm sɛf nɔ go de igen; ɛn di wan dɛn we lɛf na Siria go tan lɛk Izrɛl in pikin dɛn glori; na so PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se.
Da de de, Jekɔb in rɛspɛkt go kam dɔŋ, di fat we de nain flɛsh go ridyus.
I go tan lɛk we pɔsin we de avɛst dɔn kɔt rɛs ɛn pak am wansay ɛn de pik di rɛs wit in an, ɛn lɛk we pɔsin de gɛda rɛs na Refaim Vali.
PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd insay se, af af go lɛf de lɛk we dɛn shek ɔliv tik tu tri bɛri kin lɛf na di branch we ay pas ɔl, fo ɔ fayv kin lɛf na di frut tik in branch dɛn.
Na da de de mɔtalman go rɛspɛkt dɛn Meka ɛn dɛn go luk to Izrɛl in Oli Wan;
dɛn nɔ go rɛspɛkt dɛn ɔlta dɛn, we dɛn bil wit dɛn yon an, ɛn dɛn nɔ go abop pan wetin dɛn mek wit dɛn yon finga, lɛk di Ashirim ɔ di ɔlta dɛn fɔ bɔn insɛns.
Da de de, dɛn pawaful siti dɛn go tan lɛk di Ivayt ɛn di Amɔrayt dɛn ples dɛn we nɔbɔdi nɔ tap, we dɛn rɔnawe lɛf fɔseka di Izrɛlayt dɛn, ɛn di ples go ɛmti ɛn lonsɔm.
Bikɔs una dɔn fɔgɛt di Gɔd we sev una, ɛn una nɔ de mɛmba di Big Ston we protɛkt una; so, i lɛk we una plant fayn fayn plant dɛn ɛn put put af af tik dɛn fɔ sho wan fɔrin laylay gɔd,
i lɛk una mek dɛn gro di de we yu plant dɛn ɛn una mek dɛn pul flawa di vɛri mɔnin we una plant dɛn; pan ɔl dat, una nɔ go stil ebul avɛst natin di de we trɔbul ɛn pen we nɔ de wɛl, go kam.

E, di sawnd we plɛnti neshɔn dɛn kin mek we dɛn de wansay, kin tan lɛk di sawnd we di si kin mek we wata rɔf! E, di sawnd we plɛnti neshɔn dɛn kin mek we dɛn de wansay, kin tan lɛk di nɔys we dɛn big big si kin mek we wata rɔf!

Di neshɔn dɛn de mek nɔys lɛk we bɔku bɔku wata de rɔn, bɔt i go tɔk pan dɛn, ɛn dɛn go rɔnawe go fawe; dɛn go ches dɛn lɛk we briz de blo chaf chaf na dɛn mawnten ɛn lɛk dɔti we de tɔn rawnd wit spid ɛn grap we tinada de blo.
Ivin tɛm, na masibo! Bifo mɔnin kam, dɛn nɔ de igen! Na dɛn tin ya go mit di wan dɛn we de pwɛl wi, ɛn di wan dɛn we de tif wi.
E, land we dɛn bɔd dɛn wiŋ de mek sawnd ɔltɛm, we de oba di riva dɛn na Itiopia;

we de sɛn ambasedɔ dɛn we de pas na Riva Nayl, insay bot dɛn we na papirɔs dɛn tek mek dɛn! Una go, una dɛn mɛsenja we gɛt spid to wan neshɔn we dɛn pipul gɛt ayt ɛn dɛn bɔdi smut, pipul dɛn we dɛn de fred ɔlɔbɔt, neshɔn we pawaful ɛn de kɔnka ɔlsay, we na riva dɛn divayd dɛn land.
Una di pipul dɛn na di wɔl, una we tap na di ath, wɛn dɛn es di signal na di mawnten, una luk! Wɛn dɛn blo di trɔmpɛt, una lisin.
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD tɛl mi; “A go luk kwayɛt wan frɔm usay a tap lɛk we di ples kin ɔt ɛn klia santɛm, lɛk we klawd we gɛt dyu, gɛda santɛm we dɛn kin de avɛst.”
Bikɔs bifo di avɛst, wɛn flawa tɛm dɔn dɔn, ɛn di flawa dɔn tɔn grep we dɔn rɛp, I go kɔt kɔt di an dɛm wit da sizɔs fɔ tek trim flawa, ɛn i go chap di branch dɛn we prɛd.

Dɛn ɔl go lɛf to dɛn bɔd we de na dɛn mawnten de ɔntin ɛn kil ɔda animal dɛn fɔ it, ɛn to dɛn animal dɛn we de na di wɔl. Di bɔd dɛn we de ɔntin ɛn kil ɔda animal dɛn fɔ it, go it dɛn durin dray sizin, ɛn di animal dɛn na wɔl go it dɛn ren sizin.

Da tɛm de, dɛn go briŋ prɛzɛnt dɛn to PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti frɔm di pipul dɛn we gɛt ayt ɛn dɛn bɔdi smut, pipul dɛn we dɛn de fred ɔlɔbɔt, neshɔn we pawaful ɛn de kɔnka ɔlsay, we na riva dɛn divayd dɛn kɔntri, na Mawnt Zayɔn, di ples we PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in nem de.
Wetin PAPA GƆD se go apin to Ijipt. Una luk o, PAPA GƆD de rayd pantap wan klawd we gɛt spid ɛn kam na Ijipt; di laylay gɔd dɛn na Ijipt go trimbul bifo am ɛn di Ijipshian dɛn go wan day wit fred.
A go sɛtfaya di Ijipshian dɛn, ɛn dɛn go fɛt dɛnsɛf, brɔda agens brɔda ɛn ɔlman go fɛt in neba, siti go fɛt siti, kindɔm go fɛt kindɔm.
Ɛn di Ijipshian dɛm at go pwɛl ɛn a go kɔnfyus dɛn plan dɛm; ɛn dɛn go go fɛnɔt to di laylay gɔd dɛn ɛn di mɛrɛsin man, di luk grɔn man dɛm, ɛn di wichman dɛm, wetin go bi;
PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, i go put di Ijipshian dɛn na wan traŋa at man in an, ɛn na wan fays kiŋ go rul dɛn.
Riva Nayl go dray kpatakpata, ɛn di riva in grɔn go kek ɛn dray wan;
ɛn di kanal dɛn na Riva Nayl go stink, ɛn di branch dɛn na Riva Nayl we de na Ijipt go dray slo slo, dɛn plant dɛn we kin gro ɔnda wata, ɔl go day.
Natin nɔ go de nia Riva Nayl, natin nɔ go de na di sho, ɛn ɔl wetin dɛn plant nia Riva Nayl, go dray, ɛn briz go blo dɛn go ɛn dɛn nɔ go de igen
Ɔl di fishaman dɛn go fil am ɛn go de kray, di wan dɛn we bin de fishin wit uk na Riva Nayl; dɛn wan dɛn we de ib nɛt de, go sɔfa ɛn wik we dɛn nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du.
Di wokman dɛn we de mek linin, ɛn di wan dɛn we de mek wayt kɔtin, go pwɛlat.
Dɛn go kil di wan dɛn we dɛn de luk ɔp to na di land, ɛn ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we dɛn kin aya fɔ wok go fil am bad bad wan.
Di bigman dɛn na Zoan, fulish, dɛn kayn nɔ de; Fero in sɛnsman dɛn we bin de advays am, gi am styupid advays. How yu go tɛl Fero se, “Mi na wan sɛnsman in bɔypikin, dɛn fɔstɛm kiŋ dɛn bɔypikin”?
We una sɛns man dɛm naw? Le dɛn tɛl una, ɛn lɛ dɛn mek una no wetin PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dɔn mekɔp fɔ Ijipt.
Di bigman dɛn na Zoan dɔn tɔn fulman dɛn ɛn dɛn dɔn disiv di bigman dɛn na Mɛmfis; di wan dɛn we dɛn abop pan na di difrɛn Fambul dɛn dɔn mek Ijipt go astre.
PAPA GƆD dɔn miksɔp am wit spirit ɔf kɔnfyushɔn; ɛn dɛn dɔn mek Ijipt nɔ ebul du natin soba lɛk we drɔnkɔman de staga insay in vɔmit.
Ɛn natin nɔ go de fɔ Ijipt we di ed ɔ di tel, di gud wan ɔ di bad wan dɛn, go du.
Da de de, di Ijipshian dɛn go tan lɛk uman, ɛn go trimbul de fred bifo di an we PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti de shek na Ijipt.
Juda go tɔn tin fɔ fred fɔ di Ijipshian dɛn; ɛnibɔdi we dɛn kɔl in nem to go fred, bikɔs ɔf di kayn tin we PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dɔn mekɔp fɔ dɛn.
Da de de, fayv siti go de na Ijipt we go tɔk di laŋwej we dɛn de tɔk na Kenan, ɛn dɛn go swɛ se dɛn de wit PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti. Wan pan dɛn wande go nem, di San in Siti.
Da de de, PAPA GƆD in ɔlta go de na Ijipt, ɛn wan pila go de na di bɔda fɔ PAPA GƆD.
I go bi sayn ɛn ɛvidɛns fɔ PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti insay Ijipt; wɛn dɛn go kray to PAPA GƆD fɔseka we pipul dɛn go sɔprɛs dɛn, i go sɛn seviɔ we go pul dɛn kɔmɔt na di wan dɛn an, we de sɔprɛs dɛn.

PAPA GƆD go mek di Ijipshian dɛn no am; ɛn di Ijipshian dɛn go no PAPA GƆD da de de, ɛn dɛn go mek sakrifays ɛn sakrifays we dɛn kin bɔn na faya fɔ wɔship am, ɛn dɛn go mek prɔmis to PAPA GƆD se, dɛn go du sɔntin ɛn dɛn go du am.
PAPA GƆD go pɔnish Ijipt. I go de pɔnish dɛn ɛn de mɛn dɛn, ɛn dɛn go tɔn bak to PAPA GƆD, ɛn I go yɛri dɛn prea ɛn go mɛn dɛn.
Da de de, big rod go de we go kɔmɔt Ijipt go Asiria. Di Asirian go kam na Ijipt, ɛn di Ijipshian go go Asiria. Di Ijipshian ɛn di Asirian dɛn go wɔship togɛda.
Da de de Izrɛl go bi di nɔmba tri to Ijipt ɛn Asiria, we go bi blɛsin to di wanol wɔl,
we PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dɔn blɛs we i se, “Ijipt we na mi pipul dɛn, Asiria we na mi an a tek mek dɛn, ɛn Izrɛl we na mi pipul dɛn we a dɔn pik, go gɛt blɛsin.”
Da ia we di bigman pan di kɔmanda dɛn, we na Sagɔn we na kiŋ na Asiria bin sɛn am, atak Ashdɔd ɛn kapchɔ am,–
dat tɛn de, PAPA GƆD bin dɔn tɔk to Ayzaya we na Emɔz in bɔypikin se, “go pul di saklɔth kɔmɔt na yu wes, ɛn pul yu sus na yu fut,” ɛn i bin dɔn du wetin I se; de waka nekɛd ɛn bia fut–
nain PAPA GƆD se, “Lɛk we Ayzaya we na mi wokman dɔn waka nekɛd ɛn bia fut fɔ tri ia, we na sayn ɛn wɔnin se sɔntin we nɔ gud, go bi to Ijipt ɛn Itiopia,
na so di kiŋ na Asiria go kɛr di Ijipshian dɛn we dɛn kech go as slev ɛn di Itiopian dɛn go ɛgzayl; yɔŋ wan o, ol wan o, nekɛd ɛn biafut wit ɛmtiwes, we na shem to Ijipt.
Dat go mek dɛn at pwɛl nɔ go no wetin fɔ se, bikɔs ɔf wetin apin to Itiopia we dɛn abop pan ɛn Ijipt we dɛn de bost bɔt.

Da de de, di pipul dɛn we tap na di land dɛn nia wata, go se, “Na dis kayn tin dɔn bi to di wan dɛn we wi bin abop pan, ɛn di wan dɛn we wi bin de rɔn go to fɔ ɛp wi, ɛn fɔ pul wi kɔmɔt na di Asirian kiŋ in an! E wi, aw wi go ebul ɛskep?”

Wetin PAPA GƆD se go apin to di ayland we natin na di si. We traŋa briz dɛn we de tɔn wan ples ɛn grap, de blo na di Nɛgɛb de go, i kin kɔmɔt na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, we na bad bad land.
Dɛn sho mi wan siriɔs siriɔs vishɔn; di man we de lut, de lut, ɛn di pɔsin we de nyakanyaka, de nyakanyaka. Yu Ilam, go atak, le ambush, yu Mɛdia; A go tap ɔl di pini we i dɔn mek una pini.
Dat mek na so so wes pen a de gɛt; pen dɔn ol mi, lɛk di pen we uman de fil we i de pan pen fɔ bɔn; A dɔn so bɛn dat a nɔ de yɛri, mi at so pwɛl dat a nɔ ebul si.
Mi maynd nɔ stɛdi, fred dɔn mek a nɔ no wetin fɔ du; di ol ej we a bin de pre fɔ dɔn tɔn tɛm fɔ mi fɔ de trimbul.
Dɛn mek tebul, dɛn prɛd di rɔg dɛn, dɛn it ɛn drink. Una grap, una di bigman dɛn, una ɔyl di big shild!
Bikɔs, na dis PAPA GƆD tɛl mi: “Go, put wachman, mek i de ala tɔk wetin i de si.”
We i si man dɛn we de rayd ɔs, man dɛn we de rayd ɔs tu bay tu, man dɛn we de rayd dɔŋki, man dɛn we de rayd kamɛl, mek i lisin gud, gud gud wan.”
Nain di wan we si ala se, “Na pan wachman tawa a de tinap o, PAPA GƆD, ol de, ɛvri de, ɛn a de na mi post ol nɛt, ɛvride.
Wetin a si, man dɛn we de rayd ɔs de kam, man dɛn we de rayd ɔs, tu bay tu!” Nain i ansa se, “I dɔn fɔdɔm, Babilɔn dɔn fɔdɔm; ɔl in laylay gɔd dɛn imej dɛn dɔn skata pis pis na grɔn.”
E, mi yon we dɛn dɔn bit ɛn fana, na wetin a yɛri to PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, a de tɛl una.
Wetin PAPA GƆD se bɔt Idɔm. Pɔsin de Idɔm de ala aks mi se, “Wachman, aw di nɛt? Wachman, aw di nɛt?”
Nain di wachman se: “Mɔnin kin kam, ɛn nɛt sɛf kin kam. If yu wan no ɛnitin, aks; mɔs kam bak.”
Wetin PAPA GƆD se bɔt Arebia. Nainsay dɛn bush we tay tay pan dɛnsɛf na Arebia, una go tap, una di Dɛdanayt dɛn we de travul wit kamɛl, bay grup.
Una briŋ wata fɔ di wan dɛn we tɔsti, una go gi dɛn wan we aŋri, it fɔ it, una we tap na Tɛma.
Bikɔs dɛn dɔn rɔnawe pan sɔd, dɛn rɔnawe pan sɔd we dɛn dɔn drɔ fɔ kil dɛn, pan bo ɛn aro we dɔn rɛdi fɔ shut, ɛn pan fɛt we na plɛnti pipul de fɛt.
Na dis PAPA GƆD tɛl mi, “Insay wan ia, bay aw dɛn kin kɔnt fɔ wokman, ɔl di tin dɛn we dɛn de prez Kida fɔ, go dɔn;
ɛn di balans we go lɛf pan di man dɛn we de shut bo ɛn aro pan di pawaful fɛtman dɛn pan Kida in bɔypikin dɛn, nɔ go plɛnti; bikɔs na PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, dɔn tɔk am.”
Wetin PAPA GƆD se bɔt di Vali ɔf Vishɔn. Wetin una min we una se una dɔn go ɔp, una ɔl dɔn go ɔp pantap di os dɛn,
una we ɔltɛm na so so ala ala una de pan, siti we pak wit nɔys, siti we lɛk gladi gladi? Una we nɔto sɔd ɔ wa kin kil di wan dɛn we de day pan una.
Ɔl una rula dɛn dɔn rɔnawe togɛda, ɔl we dɛn nɔ ol bo ɛn aro, dɛn kapchɔ dɛn. Dɛn kapchɔ una ɔl we dɛn fɛn, ɔl we dɛn bin dɔn rɔnawe go fawe.
Na dat mek a se: “Nɔ luk mi lɛf mi mek a kray bita bita wan; nɔ waala yusɛf fɔ koks mi fɔseka di nyakanyaka we dɛn nyakanyaka mi pipul dɛn gyal pikin.”
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti gɛt in yon de fɔ ala ala ɛn fɔ mas mas pipul ɛn fɔ mek kɔnfyushɔn na di Vali ɔf Vishɔn, fɔ bata wɔl kan dɔŋ ɛn fɔ ala to dɛn mawnten dɛn.
Ɛn Ilam bɔn dɛn bo ɛn aro bag wit chariɔt dɛm ɛn man dɛn we de rayd ɔs, ɛn di land ɔf Kir pul di kɔba klos pan dɛn big shild dɛn.
Di vali dɛn we una lɛk pas ɔl, ful wit chariɔt, ɛn man dɛn we de rayd ɔs, tinap na di get dɛn.
I dɔn pul Juda in kɔba klos kɔmɔt. Na da de de una bin abop pan di wɛpɔn na di Fɔrɛst Os,
ɛn una bin si se di say dɛn we pwɛl na di wɔl dɛn na Devid in siti, bin plɛnti, ɛn una bin de gɛt wata na di watasay we de dɔŋ say,
ɛn una bin kɔnt di os dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn una bin brok di os dɛn fɔ mek di wɔl go traŋa.
Una dig say fɔ gɛda ɛn kip wata bitwin di tu wɔl fɔseka di ol watasay. Bɔt una nɔ bin abop to di wan we du am ɔ gɛt rɛspɛkt fɔ di pɔsin we bin dɔn plan am lɔlɔntɛm.
Da de de, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti bin se ɔlman fɔ kray ɛn fil sɔri, fɔ krep ed ɛn wɛr saklɔth;
bɔt wetin apin? Jɔy ɛn gladi gladi, de kil kaw ɛn kil ship, de it bif ɛn drink wayn. “Lɛ wi it ɛn drink bikɔs wande, wi gɛt fɔ day.”
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dɔn sho insɛf na mi yes: “Fɔ tru, a nɔ go fɔgiv una fɔ dis sin we yu dɔn kɔmit te te una day.” Na so PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se.
Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, “Kam, go to di stiwɔd na Shɛbna, we de inchaj ɔf di os, ɛn aks am se:
Wetin yu gɛt fɔ du na ya ɛn udat yu gɛt na ya, we yu dɔn dig grev fɔ yusɛf, yu we dɔn dig grev fɔ unasɛf ɔp di il ɛn dɔn kav ples fɔ yusɛf fɔ tap na dɛn big big ston?
A de tɛl yu, PAPA GƆD go es ɛn trowe yu wit trɛnk, yu traŋa man. I go bɔkul yu tayt tayt wan,
ɛn tɔn tɔn yu rawnd ɛn rawnd ɛn trowe yu lɛk bɔl na wan big big land; na de yu gɔ day ɛn na de yu fayn fayn chariɔt dɛn go de, yu we de briŋ shem to yu masta in os.
A go push yu kɔmɔt na yu ɔfis wit trɛnk ɛn yu go fɔdɔm kan dɔŋ kɔmɔt na yu wokples.
Da de de, a go kɔl Ilayakim we na mi wokman ɛn na Ilkaya in bɔypikin,
ɛn a go wɛr yu klos pan am ɛn tay yu bɛlt pan am, ɛn go gi am yu pawa; i go bi dadi fɔ di wan dɛn we tap na Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn dadi fɔ Juda.
A go put di ki fɔ Devid in os nain an; i go opin, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go lɔk; i go lɔk, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go opin.
A go fasin am lɛk pɛg na ples we wan ambɔgin nɔ go de, ɛn i go bi di tron we gɛt rɛspɛkt, nain papa in os.
Di lod nain papa in os go de nain ed; di pikin we dɛn bɔn ɛn di wan we dɛn mɛn, ɛnitin; frɔm dɛn lili kɔp to dɛn big big jɔg.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, da de de, di pɛg we bin fasin na di ples we wan ambɔgin nɔ de, go kɔmɔt; ɛn dɛn go kɔt am mek i fɔdɔm, ɛn di lod we bin de pan am, go kɔmɔt, bikɔs na PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk am.”
Wetin PAPA GƆD se go apin to Tay. Una kray, una dɛn ship dɛn na Tashish, bikɔs Tay dɔn lɛf ɛmti wan; os nɔ de, ples fɔ slam nɔ de! Na di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt Sayprɔs kan tɛl dɛm.
Una nɔ du natin, una we tap nia sho, una dɛn biznɛsman na Saydɔn; una mɛsenja dɛn dɔn pas na si
ɛn dɔn pas na difrɛn difrɛn si; una bin gɛt kɔpɔ we una bin de bay ɛn sɛl kɔn we kɔmɔt Ijipt, we na Riva Nayl in bɛnifit; una bin de tredin wit ɔl dɛn kɔntri dɛn.
Saydɔn, gɛt shem, bikɔs di si dɔn tɔk, di say we di si in trɛnk de dɔn tɔk se, “a nɔ sɔfa pen fɔ bɔn wande ɛn a nɔ bɔn pikin wande, ɛn a nɔ mɛn yɔŋ bɔbɔ dɛn wande ɛn a nɔ tren vajin gyal dɛn wande.”
Wɛn di wɔd go rich Ijipt, dɛn go fil am we dɛn go yɛri di wɔd bɔt Tay.
Una go na Tashish, ɛn kray, una we tap na di sho.
Na una siti dis we una bin de es ɔp, we dɔn de lɔlɔntɛm, we mek in pipul dɛn kɛr in nem go sɛtul fawe?
Udat plan ɔl dis agens Tay, we na di wan we de gi krawn dɛn, we in biznɛs man dɛn ɔl na kɔpɔ man dɛn, we nain treda dɛn, na di treda dɛn we dɛn rɛspɛkt pas ɔl na di wanol wɔl?
Na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dɔn plan am, fɔ mek di kak we i de kak fɔseka di nem we i dɔn mek, dɔn dɔti na PAPA GƆD in yay, fɔ disrɛspɛkt ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we dɛn rɛspɛkt na dis wɔl.
Una fulɔp una land lɛk we wata fulɔp Riva Nayl, yu Tashish in gyal pikin; kɔntrol nɔ de igen
I dɔn tret in an oba di si, I dɔn shek di kindɔm dɛm; PAPA GƆD dɔn gi kɔmand bɔt Fonishia, fɔ pwɛl pwɛl ɔl usay i abop.
Ɛn i tɔk se: “Yu nɔ go bɛtɛ igen, yu we na Saydɔn in gyal pikin we na vajin, we dɛn de sɔprɛs; i lɛk yu grap go oba Sayprɔs, de sɛf yu nɔ go gɛt alafia.”

Luk di Babilonian dɛn land! Na di pipul dɛn dis; nɔto bin Asiria. Dɛn se na wayl animal dɛn go de na Tay. Dɛn bil dɛn tawa dɛn we dɛn tek ambush, dɛn brok dɛn kiŋ os dɛm kan dɔŋ; dɛn nyakanyaka di kɔntri bɔnali.
Una kray, una dɛn ship dɛn na Tashish, bikɔs usay una abop, dɔn lɛf ɛmti.
Da tɛn de, dɛn go fɔgɛt bɔt Tay fɔ sɛvinti ia, we na di tɛm we kiŋ kin rul. Wɛn di sɛvinti ia dɔn, I go bi bak jɛs lɛk wetin wan rare gyal in siŋ se:
“Tek wan gita, pas pas na di siti, Yu rare gyal we dɛn don fɔgɛt bɔt! Ple swit myuzik, siŋ plɛnti plɛnti siŋ dɛm lɛ dɛn go de mɛmba yu.”
Wɛn di sɛvinti ia dɔn, PAPA GƆD go go waka na Tay, ɛn Tay go go bak go du in wok, ɛn go bi di rare gyal fɔ ɔl di kindɔm dɛn we de na di wɔl.
I go put wetin i de sɛl ɛn wetin i de du na PAPA GƆD in an; dɛn nɔ go kip dɛn na sto ɛn dɛn nɔ go ayd dɛn, bɔt dɛn go yuz dɛn fɔ sɔplay PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn bɔku bɔku it ɛn fayn fayn klos dɛn.
PAPA GƆD go mek natin nɔ lɛf na dis wɔl ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de, ɛn i go twis di grɔn ɛn skata di pipul dɛn we tap de.

Na jɛs lɛk aw i bi to di pipul dɛn, na so i go bi wit di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin; aw i bi to di slev, na so i go bi to in masta; aw i bi to di yɔŋ titi we de wok, na so i go bi to in misis; aw i bi to udat de bay, na so i go bi to udat de sɛl; aw i bi to udat de lɛnt, na so i go bi to udat de go lɛnt; aw i bi to udat de trɔs pipul, na so i go bi to udat de go trɔs.
Di wɔl go ɛmti kpatakpata ɛn i go pwɛl ɔltogɛda; bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk di wɔd.
Di wɔl in at de blid ɛn ɔltin de dray, Di wɔl de go biɛn ɛn de dray; Di skay ɛn di grɔn de sɔfa wik togɛda.
Di grɔn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD in yay, ɔnda di wan we tap pantap am; bikɔs dɛn dɔn brok di lɔ dɛm, dɛn nɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se, dɛn dɔn brok di Kɔvinant we na fɔ sote go.
Fɔseka dat, swɛ de it di wɔl, ɛn di pipul we tap de, de sɔfa bikɔs dɛn gilti; so di wan dɛn we tap de, de bɔn, ɛn na tu tri man dɛn lɛf.
Di wayn in at de blid, di greps tik de brokat, ɔl dɛn yaŋe yaŋe pipul dɛn de pini.
Yu nɔ de yɛri di tamborin in api sawnd igen, di nɔys we dɛn pipul we de gladi kin mek, dɔn tap, di gladi sawnd we da instrumɛnt we tan lɛk gita de mek, dɔn tap.
Dɛn nɔ de drink wayn ɛn siŋ igen; strɔŋ drink dɔn bita to di wan dɛn we de drink am.
Di siti we gɛt kɔnfyushɔn dɔn brok dɔŋ, ɔl di os dɛn lɔk so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul go insay.
Pipul dɛn vɛks de ala na trit bikɔs wayn nɔ de; di tin dɛn we de mek pipul dɛn gladi dɔn day; dɛn dɔn drɛb gladi gladi kɔmɔt na di wɔl.
Na ɛmtinɛs ɛn lonlinɛs lɛf na di siti, di get dɛn ɔl dɔn brok brok ɛn pwɛl pwɛl.
Na so i go bi na di wɔl to di difrɛn neshɔn dɛn; lɛk we greps tik ɛmti we dɛn de pik di tu tri we kin lɛf we dɛn kin dɔn pik ɔltin na di tik dɔn.
Dɛn ala de siŋ wit gladi; fɔseka PAPA GƆD we na kiŋ we pas ɔl, in rɛspɛkt, dɛn de ala na di wɛst.
So, una we de na di ist fɔ glorifay PAPA GƆD; una we de na dɛn kɔntri dɛn we de nia di si, una glorifay PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd.

Wi de yɛri prez siŋ dɛn de kɔmɔt usay di wɔl tap, siŋ dɛn we de glorifay PAPA GƆD. Bɔt a se “a sik ɛn de lɔs wet, a sik ɛn de lɔs wet. Swɛ dɔn kech mi! Bikɔs rikishi pipul dɛn de du rikishi tin dɛm, rikishi pipul dɛn, de du dɛn bad bad rikishi tin dɛm.
Fred fred, dip ol ɛn trap, de wit una, una di pipul dɛn na di wɔl!

Di wan we rɔn we i yɛri sawnd de mek i fred go fɔdɔm insay di dip ol; ɛn di wan we klem kɔmɔt na di dip ol di trap go kech am. Bikɔs di winda dɛn na evin opin, ɛn di wɔl in fawndeshɔn dɛn, de trimbul.
Di wɔl dɔn brok kpatakpata di wɔl dɔn chɛr tu, di wɔl de shek bad bad wan.
