Di wɔl de staga lɛk drɔnkɔman i de shek lɛf ɛn rayt lɛk fam os; in sin de pan am ebi ebi wan, ɛn i fɔdɔm, ɛn i nɔ go grap igen.
Da de de, PAPA GƆD go pɔnish di pawa dɛn na di ɛvin, insay evin, ɛn di kiŋ dɛn na wɔl, insay di wɔl.
Dɛn go gɛda dɛn togɛda lɛk jelman dɛn na dip wanol; dɛn go lɔk dɛn ɔp na jel, ɛn afta lɔŋ tɛm, dɛn go pɔnish dɛn.
Di mun go sɔprayz, ɛn di san go shem; bikɔs PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go ren na Mawnt Zayɔn ɛn insay Jerusɛlɛm ɛn na frɔnt di bigman dɛn i go sho in pawa.
PAPA GƆD, yu na mi Gɔd; a go es yu ɔp ɛn a go prez yu nem; bikɔs yu dɔn du wɔndaful tin dɛm, plan dɛn we dɛn mek lɔntɛm, yu kip yu wɔd ɛn dawt nɔ de de.
Bikɔs yu dɔn tɔn di siti to dɔti ip, di siti we gɛt protɛkshɔn dɔn broko broko; dɛn fɔrina dɛn kiŋ os nɔto siti igen, dɛn nɔ go eva bil am bak.
Na dat mek traŋa pipul dɛm go glorifay yu; dɛn siti we pipul dɛn we de du bad ɛn nɔ luk biɛn, tap, go fred yu.

Bɔkɔs na yu po man abop pan, di pɔsin we di wan we nɔ gɛt, abop pan we i gɛt prɔblɛm, di wan we de ayd pipul wɛn tinada de blo, ɛn di wan we de kɔba pipul we san wam; bikɔs wɛn dɛn wan we de du bad ɛn nɔ luk biɛn kin shek, i kin tan lɛk we tinada de blo pan wɔl,
lɛk we dray ples ɔt pasmak. Yu dɔn tap di nɔys we dɛn fɔrina dɛn de mek; lɛk di ɔt we di klawd we kɔba yu de pul, na so dɛn pipul we de du bad ɛn nɔ luk biɛn, dɛn siŋ kin tap.

Na pantap dis mawnten PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go mek big pati fɔ ɔlman wit fat tin dɛn, wit wayn we gɛt kɛtɛkɛmu, fat tin dɛn we gɛt bif midul di bon ɛn wayn we gɛt kɛtɛkɛmu we dɛn tek tɛm pul, lɛ i nɔ miks.
Ɛn na pan dis mawnten i go pwɛl di tin we kɔba ɔl di pipul dɛn na di wɔl, di vel we prɛd oba ɔl dɛn neshɔn na wɔl.
I go swɛla day sote go, ɛn Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd go wep wata kɔmɔt na ɔlman yay, ɛn i go pul di tin dɛn we de mek pipul dɛn disgres kɔmɔt na di wɔl; bikɔs na PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk am.
Dɛn go tɔk da de de se, “Yɛs, na wi Gɔd dis; wi dɔn wet am lɛ i go sev wi. Dis na PAPA GƆD; wi dɔn wet am; lɛ wi gladi ɛn gladi fɔ di sev we i sev wi.”
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD in an go rɛst pan dis mawnten ɛn i go mas Moab usay i de, lɛk we dɛn de mas mas dray gras na dɔŋ pit.
Ɛn i go prɛd in an midul de, lɛk we pɔsin we de swim de skata in an we i de swim. Bɔt PAPA GƆD go brok in prayd ɛn in skil we i gɛt nain an.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD go brok di ay ay wɔl we i de tek protɛkt insɛf, kan dɔŋ na grɔn, ɛn tɔn am to dɔti.
Da tɛm de, dɛn go siŋ dis siŋ na Juda; “We siti traŋa; i tek salveshɔn mek wɔl ɛn protɛkshɔn.
Opin di get dɛm, si dat di neshɔn we de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD ɛn biliv pan am go kam insay.
Yu de mek pɔsin we in maynd de to yu de wit kol at, bikɔs i biliv pan yu.
Biliv pan PAPA GƆD sote go, bikɔs Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd na lɛk akpata we de sote go.
I dɔn briŋ di pipul dɛn we bin de ɔp di ay siti, kan dɔŋ. I briŋ am kan dɔŋ, dɔŋ na grɔn ɛn ib am na dɔti.
Fut dɛn mas mas am, po man in fut, di wan dɛn we nɔ gɛt, waka pan am.”
Layf lɛvul fɔ pɔsin we de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD; na yu mek di pipul we de waka tret wit yu, dɛn rod, smut na layf.
Na di rod fɔ yu jɔjmɛnt dɛn wi de wet fɔ yu E PAPA GƆD; wetin wi sol want bad bad wan na fɔ de mɛmba yu nem.
Mi sol kin aŋri fɔ yu na nɛt, mi spirit we de insay mi de luk fɔ yu. Bikɔs we yu jɔjmɛnt dɛn de na wɔl, di pipul dɛn na wɔl de lan fɔ waka tret wit yu.
If dɛn du gud fɔ wikɛd pɔsin, i nɔ go lan fɔ waka tret wit PAPA GƆD; i de du tin we nɔ rayt na soba pipul dɛn land ɛn i nɔ de si PAPA GƆD we na kiŋ we pas ɔl, in rɛspɛkt
PAPA GƆD, yu an de ɔp bɔt dɛn nɔ de si am atɔl. Lɛ dɛn si yu zil fɔ yu pipul dɛm mek dɛn go shem. Lɛ di faya fɔ yu ɛnimi dɛn, bɔn dɛn.
PAPA GƆD, yu go mek wi gɛt pis, yu dɔn wok ɔl wi wok fɔ we.
PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd, ɔda masta dɛm apat frɔm yu bin dɔn rul wi, bɔt na yu nem nɔmɔ wi gri fɔ.
Dɛn dɔn day, dɛn nɔ go liv; dɛn na gost, dɛn nɔ go grap; na dat mek yu dɔn distrɔy dɛn ɛn mek pipul dɛn nɔ mɛmba dɛn igen igen
PAPA GƆD, yu dɔn mek di neshɔn bɔku mɔ, yu dɔn mek di neshɔn gro; yu dɔn gɛt glori; yu dɔn ad pan ɔl di bɔda dɛn na di land.
PAPA GƆD, nainsay dip trɔbul dɛn bin de we dɛn de fɛn yu, dɛn bin pre to yu wit ɔl dɛn at, we yu bin de kɔrɛkt dɛm.
Lɛk uman we gɛt bɛlɛ we de twis twis ɛn ala de kray we i de fil pen, wɛn in tɛm dɔn de rich fɔ bɔn, na so wi bin de du bikɔs ɔf yu PAPA GƆD;
wi bin gɛt bɛlɛ, wi bin de twis twis, bɔt as i bi, i tan lɛk na briz wi bɔn. Wi nɔ du natin fɔ ɛp di wɔl, ɛn di wan dɛn we tap na wɔl, nɔ day.
Una dayman dɛn go gɛt layf, dɛn bɔdi go grap. Una we de na grev, una wek ɛn siŋ wit jɔy! Bikɔs una dyu, na dyu we gɛt layt, ɛn una go mek i fɔdɔm na di land we gost de.
Mi pipul dɛm, una kam insay una rum dɛm ɛn lɔk una do dɛm; una ayd unasɛf lili wayl te di veksteshɔn dɔn.

Bikɔs PAPA GƆD de kɔmɔt nain ples kan na do fɔ pɔnish di pipul we tap na wɔl fɔseka dɛn sin, ɛn di wɔl go pul di sikrit bɔt di blɔd we dɛn dɔn shɛd pan am, ɛn i nɔ go kɔba di wan dɛn we dɛn kil, igen.
Da tɛm de, PAPA GƆD go tek in pawaful, big ɛn traŋa sɔd pɔnish Lɛviatan, da snek we de rɔnawe, Lɛviatan, da snek we de twis twis, ɛn i go kil di dragɔn we tap na di si.
Da tɛm de: “Siŋ bɔt wan fayn fayn greps fam!
Na mi PAPA GƆD, na mi de tek kia ɔf am; a de wata am ɛvri minit. Bambay ɛnibɔdi go wan ambɔg am, a de gyad am de ɛn nɛt.
A nɔ vɛks. A wish a bin gɛt chuk chuk ɛn wayl bush fɔ fɛt! A bin fɔ go mit dɛn fɔ fɛt dɛn, a bin fɔ bɔn dɛn togɛda.
If nɔto dat, lɛ dɛn kam to mi fɔ protɛkt dɛm, lɛ dɛn mek pis wit mi, lɛ dɛn mek pis wit mi.”
Tɛm go kam we Jekɔb go tinap traŋa wan, Izrɛl go pul bɔd ɛn pul flawa ɛn go ful di wanol wɔl wit frut.
I dɔn pɔnish dɛn lɛk aw i bin pɔnish di wan dɛn we bin pɔnish dɛn? Adinɔ dɛn dɔn kil dɛn, lɛk aw dɛn bin kil di wan dɛn we bin kil dɛn?
Smɔl smɔl, na we dɛn de ɛgzayl yu de ebul sho dɛn wetin yu want; I pul dɛn kɔmɔt de wit in ebi blo di de we di briz we de kɔmɔt na di ist, de blo.

So, na bay dat dɛn go pe fɔ Jekɔb in sin, ɛn na dis go bi di faynal tin we go pul in sin; wɛn i mek ɔl di ston dɛn na di ɔlta dɛn tan lɛk chɔk we dɛn gren to pawda, nɔn Ashɛrim ɔ insɛns ɔlta nɔ go tinap igen

Bikɔs di siti we gɛt protɛkshɔn dɔn lɛf ɛmti, ples we pipul dɛn bin de, lɛf ɛmti lɛk di dray ɛn ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap; na de di kaw pikin de it gras, na de i de ledɔm de it di lif dɛn kɔmɔt pan di branch dɛn.
Wɛn di branch dɛn dɔn dray, dɛn de brok dɛm; uman dɛn de kam tek dɛn mek faya. Bikɔs dɛn pipul ya nɔ de ɔndastand; na dat mek in we mek dɛm, nɔ go sɔri fɔ dɛm, In we mol dɛm, nɔ go sho dɛn ɛni fevɔ.
Da tɛn de, frɔm Riva Yufretis to Ijipt Watasay, PAPA GƆD go mas mas ɛn pul di rɛs, ɛn i go gɛda una wan ay wan, una di pipul dɛn na Izrɛl.
Ɛn da tɛm de, dɛn go blo wan big big trɔmpɛt, ɛn dɛn wan we bin lɔs na Asiria, ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we dɛn bin drɛb go Ijipt, go kam wɔship PAPA GƆD na di oli mawnten na Jerusɛlɛm.
Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan di rula na Ifrem we prawd ɛn de drɔŋɔ, ɛn di flawa we de wida, we bin de mek i luk shayn ɛn fayn, we de na di wan dɛn we jɛntri ɛn we rɔm dɔn ambɔg, dɛn ed.
PAPA GƆD gɛt di wan we pawaful ɛn traŋa; na lɛk we af af ays de fɔdɔm bɔku bɔku wan lɛk ren, lɛk ebi ebi tinada, lɛk tinada we de briŋ ebi ebi flɔd, i yuz pawa sɛn am kan dɔŋ na di wɔl.
Dɛn nɔ go mas mas dɛn drɔŋɔ man dɛn na Ifrem dɛn krawn dɛn na grɔn;

ɛn di flawa we de wida, we bin de mek i luk shayn ɛn fayn, we de na di wan dɛn we jɛntri, dɛn ed, go tan lɛk mangro we kin rɛp fɔs bifo dray sizin: wɛn pɔsin si am, as i rich nain an so, i de it am wantɛm.
Da tɛm de, na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go bi di krawn we pipul go de blɔf wit, ɛn fayn fayn kɔrɔnɛt, to di balans pipul dɛm;
ɛn di spirit fɔ jɔstis to di wan we de jɔj, ɛn trɛnk to di wan dɛn we de difɛnd di get mek fɛt nɔ rich insay.

Dɛnwanya sɛf de rol na grɔn we dɛn drink wayn ɛn de staga we dɛn drink traŋa rɔm; di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di prɔfɛt bin de rol na grɔn we dɛn drink traŋa rɔm, wayn kɔnfyus dɛm, traŋa rɔm mek dɛn staga; dɛn nɔ de si gud, dɛn de mistek we dɛn de gi jɔjmɛnt.
Bikɔs ɔl di tebul dɛn fulɔp wit vɔmit, nɔn say nɔ de we nɔ dɔti ɛn nasti.
“Udat i go tich sɛns ɛn udat i go explen di mɛsej to? Na dɛn wan we jɛs lɛf fɔ drink milk, dɛn wan we dɛn jɛs pul na bɔbi?
Bikɔs na bay, tichin pan tichin, tichin pan tichin, layn bay layn, layn bay layn, lilibit ya, lilibit yanda.”
Nɔ o, bɔt na bay trenja we de tɔk fɔrin laŋwej PAPA GƆD go tɔk to dɛn pipul ya,
di wan dɛn we i dɔn tɛl se, “Na dis na alafia; gi alafia to pɔsin we dɔn taya; ɛn na dis na rɛst”; pan ɔl dat, dɛn nɔ gri yɛri wɔd.

Na dat mek, to dɛn, PAPA GƆD in wɔd go bi tichin pan tichin, tichin pan tichin, layn bay layn, layn bay layn, lilibit ya, lilibit yanda; so dat dɛn go go, ɛn fɔdɔm wit dɛn bak, ɛn wund, trap kech dɛm ɛn dɛn kapchɔ dɛn.
So una fɔ yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd, una we tink se ɔlman ful, una we de rul di pipul dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm!

Bɔkɔs una dɔn tɔk se, “wi dɔn mek Kɔvinant wit day, ɛn wi gɛt agrimɛnt wit Ɛl; we di pasmak pɔnishmɛnt go de pas na ya i nɔ go mit wi; bikɔs na lay wi abop pan fɔ kɔba wi ɛn nainsay bɛn bɛn wi dɔn ayd”;

So, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se, “a de le wan ston fɔ fawndeshɔn na Zayɔn, ston we dɛn dɔn tɛst, wit wan ston, ston we dɛn dɔn tɛst, wan valyuebul kɔnaston, we na traŋa fawndeshɔn: ‘Udat biliv nɔ go de ɔri ɔri.’

Ɛn a go mek jɔstis bi di mɛzhɔmɛnt, ɛn fɔ waka tret wit PAPA GƆD go bi di say fɔ drɔ di layn; na af af bɔl ays we de fɔdɔm kan dɔŋ lɛk ren, go swip di lay dɛn we tek kɔba, go, ɛn na bɔku bɔku wata go fulɔp usay dɛn de ayd.”
Datɛnde, una Kɔvinant wit day go pwɛl, ɛn una agrimɛnt wit ɛl nɔ go ol wata igen; wɛn di pasmak pɔnishmɛnt go pas usay una de, i go mɔs wap una dɔŋ.
Ɛnitɛm we i pas de, i go mɔna una; bikɔs i go pas de ɛvri mɔnin, de ɛn nɛt; una mɔs fred bad bad, we una ɔndastand di mɛsej.
Bikɔs di bed tu shɔt fɔ mek pɔsin ebul tret insɛf, ɛn di kɔba klos tu smɔl fɔ mek pɔsin ebul rap insɛf.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD go grap lɛk aw i bin du na Mawnt Pɛrazim, i go rej lɛk aw i bin rej na Mawnt Gibɛɔn; fɔ du wetin i kin du-wetin i kin du kin strenj! Ɛn fɔ wok in wok-in wok kin strenj!
So, na dat mek una nɔ fɔ tink se ɔlman ful, bambay, dat mek di tay we dɛn tay una, kan trɔŋ; bikɔs a dɔn yɛri dɛn tɔk traŋa wan se, nyakanyaka de kam na di wanol land we de kɔmɔt to PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti.
Una lisin, una lisin to mi vɔys, una lisin ɛn yɛri wetin a gɛt fɔ se.
Pɔsin we de dig grɔn fɔ plant jɛs de dig ɛn nɔ de tap? I jɛs de opin ɛn brok brok di dɔti ɛn nɔ de tap?
Wɛn i dɔn lɛbul di pantap grɔn, i nɔ de plant patmɛnji ɛn taym, ɛn plant rɛs ro bay ro, ɛn plant bali usay fɔ plant am, ɛn ɔda plant dɛn de rawnd dɛm fɔ fɛnch?
Na bikɔs i gɛt di kɔrɛkt tichin; na wetin in Gɔd de tich am.
Dɛn nɔ de tek trɛshin mashin plant dil, ɛn dɛn nɔ de rayd ɔmɔlanke pan kumin fɔ plant am; bɔt na matapɛnsul dɛn de tek bit dil, ɛn na tik dɛn de tek bit kumin.
Pɔsin go mas mas wit te i mas mas? Nɔ o, i nɔ de mas mas am sote go; wɛn i de rayd in ɔmɔlanke wil pan am wit in ɔs dɛn, i nɔ de mas mas am te i tɔn pawda.
Na to PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dis wan sɛf kɔmɔt; in advays dɛn wɔndaful ɛn in sɛns pas ɔl.
E Eriɛl, Eriɛl, di siti we Devid mek in kamp! Ad wan ia to in kɔmpin lɛ di fist dɛn ɔl kam ɛn go wan bay wan.
Stil a go mek trɔbul mit Eriɛl, ɛn na soso pini ɛn bita bita kray go de de; ɛn i go tan to mi lɛk ɔlta fayasay.
Ɛn a go kamp rawnd yu ɛn a go blɔk yu rawnd wit tawa dɛm ɛn a go bil wɔl rawnd we go blɔk yu.
Dɔn na frɔm ɔnda ɔnda di grɔn yu go tɔk, na frɔm bɔtɔm di dɔst yu wɔd dɛn go kɔmɔt; yu vɔys go kɔmɔt na grɔn lɛk gost vɔys, ɛn yu go tɔk kwayɛt wan kɔmɔt na di dɔst.
Bɔt una bɔku bɔku ɛnimi dɛn go tan lɛk smɔl dɔst, ɛn dɛn bɔku bɔku pipul we nɔ de luk biɛn fɔ du bad, go tan lɛk chaf chaf we briz de blo. Ɛn bifo Jako kɔt yay, wantɛm wantɛm,
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go go sɛn tɛnda ɛn atkwek ɛn bi-big nɔys pan una, wit da traŋa briz we de tɔn wan ples ɛn grap, ɛn ɛlɛba ɛlɛba briz ɛn di faya we nɔ de lɛf natin.
Ɛn di bɔku bɔku neshɔn dɛn we de fɛt Eriɛl, ɔl di wan dɛn we de fɛt in ɛn di ples we i abop, ɛn distrɛs, go tan lɛk drim, lɛk vishɔn na nɛt.

Lɛk we man we aŋri drim se i de it ɛn wek wit di aŋri stil de pan am, ɔ wɛn man we tɔsti drim se i de drink ɛn wek wik wan, wit tɔsti stil de pan am, na so dɛn bɔku bɔku neshɔn we de fɛt mawnt Zayɔn, go tan.
Drink bɔku rɔm ɛn mek unasɛf styupid, blɛn yusɛf ɛn mek unasɛf blɛn! Drɔnk we nɔto wayn una drink; staga we nɔto traŋa rɔm mek una staga.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn put, spirit we de mek pɔsin slip dip dip wan, pan una, ɛn i dɔn lɔk una yay, una di prɔfɛt dɛm, ɛn i dɔn kɔba una ed, una di lukgrɔn man dɛm.
Ɛn di vishɔn bɔt ɔl dis tan to una lɛk di wɔd dɛm na buk we lɔk. We pipul dɛn gi am to pɔsin we sabi rid se, “Rid dis,” i go se, “A nɔ go ebul bikɔs i lɔk”
Bɔt wɛn dɛn gi di pɔsin we nɔ sabi rid se, “Rid dis” in se “A nɔ sabi rid.”
Ɛn PAPA GƆD se: “Bikɔs dɛn pipul ya kam nia mi wit dɛn mɔt ɛn ɔna mi wit dɛn lip, we dɛn at nɔ de to mi, ɛn di fred we dɛn de fred mi, na mɔtalman lɔ we dɛn kram;
fɔseka dat, a go du tin wit dɛn pipul ya we dɛn go kɔle pan, wɔndaful tin we dɛn go kɔle pan; ɛn di sɛns we dɛn sɛnsman dɛn gɛt go dɔn, ɛn di no we dɛn man dɛn we de no wetin gɛt fɔ apin, go ayd.
Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan dɛm, dɛn wan dɛm we de ayd ayd dɛn plan pan PAPA GƆD, di wan dɛn we de du tin na dak, ɛn de se “udat de si wi? Udat no wi?”

Una de tɔn tin dɛn ɔpsay dɔŋ! Di man we de wok wit kle, dɛn go luk am lɛk kle; di tin we i mek go tɔk bɔt di wan we mek am se, “nɔto in mek mi”; ɔ di tin we dɛn mek go tɔk bɔt di wan we mek am se “I nɔ gɛt sɛns.”?
Nɔto smɔl tɛm lɛf fɔ Libanɔn go tɔn fil we de bia frut, ɛn dɛn go si di fil we de bia frut lɛk tik tik bush?
Da de de, dɛf yes man go yɛri wetin dɛn go rid na buk, ɛn insay dɛn pwɛl at ɛn daknɛs, blɛnyay man go si.
Dɛn wan we put dɛn yay dɔŋ go gɛt frɛsh gladi gladi insay PAPA GƆD ɛn di po wan dɛn pan mɔtalman, go gladi insay di Oli Wan na Izrɛl.
Bikɔs di wan we de du tin nɔ luk biɛn, go kam to natin ɛn di man we de provok, go tap, ɛn dɛn go kɔt ɔf ɔl dɛn wan we de wach fɔ du bad,
we na wan wɔd i go tɔk, i go put pɔsin pan trɔbul, ɛn sɛt trap fɔ di wan we de tɔk di rayt wɔd na kɔt, ɛn wit kes we i nɔ gɛt rayt, kin win di wan we gɛt rayt.
Na dat mek PAPA GƆD we ridim Ebram, tɔk bɔt Jekɔb in os, se: “Jekɔb nɔ go shem igen, pwɛl at nɔ go sho nain fes igen
Bikɔs wɛn i go si in pikin dɛm, we na mi mek, dɛn de wit am, dɛn go mek mi nem oli; dɛn go mek Jekɔb in Oli Wan oli, dɛn go fred Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd.
Ɛn dɛn wan we dɔn mek mistek, go kam fɔ ɔndastand, ɛn dɛn wan we de grɔmbul go gri du wetin dɛn se fɔ du.
PAPA GƆD se, “swɛ go fɔdɔm pan dɛn traŋayes pikin dɛm, we de du wetin dɛn plan, bɔt nɔto mi yon plan; we de mek wanwɔd, bɔt nɔto wit mi spirit, so dat dɛn go ad sin pan sin;
we bɔn rod de go dɔŋ Ijipt, we dɛn nɔ aks mi advays fɔ go tek kɔba ɔnda Fero in pawa ɛn fɛn shɛlta ɔnda Ijipt in shado!
Na dat mek Fero in protɛkshɔn go tɔn fɔ mek una shem, ɛn di shɛlta ɔnda Ijipt in shado, go mek una disgres.
Ɔlwe in bigman dɛn de Zoan ɛn in ambasedɔ dɛn rich Enis,
dɛn ɔl go shem fɔseka pipul we nɔ gɛt fɔ prɔfit dɛm, we nɔ de ɛp dɛn nɔ de prɔfit dɛm, bɔt shem ɛn disgres nɔmɔ.”

Wetin PAPA GƆD se bɔt di bist dɛn na di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap na di sawt. Dɛn pas insay land we trɔbul ɛn pen de, usay di uman layɔn ɛn man layɔn kɔmɔt, usay di vaypa ɛn snek we de flay, dɛn put dɛn jɛntri na dɔŋki dɛn bak ɛn dɛn dia dia tin dɛn na kamɛl ɔmbak, kɛr go gi pipul dɛn we nɔ gɛt fɔ prɔfit dɛm.
Bikɔs di ɛp we Ijipt de ɛp nɔ min natin, na dat mek a dɔn gi am nem, “Dragɔn We Nɔ Ebul Du Natin.”
So, go, rayt am na tablɛt bifo dɛn, ɛn rayt am na buk, so i go de fɔ bambay as witnɛs sote go.
Bikɔs dɛn na pipul we traŋayes, bɔypikin dɛn we de lay, bɔypikin dɛn we nɔ de yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd;
we de tɛl di man dɛn we de si vishɔn se “Una nɔ fɔ si;” ɛn tɛl di prɔfɛt dɛn se, “Una nɔ prɔfisay wetin rayt to wi; tɛl wi swit wɔd, prɔfisay laylay tin dɛm,
lɛf fɔ waka na Gɔd rod, go du ɔda tin, lɛ wi nɔ yɛri bɔt Izrɛl in Oli Wan, igen”
Fɔseka dat, na dis Di Oli Wan na Izrɛl se, “Bikɔs una nɔ rɛspɛkt dis wɔd, ɛn biliv fɔ ɔprɛs pipul ɛn biev ɛniaw, ɛn abop pan dɛn;
so dis sin go tan to yu lɛk krak pan ay wɔl, we dɔn swɛl ɛn rɛdi fɔ kolaps, we go fɔdɔm wantɛm wantɛm;
ɛn go brok go lɛk kle pɔt, we kin fɔdɔm brok pis pis somɔch dat, wan big pis sɛf nɔ de pan di broko wan dɛm, we yu go tek pul faya kɔmɔt na faya ples, ɔ tek wata na wata pɔt”
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD, we na di Oli Wan na Izrɛl se, “We una tɔn bak to mi ɛn sidɔm wit mi, a go sev una; we una sidɔm saful ɛn put una trɔst pan mi, una go gɛt trɛnk.” Bɔt una nɔ gri,
bɔt una se, “Nɔ o! Wi go rayd dɛn ɔs wit spid,” so una go tek spid go; ɛn, “wi go rayd dɛn ɔs we gɛt spid,” dat go mek di wan dɛn we de rɔnata una, rɔn wit spid.
Wan tawzin pipul go rɔnawe wɛn wan pɔsin trɛtin dɛn, wɛn fayv pɔsin trɛtin una, una ɔl go le, te te una lɛf lɛk flag polpantap mawnten, lɛk sayn na il.
Fɔseka dat, PAPA GƆD de wet fɔ sho una gres, fɔseka dat, i es insɛf ɔp fɔ sho una masi. Bikɔs PAPA GƆD na Gɔd we de jɔj rayt; ɛnibɔdi we wet fɔ am, go gɛt blɛsin.
Yɛs, pipul dɛn na Zayɔn we tap na Jerusɛlɛm; una nɔ go kray igen: I go mɔs sho una gres we i yɛri una vɔys we una de kray; wɛn i yɛri am, i go ansa una.
Ɛn ɔlwe PAPA GƆD bin dɔn gi una waala ɛn nambara, una Ticha nɔ go ayd insɛf igen, bɔt una yay go si una Ticha.
Ɛn una yes go yɛri vɔys bien una de tɔk se, “Na di rod dis, waka de,” we una tɔn na lɛfan ɔ raytan.
Datɛnde, una go dɔti una laylay gɔd dɛm we kɔba wit silva ɛn di wan dɛn we kɔba wit gold, na mi yay. Una go skata dɛm lɛk tin dɛm we nɔ klin na mi yay; una go tɛl dɛn se, “kɔmɔt bifo mi!”
Ɛn PAPA GƆD go sɛn ren fɔ di sid we una plant, ɛn rɛs we go gro na di grɔn, go bɔku ɛn i go fayn. Da de de, una kaw dɛn go it na big ples we plɛnti gras de;
ɛn di uman kaw ɛn di dɔŋki dɛn we de dig di grɔn, go it dray gras we gɛt sɔl, we dɛn dɔn fana wit shɔvul ɛn fɔk.
Ɛn pan ɔl dɛn ay ay mawnten ɛn ɔl dɛn ay il, watasay dɛn go de we wata de rɔn, di de we dɛn go kil bɔku pipul, we di tawa dɛn go fɔdɔm.

Pantap dat, di mun in layt go tan lɛk di san in layt, ɛn di san in layt go brayt sɛvin tɛm mɔ, lɛk sɛvin de layt, di de we PAPA GƆD go tay usay de at in pipul dɛn ɛn mɛn di wund dɛn we dɛn bin wund we i bin pɔnish dɛm.
PAPA GƆD in nem kɔmɔt fawe wit ebi ebi vɛksteshɔn insay tik smok we de go ɔp; in lip dɛn ful wit vɛksteshɔn ɛn in tɔŋ tan lɛk faya we de bɔn ɔltin;

di blo we i de blo tan lɛk riva we ova flo we de ay rich pɔsin nain nɛk; fɔ shifta di neshɔn dɛn wit di shifta we de distrɔy, ɛn fɔ put rop we dɛn de put na ɔs mɔt fɔ kɔntrol am, na di pipul dɛn jɔ dɛm, we go mek dɛn go astre.
Una go de siŋ lɛk we una kin siŋ di nɛt fɔ dɛn oli fist, ɛn una at go gladi lɛk we pɔsin de gladi we i yɛri di flut we dɛn kin kɔmɔt fɔ go na PAPA GƆD in mawnten we na Izrɛl in Rɔk.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD go mek pipul dɛn yɛri in kiŋ vɔys ɛn dɛn go si in an de kan dɔŋ fɔ blo wit bad bad vɛksteshɔn ɛn faya we de bɔn ɔltin, wit klawd we de sɛn tɛnda ɛn af af blɔk ays kan dɔŋ.
Di Asirian dɛn go wan day wit fred eɛn dɛn yɛri PAPA GƆD in vɔys, we i bit dɛn wit in tik.
Ɛn ɛni wap we PAPA GƆD wap dɛn wit in tik we i de tek pɔnish, go bi to di tamborin ɛn gita dɛn sawnd; I go fɛt dɛm wit in yon an we i dɔn es ɔp de sho.

Bikɔs ples fɔ bɔn pɔsin bin dɔn rɛdi lɔlɔntɛm. Yɛs, dɛn bin dɔn rɛdi am fɔ di kiŋ. Di say we dɛn mek fɔ bɔn pɔsin, bin dip ɛn wayd, wit faya ɛn wud abɔmpa. Wɛn PAPA GƆD blo wit in mɔt, i go tan lɛk brim ston riva, ɛn nain go layt di faya.

Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan dɛn wan we de go na Ijipt fɔ mek dɛn ɛp dɛm ɛn abop pan ɔs, we abop pan chariɔt bikɔs dɛn plɛnti ɛn pan di man dɛm we de rayd ɔs bikɔs dɛn gɛt trɛnk bad, bɔt dɛn nɔ de luk to Izrɛl in Oli Wan ɔ fɛnɔt to PAPA GƆD!
Pan ɔl we i gɛt sɛns ɛn i de briŋ big waala, wetin i dɔn se, i nɔ de chenj am, bɔt i go tinap agens dɛn wikɛd pipul dɛn, ɛn agens di wan dɛn we de ɛp pipul we de kɔmit sin.
Di Ijipshian dɛn na mɔtalman, dɛn nɔto Gɔd; ɛn dɛn ɔs na flɛsh ɛn blɔd, ɛn nɔto spirit. We PAPA GƆD tret in an, di wan we de ɛp go bɔkfut, ɛn di wan we dɛn ɛp go fɔdɔm, ɛn dɛn ɔl go day togɛda.

Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD tɛl mi, Lɛk we layɔn ɔ yɔŋ layɔn de grɔmbul we i kech tin fɔ it, ɛn we dɛn shɛpad dɛn fɔ gɛda go atak am, di ala we dɛn de ala nɔ de skyad am ɛn dɛn nɔys nɔ de shek am, Na so PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go kam dɔn fɔ fɛt na Mawnt Zayɔn ɛn nain il.
Lɛk bɔd we de flay flay rawnd, na so PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti I go protɛkt Jerusɛlɛm; I go protɛkt am ɛn mek nɔbɔdi nɔ tɔch am, I go sɔri fɔ am ɛn sev am.
Una dɛn Izɛrlayt dɛn, una put at bak to di wan we una bin dɔn tɔn una bak pan ɛn nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du wit am.
Bikɔs da de de, ɔlman go trowe in silva ɛn gold laylay gɔd, we una an dɔn tek sin mek fɔ una.
“Ɛn sɔd go kil Asirian, nɔto mɔtalman; na sɔd, nɔto mɔtalman go kil am; ɛn i go rɔnawe frɔm di sɔd, ɛn dɛn go mek in yɔŋman dɛn go wok bay fos.
In rɔk go rɔnawe go wit fred, ɛn in ofisa dɛn go rɔnawe lɛf dɛn post wit fred,” na so PAPA GƆD we in faya de na Zayɔn se, ɛn di wan we in big big ovin de na Jerusɛlɛm.
A de tɛl una, wan kiŋ go rul we go waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, ɛn bigman dɛn go rul wit jɔstis.
Ich ɛn ɛvri wan go bi lɛk ples fɔ ayd wɛn briz de blo, ples fɔ ayd we ebi briz de blo, lɛk watasay dɛn we de rɔn na dray ples, lɛk di shed we rɔk de mek usay di land dɔn taya.
Dɔn di wan dɛn we de si, dɛn yay nɔ go lɔk ɛn di wan dɛn we dɛn de yɛri, go lisin.
Di mago mago pɔsin in maynd go jɔj soba wan, ɛn di pɔsin we de stɔma go tɔk gud ɛn klia wan.
Dɛn nɔ go kɔl pɔsin we na fulman, aristo pɔsin, igen, ɛn dɛn nɔ go kɔl man we nɔ tret, ɔnarebul.

Bikɔs pɔsin we nɔ rɛspɛkt Gɔd de tɔk mɔnɔmɔnɔ, ɛn in maynd de plan fɔ kɔmit sin: fɔ de du tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk, fɔ de tɔk rɔŋ tin bɔt PAPA GƆD, fɔ lɛf pɔsin we aŋri de kech bad bad wan ɛn nɔ gi am it, ɛn fɔ gridi tɔsti pɔsin, wata.
Di man dɛn we nɔ de waka tret, dɛn trik dɛn kin wikɛd, i kin plan wikɛd plan dɛn fɔ lay pan poman fɔ pwɛl am, pan ɔlwe di poman kin gɛt rayt.
Bɔt di man we nobul kin plan gud tin dɛn ɛn na fɔ wetin rayt i kin tinap.
Una grap, una dɛn uman dɛn we de izi layf, una lisin mi una dɛn gyal pikin dɛn we nɔ tek natin mek natin, una yɛri wetin a de se.
Lilibit afta wan ia una go trimbul, una dɛn uman dɛn we nɔ tek natin mek natin; bikɔs di wayn avɛst go pwɛl ɛn frut avɛst nɔ go kam.
Una trimbul, una dɛn uman dɛn we de izi layf, una shek wit fred, una we nɔ tek natin mek natin; una pul klos de nekɛd, ɛn rap saklɔth rawnd una wes.
Una nak una chɛst dɛn fɔseka dɛn fayn fam dɛm, fɔseka di greps tik we bin de bia bɔku bɔku wan,
bikɔs mi pipul dɛn grɔn de gro chuk chuk ɛn wayl bush; yɛs, fɔ ɔl dɛn os we gladi gladi bin de, na di gladi gladi siti.
Bikɔs dɛn go lɛf kiŋ ɛmti, da siti we bin fulɔp go ɛmti; di il ɛn di wachman tawa go tɔn ples fɔ animal fɔ tap sote go, ples we wayl dɔŋki dɛn go gladi fɔ tap, ples we ship ɛn got go de it;
tete dɛn put PAPA GƆD in Spirit insay wi, ɛn di dray ɛn ɛmti ples tɔn fil we frut de bia bɔku bɔku wan, ɛn dɛn si di fil we frut de bia bɔku bɔku wan lɛkɛ fɔrɛst.
Datɛnde, jɔstis go tap na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples, ɛn fɔ waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, go de na di fil we de bia bɔku bɔku frut.
Ɛn fɔseka we pipul de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, kolat go de, ɛn fɔseka we pipul de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, kwayɛtnɛs ɛn trɔst de sote go.
Mi pipul dɛn go tap na ples we kolat de, ɛn ples dɛn we sef fɔ tap, ɛn kwayɛt fɔ rɛst.
Ɛn di fɔrɛst go pwɛl kpatakpata ɛn dɛn go nyakanyaka di siti.
Una go gladi, una we go plant nia ɔl dɛn watasay, we de lɛf di kaw ɛn di dɔŋki dɛn fɔ waka fri.

Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan yu, yu we de pwɛl, yu we dɛn nɔ pwɛl yet; yu rikishi pɔsin, we nɔbɔdi nɔ ple dakadeke yet! We yu dɔn tap fɔ pwɛl pipul, na datɛnde dɛn go pwɛl yu; ɛn na we yu dɔn blo fɔ dakadeke pipul, dɛn go ple yu dakadeke.
Duya PAPA GƆD, sɔri fɔ wi. Wi de wet fɔ yu. Bi wi sɔpɔt ɛvri mɔnin, bi wi salveshɔn we trɔbul mit wi.
Di nɔys we tan lɛk tɛnda, kin mek di pipul dɛn rɔnawe, we yu es yusɛf ɔp, di neshɔn dɛn kin skata;
ɛn dɛn de gɛda tif tin dɛn kɔmɔt wa lɛk we katapila de gɛda; lɛk aw lokɔs de jomp, na so pipul dɛn de jamp pan am.
PAPA GƆD de ay ɔp, bikɔs na ɔp i tap I go mek jɔstis ɛn fɔ waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, de na Jerusɛlɛm;
ɛn nain go bi di wanwɔd ɛn kolat una tɛm, salveshɔn abɔmpa, sɛns ɛn sabi go de; Na fɔ fred PAPA GƆD nain jɛntri.
A de tɛl yu, di wan dɛn we gɛt maynd de kray na do; di ambasedɔ dɛm fɔ pis, de kray bita bita wan.
Di men rod dɛn lɛf ɛmti, di wan dɛn we lɛk fɔ go patrol, dɔn tap fɔ go. Dɛn dɔn brok Kɔvinant dɛm, dɛn nɔ gɛt wan rɛspɛkt fɔ witnɛs igen, rɛspɛkt nɔ de igen fɔ mɔtalman.
Di land in at de blid; Libanɔn kɔnfyus ɛn de wida; Sharɔn dɔn tan lɛk di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap; ɛn Beshan ɛn Mawnt Kamɛl dɔn shek ɔl dɛn lif dɛn kɔmɔt.
PAPA GƆD se, “Na naw a go grap,” “na naw a go es misɛf ɔp; na naw dɛn go es mi ɔp.
Yu tek in chaf chaf, yu bɔn af af tik we kin lɛf we yu kɔt rɛs; di blo blo we yu de blo, na faya we go kil yu.
Ɛn di pipul dɛn go tan lɛk ston we dɛn bɔn tɔn wet lɛm, lɛk chuk chuk we dɛn kɔt bɔn na faya.”
Una we de fawe, una yɛri wetin a dɔn du; ɛn una we de nia, una gri se a pawaful.
Di sina dɛn na Zayɔn de fred; dɛn wan we no Gɔd, dɔn bigin trimbul; “Udat pan wi ebul tap wit faya we de kil pipul? Udat pan wi ebul tap wi faya we de bɔn sote go?”

Di pipul dɛn we de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD ɛn de tɔk tret tɔk, pipul we tek di prɔfit we pɔsin we de sɔprɛs pipul de mek, pipul we nɔ de gri tek brayb, pipul we de lɔk dɛn yes we pipul dɛn de plan fɔ shɛd blɔd ɛn de lɔk in yay lɛ i nɔ si bad tin.
I go tap na ay ples; di say we i go abop pan go bi say we na rɔk dɛn de rawnd; dɛn go gi am it, ɛn i go gɛt wata ɔltɛm.
Una yay go si di kiŋ aw i fayn fɔ luk; dɛn go si land we de sote go fa.
Una maynd go tink bɔt tin dɛn we mek una fred bad bad wan; “We di pɔsin we bin de kɔnt, we di pɔsin we bin de we di kɔpɔ we dɛn gɛda?” We di pɔsin we bin de kɔnt di tawa dɛm”
Una nɔ go si dɛn fityay pipul dɛn igen pipul dɛn we bin de tɔk laŋwej we una nɔ bin de ɔndastand, de stɔma na laŋwej we una nɔ de yɛri.

Luk Zayɔn, di siti we PAPA GƆD dɔn pik fɔ de sɛlibret wi fist dɛm! Una yay dɛm go si Jerusɛlɛm, kwayɛt say fɔ tap, tɛnt we nɔ de muf, we dɛn nɔ go ɛva rut in in pɛg dɛn na grɔn, ɛn dɛn nɔ go ebul kɔt nɔn pan in rop dɛm.
Bɔt na de PAPA GƆD go de fɔ wi as kiŋ ples we gɛt wayd riva dɛn ɛn watasay dɛm, usay nɔn big ship we slev dɛn de padul go go, nɔn mayti ship nɔ go ebul pas de.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD na wi jɔj, PAPA GƆD na wi rula. PAPA GƆD na wi kiŋ; i go sev wi.

Una rop we ol tiŋs tayt, dɔn slak; I nɔ ebul ol di mast traŋa wan nain ples igen, ɔ ebul opin di sel igen Datɛnde, dɛn go sheb di abɔmpa it ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn dɔn tek na wa; di pɔsin we nɔ ebul waka sɛf, go gɛt tin fɔ it.
Ɛn nɔbɔdi we tap de nɔ go se “A nɔ wɛl”; dɛn go fɔgiv di pipul dɛn we tap de, dɛn sin.
Una kam nia, una di neshɔn dɛn, fɔ yɛri, ɛn lisin, una di pipul dɛm! Lɛ di ath lisin, ɛn ɔl udat de de; di wɔ, ɛn ɔl wetin de kɔmɔt de.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD in at wam bad bad wan pan ɔl di neshɔn dɛn, ɛn vɛks pan ɔl di wan dɛn we tap de, I dɔn kɔndɛm dɛn, ɛn dɔn gi dɛn ɔp fɔ mek dɛn go kil dɛm.
Dɛn go trowe di wan dɛn we dɛn kil, ɛn dɛn dedebɔdi dɛn sɛnt go go ɔlsay; dɛn blɔd go flo na di mawnten dɛn.
Ɔltin we de ɔp go rɔtin ɛn di skay go fol lɛk skrol. Ɔltin we de ɔp go fɔdɔm, lɛk we lif de fɔdɔm kɔmɔt pan greps tik, lɛk we lif de fɔdɔm kɔmɔt pan fig tik.
Bikɔs mi sɔd dɔn drink te i bɛlful ɔp de; A de tɛl yu, i kan dɔŋ fɔ jɔj Idɔm, pan di pipul dɛn we a dɔn kɔndɛm.
PAPA GƆD gɛt wan sɔd; na soso lod de pan am, i fulɔp wit fat, wit ship pikin ɛn got blɔd, wit di kidni fat pan manship. Bikɔs PAPA GƆD gɛt sakrifays na Bozra, bɔku bɔku kil kil na Idɔm.
Uman bush kaw go day wit dɛm, ɛn yɔŋ man kaw wit di bigman kaw dɛn. Dɛn lan go gɛ soso blɔd, ɛn di fat go mek dɛn dɔti gud fɔ plant.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD gɛt di de we i de rivɛnj, di ia we i go pe dɛn bak fɔseka Zayɔn.
Ɛn di watasay dɛn na Idɔm go bɔn lɛk ta, ɛn in dɔti go bɔn lɛk brimston; in land go tɔn ples we jɛs de bɔn.
I go bɔn de ɛn nɛt ɛn nɔ go ɔt; in smok go de go ɔp sote go. I go de ɛmti wan frɔm jɛnareshɔn to jɛnareshɔn; nɔbɔdi nɔ go pas de sote go.
Na ak ɛn pɔkyupayn go gɛt am, na awl ɛn revɛn dɛn go tap de. I go put di layn ɔf kɔnfyushɔn oba am ɛn di teprul fɔ gbos gbos oba di nobul dɛn.
Dɛn go kɔl am, Nɔn Kindɔm Nɔ De De, ɛn ɔl in bigman dɛn nɔ go gɛt rɛspɛkt.
Chuk chuk go gro usay dɛn abop, na chuk chuk ɛn plant we gɛt chuk chuk go de na dɛn barik dɛm. Jakal dɛn go de pas pas de, ɛn ɔstrich dɛn go tap de.
Ɛn di wayl bist dɛn go mit de wit di Aina dɛn, di af man af bist we dɛn de kɔl satia, go kray to in kɔmpin; yɛs, na de da wich uman go kan dɔŋ, de luk fɔ ples fɔ blo.
Na de di awl go tap, ɛn le ɛn ach, ɛn gɛda ɔl in pikin dɛn to insɛf; na de dɛn bɔd we nem kayt go gɛda, ɔlman wit in patna.
Luk ɛn rid na PAPA GƆD in buk; nɔn pan dɛnwanya nɔ de we go lɔs; nɔn pan dɛn nɔ go de we nɔ go de wit in patna. Bikɔs na PAPA GƆD in mɔt di ɔda kɔmɔt, ɛn in Spirit dɔn gɛda dɛn.
I dɔn ib days fɔ dɛm, in an dɔn sheb am gi dɛm wit di layn; i go bi dɛn yon sote go, dɛn go de de frɔm jɛnareshɔn to jɛnareshɔn.
Di ɛmti ples ɛn dray ples, go gladi, di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap go gladi ɛn plant dɛn go gro de; lɛk krɔkɔs flawa
na so in flawa dɛn go bɔs abɔmpa, ɛn go gladi wit jɔy at ɛn de siŋ. Dɛn go gi am Libanɔn in glori, ɛn di kiŋ pawa dɛn na Kamɛl Ɛn Sherɔn. Dɛn go si PAPA GƆD in glori, ɛn wi Gɔd in majɛsti.
Una mek dɛn wik an dɛn trɔŋ, ɛn stɛdi dɛn fut dɛn we de trimbul.
Tɛl dɛn wan we de fred se, “Una mek lɛk man, una nɔ fred! A de tɛl una, una Gɔd go kam fɔ rivɛnj, lɛk aw Gɔd kin pe pipul dɛn bak. I go kam sev una.”
Na datɛnde blɛnyay man in yay go opin, ɛn dɛfyɛs man in yes go opin;
dɔn kripul pɔsin go jomp lɛk dia ɛn mumu go opin in mɔt siŋ wit gladi. Bikɔs wata go bɔs na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples we natin nɔ de, ɛn watasay dɛm go de na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap;
di sansan we de bɔn pipul go tɔn usay wata de gɛda, ɛn di grɔn we tɔsti go tɔn usay wata de bɔs ɔnda grɔn; da say we dɛn jakal bin de pas pas go tɔn swamp, di gras go tɔn dɛn wata say gras dɛn.
Ɛn men rod go de de, ɛn dɛn go kɔl am di Oli Rod; pɔsin we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD in yay nɔ go pas de ɛn fulman nɔ go mistek go insay de.
Nɔn Layɔn nɔ go de de ɛn nɔn animal we kin aŋri bad bad wan, nɔ go go ɔp de; yu nɔ go si dɛn de, na di wan dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn ridim nɔmɔ go waka de.
Ɛn di wan dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn pe fɔ, go kam bak, ɛn dɛn go kam Zayɔn de siŋ; ɛn jɔy we go de sote go, go de na dɛn layf; dɛn go gɛt jɔy ɛn gladi gladi, ɛn sɔri ɛn pini, go rɔnawe.
Insay di ia we mek kiŋ Ɛzikaya fotin ia we i bi kiŋ, Sɛnakarib we na kiŋ na Asiria atak ɔl di siti dɛn we gɛt wɔl na Juda ɛn kapchɔ dɛn.

Ɛn di kiŋ na Asiria sɛn di Rabshakɛ kɔmɔt Lakish, go to Kiŋ Ɛzikaya na Jerusɛlɛm, wit big big ami. Ɛn i tinap nia di gɔta we dɛn dig na di men rod, fɔ tek wata na di say we dɛn de gɛda wata ɔpsay, fɔ go na Fula Fil.
Nain Iliakim, we Ilkaya in bɔypikin, we na di men ɔfisa na di kiŋ in os, wit Shɛbna we na di sɛktri ɛn Joa we na Esaf we de kip rɛkɔd in bɔypikin, kɔmɔt go mit am.
Ɛn di Rabshakɛ tɛl dɛn se, “Tɛl Ɛzikaya se, ‘Na dis di gret kiŋ, we na di kiŋ na Asiria se: Na wetin yu abop pan we yu gɛt bad bad kɔnfidɛns so?
Yu tink se ɛmti tɔk na tatiks ɛn pawa fɔ fɛt wa? Na udat yu abop pan naw we yu dɔn tɔn yu bak pan mi.
A de tɛl yu, na Ijipt yu de abop pan, da dray tik we dɛn se na staf, we go chuk ɛnibɔdi we liŋ pan am. Na so Fero we na kiŋ na Ijipt tan to ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we abop pan am.
Bɔt if una tɛl mi se, “Na PAPA GƆD we wi na Gɔd, wi abop pan,” nɔto di wan we in ay ples dɛn ɛn ɔlta dɛn, Ɛzikaya dɔn pul kɔmɔt, ɛn de tɛl Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm se “Na dis ɔlta una fɔ wɔship?”
Mek bagin wit mi masta we na kiŋ na Asiria: A go gi una tu tawzin ɔs, if una ebul fɛn pipul dɛn fɔ rayda dɛm.
Una ɔl nɔ du sɛf fɔ chalenj wangren ɔfisa na Asiria bikɔs, na Ijipt una abop pan fɔ gi una karej ɛn di man dɛn we de rayd ɔs.
Dɔn igen una min se a go jɛs kam nɔmɔ fɔ kam pwɛl ya if nɔto PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se fɔ du dat? Na PAPA GƆD insɛf sɛf tɛl mi se lɛ a mach kam insay dis siti ɛn pwɛl am.”

Na de Ilayakim, Shɛbna ɛn Joa tɛl di Rabshakɛ se, “duya, tɔk to wi insay Arameik bikɔs wi de ɔndastand da laŋwej de; nɔ tɔk to wi insay Juda dɛn laŋwej bikɔs di pipul dɛn we tap oba di wɔl de yɛri wetin una de se.

Bɔt di Rabshakɛ aks dɛn se if dɛn fil se na to dɛn ɛn dɛn masta nɔmɔ di kiŋ sɛn am wit da mɛsej de. I se if dɛn nɔ fil se di mɛsej na fɔ dɛn ɔl wit di ɔda man dɛm we sidɔm pantap di wɔl we na dɛn ɔl go gɛt fɔ it dɛn pupu ɛn drink dɛn pis.
Na de di Rabshakɛ tinap ɛn tɔk lawd wan na Ibru se, “Una lisin to di gret kiŋ, di kiŋ na Asiria!
“Dis na di kiŋ na Asiria de tɔk: Una nɔ mek Ɛzikaya ful una. I nɔ go ebul pul una na mi an.
Una nɔ lɛ Ɛzikaya mek una chenj una maynd fɔ trɔs pan PAPA GƆD we i de tɛl una se PAPA GƆD go mɔs pul una na di kiŋ in an, i nɔ go mek di kiŋ na Asiria kapchɔ di siti.
Una nɔ lisin to Ɛzikaya o! Mi di kiŋ na Asiria de tɛl una naw se mek una mek pis mit mi ɛn jɔyn mi. If una du dat ɔlman go it di frut we in vayn tik ɛn fig tik de bia ɛn drink wata nain yon wɛl,

te a go kam kam pul una kɔmɔt de kɛr una na land we tan lɛk una yon, land we gɛt bɔku it, wayn, bred, greps gadin. “Una nɔ lisin to Ɛzikaya bikɔs na ful i de mek una we i de tɛl una se PAPA GƆD go sev una.
Ɛni kɔntri de na wɔl we in gɔd dɔn sev da kɔntri de na di kiŋ na Asiria in an?
We di gɔd dɛn we na dɛn Emat ɛn Apad de wɔship? We di gɔd dɛn we Sɛfavaim de wɔship? Dɛn bin ebul pul Sameria kɔmɔt na mi an?
Uswan pan ɔl dɛn gɔd dɛn na dɛn kɔntri dɛn de dɔn ebul fɔ pul in kɔntri na mi an? Wetin mek una tink se PAPA GƆD go ebul pul Jerusɛlɛm kɔmɔt na mi an?”
Kiŋ Ɛzikaya bin dɔn tɛl di pipul dɛn se lɛ dɛn nɔ ansa wan wɔd, so dɛnsɛf nɔ se fiŋ.

Ilkaya in bɔypikin we Iliakim, we na di administretɔ na di kiŋ in os, wit Shɛbna we na sɛktri ɛn Joa we na Esaf we de rayt in bɔypikin go to Kiŋ Ɛzikaya wit chɛr-chɛr klos ɛn tɛl am ɔl wetin di Rabshakɛ na Asiria se.
Wɛn Kiŋ Ɛzikaya yɛri wetin di man dɛn se, i chɛr in klos ɛn wɛr saklɔth, dɔn i go insay PAPA GƆD in os.
I mek Ilayakim we na di kiŋ in administretɔ wit Shɛbna we na sɛktri ɛn di bigman dɛn pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin wɛr saklɔth, ɛn sɛn dɛn to Prɔfɛt Ayzaya we na Emɔz in bɔypikin.
Dɛn tɛl Ayzaya se Ɛzikaya se da de de na de wit waala, shem ɛn disgres, we tan lɛk we uman wan bɔn, dɔn i nɔ ebul fɔ bɔn.

Dɛn se sɔntɛm, PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd dɔn yɛri ɔl di wɔd we di kiŋ na Asiria in Rabshakɛ dɔn wes pan PAPA GƆD ɛn provok am, ɛn so PAPA GƆD go dil wit am fɔ dat, dɔn lɛ i pre fɔ di wan dɛn we lɛf naw pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
Wɛn Kiŋ Ɛzikaya in ɔfisa dɛn rich to Ayzaya,
i tɛl dɛn se lɛ dɛn tɛl di kiŋ se PAPA GƆD se lɛ i nɔ fred, lɛ i nɔ yɛk sɛf, pan ɔl we di kiŋ na Asiria in bɔbɔ dɔn tɔk bad bɔt am.
I se PAPA GƆD se in go put wan kianaba spirit pan am we go mek di wantɛm nyuz we i go yɛri, na dat go mek i rɔn go bak nain kɔntri we na de dɛn de go kil am.
Wɛn di Rabshakɛ yɛri se di kiŋ na Asiria dɔn kɔmɔt na Lakish ɛn de fɛt Libna, i go mit am de.
Wɔd rich Sɛnakarib se Kiŋ Tiraka, da kiŋ na Itiopia dɔn mach in ami fɔ go fɛt am. Wɛn i yɛri dis kayn mɛsej, i sɛn go bak to Kiŋ Ɛzikaya na Juda se,
lɛ i nɔ abop pan di gɔd we de mek am ful se Jerusɛlɛm nɔ go fɔdɔm na di kiŋ na Asiria in trap bikɔs in no se
Ɛzikaya fɔ dɔn yɛri bɔt ɔl wetin dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Asiria dɔn de du to ɔl dɛn ɔda kɔntri dɛn, we dɛn dɔn nyamanyama dɛn kpatakpata; ɛn if in fil se in go ebul kɔmɔt nain an.
I se if di gɔd dɛn we dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn de sav bin ebul fɔ pul di kɔntri dɛn nain fɔstɛm-papa dɛn an dat na di gɔd dɛn na Gozan, Eran, Rizɛf ɛn dɛn pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt Idɛn we bin de na Tɛlasa.
I se usay di kiŋ dɛn fɔ Emat, Apad, Sɛfavaim, Ina ɛn Ayva dɛn bin de.
We Ɛzikaya gɛt di kiŋ in lɛta, i rid am dɔn i kɛr am go na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn le am bifo PAPA GƆD.
Dɔn i pre to PAPA GƆD se,
“E PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl in GƆD, yu de ay wan midul dɛn Chɛryubim. Na yu wangren na GƆD pantap ɔl dɛn kindɔm na wɔl, na yu mek ɛvin ɛn ath.
PAPA GƆD duya opin yu yes ɛn lisin; PAPA GƆD duya, opin yu yay lɛ yu si; luk wetin Sɛnakarib dɔn rayt we i kɔs yu, yu we na PAPA GƆD we gɛt layf.
PAPA GƆD, na tru se di Asirian dɛn dɔn dɔnawe kpatakpata wit dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn,
dɛn dɔn trowe dɛn gɔd dɛn na faya ɛn bɔn dɛn, bɔt sɛf, nɔto gɔd dɛn, na ɛmti tik ɛn ston we na mɔtalman an dɛn tek mek dɛn.
Duya PAPA GƆD, yu na wi GƆD, pul wi nain an fɔ lɛ ɔl dɛn kindɔm na wɔl go no se na yu wangren nɔmɔ PAPA GƆD na GƆD.”
Emɔz in bɔypikin we na Ayzaya, sɛn mɛsej to Ɛzikaya se, “Dis na wetin PAPA GƆD, we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se. I se in dɔn yɛri yu prea kɔnsanin Kiŋ Sɛnakarib na Asiria,
na dis PAPA GƆD bin se bɔt am: “ ‘I nɔ rɛspɛkt yu, i de laf yu- di vajin gyal na Zayɔn; i de de shumu pan yu- we na Jerusɛlɛm in gyal pikin.
Na udat yu tink se yu de kɔs ɛn fityay? Na udat yu tink se yu de tɔk bad bɔt ɛn de kak pan? Na pan mi we na Izrɛl dɛn GƆD?

Yu sɛn mɛsenja dɛn fɔ fityay mi, dɔn yu de blɔf se yu dɔn yuz yu karej dɛn fɔ go ɔp ɔp dɛn ay ay mawnten dɛn insay insay Libanɔn; yu dɔn kɔt ɔl dɛn laŋa timba tik dɛn, yu dɔn wutuwutu dɛn fɔrɛst ɛn kɔt dɛn bɛst payn tik dɛn ɛn se nɔn say nɔ de we yu nɔ tɔch.
Yu de se yu dɔn dig wɛl na ɔda kɔntri dɛn, ɛn drink di wata we de de, yu ami dɔn mas mas di wata dɛn na Ijipt ɛn mek ɔl di wata de dray.”
Yu nɔ bin dɔn yɛri yet se na lɔntɛm a dɔn plan dat? A dɔn plan am lɔlɔntɛm se na so i fɔ bi, fɔ lɛ yu nyakanyaka di kɔntri to grabul ɛn na so i bi.
Di pipul dɛn nɔ ebul shek; dɛn bin jɛs damu ɛn mumu. Dɛn bin tan lɛk gras we de gro na bush, ɔ dɛn gras we de gro pantap ruf, we san kin bɔn am bifo i de bigin fɔ gro.
“Natin nɔ de we a nɔ no bɔt yu, aw yu de go ɛn kam, a no se yu de agens mi.
Fɔseka we yu dɔn tɔn pan mi, ɛn de kak pantap dat, a go put uk na yu nos ɛn rop na yu mɔt lɛkɛ aw dɛn kin du ɔs, ɛn mek yu go bak usay yu kɔmɔt.”

Na de Ayzaya tɛl Kiŋ Ɛzikaya se i gɛt fɔ si wan sayn. Di sayn na, da ia de, i go it wetin bɔs na grɔn fɔ insɛf. Di nɛks ia, na wetin lɛf pan di tin dɛn we bin bɔs i go it; dɔn di ɔda ia i go plant ɛn avɛst kɔn, vayn ɛn grep we i go it.
I se di pipul dɛn we lɛf na Juda go frɛsh lɛkɛ nyu plant we i rut de go dɔŋ ɛn bia frut.
I se PAPA GƆD go mek di pipul dɛn we sev ɛn di wan dɛn we lɛf de na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Mawnt Zayɔn. Na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in pawa go du am.
Ayzaya se PAPA GƆD se, as fɔ di Kiŋ na Asiria, i nɔ go mas in fut sɛf na di siti ɔ shut wan aro de. I se nɔn sojaman sɛf we gɛt big shild nɔ go go nia de ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go le ambush rawnd am.
PAPA GƆD se di kiŋ na Asiria go yuz di sem rod we i tek kam go bak, ɛn i nɔ go nia di siti. I se wetin in dɔn tɔk go bi.
PAPA GƆD se fɔ in yon sek ɛn fɔseka in savant Devid, in go fɛt fɔ di siti ɛn protɛkt am.
Da sem nɛt de, PAPA GƆD in enjɛl go na di Asirian dɛn kamp ɛn kil wan ɔndrɛd ɛn eti-fayv tawzin man dɛm. Wɛn pipul dɛn wek na mɔnin, na soso dedebɔdi dɛn si.
So Kiŋ Sɛnakarib na Asiria tɔn bak go na Ninivɛ ɛn tap de.

Wande we i de nain gɔd we nem Nisrɔk in os de wɔship am, in bɔypikin dɛn, dat na Edramɛlɛk ɛn Sharɛza go mit am de kil am wit sɔd, dɔn dɛn rɔnawe go na Ararat. In ɔda bɔypikin we nem Izaadɔn tek in ples ɛn bi kiŋ.
Da tɛm de Kiŋ Ɛzikaya sik bad bad wan ɛn wan day. Prɔfɛt Ayzaya we na Emɔz in bɔypikin go mit am ɛn tɛl am se PAPA GƆD se lɛ i mek shɔ se i du ɔl wetin i fɔ du wantɛm bikɔs i nɔ go wɛl, i go day.
Ɛzikaya tɔn in fes to di wɔl ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD se,
“E PAPA GƆD, duya mɛmba ɔl wetin a dɔn du ɛn aw a dɔn waka tret wit yu wit ɔl mi at ɛn na wetin rayt bifo yu yay a bin de du.” Ɛzikaya kray bita bita wan.
Bifo Ayzaya de lɛf di kiŋ in os, PAPA GƆD kɔl am bak ɛn tɔk to am se,
“Go bak go tɛl Ɛzikaya we de lid mi pipul dɛn se, mi PAPA GƆD we nain Devid yu papa in Gɔd se, a dɔn yɛri in prea ɛn si di kray we i kray. A go gi am fiftin ia mɔ fɔ liv.
A go sev in ɛn dis siti kɔmɔt na di kiŋ na Asiria in an. A go protɛkt di siti.”
“Dis na di sayn we PAPA GƆD de gi yu, fɔ sho yu se PAPA GƆD go du dis tin we i dɔn prɔmis.
A go mek di shado we di san kin mek na di rawnd tin we Eaz bil fɔ no tɛm, tɔn bak tɛn stɛp we i de go dɔŋ.” So di san tɔn bak di tɛn stɛp, we i bin dɔn go dɔŋ fɔs.
Dis na wetin Ɛzikaya, kiŋ na Juda bin rayt afta i bin dɔn wɛl we i bin sik:
A bin tɔk se, we a yɔŋ, A jɔs gɛt f day; dɛn put mi fɔ go usay dayman dɛn de fɔ di rɛst ɔf mi layf.
A se, a nɔ go si PAPA GƆD na dis wɔl we layf de; A nɔ go si mɔtalman igen pan di pipul dɛn we de na di wɔl.
Dɛn dɔn rut mi os kɔmɔt, ɛn pul am kɔmɔt na mi an lɛkɛ shɛpad tɛnt; a dɔn rol mi layf lɛk we pɔsin we de mek klos kin rol am; I pul mi kɔmɔt na di mashin; frɔm mɔnin te nɛt, yu de kil mi smɔl smɔl;
A de ala lɛ dɛn ɛp mi, te do klin; i brok ɔl mi bon dɛn lɛk we layɔn de brok pɔsin bon; frɔm mɔnin to nɛt, yu de kil mi smɔl smɔl.
A de ala lɛk da bɔd we dɛn kɔl swalo or lɛk kaw enjɛl, A de pini lɛk dɔv. A dɔn luk ɔp te mi yay dɛn dɔn taya. E PAPA GƆD, dɛn dɔn sɔprɛs mi, bi mi sikyɔriti!
Bɔt wetin a go se? Bɔkɔs i dɔn tɔk to mi, ɛn nainsɛf dɔn du am. A nɔ de gɛt wan slip, bikɔs mi at nɔ gud.
PAPA GƆD, na dɛn tin ya de na mɔtalman layf ɛn na ɔl dɛn tin ya mek mi spirit gɛt layf. Du ya gi mi wɛlbɔdi bak ɛn mek a liv!
Yɛs, na bin fɔ mi yon bɛtɛ na dat mek mi at pwɛl bad bad wan; Bɔt yu dɔn briŋ mi layf kam bak mek i nɔ go na ɛl, Bikɔs yu dɔn put mi sin dɛn ɔl biɛn mi.
Bikɔs dayman wɔl nɔ go ebul tɛl yu tɛnki, day nɔ go ebul prez yu; dɛn wan we de go ɛl, nɔ abop pan di waka tret we yu de waka tret.
Udat gɛt layf, udat gɛ layf, na im de tɛl yu tɛnki, lɛk aw a de du so tide; di papa de mek di pikin dɛn no se yu de waka tret.
PAPA GƆD go sev mi ɛn wi go siŋ wit instrumɛnt lɛkɛ gita tete wi day, na PAPA GƆD in os.
Naw, Ayzaya bin dɔn tɛl dɛn se, “lɛ dɛn tek dray kɔrant dɛm put an na di bwɛl, lɛ i go wɛl.”
Ɛzikaya bin aks bak se, “Wetin na di sayn se a go go ɔp na PAPA GƆD in os?”
Da tɛn de Mɛrodak Baladan, we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn sɛf na Baladan in bɔypikin, bin sɛn ambasedɔ dɛn wit lɛta ɛn prɛzɛnt to Ɛzikaya, bikɔs i yɛri se i bin sik, bɔt i dɔn wɛl.

Ɛzikaya tɛl dɛn kabɔ; ɛn sho dɛn usay i kip ɔl in jɛntri, di silva, di gold, di spays dɛm, di dia dia ɔyl, ɔl in wɛpɔn dɛm ɛn ɔl wetin i kip nain sto dɛm. Natin nɔ bin de nain os ɔ in kindɔm we Ɛzikaya nɔ sho dɛm.
Nain Ayzaya we na prɔfɛt kam to Kiŋ Ɛzikaya ɛn aks am se, “Wetin dɛn man dɛn ya want? Ɛn usay dɛn kɔmɔt kam to yu?” Ɛzikaya se “Dɛn kɔmɔt na wan fawe kɔntri kam to mi. Dɛn kɔmɔt Babilɔn.”
Nain i aks se, “Wetin ɛn wetin dɛn si insay yu os? “Ɛzikaya ansa se, “Dɛn dɔn si ɔl wetin de na mi os; natin nɔ de na mi sto dɛm we a nɔ sho dɛm.”
Nain Ayzaya tɛl Ɛzikaya se, “Yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se:
A de tɛl yu, di tɛm de kam we dɛn go kɛr ɔl wetin de na yu os, ɛn ɔl wetin yu fɔstɛmpapa dɛm dɔn gɛda te to dis de yaso, go Babilɔn; natin nɔ go lɛf, na so PAPA GƆD se.
Ɛn dɛn go kɛr sɔm pan yu bɔypikin dɛn we yu bɔn, go; ɛn dɛn go tɔn dɛn to okobo na di kiŋ na Babilɔn in pales.”
Naim Ɛzikaya tɛl Ayzaya se, “PAPA GƆD in wɔd we yu dɔn tɔk, gud.” Bikɔs in bin tink se, “Wanwɔd ɛn sikyɔriti go de mi yon tɛm.”
Una koks, una koks mi pipul dɛn na so una Gɔd se.
Tɔk saful saful to Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn tɛl am se in wa dɔn dɔn, dɛn dɔn padin in sin, se i dɔn gɛt dɔbul pɔnishmɛnt na PAPA GƆD in an fɔ ɔl in sin dɛm.
Wan vɔys de ala se: “Mek we fɔ PAPA GƆD na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples we natin nɔ de, Mek wan men rod tret wan fɔ wi Gɔd na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Ɔl dɛn vali go fulɔp; ɛn ɔl dɛn mawnten ɛn dɛn il dɛn go flat; di grɔn we nɔ lɛbul, go lɛbul, ɛn di rɔf ples dɛm go mek fayn.
Ɛn dɛn go mek ɔlman no bɔt PAPA GƆD in glori, ɛn ɔlman na wɔl go si am togɛda, bikɔs na PAPA GƆD in mɔt dɔn tɔk am.”
Wan vɔys de se “Ala!” Nain a se “wetin a go ala se?” Ɔl mɔtalman na gras, ɛn ɔl in fayn we i fayn, na lɛk flawa na fil.
Di gras de wida, di flawa de fed, wɛn PAPA GƆD blo pan am; fɔ tru, di pipul dɛn na gras.
Di gras de wida, ɛn di flawa de fed; bɔt PAPA GƆD in wɔd go tinap sote go.
Go ɔp na wan ay mawnten, Yu Zayɔn mɛsenja we de briŋ gud nyuz; ala wit trɛnk; Yu Jerusɛlɛm mɛsenja we de briŋ gud nyuz, ala, nɔ fred; tɛl di siti dɛn na Juda se, “Una luk una Gɔd!”
Una luk, Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd de kam wit pawa, ɛn nain an de rul fɔ am; luk, di pe we i de pe pɔsin fɔ di gud we i du, de wit am, ɛn di kɔmpɛnset we i de kɔmpɛnset, de wit am.
I go fid in ship dɛm lɛk shɛpad, i go gɛda di ship pikin dɛn nain an, I go bɔn dɛm nain buzɔm, ɛn i go tek tɛm lid di kombra dɛn.
Udat dɔn mɛnshɔ di si dɛn nain an wande, ɛn mek di skay de fa frɔm grɔn, gɛda ɔl di dɔti na wɔl wan say ɛn we di mawnten dɛn na skel, ɛn di il dɛn na balans?
Udat dɔn dayrɛkt PAPA GƆD in spirit wande, ɔ dɔn bi in advaysa ɛn dɔn tɛl am wetin fɔ du?
Udat I ɛva aks we sho am sɔntin, ɛn udat sho am aw fɔ trit tu pipul di sem, ɔ tich am mek i no tin, ɛn sho am aw fɔ ɔndastand sɔntin?
Biliv mi, di neshɔn dɛn na lɛk wan drɔp wata na bokit to am, ɛn I si dɛn lɛk dɔst na skel; Luk, i es ɔp di ayland dɛm lɛk fayn dɔst.
Libanɔn nɔ go du fɔ yuz as fuɛl; di animal dɛnsɛf nɔ go du fɔ sakrifays we dɛn de bɔn na faya.
Ɔl di neshɔn dɛm na wɔl na natin bifo am, I si dɛn lɛk wetin wɔs pas natin ɛn ɛmti kpatakpata.
Udat naw yu go se tan lɛk PAPA GƆD, ɔ wetin yu go kɔmpia am wit?
Lay lay gɔd! Na wokman mek am, ɛn goldsmit kɔba am wit gold, ɛn mek silva chen dɛn fɔ am.
Di wan we po, de pik wud we nɔ de rɔtin fɔ gi ɔfrin; i fɛn wan masta sabi wokman fɔ mek imej we nɔ go fɔdɔm.
Yu nɔ no yet? Yu nɔ dɔn yɛri? Dɛn nɔ bin dɔn tɛl yu frɔm di biginin? Yu nɔ bin dɔn ɔndastand frɔm we di wɔl bigin?
Nain sidɔm pantap di wɔl, ɛn di wan dɛn we de na di wɔl tan lɛk grasɔpa; in we opin di skay lɛk winda kɔtin, ɛn prɛd dɛn lɛk tɛnt fɔ tap;
di wan we de tɔn bigman dɛn to natin, ɛn mek di rula dɛn na di wɔl tɔn nɔbɔdi.
Dɛn nɔ plant dɛn gud yet sɛf, dɛn nɔ ib dɛn sid dɔn yet sɛf, dɛn nɔ trɔŋ na grɔn yet sɛf, we i blo pan dɛn, ɛn dɛn wida, ɛn di ebi ebi briz kɛr dɛn go lɛk dray gras.
Di Oli wan se, Udat una go kɔmpia mi wit, we una go se a fiba?
Es yu yay ɔp ɛn si: udat mek dɛn wan ya? In we de pul di san mun ɛn sta dɛn, ɛn kɔnt dɛn, de kɔl dɛn ɔl bay nem; bikɔs i gɛt trɛnk bad bad wan, ɛn gɛt pawa bad bad wan nɔn pan dɛn nɔ lɔs.
Wetin mek yu de se, E Jekɔb, ɛn tɔk se E Izrɛl, “Mi we ayd pan PAPA GƆD, ɛn mi Gɔd nɔ de gi mi mi rayt.”?
Yu nɔ no yet? Yu nɔ dɔn yɛri? PAPA GƆD na di Gɔd we de sote go, na im mek di wanol wɔl. I nɔ de wik, i nɔ de taya pɔsin nɔ de ebul fɛnɔt fɔ no aw I de tink.
I de gi di wan we wik, pawa, ɛn di wan we nɔ gɛt trɛnk, i de gi am mɔ trɛnk.
Ivin yut dɛn, go wik ɛn taya, ɛn yɔŋman dɛn go fɔdɔm wit bad bad taya;
bɔt di wan dɛn we biliv PAPA GƆD go gɛt frɛsh trɛnk, dɛn go flay go ɔp wit fɛda lɛk igul, dɛn go rɔn ɛn dɛn nɔ go taya; dɛn go waka ɛn dɛn nɔ go fil wik.
Una lisin mi kwayɛt wan, una di kɔntri dɛn we de nia di si, lɛ di neshɔn dɛn gɛda dɛnsɛf; lɛ dɛn kam nia, dɔn lɛ dɛn tɔk; lɛ wi kam togɛda fɔ jɔjmɛnt.

Udat shek pɔsin kɔmɔt na di ist we viktri de mit am ɛni mas we i mas? I mek neshɔn dɛn sɔrɛnda bifo am so dat i de sɔprɛs kiŋ dɛn; i de mek dɛn lɛk dɔst wit in sɔd, ɛn lɛk chaf we briz de blo go, wit in bo ɛn aro.
I rɔnata dɛn ɛn pas sef wan, na rod dɛn we in fut nɔ waka wande.
Na udat dɔn wok ɛn du dis kayn tin, de kɔl di jɛnareshɔn dɛn nem frɔm di biginin? Na mi, PAPA GƆD we na di fɔs, ɛn di las; na mi na Im.
Dɛn kɔntri we de nia wata dɔn si ɛn de fred, usay di wɔl tap, de trimbul; dɛn dɔn gɛda kam nia.
Ɔlman de ɛp in neba, ɛn de tɛl in brɔda se, “bɔk ɔp!”

Di man we de wok wit in an de ɛnkɔrej di goldsmit, ɛn di wande de smut wit ama, de ɛnkɔrej di wan we de nak di anvil, ɛn de tɔk bɔt di soda we I soda se, “I sabi wok;” ɛn dɛn nel am so dat dɛn nɔ go ebul muf am.
Bɔt yu Izrɛl, we na mi wokman, Jekɔb we a dɔn pik, dɛn na Ebram we na mi padi, in pikin dɛm;
Yu we a tek kɔmɔt usay di wɔl tap, ɛn kɔl yu kɔmɔt na di fa fa kɔna dɛn, de tɛl yu se, “Yu na mi wokman, a dɔn pik yu ɛn nɔ trowe yu”;
Nɔ fred, bikɔs a de wit yu, nɔ pwɛl at, bikɔs mi na yu Gɔd; a go gi yu trɛnk, a go ɛp yu, a go ol yu ɔp wit mi raytan we de win ɔltɛm.
A de tɛl yu, ɔl dɛn wan we vɛks pan yu bad bad wan go shem ɛn go sɔprayz; Dɛn wan we de fɛt yu go tan lɛk natin ɛn day.
Yu go luk fɔ di wan dɛn we de fɛt yu, bɔt yu nɔ go si dɛm; dɛn wan we mek wa pan yu go tan lɛk natin.
Bikɔs, mi PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd, ol yu raytan; na mi de tɛl yu se, “Nɔ fred, A go ɛp yu.”
Nɔ fred, yu Jekɔb we na wɔrɔm, una di man dɛn na Izrɛl! PAPA GƆD se, a go ɛp una; di wan we de sev una na di Oli Wan na Izrɛl.
Luk, a go mek una di mashin fɔ bit kanda kɔmɔt pan rɛs, we nyu ɛn shap, ɛn gɛt tit; Una go wok pan di mawnten dɛn ɛn nyamanyama dɛn, ɛn una go mek di il dɛn tan lɛk chaf chaf;
una go fana dɛm, ɛn briz go blo dɛn go, ɛn ebi ebi tinada go skata dɛn. Ɛn yu go gladi insay PAPA GƆD; nainsay di Oli Wan na Izrɛl, una go glori.
Wɛn po pipul ɛn dɛn wan we nɔ gɛt de fɛn wata, ɛn wata nɔ de, ɛn dɛn tɔŋ dɔn dray wit tɔsti, Mi we na PAPA GƆD go ansa dɛm, Mi we na di Gɔd na Izrɛl, nɔ go tɔn mi bak pan dɛn.
A go opin riva dɛn na dɛn dray mawnten, ɛn wata go bɔs ɔnda grɔn, shut ɔp midul dɛn vali; A go tɔn di dray ɛn ɛmti ples to watasay, ɛn wata go de bɔs ɔnda grɔn na di dray land.
A go put sida, akeshia, matul ɛn ɔliv tik dɛn, na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples; A go put sayprɛs, plen ɛn payn tik dɛn togɛda na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap;
so dat mɔtalman go si ɛn no, ɛn kɔnsida ɛn ɔndastand togɛda, se, na PAPA GƆD in an dɔn du dis, na di Oli Wan na Izrɛl, dɔn mek am.
PAPA GƆD se, una mek una kes, Jekɔb in kiŋ se, briŋ yu ɛvidɛns.
Lɛ dɛn briŋ dɛm, ɛn tɛl wi wetin gɛt fɔ apin. Tɛl wi wetin bin dɔn apin, tɛl wi bɔt dɛn, mek wi go tink bɔt dɛm, so dat wi go no aw dɛn pas; ɔ mek wi no wetin gɛt fɔ apin.
Tɛl wi wetin gɛt fɔ bi tumara; so dat wi go no se una na god dɛm; una du gud or du bad lɛ wi go pwɛl at ɛn fred bad bad wan.
Luk, una na natin, ɛn una wok na natin; di wan we pik una, nain na di bad bad tin we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk.
A shek pɔsin kɔmɔt na di nɔt, ɛn i dɔn kam, kɔmɔt usay di san de kan ɔp, ɛn i go de pre to mi; I go mas mas di rula dɛm na pɔtɔ pɔtɔ kle, lɛk we man we de wok wit kle, kin de mas mas am.
Udat bin tɔk am frɔm di biginin, lɛ wi go no, ɛn bifo di tɛm, lɛ wi go se “I rayt”? Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we bin tɔk am, nɔbɔdi nɔ bin anawns am, nɔbɔdi nɔ bin yɛri wetin yu se.
Na mi fɔs bin tɔk am to Zayɔn ɛn a gi Jerusɛlɛm wan mɛsenja wit gud nyuz.
Bɔt wɛn a luk, nɔbɔdi nɔ de; pan ɔl dɛn wan ya, nɔn advaysa nɔ de we, wɛn a aks ɛnitin, go gi mi ansa.
A de tɛl yu, dɛn ɔl na laylay; dɛn nɔ ebul du natin; dɛn laylay gɔd dɛm na lɛk ɛmti briz.
Dis na mi wokman we a de sɔpɔt, di wan we a dɔn pik, we mi sol de gladi fɔ; A dɔn put mi Spirit pan am, i go mek ɔl mɔtalman na wɔl trit in kɔmpin di sem.
I nɔ go kray ɔ ala lawd wan, ɔ ivin mek dɛn yɛri in vɔys na trit;
gras we de na watasay we dɔn wik, sɛf i nɔ go brok, wik we de bɔn lo wan na lamp, sɛf i nɔ go ɔt; i go waka tret wit PAPA GƆD fɔ mek ɔlman trit in kɔmpin di sem.
I nɔ go fel ɔ diskɔrej te i dɔn mek jɔstis sidɔm traŋa wan na wɔl; ɛn di kɔntri dɛn nia di si de wet fɔ in lɔ.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, PAPA GƆD, we mek di skay ɛn opin am wayd wan, we mek di wɔl ɛn ɔl wetin de de; we gi layf to di pipul dɛn we tap de ɛn spirit to di wan dɛn we de waka de:
Na mi na PAPA GƆD, A dɔn kɔl una fɔ waka tret na mi yay, A dɔn ol una an ɛn kip una; A dɔn gi una as Kɔvinant to di pipul dɛm, ɛn layt to di neshɔn dɛm,
fɔ opin dɛn yay we blɛn, fɔ pul di prizina kɔmɔt na jel, dɛn wan we sidɔm na daknɛs kɔmɔt na jel.
Na mi na PAPA GƆD, na dat na mi nem; a nɔ de gi mi glori to ɛni ɔda pɔsin, ɔ mi prez to dɛn laylay gɔd.
A de tɛl yu, di fɔstɛm tin dɛm dɔn bi, ɛn na nyu tin dɛn a de tɛl una bɔt; Bifo dɛn apin a de tɛl una bɔt dɛm.”
Siŋ wan nyu siŋ to PAPA GƆD, siŋ in prez usay di wɔl tap! Le di si ala ɛn ɔl wetin de de, di kɔntri dɛn nia di si ɛn di wan dɛm we tap de.
Lɛ di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap ɛn in siti dɛn, siŋ lawd lawd wan, Di vilej dɛn we Keda tap; ɛn lɛ di wan dɛn we tap na Sela siŋ wit gladi Lɛ dɛn ala pantap di mawnten dɛn.
Lɛ dɛn gi PAPA GƆD glori, ɛn prez am na di kɔntri dɛn we de nia di si.
PAPA GƆD de go lɛk pawaful man, i de bigin in bad bad vɛksteshɔn lɛk sojaman; I de ala, I de ala lawd wan, i de sho insɛf pawaful wan agens in ɛnimi dɛn.
I dɔn te we a sɛt mi mɔt, A sidɔm saful de bia; naw a go ala lɛk uman we in bɛlɛ de at am fɔ bɔn, A go fɛt fɔ blo ɛn blo fasfas.
A go mek di mawnten dɛn ɛmti ɛn yuslɛs, ɛn dray ɔl di gras dɛn; A go tɔn dɛn riva to ayland dɛn ɛn dray di watasay dɛn.

Ɛn a go pas dɛn blɛn yay na rod we dɛn nɔ no A go gayd dɛm na rod we dɛn nɔ no wande. A go tɔn di daknɛs we de bifo dɛm to layt, ɛn mek di rɔf ples dɛn to lɛbul grɔn. Na dɛn tin ya a go du, ɛn a nɔ go tɔn mi bak pan dɛm.
Dɛn wan dɛn we abop pan dɛn laylay gɔd, we de tɛl dɛn laylay gɔd dɛn se, “una na wi gɔd dɛn,” go disgres bad bad wan, ɛn dɛn go drɛb dɛn.
Una yɛri o, una we dɛf; ɛn luk, una we blɛn, lɛ una go si!
Udat blɛn, pas mi wokman, ɔ dɛf lɛk mi mɛsenja we a sɛn? Udat blɛn lɛk di wan we de wit mi wit ɔl in at, ɔ blɛn lɛk PAPA GƆD in wokman?
I de si bɔku tin, bɔt i nɔ de notis dɛn; in yes opin, bɔt i nɔ de yɛri.
PAPA GƆD bin gladi fɔ di waka we i de waka tret wit am, fɔ mek in lɔ big na pipul yay ɛn mek dɛn rɛspɛkt am.

Bɔt dɛn wan ya na pipul dɛn we dɛn dɔn tif ɛn kɛr ɔl dɛn tin dɛn go, dɛn trap dɛn ɔl na ol dɛn ɛn ayd dɛn na jel; dɛn dɔn tɔn lɛk tin fɔ kech ɛn it, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ sev dɛn, dɛn dɔn tɔn tin fɔ tif we nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ se, “put am bak!”
Us wan pan una go lisin dis, we go put atɛnshɔn ɛn lisin fɔ bambay?
Udat bin gi Jekɔb to di wan dɛn we de pwɛl, ɛn Izrɛl to di wan dɛn we de tif? Nɔto PAPA GƆD, we wi sin agens, di wan we dɛn nɔ gri waka nain rod, di wan we dɛn nɔ gri obe in lɔ?
So I put in ebi ebi vɛksteshɔn pan am ɛn in pawa fɔ fɛt; I put faya rawnd am, bɔt i nɔ bin ɔndastand; I bɔn am, bɔt I nɔ tek am mek natin.
Bɔt naw, na dis PAPA GƆD se, in we mek yu, yu Jekɔb, in we mol yu, yu Izrɛl: “Nɔ fred, a dɔn bay yu bak; A dɔn kɔl yu bay yu nem, yu na mi yon.
We yu de pas na wata, a go de wit yu; ɛn we yu de pas na dɛn riva, yu nɔ go drawn; we yu waka insay faya, yu nɔ go bɔn ɛn di flem nɔ go kil yu.
Bikɔs mi na PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd, di Oli Wan na Izrɛl we na yu seviɔ. A giwe Ijipt fɔ fri yu, ɛn ɛkschenj Itiopia ɛn Sɛba fɔ yu.
Bikɔs yu spɛshal na mi yay, ɛn yu gɛt ɔna, ɛn a lɛk yu, A giwe mɔtalman dɛn fɔ gɛt yu, ɛn ɛkschenj pipul dɛm fɔ yu layf.
Nɔ fred, bikɔs a de wit yu A go briŋ yu pikin dɛm kɔmɔt na di ist ɛn a go gɛda yu kɔmɔt na di wɛst;
A go tɛl di nɔt se, Sɔrɛnda, ɛn di sawt se, nɔ ol dɛm; briŋ mi bɔypikin dɛn kɔmɔt fawe kam ɛn mi gyal pikin dɛm kɔmɔt usay di wɔl tap,
ɔl dɛn wan we gɛt mi nem, we a bin dɔn mek fɔ mi glori, we a bin dɔn mol ɛn mek.”
Briŋ di pipul dɛn we blɛn kam, ɔlwe dɛn gɛt yay; di wan dɛn we dɛf, ɔlwe dɛn gɛt yes!

Lɛ ɔl di neshɔn dɛn gɛda togɛda, ɛn lɛ di pipul dɛn gɛda wansay. Udat pan dɛn kin tɛl wi wetin de apin, ɛn tɛl wi di tin dɛn we bin dɔn apin? Lɛ dɛn briŋ witnɛs dɛn fɔ sho se na tru, ɛn mek dɛn yɛri ɛn se, dis a tru.
PAPA GƆD se, “Una na mi witnɛs dɛn, ɛn mi savant we a dɔn pik, mek yu go no ɛn biliv mi ɛn ɔndastand se na Mi na Im. Nɔn gɔd nɔ bin de bifo mi, ɛn nɔn ɔda wan nɔ go de afta mi;
Mi, na Mi na PAPA GƆD, ɛn apat frɔm mi, nɔn ɔda seviɔ nɔ de.
A tɔk ɛn sev ɛn anawns we nɔn trenja laylay gɔd nɔ bin de wit una; ɛn una na mi witnɛs dɛn.” Na so PAPA GƆD se.
“Na Mi na Gɔd, ɛn igen, as frɔm naw, na Mi na Im; Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we ebul pul pɔsin kɔmɔt na mi an. We a de wok, udat go ambɔg am?”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, di wan we de sev una, di Oli Wan na Izrɛl: “Fɔ una sek, a go sɛn go Babilɔn go brok ɔl di ayɛn ba dɛn, ɛn di ala we in pipul dɛn de ala, go tɔn kray.
Na mi na PAPA GƆD, una Oli Wan, una kiŋ, di wan we mek Izrɛl.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, In we de mek rod na di si, we de mek futpath na dɛn big big wata dɛn,
di wan we de briŋ chariɔt ɛn ɔs, ɛn ami ɛn sojaman; dɛn lidɔm, dɛn nɔ ebul grap, dɛn ɔt dɛn, dɛn ɔt dɛn lɛk wik:
“Una nɔ mɛmba di tin dɛn we dɔn pas, ɛn nɔ tink bɔt di ol tin dɛn.
A de tɛl una, a de du nyu tin; i de bɔs naw, una nɔ no bɔt am? A go mek rod na di ɛmti ɛn dray ples we natin nɔ de, ɛn riva dɛn na ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap.

Di wayl animal dɛn go ɔna mi, di jakal ɛn di ostrich dɛm; bikɔs a de gi wata na di ɛmti ɛn dray ples we natin nɔ de, ɛn riva dɛn na di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ ebul tap, fɔ gi mi pipul dɛn we a dɔn pik, wata fɔ drink,
“we na di pipul dɛn we a dɔn mek fɔ misɛf so dat dɛn go prez mi.
“Pan ɔl dat, una nɔ bin pre to mi, yu Jekɔb; bɔt una dɔn taya wit mi, yu Izrɛl!
Una nɔ briŋ una ship dɛn fɔ mi, fɔ sakrifays dɛn we dɛn de bɔn na faya, ɔ ɔna mi wit una sakrifays dɛn. A nɔ mɔna una fɔ ɔfrin, ɔ mek una taya fɔ gi mi insɛns.
Una nɔ bay insɛns fɔ mi wit mɔni, ɔ satisfay mi wit di fat pan una sakrifays dɛn. Bɔt una dɔn pak una sin dɛn pan mi, ɛn una dɔn mek a dɔn taya wit di sin dɛn we una de kɔmit.
“Na Mi, na Mi na Im we de wep una sin dɛn kɔmɔt, fɔ mi yon sek, ɛn a nɔ go mɛmba una sin dɛn igen.
Una mɛmba mi, lɛ wi agyu; mek una kes, so dat dɛn go pruv se una gɛt rayt.
Una fɔstɛmpapa bin sin, ɛn di wan dɛn we de tɔk fɔ yu, dɔn sin agens mi;
Fɔseka dat, a nɔ bin rɛspɛkt di bigman dɛn we bin de na di oli ples, A bin mek dɛn nyakanyaka Jekob ɛn mek dɛn fityay Izrɛl.
“Bɔt naw lisin, yu Jekɔb we na mi wokman, Izrɛl we a dɔn pik!
Na dis PAPA GƆD we mek yu, se, we mol yu na yu mami bɛlɛ, ɛn we go ɛp yu: Nɔ fred, yu Jekɔb we na mi wokman, Jɛshurɔn we a dɔn pik.
Bikɔs a go tɔn wata na di land we tɔsti, 2 ɛn mek watasay dɛm na di dray grɔn; A go put mi Spirit pan yu pikin dɛn, ɛn mi blɛsin pan di wan dɛn we yu bɔn.
Dɛn go gro lɛk gras midul wata, lɛk plant we de gro nia watasay we de flo.
Dis wan go se, ‘Na mi blant PAPA GƆD’, ɔda wan go kɔl insɛf bay Jekɔb in nem, ɛn ɔda wan go rayt nain an se, ‘PAPA GƆD in yon,’ ɛn gi insɛf sɔn nem we na Izrɛl.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD we na kiŋ na Izrɛl ɛn di wan we de sev dɛn, we nain na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, se: “Na mi na di fɔs ɛn na mi na di las; apat frɔm mi nɔn ɔda gɔd nɔ de.
Udat tan lɛk mi? Lɛ i anawns am, lɛ I tɔk ɛn eksplen bifo mi. Udat dɔn ɛva anawns tin dɛm we gɛ fɔ bi wande? Lɛ dɛn tɛl wi wetin gɛt fɔ apin.
Una nɔ fred ɔ no kɔt at; a nɔ bin dɔn tɛl una lɔntɛm se i go bi? Ɛn una na mi witnɛs dɛm! Ɛni ɔda Gɔd de apat frɔm mi? Nɔn Rɔk nɔ de, a nɔ sabi ɛniwan.
Ɔl di wan dɛn we de mek dɛn laylay gɔd, na natin, ɛn di tin dɛm we dɛn de gladi fɔ, nɔ de prɔfit; dɛn witnɛs dɛn nɔ de si se ɛn nɔ no se, dɛn go mek dɛn shem.
Udat de mek dɛn laylay gɔd, ɔ mek dɛn imej we nɔ gud fɔ natin?
A de tɛl yu, dɛn go mek ɔl in kɔmpin dɛn shem, ɛn di man dɛn we de wok wit dɛn an, nɔto natin, pas mɔtalman; lɛ dɛn ɔl gɛda, lɛ dɛn tinap, dɛn go fred bad bad wan, ɛn dɛn go mek dɛn ɔl shem togɛda.
Di blaksmit mol am, ɛn wok am oba di faya kol; i shep am wit ama dɛn ɛn patan am wit in trɔŋ an; we aŋri kech am ɛn i taya, i nɔ de drink wata ɛn i kin wik.
Di kapinta de mɛzhɔ wit in teprul ɛn mak wit pɛnsul; i dizayn am wit plen ɛn mak am wit kɔmpas; i shep am lɛkɛ mɔtalman, fayn fayn mɔtalman, fɔ tap insay os.
I kɔt sida tik dɛn; ɔ i kin pik ok ɔ sayprɛs ɛn lɛf am lɛ i gro traŋa wan wit di ɔda tik dɛn na di fɔrɛst; i kin plant sida ɛn na ren kin mek i gro fayn.
Dɔn i tɔn faya wud fɔ mɔtalman; in de tek sɔm wam insɛf, i tek sɔm mek faya ɛn bek in bred; dɔn i tek am mek gɔd ɛn wɔship am. I mek laylay gɔd ɛn butu to am.
I bɔn af pan am na faya; dɔn i it bif oba di ɔda af, i de ros bif ɛn i kin satisfay; dɔn i de wam faya ɛn tɔk se, “Eey, a dɔn wam, a dɔn si faya!”
Dɔn i tek di balans mek gɔd, we nain laylay gɔd; dɔn i butu to am ɛn wɔship am; i de pre to am se, “Sev mi, bikɔs yu na mi gɔd!”
Dɛn nɔ no natin ɛn nɔ de ɔndastand; bikɔs i dɔn lɔk dɛn yay sɔ dɛn nɔ go ebul si, ɛn dɛn maynd, so dat dɛn nɔ go ebul ɔndastand.

Nɔbɔdi nɔ de kɔnsida se, ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt sɛns ɔ tɔk na dɛn maynd sɛf se “bo a dɔn bɔn af na faya, tek di faya bek bred, ɛn dɔn ros bif ɛn it am; a fɔ tek di balans mek bad bad tin we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk? A fɔ butu bifo af tik?”
Na asis i de it; na kɔnfyus maynd dɔn mek i go astre ɛn i nɔ ebul sev insɛf ɔ aks insɛf se, “Nɔto lay dis de na mi raytan so?
Mɛmba dɛn tin ya, yu Jekɔb, ɛn Izrɛl, bikɔs yu na mi wokman; Na mi mol yu, yu na mi wokman; E Izrɛl, a nɔ go fɔgɛt yu.
A dɔn swip di bad tin dɛn we yu dɔn du, go lɛk klawd, ɛn yu sin dɛn lɛk dyu; tɔn bak kam to mi, bikɔs a dɔn sev yu.
Yu skay, siŋ, bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn du am; ala, yu bɔtɔm bɔtɔm grɔn; bɔsawt wit siŋ una dɛn mawnten, yu fɔrɛst ɛn ɔl di tik we de de! Bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn sev Jekɔb, ɛn i go gɛt glori na Izrɛl.
PAPA GƆD we sev una, we mol unainsay una mami bɛlɛ, se; “Na Mi na PAPA GƆD we mek ɔl tin, we na Mi wan opin di skay rich ɔlsay, we mek dis wɔl – udat bin de wit mi?
Mi PAPA GƆD we de mek di lay we dɛn layman dɛn de lay bɔt tumara, nɔ min natin, ɛn we tɔn di mɛrɛsinman dɛn to fulman; we nɔ tek sɛns wɔd mek natin, ɛn mek dɛn sɛns tɔn fulish tin;

we de pruv wetin in wokman se, ɛn de mek shɔ se wetin in mɛsenja dɛn se, bi; we tɔk bɔt Jerusɛlɛm se, ‘Pɔsin dɛn go tap de,’ ɛn bɔt di siti dɛn na Juda, se, ‘Dɛn go bil dɛn ɛn a go mek ɔl usay brok brok, bak’;
we de tɔk to di si se, ‘Dray, A go dray una riva dɛm’;
we tɔk bɔt Sayrɔs se, ‘In na mi shɛpad, ɛn i go du ɔl wetin a plan’; I tɔk bɔt Jerusɛlɛm se, “Dɛn go bil am,’ ɛn bɔt di tɛmpul se, ‘Dɛn go le yu fawndeshɔn.’”
Na dis PAPA GƆD tɛl Sayrɔs we i dɔn anɔynt, we nain raytan a dɔn ol tayt, fɔ put neshɔn dɛn ɔnda in fut ɛn fɔ disgres kiŋ dɛn, fɔ opin domɔt dɛn fɔ am so dat get dɛn nɔ go lɔk:
A go lid yu ɛn lɛbul di mawnten dɛn, A go brok di bras do dɛn pis pis ɛn kɔt kɔt dɛn ayɛn ba dɛn.
A go gi yu di jɛntri we de na dak ɛn di tin dɛn we ayd na dɛn sikrit ples, so dat yu go no se na Mi, PAPA GƆD, Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, we kɔl yu bay yu nem.
Fɔseka Jekɔb we na mi wokman ɛn Izrɛl we a pik, A kɔl yu bay yu nem, a gi yu sɔn nem, ɔlwe yu nɔ no mi.
Na mi na PAPA GƆD, ɛn nɔn ɔda wan nɔ de, apat frɔm mi, nɔn ɔda Gɔd nɔ de; A de gyad yu, ɔlwe yu nɔ sabi mi,
mek mɔtalman go no se, frɔm usay di san de grap ɛn frɔm di wɛst, nɔn ɔda wan nɔ de apat frɔm mi; Na Mi na PAPA GƆD ɛn nɔn ɔda wan nɔ de.
A mek layt ɛn daknɛs, A mek gladi gladi ɛn waala, na Mi na PAPA GƆD, we de du ɔl dɛn tin ya.
“Sɛn ren kan dɔŋ, yu skay, ɛn lɛ di skay dɛn sɛn raychɔsnɛs kan dɔŋ lɛ di grɔn opin so dat salveshɔn go bɔs kɔmɔt, ɛn lɛ i mek raychɔsnɛs insɛf bɔs kam ɔp; na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn mek am.
“Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan pɔsin we de fɛt in Meka, lɛk kle pɔt wit di wan we mek am! Di kle kin aks di wan we de mol se, ‘Na wetin yu de mek?’ Ɔ, ‘Di tin we yu de mek nɔ gɛt andul?’
Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan di wan we aks in Papa se, “Wetin mek a tan so? Ɔ uman se, ‘Na wetin yu de pini fɔ bɔn?’”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, in we na di Oli Wan na Izrɛl, ɛn dɛn Meka; “Una go kwɛshɔn mi bɔt mi pikin dɛm, ɔ kɔmand mi bɔt mi wok we a dɔn du?
Na mi mek dis wɔl, ɛn mek mɔtalman de de; na mi an mek di skay ɛn opin am wayd, ɛn a kɔntrol ɔl wetin de de.
A dɔn wek am wit raychɔsnɛs, ɛn a go mek i waka tret pan ɔl wetin i de du; I go bil mi siti ɛn fri mi pipul dɛn we de ɛgzayl, we a nɔ go gɛt fɔ pe am ɔ gi am natin,’” Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se.

Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Ijipt in jɛntri ɛn Itiopia in makit, ɛn di Sabian dɛn we na man dɛn we big ɛn ay, go kam oba to una ɛn go blant una, dɛn go de wit una; dɛn go chen dɛn briŋ dɛn kam oba to una, ɛn dɛn go butu to una. Dɛn go beg una se, “Na una nɔmɔ PAPA GƆD de wit, ɛn nɔn ɔda Gɔd nɔ de, nɔn ɔda gɔd nɔ de apat frɔm am;”
Fɔ tru tru, yu na Gɔd we de ayd yusɛf, Yu Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd we na di Seviɔ.
Dɛn ɔl shem ɛn kɔnfyus, di wan dɛn we de mek laylay gɔd de go wit kɔnfyushɔn togɛda.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD sev Izrɛl wit salveshɔn we de so te go, dɛn nɔ go mek una shem ɔ kɔnfyus una fɔ ɛva ɛn ɛva.

Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se, we mek di skay (nain na Gɔd!), We mol dis wɔl ɛn mek am (i mek i tinap, i nɔ mek i bi ples we nɔ gɛt ɔda, i mek am fɔ pipul fɔ tap!). “Na Mi na PAPA GƆD, ɛn nɔn ɔda wan nɔ de.
A nɔ tɔk sikrit, na land ɔf daknɛs; A nɔ tɛl Jekɔb in pikin dɛm se, luk fɔ mi wit kɔnfyushɔn.’ Mi PAPA GƆD de tɔk tru, A de anawns wetin rayt.
Una gɛda unasɛf kam, una kam togɛda, una we lɛf pan di neshɔn dɛn! Dɛn nɔ no natin, dɛn wan we de waka waka wit dɛn bod laylay gɔd dɛn, ɛn fasin fɔ de pre to gɔd we nɔ ebul sev dɛm.

Tɔk ɛn put una kes; lɛ dɛn ɛŋed togɛda! Udat bin tɔk dis lɔntɛm? Udat bin anawns am frɔm di biginin? Nɔto bin Mi, PAPA GƆD? Ɛn nɔn ɔda Gɔd nɔ de apat frɔm mi, Gɔd we de waka tret ɛn we de sev; nɔn ɔda wan nɔ de apat frɔm mi.
Una tɔn to Mi so dat una go sev, ɔl di kɔna dɛn na di wɔl! Bɔkɔs na Mi na Gɔd ɛn nɔn ɔda wan nɔ de.
A dɔn swɛ wit mi nem, raychɔs wɔd dɔn kɔmɔt na mi mɔt, ɛn na wɔd we nɔ go tɔn bak; Na to mi ɔlman go baw ɛn kɔnfɛs,”
“Dɛn go tɔk bɔt mi se, na PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ de waka tret ɛn gɛt trɛnk; ɔl di wan dɛn we bin de vɛks pan am go shem ɛn kan to am.
Ɔl Izrɛl in pikin dɛn go gɛt viktri ɛn mek nem insay PAPA GƆD.
Bel baw, Nibo butu, dɛn laylay gɔd dɛn, de na dɛn animal ɛn dɛn kaw dɛn bak; dɛn tin dɛn ya we una bɔn, ebi lɛk lod we kin de na dɛn taya taya animal dɛn bak.
Dɛn butu, dɛn baw togɛda dɛn nɔ ebul sev di lod, bɔt dɛn kapchɔ dɛnsɛf go slev!
Lisin mi, una Jekɔb in os, ɔl di wan dɛn we lɛf pan Izrɛl in pipul dɛn, we na mi dɔn bɔn una frɔm we una bɔn, bɔn una frɔm una mami bɛlɛ;
te we una dɔn ol so, na Mi na Im, ɛn te una pul wet ia, a go bɔn una. A dɔn mek, ɛn a go bɔn; A go bɔn ɛn a go sev.
“Na udat una wan se a fiba ɛn mek a ikwal to, ɛn kɔmpia mi to, so dat wi go fiba?
Dɛn wan we de wes gold kɔmɔt na dɛn pɔs, ɛn we silva na skel, aya goldsmit, ɛn in tɔn am to gɔd, dɔn dɛn butu ɛn wɔship am!
Dɛn es am put na sholda, bɔn am go, fiks am nain ples, ɛn i tinap de; i nɔ ebul muf kɔmɔt nain ples. If pɔsin kray to am, i nɔ de ansa ɔ sev am kɔmɔt pan in trɔbul.
Mɛmba dis ɛn kɔnsida briŋ am bak to maynd, una sina dɛn,
mɛmba dɛn lɔntɛm tin dɛm; bikɔs na Mi na Gɔd, ɛn nɔn ɔda wan nɔ de; na Mi na Gɔd ɛn nɔn nɔ tan lɛk mi,
we frɔm di biginin a dɔn anawns di ɛndin ɛn frɔm lɔntɛm, di tin we nɔ bi yet, we de tɔk se, ‘na Mi disishɔn go tinap, ɛn a go du ɔl wetin a mek ɔp,’
a de kɔl dɛn bɔd we de it bif kɔmɔt na di ist, ɛn di man we a dɔn disayd fɔ kɔl kɔmɔt wan fawe kɔntri. A dɔn tɔk am, ɛn a go mek I bi; A dɔn mek ɔp am, ɛn a go du am.
“Una lisain to mi ya, una dɛn traŋa yɛs pipul, una we de fa frɔm dilivrans:
A go briŋ mi dilivrans kam nia, I nɔ de fawe ɛn mi salveshɔn nɔ go westɛm; A go put salveshɔn na Zayɔn, fɔ Izrɛl we na mi glori.”
Kam dɔŋ kan sidɔm na dɔti grɔn, Yu Babilɔn in vajin gyalpikin; sidɔm na grɔn usay kiŋ chia sidɔm nɔ de, Yu we na dɛn Babilonian dɛn gyal pikin dɛn! Bikɔs dɛn nɔ go se yu bɔdi saf ɛn dɛliket, igen
Tek pɛpɛ ston ɛn gren tin fɔ it, pul yu vel, pul yu gawn, es yu klos lɛ yu lɛg dɛn sho, ɛn waka krɔs di riva dɛn.
Yu nekɛdnɛs go sho, ɛn yu shem go kɔmɔt na do. A go rivɛnj, ɛn a nɔ go lɛf nɔbɔdi.
Wi Ridima – we PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nain nem- na di Oli Wan na Izrɛl.
Sidɔm kwayɛt, ɛn go na dak ples, Yu we na Babilonian dɛn gyal pikin; Bikɔs dɛn nɔ go kɔl yu di misis fɔ dɛn kindɔm, igen
A bin vɛks pan mi pipul dɛn, A disgres usay a kɔmɔt; A gi dɛn to yu, bɔt yu nɔ bin sho wan masi; na pan di ol pipul dɛn yu put yu lod we ebi pasmak.
Yu bin se “A go a bi misis sote go,” ɛn dat bin mek yu nɔ put dɛn tin ya na yu at ɔ mɛmba aw dɛn bin dɔn.
Fɔseka dat, lisin, yu we lɛk ɛnjɔymɛnt, we sidɔm sef wan, de tɔk na yu at se, “na Mi, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de we bɛtɛ pas mi; A nɔ go sidɔm lɛk unam we in man dɔn day ɔ we no wetin i min fɔ bɛr pikin.”

Dɛn tu tin ya go apin to yu di sem tɛm, di sem de; yu pikin dɛn go day ɛn yu man go day ɛn i go fɔdɔm pan yu ebi ebi wan, pan ɔl yu bɔku bɔku wich we yu de wich, ɛn di bɔku pawa we yu gɛt pan yu majik.
Yu bin fil se yu sef pan yu wikɛdnɛs, Yu bin se, “Nɔbɔdi nɔ de si mi”; Yu sɛns ɛn yu sabi bin dɔn mek yu go astre, ɛn yu bin tɔk na yu at se, “Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we bɛtɛ pas mi.”
Bɔt ivul go kam pan yu, we yu nɔ go ebul beg Gɔd fɔ; trɔbul go mit yu, we yu nɔ go ebul tek pɔnishmɛnt fɔ, ɛn yu go ruin wantɛm wantɛm, we yu nɔ go no natin bɔt.
Tinap traŋa wan wit yu majik ɛn yu bɔku bɔku wich, we yu dɔn lebɔ fɔ frɔm we yu yɔŋ; sɔntɛnde, yu go ebul sɔksid, sɔntɛnde, yu go ebul mek pɔsin fred.
Yu dɔn taya wit yu bɔku bɔku advays; lɛ dɛn tinap sev yu, dɛn wan we de divayd di skay, ɛn we de wach di sta dɛn, we kin pridikt wetin go bi to yu, we nyu mun kɔmɔt.
Luk, dɛn na lɛk dray gras we faya kin bɔn; dɛn nɔ go ebul sev dɛnsɛf frɔm di faya in pawa. Dis nɔto kol fɔ wam yusɛf, nɔto faya fɔ sidɔm bifo!
Na so di wan dɛn we dɔn wok fɔ yu, nɔ go ebul ɛp yu, we bin dɔn de wok fɔ yu frɔm we yu yɔŋ; ɔlman de skata go inyon we; nɔn nɔ go de fɔ sev yu.
Lisin dis, yu Jekɔb in os, yu we dɛn de kɔl Izrɛl, we Juda na yu dadi, we de swɛ wit PAPA GƆD in nem ɛn se yu biliv pan di Gɔd na Izrɛl, bɔt nɔ bin de tɔk tru ɔ wetin rayt.
Bikɔs dɛn kɔl dɛnsɛf di oli siti in nem, ɛn abop pan Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd; na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nain nem.
“A bin dɔn tɛl una lɔntɛm bɔt di tin dɛn we bin dɔn bi, dɛn kɔmɔt na miyon mɔt ɛn a mek una no bɔt dɛn; dɔn wantɛm wantɛm, a du dɛm, ɛn dɛn bi.
Bikɔs a no se yu traŋayes, ɛn yu nɛk na lɛk ayɛn rop ɛn yu fɔrɛd na lɛk bras,
A bin dɔn tɛl yu lɔlɔntɛm, bifo dɛn apin, a bin anawns dɛn to yu, bambay yu go se, ‘Na mi laylay gɔd dɛm, na mi bod laylay gɔd ɛn mi ayɛn laylay gɔd du dɛm.’
“Yu dɔn yɛri; naw kan luk ɔl dis; ɛn yu nɔ go tɔk bɔt am? As frɔm naw te go, a go mek una de yɛri nyu tin dɛm, tin dɛn we ayd we una nɔ no yet.
Na naw dɛn mek, i nɔ tu te yet; yu nɔ yɛri bɔt dɛn wande, pas tide, bambay yu go se, ‘bo, a bin no dɛm.’
Yu nɔ ɛva yɛri, yu nɔ ɛva no, frɔm mɔnin, yu yes nɔ bin opin. Bikɔs a bin no se, na rikishi we, yu go du tin, ɛn frɔm we yu bɔn, na rebɛl dɛn bin de kɔl yu.
“Fɔseka mi nem, a de push mi vɛks go biɛn, fɔseka mi prez, a tap am fɔ yu sek, so dat a nɔ go kil yu.
Luk, a dɔn klin yu fayn, bɔt nɔto lɛk silva; A dɔn tɛst yu na di fɔnes ɔf aflikshɔn.
Na fɔ mi yon sek, fɔ mi yon yon sek, mek a du am, bikɔs wetindu mi nem fɔ disgres? A nɔ go gi mi glori to ɔda pɔsin.
“Lisin mi, yu Jekɔb, ɛn yu Izrɛl we a dɔn kɔl! Na Mi na Im, na Mi na di fɔs, ɛn na mi na di las.
Na mi le di fawndeshɔn fɔ di wɔl, ɛn mi raytan prɛd di skay; wɛn a kɔl dɛm, dɛn de kɔmɔt tinap togɛda.
Una ɔl gɛda, ɛn yɛri! Uswan pan dɛn bin tɔk se dɛn tin ya go bi? PAPA GƆD lɛk am; i go du wetin i plan fɔ Babilɔn, ɛn in an go fɛt di Babilonian dɛn.
Mi, na Mi semwan, dɔn tɔk ɛn kɔl am, A dɔn briŋ am kam, ɛn i go sɔksid pan ɔl wetin i de du.
Kam nia mi, yɛri dis: frɔm tɛm, a nɔ de tɔk sikrit, frɔm di tɛm we i bi, a bin dɔn de de.” Ɛn naw PAPA GƆD dɔn sɛn mi ɛn in Spirit
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, Yu Ridima, we na di Oli Wan na Izrɛl: “Na mi na PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd, we de tich yu aw fɔ prɔfit, we de lid yu na di rod we yu fɔ waka na layf.
A wish yu bin de obe mi lɔ dɛn! Datɛnde yu kolat bin fɔ tan lɛk riva, ɛn di waka we yu de waka tret na mi yay, go tan lɛk swɛlin na si;
Yu pikin dɛn bin fɔ plɛnti lɛk sansan, ɛn yu pikin pikin dɛn go bɔku lɛk aw sansan bɔku; dɛn nem nɔ go ɔt atɔl ɛn dɛn nɔ go pwɛl am bifo mi.”
Una kɔmɔt na Babilɔn, una rɔnawe kɔmɔt na Chaldia, tɔk dis wit jɔy, anawns am ɔlsay, sɛn di wɔd go usay di wɔl tap; tɔk se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn bay in wokman Jekɔb bak.”
Dɛn nɔ bin tɔsti we i bin pas wit dɛn na di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap; I bin mek wata kɔmɔt na ston fɔ dɛm; I plit ston ɛn di wata bɔs kɔmɔt wit pawa.
PAPA GƆD se, “kolat nɔ de fɔ wikɛd pɔsin.”
Lisin to mi, una dɛn kɔntri dɛn nia di si, ɛn pe atɛnshɔn, una dɛn neshɔn dɛn we de fawe, PAPA GƆD kɔl mi frɔm we a de na bɛlɛ, nainsay mi mami bɛlɛ i gi mi nem.
I mek mi mɔt lɛk shap sɔd, na ɔnda in an in shado i bin ayd mi; i mek mi lɛk aro we dɛn pɔlish, ɛn ayd mi insay di bag we i de kip aro.
Ɛn i tɛl mi se, “Yu na mi wokman, yu Izrɛl, we na pan yu a go gɛt glori.”
Bɔt a se, “A dɔn lebɔ fɔ natin, Mi trɛnk ɔl dɔn wes ɛn go fɔ natin; bɔt a shɔ se mi rayt de wit PAPA GƆD, ɛn mi riwɔd de wit mi Gɔd.”
Ɛn naw PAPA GƆD de se, In we mol mi frɔm mi mami bɛlɛ, fɔ briŋ Jekɔb kam bak to am, ɛn fɔ mek Izrɛl gɛda kam to am, bikɔs a gɛt ɔna na PAPA GƆD in yay ɛn mi Gɔd dɔn bi mi trɛnk-

I se: “Na smɔl tin fɔ mek yu bi mi wokman fɔ gɛda Jekɔb in difrɛn fambul dɛn ɛn fɔ briŋ di wan dɛn pan Izrɛl we a kip, kam bak; A go mek yu lɛk layt to di neshɔn dɛm, lɛ mi salveshɔn go rich usay di wɔl tap.”

Na dis PAPA GƆD, we na Izrɛl in Ridima ɛn in Oli Wan se, to di wan we ɔlman dɔn shub na kɔna ɔltogɛda, we di neshɔn dɛn dɔn shub fa, we na di rula dɛn wokman: “kiŋ dɛm go si ɛn tinap; bigman dɛm, ɛn dɛn go lidɔm na grɔn wit dɛn bɛlɛ; bikɔs PAPA GƆD we de waka tret, we na di Oli Wan na Izrɛl, we dɔn pik yu.”

Na dis PAPA GƆD se; “Di tɛm fɔ fevɔ, a dɔn ansa yu di de fɔ salveshɔn, a dɔn ɛp yu; A dɔn kip yu ɛn gi yu fɔ bi Kɔvinant to di pipul dɛn, fɔ mek di kɔntri go tinap traŋa wan, fɔ sheb sheb di ɛmti land;
de tɛl di prizina dɛn se, ‘Una kan na do,” ɛn tɛl di wan we de na daknɛs se, “Una apia,’ Dɛn go de it na rod we dɛn de go, ɛn ɔl dɛn mawnten we dray, go bi ples we plɛnti de fɔ dɛn fɔ it;
dɛn nɔ go aŋri ɛn dɛn nɔ go tɔsti, ɔt briz ɔ san sɛf go mɔna dɛm, bikɔs na di wan we de sɔri fɔ dɛn go lid dɛm, ɛn na usay watasay dɛn de i go pas dɛn.
Ɛn a go mek ɔl mi mawnten dɛm bi rod, ɛn dɛn go bil mi men rod dɛn.
A de tɛl una, dɛnwanya go kɔmɔt fawe, ɛn fɔ tru tru, dɛn go kɔmɔt nɔt ɛn na di wɛst, ɛn dɛnwanya we kɔmɔt Aswan na di sawt.”
Siŋ wit jɔy, yu skay, ɛn yu ath, gladi; bɔs wit siŋ una dɛn mawnten dɛn, bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn koks in pipul dɛn, ɛn go sɔri fɔ in pipul dɛn we de sɔfa.
Bɔt Zayɔn se, “PAPA GƆD dɔn fɔsek mi, Mi Gɔd dɔn fɔgɛt mi.”
“Kombra go fɔgɛt in pikin we de sɔk bɔbi, we i nɔ go sɔri fɔ di bɔypikin we kɔmɔt nain bɛlɛ? Dɛn sɛf kin fɔgɛt, bɔt mi, nɔ go fɔgɛt yu.
A de tɛl yu, a dɔn kav yu na mi an dɛn; yu wɔl dɛn de bifo mi ɔltɛm.
Di wan dɛn we de bil fɔ yu, impɔtant pas di wan dɛn we de pwɛl yu, ɛn di wan dɛn we bin ɛmti yu, go kɔmɔt lɛf yu go.
Es yu yay ɔp, luk rawnd ɛn si; dɛn ɔl gɛda, dɛn kam to yu. PAPA GƆD se, wans a de, yu go wɛr dɛn ɔl lɛk trinkɛt, yu go fiks dɛn pan yusɛf lɛk aw yawo kin du.
“Fɔ tru yu ples dɛn we natin ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de ɛn yu land we dɔn pwɛl kpatakpata- fɔ tru, yu go tu smɔl naw fɔ di wan dɛn we tap de, ɛn di wan dɛn we bin swɛla yu, go de fawe.
Di pikin dɛn we bɔn di tɛm we yu bin gɛt bɛrin go tɔk wande na yu yes se: ‘Di ples tu smɔl fɔ mi; mek say we a go tap.”

Datɛnde yu go tɔk na yu at se: “Udat bin bɔn dɛnwanya fɔ mi? A bin gɛt bɛrin ɛn a nɔ bin de bɔn pikin, dɛn sɛn mi go ɛgzayl ɛn drɛb mi, bɔt udat mɛn dɛn wan ya? A de tɛl yu, dɛn lɛf mi wangren; so usay dɛn wan ya kɔmɔt?’”
Na dis PAPA GƆD de se: “A de tɛl yu, A go es mi an to di neshɔn dɛn ɛn mek mi sayn to di pipul dɛn; ɛn dɛn go briŋ yu bɔypikin dɛm na dɛn buzɔm, ɛn dɛn go bɔn yu gyal pikin dɛm na dɛn sholda.

Na kiŋ dɛn go tek una fɔ mɛn, ɛn na dɛn kwin dɛn go gi una bɔbi. Dɛn go butu dɛn fes na grɔn fɔ baw to una, ɛn lik di dɔti na una fut. Na datɛnde una go no se, na mi na PAPA GƆD; di wan dɛn we de luk to mi, nɔ go ɛva shem.”
Dɛn go ebul pul wetin trɛnk man dɔn kech, kɔmɔt nain an ɔ di wan dɛn we wikɛd rula dɔn kech, kɔmɔt nain an?

Fɔ tru, na dis PAPA GƆD se; “Dɛn kin pul di wan we di trɛnk man sɛf kech kɔmɔt nain an, ɛn dɛn go sev di wan dɛn we di wikɛd rula dɔn kech, kɔmɔt nain an, bikɔs a go fɛt di wan dɛn we de fɛt yu, ɛn a go sev yu pikin dɛn.
A go mek dɛn wan we aras yu, it dɛn yon flɛsh, ɛn dɛn go drɔnk wit dɛn yon blɔd lɛk se na wayn. Na datɛnde ɔl mɔtalman go no se, na Mi na PAPA GƆD we na una seviɔ, ɛn una Ridima, Jekɔb in Mayti Wan.”

Na dis PAPA GƆD se; “We yu mama in dayvɔs pepa, we a tek dayvɔs am? Ɔ uswan pan di wan dɛn we a o, we a sɛl una gi? No se, na fɔ yu sin dɛn mek dɛn sɛl yu ɛn na fɔ di bad bad tin dɛn we yu de du, mek a drɛb yu mami.

Wetin mek, wɛn a bin kam, nɔbɔdi nɔ de? Wɛn a kɔl, nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de fɔ ansa? Mi an dɔn shɔt we a nɔ ebul sev? Adinɔ a nɔ gɛt pawa fɔ diliva? Lisin, we a tɔk pan di si, i dray, A tɔn di riva dɛn to ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap; dɛn fish smɛl bikɔs dɛn nɔ gɛt wata, ɛn day wit tɔsti.
A mek di skay wɛr blak klos, ɛn mek i kɔba wit saklɔth.
Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd dɔn mek a sabi tɔk lɛk dɛn wan we dɛn tich, so dat a go no aw a go tɔk fɔ kɔrej pɔsin we dɔn fɛdɔp. Ɛvri mɔnin, i de wek, I de wek mi yes fɔ lisin lɛk di wan dɛn we dɛn tich.
Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd dɔn opin mi yes, ɛn a nɔ bin traŋayes, A nɔ tɔn bak.
A bin gi mi bak to di wan dɛn we de bit, ɛn mi jɔ to di wan dɛn we bin de pul di biabia; A nɔ bin ayd mi fes se a de shem, ɛn sɛf we dɛn bin de pit pan mi.
Bikɔs Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd de ɛp mi; Na dat mek dɛn nɔ ebul mi; fɔseka dat, a dɔn mek mi fes lɛk ayɛn ston; ɛn a no se dɛn nɔ go ebul mek a shem.
Di wan we go fri mi, de nia. Udat go chalenj mi? Lɛ wi tinap fes wisɛf. Udat na mi ɛnimi? Lɛ i kam mit mi.
Fɔ tru tru, Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd de ɛp mi; Udat go se a gilti? Luk, dɛn ɔl go dɔn lɛk ol klos; na moth go it dɛm.
Uswan pan una de fred PAPA GƆD ɛn de du wetin in wokman se, we de waka na daknɛs ɛn nɔ gɛt layt, bɔt stil trɔs PAPA GƆD in nem, ɛn abop pan in Gɔd?
Bɔt una ɔl na pipul dɛn we de mek faya, pipul dɛn we de layt wud. Una waka wit una faya in flem, ɛn wit di wud dɛn we una dɔn layt faya pan! Na dis una go gɛt na mi an: una go lidɔm insay tɔmɛnt.
“Lisin to mi, yu we de rɔnata dilivrans, yu we de fɛn PAPA GƆD; luk to di rɔk we dɛn kɔt yu kɔmɔt, ɛn to di kwari usay dɛn dig yu kɔmɔt.
Luk to Ebran yu we na yu dadi ɛn to Sera we bɔn yu; bikɔs na we na bin in wangren, a bin kɔl am ɛn a blɛs am ɛn mek i plɛnti.

Bikɔs PAPA GƆD go koks Zayɔn; I go kɔnfɔt ɔl in ɛmti ples dɛn we dɔn pwɛl, ɛn i go mek in dray ɛn ɛmti ples tan lɛk Idɛn, In ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, go tan lɛk PAPA GƆD in gadin; na jɔy ɛn gladi gladi go de de, wit tanksgivin ɛn pipul dɛn we de siŋ.
“Una lisin to mi, mi pipul dɛn, ɛn una yɛri mi, yu mi neshɔn; bikɔs lɔ go kɔmɔt to mi, ɛn mi jɔstis fɔ gi layt to di pipul dɛn.
Mi dilivrans de kam nia wit spid, ɛn mi salveshɔn dɔn go bifo, ɛn na misɛf go rul di pipul dɛm; di land dɛn we de nia di si, go wet fɔ mi, ɛn dɛn de abop pan mi..

Es yu yay ɔp luk di skay, ɛn luk di grɔn we de dɔŋ; bikɔs di skay go disapia lɛk smok, ɛn dis wɔl go dɔn lɛk ol klos, ɛn di wan dɛn we tap de, go day lɛk flay; bɔt mi salveshɔn go de sote go, ɛn mi dilivrans nɔ go ɛva dɔn.
“Una lisin mi, una we no aw fɔ waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, di pipul dɛn we mi lɔ de na dɛn at; una nɔ fred mɔtalman laf, ɛn nɔ pwɛl at we dɛn de kɔs una.
Bikɔs mɔth go it dɛn lɛk klos, ɛn tumbu go it dɛn lɛk wul; bɔt mi dilivrans go de sote go, ɛn mi salveshɔn go go to ɔl di jɛnareshɔn dɛn.”
Grap o, grap, pik trɛnk, E PAPA GƆD in pawa; grap, lɛk aw yu bin de du fɔstɛm, fɔ di jɛnareshɔn dɛn lɔntɛm. Nɔto yu bin kɔt Reab pis pis, we bin chuk di dragɔn?
Nɔto yu bin mek di si dray, di wata na di oshɔn; we bin mek di grɔn na di si tɔn rod, fɔ di wan dɛn we yu sev fɔ krɔs go oba?
Ɛn PAPA GƆD in pipul we i dɔn fri go tɔn bak kam, ɛn kam na Zayɔn de siŋ; ɛn gladi we de sote go, go de na dɛn ed; dɛn go gɛt jɔy ɛn gladi gladi, ɛn sɔri ɛn pini go rɔnawe go.
“Mi, na Mi na di wan we de kɔnfɔt yu; udat na yu, we yu de fred mɔtalman we gɛt fɔ day, we de fred mɔtalman we dɛn mek lɛk gras,

ɛn yu dɔn fɔgɛt PAPA GƆD we na yu Meka, we bin opin di skay wayd, ɛn le di wɔl in fawndeshɔn ɛn jɛs de fred ol de fɔseka di man we de aras, yu in bad bad vɛksteshɔn, wɛn i rɛdi insɛf fɔ nyakanyaka? Ɛn we in bad bad vɛksteshɔn naw?
Dɛn go fri di wan dɛn we dɛn dɔn sɔprɛs, kwik kwik wan; i nɔ go day ɛn go dɔŋ na grev, ɛn it nɔ go dɔn nain os.
Bikɔs na mi na PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd, we de shek di si, mek in swɛlin dɛn mek lawd lawd nɔys- na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nain nem.
A dɔn put mi wɔd na yu mɔt ɛn dɔn ayd yu ɔnda mi an in shado, de opin di skay wayd, ɛn de le dis wɔl in fawndeshɔn, ɛn de tɛl Zayɔn se, “Una na mi pipul.’”
Gɛda yusɛf, gɛda yusɛf, tinap, yu Jerusɛlɛm, yu we bin dɔn drink na PAPA GƆD in an, di kɔp we in vɛksteshɔn de, yu we dɔn drink te rich di kɛtɛ kɛtɛ na di bol we de mek pɔsin staga.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ gayd am pan ɔl di bɔypikin dɛn we i dɔn bɔn; nɔn nɔ de fɔ ol in an pan ɔl di bɔypikin dɛn we i mɛn.
Dɛn tu tin ya dɔn bi to yu- udat go tɛl yu ɔsh? Ebi ebi damej ɛn nyakanyaka, aŋri ɛn wa; udat go kɔnfɔt yu?
Yu bɔypikin dɛn dɔn taya, dɛn ledɔm lidɔm na dɛn jɔnkshɔn dɛn na ɔl dɛn trit lɛk fritambo we dɛn kech na trap; dɛn dɔn fil wetin PAPA GƆD kin du we i vɛks, we na yu Gɔd in kɔrɛkshɔn.
Fɔseka dat una yɛri dis, una di wan dɛn we de sɔfa, we drɔnk bɔt nɔ drink wayn.
Na dis PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd se, una Gɔd we de tɔk fɔ in pipul dɛn: “Luk, a dɔn tek di kɔp na una an we de mek pipul staga; una nɔ go drink pan di bol we mi veksteshɔn de, igen igen;
