ɛn A go put am na di wan dɛn we de tɔmɛnt una, dɛn an, di wan dɛn we dɔn tɛl una se, “Una lidɔm, lɛ wi mas una pas’; ɛn una dɔn mek una bak lɛk grɔn ɛn lɛk trit fɔ dɛn fɔ waka.”
Grap o, grap, pik trɛnk, yu Zayɔn; wɛr yu fayn fayn klos dɛn, Yu Jerusɛlɛm, we na di oli siti; bikɔs dɛn nɔ go kam insay to yu igen dɛn wan we nɔ sakɔmsayz ɛn we nɔ klin
Shek yusɛf kɔmɔt na dɔti, grap, Yu Jerusɛlɛm we dɛn kapchɔ; lus di rop dɛn kɔmɔt na yu nɛk, Yu Zayɔn in gyal pikin we dɛn kapchɔ.
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se, “Dɛn nɔ sɛl yu wit mɔni, ɛn dɛn nɔ go ridim yu wit mɔni.
Bikɔs na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: Fɔs mi pipul dɛn bin go dɔŋ na Ijipt fɔ go tap de, ɛn di Asirian dɛn sɔprɛs dɛn fɔ natin.
PAPA GƆD se, wetin a de du na ya, we yu luk se dɛn dɔn kɛr mi pipul dɛn go fɔ natin? Dɛn rula dɛn kray bita wan, ɛn ol de, dɛn de fityay mi nem. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Fɔseka dat, mi pipul dɛn go no mi nem; so, na da de de dɛn go no se, na Mi de tɔk; luk Mi na ya.”
Luk we dɛn fayn na dɛn mawnten dɛn dɛn pipul dɛn we de briŋ gud yus, we de anawns bɔt pis, we de briŋ nyuz bɔt gud tin, we de anawns bɔt salveshɔn, we de tɛl Zayɔn se, “Na yu Gɔd de ren.”
Una lisin, una wachman dɛn de ala, dɛn de siŋ togɛda wit jɔy; bikɔs dɛn de si yay to yay we PAPA GƆD de tɔn bak kam Zayɔn.
Una ɔl bigin siŋ togɛda, una dɛn ɛmti ples dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm; bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn koks in pipul dɛn, I dɔn ridim Jerusɛlɛm.
PAPA GƆD dɔn lɛf in oli an na do bifo ɔl dɛn neshɔn dɛn yay; ɛn ɔl di kɔna na wɔl go se wi Gɔd in salveshɔn.
Una go, una go, una go yanda, nɔ tɔch natin we dɔti na PAPA GƆD in yay; kɔmɔt to am go, go mek unasɛf klin na PAPA GƆD in yay, una we de tot di tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz na PAPA GƆD in os.
Bikɔs una nɔ go kɔmɔt go ɔri ɔri wan, ɛn una nɔ go go lɛk udat de rɔnawe, bikɔs PAPA GƆD go de bifo una, ɛn na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd go gyad una bak.
Biliv mi, mi wokman go prɔspa, dɛn go es am ɔp, ɛn i go de ay ay wan.
Lɛk we dɛn bin plɛnti we bin wɔnda pan am- we i bin damej ɛn nɔ bin fiba mɔtalman igen, ɛn nɔ bin shep lɛk mɔtalman igen-
na so i go shɔk plɛnti neshɔn dɛm; kiŋ dɛn go sɛt dɛn mɔt fɔseka am; bikɔs di tin we dɛn nɔ ɛva tɛl dɛn bɔt, dɛn go si, ɛn na di tin we dɛn nɔ yɛri bɔt wande, dɛn go ɔndastand.
Udat dɔn biliv wetin we dɔn yɛri? Ɛn to udat PAPA GƆD dɔn sho in an?
Bikɔs I gro bifo am lɛk yɔŋ plant, ɛn lɛk rut we bɔs kɔmɔt na dray grɔn; I nɔ gɛt shep ɔ fayn fes we go mek wi go luk am, ɛn nɔ gɛt da fayn fes we go mek pɔsin want am.
Mɔtalman dɛn luk dɔŋ pan am ɛn shub am fa; na man we gɛt pen ɛn brok at, ɛn na lɛk udat pipul dɛn de ayd fes pan dɛn luk dɔŋ pan am, ɛn wi nɔ rɛspɛkt am atɔl.

Fɔ tru tru, i dɔn tek ɔl di tin dɛn we de mɔna wi kɔmɔt pan wi go ɛn dɔn tek ɔl wi pen dɛn go; pan ɔl dat, wi si am lɛk udat dɛn jɛs pɔnish fɔ natin, pɔsin we PAPA GƆD jɛs pɔnish ɛn tɔmɛnt bad bad wan.
Bɔt na fɔ wi sin mek dɛn wund am, ɛn na fɔ wi sin mek dɛn brus brus am; na pan am dɛn put ɔl di pɔnishmɛnt we sev wi, ɛn na di flag we dɛn flag am, mek wi wɛl.
Wi ɔl dɔn go astre lɛk ship; ɔlman dɔn go in yon we; ɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn put wi ɔl sin dɛn pan am.

Dɛn bin dɛn trit am bad ɛn i bin sɔfa, pan ɔl dat I nɔ se wan wɔd; lɛ ship pikin we dɛn de kɛr go fɔ go kil, ɛn lɛk we ship kin tɔn mumu bifo di wan dɛn we de kɔt in ia nain bɔdi, na so i nɔ se wan wɔd.
Na bay aw dɛn trit ɛn jɔj am, mek dɛn kɛr am go; ɛn as fɔ in jɛnareshɔn, udat pan dɛn bin kɔnsida se dɛn kil am kɔmɔt na dis wɔl, ɛn mek i sɔfa fɔ mi pipul dɛn sin?
Ɛn dɛn bɛr am wit dɛn wikɛd pipul ɛn wit wan jɛntriman, we I day, pan ɔl we i nɔ du natin bad, ɛn nɔn lay nɔ bin de nain mɔt.
Bɔt ɔl dat, na bin PAPA GƆD in plan fɔ mek dɛn brus am; I mek i sɔfa; we i mek insɛf di sakrifays fɔ sin, I go si in pikin dɛn, I go mek i gɛt lɔŋ layf; PAPA GƆD in plan go sɔksid nain an;

I go si di bɛnifit fɔ di pen we in sol sɔfa, ɛn i go satisfay; na bay in sɛns di pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, we na mi wokman, mek PAPA GƆD kɔnt bɔku pipul dɛn se, dɛn de waka tret nain yay; ɛn i go tot dɛn sin dɛm.

Fɔseka dat, a go mek say fɔ am wit dɛn pipul dɛn we gɛt ay rɛspɛkt, ɛn nain ɛn di pawaful pipul dɛn go sheb di viktri; bikɔs i gi insɛf fɔ day fɔ di wɔl we nɔbɔdi nɔ fos am, ɛn dɛn bin kɔnt am as wan sina; pan ɔl dat, i tot bɔku pipul sin, ɛn bin pre fɔ di pipul dɛn we de kɔmit sin.

“Siŋ, yu uman we nɔ ebul bɔn, yu we nɔ bɔn; bɔsawt wit siŋ ɛn ala lawd wan, yu we nɔ ɛva fil pen fɔ bɔn wande! Bikɔs di uman we in man dɔn lɛf am go bɔn mɔ pikin pas di uman we mared. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Mek di say we yu tɛnt de, big, ɛn ɛkstɛnd yu tɛnt we yu tap; nɔ sidɔm, ad mɔ rop ɛn mek di tɛnt in pɛg dɛn trɔŋ mɔ.
Bikɔs una go prɛd ɔlsay, na di rayt ɛn na di lɛft, ɛn na una pikin pikin dɛn di neshɔn dɛn go blant, ɛn pipul dɛn go tap na di siti dɛn we bin ɛmti.
“Nɔ fred, bikɔs yu nɔ go shem; nɔ kɔnfyus yusɛf, bikɔs nɔbɔdi nɔ go mek yu shem; bikɔs yu go fɔgɛt di shem we mit yu we yu bin yɔŋ, ɛn yu nɔ go mɛmba di tɔk we dɛn tɔk bɔt yu we yu man bin day, igen
Bikɔs yu meka na yu man, we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nain nem; ɛn na di Oli Wan na Izrɛl na yu Ridima, we dɛn kɔl, di Gɔd fɔ di wanol wɔl.
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn kɔl yu lɛk wɛf we dɛn lɛf to insɛf, ɛn in at pwɛl, lɛk wɛf we mared yɔŋ, dɔn in man ib am na do, na so una Gɔd se.
A bin fɔsek una fɔ shɔt tɛm, bɔt we a go sɔri fɔ una bad bad wan, a go gɛda una bak.
Bikɔs a bin vɛks pan una bad bad wan fɔ shɔt tɛm, A bin ayd mi fes pan una, bɔt wit di lɔv we de sote go, a go sɔri fɔ una, na so PAPA GƆD we na una Ridima se.
“Bikɔs, to mi, dis na lɛk Noa in tɛm: lɛk aw a bin swɛ se di wata we bin kam Noa in tɛm nɔ fɔ ɛva kam na di ath igen, na so a dɔn swɛ se a nɔ go veks pan una igen ɛn nɔ go tɔk pan una igen
Di mawnten dɛn kin skata ɛn di il dɛn kin brok, Bɔt di lɛk we a lɛk una we nɔ de chenj, nɔ go dɔn, ɛn mi Kɔvinant fɔ kɔl at, nɔbɔdi nɔ go pul am kɔmɔt, na so PAPA GƆD we de sɔri fɔ una, se.
E, yu we de sɔfa, we tinada dɔn blo, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ koks yu, lisin to mi, a go sɛt yu ston dɛn insay saf silva wayt ayɛn, ɛn le yu fawndeshɔn dɛm wit safaya.
A go bil yu tawa dɛm wit rubi ston, ɛn yu get dɛm wit ston dɛn we brayt lɛk faya, ɛn ɔl yu wɔl dɛm wit dia dia ston.
Na PAPA GƆD go tich ɔl yu bɔypikin dɛn, ɛn bɛtɛ go fala dɛn na layf, nɔto kɔmɔn.
Bikɔs yu de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, yu go tinap traŋa; nɔbɔdi nɔ go aras yu, bikɔs yu nɔ go fred; ɛn bad bad tin we go mek yu trimbul ɛn fred, nɔ go kam nia yu.
If ɛnibɔdi fɛn plaba, nɔto mi i kɔmɔt to; ɛnibɔdi we fɛn yu plaba go fɔdɔm fɔseka una.
A dɔn mek di blaksmit we go blo di kol faya, ɛn mek wɛpɔn fɔ yuz. Igen, a dɔn mek di man we de pwɛl, fɔ distrɔy;
Nɔn wɛpɔn we dɛn mek fɔ kil yu, nɔ go wok; ɛn ɛnibɔdi we jɔj yu, yu go pruv am rɔŋ. Dis na wetin go apin to PAPA GƆD in wokman dɛn, ɛn di fri we dɛn fri to mi. Na so PAPA GƆD se.”
E, lɛ ɔlman we tɔsti, kam na di watasay dɛn; ɛn lɛ udat we nɔ gɛt kɔpɔ, kam, bay ɛn it! Kam, bay wayn ɛn milk i lɛk yu nɔ gɛt kɔpɔ ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt prayz.
Wetin du una de spɛnd una kɔpɔ pan tin we nɔto tin fɔ it, ɛn put yu lebɔ pan tin we nɔ de mek yu satisfay? Lisin mi gud gud wan, ɛn it wetin gud, ɛn gladi fɔ dɛn rich it dɛn.
Opin una yes lisin, ɛn kam to mi; una yɛri, mek una go gɛt layf; ɛn a go mek Kɔvinant wit yu we go de sote go, mi tru tru lɛk we nɔ de chenj, we a lɛk Devid.
A dɔn mek am witnɛs to di difrɛn difrɛn pipul dɛn, ɛn di lida ɛn kɔmanda fɔ di pipul dɛm.
A de tɛl yu, yu go sɛn kɔl neshɔn dɛn we una nɔ no, ɛn neshɔn dɛn we nɔ bin no, go rɔn kam to yu, Fɔseka PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd, di Oli Wan na Izrɛl bikɔs I dɔn es una ɔp na wɔl.
PAPA GƆD se “Luk fɔ PAPA GƆD di tɛm we mɔtalman kin ebul fɛn am, pre to am we i de nia;

lɛ wikɛd pɔsin lɛf fɔ du bad, ɛn di pɔsin we nɔ de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, chenj di we we i de tink; mek i tɔn bak go to PAPA GƆD, mek i go sɔri fɔ am, dat na to wi Gɔd, bikɔ i go padin am fɔ ɔltin.
Bikɔs una nɔ de tink di we, we mi de tink, ɛn una nɔ de du tin, di we we mi de du tin, na so PAPA GƆD se.
Bikɔs, lɛk aw di skay ay pas di grɔn, na so di we we a de du tin, ay pas una yon ɛn di we we a de tink, ay pas di we we una de tink.
“Bikɔs lɛk aw ren ɛn sno de fɔdɔm kan dɔŋ kɔmɔt na di skay, ɛn nɔ de go ɔp bak, bɔt de wata di grɔn, de mek tin dɛn bia ɛn gro, de gi sid to di pɔsin we de plant, ɛn tin fɔ it to di wan we de it,
na so mi wɔd we de kɔmɔt na mi mɔt, go bi; i nɔ go tɔn bak kan to mi i nɔ du natin, bɔt i go du wetin a sɛn am fɔ du, ɛn i go do wɛl pan di tin we a sɛn am fɔ go du.
“Bikɔs una go wit gladi, ɛn dɛn go lid una go wit kolat; di mawnten dɛn ɛn di il dɛn we de bifo yu go bɔsawt de siŋ, ɛn ɔl di tik dɛn na di fil go klap dɛn an.
Instɛd ɔf chuk chuk, na Sayprɛs tik go gro, Instɛd ɔf wayl bush, na matul tik go gro; ɛn i go bi tin fɔ tek mɛmba PAPA GƆD, we go bi sayn we go de sote go, ɛn nɔ go ɛva dɔn.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se; “Trit ɔlman di sem ɔltɛm ɛn waka tret na mi yay, bikɔs i nɔ go te igen, mi salveshɔn go kam, ɛn ɔlman go no se a kin sev.
Di man we de du dis go gɛt blɛsin, ɛn di mɔtalman we ol am tayt, dat na di wan we de kip di de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst, ɛn nɔ de bamfa am, ɛn nɔ put an pan ɛni bad tin.”
Lɛ di fɔrina we dɔn jɔyn insɛf to PAPA GƆD nɔ se, “Fɔ tru, PAPA GƆD go sɛpret mi frɔm in pipul dɛn; ɛn lɛ di okobo nɔ se, “Mi na dray tik.”
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Di okobo dɛn we de kip mi de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst, we pik fɔ du di tin dɛn we de mek a gladi ɛn ol mi Kɔvinant tayt,
A go gi dɛn tin fɔ tek mɛmba am ɛn mek i pɔpyula, insay mi os ɛn usay a tap, we bɛtɛ pas bɔypikin ɛn gyal pikin dɛn; A go gi dɛn nem we go de sote go ɛn nɔ go dɔn.
“Ɛn di fɔrina dɛn we jɔyn dɛnsɛf to PAPA GƆD, fɔ sav am, fɔ lɛk PAPA GƆD in nem, ɛn fɔ bi in wokman dɛm, ɔlman we de kip di de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst ɛn nɔ de bamfa am, ɛn ol mi Kɔvinant tayt-

na dɛn a go briŋ kam na mi oli mawnten, ɛn mek dɛn jɔli na mi os we na fɔ pre; a go gri fɔ dɛn sakrifays dɛn we dɛn de bɔn na faya, ɛn dɛn ɔda sakrifays dɛn, na mi ɔlta; bikɔs mi os go bi, os fɔ pre fɔ ɔlman na wɔl.
Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, we de gɛda di Izrɛlayt dɛn we bin de ɛgzayl kam, A go stil gɛda ɔda wan dɛm kam to am apat frɔm dɛn wan dɛn we i dɔn gɛda.”
Una ɔl dɛn bist dɛn na bush, una kam it – una ɔl di bist dɛn na fɔrɛst.
In wachman dɛn blɛn, dɛn ɔl nɔ sabi natin; dɛn ɔl na mumu lɛk dɔg, dɛn nɔ ebul bak; dɛn jɛs de lidɔm, drim, ɛn dɛn lɛk fɔ slip.
Dɔg ebul it bɔku; i nɔ de ɛva du fɔ dɛm. Di shɛpad dɛnsɛf nɔ no natin; dɛn ɔl dɔn go dɛn yon we, ɔlman de du wetin go prɔfit am, ɔlman fɔ insɛf.
Dɛn se, “kam, lɛ wi go drink wayn, lɛ wi bɛlful wit rɔm; ɛn tumara go bi lɛk tide, i go bɛtɛ pas tide sɛf.”

Pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay kin day, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de put am nain at; oli pipul dɛn we de sav Gɔd de go, we nɔbɔdi nɔ de ɔndastand. Bikɔs dɛn kin pul di man we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, kɔmɔt pan waala,
i go gɛt kol at; di wan dɛn we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay lidɔm de blo na dɛn bed dɛn.
Bɔt una kam nia ya, una da wichuman in bɔypikin dɛn, una we bambot man ɛn rare gyal bɔn.
Udat una de tek mek fɔn? Udat una de opin una mɔt wayd pan ɛn pul tɔŋ pan? Una nɔto pikin dɛn we dɛn bɔn insay lɔlɛsnɛs, pikin dɛn we dɛn bɔn insay di siti,
una we de de gɛt filin bad wan fɔ fala uman usay dɛn big tik dɛn de, ɔnda ɔl dɛn grin tik; una we de kil una pikin dɛn na dɛn vali dɛn, ɔnda di say we dɛn big rɔk plit?
Na usay dɛn smut ston dɛn de na dɛn vali, una blant, na dɛm, yɛs na dɛm, na una lɔt; na to dɛn una dɔn mek drink ɔfrin to; una dɔn briŋ sid ɔfrin. Mi at go kol fɔ dɛn kayn tin dɛn ya?
Na pantap di ay ay mawnten yu dɔn mek yu bad; 2 ɛn na de yu bin go mek yu sakrifays.

Na biɛn di do ɛn di do domɔt yu dɔn put yu sayn; bikɔs yu abandɔn mi, yu dɔn pul yu bedshit, yu dɔn go ɔp to am yu dɔn mek i wayd, yu dɔn bagin fɔ yusɛf wit dɛn, yu dɔn lɛd dɛn bed, yu dɔn si nekɛdnɛs.
Yu bin patrol go to Mɔlɛk wit ɔyl ɛn ad pan yu pafyum dɛm; yu sɛn ambasedɔ dɛn go fafawe, ɛn sɛn dɛnsɛf go dɔŋ na ɛl.
Yu bin taya wit di laŋa we di rod lɔŋa bɔt yu nɔ bin se, “Dis oplɛs”; yu bin fɛn nyu layf fɔ yu trɛnk ɛn so yu nɔ bin taya.
Udat yu de fred bad bad wan so, we yu bin lay, ɛn nɔ bin mɛmba mi, we mek yu nɔ tink bɔt mi? A nɔ dɔn sɛt mi mɔt, fɔ lɔŋ tɛm naw, ɛn so yu nɔ de fred mi?
A go tɔk bɔt di waka we yu de waka tret na mi yay ɛn di tin dɛn we yu de du, bɔt dɛn nɔ go ɛp yu.
We yu ala lɛ yu bɔku laylay gɔd dɛn sev yu! Di briz go kɛr dɛn go, Wangren wit mɔt go kɛr dɛn go. Bɔt di wan we de kam to mi fɔ protɛkshɔn, nain di land go blant, ɛn go inɛrit ɔl mi oli mawnten dɛn.
Ɛn dɛn go se, “Bil am, yɛs, bil am, rɛdi di rod, pul ɔltin we de blɔk dɛm kɔmɔt usay mi pipul dɛn fɔ pas.”

Bikɔs na dis di ay ɛn mayti wan we tap na itaniti, we in nem na Oli, se: “A tap na di ay ɛn oli ples, wit di wan we i gɛt sɔri ɛn ɔmbul spirit, fɔ gi layf bak to di ɔmbul pɔsin in spirit, ɛn fɔ gi layf bak to di sɔri pɔsin in at
Bikɔs a nɔ go fɛt te go ɛn nɔ go de vɛks ɔltɛm; bikɔs na mi di spirit de kɔmɔt to; ɛn a dɔn mek di lo blo blo we gi layf.
Fɔseka di sin we i kɔmit we i de milɛ pipul, a bin vɛks, so a pɔnish am, a ayd mi fes ɛn a bin veks; bɔt i stil bin de bakslayd we i de du wetin in at tɛl am.
A dɔn no aw i de biev, bɔt a go mɛn am; a go lid am ɛn pe am bak wit kɔnfɔt, de mek di wan dɛn we de sɔri fɔ am gɛt di pemɛnt fɔ wetin de kɔmɔt na mɔt.
PAPA GƆD se, pis, yɛs, lɛ di wan we de fa ɛn di wan we de nia gɛt pis; ɛn a go mɛn am.
Bɔt wikɛd pɔsin na lɛk di si, we i de tɔn tɔn bikɔs i nɔ ebul blo, ɛn in wata dɛn de sɛn pɔtɔ pɔtɔ ɛn dɔti ɔp,
Mi Gɔd se, Pis nɔ de fɔ wikɛd pipul.”
Ala lawd wan, nɔ sɛt yu mɔt, ala lawd wan lɛk trɔmpɛt; tɛl mi pipul dɛn di brok we dɛn dɔn brok mi lɔ tɛl Jekɔb in os bɔt dɛn sin dɛm.

Bɔt dɛn de luk fɔ mi ɛvride, ɛn dɛn kin gladi fɔ no bɔt mi, lɛk se dɛn na neshɔn we de waka tret na mi yay ɛn nɔ bin abandɔn dɛn Gɔd in lɔ dɛm; dɛn de aks mi nɔ fɔ tek nɔbɔdi pat pan jɔjmɛnt, dɛn de gladi fɔ kam nia Gɔd.

“Wetin mek wi dɔn fast, ɛn yu mek lɛk yu nɔ no? Wetin mek wi dɔn ɔmbul wisɛf ɛn yu mek lɛk yu nɔ no bɔt dat?” Luk, di tɛm we una kin de fast una kin de fala una yon ɛnjɔymɛnt; ɛn aras ɔl una wokman dɛn.
A de tɛl una, una kin fast fɔ mek plaba ɛn fɛt nɔmɔ ɛn fɔ bɔks pipul wit una wikɛd an. Dɛn una kayn fast dɛn tɛm ya nɔ go mek a yɛri una prea.
Na dis kayn fast a pik, fɔ mek pɔsin ɔmbul insɛf wande? Na fɔ mek i butu in ed lɛk dɛn ay gras, ɛn fɔ prɛd saklɔth ɛn put asis ɔnda am? Yu go kɔl dis fast, ɛn de we PAPA GƆD go gri fɔ?
“Nɔto di fast dis we a pik: fɔ lus di rop dɛn we dɛn tek tay pipul wit wikɛdnɛs, fɔ lus di prɔblɛm dɛn we dɛn tay na pipul dɛn nɛk, lɛ dɛn lɛf fɔ aras pipul, ɛn fɔ tap fɔ trit pipul bad?
Nɔto fɔ sheb yu it wit udat aŋri, ɛn briŋ di po man we nɔ gɛt say fɔ tap, kam na yu os; we yu si di wan we nɔ gɛt klos, fɔ gi am klos, ɛn nɔ fɔ de ayd pan yu fambul dɛm?
Na datɛnde yu layt go shayn lɛk ali mɔnin layt, ɛn yu wɛlbɔdi go kam wit spid; na di waka we yu de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, ɔlman go no yu fɔ, ɛn na PAPA GƆD in glori go de gyad yu bak.
Datɛnde, yu go kɔl PAPA GƆD ɛn I go ansa; yu go kray to am, ɛn i go se, Luk Mi na ya. “If yu pul una prɔblɛm dɛn kɔmɔt na una ed we na pɔynt finga ɛn bad at,
if yu gi yusɛf fɔ aŋri pipul ɛn gi di wan we de sɔfa, wetin i want, na datɛnde yu layt go sho na dak ɛn usay dak na yu layf go brayt lɛk twɛlv oklɔk santɛm.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD go gyad yu ɔltɛm, ɛn satisfay yu at wit gud tin dɛn, ɛn go mek yu bon dɛn tɔŋ; ɛn yu go tan lɛk gadin we dɛn de wata, lɛk wata we de bɔs kɔmɔt ɔnda grɔn, we in wata nɔ de dray.

Ɛn dɛn go bil ɔl dɛn ol ol broko ples dɛn bak; ɛn una go de le fawndeshɔn we bɔku lɔntɛm jɛnareshɔn dɛn nɔ bin le; ɛn dɛn go kɔl una, di wan dɛn we de ripia ɔl usay bin brok na di wɔl, ɛn di wan dɛn we ripia trit dɛn, we pipul go tap.

If yu rɛspɛkt di de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst de ɛn nɔ du wetin yu lɛk fɔ du na mi oli de, ɛn kɔl di de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst we, de we yu gladi fɔ, ɛn kɔl di de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst, tɛn we una gladi fɔ ɛn PAPA GƆD in oli de, de we fɔ ɔna; if yu ɔna am, ɛn nɔ du wetin yu want fɔ du, ɔl fala yu yon ɛnjɔymɛnt, ɔ de tɔk aydul tɔk;
na datɛnde yu go gladi fɔ de wit, PAPA GƆD, ɛn a go mek dɛn rɛspɛkt yu ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl; yu go ɛnjɔy di tin dɛn we blant yu dadi Jekɔb, bikɔs na PAPA GƆD dɔn opin mɔt tɔk am.
Luk, PAPA GƆD in an nɔ shɔt fɔ mek I nɔ ebul sev; ɔ in yes nɔ kɔk we I nɔ go ebul yɛri;
bɔt una sin dɛn dɔn mek sɛpreshɔn bitwin una ɛn una Gɔd, ɛn una sin dɛn dɔn ayd in fes pan una we mek I nɔ de yɛri.
Bikɔs una an dɛn dɔti wit blɔd ɛn yu fiŋa dɛn, wit sin; una lip dɛn dɔn tɔk laylay tɔk dɛn, dɔn una tɔŋ de tɔk wikɛd wikɛd tin dɛn.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de kɛr pɔsin go kot we i nɔ gɛt bakin, nɔbɔdi nɔ de kɛr pɔsin go kot ɔnɛs wan; dɛn kin abop pan ɛmti pli, ɛn kin lay, dɛn kin plan na dɛn maynd fɔ du bad, bɔt na sin dɛn kin kɔmit
Dɛn ach snek eg dɛn, dɛn wiv spayda wɛb; udat it dɛn eg go day, ɛn pan wan we dɛn brok, na pikin snek de kɔmɔt.
Pɔsin nɔ go ebul wɛr spaydawɛb fɔ klos ɛn mɔtalman nɔ go ebul kɔba insɛf wit wetin dɛn kin mek. Dɛn wok dɛn na sinful wok ɛn na fɔ du bad de na dɛn an.
Dɛn de rɔn fɔ go du bad, ɛn de mekes fɔ shɛd inosɛnt blɔd; na fɔ kɔmit sin nɔmɔ de na dɛn at, na ɛmtinɛs, ɛn fɔ distrɔy, de na dɛn ay we dɛn.
Dɛn nɔ no di rod fɔ fɛn kolat, ɛn jɔstis nɔ de na dɛn pan ɔl wetin dɛn de du; dɛn dɔn mek dɛn rod dɛn bɛn bɛn, ɛn nɔbɔdi we de wit dɛn, nɔ gɛt kolat.
Fɔseka dat, jɔstis nɔ de nia wi, ɛn fɔ waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, nɔ de rich wi; we luk fɔ layt, bɔt na daknɛs wi si, ɛn fɔ braytnɛs, bɔt na dak wi de waka.
Wi de fil fil di wɔl dɛn lɛk blɛn yay, waka de fil fil lɛk dɛn wan we nɔ gɛt yay; we de bɔkfut sansan tɛm lɛk aw dɛn de bɔk fut na nɛt, we wi de wit dɛn wan we get ɛnaji, wi kin tan lɛk dayman.
Wi ɔl de grɔmbul lɛk dɛn dɔg, wi de pini, ɛn pini lɛk dɔv; we de luk fɔ jɔstis, bɔt i nɔ de; fɔ salveshɔn sɛf, bɔt i de fa frɔm wi.
Bikɔs wi sin dɛn bɔku bifo yu, ɛn wi sin dɛn dɔn tɔk agens wi; bikɔs wi sin dɛn de wit wi, ɛn wi no wi sin dɛn:
fɔ kɔmit sin, ɛn de dinay PAPA GƆD, ɛn tɔn kɔmɔt, lɛf fɔ fala wi Gɔd, de tɔk aw fɔ sɔprɛs pipul ɛn fɔ ribɛl, de plan na dɛn maynd, ɛn de tɔk laylay wɔd kɔmɔt na wi at.
Dɛn dɔn drɛb Jɔstis go bak, ɛn, fɔ waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, in tinap fawe; tru in dɔn fɔdɔm na dɛn pɔblik skwaya dɛn, ɛn sobanɛs in nɔ ebul go insay.
Tru nɔ de igen, ɛn di wan we lɛf wikɛdnɛs, de mek insɛf pɔsin we dɛn fɔ du bad to. PAPA GƆD bin si am, ɛn I nɔ bin pliz we nɔn jɔstis nɔ de.
I si se pɔsin nɔ bin de, ɛn i wɔnda se nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ put mɔt de, na datɛnde, in yon an mek i gɛt viktri, ɛn in raychɔsnɛs mek i ebul tinap.
I wɛr raychɔsnɛs fɔ brɛsplet, ɛn wan ɛlmɛt ɔf salveshɔn, nain ed; I wɛr gamɛnt ɔf vɛnjɛns, fɔ in klos, ɛn rap insɛf insay bad bad vɛksteshɔn, fɔ ovakot.
Na akɔdin to wetin dɛn du, i go pe dɛn bak, vɛksteshɔn fɔ di wan dɛn we de agens am, ɛn i go sho lɔv to in ɛnimi dɛn; i go sho lɔv to di kɔntri dɛn we de nia di si.
So dɛn go fred PAPA GƆD in nem na di wɛst, ɛn in glori kɔmɔt usay di san de rayz; bikɔs I go kam lɛk watasay we di wata de rɔn wit spid, we na PAPA GƆD in briz de push am.
“Ɛn I go kam na Zayɔn fɔ sev pipul, fɔ dɛn wan dɛn na Jekɔb we tap fɔ kɔmit sin. Na so PAPA GƆD se.

“PAPA GƆD se, “As fɔ mi, dis na mi Kɔvinant wit dɛm: mi spirit we de pan yu ɛn mi wɔd we a dɔn put na yu mɔt, nɔ go kɔmɔt na yu mɔt, i nɔ go kɔmɔt na yu pikin dɛm mɔt, ɔ dɛn yon pikin pikin dɛn mɔt. Na so PAPA GƆD se, frɔm naw, ɛn sote go.”
Grap ɛn shayn; bikɔs yu layt dɔn kam, ɛn PAPA GƆD in glori dɔn kam pan yu.
Bikɔs, daknɛs go kɔba di wanol wɔl, ɛn tik daknɛs go kɔba di neshɔn dɛm; bɔt PAPA GƆD go kam pan yu, ɛn dɛn go si in glori pan yu.
Neshɔn dɛm go kam to yu layt, ɛn kiŋ dɛn to di brayt layt we go de sho pan yu.
Es yu yay ɔp luk rawnd yu, lɛ yu si fɔ yusɛf; dɛn ɔl dɔn gɛda togɛda, dɛn kam to yu; Yu bɔypikin dɛn go kɔmɔt fawe kam, ɛn dɛn go tot yu gyal pikin dɛn na an.
Dɔn yu go si ɛn go shayn, yu at go pliz ɛn gladi pasmak, bikɔs dɛn go gi yu di beberebe tin dɛn we de na di si, di neshɔn dɛn jɛntri go kam to yu.
Nɔto kɔmɔn kamɛl go ful yu land, yɔŋ kamɛl dɛn na Midian ɛn Ɛfa; ɔl dɛn wan dɛm na Shiba go kam. Dɛn go briŋ gold ɛn churay, ɛn dɛn go anawns PAPA GƆD in prez.
Dɛn go gɛda ɔl Kɛda in got ɛn ship dɛn kan to yu, di manship dɛn na Nɛbayɔth, go sav yu; dɛn go kam ɔp na mi ɔlta ɛn a go gri fɔ dɛm, ɛn a go mek dis mi os we gɛt glori gɛt mɔ glori.
Udat dɛn wan ya we de flay lɛk klawd, ɛn lɛk dɔv dɛn we de flay go na dɛn winda?

Bikɔs dɛn kɔntri dɛn we de na di si, go wet fɔ mi, Tashish in ship dɛn fɔs, fɔ briŋ yu bɔypikin dɛn kɔmɔt fa, ɛn dɛn silva ɛn gold kam wit dɛn, fɔseka PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd, in nem; ɛn fɔ di Oli Wan na Izrɛl, bikɔs, i dɔn mek yu de shayn.
Fɔrina dɛn go bil yu wɔl dɛm, ɛn dɛn kiŋ dɛn go sav yu; bikɔs na we a vɛks a bin bit yu, bɔt bikɔs a fevɔ yu, a bin dɔn fɔgiv yu.
Yu get dɛn go opin ɔltɛm; de ɛn nɛt, dɛn nɔ go lɔk; so dat pipul dɛn go briŋ dɛn neshɔn dɛn jɛntri kam to yu, wit dɛn kiŋ dɛn ɔl na di prosɛshɔn.
Bikɔs di neshɔn ɛn di kindɔm we nɔ gri sav, yu go pɛrish; Dɛn neshɔn de go distrɔy kpatakpata.
Libanɔn in glori go kam to yu, di sayprɛs tik, plen tik ɛn payn tik, fɔ kam byutifay di ples fɔ wɔship mi; ɛn a go mek di ples fɔ mi fut gɛt glori.
Dɛn wan dɛn we bin de sɔprɛs yu, dɛn bɔypikin dɛn go kam de dɔbalɛ to yu, ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we nɔ tek yu mek natin go butu na yu fut; dɛn go kɔl yu, PAPA GƆD in Siti, di Oli Wan na Izrɛl in Zayɔn.
Pan ɔl we dɛn bin dɔn fɔsek yu, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de pas insay yu, A go mek yu lɛk kiŋ sote go, ples fɔ gladi fɔ, insay ɔl di jɛnareshɔn dɛn.
Yu go sɔk dɛn neshɔn dɛn milk, yu go sɔk kiŋ dɛn bɔbi; ɛn yu go no se Mi, na PAPA GƆD, mi na yu seviɔ ɛn yu Ridima, Jekɔb in Mayti Wan.
Usay na bras, a go briŋ gold, ɛn usay na ayɛn, a go briŋ silva; usay na wud, bras, usay na ston, ayɛn. A go mek kol at bi yu ovasia dɛn, ɛn raychɔsnɛs, bi di wan dɛn we de gi pipul wok fɔ du.
Dɛn nɔ go yɛri bɔt fɛt fɛt na yu land igen, wahala ɛn distrɔkshɔn nɔ go de insay yu bɔda dɛn igen; yu go kɔl yu wɔl dɛn, Salveshɔn, ɛn kɔl yu get dɛn, prez.
Dis san nɔ go gi yu layt igen de tɛm, fɔ mek di ples brayt di mun sɛf nɔ go sho yu layt na nɛt; bɔt na PAPA GƆD go bi yu layt we go las sote go, ɛn yu Gɔd go bi yu glori.
Yu san nɔ go go dɔŋ igen, ɛn yu mun sɛf naɔ go ayd insɛf; bikɔs na PAPA GƆD go bi yu layt we go las sote go, ɛn yu tɛm fɔ fil sɔri, go tap.
Yu pipul dɛn ɔl go waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay; di land go blant dɛn sote go, di yɔŋ wan dɛn we bɔs pan di plant we plant, di tin dɛn we na misɛf du, mek a go gɛt glori.
Di las wan go bi ɛkstɛndɛd famili, ɛn di wan we smɔl pas ɔl go bi wan big big neshɔn; Mi na PAPA GƆD; we di tɛm rich, A go mekes du am.

Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd in Spirit de pan mi, bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn anɔynt mi fɔ briŋ gud yus to di wan dɛn we de sɔfa; I dɔn sɛn mi fɔ mɛn dɛn wan we gɛt brok at, fɔ anawns to dɛn wan we dɛn bin dɔn kapchɔ, se, dɛn dɔn fri, fɔ opin di jel yad fɔ di wan dɛn we dɛn tay;
fɔ anawns se dis na di ia fɔ PAPA GƆD in fevɔ, ɛn di de we wi Gɔd go rivɛnj; fɔ koks ɔl udat at de blid;

fɔ gi dɛn wan dɛn na Zayɔn we dɛn at de blid– fɔ gi dɛn galans instɛd ɔf ashis, gladi gladi ɔyl, instɛd ɔf at we de blid, Prez ova kot instɛd ɔf taya bɔdi; so dat dɛn go kɔl dɛn di kɔtintri fɔ waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, di tin we PAPA GƆD plant, mek I go gɛt glori.
Dɛn go bil dɛn ol ol ples we bin dɔn brok brok, dɛn go bil na say dɛn we bin dɔn pwɛl pwɛl bad bad wan; dɛn go mek di siti dɛn we bin dɔn pwɛl bak, we bin dɔn pwɛl bad bad wan lɔlɔntɛm.
Trenja dɛm go tinap fid una ship ɛn got dɛm, Fɔrina dɛn go dig una fam ɛn sibɔt una greps gadin dɛm;
Bɔt dɛn go kɔl una PAPA GƆD in man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛm, pipul dɛn go tɔk bɔt una se una na wi GƆD in minista dɛm; una go it di neshɔn dɛn jɛntri, ɛn una go ɛnjɔy insay dɛn jɛntri.
Bifo una shem, na dɔbul blɛsin una go gɛt, Bifo una disgres, na gladi una go jɛs de gladi; gladi pan wetin na dɛn yon; fɔseka dat, na dɔbul blɛsin una go gɛt na una land ɛn una gladi go de sote go.
Bikɔs, mi we na PAPA GƆD lɛk jɔstis, A et tif ɛn fɔ de du rɔŋ tin; A go mɔs pe dɛn bak, ɛn a go mek Kɔvinant we go de sote go, wit dɛm.
Dɛn go no dɛn jɛnareshɔn dɛn na di neshɔn dɛm, ɛn di difrɛn difrɛn pipul dɛm na di wɔl, go no dɛn pikin dɛm; ɔl udat si dɛm go no dɛn se, na dɛn na di pipul dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn blɛs.

A go gladi ebi ebi wan fɔ PAPA GƆD, mi sol go es mi Gɔd ɔp; bikɔs i dɔn wɛr salveshɔn klos pan mi, I dɔn kɔba mi wit raychɔsnɛs gawn, lɛk aw dɛn ɔkɔ kin put plɛnti plɛnti galans pan insɛf, ɛn lɛk we yawo kin drɛs insɛf wit in riŋ ɛn chen dɛm.
Bikɔs, lɛk aw yɔŋ plant de bɔs kɔmɔt na grɔn, ɛn lɛk aw gadin de mek wetin dɛn plant insay am, bɔs kam ɔp, na so Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd go mek raychɔsnɛs ɛn prez bɔs bifo ɔl di neshɔn dɛm.
Fɔseka Zayɔn a nɔ go sɛt mɔt, ɛn a nɔ go blo fɔseka Jerusɛlɛm, te di pul we dɛn pul dɛn ed kɔmɔt, kam na do lɛk mɔnin, ɛn di fri we i dɔn fri tan lɛk brayt layt.
Di wanol wɔl go si se dɛn dɔn pul yu ed kɔmɔt, ɛn ɔl di kiŋ dɛn go si di shayn we una de shayn; ɛn dɛn go gi yu nyu nem we na PAPA GƆD in sɛf sɛf go gi una.
Una go tan lɛk fayn fayn krawn na PAPA GƆD in an, ɛn lɛk kiŋ krawn na yu Gɔd in an.

Dɛn nɔ go kɔl yu, di wan we dɛn lɛf to insɛf igen, ɛn dɛn nɔ go kɔl yu land, ɛmti land igen; Bɔt dɛn go kɔl yu, Na yu mi at de gladi fɔ, ɛn dɛn go kɔl yu land, Mared land; bikɔs PAPA GƆD lɛk yu, ɛn yu land go mared.
Bikɔs, lɛk aw yɔŋnam go mared vajingyal, na so yu bɔypikin dɛn go mared yu, ɛn lɛk aw ɔkɔ kin gladi fɔ yawo, na so yu Gɔd go gladi fɔ yu.
E Jerusɛlɛm, na pantap yu wɔl dɛn, A dɔn put wachman dɛm; ol de, ol nɛt dɛn nɔ go ɛva kwayɛt.. Yu we de mek PAPA GƆD de mɛmba. Nɔ blo atɔl,
ɛn nɔ mek I blo sote i mek Jerusɛlɛm tinap ɛn mek am wan we fɔ prez na dis wɔl.
PAPA GƆD dɔn swɛ wit in raytan ɛn wit in pawaful an se: “A nɔ go give una ɛnimi dɛn yu it fɔ it igen, ɛn fɔrina dɛn nɔ go drink una wayn we yu lebɔ fɔ;
bɔt na di wan dɛn we avɛst am, go it am ɛn prez PAPA GƆD, ɛn di wan dɛn we gɛda am, go drink am na di kɔtyad dɛn na mi oli ples fɔ wɔship.”
Pas go, pas na di get go, rɛdi di rod fɔ di pipul dɛn; una bil di men rod, una bil am, klia di ston ston dɛm kɔmɔt pan am, es bana ɔp oba di pipul dɛm.
“A de tɛl yu, PAPA GƆD dɔn anawns to di las kɔna na wɔl: Tɛl Zayɔn in gyal pikin dɛn se “Biliv mi, una salveshɔn de kam; biliv mi, in riwɔd de wit am, ɛn in pe de bifo am.
Ɛn dɛn go kɔl dɛm Di oli pipul, Di wan dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn pe fɔ; ɛn dɛn go kɔl yu, Di wan we dɛn de luk fɔ, siti we dɛn nɔ lɛf to insɛf.
Udat dis we kɔmɔt Bozra Siti na Idɔm, wit rɛd klos, yu we fayn fɔ luk na yu klos, we de mach wit pawa? “Na Mi we pawaful fɔ sev pipul de anawns se pɔsin dɔn fri.
Wetindu yu klos rɛd, ɛn yu klos tan lɛk udat de mas greps fɔ mek wayn?

“Mi wangren dɔn mas mas di say we dɛn de mek wayn, ɛn nɔbɔdi pan di pipul dɛn nɔ bin de wit mi; A waka dɛm wit wamat ɛn mas mas dɛn wit vɛksteshɔn; dɛn blɔd we de gi dɛn layf sprinkul pan mi klos, a dɔn sten ɔl wetin a wɛr.
Bikɔs di de fɔ rivɛnj bin de na mi at, ɛn di ia fɔ ridim pipul dɔn kam.
A luk fɔ pɔsin fɔ ɛp mi, bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de; A bin shɔk, bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ sɔpɔt mi; so na mi yon an gi mi viktri, ɛn na mi vɛksteshɔn sɔpɔt mi.
A mas mas difrɛn difrɛn pipul dɛn wit wamat, A nyakanyaka dɛn we a vɛks, ɛn a trowe dɛn blɔd we de gi dɛn layf, na grɔn.”

A go tɔk bɔt PAPA GƆD in lɔv we nɔ de chenj, PAPA GƆD in prez, bay ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD dɔn gi wi, ɛn di wɔndaful gud we i gud to Izrɛl we I du fɔ dɛn bikɔs i sɔri fɔ dɛm, bay aw in lɔv we nɔ de chenj, de abɔmpa.
Bɔkɔs I se, Fɔ tru tru, dɛn na mi pipul dɛn, bɔy pik dɛn we nɔ go ple yuki yuki; ɛn I kam bi dɛn seviɔ.
Insay ɔl dɛn siknɛs, insɛf bin sik, ɛn di enjɛl we kin de ɔlsay we i de, bin sev dɛm; na wit lɔv ɛn di sɔri we i de sɔri fɔ dɛn mek i ridim dɛm; I es dɛn ɛn tot ɔl dɛn lɔntɛm dez dɛm.
Bɔt dɛn tɔn agens am ɛn mek di oli spirit vɛks; so, i kan tɔn fɔ bi dɛn ɛnimi, ɛn insɛf fɛt dɛm.
Naim I mɛmba di lɔntɛm we Mozis na bin in wokman, We di pɔsin we pul di ship dɛn shɛpad dɛn kɔmɔt insay di si? We di wan we put in oli Spirit pan dɛm,
we mek in pawaful an fɔ go na Mozis in raytan, we sheb di Si bifo dɛm fɔ mek nem we go de sote go, fɔ insɛf,
di wan we pas dɛn na di dip dip si? Lɛ we ɔs kin stɛdi na di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap, na so dɛn nɔ shek wan.
Lɛk we kaw dɛn kin de go dɔŋ dɛn vali, na so PAPA GƆD in spirit bin mek dɛn rɛst. Na so yu bin lid yu pipul dɛn fɔ mek big nem fɔ yusɛf.
Luk dɔn kɔmɔt na yu, oli ɛn gloriɔs ples we yu tap. We yu zil ɛn yu pawa? Di want we yu kin wan fɔ si pɔsin na yu at, ɛn di sɔri we yu de sɔri fɔ pɔsin nɔ de na yu at fɔ mi igen
Na yu na wi Papa ɔlwe Ebram nɔ no wi ɛn Izrɛl nɔ gri se wi ɔl na wan; PAPA GƆD, na yu na wi Papa, Na Wi Lɔntɛm Ridima na yu nem
E PAPA GƆD, wetin mek yu de mek wi lɛf wetin yu se, de du ɔda tin ɛn traŋa wi at, so dat wi nɔ go fred yu? Tɔn yu at bak to wi fɔseka yu wokman dɛm, fɔseka di trayb we na yu yon pipul dɛm.
Yu oli ples bin blant yu oli pipul dɛn lili wayl; wi ɛnimi dɛn dɔn mas mas am brok kan dɔŋ.
Wi dɔn tɔn lɛk dɛn wan we yu nɔ ɛva rul bifo, lɛk dɛn wan we nɔ gɛt yu nem.
Aw a wish se yu go chɛr di skay dɛn ɛn kam dɔŋ, so di mawnten dɛn shek we dɛn si yu-
lɛk we faya kin layt dray tik ɛn lɛk we faya kin mek wata bwɛl – so yu ɛnimi dɛn go no udat yu bi, ɛn lɛ di neshɔn dɛn go trimbul bikɔs yu de!
We yu bin du fiaful fiaful tin dɛm we wi nɔ de ɛkspɛkt Yu kin kam dɔŋ, ɛn di mawnten dɛn kin shek bifo yu.
Frɔm di wɔl bigin, nɔbɔdi nɔ yɛri ɔ ɔndastand wit in yes, nɔn yay nɔ si ɛni ɔda Gɔd apat frɔm yu, we de wok fɔ dɛn wan we biliv am.

Yu de tɛl di wan dɛn we de waka tret na yu yay, kɔba, dɛm wan dɛm we de mɛmba yu bay we dɛn de du wetin yu se dɛn fɔ de du. Wan tɛm, yu bin vɛks, ɛn wi bin kɔmit sin; wi dɔn de insay wi sin fɔ lɔng, ɛn ɛnibɔdi go sev wi?
We ɔl dɔn tan lɛk pɔsin we nɔ klin na Gɔd yay, ɛn ɔl di tin dɛn we wi de du se wi de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, tan lɛk smɛl dɔti klos. Wi ɔl de fed lɛk lif, ɛn wi sin dɛn de kɛr wi go lɛk briz.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we de pre to yu, we de stren insɛf fɔ go grip yu; bikɔs yu dɔn ayd yu fes pan wi, ɛn yu dɔn put wi na wi sin dɛn an.
Pan ɔl dat, PAPA GƆD, na yu na wi Papa; wi na di kle, ɛn na yu na di man we de wok wit kle; wi ɔl na yu wok we yu du wit yu an.
Nɔ vɛks pasmak O PAPA GƆD, ɛn nɔ mɛmba sin sote go. Duya, tink gud, wi ɔl na yu pipul dɛm.
Yu oli siti dɛn dɔn tɔn dray ɛn ɛmti ples, Zayɔn dɔn tɔn dray ɛm ɛmti ples, Jerusɛlɛm in na ples we nɔbɔdi nɔ de.
Wi oli ɛn fayn fayn os, usay wi papa dɛn bin de prez yu, faya dɔn bɔn am, ɛn ɔl di fayn fayn ples dɛn dɔn broko broko.
Yu go ol yu at pan dɛn kayn tin ya PAPA GƆD? Yu go sɛt mɔt ɛn de wund wi bad bad wan?
A bin rɛdi fɔ lɛ dɛn wan dɛn we nɔ aks fɔ mi, fɛn fɛn mi; A bin dɔn rɛdi fɔ lɛ dɛn wan dɛn we nɔ luk fɔ mi, fɛn mi. A bin se, “Luk mi na ya, luk mi na ya,” to di neshɔn we nɔ de pre to mi.
Ol de, a de opin mi an to pipul dɛn we dɔn tɔn dɛn bak pan mi, pipul dɛn we de du di tin dɛn we gud, bɔt de fala wetin dɛn at tɛl dɛm;
pipul dɛn we de provok mi bifo mi fes, ɔltɛm, de mek sakrifays na dɛn gadin dɛm ɛn de bɔn insɛns pantap blɔk;
pipul dɛn we de sidɔm pantap dɛn grev ɛn pas di nɛt na sikrit ples dɛm; de it ɔg bif, ɛn na sup we dɛn tek dɛn bad bad tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk de na dɛn pɔt ɛn pan dɛm.
Pipul dɛn we de se, “Kip to yusɛf, nɔ kam nia mi, bikɔs a tu oli fɔ yu.” Dɛn tin ya na smok na mi nos ol, ɛn faya we de bɔn ol de.
A de tɛl yu, i rayt bifo mi: “I nɔ go sɛt mɔt, bɔt a go tɔn am gi dɛn, yɛs, a go tɔn am gi dɛm na dɛn buzɔm,
dɛn sin ɛn dɛn papa dɛn sin togɛda, bikɔs dɛn bɔn insɛns na dɛn mawnten ɛn fityay mi na dɛn il, A go mɛnshɔ di pe fɔ di tin dɛn we dɛn bin dɔn du put na dɛn buzɔm. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Lɛk we wayn de na bɔnch greps ɛn dɛn kin se, “Nɔ pwɛl am, bikɔs blɛsin de pan am,’ na so a go du fɔseka mi wokman, ɛn nɔ nyakanyaka dɛn ɔl.
A go briŋ Jekɔb in pikin pikin dɛm ɛn di wan dɛn na di Juda fambul we go gɛt mi mawnten, kam na di wan dɛn we pik go gɛt am, ɛn na mi wokman dɛn go tap de.
Sharɔn go tɔn say we ship ɛn got de it gras ɛn Eko vali go tɔn ples fɔ kaw fɔ lidɔm fɔ mi pipul dɛn we dɔn de fɛn mi.
Bɔt una we dɔn fɔsek PAPA GƆD, we dɔn fɔgɛt mi oli mawten, we sɛt tebul fɔ Tumara Jɛntri ɛn ful kɔp dɛn wit dɛm miksɔp wayn fɔ Dɛstini;

A go mek, fɔ lɛ dɛn kil una, bi yu dɛstini, ɛn una ɔl go gri lɛ dɛn kil una; bikɔs, wɛn a bin kɔl una, una nɔ bin ansa, we a bin tɔk, una nɔ bin lisin, bɔt una du bad bad tin dɛn na mi yay, ɛn pik fɔ du tin dɛn we a nɔ go gladi fɔ.”

Fɔseka dat, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: “A de tɛl una, mi wokman dɛn go it, bɔt una go de aŋri wan; biliv mi, mi wokman dɛm go gɛt tin fɔ drink, bɔt una go tɔsti; mi wokman dɛn go de gladi, bɔt dɛn go mek una shem;
A de tɛl una, mi wokman dɛn go siŋ bikɔ dɛn at gladi, bɔt una go ala de kray fɔseka di pen we de na una at, ɛn una go kray fɔseka di pen na una spirit.
Una nem go lɛf to mi pipul we a dɔn pik, fɔ tek kɔs pɔsin, ɛn Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd go kil una; bɔt I go kɔl in wokman dɛn difrɛn nem.

So dat ɛnibɔdi we blɛs insɛf na di land go tek di Gɔd we de waka tret, blɛs insɛf ɛn ɛnibɔdi we de swɛ na di land go swɛ to di Gɔd we de waka tret; bikɔs a dɔn fɔgɛt di trɔbul dɛn we dɔn pas ɛn dɛn dɔn ayd pan mi.
A mek nyu skay ɛn nyu wɔl; ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go mɛmba di fɔstɛm tin dɛm ɔ ivin kam na dɛn maynd.
Bɔt una gladi ɛn mek gladi gladi sote go bikɔs ɔf wetin a mek; bikɔs, a de tɛl una, a go mek Jerusɛlɛm ples fɔ gladi gladi, ɛn in pipul dɛm go bi pipul dɛn we gladi ɔltɛm.
A go gladi fɔ Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn gladi fɔ mi pipul dɛm; no mɔ dɛn nɔ go yɛri kray kray ɛn brokat kray insay de.

Pipul de rɔn wata na yay, ɛn trɔbul kray; fɔ lɛ pikin liv fɔ tu tri de ɛn day ɔ lɛ ol pɔsin day bifo in tɛm, nɔ go bi insay de igen, bikɔs pikin go ol ɔndrɛd ia bifo i day ɛn dɛn go si di wan we day bifo i ol ɔndrɛd se, i gɛt swɛ.
Dɛn go bil os ɛn tap pan dɛm; dɛn go plant greps fam ɛn it di frut.

Dɛn nɔ go bil, ɔda pɔsin go tap de; dɛn nɔ go plant, ɔda pɔsin go it; bikɔs, na lɛk aw tik de te na wɔl, na so mi pipul dɛn go liv lɔŋ, ɛn mi pipul dɛn we a dɔn pik go ɛnjɔy wetin dɛn wok fɔ, fɔ lɔng.
Dɛn nɔ go lebɔ fɔ natin, ɔ bɔn pikin we go briŋ waala; bikɔs dɛn go bi sid dɛm we PAPA GƆD dɔn blɛs, dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛm.
Bifo dɛn de pre to mi, a go dɔn ansa, as dɛn de tɔk so, a dɔn yɛri.
Di wulf ɛn di ship pikin go it togɛda, di layɔn go it dray gras lɛk kaw; ɛn na dɔti go bi snek in it. Dɛn nɔ go wund ɔ kil nɔbɔdi na ɔl mi oli mawten dɛm. Na so PAPA GƆD se.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Ɛvin na mi tron ɛn di ath na mi fut rɛst: uskayn os una go bil fɔ mi, ɛn uskayn ples a go tap?
PAPA GƆD se, Ɔl dɛn tin ya na mi mek dɛm, so ɔl dɛn tin ya na mi yon. Bɔt na dis kayn man a go luk to, man we ɔmbul ɛn de ripɛnt ɛn de trimbul we dɛn yɛri mi wɔd.

“Di pɔsin we de kil kaw na lɛk pɔsin we kil mɔtalman; pɔsin we de sakrifays ship pikin na lɛk udat brok dɔg nɛk; pɔsin we de mek sid ɔfrin na lɛk pɔsin we de sakrifays ɔg blɔd; pɔsin we de mek sakrifays wit insɛns fɔ mɛmba wetin bin dɔn bi, na lɛk pɔsin we de blɛs lay lay gɔd. Dɛn dɔn pik dɛn yon we, we dɛn want fɔ de, dɛn sol de gladi fɔ du dɛn bad bad tin dɛm we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk.
Misɛf igen go pik siknɛs ɛn waala fɔ dɛm ɛn mek di tin dɛn we dɛn de fred, mit dɛm; bikɔs, wɛn a bin kɔl dɛm, nɔbɔdi nɔ ansa, wɛn a bin tɔk, dɛn nɔ lisin; bɔt dɛn du tin dɛn we ivul na mi yay.”
Una yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd yu we de trimbul we yu yɛri in wɔd: ‘Yu brɔda dɛn we et yu ɛn trowe yu na do fɔseka mi nem dɔn se, “Lɛ PAPA GƆD tek glori so dat wi go si se yu gladi’; bɔt na dɛn go shem.
Una lisin, ala ala de na di siti! Vɔys de kɔmɔt na di tɛmpul! Na PAPA GƆD in vɔys, I de pe in ɛnimi dɛn bak!
Bifo I go into lɛbɔ so I dɔn bɔn; bifo pen ol am so I dɔn bɔn bɔypikin.
Udat dɔn yɛri tin lɛk dat wande? Udat dɔn si tin lɛk dat wande? Kɔntri go mek insay wande? Dɛn go ebul mek wanol neshɔn insay wan minit? Bikɔs as Zayɔn go into lebɔ so I bɔn in bɔypikin dɛm.
PAPA GƆD aks se, A fɔ opin di wumb ɛn nɔ mek i bɔn? Mi we de mek uman bɔn fɔ lɔk di wumb? Na so una Gɔd aks.
“Una gladi wit Jerusɛlɛm ɛn una gladi fɔ am, una ɔl we lɛk am; gladi wit am fɔr in jɔy, una ɔl we de sɔri fɔ am;
so dat una go sɔk ɛn satisfay wit in bɔbi we de bayo bayo; so dat una drink gud wit ɛnjɔymɛnt kɔmɔt nain glori we i gɛt abɔmpa.”

Bikɔs na di PAPA GƆD se; “A de tɛl una, a go mek prɔspɛriti go to am lɛk riva, ɛn di neshɔn dɛn jɛntri go to am lɛk riva we de ova flo; ɛn una go sɔk, ɛn i go tot una nain fut ɛn mek una dans nain ni.
Lɛk pikin we in mami de bayo bayo, na so a go bayo bayo una; una go gɛt kɔnfɔt na Jerusɛlɛm.
Una go si ɛn una go gladi; una bon dɛm go ɛlti lɛk gras; ɛn dɛn go no se PAPA GƆD de blɛs in wokman dɛm ɛn in wamat na pan in ɛnimi dɛm.
“Bikɔs, PAPA GƆD go kam wit faya, ɛn in chariɔt dɛn go kam lɛk tinada, fɔ pul in bad bad wamat wit vɛksteshɔn, ɛn kɔrɛkt pipul wit faya.
Bikɔs na wit faya PAPA GƆD go kɛriawt jɔjmɛnt; ɛn wit in sɔd pan ɔlman na wɔl; ɛn di wan dɛn we PAPA GƆD kil go plɛnti.
PAPA GƆD se, ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we de mek dɛnsɛf klin na dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛn yay fɔ go insay dɛn gadin, de it ɔg bif, dɛn insɛkt dɛn we de pwɛl fam ɛn arata, go day togɛda.
Bikɔs a no wetin dɛn de du ɛn aw dɛn kin tink, ɛn a de kam gɛda ɔl di neshɔn ɛn difrɛn laŋwej dɛm; ɛn dɛn go kam, ɛn dɛn go si mi glori;

Ɛn a go put wan sayn to dɛn. Ɛn a go sɛn di wan dɛn we nɔ day pan dɛn go na difrɛn neshɔn dɛm, dat na Tashish, Tubal ɛn Javan, to dɛn fa fawe kɔntri dɛn we de nia si, ɛn nɔ yɛri bɔt mi yet ɛn nɔ si mi glɔri yet; na dɛn go go tɛl dɛn bɔt mi glɔri.

Ɛn dɛn go briŋ ɔl una brɔda dɛn kɔmɔt na ɔl di neshɔn dɛm lɛk ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD, pan ɔs ɛn pan chariɔt dɛm, insay Karavan ɛn pan dɔŋki ɛn kamɛl go na mi oli mawnten Jerusɛlɛm, jɛs lɛk aw di Izrɛlayt dɛn de briŋ sid ɔfrin na klin plet na PAPA GƆD in os. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
PAPA GƆD se, “na sɔm pan dɛm bak a go tek mek di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn livayt dɛm”.
PAPA GƆD se, “Bikɔs, lɛk we di nyu skay dɛm ɛn di nyu ath we a go mek go de bifo mi sote go, na so yu jɛnareshɔn ɛn yu nem go de.
Frɔm nyu mun to nyu mun, ɛn frɔm de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst to de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst, ɔlman go kam wɔship mi. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
“Ɛn dɛn go kɔmɔt go, go luk di man dɛn we tɔn dɛn bak pan mi dɛn dedebɔdi dɛm; bikɔs dɛn tumbu nɔ go day, dɛn faya nɔ go ɔt. Nɔbɔdi nɔ go gladi fɔ si dɛm.
Di wɔd dɛn we Jɛrimaya, we na Ilkaya, wan pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na Anatɔt, na di land ɔf Bɛnjamin in yon bɔypikin,
we na to am PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam di ia we mek Josaya, we na Amɔn in bɔypikin, tɔtin ia as kiŋ na Juda.

PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam bak di tɛm we Josaya in bɔypikin, Jɛhoiyakin na bin kiŋ na Juda, ɛn te di tɛm we Zɛdikaya we na Josaya in bɔypikin bin ilɛvin ia na pawa, sote di tɛm we dɛn kapchɔ Jerusɛlɛm insay di mɔnt we mek fayv.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se,
“Bifo a mek yu na yu mami in bɛlɛ, a bin dɔn no yu, ɛn bifo yu bɔn, a bin dɔn kɔnsikret yu fɔ mi wok; a pik yu fɔ bi prɔfɛt to ɔl di neshɔn dɛm.”
Naim a se, “E PAPA GƆD we na mi Gɔd! I apin se a nɔ no aw fɔ tɔk bikɔs mi na jɛs wan yɔŋ bɔbɔ.”
Bɔt PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “Nɔ tɔk se, ‘mi na jɛs wan yɔŋ bɔbɔ, bikɔs yu go go to ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we a go sɛn yu to, ɛn ɛnitin a se paopa yu fɔ tɔk, yu go tɔk am.
Nɔ fred dɛm, bikɔs a de wit yu fɔ sev yu,” na so PAPA GƆD se.
Nain PAPA GƆD es in an ɛn tɔch mi mɔt; dɔn PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “a de tɛl yu, a dɔn put mi wɔd na yu mɔt.
Tide, a dɔn put yu oba neshɔn ɛn kindɔm dɛm, fɔ pik kɔmɔt ɛn fɔ brokdɔŋ, fɔ pwɛl ɛn fɔ kapsay fɔ bil ɛn fɔ plant.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se, “Jɛrimaya, wetin yu de si?” Nain a se, “A si Almɔnd tik branch.”
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “Yu si di kɔrɛkt tin, bikɔs a de wach mi wɔd fɔ du wetin a se.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi sɛkɛn tɛm se, “Wetin yu de si?” Nain a se, “A si wan pɔt we de bwɛl ɛn in fes tɔn kɔmɔt na di nɔt.”
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “Na di nɔt ivul go kɔmɔt go pan di pipul dɛn we tap na di land.

PAPA GƆD se, na dat mek A de kɔl ɔl di trayb dɛn we de na di kindɔm dɛm na di nɔt; ɛn dɛn go kam, ɛn dɛn ɔl go put dɛn tron na di ɛntrans na di get fɔ go insay Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn liŋ dɛn pan ɔl di wɔl dɛn we de rawnd, ɛn pan ɔl di siti dɛn na Juda.
Ɛn a go pas mi jɔjmɛnt agens dɛm, fɔ ɔl dɛn wikɛdnɛs we dɛn fɔseka mi; dɛn dɔn bɔn insɛns to dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛm, ɛn wɔship di tin dɛn we dɛn mek wit dɛn yon an.
Bɔt yu, tay yu trɔsis tayt, grap go tɛl dɛn ɔltin we a dɔn tɛl yu traŋa wan se yu fɔ du. Nɔ mek dɛn pwɛl yu at o. If nɔto so, a go pwɛl yu at bifo dɛm.

Ɛn a de tɛl yu, a de mek wan siti we gɛt protɛkshɔn fɔ yu, ayɛn pila, ɛn bras wɔl dɛm, agens di wanol land, agens di kiŋ dɛn na Juda, in bigman dɛm, in man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn di pipul dɛn na di land.
PAPA GƆD se, dɛn go fɛt yu; bɔt dɛn nɔ go ebul yu, bikɔs a de wit yu fɔ fɛt fɔ yu.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se,

“Go anawns na Jerusɛlɛm lɛ ɔlman yɛri, se, Na so PAPA GƆD se, A mɛmba aw una nɔ bin tek mi mek jok we una bin yɔŋ, di lɛk we una bin lɛk mi lɛk nyu yawo, aw una bin de biɛn mi na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples, land we dɛn nɔ plant wande.
Izrɛl bin oli to PAPA GƆD, dɛn na bin di fɔs frut dɛn na di avɛst. Ɔl di wan dɛn we it pan am bin gilti stret; bad bad tin bin mit dɛm, na so PAPA GƆD se.
Una yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd, yu Jekɔb in os, ɛn ɔl di difrɛn famili dɛn na Izrɛl.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Us rɔŋ tin una papa dɛm bin fɛnɔt se a du, we mek dɛn bin go fa kɔmɔt nia mi, ɛn go fala wɔtlɛs layf ɛn tɔn wɔtlɛs pipul?

Dɛn nɔ bin se, “We PAPA GƆD we bin fɛt pul wi kɔmɔt na Ijipt, we bin de bifo wi na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples, land we na so so ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ ebul tap wit dip dip ol dɛm, land we dak bad bad wan ɛn wata nɔ de, land we pipul dɛn nɔ de pas kɔmɔt wan say go ɔda say, ples we nɔbɔdi nɔ tap?’
Ɛn a briŋ una kam na land we plɛnti de fɔ it, mek una go ɛnjɔy di frut dɛm ɛn di gud tin dɛm. Bɔt wɛn una bin kam de, una dɔti di land na mi yay, ɛn mek di tin we a gi una tɔn bad bad tin we a et.

Di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ bin aks se, ‘We PAPA GƆD?’ Dɛn wan dɛn we de andul di lɔ nɔ bin no mi; di rula dɛn sin agens mi; di prɔfɛt dɛn bin de prɔfisay se na Beal tɛl dɛn so, ɛn dɛn bin put at pan tin dɛn we nɔ go mek dɛn bɛtɛ.
PAPA GƆD se, “Fɔseka dat, a go stil fɛt una, ɛn a go mek kes agens una pikin dɛn pikin dɛm.
Krɔs go na di kos dɛn na Sayprɔs go si, ɔ sɛn go Keda mek dɛn tek tɛm aks gud, ɛn si if ɛnitin lɛk dat dɔn apin bifo.
Neshɔn de we dɔn chenj in gɔd dɛm, ɔl we dɛn nɔto tru tru gɔd dɛm? Bɔt mi pipul dɛn dɔn chenj dɛn glori, fɔ tin we nɔ de bɛnifit nɔbɔdi.
PAPA GƆD se Lɛ wetin apin shɔk una di skay dɛm lɛ i shɔk una, mek una wɔnda te una nɔ no wetin fɔ du,
bikɔs mi pipul dɛn dɔn du tu bad bad tin; dɛn dɔn fɔsek mi, we na di say we wata we de gi layf de kɔmɔt, ɛn dɛn dɔn dig wɛl dɛm fɔ dɛnsɛf, wɛl dɛn we broko broko we nɔ de ol wata.
“Izrɛl na slev? Na aws bɔy usay i bɔn? Wɛl wetindu i dɔn tɔn tin fɔ ɔntin ɛn kil?
Dɛn layɔn dɛm dɔn ala pan am, dɛn dɔn ala lawd lawd wan. Dɛn dɔn mek in land yuslɛs; in siti dɛm dɔn broko broko, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ tap de.
Pantap dat, di man dɛm na Mɛmfis ɛn Tapanis dɔn brok di krawn na una ed.
Nɔto unasɛf dɔn mek dis apin to una, we una fɔsek PAPA GƆD, we na una Gɔd, we i de bifo una na rod?
Luk naw, wetin una gen we una go Ijipt, na fɔ drink wata na Riva Nayl? Ɔ wetin una gen we una go Asiria, na fɔ go drink wata na Riva Yufretis?
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, una wikɛdnɛs go pɔnish una, ɛn di fɔsek we una fɔsek mi go jɔj una. Una no ɛn si se na bad bad ɛn bita tin fɔ una fɔ fɔsek PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd; una nɔ rɛspɛkt mi wan.

“Bikɔs una dɔn lɛf fɔ wok fɔ mi lɔlɔntɛm ɛn nɔ de du wetin a se una fɔ de du igen, ɛn una se, “A nɔ go sav yu igen” Yɛs, na pantap ɔl dɛn ay il ɛn ɔnda ɔl dɛn grin tik una de butu to dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛn lɛk rare gyal.
Pan ɔl dat, a plant wan fayn fayn greps tik fɔ una we in sid na piɔ sid. Aw una manej tɔn lo layf pipul ɛn dɔn bi wayl greps?
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, ɔl we una was unasɛf wit sop, ɛn una yuz bɔku bɔku sop, di gilt stil de sho na una fes.

Aw una go se, “A nɔ dɔti na PAPA GƆD in yay, a nɔ de wɔship dɛn lay lay gɔd’? Luk di kayn sin we una de kɔmit na di vali; luk wetin una dɔn du – una tan lɛkɛ yɔŋ kamɛl we nɔ ebul stɛdi, bɔt de waka ɔp ɛn dɔŋ na di sem ples,

lɛkɛ wayl yɔŋ dɔŋki we dɔn yus to di dray ɛn ɛmti ples, we de smɛl briz we i fil fɔ man! Udat go ebul kɔntrol am we i dɔn gɛt filin? Di man dɔŋki dɛn we want am nɔ gɛt fɔ stren dɛnsɛf fɔ gɛt am; wɛn in mɔnt rich, dɛn go si am.
Una nɔ de mas grɔn wit una ɛmti fut ɛn una nɔ de gri mek tɔsti mek yu trot dray. Bɔt una se; ‘Na fɔ natin, bikɔs a dɔn lɛk trenja dɛn, ɛn na dɛn a de wit.
“Lɛkɛ we dɛn kin jankonico tifman wɛn dɛn kech, na so dɛn go jankonoco Izrɛl: dɛm, dɛn kiŋ dɛm, dɛn bigman dɛm, dɛn man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn dɛn prɔfɛt dɛm,
we de tɔk to tik se, ‘Yu na mi papa,’ ɛn to ston se, ‘Na yu mek a de bɔn.’ Bikɔs dɛn dɔn tɔn dɛm bak pan mi, nɔto dɛn fes. Bɔt we dɛn kin gɛt trɔbul, dɛn kin de se, ‘Duya sev wi!’
Bɔt we una gɔd dɛm we una mek fɔ unasɛf? Le dɛn tray if dɛn go ebul sev una, we trɔbul kam; bikɔs aw una siti dɛn bɔku, na so una gɔd dɛn bɔku, Yu Juda.
“Wetin du una de kɔmplen bɔt mi? Una ɔl dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn mi. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
PAPA GƆD se, A dɔn pɔnish una pikin dɛm te, dɛn nɔ gri chenj; na unasɛf tek una an kil una prɔfɛt dɛn lɛk layɔn we aŋri bad bad wan.
So una, dis jɛnareshɔn, du wetin PAPA GƆD se, A dɔn tan lɛk dray ɛn ɛmti ples to Izrɛl, ɔ land we dak bad bad wan? Wɛl wetindu mi pipul dɛn de se, ‘wi dɔn fri, wi nɔ go kam to yu igen?
Uman we nɔ mared yet go fɔgɛt in riŋ chen ɛn baŋuls dɛn, ɔ yawo go fɔgɛt in mared klos? Bɔt mi pipul dɛn dɔn fɔgɛt bɔt mi lɔlɔntɛm.
Una sabi waka fɔ go fɛn una lɔva dɛm! Somɔch dat una dɔn tich dɛn wikɛd uman dɛm, fɔ du wetin una de du.
Igen, una klos dɛn sten wit po inosɛnt pipul dɛn blɔd; una nɔ kech dɛn de brok os go insay. Bɔt stil, wit ɔl dɛn tin ya so,
una se, ‘A inosɛnt; fɔ tru, in nɔ vɛks pan mi igen.’ A de tɛl una, a go jɔj una fɔ we una de tɔk se, ‘A nɔ kɔmit sin.’
Luk we una de pas pas pan pipul, we nɔto so una bin tan! Ijipt go mek una shem, lɛkɛ aw Asiria bin mek una shem.
Una go kɔmɔt pan da shem de wit una an na una ed, bikɔs PAPA GƆD nɔ gri fɔ di wan dɛn we una biliv, ɛn dɔn nɔ go bɛtɛ una.

PAPA GƆD se, “If man dayvɔs in wɛf ɛn in wɛf kɔmɔt to am ɛn go mared to ɔda pɔsin, di man go go bak to di uman? Dat nɔ go mek di land dɔti na PAPA GƆD in yay? Yu dɔn bi rare gyal wit bɔku lɔva dɛm, dɔn yu wan kam bak to mi?

Es yu yay luk di ɛmti mawnten dɛm ɛn si! Usay de we yu nɔ dɔn rare? Yu dɔn sidɔm nia di rɔd de wet fɔ yu lɔva dɛm, lɛkɛ dɛn Arab na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples. Yu dɔn mek di land dɔti na PAPA GƆD yay wit yu rare gyal biznɛs.
Fɔseka dat, wan ren nɔ de kam, ren nɔ de kam ren sizin; pan ɔl dat yu stil yu gɛt rare gyal fɔrɛd, yu nɔ gri shem.
Yu nɔ jɛs de pre to mi se, ‘Mi Papa, na yu na mi padi we a bin yɔŋ –
I go vɛks pan mi sote go, I go stɔbɔn sote go?’ Luk, yu dɔn tɔk am, bɔt una dɔn du ɔl di ivul tin dɛn we una ebul du.”
PAPA GƆD tɛl mi dyurin di tɛm we Josaya na bin kiŋ, se, “Yu dɔn si wetin i du, dawande we nɔ gɛt feth, we nem Izrɛl, aw i bin go ɔp ɔl dɛn ay il ɛn ɔnda ɔl dɛn grin tik, de biev lɛk rare gyal?
A bin de tɔk na mi at se, ‘dis, we i dɔn du ɔl dɛn tin dɛn ya dɔn, i go kam bak to mi;’ bɔt i nɔ kam bak, ɛn in fɔls sista, Juda, bin si.
I bin si se, fɔ ɔl di adɔltri we dawande, we na Izrɛl we nɔ gɛt feth, bin kɔmit, a bin dɔn dayvɔs am; pan ɔl dat, da in fɔls sista nɔ bin fred, insɛf go mek insɛf rare gyal.
Bikɔs i nɔ de shem fɔ rare, i dɔti di land na PAPA GƆD in yay we i de kɔmit adɔltri de wɔship tik ɛn ston.
Pan ɔl dat, in fɔls sista, Juda, nɔ kam bak to mi wit ɔl in at, bɔt bin de pritɛnd; na so PAPA GƆD se.”
Ɛn PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “Izrɛl we nɔ gɛt feth dɔn sho se i nɔ gilti rich Juda we de mek fɔls.
Go anawns to di pipul dɛn na di nɔt, se PAPA GƆD se, ‘Tɔn bak kam to mi, yu Izrɛl we nɔ gɛt feth. PAPA GƆD se, A nɔ go vɛks pan una igen bikɔs Mi na Gɔd we de sɔri fɔ pipul; A nɔ go vɛks igen igen
Una jɛs gri nɔmɔ se una gilti, se una dɔn tɔn una bak pan PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd ɛn skata una lɔv to trenja dɛn ɔnda ɔl dɛn grin tik dɛm ɛn una nɔ obe mi kɔmandmɛnt dɛm.
PAPA GƆD se, una tɔmbak kam to mi bikɔs mi na una masta; A go tek wan wan pɔsin na ich siti, ɛn tu tu na ich famili ɛn a go briŋ una kam Zayɔn.
“Ɛn a go gi una shɛpad dɛn we a lɛk, we go fid una wit sɛns ɛn sabi.
Ɛn wɛn una dɔn mɔltiplay ɛn grow na di land, PAPA GƆD se, una nɔ go se, “PAPA GƆD in Ak ɔf di Kɔvinant” igen. I nɔ go kam na una maynd ɔ una nɔ go mɛmba am, ɔ mis am; una nɔ go mɛk am igen.
Da tɛm de, dɛn go kɔl Jerusɛlɛm, PAPA GƆD in tron, ɛn ɔl di difrɛn neshɔn gɛda de fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD na Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn dɛn nɔ go stɔbɔn de du wetin dɛn ivul at dɛn se.
Dɛn tɛm dɛn de, di Juda fambul go jɔyn wit di Izrɛl fambul, ɛn una go kɔmɔt na di land na di nɔt togɛda, go na di land we a bin gi una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm as dɛn yon prɔpati.
A bin de tink bɔt aw a go put una wit mi bɔypikin dɛm, ɛn gi una fayn fayn land, prɔpati we fayn pas ɔl dɛn neshɔn dɛn yon. Ɛn a bin tink se una go kɔl mi, Mi Papa, ɛn nɔ go tɔn una bak pan mi.
PAPA GƆD se, Biliv mi, “lɛkɛ aw wɛf we nɔ gɛt feth kin lɛf in man, na so una Izrɛl nɔ bin gɛt feth pan mi.
Yu yɛri wan vɔys na ɛmti il, we Izrɛl in bɔypikin dɛn de kray ɛn beg, bikɔs dɛn kɔrɔpt, dɛn dɔn fɔgɛt PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd.
“Una kam bak to mi, una dɛn bɔypikin dɛn we nɔ gɛt feth, a go mɛn una mek una go gɛt feth.” “Luk, we dɔn kam to yu; bikɔs yu na PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd.
Fɔ tru, di tin dɛn we de apin na di il dɛn de mek pɔsin tink tin we nɔ bi, dat na di kayn wɔship we de na di mawnten dɛm. Fɔ tru, na PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd nɔmɔ go sev Izrɛl.
“Bɔt frɔm we una yɔŋ, di shemful biznɛs pwɛl ɔl wetin wi fɔstɛmpapa dɛn dɔn wok fɔ, dɛn ship ɛn dɛn kaw, ɛn dɛn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛm.
Lɛ wi lidɔm pan wi shem, ɛn lɛ wi disrɛspɛkt kɔba wi; bikɔs wi dɔn kɔmit sin agens PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd, wi ɛn wi papa dɛm, frɔm we wi yɔŋ, te tide; ɛn wi nɔ dɔn obe PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd in vɔys.”
PAPA GƆD se, “E Izrɛl, If una tɔmbak kam, na mi una fɔ tɔmbak kam to. If una lɛf fɔ du ɔl dɛn bad bad tin dɛn we a nɔ lɛk, ɛn una nɔ dawt,
ɛn if una swɛ se, ‘Wans PAPA GƆD de,’ fɔseka di tru, fɔ jɔstis sek, ɛn fɔ tretwaka, na da tɛm de ɔl dɛn neshɔn dɛm go blɛs dɛnsɛf insay in nem ɛn na wit in nem dɛn go mek mɔt.”
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD tɛl di man dɛm na Juda ɛn di wan dɛn we tap na Jerusɛlɛm: “Una dig una grɔn we nɔ de bɔn, ɛn nɔ plant midul chukchuk.

Una sakɔmsayz unasɛf to PAPA GƆD, una pul di fɔs kanda we de ɔntɔp una at, Una di man dɛn na Juda ɛn una we tap na Jerusɛlɛm; if nɔto so, mi vɛksteshɔn go kɔmɔt lɛkɛ faya ɛn bɔn, we nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul ɔt am, bikɔs ɔf di ivul we de pan di tin dɛn we una de du.”
Tɛl ɔlman na Juda, ɛn anawns na Jerusɛlɛm se, “Blo di trɔmpɛt ɔlsay na di land; ala lawd lawd wan ɛn se, ‘Una gɛda wan say, lɛ wi go insay di siti dɛn we gɛt protɛkshɔn!’
Una put put sayn post dɛn we de sho rod fɔ go Zayɔn, una rɔn fɔ una layf, nɔ westɛm bikɔs a de briŋ bad bad tin kɔmɔt na di nɔt, wit wan big big nyakanyaka.

Wan layɔn dɔn kɔmɔt na di tay tay bush we i bin fasin, pɔsin we de nyakanyaka neshɔn dɛn de na rod; i dɔn kɔmɔt nain ples fɔ go mek yu land ples we natin nɔ de bi; una siti dɛn go tɔn pwɛl pwɛl ples usay pipul dɛn nɔ tap.
Fɔseka dat, wɛr saklɔth na yu bɔdi, kray de ala lawd wan; bikɔs PAPA GƆD stil vɛks pan wi bad bad wan.
PAPA GƆD se, “Da de de, kiŋ ɛn di bigman dɛn go fred; di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin go sɔprayz ɛn di prɔfɛt dɛn go wɔnda.”
Nain a se, “E PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, fɔ tru, yu dɔn disiv dɛn pipul ya ɛn Jerusɛlɛm totali, we yu se, ‘ɔltin go fayn fɔ una’; we i bi se nɛf de na dɛn trot!”

Da tɛm de, dɛn go tɛl dɛm pipul dɛn ya, ɛn Jerusɛlɛm se, “Wan ɔt briz de blo kɔmɔt na di mawnten dɛn na di ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap, kam to mi pipul dɛn gyal pikin, nɔto fɔ kam fana di dɔti wan dɛn kɔmɔt ɔ fɔ kam klin dɛm o,
na briz we pasmak fɔ dɛn kayn tin dɛn de, de kam fɔ mi. Una no se na mi de pas jɔjmɛnt pan di pipul dɛm.”
Una luk, i de kam lɛkɛ klawd, in ɔs ɛn karej dɛm tan lɛkɛ wɛn da ebi ebi briz we de tɔn rawnd wit spid, de blo; in ɔs dɛn de rɔn pas dɛn igul – swɛ dɔn fɔdɔm pan wi, bikɔs wi yon dɔn dɔn!
E Jerusɛlɛm, una was wikɛdnɛs kɔmɔt na una at, so dat una go sev. Aw lɔŋ una ivul plan dɛn go de na una at?
Bikɔs wan vɔys we kɔmɔt na Dan de tɔk ɛn anawns se, bad bad tin gɛt fɔ kɔmɔt Mawnt Ifrem kam.
Wɔn di neshɔn dɛn se i de kam; anawns to Jerusɛlɛm se, “Pipul dɛn we go ambush dɛm de kɔmɔt na fawe land kam, dɛn de ala pan di siti dɛn we de na Juda.
PAPA GƆD se, dɛn sɔrawnd am lɛkɛ aw dɛn wan dɛn we de gyad fil kin de rawnd am, bikɔs i dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn mi.
Na di we we una de biev ɛn di tin dɛn we una de du, dɔn mek tin lɛk dis mit una. Na una yon dɔn dɔn so, ɛn i bita; una dɔn fil am na una at.
Di pen pasmak! Di pen pasmak! A nɔ go ebul bia igen! O mi at-kes! Mi at de bit fas fas; A nɔ go ebul bia; bikɔs a de yɛri di trɔmpɛt in sawnd, we na di alam fɔ wa.
Dizasta fala Dizasta siriɔs wan, di wanol land lɛf ɛmti ɛn yuslɛs. Wantɛm wantɛm so, mi tɛnt dɛn dɔn pwɛl, bifo yu mekɔp, mi kɔtin sɛf dɔn pwɛl.
Aw lɔŋ a go si di sayn, ɛn yɛri di trɔmpɛt?
“Bikɔs mi pipul dɛn fulish, dɛn nɔ no mi; dɛn na styupid pikin dɛm, dɛn nɔ de ɔndastand natin. Dɛn gɛt skil fɔ du ivul tin dɛm, bɔt dɛn nɔ no aw fɔ du gud.”
A luk di dunia, eya, i bin ɛmti ɛn yuslɛs; ɛn we a luk di klawd dɛm, dɛn nɔ bin gɛt nɔn layt.
A luk di mawnten dɛm, eya, dɛn bin de shek, ɛn ɔl di il dɛn bin de muf go bifo ɛn biɛn.
A luk, bɔt eya, nɔn mɔtalman nɔ bin de, ɛn ɔl di bɔd dɛm na di skay bin dɔn rɔnawe.
A luk, eya, da land we plant bin de gro fayn fayn wan, dɔn tɔn ɛmti ples we pipul nɔ go ebul tap, ɛn ɔl in siti dɛn dɔn broko broko bifo PAPA GƆD, ɛn bifo in bad bad vɛksteshɔn.
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se, “Di wanol land go lɛf ɛmti bɔt a nɔ go pwɛl am kpatakpata.
Bikɔs di wɔl go munin, ɛn di klawd dɛn we de oba una ed go blak; bikɔs mi dɔn tɔk, mi dɔn se i fɔ bi; A nɔ taya, ɛn a nɔ go chenj mi mind.”

As dɛn yɛri di sawnd we pipul dɛn de rayd ɔs ɛn pipul dɛn de faya bo ɛn aro, ɔl di siti dɛm rɔnawe; dɛn go na bush bush we taŋul; dɛn klem pan dɛn rɔk dɛm; ɔl di siti dɛn lɛf to dɛnsɛf, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de de..

Ɛn yu, yu we lɛf ɛmti wan, wetin yu min we yu drɛs wit brayt brayt rɛd, we yu dɛkɔret yusɛf wit ɔlkayn gold chen, riŋ ɛn baŋuls, ɛn prɛd yu yay dɛm wit pent? Yu de mek yusɛf fayn fayn fɔ natin. Yu lɔva dɛn nɔ want yu igen; dɛn de tray fɔ kil yu.

Bikɔs a yɛri pɔsin de kray lɛkɛ we uman de lebɔ, lɛkɛ we uman kin de bɔn in fɔs pikin, dat na Zayɔn in gyal pikin dɛn de kray ɛn de fɛt fɔ blo, dɛn opin dɛn an dɛn wayd wayd wande se, “Swɛ dɔn kech mi! A de fent bifo di wan dɛn we de kil mi.”
Rɔn ɔp ɛn dɔŋ di trit dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm, luk ɛn tek notis! Sach in opin ples dɛn si if yu go fɛn wan pɔsin, pɔsin we trit ɔlman ikwal ɛn de tɔk tru; so dat a go sɔri fɔ Jerusɛlɛm.
Ɔlwe dɛn kin swɛ se, “Wans PAPA GƆD de,” dɛn stil kin lay.
E PAPA GƆD, nɔto di tru yu de luk fɔ? Yu dɔn bit dɛm, bɔt dɛn nɔ fil pen; yu dɔn kil sɔm pan dɛm bɔt dɛn nɔ gri tek kɔrɛkshɔn. Dɛn dɔn mek dɛn fes dɛn traŋa pas rɔk; dɛn nɔ gri fɔ chenj.
Nain a se, “Dɛn wan ya na po po pipul dɛm, dɛn nɔ gɛt sɛns; bikɔs dɛn nɔ no PAPA GƆD in we, dɛn Gɔd in lɔ.
A go go to dɛn wan we big, ɛn a go tɔk to dɛm; bikɔs dɛn no PAPA GƆD in we di lɔ we dɛn Gɔd Ɔlmayti gɛt.” Bɔt dɛn nɔ de obe PAPA GƆD in lɔ igen, dɛn dɔn kɔt rop.

Fɔseka dat, na layɔn we go kɔmɔt na fɔrɛst go kil dɛm, na wulf we kɔmɔt na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, go nyakanyaka dɛm. Wan lɛpɛt de waka nia dɛn siti dɛm fɔ du bad, i go chɛr chɛr ɛnibɔdi we kɔmɔt insay di siti go na do, pis pis; bikɔs dɛn sin dɔn bɔku, ɛn di dinay we dɛn de dinay PAPA GƆD dɔn tumɔs.
“Aw a go sɔri fɔ yu? Yu pikin dɛm dɔn fɔsek mi, ɛn dɛn dɔn tek dɛn wan dɛn we nɔto gɔd, dɛn nem swɛ. We a bin fid dɛm te dɛn bɛlful, dɛn bin kɔmit adɔltri ɛn gɛda go na dɛn rare gyal dɛn os.
Dɛn na bin dɛn machɔ man os we dɛn de fid gud gud wan we want uman ɔltɛm, ɔlman de kray fɔ gɛt in neba wɛf.
PAPA GƆD se, “A nɔ fɔ pɔnish dɛm fɔ dɛn kayn tin dɛn de? Ɛn a nɔ fɔ rivɛnj fɔ mi nem pan kayn neshɔn lɛkɛ dis?
“Waka insay dɛn greps fam, ro bay ro ɛn pwɛl dɛm, bɔt nɔ pwɛl ɔltin; kɔt kɔt dɛn branch dɛm, bikɔs nɔto PAPA GƆD gɛt dɛm.
PAPA GƆD se, “Bikɔs Izrɛl ɛn Juda nɔ bin de waka tret wit mi atɔ.”
Dɛn dɔn tɔk lay lay tin dɛm bɔt PAPA GƆD ɛn dɔn se, ‘I nɔ go du yu ɛnitin; natin bad nɔ go apin to wi ɛn i nɔ go kil wi ɔ mek aŋri kam na tɔŋ.
Di prɔfɛt dɛn go tan lɛk briz; bikɔs di wɔd nɔ de insay dɛm. Na so i go bi to dɛm!”
Bikɔs ɔf dat, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd Ɔlmayti se, “Bikɔs dɛn dɔn tɔk da wɔd de, a de mek mi wɔd na mɔt tan lɛkɛ faya ɛn dɛn pipul ya, di wud ɛn di faya go bɔn dɛm.

PAPA GƆD se, “Yu Izrɛl, biliv mi, a de mek wan neshɔn kam atak una, neshɔn we de kɔmɔt fa fawe. Na neshɔn we ebul bia, na dɛn lɔntɛm neshɔn, na neshɔn we una nɔ no dɛn laŋwej ɛn una nɔ go ɔndastand wetin dɛn de se.
Di say we dɛn de put dɛn aro tan lɛkɛ grev; ɛn dɛn na pawaful fɛtman dɛm.

Dɛn go it ɔl wetin una avɛst ɛn ɔl di it we una gɛt fɔ it; dɛn go it una bɔypikin ɛn gyal pikin dɛm; dɛn go it una ship, got ɛn kaw dɛm; dɛn go it una greps ɛn una fig tik dɛm; una siti dɛn we una protɛkt ɛn abop pan, na sɔd dɛn go tek pwɛl dɛm.”
PAPA GƆD se, “Ivin dɛn tɛm dɛn de, a nɔ go kil dɛn ɔl.

Ɛn we una pipul dɛm go se, ‘wetin mek PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd dɔn du ɔl dɛn kayn tin ya to wi?’ Una go tɛl dɛm se, ‘Lɛk we una fɔsek mi go sav fɔrin gɔd dɛm na una land, na semweso una go sav trenja dɛm na land we nɔto una yon.’”
PAPA GƆD se, anawns dis na Izrɛl, tɔk am na Juda;
“Una yɛri o, una dɛn fulish pipul dɛn we nɔ gɛt sɛns, una we gɛt yay bɔt nɔ de si, una we gɛt yes bɔt nɔ de yɛri.

PAPA GƆD se, una nɔ de fred mi? Una nɔ de trimbul bifo mi? A put sansan as bawndri fɔ di si, baria we de de ɔltɛm we i nɔ de pas; i lɛk aw di swɛlin dɛn tɔnɔbɔ, dɛn nɔ de pas da bawndri de, i lɛk aw dɛn ala, dɛn nɔ go ebul jomp am.
Bɔt dɛn pipul ya gɛt traŋayes ɛn rebɛl at; dɛn dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn mi go dɛn yon we.
Dɛn nɔ de tɔk na dɛn at se, ‘Lɛ wi fred PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd, we de gi wi ren, ren sizin, di amatan ren, ɛn di draysizin ren, ɛn de kip, di wik dɛm fɔ di avɛst, fɔ wi.’
Una bad layf dɔn mek una nɔ de gɛt ɔl dɛn tin dɛn ya igen, ɛn una sin dɛm dɔn diprayv una.
Bikɔs, wikɛd pipul dɛn de amɔŋ mi pipul; dɛn de ayd dɛnsɛf lɛkɛ flawa de wet fɔ du bad, Dɛn kin sɛt trap; dɛn kin kech mɔtalman.
Dɛn os dɛn ful wit bad at ɛn tif, lɛkɛ aw blay kin ful wit bɔd; na dat mek dɛn dɔn jɛntri ɛn gɛt pawa,
dɛn dɔn fat ɛn de shayn. Dɛn nɔ de fred fɔ du ɛnikayn wikɛd tin to nɔbɔdi; dɛn de gi bɛn bɛn jɔjmɛnt to dɛn wan dɛn we dɛn papa dɔn day, fɔ du mɔ wikɛdnɛs, ɛn dɛn nɔ de fɛt fɔ dɛn wan dɛm we nɔ gɛt.
PAPA GƆD se, “A nɔ fɔ pɔnish dɛm fɔ dɛn tin dɛn de? Ɛn a nɔ fɔ rivɛnj fɔ mi nem pan neshɔn lɛkɛ dis kayn?
Na tin we at fɔ biliv ɛn de shɔk pipul dɔn apin na di land so:
di Prɔfɛt dɛm de gi laylay prɔfisi, ɛn dɛn man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, de du wetin dɛn fil; na dat mi pipul dɛn lɛk lɛ de bi, bɔt wetin una go du we di ɛnd go kam?

Una rɔn go ayd, una Bɛnjamin in pikin dɛm, una rɔn kɔmɔt insay Jerusɛlɛm! Una blo di trɔmpɛt na Tɛkoa, ɛn put sayn ɔp na Bɛtachɛrɛm; bikɔs bad bad tin de na rod de kam kɔmɔt na di nɔt, ɛn ebi ebi nyakanyaka.
A go pwɛl di fayn fayn wan we dɛn tek tɛm mɛn, we na Zayɔn in gyal pikin.
Sɔm shɛpad ɛn dɛn ship dɛn go kam fɛt am; dɛn go mek dɛn tɛnt dɛn rawnd am, ɔlman go mɛn dɛn animal dɛm usay dɛn want.
“Una rɛdi fɔ mek wa pan am; una grap, lɛ wi atak am twɛlv oklɔk santɛm!” “Swɛ dɔn kech wi, bikɔs di de de dɔn, bikɔs ivintɛm shado dɛn dɔn bigin lɔŋ!”
“Una grap, lɛ wi atak am na nɛt, ɛn nyakanyaka di kiŋ in os dɛm we de de!”
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, “Una kɔt kɔt in tik dɛm; bil ay dɔti rawnd Jerusɛlɛm fɔ blɔk dɛm. Na di siti dis we dɛn fɔ pɔnish; na so so sɔprɛshɔn de de.
Lɛkɛ aw i de mek shɔ se in wata frɛsh, na semweso in de mek shɔ se in wikɛdnɛs frɛsh; na fɛtfɛt ɛn nyakanyaka, yu go yɛri de; ɔltɛm na siknɛs ɛn wund a de si.
A de wɔn una o, Jerusɛlɛm, if nɔ so, a go avɔyd una; if nɔ so a mek yu ɛmti ples, land we nɔbɔdi nɔ tap.”

Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se; “Dɛn go ɛmti di balans pipul dɛn kɔmɔt Izrɛl lɛkɛ we dɛn kin klin greps fam te natin nɔ lɛf; pas yu an pan in branch dɛn wantɛm mɔ, lɛkɛ aw dɛn wan dɛn we de pik greps kin du.”
Udat a go tɔk to ɛn wɔn, so dat dɛn go yɛri? I bi se, dɛn yes dɛn lɔk, dɛn nɔ ebul lisin; I bi se, to dɛm, PAPA GƆD in wɔd na tin fɔ laf, dɛn nɔ gɛt tɛm fɔ am.

Fɔseka dat, PAPA GƆD in sem vɛksteshɔn ful insay mi; A dɔn taya fɔ bia kip am insay mi. “Empti am pan dɛn pikin na trit, ɛn igen, pan dɛn yɔŋbɔy dɛm ɔl usay dɛn gɛda; dɛn go kɛr mared man ɛn in wɛf go, di ol grani ɛn grampa dɛm, ɛn di wan dɛnsɛf we dɔn olpasmak.
Dɛn go gi ɔda pipul dɛn, dɛn os dɛm, wit dɛn fam ɛn dɛn wɛf dɛm sɛf; bikɔs a go pɔnish di pipul dɛn na di land,” na so PAPA GƆD se.”
Bikɔs, frɔm di smɔl wan to di wan we big pas dɛn ɔl, dɛn ɔl want fɔ mek tif tif prɔfit; ɛn, frɔm prɔfɛt to man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, dɛn ɔl de ple yuki yuki gem.
Dɛn dɔn mɛn mi pipul dɛn wund af ɛn af, we dɛn de se, ‘Una gɛt kolat, una gɛt kolat,’ we wan kolat nɔ de.

Dɛn bin de shem we dɛn bin de du dɛn bad bad tin dɛn we a nɔ lɛk? Nɔ, dɛn nɔ bin de shem; dɛn nɔ bin no aw fɔ shem. Fɔseka dat, dɛn go day wit dɛn wan dɛn we go day; na di tɛm we a go pɔnish dɛm dɛn yon go dɔn,” na so PAPA GƆD se.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, “Una go tinap na forod ɛn wach, una aks fɔ dɛn ol rod, usay di gud rod de; ɛn una waka de, ɛn fɛn kolat fɔ una sol. Bɔt dɛn se, ‘we nɔ go waka de.’
A put pɔsin fɔ de wach una, ɛn tɛl una se, ‘Una lisin fɔ di trɔmpɛt!’ Bɔt dɛn se, ‘wi nɔ go lisin.’
Fɔseka dat, una yɛri o, una di neshɔn dɛm, mek una no, una di pipul dɛm we gɛda bifo PAPA GƆD, wetin go apin to dɛm.
Yɛri o, yu ath, a de briŋ dizasta kam pan dɛn pipul ya, we na di pe we dɛn fɔ gɛt fɔ di wok we dɛn du, bikɔs dɛn nɔ yɛri mi wɔd; as fɔ mi lɔ dɛm, dɛn nɔ de obe dɛm sɛf.
Wetin mek insɛns de kɔmɔt Shiba kam fɔ mi, ɔ wetindu shuga ken de kɔmɔt fawe kam fɔ mi? Una sakrifays dɛn we una de bɔn na faya, nɔ gud fɔ mi fɔ gri fɔ, jɛs lɛk we una sakrifays dɛn nɔ kin pliz mi.

Fɔseka dat na dis PAPA GƆD se: “A de tɛl una, A go put blɔk we de mek pɔsin fɔdɔm bifo dɛn pipul ya, blɔk we de mek pɔsin fɔdɔm we dɛn go bɔk dɛn fut pan; di papa dɛm ɛn di bɔypikin dɛm togɛda, neba ɛn padi go day.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, “A de tɛl una, saten pipul dɛn de kɔmɔt di kɔntri we de na di nɔt, wan big big neshɔn we de usay di wɔl ɛnd, de rɛdi fɔ fɛt wa.

Dɛn dɔn ol bo ɛn spia dɛn wikɛd ɛn dɛn nɔ de sɔri fɔ nɔbɔdi, di sawnd we dɛn de mek tan lɛkɛ we di si de tɔnɔbɔ; dɛn de rayd ɔs, dɛn drɛs lɛkɛ man we rɛdi fɔ fɛt wa, agens yu, yu Zayɔn in gyal pikin.”
Wi dɔn yɛri bɔt dat, wi an dɛm dɔn wik; pen dɔn ol wi da pen we uman de fil we i de bɔn.
Una nɔ go na fam, ɛn una nɔ waka na forod; bikɔs di ɛnimi gɛt sɔd, fred fred de ɔlɔbɔt.

Yu mi pipul dɛn gyal pikin, go wɛr saklɔth, ɛn rol rolpan ashis; mek sɔri lɛk na fɔ yu wangren bɔypikin yu de munin fɔ, kray bita bita wan pas ɔl; bikɔs i nɔ go te igen, di wan we de kil pipul dɔn kam fɔ kil wi.
“A dɔn mek yu di pɔsin we de tɛst mi pipul dɛm ɛn mek dɛn biev bɛtɛ pas fɔs, so dat yu go no ɛn tɛst dɛn aw dɛn liv ɛn wetin dɛn de du.
Dɛn na traŋayes rebɛl dɛm, we de ɔlɔbɔt de koŋosa; dɛn na bras ɛn ayɛn, dɛn ɔl kɔrɔpt.
Di kaw kanda de blo di fawa ebi ebi wan, di faya de mɛlt di lɛd; na fɔ natin dɛn de tray fɔ chenj di we, we dɛn de biev, bikɔs wikɛd pɔsin nɔ de chenj.
Dɛn kɔl dɛm, “Silva we nɔbɔdi nɔ want,” bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn se I nɔ wan dɛm atɔl.”
Dis na PAPA GƆD in wɔd we bin kam to Jɛrimaya:
“Tinap na di get na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn anawns to di pipul dɛn se, Una yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD se, una ɔl di man dɛm na Juda we de pas na dɛn get ya kam insay fɔ kam wɔship PAPA GƆD.
Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se, “Una chenj di we we una de biev ɛn di tin dɛn we una de du, ɛn a go mek una tap na dis ples.
Una nɔ abop pan dɛn wɔd dɛn ya we dɛn de tek mek una fil se na tru tin dɛn de du: ‘Dis na PAPA GƆD in Tɛmpul, PAPA GƆD in tɛmpul, PAPA GƆD in tɛmpul.’
“Bikɔs if una chenj una we ɛn fɔ tru tru lɛf dɛn tin dɛn we una de du, if una trit ɔlman di sem fɔ tru tru, ɛn gi udat gɛt rayt in rayt,
if una nɔ sɔprɛs dɛn trenja, dɛn pikin dɛn we dɛn mami ɛn dadi dɔn day, ɔ uman we in man dɔn day, ɔ kil inosɛnt pɔsin na ya, ɛn if una nɔ de biɛn ɔda gɔd dɛm we dat go ambɔg una,
a go mek una tap na ya, dis land we a bin dɔn gi una fɔstɛm-papa dɛm sote go.
“Una lisin, una abop pan wetin dɛn de tɔk fɔ ful una, we na wɔd dɛm we nɔ go bɛnifit una.
Una go tif, kil pɔsin, kɔmit adɔltri, swɛ fɔ natin, bɔn insɛns to Beal, ɛn wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛm we una nɔ bin no,
ɛn kam bak kam tinap bifo mi insay dis os, we na mi os, ɛn se ‘wi dɔn fri!’– Pas nɔmɔ fɔ mek una stil de du dɛn bad bad tin dɛn ya we a nɔ lɛk?
PAPA GƆD se, Mi os dɔn tɔn to tifman os na una yay? Biliv mi, misɛf dɔn si dat.
Una go naw naw na mi ples we bin de na shilo, usay na di fɔs ples we a bin mek mi nem tap, ɛn go si wetin a du am fɔseka di wikɛdnɛs we mi pipul dɛn we na Izrɛl, bin de du.
PAPA GƆD se, ɛn rayt naw, bikɔs una dɔn du ɔl dɛn tin ya, ɛn wɛn a bin de tɔk to una ɛn nɔ de blo, una nɔ bin lisin, ɛn wɛn a kɔl una, una nɔ ansa,
a go du di os, we dɛn de kɔl wit mi nem, ɛn we we na pan am una abop, ɛn di ples we a gi una ɛn una fɔstɛm-papa dɛm, di sem tin we a bin du Shilɔ.
Ɛn a go drɛb una kɔmɔt bifo mi, lɛkɛ we a drɛb ɔl una kɔntriman dɛm, we na Ifrem in pikin dɛm.
“As fɔ yu, nɔ pre fɔ dɛn pipul dɛn ya, ɔ kray ɔ ala de pre fɔ dɛm, ɛn nɔ tray fɔ chenj mi maynd, bikɔs a nɔ go lisin yu.
Yu nɔ si wetin dɛn de du na di siti dɛn na Juda ɛn na di trit dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm?

Di pikin dɛm de gɛda wud, di papa dɛn de layt faya, ɛn di uman dɛn de miks flawa mek do, fɔ mek kek fɔ di kwin ɔf ɛvin, ɛn de tɔn drink na grɔn de mek sakrifays to ɔda gɔd dɛm, fɔ provok mi mek a a go vɛks.
PAPA GƆD se, “Na mi dɛn de provok? Nɔto dɛnsɛf, fɔ kɔnfyus dɛnsɛf?
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, “A go put mi animal, a go put am pan tik dɛm na bush ɛn di frut dɛn we de gro kɔmɔt na grɔn; i go bɔn ɛn i nɔ go ɔt.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se, “Una ad una sakrifays we dɛn de bɔn na faya to una sakrifays dɛm ɛn it di flɛsh.
Bikɔs di tɛm we a pul dɛm kɔmɔt na di land ɔf Ijipt, a nɔ bin tɔk to una Papa dɛm ɔ kɔmand dɛm bɔt ɔfrin we de bɔn na faya ɔ sakrifays dɛm.
Bɔt, na dis kɔmand a bin gi dɛm se, ‘Obe mi vɔys, ɛn a go bi una Gɔd ɛn una go bi mi pipul dɛm; una liv aw a se una fɔ liv, so dat una go ɛnjɔy una layf.’
Bɔt dɛn nɔ obe mi ɛn nɔ ivin pe atɛnshɔn to mi, bɔt dɛn bin de du wetin dɛn maynd tɛl dɛm ɛn wetin dɛn stɔbɔn at dɛn se, ɛn bin jɛs de go biɛn; dɛn nɔ go bifo wan stich.
Frɔm di de we una papa dɛm kɔmɔt Ijipt, te tide, a nɔ de taya fɔ sɛn ɔl mi wokman dɛn we na di prɔfɛt dɛm, to dɛm, de afta de;
pan ɔl dat, dɛn nɔ yɛri mi wɔd ɔ pe atɛnshɔn to mi, bɔt dɛn kɔk dɛn yes. Dɛn du wɔs tin pas dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛm.
“Na so yu go tɔk ɔl dɛn tin ya to dɛm, bɔt dɛn nɔ go lisin yu. Yu go kɔl dɛm bɔt dɛn nɔ go ansa yu.
Ɛn yu go tɛl dɛm se, ‘Na di neshɔn dis we nɔ yɛri PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔ in wɔd, ɛn nɔ gri mek i kɔntrol dɛm; di tru dɔn day; i nɔ de na dɛn mɔt igen
Una kɔt una ia trowe; una kray na dɛn ɛmti mawnten dɛn bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn se i nɔ want ɛn pul an pan di jɛnareshɔn we kin mek i vɛks bad bad wan.’
PAPA GƆD se, “na bikɔs di bɔypikin dɛn na Juda dɔn du ivul tin dɛn bifo mi fes; dɛn dɔn du di bad bad tin dɛn we a nɔ lɛk na mi os we mi nem de, fɔ dɔti am na mi yay.
Ɛn dɛn dɔn bil wan ɔlta we nem Tɔfɛt, we de na Inɔm in bɔypikin in vali, fɔ bɔn dɛn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛm na faya; tin we a nɔ tɛl dɛn fɔ du, ɛn dat nɔ bin kam na mi maynd sɛf.

PAPA GƆD se, “a de tɛl una, fɔseka dat, di tɛm de kam we dɛn nɔ go kɔl am Tɔfɛt ɔ Inɔm in bɔypikin in vali, bɔt dɛn go kɔl am, di Vali ɔf slɔta: bikɔs dɛn go de bɛr na Tɔfɛt, bikɔs, ples nɔ de ɔda say.
Ɛn dɛn pipul ya dɛn dedebɔdi dɛm, go bi it fɔ dɛn bɔd dɛn we de flay ɔp di klawd, ɛn fɔ dɛn wayl animal dɛn na wɔl; ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go skyad dɛm.
Ɛn a go mek gladi gladi ɛn ɛnjɔymɛnt, ɛn ɔkɔ ɛn yawo vɔys, lɔs na di siti dɛn na Juda ɛn di trit dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm, bikɔs di land nɔ go gud fɔ natin.

PAPA GƆD se, “Da tɛm de, dɛn go pul di kiŋ dɛn na Juda dɛm bon, dɛn bigman dɛm bɔn dɛm, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn bon, dɛn prɔfɛt dɛn bon, ɛn di wan dɛn we tap na Jerusɛlɛm dɛn bon, kɔmɔt na dɛn grev;

ɛn dɛn go prɛd dɛm bifo di san ɛn di mun, ɛn ɔl wetin de ɔp di klawd, we dɛn bin lɛk ɛn bin de sav, di tin dɛn we dɛn bin de rɔn afta, tin dɛn we dɛn bin de fɛn ɛn wɔship; dɛn nɔ go gɛda dɛm bɛr dɛm; dɛn go tan lɛk kaw tɔylɛt na grɔn.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, ‘di wan dɛn we go lɛf pan dis ivul famili, go prifa fɔ day dan fɔ liv, na di ples dɛn we a dɔn drɛb dɛm go.’
Yu go tɛl dɛm se, “Na dis PAPA GƆD se; wɛn mɔtalman fɔdɔm, dɛn nɔ de grap bak? If pɔsin kɔmɔt biɛn pɔsin, i nɔ kin tɔn bak kam?
Wetindu dɛn pipul ya dɔn tɔn dɛn bak pan mi ɛn nɔ gri tɔn bak? Dɛn biliv pan lay lay tin dɛn gud gud wan, ɛn nɔ gri tɔn bak kam to mi.

A dɔn pe atɛnshɔn to dɛm ɛn dɔn lisin dɛm, bɔt dɛn nɔ tɔk tru; nɔn pan dɛm nɔ ripɛnt fɔseka in wikɛdnɛs, bifo dat dɛn de aks se, ‘wetin a du?’ Ɔlman de go in yon we, lɛkɛ we ɔs de rɔn go insay batul fil.
Ivin kaw enjɛl we de flay ɔp di klawd no tɛm fɔ tɔmbak; dɛn dɔv, di bɔd we dɛn kɔl swalo, ɛn di big bɔd we dɛn kɔl kren, sɛf no tɛm fɔ tɔn bak go om; bɔt mi pipul dɛn nɔ no PAPA GƆD in lɔ.
‘Aw una go se, ‘wi gɛt sɛns, ɛn PAPA GƆD in lɔ de to wi?’ A de tɛl una, dɛn sɛktri dɛn lay lay pɛn dɛn dɔn mek i dɔn tɔn to lay lay.
Dɛn go mek di sɛnsman dɛn shem, dɛn go kɔnfyus ɛn dɛn go kech dɛm; wetindu? Dɛn dɔn put PAPA GƆD in wɔd wansay, uskayn sɛns dɛn gɛt naw?

Fɔseka dat, a go gi dɛn wɛf dɛm to ɔda man dɛn ɛn dɛn fam dɛm to di wan dɛn we go win dɛm, bikɔs, frɔm di lili wan to di big wan, ɔlman awn awn fɔ tif tif prɔpati; frɔm di prɔfɛt to di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɔlman de pan rikishi.
Dɛn dɔn mɛn mi pipul dɛn wund layt wan, we dɛn de se, ‘kol at, kol at,’ we kol at nɔ de.

Dɛn bin shem wɛn bin de du di tin dɛn we a nɔ lɛk? Nɔ, dɛn nɔ bin shem at ɔl; dɛn nɔ bin no aw fɔ mɛlt. Fɔseka dat, dɛn go day wit dɛn wan dɛm we go day; wɛn a pɔnish dɛm, a go ib dɛm oba. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
PAPA GƆD se, “Wɛn a go gɛda dɛm, nɔn greps nɔ de na di greps tik, ɛn nɔn fignɔt na de na di fig tik; ivin di lif dɛm dɔn wida, ɛn wetin a bin gi dɛm nɔ de pan dɛn igen”

Wetin mek wi de sidɔm ɛn nɔ de du natin? Una gɛda wan ples, lɛ wi go na di siti dɛm we gɛt wɔl rawnd go day de; bikɔs PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd dɔn swɛ wi fɔ day, ɛn i dɔn gi wi pɔyzin wata fɔ drink, bikɔs wi dɔn kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD.
Wi luk fɔ kol at, bɔt nɔn gud nɔ kɔmɔt bien, wi luk fɔ tɛm fɔ mɛn wisɛf, bɔt na tin dɛn we mek wi fred apin.
Dɛn yɛri dɛn ɔs dɛn we dɛn de sniz ɔl di we na Dan; we dɛn man ɔs dɛn de ala, di wanol land de shek. Dɛn kam kam it ɔltin na di land ɛn wetin fulɔp de, dat na di siti ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we tap de.
Bikɔs, a de sɛn snek dɛm go tap wit una da smɔl ɛn pɔyzinɔs snek we dɛn nɔ go ebul tem, ɛn dɛn go bɛt una, Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Mi sɔro nɔ de dɔn, mi at sik.
Yɛri, mi pipul dɛn gyal pikin dɛn kray, ɔlɔbɔt na di land; “PAPA GƆD nɔ de na Zayɔn? In kiŋ nɔ de de? “Wetindu dɛn provok mi te a vɛks wit dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛn, ɛn wit fɔrin lay lay gɔd dɛm?”
“Di avɛst dɔn pas, ɛn di dray sizin dɔn dɔn, ɛn wi nɔ sev.”
Bikɔs mi pipul dɛn gyal pikin dɛn wund de na mi at, Mi at pwɛl, ɛn pwɛlat dɔn kech mi.
Mɛrɛsin nɔ de na Giliad? Dɔkta nɔ de de? So wetindu mi pipul dɛn gyal pikin nɔ wɛl te tide?
If nɔmɔ mi ed na bin wata, ɛn mi yay dɛm na fawnten we de pul wata na yay, so dat a go kray de ɛn nɛt fɔ di kil we dɛn kil mi pipul dɛn gyal pikin!

If nɔmɔ a bin gɛt lɔjin ples na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, fɔ pipul dɛn we de pas de, so dat a go lɛf mi pipul dɛm ɛn kɔmɔt nia dɛm go ɔda say! Bikɔs dɛn ɔl na pipul dɛm we de fala dɛn kɔmpin man ɛn wɛf, dɛn de togɛda de du ɛnitin fɔ gɛt ɛnitin we dɛn want.
PAPA GƆD se, ‘Dɛn bɛn dɛn tɔŋ dɛm lɛkɛ bo; na rikishi instɛd ɔf tru, dɔn tinap traŋa wan na di land; bikɔs dɛn de kɔmɔt frɔm wan ivul tin to ɔda wan, ɛn dɛn nɔ no mi.
Lɛ ɔlman tek tɛm wit in neba, ɛn nɔ biliv nɔn brɔda; bikɔs ɔl di brɔda dɛn disitful, ɛn ɔl neba de go ɔlɔbɔt de koŋosa.
Ɔlman de disiv in neba, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de tɔk tru; dɛn dɔn lan dɛn mɔt fɔ lay; dɛn de kɔmit sin ɛn kin fil taya pasmak fɔ ripɛnt.
PAPA GƆD se, ‘Dɛn de pak sɔprɛshɔn pan sɔprɛshɔn ɛn rikishi pan rikishi, ɛn dɛn nɔ gri fɔ no mi.
Fɔseka dat, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, “Naw, a go klin dɛm ɛn tɛst dɛm, bikɔs wetin igen a go du fɔ mi pipul dɛm?
Dɛn tɔŋ na aro we de kil pɔsin; i de disiv pipul; dɛn de tɔk pisfuli to dɛn neba dɛn wit dɛn mɔt, bɔt insay in at, i de plan fɔ du am bad.
PAPA GƆD se, ‘A nɔ fɔ pɔnish dɛm fɔ dɛn kayn tin dɛn ya? Ɛn a nɔ fɔ rivɛnj fɔ mi nem pan kayn neshɔn lɛkɛ dis?

Una bigin kray ɛn ala fɔ dɛn mawnten dɛm, ɛn kray fɔ di say dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples, bikɔs dɛn de yuslɛs wan, so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ de pas de, ɛn dɛn nɔ de yɛri di kaw dɛn de kray igen; di bɔd dɛm we de flay na di skay, ɛn di animal dɛn, dɔn rɔnawe.
A go mek Jerusɛlɛm broko broko ples we ɔltin pak pantap in kɔmpin, ples we na so so Jakal tap; di siti dɛn na Juda go tɔn ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, ples we anch sɛf nɔ de.”

Udat na di man we so gɛt sɛns dat i kin ɔndastand dɛn tin ya? Udat PAPA GƆD tɔk to we go tɛl di ɔda pipul dɛm? Wetindu ɔltin na di land broko broko ɛn lɛf yuslɛs, lɛk di dray ɛn ɛmti ples, we mek pipul dɛn nɔ de pas de?
Ɛn PAPA GƆD se, “Bikɔs dɛn dɔn fɔsek mi lɔ we a gi dɛm, ɛn nɔ du wetin a se, ɔ du tin akɔdin to mi lɔ,
bɔt dɔn tek traŋayes du wetin dɛn yon at se, ɛn go wɔship dɛn Beal, jɛs lɛk aw dɛn fɔstɛmapa dɛn lan dɛm.
Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na di Gɔd na Izrɛl se: A go fid dɛn pipul dɛn ya wit wɔm wud, ɛn gi dɛn wata we gɛt pɔyzin fɔ drink.
A go skata dɛm na difrɛn difrɛn neshɔn dɛn we dɛm o, dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛm o, nɔ no wande; ɛn a go de kil kil dɛm, te a kil dɛn dɔn.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se: “Tink, ɛn sɛn kɔl dɛn uman dɛm we de munin; sɛn kɔl di uman dɛm we sabi wok wit dɛn an;
lɛ dɛn mekes kam ɛn kam bigin kray fɔ wi, so dat wata go rɔn wi yay, ɛn wi yay in kɔba go bɔs wata.
Bikɔs, wi de yɛri pipul dɛn de kray na Zayɔn se: “Wetin mek wi dɔn alaki so! Dɛn dɔn disgres wi bad bad wan,, bikɔs wi dɔn kɔmɔt na di land, bikɔs dɛn dɔn brok brok wi os dɛm.”
Una dɛn uman dɛm, una yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd, ɛn lɛ una yes dɛn lisin gud wetin de kɔmɔt nain mɔt; una tich una gyal pikin aw fɔ kray, ɛn ɔlman tich in neba wan wan bɛrin siŋ.
Bikɔs, day dɔn pas na wi winda dɛm, kam insay wi kiŋ os dɛm, i dɔn mek wi pikin nɔ de go na trit ɛn mek di yɔŋbɔy dɛm nɔ de go midul tɔŋ igen
Tɔk se, “Na so PAPA GƆD se: “Dɛn man dɛn dedebɔdi dɛn go fɔdɔm lɛkɛ kaw pupu na fam, lɛkɛ kɔn we nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛda, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go gɛda dɛm.’”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, “Le di sɛnsman nɔ bost fɔ in sɛns, le di pawaful man nɔ bost fɔ in trɛnk, ɛn lɛ di jɛntri man nɔ boast bɔt in jɛntri;

bɔt le udat de bost, bost se in ɔndastand mi ɛn no mi, ɛn dat mi na PAPA GƆD we mi lɔv nɔ de shek, a de trit ɔlman di sem, ɛn a de waka tret na dis wɔl; bikɔs na dɛn tin ya de mek a gladi; na so PAPA GƆD se.
PAPA GƆD se, “Di tɛm de kam, we a go pɔnish ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we sakɔmsayz bɔt stil dɛn nɔ sakɔmsayz –

Ijipt, Juda, Idɔm, di bɔypikin dɛn na Amɔn, Moab, ɛn ɔl udat tap na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, we de krep rawnd dɛn ed; bikɔs ɔl dɛn neshɔn dɛn de nɔ sakɔmsayz, ɛn di wanol Izrɛl dɛn at nɔ sakɔmsayz.”
Izrɛl, una yɛri di wɔd we PAPA GƆD de tɛl una.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Una nɔ lan dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn we, ɔ mek dɛn sayn dɛn we de sho ɔp di skay pwɛl una at bikɔs dɛn neshɔn dɛm kin fred dɛm,
bikɔs na fɔls kɔstɔm di neshɔn dɛn gɛt. Dɛn kɔt wan tik na di fɔrɛst, ɛn man we de wok wit in an tek aks kav am.
Pipul dɛn drɛs am wit silva ɛn gold; dɛn fasin am wit ama ɛn nel so dat i nɔ go kɔmɔt.
Dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛm na lɛkɛ Ta bebi na wata mɛlɔn fam, ɛn dɛn nɔ de tɔk; pas dɛn tot dɛm, bikɔs dɛn nɔ ebul waka. Nɔ fred dɛm, bikɔs dɛn nɔ ebul du yu bad, semweso, i nɔ de pan dɛn fɔ du gud.”
Nɔn gɔd nɔ de we tan lɛkɛ yu, PAPA GƆD; yu wɔndaful, ɛn yu nem gret ɛn pawaful.

Udat de we nɔ go fred yu, Yu we kiŋ fɔ di neshɔn dɛm? Bikɔs ɔlman sɔpoz fɔ rɛspɛkt yu; bikɔs pan ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we gɛt sɛns bad bad wan na di neshɔn dɛm ɛn insay ɔl dɛn kindɔm dɛm, nɔn nɔ de we tan lɛkɛ yu.
Dɛn styupid ɛn fulish; wetin dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛn we na ɛmti bod go ebul tich dɛm ɔ tɛl dɛm!
Dɛn bay lay lay gɔd we dɛn pent wit silva na Spen, ɛn gold wan na Ufaz. Na man we de kav tiŋs dɛn ɛn goldsmit, mek dɛm; dɛn klos dɛn na rɛd ɛn mov; na pipul dɛn we de wok wit dɛn an mek dɛm.
Bɔt na PAPA GƆD na di tru tru Gɔd; in na di Gɔd we de alayv ɛn di kiŋ we de sote go. We i vɛks, di wanol wɔl de shek, ɛn di neshɔn dɛm nɔ ebul bia in vɛksteshɔn.
Na dis yu go tɛl dɛm: “Dɛn gɔd dɛm we nɔto dɛn mek ɔp di klawd ɛn dɔŋ di grɔn, go alaki na grɔn ɛn ɔnda di klawd.”
Naim mek di wɔl wit in pawa, in we yuz in sɛns mek di wɔl, ɛn tek in sabi prɛd di klawd.
Wɛn i pas kɔmand, di wata dɛn we de ɔp di klawd kin slap slap dɛnsɛf; ɛn i kin mek smok grap kɔmɔt na di las las pat dɛn na di wɔl. I mek laytin fɔseka ren, ɛn i briŋ briz kɔmɔt nain sto.
Ɔl mɔtalman styupid ɛn nɔ gɛt sɛns; ɔl dɛn goldsmit dɛn go shem fɔ dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛm; bikɔs dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛn na lay lay, ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt layf.
Dɛn yuslɛs, ɛn na imajin dɛn imajin da kayn tin de; di tɛm we dɛn go gɛt dɛn pɔnishmɛnt, dɛn go day.
Di wan we Jekob gɛt nɔ tan lɛkɛ dɛn wan ya, bikɔs nain mek ɔltin, ɛn Izrɛl na di pipul dɛn we i pik fɔ insɛf; na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nain nem.
Una gɛda una bɔndul na grɔn, una we dɛn dɔn sɔrawnd!
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD se “A de trowe di wan dɛm we tap na di land, na do dis tɛm, ɛn a go briŋ trɔbul pan dɛm, so dat dɛn go fil am.”
E mi, swɛ dɔn kech mi, fɔseka di kayn pen we a de fil! A wund bad bad wan. Bɔt a se “Fɔ tru tru dis na siknɛs, ɛn a mɔs bia wit am.”
Mi tɛnt dɔn pwɛl, ɛn ɔl di rop dɛn dɔn kɔt kɔt; mi pikin dɛn dɔn lɛf mi go; ɛn wan nɔ lɛf; nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ bil mi tɛnt bak, ɛn ɛŋ mi kɔtin dɛm.
Bikɔs di shɛpad dɛn styupid, ɛn dɛn nɔ de aks PAPA GƆD bɔt natin; dat mek dɛn nɔ du wɛl na layf, ɛn ɔl dɛn ship dɛm dɔn skata ɔlɔbɔt.
Una lisin, na rumɔ! Luk, i de kam! –- Big kɔnfyushɔn de na di nɔt kɔntri fɔ kam mek di siti dɛn na Juda ɛmti, ɛn ples we na so so Jakal tap.
PAPA GƆD, a no se wetin mɔtalman de du nɔ de nainyon an, ɛn mɔtalman nɔ ebul kɔntrol inyon layf ɔ dayrɛkt in stɛp dɛm.
Kɔrɛkt mi PAPA GƆD, bɔt mek am smɔl smɔl mek a nɔ fil am nɔto we yu vɛks, if nɔ so yu go jɛs kil mi.
Tɔn mi vɛksteshɔn pan di neshɔn we nɔ no yu, ɛn pan di pipul dɛn we nɔ de pre to yu; bikɔs dɛn dɔn kil Jekɔb; dɛn dɔn kil am ɛn it am, ɛn dɛn dɔn mek di ples we i bin tap, yuslɛs.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd we rich Jɛrimaya: I se,
“Lisin wetin wi gri pan insay di Kɔvinant, ɛn tɛl di man dɛm na Juda ɛn dɛn wan dɛm we tap na Jerusɛlɛm.
Yu go tɛl dɛm se, Na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Na alaki go mit di pɔsin we nɔ du wetin di Kɔvinant se,

we a bin kɔmand una fɔstɛmpapa dɛn fɔ du, we a bin briŋ dɛm kɔmɔt Ijipt, kɔmɔt na di ayɛn fayasay, de tɛl dɛn se, Una lisin mi ɛn du ɔl wetin a kɔmand una fɔ du. Na dat go mek una bi mi pipul dɛn ɛn mi go bi una Gɔd,
so dat a go du wetin a bin dɔn swɛ to una fɔstɛmpapa dɛn se a go du fɔ dɛm, dat na fɔ gi dɛn wan land we gud fɔ plant ɛn fɔ mɛn animal we dɛn gɛt so.” Nain a ansa se, “PAPA GƆD, lɛ i bi so.”
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “Anawns ɔl dɛn tin ya na di siti dɛn na Juda ɛn na di trit dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm: Yɛri wetin di Kɔvinant se, dɛn du dɛm.
Bikɔs a bin wɔn una fɔstɛmpapa dɛn siriɔs siriɔs wan we a bin pul dɛn kɔmɔt Ijipt, ɛn a bin de wɔn dɛm ɔltɛm, ivin to tide, Una de du wetin a se una fɔ de du.

Stil dɛn nɔ du am ɔ ivin lisin, bɔt dɛn ɔl du di traŋayes tin we dɛn ivul at tɛl dɛn fɔ du. Na dat mek a dɔn tɛl dɛn di kayn pɔnishmɛnt we di Kɔvinant we a bin kɔmand dɛn fɔ obe, bɔt dɛn nɔ bin obe, se dɛn fɔ gɛt
PAPA GƆD tɛl mi bak se, “Ribɛliɔn de bitwin di man dɛm na Juda ɛn dɛn wan dɛm we tap na Jerusɛlɛm.
Dɛn dɔn tɔn bak to dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛn we nɔ bin gri yɛri mi wɔd, dɛn sin; dɛn dɔn go fɔ go sav ɔda gɔd dɛm; Izrɛl ɛn Juda dɔn brok mi Kɔvinant we a bin mek wit dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛm.
Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se, A de briŋ ivul tin pan dɛm we dɛn nɔ go ebul pul dɛn ed kɔmɔt; ɔl we dɛn go kray to mi, A nɔ go lisin dɛm.
Da tɛm de, di siti dɛm na Juda ɛn di wan dɛm we tap na Jerusɛlɛm, go go ɛn kray to di gɔd dɛm we dɛn bin de bɔn insɛns to, bɔt dɛn nɔ go ebul sev dɛm we trɔbul mit dɛm.
