Bikɔs una gɔd dɛm dɔn bɔku lɛkɛ aw una siti dɛm dɛn bɔku, Yu Juda; ɛn lɛkɛ aw di trit dɛm bɔku na Jerusɛlɛm, na semweso di ɔlta dɛm we una dɔn bil we shemful, dɛnsɛf bɔku; ɔlta dɛn fɔ bɔn insɛns to Beal.
Fɔseka dat, nɔ pre fɔ dɛn pipul dɛn ya, ɔ kray to mi, ɔ pre fɔ beg fɔ dɛm, bikɔs a nɔ go lisin we dɛn kɔl mi we trɔbul mit dɛm.
Us rayt di wan we a lɔv gɛt insay mi os we dɛn dɔn ple dɔti gem? Na vaw dɛn we i go mek ɔ we i sakrifays flɛsh go ebul mek i nɔ alaki? Yu go gladi afta dat?
PAPA GƆD bin de kɔl yu, ‘Grin greps tik, we fayn fɔ si wit frɛsh frɛsh frut dɛm’; bɔt na wantɛm ala i gɔ ala wit ebi tɛnda ɛn laytin, i go sɛt faya pan am, ɛn ɔl in branch dɛm go bɔn.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, we bin plant una, dɔn swɛ una, fɔseka di ivul tin we Izrɛl ɛn Juda dɔn du, we dɛn provok mi te a vɛks, we dɛn de bɔn insɛns to Beal.”
PAPA GƆD bin mek a no, ɛn a bin no; dɔn i bin did sho mi di ivul tin dɛn we dɛn de du.

Bɔt mi na bin lɛk nays ship pikin we dɛn kɛr go fɔ go kil. A nɔ bin no se na bin agens mi dɛn bin dɔn mek plɔt, we dɛn de se, “Lɛ wit pwɛl pwɛl di tik wit in frut dɛm, lɛ wi kil am, so dat dɛn nɔ go mɛmba in nem igen.”
Bɔt, duya PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, yu we de jɔj rayt, yu we de tɛst di at ɛn di maynd, rivɛnj fɔ mi, bikɔs na to yu a lɛf mi kes.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt di man dɛn na Anatɔt we wan kil yu ɛn de tɔk se, “We yu de prɔfisay, yu nɔ fɔ tɔk se na PAPA GƆD se, ɔ nɔso, wi go kil yu”–
so, na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se fɔseka dat: “Biliv mi, a go pɔnish dɛm; di yɔŋbɔy dɛm go day na wa; dɛn bɔypikin dɛm ɛn dɛn gyal pikin go day wit aŋri;
ɛn nɔn pan dɛn nɔ go lɛf. Bikɔs a go mek bad bad tin mit di man dɛm na Anatɔt, we di ia fɔ dɛn pɔnishmɛnt kam.”

PAPA GƆD, ɛni tɛm we a kɔmplen to yu, na yu kin gɛt rayt, Pan ɔl dat, a stil de kɛr mi kes go to yu. Wetindu wikɛd pipul dɛn de bɛtɛ na layf? Wetindu ɔl dɛn pipul dɛn we de ple dakadeke de bɛtɛ na layf?
Yu plant dɛn, ɛn dɛn pul rut ɔnda grɔn, dɛn gro ɛn bia frut, yu de nia dɛn mɔt ɛn fawe frɔm dɛn at.
E PAPA GƆD, yu no mi; yu de si mi, ɛn yu kin tɛst fɔ no di kayn maynd we a gɛt fɔ yu. Pul dɛm kɔmɔt na do lɛk ship we dɛn de go kil, ɛn put dɛm wansay fɔ di de we dɛn kin kil dɛm.

Aw lɔŋ di land go de sɔri, ɛn di gras na ɔl dɛn fil de wida? Fɔseka di wikɛdnɛs we di wan dɛm we tap de, de du, di animal dɛm ɛn di bɔd dɛm ɔl de day, bikɔs pipul dɛn de tɔk se; “I nɔ go si aw wi go ɛnd.”
“If yu dɔn rɔn res wit pipul dɛm, ɛn yu dɔn gens wit dɛm, aw yu go ebul rɔn res wit ɔs? Ɛn if yu fɔdɔm na land we sef, aw yu go du insay di jɔngul we de nia Riva Jɔdan?
Bikɔs, ivin yu brɔda dɛn ɛn yu di wan dɛn we de na yu papa in os sɛf dɔn mek yu dakadeke; dɛn de tigi tigi biɛn di wan dɛn we de agens yu; nɔ biliv dɛm, ɔl we dɛn de tɔk faynfayn wan to yu.”
“A dɔn fɔsek mi os, A dɔn abandɔn Izrɛl; A dɔn giwe di wande lɛk insay mi sol to in ɛnimi dɛm.
Di pipul dɛn we a dɔn pik dɔn tɔn to mi lɛkɛ layɔn na fɔrɛst, I dɔn ala pan mi; fɔseka dat, a dɔn et am.
Mi pipul dɛn we a klɛk dɔn tɔn to mi lɛk da spɔt spɔt bɔd we dɛn kin ɔntin fɔ it? Ɔl dɛn bɔd dɛn we dɛn de ɔntin fɔ it, de atak ɔlɔbɔt? Go, go gɛda ɔl dɛn wayl animal dɛn; briŋ dɛm lɛ dɛn kam it.
Plɛnti shɛpad dɛn dɔn pwɛl pwɛl usay a de plant greps, dɛn dɔn mas mas mi fam, dɛn dɔn mek mi fayn fayn ples to wan ɛmti ɛn dray, gud fɔ natin ples.
Dɛn dɔn mek i tɔn ɛmti ples; i ɛmti, i de kray to mi. Di wanol land dɔn ɛmti, bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ bisin.
Pipul dɛn we de nyakanyaka dɔn kɔmɔt na ɔl dɛn mawten dɛn na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, kam; bikɔs PAPA GƆD in sɔd de kil frɔm wan ɛnd na di land, to di ɔda ɛnd; nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛt kol at.
Dɛn dɔn plant wit, ɛn dɛn avɛst chuk chuk, dɛn dɔn yagba dɛnsɛf te dɛn dɔn taya, bɔt nɔ prɔfit natin. Dɛn go shem fɔseka dɛn avɛst fɔseka PAPA GƆD in bad bad vɛksteshɔn.”

Na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt ɔl mi bad bad neba dɛm we put an pan di prɔpati we a dɔn gi Izrɛl we na mi pipul dɛm, as dɛn yon prɔpati: “A de tɛl yu, a go rut dɛm kɔmɔt na dɛn land, ɛn a go rut Juda kɔmɔt pan dɛm.
Ɛn afta a dɔn rut dɛm kɔmɔt, a go sɔri fɔ dɛm, ɛn a go briŋ dɛn ɔl kam bak, ich to in pipul dɛn, ɛn ich wan, to dɛn land.

Dɔn, if dɛn go tek tɛm lan fɔ liv di we we mi pipul dɛn liv, fɔ tek mi nem swɛ se, ‘Wans PAPA GƆD de,’ lɛk aw dɛn bin lan mi pipul dɛm fɔ swɛ wit Beal in nem, na da tɛm de dɛn go ebul mek ɔp dɛnsɛf we dɛn de wit mi pipul dɛm.
Bɔt, if ɛni neshɔn nɔ lisin, a go rut am kɔmɔt ɔltogɛda ɛn nyakanyaka am. Na so PAPA GƆD se.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD tɛl mi, “Go bay wan linin skintayt, wɛr am, ɛn nɔ dɔk am na wata”
So a bay wan linin skintayt bay wetin PAPA GƆD se, ɛn wɛr am.
Naim PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi sɛkɛn tɛm se,
“Pul di skintayt we yu bay, we de na yu wes, ɛn go na Riva Yufretis, ɛn ayd am insay insay usay di rɔk plit.”
So a go ayd am nia Riva Yufretis, lɛk aw PAPA GƆD bin kɔmand mi fɔ du.
Afta lɔŋ tɛm, PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “Go na Riva Yufretis go tek di skintayt we a bin kɔmand yu fɔ go ayd de, kɔmɔt de.”
Nain a go na Riva Yufretis, ɛn dig di skintayt kɔmɔt na di ple we a bin ayd am. We a go luk am, di skintayt dɔn pwɛl; it nɔ bin gud fɔ natin.
Nain PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: na semweso a go pwɛl Juda in prawd we i de mek ɛn di tin we mek Jerusɛlɛm de kak.
Dɛn ivul pipul dɛn ya, we nɔ gri yɛri mi wɔd, we de fala dɛn yon stɔbɔn at de go wɔship ɛn sav ɔda gɔd dɛm, go tan lɛk dis skintayt we nɔ gud igen fɔ natin.

Bikɔs, lɛk aw skintayt kin grip pɔsin wes, na semweso a bin mek di wanol Izrɛl ɛn di wanol Juda ol mi tayt, so dat dɛn go bi mi yon pipul dɛm, pipul dɛn we go mek nem fɔ mi, we go mek dɛn prez mi, we go mek a femɔs; bɔt usay, dɛn nɔ gri lisin to mi. Na so PAPA GƆD se.

PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɛrimaya fɔ tɛl di pipul dɛn se ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se, “Ɔl dɛn jɔg dɛn go ful wit wayn.” PAPA GƆD se, ‘Dɔn dɛn go aks yu se, ‘Na tru se wi nɔ bin no se ɔl dɛn jɔg dɛn go ful wit wayn?’

Dɔn yu go tɛl dɛn se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Biliv mi, a go mek ɔlman we tap na land drɔŋɔ: Di kiŋ dɛm we sidɔm na Devid in tron, di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, di prɔfɛt dɛm, ɛn ɔlman we tap na di Jerusɛlɛm go drɔŋɔ.
PAPA GƆD se, “A go kech tu pɔsin baŋ dɛn pan dɛnsɛf; a go baŋ papa ɛn pikin. A nɔ go fil am fɔ nɔbɔdi, ɔ nɔ go lɛf nɔbɔdi ɔ a sɔri fɔ ɛnibɔdi, we go mek a nɔ dɔnawe wit am.”
Una yɛri o ɛn una lisin; una lɛf fɔ mek prawd, bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk.
Una glɔrifay PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd bifo di ples dak, bifo una bɔk una fut, na dɛn mawnten dɛn na nɛt, ɛn wɛn yu de luk se layt de kam i mek di ples dak lilibit, ɛn mek i dak bad bad wan.
Bɔt if una nɔ gri lisin, mi sol go kray sikrit wan fɔ di prawd we una de mek; mi yay dɛn go kray bita bita wan, ɛn de rɔn wata bikɔs dɛn dɔn kɛr PAPA GƆD in ship dɛn go mek slev.
Tɛl di kiŋ ɛn di kwin mami se; “Una de wit di ɔdinari pipul dɛm, bikɔs una fayn fayn krawn dɔn kɔmɔt na una ed.”
Di siti dɛn na di Nɛgɛb dɔn lɔk, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ opin dɛm; dɛn dɔn kɛr di wanol Juda ɛgzayl, dɛn kɛr dɛn ɔl go ɛgzayl.
“Una es una yay ɔp ɛn luk di wan dɛn we de kɔmɔt na di nɔt. We di ship dɛn we dɛn bin gi una, una fayn fayn ship dɛm?
Wetin una go se, wɛn dɛn put dɛn wan dɛn we na una sɛf tich fɔ bi una padi dɛn, oba una? Pen nɔ go ol una lɛk uman we de lebɔ?
Ɛn if una tɔk na una at se, ‘Wetindu dɛn tin dɛn ya dɔn apin to wi?’ Na bikɔs una sin dɛm dɔn bɔku nain mek dɛn dɔn es una skat dɛn ɔp, ɛn rep una.
Pɔsin we kɔmɔt Itiopia go ebul chenj in bɔdi in kɔla ɔ lɛpɛt wep in spɔt dɛm kɔmɔt? So una we na fɔ du bad nɔmɔ de na una blɔd, kin ebul du gud.
A go skata una lɛk chaf chaf we briz we kɔmɔt na ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, de blo.
PAPA GƆD se na so i fɔ bi to una, dis na una pɔshɔn we a dɔn mɛnshɔ fɔ una, bikɔs yu dɔn fɔgɛt bɔt mi, ɛn de biliv pan lay lay.
Na misɛf sɛf go es una skat kɔba una fes, ɛn una go disgres.

A dɔn si di kayn ambishɔn we una gɛt, una adɔltri dɛm ɛn di mek we una de mek lɛk ɔs, ɛn una lo lo rare layf, na dɛn il dɛm ɛn dɛn fam. Swɛ go mit yu, Yu Jerusɛlɛm! Aw lɔŋ yu go de bifo yu go klin na Gɔd yay?
PAPA GƆD in wɔd we rich Jɛrimaya kɔnsanin di drawt:
“Juda de kray ɛn in get dɛm lɛf ɛmti; in pipul lidɔm na grɔn de kray, ɛn di kary we Jerusɛlɛm de kray, de go ɔp.
Di bigman dɛm we de de, sɛn dɛn wokman dɛm fɔ go gɛt wata; dɛn kam na di wɛl dɛm, dɛn nɔ si wata, dɛn go bak wit ɛmti kitul dɛm; dɛn shem ɛn kɔnfyus, ɛn dɛn kɔba dɛn ed.
Bikɔs di grɔn nɔ bia natin, bikɔs ren nɔ kam, di fama dɛn de shem, dɛn kɔba dɛn ed.
Ivin di uman dia na bush de fɔsek in yɔŋ pikin we i jɛs bɔn bikɔs gras nɔ de.
Dɛn wayl dɔŋki dɛm tinap na di ɛmti il dɛm, dɛn de blo lɛk we dɛn dɔg kin pul dɛn tɔŋ na do; dɛn nɔ de si bɛtɛ igen bikɔs tin nɔ de fɔ it.
“Ɔldo wi sin dɛm de sho se wi dɔti na Gɔd yay, bɔt duya PAPA GƆD, du sɔntin fɔseka yu nem; bikɔs wi bakslayd bɔku bɔku tɛm, wi dɔn kɔmit sin to yu.
E ya, yu we na yu Izrɛl abop pan, yu we kin sev am we i gɛt trɔbul, wetin mek yu fɔ tan lɛkɛ trenja na di land, lɛkɛ pɔsin we de travul we kan beg fɔ slip fɔ di nɛt?
Wetin mek yu fɔ tan lɛkɛ pɔsin we kɔnfyus, lɛkɛ pawaful man we nɔ ebul sev pɔsin? Bɔt stil, yu PAPA GƆD, de wit wi, ɛn na yu gɛt wi; duya, nɔ lɛf wi.”

Na dis PAPA GƆD se kɔnsanin dɛn pipul ya: “Na so dɛn dɔn lɛk fɔ de rɔnawe pan mi, dɛn nɔ de kɔntrol dɛn fut; fɔseka dat, PAPA GƆD nɔ go aksɛpt dɛm, naw, i go mɛmba dɛn sin dɛm ɛn pɔnish dɛm fɔseka dɛn sin dɛm.”
PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se: “Nɔ pre fɔ dɛn pipul dɛn ya.
Ilɛk dɛn fast, a nɔ go yɛri dɛn kray, ɛn ilɛk dɛn mek sakrifays we dɛn de bɔn na faya ɛn sid ɔfrin, a nɔ go tek dɛm; bɔt a go kil dɛm wit wa, aŋri ɛn wit bad bad sik dɛm.
Nain a se; “E, Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd, di prɔfɛt dɛm de tɛl dɛm se, ‘Una nɔ go fɛt wa, ɛn una nɔ go day wit aŋri, bɔt a go mɔs gi una kol at na dis ples,’”

Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se; “Di prɔfɛt dɛm de yuz mi nem fɔ gi lay lay prɔfisi; A nɔ sɛn dɛm ɛn a nɔ tɛl dɛm fɔ tɔk to dɛm. Na lay lay prɔfisi dɛn de gi una; na lay lay vishɔn dɛn de pul na dɛn ed de lay gi una.

Fɔseka dat, PAPA GƆD se, kɔnsanin di prɔfɛt dɛm we de tek mi nem gi lay lay prɔfisi, ɔl we a nɔ sɛn dɛm, ɛn de se, ‘Wa ɛn bad bad aŋri nɔ go kam na dis land’: Na wa ɛn bad bad aŋri go kil dɛn prɔfɛt dɛn de.

Ɛn dɛn go trowe di pipul dɛm we dɛn de prɔfisay to, midul trit na Jerusɛlɛm. Na aŋri ɛn wa go kil dɛm ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go bɛr dɛm– nɔbɔdi nɔ go de fɔ bɛr dɛm – dɛm, dɛn wɛf dɛm, dɛn bɔypikin dɛm ɛn dɛn gyal pikin dɛm. Bikɔs a go gi dɛn di pe fɔ dɛn wikɛdnɛs.
“Yu go tɛl dɛm se: ‘Lɛ wata rɔn mi yay de ɛn nɛt, ɛn lɛ dɛn nɔ tap, bikɔs dɛn dɔn wund mi pipul dɛn gyal pikin we na vajin bad bad wan we dɛn wap am at at wan.

If a go na fam, a go si dɛn wan dɛn we day na wa! If a go insay di siti a go mit bad bad aŋri de! Bikɔs di prɔfɛt ɛn di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, de wirɔn ɔp ɛn dɔŋ de mek pipul dɛn pe dɛn fɔ dɛn wok, we dɛn nɔ no natin.’”

Yu nɔ want Juda igen igen? Yu dɔn et Zayɔn? Wetin mek yu put siknɛs pan wi so dat mɛrɛsin nɔ de fɔ mɛn am? Wi luk fɔ pis, bɔt nɔn gud nɔ kam; we wet se tɛm go kam we wi go wɛl, bɔt na bad bad tritmɛnt wi gɛt.
E PAPA GƆD, wi gri se wi dɔn du bad ɛn wi gri se wi fɔstɛmpapa dɛn bin kɔmit sin, bikɔs wi dɔn sin to yu.
Nɔ luk usay yu nem de bad yay, nɔ disɔna yu tron we ɔlman de prez; duya, mɛmba o ɛn nɔ brok di Kɔvinant we yu mek wit wi.

Ɛni pan dɛn neshɔn dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛn we de mek ren kam, de wit una? Ɔ di klawd insɛf ebul mek ren kam? Nɔto yu na di wan we de mek ɔl dat bi, PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd? Na yu wi abop pan, bikɔs na yu de du ɔl dɛn tin ya.
Nain PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, ‘Ɔlwe Mozis ɛn Samiɛl bin tinap bifo mi, mi at stil nɔ bin tek dɛn pipul ya. Drɛb dɛn kɔmɔt bifo mi lɛ dɛn go!

Ɛn wɛn dɛn aks yu se, ‘usay wi fɔ go?’ Yu fɔ tɛl dɛm se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Dɛn wan dɛn we fɔ day bay siknɛs, go day bay siknɛs, ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we fɔ day na wa, go day na wa; dɛn wan dɛn fɔ day we bay bad bad aŋri, go day bay bad bad aŋri, ɛn di wan dɛn we na fɔ kech kɛr go mek slev, go go as slev.”
“PAPA GƆD se, a go pik fo kayn tin dɛn we go nyakanyaka dɛm; sɔd fɔ kil dɛm, dɔg dɛn fɔ chɛr chɛr dɛm, ɛn di bɔd dɛm na di skay, ɛn di wayl animal dɛn na wɔl fɔ it dɛm ɛn nyakanyaka dɛm.
Ɛn a go mek di difrɛn kɔntri dɛn na di wanol wɔl fred dɛn bad bad wan fɔseka wetin Ɛzikaya we na kiŋ na Juda, in bɔypikin Manasɛ bin du na Jerusɛlɛm.
Udat go sɔri fɔ yu, Yu Jerusɛlɛm, ɔ udat go kray nain at fɔ yu? Udat go lɛf wetin i de du fɔ aks bɔt yu?
PAPA GƆD se, yu bin dɔn tɔn yu bak pan mi, ɛn yu bin jɛs de go biɛn; so a tek akshɔn agens yu ɛn nyakanyaka yu; – A nɔ go ebul sɔri fɔ una igen
A dɔn shifta dɛm wit shifta fɔk na di get na di land dɛm; A dɔn mek dɛn gɛt bɛrin, ɛn a dɔn nyakanyaka mi pipul dɛn; nɔ dɛn nɔ chenj.
A dɔn mek di uman dɛn we dɛn man dɔn day dɔn plɛnti pas di sansan na si; a dɔn briŋ kilman kam sansantɛm kam kil kombra dɛn bɔypikin dɛn; A dɔn mek pen ɛn fred kam pan dɛm wantɛm wantɛm.
Di uman we bɔn sɛvin pikin, dɔn lɛf to insɛf; I dɔn fent;; In san go dɔŋ sansantɛm; dɛn dɔn disgres am ɛn i dɔn shem. A go kil di balans wan dɛm na wa bifo dɛn ɛnimi dɛm. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Trɔbul dɔn mit mi o, mi mami, we yu bɔn mi fɔ de gɛt kɔntɔfili ɛn waala wit ɔlman na di land! A nɔ trɔs to nɔbɔdi wande ɛn a nɔ lɛnt nɔbɔdi, pan ɔl dat, dɛn ɔl de kɔs mi.
Lɛ i bi so, E PAPA GƆD if a nɔ dɔn tɔk to yu fɔ dɛn yon gud, ɛn if a nɔ dɔn beg yu fɔ mi ɛnimi dɛm we dɛn gɛt trɔbul we waala mit dɛm!
Pɔsin go ebul brok ayɛn, ayɛn ɛn brɔnz we kɔmɔt na di nɔt?
“A go giwe ɔl una jɛntri ɛn ɔl una dia dia tin dɛn we una kip, to pipul dɛn we go bit una na wa, fɔseka ɔl di sin dɛn we una kɔmit na una wanol eria,
A go mek una sav una ɛnimi dɛm, na land we una nɔ no, bikɔs we a vɛks, wan faya kin kech we go bɔn sote go.”
E PAPA GƆD, yu no; mɛmba mi ɛn ɛn ɛp mi, ɛn rivɛnj fɔ mi pan di wan dɛm we de du mi bad. Nɔ peshɛnt wit dɛn te dɛn kil mi; no se fɔseka yu a de bia shem.
A yɛri ɔl wetin yu se, ɛn a ɔndastand, ɛn wetin yu se mek a gladi ɛn dat mek mi at swit; bikɔs na yu gɛt mi, O PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti.
A nɔ bin sidɔm wit pipul dɛn we lɛk ɛnjɔymɛnt; ɛn a nɔ bin gladi; A bin sidɔm mi wangren bikɔs na so yu se a fɔ du, bikɔs yu bin dɔn mek a vɛks.
Wetin mek mi pen nɔ de tap, mi wund nɔ de wɛl, i nɔ de gri wɛl? Yuwan tan lɛk watasay we de disiv pipul, lɛkɛ watasay we kin tap fɔ rɔn ɛnitɛm?

Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se; “If yu kam bak, a go tek yu bak, ɛn una go sav mi stil. If yu de tɔk soba tɔk ɛn nɔ de tɔk rɔbish, na yu go de tɛl pipul wetin a se. Dɛn go tɔn to yu, bɔt yu nɔ gɔ tɔn to dɛm.
Ɛn a go mek yu tan lɛk traŋa traŋa brɔnz wɔl to dɛn pipul dɛn ya; dɛn go fɛt yu, bɔt dɛn nɔ go ebul yu, bikɔs a de wit yu fɔ sev yu ɛn pul yu kɔmɔt na dɛn an. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
“A go pul yu kɔmɔt na wikɛd pipul dɛn an, ɛn pe pul yu kɔmɔt na rutlɛs pipul dɛn an.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi bak se,
“Yu nɔ fɔ mared, ɛn yu nɔ fɔ bɔn bɔypikin ɔ gyal pikin dɛm na ya.
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt di bɔypikin ɛn gyal pikin dɛm we bɔn na ya, ɛn bɔt dɛn mami dɛn we bɔn dɛm, ɛn dɛn dadi dɛm we bɔn dɛm na dis land;

Na bad bad siknɛs dɛm go kil dɛm. Nɔbɔdi nɔ go kray fɔ dɛm ɛn dɛn nɔ go bɛr dɛm; dɛn go tan lɛk manyɔ pantap di grɔn. Dɛn go day na wa ɛn wit bad bad aŋri, ɛn dɛn dedebɔdi dɛm go bi it fɔ di bɔd dɛm na di skay, ɛn fɔ dɛn wayl animal dɛm na di wɔl.

“Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se: Una nɔ go insay ɛni os we bɛrin de, ɔ go kray fɔ ɛnibɔdi ɔ sɔri wit dɛm; bikɔs a dɔn tek mi pis kɔmɔt pan dɛn pipul dɛn ya, mi lɛk we a lɛk dɛm we nɔ de shek ɛn mi masi. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Big wan o, ɛn smɔl wan o, ɔl go day na dis land; dɛn nɔ go bɛr dɛm, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go kray fɔ dɛm, ɔ kɔt insɛf ɔ shayn in ed fɔseka dɛm.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ go it ɔ drink wit ɛnibɔdi we de munin, fɔ kos am fɔ di wan dɛn we day; ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go simpatayz wit am fɔ in papa ɔ mami.
Yu nɔ fɔ go insay ɛni os we dɛn de mek gladi gladi, fɔ sidɔm wit dɛm, fɔ it ɛn drink.

Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se; A de tɛl una, a go mek gladi gladi tap na ya, bifo una yay ɛn nainsay una yon tɛm. Laf laf ɛn gladi gladi go tap; ɔkɔ in vɔys ɛn yawo in vɔys go tap na di ples.
“Ɛn wɛn yu tɛl dɛn pipul dɛn ya, ɔl dɛn wɔd ya, dɛn go aks yu se, ‘wetin mek PAPA GƆD dɔn se ɔl dɛn bad bad tin ya fɔ apin to wi? Wetin na wi sin? Us sin i dɔn kɔmit agens PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd?
PAPA GƆD se, dɔn yu go tɛl dɛm se, ‘Na bikɔs una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm dɔn fɔsek mi, ɛn dɔn go de biɛn ɔda gɔd dɛm, ɛn de sav dɛm ɛn wɔship dɛm, ɛn fɔsek mi ɛn nɔ de kip mi lɔ,
ɛn bikɔs una dɔn du wɔs pas una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm, bikɔs a si se una ɔl de fala inyon stɔbɔn ɛn ivul we, ɛn nɔ gri fɔ lisin to mi;
fɔseka dat, a go trowe una kɔmɔt na dis land go na wan land we una ɔ una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm nɔ no, ɛn na de una go sav ɔda gɔd dɛm de ɛn nɛt, bikɔs a nɔ go sho una masi.’
PAPA GƆD se, “Fɔseka dat, di tɛm de kam we nɔbɔdi no go de se, ‘Wans PAPA GƆD we pul di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmɔt Ijipt de,’

bɔt dɛn go se, ‘Wans PAPA GƆD de, PAPA GƆD we pul di Izrɛlayt dɛn kɔmɔt na di nɔt kɔntri, ɛn ɔl dɛn difrɛn kɔntri we in bin dɔn drɛb dɛn go.’ Bikɔs a go briŋ dɛm kam bak na dɛn yon land we a bin dɔn gi dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛm.
“PAPA GƆD se, “Biliv mi, a de sɛn fɔ bɔku fishaman dɛm, ɛn dɛn go kech dɛm; afta dat, a go sɛn fɔ bɔku ɔntin man dɛm, ɛn dɛn go ɔntin dɛm na ɔl di mawnten ɛn ɔl dɛn il, ɛn ɔl di ol dɛm na dɛn rɔk.
Bikɔs mi yay de pan ɔl wetin dɛn de du; natin we dɛn de du nɔ ayd pan mi, ɛn dɛn sin dɛm nɔ ayd pan mi.

Ɛn a go pe dɛm dɔbul fɔ di bad tin dɛn we dɛn de du ɛn fɔ dɛn sin, bikɔs dɛn dɔn dɔti mi land na mi yay wit dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛm we a et bad bad wan, ɛn dɔn fulɔp di land wit di bad bad tin dɛn we a nɔ lɛk.”

E PAPA GƆD, we de gi mi trɛnk ɛn we de protɛkt mi, yu we de kɔba mi we a gɛt trɔbul, na to yu di neshɔn dɛn go kam we go kɔmɔt ɔlsay kan tɔk se: “Dɛn nɔ lɛf natin gi wi fɔstɛmpapa dɛm pas lay lay, wɔtlɛs tin dɛm we nɔ go min natin to dɛm.
Mɔtalman go ebul mek gɔd fɔ insɛf? Dɛn wan dɛn de nɔto gɔd dɛm!”
“Fɔseka dat, a go mek dɛn no dis wantɛm nɔmɔ, a go mek dɛn no mi pawa ɛn mi trɛnk, ɛn dɛn go no se mi nem na PAPA GƆD.”
“Dɛn rayt Juda in sin wit ayɛn pɛn; na wit pɛn we gɛt dayamɔn mɔt dɛn tek dig rayt am pan di tablɛt na dɛn at, ɛn pan di ɔn dɛm na dɛn ɔlta dɛm,
wɛn dɛn pikin dɛn de mɛmba dɛn ɔlta dɛm ɛn dɛn Asherim, we liŋ pan ɔl dɛn grin tik, ɛn de pantap di ay il dɛm,
ɛn na di mawtin dɛn na di opin kɔntri. A go giwe ɔl una Jɛntri ɛn ɔl una dia dia tin dɛn we una kip, fɔseka una sin dɛn we una kɔmit ɔloba di land.
Una go pul an pan di land we a bin gi una, ɛn a go mek una sav una ɛnimi dɛm na land we una nɔ no, bikɔs we a vɛks, faya kin layt we go kech sote go.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Swɛ go mit, di pɔsin we abop pan mɔtalman, we pul in at kɔmɔt to PAPA GƆD ɛn put in at to mɔtalman.
In na lɛk bush we natin nɔ de gro na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, ɛn bɛtɛ nɔ go fala am. I go tap na dɛn ston ston say na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples, na di ples we sɔl de plɛnti ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ tap.
“Di man we abop pan PAPA GƆD go gɛt blɛsin, we na PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ i abop pan.
In na lɛk tik we dɛn plant nia watasay, we de sɛn in rut go nia di wata, ɛn nɔ de fred we di ples ɔt, bikɔs in lif dɛn grin ɔltɛm, ɛn nɔ de kɔtat we drawt kam, bikɔs i nɔ de tap fɔ bia frut”
Mɔtalman at disitful pas ɔltin, ɛn i kɔrɔpt in kayn nɔ de; udat go ebul ɔndastand am?
“Mi PAPA GƆD, sach mɔtalman maynd ɛn tɛst mɔtalman at, fɔ pe ɔlman bay wetin i du, di pe we i fɔ gɛt fɔ di kayn wok we i wok.”
Di pɔsin we de gɛt mɔni di rɔŋ we tan lɛk bush fɔl we de ach eg we i nɔ le, tɛm go kam we dɛn go lɛf am go, ɛn i go kan tɔn fulman in di ɛnd.
Wan gloriɔs tron we de pantap mawnten frɔm di biginin, na di ples we wi fɔ pre to PAPA GƆD.
E PAPA GƆD we Izrɛl abop pan, ɔl udat fɔsek yu go shem; dɛn wan dɛm we tɔn bak pan yu, dɛn go rayt bɔt dɛm na wɔl, bikɔs dɛn fɔsek PAPA GƆD we na di fawnten we de gi wata we de gi layf.
Mɛn mi, duya PAPA GƆD ɛn a go wɛl; sev mi ɛn a go sev; bikɔs na yu a de prez
Dɛn de aks mi se, “We PAPA GƆD in wɔd? Le i kam!”
A fos yu fɔ sɛn ivil ɛn a nɔ want di de fɔ dizasta fɔ kam, yu no; wetin kɔmɔt na mi mɔt na bifo yu a tɔk am.
Nɔ mek a fred yu; Na yu a fɔ go ayd to we a gɛt trɔbul.
Le dɛn wan dɛm we du mi bad, shem, bɔt nɔ mek a shem; le dɛn kɔnfyus; bɔt nɔ mek a kɔnfyus; lɛ di de fɔ ivul kam pan dɛm; ɛn nyakanyaka dɛn dɔbul!
PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se, “Go tinap na Bɛnjamin Get we na de ɔl dɛn kiŋ dɛm na Juda de pas go insay ɛn kan na do, ɛn na ɔl di get dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm,
ɛn tɔk se: Una lisin wetin PAPA GƆD se, una dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Juda ɛn ɔlman na Juda, ɛn ɔl udat tap na Jerusɛlɛm, we de pas na dis get go insay.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Una tek tɛm fɔseka una layf, ɛn nɔtot lod de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst de pas na di get dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm briŋ dɛn kam insay.
Una nɔtot lod kɔmɔt insay una os dɛm de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst de ɔ du ɛni wok, bɔt kip de di fɔ blo ɛn rɛst oli, lɛkɛ aw a bin kɔmand una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm.
Pan ɔl dat, dɛn nɔ lisin ɔ pe atɛnshɔn to mi, bɔt dɛn mekɔp dɛn maynd so dat dɛn no go yɛri fɔ tek wetin a se dɛn fɔ du.
PAPA GƆD se, “Bɔt if una lisin to mi, ɛn nɔ pas insay dis siti in get dɛn wit lod de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst, bɔt una kip di de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst oli ɛn nɔ du nɔn wok,

datɛnde, na kiŋ dɛm we sidɔm na Devid in tron, go pas de kam insay de rayd ɔs ɛn kariej, dɛm ɛn dɛn bigman dɛm, di man dɛn na Juda ɛn di wan dɛn we tap na Jerusɛlɛm; ɛn pipul dɛm go tap na dis siti sote go.

En pipul dɛm go kɔmɔt na di siti dɛm na Juda ɛn dɛn ples dɛm ɔlɔbɔt na Jerusɛlɛm kam. Dɛn go kɔmɔt na Bɛnjamin, Shɛfɛla, di il kɔntri ɛn di nɛgɛb. Dɛn go de briŋ sakrifays we dɛn de bɔn na faya ɛn ɔda sakrifays, sid ɔfrin dɛm ɛn insɛns, ɛn ɔfrin fɔ tɛl tɛnki fɔ kam na PAPA GƆD in os.

Bɔt if una nɔ lisin to mi, fɔ kip di de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst oli, ɛn nɔ fɔ tot lod pas insay di get dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst, a go layt faya nain get dɛm, ɛn i go bɔn di kiŋ os dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul ɔt am.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd we bin mit Jɛrimaya se:
“Grap, ɛn go na di pɔta in os, ɛn na de a go mek yu yɛri wetin a gɛt fɔ tɛl yu.”
So a go dɔŋ na di pɔta in os, ɛn a mit i de wok nain wil.
Ɛn di tin we in bin de mek wit kle pwɛl nain an, so i mek am to ɔda tin ɛn i bin gud we di pɔta du dat.
Nain PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi.
PAPA GƆD se, E Izrɛl, a nɔ fɔ ebul du wit una lɛk aw di pɔta dɔn du? Izrɛl, aw una si di kle tan na di pɔta in an, na semweso una sɛf tan na mi an.
Ɛni tɛm we a tɔk bɔt ɛni neshɔn ɔ kindɔm se a go rut an, brok am dɔŋ ɛn nyakanyaka am,
ɛn if da neshɔn de we a de tɔk bɔt chenj ɛn lɛf fɔ du bad, a go ripɛnt fɔseka di bad we a bin de plan fɔ du to dɛm.
Ɛn, ɛni tɛm we a tɔk sɔntin bɔt ɛni neshɔn ɔ kindɔm se, a go bil am ɛn plant am,
if i du bad tin bifo mi, ɛn nɔ lisin to wetin a se, datɛnde a go ripɛnt fɔ di gud we a bin se a de du dɛm.

Fɔseka dat, tɛl di man dɛm na Juda ɛn dɛn wan dɛm we tap na Jerusɛlɛm se: “Na dis PAPA GƆD se, a de rɛdi fɔ du ivul tin agens una ɛn a de mek plan fɔ una. Lɛ ɔlman chenj kɔmɔt pan in ivul we, ɛn chenj aw una liv ɛn wetin una de du.
“Bɔt dɛn se, ‘Dat na fɔ natin! Wi go du wetin wi dɔn plan ɛn ɔlman go du wetin in traŋayes ɛn ivul at se.
“Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se: Aks na di difrɛn neshɔn dɛm se, udat dɔn yɛri dis kayn tin? Da vajin we na Izrɛl, dɔn du bad bad tin.
Di sno na Libanɔn, de lɛf di stip rɔf rɔk dɛm we de na Siriɔn? Di watasay dɛn na dɛn mawnten dɛn de dray dɛn kol watasay dɛm we de rɔn?
Bɔt mi pipul dɛm dɔn fɔgɛt bɔt mi, dɛn de bɔn insɛns fɔ dɛn lay lay gɔd; dɛn dɔn bɔk fut na di rod dɛn we dɛn de fala we na di ol rod dɛm, ɛn dɛn dɔn lɛf di men rod, go waka na dɛn yad rod,
ɛn dɔn mek dɛn land ples fɔ fred, tin fɔ sɔktik pan sote go. Ɛnibɔdi we pas nia de kin fred ɛn kin shek dɛn ed.
A go skata dɛm lɛkɛ di briz we de blo kɔmɔt na di ist bifo dɛn ɛnimi dɛn. A go sho dɛm mi bak, nɔto mi fes, da de we dɛn kalamiti go mit dɛm.”

Nain dɛn se, “Una kam le wi mek plan agens Jɛrimaya, bikɔs wi nɔ go shɔt ɔf man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ tich wi di lɔ, ɛn sɛnsman dɛn fɔ gi wi sɛns, ɛn prɔfɛt dɛn fɔ tɛl wi PAPA GƆD in wɔd. Dɛn se, una kam lɛ wi tek wi mɔt bit am, ɛn lɛ wi nɔ tek natin we i de se siriɔs.
Lisin to mi, duya PAPA GƆD, ɛn yɛri di beg we a de beg yu.
Iuvl na pemɛnt fɔ gud? Pan ɔl dat, dɛn dɔn dig dip ol fɔ mi layf. Mɛmba aw a bin tinap bifo yu, fɔ tɔk gud bɔt dɛm, fɔ mek yu at kol fɔ dɛm.

Fɔseka dat, gi yu pikin dɛm to bad bad aŋri; mek dɛn kil dɛm na wa, le dɛn wɛf dɛm tɔn uman dɛn we nɔ gɛt pikin, ɛn uman dɛn we dɛn man dɛn dɔn day, mek dɛn man dɛn mit day bay siknɛs, ɛn mek dɛn kil ɔl dɛn yɔŋ bɔbɔ dɛn na wa.
Mek dɛn yɛri kray na dɛn os dɛm, we yu go mek dɛn atak dɛm we dɛn nɔ mekɔp! Bikɔs dɛn dɔn dig dip dip ol fɔ kech mi, ɛn dɔn mek trap dɛn fɔ mi.
PAPA GƆD, yu no ɔl dɛn plan dɛm fɔ kil mi. Nɔ fɔgiv dɛn sin dɛm, ɛn nɔ wep dɛn sin kɔmɔt bifo yu. Lɛ dɛn bit dɛm bifo yu; dil wit dɛm di tɛm we yu vɛks.
Na dis PAPA GƆD bin se, “Go bay kle flask to dɛn pɔta, ɛn go wit sɔm pan di ɛlda dɛm ɛn sɔm pan di bigman dɛm pan di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin,
ɛn go na di vali ɔf di sɔn ɔf Inɔm fɔ go insay Pɔtshɛd Get, ɛn tɔk dɛn wɔd dɛn ya, we a de tɛl yu, lɛ ɔlman yɛri.

Yu fɔ se, ‘Yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD se, una di kiŋ dɛn na Juda ɛn dɛn wan dɛm we tap na Jerusɛlɛm. Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, we na di Gɔd na Izrɛl se, Biliv mi, a go so mek bad bad tin mit una dat ɛnibɔdi we yɛri bɔt dat, in yes go trimbul.

Bikɔs di pipul dɛn dɔn fɔsek mi ɛn bamfa dis ples we dɛn de bɔn insɛns de to ɔda gɔd dɛm we dɛm ɛn dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛm, ɛn dɛn kiŋ dɛn na Juda nɔ no wande; ɛn bikɔs dɛn dɔn ful dis ples wit inosɛnt pipul dɛn blɔd,
ɛn dɛn dɔn bil Beal ɔlta dɛm fɔ bɔn dɛn bɔypikin dɛm insay di faya as sakrifays we dɛn de bɔn na faya, to Beal, we a nɔ kɔmand dɛm ɔ ɔda dɛm fɔ du, ɛn i nɔ bin ivin krɔs mi maynd;
PAPA GƆD se, fɔseka dat, tɛm de kam we dɛn nɔ go kɔl dis ples Tɔfɛt, ɔ Inɔn in bɔypikin in vali Igen, bɔt dɛn go kɔl am di vali ɔf slɔta.

Ɛn na dis ples a go pwɛl Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm dɛn plan, ɛn a go mek dɛn pipul dɛn day na wa bifo dɛn ɛnimi dɛm, ɛn na di wan dɛm we de afta dɛn layf, dɛn an. A go gi dɛn dedebɔdi to dɛn bɔd we de flay na di skay ɛn dɛn wayl animal dɛn na wɔl.
Ɛn a go mek dis siti tɔn ples fɔ fred, ples we dɛn go de sɔktit pan; ɔlman we de pas nia de go fred ɛn sɔktit bikɔs ɔf ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we dɔn mit dɛm.
A go mek dɛn it dɛn bɔypikin ɛn gyalpikin dɛm, ɛn ɔlman go de it in neba, di tɛm we dɛn go sɔrawnd dɛm ɛn distrɛs dɛm, we na dat dɛn ɛnimi dɛm ɛn dɛn wan we de afta dɛn layf, de tek mɔna dɛm.
“Dɔn yu go brok di flask bifo di man dɛm we go wit yu,

ɛn yu go tɛl dɛm se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se: Na so a go brok dɛn pipul ya ɛn dis siti, lɛkɛ we pɔsin de brok di tin we pɔta mek wit kle, so dat dɛn nɔ go ebul pach am igen. Pipul dɛn go de bɛr na Tɔfɛt, bikɔs nɔn ɔda say nɔ go de fɔ bɛr.’
PAPA GƆD se, na so a go du na dis ples, ɛn to di pipul dɛm we tap de fɔ mek dis siti tan lɛkɛ Tɔfɛt.

Di os dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn di kiŋ dɛm na Juda dɛn os dɛm –ɔl di os dɛn we dɛn bin dɔn bɔn insɛns na dɛn ruf, to di san, mun ɛn sta dɛm, ɛn dɔn tɔn drink ɔfrin dɛm to ɔda gɔd dɛm – da os de go dɔti na mi yay lɛk Tɔfɛt, lɛkɛ dis ples Tɔfɛt.’”
Nain Jɛrimaya kɔmɔt na Tɔfɛt, usay PAPA GƆD bin sɛn am fɔ go prɔfisay, ɛn tinap na di yad na PAPA GƆD in os, ɛn tɛl ɔl di pipul dɛn se:
“Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se, A de briŋ ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we a bin dɔn se go apin, pan dis siti ɛn ɔl in tɔŋ dɛm, bikɔs dɛn dɔn traŋayes bad bad wan ɛn nɔ gri yɛri mi wɔd.”
I apin se Pash, we na man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn na Ima we na di bigman pan ɔl di wokman dɛm na PAPA GƆD in os, in bɔypikin, yɛri we Jɛrimaya bin de prɔfisay dɛn tin ya.
Pashɔ bit Jɛrimaya ɛn chen am na di ples we de fɔ chen pipul na di Bɛnjamin get we de ɔp say na PAPA GƆD in os.
Di nɛks de, we Pashɔ fri Jɛrimaya kɔmɔt na di chen, Jɛrimaya tɛl am se, PAPA GƆD nɔ de kɔl yu Pashɔ, i de kɔl yu Tɛrɔ ɔlɔbɔt.

Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se: Lisin, a go mek yu tɛrɔ to yusɛf ɛn to ɔl yu padi dɛm. Yu go de luk so dɛn de kil dɛn na wa. Ɛn a go mek di kiŋ na Babilɔn kapchɔ Juda; i go kɛr dɛn go Babilɔn go mek dɛn slev, ɛn go kil dɛm wit sɔd.

Pantap dat, a go gi ɔl di siti in jɛntri, ɛn in prɔfit, ɔl in tiŋs dɛm we prɛshɔs to am, ɛn ɔl di kiŋ dɛn jɛntri we dɛn bin kip, to dɛn ɛnimi dɛm, we go tek dɛn tiŋs dɛn, kapchɔ dɛm ɛn kɛr dɛn go Babilɔn.
Ɛn yu, Pashɔ, ɛn ɔl udat tap na yu os, go go bi slev; na Babilɔn yu go go, ɛn na de yu go day, ɛn na de dɛn go bɛr, yu ɛn ɔl yu padi dɛm we yu bin gi lay lay prɔfisi.”
E PAPA GƆD, yu dɔn disiv mi, ɛn yu bin disiv mi fɔ tru; yu traŋa pas mi, ɛn na yu win. A dɔn tɔn tin fɔ laf ol de; ɔlman de provok mi.
Bikɔs ɛnitɛm we a tɔk, a de tɔk lawd, a de ala, se “Fɛt fɛt ɛn nyakanyaka!” Bikɔs PAPA GƆD in wɔd dɔn mek dɛn de trit mi lɛk kresman.
If a mekɔp se, “A nɔ go tɔk bɔt am, ɔ nɔ tɔk bɔt in nem igen,” sɔntin de insay mi at, we tan lɛk faya insay mi bon dɛm, ɛn a taya fɔ ol am insay, ɛn a nɔ ebul kip am igen

Bikɔs a de yɛri bɔku bɔku sumu sumu. Fred fred de ɔlɔbɔt! “Pul am kɔmɔt na yu at! Lɛ wi pul am kɔmɔt na yu at! Na so ɔl mi tayt padi dɛn de se, de wach fɔ mi dawnfɔl. ‘Sɔntɛnde, wi go ebul disiv am, datɛnde, wi go gɛt am to wetin wi want, ɛn rivɛnj pan am.”

Bɔt PAPA GƆD de wit mi, ɛn na sojaman we dɛn de fred bad bad wan; so di wan dɛn we de aras mi go bɔk dɛn fut, dɛn nɔ go ovakɔm mi. Dɛn go shem bad bad wan, bikɔs dɛn nɔ go sɔksid. Dɛn nɔ go fɔgɛt dɛn ɛvalastin disgres.
E PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, we de tray dɛn wan dɛm we de waka tret na yu yay, yu we de si pipul dɛn at ɛn dɛn maynd, rivɛnj pan dɛm, bikɔs na to yu a lɛf mi kes.
Siŋ to PAPA GƆD; prez PAPA GƆD! Bikɔs i dɔn sev po pɔsin layf kɔmɔt na wikɛd pipul dɛn we de du bad.
Le swɛ de pan di de we a bin bɔn! Mek di de we mi mami bɔn mi, nɔ gɛt blɛsin!
Le swɛ mit di man we bin briŋ di nyuz to mi papa se, “Yu dɔn gɛt bɔypikin,” we mek i gladi bad bad wan.
Le da man de bi lɛkɛ dɛn siti dɛm we PAPA GƆD de ib oba, i nɔ sho masi; lɛ yɛri kray na mɔnin ɛn alam san sam tɛm,
bikɔs i nɔ bin kil mi insay mi mami bɛlɛ; so dat mi mama bin fɔ dɔn bi mi grev, ɛn in wumb go gret sote go.
Wetin mek a kɔmɔt na mi mama in bɛlɛ fɔ kam si trɔbul ɛn sɔri layf, ɛn spɛnd mi wanol layf pan shem?

Na di wɔd dis we kam to Jɛrimaya, we kɔmɔt to PAPA GƆD di tɛm we kiŋ Zɛdikaya bin sɛn Pashɔ, we na Malkaya in bɔypikin, ɛn Zɛfinaya we na di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, we semweso na bin Maasɛaya in bɔypikin, to am se,
“Fɛnɔt to PAPA GƆD fɔ wi, bikɔs Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn de mek wa pan wi; sɔntɛnde, PAPA GƆD go yuz ɔl in wɔndaful tin dɛn we i kin du, fɔ ɛp wi, ɛn i go mek i fred fɔ fɛt wi.”
Nain Jɛrimaya tɛl dɛn se:

“Go tɛl Zɛdikaya se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: A go gɛda ɔl di wɛpɔn dɛm fɔ fɛt wa, we de na una an, we una de yuz fɔ fɛt di kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn di Babilonian dɛm we sɔrawnd una na do na una wɔl dɛm; ɛn a go briŋ dɛm ɔl kam put na di siti sɛnta.
Na misɛf sɛf go fɛt una wit mi traŋa an we opin, wit vɛksteshɔn ɛn ɔt tɛmpa, ɛn wit bad bad wamat.
Ɛn a go kil ɔl dɛn wan dɛm we tap na dis siti, dat na mɔtalman ɛn animal; na ebi ebi siknɛs go kil dɛm.

PAPA GƆD se, afta dat, A go mek Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, we na Zɛdikaya dɛn ɛnimi dɛn we de tray fɔ kil dɛm, ebul kapchɔ Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda, ɛn in wokman dɛm, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn na dis siti we nɔ day di tɛm we siknɛs, wa ɛn bad bad aŋri bin mit dɛm; Nɛbyukadnɛza go kil dɛm wit sɔd; i nɔ go luk nɔbɔdi ɛn sɔri fɔ am, ɔ lɛf ɛnibɔdi ɔ fil nain at fɔ nɔbɔdi.
“Yu go tɛl dɛn pipul ya se: ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD se: A de sho una wetin pɔsin go du fɔ gɛt lɔŋ layf ɛn wetin pɔsin go du we i go day.
Udat nɔ gri kɔmɔt na di siti go day na wa, ɔ wit bad bad aŋri ɔ siknɛs; bɔt udat go na do go sɔrɛnda to di Babilonian dɛm we sɔrawnd una, nɔ go day, ɛn i go gɛt in layf fɔ in prayz na wa.
PAPA GƆD se, bikɔs a dɔn tɔn mi fes to dis siti fɔ bad, ɛn nɔto fɔ gud; a go mek di kiŋ na Babilɔn kapchɔ am, ɛn i go bɔn am wit faya?
“Ɛn tɛl di kiŋ na Juda in os se, ‘Yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd,

Yu Devid in os! Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “kɛri awt jɔstis na mɔnin, ɛn sev pipul dɛn kɔmɔt na di wan dɛn we de sɔprɛs dɛm, dɛn an, in we dɛn dɔn tif, if nɔ so, mi vɛksteshɔn go mit dɛm lɛk faya, ɛn bɔn, we nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul ɔt am, fɔseka di ivul tin dɛm we una de du.’”
PAPA GƆD se, “Biliv mi, a de agens una we tap na di vali, Yu rɔk na flat grɔn, yu we de se, ‘udat go kam dɔŋ kam fɛt wi, ɔ udat go kam usay wi tap?’
PAPA GƆD se, A go pɔnish una bay wetin una du; A go layt faya insay in fɔrɛst, ɛn i go bɔn ɔl wetin de rawnd am.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Go na di kiŋ na Juda in os, ɛn tɔk dɛn wɔd ya de,
se, ‘Yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd, yu kiŋ na Juda, we sidɔm na Devid in tron, yu ɛn yu wokman dɛm, ɛn yu pipul dɛn we de pas na dɛn get ya.

Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Trit ɔlman ikwali ɛn waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, ɛn pul di pɔsin we dɛn dɔn tif kɔmɔt na di wan we de sɔprɛs am in an. Nɔ trit fɔrina, pikin we in papa dɔn day ɛn uman we in man dɔn day, bad ɔ wit Vayolɛns, ɛn nɔ kil pɔsin we inosɛnt.
Bikɔs, if una obe dis wɔd fɔ tru tru, datɛnde una go pas na di get dɛm go insay di os, una di kiŋ dɛm we de sidɔm na Devid in tron, de rayd ɔs ɛn karej, dɛm ɛn dɛn wokman dɛm ɛn dɛn pipul dɛm.
PAPA GƆD se, Bɔt if una nɔ lisin dɛn wɔd ya, A swɛ bay misɛf, dis os go tɔn ples we nɔbɔdi nɔ de.

Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt di kiŋ na Juda in os. “Yu tan lɛk Giliad to mi, lɛk di il na Libanɔn in pantap, fɔ tru tru, a go mek yu tɔn ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, dat na siti we nɔbɔdi no tap.
A go mek pipul dɛn we de nyakanyaka fɔdɔm pam una, ɔlman wit in wɛpɔn dɛm; ɛn dɛn go kɔt una bɛst sida tik dɛm, ɛn trowe dɛm na faya.
“Ɛn bɔku neshɔn dɛm go pas bay dis siti ɛn ɔlman go aks in kɔmpin se, “wetin mek PAPA GƆD dil wit dis big siti so?”
Ɛn dɛn go ansa se, “Na bikɔs dɛn fɔsek PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd in Kɔvinant ɛn go wɔship ɛn sav ɔda gɔd dɛm.” ’”
Nɔ kray fɔ pɔsin we dɔn day, nɔ sɔri fɔ am; bɔt kray bita bita wan fɔ udat go, bikɔs i nɔ go kam bak igen fɔ kam si in kɔntri we i bɔn.
Bikɔs, na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt Joaaz, we na Josaya we na kiŋ na Juda in bɔypikin, we bin ren instɛd ɔf in papa Josaya, ɛn we bin kɔmɔt na dis ples: I se, “I go kam na ya igen,
bɔt na di ples we dɛn kapchɔ am go, i go day, ɛn i nɔ go si dis land igen.
“Swɛ go mit di wan we bil in wan flat os bay we i nɔ waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, ɛn bil garɛt os bay we i nɔ de trit pipul dɛn ikwali; in we mek in neba wok fɔ am fɔ natin, ɛn nɔ gi am in pe;
in we se, ‘A go bil big os fɔ misɛf wit big big rum dɛm ɔpstiaz,’ ɛn mek dɛn winda dɛm fɔ am, wit sida bod, ɛn pent am wit rɛd pent.
Yu tink se yu na kiŋ bikɔs yu de bil wit sida bod lɛk yu kɔmpin? Yu fɔstɛmpapa dɛn nɔ bin de it ɛn drink, ɛn trit ɔlman ikwali ɛn waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay? Da tɛm de, ɔltin bin fayn fɔ am.
PAPA GƆD se, I gi fia jɔjmɛnt to po pipul; da tɛm de ɔltin bin fayn. Dat nɔ sho yu se i no mi?
Bɔt yu gɛt yay ɛn at fɔ rog pipul dɛn nɔmɔ, fɔ shɛd inosɛnt blɔd, ɛn fɔ sɔprɛs ɛn fɛt pipul.”

Fɔseka dat na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt Jɛoiakim we na Josaya, we na kiŋ na Juda, in bɔypikin: “Dɛn nɔ go kray fɔ am, lɛk we dɛn kin se, ‘E mi brɔda!’ Ɔ ‘E mi sista!’ Dɛn nɔ go kray fɔ am, lɛk we dɛn kin se ‘E mi masta! Ɔ ‘A iz majɛsti!’
“Dɛn go bɛr am lɛkɛ aw dɛn kin bɛr dɔŋki, we dɛn kin drɛg go trowe na do fa frɔm di get dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm.’
“Go na Libanɔn, ɛn ala tɛl dɛn, ɛn es yu vɔys na Beshan; tinap na Abarim ala, bikɔs dɛn dɔn kil ɔl yu lɔva dɛm.
A bin tɔk to yu wɛn yu bin jɛntri, bɔt yu bin se, ‘A nɔ go lisin.’ Na so yu tan frɔm we yu yɔŋ, yu nɔ du wetin a se.
Na briz go bi yu shɛpad, dɛn yon shɛpad dɛm, ɛn dɛn go kapchɔ yu lɔva dɛn go tɔn dɛm slev; dɛn yu go shem ɛn kɔnfyus bikɔs ɔf ɔl yu wikɛdnɛs.
Yu, una we tap na Libanɔn midul dɛn sida tik dɛm, wɛn di pen kam pan una, una go ala nɔto kɔmɔn, i go tan lɛk da pen we uman kin fil we i de bɔn!”
PAPA GƆD se, as lɔŋ as a de alayv, ɔldo na Jɛoiachin, we na Jɛoiakim, kiŋ na Juda in bɔypikin na bin di riŋ na mi an we a de tek sayn, a go stil rut una kɔmɔt na mi an,
ɛn gi una to dɛn wan we wan kil una, dɛn wan we una de fred, dat na Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn ɛn dɛn Babilonian dɛm.
A go fos una ɛn una mami we bɔn una, fɔ go na ɔda kɔntri we nɔto de una bɔn, ɛn na de una go day.
Bɔt di land we dɛn aŋri fɔ go bak, dɛn nɔ go go igen.”
Nain a se, dis man, Jɛoiachin, dɔn tɔn broko pɔt, tin we nɔbɔdi nɔ bisin bɔt? Wetindu yu de tot in ɛn in pikin dɛm, trowe dɛm na land we dɛn nɔ no?
E land, land, land, yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd!
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Rayt an dɔŋ se dis man nɔ gɛt pikin, se na man we nɔ go ɛva bɛtɛ na layf; bikɔs nɔn pan in pikin dɛn nɔ go ɛva sidɔm na Devid in tron, ɛn rul Juda.”
“PAPA GƆD se, swɛ go mit dɛn shɛpad dɛn we de pwɛl ɛn skata mi ship dɛm.

Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se bɔt dɛn shɛpad dɛm we de kia fɔ mi pipul dɛm: “Una dɔn skata mi ship dɛm, ɛn una dɔn drɛb dɛm go, ɛn una nɔ atɛnd to dɛm. A de tɛl una, a go atɛnd to una fɔ di ivul tin dɛn we una du, na so PAPA GƆD se.
Dɔn a go gɛda di wan dɛn we lɛf pan mi ship dɛm kɔmɔt na ɔl di difrɛn kɔntri dɛm we a dɔn drɛb dɛm go, ɛn a go briŋ dɛm kam bak na dɛn os, ɛn dɛn go ebul bɔn ɛn dɛn go plɛnti.
A go put shɛpad dɛn oba dɛm, we go luk afta dɛm, ɛn dɛn nɔ go fred igen ɛn dɛn nɔ go pwɛlat, ɛn dɛn nɔn nɔ go lɔs, na so PAPA GƆD se.

PAPA GƆD se, “A de tɛl una se, di tɛm de kam we a go es wan branch na Devid in layn, we de waka tret na mi yay, ɛn i go ren as kiŋ ɛn go wok wit sɛns, ɛn i go trit ɔlman ikwali ɛn waka tret wit ɔlman na di land.
Nain tɛm Juda go sav, ɛn Izrɛl go liv de wit kolat. Ɛn na dis nem dɛn go kɔl am: ‘PAPA GƆD na wi tret waka.’
“PAPA GƆD se, fɔseka dat, a de tɛl una, di tɛm de kam we mɔtalman go lɛf fɔ de se, ‘Wans PAPA GƆD we pul Izrɛl kɔmɔt Ijipt, de,’
bɔt go de se, ‘Wans PAPA GƆD de we pul Izrɛl in jɛnareshɔn dɛm ɛn de bifo dɛn fɔ kɔmɔt na di nɔt kɔntri, ɛn ɔl di kɔntri dɛm we i bin dɔn drɛb dɛm go.’ Da tɛm de, dɛn go tap na dɛn yon land.”
As fɔ di prɔfɛt dɛn yon: Mi at pwɛl, mi bɔdi de trimbul; mi na lɛkɛ drɔnkɔman, lɛkɛ man we rɔm dɔn chak, fɔseka PAPA GƆD ɛn fɔseka in oli wɔd.

Bikɔs di land ful wit pipul dɛn we de kip pipul man ɛn wɛf; di land de munin fɔseka di swɛ, ɛn di say dɛn we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples, dɔn dray. Ɔl wetin dɛn de du, ivul, ɛn dɛn de misyuz dɛn pawa.
PAPA GƆD se, “Di prɔfɛt dɛm ɛn di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, dɛn ɔngɔdli, se Gɔd Ɔlmayti, ivin na mi os, a dɔn si dɛn wikɛdnɛs de.
Fɔseka dat, dɛn wanol layf go tan lɛkɛ slipul rod na dak ples, we na de dɛn go push dɛn go fɔdɔm; bikɔs a go mek bad bad tin mit dɛm we di tɛm kam fɔ dɛn fɔ gɛt dɛn pɔnishmɛnt, na so PAPA GƆD se.
A si wan bad abit pan di prɔfɛt dɛn na Sameria: dɛn de tek Beal in nem prɔfisay ɛn mek mi pipul dɛn we na Izrɛl, go astre.

As fɔ di prɔfɛt dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm, a si bad bad tin pan dɛn we nɔ fayn fɔ du: dɛn de kɔmit lidɔm wit dɛn kɔmpin wɛf ɛn dɛn lay dɛn kayn nɔ de; dɛn de ɛp dɛn wan we de du bad, we mek nɔbɔdi nɔ de chenj kɔmɔt pan in wikɛd we; dɛn ɔl dɔn tan lɛkɛ Sɔdɔm to mi, ɛn di pipul dɛm we tap de, tan lɛkɛ Gɔmɔra.

Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se bɔt di prɔfɛt dɛm: “Biliv mi, a go fid dɛm wit wɔm wud ɛn gi dɛm wata we gɛt pɔyzin fɔ drink; bikɔs na frɔm dɛn di prɔfɛt dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm ɔngɔdlinɛs kɔmɔt prɛd na di land.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se: “Una nɔ lisin wetin di prɔfɛt prɔfisay to una, fɔ mek una jɛs de abop fɔ natin; na wetin de na dɛn maynd dɛn de tɔk, nɔto wetin PAPA GƆD se.
Dɛn de tɛl dɛn wan dɛm we nɔ biliv PAPA GƆD in wɔd ɔltɛm se, “Ɔltin go fayn fɔ yu’; ɛn kin tɛl dɛn wan dɛn we nɔ de gri du wetin PAPA GƆD se, bɔt de fala dɛn yon at, se, ‘Nɔn bad tin nɔ go mit una.’”
Bikɔs us wan pan dɛm dɔn de na PAPA GƆD in kansul wande fɔ ɔndastand ɛn yɛri in wɔd, ɔ us wan pan dɛm dɔn put at ɛn lisin in wɔd?
A de tɛl una, PAPA GƆD in tinada de blo! Bad bad veksteshɔn dɔn sho, ebi briz we de tɔn rawnd;; i go bɔs na dɛn wikɛd pipul dɛn ed.
PAPA GƆD in veksteshɔn nɔ go tap sote i dɔn du ɛn kɔmplit wetin I plan nain maynd fɔ du. Leta, una go ɔndastand am klia wan.
“A nɔ sɛn di prɔfɛt dɛm, bɔt dɛn rɔn go; a nɔ tɔk to dɛm bɔt dɛn prɔfisay.
Bɔt if dɛn bin dɔn de na mi kansul datɛnde na wetin a se dɛm bin fɔ tɛl mi pipul dɛm, ɛn dɛn bin fɔ dɔn chenj kɔmɔt pan dɛn ivul we, ɛn kɔmɔt pan di ivul tin dɛn we dɛn de du.
“PAPA GƆD se, mi na Gɔd we de nia ɛn nɔto Gɔd we a de fa?
PAPA GƆD se, Ɛnibɔdi go ebul ayd insɛf na ɛni sikrit ples we a nɔ go ebul si am? A nɔ de ɔlsay na wɔl?
A dɔn yɛri wetin di prɔfɛt dɛm we de tek mi nem prɔfisay lay lay prɔfisay, se, we dɛn de se, ‘A drim, A drim!
Aw lɔŋ lay lay go de insay dɛn prɔfɛt dɛn at, we de prɔfisay lay lay ɛn we de tɔk wetin dɛn at se fɔ de disiv pipul,
we de tink fɔ mek mi pipul dɛm fɔgɛt mi nem bay di drim we dɛn de tɛl dɛn kɔmpin, jɛs lɛk aw dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛm fɔgɛt mi nem fɔseka Beal?
PAPA GƆD se, Lɛ di prɔfɛt we drim, tɔk bɔt di drim, bɔt lɛ di wan we gɛt mi wɔd, prich mi wɔd wit ɔl in at. Ɛnitin de pan strɔ we mek in ɛn wit fiba?
PAPA GƆD se, mi wɔd nɔto lɛkɛ faya, ɛn lɛkɛ ama we de brok rɔk pis pis?
PAPA GƆD se, Fɔseka dat, a de agens di prɔfɛt dɛm we de tif mi wɔd na dɛn kɔmpin mɔt.’
PAPA GƆD se, a de agens di prɔfɛt dɛm we de opin dɛn mɔt tɔk se, ‘Na PAPA GƆD se.’

PAPA GƆD se, a de agens dɛn wan dɛm we de prɔfisay wit lay lay drim, we de lay gi dɛm ɛn mek mi pipul dɛn go astre bay dɛn lay lay ɛn dɛn rɛklɛsnɛs, we a nɔ sɛn dɛm ɔ nɔ pik dɛm; we yu luk am, dɛn nɔ de ɛp dɛn pipul dɛn ya at ɔl.
Wɛn wan pan dɛn pipul ya, ɔ prɔfɛt, ɔ man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, aks yu se, ‘Wetin na PAPA GƆD in lod? Yu fɔ tɛl dɛn se, ‘Na yu na di Lod’ ɛn a go trowe yu. Na so PAPA GƆD se.’
Ɛn as fɔ ɛni prɔfɛt, ɔ man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɔ wan pan di pipul dɛn we go opin in mɔt tɔk se, ‘PAPA GƆD in lod,’ a go pɔnish da man de ɛn ɔl udat de nain os.
Bifo dat, na so ɔlman go de aks in neba, ɛn in brɔda, ‘Wetin PAPA GƆD ansa se?’ Ɔ ‘Wetin PAPA GƆD se?’
Bɔt una nɔ fɔ tɔk di wɔd, PAPA GƆD in lod’ igen igen, bikɔs di lod na ɔlman wɔd, ɛn una de kɔrɔpt PAPA GƆD we de alayv, we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, we na wi Gɔd, in wɔd.
Na so yu go aks di prɔfɛt dɛm, ‘Wetin PAPA GƆD ansa yu se? Ɔ ‘Wetin PAPA GƆD se?’
Bɔt if una tɔk se, ‘PAPA GƆD in lod,’ na dis PAPA GƆD se, ‘Bikɔs yu dɔn tɔk dɛn wɔd ya, “PAPA GƆD in Lɔd,” wɛn a sɛn to yu se una se, “Una nɔ fɔ tɔk se, PAPA GƆD in Lɔd,”
fɔseka dat, fɔ tru tru, a go es una ɛn trowe una kɔmɔt bifo mi, una ɛn di siti we a gi una ɛn una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm.
Ɛn a go briŋ ɛvalastin disgres ɛn shem ɔltɛm pan una, we nɔbɔdi nɔ go ɛva fɔgɛt.”

Afta we Nɛbyukadnɛza, we na kiŋ na Babilɔn bin dɔn kɛr Jɛkonaya, we na Jɛoiakim we na kiŋ na Juda, in bɔypikin, togɛda wit di bigman dɛm na Juda, di man dɛm we de mek tinks dɛn wit dɛn an, ɛn di goldsmit ɛn blaksmit dɛm, go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm, PAPA GƆD bin sho mi dis vishɔn; A si tu baskit fignɔt we dɛn put bifo PAPA GƆD in tɛmpul.
Wan baskit gɛt gud gud fignɔt, lɛk di fɔs fignɔt dɛn we kin rɛp, bɔt insay di ɔda baskit, na fignɔt dɛn we nɔ gud de de. Dɛn so pwɛl dat pɔsin nɔ go ebul it dɛm.
Nain PAPA Gɔd aks mi se, “Wetin yu de si Jɛrimaya?” A se “A si Fignɔt dɛm. Di wan dɛn we gud, gud tumɔs ɛn di wan dɛm we pwɛl, pwɛl bad bad wan. Dɛn so pwɛl dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul it dɛm.
Nain PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:
“Na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: A go si di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt Juda go ɛgzayl, we a pul kɔmɔt ya sɛn go na di Babilonian dɛn land, lɛkɛ dɛn gud fignɔt dɛm ya.
A go gyad dɛm sote go, ɛn a go briŋ dɛm kam bak na dis land. Nɔto brok a go brok dɛm, na bil a go bil dɛm; nɔto rut a go rut am, na plant a go plant am.
A go gi dɛm di at fɔ no se na mi na di PAPA GƆD; ɛn dɛn go bi mi pipul ɛn mi go bi dɛn Gɔd, bikɔs dɛn go kam bak to mi wit ɔl dɛn at.

“Bɔt na dis PAPA GƆD se: Lɛk aw yu si dɛn fignɔt dɛm we so pwɛl dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul it dɛm, na so a go trit Zɛdikaya, we na kiŋ na Juda, in bigman dɛm, di pipul dɛm we kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm we lɛf na dis land, ɛn dɛn wan we tap na Ijipt.
A go mek dɛn tin fɔ fred to ɔl di kɔntri dɛm na di wɔl. Pipul go shem fɔ de wit dɛm, dɛn nem nɔ go gɛt rɛspɛkt, dɛn go provok dɛm ɛn go bi pipul dɛn we gɛt swɛ, ɔlsay usay a go drɛb dɛn go.
Ɛn a go sɛn wa, bad bad aŋri ɛn siknɛs pan dɛm, sote dɛn ɔl day kpatakpata kɔmɔt na di land we a gi dɛn ɛn dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛm.
Na di wɔd dis we rich Jɛrimaya bɔt di pipul dɛn na Juda, insay di ia we mek Jɛoiakim we na Josaya in bɔypikin fo ia as kiŋ na Juda (dat na bin Nɛbyukadnɛza in fɔs ia as kiŋ na Babilɔn)
we Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt tɛl ɔl di pipul dɛn na Juda ɛn ɔl dɛn wan we tap na Jerusɛlɛm:
I se, “Fɔ twɛnti tri ia, frɔm di ia we mek Josaya we na Amɔn in bɔypikin, tɔtin ia as kiŋ na Juda’ te to dis de, PAPA GƆD in wɔd dɔn kam to mi ɛn a dɔn kɔntinyu fɔ tɔk to una, bɔt una nɔ lisin.
Una nɔ lisin ɛn una nɔ opin una yes fɔ yɛri, ɔlwe PAPA GƆD de sɛn ɔl in wokman dɛm, we na di prɔfɛt dɛm, to una ɔltɛm
se, “Una chenj, una ɔl lɛf dɛn una ivul we dɛm ɛn una lɛf di tin dɛn we una de du we nɔ rayt, ɛn tap na di land we PAPA GƆD dɔn gi una ɛn una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm lɔntɛm, ɛn fɔ sote go;
una nɔ fɔ de biɛn ɔda gɔd dɛm fɔ go sav dɛm ɛn wɔship dɛm, ɔ prɔvok mi mek a vɛks wit wetin una de du. Datɛnde, a nɔ go am una.’
PAPA GƆD se, pan ɔl dat, una nɔ lisin to mi, so dat una go provok mi mek a vɛks wit wetin una an de du to una yon dɛtrimɛnt.
“Fɔseka dat na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se: Bikɔs una nɔ obe mi wɔd,

biliv mi, a go sɛn fɔ ɔl di trayb dɛn we de na di nɔt, ɛn fɔ mi wokman Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn a go mek dɛn atak dis land ɛn di pipul dɛm we tap de, ɛn ɔl di neshɔn dɛm we de rawnd am; a go nyakanyaka dɛm kpatakpata ɛn mek dɛn tɔn tin fɔ fred, fɔ sɔktit ɛn pipul go shem fɔ de wit dɛm, sote go.
Pantap dat, a go mek ɛnjɔymɛnt ɛn gladi gladi nɔ de na dɛn layf. Dɛn nɔ go gɛt fɔ yɛri ɔkɔ ɛn yawo vɔys, dɛn nɔ go yɛri di grenin ston in sawnd ɛn na dak dɛn go de.
Dis wanol land go tɔn to broko broko ɛn gud fɔ natin ples, ɛn dɛn neshɔn dɛn ya go sav di kiŋ na Babilɔn fɔ sɛvinti ia.
We sɛvinti ia dɔn, a go pɔnish di kiŋ na Babilɔn ɛn da neshɔn de, di chaldian dɛm land fɔ dɛn sin, ɛn mek di land gud fɔ natin sote go. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
A go mek ɔltin we a bin dɔn se go bi to da land de, mit dɛm; ɔltin we rayt na dis buk, we Jɛrimaya bin dɔn prɔfisay se go bi to ɔl dɛn neshɔn.
Bikɔs bɔku neshɔn dɛm ɛn big big kiŋ dɛn go tek dɛn mek slev; ɛn a go pe dɛm bay di wok we dɛn du, wetin dɛn du wit dɛn yon an.
Na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd tɛl mi: “Tek di kɔp we gɛt di wayn ɔf vɛksteshɔn na mi an, ɛn mek ɔl di neshɔn dɛn we a de sɛn yu go, drink pan am.
Dɛn go drink ɛn staga ɛn lɔs kɔntrol fɔseka di wa we a de sɛn wa pan dɛm.”
So a tek di kɔp na PAPA GƆD in an, ɛn mek ɔl di neshɔn dɛm we PAPA GƆD sɛn mi to, drink pan am.
Jerusɛlɛm ɛn di siti dɛn na Juda, in kiŋ dɛm ɛn bigman dɛm, fɔ mek dɛm gud fɔ natin ɛn ɛmti, ples fɔ sɔktit ɛn ples we gɛt swɛ te tide;
Fero we na kiŋ na Ijipt, in wokman dɛm, di bigman dɛm, ɔl in pipul dɛm
ɛn ɔl di fɔrina dɛn we de wit dɛm; ɔl di kiŋ dɛn na Ɔz ɛn ɔl di kiŋ dɛn na di Filistin dɛm land (Ashkɛlɔn, Gaza, Ɛkrɔn, ɛn dɛn wan we lɛf na Ashdɔd);
Idɔm, Moab, ɛn Amɔn in bɔypikin dɛm;
ɔl di kiŋ dɛm na Taya, ɔl di kiŋ dɛn na sidɔm, ɛn di kiŋ dɛm na di kos oba di si;
Dedan, Tɛma, Bɔz ɛn ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we de krep rawnd dɛn ed;
ɔl di kiŋ dɛm na Arebia ɛn ɔl di kiŋ dɛm fɔ dɛn miksɔp trayb dɛm we tap na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap;
ɔl di kiŋ dɛm na Zimri, ɔl di kiŋ dɛm na Ilam, ɛn ɔl di kiŋ dɛm na Mɛdia;
ɔl di kiŋ dɛm na di nɔt, di wan dɛn we de fa ɛn di wan dɛn we de nia, wan bay wan, ɛn ɔl di kɔntri dɛn na di wɔl we de na dis wɔl. Ɛn afta dɛm, na di kiŋ na Babilɔn go drink.
“Dɔn yu go tɛl dɛm se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Una drink, mek una drɔnk ɛn vɔmit. Una fɔdɔm ɛn nɔ grap igen, fɔseka di wa we a de sɛn pan una.’
“Ɛn if dɛn nɔ gri fɔ tek di kɔp na yu an fɔ drink, datɛnde yu go tɛl dɛn se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se: Una fɔ drink!
Bikɔs, a bigin fɔ du bad na di siti we gɛt mi nem, so na una fɔ go fri? Una nɔ go go fri, bikɔs a de sɛn kɔl wan sɔd agens ɔl di wan dɛm we tap na di wɔl. Na so PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se.

“Fɔseka dat, na ɔl dɛn wɔd dɛn ya yu go yuz fɔ prɔfisay agens dɛm, ɛn tɛl dɛm se “PAPA GƆD go ala lɛk Layɔn ɔp usay I de, ɛn na In oli ples we I tap, I go de, de tɔk; i go ala lɛk Layɔn ebi ebi wan pan in pipul dɛm we i de mɛn, ɛn ala, lɛkɛ dɛn wan dɛm we de mas mas greps, ɛn agens ɔl di wan dɛm we tap na wɔl.
Di lawd sawnd go ɛko usay di wɔl tap, bikɔs PAPA GƆD gɛt kes agens di neshɔn dɛm; i de bigin kes wit ɔlman na wɔl, ɛn as fɔ di wikɛd pipul dɛm, i go kil dɛm. Na so PAPA GƆD se.’
“Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se; A de tɛl una, ivul dɔn bigin frɔm wan neshɔn to ɔda neshɔn, ɛn big tinada tɔn tɔn de fa na di fa pat dɛm na di wɔl!
“Ɛn di wan dɛn we PAPA GƆD go kil da de de, go kɔmɔt frɔm wan say na wɔl to di ɔda. Nɔbɔdi nɔ go kray fɔ dɛm, ɔ gɛda dɛm ɔ bɛr dɛm; dɛn go tɔn manyɔ na grɔn.
“Una ala ɛn kray, una dɛn shɛpad dɛm, ɛn una rolpan asis una we gɛt di ship dɛm, bikɔs di de fɔ kil una ɛn skata una dɔn kam, ɛn yu go day lɛkɛ man ship we dɛn pik bikɔs i fat.
Nɔn aydin ples nɔ go de fɔ di shɛpad dɛm, ɔ ples fɔ dɛn wan dɛm we na di masta dɛn, fɔ ɛskep.
Una lisin we dɛn shɛpad dɛn de kray, ɛn we di wan dɛm we na di masta dɛn de ala! Bikɔs PAPA GƆD de pwɛl dɛn ples we plɛnti gras de gro fɔ fid animal,
ɛn di ship dɛn we bin de wit kolat dɔn tɔmɛnt fɔseka PAPA GƆD in bad bad vɛksteshɔn.
I dɔn rɔnawe kɔmɔt nain kev lɛkɛ layɔn bikɔs dɛn land dɔn tɔn gud fɔ natin bikɔs ɔf di ɔprɛsɔ in sɔd, ɛn fɔseka in bad bad veksteshɔn.”
Dis wɔd ya kɔmɔ to PAPA GƆD di tɛm we Jɛoiakim, we na bin Josaya, kiŋ na Juda in bɔypikin bin bigin rul,
“Na dis PAPA GƆD se: tinap na PAPA GƆD in yad nain os ɛn tɛl ɔl di pipul dɛn, we kɔmɔt na di siti dɛm na Juda, we kam wɔship na PAPA GƆD in os, ɔltin we a bin kɔmand yu fɔ tɛl dɛm; nɔ lɛf wan wɔd.
Sɔntɛm dɛn go lisin, ɛn ɔlman go lɛf dɛn ivul tin dɛn we dɛn de du, so dat a nɔ go du di bad bad tin we a bin dɔn plan fɔ du dɛm, fɔseka di ivul tin dɛn we dɛn de du.
Yu go tɛl dɛm se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD se: If una nɔ gri lisin to mi, ɛn du wetin mi lɔ dɛn we a gi una, se,
ɛn fɔ pe atɛnshɔn to wetin mi wokman dɛn we na di prɔfɛt dɛn we a sɛn to una ɔjɛnt ɔjɛnt wan, ɔldo una nɔ lisin dɛm,
A go mek dis Tɛmpul tan lɛk Shilo, ɛn a go mek ɔlman na wɔl yuz dis siti in nem fɔ de swɛ.’”
Dɛm man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di prɔfɛt dɛn, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm yɛri we Jɛrimaya de tɔk dɛn wɔd ya insay PAPA GƆD in os.
Ɛn wɛn Jɛrimaya dɔn tɔk ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD kɔmand am fɔ tɛl ɔl di pipul dɛm, nain di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di prɔfɛt dɛm, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm gɛda am, de tɔk se, “yu go day!
Wetin du yu dɔn prɔfisay wit PAPA GƆD in nem, se, “Dis Os go tan lɛkɛ Shilɔ, ɛn dis siti go bi gud fɔ natin, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de?” Ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn gɛda rawnd Jɛrimaya insay PAPA GƆD in os.
Wɛn di bigman dɛn na Juda yɛri bɔt dɛn tin ya, dɛm kɔmɔt na di kiŋ in os kam ɔp na PAPA GƆD in os sidɔm na dɛn ples insay di Nyu Get na PAPA GƆD in os.

Nain di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn di prɔfɛt dɛm tɛl di bigman dɛm ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn se, “Dis man sɔpoz fɔ gɛt dɛt sɛntɛns, bikɔs i dɔn prɔfisay agens dis siti, as una bin dɔn yɛri wit una yon yes.”
Nain Jɛrimaya tɔk to ɔl di bigman dɛm ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm, se, “Na PAPA GƆD sɛn mi fɔ kam prɔfisay agens dis os ɛn dis siti, ɔl dɛn wɔd dɛm we una yɛri a tɔk.
So fɔseka dat, una chenj una we ɛn di tin dɛn we una de du, ɛn du wetin PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd se, dɔn PAPA GƆD nɔ go du di bad tin dɛn we i dɔn tɔk se i go du una.
Bɔt, as fɔ mi, a de na una an. Una du mi wetin una fil se gud ɛn rayt.
Una jɛs no se, if una kil mi, una go put inosɛnt blɔd na una an ɛn na dis siti ɛn pan di wan dɛm we tap de, bikɔs na tru se, na PAPA GƆD sɛn mi to una, fɔ tɔk ɔl dɛn wɔd ya na una yes.”

Nain di bigman dɛn ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn tɛl di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn di prɔfɛt dɛm, se, “Dis man nɔ dizav fɔ gɛt dɛt sɛntɛns, bikɔs i dɔn tɔk to wi wit PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd in nem.”
Nain wan pan di ɛlda dɛm na di land, tinap ɛn tɔk to ɔl di pipul dɛn se,

“Mayka na Mɔrɛshɛt, bin de prɔfisay di tɛm we Ɛzikaya na bin kiŋ na Juda, ɛn i bin tɛl ɔl di pipul dɛn na Juda se: ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, Dɛn go dig Zayɔn lɛkɛ fam; Jerusɛlɛm go tɔn dɔti ip, ɛn di il na PAPA GƆD in os, go tɔn fɔrɛst.

Ɛzikaya we na bin kiŋ na Juda ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm na Juda bin kil am? I nɔ bin fred PAPA GƆD, ɛn beg PAPA GƆD fɔ sɔri fɔ am, ɛn PAPA GƆD nɔ bin rigrɛt ɛn nɔ du wetin i bin dɔn se i go du dɛm? Bɔt wi de rɛdi fɔ briŋ big big wuala pan wisɛf.”

Wan ɔda man bin de, we bin de prɔfisay wit PAPA GƆD in nem, dat na Yuraya, we na Shemaya in bɔypikin we kɔmɔt Kiriat Jɛraim. I bin prɔfisay agens dis siti ɛn agens dis land, de tɔk di sem tin we Jɛrimaya tɔk.
Wɛn Kiŋ Jɛoiakim wit ɔl in sojaman dɛm ɛn ɔl di bigman dɛm, yɛri wetin Yuraya se, di kiŋ luk fɔ we fɔ kil am; bɔt we Yuraya yɛri bɔt dat, i bin fred, so I rɔnawe go Ijipt.
Nain Kiŋ Jɛoiakim sɛn sɔm man dɛm, we na Ɛlnetan we na Akbɔ in bɔypikin ɛn ɔda wan dɛm,
go Ijipt, ɛn dɛm bin briŋ Yuraya kɔmɔt Ijipt kam to Kiŋ Jɛoiakim, we bin kil am wit sɔd, ɛn trowe in dedebɔdi usay dɛn kin bɛr dɛn ɔdinari pipul dɛn.
Bɔt Aikam, we na Shafan in bɔypikin, bin de wit Jɛrimaya, we mek dɛn nɔ gi am to di pipul dɛm, fɔ mek dɛn kil am.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to Jɛrimaya, di tɛm we Zɛdikaya, we na Josaya, kiŋ na Juda in bɔypikin, bigin ren.
Na dis PAPA GƆD bin tɛl mi: “Mek lɛda strap ɛn bod yok put na yu nɛk.
Sɛn wɔd to di kiŋ na Idɔm, di kiŋ na Moab, di Amonayt dɛn kiŋ, di kiŋ na Taya, ɛn di kiŋ na Saydɔn tru di mɛsenja dɛm we dɔn kam Jerusɛlɛm to Zɛdikaya, we na kiŋ na Juda.
Gi dɛm dɛn wok ya fɔ dɛm masta dɛm: ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Na dis una go tɛl una masta dɛm:
“Na mi we tek mi gret pawa ɛn mi an we a opin wayd wayd wan, mek dis wɔl, di mɔtalman ɛn di animal dɛm we de na wɔl, ɛn a gi am to udat a fil se rayt to mi, fɔ gi.
So, fɔseka dat, a dɔn gi ɔl dɛn land dɛm ya to Nɛbyukadnɛza, we na di kiŋ na Babilɔn ɛn mi wokman, ɛn a dɔn gi am di animal dɛn na bush fɔ sav am.
Ɔl di neshɔn dɛm go sav im, in bɔypikin ɛn in grampikin, sote di tɛm fɔ in yon land kam; datɛnde, bɔku neshɔn dɛm ɛn pawaful kiŋ dɛm go mek am dɛn slev.

“ ‘ “Bɔt if ɛni neshɔn ɔ kindɔm nɔ gri sav dis Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn nɔ rɛdi fɔ du ɛnitin, ɛnitɛm, fɔ di kiŋ na Babilɔn, a go pɔnish da neshɔn de wit wa, wit bad bad aŋri ɛn wit siknɛs, te a dɔn mek Nɛbyukadnɛza nyakanyaka am kpatakpata. Na so PAPA GƆD se.

So una nɔ lisin to una prɔfɛt dɛm, ɔ una lukgrɔn man dɛm, di wan dɛn we se dɛn de drim, di wan dɛn we de tɛl una wetin go apin bambay, ɔ dɛn majikman dɛn we de tɛl una se, ‘Una nɔ fɔ sav di kiŋ na Babilɔn.’
Bikɔs na lay lay dɛn de prɔfisay to una, we go mek dɛn go pul una kɔmɔt na di land, kɛr una go fawe, ɛn a go drɛb una kɔmɔt de, ɛn una go sɔfa bad bad wan.
Bɔt ɛni neshɔn we go gri fɔ wok fɔ di kiŋ na Babilɔn ɛn sav am, A go lɛf dɛn na dɛn yon land, fɔ mek fam ɛn fɔ tap de. Na so PAPA GƆD se.” ’”
A de tɔk di sem tin to Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda: “Yu ɛn yu pipul fɔ put unasɛf ɔnda di kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn sav in ɛn in pipul dɛm so dat una nɔ go day.
Wetin du yu ɛn yu pipul dɛn fɔ day na wa, ɔ wit bad bad aŋri, ɛn wit siknɛs, lɛk aw PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk se go apin to ɛni neshɔn we nɔ gri sav di kiŋ na Babilɔn?
Nɔ lisin dɛm prɔfɛt we de se, ‘Una nɔ fɔ de ɔnda di kiŋ na Babilɔn,’ bikɔs na lay lay prɔfisi dɛn de gi una.
PAPA GƆD se, ‘A nɔ sɛn dɛm, bɔt dɛn de tek mi nem gi una lay lay prɔfisi, so dat a go drɛb una ɛn una go sɔfa bad bad wan, una ɛn di prɔfɛt dɛm we de prɔfisi to una.”

So a tɔk to di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn, se, “Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Una nɔ lisin to wetin di prɔfɛt dɛm we de prɔfisay to una, de se, we dɛn de tɔk se, ‘I nɔ go te igen, dɛn go briŋ di tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz na PAPA GƆD in os, kam bak kɔmɔt Babilɔn,’ bikɔs na lay lay prɔfisi dɛn de gi una.
Una nɔ lisin to dɛm; una sav di kiŋ na Babilɔn mek una nɔ go day. Wetindu dis siti fɔ yuslɛs ɛn ɛmti?

If dɛn na prɔfɛt dɛm, ɛn if PAPA GƆD in wɔd de wit dɛm, lɛ dɛm pre to PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, so dat dɛn nɔ go tek di tin dɛn we fɔ yuz na PAPA GƆD in os, we lɛf insay PAPA GƆD in os, di wan dɛn insay di kiŋ na Juda in os, ɛn na Jerusɛlɛm, go Babilɔn.
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se bɔt di pila dɛm, di si, di stand dɛm, ɛn di balans vɛsul dɛm we lɛf insay dis siti,
we Nebyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, nɔ bin kɛr Jɛkonaya we na Jɛoiakim, kiŋ na Juda in bɔypikin kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn ɔl di bigman dɛn na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm, go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn–
na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, se, kɔnsanin di vɛsul dɛm we lɛf na PAPA GƆD in os, di wan dɛm na di kiŋ na Juda in os, ɛn na Jerusɛlɛm:
PAPA GƆD se, “Dɛn fɔ kɛr dɛm go Babilɔn ɛn dɛn fɔ lib de te di de we Mi go tɔn mi atɛnshɔn to dɛm. Na da tɛm de, a go briŋ dɛm kam bak, ɛn put dɛm bak na dis ples, lɛk aw dɛn bin de.”

Insay da sem ia de, we Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda bin bigin rul, na di mɔnt we mek fayv, insay di ia we mek fo, Ananaya we na Azɔ, we na di prɔfɛt we kɔmɔt Gibɛɔn, in bɔypikin, tɔk to mi insay PAPA GƆD in os, bifo di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn, se,
“Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: A dɔn brok di kiŋ na Babilɔn in pawa.
Insay tu ia, a go briŋ ɔl di tin dɛn fɔ yuz na PAPA GƆD in os kam bak, we Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, bin tek kɔmɔt na dis ples kɛr go Babilɔn.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, “A go briŋ Jɛkonaya we na Jɛoiakim we na kiŋ na Juda in bɔypikin, ɛn ɔl di wan dɛn we bin kɔmɔt Juda go ɛgzayl, bikɔs a go brok di kiŋ na Babilɔn in pawa.”
Nain Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt tɔk to Ananaya we na prɔfɛt bifo ɔl di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm we bin tinap insay PAPA GƆD in os;

Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt mɔk am ɛn se, “Emɛn! Lɛ PAPA GƆD du am; lɛ PAPA GƆD mek wetin yu dɔn prɔfisay, bi, ɛn mek i briŋ ɔl di tin dɛn fɔ yuz na PAPA GƆD in os ɛn ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we dɛn kɛr go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn, kam bak na ya.
Pan ɔl dat, lisin wetin a gɛt fɔ tɔk we yu ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn go yɛri.
Dɛn prɔfɛt dɛm we bin dɔn de lɔlɔntɛm bifo yu ɛn mi, bin prɔfisay bɔt wa, bad bad aŋri, ɛn siknɛs pan bɔku bɔku kɔntri dɛm ɛn big big kindɔm dɛm
As fɔ di prɔfɛt we prɔfisay bɔt pis, we wetin da prɔfɛt de prɔfisay apin, datɛnde ɔlman go no se na PAPA GƆD sɛn da prɔfɛt de fɔ tru.”
Nain Prɔfɛt Ananaya pul di bod yok kɔmɔt na Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt in nɛk, ɛn brok brok dɛm.

Nain Ananaya tɔk bifo ɔl di pipul dɛn se, “Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Na semweso a go brok Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn in yok kɔmɔt na ɔl di neshɔn dɛn nɛk, insay tu ia.” Bɔt Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt bin go in we.
Sɔm tɛm afta we Prɔfɛt Ananaya bin dɔn brok di bod yok kɔmɔt na Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt in nɛk, PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to Jɛrimaya:
I se, “Go, tɛl Ananaya se:, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Yu dɔn brok di bod yok, bɔt instɛ ɔf bod yok, a go mek ayɛn yok.

Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: A dɔn put ayɛn yok fɔ ad lebɔ na ɔl dɛn neshɔn ya dɛn nɛk fɔ wok fɔ Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn dɛn go sav am, bikɔs a dɔn ivin gi am dɛn animal na bush.’”
Nain Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt tɛl Prɔfɛt Ananaya se “Lisin, Ananaya, PAPA GƆD nɔ sɛn yu, ɛn yu dɔn mek dɛn pipul ya dɔn biliv pan lay lay.
Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se: ‘a go pul yu kɔmɔt na dis wɔl. Dis vɛri ia, yu go day, bikɔs yu dɔn tɔn agens PAPA GƆD bay wetin yu se.’”
Ananaya day insay di mɔnt we mek sɛvin da sem ia de.

Na dis Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt bin rayt insay di lɛta we i sɛn kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm go to di bigman dɛm pan di wan dɛm we bin de ɛgzayl, ɛn to di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, di prɔfɛt dɛm, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm we Nɛbyukadnɛza bin dɔn kɛr go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn, kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm.
Dis na bin afta kiŋ Jɛkonaya, ɛn di kwin mami, di okobo dɛm, di bigman dɛm na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm, di man dɛn we de mek tiŋs wit dɛn an, di goldsmit ɛn blaksmit dɛm, bin dɔn kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm.
Na Ilasa we na Shafan in bɔypikin, ɛn Gɛmaria we na Ilkaya in bɔypikin, bin kɛr di lɛta go, dat na Ilkaya we Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda, bin sɛn to Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn. Di lɛta se:
“Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd de se to ɔl di wan dɛn we de ɛgzayl we a sɛn kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn:
Una bil os dɛm ɛn tap de; una plant gadin ɛn it wetin gro de.

Una mared uman dɛm ɛn bɔn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛm; una mared uman dɛm fɔ una bɔypikin dɛm ɛn gi una gyal pikin dɛm mek dɛn mared dɛm, so dat dɛn go bɔn bɔypikin ɛn gyal pikin dɛm; una fɔ bɔn bɔku mek una go bɔku mɔ, bikɔs nɔto ridyus una fɔ ridyus.
Du ɔltin fɔ ɛp di siti we a dɔn sɛn una go ɛgzayl, ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD fɔ am, bikɔs na we di siti bɛtɛ, unasɛf go gɛt ɔl wetin una want.
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Una nɔ gri lɛ una prɔfɛt dɛm ɛn lukgrɔn man dɛm we de wit una, lay gi una, ɛn una nɔ lisin to dɛn drim dɛm we dɛn de drim,
bikɔs na lay lay prɔfisi dɛn de gi unainsay mi nem; a nɔ sɛn dɛm. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
“Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se: wɛn sɛvinti ia dɔn fɔ Babilɔn, a go kam to una ɛn go du wetin a prɔmis se a go du fɔ una ɛn briŋ una kam bak na dis ples.
PAPA GƆD se, bikɔs A no de plan dɛm we A gɛt fɔ una, plan dɛm fɔ una bɛtɛ wan, fɔ mek una abop ɛn bɛtɛ bambay.
Datɛnde, una go kɔl mi ɛn pre to mi, ɛn a go yɛri una.
Una go luk fɔ mi ɛn una go fɛn mi; we una luk fɔ mi wit ɔl una at,

una go fɛn mi ɛn a go gi una ɔl una jɛntri bak ɛn gɛda una kɔmɔt na ɔl di neshɔn dɛn ɛn ɔl di ples dɛn we a bin dɔn drɛb una go, ɛn a go briŋ una bak na di ples we a drɛb una kɔmɔt go ɛgzayl. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
“Bikɔs una dɔn se, ‘PAPA GƆD dɔn mek pipul dɛn prɔfɛt pan wi na Babilɔn,’–
Na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt di kiŋ we sidɔm na Devid in tron, ɛn bɔt ɔl di pipul dɛn we tap na dis siti, una fambul dɛn we nɔ bin go ɛgzayl wit una:
Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, A de sɛn wa, bad bad aŋri ɛn siknɛs pan dɛm, ɛn a go mek dɛm lɛkɛ stinkin fig we dɔn so rɔtin dat dɛn kyant it am.

A go mek wa, bad bad aŋri ɛn siknɛs de biɛn dɛm, ɛn a go mek dɛn pipul fɔ fred na ɔl di kɔntri dɛm na di wɔl. Pipul go shem fɔ de wit dɛm, dɛn nem nɔ go gɛt rɛspɛkt, dɛn go provok dɛm ɛn go bi pipul dɛn we gɛt swɛ, ɔlsay usay a go drɛb dɛn go,
PAPA GƆD se, bikɔs dɛn nɔ yɛri mi wɔd we a de sɛn mi wokman dɛn we na di prɔfɛt dɛn, fɔ tɛl dɛn ɔltɛm. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Una yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd, una ɔl we a drɛb kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn:

‘Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, se bɔt Eab we na kolaya in bɔypikin, ɛn Zɛdikaya we na Maasɛya in bɔypikin we de yuz mi nem gi una lay lay prɔfisi: A de tɛl una, A go mek Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, kech dɛm ɛn kil dɛm bifo una.
Fɔseka dɛn, ɔl di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt ɛgzayl na Juda we de Babilɔn go de swɛ dis swɛ: “Lɛ PAPA GƆD mek yu tan lɛk Zɛdikaya ɛn Eab, we di kiŋ na Babilɔn bin ros na faya,”

bikɔs dɛn dɔn mek dɛnsɛf fulish na Izrɛl, dɛn dɔn kɔmit adɔltri wit dɛn neba dɛm wɛf dɛm, ɛn dɛn dɔn tek mi nem tɔk laylay wɔd dɛm, we nɔto mi kɔmand dɛm fɔ du am. Na mi na di wan we no, ɛn na mi na di witnɛs. Na so PAPA GƆD se.’”
Yu fɔ tɛl Shemaya we kɔmɔt Nɛɛlam se;

Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, se: Yu dɔn sɛn lɛta wit yu yon nem to ɔl di pipul dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn to Zɛfinaya we na Maasɛya we na man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, in bɔypikin, ɛn to ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, se,

‘PAPA GƆD dɔn mek yu di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin instɛd ɔf Jɛoayada we na man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, fɔ de inchaj ɔf PAPA GƆD in os, oba ɔl dɛn krɛsman we de prɔfisay, fɔ put am na chen.
So wetindu yu nɔ dɔn tɛlɔf Jɛrimaya we de Anatɔt we de prɔfisay to yu?
Bikɔs i dɔn sɛn to wi na Babilɔn, se, “Una go de ɛgzayl lɔŋ; una bil os dɛm ɛn tap pan dɛm, una mek fam ɛn it wetin dɛn bia.” ’”
Zɛfinaya we na man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, rid dis lɛta bifo Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt.
Nain PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to Jɛrimaya se:
“sɛn to ɔl di wan dɛn we de ɛgzayl se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt Shemaya we kɔmɔt Nɛɛlam: Bikɔs Shemaya dɔn prɔfisay to una we a nɔ bin sɛn am, ɛn i dɔn mek una biliv in lay lay,

fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se: A de tɛl una, a go pɔnish Shemaya we kɔmɔt Nɛɛlam ɛn in bɔnshɔ; wan pan in bɔnshɔ nɔ go liv fɔ si di gud tin dɛn we a go du fɔ mi pipul dɛm, bikɔs i dɔn tɔk lɛk rebɛl agens PAPA GƆD. Na so PAPA GƆD se.’”
Di wɔd we PAPA GƆD sɛn to Jɛrimaya.
“Na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Rayt ɔltin we a dɔn tɛl yu na buk.
PAPA GƆD se, Bikɔs di tɛm de kam we a go gi mi pipul dɛm we na Izrɛl ɛn Juda, dɛn jɛntri bak, ɛn a go briŋ dɛm kam bak na di land we a bin gi dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛm, ɛn dɛn go tek am fɔ dɛnsɛf.”
Na so PAPA GƆD se bɔt Izrɛl ɛn Juda:
“Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Wi dɔn yɛri di fred fred ala, bad bad fred fred, ɛn nɔn kolat nɔ de.
Aks naw, ɛn no, if man go ebul bɔn pikin? Wɛl wetindu a de si ɔl dɛn man dɛn de put dɛn an na dɛn wes lɛkɛ uman we de in lebɔ? Wetindu ɔlman fes pel so?
Ey! Da de de go so big nɔn ɔda de nɔ go tan lɛk am; na tɛm fɔ Jekob fɔ sɔfa; bɔt stil, a go sev am.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, “I go apin da de de se, a go brok di chen kɔmɔt na dɛn nɛk, ɛn a go fri dɛm, ɛn trenja dɛn nɔ go tek dɛn mek bɔy igen
Bɔt dɛn go sav PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd, ɛn Devid we na dɛn kiŋ, we a go gi dɛm.

PAPA GƆD se, so nɔ fred natin. Yu Jekob we na mi wokman, ɛn unasɛf Izrɛl nɔ pwɛlat; bikɔs a ebul sev una ivin we a de fa, ɛn a ebul sev una pikin dɛn kɔmɔt na di land we dɛn mek dɛm slev. Jekob go tɔmbak kam ɛn i go gɛt kolat ɛn alafia, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go gi am kɔtat.

PAPA GƆD se, bikɔs a de wit yu fɔ sev yu; A go nyakanyaka ɔl di neshɔn dɛm we a skata una, bɔt as fɔ una, a nɔ go nyakanyaka una. A go disiplin una bay aw una de biev, ɛn natin nɔ go mek a nɔ pɔnish una.
“Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se: Di pen we una gɛt na una at, nɔ de mɛn, ɛn una wund dɛn dip.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ fɛt una kes, mɛrɛsin nɔ de fɔ mɛn una wund, una nɔ go tek mɛn.

Ɔl una lɔva dɛm dɔn fɔgɛt una; dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt una; bikɔs a dɔn trit una di we pɔsin go trit in ɛnimi, di pɔnishmɛnt we pɔsin we nɔ gɛt masi go gi in ɛnimi, bikɔs una gilti bad bad wan, bikɔs una sin pasmak.
Wetin du una de kray bɔt una pen? Una pen nɔ de mɛn. Na bikɔs una gilti bad bad wan, ɛn bikɔs yu sin pasmak, mek A du dɛn tin ya to una.
Fɔseka dat, dɛn go kil ɔl di wan dɛn we kil una ɛn ɔl una ɛnimi dɛm go go tɔn slev; wan nɔ go lɛf; dɛn go tif ɔl di wan dɛn we tif una, ɛn a go sɔprɛs ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we sɔprɛs una.
PAPA GƆD se, Bikɔs a go gi una, una wɛlbɔdi bak ɛn a go mɛn una wund dɛm, bikɔs dɛn dɔn kɔl yu awtkast: ‘Na Zayɔn, we nɔbɔdi nɔ bisin bɔt!’
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: A de tɛl una, a go gi Izrɛl dɛn jɛntri bak, ɛn sɔri fɔ in pipul dɛm; a go bil di siti bak pantap in il, ɛn di kiŋ in os go tinap bak di say we i bin de.
Nainsay dɛm, tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki siŋ, dɛn go kɔmɔt, ɛn dɛn wan dɛm vɔys we gladi. A go mek dɛn plɛnti, ɛn dɛn nɔ go bi tu tri nɔmɔ; A go mek dɛm gɛt rɛspɛkt, ɛn dɛn nɔ go smɔl.
Dɛn pikin dɛm go de lɛkɛ aw dɛm bin de lɔntɛm, ɛn dɛn go gɛda bifo mi; ɛn a go pɔnish ɔl dɛn wan dɛm we sɔprɛs dɛm.
Dɛn bigman go bi wan pan dɛm, dɛn rula go kɔmɔt pan dɛm; A go mek i kam nia mi, ɛn i go kam mit mi, bikɔs udat kres fɔ kam mit mi we a nɔ kɔl am? Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Ɛn una go bi mi pipul, ɛn mi go bi una Gɔd.”
Luk, PAPA GƆD in tinada! I dɔn vɛks, wayl briz de blo; i go bɔs pan dɛn wikɛd pipul dɛn ed.
PAPA GƆD in bad bad vɛksteshɔn nɔ go tɔn bak sote i dɔn du ɛn kɔmplit wetin i plan fɔ du. Leta, una go ɔndastand dis.
“PAPA GƆD se, Da tɛm de, a go bi ɔl di famili dɛn na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, ɛn dɛn go bi mi pipul.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Di pipul dɛn we nɔ day na di wa bin gɛt gres na di wildanɛs; wɛn Izrɛl bin de go om,
PAPA GƆD apia to am frɔm fawe. A lɔv yu wit da lɔv we de sote go; fɔseka dat a kɔntinyu fɔ waka tret wit una.
A go ɛstablish una bak, ɛn yu go establish, Yu Izrɛl we na vajin! Una go mek una tamborin dɛn bak, ɛn una go de dans wit dɛn wan we de mek gladi gladi.
Yu go plant greps fam bak pantap di mawnten dɛm na Sameria; di fama dɛn go plant, ɛn dɛn go ɛnjɔy di frut.
Bikɔs tɛm go kam we dɛn wachman dɛm go ala kɔl ɔlman na di il kɔntri na Ifrem se: ‘Una grap, lɛ wi go ɔp na Zayɔn, to PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd.’”

Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Siŋ lawd lawd wan wit gladi gladi fɔ Jekob ɛn pul siŋ fɔ di chif fɔ ɔl dɛn neshɔn; anawns am, prez am, ɛn tɔk se, ‘PAPA GƆD dɔn sev in pipul, di balans pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn we lɛf.’

A de tɛl una, a go briŋ dɛn kam kɔmɔt na di nɔt kɔntri, ɛn gɛda dɛm kɔmɔt na di say we far pas ɔl na dis wɔl, ɛn di blɛnyay ɛn di wan dɛn we lem go de pan dɛm, togɛda wit dɛn bɛlɛuman dɛm ɛn di wan dɛn we de lebɔ; dɛn go kam bak as plɛnti plɛnti pipul.

Dɛn go de kray fɔ jɔy we dɛn de kam, ɛn a go de koks dɛn we a de kɛr dɛm go bak, A go mek dɛn waka nia watasay dɛm, na stret rod we dɛn nɔ go bɔk dɛn fut; bikɔs mi na Izrɛl dɛn papa, ɛn na Ifrem na mi fɔs pikin.
“Una yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd, una di neshɔn dɛm, ɛn anawns am na di land dɛn we de nia wata we de fawe; se, ‘In we skata Izrɛl go gɛda am, ɛn i go mɛn am lɛkɛ aw shɛpad de mɛn in ship.’
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn ridim Jekob, ɛn i dɔn ridim am kɔmɔt na an dɛm we tu traŋa fɔ am

Dɛn go kam ɛn siŋ lawd lawd wan na di mawnten dɛn na Zayɔn, dɛn go gladi fɔseka di gud tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD de du fɔ dɛm, fɔseka di rɛs, di wayn ɛn di ɔyl, ɛn fɔseka di pikin ship ɛn kaw; dɛn layf go tan lɛkɛ gadin we dɛn dɔn wata, ɛn dɛn nɔ go lɛf to dɛnsɛf igen.
Na da tɛm de dɛn yɔŋgyal dɛm go gladi de dans, dɔn di yɔŋman dɛm ɛn di olpa dɛn go gladi. A go mek dɛn munin tɔn gladi A go koks dɛm, ɛn gi dɛm sɔro tɔn gladi.
A go mek di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, gɛt ɔl wetin dɛn want, ɛn mi pipul dɛn at go kol fɔseka di gud we a go du fɔ dɛm,” na so PAPA GƆD se.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Dɛn yɛri wan vɔys na Rama, bita bita kray. Rechɛl de kray fɔ in pikin dɛm; i nɔ gri fɔ tek ɔsh fɔ in pikin dɛm, bikɔs dɛn dɔn day.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “nɔ yuz yu vɔys fɔ kray, ɛn nɔ yuz yu yay fɔ wata fɔ rɔn bikɔs yu go gɛt di pe fɔ yu wok, ɛn dɛn go kɔmɔt na dɛn ɛnimi in land kam bak.
PAPA GƆD se, abop de fɔ una tumara, ɛn una pikin dɛm go kam bak na dɛn yon kɔntri.
A dɔn yɛri Ifrem in kɔmplen, we i de se, ‘Yu dɔn disiplin mi, ɛn yu disiplin mi lɛk kaw pikin we nɔ gɛt trenin; briŋ mi kam bak so dat a go de lɛk aw a bin de, bikɔs na yu na PAPA GƆD we na mi Gɔd.
Bikɔs, afta a bin dɔn tɔn mi bak pan yu, a bin ripɛnt; ɛn we a ɔndastand, a bit misef; a bin shem, ɛn a bin kɔnfyus, bikɔs a bin gɛt mi disgres we a yɔŋ.’

Na Ifrem na mi bɔypikin we we a lɛk? Naim na mi pikin we a lɛk bad bad wan? Bikɔs, ɔltɛm we a de tɔk bad bɔt am, A stil de mɛmba am. Fɔseka dat, mi at stil de fil fɔ am; A go sɔri fɔ am fɔ tru tru. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
“Una mak rod dɛm fɔ unasɛf, una put tik dɛn fɔ mɛmba di rod fɔ go bak; una mɛmba di rod gud, di rod we una pas go. Kam bak, Yu Izrɛl we na vajin, una tɔn kam bak na una siti dɛm.
Aw lɔŋ yu go de dawt, Yu gyal pikin we nɔ gɛt feth? Bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn mek nyu tin na di wɔl: uman de gyad man.”

Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: “wan tɛm mɔ, dɛn go yuz dɛn wɔd ya na Juda ɛn in siti dɛm, we a go gi dɛm dɛn jɛntri bak: “PAPA GƆD GO blɛs yu, yu we nainsay yu raychɔsnɛs tap, Yu oli il!’
Juda ɛn ɔl in siti dɛm, wit di fama dɛm ɛn dɛn wan we de wirɔn wit dɛn ship, go tap de togɛda.
Bikɔs a go satisfay di sol we dɔn taya, ɛn a go it to ɔl dɛn sol we fɛdɔp.”
Na dat mek we a wek ɛn luk, a bin ɛnjɔy mi slip.
PAPA GƆD se, “Di de de kam, we a go plant mɔtalman sid ɛn animal sid na Izrɛl ɛn Juda.
Ɛn i go kam bi se, as a dɔn wata dɛm mek a go rut ɛn brok dɛm, fɔ ib dɛm oba ɛn nyakanyaka dɛm, ɛn briŋ wahala, so a go wata dɛm fɔ bil ɛn fɔ plant. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Dɛn tɛm dɛn de, dɛn nɔ go de se: ‘Di dadi dɛm dɔn it sawa greps, ɛn di pikin dɛn tit de kramp.’
Bɔt ɔlman go day fɔ inyon sin; ɛnibɔdi we it sawa greps, nain tit go kramp.
PAPA GƆD se, ‘Di de dɛn de kam, we a go mek nyu Kɔvinant wit Izrɛl ɛn Juda,
i nɔ go tan lɛk di Kɔvinant we a bin mek wit dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛm, we a bin ol dɛn an pul dɛn kɔmɔt Ijipt, mi Kɔvinant we dɛn brok, ɔlwe mi na bin dɛm man. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
PAPA GƆD se, ‘Bɔt na di kayn Kɔvinant dis we a go mek wit Izrɛl dɛn tɛm dɛn de: A go put mi lɔ insay dɛm ɛn a go rayt am na dɛn at; ɛn a go bi dɛm Gɔd, ɛn dɛn go bi mi pipul.

Ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go gɛt fɔ tich in neba ɔ in brɔda igen se ‘Yu fɔ no PAPA GƆD,’ bikɔs dɛn go no mi, frɔm di smɔl wan pan dɛm, to di wan we big pas ɔl, bikɔs a go fɔgiv dɛm fɔ dɛn wikɛdnɛs, ɛn a nɔ go mɛmba dɛn sin igen.” Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, udat gi di san fɔ bi layt santɛm ɛn fiks di mun ɛn di sta dɛm ɔdali fɔ gi layt na nɛt, udat de shek shek di si so dat di swɛlin dɛn go ala– na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nain nem;
“PAPA GƆD se, if di we we dɛn fiks skata bifo mi, na da tɛm de Izrɛl in pikin dɛm go lɛf fɔ bi neshɔn bifo mi sote go.’

Na dis PAPA GƆD se: “If pɔsin go ebul mɛnshɔ ɔp di klawd, ɛn if pɔsin kin ebul fɛnɔt aw di ath in fawndeshɔn tan, da tɛn de, a go ib ɔl Izrɛl pikin dɛm oba fɔseka ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn du.” Na so PAPA GƆD se.
PAPA GƆD se, “A de tɛl una, di tɛm de kam we dɛn go bil di siti bak, frɔm Ananɛl Tawa to di Kɔna Get, fɔseka PAPA GƆD.
Ɛn di Mɛzhɔmɛnt go go bifo mɔ, stret to Garɛb il, dɔn i go tɔn to Goa.
Di wanol dedebɔdi vali ɛn di ashis, ɛn ɔl di fil dɛm sote rich kidrɔn watasay, to di Ɔs Get kɔna we yu de go ist, fɔ oli to PAPA GƆD. Dɛn nɔ go atak am ɔ nyakanyaka am igen sote go.”
Di wɔd we PAPA GƆD sɛn to Jɛrimaya, insay di ia we mek Zɛdikaya tɛn ia as kiŋ na Juda, we na bin di ia we mek etin we Nɛbyukadnɛza bin dɔn de na pawa.
Da tɛm de, di kiŋ na Babilɔn in ami bin sɔrawnd Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn dɛn bin lɔk Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt, na di gyadman dɛn yad, we bin de na di kiŋ na Juda in os.
Bikɔs Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda bin dɔn lɔk am ɔp, de se, “Wetin du yu fɔ prɔfisay se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD se: A de tɛl una, a de gi dis siti to di kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn i go kapchɔ am;
Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda nɔ go ɛskep, di Babilonian dɛn go kech am go to di kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn i go tɔk to am fes to fes, ɛn dɛn go si kojuma koju;
ɛn i go tek Zɛdikaya go Babilɔn, ɛn na de i go de sote a go waka to am. Ɔlwe una go fɛt di Babilonian dɛm, una nɔ go ebul dɛm’?”
Jɛrimaya se, “PAPA GƆD in wɔd rich mi se:
Biliv mi, Anamɛl, we na yu ɔnkul Shalum in bɔypikin, go kam tɛl yu se, ‘Bay mi land we de na Anatɔt bikɔs na yu nɔmɔ gɛt di rayt fɔ ridim am we yu bay am.’

Nain Anamɛl we na mi kɔzin kam to mi insay di pales yad, akɔdin to wetin PAPA GƆD bin se, ɛn tɛl mi se, ‘Bay mi land we de na Anatɔt, na di land ɔf Bɛnjamin, bikɔs na yu gɛt di rayt fɔ ridim am we yu bay am; bay am fɔ yusɛf.’ Na da tɛm de a no se na PAPA GƆD in wɔd.
“So a bay di land na Anatɔt to mi kɔzin Anamɛl, ɛn a we di mɔni pe am. Na bin sɛvintin silva kɔpɔ.
A sayn di kɔnveans, sil am, gɛt witnɛs dɛm ɛn we di mɔni na skel.
Dɔn a tek di sil kɔnveans we ɔl di agrimɛnt rayt, ɛn di kɔpi we nɔ sil;
a gi Baruch we na Nɛria in bɔypikin ɛn Masɛya in grampikin, bifo Anamɛl we na mi kɔzin, di witnɛs dɛm we sayn di kɔnveans, ɛn ɔl di Ju dɛm we bin sidɔm insay di gyad dɛn yad.
A tɛl Baruch bifo dɛn ɔl, se,
‘Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: tek dɛn kɔnveans dɛn ya, di sil wan ɛn di wan we nɔ sil, ɛn put insay kle kɔntena, so dat dɛn go las lɔŋ.
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se; Dɛn go bay os ɛn land ɛn greps bak na dis land.
“Afta a dɔn gi Baruk we na Nɛria in bɔypikin di kɔnveans, a pre to PAPA GƆD se:
‘E PAPA GƆD we na mi Gɔd! Na yu mek ɔp di klawd ɛn di wɔl wit yu big big pawa ɛn wit yu an we yu opin wayd! Natin nɔ traŋa fɔ yu fɔ du,
yu de sho lɛknɛs we nɔ de shek to tawzin tawzin pipul, bɔt yu de tɔn di papa dɛm gilt pan dɛn pikin dɛm, Yu big ɛn mayti Gɔd we in nem na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti,
we sabi plan wit sɛns ɛn kin du wɔndaful tin: I de si ɔl mɔtalman in we, ɛn de pe ɔlman bay in we ɛn bay wetin dɛn mek bi.
In we dɔn sho sayn ɛn wɔnda na Ijipt, ɛn te tide i de du am na Izrɛl ɛn to ɔlman na di wɔl, ɛn dat mek dɛn no yu ɔlsay jɛs lɛk tide.
Yu briŋ yu pipul dɛm we na Izrɛl kɔmɔt Ijipt, wit sayn ɛn wɔnda, wit traŋa an ɛn an we strɛch opin wayd, ɛn wit tin we de mek pipul fred bad bad wan;
ɛn yu gi dɛm dis land, we yu bin swɛ to dɛm fɔstɛmpapa fɔ gi dɛm; land we gud fɔ plant ɛn fɔ mɛn animal;
ɛn dɛn bin go insay de ɛn tek am fɔ dɛnsɛf. Bɔt dɛn nɔ bin obe yu vɔys ɔ du wetin yu lɔ se; dɛn nɔ du natin pan ɔl wetin yu kɔmand dɛm fɔ du. Na fɔseka dat yu mek ɔl dɛn bad bad tin ya mit dɛm.

Di dɔti we dɛn pak rawnd fɔ klem ɛn atak, dɔn bil kam ɔp di siti fɔ kapchɔ am, ɛn fɔseka wa ɛn bad bad aŋri ɛn siknɛs, dɛn go gi di siti to di Babilonian dɛm we de fɛt dɛm. Wetin yu bin se dɔn bi, ɛn yu si am wit yu yay.
Pan ɔl dat, yu PAPA GƆD we na mi Gɔd tɛl mi se, “Bay di land wit mɔni ɛn gɛt witnɛs dɛm” –ɔlwe di Babilonian dɛn de kapchɔ di siti.’”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd rich Jɛrimaya. I se:
‘A de tɛl una, na mi na PAPA GƆD di Gɔd fɔ ɔl mɔtalman; ɛnitin de we traŋa fɔ mi fɔ du?
Fɔsɛka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se: Biliv mi, a de gi dis siti to di Babilonian dɛm ɛn to Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn i go kapchɔ am.
Di Babilonian dɛm we de fɛt dis siti go kam sɛt faya pan am, ɛn bɔn am, wit di os dɛm we dɛn dɔn bɔn insɛns na dɛn ruf to Beal, ɛn dɛn dɔn mek drink ɔfrin to ɔda gɔd dɛm, fɔr provok mi mek a vɛks.

Bikɔs na so so ivul Izrɛl in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn Juda in bɔypikin dɛn dɔn du bifo mi fɔrm we dɛn yɔŋ; Izrɛl in bɔypikin dɛm nɔ du natin pas fɔ prɔvok mi mek a vɛks bay wetin dɛn de du wit dɛn yon an. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
I se. Dis siti dɔn mek a vɛks ɛn mek mi at wam frɔm di de we dɛn bin bil am, te to tide, so a go pul am kɔmɔt bifo mi

fɔseka ɔl di bad we Izrɛl in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn Juda in bɔypikin dɛm du fɔ provok mi mek a vɛks– dɛn kiŋ dɛn, dɛn man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, dɛn prɔfɛt dɛm, di man dɛn na Juda ɛn di pipul dɛn we tap na Jerusɛlɛm.
Dɛn nɔ tɔn dɛn fes to mi, na dɛn bak dɛn tɔn to mi; ɛn ɔlwe a de tich dɛm a nɔ de taya, dɛn nɔ lisin fɔ mek dɛn lan.
Dɛn put dɛn bad bad tin dɛn we a nɔ lɛk insay di os we dɛn se na fɔ mi, fo dɔti am na mi yay.

Dɛn bil ples dɛm fɔ wɔship Beal na Inɔm in bɔypikin in vali, fɔ sakrifays dɛn bɔy ɛn gyalpikin dɛm to molɛk, ɔlwe a nɔ kɔmand dɛn fɔ du dat, ɛn dat nɔ kam na mi maynd sɛf, fɔ mek dɛn du da tin we a et bad bad wan, fɔ mek Juda kɔmit sin.
“Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se bɔt dis siti we yu tɔk bɔt se, ‘Dɛn dɔn gi am to di kiŋ na Babilɔn we yu go yuz, wa, bad bad aŋri ɛn siknɛs’:
Biliv mi, a go gɛda dɛm kɔmɔt na ɔl di kɔntri dɛm we a bin drɛb dɛn go we a bin vɛks ɛn mi at bin wam bad bad wan; a go briŋ dɛn kam bak na ya, ɛn a go mek dɛn sef.
Ɛn dɛn go bi mi pipul ɛn a go bi dɛn Gɔd.
A go gi dɛm wan at ɛn wan we, so dat dɛn go fred mi sote go fɔ dɛn yon gud, ɛn fɔ dɛn pikin dɛn gud.
A go mek wan Kɔvinant wit dɛn we go de sote go, so dat a nɔ go tap fɔ du dɛn gud; ɛn a go put fred na dɛn at fɔ mi, so dat dɛn nɔ go tɔn bak pan mi.
A go de gladi fɔ du dɛm gud, ɛn a go plant dɛm na dis land in wit tret maynd, wit ɔl mi at ɛn mi sol.
“Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se: Jis lɛk aw a briŋ ɔl dɛn bad bad tin dɛn ya pan dɛn pipul ya, na so a go briŋ ɔl di gud tin dɛm we a dɔn prɔmis dɛm, to dɛm.
Dɛn go bay grɔn na dis land we yu de tɔk bɔt se, i nɔ gud fɔ natin, witawt mɔtalman ɔ animal; i dɔn bi di Babilonian dɛn yon.

Dɛn go bay land wit mɔni, ɛn dɛn go sayn ɛn witnɛs kɔnveans dɛm, na di land ɔf Bɛnjamin, na di ples rawnd Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn na di siti dɛn na Juda, di siti dɛn na di il kɔntri, di Shɛfɛla dɛn siti dɛn, ɛn na di siti dɛn we de na di Nɛgɛb; bikɔs a go gi dɛm dɛn jɛntri bak. Na so PAPA GƆD se.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd rich Jɛrimaya di sɛkɛn tɛm, we dɛn bin stil lɔk am ɔp insay di pales yad.
Na dis PAPA GƆD we mek di wɔl se, di GƆD we mol am mek i de aw i de so – na PAPA GƆD na In nem:
Kɔl mi ɛn a go ansa yu, ɛn a go tɛl yu di wɔndaful tin dɛn we ayd we yu nɔ no yet.
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se, bɔt di os dɛm na dis siti ɛn di kiŋ dɛn na Juda dɛn os dɛm, we dɛm bin brok kam dɔŋ fɔ difɛnd dɛnsɛf agens di blɔked dɛm bifo di wa:
Di Babilonian dɛm de kam fɛt dɛm, ɛn dɛn go fulɔp dɛn os dɛn wit dedebɔdi we a go kil we a vɛks ɛn mi at wam, bikɔs a nɔ de luk na dis siti fɔseka ɔl dɛm wikɛdnɛs.
A de tɛl yu, a go briŋ wɛlbɔdi ɛn mɛrɛsin, ɛn a go mɛn dɛm ɛn gi dɛm plɛnti plɛnti jɛntri ɛn sikiɔriti.
A go gi Juda dɛn jɛntri bak, ɛn gi Izrɛl dɛn jɛntri bak, ɛn bil dɛm bak lɛkɛ aw dɛm bin de fɔstɛm.
A go pul ɔl di sin dɛn we dɛn sin agens mi, ɛn a go fɔgiv dɛn fɔ ɔl dɛn sin ɛn fɔ we dɛn kin tɔn dɛn bak pan mi. A go mek dɛn klin na mi yay.

Ɛn a go de gladi fɔ yɛri dis siti in nem. I go bi prez ɛn glori to ɔl di neshɔn dɛm na wɔl, neshɔn dɛn we go yɛri bɔt ɔl di gud tin we a de du fɔ dɛm: dɛn go fred ɛn trimbul fɔseka ɔl di gud ɛn ɔl di jɛntri we a de provayd fɔ dɛm.
