Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Na dis ples we yu tɔk bɔt se, ‘Na ɛmti ɛn yuslɛs ples we mɔtalman ɔ animal nɔ de de,’ dat na di siti dɛn na Juda ɛn di trit dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm we ɛmti ɛn yuslɛs we mɔtalman ɔ animal nɔ de de, dɛn go yɛri

pipul dɛn de ɛnjɔy ɛn gladi gladi; ɔkɔ ɛn yawo go gladi gladi, yu go yɛri dɛn wan dɛm we de siŋ dɛn vɔys, we dɛn de briŋ tɛl Gɔd tɛnki ɔfrin dɛm kam na PAPA GƆD in os: ‘Tɛl PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti tɛnki, bikɔs PAPA GƆD gud, bikɔs in lɔv we nɔ de chenj go de sote go!’ Bikɔs a go gi di land in jɛntri bak lɛk aw i bin de fɔstɛm. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
“Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se: Na dis ples we dɛn se ɛmti ɛn yuslɛs we mɔtalman ɛn animal nɔ de, shɛpad dɛn go tap de bak de fid dɛn ship dɛn.

PAPA GƆD se, Na di il kɔntri, na di siti dɛm na di Shɛfɛla, di siti dɛm na Nɛgɛb, di Land ɔf Bɛnjamin, di ples dɛn we de rawnd Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn di siti dɛm na Juda, ship dɛn go pas ɔnda di wan we de kɔnt dɛn in an.
PAPA GƆD se, ‘Di tɛm de kam we a go du ɔl wetin a prɔmis Izrɛl ɛn Juda.
Dɛn dez dɛn de ɛn da patikla tɛm de, A go mek wan grup we de waka tret wit mi bɔsawt fɔseka Devid; ɛn i go trit ɔlman di sem ɛn go waka tret na di land.
Dɛn tɛm dɛn de, dɛn go sev; Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm go sikiɔ. Ɛn na di nem dis we dɛn go de kɔl am: Na PAPA GƆD na wi Raychɔsnɛs.’
“Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se: Devid nɔ go ɛva de i nɔ gɛt pɔsin we fɔ sidɔm na di tɔŋn na Izrɛl,
ɛn di Lɛvitikal man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn nɔ go ɛva de dɛn nɔ gɛt pɔsin bifo mi fɔ mek bɔn sakrifays, sid ɔfrin ɛn fɔ de mek sakrifays sote go.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to Jɛrimaya:
“Na dis PAPA GƆD se: if una kin brok mi Kɔvinant wit santɛm ɛn mi Kɔvinant wit nɛt, so dat de ɛn nɛt nɔ go kam di tɛm we dɛn fɔ kam,
we min se una kin brok mi Kɔvinant wit Devid we na mi wokman, so dat i nɔ go gɛt bɔypikin fɔ sidɔm nain tron, ɛn di Lɛvitikal man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de minista to mi.

Lɛkɛ aw pɔsin nɔ go ebul kɔnt di tin dɛn we de ɔp di klawd, ɛn lɛk aw pɔsin nɔ go ebul kɔnt di sansan na di si, na so a go mɔltiplay Devid we na mi wokman, in disɛndant dɛm, ɛn di Lɛvitikal man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn we de minista to mi, dɛn disɛndant dɛn.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to Jɛrimaya:
“Yu nɔ yɛri we dɛn pipul dɛn ya de tɔk se, ‘PAPA GƆD dɔn drɛb di tu fambul dɛm we i bin dɔn pik’? Dɛn dɔn so luk mi pipul dɛm wit fɔni yay dat dɛn nɔ tan lɛk neshɔn to dɛm igin.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: If a nɔ bin dɔn mek mi Kɔvinant wit de ɛn nɛt, ɛn di lɔ dɛn we de kɔntrol ɛvin ɛn ath,

datɛnde, a bin fɔ pul an pan Jekob ɛn Devid we na mi wokman dɛn disɛndant dɛm, ɛn a nɔ go pik wan pan in disɛndant dɛn fɔ rul Ebram, Ayzak ɛn Jekob dɛn sid. Bikɔs a go gi dɛm dɛn jɛntri bak, ɛn a go sho dɛn masi.”

Dis na PAPA GƆD in wɔd we rich Jɛrimaya, di tɛm we Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn ɛn ɔl in ami, ɔl di kindɔm dɛm na di wɔl we de ɔnda in pawa, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn na wɔl, bin de fɛt Jerusɛlɛm ɛn ɔl in siti dɛm:
Na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Go tɔk to Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda, ɛn tɛl am se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Biliv mi, a de gi dis siti to di kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn i go bɔn am wit faya.
Yu nɔ go ɛskep, bɔt dɛn go kapchɔ yu kɛr go to am; yu go si di kiŋ na Babilɔn kojuma koju, ɛn yu go tɔk to am fes to fes; ɛn yu go go na Babilɔn.’
Bɔt stil lisin wetin PAPA GƆD se, Yu Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda! Na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt yu: ‘Yu nɔ go day na wa.

Yu go day wit kolat. Ɛn jɛs lɛk we dɛn bin bɔn churay fɔ yu fɔstɛmpapa dɛm, dat na di fɔstɛm kiŋ dɛm we bin de bifo yu, na so pipul dɛm go bɔn churay fɔ yu, ɛn kray fɔ yu se, ‘E wi kiŋ!” ‘Bikɔs a dɔn tɔk am. Na so PAPA GƆD se.”
Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt bin tɛl Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda, we i bin de Jerusɛlɛm,
wɛn di kiŋ na Babilɔn in ami bin de fɛt Jerusɛlɛm ɛn ɔl di siti dɛm we bin lɛf na Juda, ɛn Lakish ɛn Azɛka; bikɔs dɛn na bin di tu siti dɛm we bin gɛt protɛkshɔn na Juda we bin lɛf.
Dis na PAPA GƆD in wɔd we bin rich Jɛrimaya, afta kiŋ Zɛdikaya bin dɔn mek wan Kɔvinant wit ɔl di pipul dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm, fɔ mek pɔblik anawnsmɛnt fɔ fridɔm,
se ɔlman fɔ fri in Ibru slev dɛm, man ɔ uman, so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go mek in Ju brɔda ɔ sista slev.
Ɛn dɛn bin obe; ɔl di bigman dɛm, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn we bin dɔn mek di Kɔvinant se, ɔlman fɔ fri in slev, man ɔ uman, so dat dɛn nɔ go bi slev igen; dɛn bin obe ɛn bin fri dɛm.
Bɔt leta, dɛn tɔn rawnd ɛn tek di pipul dɛn we dɛn bin dɔn fri, we na man ɛn uman dɛm, mek slev bak.
Dis na PAPA GƆD in wɔd we kɔmɔt to PAPA GƆD kam to Jɛrimaya:
Na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: A bin mek Kɔvinant wit una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm, wɛn a pul dɛm kɔmɔt Ijipt insay waala. Di Kɔvinant se,

‘Afta siks ia, ɔlman fɔ fri in kɔmpin Ibru we dɛn bin dɔn sɛl gi am, we dɔn sav fɔ siks ia; yu fɔ fri am lɛ i lɛf fɔ wok fɔ yu.’ Bɔt una fɔstɛmpapa dɛn nɔ lisin to mi ɔ ivin pe atɛnshɔn to wetin a se.
Trade una bin ripɛnt ɛn du wetin rayt na mi yay, we una mek pɔblik anawnsmɛnt fɔ fridɔm, se ɔlman fɔ fri in kɔmpin Ibru, ɛn una bin mek Kɔvinant bifo na mi os we una bil fɔ mi;
bɔt una tɔn rawnd ɛn briŋ fityay to mi nem we una ɔl tek una man ɛn uman slev dɛm bak, we una bin dɔn fri akɔdin to wetin dɛn bin want, ɛn una mek dɛn slev bak.

Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se: una nɔ obe mi we una nɔ kip to di pɔblik anawnsmɛnt fɔ fridɔm, we ɔlman fɔ fri in brɔda ɛn neba; so a de anawns se una fridɔm na to wa, siknɛs ɛn bad bad aŋri. A go so du am dat ɔl di kindɔm dɛn na di wɔl go fred bad bad wan, we dɛn go yɛri wetin apin to una. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
As fɔ di man dɛm we brok di Kɔvinant agrimɛnt, we nɔ du wetin di Kɔvinant we dɛn mek bifo mi se, a go trit dɛm lɛkɛ aw dɛn trit di ship pikin we dɛn bin sheb tu, ɛn pas midul–
dat na di bigman dɛm na Juda, di bigman dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm, di Okobo dɛm, di man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm na di land we bin pas midul di ship pikin we una bin sheb tu;
ɛn a go mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛm ɛn dɛn wan dɛm we wan kil dɛm, kapchɔ dɛm. Na dɛn bɔd we de flay ɔp klawd ɛn dɛn animal dɛn go it dɛn dedebɔdi.
Ɛn a go mek Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda in ɛnimi dɛn we de fɛn we fɔ kil am, kapchɔ in ɛn in bigman dɛm, dat na di kiŋ na Babilɔn in ami, we bin dɔn kɔmɔt to una go bak na dɛn kɔntri.
PAPA GƆD se, A go kɔmand dɛm ɛn briŋ dɛn kam bak na dis siti; ɛn dɛn go fɛt una ɛn kapchɔ am, ɛn bɔn am wit faya. A go mek di siti dɛm na Juda tɔn gud fɔ natin ples, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de.
Dis na PAPA GƆD in wɔd we rich Jɛrimaya di tɛm we Jɛoiakim, we na Josaya in bɔypikin, na bin kiŋ na Juda:
PAPA GƆD se, “Go na dɛn Rekabayt dɛn os go tɔk to dɛm, ɛn briŋ dɛm kam na PAPA GƆD in os insay wan pan di rum dɛm; dɔn gi dɛm wayn fɔ drink.”
So a tek Jaazanaya, we na Abazinaya in bɔypikin Jɛrimaya, yon bɔypikin, ɛn in brɔda dɛm, ɛn ɔl in bɔypikin dɛm ɛn di wanol Rekabayt os.

A briŋ dɛm kam na PAPA GƆD in os insay Anan we na Igdalia we na man ɔf Gɔd we bin tap nia di bigman dɛn rum, in bɔypikin in rum. Di rum bin de oba Maasɛya we na Shalum, wan pan di bigman na di tɛmpul in bɔypikin inyon rum.
A put jɔg dɛn we fulɔp wit wayn ɛn kɔp bifo dɛm. Nain a tɛl dɛm se, “Una drink wayn.”
Bɔt dɛn ansa mi se, “Wi nɔ go drink nɔn wayn, bikɔs Jonadab we na Rekab in bɔypikin we na mi fɔstɛmpapa, kɔmand wi se ‘Una nɔ fɔ drink wayn, una bɔypikin dɛnsɛf, sote go;
una nɔ fɔ bil os; una nɔ fɔ ib sid na gadin, una nɔ fɔ plant ɔ ivin gɛt greps fam; bɔt una fɔ tap na tɛnt te una day, so dat una go liv lɔŋ na di land we una de as fɔrina.’
Wi dɔn obe ɔl wetin Jonadab we na Rekab in bɔypikin, wi fɔstɛmpapa se, we i se wi nɔ fɔ drink wayn te wi day, wi, wi wɛf dɛm, wi bɔy ɛn gyalpikin dɛm,
ɛn nɔ fɔ bil os fɔ tap. Wi nɔ gɛt nɔn greps fam ɔ fam ɔ sid;
bɔt na tɛnt wi dɔn tap ɔl di tɛm, ɛn wi dɔn obe ɛn du ɔl wetin Jonadab we na wi fɔstɛmpapa kɔmand wi fɔ du.
Bɔt we Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn bin kam fɛt di land, wi bin se, ‘Una kam le wi go na Jerusɛlɛm bikɔs wi de fred di Babilonian dɛn ami ɛn di Sirian dɛn ami.’ Na dat mek na Jerusɛlɛm wi tap.”
Nain PAPA GƆD in wɔd rich Jɛrimaya:
Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Go tɛl di man dɛm na Juda ɛn di wan dɛn we tap insay Jerusɛlɛm se, PAPA GƆD se; Una nɔ go lisin to wetin a de tɔk ɛn du wetin a se?

Di kɔmand we Jonadeb we na Rekab in bɔypikin bin gi in yon bɔypikin dɛn, we i se dɛn nɔ fɔ drink wayn, dɛn kip to am; ɛn dɛn nɔ drink nɔn wayn te tide, bikɔs dɛn dɔn obe dɛn papa in kɔmand. Ɔltɛm a de tɔk to una, bɔt una nɔ de lisin mi.

A dɔn sɛn ɔl mi wokman dɛm we na di prɔfɛt dɛn to una ɛn a de sɛn dɛm ɔltɛm se, ‘Ɔlman fɔ lɛf in ivul we ɛn lɛf wetin una de du, ɛn nɔ de biɛn ɔda gɔd dɛm de sav dɛm, datɛnde una go tap na di land we a gi una ɛn una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm.’ Bɔt una nɔ ivin put una yes lisin to mi.
Jonadab in bɔypikin dɛn ɛn Rekab in bɔypikin kip dɛn papa dɛn kɔmand we dɛn gi dɛm, bɔt dɛn pipul ya nɔ obe mi.

Fɔseka dat na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Biliv mi, a de briŋ ɔl di bad bad tin dɛm pan Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm, we a bin dɔn tɔk se go bi to dɛm; bikɔs a tɔk to dɛm bɔt dɛn nɔ lisin, a dɔn kɔl dɛm bɔt dɛn nɔ ansa.
Bɔt Jɛrimaya tɛl di Rekabayt dɛn se, “Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Bikɔs una dɔn obe Jonadab we na una papa kɔmand ɛn du ɔl wetin in lɔ dɛn se ɛn ɔl wetin i kɔmand una fɔ du,
na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Jonadab we na Rekab in bɔypikin nɔ go ɛva de i nɔ gɛt pɔsin fɔ tinap bifo mi.”
Di ia we mek Jɛoiakim we na Josaya in bɔypikin, fo ia as kiŋ na Juda, PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to Jɛrimaya. I se,
“Tek wan skrol ɛn rayt ɔl wetin a dɔn tɔk agens Izrɛl ɛn Juda, ɛn ɔl ɔda neshɔn dɛm, frɔm di de we a bigin tɔk to yu, dat na frɔm Josaya in tɛm, te tide.
Sɔntɛm Juda dɛn go yɛri bɔt ɔl di bad bad plan we a gɛt fɔ dɛm, so dat ɔlman go lɛf fɔ du ivul, ɛn a go fɔgiv dɛm fɔ dɛn wikɛdnɛs ɛn dɛn sin.”
Nain Jɛrimaya kɔl Baruch we na Nɛraya in bɔypikin, ɛn Baruch rayt ɔl wetin Jɛrimaya tɛl am se PAPA GƆD bin tɛl am, pan wan skrol.
Nain Jɛrimaya tɛl Baruch traŋa wan se, “Dɛn dɔn ban mi fɔ go na PAPA GƆD in os;

so na yu go go. Di fɔs de, yu go rid di skrol we yu bin rayt we a bin de tɔk, insay PAPA GƆD in os lɛ ɔl di pipul dɛn yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd. Yu go rid am bak na Juda lɛ ɔl di man dɛn we kam na dɛn siti dɛn yɛri.
Sɔntɛm dɛn pre lɛ PAPA GƆD fɔgiv dɛm we go mek ɔlman lɛf fɔ du bad, bikɔs di tin we PAPA GƆD dɔn anawns se in go du, nɔ gud fɔ tɔk.”
So Baruch we na Nɛraya in bɔypikin, du ɔl wetin Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt bin ɔda am fɔ du, dat na fɔ rid PAPA GƆD in wɔd na PAPA GƆD in os.

Insay di mɔnt we mek nayn na di ia we mek fayv, we Jɛoiakim we na Josaya in bɔypikin bin de rul Juda, ɔl di pipul dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm we kɔmɔt na di siti dɛm na Juda kam Jerusɛlɛm, anawns se dɛn fɔ pre ɛn fast to PAPA GƆD.

So Baruch rid wetin Jɛrimaya bin tɛl am fɔ rayt na di skrol na PAPA GƆD in os, insay Gɛmaraya we na Shafan we na di sɛktri, in bɔypikin in rum, we bin de na di yad we de ɔpsay as yu de go insay di Nyu Get na PAPA GƆD in os.
We Maykaya we na Gɛmaraya in bɔypikin ɛn Shafan in grampikin yɛri ɔl wetin Baruch rid na di strol se PAPA GƆD se,

i go dɔŋ na di kiŋ in os insay di sɛktri in ɔfis; ɔl di bigman dɛn bin sidɔm de: Ilayshama we na di sɛktri, Dɛlayla we na Shemaya in bɔypikin, Ɛlnetan we na Akbɔ in bɔypikin, Gamaraya we na Shafan in bɔypikin, Zɛdikaya we na Ananaya in bɔypikin, ɛn ɔl di ɔda bigman dɛm.
So Maykaya tɛl dɛm ɔl wetin i yɛri se PAPA GƆD se, we Baruch bin rid di skrol lɛ ɔlman yɛri.

Nain ɔl di bigman dɛn sɛn Jehudi we na Netanaya in bɔypikin, Shɛlɛmaya in grampikin ɛn Kushi in gret grampikin fɔ go tɛl Baruch, se, “Tek di skrol we yu rid to ɔl di pipul dɛm kam.” So Baruch we na Nɛraya in bɔypikin, tek di skrol go to dɛm.
Nain dɛn se, “sidɔm ɛn rid am.” So Baruch rid am to dɛm.
Wɛn dɛn yɛri ɔl wetin rayt de, dɛn tɔn de luk dɛnsɛf wit fred; nain dɛn tɛl Baruch se, “wi mɔs tɛl to di kiŋ bɔt ɔl wetin rayt na di skrol.”
Dɔn dɛn aks Baruch se, “Tɛl wi, aw yu manej rayt ɔl dɛn tin ya? Naim bin de tɔk yu de rayt?”.
Baruch ansa dɛm se “In bin de tɔk mi de rayt wit ink na di skrol.”
Nain di bigman dɛn tɛl Baruch se “Una go ayd, yu ɛn Jɛrimaya, ɛn una nɔ mek ɛnibɔdi no usay una de.”
So dɛn go insay di kiŋ in kot, afta dɛn bin dɔn put di skrol insay Ilayshama we na di sɛktri in ɔfis; nain dɛn tɛl di kiŋ ɔl wetin rayt na di skrol.
Nain di kiŋ sɛn Jehudi fɔ go tek di skrol, ɛn i tek am na Ilayshama we na di sɛktri in ɔfis; dɔn Jehudi rid am to di kiŋ ɛn ɔl di bagman dɛm we bin tinap nia di kiŋ.
Na bin di mɔnt we mek nayn, ɛn di kiŋ bin de nain winta os, ɛn faya bin de kech insay di kolpɔt we bin de nia am.
As Jehudi rid tri ɔ fo paregraf so, di kiŋ de kɔt am kɔmɔt wit pɛn nɛf ɛn trowe am insay di faya na di kolpɔt. Na so i du sote ɔl di skrol bɔn dɔn na di faya we bin de insay di kolpɔt.
Stil, di kiŋ ɔ ɛni ɔf in wokman dɛm we bin yɛri ɔl wetin rayt na di skrol, nɔ bin fred natin, ɛn dɛn nɔ bin chɛr dɛn klos.
Ivin we Ɛlnetan, ɛn Dɛlayla ɛn Gɛmaraya beg di kiŋ nɔ fɔ bɔn di skrol, i nɔ lisin dɛm.

Bifo dat, di kiŋ ɔda Jɛrameɛl we nain di kiŋ in bɔypikin, ɛn Sɛraya we na Azriɛl in bɔypikin, ɛn Shɛlɛmaya we na Abdeɛl in bɔypikin, fɔ arɛst Baruch we na di sɛktri ɛn Jɛrimaya we na di prɔfɛt, bɔt PAPA GƆD bin ayd dɛm
Afta di kiŋ bin dɔn bɔn di skrol wit ɔl wetin Jɛrimaya bin tɛl Baruch fɔ rayt, PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to Jɛrimaya se:
“Tek ɔda skrol ɛn rayt ɔl wetin yu bin rayt pan di fɔs wan we Jɛoiakim we na kiŋ na Juda, bin bɔn na faya.

As fɔ Jɛoiakim we na kiŋ na Juda, yu go tɔk se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD se. Yu dɔn bɔn dis skrol de se, “Wetin mek yu dɔn rayt pan am se di kiŋ na Babilɔn go mɔs kam nyakanyaka dis land, ɛn nɔ go lɛf mɔtalman ɔ animal sɛf de?”

Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt Jɛoiakim we na kiŋ na Juda. I nɔ gɛt nɔn pikin nain layn we go sidɔm na Devid in tron, ɛn in, dɛn go trowe in dedebɔdi usay san go de bɔn am de tɛm, kol go mit am na nɛt.
A go pɔnish im ɛn in pikin dɛm ɛn in wokman dɛm fɔ dɛn sin; A go mek ɔl di bad bad tin dɛm we a bin dɔn se go mit dɛm we dɛn nɔ biliv, mit di wan dɛm we tap na Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn di man dɛn na Juda.’”

So Jɛrimaya tek ɔda skrol gi Baruch we na di sɛktri, dat na Nɛraya in bɔypikin, we bin rayt ɔl wetin Jɛrimaya bin tɛl am fɔ rayt na da skrol we Jɛoiakim we na kiŋ na Juda, bin bɔn na faya; i rayt ɔl wetin bin rayt na di fɔs skrol ɛn ɔda mɛsej dɛm we fiba dawande.
Na Zɛdikaya we na Josaya in bɔypikin we Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn bin mek kiŋ na Juda, bin rul instɛd ɔf Jɛoiachin we na Jɛoiakim in bɔypikin.
Bɔt in o, in wokman dɛm o, di pipul dɛm na di land o, nɔ tek PAPA GƆD in wɔd we Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt de tɛl dɛm, mek natin.

Kiŋ Zɛdikaya sɛn Jɛukal we na Shelɛmaya in bɔypikin, ɛn Zɛfinaya we na di man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn na Maasɛia in bɔypikin, to Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt se, “Pre fɔ wi to PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd.”
Datɛnde, Jɛrimaya bin stil fri fɔ waka ɔlɔbɔt, bikɔs dɛn nɔ bin dɔn put am na Jel yet.
Fero in ami bin dɔn kɔmɔt insay Ijipt; so wɛn di Babilonian dɛm we bin dɔn sɔrawnd Jerusɛlɛm yɛri dat, dɛn kɔmɔt na Jɛrusɛlɛm tret.
Nain PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt:
“Na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Na dis yu go tɛl di kiŋ na Juda we sɛn yu fɔ kam fɛnɔt to mi, ‘A de tɛl yu. Fero in ami we kam ɛp una, de rɛdi fɔ go na Ijipt we na dɛn yon land.
Dɔn di Babilonian dɛn go kam bak kam fɛt una; dɛn go kapchɔ una siti ɛn go bɔn am wit faya.’”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se. Una nɔ ful unasɛf de se, “Paopa, di Babilonian dɛn nɔ go atak wi,” bikɔs dɛn nɔ go lɛf una.
Ivin if una kil di wanol Babilonian ami we de fɛt una, ɛn na so so man dɛm we wund nɔmɔ lɛf, ɛn dɛn ɔl lidɔm insay dɛn tɛnt dɛm, dɛn go mɔs grap ɛn bɔn dis siti wit faya.’”
Di Babilonian ami bin dɔn kɔmɔt nia Jerusɛlɛm we dɛn yɛri se Fero in Ami de kam.
Jɛrimaya bin lɛf fɔ go na di land ɔf Bɛnjamin fɔ go tek in yon shia pan in pipul dɛn prɔpati.

Wɛn i rich na Bɛnjamin Get, di bigman pan di sikyɔriti we nam Irija we na Shɛlɛmaya in bɔypikin ɛn Ananaya in grampikin, arɛst Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt, se, “Yu de rɔnawe fɔ go oba to di Babilonian dɛm,”
Nain Jɛrimaya se, “Nɔto tru; Nɔto rɔnawe a de rɔnawe go to di Babilonian dɛm.” Bɔt Irijah nɔ lisin to am. I gɛda am ɛn briŋ am to di bigman dɛm.
Di bigman dɛn bin vɛks bad bad wan pan Jɛrimaya. So dɛn bin bit am ɛn lɔk am ɔp na Jonɛthan we na di sɛktri in os, bikɔs dɛn bin dɔn tɔn am to Jel.
We dɛn bin dɔn put Jɛrimaya na di ɔndagrɔn sɛl dɛm, ɛn i dɔn de de fɔ lɔŋ,

nain kiŋ Zɛdikaya sɛn se mek dɛn kɛr am go to am, ɛn i tɛl am kabɔ. Nain di kiŋ aks am sikrit wan nain os se, “Yu nɔ gɛt nɔn wɔd frɔm PAPA GƆD?” Jɛrimaya se, “A gɛt.” Nain i se, “Di kiŋ na Babilɔn go kapchɔ yu.”
Jɛrimaya aks kiŋ Zɛdikaya igen se, “Wetin a du yu, ɔ yu wokman dɛm, ɔ dɛn pipul ya, we mek una put mi na jel?
We una prɔfɛt dɛm we bin prɔfisay to una se, ‘Di kiŋ na Babilɔn nɔ go atak yu ɛn agens dis land?
Naw, a beg yu mi lɔd ɛn mi kiŋ, lisin to mi: lɛ di beg we a de beg tɔch yu at, ɛn duya, nɔ sɛn mi go bak na Jonɛthan we na di sɛktri in os, if nɔso, a go day de.”

So kiŋ Zɛdikaya gi ɔda ɛn dɛn sɛn Jɛrimaya go na di pales yad; ɛn dɛn bin de gi am wan lof bred ɛvirde we de kɔmɔt na di bekri dɛm, sote di bred na di siti bin dɔn. So Jɛrimaya bin de na di pales yad.
Shefataya we na Matan in bɔypikin, Gɛdalaya we na Pashɔ in bɔypikin, Jɛukal we na Shelɛmaya in bɔypikin, ɛn Pashɔ we na Malkaya in bɔypikin, bin yɛri wetin Jɛrimaya bin de tɛl di pipul dɛm, we i se

“Na dis PAPA GƆD se. Ɛnibɔdi we go kɔntinyu fɔ tap na dis siti, go day na wa, wit bad bad aŋri ɔ bay siknɛs; bɔt di wan dɛn we go to di Babilonian dɛm, dɛn layf go sev; dɛn layf go bi di prayz fɔ wa, ɛn dɛn nɔ go day.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, Dis kiŋ na Babilɔn in ami go mɔs kapchɔ dis siti.”

Nain di bigman dɛn tɛl di kiŋ se, “Lɛ wi kil dis man, bikɔs i de pwɛl di soja man dɛn we lɛf na di siti, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn at wit da kayn wɔd de we i de tɛl dɛm. Bikɔs dis man nɔ de mɛmba fɔ di pipul dɛn sefti o, na dɛn day wan i want.”
Nain Kiŋ Zɛdikaya se, wɛl, di man de na una an, bikɔs di kiŋ kyant do ɛnitin agens una.”

So dɛn tek Jɛrimaya ɛn ib am insay Prins Malkaya we na di kiŋ in bɔypikin in wɛl, we bin de na di pales yad, Na rop dɛn tek put am dɔŋ de. Nɔn wata nɔ bin de de pas pɔtɔpɔtɔ so Jɛrimaya sink insay di pɔtɔ pɔtɔ.
Wɛn Ebɛdmɛlɛk, wan Itiopian okobo we bin tap na di kiŋ in os, yɛri se dɛn dɔn put Jɛrimaya insay di wɛl–di kiŋ bin sidɔm na Bɛnjamin Get–
Ɛbɛdmɛlɛk kɔmɔt insaya di kiŋ in os go tɛl di kiŋ se,
“Mi masta we na di kiŋ, dɛn man ya dɔn du bad bay wetin dɛn du to Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt, we dɛn put am insay da wɛl; ɛn i go day de wit angri, bikɔs nɔn it nɔ lɛf na di siti.”
Nain di kiŋ ɔda Ɛbɛdmɛlɛk we na Itiopian se, “Tek tri man dɛm na ya go pul Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt kɔmɔt insay di wɛl bifo i day.”
So Ɛbɛdmɛlɛk tek di man dɛn go na di kiŋ in os, na wan wɔdrob na di sto, ɛn pal sɔm chɛr chɛr klos dɛm ɛn klos dɛn we dɔn pwɛl we i sɛn dɔŋ to Jɛrimaya na di wɛl wit rop.
Nain Ɛbɛdmɛlɛk we na Itiopian tɛl Jɛrimaya se, “Put di ol chɛr chɛr klos dɛn ɛn di ol wan dɛm ɛn di rop ɔnda yu ɔnda an.” Jɛrimaya du wetin i se.
Nain dɛn drɔ Jɛrimaya kam ɔp wit di rop dɛm ɛn es am kɔmɔt insay di wɛl. So Jɛrimaya kɔntinyu fɔ tap na di pales yad.
Kiŋ Zɛdikaya sɛn fɔ Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt ɛn tɛl am kabɔ na di tɔd domɔt na PAPA GƆD in os. Di kiŋ tɛl Jɛrimaya se, “A go aks yu wan kwɛshɔn; nɔ ayd natin pan mi.”
Nain Jɛrimaya tɛl Zɛdikaya se, “If a tɛl yu, yu shɔ se yu nɔ go kil mi? Ɛn if a advays yu, yu shɔ se yu go lisin to mi.”
Nain kiŋ Zɛdikaya swɛ sikrit wan to Jɛrimaya se, “Wans PAPA GƆD we mek wi sol dɛn, de, a nɔ go kil yu ɔ an yu oba to dɛn man ya we wan kil yu.”

Nain Jɛrimaya tɛl Zɛdikaya se, Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se, If yu sɔrɛnda to di kiŋ na Babilɔn in bigman dɛm, dɛn go spia yu layf ɛn dɛn nɔ go bɔn dis siti wit faya, ɛn yu ɛn ɔlman na yu os nɔ go day.
Bɔt if yu nɔ sɔrɛnda to di kiŋ na Babilɔn in bigman dɛm, I go gi di siti to di Babilonian dɛn, ɛn dɛn go bɔn am wit faya, ɛn yu nɔ go ɛskep.
Nain Kiŋ Zedikaya tɛl Jɛrimaya se, “A de fred di Ju dɛm we dɔn rɔnawe go jɔyn di Babilonian dɛm, lɛ dɛn nɔ an mi oba to dɛm ɛn lɛ dɛn nɔ molɛs mi.”
Nain Jɛrimaya se, “Dɛn nɔ go an yu oba to dɛm. Du wetin a tɛl yu se PAPA GƆD se, wantɛm wantɛm, ɛn i go bi wɛl wit yu ɛn dɛn go spia yu layf.
Bɔt if yu nɔ gri sɔrɛnda, na di vishɔn dis we PAPA GƆD dɔn sho mi:

A si dɛn de kɛr ɔl di uman dɛn we lɛf na di kiŋ na Juda in os go to di bigman dɛn na Babilɔn de se, Yu padi dɛn we yu bin biliv dɔn ple yu tampale, ɛn dɔn gɛt yu aw dɛn want yu; naw we una fut dɔn sink insay pɔtɔpɔtɔ dɛn dɔn kɔmɔt biɛn yu.’
Dɛn go kɛr ɔl yu wɛf dɛm ɛn yu bɔypikin dɛm go to di Babilonian dɛm, ɛn yusɛf nɔ go ɛskep; di kiŋ na Babilɔn go kapchɔ yu ɛn dɛn go bɔn dis siti wit faya.”
Nain Zɛdikaya tɛl Jɛrimaya se, ‘Nɔ tɛl nɔbɔdi bɔt dɛn tin ya ɛn a nɔ go kil yu.
If di bigman dɛn yɛri se a dɔn tɔk to yu, ɛn kam mit yu se, ‘tɛl wi wetin yu bin tɛl di kiŋ ɛn wetin di kiŋ tɛl yu; nɔ ayd natin pan wi ɛn wi nɔ go kil yu,’
yu go tɛl dɛn se, ‘A bin beg di kiŋ mek i nɔ sɛn mi go bak na Jonɛthan in os mek a nɔ go day de.’”
Nain ɔl di bigman dɛn kam to Jɛrimaya kan aks am, ɛn i ansa dɛm jɛs lɛk aw di kiŋ bin dɔn sho am fɔ du. So dɛn lɛf fɔ tɔk to am bikɔs nɔbɔdi nɔ bin yɛri wetin in ɛn di kiŋ bin tɔk.
Ɛn Jɛrimaya kɔntinyu fɔ tap na di pales yad te di tɛm we dɛn kapchɔ Jerusɛlɛm.
Insay di mɔnt we mek tɛn, na di ia we mek kiŋ Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda, nayn ia na pawa, Nɛbyukadnɛza, we na kiŋ na Babilɔn ɛn in wanol ami bin atak Jerusɛlɛm ɛn sɔrawnd am;
insay di ia we mek kiŋ Zɛdikaya ilɛvin ia as kiŋ, na di nayn de insay di mɔnt we mek fo, ɛn insay di mɔnt we mek fo, dɛn bin brok di wɔl dɛn na di siti.

Wɛn dɛn kapchɔ Jerusɛlɛm, ɔl di bigman dɛn na Babilɔn bin kam sidɔm na di midul get: sɔm pan dɛn na Nagal Sarɛza, Samga Nɛbɔ, Sasɛchim we na Rabsaris, wan ɔda Nagal Sarɛza we kɔmɔt Rabmag, wit ɔl di kiŋ na Babilɔn in ɔda ofishal dɛm.
Wɛn Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda, ɛn ɔl di sojaman dɛm si dɛm, dɛn bigin rɔnawe kɔmɔt di siti na nɛt, de pas na di kiŋ in gadin insay di get we de bitwin di tu wɔl dɛm, ɛn dɛn go to di Araba say.

Bɔt di Babilonian ami rɔnata dɛm ɛn kech Zɛdikaya na di flat grɔn na Jɛriko; wɛn dɛn kech am, dɛn briŋ am kam to Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, na Ribla, dat na di land ɔf Amat: ɛn i pas sɛntɛns pan am
Di kiŋ na Babilɔn kil Zɛdikaya in bɔypikin dɛm bifo in yay na Ribla; ɛn di kiŋ na Babilɔn kil ɔl di bigman dɛm we bin de nia di kiŋ na Juda.
I bɔs Zɛdikaya in yay dɛm ɛn tay am wit chen fɔ kɛr am go Babilɔn.
Di Babilonian dɛm bin bɔn di kiŋ in os ɛn di pipul dɛn os dɛm, ɛn brok di wɔl na Jɛrusɛlɛm.
Nain Nɛbyuzaradan we na di kapten fɔ di gyadman dɛm, kɛr di balans pipul dɛn we bin lɛf na di siti, di wan dɛn we bin dɔn rɔnawe kɔmɔt de, ɛn di wan dɛm we bin lɛf, go ɛgzayl.
Nɛbyuzaradan, we na di kapten fɔ di gyadman dɛn, bin lɛf sɔm pan di po pipul dɛn we nɔ gɛt natin. Dɛn bin gi dɛm greps fam ɛn grɔn dɛm togɛda.
Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn pas kɔmand bɔt Jɛrimaya to Nɛbyuzaradan, we na di kapten fɔ di gyadman dɛn se,
“Tek am go, tek gud kia ɔf am ɛn nɔ du am bad, ɛn du wetin i tɛl yu.”
So Nɛbyuzaradan we na di kapten, Nɛbyushazban we na Rabsaris, Nagal Sharɛza we na Rabmag ɛn ɔl di kiŋ na Babilɔn in bigman dɛm,
sɛn tek Jɛrimaya kɔmɔt na di pales yad. Dɛn an am oba to Gɛdalaya we na bin Aikam in bɔypikin ɛn Shafan in grampikin, so dat i go kɛr am go nain os. So i bin tap wit di pipul dɛm.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to Jɛrimaya, di tɛm we dɛn bin lɔk am ɔp, na di pales yad se:
“Go tɛl Ɛbɛdmɛlɛk, da Itiopian we na okobo se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Biliv mi, a go du wetin a se na dis siti fɔ bad, ɛn nɔto fɔ gud, ɛn dɛn go opin bifo yu yay da de de.
PAPA GƆD se, Bɔt a go sev yu da de de, ɛn di man dɛn we yu de fred nɔ go kapchɔ yu.
Bikɔs a go mɔs sev yu ɛn yu nɔ go day na wa; bɔt yu go gɛt yu layf as di prayz na di wa, bikɔs yu dɔn put yu at to mi. Na so PAPA GƆD se.’”

Dis na PAPA GƆD in wɔd we kam to Jɛrimaya afta Nɛbyuzaradan we na di kapten fɔ di gyadman dɛm, bin fri am lɛ i kɔmɔt na Rama, afta i bin chen am go ɛgzayl wit di wan dɛn we dɛn bin kapchɔ na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda, fɔ go Babilɔn.
Di kapten tek Jɛrimaya go na kɔna ɛn tɛl am se, “Na PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd tɔk wit in pawa se dis bad tin fɔ apin na ya;
na PAPA GƆD mek i bi, ɛn na wetin I bin se I go du, I du. Na bikɔs una kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD, ɛn nɔ du wetin I se, mek dɛn tin ya apin to una.

Naw, a de pul di chen dɛn kɔmɔt na yu an ɛn fri yu. If yu tink se i gud fɔ go Babilɔn wit mi, yu kin kam, ɛn a go luk afta yu wɛl; bɔt if i tink se i nɔ rayt fɔ go Babilɔn wit mi, nɔ kam. Luk di wanol land de bifo yu; go usay yu tink se gud ɛn rayt fɔ go.

Bɔt if yu nɔ de go, tɔn bak to Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin ɛn Shafan in grampikin, we di kiŋ na Babilɔn dɔn pik fɔ bi gɔvna fɔ di siti dɛn na Juda; go tap wit am wit di pipul dɛn ɔ go ɛnisay yu tink se rayt.” So di kapten fɔ di gyadman dɛn gi am it ɛn prɛzɛnt, ɛn lɛf am lɛ i go.
Nain Jɛrimaya go to Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin na Mizpa, ɛn tap wit am wit di pipul dɛn we bin lɛf na di land.

We ɔl di kapten dɛm na di difrɛn fɔs dɛm na di opin kɔntri ɛn dɛn man dɛm yɛri se di kiŋ na Babilɔn dɔn pik Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin, fɔ bi gɔvna na di land, ɛn dɔn put di man, uman ɛn pikin dɛm nain kia, we na dɛm popoliopo dɛn na di land we dɛn nɔ bin kɛr go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn,

dɛn go to Gɛdalaya na Mizpa – dat na Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin, Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin, Sɛraya we na Tanumɛt in bɔypikin, Efai we na Nɛtofatayt in bɔypikin dɛm, Jɛzanaya we na da Maakatayt in bɔypikin, ɛn dɛn man dɛm.

Gɛdalaya, we na Aikam in bɔypikin ɛn Shafan in grampikin, prɔmis dɛm ɛn dɛn man dɛm we i tɛl dɛn se, “Una nɔ fred fɔ wok fɔ di Babilonian dɛm. Una tap na di land ɛn sav di kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn ɔltin gi ɔrayt wit yu.

As fo mi, a go tap na Mizpa fɔ tinap fɔ una bifo di Babilonian dɛn we go kam to wi; bɔt as fɔ una, una gɛda wayn ɛn dray sizin frut ɛn ɔyl, ɛn kip dɛm na una kɔntena dɛn, ɛn tap na di siti dɛm we una dɔn kapchɔ.”

Semweso, wɛn ɔl di Ju dɛm we bin de na Moab, ɛn di wan dɛn we bin de wit dɛn Amɔnite dɛm, ɛn di wan dɛn na Idɔm ɛn ɔda say, yɛri se di kiŋ na Babilɔn dɔn lɛf sɔm pipul na Juda, ɛn dɔn pik Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin Shafan in grampikin fɔ bi Gɔvna oba dɛm,
dɛn ɔl kɔmɔt na di ples we dɛn bin drɛb dɛm go ɛn kam bak to Gɛdalaya na Mizpa insay Juda; ɛn dɛn bin gɛda wayn ɛn dray sizin frut plɛnti plɛnti wan.
I apin se Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin ɛn ɔl di lida dɛm fɔ di sojamam dɛm we de na di opin kɔntri, bin kam to Gɛdalaya na Mizpa
ɛn tɛl am se, “Yu no se Bealis we na di Amonayt dɛn kiŋ, dɔn sɛn Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin fɔ kam kil yu?” Bɔt Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin nɔ biliv dɛm.

So Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin tɔk sikritli to Gɛdalaya na Mizpa se, “Lɛ a go kil Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go no. Wetin du i wan kil yu? Na fɔ mek ɔl dɛn Ju dɛm we de ya wit yu go skata, ɛn di balans we de na Juda day?”
Bɔt Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin tɛl Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin se, “Yu nɔ go du da kayn tin de, bikɔs na lay yu de lay pan Ishmɛl.”

Insay di mɔnt we mek sɛvin, Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin ɛn Ilayshama in grampikin, we kɔmɔt na di rɔyal famili, ɛn wan pan di kiŋ in chif ɔfisa dɛm, kam wit tɛn man to Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin, na Mizpa. As dɛn ɔl bin de it togɛda na Mizpa,
Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin ɛn di tɛn man dɛm grap ɛn chap Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin ɛn Shafan in grampikin wit sɔd ɛn kil am, in we di kiŋ na Babilɔn bin dɔn pik fɔ bi gɔvna na di land.
Ishmɛl kil ɔl di Ju dɛm we bin de wit Gɛdalaya na Mizpa ɛn di Babilonian sojaman dɛm we bin apin fɔ de de.
Da sem de de afta dɛn mɔda Gɛdalaya, bifo ɛnibɔdi no bɔt wetin dɔn apin,
eti man we kɔmɔt Shɛkɛm, Shilo ɛn Sameria, we dɛn bia bia shev, dɛn klos chɛr chɛr ɛn dɛn bɔdi kɔt kɔt, kam de briŋ sid ɔfrin ɛn insɛns fɔ kam gi na PAPA GƆD in os.
So Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin kɔmɔt insay Mizpa go mit dɛm; i bin de kray we i bin de go mit dɛm. As i de rich to dɛm, nain i se, “Una kam insay to Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin.”
Wɛn dɛn kam insay di siti, nain Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin ɛn di man dɛm we de wit am, kil kil dɛm ɛn ib dɛm insay wɛl.
Bɔt tɛn pan dɛm bin de we tɛl Ishmɛl se, “Nɔ kil wi, bikɔs wi gɛt sto ful wit wit, bali, ɔyl ɛn ɔni we wi ayd insay di fil.” So i nɔ bin kil in ɛn in kɔmpin dɛm.

I apin se di wɛl we Ishmɛl bin trowe ɔl di man dɛn we i kil, dɛn dedebɔdi, na bin di big wɛl we kiŋ Asa bin mek fɔ gyad dɛnsɛf lɛ Baasha we na kiŋ na Izrɛl, nɔ atak dɛm; Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin, ful am wit dedebɔdi.

Afta dat, Ishmɛl bin kapchɔ di balans pipul dɛm we bin de na Mizpa, i kapchɔ di kiŋ in gyalpikin dɛm ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm we bin lɛf na Mizpa, we Nɛbyuzaradan we na di Gyadman dɛn kapten, bin dɔn put na Gɛdalay we na Aikam in bɔypikin, in kia. Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin kapchɔ dɛn ɛn bin rɛdi fɔ krɔs go oba to di Amonite dɛm.
Bɔt we Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin, ɛn ɔl di lida dɛm fɔ di difrɛn fɛtman dɛm, yɛri bɔt ɔl di bad bad tin we Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin, dɔn du,
dɛn tek ɔl dɛn man dɛm go fɔ go fɛt Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin. Dɛn mit am na da big watasay we gɛt stɛp fɔ go dɔŋ we de insay Gibiɔn.
Wɛn ɔl di pipul we bin de wit Ishmɛl si Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin, ɛn ɔl di lida dɛm fɔ di difrɛn fɛtman dɛm we bin de wit am, dɛn gladi.
So ɔl di pipul dɛn we Ishmɛl bin dɔn kapchɔ na Mizpa, bin tɔn rawnd kam bak ɛn go to Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin.
Bɔt Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin ɛskep wit et man kpɔmɔt to Joanan go to di Amɔnite dɛm.

So Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin ɛn ɔl di lida fɔ di difrɛn fɛtman dɛm, tek ɔl di balans pipul dɛm we Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin bin dɔn kapchɔ na Mizpa kɛr go afta i bin dɔn kil Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin – dɛn na bin sojaman dɛm, uman dɛm, pikin dɛm, ɛn okobo dɛm we Joanan briŋ kam bak kɔmɔt Gibiɔn.
Nain dɛn go ɛn tap na Gɛrut Chimam nia Bɛtliɛm, as dɛm bin plan fɔ go Ijipt,
fɔseka di Babilonian dɛm; dɛn bin de fred dɛm bikɔs, Ishmɛl we na Netanaya in bɔypikin, bin dɔn kil Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin, we di kiŋ na Babilɔn bin dɔn mek gɔvna oba di land.
Ɔl di kɔmanda dɛm fɔ di difrɛn fɛtman dɛm ɛn Joanan we na Karɛn in bɔypikin, ɛn Azaraya we na Oshaya in bɔypikin, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm, frɔm di list wan to di wan we pas dɛn ɔl, kam nia
ɛn tɛl Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt se, “Lisin wi prɔblɛm dɛm ɛn pre to PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd fɔ wi, fɔseka ɔl di wan dɛm we lɛf (bikɔs wi we lɛf na jɛs tu tri pan di wanol nɔmba as yusɛf kin si)
so dat PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd go sho wi di rɔd we wi fɔ waka, ɛn di tin dɛm we wi fɔ du.”

Nain Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt tɛl dɛm se, “A dɔn yɛri wetin una se; biliv mi, a go pre to PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd ɛn tɛl am ɔl wetin una se, ɛn ɛnitin we PAPA GƆD ansa se, a go tɛl una; a nɔ go ayd natin pan una.”
Nain dɛn tɛl Jɛrimaya se, “Mek PAPA GƆD bi di witnɛs we nɔ de lay ɛn de waka tret fɔ tɔk agens wi if wi nɔ du ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD we na yu Gɔd, sɛn se wi fɔ du.
I gud o, i bad o, wi go du wetin PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd we wi de sɛn yu to naw, so dat ɔltin go gud fɔ wi we wi du wetin PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd se.”
Afta tɛn dez PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to Jɛrimaya.
Nain i sɛn kɔl Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin, ɔl di kɔmanda dɛm fɔ di difrɛn fɛtman dɛm, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm; frɔm di las wan to di wan we pas dɛn ɔl,
ɛn tɛl dɛm se, “Na dis PAPA GƆD we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd we una bin sɛn mi to, fɔ go put una kes to:
I se: If una go kɔntinyu fɔ de na dis land, dat go mek a es una ɔp ɛn nɔ put una dɔŋ; a go plant una ɛn nɔ rut una; bikɔs a dɔn sɔri ɛn nɔ go du di bad bad tin we a bin wan du una, igen.
Una nɔ frɛd di kiŋ na Babilɔn we una bin de fred igen; una no frɛd am, na so PAPA GƆD se, bikɔs a de wit una fɔ pul una kɔmɔt nain an.
A go sho una masi, so dat insɛf go sho una masi ɛn mek una de na una yon land.
Bɔt if una se, ‘Wi nɔ go kɔntinyu fɔ tap na dis land,’ we min se na PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd una de disobe,
ɛn una de se, ‘Nɔ, wi go go na Ijipt, usay wa nɔ go mit wi, ɔ de yɛri trɔmpɛt de blo, ɔ tin fɔ it nɔ de, ɛn wi go tap de,’
wɛl, una lisin wetin PAPA GƆD se, una di balans pipul dɛn we lɛf na Juda. Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: If una tɔn una fes fɔ go Ijipt fɔ go tap de,
na di wa we una de fred go mit una bɛtɛ bɛtɛ wan na Ijipt de; ɛn di bad bad aŋri we una de fred, go de biɛn una bɛtɛ bɛtɛ wan na Ijipt; ɛn na de una una go day.
Ɔl di man dɛm we tɔn dɛn fes dɛm fo go Ijipt fo go tap de, go day na wa, ɔ wit bad bad aŋri ɔ wit siknɛs; di kayn bad bad tin we a go du dɛm go mek nɔn pan dɛm nɔ lɛf ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go de we nɔ go day.

“Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd, se: lɛkɛ aw A kin mi put mi vɛksteshɔn ɛn mi wam at pan di wan dɛm we tap na Jerusɛlɛm, na semweso a go pul mi wan at pan una we una go na Ijipt. Dɛn go et una bad bad wan. Dɛn go fred, swɛ, kɔs ɛn provok una. Una nɔ go si dis ples igen.
PAPA GƆD dɔn tɛl una se, ‘E, una we lɛf na Juda, ‘Una nɔ go na Ijipt.’ Una no wantɛm se na di las wɔnin a dɔn gi una so,

so dat a una nɔ go go astre we una go gɛt fɔ tek una layf pe fɔ. Bikɔs una sɛn mi to PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd se, ‘Pre fɔ wi to PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd ɛn wi go du ɛnitin we PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd tɛl wi se, wi fɔ du.’
Ɛn tide, a dɔn tɛl una wetin I se, bɔt una nɔ obe natin pan ɔl wetin PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd sɛn mi fɔ kam tɛl una.
So una no naw se tabi tabi nɔ de, una go day na wa, una go day wit bad bad aŋri, ɛn wit siknɛs na di ples we una at de gi una fɔ go tap.”
Wɛn Jɛrimaya dɔn tɔk ɔltin we PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd se, to ɔl di pipul n dɔn we na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd sɛn am fɔ tɛl dɛm,

Azaraya, we na Hoshaya in bɔypikin ɛn Joanan we na Karera in bɔypikin ɛn ɔl di fityay man dɛm tɛl Jɛrimaya se, “Yu de lay. PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd nɔ sɛn yu fɔ kam tɛl wi se, ‘Una nɔ go Ijipt fɔ go tap de’;
bɔt na Baruch we na Nɛraya in bɔypikin dɔn put yu agens wi, fɔ gi wi to di Babilonian dɛm so dat dɛn go kil wi, ɔ kɛr wi go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn.”
So Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin ɛn ɔl di kɔmanda dɛm fɔ di difrɛn fɛt man dɛm, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm nɔ bin du wetin PAPA GƆD se, dat na fɔ mek dɛn kɔntinyu fɔ tap na Juda.

Bɔt Joanan we na Karɛa in bɔypikin ɛn ɔl di kɔmanda dɛm fɔ di difrɛn fɛtman dɛm, tek ɔl di balans pipul dɛm we bin lɛf na Juda, dat na di pipul dɛm we bin dɔn kɔmɔt na ɔl di difrɛn neshɔn dɛm we PAPA GƆD bin drɛb dɛm go, tɔn bak kan tap na Juda–

di man dɛm, di uman dɛm, di pikin dɛm, di kiŋ in gyal pikin dɛm ɛn ɔlman we Nɛbyuzaradan we na di kapten fɔ di gyadman dɛm, bin lɛf to Gɛdalaya we na Aikam in bɔypikin ɛn semweso, Shafan in grampikin; wit Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt ɛn Baruch we na Nɛraya in bɔypikin.
Dɛn kam na Ijipt, bikɔs dɛn nɔ obe PAPA GƆD. Dɛn rich as fa as Tapanis.
Nain PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to Jɛrimaya na Tapanis se:
“Tot big big ston dɛm go ayd dɛm insay di pɔtɔpɔtɔ kle we de na di pevmɛnt we de fɔ go insay Fero in pales na Tapanis, ɛn mek di man dɛm na Juda si yu,

ɛn tɛl dɛm se, ‘Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: A de tɛl una, a go sɛn tek Nɛbyukadnɛza, mi wokman we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, ɛn i go put in tron pantap dɛn ston ya we a dɔn ayd, ɛn i go prɛd in kiŋ tɛnt oba dɛm.
I go kam kapchɔ Ijipt, ɛn i go gi siknɛs to di wan dɛn we fɔ day wit siknɛs, i go mek slev wit di wan dɛn we fɔ bi slev, ɛn go mek wa pan di wan dɛm we fɔ day na wa.
I go layt faya insay di gɔd dɛm na Ijipt dɛn tɛmpul dɛm; ɛn i go bɔn dɛm ɛn kɛr dɛm go as slev; ɛn i go klin Ijipt lɛkɛ aw shɛpad de klin in kot we gɛt lɔs; ɛn i go kɔmɔt de wit kolat.
I go brok di imej dɛn we dɛn de wɔship na Ɛliopolis we de na Ijipt; ɛn i go bɔn di gɔd dɛm na Ijipt, dɛn tɛmpul dɛm wit faya.’”
Tap na Migdɔl, Tapanis ɛn Mɛmfis we de na Ijipt, ɛn na Patrɔs.

PAPA GƆD in wɔd we bin kam to Jɛrimaya bɔt ɔl di Ju dɛm we bin “Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Una dɔn si ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we a du to Jerusɛlɛm ɛn to ɔl di siti dɛm na Juda. Luk dɛm de lɛk tide, dɛn nɔ gud fɔ natin, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ tap de,
fɔseka di wikɛd tin dɛm we dɛn du, tin dɛn we mek a vɛks, dat na we dɛn bin de bɔn insɛns ɛn sav ɔda gɔd dɛm we dɛn, una ɛn ivin una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm nɔ no.
Pan ɔl dat, a bin de sɛn mi wokman dɛm we na di prɔfɛt dɛn to una ɔltɛm fɔ tɛl una se, ‘Ey, una nɔ du dis bad bad tin we a et bad bad wan!’
Bɔt dɛn nɔ lisin ɔ ivin pe atɛnshɔn fɔ mek dɛn go lɛf dɛn bad bad tin dɛn de ɛn nɔ de bɔn insɛns to ɔda gɔd dɛm igen.
Fɔseka dat, a bin put mi wamat ɛn mi vɛksteshɔn pan dɛm, ɛn dɛn bin si am na di siti dɛm na Juda ɛn na di trit dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm; ɛn dɛn tɔn west ɛn gud fɔ natin de lɛkɛ tide.

Ɛn naw, na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Wetin du una de du dis kayn bad bad tin to unasɛf, fɔ mek una nɔ gɛt mɔ man ɛn uman, yɔŋ bebi ɛn pikin dɛm na Juda we dat go mek nɔbɔdi nɔ lɛf pan una?

Wetindu una de provok mi mek a vɛks bay wetin una de du, we una de bɔn insɛns to ɔda gɔd dɛm na Ijipt usay una dɔn kam tap, we go mek nɔbɔdi nɔ want fɔ gɛt ɛnitin fɔ du wit una, ɛn una gɛt swɛ ɛn tɔn provokeshɔn na ɔl di neshɔn dɛm na di wɔl?
Una dɔn fɔgɛt una fɔstɛmpapa dɛn wikɛdnɛs, di kiŋ dɛn na Juda dɛn wikɛdnɛs, dɛn wɛf dɛn wikɛdnɛs, una sɛf yon wikɛdnɛs ɛn una wɛf dɛn wikɛdnɛs we dɛn du na Juda ɛn na di trit dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm?
Dɛn nɔ put dɛnsɛf dɔŋ te tide, ɛn dɛn nɔ rɛspɛkt mi, ɛn nɔ du wetin mi lɔ we a gi una ɛn una fɔstɛmpapa dɛn, se.
“Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: A de tɛl una, a go tay mi at pan una ɛn du una bad ɛn nyakanyaka di wanol Juda.

A go kech di balans wan dɛm we lɛf na Juda we dɛnsɛf de mekɔp fɔ go Ijipt, ɛn dɛn ɔl go day; na Ijipt dɛn go day; dɛn go day na wa ɔ wit bad bad aŋri; frɔm di las wan to di wan we gɛt pawa pas dɛn ɔl, go day na wa ɛn wit bad bad aŋri; dɛn go tɔn tin we at fɔ luk, pipul dɛn go trit dɛn lɛk dɔg ɛn go tek dɛn nem fɔ swɛ ɛn go provok dɛm.
A go pɔnish dɛn wan we tap na Ijipt lɛkɛ aw a dɔn pɔnish di wan dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm, wit wa, bad bad aŋri ɛn wit siknɛs,
so dat nɔn pan di balans we bin de na Juda we dɔn kam tap na Ijipt nɔ go ɛskep, ɔ liv ɔ tɔn bak go Juda, usay dɛn want fɔ tɔmbak fo go tap; bikɔs dɛn nɔ go go bak, pas sɔm rɛfyuji dɛm.”
Nain ɔl di man dɛm we no se dɛn wɛf dɛn dɔn bɔn insɛns to ɔda gɔd dɛm, ɛn ɔl di uman dɛm we tinap de, we na bin bɔku bɔku pipul dɛm, ɛn ɔl di pipul we tap na Patrɔs na Ijipt ansa Jɛrimaya se:
“As fɔ wetin yu dɔn tɛl wi se PAPA GƆD se fɔ tɛl wi, wi nɔ go lisin to yu.

Bɔt wi go du ɔl wetin wi dɔn swɛ se wi go du, dat na fɔ bɔn insɛns to di Kwin na ɛvin ɛn fɔ tamisilɛ to am, lɛkɛ aw wi bin dɔn de du, wi ɛn wi fɔstɛmpapa dɛm, wi kiŋ dɛm ɛn wi bigman dɛm, na di siti dɛn na Juda ɛn na di trit dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm; bikɔs dɛn tɛm dɛn de, wi bin gɛt plɛnti it, ɛn bɛtɛ bin de fala wi ɛn nɔn bad tin nɔ bin de apin to wi.
Bɔt frɔm we wi lɛf fɔ bɔn insɛns to di Kwin na ɛvin ɛn lɛf fɔ tamisilɛ to am, naim wi nɔ de gɛt natin igen, ɛn wi bigin day na wa ɛn wit bad bad aŋri.”
Dɔn di uman dɛn se, “Wɛn wi bin de bɔn insɛns to di Kwin na ɛvin ɛn tamisilɛ to am, nɔto wi man dɛm bin gri fɔ mek wi mek kek fɔ am ɛn tot in imej ɛn tamisilɛ to am?”
Nain Jɛrimaya tɛl ɔl di pipul, di man dɛm ɛn di uman dɛm, ɛn ɔl di pipul we bin gi am da ansa de se:

“As fɔ di insɛns dɛn we una dɔn bɔn na di siti dɛn na Juda, ɛn na di trit dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm, una ɛn una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm, una kiŋ dɛm ɛn una bigman dɛm ɛn di pipul dɛn na di land, PAPA GƆD nɔ mɛmba dat? I nɔ bin kam to in maynd?
PAPA GƆD nɔ bin ebul bia di bad bad tin dɛm ɛn di tin dɛm we i et bad bad wan we una dɔn du; na dat mek una land dɔn tɔn gud fɔ natin, i dɔn gɛt swɛ ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ tap de, lɛk aw i de lɛkɛ tide.
Na bikɔs una bɔn insɛns, ɛn bikɔs una kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD, ɛn nɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD se, ɔ obe in lɔ dɛm, in ɔda ɛn in kɔmandmɛnt dɛm, mek dis bad bad tin dɔn apin to una de lɛkɛ tide.”
Jɛrimaya tɛl ɔl di pipul ɛn ɔl di uman dɛm se, “Una yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD se, una ɔl we kɔmɔt Juda go tap na Ijipt;

Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: Una ɛn una wɛf dɛm dɔn tɔk wit una yon mɔt dɛn, ɛn una dɔn du am wit una yon an dɛm we una se, ‘Wi go du ɔl wetin wi dɔn swɛ se wi go du, dat na fɔ bɔn insɛns to di Kwin na ɛvin ɛn fɔ tamisilɛ to am.’ So una kip to una prɔmis ɛn du wetin una prɔmis!

Fɔseka dat, una yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD se, una we kɔmɔt Juda go tap na Ijipt: PAPA GƆD se, a de tɛl una, a dɔn swɛ wit mi gret nem se, nɔn man we kɔmɔt Juda go tap na Ijipt nɔ go yuz mi nem fɔ swɛ igen, dat na we dɛn kin se, ‘Wans PAPA GƆD we na Gɔd de.’
Biliv mi, a de wach dɛm fɔ du dɛm bad ɛn nɔto fɔ du dɛm gud; ɔl di man dɛm we kɔmɔt Juda go tap na Ijipt go day na wa ɛn wit bad bad aŋri, te nɔn pan dɛn nɔ lɛf.
Di wan dɛn we go ɛskep we nɔ go day na wa, we go kɔmɔt Ijipt go bak na Juda, nɔ go plɛnti; ɛn ɔl di balans we bin lɛf na Juda, we bin kam Ijipt kam tap, go no udat in wɔd go pas, mi yon ɔ dɛn yon.
PAPA GƆD se, na dis go bi di sayn se a go pɔnish una na dis ples, so dat una go no se na mi wɔd go pas fɔ du una bad, nɔto una yon:

Na dis PAPA GƆD se, A de tɛl una, a go gi Fero Ofra we na kiŋ na Ijipt to in ɛnimi dɛm, di wan dɛm we want fɔ kil am, jɛs lɛkɛ aw a bin gi Zɛdikaya we na bin kiŋ na Juda to Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, we na bin in ɛnimi ɛn bin want fɔ kil am.”

Dis na wetin Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt bin tɛl Baruch we na Nɛraya in bɔypikin, wɛn i bin de rayt dɛn tin ya insay wan buk we Jɛrimaya in bin de tɔk, insay di ia we mek fo, we Jɛoiakim we na Josaya in bɔypikin bin de rul Juda:
“Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se fɔ tɛl yu, Yu Barush:
Yu bin tɔk se, ‘Swɛ dɔn mit mi! Bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn ad sɔro to mi pen; A dɔn taya fɔ pini ɛn a nɔ ebul blo.”
Na dis yu go tɛl am, Na dis PAPA GƆD se: Biliv mi, a de brok wetin a bin dɔn bil, ɛn a de rut wetin a bin dɔn plant– dat na di wanol land.
PAPA GƆD se, Yu de luk fɔ big tin fɔ yusɛf? Nɔ luk fɔ big tin; bikɔs, mi de tɛl yu se, a go du bad bad tin to ɔlman na wɔl, bɔt a go gi yu yu layf as prayz fɔ wa ɔlsay we yu go.”
Dis na PAPA GƆD in wɔd we bin kam to Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt, bɔt di neshɔn dɛm.

Bɔt Ijipt. Dis na bɔt Fero Nɛko we na kiŋ na Ijipt in Ami, we bin de nia Riva Yufretis na Kakɛmish, we Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn bin bit insay di ia we mek fo, we Jɛoiakim we na Josaya in bɔypikin, na bin kiŋ na Juda:
“Una rɛdi una smɔl shild ɛn big shild, ɛn una go fɔ go fɛt!
Una rɛdi di ɔs dɛm; una klɛm, Una di ɔsman dɛm! Una tinap usay una fɔ de wit una ɛlmɛt dɛm, una klin una spia dɛm, ɛn wɛr una fɛt klos we sɔd nɔ de pas!
Wetin mek a dɔn si am? Dɛn at pwɛl ɛn dɔn tɔn bak. Dɛn dɔn bit dɛn sojaman dɛm ɛn dɛn dɔn rɔnawe kwik kwik wan; dɛn nɔ luk biɛn sɛf– fred fred de ɔlɔbɔt! Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Di wan dɛm we ebul rɔn fast nɔ ebul rɔnawe, semweso, di sojaman nɔ ebul ɛskep; dɛn dɔn bɔk fut ɛn fɔdɔm, na di nɔt nia Riva Yufretis.
“Udat dis, we de grap lɛkɛ Riva Nayl, lɛkɛ dɛn riva we dɛn wata de pul swɛlin?
Ijipt de grap lɛkɛ Riva Nayl, lɛkɛ dɛm riva we de pul swɛlin. I se, a go grap, a go kɔba di wanol wɔl, a go nyakanyaka siti dɛm ɛn di wan dɛm we tap de.

Una go de, Una di ɔs dɛm, ɛn rej, Una rɔn lɛkɛ una kres, una di chariɔt dɛm! Lɛ di sojaman dɛm go bifo: di man dɛm we kɔmɔt Itiopia ɛn Libia we de fɛt wit big shild, ɛn di man dɛm we kɔmɔt Lidia we sabi fɛt wit bo.

Da de de, na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in de, na de fɔ rivɛnj, fɔ rivɛnj fɔ insɛf pan in ɛnimi dɛm, Di sɔd go kil te i bɛlful, ɛn drink dɛn blɔd te i bɛlful. Bikɔs PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go mek sakrifays na di nɔt kɔntri nia riva Yufretis.
Go ɔp na Giliad, go tek mɛrisin, Yu Ijipt in gyal pikin we na vajin! Una dɔn yuz bɔku mɛrɛsin fɔ natin; yu nɔ go wɛl igen.
Di neshɔn dɛm dɔn yɛri bɔt yu disgres, ɛn dɛn yɛri yu kɔmplen ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl; bikɔs sojaman de fɔdɔm pan sojaman; dɛn tu day togɛda.”
Wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt aw Nɛbyukadnɛza we an kiŋ na Babilɔn go kam fɔ kam atak Ijipt:
“Tɛl dɛm na Ijipt ɛn anawns na Migdɔl; anawns na Mɛmfis ɛn Tapanis; Tɛl dɛm se, ‘Una rɛdi ɛn pak ɔltin rɛdi, bikɔs wa go kil pipul dɛn ɔlɔbɔt rawnd una.’
Wetindu Apis dɔn rɔnawe? Wetindu una man kaw nɔ tinap? Bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn push am dɔŋ.
Una plɛnti bɔk fut ɛn fɔdɔm, ɛn dɛn tɔk to dɛnsɛf se, ‘Una grap lɛ wi go bak to wi yon pipul dɛm we na di land we wi bɔn, fɔseka di wan we de sɔprɛs dɛm, in sɔd.’
Kɔl Fero we na kiŋ na Ijipt dis nem ‘Man we de mek nɔys ɛn westɛm.’
“Di kiŋ se, wans a de, dat na di kiŋ we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, lɛkɛ we Mawnt Tabɔ ay pas di ɔda mawnten dɛm, ɛn lɛkɛ we Mawnt Kamɛl ay pas di si, na so di atak go tan.
Una rɛdi una lod dɛm fɔ go ɛgzayl, Una we tap na Ijipt! Bikɔs Mɛmfis go tɔn gud fɔ natin, ples we nyakanyaka we nɔbɔdi nɔ tap.
“Ijipt na wan fayn kaw pikin, bɔt wan flay we de bɛt we kɔmɔt na di nɔt, dɔn kam pan am.
Ivin in soja dɛm we dɛn aya we de wit am, na lɛk fat fat kaw pikin; bɔt usay, dɛn dɔn tɔn ɛn rɔnawe togɛda, dɛn nɔ tinap; bikɔs di de ɔf kalamiti, dɔn kam pan dɛm, di tɛm fɔ dɛn pɔnishmɛnt.
“I de mek sawnd lɛkɛ we snek de rɔn fɔ go ayd; bikɔs in ɛnimi dɛn de kam mit am wit pawa, ɛn de kam fɔ kam fɛt am wit aks, lɛkɛ dɛn man dɛm we de kɔt tik.
PAPA GƆD se, dɛn go chap chap in fɔrɛst, ɔl we pɔsin nɔ go ebul go insay de, bikɔs dɛn bɔku pas lokɔs; pɔsin nɔ go ebul kɔnt dɛm.
Ijipt in gyal pikin go shem, dɛn go kapchɔ am gi to pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt na di na di nɔt,”
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: biliv mi, a go pɔnish Amɔn we de na Thibis, ɛn Fero, ɛn Ijipt ɛn in gɔd dɛm, ɛn in kiŋ dɛm pɔnishmɛnt go go pan Fero ɛn ɔl udat abop pan am.
A go gi dɛm to di wan dɛn we wan kil dɛm, dat na to Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn ɛn in ɔfisa dɛm. Afta dat, pipul dɛn go tap na Ijipt, lɛkɛ lɔntɛm.

“Bɔt nɔ fred, Yu Jekob we na mi wokman, nɔ pwɛlat, Yu Izrɛl; bikɔs tabi tabi nɔ de, a go de fawe a sev una, ɛn a go sev una pikin dɛm kɔmɔt na di land we dɛn mek dɛm slev. Jekob go tɔn bak kam ɛn de wit kolat ɛn alafia, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go gi am kɔtat.

PAPA GƆD se, nɔ fred, Yu Jekob we na mi wokman, bikɔs a de wit yu. A go nyakanyaka ɔl di neshɔn dɛm we a dɔn drɛb yu go, bɔt yu, a nɔ go nyakanyaka yu. A go disiplin una bay wetin una du, ɛn nɔn we nɔ de we a go lɛf una, ɛn nɔ pɔnish una.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd we kam to Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt, bɔt di Filistin dɛm, bifo Fero bin atak Gaza.

“Na dis PAPA GƆD se, A de tɛl una, wata de grap kɔmɔt na di nɔt, ɛn i go bi flɔd; di wata go kɔba di land ɛn ɔl wetin de de, i go kɔba di siti ɛn di wan dɛm we tap de. Di man dɛn go ala de kray, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛm we tap de, go kray.
We in ɔs dɛn go de stamp dɛn fut, ɛn di chariɔt dɛm go de kam wit spid, ɛn dɛn wil dɛn go de mek ebi nɔys, papa nɔ go luk fɔ dɛn pikin dɛm we dɛn de rɔn, bikɔs dɛn an dɛm go wik,

fɔseka di de we de kam fɔ nyakanyaka ɔl di Filistin dɛm, fɔ kil ɔl di ɛlpa dɛn we lɛf na Taya ɛn Sidɔm. Bikɔs PAPA GƆD de nyakanyaka ɔl di filistin dɛm, dat na di balans pipul dɛn we de na Krit Ayland.
Shayned dɔn mit Gaza, Ashkɛlɔn in dɔn kwayɛt. Una di balans pipul dɛn na Filistia, aw lɔŋ una go de kɔt kɔt unasɛf?
Ey, PAPA GƆD in sɔd! Awlɔŋ yu go de kil pipul? Put yusɛf insay yu kes, ɛn blo kwayɛt wan!
Aw i go blo, we PAPA GƆD dɔn gi am wok fɔ du? I dɔn gi am wok fɔ atak Askɛlɔn, ɛn atak di pipul dɛn we tap na di kos.”

PAPA GƆD tɔk bɔt Moab. Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: “Swɛ dɔn kech Nɛbo, bikɔs i nɔ gud fɔ natin igen! Kiriataim dɔn shem bikɔs dɛn dɔn kapchɔ am; dɛn dɔn nyakanyaka dɛn barik ɛn dɛn dɔn shem;
Di no we ɔlman bin no bɔt Moab, nɔ de igen. Na Ɛshbɔn dɛn plan bad fɔ am: ‘Kam, lɛ wi mek i nɔ bi neshɔn igen!’ Una sɛf, Una dɛn kresman dɛm, dɛn go mek una mɔt sɛt; wa go mit una ɔltɛm.
Una lisin! Horonaim de ala se, ‘Fɛt fɛt ɛn ɔlsay broko broko ɛn pwɛl pwɛl!’
Dɛn dɔn nyakanyaka Moab; dɛn de yɛri kray de kɔmɔt ɔl di we na Zoa.
Bikɔs dɛn kɔntinyu de kray we dɛn de go ɔp na Luit; bikɔs, dɔŋ na Haronaim dɛn dɔn yɛri we dɛn de kray se dɛn dɔn nyakanyaka dɛm.
Una rɔnawe! Una sev unasɛf! Una mek lɛkɛ wayl dɔŋki we tap na di ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap!
Wetindu, na bikɔs una bin abop pan una ples dɛn we una de ayd ɛn pan una jɛntri, dɛn go kapchɔ yusɛf; ɛn Chɛmɔsh go go ɛgzayl wit in man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn dɛn bigman dɛm.
Di wan we de nyakanyaka pipul ɛn dɛn ples dɛm, go kam na ɔl di siti dɛm, ɛn nɔn siti nɔ go ɛskep; dɛn go pwɛl di vali, ɛn go nyakanyaka di flat land, jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD bin se.
“If yu gi Moab chans, i go rɔnawe; in siti dɛm go tɔn gud fɔ natin, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de.
“Swɛ go mit da pɔsin we de mek slak wit PAPA GƆD in wok ɛn swɛ go mit da pɔsin we de kip in sɔd mek i nɔ kil pɔsin.
“Moab dɔn de kwayɛt wan frɔm we i yɔŋ ɛn dɔn sɛtul lɛk kɛtɛ kɛtɛ bɔtɔm pawayn; dɛn nɔ ɛva tɔn am frɔm bɔtul to bɔtul, ɛn i nɔ go ɛgzayl wande; so i stil tes di sem, ɛn in sɛnt sɛf nɔ chenj.
PAPA GƆD se, “Fɔseka dat, a de wɔn una, di de de kam we a go sɛn pipul dɛn we de tɔn tin oba we go tɔn am oba, ɛn ɛmpti in bɔtul dɛm ɛn brok in jɔg dɛm pis pis.
Datɛnde, Moab go shem fɔseka Chɛmɔsh, lɛkɛ aw Izrɛl bin bi shem fɔseka Bɛtɛl, we dɛn bin biliv bad bad wan.
“Wetindu una de se, ‘Wi na iro dɛm ɛn wi na man dɛn we sabi fɛt?
Di wan we de nyakanyaka Moab ɛn in siti dɛm dɔn kam, ɛn dɛn dɔn kil kil di bɛst wan pan di yɔŋman dɛm. Na so di kiŋ we nem PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se
Di tɛm fɔ di kalamiti we fɔ mit Moab, nɔ de fa igen ɛn pen ɛn trɔbul de kam mit am kwik kwik.
Una kray fɔ am, una ɔl we de rawnd am, ɛn ɔl udat no in nem; una tɔk se, ‘Aw di staf we gɛt pawa du brok, di staf we ɔlman de wɔnda pan!’
“Kam dɔŋ kɔmɔt na yu glɔri, ɛn sidɔm na di dray grɔn, Una we tap na Dibɔn! Bikɔs di wan we de nyakanyaka Moab dɔn kam atak una; i dɔn nyakanyaka di ples dɛn we una biliv fɔ ayd.
Una tinap na rod de wach una we tap na Aroa! Ask di man we de rɔnawe ɛn di uman we de ɛskep; se, ‘Wetin apin?’
Moab dɔn shem, bikɔs i dɔn broko broko; ala kray! Una anawns am nia Riva Anɔn se, Moab dɔn tɔn gud fɔ natin ples.
“Jɔjmɛnt dɔn kam pan di land we flat lɛk tebul, i dɔn kam pan Holɔn, ɛn Jaza ɛn Mɛfat,
ɛn pan Dibɔn ɛn Nɛbo, ɛn pan Bɛt Diblataim,
Kiriataim, Bɛtgamul ɛn Bɛtmɛɔn.
Jɔjmɛnt kam igen pan Kɛriɔt ɛn Bozra, ɛn ɔl di siti dɛm na Moab, di wan dɛn we de fa ɛn di wan dɛn we de nia.
PAPA GƆD se, dɛn dɔn kɔt Moab in ɔn kɔmɔt ɛn brok in an.
“Mek i drɔnk, bikɔs i es insɛf ɔp agens PAPA GƆD; dat go mek Moab rol insay in yon vɔmit, ɛn pipul dɛn go laf am.
Izrɛl nɔto bin ridikul to yu? Dɛn bin kech am wit tifman dɛm we mek ɛnitɛm una de tɔk bɔt am, una de shek una ed?
“Una kɔmɔt na di siti, ɛn go tap insay dɛn rɔk, Una we tap na Moab! Una mek lɛkɛ dɛn dɔv we de bil os, insay di rɔk na dɛn il dɛn ɛntrans.
Wi dɔn yɛri bɔt di prawd we Moab in prawd– i prawd bad bad wan– aw i arogant, prawd ɛn aw i tink tumɔs ɔf insɛf, ɛn aw i de kak.
PAPA GƆD se, A no aw i de tink se i bɛtɛ pas ɔlman, di bost we i de bost na lay lay, ɛn ɔltin we i de du na lay lay
Fɔseka dat, a go ala kray fɔ Moab; A kray fɔ ɔlman na Moab; A go sɔri fɔ di man dɛm na kirɛrɛs.
A go kray fɔ yu pas aw a go kray fɔ Jaza, Yu greps tik we de na Sibma! Yu branch dɛm pas oba di si, ɛn i rich as fa as Jaza; di wan we de fɔ pwɛl dɔn fɔdɔm pan yu dray sizin frut dɛm ɛn yu greps.

Dɛn dɔn tek gladi gladi ɛn jɔy kɔmɔt na Moab we na land we gud fɔ plant; A dɔn mek wayn nɔ de na di ples we dɛn de mek wayn igen; nɔbɔdi nɔ de mas mas greps, de ala wit jɔy igen; di ala we yu de yɛri nɔto ala fɔ jɔy.
“Ɛshbɔn ɛn Ɛlealɛ ala lawd lawd wan; dɛn yɛri as fa as Jaaz, frɔm Zoa to Oronaim ɛn Ɛglat Shɛlishia. Bikɔs di watasay dɛm na Nimrim dɔn tɔn ɛmti ples.
PAPA GƆD se, A go mek di pɔsin we de mek sakrifays na di ay ples ɛn bɔn insɛns to in gɔd, tap fɔ mek sakrifays ɛn bɔn insɛns to in gɔd.
Fɔseka dat, mi at de kray fɔ Moab lɛkɛ flut, ɛn mi at de kray lɛkɛ flut fɔ di man dɛm na Kir Ɛrɛs; fɔseka we, di jɛntri we dɛn dɔn gɛda, dɔn dɔn.
“Bikɔs dɛn dɔn krep ɔl dɛn ed ɛn shev ɔl dɛn bia bia; wund wund de na ɔl dɛn ed ɛn saklɔth de na dɛn wes.
Natin nɔ de apin pantap ɔl di os dɛn na Moab ɛn na ɔl di opin ples dɛm pas sɔri sɔri siŋ; bikɔs a dɔn mek Moab tɔn lɛk tin we nɔbɔdi nɔ bisin bɔt. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
If yu si aw i dɔn broko broko! Na so di pipul dɛn ala de kray! Moab dɔn shem! So Moab dɔn tɔn tin fɔ ridikul ɛn fred to ɔl di wan dɛm we de rawnd am.”
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se: “I go flay kwik kwik lɛkɛ igul, ɛn opin in wiŋ dɛm agens Moab.
Dɛn go kapchɔ di siti, ɛn siz ɔl dɛn ples dɛn fɔ ayd. Da de de, di sojaman dɛn na Moab dɛn at, go tan lɛkɛ uman we de bɔn, in at;
Dɛn go nyakanyaka Moab ɛn i nɔ go bi neshɔn igen bikɔs i put insɛf ɔp agens PAPA GƆD.
Na fred fred, dip dip ol, ɛn trap de bifo una, Una we tap na Moab! Na so PAPA GƆD se.

Di wan dɛn we rɔnawe pan wetin dɛn de fred go fɔdɔm insay di dip dip ol, ɛn di pɔsin we klem kɔmɔt insay di ol na trap go kech am. Bikɔs a go mek dɛn tin ya mit Moab we di ia rich fɔ dɛn pɔnishmɛnt. Na so PAPA GƆD se.

“Pipul dɛn we de rɔnawe de sidɔm nia Ɛshbɔn ɛlplɛs wan; bikɔs faya dɔn kɔmɔt na Ɛshbɔn, faya we kɔmɔt na Siɔn in os; i dɔn nyakanyaka Moab in fɔrɛd, we na bɔypikin dɛn we de kɔz kɔnfyushɔn, dɛn krawn.
Swɛ dɔn fɔdɔm pan yu, Yu Moab! Di pipul dɛm na Chɛmɔsh, dɔn dɔn; bikɔs dɛn dɔn kapchɔ una bɔypikin, ɛn go tek yu gyalpikin dɛm mek slev.
Pan ɔl dat, a go gi Moab in jɛntri bak leta. Na so PAPA GƆD se.” Na so di Jɔjmɛnt fɔ Moab tap fɔs.
Dis na bɔt di Amonayt dɛm, na dis PAPA GƆD se: “Izrɛl nɔ gɛt bɔypikin? I nɔ gɛt pɔsin we go tek in ples? Wɛl wetindu Milkɔm dɔn tek Gad lɛk nainyon, ɛn in pipul dɛn go sɛtul na dɛn siti dɛm?

PAPA GƆD se, fɔseka dat, di tɛm de kam we A go mek di pipul dɛn yɛri di ala we pipul dɛn kin ala na wa, na Raba we na dɛn Amonayt dɛn siti; i go tɔn gud fɔ natin ip, ɛn dɛn go bɔn dɛn vilej dɛm wit faya; na datɛnde Izrɛl go tek land na di pipul dɛn an, we bin tek dɛn land. Na so PAPA GƆD se.

‘Ala kray, Yu Ɛshbɔn, bikɔs Ay dɔn tɔn gud fɔ natin ples! Una kray, una di gyalpikin dɛm na Raba! Una tay saklɔth rawnd una wes, una kray sɔri wan ɛn rɔn ɔp ɛn dɔŋ kɔnfyus wan! Bikɔs Molɛk go go ɛgzayl, wit in man dɛm we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn dɛn bigman dɛm.
Wetindu yu de bost bɔt yu vali dɛm, Yu gyalpikin we nɔ de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD, yu we bikɔs yu abop pan yu dia tiŋs dɛm we yu kip, de tɔk se, ‘Udat go kam atak mi?’

PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, biliv mi, a go mek bad bad tin mit yu we yu go fred, tin we go kɔmɔt to di wan dɛn we de rawnd yu, ɛn dɛn go drɛb una, ɔlman go bisin bɔt inyon layf, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go de fɔ gɛda dɛm igen.
PAPA GƆD se, “Bɔt afta dat, a go gi di Amonayt dɛm, dɛn jɛntri bak.”
Dis na bɔt Idɔm, na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se: Sɛnsman dɛn nɔ de na Idɔm igen? Di Advaysa dɛn nɔ ebul advays igen? Sɛnsman dɛn dɔn dɔn?
Una rɔnawe, una tɔn bak, una go ayd na dɛn kev, Una di pipul dɛn we tap na Dɛdan! Bikɔs a go mek di kalamiti we bin mit Isɔ di tɛm we a bin pɔnish am, mit am.
If man dɛm we de pik greps, pik greps fɔ yu, dɛn nɔ go lɛf sɔm na grɔn? If tifman dɛm kam na nɛt, nɔto wetin dɛn ebul pwɛl dɛn go pwɛl nɔmɔ?

Bɔt A dɔn trip Isɔ nekɛd, A dɔn mek ɔlman no di ples dɛm we i de ayd, ɛn i nɔ ebul fɔ ayd usay nɔbɔdi nɔ go si am igen. Dɛn dɔn nyakanyaka in pikin dɛm, ɛn in brɔda dɛm, ɛn in neba dɛm; nɔn pan dɛm nɔ de igen.
Una lɛf una pikin dɛm we nɔ gɛt papa, a go mek dɛn de; ɛn tɛl una uman dɛn we dɛn man dɛn dɔn day se mek dɛn abop pan mi.”
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD se: “If dɛn wan dɛm we nɔ sɔpoz fɔ drink pan di kɔp, fɔ drink pan am paopa, yu tink se yusɛf nɔ fɔ gɛt pɔnishmɛnt? Yu nɔ go go fri, yusɛf fɔ drink de.
PAPA GƆD se, Bikɔs a dɔn swɛ to misɛf se Bozra go tɔn ples fɔ fred, fɔ provok, gud fɔ natin ɛn ples fɔ tek swɛ; ɛn ɔl in siti dɛn go tɔn gud fɔ natin ples sote got.”
A dɔn gɛt wɔd to PAPA GƆD, ɛn dɛn dɔn sɛn mɛsenja dɛm to ɔl di neshɔn dɛm: “Una gɛda unasɛf wan say ɛn atak am, ɛn grap fɔ fɛt wa!”
Bikɔs, a go mek una luk fɔni to di ɔda neshɔn dɛm, ɛn dɛn nɔ go tek una mek natin.

Di fred we una tink se pipul dɛn de fred una, ɛn di prawd we una prawd dɔn lay gi una, una we tap insay dɛn ol na dɛn rɔk ɔntɔp dɛn mawnten. Ilɛk una mek una os dɛn ɔp ɔp lɛk dɛn igul dɛn yon, a go briŋ una kɔmɔt de kam dɔŋ. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
“Idɔm go tɔn ples fɔ fred; ɔlman we go pas go fred, ɛn dɛn go sɔktit fɔseka di kayn dizasta we mit dɛm.
PAPA GƆD se, jɛs lɛkɛ aw Sɔdɔm ɛn Gɔmɔra, ɛn di siti dɛm we bin de nia dɛm bin pwɛl, na so nɔn mɔtalman nɔ go tap de, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go slip de.

A de tɛl una, lɛkɛ we bɔku ship dɛn kin rɔn we layɔn de kɔmɔt na bush nia Riva Jɔdan, fɔ kam atak dɛm, na so a go mek dɛn rɔnawe pan am; ɛn a go apɔynt ɛnibɔdi we a pik fɔ rul am. Bikɔs, udat gɛt pawa lɛkɛ mi? Udat go sɛn kɔl mi? Us shɛpad go tinap bifo mi?
Fɔseka dat, una yɛri di plan we PAPA GƆD dɔn mek fɔ Idɔm ɛn wetin i dɔn mekɔp fɔ dɛn wan dɛm we tap na Tɛman: Dɛn go drɛg di lili wan dɛnsɛf go; dɛn ɔl go wɔnda fɔ seka di kayn tin we apin to dɛm.
Di ath go trimbul fɔ di kayn sawnd we dɛn go mek we dɛn go fɔdɔm; dɛn go yɛri we dɛn go ala, na di Rɛd si.
A de tɛl una, wan pɔsin go grap ɛn flay lɛk igul, ɛn prɛd in wiŋ dɛm oba Bozra, ɛn di sojaman dɛn na Idɔm, dɛn at dɛn go tan da de de lɛkɛ uman we de lebɔ, in at.”
Dis na bɔt Damaskɔs “Amat ɛn Apad dɔn kɔnfyus, bikɔs dɛn dɔn yɛri bad bad nyuz; dɛn fred bad bad wan, dɛn at de wɔri lɛk di si, we nɔ ebul de wanples ɛn nɔ mek nɔys.
Damaskɔs dɔn wik, i dɔn tɔn fɔ rɔnawe, i nɔ no wetin fɔ du, pen ɛn brok at dɔn ol am lɛkɛ uman we de pan lebɔ.
Luk we ɔlman dɔn pul at pan da femɔs siti, siti we ɔltɛm gɛt jɔy!
Fɔseka dat, in yɔŋman dɛm go day na dɛn opin ples dɛm, ɛn dɛn go kil ɔl dɛn sojaman dɛm da de de. Na so PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se.
Ɛn a go layt faya na di wɔl na Damaskɔs, ɛn i go bɔn Bɛnadad in pales.”
Dis na bɔt Kɛda ɛn Azɔ Kindɔm dɛm, we Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn bin nyakanyaka. Na dis PAPA GƆD se, “Una grap, una go atak Kɛda! Una nyakanyaka di pipul dɛn na di ist!
Dɛn go tek dɛm os ɛn dɛn ship dɛm, dɛn kɔtin dɛm we dɛn ɛŋ ɛn ɔl dɛn tiŋs dɛm; dɛn go kɛr dɛn kamɛl dɛm go, ɛn pipul dɛn go ala tɛl dɛm se: ‘Waala de ɔlɔbɔt pan una!’
PAPA GƆD se, Una rɔnawe, una go fawe, una go tap insay dɛn kev, Una we tap na Azɔ! Bikɔs Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn, dɔn mek plan fɔ una, ɛn dɔn mek arenjmɛnt fɔ du una sɔntin.
PAPA GƆD se, “Una grap, una go atak wan neshɔn we de wit kol at, we gɛt sikiɔriti, na so PAPA GƆD se, we nɔ gɛt get ɔ ayɛn ba, neshɔn we nain wangren de to insɛf.

Dɛn kamɛl dɛm go tɔn tin fɔ tek kɛr go afta wa, ɛn dɛn kaw dɛn go tɔn tin fɔ tek fri. A go skata lɛft ɛn rayt, dɛn wan we de krep rawnd dɛn ed, ɛn a go mek dɛn kalamiti mit dɛm ɔlɔbɔt. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Azɔ go tɔn ples fɔ dɛn Jakal fɔ tap, ɛn i go tɔn gud fɔ natin ples sote go; nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de, nɔbɔdi nɔ go slip de sɛf.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd we kam to Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt, bɔt Ilam, di tɛm we Zɛdikaya na bin kiŋ na Juda
Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, “a de tɛl una, a go brok di bo na Ilam, we na dɛn bakbon we mek dɛn gɛt pawa;
a go mek di fo kayn briz we de blo kɔmɔt na di fo kɔna dɛn na di klawd, blo na Ilam, ɛn a go skata dɛm insay ɔl dɛn briz de, ɛn nɔn neshɔn nɔ go de we di wan dɛn we a drɛb kɔmɔt Ilam, nɔ go de.
PAPA GƆD se, A go mek Ilam fred in ɛnimi dɛm, ɛn dɛn wan dɛm we wan fɔ kil dɛm; a go mek bad bad tin mit dɛm wit vɛksteshɔn. A go mek fɛt fɛt mit dɛn sote a kil dɛn ɔl dɔn;
PAPA GƆD se, A go put mi tron na Ilam, ɛn kil ɔl dɛn kiŋ ɛn bigman dɛm.
PAPA GƆD se, “bɔt leta, a go gi Ilam dɛn jɛntri bak. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Di wɔd we PAPA GƆD tɔk bɔt Babilɔn ɛn di pipul dɛn na Babilɔn, we Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt, bin tɔk.

“Tɔk am ɛn anawns am na ɔl di neshɔn dɛm, una rayt am usay ɔlman go si am, ɛn una anawns am, una nɔ ayd am, una tɔk am, se: ‘Dɛn dɔn kapchɔ Babilɔn, Bɛl dɔn shem, Mɛrodak in de wɔnda. Dɛn dɔn mek in imej shem, in lay lay gɔd dɛn dɛm de wɔnda.’
Bikɔs, na di nɔt wan neshɔn go kɔmɔt kam atak am, we go mek mek in land tɔn gud fɔ natin ples, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de; di mɔtalman ɛn di animal dɛm ɔl go rɔnawe.
“PAPA GƆD se, dɛn tɛm dɛn de, di pipul dɛm na Izrɛl ɛn di pipul dɛm na Juda go jɔyn togɛda, de kray de kam; ɛn dɛn go luk fɔ PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd.
Dɛn go aks fɔ di rod fɔ go Zayɔn, ɛn dɛn go tɔn dɛn fes de, de se, “Una kam lɛ wi jɔn wisɛf to PAPA GƆD wit wan Kɔvinant we go de sote go we nɔbɔdi nɔ go ɛva fɔgɛt.’
“Mi pipul dɛm dɔn bi lɛkɛ ship dɛn we dɔn lɔs; dɛn shɛpad dɛn dɔn mek dɛn go astre, we dɛn bin mek dɛn go na dɛn mawnten; dɛn dɔn kɔmɔt na wan mawten go na ɔda il, dɛn dɔn fɔgɛt usay dɛn kɔmɔt.
Ɔl di wan dɛn we si dɛm, de atak dɛm, ɛn dɛn ɛnimi dɛm se,. “Wi nɔ gilti, bikɔs dɛn dɔn kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD we gɛt dɛm, PAPA GƆD we dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛn bin abop pan.’
“Una rɔnawe kɔmɔt Babilɔn, una kɔmɔt insay di Chaldian dɛn land, ɛn mek lɛkɛ man got we kin de bifo ɔl di ɔda wan dɛm.,

Bikɔs a de mek sɔm big big neshɔn dɛn we de na di nɔt kɔntri, dɛn at wam pan Babilɔn, ɛn a go mek dɛn jɔynan kam atak Babilɔn. Dɛn go gɛda dɛnsɛf kam atak am; na da tɛm de dɛn go kapchɔ am. Dɛn aro, na lɛkɛ sojaman we sabi fɛt bad bad wan ɛn nɔ de kɔmɔt wa go om, i nɔ kil nɔbɔdi.
PAPA GƆD se, dɛn go tif ɔltin na Babilɔn, ɛn ɔl di wan dɛn we go tif dɛm, go satisfay.
“Ɛnti una de gladi naw ɛn de es unasɛf ɔp, una we bin tif ɔltin na mi kɔntri, ɛnti una want want lɛk we yɔŋ kaw kin want gras, ɛn una de mek lɛk dɛn yɔŋ ɔs,
una mama go shem bad bad wan, di uman we bɔn yu go disgres. I go bi se na im go de las pan ɔl di neshɔn dɛm, I go tɔn dray ɛn ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ ebul tap.
Fɔseka di vɛks we PAPA GƆD vɛks, nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de bɔt i go tɔn gud fɔ natin ples to di bakbon; ɔl udat pas nia Babilɔn go wɔnda ɛn sɔktit, fɔseka di we we i pwɛl.
Una gɛda unasɛf ɔlɔbɔt go fɛt Babilɔn, una ɔl we shut bo ɛn aro; una shut am, una nɔ kip wan aro, bikɔs i dɔn kɔmit sin to PAPA GƆD.

Una siŋ rawnd am ɔlɔbɔt, i dɔn sɔrɛnda; di tin dɛn we i bin de tek protɛkt insɛf, dɔn fɔdɔm in protɛkshɔn dɛm dɔn fɔdɔm kan dɔŋ, bikɔs dis na PAPA GƆD in pe: tɔn am gi am, mek yu du am wetin i bin yu.
Mek wan fama nɔ de na Babilɔn igen, ɛn wan di wan dɛn we de andul kɔtlas fɔ avɛst; fɔseka di ami we go atak dɛm, ɔlman go go to in pipul dɛm ɛn ɔlman go rɔnawe go nainyon kɔntri.
“Izrɛl na ship we layɔn dɛm de fɛn fɔ kech ɛn it we mek i de rɔnawe. Fɔs, di kiŋ na Asiria atak am, ɛn naw, Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn de klin in bon bon.
Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Izrɛl dɛn Gɔd se: a go pɔnish di kiŋ na Babilɔn lɛk aw a bin pɔnish di kiŋ na Asiria.
A go mek Izrɛl go bak na dɛn land, ɛn i go it na Mawnt Kamɛl ɛn na Beshan, ɛn dɛn go gɛt ɔl wetin dɛn want na di il dɛm na Ifrem ɛn na Giliad.
PAPA GƆD se, dɛn dez dɛn de ɛn da tɛm de, dɛn go luk fɔ sin na Izrɛl, bɔt dɛn no go fɛn natin; dɛn go luk fɔ sin na Juda bɔt dɛn nɔ go fɛn natin; bikɔs a go fɔgiv di wan dɛm we a nɔ go kil.
PAPA GƆD se, “Una go atak Mɛrataim, ɛn una go atak di pipul dɛn na Pɛkɔd. Una kil dɛm ɛn nyakanyaka dɛm, ɛn una fɔ du ɔl wetin a se una fɔ du paopa.
Nɔys we dɛn kin mek we wa de, ɛn ebi ebi nyakanyaka de na di land
Luk we di wan we bin de ama di wanol wɔl, dɔn kɔt fɔdɔm brok! Luk wetin Babilɔn dɔn tɔn, tin we fɔ fred to di neshɔn dɛm!
E Babilɔn, a sɛt trap fɔ yu ɛn i kech yu, ɛn yu nɔ bin no bɔt dat; a fɛn yu ɛn kech yu bikɔs yu dɔn tray fɔ fɛt PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD dɔn opin usay i kin kip in wɛpɔn dɛm, ɛn i dɔn pul di wɛpɔn dɛm we i kin yuz we i at kin wam, bikɔs Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd Ɔlmayti gɛt wok fɔ du na di Babilonian dɛn land.
Una atak am ɔlɔbɔt; una opin in sto dɛm; payl am lɛk we dɛn kin payl rɛs, ɛn nyakanyaka am kaptakapta; le natin nɔ lɛf pan am.
Kil ɔl in man kaw dɛm, lɛ dɛn ɔl day. Swɛ dɔn kech dɛm, bikɔs di tɛm dɔn kam, dat na di tɛm we dɛn fɔ gɛt dɛn pɔnishmɛnt.
“Una lisin! Dɛn de rɔnawe kɔmɔt Babilɔn, fɔ go anawns na Jerusɛlɛm bɔt di rivɛnj we PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd, wan rivɛnj fɔ in Tɛmpul.

“Una kɔl di man dɛn we de shut bo ɛn aro fɔ go atak Babilɔn. Una sɔrawnd am ɔlɔbɔt; lɛ nɔn pan dɛm nɔ ɛskep. Una pe am akɔdin to in wok, una du am ɔl wetin in dɔn du ɔda pipul; bikɔs i dɔn mek prawd ɛn nɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD we na di Oli wan na Izrɛl, se fɔ du.
PAPA GƆD se, “Fɔseka dat, in yɔŋman dɛm go day na di opin ples dɛm, ɛn dɛn go kil ɔl in sojaman dɛm da de de.
PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd Ɔlmayti se, “A de tɛl yu we de mek prawd, se a de agens yu, bikɔs di tɛm dɔn kam, dat na di tɛm we a go pɔnish yu.
Di pɔsin we prawd go bɔk fut fɔdɔm, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go de fɔ es am, ɛn a go layt faya nain siti dɛm, ɛn i go bɔn ɔl wetin de rawnd am.
“Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se: Dɛn de sɔprɛs di pipul dɛm na Izrɛl ɛn di pipul dɛm na Juda; ɔl di wan dɛm we kapchɔ dɛm go slev, nɔ gri lɛf dɛm; dɛn nɔ gri le dɛn go.
Di wan we kin pe fɔ fri dɛm, traŋa; na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nain nem. I go mɔs tɔk fɔ dɛm, so dat di wanol wɔl go blo, bɔt Babilɔn nɔ go gɛt kolat.
“PAPA GƆD se, wa go fɔdɔm pan di Babilonian dɛm, ɛn di pipul dɛm we tap na Babilɔn, ɛn in bigman ɛn sɛnsman dɛm!
Wa go fɔdɔm pan di mɛrɛsin man dɛm, so dat dɛn go tɔn fulman! Wa go fɔdɔm pan in sojaman dɛm, we go mek dɛn day day!
Wa go fɔdɔm pan in ɔs dɛm ɛn di man dɛm we de rayd in chariɔt dɛm, ɛn pan ɔl dɛn fɔrin sojaman dɛm we de wit dɛm, we go mek dɛn biev lɛk uman! Wan go mek dɛn tif, ɔl dɛn jɛntri we dɛn kip!
Drawt go fɔdɔm pan ɔl dɛn si dɛm we go mek dɛn ɔl dray! Bikɔs na land we bɔku bɔku imej dɛn de, ɛn dɛn kres bɔt aydɔl dɛm.
Fɔseka dat, na dɛn wayl animal ɛn dɛn aina go tap na Babilɔn, wit dɛn Ɔstrich; pipul dɛn nɔ go tap de igen sote go, pipul dɛn nɔ go tap de igen igen.
PAPA GƆD se lɛk we i nyakanyaka Sɔdɔm ɛn Gɔmɔra ɛn dɛn nɛba dɛm we pipul dɛn nɔ tap de, na so nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de, ɛn nɔn mɔtalman nɔ go tap de.
“Biliv mi, pipul dɛm we kɔmɔt frɔm di nɔt; traŋa traŋa neshɔn ɛn bɔku bɔku kiŋ de rɛdi fawe fɔ kam fɛt.
Dɛn gɛt bo ɛn spia; dɛn wikɛd ɛn dɛn nɔ de sɔri. Di sawnd we dɛn de mek we dɛn de waka tan lɛk we di si de ala; dɛn de rayd ɔs, dɛn rɛdi fɔ fɛt yu, Yu Babilɔn in gyalpikin!
“Di kiŋ na Babilɔn dɔn yɛri bɔt dɛm, ɛn i nɔ ebul du natin; pen ol am, da pen we uman de fil we i de bɔn.

“A de tɛl una, lɛkɛ we ship dɛn kin rɔn we layɔn kin kɔmɔt na bush nia Riva Jɔdan, fɔ kam atak dɛm, na so a go mek dɛn kɔmɔt to am we i nɔ mekɔp; A go pik ɛnibɔdi we mi lɛk fɔ rul am. Bikɔs, udat gɛt pawa lɛkɛ mi? Udat go sɛn kɔl mi? Us shɛpad ebul tinap bifo mi?

Fɔseka dat, una yɛri di plan we PAPA GƆD dɔn mek fɔ Babilɔn ɛn wetin i dɔn mekɔp fɔ dɛn wan dɛm we tap na Babilɔn: Dɛn go mɔs drɛg di lili wan dɛnsɛf go; dɛn ɔl go mɔs wɔnda, fɔseka di kayn tin we de apin to dɛm.
Wɛn dɛn go kapchɔ Babilɔn, di wanol wɔl go shek, ɛn ɔl di ɔda neshɔn dɛm go yɛri we i de ala.”
Na dis PAPA GƆD se, ‘Biliv mi, A go mek di wan we de nyakanyaka, in at wam pan Babilɔn, pan di pipul dɛn we tap na Babilɔn;
A go sɛn pipul dɛn we de fana na Babilɔn, ɛn dɛn go fana am, ɛn dɛn go ɛmpti in land, wɛn dɛn go atak am ɔlɔbɔt di de we in trɔbul go mit am.
Lɛ di man we de shut bo ɛn aro, nɔ bɛn in bo, ɛn lɛ i nɔ wɛr di tin we dɛn kin wɛr fɔ go fɛt. Una nɔ sɔri fɔ ivin di yɔŋ wan dɛm; bɔt una nyakanyaka ɔl in pipul dɛm.
Dɛn go lidɔm day wan na Babilɔn we dɛn go dɔn kil dɛm, ɛn wund wund wan nain trit dɛm.
Bikɔs Izrɛl ɛn Juda dɛn Gɔd we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, nɔ fɔsek dɛm; bɔt di Babilonian dɛm gilti bad bad wan to di Oli wan na Izrɛl.
“Una rɔnawe kɔmɔt Babilɔn, lɛ ɔlman sev inyon layf! Nɔ mek yu sɔfa pan in pɔnishmɛnt, bikɔs dis na di tɛm fɔ PAPA GƆD in rivɛnj we na di pemɛnt we i de gi am.
Babilɔn na bin gold kɔp na PAPA GƆD in an, we mek ɔl di wanol wɔl drɔnk; di neshɔn dɛm drink pan in wayn, fɔseka dat, di neshɔn dɛm kres.
Wantɛm wantɛm, Babilɔn dɔn fɔdɔm ɛn dɔn brok Una ala fɔ am! Una kɛr mɛrɛsin go fɔ in pen dɛm; sɔntɛm, i go mɛn.
Wi bin fɔ dɔn mɛn Babilɔn, bɔt i nɔ tek mɛn. Fɔsek am, lɛ wi ɔl go na wi difrɛn kɔntri dɛm; bikɔs in jɔjmɛnt dɔn rich ɔp na ɛvin ɛn dɔn rich di skay.
PAPA GƆD dɔn pul wi ed; una kam lɛ wi anawns na Jerusɛlɛm, bɔt PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd in wok.

“Una shap di aro dɛm! Una tek di big shild dɛm! PAPA GƆD dɔn mek di kiŋ dɛn na Mɛdia dɛn at wam, bikɔs wetin i mekɔp fɔ Babilɔn, na fɔ nyakanyaka am, bikɔs na da we de PAPA GƆD de rivɛnj, rivɛnj fɔ in tɛmpul.

Una gi sayn fɔ atak di wɔl dɛm na Babilɔn, una put mɔ gyadman dɛm; una put man dɛm fɔ wach; una rɛdi fɔ di ambush dɛm; bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn mek in plan dɔn fɔ wetin i bin tɔk bɔt di pipul dɛm we tap na Babilɔn.
Ey, yu we tap nia bɔku riva dɛm, yu we jɛntri bad bad wan, yu yon dɔn dɔn, di trɛd we ol yu layf dɔn kɔt.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dɔn swɛ wit in nem se: A go mɔ mek di mɔtalman we tap insay yu, plɛnti lɛk lokɔs, ɛn na dɛn go bigin ala de gladi we dɛn go dɔn kɔnka yu.
“Na Im mek di wɔl wit in pawa, di wan we mek di wɔl wit in sɛns, ɛn na wit In ɔndastandin I mek ɔp klwad opin so.
Wɛn I tɔk, bɔku bɔku wata de gɛda ɔp di klawd, ɛn I de mek smɔl smɔl kol wata de kɔmɔt ɔnda di grɔn. I de mek laytin flash we ren de kam, ɛn I mek briz de blo kɔmɔt na In sto.
Ɔlman we nɔ lan natin, styupid; ɔl dɛn goldsmit dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛm, go mek dɛn shem; bikɔs dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛm na fɔls, ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt layf.
Dɛn nɔ min natin, ɛn dɛn na lay lay; dɛn go nyakanyaka dɛm we di tɛm kam fɔ pɔnish di pipul dɛm.
Jekɔb in Gɔd nɔ tan lɛk dɛm, bikɔs na im mek ɔltin, ɛn na Izrɛl na di pipul dɛm we I dɔn pik; ɛn na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nain nem.
“Na una na mi ama, ɛn wɛpɔn fɔ fɛt wa: na una a de tek brok neshɔn dɛm pis pis; ɛn na una a de tek nyakanyaka kindɔm dɛm;
na una a de tek brok dɛn ɔs ɛn di wan we de rayd am; ɛn na una a de tek brok chariɔt ɛn di wan we de rayd am;
na una a de tek brok man ɛn uman dɛm pis pis; na una a de tek brok olpa ɛn yɔŋbɔbɔ pis pis; na una a de tek brok yɔŋman ɛn yɔŋgyal dɛm pis pis;
na una a de tek brok shɛpad ɛn in ship dɛm pis pis; na una a de tek brok fama ɛn in tim pis pis; na una a de tek brok gɔvna dɛm ɛn kɔmanda dɛm pis pis.
PAPA GƆD se, “A go pe Babilɔn ɛn ɔl udat tap na Babilɔn bifo una yay, fɔ ɔl di bad bad tin dɛm we dɛn dɔn du Jerusɛlɛm.
PAPA GƆD se, “A de agens yu, Yu mawnten we de fɔ pwɛl; yu we de fɔ pwɛl di wanol wɔl; a go ol yu ɛn nyamanyama yu flat na grɔn, ɛn mek yu tɔn bɔn bɔn mawnten..
Dɛn nɔ go tek nɔn ston kɔmɔt pan yu fɔ mek kɔna ston ɛn nɔn ston fɔ mek fawndeshɔn, bɔt yu go de so nɔ mɔ, ‘gud fɔ natin.’ Na so PAPA GƆD se.

“Una mek signal na di wɔl, una blo di trɔmpɛt insay di neshɔn dɛm; una rɛdi di neshɔn dɛm fɔ fɛt am, una sɛn kɔl di kindɔm dɛm agens am, dat na Ararat, Mini, ɛn Ashkɛnaz; una pik wan ɔfisa we go de bifo, ɛn briŋ di ɔs dɛm bɔku wan lɛkɛ we lokɔs de jam dɛnsɛf.
Una rɛdi di neshɔn dɛm fɔ fɛt am, di kiŋ dɛm na mɛdia, wit dɛn gɔvna dɛm ɛn di wan dɛn we de nɛks to dɛm, ɛn ɔl di kɔntri dɛm we de ɔnda dɛn kɔntrol.
Di land de trimbul ɛn de tɔn tɔn wit pen, bikɔs wetin PAPA GƆD plan fɔ du Babilɔn mɔs bi, dat na fɔ mek Babilɔn ɛmti ɛn gud fɔ natin ples, we nɔbɔdi nɔ tap.
Di sojaman dɛm na Babilɔn dɔn lɛf fɔ fɛt, dɛn stil de na dɛn ples we dɛn biliv; dɛn dɔn taya, dɛn dɔn fred lɛk uman; faya dɔn kech in os, in get dɛm dɔn brok.
Rɔna de mit in kɔmpin rɔna na rod, ɛn mɛsenja de mit in kɔmpin mɛsenja na rod, fɔ go tɛl di kiŋ na Babilɔn se, dɛn dɔn kapchɔ in siti ɔlɔbɔt;
Dɛn dɔn kapchɔ di brij dɛm dɛn dɔn bɔn di protɛkshɔn wit faya, ɛn di sojaman dɛn dɔn fred bad bad wan.
Bikɔs na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, we na Izrɛl in Gɔd se: Babilɔn in gyalpikin na lɛkɛ grɔn fɔ mas mas kanda rɛs di tɛm we dɛn de mas mas am; bɔt afta lili tɛm, di tɛm ɔf in avɛst go kam.
“Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn dɔn kil mi, i dɔn nyamanyama mi, i dɔn mek a dɔn tɔn lɛkɛ ɛmpti kɔp, i dɔn swɛla mi lɛkɛ mɔnsta; i dɔn fulɔp in bɛlɛ wit mi fayn fayn it dɛm, i dɔn trowe di balans.
Lɛ di fɛt we i dɔn fɛt mi ɛn mi kɔntriman dɛm, de na Babilɔn dɛn ed,” lɛ di pipul dɛm we tap na Jerusɛlɛm se, ‘Lɛ mi blɔd de na di pipul dɛn we tap na Babilɔn dɛn ed,” lɛ Jerusɛlɛm se so.
Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se: “A go fɛt una kes ɛn rivɛnj fɔ una. A go dray Babilɔn dɛn si ɛn mek dɛn fawnten dray;
ɛn Babilɔn go tɔn ruin payl, we dɛn Jakal dɛn go de ɔltɛm, ples we pipul go fred ɛn de sɔktit, ɛn we nɔbɔdi nɔ tap.
“Dɛn go ala togɛda lɛkɛ layɔn; dɛn go grɔmbul lɛkɛ layɔn pikin.
Ɛnti dɛn lɛk bɔku it, a go mek pati fɔ dɛm ɛn mek dɛn drɔnk sote dɛn slip ɛn slip ɛvalastin slip ɛn nɔ wek igen. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
A go briŋ dɛm dɔŋ lɛkɛ ship pikin usay dɛn go kil dɛm, lɛk man ship ɛn man got dɛm.
“Luk we dɛn dɔn kapchɔ Babilɔn, di wanol wɔl dɔn lɛf fɔ prez dɛm! Luk wetin Babilɔn dɔn tɔn, ples we de mek pipul fred!
Di si dɔn kɔba Babilɔn; i dɔn kɔba wit ebi ebi swɛlin.
Wetin apin to in siti dɛm de mek pipul fred, ɛn i dɔn tɔn land we wata nɔ de, ɛn ɛmti ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, ples we nɔn mɔtalman nɔ de pas.
Ɛn A go pɔnish Bɛl we de na Babilɔn, ɛn pul wetin de insay in mɔt we i bin dɔn swɛla. Di neshɔn dɛm nɔ go wɔship am igen; Babilɔn in wɔl dɔn fɔdɔm.
“Mi pipul dɛm, una kɔmɔt de! Lɛ ɔlman sev in layf frɔm PAPA GƆD in bad bad vɛksteshɔn!
Lɛ una at nɔ pwɛl, ɛn una nɔ fred fɔseka di kayn rumɔ we una de yɛri na di land, wɛn yu yɛri wan rumɔ dis ia, na ɔda rumɔ yu go yɛri di ɔda ia, ɛn fɛt de na di land, ɛn rula de fɛt in kɔmpin rula.
“Fɔseka dat, a de tɛl una, di tɛm de kam, wɛn a go pɔnish di imej dɛm na Babilɔn; a go mek dɛn wanol land shem, ɛn ɔl di wan dɛm we dɛn kil go day insay am.
PAPA GƆD se, ɔp di klawd ɛn dɔŋ na dis wɔl, ɛn ɔl wetin de insay dɛm, go siŋ wit gladi we Babilɔn go fɔdɔm; bikɔs di wan dɛm we go nyakanyaka dɛm, go kɔmɔt na di nɔt.
Babilɔn go mɔs fɔdɔm fɔseka di Izrɛlayt dɛn we dɛn dɔn kil, lɛ fɔseka di pipul we, dɛn dɔn kil pipul ɔlɔbɔt na di wɔl.
“Una we dɛn nɔ kil, una go, una nɔ tinap! Una fɔ mɛmba PAPA GƆD i lɛk una de fa, ɛn lɛ Jerusɛlɛm de na yu maynd:
‘Wi de shem, bikɔs wi dɔn yɛri disgresful tin; disrɛspɛkt dɔn mek wi kɔba wi fes, bikɔs trenja dɛn dɔn kam insay di oli ples dɛm na PAPA GƆD in os.
PAPA GƆD se, fɔseka dat, di tɛm de kam, wɛn a go kɛriawt jɔjmɛnt pan in imej dɛm, ɛn ɔlsay na di land, di wan dɛm we wund, go pini.
PAPA GƆD se, Ilɛk dɛn bil traŋa traŋa ay ay wɔl mek dɛn nɔ go atak dɛm, a go stil sɛn pipul dɛn go atak dɛm.
“Una lisin! Babilɔn de kray! Nɔys we de sho se dɛn de nyakanyaka dɛm bad bad wan, de kɔmɔt na Babilɔn!
Bikɔs PAPA GƆD de mek Babilɔn tɔn gud fɔ natin ples, ɛn I de sɛt in mɔt we gɛt pawa. Dɛn kin ala lɛkɛ we swɛlin de baŋ dɛnsɛf na big si ɛn dɛn kin de ala bad bad wan we dɛn kin atak ɔda kɔntri,

bikɔs di wan we de nyakanyaka dɔn atak am, i dɔn atak Babilɔn; dɛn dɔn kapchɔ in sojaman dɛm, dɛn dɔn brok dɛn bo dɛm pis pis; bikɔs PAPA GƆD na Gɔd we de pe pipul fɔ di wok we dɛn du, i go mɔs tɔn am gi dɛm.
A go mek in bigman dɛm ɛn in sɛnsman dɛm, in gɔvna dɛm, in kɔmanda dɛm, ɛn in sojaman dɛm, drɔŋɔ; dɛn go slip ɛvalastin slip ɛn nɔ wek igen, na so di Kiŋ we nem PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, se.
“Na dis PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se: Di brɔd wɔl na Babilɔn, go fɔdɔm flat na grɔn ɛn dɛn go bɔn in ay get dɛm wit faya. Di pipul dɛm de lebɔ fɔ natin, ɛn di neshɔn dɛm taya dɛnsɛf nɔmɔ fɔ faya.

Di wɔd we Jɛrimaya we na prɔfɛt bin tɛl Sɛraya we na Nɛraya in bɔypikin, ɛn Maasɛya in grampikin traŋa wan se fɔ du, wɛn i bin fala Zɛdikaya we na kiŋ na Juda, go Babilɔn insay di ia we mek Zɛdikaya fo ia na pawa. Na Sɛraya na bin di man we de inchaj ɔf provishɔn fɔ di kiŋ.
Jɛrimaya bin rayt ɔl di bad bad tin dɛm we fɔ mit Babilɔn insay wan buk, dat na ɔltin we rayt na ya bɔt Babilɔn.
Nain Jɛrimaya tɛl Sɛraya se: wɛn yu rich Babilɔn, si dat yu rid ɔl wetin rayt de,
ɛn tɔk se, ‘E PAPA GƆD, yu dɔn tɔk bɔt dis ples se, yu go pwɛl am kpatakpata, we nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de, mɔtalman ɔ animal, ɛn i go tɔn gud fɔ natin ples sote go.
Wɛn yu dɔn rid dis buk dɔn, tay wan ston pan am ɛn trowe am midul Riva Yufretis,
ɛn tɔk se, ‘Na so Babilɔn go sink nɔ fɔ grap igen, fɔseka di bad bad tin we a de mek mit am.’” Na Jɛrimaya in wɔd dɛm dɛnwanya so fa.
Zɛdikaya bin twɛnti-wan ia we i bi kiŋ; ɛn i bin tap na Jerusɛlɛm de rul fɔ ilɛvin ia. In mama nem Aamutal, we na Jɛrimaya we de Libna, in gyalpikin.
Ɛn i bin du tin dɛn we ivul na PAPA GƆD in yay, jɛs lɛk wetin Jɛoiakim bin du.
Fɔ tru tru, bikɔs PAPA GƆD bin vɛks bad bad wan, di kayn tin dɛm we apin na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda, bin mek PAPA GƆD trowe dɛm kɔmɔt bifo am. Ɛn Zɛdikaya bin ribɛl agens di kiŋ na Babilɔn.

Ɛn insay di de we mek tɛn na di tɛn mɔnt insay di ia we mek nayn we i ren, Nɛbyukadnɛza we na kiŋ na Babilɔn bin kam wit ɔl in ami kam atak Jerusɛlɛm, ɛn dɛm bin sɔrawnd dɛm ɛn bin dig gɔta dɛm ɔlɔbɔt.
So, dɛn bin sɔrawnd di siti sote di ia we mek kiŋ Zɛdikaya Ilɛvin ia na pawa.
Di de we mek nayn insay di mɔnt we mek fo, di aŋri bin dɔn so pasmak na di siti dat natin nɔ bin de fɔ di pipul dɛn fɔ it.

Nain dɛn du wan bad tin we dɛn nɔ fɔ du, na di siti; ɔl di sojaman dɛm rɔnawe kɔmɔt na di siti na nɛt, ɛn pas na wan get we de bitwin di tu wɔl we de nia di kiŋ in gadin, ɛn di Babilonian dɛm bin de rawnd di siti. Dɛn bin go bay Riva Jɔdan say.
Bɔt di Babilonian ami bin rɔnata di kiŋ, ɛn kech Zɛdikaya na di flat grɔn na Jɛriko; ɛn ɔl in sojaman dɛm bin skata ɛn nɔ bin de nia am.
Nain dɛm kapchɔ di kiŋ, ɛn briŋ am kam to di kiŋ na Babilɔn, na Ribla insay Amat, ɛn i pas sɛntɛns pan am.
Di kiŋ na Babilɔn bin kil Zɛdikaya in bɔypikin dɛm bifo in fes, ɛn kil ɔl di bigman dɛm na Juda, insay Ribla.
I pul Zɛdikaya in yay dɛm, ɛn tay am wit chen, ɛn di kiŋ na Babilɔn bin kɛr am go na Babilɔn ɛn put am na jel, sote di de we i day.

Di de we mek tɛn insay di mɔnt we mek fayv insay di ia we mek Kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza nayntin ia na pawa na Babilɔn– Nɛbyuzaradan we na di kapten pan di gyadman dɛm we de wok fɔ di kiŋ na Babilɔn, bin go na Jerusɛlɛm.
I bɔn PAPA GƆD in os, i bɔn di kiŋ in os ɛn ɔl di os dɛm na Jerusɛlɛm; i bɔn ɔl dɛn big big os dɛm.
Ɛn ɔl di Babilonian sojaman dɛm we bin de wit di kapten pan di gyadman dɛm, brok ɔl di wɔl we de rawnd Jerusɛlɛm.

Ɛn Nɛbyuzaradan, we na di kapten pan di gyadman dɛm, kɛr sɔm pan di popoliopo dɛm ɛn di balans pipul dɛm we bin lɛf na di siti, ɛn di wan dɛm we bin dɔn rɔnawe kɔmɔt to di kiŋ na Babilɔn, togɛda wit di balans pipul dɛn we sabi wok wit dɛn an, go mek slev.
Bɔt Nɛbyuzaradan we na di kapten pan di gyadman dɛm, bin lɛf sɔm pan di popoliopo dɛm na di land fɔ plant greps ɛn dig grɔn fɔ plant.
Di Babilonian dɛn brok di bras pila dɛm, di stand ɛn di big bras tank we de insay PAPA GƆD in os, ɛn kɛr ɔl di bras go Babilɔn.
Dɛn tek di pɔt dɛn, shɔbul, sizɔs fɔ trim wik, di dish dɛn fɔ bɔn insɛns, ɛn ɔl di bras tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz na di tɛmpul;

igen dɛn tek di smɔl bol dɛm, ɛn di faya pan dɛm, ɛn di besin ɛn pɔt dɛm, ɛn di lampstand dɛm, ɛn di dish dɛm fɔ insɛns, ɛn di bol dɛm fɔ tamisilɛ. Nɔto kɔmɔn gold di kapten bin kɛr go. Nɔto kɔmɔn silva di kapten bin kɛr go.

As fɔ di bras we bin de pan di tu pila dɛm, di wan tank wit di twɛlv bras man kaw dɛm we bin de ɔnda di tank, ɛn di stand dɛm we Sɔlɔmɔn bin mek fɔ PAPA GƆD in os, i bin so bɔku dat nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul we am.
As fɔ di pila dɛm, wan pila in ayt na twɛnti-sɛvin fut, ɛn na bin etin fut go rawnd ɛn dɛn bin tri inchis tik ɛn ol bin de insay.
Di bras dizayn we bin de pantap wan pila, in ayt na fo ɛn af fut, dɔn dɛn dɛkɔret am wit bras pomigranet frut dizayn ɔl rawnd. Na di sem tin dɛn du to di ɔda wan.
Na naynti-siks pomigranet bin de na di sayd dɛm; ɔl di pomigranet dɛm na bin wan ɔndrɛd we dɛn jɔyn jɔyn ɔlɔbɔt.
Di kapten pan di gyadman dɛm tek Sɛraya we na di edman fɔ di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin wit in asistant we na Zɛfanaya ɛn di tri getman dɛn;

ɛn na di siti, i tek di ɔfisa we bin de inchaj ɔf di sojaman dɛm ɛn sɛvin pan di man dɛn we de advays di kiŋ we bin de na di siti; ɛn di sɛktri to di kɔmanda na di ami we rɛspɔnsibul gɛda di pipul dɛn na di land; ɛn siksti man dɛn we tap na di siti.
Kɔmanda Nɛbyukanadan kɛr ɔl dɛn pipul ya go dɛn go to kiŋ Nɛbyukadnɛza, na Ribla.
Di kiŋ kil dɛn ɔl. I kil dɛn ɔl na Ribla we de na Amat. Na so di pipul dɛn na Juda tek kɔmɔt na dɛn kɔntri go ɛgzayl na Babilɔn.
Dis na di amawnt ɔf di pipul we Nɛbyukadnɛza bin kɛr go mek slev: insay di ia we mek sɛvin, na bin tri tawzin ɛn twɛnti-tri Ju dɛm.
Insay di ia we mek etin we Nɛbyukadnɛza bin de na pawa, i kɛr et ɔndrɛd ɛn tati-tu pipul kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm go slev;

insay di ia we mek twɛnti-tri we Nɛbyukadnɛza de na pawa, Nɛbyuzaradan we na di kapten pan di gyadman dɛm bin kɛr sɛvin ɔndrɛd ɛn fɔti-fayv Juz go mek slev; ɔl ɛn ɔl, na bin fo tawzin siks ɔndrɛd pipul.

Insay di de we mek twɛnti-fayv na di mɔnt we mek twɛlv insay di ia we mek tati-sɛvin we dɛn bin kapchɔ Jɛoayachin we na bin kiŋ na Juda, go ɛgzayl, Ivilmɛrodak we bi kiŋ na Babilɔn da ia de, gi Jɛoayachin we na bin kiŋ na Juda in rɛspɛkt bak, ɛn fri am kɔmɔt Jel;
ɛn i bin tɔk fayn wan to am, ɛn i gi am pozishɔn pas di kiŋ dɛn we bin de wit am, na Babilɔn.
So Jɛoayachin bin pul in Jelman klos. Ɛn ɛvride, i bin de it na di kiŋ in tebul;
