“Mɔtalman tɔk to dɛn bigman dɛn ya na Izrɛl, ɛn tɛl dɛn se, ‘Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se, Na fɔ kam fɛnɔt to mi una kam? Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se, wans mi de, una nɔ go fɛnɔt to mi.
Yu go jɔj dɛm Mɔtalman, yu go jɔj dɛm? If na dat, lɛ dɛn no di bad bad tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk we dɛn fɔstɛmpapa dɛn du,
ɛn tɛl dɛn se, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se; di de wɛn a bin pik Izrɛl, a bin swɛ to Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn. We a sho misɛf to dɛn na Ijipt, a bin swɛ to dɛm ɛn se, na mi na di PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd.
Da de de, a bin swɛ to dɛn se a go pul dɛn kɔmɔt Ijipt, kam na wan land we a dɔn fɛn fɔ dɛm, land we gud fɔ plant ɛn fɔ mɛn animal, we na di land we fayn pas ɔl.
Ɛn a bin tɛl dɛn se, lɛ dɛn ɔl trowe dɛn tin dɛn we a et bad bad wan we dɛn at de pan, ɛn lɛ dɛn nɔ dɔti dɛnsɛf na mi yay wit Ijipt dɛn laylay gɔd dɛn; Mi na PAPA GƆD we na una Gɔd.

Bɔt dɛn bin tɔn dɛn bak pan mi ɛn nɔ gri lisin to mi; dɛn ɔl nɔ bin gri trowe di tin dɛn we a et bad bad wan we dɛn at bin de pan, ɛn dɛn nɔ bin gri kɔmɔt biɛn Ijipt dɛn laylay gɔd dɛn. Dɛn a bin tink se a fɔ put mi vɛksteshɔn pan dɛn ɛn put mi krɔs pan dɛn na Ijipt.
Bɔt a bin du so fɔseka mi nem, so dat dɛn nɔ go fityay mi bifo di neshɔn dɛn we dɛn bin tap, we na bifo dɛn a bin sho misɛf to dɛn bay we a bin pul dɛn kɔmɔt Ijipt.
So a bin pul dɛn kɔmɔt Ijipt ɛn briŋ dɛn kam na di land we ɛmti ɛn natin nɔ de.
A bin gi dɛm mi lɔ dɛm ɛn sho dɛm mi kɔmand dɛm, we na dɛnɔl mɔtalman we de na wɔl fɔ du.
Pantap dat, a bin gi dɛm mi de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst as sayn bitwin mi ɛn dɛn, so dat dɛn go no se na mi PAPA GƆD de mek dɛn oli.

Bɔt Izrɛl bin ribɛl agens mi na di say we ɛmti ɛn dray we natin nɔ de; dɛn nɔ bin du wetin mi lɔ se, bɔt tɔn dɛn bak pan mi kɔmand dɛm, we na we mɔtalman du dɛm dɛn go gɛt lɔŋ layf; dɛn disrɛspɛkt mi de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst bad bad wan. So a bin tink se a fɔ put mi vɛksteshɔn pan dɛn na di ɛmti ples we natin nɔ de, so dat dɛn ɔl go day.
Bɔt a bin du so fɔseka mi nem, so dat dɛn nɔ go pwɛl mi nem bifo di neshɔn dɛm usay dɛn bin tap, we na bifo dɛn a bin sev dɛm.
Ɛn na so a bin swɛ na di say we ɛmti ɛn dray we natin nɔ de, se, a nɔ go briŋ dɛm kam na di land we a bin dɔn gi dɛm, we gud fɔ plant ɛn fɔ mɛn animal, di land we dɛn de kɔle pan pas ɔl ɔda land,
bikɔs dɛn tɔn dɛn bak pan mi kɔmand dɛm, ɛn nɔ waka bay aw mi lɔ dɛn se, ɛn nɔ rɛspɛkt mi de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst; dat na bikɔs dɛn at bin de to dɛn laylay gɔd dɛm.
Pan ɔl dat, a bin mek lɛk a nɔ si dɛm, ɛn a nɔ bin nyakanyaka dɛm, ɔ mek dɛn day na di say we ɛmti ɛn dray we natin nɔ de.

“Ɛn a bin tɛl dɛm pikin dɛm na di say we ɛmti ɛn dray we natin nɔ de se, Una nɔ du wetin una fɔstɛm-papa dɛn bin de du, ɛn nɔ biliv wetin dɛn bin biliv. Una nɔ dɔti unasɛf na mi yay wit dɛn laylay gɔd dɛn.
Na mi PAPA GƆD na una Gɔd; una du wetin mi lɔ se, ɛn mek shɔ se una obe mi kɔmand dɛm,
ɛn mek mi de dɛn fɔ blo ɛn rɛst oli so dat dɛn go bi sayn bitwin mi ɛn una, so dat una go no se, mi we na PAPA GƆD, na una Gɔd.

Bɔt di pikin dɛn bin ribɛl agens mi; dɛn nɔ bin du wetin mi lɔ dɛn se, ɛn nɔ bin bisin bɔt mi kɔmand dɛm, we na we mɔtalman du dɛn, dɛn go gɛt lɔŋ layf, ɛn semwe dɛn nɔ bin rɛspɛkt mi de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst. “So a bin tink na mi at se a fɔ put mi bad bad vɛksteshɔn pan dɛm, ɛn put mi krɔs pan dɛm na di say we ɛmti ɛn natin nɔ de.
Bɔt a bin ol mi at, ɛn a bin du so fɔseka mi nem, so dat dɛn nɔ go pwɛl mi nem to di neshɔn dɛm, we na bifo dɛn a bin sev dɛn.
Pantap dat a bin swɛ to dɛn na di say we ɛmti ɛn natin nɔ de, se, a go skata dɛm na ɔl di difrɛn neshɔn dɛm, ɛn sheb sheb dɛm ɔlsay na di difrɛn difrɛn kɔntri dɛm,
bikɔs dɛn nɔ bin kɛriawt mi kɔmand dɛm, bɔt bin dɔn tɔn dɛn bak pan mi lɔ dɛm ɛn nɔ bin rɛspɛkt mi de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst, ɛn dɛn bin dɔn put at to dɛn papa dɛn laylay gɔd dɛm.
Pantap dat, a bin gi dɛn lɔ dɛm we nɔ gud ɛn kɔmand dɛm we go mek dɛn nɔ gɛt lɔŋ layf;
ɛn a bin dɔti dɛm na mi yay wit dɛn yon yon prɛzɛnt dɛm, dat na we a mek dɛn sakrifays ɔl dɛn fɔs pikin dɛn na faya, so dat dɛn go fred bad bad wan; a du so, so dat dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
“So mɔtalman, tɔk to Izrɛl ɛn tɛl dɛm se, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: na semweso so una fɔstɛmpapa dɛn pwɛl mi nem, bay we dɛn bin kɔmɔt biɛn mi.

Bikɔs we a bin dɔn briŋ dɛm kam na di land we a bin dɔn swɛ se a go gi dɛm, ɛnisay we dɛn si ay il ɔ tik we gɛt bɔku lif, na de dɛn kin go mek dɛn sakrifays dɛn, ɛn kin gi wetin go mek mi at wam. Na de dɛn swit sɛnt kin kɔmɔt kam ɔp, ɛn na de dɛn kin tɔn dɛn drink ɔfrin dɛm.
(A aks dɛn se, ‘wetin na dis ay ples we una kin go? So dɛn kɔl di ples Bama, te dis de.)
So, tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: una go dɔti unasɛf na mi yay lɛk aw una fɔstɛmpapa dɛn bin du, ɛn go biɛn dɛn tin dɛn we a et bad bad wan?

We una gi una prɛzɛnt dɛm ɛn sakrifays una bɔypikin dɛn na faya, una de dɔti unasɛf na mi yay wit ɔl una laylay gɔd dɛn te tide. Na una fɔ kam fɛnɔt to mi, una Izrɛl? Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se, wans a de, una nɔ go ebul fɛnɔt to mi.
“Wetin de na una maynd nɔ go ɛva bi - dat na we una kin tink se, “lɛ wi tan lɛk di neshɔn dɛm. Lɛ wi tan lɛk di fambul dɛn we de na dɛn ɔda kɔntri dɛn, ɛn wɔship bod ɛn ston!
Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se, wans a de, biliv mi, na wit mi pawaful an, ɛn wit mi an we rɛdi fɔ blo, ɛn na we a de du bad we a vɛks bad bad wan, A go bi kiŋ oba una.
A go pul una kɔmɔt to di difrɛn difrɛn pipul dɛn, ɛn gɛda una kɔmɔt na di difrɛn difrɛn kɔntri dɛn we una skata wit mi pawaful an, mi an we rɛdi fɔ blo ɛn we a de du bad we a vɛks bad bad wan;
ɛn a go briŋ una kam na di difrɛn pipul dɛn ples we ɛmti ɛn natin nɔ de; ɛn na de a go jɔj una fes to fes.
Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se, lɛk aw a bin jɔj una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm na di say we ɛmti ɛn natin nɔ de, na Ijipt, na so a go jɔj una.
A go rul una traŋa wan ɛn tren una lɛk soja, ɛn mek una rɛspɛkt mi Kɔvinant we a mek wit una.
A go pɔj di rebɛl dɛn ɛn di wan dɛn we de kɔmit sin kɔmɔt insay una; a go pul dɛn kɔmɔt na di land we dɛn tap, bɔt dɛn nɔ go go insay Izrɛl. Na datɛnde una go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.

“As fɔ una, una Izrɛl, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: if una nɔ de lisin to mi, lɛ ɔlman go sav in laylay gɔd frɔm naw sote go, bɔt una nɔ go ebul fityay mi nem igen wit una prɛzɛnt dɛn ɛn laylay gɔd dɛm.

“Bikɔs na pan mi oli mawnten, pantap di ay mawnten na Izrɛl, na de di wanol Izrɛl, dɛn ɔl, go wɔship mi na di land; na de a go gri fɔ dɛm, ɛn aks fɔ una kɔntribyushɔn dɛm paopa, ɛn di bɛst wan dɛn pan una prɛzɛnt dɛn, ɛn ɔl una oli ɔfrin dɛm.

A go gri fɔ una lɛk aw a kin gri fɔ fayn sɛnt we de mek a gladi, we a go briŋ una kɔmɔt to di difrɛn difrɛn pipul dɛn, ɛn gɛda una kɔmɔt na di difrɛn difrɛn kɔntri dɛn we una bin skata; ɛn a go sho mi olinɛs klia wan pan una, bifo di difrɛn neshɔn dɛm.
Ɛn una go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD, we a briŋ una kam na Izrɛl, di land we a bin swɛ a go gi una fɔstɛmpapa dɛm.
Ɛn na de una go mɛmba una bievyɔ dɛm, ɛn ɔl di tin dɛn we una bin de du, we una bin tek fɔ dɔti unasɛf; ɛn una go et unasɛf fɔ ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we una dɔn du.
Ɛn una go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD, we a go dil wit una, nɔto fɔ una bad bad tin dɛn we una de du, ɛn nɔto fɔ una kɔrɔpt bievyɔ o Izrɛl. Na so Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kan to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, tɔn yu fes na di sawt, ɛn prich agens di sawt, ɛn prɔfisay agens di fɔrɛst land we de na di sawt;

tɛl di fɔrɛst we de na di sawt se, Yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd: Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se, luk ya, a go layt faya pan yu, ɛn i go bɔn ɔl yu frɛsh ɛn dray tik dɛn; natin nɔ go ebul ɔt am ɛn ɔl udat de frɔn nɔt to sawt go fil di it.
Ɔlman na wɔl go si se na mi PAPA GƆD layt di faya; natin nɔ go ɔt am.”
Nain a se, “E Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd! Dɛn de tɔk bɔt mi se, “nɔto in ebul mekɔp stori dɛn we gɛt minin?”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se: “Mɔtalman, tɔn yu fes to Jerusɛlɛm,
ɛn prich agens di ples dɛn we dɛn de wɔship, ɛn prɔfisay agens Izrɛl.
Ɛn tɛl Izrɛl se, na dis PAPA GƆD se: una lisin, a de agens una, ɛn a go drɔ mi sɔd kɔmɔt nain kes, ɛn a go kil di wan dɛn we de waka tret wit mi ɛn di wan dɛn we nɔ de waka tret wit mi.
Bikɔs a go kil di wan dɛn we tret wit mi ɛn di wan we nɔ de waka tret, na dat mek mi sɔd go kɔmɔt nain kes pan ɔlman, frɔm sawt to nɔt,
Ɛn ɔlman go no se, na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn pul mi sɔd kɔmɔt nain kes; ɛn i nɔ go go insay in kes igen
So, mɔtalman; pini wit brokat, ɛn bad bad pwɛlat bifo dɛn.

Ɛn wɛn dɛn aks yu se, “wetin mek yu de blo kan dɔŋ so?” Yu go se, ‘na fɔseka di nyuz. Wɛn di nyuz go kam, ɔlman go fred, ɛn ɔlman bɔdi go brok, ɔlman spirit go wik ɛn ɔlman ni go wik lɛk wata. Una lisin, i go kam ɛn i go bi ma;” Na so Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se.
Nain PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, prɔfisay se, na dis PAPA GƆD se: wan sɔd, dɛn dɔn shap wan sɔd ɛn de pɔlish am,
dɛn shap am fɔ kil, ɛn pɔlish am fɔ flash lɛk laytin! Ɔ na fɔn wi de mek? Mi bɔypikin, yu nɔ rɛspɛkt di rɔd, wit ɔltin we dɛn tek bod mek.
So dɛn gi di sɔd fɔ mek dɛn pɔlish am, so dat dɛn go ebul yuz am; dɛn shap ɛn pɔlish am fɔ gi di pɔsin we de kil.
Kray ɛn ala lawd wan, mɔtalman, bikɔs i de agens mi pipul dɛn; i de agens ɔl di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl; dɛn dɔn gi dɛm ɛn mi pipul dɛn to di sɔd. So, slap yu tay at at wan.
Bikɔs i nɔ go tan lɛk se na tray a de tray una - wetin dat go du if una dɔn rɛspɛkt di rɔd? Na so Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se,
so mɔtalman, prɔfisay; klap yu an, ɛn lɛ di sɔd kam dɔŋ tu tɛm, yɛs, tri tɛm, di sɔd fɔ dɛn wan we dɛn go kil; na di sɔd fɔ di plɛnti plɛnti kil kil, we de rawnd dɛm,
so dat dɛn at dɛn go pwɛl, ɛn bɔku go day na ɔl dɛn get dɛm. A dɔn gi di sɔd we de shayn; o ya, dɛn dɔn mek am lɛk laytin, dɛn dɔn pɔlish am fɔ kil.
Chap shap wan, rayt ɛn lɛft, usay dɛn kɛr yu ɛj go.
Misɛf go klap mi an, ɛn a go satisfay mi bad bad vɛksteshɔn. Na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk am.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi bak se:
mɔtalman, mek tu rod usay di kiŋ na Babilɔn in sɔd go pas kam; dɛn ɔl tu go kɔmɔt na di sem land. Dɔn mek saynbod, ɛn mek am usay di rod fɔ go insay di siti bigin;
mek rod, we di sɔd go pas kam Raba, we di Amonayt dɛn siti, ɛn Juda ɛn na Jerusɛlɛm we gɛt protɛkshɔn.
Bikɔs di kiŋ na Babilɔn tinap usay di rod sheb, usay di tu rod bigin fɔ mek majik; i shek di aro dɛn, ɛn lukgrɔn to di tɛrafim, dɔn luk aw di liva tan, fɔ fɛnɔt.

Di ansa fɔ Jerusɛlɛm kam nain raytan, fɔ mek dɛn opin dɛn mɔt fɔ kray, mek dɛn mɔt de ala, fɔ tek big big tik dɛn we gɛt ayɛn ed, de wap di do fɔ brok am, fɔ payl ay ay dɔti ɛn fɔ bil tawa dɛn fɔ tek blɔked.
Bɔt i go tan to dɛm lɛk laylay luk grɔn; dɛn dɔn swɛ siriɔs siriɔs swɛ; bɔt PAPA GƆD mɛmba dɛn sin, we mek dɛn go kapchɔ dɛm.

Fɔseka dis, na so PAPA GƆD se: bikɔs una dɔn mek a mɛmba una sin, ɛn bikɔs una wikɛd bievyɔ dɛn so dɔn ɛkspoz, so dat una wikɛdnɛs de sho pan ɔltin we una de du - ɛn bikɔs a dɔn mɛmba una, dɛn go kech unainsay una wikɛdnɛs.
Ɛn yu, yu wikɛd wan we nɔ oli, yu Izrɛl in bigman, yu we yu kɔp dɔn ful, tɛm fɔ yu las pɔnishmɛnt dɔn kam,
na so Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: pul di tɔban, ɛn pul di krawn; tin dɛn nɔ go stil bi di sem lɛk aw dɛn de so; es ɔp ay wetin de dɔŋ, ɛn briŋ dɔŋ wetin de ay ɔp.
Na ruin, na ruin, a go ruin am; natin, natin nɔ go lɛf pan am te di wan kam, we nain gɛt rayt; ɛn naim a go gi am to.

“Ɛn yu mɔtalman, prɔfisay se, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se bɔt di Amonayt dɛn, ɛn bɔt dɛn disgres; tɛl dɛn se, wan sɔd, wan sɔd dɔn kɔmɔt nain kes fɔ kil, dɛn pɔlish am te i de glita ɛn de flash lɛk laytin -
Wɛn dɛn de si laylay vishɔn fɔ una, ɛn wɛn dɛn de lay gi una bɔt una tumara - fɔ le am na di wan dɛn we wikɛd ɛn nɔ oli, dɛn nɛk dɛn, we na di tɛm fɔ dɛn las las pɔnishmɛnt, ɛn dɛn kɔp dɔn ful.
Put di sɔd bak nain kes. A go jɔj una na di ples we a mek una, dat na di kɔntri we una kɔmɔt.
Ɛn a go put mi vɛksteshɔn pan una; a go blo mi vɛksteshɔn in faya pan una; ɛn a go gi una to dɛn kruɛl pipul dɛm, pipul dɛn we sabi fɔ nyakanyaka gud gud wan.
Na una go bi di karozin fɔ lɛ di faya kech; una blɔd go de na di land, ɛn dɛn nɔ go mɛmba una igen, igen, bikɔs na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk am.
Pantap dat, PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi ɛn i se,
“Yu mɔtalman, yu go jɔj? Yu go jɔj di siti we ful wit blɔd? Wɛl, tɛl am ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk we i de du.
Yu go tɛl am se, Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: di siti we de shɛd blɔd insay am, so dat in tɛm go kam, ɛn de mek lay lay gɔd dɛm fɔ dɔti insɛf na PAPA GƆD in yay!

Yu gilti bikɔs ɔf di blɔd we yu dɔn shɛd, ɛn dɔn dɔti yusɛf na PAPA GƆD in yay wit di lay lay gɔd dɛn we yu dɔn mek; ɛn yu dɔn mek yu de dɔn kam nia, di tɛm we yu kɔp fɔ ful. So a dɔn mek una bi tin fɔ laf na dɛn neshɔn dɛm ɛn pipul dɛn fɔ provok na ɔl di ɔda kɔntri dɛm.
Dɛn wan dɛn we de nia una, ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we de fawe, go mɔk una, una dɛn wikɛd tin dɛm ya, we ful wit so so plaba.
Biliv mi, di Izrɛl bigman dɛm we tap insay yu, bikɔs ɔf dɛn pawa, de shɛd blɔd.

Dɛn de luk dɔŋ pan di dadi ɛn mami we de wit una; una de tek mɔni dɛm bay pawa na di trenja dɛm we kan tap wit una, dɛn an; una de rɔŋ dɛn wan dɛm we dɛn dadi dɛm dɔn day, ɛn dɛn uman dɛn we dɛn man dɛn dɔn day.
Una dɔn luk dɔŋ pan mi oli tin dɛm ɛn nɔ rɛspɛkt mi de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst.
Sɔm man dɛn de de we de tɔk bad tin dɛm bɔt pɔsin dɛm, ɛn pwɛl dɛm so dat dɛn go kil dɛm; ɔda man dɛn de we de mek sakrifays na dɛn mawnten; sɔm man dɛn de rud midul una.
Sɔm man dɛn de lidɔm wit dɛn dadi dɛn wɛf dɛm; sɔm de lidɔm wit uman dɛn we de ɔp.
Dɛn de du bad bad tin we Papa Gɔd nɔ lɛk wit dɛn neba wɛf; ɔda wan dɛn de we dɔti na Papa Gɔd in yay; ɔda dɛn de we de dɔti dɛn sista, we na dɛn dadi in gyal pikin.
Sɔm man de we de tek brayb fɔ kil; una de tek intrɛs ɛn ad mɔ pan di mɔni ɛn mek prɔfit na una neba dɛn ed bay pawa; ɛn una dɔn fɔgɛt bɔt mi, Na so Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se.
Fɔseka dat, a go klap mi an fɔseka di tif tif prɔfit we una dɔn mek, ɛn fɔseka di blɔd we una dɔn wes na Izrɛl.
Una go ebul bia fɔ lɔŋ? Ɔ una go stil gɛt trɛnk we a go dɔn dil wit una? Na Mi PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk am, ɛn a go du am.
A go skata una na dɛn difrɛn neshɔn dɛm ɛn sheb sheb una na difrɛn difrɛn kɔntri dɛm, ɛn a go bɔn di dɔti kɔmɔt pan una kpatakpata.
Ɛn dɛn go tɔk bad bɔt mi nem fɔseka una, ɛn una go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman in bɔypikin, Izrɛl dɔn wɔtlɛs to mi; dɛn ɔl, silva, bras ɛn tin ɛn ayɛn ɛn lɛd we de insay di big ovin, ɔl dɛn wɔtlɛs.
Fɔseka dat, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: bikɔs una ɔl dɔn wɔtlɛs, a go gɛda una na Jerusɛlɛm.

Lɛk aw mɔtalman dɛn de gɛda silva ɛn bras ɛn ayɛn ɛn lɛd ɛn tin put na di big ovin, ɛn blo faya pan am fɔ mɛlt am; na so a go gɛda una wit vɛksteshɔn ɛn wamat, ɛn a go put unainsay di big ovin ɛn mɛlt una.
A go gɛda una ɛn blo di faya we de pan mi vɛksteshɔn pan una, ɛn unasɛf go mɛlt insay de.
Lɛk we silva de mɛlt insay big ovin, na so unasɛf go mɛlt insay de; ɛn una go no se na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn put mi vɛksteshɔn pan una.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se: “Mɔtalman tɛl am se:
yu na land we nɔ klin, ɔ we ren nɔ bin fɔdɔm pan vɛksteshɔn de.

Di bigman na di kɔntri, tan lɛk we layɔn de ala we i de chɛr chɛr wetin i kech fɔ it; dɛn pwɛl mɔtalman dɛn layf; dɛn dɔn tek dɛn jɛntri ɛn dia dia tin dɛm; dɛn dɔn mek bɔku uman tɔn, dɛn we dɛn man dɛn dɔn day, insay de.

Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɔn trit mi lɔ dɛn wit fityay, ɛn nɔ gɛt rɛspɛkt fɔ mi oli tin dɛm. Dɛn nɔ gɛt nɔn difrɛn bitwin wetin oli ɛn wetin na ɔl man yon, ɛn na so dɛn nɔ tich pipul wetin difrɛn pan wetin klin ɛn wetin nɔ klin, dɔn, dɛn nɔ de tek mi de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst mek natin, we min se dɛn nɔ rɛspɛkt mi.
Dɛn bigman dɛn we de de, tan lɛk wulf we de chɛr di tin we i kech fɔ it, dɛn de kil pipul ɛn nyakanyaka pipul dɛn layf fɔseka jɛntri we nɔ klin na Gɔd yay;
Ɛn in prɔfɛt dɛn dɔn dab dab wayt wɔsh fɔ dɛm; dɛn de si lay lay vishɔn dɛm we nɔ tru ɛn de gi laylay mɛsej dɛm se, ‘Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se,’ wɛn PAPA GƆD nɔ bin tɔk atɔl.
Di pipul dɛn na di land, dɔn praktis fɔ tek tin bay fos ɛn fɔ tif ɛn kil; dɛn dɔn sɔprɛs dɛn po pipul, ɛn dɛn dɔn tek tin bay pawa kɔmɔt na trenja an ɛn natin nɔ de kɔmɔt biɛn.
Ɛn a bin luk fɔ wan man pan dɛn, we go bil di wɔl ɛn tinap na di gap bifo mi fɔ di land, so a nɔ go nyakanyaka am; bɔt a nɔ fɛn nɔbɔdi.
Fɔseka dat, a dɔn put mi vɛksteshɔn pan dɛm; a dɔn kil dɛm wit mi wamat in faya; a dɔn pe dɛn bak bay aw dɛn biev. Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd tɔk se.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, tu uman dɛm bin de, wan mami gyal pikin dɛm.
Dɛn bin de rare na Ijipt; dɛn bin de rare wɛn dɛn yɔŋ; na de dɛn bin kwis dɛn bɔbi dɛm ɛn ple wit dɛn vajin buzɔm dɛm.
Di big wan bin nem Oola, ɛn in sista bin nem Ooliba. Dɛn bin kam blant mi, ɛn dɛn bɔn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛm. As fɔ dɛn nem dɛm, Oola na Sameria ɛn Ooliba na Jerusɛlɛm.
“Oola bin de rare we i blant mi; ɛn i bin de sho bɔku lɔv to in switat dɛn we na di Asirian dɛm,
fɛtman dɛn we de wɛr pɔpul klos, gɔvna dɛm ɛn kɔmanda dɛm, dɛn ɔl na yɔŋ man dɛn we tan lɛkɛ tin fɔ it, man dɛn we de rayd pan ɔs dɛm.
I bin rare, gi insɛf fri wan to dɛn, to ɔl di bɛtɛ wan pan di Asiria man dɛm. Ɛn i dɔti insɛf na mi yay wit ɔl di lay lay gɔd dɛm, we ɔl di wan we i de sho bɔku lɔv, bin gɛt.

I nɔ bin tap in rare layf we i bin dɔn de pan, frɔm we i bin de na Ijipt; bikɔs frɔm di tɛm we i bin yɔŋ, man dɛn dɔn de lidɔm wit am ɛn ol in vajin buzɔm, ɛn dɛn tɔn di want we dɛn want uman bad bad wan, to am.
So fɔseka dat, a bin put am nain switat dɛn, dat na di Asirian dɛm we i bin de sho bɔku lɔv.
Na dɛn kam sho in nekɛdnɛs na do; dɛn kapchɔ in bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛm; ɛn dɛn kil in wit sɔd; ɛn i bin kam bi wan we dɛn uman de tɔk bad bɔt, afta dɛn bin dɔn kɛri awt jɔjmɛnt pan am.
“In sista Ooliba bin si ɔl dis, stil in bin kɔrɔpt mɔ pas in sista, bay aw in bin de sho bɔku lɔv, ɛn pan in rare, we bin wɔs pas in sista yon.
I bin sho bɔku lɔv to di Asirian dɛn gɔvna dɛm, ɛn kɔmanda dɛm, dɛn fɛtman dɛm insay dɛn ful unifɔm fɔ fɛt, man dɛn we de rayd ɔs ɛn dɛn ɔl na yɔŋ man dɛm we fayn lɛk tin fɔ it.
Ɛn a bin si se in bin dɔti na mi yay; dɛn ɔltu waka di sem rod.
Bɔt Ooliba in bin rare pasmak; i bin si man dɛm we dɛn drɔ na wɔl, di Babilonian dɛn pikchɔ we dɛn drɔ wit rɛd pent;
dɛn tay bɛlt rawnd dɛn wes, ɛn gɛt big big tɔban we de flay na dɛn ed, ɛn dɛn ɔl luk lɛk ɔfisa dɛn, pikchɔ we sho tru Babilonian we bɔn na Chaldia.
Wɛn Ooliba bin si dɛm, i fɔl fɔ dɛm bad bad ɛn sɛn mɛsenja dɛn go to dɛm na Babilɔn.

Ɛn di Babilonian dɛn bin kan to am nain bed we i kin mek lɔv, ɛn dɛn dɔti Ooliba na Gɔd yay wit di bad bad want we dɛn want uman; afta dɛn dɔn dɔti am na Gɔd yay dɔn, i fil nasti ɛn in at kɔmɔt pan dɛn.
Wɛn i bin dɔn rare opin opin wan ɛn nɔ bisin aw i de sho in nekɛdnɛs, a bin fɛdɔp ɛn lɛf am to insɛf, lɛk aw a bin kɔmɔt biɛn in sista.
Na da tɛm de i bigin rare mɔ, de mɛmba di tɛm we i bin yɔŋ, we i bin de rare na Ijipt
we i bin de sho bɔku lɔv to in switat dɛn de, we dɛn prayvet na lɛk dɔnki yon, ɛn wɛn dɛn dischaj, i tan lɛk ɔs yon.
Na dat mek yu de mɛmba di rud we yu bin de biev we yu bin yɔŋ wɛn di Ijipshian dɛn de andul una buzɔm ɛn kwis una yɔŋ bɔbi dɛm.”
Fɔseka dat, E Ooliba, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: “Biliv mi, a go mek yu switat dɛm we yu dɔn fɛdɔp wit grap pan yu, ɛn a go mek dɛn atak yu ɔlsay:

Di Babilonian dɛm, ɛn ɔl di Chaldian dɛm, Pɛkɔd ɛn Shoa ɛn Koa, ɛn ɔl di Asirian dɛm de wit dɛm, yɔŋ man dɛm we fayn lɛk tin fɔ it, ɛn gɔvna dɛm, kɔmanda dɛm, ɔfisa dɛm, ɛn fɛt man dɛm, dɛn ɔl de rayd ɔs.

Ɛn dɛn go kɔmɔt na di nɔt kam atak yu. Dɛn go de rayd chariɔt ɛn trɔk dɛm, ɛn go kam wit bɔku bɔku pipul kan atak yu; dɛn go atak yu wit bɔkla, shild ɛn ɛlmɛt, ɛn a go lɛf di jɔjmɛnt na dɛn an, ɛn dɛn go jɔj una bay aw dɛn sabi jɔj.

Ɛn a go so put mi vɛksteshɔn pan una, so dat na wit bad bad vɛksteshɔn, dɛn go dil wit una. Dɛn go kɔt una nos ɛn una yes dɛm kɔmɔt, ɛn dɛn go kil una pikin dɛn wit sɔd. Dɛn go kapchɔ una bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛm, ɛn na faya go kil una pikin dɛm.
Pantap dat, dɛn go tek ɔl una klos dɛn, ɛn ɔl una juɛl dɛm.
Na so a go tap yu rudnɛs ɛn una rarelayf we yu briŋ kɔmɔt Ijipt; so dat yu nɔ go es una yay ɔp fɔ luk di Ijipshian dɛm ɔ ivin mɛmba dɛm igen
Ɛn na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: Lisin, a go gi yu to di wan dɛn we una et, di wan dɛn we yu bin fɛdɔp wit ɛn bin kɔmɔt biɛn.
Ɛn dɛn go dil wit yu wit etrɛd, ɛn tek ɔl di tin dɛn we yu dɔn wok fɔ go, ɛn lɛf yu nekɛd ɛn ɛmti, ɛn di nekɛdnɛs pan yu rarelayf go mɔs kɔmɔt na do. Na yu rudnɛs ɛn yu rarelayf
dɔn briŋ dis kam pan yu, bikɔs yu bin de rare to di neshɔn dɛm, ɛn dɔti yusɛf na mi yay wit dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛm.
Yu dɔn waka di rod we yu sista bin waka, ɛn na so a go gi yu, yu sista in kɔp na yu an.
Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: “yu go drink na yu sista in kɔp we dip ɛn big. Dɛn go laf yu ɛn tek yu mek lafin stɔk bikɔs di kɔp gɛt bɔku tin insay;
Na drɔŋɔ drɔŋɔ ɛn sɔri layf yu go de. Yu sista Sameria in kɔp, na kɔp we gɛt bad bad fred fred ɛn distrɔkshɔn;
yu go drink am, ɛn dɔn ɔltin, ɛn yu go jɔg jɔg yu ia, ɛn chɛr chɛr yu bɔbi dɛm Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se, bikɔs na mi dɔn tɔk am.
Fɔseka dat, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: Bikɔs una dɔn fɔgɛt bɔt mi ɛn dɔn trowe mi, una lisin wetin go apin to una fɔseka una rudnɛs ɛn rare layf.”
PAPA GƆD bin tɛl mi se: “Mɔtalman, yu go jɔj Oola ɛn Ooliba? Dɛn, tɛl dɛm di tin dɛn we dɛn du we a et bad bad wan.
Bikɔs dɛn dɔn kɔmit adɔltri, ɛn blɔd de na dɛn an; dɛn dɔn kɔmit adɔltri wit dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛm; sɛf dɔn gi mi bɔypikin dɛn we dɛn bɔn fɔ mi to lay lay gɔd fɔ it.
Semweso, na dɛn tin ya dɛn dɔn du mi: dɛn dɔti mi ples we dɛn de pre to mi ɛn luk dɔŋ pan mi de fɔ blo ɛn rɛst di sem de.
Bikɔs dɛn dɔn kil dɛn pikin dɛm as sakrifays to dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛn, di sem de, dɛn de kam insay mi ples we dɛn de pre to mi kam dɔti am. Fɔ tru, na dis dɛn de du na mi os.
Dɛn bin ivin sɛn mɛsenja go kɔl man dɛn we de fawe fɔ kam, ɛn biliv mi, dɛn kam. Fɔseka dɛm, yu bin was yusɛf, pent yu yay dɛm, ɛn drɛs yusɛf wit ɔlkayn riŋ chen ɛn baŋuls.
Ɛn yu bin sidɔm pan wan ɔfishal kawch, we bin gɛt tebul, we prɛd wit fayn fayn tebul klos, ɛn na de yu bin dɔn put mi insɛns ɛn mi ɔyl.

Di nɔys we pipul we nɔ bisin bɔt ɛnitin kin mek, bin de wit am; ɛn dɛn bin briŋ dɛn chip chip drɔŋɔ drɔŋɔ pɔsin dɛn kɔmɔt na di dray ɛn ɛmti ples; ɛn di uman dɛn wɛr baŋuls na dɛn an, ɛn fayn fayn krawn na dɛn ed.
“Nain a aks se, man dɛnsɛf nɔ de kɔmit adɔltri wɛn dɛn de rare wit am?
Bikɔs dɛn dɔn lidɔm wit am, lɛk we man dɛn de go fɛn rare gyal, na so dɛn de go fɛn Oola ɛn Ooliba fɔ go du rudnɛs.

Bɔt dɛn man dɛn we de waka tret na Papa Gɔd in yay, go pas jɔjmɛnt pan am wit di sɛntɛns dɛn we dɛn kin sɛntɛns dɛn uman we kɔmit adɔltri, ɛn wit di sɛntɛns we dɛn kin pas pan uman dɛn we kil ɛn mek blɔd flo; bikɔs dɛn na uman we de kɔmit adɔltri ɛn we blɔd de na dɛn an.’
Bikɔs na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: briŋ wan big big krawd kan mit dɛm, ɛn a go mek dɛm pipul we fɔ de du bad ɛn tin fɔ kapu kapu.
Ɛn di bɔku krawd go ston dɛm ɛn kil dɛm wit dɛn sɔd dɛm; dɛn go kil dɛn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛm ɛn bɔn dɛn os dɛn kan dɔŋ.
Ɛn na so a go tap rudnɛs na di kɔntri, sɔntɛm dat go mek ɔl uman dɛn tek wɔnin ɛn nɔ kɔmit rudnɛs lɛk aw una dɔn du.
Ɛn una go gɛt di pe fɔ una rudnɛs, ɛn una go bia una pɔnishmɛnt fɔ di adɔltri we una kɔmit we na sin, ɛn una go no se na mi na di Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd.”
Di de we mek tɛn na di mɔnt we mek tɛn, insay di ia we mek nayn, PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, rayt tide in nem, dis vɛri de. Di kiŋ na Babilɔn dɔn blɔked Jerusɛlɛm dis sem de.
Afta dat, pul wan stori we gɛt minin, to di rebɛl os ɛn tɛl dɛn se, Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se Put di pɔt na faya, put an de, tɔn wata insay de;
put am pan di bif we dɔn kɔt kɔt, ɔl di gud say dɛm, di tay ɛn di sholda; ful am wit di bon dɛm we fayn pas ɔl.
Tek di wan we fayn pas ɔl pan di ship dɛm, put di wud ɔnda di pɔt; bwɛl di bif we yu dɔn kɔt kɔt Bwɛl di bon dɛnsɛf.

“Fɔseka dat, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: Swɛ go fɔdɔm pan da siti we dɛn de kil kil pipul, da siti we insay in pɔt rɔsti, ɛn di rɔsti nɔ kɔmɔt pan am yet! Jis pul am pis bay pis kɔmɔt insay de bɔt nɔ pik ɛn chus.
Bikɔs di blɔd we i dɔn shɛd stil de insay am; i put an pan di ɛmti rɔk, ɛn i nɔ tɔn am na grɔn so dat i go kɔba an wit dɔti.
A dɔn put di blɔd, we i dɔn shɛd pan di nekɛd rɔk, so dat i nɔ go kɔba ɛn so dat mi fuk fuk go grap fɔ tek rivɛnj.
So na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: Swɛ go mit da siti we blɔd plɛnti! Sɛf, a go mek di payl bɔku.
Pak di wud, mek di faya, bwɛl di bif gud, dɔn trowe di sup wata, ɛn mek di bon dɛn bɔn kpatakpata.
Dɔn put di ɛmti pɔt na di faya so dat di pɔt go wam, so dat in kɔpa we dɛn tek mek am go bɔn ɛn ɔl in dɔti go mɛlt insay am, ɛn di rɔsti we de pan am go dɔn kpatakpata.
A dɔn yagba misɛf fɔ natin; faya nɔ ebul pul di rɔsti we dɔn tik pan am kɔmɔt.
Di rɔsti na yu dɔti dɔti rudnɛs. Bikɔs a bin fɔ dɔn klin yu, ɛn bikɔs yu nɔ bin klin kɔmɔt pan yu dɔti we yu dɔti, yu nɔ go ɛva klin igen te a dɔn satisfay mi vɛksteshɔn pan yu.

Na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk so: ɛn i go bi, A go du am; A nɔ go chenj mi maynd, ɛn A nɔ go sɔri fɔ ɛnibɔdi, A nɔ go rigrɛt; A go jɔj una bay aw una de biev ɛn bay wetin una du. Na so Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se.
Igen, PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:
Mɔtalman, lisin, a dɔn rɛdi fɔ tek di tin we yu lɛk kɔmɔt na yu an bifo jako kɔt yay; pan ɔl dat, yu nɔ go munin ɔ kray ɔ mek wata rɔn dɔŋ yu yay.
Pini, bɔt nɔto lawd wan; nɔ munin atɔl fɔ dayman. Tay yu tɔban rawnd yu ed ɛn wɛr yu sus na yu fut; nɔ kɔba yu mɔt ɛn nɔ it bɛrin it.
So na mɔnin, a tɔk to di pipul dɛm, ɛn bay ivintɛm, mi wɛf day. So di nɛks de mɔnin, a nɔ bin munin ɛn a nɔ bin kray.
Ɛn di pipul dɛn tɛl mi se, ‘yu nɔ go tɛl wi wetin ɔl dis we yu de du so min fɔ wi?
Nain a tɛl dɛn se; “PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se;

‘Tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: una lisin; a nɔ go rɛspɛkt mi ples we una de pre to mi igen, we na de una prayd in pawa de, we de mek una yay dɛn gladi ɛn we de mek una sol want am bad bad; ɛn na wa una bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛm we una lɛf biɛn, go day.
Ɛn una go du lɛk aw misɛf dɔn du; una nɔ go kɔba una mɔt dɛm ɛn una nɔ go it bɛrin it.
Una tɔban dɛn go de na una ed ɛn una sus dɛn go de na una fut; una nɔ go munin ɔ kray, bɔt una go munin fɔ una sin ɛn pini na una chɛst to una kɔmpin.
Na so Izikɛl go bi sayn to una; lɛk aw i du, na so unasɛf go du ɔl wetin i bin du. Wɛn dis bi, na da tɛm de una go no se, na mi na Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd.

“Ɛn yu mɔtalman; di de we a go tek wetin na dɛn protɛkshɔn kɔmɔt na dɛn an, we a go tek wetin kin mek dɛn gladi ɛn wetin mek dɛn femɔs, di tin dɛm we dɛn lɛk bad bad wan, ɛn sɛf dɛn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛm kɔmɔt na dɛn an,
na da de de, na pɔsin we rɔnawe bikɔs i dɔn du bad ɛn dɛn de fɛn am, go kam briŋ di nyuz to yu.
Da de de, yu mɔt go opin, ɛn yu go tɔk to di wan we bin ebul fɔ rɔnawe, yu nɔ go bi mumu igen. Na so yu go bi sayn to dɛm; ɛn dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, tɔn yu fes to di Amonayt dɛm ɛn prɔfisay to dɛm.

Tɛl di Amonayt dɛn se, una lisin to wetin Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se, Bikɔs yu bin shumɔ pan mi ples we dɛn de pre to mi wɛn dɛn bin dɔti am; ɛn pan di Izrɛl wɛn i bin pwɛl kpatakpata natin nɔ de, ɛn pan Juda wɛn dɛn bin de ɛgzayl;
fɔseka dat, A gi una to di pipul dɛn na di ist as dɛn yon, ɛn dɛn go bil dɛn kamp wit una ɛn bil dɛn os dɛn insay una kɔntri; dɛn go it una frut dɛm ɛn drink una milk.
A go mek Raba bi say we kamɛl dɛn de kam it gras, ɛn di Amonayt dɛn siti dɛn go bi ples we ship dɛn go de slip. Na da tɛm de una go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
Bikɔs na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se; Bikɔs una dɔn klap una an dɛm ɛn stamp una fut de gladi, wit ɔl di malis we de insay una fɔ Izrɛl,

a de tɛl una, a dɔn rɛdi fɔ dil wit una, ɛn gi una lɛk prɛzɛnt to ɔda neshɔn dɛm; ɛn a go pul una kɔmɔt pan di pipul dɛn, ɛn mek una day kɔmɔt lɛf di ɔda kɔntri dɛm; a go dɔnawe wit una. Na da tɛm de una go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
“Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: Bikɔs Moab in se Juda dɛn tan lɛkɛ ɔl di ɔda neshɔn dɛm,
fɔseka dat, a go mek dɛn atak Bet Jɛshimɔt, Beal Meɔn ɛn Kiriataim, we na di siti dɛn we de kɔba di bɔda dɛn na Moab ɛn we dɛn de tek blɔf.
A go gi am togɛda wit di Amonayt dɛn, to di pipul dɛn na di ist, fɔ mek i blant dɛm so dat dɛn nɔ go mɛmba dɛm igen igen na di wɔl,
ɛn a go keri awt jɔjmɛnt pan Moab. Na da tɛm de dɛn go no se, na mi na PAPA GƆD.
“Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: Bikɔs Idɔm bin akt wit rivɛnj pan Juda ɛn dɔn ɔfɛnd bad bad wan fɔ we i rivɛnj pan dɛm,

na so Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se fɔseka dat: a go tret mi an pan Idɔm, ɛn kil ɔl di mɔtalman dɛn, ɛn ɔl di animal dɛnsɛf; ɛn a go so mek am, dat i go ɛmti ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de; frɔm Timan te rich Dedan, na sɔd go kil dɛm ɔl.
Ɛn a go rivɛnj pan Idɔm tru mi pipul we na Izrɛl; ɛn dɛn go dil wit dɛm bay aw a vɛks ɛn aw mi at wam. Na so Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se.
“Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: Bikɔs di filistin dɛn bin akt wit rivɛnj ɛn bin tek rivɛnj wit malis na dɛn at fɔ pwɛl kpatakpata we, we nɔ de ɛva dɔn;
fɔseka dat, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: una lisin, a go tret mi an pan di Filistin dɛm, ɛn a go kil di Chɛrɛtayt dɛm ɛn pwɛl di balans we lɛf pan di si kos dɛm.
A go kɛriawt big big rivɛnj pan dɛm wit bad bad vɛksteshɔn ɛn pɔnishmɛnt. Dɔn dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD, wɛn a go rivɛnj pan dɛm.”
Insay di ia we mek ilɛvin, PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:
“mɔtalman, bikɔs Taya bin tɔk bɔt Jerusɛlɛm se: ‘Ɛnɛh, di pipul dɛn get dɔn brok ɛn i dɔn opin fɔ mi; a go gɛt ɔl wetin a bin dɔn lɔs bak naw we dɛn dɔn nyakanyaka am.
Fɔseka dat, Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: Una lisin, a de agens una, Yu Taya, ɛn a go briŋ bɔku neshɔn kam pan yu, lɛk aw di si kin briŋ swɛlin dɛn kam ɔp.
Dɛn go pwɛl pata pata Taya in wɔl dɛn, ɛn brok kam dɔŋ in tawa dɛn, ɛn a go krep in grɔn pan am, ɛn mek i bi wan dray ɛmti big big rɔk na di si.
I go bi ples midul di si, we na de dɛn go de prɛd dɛn nɛt dɛm; bikɔs a dɔn tɔk am, PAPA GƆD se. Ɛn i go bi ples fɔ di neshɔn dɛn fɔ pwɛl.
Ɛn di sɔd go kil in gyal pikin dɛm we de na di menland. Na da tɛm de dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.

Wɛl, na dis PAPA GƆD se: una lisin, a go briŋ kam pan Taya, frɔm di nɔt Nɛbyukadnɛza we na di Babilɔn kiŋ, di kiŋ oba di ɔda kiŋ dɛm; i go kam wit ɔs ɛn chariɔt dɛm, ɛn wit man dɛm we de rayd ɔs dɛm ɛn bɔku bɔku soja man dɛm.
I go kil una gyal pikin dɛn na di menland, wit di sɔd, i go bil wan blɔked wɔl pan una, ɛn sɛf payl dɔti ay ay wan pan una, ɛn es pan una, wan ruf we mek wit shild dɛm.
I go sɛn pan una di shɔk we di big tik dɛn we gɛt ayɛn na dɛn ed, go de mek, as dɛn de bata una wɔl dɛn kan dɔŋ; ɛn i go tek in aks dɛm brok una tawa dɛn kan dɔŋ.

In ɔs dɛn go so bɔku, dat di dɔst we dɛn go de mek, go kɔba una. Una wɔl dɛn go de shek wit di nɔys we di ɔsman dɛm ɛn di trɔk dɛm, ɛn chariɔt dɛm go de mek, wɛn i go krɔs una gɛt dɛm go insay, lɛk wan we de go insay wan big siti we dɛn dɔn brok in wɔl kan dɔŋ.
I go mas mas una trit dɛm wit in ɔs dɛn sus; i go kil una pipul dɛn wit in sɔd; ɛn una pawaful pila dɛn go fɔdɔm kan na grɔn.

Dɛn go tif bay fos una richis dɛm ɛn ɔnt fɔ una makit; dɛn go brok una wɔl dɛn kam dɔŋ, ɛn pwɛl pata una fayn fayn os dɛm; dɛn go trowe una ston dɛm, ɛn una big big tik dɛn we dɔn slayz slayz, ɛn una grɔn dɔti, midul di wata dɛm
ɛn a go tap di myuzik we una siŋ dɛn gɛt, ɛn dɔn nɔ go yɛri igen igen di sawnd we una laya dɛn de mek.
A go mek una bi wan nekɛd, dray rɔk; una go bi wan ples fɔ de prɛd nɛt dɛn pan; ɛn dɛn nɔ go ɛva bil di kɔntri igen; bikɔs mi, we na di PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk am; PAPA GƆD se.
“Na dis PAPA GƆD se to Taya: Di kos kɔntri dɛm nɔ go shek wɛn dɛn yɛri di sawnd we mek wɛn yu fɔdɔm; wɛn dɛn wan dɛm we wund de pini wit pen; wɛn dɛn de kil bɔku bɔku pipul midul una?

Da tɛn de, ɔl di si in kiŋ dɛm, go kɔmɔt kam dɔŋ frɔm dɛn tron dɛm, ɛn pul dɛn kiŋ klos dɛm, ɛn pul wan bay wan, dɛn klos dɛn we fayn fayn dizayn bin dɔn wok pan; na da tɛm de dɛn go kɔba dɛnsɛf wit trimbul fɔ klos; dɛn go sidɔm na grɔn ɛn jis de trimbul, trimbul ebri minit ɛn ful wit fred fɔ yu.

Ɛn dɛn go bigin siŋ bɛrin siŋ oba yu ɛn se to yu, ‘Aw yu dɔn disapia kɔmɔt na di si dɛm, O big siti we bin gɛt fem, we bin gɛt pawa pan di si, yu ɛn yu pipul we bin tap de, ɛn we una bin de fos una wikɛdnɛs pan ɔl di menland.”
Naw di ayland dɛn de trimbul di de we yu fɔdɔm; yɛs di ayland dɛn na di si bin fred ɛn diskɔrej we yu dɔn dɔn.
Wɛl, na dis PAPA GƆD se: wɛn a go mek una wan big siti we pwɛl ɛn distrɔy, lɛk di ɔda big siti dɛm we nɔbɔdi nɔ tap, ɛn wɛn a go briŋ di dip si kam oba una, ɛn di big big wata dɛn kɔba una,

dɛn a go shub una go dɔŋ wit dɛn wan dɛm we de go dɔŋ insay di pit, to dɛn lɔntɛm pipul, dɛn a go mek yu tap na di ɔnda wɔl pan dɛn lɔŋlɔŋtɛm ples dɛn we dɔn fɔdɔm ɛn broko broko, wit dɛn wan dɛn we de go dɔŋ na di pit, so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap insay yu, ɔ gɛt ples na di kɔntri we di pipul dɛn de alayv.
A go briŋ yu kam to wan kayn ɛndin we go mek yu fred bad bad, ɛn yu nɔ go liv igen igen: ivin do dɛn go de luk fɔ yu ɔlsay, dɛn nɔ go eba fɛn yu, PAPA GƆD tɔk se.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“naw, yu, mɔtalman, mek wan bɛrin siŋ fɔ Taya,

ɛn tɛl Taya, we de usay di si bigin, in we de sɛl to dɛn difrɛn pipul we de na di bɔku bɔku kos kɔntri dɛm, tɛl am se, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: “O Taya, yu dɔn se, ‘di fayn we a fayn nɔ gɛt nɔn bɔt,’
Yu bɔda dɛn de midul di si; di wan dɛn we bil yu mek yu fayn ɛn yu nɔ gɛt nɔn bɔt.
Dɛn tek di fa tik dɛn na Sɛnir fɔ mek yu bod flo dɛm; dɛn tek wan sida tik na Libanɔn fɔ mek wan pol fɔ yu sel.
Dɛn tek di ok tik na Beshan fɔ mek yu padul dɛm; dɛn tek payn tik mek yu dɛk, payn tik we kɔmɔt Sayprɔs in kost dɛm ɛn wok an wit ayvri.
Yu sel na bin fayn linin we dɛn wok na Ijipt, we igen na yu flag, yu kanopi na bin blu ɛn pɔpul we kɔmɔt na Ilaysha in kos dɛm.
Na dɛn wan we tap na Saydɔn ɛn Avad na bin yu padul man dɛm; Zema man dɛm we sabi wok wit dɛn an, bin de insay yu, ɛn na dɛn na bin yu kapten dɛm.
Gɛbal in bigman dɛm ɛn in mastasabi wokman dɛn bin de insay yu, de lɔk di ol dɛn na yu sayd; ɔl di ship dɛn na di si wit dɛn shipman dɛm bin de insay yu fɔ ɛkschenj fɔ yu makit dɛm.
Pashia ɛn Lud ɛn Put bin de na yu ami as yu wa fɛtman dɛm; dɛn bin ɛng dɛn big shild ɛn ɛlmɛt insay yu; dɛn bin gi yu glori.
Avad ɛn Ɛlek man dɛn bin de rawnd yu wɔl dɛn, ɛn Gamad man dɛm bin de insay yu tawa dɛm; dɛn bin ɛng dɛn big shild dɛn rawnd yu wɔl dɛn, dɛn bin mek yu fayn wan nɔ gɛt nɔn bɔt.
Tashish bin trafik wit yu, bikɔs yu gɛt ɔl kayn bɔku richis; dɛn ɛkschenj silva, ayɛn, tin ɛn lɛd fɔ yu makit.
Javan, Tubal ɛn Mɛshɛk bin tredin wit yu; dɛn ɛkschenj mɔtalman dɛn ɛn bras vɛsul dɛn fɔ yu makit.
Bethtigama bin ɛkschenj dɛn ɔs dɛm, di ɔs dɛm we dɛn de rayd fɔ go fɛt, ɛn dɛn dɔŋki dɛm fɔ yu makit
Di Rods man dɛn bin tredin wit yu; bɔku bɔku dɛn kos kɔntri dɛn na bin yu spɛshal makit; dɛn briŋ ayvri tɔsk dɛn ɛn ebɔni kam pe yu.
Idɔm bin trafik wit yu fɔseka di bɔku bɔku makit dɛn we dɛn dizayn fayn fayn wan fayn linin, kɔral ɛn aget, fɔ yu makit dɛn.
Juda ɛn di Izrɛl kɔntri bin tredin wit yu; dɛn ɛkschenj wit, ɔliv, ɛn ali fig dɛm, ɔni, ɔyl ɛn bam, fɔ yu makit.
Damaskɔs bin trafik wit yu fɔ yu bɔku bɔku makit dɛn, fɔseka yu ɔl kayn bɔku richis; Ɛlbɔn wayn ɛn wayt wul, ɛn uzal wayn.
Na dɛn wande, dɛn ɛkschenj fɔ yu makit dɛm; dɛn bin bata gud gud ayɛn, kasia ɛn kalmɔs fɔ yu makit.
Dedan bin tredin wit yu sadul klos we dɛn de sidɔm pan fɔ rayd ɔs.
Arebya ɛn ɔl di kida kiŋ dɛm na bin yu kostamɛnt, we yu de gi lo prayz pas ɔl, pan ship pikin dɛn, manship dɛm, ɛn got dɛm; na dɛn wan ya dɛn bin trafik wit yu.
Di Shiba ɛn Raama treda dɛn bin tredin wit yu; dɛn bin ɛkschenj ɔl kayn spays we bɛtɛ pas ɔl, ɛn ɔl kayn prɛshɔs ston dɛm ɛn gold.
Erab, Kanɛ, Idɛn, Ashu ɛn Kilman bin tredin wit yu
Dɛn wan ya bin tredin wit yu pan di klos dɛn we gɛt gud dizayn. Ɛn pan kapɛt dɛn we gɛt bɔku kɔla ɛn we dɛn tay wit kɔd dɛm fɔ mek dɛn sef; na wit dɛn wan ya dɛn tredin wit yu.

Di Tashish ship dɛn bin travul wit yu makit fɔ yu so yu bin ful ɛn lod bad bad wan midul di si. Di wan dɛn we de padul fɔ yu, dɔn briŋ yu kɔmɔt kam na di ay si dɛm. Di briz we kɔmɔt na di ist dɔn rɛk yu midul midul di si.
Yu padulman dɛm dɔn briŋ kam midul midul di si. Di briz we de kɔmɔt na di ist dɔn rɛk yu midul midul di si.

Yu jɛntri, yu tin dɛn we yu de sɛl, yu makit, yu shipman dɛm ɛn yu kapten dɛm, yu kɔkman dɛm, yu kostamɛnt dɛm fɔ yu makit ɛn ɔl yu fɛtman dɛn we de insay yu, wit ɔl yu krawd we de midul yu, sink go insay di si di de we yu dɔn kpatakpata.
Di vilej dɛn shek Wɛn dɛn yɛri di sawnd we yu kapten dɛn de kray
Ɛn ɔl dɛn wan we de padul de kɔmɔt kan dɔŋ dɛn ship. Di siman dɛn ɛn ɔl di kapten na di si tinap na shɔ
ɛn dɛn ɔl de kray lawd lawd wan fɔ yu, ɛn dɛn de kray bita bita wan. Dɛn de trowe dɔti na dɛn ed ɛn de rolpan asis.
Dɛn shayn dɛn ed fɔseka yu, ɛn tay saklɔth pan dɛnsɛf, ɛn dɛn de kray oba yu, bay aw dɛn sol bita, ɛn wit bita bita munin
Pan di kray we dɛn de kray, dɛn mek wan bɛrin siŋ fɔ yu, ɛn de kray sɔri wan oba yu; ‘udat dɛn bin ɛva pwɛl bad bad wan lɛk Taya midul si?
Wɛn yu makit dɛn bin de kam pan di si dɛm yu bin satisfay bɔku bɔku pipul; wit yu bɔku bɔku richis ɛn makit yu bin mek di kiŋ dɛn na di wɔl jɛntri.
Naw di si dɛn dɔn rɛk yu, dɔŋ dɔŋ di wata dɛm; yu makit ɛn ɔl yu shipman dɛn dɔn sink wit yu
Ɔl dɛn wan we tap na dis kos kɔntri dɛm dɔn ful wit fred fɔ yu; ɛn dɛn kiŋ dɛn de fred bad bad dɛn fes dɛn dɔn rampul.
Di makit man dɛm, pan di pipul, de sɔktit pan yu; yu ɛndin dɔn kan bin wan we de mek yu fred bad bad ɛn yu nɔ go de igen igen fɔrɛva ɛn ɛva.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se: “mɔtalman, tɛl di Taya kiŋ se,

na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: “Bikɔs yu prawd ɛn yu dɔn se, ‘misɛf na gɔd, a de sidɔm usay dɛn gɔd de sidɔm, midul midul di si, stil yu na natin bɔt wan mɔtalman, ɛn yu nɔto nɔn gɔd, ɔl we yu de tink se yu na gɔd–
Fɔ tru tru, yu gɛt sɛns pas Daniɛl; nɔn sikrit nɔ ayd pan yu;
Na wit yu sɛns ɛn yu ɔndastandin yu dɔn tek gɛt bɔku jɛntri fɔ yusɛf, ɛn yu dɔn gɛda gold ɛn silva put usay yu de kip yu jɛntri.
Na wit yu bɔku sɛns we yu gɛt pan tredin yu dɔn tek ad mɔ jɛntri, so yu dɔn prawd fɔseka yu jɛntri–
So fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se; bikɔs yu tink yu sɛf se yu gɛt sɛns lɛk wan gɔd.
Wɛl, fɔseka dat, lisin, a go briŋ trenja dɛn kam pan yu, di neshɔn we wikɛd bad pas ɔl di neshɔn dɛm; ɛn dɛn go pul dɛn sɔd dɛm pan di fayn we yu sɛns fayn ɛn dɔti yu glori.
Dɛn go shub yu go dɔŋ insay di pit, ɛn yu go day lɛk aw dɛn wan we dɛn kil, day bɔtɔm bɔtɔm di si.
Yu go stil se, ‘mi na wan gɔd,’ bifo ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we kil yu, Ivin do yu na natin bɔt wan mɔtalman, ɛn nɔto nɔn gɔd, na dɛn wan dɛn an we wund yu?
Yu go day di kayn day we dɛn wan we nɔ sakɔmsayz, kin day na fɔrena dɛn an bikɔs a dɔn tɔk am, PAPA GƆD se.”
Sem we so PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
Mɔtalman siŋ bɛrin siŋ oba di Taya kiŋ, ɛn tɛl am se, na dis PAPA GƆD se: yu na bin di sil we nɔ gɛt ɛni bɔt yu gɛt bɔku bɔku sɛns ɛn yu fayn nɔ gɛt nɔn bɔt,

yu bin de na Idɛn, PAPA GƆD in gadin. Ɔl kayn prɛshɔs ston na dɛm bin kɔba yu, kanɛlyan, Topaz ɛn Jaspa, krisolayt bɛril ɛn oniks Safaya, Kabɔnkul ɛn Ɛmirald; ɛn yu ɛngrevin dɛm bin wok insay gold’ Dɛn bin rɛdi dɛm di de dɛn bin mek yu
A bin put yu wit wan Chɛrɔb we gɛt pawa fɔ gyad yu yu bin de pan PAPA GƆD in oli mawnten; yu bin de waka midul ston dɛm we gɛt faya.
Yu bin klin bay aw yu de biev frɔm di de wɛn dɛn mek yu, te bad bad wikɛdnɛs kam insay yu.

Pan aw yu tredin bin de bɔku no so bad bad bay fos fɛt bin pak pan yu ɛn yu bin wikɛd mɔ so a bin trowe yu lɛk swɛ tin kɔmɔt na PAPA GƆD in mawnten ɛn di Chɛrɔb we bin de gyad yu drɛb yu kɔmɔt pan midul di ston dɛm we gɛt faya.
Yu at bin prawd fɔseka di fayn we yu fayn; yu bin kɔrɔpt yu sɛns fɔseka yu glori a trowe yu kan dɔŋ na grɔn; a bin opin yu bifo kiŋ dɛm so dat dɛn yay go ɛnjɔy bad bad wan we dɛn de luk yu

Bay aw yu bad bad wikɛdnɛs bin dɔn bɔku as yu tredin nɔ bin tret yu nɔ bin rɛspɛkt yu sekred ples dɛm fɔ pre; so a bin briŋ faya kɔmɔt midul yu; i bɔn yu dɔn pata pata, ɛn a bin tɔn yu to asis na di wɔl bifo ɔl dɛn wan we no yu, dɛn yay.
Ɔl dɛn wan we no yu pan di difrɛn pipul dɛn bin de fred yu bad bad wan; yu ɛndin dɔn kam bi wan we de mek yu fred bad bad ɛn yu nɔ go de igen fɔrɛva ɛn ɛva.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, tɔn yu fes to Saydɔn, ɛn prɔfisay pan am se,
na dis PAPA GƆD we na Gɔd se; “Una lisin, a de agens una, O Saydɔn, ɛn a go sho mi glori midul una. Ɛn dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD wɛn a go kɛriawt jɔjmɛnt dɛm pan am, ɛn sho mi olinɛs pan am,
bikɔs a go sɛn bad bad sik we de kil insay am, ɛn blɔd pan in trit dɛm ɛn di wan we dɛm kil wit di sɔd we de agens am ɔl say go fɔdɔm insay de, na da tem de dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
“Ɛn fɔ di Izrɛl pipul, nɔn braya nɔ go de fɔ chuk dɛm, ɔ chuk chuk fɔ chuk dɛm pan ɔl dɛn neba we bin dɔn luk dɔŋ pan dɛm. Na da tɛm de dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
“PAPA GƆD se: wɛn a gɛda Izrɛl kɔmɔt to di difrɛn pipul usay dɛn skata, ɛn sho dɛm mi olinɛs bifo di neshɔn dɛn yay, na da tɛm de, dɛn go tap na dɛn yon kɔntri we a bin gi Jekɔb we na mi wokman.

Ɛn dɛn go tap de wit kolat, ɛn dɛn go bil os dɛm ɛn mek greps fam dɛm. Dɛn go de sef wan, wɛn a kɛri awt jɔjmɛnt dɛn pan ɔl dɛn neba we bin de luk dɔŋ pan dɛm. Na da tɛm de, dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd.”
Insay di nɔmba tɛn ia, pan di nɔmba twɛlv de na di nɔmba tɛn mɔnt, PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman tɔn yu fes pan Fero, Ijipt in kiŋ ɛn prɔfisay agens am ɛn agens ɔl Ijipt;
tɔk se, na dis PAPA GƆD se, “una lisin, a de agens una, Fero, Ijipt in kiŋ di pawaful dragɔn we ledɔm midul in strim wata dɛm, ɛn we de se, ‘mi nayl, na mi yon, na mi mek am.’
A go put uk dɛn na yu jɔ dɛn, ɛn mek di fish na yu wata dɛn fasin pan yu skel dɛn; ɛn go drɔ yu kɔmɔt pan midul yu wata, gi dɛm wit ɔl yu fish na yu wata dɛn we fasin pan yu skel dɛm.

Ɛn a go trowe yu go na di ples we dray ɛn natin nɔ de, yu ɛn ɔl yu fish na di wata dɛm. Yu go fɔdɔm na di opin fil, ɛn dɛn nɔ go gɛda ɛn bɛr yu. A dɔn gi yu fɔ bi it To di bist dɛn we de na grɔn, ɛn to di bɔd dɛm we de flay.
Da tɛn de, ɔl di wan dɛn na Ijipt go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD, bikɔs yu dɔn bi lɛk wan gras pol fɔ di Izrɛl pipul.
Fɔ wɛn dɛn bin ol yu traŋa wan wit dɛn an, yu bin brok ɛn chɛr ɔl dɛn sholda; ɛn wɛn dɛn bin liŋ pan yu, yu bin brok ɛn mek ɔl dɛn wes shek,
fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se; a go briŋ wan sɔd kam pan una, ɛn a go kil mɔtalman ɛn bist we de pan yu;
ɛn di Ijipt kɔntri go bi wan ɛmti ples we natin nɔ de ɛn yuslɛs. Na da tɛm de dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD. “Bikɔs yu dɔn se, ‘di nayl na mi yon, na mi mek am,
so lisin, a de agens yu, ɛn agens yu wata dɛm, ɛn a go distrɔy di Ijipt kɔntri pata pata ɛn mek am nɔ fit fɔ ɛnitin fɔ de de, frɔm Migdɔl to Sayɛnɛ, te rich Ithiopya in bɔda.
Nɔn mɔtalman in fut nɔ go mas pas insay am, ɛn nɔn bist in fut nɔ go mas pas insay am; ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de fɔ fɔti ia.

Ɛn a go mek di Ijipt kɔntri bi wan ɛmti ples we natin nɔ de, midul ɔl di ɔda ɛmti kɔntri dɛm, we natin nɔ de. Ɛn in big tɔŋ dɛm fɔ fɔti ia bi wan ɛmti ples we nɔ fit fɔ ɛnitin fɔ de de, pan di big tɔŋ dɛn we dɛn pwɛl pata pata. A go skata di Ijipt pipul pan di neshɔn dɛm, ɛn sheb sheb dɛm pan di difrɛn kɔntri dɛn.
“Bikɔs na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se, wɛn fɔti ia dɔn dɔn, a go gɛda di Ijipt pipul kɔmɔt pan ɔl di difrɛn neshɔn, usay dɛn bin skata de.
A go gi dɛn bak to di Patrɔs kɔntri di kɔntri we dɛn blant; ɛn na de dɛn go bi wan ɔmbul ɔmbul kindɔm.
I go bi di wan we ɔmbul pas ɔl pan ɔl di kindɔm; ɛn i nɔ go ɛva es insɛf ɔp pantap di neshɔn dɛn; ɛn a go mek dɛn so ɔmbul dat dɛn nɔ go nɛva ɛva rul igen oba di neshɔn dɛm.
Ɛn in go nɛva ɛva bi di Izrɛl pipul dɛn abop igen, ɛn dɛn de mɛmba dɛn bad bad wikɛdnɛs fɔ wɛn dɛn kiŋ tɔn to am fɔ ep dɛm. Na datɛnde dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
Insay di nɔmba twɛnti-sɛvin ia, pan di fɔs de na di fɔs mɔnt, PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:

“Mɔtalman, Nɛbyukadnɛza, Babilɔn in kiŋ bin mek in ami man dɛn fɛt traŋa wan agens Taya; dɛn bin shayn ɔl di man ed, ɛn skin ɔl man dɛn sholda; stil, in ɛn in ami man dɛn nɔ bin gɛt ɛni pe fɔ sho fɔ di fɛt we i bin dɔn fɛt agens Taya.

Fɔseka dis ya, na dis PAPA GƆD se: Una lisin, a go gi di Ijipt kɔntri to Nɛbyukadnɛza, Babilɔn in kiŋ; ɛn i go kɛr go ɔl Ijipt in richis, ɛn i go tif am, ɛn klɛa am. Ɛn na dɛn wande go bi in amiman dɛn pe.
A dɔn gi Nɛbyukadnɛza di Ijipt kɔntri as in pe we i wok fɔ bikɔs na mi dɛn bin de wok fɔ, na so PAPA GƆD se.
Na da de de, a go mek wan ɔn gro kɔmɔt pan di Izrɛl pipul, ɛn a go opin yu mɔt midul dɛm. Na da tɛm de dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, prɔfisay ɛn se, Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: “Ala kray big wan se, ‘Una fred da de de!’
Bikɔs di de dɔn kan nia, PAPA GƆD in de dɔn nia. I go bi wande we go ful wit klawd dɛm, di tɛm fɔ jɔjmɛnt pan di neshɔn dɛm.
Wan sɔd go kam pan Ijipt ɛn bad bad sɔfrin go de na Ithiopya wɛn di wan dɛn we dɛn go kil, fɔdɔm na Ijipt, ɛn wɛn dɛn go kɛr ɔl in richis go, ɛn dɛn brok kam dɔŋ in fawndeshɔn dɛm.
Ithiopia ɛn Put ɛn Lɔd ɛn ɔl Arebya ɛn Libia, ɛn di pipul dɛn we bin jɔyn an, go fɔdɔm wit am, bay di sɔd.
“Na dis PAPA GƆD se dɛn wan dɛn we de fɔ Ijipt go fɔdɔm, ɛn in pawa we i prawd bɔt, go kam dɔn; frɔm Midɔl to Sayrini dɛn go fɔdɔm insay am bay di sɔd na so PAPA GƆD se.
Ɛn i go bi wan ɛmti ples we natin nɔ de, midul Ɔl di ɔda kɔntri dɛm we ɛmti natin nɔ de ɛn in big siti dɛn go de midul di ɔda big siti dɛm we dɔn pwɛl bad bad ɛn ɛmti
Na da tɛm de dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD, di tɛm we a go dɔn layt faya na Ijipt ɛn ɔl dɛn wan we ɛp am dɔn brok kan dɔŋ.

Da de de mɛsenja dɛn we dɔn rɔn wit bad bad spid go kɔmɔt frɔm mi ɛn go fɔ mek fred ful di Ithiopya pipul di tɛm we dɛn nɔ de tink am; ɛn bad bad sɔfrin go fɔdɔm pan dɛm di de fɔ Ijipt in jɔjmɛnt; bikɔs fɔ tru tru i de kam!
Na dis PAPA GƆD se: a de kam tap Ijipt in richis bay Nɛbyukadnɛza in an, Babilɔn in kiŋ

In ɛn in pipul wit am, we dɛn na di neshɔn we wikɛd bad bad pas ɔl Dɛn go briŋ an kam insay di kɔntri fɔ pwɛl am pata pata ɛn dɛn go pul dɛn sɔd agens Ijipt, ɛn ful di kɔntri wit di wan dɛn we dɛn kil.

Ɛn a go dray di nayl ɛn a go sel di kɔntri gi to ivil mɔtalman dɛn an ɛn a go briŋ kam pan di kɔntri ɛn ɔl wetin de insay am, ɛmtinɛs we natin nɔ go de atɔl bay fɔrena dɛn an; na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk am.
“Na dis PAPA GƆD se: A go pwɛl pata pata di lay lay gɔd dɛm ɛn a go kam tap di imej dɛn, we de na Mɛmfis; nɔn kiŋ nɔ go de na di Ijipt kɔntri igen; ɛn na so a go mek fred fred de na di Ijipt kɔntri.
A go mek Patrɔs bi wan ɛmti ples we natin nɔ fit fɔ de ɛn a go layt faya na Zoan, ɛn a go kɛriawt jɔjmɛnt akshɔn dɛn pan Tibs.
Ɛn a go tɔn mi vɛks lɛk wata, pan Pɛlusiɔm, we na Ijipt in pawaful ples, ɛn a go kil Tibs in bɔku bɔku pipul.
Ɛn a go layt faya na Ijipt Pɛlusiɔm go de pan dip dip pen! Dɛn go brok go insay Tibs ɛn in wɔl dɛn go brok kam dɔŋ.
Di sɔd nain go kil di yɔŋ man dɛn na Ɔn ɛn Pibesɛt ɛn dɛn go kech di uman dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn go as prizina.
Di de go dak na Teafɛnɛz, di tɛm we a go brok Ijipt dɛn kɔntrolpan Tefaniz, ɛn in prawd pawa go dɔn, klawd nain go kɔba am ɛn dɛn go kech in gyal pikin dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛm go as prizina.
Na so a go kɛri awt jɔjmɛnt pan Ijipt. Na da tɛm de dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
Insay di nɔmba ilɛvin ia, pan di sɛvin de na di fɔs mɔnt, PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“mɔtalman, a dɔn brok Fero, Ijipt in kiŋ, in an. Ɛn fɔ tru tru, dɛn nɔ tay am yet wit bandej we nain go mek i wɛl, so dat i go gɛt trɛnk fɔ andul di sɔd.
Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se: Una lisin, a de agens Fero, Ijipt in kiŋ, ɛn a go brok ɔl tu in an dɛn, di wan we gɛt trɛnk, ɛn di wan we bin dɔn brok; ɛn a go mek di sɔd fɔdɔm kɔmɔt nain an.
A go skata di Ijipt pipul na di neshɔn dɛm, ɛn sheb sheb dɛm ɔlsay na di difrɛn kɔntri dɛm.
Ɛn a go gi di Babilɔn kiŋ trɛnk nain an dɛm, ɛn put mi sɔd nain an; bɔt a go brok Fero in an dɛm. Ɛn i go pini dip wan bifo am, lɛk pɔsin we de day.
A go gi di Babilɔn kiŋ trɛnk nain an dɛm, bɔt Fero in an dɛm go fɔdɔm ɛn dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD. Wɛn a put mi sɔd na di Babilɔn kiŋ in an, i go tret am pan di Ijipt kɔntri.
Ɛn a go skata di Ijipt pipul pan di neshɔn dɛm ɛn sheb sheb dɛm ɔlsay na di difrɛn difrɛn kɔntri dɛm. Na da tɛm de dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
Insay di ilɛvin ia, pan di fɔs de na di tɔd mɔnt, PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
Mɔtalman, tɛl Fero, Ijipt in kiŋ, ɛn in bɔku bɔku pipul, se: udat una fiba pan di pawa we una gɛt?
Una lisin, a go kɔmpia una to wan sida tik na Libanɔn, we gɛt fayn an dɛm ɛn bɔku shed lɛk bɔku tik na fɔrɛst, dɛn yon ɛn i bin ay bad bad wan; in pantap bin rich na di klawd dɛn.

Di wata dɛn bin mek i rɔju di dip si wata bin mek i gro laŋa laŋa wan, as i de mek in riva wata dɛn de rɔn rawnd di ples we dɛn plant am, ɛn i de sɛn in strim wata dɛn go pan ɔl di tik dɛn na di fɔrɛst
So i bin gro ay ay wan, lɛk tawa, oba ɔl di tik dɛn na di fɔrɛst in tik tik an dɛn bin gro big mɔ ɛn in smɔl an dɛn bin laŋa laŋa bikɔs in shut dɛn bin gɛt bɔku bɔku wata
Ɔl di bɔd dɛn na di ia bin mek dɛn os pan in tik tik an dɛn; ɛn ɔnda in smɔl an dɛn, ɔl dɛn bist na di fil bin de bɔn dɛn pikin; ɛn na pan in shed ɔl dɛn pawaful neshɔn bin tap.
I bin fayn fɔ tru tru pan in pawa ɛn bay aw in an dɛn bin laŋa laŋa; bikɔs in rut dɛn bin go dɔŋ dɔŋ go rich bɔku bɔku wata

Di sida tik dɛn na PAPA GƆD in gadin nɔ bin ebul fɔ rayval wit am ɛn na so di fa tik dɛn nɔ kyant in tik tik an dɛm. Di plen tik dɛn na bin natin to in smɔl an dɛn; nɔn tik na PAPA GƆD in gadin nɔ bin fayn rich am.
A bin mek i fayn pas mak wit di bɔku bɔku an dɛn we i gɛt ɛn ɔl dɛn tik dɛm na Idɛn bin de jɛlɔs am, we dɛn ɔl bin de na PAPA GƆD in gadin.
Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se, bikɔs i bin ay ay lek tawa ɛn i bin mek in pantap de na di klawd dɛm; ɛn in at bin prawd bikɔs i ay bad bad wan,
a go gi an to wan pan di neshɔn dɛn we, pawaful bad bad, in an; ɛn fɔ tru tru i go dil wit am as to aw i bin wikɛd. A dɔ trowe an na do.

Fɔrena dɛm, dɛn wan we wikɛd bad bad pas ɔl di neshɔn dɛm, go kɔt an kam dɔŋ ɛn lɛf am. In an dɛn go fɔdɔm na di mawnten dɛn ɛn na ɔl di vali dɛm, ɛn in tiktik an dɛm go lidɔm brok brok wan pan ɔl di say we wata dɛn de pas na di kɔntri; ɛn ɔl di difrɛn pipul na di wɔl go kɔmɔt pan in shed ɛn lɛf am.
Ɔl dɛn bɔd we de flay go tap pan in pwɛl pwɛl broko broko wan, ɛn ɔl di bist na di fil go tap pan in an dɛm.

Ɔl dis na fɔ mek nɔn tik we de na di watasay dɛn go gro ay ay, lɔfti wan, igen ɔ mek in pantap de na di klawd dɛm; ɛn nɔn tik we de drink wata nɔ go gro ay wan rich dɛm; fɔ dɛn dɔn gi dɛn ɔl fɔ day go na di ɔnda wɔl de wit mɔtalman dɛm, wit dɛn wan we de go dɔŋ na di pit.

Na dis PAPA GƆD se: wɛn I go go dɔŋ na Shiɔl, I go mek di si kray bad bad wan fɔ am, ɛn mek i ol in riva wata dɛn, ɛn bɔku bɔku wata nɔ go flo; a go mek Libanɔn wɛr munin fɔ am, ɛn ɔl di tik dɛn na di fil go fent fɔseka am.

A go mek di neshɔn dɛn trimbul wɛn dɛn yɛri di sawnd we go mek wɛn i fɔdɔm, wɛn a go trowe am kam dɔŋ na Shiɔl wit dɛn wan we de go dɔŋ na di pit; ɛn ɔl di tik dɛn na Idɛn Libanɔn in spɛshal ɛn bɛst wan dɛn, ɔl di wan dɛn we de drink wata, go gɛt kol at na di ɔnda wɔl.
Dɛn sɛf go go dɔŋ wit am na Shiɔl, to dɛn wan we sɔd kil; yɛri, dɛn wan we bin tap nain shed pan di neshɔn dɛm, go day pata.

So na us wan yu fiba fɔ glori ɛn impɔtant pan di tik dɛn na Idɛn? Dɛn go briŋ yu kam dɔŋ wit di tik dɛn na Idɛn na di ɔndawɔl; yu go ledɔm de, wit dɛn wan we nɔ sakɔmsayz, wit dɛn wan we sɔd kil. “Dis na Fɛro wit ɔl in krawd dɛn. Na so PAPA GƆD se.”
Insay di twɛlv ia, pan di fɔs de na di twɛlv mɔnt, PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:

“Mɔtalman in bɔypikin, siŋ wan berin siŋ oba Ijipt in kiŋ Fero ɛn se: “yu tink yusɛf se yu na layɔn pan di neshɔn dɛm, bɔt yu na lɛk wan aligeta na di si wata; yu bɔs kɔmɔt na yu riva wata dɛm, miks miks di wata dɛm wit yu fut dɛn, ɛn dɔti, te i smɛl, dɛn riva wata.
Wɛl na dis PAPA GƆD se: a go sɛn mi nɛt oba yu wit bɔku bɔku difrɛn pipul; ɛn a go drɛg yu kam ɔp na mi dragnɛt.
Ɛn a go trowe yu na grɔn, na di opin fil a go fliŋ yu, ɛn a go mek ɔl di bɔd dɛn we de flay sidɔm pan yu, ɛn a go mek di bist dɛn na di wanol wɔl it gridi gridi wan pan yu
A go skata skata yu flɛsh pan di mawnten dɛm, ɛn ful di vali dɛn wit yu dedebɔdi
A go sok di kɔntri gud gud wan, te go ɔp to di mawnten dɛm, wit yu blɔd we go rɔn lɛk wata; ɛn di say dɛn we wata de pas go ful wit yu.
Wɛn a wep yu kɔmɔt, a go kɔba di ɛvin dɛm, ɛn mek di sta dɛm dak; a go kɔba di san wit wan klawd, ɛn di mun sɛf nɔ go shayn
Ɔl ɛvin in brayt layt dɛm a go mek dɛn dak oba yu, ɛn a go put daknɛs na yu kɔntri, Na so PAPA GƆD se.
A go mek bɔku difrɛn pipul dɛn at pwɛl, wɛn a go kech yu, kɛr yu go pan di neshɔn dɛn, as prizina, insay kɔntri dɛn we yu nɔ sabi.

A go mek bɔku difrɛn pipul shɔk bad bad wan we dɛn si yu, ɛn dɛn kiŋ dɛn go trimbul bad bad wit fred fɔseka yu, wɛn a go pas pas mi sɔd bifo dɛm; dɛn go trimbul ɔl di tɛm, wan bay wan, fɔ in yon layf, di de we yu go fɔdɔm.
Fɔ na dis PAPA GƆD se: di Babilɔn kiŋ in sɔd go kam pan una.
A go mek una bɔku bɔku day bay di pawaful neshɔn dɛn sɔd, ɔl dɛn neshɔn we wikɛd bad bad pas ɔl di ɔda neshɔn dɛm. “Dɛn go briŋ kan Ijipt in prawd to natin, ɛn ɔl in bɔku bɔku pipul dɛn go day.
A go kil ɔl in bist dɛm we de na bɔku wata say dɛm, ɛn nɔn mɔtalman nɔ go ambɔgin dɛm igen igen, ɛn na so nɔn bist in sus go ambɔgin dɛm.
Dɛn a go klin dɛn wata ɛn mek dɛn riva wata rɔn lɛk ɔyl, PAPA GƆD tɔk se.

Wɛn a go mek Ijipt kɔntri wan ɛmti ples we natin ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de ɛn wɛn dɛn go dɔn pul ɔl tin, kɔmɔt we ful di kɔntri, ɛn wɛn a go dɔn kil ɔl dɛn wan we tap de, na datɛnde, dɛn go no se mi na PAPA GƆD.
Dis na di bɛrin siŋ we dɛn go de siŋ; dɛn neshɔn gyal pikin dɛm go siŋ am; ɛn dɛn go siŋ oba Ijipt, ɛn oba ɔl in bɔku bɔku krawd, PAPA GƆD tɔk se.
Insay di twɛlv ia, pan di fiftin de na di fɔs mɔnt, PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, kray lawd wan oba Ijipt in bɔku bɔku krawd, ɛn sɛn dɛn, in ɛn di rɔyal neshɔn dɛm ɛn dɛn gyal pikin go dɔŋ na di ɔndawɔl, to dɛn wan we dɔn go dɔŋ insay di Pit
‘na udat yu fayn pas bad bad wan? Go dɔŋ ɛn go lidɔm wit dɛn wan we nɔ sakɔmsayz
Dɛn go fɔdɔm midul dɛn wan we sɔd kil, ɛn ɔl in bɔku bɔku krawd go lidɔm wit am.
Dɛn pawaful chif go tɔk na Shiɔl bɔt dɛm, ɛn sɛf bɔt di wan dɛn we de ɛp dɛm, di wan dɛm we nɔ sakɔmsayz, we dɛn kil wit sɔd, se: ‘dɛn dɔn kam dɔŋ, dɛn lidɔm ɛn nɔ de shek at ɔl.’
“Asiria, ɛn ɔl in krawd, de de, ɔl di wan we sɔd kil, dɛn grev dɛn de rawnd am.

Ɛn dɛn grev dɛn de na di say dɛn we fa pas ɔl na di pit; ɛn in krawd dɛn de rawnd in grev; dɛn kil dɛn ɔl, di sɔd nain mek dɛm fɔdɔm, dɛn we bin de prɛd bɔku bɔku fred fred na di kɔntri, usay dɛn wan we de livin tap.

Ɛlam ɛn ɔl in bɔku bɔku krawd we de rawnd in grev, de de; dɛn kil dɛn ɔl, di sɔd nain ib dɛn dɔŋ, ɛn dɛn nɔ bin sakɔmsayz we go dɔŋ na di ɔnda wɔl, bikɔs dɛn bin de prɛd bɔku bɔku fred fred na di kɔntri we di livin tap. Ɛn dɛn de bia dɛn shem wit dɛn wan we go dɔŋ na di pit.

Dɛn dɔn mek wan grev fɔ am wit di wan dɛn we dɛn kil, wit ɔl in bɔku bɔku krawd, dɛn grev dɛn de rawnd am, ɛn dɛn ɔl nɔ sakɔmsayz; di sɔd nain kil dɛm; fɔ di bɔku bɔku fred we dɛn de fred dɛm, bin dɔn prɛd na di kɔntri we di livin dɛn tap, ɛn dɛn de bia dɛn shem wit dɛn wan we go dɔŋ na di pit; dɛn put dɛn wit dɛn wan we dɛn kil.
“Mɛshɛk ɛn Tubal de de, ɛn ɔl dɛn bɔku bɔku krawd, dɛn grev dɛn de rawnd am ɛn dɛn ɔl nɔ sakɔmsayz, di sɔd nain kil dɛm bikɔs dɛn prɛd bɔku bɔku fred fred na di kɔntri we di livin dɛn tap.

Ɛn dɛn nɔ lidɔm wit dɛn pawaful lɔntɛm man dɛm we bin dɔn fɔdɔm ɛn go dɔŋ na shiɔl wit di wɛpɔn dɛm we dɛn bin de tek fɛt na wa; ɛn udat, dɛn bin put dɛn sɔd dɛn ɔnda dɛn ed, ɛn dɛn shild dɛm bin de pan dɛm bon bon; bikɔs di bɔku fred we dɛn bin de fred di pawaful man dɛm bin de na di kɔntri usay dɛn wan, we de livin, dɛn tap.
Na so dɛn go brok yu dɔŋ ɛn yu go lidɔm wit dɛn wan we nɔ sakɔmsayz, wit dɛn wan we sɔd kil.
Idɔm de de, in kiŋ dɛm ɛn ɔl di kiŋ dɛm, udat wit ɔl dɛn pawa, lidɔm wit dɛn wan we sɔd kil; dɛn ledɔm wit di wan dɛm we nɔ sakɔmsayz, wit dɛn wan we go dɔŋ na di pit.

Di kiŋ dɛn na di Nɔt, de de, dɛn ɔl ɛn di Sidonian, we dɔn go dɔŋ wit shem wit di wan dɛm we dɛn kil, fɔseka ɔl di bɔku bɔku fred fred we dɛn mek bi wit dɛn pawa, ɛn dɛn nɔ sakɔmsayz, dɛn lidɔm wit dɛn wan we di sɔd kil, ɛn dɛn bia dɛn shem wit dɛn wan we go dɔŋ na di pit.
Wɛn Fero go si dɛm, i go kɔrej insɛf fɔ ɔl in bɔku bɔku krawd, fero ɛn ɔl in soja man, PAPA GƆD tɔk se.

Bikɔs i prɛd bɔku bɔku fred dɛm na di say we mɔtalman dɛn de; fɔseka dat, dɛn go le am wit di wan dɛn we nɔ sakɔmsayz, wit dɛn wan we dɛn kil wit sɔd, Fero ɛn ɔl in bɔku bɔku pipul dɛm. Na so PAPA GƆD we na Gɔd se.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“mɔtalman, tɔk to yu pipul ɛn tɛl dɛn se, if a briŋ di sɔd kam pan di kɔntri, ɛn di pipul na di kɔntri tek wan man pan dɛm, ɛn mek am wachman,
ɛn if i si di sɔd de kam pan di kɔntri ɛn i blo di trɔmpɛt ɛn wɔn di pipul;
dɛn if ɛni wan we yɛri di trɔmpɛt in sawnd ɛn i nɔ lisin, ɛn di sɔd kam ɛn tek am go in blɔd go de pan in yon ed.
I bin yɛri di trɔmpɛt in sawnd, ɛn i nɔ lisin, in blɔd go de pan insɛf. Bɔt if i bin tek wɔnin i bin fɔ sev in layf.

Bɔt if di wachman si di sɔd de kam, ɛn i nɔ blo di trɔmpɛt, so dat i wɔn di pipul, ɛn di sɔd kam, ɛn tek ɛni wan pan an dɛm; i go tek da man de pan in bad bad wikɛdnɛs, bɔt a go aks fɔ in blɔd na di wachman in an.
So yu mɔtalman, a dɔn mek yu wachman fɔ Izrɛl pipul; ɛnitɛm we yu yɛri wɔd frɔm mi, yu go gi dɛn mi wɔnin.

If a se to di wikɛd man, O wikɛd man, yu go day fɔ tru tru, ɛn yu nɔ tɔk fɔ wɔn di wikɛd man fɔ lɛ i chenj pan in wikɛdnɛs, da wikɛd man de, go day pan in bad bad wikɛdnɛs, bɔt a go aks fɔ in blɔd na yu an.
Bɔt if yu wɔn di wikɛd man fɔ chenj pan in wikɛdnɛs ɛn i nɔ tɔn frɔm in wikɛdnɛs, i go day pan in bad bad wikɛdnɛs, bɔt yu go dɔn sev yu layf.
“Ɛn yu mɔtalman in bɔypikin, tɔk to di Izrɛl pipul se, na dis una bin se: wi bad tin dɛn we wi de du, ɛn wi wikɛdnɛs dɛn, de pan wi, ɛn wi de day slo wan fɔseka dɛm; so aw wi go ebul fɔ liv?’

Tɛl dɛn se, as a de livin, PAPA GƆD se, a nɔ de gladi wɛn di wikɛd day, bɔt a go gladi if di wikɛd chenj pan in we ɛn so i go liv; una tɔn bak, tɔn bak frɔm una ivil we dɛm; fɔ wetin fɔ mek una day, O Izrɛl pipul?

Ɛn yu, mɔtalman, tɔk to yu pipul se, di wan we de waka tret, in tret we i de waka nɔ go sev am wɛn i du bad; ɛn as fɔ di wikɛdnɛs we di wikɛd de du, i nɔ go fɔdɔm fɔseka di wikɛdnɛs, wɛn i go dɔn chenj pan am; ɛn di wan we de waka tret nɔ go ebul fɔ liv fɔseka aw i bin de waka tret fɔs tɛm, bifo i du wikɛdnɛs dɛm.

Ivin do a se to di wan we de waka tret, dat i go liv fɔ tru tru, stil if i ɛng pan in tret we i de waka, dɔn i go du bad bad wikɛdnɛs, dɛn nɔ go mɛmba nɔn pan in gud dɛn, we i bin de waka tret; bɔt i go day pan di bad bad wikɛdnɛs we i dɔn du.
Efen, ivin do a se to di wikɛd, ‘yu go day fɔ tru tru’ stil if i chenj pan in wikɛdnɛs ɛn du wetin rayt ɛn wetin di lɔ se,
if di wikɛd gi bak di plɛj ɛn wetin i bin dɔn tif, ɛn i waka bay di lɔ dɛn we de gi layf, ɛn i nɔ de du ɛni bad bad wikɛdnɛs; fɔ tru tru, i go liv, i nɔ go day.
Dɛn nɔ go mɛmba, agens am, nɔn pan di wikɛd tin dɛn we i bin dɔn du; i dɔn du wetin di lɔ se ɛn wetin rayt, so fɔ tru tru, i go liv.
“Stil yu pipul dɛn se, ‘PAPA GƆD in we nɔ tret; wɛn na dɛn yon we nɔ tret.
Wɛn di wan we de waka tret chenj pan di tret we i bin de waka, ɛn du bad bad wikɛdnɛs, i go day fɔ dat.
Ɛn wɛn di wikɛd chenj pan in wikɛdnɛs, ɛn du wetin di lɔ se ɛn we rayt, i go liv fɔseka dat.
Stil, una se, ‘PAPA GƆD in we nɔ tret.’ O Izrɛl pipul, a go jɔj una wan bay wan, fɔseka una we dɛm.”
Insay di twɛlv ia, pan wi ɛgzayl, pan di fayv de na di tɛn mɔnt, wan man we rɔnawe frɔm Jerusɛlɛm, bin kam to mi ɛn se “Di big siti dɔn fɔdɔm.”
Da tɛm de PAPA GƆD in an bin de pan mi, di ivintɛm bifo di rɔnawe bin kam; ɛn bay di tɛm di man bin kam to mi na mɔnin, PAPA GƆD bin dɔn opin mi mɔt; so mi mɔt bin opin; ɛn a nɔ bin mumu igen
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se: Mɔtalman,

Dɛn wan we tap na dɛn yuslɛs ples dɛm, na Izrɛl kɔntri, de tɔk tɔk se, ‘Ebraam na bin wangren man, stil i bin ebul fɔ mek di kɔntri in yon; bɔt wi bɔku, dɛn dɔn gi wi di kɔntri fɔ tru tru fɔ lɛ wi tek am fɔ wi yon.’
Fɔseka dat, tɛl dɛn se, na dis PAPA GƆD se: Wɛn una de it bif wit in blɔd pan am, ɛn de es una yay to una lay lay gɔd dɛm, ɛn de mek blɔd flo; di kɔntri go bi una yon?
Una go bak to di sɔd, una de du dɛn wikɛd tin dɛn we de briŋ etrɛd ɛn bad bad fred fred ɛn ich wan pan una de dɔti in neba wɛf; di kɔntri go bi una yon?

Tɛl dɛm dis ɛn se, na dis PAPA GƆD se: as a de livin, fɔ tru tru, dɛn wan we de na di ɛmti yuslɛs ples dɛm go fɔdɔm bay di sɔd; ɛn di wan we de na di opin fil, a go gi to dɛn bist fɔ it awaŋɔt wan; ɛn dɛn wan we de na say dɛn we sef gud gud wan, ɛn we de insay kev dɛm, ɔl go day wit bad bad sik we de kil.
Ɛn a go mek di kɔntri wan ples we nɔbɔdi ɛn natin nɔ de ɛn we yuslɛs; ɛn in prawd pawa go dɔn pata; ɛn Izrɛl in mawnten dɛm go so pwɛl pata pata wan dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go pas de
na datɛnde, dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD wɛn a go dɔn mek di kɔntri, ples we nɔbɔdi ɛn natin nɔ de ɛn we yuslɛs fɔseka ɔl dɛn wikɛd tin dɛn we de briŋ etrɛd ɛn bad bad fred fred, we dɛn dɔn du.
“As fɔ yu mɔtalman, yu pipul we de kongosa yu nia di wɔl dɛn ɛn na dɛn os domɔt ɛn de se to dɛnsɛf, wan wan to in brɔda, ‘kam yɛri wetin na di wɔd we de kɔmɔt to PAPA GƆD.’
Ɛn dɛn kam to yu lɛk aw pipul dɛn kin kam, ɛn dɛn sidɔm bifo yu lɛk mi yon pipul, ɛn dɛn yɛri wetin yu se bɔt dɛn nɔ go du am; fɔ dɛn de sho bɔku lɔv wit dɛn mɔt bɔt dɛn at fasin pan dɛn prɔfit.
Ɛn fɔ tru, yu tan to dɛm lɛk wan we de siŋ wit fayn fayn vɔys, lɔv siŋ dɛm, ɛn de ple gud gud wan pan myuzik instrumɛnt, bikɔs dɛn de yɛri wetin yu se, bɔt dɛn nɔ go du am.
Wɛn dis go bi – ɛn i go kam fɔ tru tru! – Na da tɛn de dɛn go no se wan prɔfɛt bin de wit dɛm.”
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, prɔfisay agens di Izrɛl shɛpad dɛm, prɔfisay ɛn se to dɛm, na dis PAPA GƆD se: Ivin to di shɛpad dɛm, O Izrɛl shɛpad dɛm we bin jɛs di fid unasɛf? Nɔ to di ship dɛn shɛpad dɛn fɔ fid?
Na yu de it di bɛst say dɛm, una de tek di wul dɛn mek klos fɔ unasɛf, una de kil bɔku di fat fat ship, bɔt una nɔ de fid di ship dɛm.

Una nɔ mek di wik wan dɛn gɛt trɛnk; una nɔ mɛn di wan dɛn we sik; una nɔ bandej di wan dɛn we kripul; di wan dɛn we bin stre una nɔ briŋ dɛn bak; di wan dɛn we lɔs una nɔ fɛn dɛm, ɛn una bin rul di ship dɛm rɔf wan ɛn bay fos.
So dɛn bin skata skata bikɔs nɔn shɛpad nɔ bin de; ɛn dɛn bin kam bi it fɔ dɛn wayl bist dɛn.
Mi ship dɛn bin skata skata, dɛn bin de drif oba ɔl di mawnten dɛn ɛn pan ɔl di ay il; mi ship dɛn bin skata skata oba ɔl say pan di wɔl ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ bin sach ɔ luk fɔ dɛm.
“Fɔseka dat, una shɛpad dɛm, una yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd:

As a de livin, PAPA GƆD se, bikɔs mi ship dɛn dɔn kam bi bif fɔ it, ɛn mi ship dɛn dɔn kam bi bif fɔ ɔl di wayl bist dɛm, bikɔs nɔn shɛpad nɔ bin de; ɛn bikɔs mi shɛpad dɛn nɔ bin sach fɔ mi ship dɛm, bɔt di shɛpad dɛn bin dɔn fid dɛnsɛf, ɛn nɔ bin fid mi ship dɛn;
fɔseka dat, una shɛpad dɛn, una yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd:

Una lisin, a de agens di shɛpad dɛn; ɛn a go aks fɔ mi ship dɛn nain an, ɛn a go tap dɛn fɔ fid di ship dɛn; di shɛpad dɛn nɔ go fid dɛnsɛf igen igen A go sev mi ship dɛn pan dɛn mɔt, so dat dɛn nɔ go bi it fɔ dɛm.
Fɔ na dis PAPA GƆD se: Una lisin, mi, misɛf, sɛf, go sach fɔ mi ship dɛn. Ɛn a go luk ɔl say fɔ dɛm.

Lɛk we shɛpad kin luk ɔlsay fɔ in ship dɛn we sɔm kin dɔn skata ɔlsay, na so a go luk ɔlsay fɔ mi ship dɛm; ɛn a go sev dɛm pan ɔl di ples dɛm we dɛn bin dɔn skata go, insay wande, we go gɛt klawd dɛn ɛn tik daknɛs.

Ɛn a go briŋ dɛn kɔmɔt pan di difrɛn difrɛn pipul, ɛn gɛda dɛn frɔm di difrɛn, difrɛn kɔntri ɛn a go briŋ dɛn kam na dɛn yon kɔntri; ɛn a go fid dɛm na di Izrɛl mawnten dɛm, bay di fawnten dɛm, ɛn na ɔl di say we pipul dɛn tap na di kɔntri.

A go fid dɛn wit rich gras, ɛn dɛn rich gras ya go de pantap Izrɛl ay mawnten dɛm; na de dɛn go lidɔm na di ples we gɛt gud gud gras fɔ it, ɛn dɛn go fid pan di gud rich gras pan di Izrɛl mawnten dɛm.
Misɛf sɛf nain go bi mi ship dɛn shɛpad, ɛn na mi go mek dɛn lidɔm. PAPA GƆD tɔk se.

A go luk fɔ di wan dɛn we lɔs, ɛn a go briŋ kam bak di wan we stre, ɛn a go mɛn dɛn wan we kripul, ɛn a go mek di wik dɛn gɛt trɛnk, ɛn a go wach gud gud wan di wan dɛm we fat ɛn di wan dɛm we gɛt trɛnk; ɛn a go fid dɛn di rayt we.
As fɔ ɔl mi ship; na dis PAPA GƆD se: una lisin, a go jɔj bitwin ship ɛn ship, manship dɛm ɛn mangot dɛm.
I nɔ du fɔ una fɔ fid pan di rich gras nɔmɔ, bɔt una fɔ mas mas dɔŋ wit una fut dɛn di balans we lɛf pan una gras; ɛn fɔ drink pan di klin wata, una fɔ dɔti di balans wit una fut?
Ɛn mi ship dɛn fɔ it wetin una dɔn mas mas wit una fut dɛm, ɛn drink wetin una dɔn dɔti wit una fut dɛm, te i smɛl?
“Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD tɛl dɛm, misɛf sɛf go jɔj bitwin di fat ship ɛn di dray ship.
Bikɔs una de tek una sayd ɛn sholda dɛn de push push, dɛn shɔb ɔl di wik wan wit una ɔn dɛm, te una skata dɛm go ɔlsay.
I go sev ɔl mi ship, dɛn nɔ go bi bif fɔ it igen igen: ɛn a go jɔj bitwin ship ɛn ship.
Ɛn a go put wan shɛpad, mi savant Devid, oba dɛm: ɛn i go fid dɛm; i go fid dɛm ɛn bi dɛn shɛpad.
Ɛn mi PAPA GƆD, go bi dɛn PAPA GƆD, ɛn mi savant Devid go bi kiŋ midul dɛm; na mi, PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk am.
A go mek wan pis Kɔvinant wit dɛm ɛn a go drɛb wayl bist dɛm kɔmɔt na di kɔntri so dat dɛn go tap sef wan, na di wayd wayd ples we ɛmti ɛn natin nɔ de, ɛn slip sɛf wan na di fɔrɛs dɛm.
Ɛn a go mek dɛm ɛn di ples dɛn rawnd mi il bi wan blɛsin; ɛn a go mek ren fɔdɔm ren sizin tɛm; ɛn i go bi blɛsin ren.

Ɛn di tik dɛn na di fil go bia frut dɛm ɛn bɔku tin dɛn go gro na grɔn, ɛn dɛn go sef na dɛn kɔntri; ɛn dɛn go no se na mi na di PAPA GƆD, wɛn a go brok di ayɛn ba dɛm pan wetin chok dɛn, ɛn sev dɛn frɔm dɛn wan dɛn an, we mek dɛn slev;
dɛn nɔ go bi bif fɔ it igen igen to di neshɔn dɛm, ɛn na so di bist dɛm na di kɔntri nɔ go it dɛm awaŋɔt wan; dɛn go tap sef sef wan ɛn natin nɔ go mek dɛn fred.
Ɛn a go mek fɔ dɛm, fam dɛm we de flɔrish, so dat aŋri nɔ go kil dɛm igen igen na di kɔntri ɛn dɛn nɔ go gɛt fɔ bia ɛni disgres frɔm di neshɔn dɛm igen igen
Ɛn dɛn go no se, na mi we na PAPA GƆD, de wit dɛm, ɛn dat na dɛm, di Izrɛl pipul, na mi yon pipul, PAPA GƆD tɔk se.
Ɛn una na mi ship, di ship we de na mi ples we gɛt rich gras, ɛn na mi na una PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD tɔk se.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“mɔtalman, tɔn yu fes to Mawnt Seir ɛn prɔfisay agens am,
ɛn tɛl am se, PAPA GƆD se: una lisin, a de agens yu Mawnt Seir, ɛn a go tret mi an pan yu, ɛn a go mek yu bi wan ples we nɔbɔdi ɛn natin nɔ de.
A go nyakanyaka una siti dɛn ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap de ɛn una go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
Bikɔs una lɛk fɔ bi pipul dɛn ɛnimi ɔltɛm ɛn una mek dɛn kil kil di Izrɛlayt dɛn di tɛm we wahala bin mit dɛn, di tɛm we dɛn bin de tek dɛn las pɔnishmɛnt;
so PAPA GƆD we na GƆD se, wans mi de, a go rɛdi una fɔ blɔd ɛn blɔd go rɔnata una; bikɔs una gilti fɔ blɔd, so blɔd go rɔnata una.
A go nyakanyaka Mawnt Sɛir ɛn mek nɔbɔdi nɔ tap de; a go mek nɔbɔdi nɔ kam ɛn go de.
Ɛn a go ful yu mawnten dɛm wit di wan dɛn we dɛn kil; dɛn wan we dɛn kil wit di sɔd go fɔdɔm na yu il dɛn, ɛn insay yu vali dɛm ɛn insay ɔl yu dip dip naro vali dɛm.
A go mek yu bi wan ples we nɔbɔdi ɛn natin go de, te go, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap na yu big siti dɛm. Dɛn yu go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
Bikɔs yu bin se, ‘dɛn tu neshɔn ya ɛn dɛn tu kɔntri ya, go bi mi yon, ɛn wi go mek dɛn wi yon’ - ivin de PAPA GƆD bin dede-
Fɔseka dat, as a de livin, PAPA GƆD se, a go dil wit yu bay di vɛksteshɔn ɛn jɛlɔs we yu bin sho pan di etrɛd we yu gɛt fɔ dɛm. Ɛn misɛf go mek una no mi pan unasɛf, wɛn a jɔj una.
Ɛn una go no se na mi PAPA GƆD, bin dɔn yɛri ɔl di kɔs we yu bin kɔs di Izrɛl mawnten dɛn se, ‘dɛn dɔn lɛf ɛmti natin ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de de, so dɛn dɔn gi wi fɔ lɛ wi it am awaŋɔt we.
Ɛn una bin mek unasɛf big pan mi wit una mɔt, ɛn ad mɔ ɛn mɔ wɔd pan mi; a bin yɛri am.
So na dis PAPA GƆD se: fɔ mek di ol wɔl gladi, gladi, a go mek una ɛmti, nɔbɔdi ɛn natin nɔ go tap pan yu,

Lɛk aw yu bin gladi bad bad wan pan di Izrɛl pipul prɔpati we dɛn lɔntɛm pipul lɛf fɔ dɛm, bikɔs i bin ɛmti, natin ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go tap pan yu, Mawnt Seir, ɛn ɔl Idɔm, dɛn ɔl. Na datɛnde, dɛn go no se, na mi na PAPA GƆD.
“Ɛn yu mɔtalman, prɔfisay to di Izrɛl mawnten dɛm ɛn se, O Izrɛl mawnten dɛm, yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD in wɔd se:
na dis PAPA GƆD se: bikɔs di ɛnimi se bɔt una, ‘Aba’ ɛn ‘di lɔntɛm ay ples dɛm dɔn blant wi naw,’

fɔseka dis, prɔfisay ɛn se, na dis PAPA GƆD se: bikɔs, yɛs, bikɔs dɛn mek una ɛmti, natin ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de de, ɛn so kwis una ɔlsay dat una blant di balans neshɔn dɛm, ɛn una kam bi udat dɛn de tɔk bɔt ɛn di ivul kongosa we di pipul de kongosa;

fɔseka dis, O Izrɛl mawnten dɛm, yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD in wɔd se: na dis PAPA GƆD se to di mawnten dɛm ɛn di il dɛm, di watasay dɛm ɛn di vali dɛm, di ɛmti, yuslɛs ples we natin ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de, ɛn di big siti dɛm we nɔbɔdi nɔ de, ɛn we dɔn kam bi say we di balans neshɔn dɛn rawnd, de ambɔgin bad bad, ɛn laf, laf;

fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se; a de tɔk pan mi bad bad jɛlɔs we a gɛt pan di balans neshɔn dɛm ɛn pan ɔl Idɔm, we gi mi kɔntri to dɛnsɛf fɔ dɛn yon, ɛn gladi wit ɔl dɛn at, ɛn nɔ gɛt rɛspɛkt at ɔl, so dat dɛn go tek am fɔ dɛn yon ɛn pwɛl am pata pata.

Fɔseka dat, prɔfisay bɔt di Izrɛl kɔntri, ɛn se to di mawnten dɛm, ɛn di il dɛm, di dip dip naro vali dɛm, di vali dɛnsɛf, se, na dis PAPA GƆD se; una lisin, a de tɔk pan mi jɛlɔs in bad bad vɛks wan, bikɔs una dɔn bia ɔl di disgres we di neshɔn dɛn briŋ pan una.
Fɔseka dat, na dis PAPA GƆD se; a swɛ se di neshɔn dɛm we de rawnd una, dɛnsɛf go bia di sem disgres we dɛn bin briŋ pan una.
Bɔt una, O Izrɛl mawnten dɛm, una go pul una an dɛm kɔmɔt na do, ɛn gi una frut to mi Izrɛl pipul; fɔ dɛn go kam om jis nɔ.
Fɔ, una lisin, a de fɔ una ɛn a go tɔn to una, ɛn dɛn go dig ɛn plant pan una
ɛn a go ad mɔ ɛn mɔ mɔtalman dɛn pan una, ɛn ɔl Izrɛl pipul, pan dɛn ɔl; dɛn go tap na di big siti ɛn bil bak ɔl di ples dɛn we bin dɔn yuslɛs.

Ɛn a go ad mɔ ɛn mɔ mɔtalman, ɛn bist dɛm pan una; ɛn dɛn go plɛnti mɔ ɛn mɔ ɛn dɛn go bia bɔku frut dɛm; ɛn a go mek dɛn tap wit una lɛk aw dɛn bin de bifo, ɛn du mɔ gud pas wetin dɛn bin ɛva de du bifo, to una. Na datɛnde dɛn go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
Yɛs, a go mek mɔtalman dɛn waka na una ples, ivin Izrɛl, in pipul; ɛn dɛn go tek una, ɛn una go bi dɛn prɔpati, ɛn una nɔ go kil dɛn pikin dɛn igen, igen
So, na dis PAPA GƆD se: bikɔs mɔtalman dɛn se to una, ‘una de it mɔtalman dɛn awaŋɔt wan, ɛn una de kil una neshɔn pikin dɛn.
Fɔseka dat, una nɔ go it mɔtalman dɛn awaŋɔt wan igen igen, ɛn una nɔ go kil una neshɔn pikin dɛn igen igen, PAPA GƆD tɔk se
ɛn a nɔ go mek una yɛri igen igen di neshɔn dɛn kɔmplen, kɔmplen; ɛn una nɔ go bia di pipul dɛn disgres igen igen, ɛn nɔ mek una neshɔn bɔk in fut igen igen, PAPA GƆD tɔk se.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“mɔtalman, wɛn Izrɛl pipul bin tap na dɛn yon kɔntri, dɛn bin dɔti am bay aw dɛn bin de biev ɛn wetin dɛn de du; dɛn bievyɔ bifo mi bin tan lɛk we uman nɔ ba klin wɛn in mun de ɔp.
So a bin tɔn mi bad bad vɛks pan dɛm lɛk wata, fɔseka di blɔd we dɛn dɔn mek flo na di kɔntri, ɛn fɔseka di lay lay gɔd dɛm we dɛn tek dɔti mi.
A bin skata skata dɛn pan di neshɔn dɛm, ɛn dɛn bin sheb sheb pan di difrɛn difrɛn kɔntri dɛm; a bin jɔj dɛm bay aw dɛn bin de biev ɛn wetin dɛn bin de du.

Bɔt wɛn dɛn bin kam to di neshɔn dɛm, ɛnisay dɛn go, dɛn nɔ bin rɛspɛkt mi oli nem; ɛn we pipul de tɔk bɔt dɛn, dɛn de se, ‘dɛn wan ya, na PAPA GƆD in pipul, bɔt stil dɛn bin gɛt fɔ kɔmɔt nain kɔntri.
Bɔt a bin kia fɔ mi oli nem, we di Izrɛl pipul kam mek di neshɔn dɛm usay dɛn bin go, luk dɔŋ pan.
“Fɔseka dat, tɔk to di Izrɛl pipul se, na dis PAPA GƆD se: nɔto fɔ una sek, O Izrɛl pipul, mek a de kam akt o, bɔt na fɔ mi oli nem in sek, we una nɔ rɛspɛkt na di neshɔn dɛm we una go.

Ɛn a go pruv di oli, we, mi pawaful nem oli, we dɛn nɔ rɛspɛkt na di neshɔn dɛm, ɛn we una nɔ rɛspɛkt dɛm; ɛn di neshɔn dɛn go no se na mi na di PAPA GƆD, wɛn a pruv, bifo dɛn yay, pan una, mi oli we a oli.
Fɔ a go tek una kɔmɔt pan di neshɔn dɛm ɛn gɛda una kɔmɔt pan ɔl di kɔntri dɛm ɛn briŋ una kam insay una yon kɔntri.
A go sprinkul klin wata pan una, ɛn una go klin pan ɔl una dɔti dɛm, ɛn a go was una klin pan ɔl una lay lay gɔd dɛm.
A go gi una nyu at ɛn put nyu spirit insay una. Ɛn a go pul di ston at we de pan una bɔdi ɛn gi una at we mek wit flɛsh
ɛn a go put mi yon spirit insay una, ɛn mek una waka bay aw mi lɔ dɛn se, ɛn mek una kiaful aw una de du mi kɔmand dɛm.
Una go tap na di kɔntri we a bin dɔn gi una dadi dɛm, ɛn una go bi mi pipul, ɛn a go bi una PAPA GƆD.
Ɛn a go sev una pan ɔl una dɔti dɛn, ɛn a go samɔns di sid dɛm ɛn mek dɛm plɛnti ɛn a nɔ go mek ɛni aŋribɛlɛ kam pan una.
A go mek di tik dɛn bia bɔku bɔku frut, ɛn di fil dɛnsɛf go bia plɛnti plɛnti so dat una nɔ go bia di aŋri bɛlɛ disgres we una bin bia na di neshɔn dɛm igen igen.
Dɛn una go mɛmba una ivul bievyɔ ɛn di tin dɛn we una bin de du we nɔ gud, ɛn una go et unasɛf fɔ una bad bad wikɛdnɛs ɛn di wikɛd tin dɛn we una bin de du we de briŋ etrɛd ɛn bad bad fred fred.
Bɔt nɔto fɔ una sek a go akt, PAPA GƆD se; ɛn mek una no dat O Izrɛl pipul, una fɔ shem ɛn wɔri bɔt una bievyɔ dɛn.
“Na dis PAPA GƆD se; da de we a go was una klin pan ɔl una wikɛd wikɛd tin dɛm, a go mek pipul kam tap na di big siti dɛm, ɛn dɛn go bil di yuslɛs ples dɛn bak.
Ɛn di kɔntri we bin ɛmti, nɔbɔdi ɛn natin nɔ bin de de, dɛn go dig ɛn plant pan am, ɛn i nɔ tan igen lɛk di ɛmti ples we natin ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de, we i bin bi na ɔl dɛn wan we kin de pas de, dɛn yay.

Ɛn dɛn go se, ‘dis kɔntri we bin ɛmti, natin ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de de, dɔn tan naw, lɛk di gadin na Idɛn, ɛn pipul dɛn dɔn tap na di big siti dɛm we bin ɛmti, nɔbɔdi ɛn natin nɔ de de ɛn bin dɔn pwɛl pata pata ɛn we bin yuslɛs; ɛn dɛn dɔn strɛnkin dɛm traŋa traŋa wan.
Dɛn di neshɔn dɛn we lɛf rawnd una, go no se na mi, PAPA GƆD, dɔn bil bak di ples dɛn we bin dɔn pwɛl pata pata ɛn dɔn plant bak na di ples we bin ɛmti, natin ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de de.
“Na dis PAPA GƆD se: na dis sɛf a go mek di Izrɛl pipul aks mi fɔ du fɔ dɛm: fɔ mek a ad mɔ ɛn mɔ to dɛn mɔtalman dɛn lɛk bɔku bɔku ship.

Lɛk di bɔku ship fɔ sakrifays dɛm, lɛk di bɔku ship na Jerusɛlɛm we kin de, wɛn dɛn gɛt dɛn fist de dɛn, we dɛn bin dɔn chuz; so dat di big siti dɛm we bin yuslɛs, go ful wit bɔku bɔku mɔtalman dɛn lɛk bɔku bɔku ship. Na datɛnde dɛn go no se na mi na Papa Gɔd.
PAPA GƆD in an bin de pan mi ɛn i pul mi kɔmɔt wit PAPA GƆD in Spirit, ɛn put mi dɔŋ midul di vali, ɛn i bin fulɔp wit bon.
Ɛn PAPA GƆD bin tek mi go rawnd dɛm; ɛn a de tɛl yu, dɛn bin plɛnti na di vali, ɛn fɔ tru, dɛn bin dɔn dray bad bad wan.
Nain PAPA GƆD aks mi se, “Mɔtalman, dɛn bon ya go gɛt layf igen?” Nain a ansa se, “E Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd, na yu wangren no.”
Igen, PAPA GƆD se to mi, “Prɔfisay pan dɛn bon ya, ɛn tɛl dɛn se, Una dɛn dray bon dɛm ya, una yɛri PAPA GƆD in wɔd.
Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se to dɛn bon ya; una lisin, a go mek blo blo kam insay una, ɛn una go gɛt layf.
Ɛn a go put mɔsul dɛn pan una, ɛn a go mek flɛsh kam pan una, ɛn kɔba una wit skin, ɛn put blo blo insay una; ɛn una go gɛt layf; ɛn una go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD.
So a bin prɔfisay lɛk aw PAPA GƆD bin ɔda mi; ɛn as a bin de prɔfisay, nɔys bigin mek, ɛn una lisin, wan shek shek sawnd bin de mek kwik kwik wan; ɛn di bon dɛn kam togɛda, bon to bon.
Ɛn as a bin de luk, mɔsul dɛn bin de pan dɛm ɛn flɛsh bin dɔn kam pan dɛm, ɛn skin bin dɔn kɔba dɛm; bɔt nɔn blo blo nɔ bin de insay dɛm.

Dɛn PAPA GƆD se to mi, “prɔfisay to di blo blo, prɔfisay mɔtalman ɛn se to di blo blo, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: Yu blo blo, kɔmɔt ɔlsay, ɛn kam blo pan dɛn wan ya we dɛn bin dɔn kil, so dat dɛn go gɛt layf.
So a bin prɔfisay lɛk aw PAPA GƆD bin ɔda mi, ɛn di blo blo kam insay dɛm ɛn dɛn gɛt layf, ɛn tinap wit dɛn fut, ɛn dɛn tɔn wan big big krawd.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD se to mi, “Mɔtalman, dɛn bon ya, na di wanol Izrɛl. Una lisin, dɛn se, ‘wi bon dɛn dɔn dray, ɛn wi nɔ abop igen; wi nɔ gɛt nɔn link na di wɔl igen.’
Fɔseka dat, prɔfisay, ɛn tɛl dɛn se, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: una lisin, ‘O mi pipul, a go opin una grev dɛm, ɛn pul una kɔmɔt insay una grev dɛm, ɛn a go briŋ una kam om insay Izrɛl.
Ɛn una go no se na mi na PAPA GƆD wɛn a opin una grev dɛm, ɛn pul una kɔmɔt insay una grev dɛm, O mi pipul.
Ɛn a go put mi spirit insay una, ɛn una go gɛt layf, ɛn a go put unainsay una yon kɔntri; dɛn una go no se na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk, ɛn a dɔn du am Na so PAPA GƆD se.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, tek wan tik ɛn rayt pan am se, ‘Fɔ Juda, ɛn di Izrɛl pikin dɛm we jɔyn wit am; dɔn, tek wan ɔda tik ɛn rayt pan an se, ‘fɔ Josɛf (di Ifrem tik), ɛn ɔl di Izrɛl pipul we jɔyn an wit am.’
Dɔn, jɔyn dɛn togɛda fɔ mek wan tik, so dat dɛn go bi wan na yu an.
Ɛn wɛn yu pipul dɛn aks se, ‘yu nɔ go sho wi wetin yu min wit dɛn tik ya?

Tɛl dɛn se, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: una lisin, a de rɛdi fɔ tek Josɛf in tik (we de na Ifrɛm in an) ɛn di fambul dɛn na Izrɛl we de wit am; ɛn a go jɔyn Juda in tik wit Josɛf in yon, ɛn mek dɛm wan tik, so dat dɛn go bi wan na mi an.
Wɛn di tik dɛn we yu rayt pan de na yu an bifo dɛn yay,
dɛn tɛl dɛn se, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: una lisin, a go tek di Izrɛl pipul kɔmɔt na di neshɔn dɛm we dɛn dɔn go, ɛn a go gɛda dɛm kɔmɔt ɔlsay, ɛn briŋ dɛm kam na dɛn yon kɔntri;
ɛn a go mek dɛm bi wan neshɔn na di kɔntri, na di mawnten dɛm na Izrɛl; ɛn na wangren kiŋ go bi kiŋ oba dɛn ɔl; ɛn dɛn nɔ go bi tu neshɔn igen igen, ɛn dɛn nɔ go sheb fɔ bi tu kindɔm igen igen.

Dɛn nɔ go dɔti dɛnsɛf igen igen wit dɛn lay lay gɔd dɛm, ɛn dɛn etful tin dɛn, ɔ wit ɛni pan dɛn wikɛd bad bad tin dɛn; bɔt a go sev dɛm pan ɔl dɛn bad tin we dɛn bin go bak to ɛn we mek dɛn sin, ɛn a go was dɛn klin; ɛn dɛn go bi mi pipul ɛn mi go bi dɛn PAPA GƆD.
“Mi savant Devid go bi kiŋ oba dɛm; ɛn dɛn ɔl go gɛt wangren shɛpad. Dɛn go fala mi ɔda dɛn ɛn kiaful fɔ du mi lɔ dɛm.
Dɛn go tap na di kɔntri we dɛn dadi bin tap ɛn we a bin gi to mi savant Jekɔb; dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn, ɛn dɛn pikin pikin dɛm go tap de so te go; ɛn Devid mi savant go bi dɛn kiŋ so te go.
A go mek wan pis Kɔvinant wit dɛm; i go bi Kɔvinant wit dɛn we go de so te go; ɛn a go blɛs dɛm ɛn ad mɔ ɛn mɔ pan dɛm, ɛn a go put mi ples we dɛn de pre to mi, midul dɛm, fɔ ɛva ɛn ɛva, so te go
Mi os we a tap go de wit dɛm; ɛn mi go bi dɛm PAPA GƆD, ɛn dɛn go bi mi pipul.
Dɛn di neshɔn dɛm go no se na mi di PAPA GƆD mek Izrɛl oli, wɛn mi ples we dɛn de pre to mi de midul dɛm fɔ ɛva ɛn ɛva, so te go.
PAPA GƆD in wɔd bin kam to mi se:
“Mɔtalman, tɔn yu fes to Gɔg, Magɔg in kntri, ɛn we na di chif kiŋ fɔ Mishɛk ɛn Tubal,
ɛn prɔfisay pan am ɛn se, na dis PAPA GƆD se: una lisin, a de agens yu, yu Gɔg, Mishɛk ɛn Tubal dɛn chif kiŋ;

ɛn a go tɔn una rawnd, ɛn put uk dɛn insay una jɔ dɛm, ɛn a go pul yu kɔmɔt ɛn ɔl yu ami, yu ɔs dɛm, ɛn ɔsman dɛm, we dɛn ɔl wɛr ful amɔ, wan pawaful krawd, dɛn ɔl gɛt smɔl shild ɛn big shild, ɛn sɔd dɛn we dɛn de yuz
Pashia, Kush ɛn Put ɔl de wit dɛm, dɛn ɔl gɛt big shild ɛn ɛlmɛt;
Goma ɛn ɔl in krawd dɛm Bɛthtogama we kɔmɔt fa fa we na di nɔt, wit yu.
Rɛdi ɛn rɛdi prɔpa, yu ɛn ɔl di krawd dɛn we dɔn gɛda togɛda rawnd yu, ɛn yu na dɛn gyad.

Afta bɔku de dɛn dɔn pas, yu go dɔn gɛda gud pan di las ia dɛn we gɛt fɔ kam; yu go go agens di kɔntri we dɔn kɔmɔt pan wa ɛn dɔn bil bak di kɔntri usay pipul bin dɔn gɛda frɔm bɔku neshɔn dɛn pan di Izrɛl mawnten dɛm we bin dɔn bi yuslɛs fɔ lɔŋ lɔŋ tɛm; di pipul dɛn bin dɔn kɔmɔt pan di neshɔn dɛn naw dɛn ɔl tap sef wan.
Yu go go bifo, de go lɛk wan big big tinada wit ren, yu go bi lɛk wan klawd we de kɔba di kɔntri, yu ɛn ɔl yu krawd dɛm, ɛn di bɔku pipul wit yu.
“Na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se; Da de de, tiŋs dɛn go de kam na yu maynd, ɛn yu go mek wan ivul plan
ɛn se, ‘A go go fɛt agens di kɔntri we di vilej dɛn nɔ gɛt wɔl; a go atak di kwayɛt pipul we tap sef wan, dɛn ɔl nɔ gɛt wɔl dɛn, ɛn sɛf nɔ gɛt ba dɛn ɔ get’;

fɔ siz tin dɛn bay fos ɛn kɛr tif tiŋs na wa dɛm go; fɔ atak di ples dɛn we bin yuslɛs bɔt usay pipul dɛn dɔn tap naw, ɛn di pipul we dɛn bin gɛda kɔmɔt na difrɛn neshɔn dɛm, we dɔn gɛt kaw dɛm ɛn prɔpati dɛm, we tap midul di wɔl.

Shiba ɛn Dedan ɛn di Tashish treda dɛm ɛn ɔl in vilej dɛm go se to yu, “yu dɔn kam fɔ siz tin dɛn bay fos? Yu dɔn gɛda ɔl yu kɔmred dɛn so dat yu go kɛr tiŋs dɛn go, yu go kɛr silva ɛn gol, yu go tek kaw dɛn ɛn prɔpati dɛn, ɛn fɔ siz bɔku tin dɛn bay fos?
Fɔseka dat, Mɔtalman, prɔfisay ɛn se to Gɔg se, na dis Papa Gɔd we na Gɔd se: da de de, wɛn mi izrɛl pipul dɛn go de sef wan, una go de mek ala ala
