A si di manship de rɔn wit spid de go wɛst, nɔt ɛn sawt; nɔn ɔda bist nɔ bin ebul tinap bifo am, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul pul pɔsin kɔmɔt nain an; i bin jɛs de du wetin i lɛk ɛn i bin de es insɛf ɔp.
As a bin de wɔnda, nain a si wan mangot kɔmɔt frɔm di wɛst krɔs di wanol wɔl, ɛn nɔ bin tɔch di grɔn. Di got bin gɛt wan ɔn we ɔl man go si izi wan bitwin in yay dɛn.
I bin kam to di manship we bin gɛt di tu ɔn, ɛn we a bin si tinap na di sho, ɛn di got bin atak di ship traŋa wan wit vɛksteshɔn.

A si di got we i bin kam nia di manship, ɛn i bin so vɛks pan am dat i bɔt di manship ɛn brok in tu ɔn; ɛn di manship nɔ bin gɛt ɛni pawa igen fɔ fɛt di got, bɔt di got bin ib di manship na grɔn ɛn mas mas am; nɔbɔdi nɔ bin ebul fɔ pul di manship na di got in an.

Dɛn di man got bigin fɔ es insɛf ɔp bad bad wan; bɔt wɛn i bin dɔn gɛt bɔku pawa, di big big ɔn bin brok. Usay da ɔn de bin kɔmɔt, fo ɔn we ɔlman go si izi wan bɔs de, de pɔynt to di fo difrɛn say we briz de blo.
Wan lili ɔn kɔmɔt pan wan pan di ɔn dɛn ɛn gro big big wande pɔynt sawt, ist ɛn to di lan we dɛn de prez pas ɔl.
I gro big big wan, te rich ɛvin; i trowe sɔm pan di sta dɛn na grɔn ɛn mas mas dɛn.
I mek insɛf big lɛk di man na os; i ɔpoz di lida na di ami na ɛvin, tap di ɛvride sakrifays we dɛn de mek to PAPA GƆD ɛn briŋ disgres to PAPA GƆD in os.
PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn bigin kɔmɔt biɛn am ɛn gi dɛnsɛf to di ɔn in pawa.

Nain a yɛri wan Oli Wande tɔk; ɛn wan ɔda Oli wan tɛl di wan we bin de tɔk se, “aw lɔŋ dis vishɔn ya bɔt di sakrifays we dɛn de bɔn ɔltɛm, ɛn di sin dɛn we de pwɛl at, ɛn di tek we dɛn dɔn tek di ples we dɛn de pre, ɛn aw dɛn de mas mas di man na os ɔnda dɛn fut?”
Ɛn i ansa am se, “Fɔ wan tawzin, wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti dez, di ples we dɛn de pre go kam bak to di rayt we, aw i bin tan bifo.’
Wɛn mi, Daniɛl, dɔn si di vishɔn, a bigin tray fɔ fɛnɔt wetin i min, ɛn wantɛm wantɛm, sɔntin we fiba mɔtalman bin kan tinap bifo mi.
Ɛn a yɛri wan man vɔys de kɔmɔt bitwin di tu say dɛn pan di riva Ulay ɛn de kɔl se, “Gebrɛl, sho dis man mek i ɔndastand wetin di vishɔn min.”
So Gebrɛl bin kam nia usay a bin tinap; ɛn wɛn i kam, a bin fred ɛn butu mi fes na grɔn. Bɔt i tɛl mi se, “Mɔtalman, a wan lɛ yu ɔndastand se, dis vishɔn na fɔ di tɛm we di wɔl go dɔn.’
As i bin de tɔk to mi, a bigin slip dip dip wan, wit mi fes na grɔn, bɔt i tɔch mi ɛn mek a tinap.
I se, “Luk, a go mek yu no wetin go bi na di las pat wɛn di vɛksteshɔn go dɔn; i gɛt fɔ du wit di tɛm we dɛn bin dɔn pik fɔ lɛ di wɔl dɔn.
As fɔ di manship wit di tu ɔn we yu si, di tu ɔn na fɔ di Midian ɛn Pashian kiŋ dɛn.
Ɛn di mangot na di Grik dɛn kiŋ, ɛn di big ɔn we bin de bitwin in yay dɛn, na fɔ di fɔs kiŋ.
As fɔ di ɔn we bin brok, we fo ɔdawan dɛn bin tek in ples, i de sho se fo ɔda kindɔm go kɔmɔt insay in neshɔn bɔt nɔn nɔ go gɛt di sem pawa lɛk di fɔs kiŋ.
Ɛn bay di tɛm we dɛn yon pawa de dɔn, wɛn dɛn wikɛd wan dɛn kɔp go dɔn ful, wan kiŋ we nɔ de laf we sabi andul prɔblɛm, go kam.
I go gɛt bɔku pawa ɛn i go so de pwɛl ɛn kil, dat pipul dɛn go de fred am. I go de win pan ɔl wetin i de du, ɛn i go nyakanyaka plɛnti bigman dɛn, ɛn semwe, dɛn pipul we biliv pan PAPA GƆD.

Bay in kɔni kɔni, di tɛm we i de na pawa, i go mek pipul dɛn prɔfit pan fɔls layf, ɛn i go de tink nain maynd se in na bigman wit bɔku pawa. Di tɛm we pipul dɛn nɔ de tink am, i go kil bɔku; ɛn i go ivin fɛt di prins we ay pas ɔl di prins dɛn; bɔt i go rich in watalo we nɔto bay mɔtalman an.
Di vishɔn we yu si ivin ɛn mɔnin we yu dɔn no di minin naw, na tru tru tin; bɔt kip di vishɔn sikrit bikɔs i nɔ go bi jis nɔ.”
Mi Daniɛl, bin fil wik ɛn sik lidɔm fɔ tu tri de; dɔn a bin grap ɛn bigin du di kiŋ in wok bak; bɔt di vishɔn bin shɔk mi ɛn a nɔ bin ɔndastand am atɔl.
Di fɔs ia we Dariɔs, Zaksis in bɔypikin, we bɔn na Mɛdia, bɔt bin bi kiŋ na di Babilonian dɛn kindɔm,
insay di fɔs ia we i bi kiŋ, mi Daniɛl, bin si insay di buk dɛn, ɔmɔs ia go gɛt fɔ pas bifo Jerusɛlɛm go kan to akɔdin to wetin PAPA GƆD bin tɛl Prɔfɛt Jɛrimaya, ɛn dat na sɛvinti ia.
Nain a put mi atɛnshɔn to PAPA GƆD de pre ɛn beg am. A wɛr chɛr chɛr klos ɛn rɔb ashis.
A pre to PAPA GƆD we na mi Gɔd de kɔnfɛs se, “PAPA GƆD we ay pas ɔl ɛn we fɔ fred, we de kip in prɔmis, ɛn di lɛk we i lɛk di wan dɛn we lɛk am ɛn de du wetin i se, nɔ de shek.
Wi dɔn kɔmit sin ɛn dɔn du bad, ɛn biev wikɛd wan ɛn tɔn wi bak ɛn nɔ du wetin yu lɔ ɛn ɔda dɛn se;
Wi nɔ bin lisin wetin yu wokman dɛn, di prɔfɛt dɛn bin de tɔk wetin yu tɛl dɛn fɔ tɛl wi kiŋ dɛn, wi prins dɛn, ɛn wi papa dɛn, ɛn to ɔl di pipul na di land.

PAPA GƆD, fɔ waka tret de na yu an, bɔt wi de disgres wisɛf ɔltɛm to di man dɛn na Juda, to di wan dɛn we tap na Jesuselɛm, ɛn to ɔl Izrɛl; dɛn wan dɛn we de nia ɛn di wan dɛn we de fa we, bikɔs ɔf di wikɛd tin dɛn we wi dɔn du to yu.
PAPA GƆD, wi de disgres wisɛf ɔltɛm; wi kiŋ dɛn de disgres dɛnsɛf, wi bigman dɛn de disgres dɛnsɛf ɛn wi papa dɛn de digres dɛnsɛf, bikɔs wi de sin agens yu.
PAPA GƆD, sɔri at ɛn fɔgivnɛs de na yu an; bikɔs wi dɔn tɔn wi bak gi am,
ɛn nɔ de du wetin PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd se, dat na fɔ du wetin in wokman ɛn prɔfɛt dɛn tich wi.

Di wanol Izrɛl dɔn disobe yu ɛn tɔn wi bak, ɛn nɔ gri fɔ du wetin yu se. Di swɛ dɛn ɛn di wanwɔd we wi mek fɔ du wetin rayt insay Mozis in lɔ we na PAPA GƆD in wokman, dɔn fɔdɔm pan wi, bikɔs wi dɔn kɔmit sin to yu.
PAPA GƆD dɔn du wetin i se i go du wɛn wi bigman dɛn we de oba wi, we i briŋ big big wahala kam pan wi; bikɔs wetin bi to Jerusɛlɛm, nɔ bi nɔwe na dis wɔl wande.
As i rayt na Mozis in lɔ, na so ɔl dis wahala dɔn mit wi. Pan ɔl dat, wi nɔ tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki fɔ di sɔri we PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd sɔri fɔ wi.
Nain mek so PAPA GƆD bin dɔn rɛdi di trɔbul ɛn sɛn am pan wi; bikɔs PAPA GƆD we na wi GƆD de waka tret pan ɔltin we i dɔn du ɛn wi nɔ gri du wetin i se.
So duya PAPA GƆD we na wi Gɔd, yu we pul yu pipul dɛn kɔmɔt Ijipt wit yu pawa, dɔn gɛt gud nem te dis tɛm ya; wi dɔn kɔmit sin, wi dɔn du bad.

Duya PAPA GƆD, fɔseka ɔl di tret waka we yu de waka, lɛ yu wamat ɛn yu pɔnishmɛnt nɔ kam pan Jerusɛlɛm we na siti we na yu oli il; fɔseka wi sin dɛn ɛn di bad tin dɛn we wi papa dɛn dɔn du, Jerusɛlɛm ɛn yu pipul dɛn tɔn tin fɔ laf, to di pipul dɛn we de rawnd wi.
So duya wi PAPA GƆD, yɛri di prea we yu wokman de pre, ɛn de beg we i de beg yu, ɛn fɔ yu yon sek, PAPA GƆD, mek yu fes shayn pan yu oli ples we dɛn de pre to yu, bɔt we dɔn pwɛl naw.

Duya PAPA GƆD, opin yu yes ɛn yɛri; opin yu yay dɛn ɛn luk aw wi dɔn nyakanyaka, ivin di siti we gɛt yu nem; fɔ wi nɔ de beg yu PAPA GƆD bikɔs wi gɛt rayt sa, bɔt bikɔs yu na PAPA GƆD we kin sɔri dip dip wan.
PAPA GƆD duya, yɛri; PAPA GƆD, duya, sɔri fɔ wi; PAPA GƆD yɛri wi ɛn du sɔntin; nɔ wes tɛm, fɔ yu pipul dɛn sek, duya mi PAPA GƆD, bikɔs na yu nem de pan yu siti ɛn yu pipul dɛn.
We a bin de tɔk ɛn pre, de beg PAPA GƆD fɔ mi ɛn mi pipul dɛm we na Izrɛl, dɛn sin, ɛn bin de put mi kes bifo PAPA GƆD we na mi Gɔd fɔseka mi Gɔd in oli il;
We a bin de pre, di man we nem Gebrɛl, we a bin dɔn si insay di fɔs vishɔn, bin flay kam usay a bin de, wit spid. Dat apin di tɛm we wi kin mek di ivintɛm sakrifays.
I ɛksplen se, “Daniɛl, a dɔn kam naw fɔ kam gi yu sɛns ɛn mek yu ɔndastand.
Di tɛm we yu bin bigin beg PAPA GƆD, wɔd bin kɔmɔt, ɛn a kam fɔ tɛl yu wetin dɛn se, bikɔs ɔlman lɛk yu; so, tink bɔt wetin a go tɛl yu ɛn ɔndastand di vishɔn.

“Dɛn dɔn put sɛvinti tayms sɛvin ia, we na lɔ fɔseka una oli siti ɛn yu pipul dɛn, fɔ tap wikɛdnɛs, fɔ tap sin, ɛn fɔ pe fɔ di bad bad tin dɛn, lɛ pipul de waka tret ɔltɛm, fɔ kɔba di vishɔn ɛn di prɔfɛt ɛn fɔ pre fɔ wan ples we go oli pas ɔl mek i go klin.

A wan mek yu no ɛn ɔndastand se, frɔm di tɛm we dɛn tɔk se mek di pipul dɛn kam bak to PAPA GƆD ɛn bil Jerusɛlɛm, te di tɛm we di wan we dɛn dɔn anɔynt, we na prins, go kam, dat go bi sɛvin wik. Dɛn fɔ siksti tu wik dɛn go bil bak wit skwaya dɛn ɛn dip dip gɔta we go ful wit wata, bɔt i go bi tɛn we wahala go de.

Wɛn di siksti tu wik go dɔn dɔn, dɛn go kil di pɔsin we dɛn dɔn anɔynt ɛn i go tɔn po man. Ɛn di prins we go gɛt fɔ kam, in pipul dɛm go nyakanyaka di siti ɛn di ples we dɛn de pre. Ɔltin go dɔn wantɛm wantɛm. Bay di tɛm we ɔltin go dɔn, wa go fɔdɔm. I go bi lɔ se dɛn fɔ nyakanyaka di siti.

I go mek traŋa Kɔvinant wit bɔku pipul fɔ wan wik; ɛn fɔ af da tɛm de, i go mek dɛn tap fɔ mek sakrifays ɛn ɔfrin. Pɔsin go kɔmɔt na di say we dɛn de du wetin PAPA GƆD et, te di tɛm we di lɔ go kech di pɔsin we de pwɛl ɔlsay.”

Insay di tɔd ia we Sayrɔs na bin kiŋ na Pashia, wɔd bin kam to Daniɛl we in ɔda nem na bin Bɛlshaza. Di wɔd na bin tru wɔd, ɛn i bin briŋ big big kɔnfyushɔn. Daniɛl bin ɔndastand wetin dɛn se ɛn bin ɔndastand di vishɔn.
Dɛn tɛn dɛn de, mi, Daniɛl, bin de fast ɛn pre fɔ tri wik.
A nɔ bin de it natin we swit ɛn fayn, nɔn bif, nɔn wayn sɛf nɔ krɔs mi mɔt, ɛn a nɔ rɔb ɔyl pan misɛf at ɔl, fɔ di ful tri wik.
Di de we mek twɛnti fo insay di fɔs mɔnt na di Ju kalɛnda, as a bin tinap na di sho na da big riva, dat na Riva Taygris;
a es mi yay ɔp ɛn luk, nain a si wan man we bin wɛr linin klos ɛn i bin tay bɛlt we dɛn mek wit di gold we fayn pas ɔl, rawnd in wes, ɛn i kɔmɔt na Ɔpaz.

In bɔdi bin tan lɛk dayamɔn, ɛn in fes de shayn lɛk Laytin. In yay dɛn tan lɛk tɔch layt ɛn in an ɛn lɛg dɛn tan lɛk dɛn bras we dɛn pɔlish we de shayn, ɛn wɛn i de tɔk, in vɔys bin tan lɛk we big big krawd de mek nɔys.
Na mi Daniɛl waŋren bin si di vishɔn: bikɔs di pipul dɛn we wi ɔl bin de nɔ bin si dis vishɔn, bɔt dɛn bin de trimbul bad bad wan ɛn dɛn rɔnawe go ayd.
So na mi waŋren bin lɛf ɛn si dis big big vishɔn, ɛn a bin wik bad bad wan ɛn mi fes we bin de shayn brayt wan bin chenj bad bad wan, ɛn ɔl mi bɔdi bin wik.
Nain a yɛri in vɔys, ɛn wɛn a yɛri in vɔys, a butu na grɔn ɛn slip dip dip wan wit mi fes tɔn na grɔn.
Nain wantɛm, wan an tɔch mi, we mek mi an ɛn ni dɛn ɔl trimbul.
Nain i tɛl mi se, “Daniɛl, man we dɛn lɛk pasmak, lisin wetin a de tɛl yu. Tinap tret, bikɔs dɛn sɛn mi to yu.” Di tɛm we i bin de tɔk to mi, a tinap de trimbul.

Nain i tɛl mi se, “Daniɛl, nɔ fred, bikɔs frɔm di fɔs de we yu bin dɔn mek ɔp yu maynd fɔ ɔndastand ɛn put yusɛf dɔŋ bifo PAPA GƆD, dɛn bin dɔn yɛri wetin yu bin de se, ɛn a kam to yu bikɔs ɔf wetin yu bin de se.
Di prins we de na di Pashian kindɔm bin de fɛt mi fɔ twɛnti wande, bɔt Maykɛl, wan pan di akenjɛl dɛn, bin kan ɛp mi, so a lɛf an de wit di prins we de na di Pashian kindɔm,
ɛn a dɔn kam fɔ mek yu ɔndastand wetin gɛt fɔ apin to yu pipul dɛn bambay. Bikɔs di vishɔn nɔto fɔ naw, na fɔ bambay.
We i bin dɔn tɛl mi dɛn tin ya dɔn, a butu mi fes na grɔn ɛn nɔ bin ebul tɔk.
Nain a si sɔmbɔdi we tan lɛk mɔtalman tɔch mi lip dɛn, na datɛnde a bin ebul tɔk. Nain a tɛl di wan we bin tinap bifo mi se, “O mi PAPA GƆD, bikɔs ɔf di vishɔn, ɔl mi bɔdi de at mi ɛn ɔl mi bɔdi wik.
Aw mi we na mi masta in wokman go tɔk to mi masta? Rayt naw, mi bɔdi wik bad bad wan, ɛn a nɔ ebul blo bɛtɛ igen sɛf.”
Nain sɔmbɔdi we tan lɛk mɔtalman tɔch mi ɛn mek a gɛt trɛnk bak.

Nain i tɛl mi se, ‘Yu mɔtalman we dɛn lɛk pasmak, nɔ fred, lɛ yu gɛt kol at; gɛt maynd ɛn gɛt ay kɔrej.” Wɛn i dɔn tɔk to mi dɔn, a bin gɛt trɛnk bak. Nain a se, “Lɛ mi masta tɔk bikɔs yu dɔn gi mi trɛnk.”
Nain i se, “Yu no wetin mek a kam to yu? Naw, a go go bak ɛn go fɛt di prins na Pashia. Wɛn a go dɔn dɔn wit am, datɛnde, di prins na Gris go kam.
Bɔt a go tɛl yu wetin rayt insay di buk we gɛt di tru: Nɔbɔdi nɔ de we de ɛp mi fɛt dɛn prins dɛn ya, pas Maykɛl we na una prins.
Di tin we mi bin du di fɔs ia we Dariɔs, we kɔmɔt Mɛdis, bin de rul, a tinap fɔ am ɛn sɔpɔt am.

Naw a go tɛl yu di tru tin. Tri mɔ kiŋ dɛn go kɔmɔt na Pashia; afta dat di nɔmba fo kiŋ go kam we go jɛntri fafawe pas ɔl di ɔda wan dɛn; bɔt wɛn i dɔn gɛt bɔku pawa bikɔs i jɛntri, i go mek ɔlman de agens di Grik Kindɔm..
Afta dat, wan pawaful kiŋ go kam, ɛn i go rul wit bad bad kɔntrol ɛn du wetin in fil fɔ du.

Wɛn i go dɔn gɛt pawa gud gud wan, in kindɔm go skata ɛn go sheb to di fo say we briz de blo kɔmɔt ɛvin, bɔt nɔto to nɔn pan in jɛnareshɔn, ɛn nɔto bay di kayn pawa we i bin de tek rul; bikɔs dɛn go jɔg di kindɔm nain an ɛn i go go to ɔda pipul dɛn we nɔ blant in jɛnareshɔn.
“Di kiŋ we de na di sawt go gɛt pawa, bɔt wan pan in prins dɛn go gɛt pawa pas am, ɛn in yon rul go pawaful bad bad.

Afta sɔm ia go dɔn pas, di kiŋ na Ijipt go mek wan wɔd wit di kiŋ na Siria, ɛn go gi am in gyal pikin fɔ mared. Bɔt di wanwɔd nɔ go las; dɛn go kil in ɛn in pikin, in man in papa ɛn in wokman dɛn we go wit am.
Dɛn tɛm dɛn de, wan pan di kiŋ in fambul dɛn go bi kiŋ; i go go insay di kiŋ na Siria in ples we dɛn kin ayd ɛn go dil wit dɛn ɛn go kɔnka dɛn.
I go kɛr dɛn gɔd dɛn go Ijipt, wit dɛn imej we dɛn mek wit mɛtal ɛn dɛn gold ɛn silva tin dɛn; Fɔ sɔm tɛm, i go lɛf fɔ atak di kiŋ na Siria.
Afta dat, di kiŋ na Siria go kam fɛt di kiŋ na Ijipt, bɔt i go tɔn bak go nain yon land.
“Di kiŋ na Siria in bɔypikin dɛn go mek wa ɛn gɛda bɔku bɔku ami man, we go kam te dɛn pasmak, dɔn dɛn pas go, ɛn dɛn go kɛr di wa go igen te rich na dɛn baraks.
Dɛn di kiŋ na Ijipt go vɛks bad bad wan, ɛn go kɔmɔt kam fɛt di kiŋ na Siria; plɛnti plɛnti pipul dɛn go go wit am, bɔt di kiŋ na Siria go kapchɔ am.
Ɛn wɛn i go dɔn kapɔch bɔku bɔku sojaman dɛn, i go fil prawd ɛn kil tawzin tawzin, bɔt stil, i nɔ go win.
Di kiŋ na Siria go gɛda bɔku bɔku pipul bak we plɛnti pas di las tɛm; afta sɔm ia go dɔn pas, i go kam wit big big ami ɛn bɔku bɔku tin dɛn fɔ it wɛr ɛn fɛt.
“Dɛn tɛm dɛn de, bɔku pipul go de agens di kiŋ na Ijipt; ɛn dɛn man dɛn we lɛk fɛt we de wit una yon pipul dɛn, go mek prawd so dat di vishɔn go kam tru, bɔt dɛn nɔ go ebul.
Dɛn di kiŋ na Siria go kam blɔk blɔk di eria ɛn kapchɔ wan siti we dɛn de gyad gud gud wan. Di ami na Ijipt nɔ go ebul fɛt dɛn; di ami we na pik dɛn pik dɛnsɛf nɔ go ebul fɛt dɛn.
Bɔt di wan we go kam fɛt am, go du wetin in fil fɔ du, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul tinap bifo am; ɛn i go tinap na di land we dɛn de prez pas ɔl, ɛn i go gɛt pawa oba ɔl.

I go mekɔp in maynd fɔ kam wit ɔl di pawa nain wanol kindɔm, ɛn i go briŋ kɔndishɔn dɛn fɔ lɛ pis go de, ɛn i go du wetin dɛn se. I go gi am uman dɛn gyal pikin we fɔ pwɛl di kindɔm; bɔt dat nɔ go wok ɛn in nɔ go bɛnifit am.
Afta dat, i go tɔn in atɛnshɔn to di kɔntri dɛn we de nia wata, ɛn i go kapchɔ bɔku; bɔt wan kɔmanda go tap in fityay; fɔ tru i go tɔn di kiŋ na Siria in fityay bak pan am.
So di kiŋ go tɔn de go bak na di barik nain yon kɔntri, bɔt i go bɔk in fut ɛn fɔdɔm, ɛn dɛn nɔ go si am igen
Ɔda pɔsin go tek in ples ɛn in go sɛn pɔsin we go de pik taks mɔni lɛ di kindɔm go bɛtɛ; bɔt insay tru tri de, dɛn go kil am; nɔto bay vɛksteshɔn ɛn nɔto insay fɛt.
Di pɔsin we go tek in ples na sɔmbɔdi we nɔ rɛspɛkt nɔbɔdi ɛn nɔ no bɔn na kiŋ layn; nɔbɔdi nɔ go se i kam fɔ pawa bɔt i go tek swit mɔt tek pawa.
I go nyakanyaka bɔku bɔku ami dɛm nain rod kpatakpata; ɛn di rula sɛf we Gɔd pik.
Ɛn frɔm di tɛm we dɛn go mek wanwɔd wit am, i go biev lɛk grin snek na grin gras.

Ɛn i go gɛt mɔ pawa wit pipul dɛn we nɔ plɛnti. Di tɛm we nɔbɔdi nɔ de tink, i go kam na di say we jɛntri pas ɔlsay na di kɔntr; ɛn in go du wetin in papa dɛn ɛn in papa dɛn papa dɛn nɔ bin du; i go sheb tin dɛn we dɛn tif tin dɛn we dɛn kapchɔ we dɛn go fɛt, ɛn ɔda tin dɛn gi di pipul dɛn we dɛn bin ebul tek. I go mek plan fɔ pwɛl di barik dɛn, bɔt dat nɔ go las lɔŋ.

I go mek wan big big ami we go mek i gɛt pawa ɛn in maynd go de pan di kiŋ na Ijipt; bɔt di kiŋ na Ijipt go fɛt wit wan big pawaful ami, bɔt i nɔ go ebul tinap, bikɔs dɛn go mek difrɛn difrɛn plan dɛn fɔ am.
Ivin di wan dɛn we bin de it in gud it go tɔn pan am; dɛn go klia in wanol ami ɛn bɔku go day.
As fɔ di tu kiŋ dɛn, na fɔ du bad nɔmɔ go de na dɛn maynd; dɛn go sidɔm na di sem tebul de lay gi dɛnsɛf. Dɛn nɔ go gɛt wetin dɛn want bikɔs di tɛm nɔ kam yet we PAPA GƆD se i fɔ bi.
Ɛn i go go bak nain land wit bɔku bɔku tin dɛn, bɔt in at nɔ go pliz wit di oli Kɔvinant. Ɛn i go du wetin in want fɔ du, ɛn go bak nain yon kɔntri.
We di tɛm kam we PAPA GƆD se, i go tɔn bak go na di sawt; bɔt dis tɛm nɔ go tan lɛk aw i bin bi fɔstɛm.

Bikɔs ship dɛn we kɔmɔt Kitim go kam fɛt am, ɛn i go fred ɛn tɔn bak kɔmɔt de; i go tɔn bak, ɛn i go vɛks bad bad wan ɛn fɛt di oli Kɔvinant. I go tɔn bak ɛn lisin to di wan dɛn we dɔn tɔn dɛn bak pan di oli Kɔvinant.
In ami dɛn go kam dɛsikret di tɛmpul ɛn di barik, ɛn go tap di bɔn sakrifays we nɔ de tap ɛn du tin we PAPA GƆD nɔ lɛk we go briŋ trɔbul.
I go mek swit mɔt to pipul ɛn dɛn go sɔpɔt in wanwɔd we in mek; bɔt di pipul dɛn we no dɛn PAPA GƆD, go tinap traŋa wan ɛn tek akshɔn.
Di wan dɛn we gɛt sɛns pan di pipul dɛm go mek bɔku ɔndastand, ɔlwe dɛn go de kil dɛn wit sɔd ɛn faya, ɛn de mek dɛn slev, ɛn tek ɔl dɛn prɔpati fɔ sɔm tɛm.
Wɛn dɛn go de kil dɛn, na tu tri pipul nɔmɔ go ɛp dɛn. Bɔku go mek ipokrit to dɛn lɛk dɛn de wit dɛn;
Ɛn dɛn go kil sɔm pan di wan dɛn we gɛt sɛns, bɔt dat go mek di pipul dɛn klin na PAPA GƆD yay, te di tɛm rich bikɔs di tɛm nɔ rich yet.

Di kiŋ go de du wetin in want fɔ du. I go mek prawd ɛn mek insɛf big pas ɔl dɛn gɔd, ɛn i go de tɔk strenj tin dɛn agens PAPA GƆD we ay pas ɔl dɛn gɔd. Bɛtɛ go fala am te i satisfay se in dɔn trit di pipul dɛn bad dɔn; bikɔs wetin i plan fɔ du, i mɔs du am.
I nɔ go bisin bɔt in papa dɛn gɔd dɛn, ɛn di gɔd we uman dɛn lɛk bad; i nɔ go bisin bɔt ɛni ɔda gɔd, bikɔs i go mek insɛf big pas dɛn ɔl.
Bifo i rɛspɛkt di ɔda gɔd dɛn, i go rɛspɛkt di gɔd we de na barik; gɔd we in papa dɛn nɔ no na im i go ɔna wit gold ɛn silva ɛn dayamɔn ɛn dia dia prɛzɛnt dɛn.
I go tinap fɔ in traŋa traŋa barik dɛn, ɛn na wan fɔrin gɔd go ɛp am; i go gi big rɛspɛkt to di wan dɛn we gri fɔ am. I go mek dɛn rul oba plɛnti pipul ɛn go sheb land gi dɛn fɔ we dɛn gri fɔ am.
We di tɛm rich, di kiŋ na di sawt go atak am; bɔt di kiŋ na nɔt go rɔsh pan am lɛk ebi briz wit ɔs ɛn karej ɛn pipul we de rayd ɔs, ɛn wit plɛnti plɛnti ship. I go atak kɔntri dɛn lɛk briz ɛn pas go.
I go kam na di land we dɛn de prez pas ɔl ɛn tɛn tawzin tawzin go day, bɔt dɛn kɔntri dɛn ya go sev: Idɔm ɛn Moab ɛn di men pat pan di Amonayt dɛn kɔntri.
I go atak sɔm kɔntri dɛn ɛn Ijipt no go go fri.
I go bi di pɔsin we de kɔntrol ɔl di jɛntri; di gold ɛn silva ɛn ɔl di tin dɛn we gɛt prayz na Ijipt; afta dat, i go go to Libia ɛn Ithiopia.
Bɔt nyuz we go kɔmɔt na di ist ɛn na Ijipt go mek i fred, ɛn i go go wit di bad bad vɛksteshɔn fɔ kil ɛn nyakanyaka ɔmɔs i ebul.
Ɛn i go mek in tɛnt dɛm, we i go tap lɛk kiŋ, bitwin di si ɛn di oli mawnten we dɛn de prez pas ɔl; bɔt pan ɔl dat, i go rich in watalo ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ɛp am.

Da tɛm de, Maykɛl, we na di pawaful akenjɛl we de kia fɔ una pipul, go grap. Tɛm go kam we trɔbul go de we nɔ bi wande frɔm we di wɔl bigin te tide; bɔt na da tɛm de dɛn go fri una pipul dɛn, ɔl dɛn wan dɛn we dɛn nem rayt insay di buk.
Bɔku pan di wan dɛn we dɔn day go wek. Sɔm go gɛt layf sote go ɛn sɔm go gɛt shem ɛn disgres sote go.
Ɛn di wan dɛn we gɛt sɛns, go shayn lɛk aw di skay kin shayn brayt wan, Di wan dɛn we sho bɔku pipul aw fɔ waka di rayt we, go shayn lɛk di sta dɛn, sote go.
Bɔt yu Daniɛl, nɔ tɔk natin ɛn lɔk di buk, te di tɛm we di ɛnd go kam. Bɔku go de rɔn ɔp ɛn dɔŋ ɛn pipul go gɛt plɛnti sɛns.
Nain mi Daniɛl wach ɛn si tu ɔda pipul dɛn tinap; wan na dis sho ɛn di ɔda wan na di ɔda sho obasay.
Nain a aks di man we wɛr linin klos, we bin de ɔp say se, “aw lɔŋ i go tek bifo dɛn wɔnda ya go dɔn?”

Di man we bin wɛr linin klos we bin de ɔp say oba di watasay, es in rayt an ɛn lɛf an ɔp to ɛvin, ɛn a yɛri we i de swɛ wit di wan we nɔ de day in nem, se i go bi fɔ tri ɛn af ia. Dɔn i se, na wɛn di oli pipul dɛn pawa go dɔn, ɔl dɛn tin ya go dɔn bi.
A bin yɛri, bɔt a nɔ bin ɔndastand. Nain a se, “Du ya masta, wetin ɔl dɛn tin ya min?”
Nain i se, “Daniɛl, go usay yu de go, bikɔs dɛn dɔn kɔba ɛn lɔk tayt ɔl wetin dɛn se, te di tɛm kam we di wɔl go dɔn.

Bɔku go mek dɛnsɛf klin na PAPA GƆD yay, ɛn mek dɛnsɛf wayt ɛn luk gud; bɔt di wikɛd pipul dɛn go du mɔ wikɛd tin dɛn; ɛn nɔn pan di wikɛd pipul dɛn nɔ go ɔndastand, bɔt di wan dɛn we gɛt sɛns go ɔndastand.
Frɔm di tɛm we dɛn go pul di bɔn sakrifays we nɔ de tap, dat na di bad bad tin we dɛn du, go bi wan tawzin, tu ɔndrɛd ɛn naynti de.
Blɛsin go de fɔ di pɔsin we go ebul wet ɛn si di wan tawzin, tri ɔndrɛd ɛn tati fayv de.
Bɔt yu go yu we te di tɛm we ɔltin go dɔn go kam; go ɛn go rɛst. Yu go tinap na di ples we dɛn dɔn kip fɔ yu we di tɛm kam we ɔltin fɔ dɔn.
Di tɛm we Uzaya, Jotham, Eaz ɛn Ɛzikaya dɛn na bin kiŋ na Juda, ɛn wɛn Jɛroboam, we na Joash in bɔypikin, na bin kiŋ na Izrɛl, PAPA GƆD tɔk to Ozie, we na Biiri in bɔypikin.
Wɛn PAPA GƆD bin tɔk to Ozie di fɔs tɛm, PAPA GƆD tɛl am se mek i go fɛn wan rare gyal, mared am ɛn bɔn pikin wit am bikɔs na so Izrɛl de biev we dɛn lɛf PAPA GƆD ɛn nɔ bisin bɔt am.
Insɛf go fɛn wan gyal we nem Goma we na Diblaim in gyal pikin, Ozie mared am ɛn dɛn bɔn wan bɔbɔ.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am se i fɔ gi di pikin nem Jɛzril bikɔs i nɔ go tu te igen i go pɔnish Jɛu in pipul fɔ ɔl di blɔd we Jɛu wes na Jɛzril. Dɔn i se in go mek Jɛu in pipul lɛf fɔ rul Izrɛl.
I se na da de de i go pwɛl ɔl wetin Izrɛl de tek fɛt na di Jɛzril vali.
Goma gɛt ɔda bɛlɛ bak bɔn titi dis tɛm. PAPA GƆD tɛl Ozie fɔ gi di pikin nem “a nɔ de sɔri fɔ am,” bikɔs in nɔ go sɔri fɔ Izrɛl igen ɛn i nɔ go fɔgiv dɛn wankɔpɔ.
I se in go sɔri fɔ di wan dɛn na Juda ɛn in PAPA GƆD, we na dɛn Gɔd go pul dɛn pan trɔbul bɔt i nɔ go yus aro ɔ sɔd ɔ wa ɔ ɔs dɛn ɔ di man dɛn we de rayd ɔs.
Wɛn Goma dɔn pul di pikin we nem “a nɔ de sɔri fɔ am” na bɔbi, i gɛt ɔda bɛlɛ ɛn bɔn ɔda bɔbɔ.
PAPA GƆD se fɔ gi am nem, “nɔto mi pɔsin,” bikɔs Izrɛl nɔto in pipul igen ɛn in nɔto dɛn Gɔd.
Pan ɔl dis, di Izrɛlayt go bɔku lɛk sansan we nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul kɔnt; ɛn usay dɛn bin kɔl dɛn “nɔto mi pɔsin” na di sem ples dɛn go se “PAPA GƆD we nɔ de day in pikin dɛn.”
Di pipul na Juda ɛn di wan dɛn na Izrɛl go mek wanwɔd. Dɛn go pik wan edman ɛn dɛn ɔl go bɛtɛ na di land bikɔs da de de go bi big de na Jɛzril.
So kɔl yu kɔmpin Izrɛlayt dɛn “Mi pɔsin,” ɛn di uman dɛn, kɔl dɛn “A go sɔri fɔ am.”
“Beg una mama fɔ mi duya bikɔs in nɔto mi wɛf, ɛn mi nɔto in man– mek i lɛf fɔ rare, ɛn fɔgɛt bɔt di man dɛn we i dɔn kip.
Ɔ nɔ so a go trip am nekɛd lɛ ɔlman si am aw in mami bɔn am, so dat nɔn man nɔ go want am we i si am, ɛn a go mek i tan lɛk land we wata nɔ de, ɛn day wit tɔsti.
A nɔ go sɔri fɔ di pikin dɛn bikɔs na pan di rare wok i bɔn dɛn.
Dɛn mama na bin rare gyal ɛn na wit da kayn shem de i bɔn dɛn. I se in go fala di man dɛn na we de gi mi it, klos, linin, pafyum ɛn rɔm.
So naw, a go de wach am, a go lɔk am na os ɛn put babwaya na di fɛnch, so dat i nɔ go ebul kɔmɔt na do.
I go rɔnata in man dɛn bɔt i nɔ go kech dɛn ɛn i go de luk fɔ dɛn bɔt i nɔ go fɛn dɛn. Na da tɛm de i go se mek i go bak to in maredman bikɔs i bin bɛtɛ fɔ am wɛn dɛn tu de, pas wɛn i de paspas.
I nɔ bin no se na mi bin de gi am it, drink ɛn pafyum ɛn na mi bin de gi am silva ɔl di gold we dɛn bin de yuz fɔ wɔship Beal.
Di tɛm de kam we a nɔ go gi am it igen a nɔ go gi am rɔm igen, ɛn a go tek di linin ɛn di pafyum sɛf we i de yuz fɔ kɔba in kanda.
Na naw a go trip am nekɛd frɔnt in man dɛn we i bin de kip ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul pul am na mi an
Na so a go tek tɛm tap ɔl in ladida we i kin mek fɔ di ful mun fɛstival dɛn, di sɛvin de we na fɔ pre ɛn blo ɛn ɔl dɛn ɔda ɔlide dɛn.
A go pwɛl pwɛl in greps tik dɛn ɛn ivin di fig tik we dɔn bia we na dat kin mek i se, na di tɛnki dat we in man dɛn gi am. I se in go tɔn dɛn to bush, ɛn dɛn wayl animal dɛn go pwɛl dɛn.
A go mek i sɔfa fɔ dɛn tɛm we i de mek gladi-gladi fɔ Beal we kin mek i bɔn insɛns to am ɛn drɛs wit riŋ ɛn ɔda aŋins ɛn shekins, go mit in man dɛn ɛn fɔgɛt bɔt mi. Na so PAPA GƆD se.
So a go ful in yay wit tinks dɛn ɛn briŋ am kam na di ɛmti land we pipul nɔ go ebul tap, ɛn koks am wit swit swit tɔk.

Na de a go gi am greps gadin dɛn, n a go mek di Trɔbul Vali, we kin gɛt ɔlkayn trɔbul, ples we pɔsin go pas we i abop. Na de i go ansa mi lɛk aw i bin du we in na bin yɔŋgyal, di tɛm we i bin jɛs kɔmɔt Ijipt.
PAPA GƆD se na da de de i go kɔl am in man ɛn i nɔ go yuz di nem we i kin yuz fɔ kɔl Beal, fɔ kɔl am igen
A go pul ɔl di nem dɛn we i bin de kɔl Beal kɔmɔt nain mɔt ɛn i nɔ go kɔl dɛn nem de igen

I se da tɛm de in ɛn ɔl dɛn wayl animal na bush, dɛn bɔd we de flay ɛn dɛn tin sɛf we kin de krip na grɔn go tay bagin ɛn in go mek natin nɔ tɔch am wɛda na bo ɛn aro, ɔ sɔd ɛn if wa fɔdɔm na di kɔntri, so we go lidɔm, natin nɔ go mek i fred.
I se in go mek Izrɛl in wɛf sote go; A go sho am wetin tret ɛn fia wetin tru lɔv min ɛn ɛn wit sɔri at.
A go waka tret wit yu insay di mared am, dɔn yu go biliv se in na PAPA GƆD.
PAPA GƆD se na da sem de de in go ansa di pipul dɛn prea na ɛvin dɔn dɛn go gɛt wetin dɛn bin de pre fɔ.
Ren go fɔdɔm, plant dɛn go gro ɛn bia bɔku tin fɔ it dɔn dɛn go gɛt wayn fɔ drink ɛn ɔyl fɔ dɛn bɔdi ɛn wɔd fɔ ansa di pipul na Jɛzril.
A go sho am wetin i min fɔ mek a lɛk di land. A go sɔri fɔ “a nɔ de sɔri fɔ am”; ɛn lɛ “nɔto mi pɔsin” no se in na mi pɔsin, dɔn insɛf go se, “Yu na mi Gɔd.”

PAPA GƆD tɛl mi se fɔ go bak go fɛn dis uman ya we na rare gyal we de pas ɛn kip ɔlkayn man dɛn; jɛs lɛk we in di PAPA GƆD lɛk di Izrɛlayt dɛn pan ɔl we dɛn de lɛf am go wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn ɛn lɛk dray greps we dɛn de sakrifays to dɛn.
So a pe fiftin silva kɔpɔ fɔ am wit bɔlgɔ we we wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fifti kilogram.
A tɛl am se i fɔ tap wit mi naw ɛn lɛf fɔ bi rare gyal. A se nɔto ɛni ɔda man gɛt am ɛn na so insɛf go de wit am.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn go de fɔ lɔŋ ɛn nɔ go gɛt kiŋ ɔ prins, dɛn nɔ go ivin mek sakrifays; ples ɔ pɔsin fɔ mek sakrifays nɔ go de, ɛn dɛn nɔ go ebul no wetin PAPA GƆD se.
Tɛm go kam we di Izrɛlayt dɛn go tɔn bak to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd, ɛn Devid go bi dɛn kiŋ; dɔn dɛn go gɛt fred fɔ PAPA GƆD ɛn ɔl di gud we i go du fɔ dɛn bambay.

Izrɛlayt dɛn, opin una yes ɛn yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD se, bikɔs PAPA GƆD gɛt siriɔs kɔmplen bɔt wetin di Izrɛlayt dɛn de du we i nɔ lɛk. Pipul jɛs de biev adɔnkiadam. Dɛn de wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn ɛn nɔ bisin fɔ no am na di land;
dɛn de swɛ, dɛn de lay, dɛn de kil, dɛn de tif ɛn dɛn de kip dɛnsɛf gbay.
Dat mek di land de kray, ɛn ɔl udat tap de, de pan mɔnɛ, wit dɛn wayl animal na bush, dɛn bɔd we de flay ɛn ivin dɛn fish na wata, ɔl go day.
Lɛ nɔbɔdi nɔ pɔynt fiŋa pan in kɔmpin bikɔs na di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin i de blem.
I se de tɛm, dɛn go bɔk dɛn fut. Na nɛt, dɛn ɛn di prɔfɛt dɛn go bɔk dɛn fut ɛn in go dɔnawe wit Izrɛl we na dɛn mama.

Na bikɔs di pipul nɔ no in we na dat mek PAPA GƆD mek dɛn de sɔfa so. I se dɛn dɔn tɔn dɛn bak pan am so insɛf dɔn lɛf di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin to dɛnsɛf. Ɛn bikɔs dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt PAPA GƆD in lɔ dɛn, insɛf nɔ bisin bɔt dɛn.
I se aw dɛn de bɔku, na so dɛn de du tin we i nɔ lɛk. I se in go mek dɛn gres tɔn to gras.
I se na di sakrifays we di pipul we sin de ɔfa dɛn liv bay; so dɛn jɛs want dɛn fɔ de sin.
Da tɛm de di pipul ɛn dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ dɛn sin go fiba dɛnsɛf bikɔs dɛn ɔl gridi. I se in go pɔnish dɛn fɔ wetin dɛn de du ɛn pe dɛn fɔ wetin dɛn wok fɔ.
I se dɛn go it bɔt dɛn nɔ go ɛva satisfay wit wetin dɛn gɛt, dɛn go wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn bɔt natin nɔ go kɔmɔt biɛn dat; bikɔs dɛn lɛf PAPA GƆD, we na dɛn Gɔd fɔ wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn.
I se ɛni kaynaba wayn de mek pipul lɔs dɛn sɛns.
I se in pipul go aks tik bɔt tin we dɛn wan no, ɛn fil se waka tik fɔ tɛl dɛn wetin fɔ du. Na waka waka spirit dɔn pul dɛn kɔmɔt to PAPA GƆD ɛn dɛn lɛf dɛn Gɔd go wɔship dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn.

Na ɔp di mawnten dɛn de go mek dɛn sakrifays ɛn na pantap di il, dɛn kin bɔn ɔlkayn insɛns. Dɛn go ivin du wetin dɛn wan du ɔnda di kɔtin tri ɛn ɔda big big tik dɛn, bikɔs dɛn de gi gud shed. I se na dat ɔl mek dɛn yɔŋ gyal dɛn de mek lɛk rare gyal ɛn dɛn mared uman dɛn de lɛf dɛn man dɛn na os, go kip ɔda man.

I se in nɔ go pɔnish di yɔŋ gyal dɛn fɔ we dɛn de biev lɛk rare gyal ɛn di mared uman dɛn fɔ we dɛn de lɛf dɛn man dɛn na os, go kip ɔda man dɛn; bikɔs di man dɛnsɛf de biɛn di rare gyal dɛn, ɛn dɛn de fala di rare gyal dɛn ɛn di ple bɔy dɛn we kin de na di ɔda gɔd dɛn os; ɛn ɛnibɔdi we nɔ ɔndastand wetin de apin, de pwɛl insɛf.
I tɛl Izrɛl se pan ɔl we dɛn de biev lɛk rare gyal, dɛn nɔ fɔ miks di pipul na Juda pan wetin dɛn de du. I se di pipul na Juda nɔ fɔ fala dɛn go na Gilgal ɔ Bɛthavɛn ɛn ivin swɛ to PAPA GƆD.
I se lɛk aw yɔŋ uman kaw kin traŋayes na so Izrɛl traŋayes; na so PAPA GƆD nɔ go ebul fɔ gi dɛn wetin dɛn want ivin if dɛn de usay gras bɔku.
I se fɔ lɛf Ifrem bikɔs i de ɛnjɔy we i de wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn.
We dɛn dɔn drɔnk, dɛn lɛk fɔ de biɛn dɛn rare gyal. Dɛn de ɛnjɔy da layf de pas di wan we go mek dɛn gɛt rɛspɛkt.
I se na so dɛn go alaki lɛk na big briz blo kɛr dɛn go ɛn dɛn go shem fɔ wetin dɛn de du.

I tɔk to di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin. I se mek dɛn lisin to wetin i pipul na Izrɛl de se as bay rayt na dɛn fɔ no ɛn du wetin rayt. I se na dɛn dɔn blɔk we fɔ ɔda pipul we dɛn bin de wɔship dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn na Mizpa ɛn Tabɔ.
I se dɛn dig ol fɔ dɛn na Shitim ɛn na ɔlman i go blem.
I se in no Ifrem so dɛn nɔn na Izrɛl nɔ gɛt fɔ ayd pan am; fɔ naw i se Ifrem dɔn mek insɛf lɛk rare gyal ɛn dɛn ɔl na Izrɛl dɔn dɔti dɛnsɛf.
Aw di pipul de liv nɔ de gi dɛn chans fɔ tɔn bak to PAPA GƆD. Di we we dɛn dɔn yus fɔ wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn so de insay dɛn dat dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt PAPA GƆD igen
Na di mek we Izrɛl de mek lɛ dɛn tan so; na so Ifrem go bɔk in fut ɛn Juda insɛf go jɔyn dɛn.
Dɛn go tek dɛn animal dɛn se dɛn de go mek sakrifays to PAPA GƆD bɔt dɛn nɔ go fɛn am bikɔs i dɔn lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf.
Dɛn nɔ biev fayn fɔ lɛf PAPA GƆD bikɔs dɛn ivin go bɔn pikin dɛn we nɔto in yon. Bɛtɛ nɔ go fala dɛn ɛn ɔl wetin dɛn plant sɛf go pwɛl.
Una blo di ɔn na Gibia ɛn blast di trɔmpɛt na Rama, Sawnd di alam na Bɛthavɛn; una mach, go bigin di fɛt, pipul we de na Bɛnjamin.
We di tɛm rich fɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ pɔnish una, Ifrem nɔ go fayn fɔ luk bikɔs a go dɔn nyamanyama dɛn. Ɛn ɔl di fambul dɛn na Izrɛl go no bɔt dat.
Di bigman dɛn na Juda, dɛn ɔl tan lɛkɛ tifman bikɔs dɛn dɔn pul di mak na di bawndri, so dɛn go fil di vɛks we a vɛks lɛkɛ we yu de tɔn wata pan pɔsin.
Ifrem de fil bad bikɔs ɔf mi jɔjmɛnt sins i bin dɔn mekɔp in maynd fɔ lɛf mi go wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn.
Dat mek a tan lɛk bɔgbɔg to Ifrem ɛn to Juda bikɔs a de it dɛn lɛk aw bɔgbɔg de it bod.
Wɛn Ifrem si se i sik dɔn Juda si di wund we i gɛt, Ifrem go to di kiŋ na Asiria, we i tink se na wɔndaful kiŋ, bɔt i nɔ ebul fɔ mɛn dɛn.

A go tan lɛk layɔn we nyamanyama it we i kech na Ifrem bɔt biev lɛk yɔŋ layɔn to Juda ɛn nɔ pwɛl am bɛtɛ. A nɔ go pwɛl dɛn nɔmɔ, a go tek dɛn go usay a wan go; dɛn go de wit mi ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul pul dɛn na mi an.
A go kam bak na ya sote dɛn ebul fɔ gri se dɛn dɔn sin ɛn lɛf fɔ du bad ɛn kam bak to mi wɛn tin dɔn mɔna dɛn na da tɛm de dɛn go want fɔ kam bak.
Una kam mek wi go bak to PAPA GƆD. Nain dɔn nyamanyama wi so i go gɛda wi bak; i dɔn wund wi so i go mɛn wi bak.
Bay di sɛkɛn de, i go si wi, i go mek wi grap di tɔd de, so i go de si wi.
Lɛ wi du ɔl wetin wi ebul du fɔ mek wi no PAPA GƆD; natin nɔ gɛt fɔ tap am fɔ du wetin i wan du. I go kam lɛk ren lɛk we ren de kam kam amatan tɛm.
Ifrem, wetin a go du wit una? Wetin a go du wit una Juda? Una lɛknɛs nɔ de las, i kin lɔs kwik lɛk dyu.
Dat mek i sɛn prɔfɛt dɛn fɔ tɔk se in dɔn rɛdi fɔ tek di wɔd dɛn we de kɔmɔt nain mɔt jɔj dɛn. I se natin nɔ gɛt fɔ tap in jɔjmɛnt bikɔs i tan lɛk we nɛt de fala de.
I se wetin i want pas ɔl na fɔ lɛ pipul de lɛk am ɔltɛm, nɔto fɔ mek dɛn de mek sakrifays to am. I go bɛtɛ lɛ una no am, pas fɔ mek sakrifays we dɛn de bɔn na faya.
I se dɛn de biev lɛk Adam we nɔ du wetin i se bikɔs i nɔ bin gɛt feth pan wetin i se.
I se na soso bad pipul de na Giliad ɛn dɛn did dɔn wes blɔd.

Lek we tifman dɛn kin le ambush fɔ pipul dɛn, na so di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin dɛn kin de tayt wan; dɛn kin atak ɛn kil pipul we de na di rod fɔ go fɔ go mek sakrifays na Shɛkɛm. Na soso bad bad tin dɛn du.
I se in dɔn si ɔlkayn bad tin de bi insay Izrɛl; Ifrem in jɛs de pan bambot layf so ɔltin dɔn rɔtin insay Izrɛl.
Yu Juda, di tɛm go kam we a go pɔnish yu fɔ di bad we yu du, di tɛm we a go gi mi pipul dɛn ɔl wetin dɛn bin dɔn lɔs bak.

I se i tan lɛk ɛnitɛm we i kin wan gi di Izrɛlayt dɛn wetin dɛn bin gɛt, dɛn kin grap bak wit dɛn kɔrɔpshɔn na Ifrem ɛn dɛn wikɛdnɛs na Sameria, dɔn dɛn kin de pan dɛn dabaru trik, dɛn kin de tif ɛn du ɔlkayn bad tin.
Dɛn nɔ bin fil se i de mɛmba ɔl di bad we dɛn dɔn du. Naw na soso dɛn bad i de si.
Dɛn tek dɛn wikɛdnɛs fɔ ful di kiŋ dɔn in ɛn in pikin dɛn kin gladi. Dɛn ɔl na wan.
Dɛn jɛs de fɔ de wɔship ɔda gɔd dɛn. Dɛn tan lɛk ovin we kin dɔn wam bɔt di beka nɔ skata di faya gud, frɔm di tɛm we i de miks di flawa te di bred de rayz.
Wɛn di kiŋ gɛt gladi-gladi, di kiŋ in pikin dɛn kin drink te dɛn drɔnk dɔn di kiŋ in kin ivin de ple wit di man dɛn we nɔ gɛt wan rɛspɛkt fɔ am.
Dɛn wamat kin tan lɛkɛ ovin we nɔ kol dɔn ol nɛt dɔn na mɔnin, dɛn kin jɛs blez.
Na da wamat de dɛn kin mek pan di kiŋ dɛn te dɛn kil dɛn. Dɛn nɔn nɔba mɛmba se PAPA GƆD de.
Izrɛl de miks wit ɔda pipul we mek dɛn tan lɛk flɔks maŋro.
Dɛn nɔ no sɛf se di fala we dɛn de fala fɔrina de ambɔg dɛn. Dɛn tan lɛk we pɔsin dɔn gɛt wet ia bɔt i nɔ no se in trɛnk ɔl dɔn dɔn.
Na di prawd we Izrɛl de mek lɛ ɔltin de kɔmɔt bad fɔ am; pan ɔl dat, dɛn nɔ tɔn bak go to PAPA GƆD we na dɛn Gɔd.
Di pipul na Izrɛl de biev lɛk bɔd we nɔ gɛt sɛns. Dɛn go fɔs na Ijipt fɔ mek dɛn ɛp dɛn dɔn dɛn flay go Asiria.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD se, as dɛn de flay ɔlɔbɔt na so i go kech dɛn nain nɛt, dɔn i go briŋ dɛn kam dɔŋ ɛn pɔnish dɛn fɔ di bad we dɛn dɔn du.
I se dɛn dɔn alaki bikɔs dɛn lɛf fɔ fala am. Dɛn dɔn pwɛl dɛnsɛf kpatakpata bikɔs dɛn tɔn dɛn bak pan am. I se pan ɔl we i de tray fɔ pul dɛn pan trɔbul, dɛn de lay pan am.

I se dɛn at nɔba de to am wɛn dɛn de pre, bifo dat dɛn kin lidɔm na dɛn bed ol nɛt de kray; we dɛn want dɛn plant dɛn fɔ gro sɛf, dɛn kin fala dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn we fɔ wɔship ɛn kɔt kɔt dɛnsɛf fɔ gɛt dɛn.
Pan ɔl we na PAPA GƆD mek dɛn gɛt trɛnk ɛn mek dɛn bi wetin dɛn bi, dɛn stil de plan bad fɔ PAPA GƆD.

Dɛn tɔn fɔ wɔship Beal ɛn nɔ bisin bɔt wetin dɛn de du jɛs lɛk aw bo we de shut aro nɔba bisin bɔt usay i fɔdɔm; dɛn kiŋ pikin dɛn ɔl de day na wa bikɔs dɛn nɔ sabi tɔk, dɔn di Ijipshian dɛn go laf dɛn.
PAPA GƆD se fɔ ala lawd lawd wan mek ɔlman yɛri se bikɔs di pipul dɔn brok PAPA GƆD in Kɔvinant ɛn in lɔ dɛn, di ɛnimi dɛn we de pas lɛk yuba de ɔlsay na PAPA GƆD in os.
Naw dɛn de ala se dɛn no PAPA GƆD.
Dɛn dɔn lɛf fɔ du wetin gud so a go mek di ɛnimi dɛn rɔnata dɛn.
PAPA GƆD se dɛn nɔ de aks am we dɛn wan krawn dɛn kiŋ ɛn ivin we dɛn de pik dɛn bigman dɛn, in nɔ de no sɛf. Dɛn tek dɛn silva ɛn dɛn gold, mek ɔda gɔd dɛn ɛn fɛn dɛn yon waala.
I se in nɔ want di kaw pikin we dɛn mek na Sameria. Dat go mek i de vɛks mɔ ɛn mɔ. I aks se if Izrɛl go jɛs de pan da kayn layf de nɔmɔ.
Na mɔtalman yuz skil fɔ mek am. Noto gɔd so dɛn go nyamanyama da kaw pikin de na Sameria.
We dɛn du smɔl bad, na big wande mit dɛn. Rɛs ed we tinap nɔ gɛt ed, so i nɔ go pul natin fɔ it; if i bin gɛt sɛf, na fɔrina dɛn go it am.
I se ɔltin dɔn dɔn fɔ Izrɛl, naw dɛn jɛs fiba nɔnɛntiti to di ɔda neshɔn dɛn.
Dɛn dɔn go ɔp Asiria, lɛk wayl dɔŋki we in wande waka we ɛnitin kin mit am; Ifrem, in gɛt pipul we i pe fɔ lɛk am.
Ɔl we dɛn aya pipul na di ɔda neshɔn dɛn fɔ fɛt fɔ dɛn, a go nyakanyaka dɛn. Da tɛm de dɛn go blo fɔs fɔ de krawn kiŋ dɛn ɛn pik ɔda bigman dɛn.
Bikɔs Izrɛl kin sin we dɛn de mek sakrifays, aw dɛn de mek mɔ ɔlta, na so dɛn de sin mɔ.
I se ivin if i mek tɛn tawzin lɔ bɔt di sin we dɛn de sin, dɛn nɔ go bisin sɛf. I go tan lɛk na strenj tin to dɛn.

Dɛn lɛk fɔ mek sakrifays. Dɛn kin mek sakrifays ɛn it am bak bɔt PAPA GƆD nɔ bisin bɔt dɛn sakrifays. I go mɛmba di bad we dɛn dɔn du ɛn pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat ɛn mek dɛn go bak pan di slev layf we dɛn bin yuz na Ijipt.

I se Izrɛl dɔn fɔgɛt PAPA GƆD we mek dɛn bɔt dɛn bil dɛn fayn os fɔ dɛn kiŋ dɛn; dɛn dɔn bil mɔ ɛn mɔ ples wit traŋa wɔl dɛn na Juda; bɔt in go mek faya kech ɛn bɔn di ples dɛn we dɛn bil ɛn pwɛl pwɛl ɔl wetin dɛn abop pan.

Ozie tɛl di Izrɛlayt dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ gladi lɛk di ɔda pipul; i se dɛn dɔn mek dɛnsɛf lɛk rare gyal we dɛn lɛf dɛn yon PAPA GƆD go fala ɔda gɔd dɛn. I se dɛn ivin dɔn biev lɛk aw rare gyal kin biev we dɛn aya am ɛn gladi fɔ de pas ɔlɔbɔt na di os we dɛn de mil fɔ gɛt wetin dɛn go it.
I se di tin dɛn we dɛn de mil ɛn di greps sɛf we dɛn de tek mek wayn nɔ go du fɔ fid dɛn. I se dɛn go disapɔynt.
I se dɛn nɔ go lɛf na PAPA GƆD in land we ɔltin de, bɔt Ifrem go go bak na Ijipt ɛn we dɛn de na Asiria, dɛn go it it we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD in yay.

Dɛn nɔ fɔ tamisilɛ wit rɔm to PAPA GƆD ɛn nɔ go gladi wit dɛn sakrifays. Dɛn it go tan lɛk it we dɛn pul fɔ dayman; ɛnibɔdi we it am nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD in yay; bikɔs na dɛnsɛf nɔmɔ go it dɛn it; dɛn nɔ fɔ kɛr am go na PAPA GƆD in os.
I aks dɛn wetin dɛn go du tɛm we PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ mek gladi-gladi.
If dɛn go na Asiria, Ijipt go fala dɛn go gɛda dɛn de dɔn dɛn go bɛr dɛn na Mɛmfis. Da tɛm de na soso chukchuk go de pan dɛn silva ɛn insay dɛn tɛnt dɛn.

Izrɛl go no fɔ tru tru se di tɛm dɔn rich we dɛn fɔ pe fɔ ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn du. Dɛn mek PAPA GƆD in prɔfɛt dɛn ful ɛn dɛn ɔda man dɛn we de nia PAPA GƆD, dɛn mek dɛn fiba fulman bikɔs di pipul pasmak pan dɛn sin.
Di prɔfɛt na wachman fɔ PAPA GƆD in Ifrem pipul bɔt pan ɔl dat, dɛn nɔ tek am mek natin, dɛn ivin de mɔna am na PAPA GƆD in os.
I se dɛn so dɔn du bad i tan lɛk aw di pipul na Gibia bin biev. I se PAPA GƆD go mɛmba di sin we dɛn de sin ɛn i go pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat.

PAPA GƆD se lɛk aw greps go gro na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, na so Izrɛl bin tan we i fɛn am. Ɛn lɛk aw di fɔs frut na fig tik kin rɔtin di fɔs tɛm we i bɔn, na so i bin si dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn. Bɔt na so dɛnsɛf bin go na Mawnt Peɔ, go nɔnsɛns dɛnsɛf ɛn gi dɛnsɛf to Beal we mek PAPA GƆD et dɛn bad bad wan
I se di glori ɛn aje we Ifrem gɛt go flay go lɛk bɔd ɛn dɛn nɔ go bɔn pikin igen, dɛn nɔ go gɛt bɛlɛ igen ɛn sɛf dɛn nɔ go ɛva tek in.
PAPA GƆD se ivin di pikin dɛn we dɛn gɛt go day. Nɔn nɔ go lɛf. I se dɛn go did alaki we i lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf.
I se in dɔn si se ɔl Ifrem in bɔypikin dɛn go day wan bay wan. I se na Ifrem de fɛn dɛn day fɔ dɛnsɛf.
I aks PAPA GƆD fɔ gi dɛn wetin in wan gi dɛn. Lɛ PAPA GƆD mek dɛn bɛlɛ wes ɛn lɛ ɔl dɛn bɔbi dray.

PAPA GƆD se we dɛn bin de Gilgal, na de dɛn bigin du bad so na frɔm da tɛm de dɛn dɔn mek i et dɛn biznɛs. I se bikɔs ɔf di bad we dɛn de du, in go drɛb dɛn kɔmɔt nain os. I se in nɔ go lɛk dɛn igen ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn ɔl de mek rebɛl pan am.
I se ɔltin dɔn dɔn fɔ Ifrem. Dɛn nɔ go ebul fɔ bia frut igen Ivin if dɛn bɔn pikin, PAPA GƆD se i go kil ɔl di pikin dɛn.
Ozie se in PAPA GƆD go lɛf di pipul to dɛnsɛf bikɔs dɛn nɔ de yɛri in wɔd; I se na so dɛn go de ɔlɔbɔt de wɔndrin midul di ɔda neshɔn dɛn.

Izrɛl tan lɛk tik we de gro na gud grɔn - na so i frɛsh ɛn de bia bɔku frut. Bɔt as dɛn de bɔku, na so dɛn de bil mɔ ples fɔ wɔship Beal; as tin de bɛtɛ na di kɔntri, na so dɛn de kɔmɔt biɛn PAPA GƆD.
Dɛn at nɔ de to PAPA GƆD, so naw dɛn fɔ pe fɔ wetin dɛn du. PAPA GƆD go pwɛl pwɛl dɛn ɔlta dɛn ɛn nyamanyama ɔl wetin dɛn bil fɔ wɔship Beal.
Na da tɛm de dɛn go se dɛn nɔ gɛt kiŋ as dɛn nɔ gɛt fred fɔ PAPA GƆD sɛf ɛn aks dɛnsɛf se, if dɛn gɛt kiŋ sɛf, wetin i go du fɔ dɛn.
Na ɛmti tɔk dɛn de tɔk; dɛn de swɛ fɔ natin se dɛn de mek wanwɔd; so jɔjmɛnt go bɔs pan dɛn lɛk gras we gɛt pɔyzin na di rod dɛn we divayd plant na fam..

Di pipul na Sameria go fred we dɛn si di kaw-pikin dɛn we dɛn mek na Bɛthavɛn. Di pipul go fil am lɛk se dɛn gɛt bɛrin ɛn dɛn man dɛn we de mek sakrifays to Beal sɛf go fil am we PAPA GƆD dɔn pul di tin we dɛn de blɔf fɔ kɔmɔt to dɛn.
Dɛn go tek di lay lay gɔd insɛf go Asiria as prɛzɛnt fɔ di kiŋ. Di pipul na Ifrem ɛn Izrɛl go shem so fɔ we dɛn de fala ɔda gɔd dɛn.
Sameria dɛn kiŋ go tan lɛk aw wata we de kɛr wud chips go.
Di ples dɛn na Avɛn we dɛn mek fɔ wɔship dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn go pwɛl, soso chuk chuk nain go de pan dɛn, dɔn da tɛm de dɛn go ala se mek di mawnten dɛn kɔba dɛn ɛn di il dɛn fɔdɔm pan dɛn.
PAPA GƆD se frɔm we Izrɛl bigin sin na Gibia, dɛn nɔ chenj. I se na dat Gibia fɛt dɛn da tɛm de.
I se na dat mek in go pɔnish dɛn fɔ wetin dɛn de du naw, ɛn di ɔda neshɔn dɛnsɛf go mek bagin fɔ fɛt dɛn wɛn i go rɛdi fɔ pɔnish dɛn fɔ dɛn dɔbul sin.

Ifrem na lɛk yɔŋ uman kaw we lɛk fɔ de mas mas tin dɛn bɔt a nɔ gri fɔ tay in nɛk to in kɔmpin fɔ wok; bɔt naw, Ifrem gɛt fɔ wok wit in kɔmpin so dɛn go mek Juda jɔyn am fɔ wok. Jekɔb go gɛt fɔ wok insɛf.
So udat plant sid we raychɔs go gɛt lɔv we nɔ de chenj fɔ in avɛst; tɛm dɔn rich we ɔlman fɔ tray no ɛn du wetin PAPA GƆD want dɔn i go mek bɛtɛ fala ɔlman.
We dɛn dɔn plant di sid dɛn wit sin, na soso kɔrɔpshɔn ɛn lay go bi dɛn frut we go bia. As na dɛn sojaman dɛn ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn gɛt fɔ fɛt wit, dɛn abop pan,
na soso fɛt fɛt dɛn go de pan, ɔl di tin dɛn we dɛn mek fɔ fɛt wit go pwɛl lɛk aw kiŋ Shalman bin pwɛl Bɛthabɛl we dɛn go fɛt; dɛn bin ivin kil mami ɛn pikin da tɛm de.
PAPA GƆD se na di sem tin go bi to Izrɛl fɔ di bad we dɛn bad. Wɛn di tɛm rich, Izrɛl dɛn kiŋ go day pan di katakata.
PAPA GƆD se Frɔm we Izrɛl smɔl nain i lɛk am ɛn frɔm we dɛn de Ijipt, nain i dɔn pik am fɔ bi in yon pɔsin.
I se, di mɔ we i de drɔ dɛn to insɛf, na di mɔ dɛn de rɔn kɔmɔt frɔm am; dɛn de fɔ de mek sakrifays to di Beal dɛn; ɛn bɔn insɛns to di gɔd dɛn we dɛn mek.
I se nain sem wan tich Ifrem fɔ waka. I tot am nain an lɛk bebi bɔt i nɔ bisin fɔ no if na PAPA GƆD mek i tinap so.
I bin de waka wit dɛn wit sɔri at rop, wit lɛknɛs ankɔf, ɛn na mi bin dɔn bi di pɔsin we mek di ston na dɛn jabon nɔ de at, ɛn a bin butu fɔ fid dɛn.
Bɔt as dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt am, dɛn go go bak na Ijipt ɛn dɛn kiŋ go de na Asiria.
Na soso fɛt dɛn go de pan. Dɛn go fɛt na di siti, dɛn go pwɛl di get dɛn ɛn ivin dɛn dɛn traŋa wɔl we dɛn bin bil kin pwɛl.
I se sins di pipul dɔn mekɔp fɔ lɛf am to insɛf, na dɛnsɛf dɔn pik se tin fɔ traŋa fɔ dɛn ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul ɛp dɛm.

I tɔk se in nɔ go ebul fɔ givɔp pan Izrɛl ɛn in nɔ go lɛf Izrɛl to dɛnsɛf I se i nɔ go trit dɛn lɛk di pipul na Adma ɔ mek dɛn tan lɛk di wan dɛn na Zɛboim. In at nɔ go mek i du dat bikɔs i lɛk dɛn tumɔs.
I se i nɔ go gri lɛ i vɛks te i du wetin i nɔ go lɛk fɔ du. I nɔ go mek i vɛks pan Ifrem te i dɔnawe wit am; In na PAPA GƆD, in nɔto mɔtalman ɛn i de midul dɛn as di wan we oli, so nɔto dat i de fɔ.
I se in pipul go fala am we in PAPA GƆD go biev lɛk layɔn. I go mek big nɔys, dɔn in pikin dɛn go trimbul kɔmɔt na di wɛst go mit am;
dɛn go de trimbul lɛk bɔd dɛn we flay kɔmɔt Ijipt ɛn lɛk dɔv dɛn we flay kɔmɔt Asiria. Na da tɛm de PAPA GƆD go sɛn dɛn go na dɛn os dɛn bak.
PAPA GƆD se Ifrem dɔn de lay pan am gbay ɛn Izrɛl in jɛs de mek am ful; bɔt Juda in de du wetin PAPA GƆD we Oli want ɛn so PAPA GƆD stil de wit dɛn.
Ifrem in jɛs de wes in tɛm ol de. Na soso lay ɛn fɔls layf i de pan. Dɛn dɔn mek bagin wit Asiria ɛn dɛn de tredin wit Ijipt.
PAPA GƆD dɔn pas jɔjmɛnt pan Juda, ɛn i go pɔnish Jekɔb in pipul fɔ wetin dɛn du ɛn na so dɛn go gɛt dɛn pe.
Wɛn Jekɔb bin de nain mama in bɛlɛ, nain brɔda i bin de fɛt, dɔn we i big, i fɛt wit PAPA GƆD.
I rasul wit enjɛl ɛn win am. I kray ɛn beg di enjɛl fɔ blɛs am. I mit PAPA GƆD na Bɛthɛl ɛn dɛn tu tɔk.
PAPA GƆD we na Ɔlmayti Gɔd, we in pawa pas ɔl, nain nem PAPA GƆD.
Naw, i want dɛn fɔ kam bak to PAPA GƆD. Lɛ dɛn tek in wɔd fɔ lɛk dɛnsɛf, trit dɛn kɔmpin fayn ɛn jɛs de du wetin PAPA GƆD want.
PAPA GƆD se, biznɛsman we de rog de ɛnjɔy we i de pas am pan pipul.
Ifrem in de blɔf se dat dɔn mek i jɛntri bɔt ɔl wetin i dɔn gɛda fɔ insɛf nɔ du fɔ pe fɔ di bad nem we i dɔn gɛt.
I se in na PAPA GƆD dɛn Gɔd frɔm di tɛm we dɛn de na Ejipt. So in kin stil mek lɛ dɛn tap na dɛn bafa dɛn, tɛm dɛn we dɛn gɛt gladi-gladi.
I mɛmba dɛn se nain bin de tɔk to di prɔfɛt dɛn; i bin lɛ dɛn de gɛt bɔku vishɔn ɛn kin gi dɛn parebul fɔ di pipul.
I se if di pipul na Giliad de pan sin, dɛn go pe dia wan fɔ dat; if dɛn de mek sakrifays to ɔda gɔd dɛn na Giliad, i se, i go nyamanyama dɛn ɔlta dɛn we de na dɛn fil dɛn we dɛn dɔn mek fayn.
Ozie se Jekɔb we na bin dɛn fɔstɛm-papa bin rɔnawe go na Aram usay i mɛn ship bifo dɛn gi am wɛf.
Na wan prɔfɛt PAPA GƆD yuz fɔ pul Izrɛl kɔmɔt Ijipt ɛn na prɔfɛt bak i yuz fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn de du wetin PAPA GƆD want.
Di pipul naw dɔn provok PAPA GƆD te i dɔn vɛks, so PAPA GƆD go jɛs lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf ɛn pɔnish dɛn fɔ ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn du.
Wɛn Ifrem kin tɔk man dɛn kin trimbul. Ɔlman na Izrɛl bin rɛspɛkt am so dɛn bin de tɔk in gud nem; bɔt we i bin de wɔship Beal, i fɛn bad nem fɔ insɛf we mek i lɔs in rɛspɛkt.
Naw dɛn sin dɔn pasmak. Dɛn de mek mɔ tin dɛn fɔ wɔship. Dɛn de yuz dɛn silva dɛn fɔ mek dɛn fayn. Dɔn dɛn se na to dɛn dɛn fɔ mek sakrifays. Mɔtalman dɛn tɔn fɔ de kis di kaw-pikin dɛn we dɛn mek.
So dɛn go tan lɛk aw daknɛs kin lɔs ɔ dyu we fɔdɔm kin dray we do klin. Lɛk aw briz kin kɛr chaf chaf go we dɛn de fana ɔ smok kin lɔs afta i pas na winda.
PAPA GƆD se nain na PAPA GƆD dɛn Gɔd frɔm di tɛm we dɛn de na Ijipt; I tɛl dɛn se nain nɔmɔ dɛn no bikɔs nain wan ebul pul dɛn pan trɔbul.
I mɛmba dɛn se we dɛn bin de na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, nain bin de kia fɔ dɛn usay bay rayt wata nɔ de;
bɔt wɛn dɛn rich usay dɛn kin it ɛn drink ɛn bɛlful aw dɛn want, dɔn dɛn at layt, dɛn fɔgɛt bɔt PAPA GƆD.
So insɛf go tan lɛk layɔn ɔ lɛpɛt pan dɛn we go de taym dɛn fɔ kech dɛn.
I se in go biev to dɛn lɛk aw bia we dɛn tif in pikin dɛn kin biev, i go jomp pan dɛn ɛn nyamanyama dɛn lɛk aw layɔn ɔ ɔda wayl animal go nyamanyama bif we i kech.
I se in go dɔnawe wit Izrɛl ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul ɛp dɛn.
I aks dɛn usay di kiŋ ɔ dɛn ɔda aristo de we dɛn bin ala se dɛn want.
I se in bin vɛks bɔt in gi dɛn di kiŋ dɛn dɔn we i wan fɔ pɔnish dɛn, i mek dɛn nɔ gɛt kiŋ igen
I se in dɔn kip Ifrem in sin na bank.
I de biev lɛk fulman. In mama de fil pen fɔ bɔn bɔt i nɔ de gri kɔmɔt na do.
I se in nɔ go ebul fɔ mek dɛn nɔ day. In nɔ go tap day fɔ tek dɛn go, so day kin mek dɛn sik ɛn day. Day kin pwɛl dɛn kpatakpata ɛn in nɔ go sɔri fɔ dɛnsɛf.

I se pan ɔl we nain go kɔmɔt fayn pan ɔl in brɔda dɛn, PAPA GƆD go mek briz kɔmɔt Ist na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap ɛn di briz go dray ɔl dɛn de gɛda wata ɛn dɛn ol we wata kin bɔs, i go ivin mek ɔl wetin i bin dɔn gɛda dɔn.
Sameria go bia wetin gɛt fɔ mit am bikɔs i mek rebɛl pan in PAPA GƆD; dɛn ɔl go day na wa, dɛn go bit di lili pikin dɛn te dɛn day ɛn plit di bɛlɛuman dɛn bɛlɛ opin.
Izrɛl, una kam bak to PAPA GƆD una Gɔd bikɔs una dɔn fɔm we una sin.
Una pre to am ɛn kam bak to PAPA GƆD. Una tɛl am ɔl wetin una dɔn du ɛn beg am fɔ sɔri fɔ una ɛn ansa una prea dɔn una go prez am.
Tɛl am se Asiria nɔ ebul pul una pan trɔbul ɛn una nɔ go sidɔm pantap ɔs de blɔf igen Una nɔ go kɔl tin dɛn we una tek an mek, PAPA GƆD. Tɛl am se una no se nain de sɔri fɔ udat nɔ gɛt papa.
PAPA GƆD se, In go mek di pipul dɛn biliv am; in go lɛk dɛn wit ɔl in at, bikɔs i nɔ vɛks pan dɛn igen
I se in go tan lɛk dyu to di pipul we go mek dɛn de frɛsh ɛn prɛd lɛk ren sizin bɔlɔgi. Dɛn rut go tan lɛk kɔtintri.
I go gɛt bɔku branch we go fayn fɔ luk so. I go pul fayn sɛnt lɛk wayn we dɛn mek na Libanɔn.
I se di pipul go go bak to am dɛn in go mek dɛn frɛsh lɛk gadin; dɛn go bɔn bɔku pikin, ɛn go de pul fayn sɛnt lɛk di wayn na Libanɔn.

I aks Ifrem se wetin i gɛt fɔ du wit dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn we dɛn de mek. I mɛmba dɛn se nain na di wan we de ansa dɛn prea ɛn luk afta dɛn. I se in tan lɛk tik we grin ɔltɛm so i kin bia frut ɔltɛm so dɛn fɔ abop pan am fɔ frut.
Udat gɛt sɛns fɔ ɔndastand dɛn tin ya; udat ebul fɔ no wetin i min, lɛ i no; bikɔs PAPA GƆD de du wetin rayt ɛn pipul dɛn we rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD de du wetin i se bɔt udat nɔ du wetin i se go ambɔg.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to Joɛl we na Pɛthuɛl in bɔypikin:
I se dɛn olpa fɔ yɛri dis ɛn ɔl udat tap na Juda sɛf fɔ lisin! I aks if dɛn kayn tin de dɔn bi dɛn tɛm ɔ di tɛm we dɛn fɔstɛm-papa bin de.
I se dɛn fɔ tɛl dɛn pikin dɛn; ɛn dɛnsɛf fɔ tɛl dɛn yon pikin dɛn, we go tɛl dɛn yon pikin na dɛnsɛf yon jɛnareshɔn.

I se wetin di lokɔs dɛn we de kɔt kɔt tin dɛn lɛf, nain di lokɔs dɛn we de waka togɛda bɔku bɔku wan, dɛnsɛf dɔn it. Wetin di lokɔs dɛm we de waka togɛda bɔku bɔku wan lɛf, nain di lokɔs dɛn we de jomp jomp dɔn it, dɔn wetin di lokɔs dɛn we de jomp jomp lɛf, nain di lokɔs dɛn we de pwɛl pwɛl tiŋs, dɛn dɔn it.
I beg ɔl drɔnkɔman fɔ wek ɛn kray; i se ɔl di wan dɛn we kin drink rɔm fɔ kray bita bita wan bikɔs dɛn dɔn lɔs di swit swit wayn we dɛn kin drink, i se dɛn mɔt nɔ go gɛt fɔ tes am igen
I kɔl di lokɔs dɛn, neshɔn. I se na wanol neshɔn dɔn atak in land so; dɛn pawaful ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul kɔnt dɛn; dɛn gɛt tit dɛn we traŋa lɛk layɔn yon, ɛn dɛn shap lɛk uman layɔn yon
I se di neshɔn dɔn nyamanyama in vayn tik dɛn ɛn dɔn mek di fig tik dɛn nɔ gud fɔ natin; di neshɔn dɔn so nekɛd di tik dɛn dat dɛn dɔn fɔdɔm; na so dɛn wayt.
I se dɛn fɔ kray ɛn wɛr munin fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri lɛk vajin we in man jɛs day yɔŋ wan.
Dɛn nɔ go ebul mek ɔfrin to PAPA GƆD nain os igen wit di gren dɛn ɛn drink. Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin we de wok fɔ PAPA GƆD fɔ sɔri ɛn kray.
I se di fil dɛn nɔ gud fɔ natin igen; bikɔs ɔl di gren dɛn we dɛn plant dɔn pwɛl, di wayn nɔ bɛtɛ igen, ɛn di ɔyl sɛf dɔn dɔn.
I se dɛn fama dɛn fɔ kɔnfyus ɛn sɔprayz, di wan dɛn we kin mek wayn fɔ kray we dɛn si wetin dɔn apin to di wit ɛn bali; bikɔs dɛn nɔ ebul pul natin igen, ɔltin dɔn pwɛl.

Di greps tik dɔn wida, di fig tik nɔ bɛtɛ igen Di pomigranet tik, pam tik ɛn apul tik ɛn di ɔda tik dɛn na di fil, ɔl dɔn wida; ɛn di pipul dɛn ɔl nɔ gladi igen Mɔtalman pikin dɛn ɔl nɔ ebul gladi igen

I se di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ sɔri ɛn wɛr saklɔth fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri, dɛn fɔ kray as pipul we de sav na di ɔlta. I se dɛn fɔ go insay PAPA GƆD in os wɛr saklɔth fɔ slip. Dɛn we de wok fɔ PAPA GƆD! Bikɔs pipul nɔ ebul mek di gren ɛn drink ɔfrin igen na dɛn PAPA GƆD in os.
I se dɛn fɔ mek dɛn fast, dɛn ɔl gɛda wan ples, Fɔ gɛda ɔl di bigman dɛn ɛn ɔlman we tap na di land, dɛn fɔ mit na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD in os; ɛn kray to PAPA GƆD.
Da de de na de! Bikɔs di tɛm we PAPA GƆD go kam nɔ fa igen i go kam lɛk tin we de nyakanyaka we kɔmɔt to di Ɔlmayti
I aks if dɛnsɛf nɔ si aw it dɛn pwɛl aw dɛn jɔy ɛn wetin kin mek dɛn gladi nɔ de na PAPA GƆD in os igen
We di sid dɛn de ɔnda di dray grɔn, dɛn de wida, di ples we dɛn kip di tin dɛn we dɛn avɛst, ɔl ɛmti; di sid dɛn os ɔl dɔn pwɛl bikɔs sid dɛn nɔ de fɔ kip de.
I se di bist dɛn ɔl de ala wit pen. Di kaw dɛn nɔ no wetin fɔ du bikɔs dɛn nɔ gɛt ples fɔ go it igen; ɛn ivin di ship ɛn got dɛn ɔl nɔ no wetin fɔ du.
PAPA GƆD, na to yu a de kray o! Faya dɔn pwɛl ɔl usay di animal dɛn fɔ it we de na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, ɛn di faya dɔn bɔn ɔl di tik dɛn na di fil.
Dɛn wayl animal ɔl de kray to yu bikɔs di watasay dɛn ɔl dɔn dray, ɛn faya dɔn pwɛl ɔl usay di animal dɛn fɔ go it we de na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Blo di trɔmpɛt na Zayɔn; mek nɔys fɔ kɔl atɛnshɔn pantap PAPA GƆD in oli mawnten! Lɛ ɔl di pipul we tap na di land trimbul bikɔs di de we PAPA GƆD de kam de nia,

na de we ɔltin go dak ɛn luk sɔri, i mek di ples dak bad bad wan Lɛk aw di ples go blak na di mawnten na so di pipul go bɔku ɛn pawaful; i go at fɔ si dɛn kayn, we nɔ bin ɛva bi bifo ɛn i nɔ go ɛva bi igen na ɔl di jɛnareshɔn.
Faya de bifo dɛn ɛn biɛn dɛnsɛf, faya de bɔn. Di land bifo dɛn tan lɛk aw da fam na Idɛn tan, bɔt afta dat di ples tan lɛk ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, ɛn natin nɔ de pas dɛn de.
Dɛn fiba lɛk ɔs dɛn, ɛn dɛn de rɔn lɛk we ɔs de rayd go wa.
Lɛk aw di chariɔt dɛnsɛf kin mek, na so dɛn de jomp pantap di mawnten, lɛk we faya de bɔn wit ayɛnkol ɛn de pwɛl ɔltin; lɛk aw pawaful ami kin rɛdi fɔ go fɛt.
Bifo dɛn, ɔl di pipul bin de pan pen, dɛn ɔl fes bin wayt so.
Lɛk aw sojaman dɛn kin mek, na so dɛn de mek, lɛkɛ sojaman dɛn we de fɛt nɔmɔ, na so dɛn kin klem ay wɔl. Dɛn ɔl de mach go usay dɛn wan go, natin nɔ de mek dɛn chenj dɛn rod.
Dɛn nɔ de mistek baŋ dɛn kɔmpin, nɔn pan dɛn nɔ de mis in rod; dɛn de go usay dɛn wan go ɛn nɔn wɛpɔn nɔ ebul tap dɛn.
Dɛn bɔs insay di siti, klem ɔp di wɔl dɛn; dɛn klem go insay di os dɛn, pas na winda lɛkɛ tifman.
Wɛn dɛn bɔs, di ath trimbul, ɛvin sɛf trimbul. Di san ɛn mun ɔl dak ɛn di sta dɛn nɔ gri shayn igen
PAPA GƆD yuz in vɔys fɔ tɔk bifo in ami, di pipul nain ami so bɔku; di pɔsin we de gi dɛn ɔda so pawaful. Di de we PAPA GƆD go kam na big de we pɔsin fɔ fred; nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul fɔ bia am.
PAPA GƆD se, naw naw, dɛn fɔ go bak to am wit ɔl dɛn at, dɛn fɔ fast ɛn kray, ɛn sho se dɛn sɔri;

ɛn nɔto dɛn klos nɔmɔ dɛn fɔ chɛr fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri, na dɛn at dɛn, dɛn fɔ ɛmti bifo am. In naw se lɛ dɛn go bak to PAPA GƆD we na GƆD bikɔs nain gɛt gud at ɛn sɔri - at bad, i nɔ de vɛks kwik ɛn in lɔv fɔ dɛn nɔ de chenj, ɛn i rɛdi fɔ fɔgiv dɛn ɔltɛm.
I se nɔbɔdi nɔ no if i go sɔri fɔ dɛn, ɛn blɛs dɛn, if dɛn go gi PAPA GƆD we na GƆD, dɛn gren ɛn drink ɔfrin.
Blo di trɔmpɛt na Zayɔn; mek lɛ ɔlman fast; I se fɔ lɛ dɛn ɔl gɛda wan ples fɔ pre,
fɔ mek ɔlman we gɛda oli; fɔ kɔl ɔl di big pipul togɛda gɛda dɛn pikin dɛn ɛn ivin dɛn wan we de sɔk bɔbi. Ɔkɔ ɛn yawo sɛf fɔ kɔmɔt na do.

I se midul usay dɛn kin kip kot ɛn usay di ɔlta de, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, fɔ kray ɛn beg PAPA GƆD fɔ sɔri fɔ di pipul. Dɛn fɔ tɛl am lɛ i nɔ mek in yon pipul shem we go mek di ɔda neshɔn dɛn gɛt wɔd fɔ tɔk. I se i nɔ fɔ mek di ɔda neshɔn dɛn aks dɛn usay dɛn GƆD de.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD fil bad bɔt wetin de bi na di land, so i sɔri fɔ in pipul.
PAPA GƆD ansa dɛn ɛn tɛl dɛn se in de gi dɛn sid, wayn, ɛn ɔyl, ɛn dat go mek dɛn satisfay mɔ; i se in nɔ go mek dɛn ɔda neshɔn luk dɛn ɛn sɔktit igen

I se in go mek di lokɔs dɛn we bin bɔs kɔmɔt na di Nɔth go fa frɔm dɛn. I se in go mek dɛn go usay dray ɛn we nɔ gɛt natin fɔ pwɛl, di wan dɛn we de bifo go go na di Dɛd Si, dɔn di wan dɛn we de biɛn go go na di Mɛditarenian Si, di smɛl we dɛn go smɛl go de go ɔlsay. Fɔ tru, PAPA GƆD de du big wok.
I se di land nɔ fɔ fred; i fɔ gladi ɛn mek fil gud, bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn du big wok!
I se dɛn wayl animal na bush nɔ fɔ fred, bikɔs di ples we dɛn kin it na di land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, grin; di tik de bia frut, di fig tik ɛn di vayn tik de pul wetin dɛn fɔ pul.

I se di pipul na Zayɔn fɔ gladi dɛn fɔ fil gud fɔseka PAPA GƆD, we na dɛn GƆD bikɔs i dɔn sɛn ren kwik fɔ mek dɛn no se i min wetin i se. I sɛn di ren bɔku bɔku wan kam dɔŋ di wan we kam kwik o ɛn di wan we kam leta lɛk aw dɛn fɔ kam.
Di ples we dɛn kin mas mas rɛs we dɛn kɔt am, go gɛt bɔku sid, di ples we dɛn kin put wayn ɛn ɔyl go ful te i rɔnoba.
I se in go mek ɔl wetin di lokɔs dɛn bin dɔn it, dat na, di lokɔs dɛn we bin bɔs lɛkɛ big ami, we i bin sɛn pan dɛn, bi wetin dɛn bin bi bak.
I se dɛn go it te dɛn se i du, ɛn prez PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD in nem, we dɔn de du wɔndaful tin fɔ dɛn. Ɛn in pipul nɔ go ɛva shem igen
I se dɛn go no se i de wit di pipul na Izrɛl, ɛn dat in PAPA GƆD, na dɛn GƆD ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt nɔn ɔda wan. Ɛn i nɔ go mek in pipul shem igen
I se di tɛm go rich we in go put in Spirit pan ɔlman; dɛn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn go de tɔk PAPA GƆD Wɔd, dɛn olpa dɛn go de drim gbay ɛn dɛn yɔŋ man dɛn go de si vishɔn.
In Spirit go ivin go pan dɛn wokman ɛn savant - gyal dɛn.
I se in go wɔn dɛn na ɛvin ɛn ath bɔt wetin go bi wit blɔd, faya ɛn smok.
San nɔ go shayn, di ples go dak ɛn di mun go rɛd lɛk blɔd. I se ɔl dis go bi di de we PAPA GƆD go kam, dat na di big de we wi fɔ fred.
Dat tɛm de, i go bi se, ɔl udat kɔl PAPA GƆD in nem fɔ sev am, go sev. PAPA GƆD dɔn se, sɔm pipul go de na Jerusɛlɛm we di waala nɔ go mit. Bɔt sɔm pan dɛn go de we na PAPA GƆD chuz fɔ sev dɛn.
PAPA GƆD se we da tɛm de rich we i go gi Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm dɛn prɔpati dɛn bak,
in go gɛda di neshɔn dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn go na di Vali ɔf Jɔjmɛnt. I se na de i go jɔj dɛn fɔ wetin dɛn du to di Izrɛlayt dɛn, we nain pipul. I se dɛn skata in pipul ɔlɔbɔt ɛn sheb in land, dɔn dɛn
trowe days fɔ luk grɔn fɔ in pipul. I gi dɛn wan bɔbɔ fɔ gɛt wan rare gyal dɔn dɛn sɛl di gyal pikin dɛn fɔ wayn ɛn a drink am.
I aks wetin Taya, Saydɔn ɛn dɛn ɔda siti dɛn na Filistia gɛt fɔ du wit am. I se if na pe dɛn wan pe bak insɛf go pe dɛn bak kwik wan fɔ ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn du ɛn i nɔ go westɛm sɛf!
I se dɛn go tek in silva ɛn gold go na dɛn pegan gɔd dɛn os.
I se dɛn dɔn sɛl di pipul na Juda ɛn Jerusɛlɛm gi di Grik dɛn ɛn pul dɛn kɔmɔt usay dɛn tap.
Bɔt in go mek dɛn kɔmɔt na di say we dɛn sɛl dɛn ɛn i go pe di neshɔn dɛn fɔ wetin dɛn du.
I se insɛf go sɛl dɛn bɔy ɛn gyal pikin dɛn gi di pipul na Juda ɛn dɛnsɛf go sɛl dɛn gi di Sabian dɛn we de fawe. I se nain PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk am.
Fɔ tɛl di neshɔn dɛn: fɔ rɛdi fɔ fɛt wa, fɔ kɔl ɔl di sojaman dɛn. Lɛ ɔl udat ebul fɛt kam ɛn go fɛt di fɛt.
Nak nak di tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz fɔ plant mek i tɔn sɔd ɛn di tin we dɛn kin tek bab tik fɔ mek am lɛ i tɔn spia; ivin di wan dɛn we nɔ gɛt trɛnk fɔ biliv se dɛn gɛt trɛnk.
Ɔl di neshɔn dɛn we de rawnd, una mekes kam, una gɛda unasɛf de. PAPA GƆD duya mek yu pipul fɛt gud.
Lɛ di neshɔn dɛnsɛf rɛdi ɛn go dɔŋ di Vali ɔf Jɔjmɛnt; bikɔs na de PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ sidɔm jɔj ɔl di neshɔn ɔlɔbɔt.
Put di nɛf we fɔ tek avɛst de bikɔs di tin dɛn fɔ avɛst dɔn rɛp. Fɔ go usay dɛn de mek wayn bikɔs di ples dɔn ful. Di kyas dɛn fɔ di wayn ful te dɛn rɔnoba, bikɔs di bad we de pan dɔn pasmak.
Bɔku bɔku pipul, bɔku bɔku pipul, na di vali we dɛn kin gri pan sɔntin! PAPA GƆD de kam na di Vali we dɛn kin gri pan sɔntin.
Di san ɛn di mun ɔl go dak ɛn di sta dɛn nɔ go gri fɔ shayn.
PAPA GƆD mek nɔys lɛkɛ layɔn na Mawnt Zayɔn. In vɔys lɛk tɛnda na Jerusɛlɛm; ɛn ɛvin ɛn ath go trimbul. Bɔt PAPA GƆD go bi di sikyɔriti fɔ in pipul, di kɔtintri fɔ di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
I se da tɛm de dɛn go no se in na PAPA GƆD we na dɛn GƆD, di wan we de na di oli il na Zayɔn. Jerusɛlɛm go bi in oli siti ɛn trenja dɛn nɔ go jɛs de tek de mek natin.
Da de de, di mawnten dɛnsɛf go gɛt wayn bɔku ɛn di il dɛn go gɛt bɔku milk, ɔl di watasay dɛn na Juda go gɛt bɔku wata; ɛn wata sɛf go bɔs insay PAPA GƆD in os fɔ wata di Shitim Vali.
Ijipt go tan lɛk ples we dɛn lɛf to insɛf ɛn Idɔm go tan lɛk ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap, bikɔs ɔf di fɛt fɛt we dɛn dɔn du to di pipul na Juda, we dɛn dɔn kil fɔ natin.
Bɔt pipul go tap na Juda sote go, ɛn Jerusɛlɛm sɛf fɔ ɔl di jɛnareshɔn.
I se in nɔ go lɛ dɛn blɔd wes fɔ natin, in go mɔs pɔnish udat gilti, bikɔs in na PAPA GƆD we de na Mawnt Zayɔn.

Dis na wetin Emɔs we de mɛn ship we kɔmɔt Tɛkoa tɔk. PAPA GƆD sho ɔl dɛn tin ya to Emɔs bɔt Izrɛl tu ia bifo di athkwek bi, di tɛm we Uzaya na bin kiŋ na Juda, dɔn Jɛroboam we na Jɛoash in bɔypikin na bin kiŋ na Izrɛl.
Emɔs tɔk se: “Di wantɛm ala we PAPA GƆD ala na Mawnt Zayɔn; wit in vɔys na Jerusɛlɛm we tan lɛkɛ tinada, ɔl dɛn grin plant wida, dɛn lif na Mawnt Kamɛl rɔtin.”
PAPA GƆD in tɔk se, “Di pipul na Damaskɔs dɔn sin bɔku bɔku, ɛn a mɔs pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat. Dɛn siz advantej pan di pipul dɛn na Giliad ɛn wok dɛn lɛkɛ slev.
A go sɛn faya na Kiŋ Azaɛl in os ɛn nyakanyaka di wɔl we Kiŋ Bɛnadad bil rawnd de.

A go brok di ayɛn ba we dɛn yuz fɔ blɔk di get fɔ go insay Damaskɔs. A go kil di man we de rul na Avɛn Vali ɛn di ɔda wan dɛn we de kɔntrol di staf na Bɛthidɛn. Dɛn a go kapchɔ ɔl di pipul we de na Siria kɛr dɛn go na Kir.”
PAPA GƆD tɔk se: “Di pipul na Gaza dɔn sin bɔku bɔku, ɛn a mɔs pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat. Dɛn grap go kapchɔ di pipul dɛn na dɛn vilej ɛn sɛl dɛn as slev to di pipul dɛn na Idɔm.
A go sɛn faya na Gaza ɛn nyakanyaka di wɔl we de rawnd de.
A go kil di man dɛn we de rul na Ashdɔd ɛn di ɔda wan dɛn we de kɔntrol di staf na Ashkɛlɔn. A go pɔnish di pipul dɛn we de na Ɛkrɔn ɛn di wan dɛn we lɛf na Filistia dɛn ɔl go day.”

PAPA GƆD tɔk se: “Di pipul na Taya dɔn sin bɔku bɔku, ɛn a mɔs pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat. Dɛn grap go kapchɔ pipul dɛn na dɛn vilej ɛn sɛl dɛn as slev to di pipul dɛn na Idɔm. Dɛn nɔ kip to di agrimɛnt we dɛn fɔ sho dɛn na brɔda dɛn.
A go sɛn faya na Taya ɛn nyakanyaka di wɔl we de rawnd de.”

PAPA GƆD tɔk se: “Di pipul na Idɔm dɔn sin bɔku bɔku, ɛn a mɔs pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat. Dɛn grap go tek sɔd de rɔnata ɛn kil di Izrɛlayt dɛn we na dɛn brɔda, dɛn nɔ sho lɔv lɛk fɔ se dɛn na brɔda dɛn. Dɛn se dɛn vɛks, so dɛn nɔ bisin if dɛn na brɔda ɔ nɔto brɔda.
A go sɛn faya na Tɛman ɛn nyakanyaka di wɔl we de rawnd Bozra.”
PAPA GƆD tɔk se: “Di pipul na Amɔn dɔn sin bɔku bɔku, ɛn a mɔs pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat. Wɛn dɛn go fɛt Giliad fɔ tek dɛn land, dɛn plit bɛlɛuman dɛn bɛlɛ opin ɛn pul di pikin kɔmɔt.
A go sɛn faya na Raba ɛn nyakanyaka di wɔl we de rawnd de. Na big big kray go de di de we dɛn go fɛt wa ɛn di fɛt go tan lɛk wɛn big big tinada de blo.
A go mek di kiŋ ɛn in ɔfisa dɛn go ɛgzayl.”
PAPA GƆD tɔk se: “Di pipul na Moab dɔn sin bɔku bɔku, ɛn a mɔs pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat, bikɔs dɛn bɔn di kiŋ na Idɔm in bonbon to ashis.
A go sɛn faya na Moab ɛn nyakanyaka di wɔl we de rawnd Kɛriɔth. Aw di pipul go de ala na so trɔmpɛt go de blo ɛn na so dɛn go de day.
A go kil di pɔsin we de rul de ɛn in ɔfisa dɛn.”

PAPA GƆD tɔk se: “Di pipul na Juda dɔn sin bɔku bɔku, ɛn a mɔs pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat. Dɛn nɔ gri kip di lɔ we mi PAPA GƆD gi dɛn, ɛn dɛn nɔ du wetin a se, bifo dat na lay lay gɔd dɛn sidɔm fɔ de wɔship, dɛn gɔd dɛn we dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn bin de wɔship.
A go sɛn faya na Juda ɛn nyakanyaka di wɔl we de rawnd Jerusɛlɛm.”
PAPA GƆD tɔk se: “Di pipul na Izrɛl dɔn sin bɔku bɔku, ɛn a mɔs pɔnish dɛn fɔ dat. Dɛn de sɛl ɔnɛs pipul fɔ silva, dɔn di poman fɔ sandal.
Dɛn de sidɔm na poman in ed lɛkɛ we dɛn de mas dɔti, ɛn siz advantej pan am. Papa ɛn pikin de sɛks wit di sem uman ɛn briŋ shem kam pan mi nem.
Klos we pɔsin go plɛj to dɛn, nain dɛn de wɛr fɔ kam slip nia dɛn ɔlta dɛn. Di rɔm we nain dɛn se pipul fɔ pe, nain dɛn de drink insay mi os, we na dɛn PAPA GƆD in os.
“Dɛnsɛf si aw a nyakanyaka dɛn Amɔrayt we laŋa lɛk sida tik, ɛn traŋa lɛk ok tik. Dɛn si aw a trifut ɛn kapsay dɛn.
A pul una kɔmɔt Ijipt ɛn mek una pas na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap fɔ foti ia fɔ mek a go gi una di Amɔrayt dɛn land.
Noto mi mek una bɔypikin dɛn bi prɔfɛt ɛn mek di yɔŋ bɔbɔ dɛn bi Nazirayt? Noto so i bi una dɛn Izrɛlayt? Una tɔk nɔ!
Naw una grap go mek di Nazirayt dɛn de drink rɔm ɛn tɛl di prɔfɛt dɛn se dɛn nɔ fɔ tɔk wetin a tɛl dɛn.
Fɔseka wetin una de du, a go mas una lɛk aw ɔmɔlanke we lod bad bad wande mas dɔti.
Dɛn wan we ebul rɔn nɔ go ebul fɔ rɔn, yu we gɛt trɛnk, nɔ abop pan yu trɛnk ɛn yu we na tɔf soja nɔ go ebul sev yu layf.
Di man we de fɛt wit bo ɛn aro nɔ go ebul fɔ tinap, di sojaman we gɛt spid na fut nɔ go ebul rɔn, ɛn di man sɛf we de rayd ɔs nɔ go ebul sev in layf.
Ivin di sojaman we de mek brev go rɔnawe lɛf in wɛpɔn.” Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Una dɛn Izrɛlayt dɛn, una lisin gud o wetin PAPA GƆD tɔk bɔt una! Una we na una i pul kɔmɔt na Ijipt:
“Na una a pik pan ɔl dɛn pipul na di wɔl, so a go pɔnish una gud fashin fɔ wetin una du.”
Una dɔn wande si tu man we nɔ gri de waka?
Layɔn go de ala na bush we i nɔ kech nɔn bif? Bebi layɔn de kray insay in ol we i nɔ gɛt natin fɔ it?
Bɔd de go na trap we dɛn nɔ sɛt fɔ kech am? Trap go fak fɔ kech we bif nɔ tɔch am?
Pipul go yɛri ɔn fɔ wa dɛn nɔ fred? Wɛn dombolo fɔdɔm na di siti, nɔto mi, PAPA GƆD de mek i bi?
PAPA GƆD we na GƆD, nɔ de wande du sɔntin we i nɔ de tɛl in savant dɛn we na prɔfɛt.
Wɛn layɔn ala, udat nɔ go fred? We PAPA GƆD, we na GƆD, dɔn tɔk, us prɔfɛt go lɔk in mɔt?
Tɛl dɛn pipul we tap na di sef ples na Ashdɔd ɛn Ijipt se lɛ dɛn gɛda go tinap na dɛn mawnten we de rawnd Sameria ɛn wach di katakata we de de ɛn aw pipul de siz advantej pan dɛn kɔmpin.
PAPA GƆD se, dɛn nɔ no aw fɔ du natin di rayt we. Dat na dɛn wan dɛn we de kip dɛn bad bad ɛn tif tif tin dɛn na dɛn os
PAPA GƆD we na GƆD tɔk se, “Ɛnimi go atak di kɔntri, i go brok di sikyɔriti we una abop pan ɛn nyakanyaka ɔl una militri bes.”

PAPA GƆD tɔk igen se: “Lɛkɛ aw man we de mɛn ship kin de fɛt fɔ pul di ship kɔmɔt na layɔn in mɔt we na tu fut ɔ waŋren yes nɔmɔ i kin jɔg kɔmɔt na di layɔn in mɔt, ɔ lɛkɛ aw pɔsin de pul bed ed ɔ fut kɔmɔt sɔnsay bɔt lɛf di ɔda pat pan di bed, na so na tu-tri nɔmɔ go lɛf pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn we de na Sameria.”
“Yɛri dis mɛsej ɛn wɔn Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn se, na so PAPA GƆD we na GƆD se.
Da de de a go pɔnish Izrɛl fɔ di bad we dɛn de du. A go pwɛl pwɛl di ɔlta dɛn na Bɛthɛl; A go kɔt di ɔn dɛn na di ɔlta ɛn trowe dɛn na grɔn.
A go brok dɛn dray sizin os ɛn di ren sizin os. A go pwɛl ɔl di os dɛn we dɛn drɛs wit ayvri ɛn ɔl dɛn fayn fayn os we dɛn gɛt.” Na mi PAPA GƆD tɔk so.
Una lisin o, una dɛn na dɛn mawnten dɛn na Sameria we fat lɛk dɛn kaw na Beshan, we de fɔ mek dɛn de siz advantej pan poman, bikɔs una de mɔna una man dɛn se dɛn fɔ de kɛr wayn go fɔ una fɔ de drink!
PAPA GƆD we na GƆD dɔn swɛ to insɛf se, “Di tɛm de kam we na uk dɛn go tek kech una, dɛn go fishin una wan wan wit uk.
Na drɛg dɛn go drɛg una pas midul dɛn krak wɔl, ɛn kɛr una go na Mawnt Amɔn.” Na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk so.
“Una go na Bɛthɛl lɛ una go du mɔ bad; una go bak na Gilgal ɛn go du wetin pas dat. Una mek di sakrifays we una kin mek ɛvri mɔnin, dɔn una pe una tayth ɛvri tri de.
If una want sɛf una kin bek bred we gɛt yist ɛn mek sakrifays wit am, dɔn una kin blɔf se una de gi PAPA GƆD mɔ pas wetin una fɔ gi am - una blɔf nɔ, una dɛn Izrɛlayt dɛn, bikɔs na dat una lɛk fɔ du.
“A mek aŋri de na ɔl dɛn siti. A nɔ mek wan sid rɛs sɛf de fɔ it, pan ɔl dat, una nɔ klɔk mi.
A ol di ren mek wan drɔp nɔ fɔdɔm di tɛm we una plant dɛn fɔ gro. A mek ren kam na wan siti, ɛn mek ren nɔ kam na di ɔda wan. Wan fam gɛt wata ɛn di ɔda wan nɔ gɛt natin ɛn dray.
Ɔlman bin de wirɔn ɔp ɛn dɔŋ frɔm siti to siti fɔ wata, bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛt bɛtɛ wata fɔ drink. Pan ɔl dat, una nɔ klɔk mi.
“Bɔku bɔku tɛm a de mek bad sik dɛn pwɛl una greps gadin, it ɔl una fig ɛn ɔliv tik. Pan ɔl dat, una nɔ klɔk mi.
“A sɛn bɔku bɔku waala pan una lɛk aw a bin du na Ijipt. A mek una yɔŋman dɛn day na wa ɛn mek dɛn kapchɔ una ɔs dɛn. Dɔn a mek una kamp dɛn de smɛl wit soso dedebɔdi. Pan ɔl dat, una nɔ klɔk mi.
“A nyakanyaka una lɛk aw a bin nyakanyaka Sɔdɔm ɛn Gomɔra. Una bin tan lɛk af tik we dɛn pul na faya. Pan ɔl dat, una nɔ klɔk mi. “Na so mi PAPA GƆD se.
“So, na naw misɛf de kam andul una na Izrɛl; ɛn bikɔs ɔf aw a de kam dil wit una, una tay una trɔsis o, Izrɛl fɔ brakɛt una PAPA GƆD!”
Di wan we mek dɛn mawnten ɛn di briz. Di wan we de sho wetin de nain bɛlɛ to mɔtalman; we de tɔn de to nɛt, we de rul di wanol wɔl. Nain nem PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti!
Una dɛn Izrɛlayt dɛn, una lisin o, una lisin to dis bɛrin siŋ we a de siŋ fɔ una:
Izrɛl we bin inosɛnt dɔn fɔdɔm. I nɔ de grap igen I lidɔm na grɔn lɛk bif, nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ es am ɔp.
PAPA GƆD we na GƆD tɔk se: “Izrɛl sɛn wan tawzin sojaman fɔ go fɛt na wa bɔt na ɔndrɛd nɔmɔ tɔn bak; wan ɔda siti sɛn wan ɔndrɛd sojaman bɔt na tɛn nɔmɔ tɔn bak.”
PAPA GƆD tɔk to Izrɛl se: “Una kam bak to mi fɔ lɛ una go gɛt layf;
Una nɔ go na Bɛthɛl fɔ go pre, dɛn gɛt fɔ le ambush de fɔ una; ɛn una nɔ go sɛf na Gilgal bikɔs dɛn gɛt fɔ kɛr ɔlman we de de go ɛgzayl. Una nɔ fɔ go na Biashiba go wɔship mi.”
Una go bak to PAPA GƆD fɔ lɛ una go gɛt layf, ɔ nɔ so i go kam dɔŋ lɛk faya kam bɔn di Izrɛlayt dɛn, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go lɛf fɔ ɔt di faya na Bɛthɛl.
E una we de tɔn rayt to rɔŋ, una we de twis twis pan kes!
Di wan we mek ɛvin ɛn dɛn sta, we de tɔn nɛt to de, ɛn de to nɛt, we de tek di wata na di si, ɛn wata di grɔn, nain nem PAPA GƆD,
nain de dɔnawe wit dɛn wan we gɛt trɛnk ɛn brok dɛn wɔl.
Una et dɛn wan we de tɛl una na kot se una rɔŋ ɛn nɔ lɛk udat de tɔk tru.
Una de tek aramu na poman an ɛn fos dɛn fɔ gi una rɔ wit; fɔ da aramu we una dɔn tek fɔ bil ston os, so una nɔ go slip insay di os. Da vayn gadin sɛf we una dɔn mek, una nɔ go tes di wayn.
A de si ɔl di bɔku dabaru we una de ple, ɛn di bad bad tin dɛn we una de du. Una we de brayb ɛn siz advantej pan pɔsin we de waka tret na PAPA GƆD in yay, wɛn una de jɔj kes, una de gi poman rɔŋ.
O - o! Dat min se dɛn wan we gɛt sɛns fɔ sɛt mɔt ɛn mek lɛk se dɛn nɔ si ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we de bi.
Noto bad una fɔ de du naw, na gud, fɔ lɛ una go gɛt layf, dɔn PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go de wit una lɛkɛ aw una tink se i de wit una.
Una lɛf fɔ du bad, una du gud; una mek fia ple na kot, sɔntɛm da tɛm de PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go sɔri fɔ di wan dɛn we lɛf pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn.

Dis na wetin PAPA GƆD, we na GƆD Ɔlmayti PAPA GƆD se bikɔs ɔf traŋayes: “Big big kray go de na ɔl dɛn trit ɛn kɔna. Ɔlman go de ala “woyo, woyo!” Dɛn go sɛn kɔl dɛn ɔdinari fama dɛn ɛn dɛn pipul we dɛn kin pe fɔ kray na bɛrin fɔ kray fɔ una.
Na soso kray go de na dɛn vayn frut fam sɛf we dɛn nɔba kray. Na misɛf go du dis fɔ pɔnish una. “Na so PAPA GƆD se.
Alaki go mit una we de wet fɔ PAPA GƆD in jɔjmɛnt! Una de wet fɔ da de de bɔt us gud i go du una? Na daknɛs nɔmɔ go kɔba una, layt nɔ gɛt fɔ de.
Da de de go tan lɛk we man de rɔnawe pan layɔn dɔn i go bɔs pan tayga; ɔ as i rɔn go nain os fɔ go ayd, snek go bɛt am we i liŋ na wɔl de blo.
Una dɔn si naw se di de we PAPA GƆD go gi jɔjmɛnt na soso daknɛs go de de? Yɛs, na tin go bi da de de.
“A et wetin una de du! A nɔ wan si di rɔbish we una de pan se una de wɔship mi.
Una grap mek animal sakrifays ɛn sid sakrifays to mi. A nɔ want am. I lɛk una briŋ dɛn fat fat animal fɔ mek sakrifays to mi, a nɔ go luk una sɛf.
Una kɔmɔt bifo mi wit una nɔnsɛns siŋ dɛn! A nɔ wan yɛri una ap ɛn a nɔ de lisin sɛf.
Una mek jɔstis ɛn fia ple de flo lɛkɛ riva, una du wetin rayt ɔl di tɛm, lɛ i bi lɛk wata we nɔ de dray.
“E bo una dɛn Izrɛlayt dɛn! Noto sakrifays ɛn ɔfrin una bin de gi mi fɔ sho se una fethful to mi di tɛm we a bin kɛr una go na di land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap fɔ fɔti ia.
Bɔt naw, una go gɛt fɔ tot una gɔd we nem Sakuth we nain na una kiŋ gɔd, ɛn Kaywan, we insɛf na una sta gɔd go
wɛn a de sɛn una go ɛgzayl biɛn Damaskɔs. “Na so PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se.

Waala go mit una dɛn bigman dɛn we liv izi layf na Zayɔn, una dɛn agbagba dɛn we fil se ɔltin ɔrayt wit una na Sameria, una dɛn bigman dɛn na da wɔndaful kɔntri we nem Izrɛl, we na una di pipul kin de go to fɔ ɛp dɛn!

Una de tɛl di pipul dɛn se lɛ dɛn go luk na Kalnɛ, dɔn lɛ dɛn go luk bak na Amath we na big siti, dɔn igen lɛ dɛn go dɔŋ na Gath we na di Filistin dɛn siti, lɛ dɛn go si if ɛniwan pan dɛn siti de pawaful lɛk Izrɛl ɛn Juda ɔ if dɛn gɛt land lɛkɛ una.
Una nɔ want fɔ de tink bɔt di dombolo we gɛt fɔ mit una, ɛn di we ɛn mana we una de du tiŋs go mek di waala ɔ dombolo mit una jisnɔ.
Waala go mit dɛn wan dɛn we de kak na ayvri bed ɛn strɛch dɛnsɛf na dɛn kawch dɛn, de it yɔŋ ship bif pan di ship dɛn, ɛn yɔŋ kaw we kɔmɔt na di wɔrɛ.
Una de ple myuzik ɛn siŋ lɛk Kiŋ Devid wit in ap.
Una de drink wayn na kalbas ɛn spre dɛn dia pafyum ɛn nɔ bisin sɛf bɔt di waala we gɛt fɔ mit Izrɛl.
Wɛl, na una fɔs go tes di waala fɔ go ɛgzayl, dɔn da tɛm de naw ɔl di ladida go tap.
PAPA GƆD we na GƆD dɔn swɛ to insɛf ɛn gi dis siriɔs wɔnin: “A et di kak we di Izrɛlayt dɛn de kak fɔ dɛn fayn fayn simɛnt os; a go mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn kapchɔ di siti ɛn tek ɔl wetin de de.”
If na tɛn man lɛf biɛn de ayd na wan os, dɛn ɔl go day.

Na di dayman in fambul we lɛf go go bɛr am. Di pɔsin we de go bɛr go de aks if nɔbɔdi nɔ lɛf insay di os. Di wan we de insay di os go ansa se nɔ, ɛn tɛl di ɔda pɔsin fɔ sɛt in mɔt, lɛ dɛn bikyaful nɔ fɔ kɔl PAPA GƆD in nem.
Wɛn PAPA GƆD gi ɔda, big ɛn smɔl os go brok pispis.
Ɔs go de galɔp pantap rɔk? Fama kin yuz kaw dɛn fɔ dig na di si? Bɔt una dɔn tɔn jɔstis to pɔyzin ɛn gi rayt to udat rɔŋ.
Una de blɔf se una dɔn kech Lɔdiba. Una de bost se una gɛt trɛnk fɔ kapchɔ Kanaim.
PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti insɛf tɔk se, “Una dɛn Izrɛlayt dɛn, a de sɛn fɔrin ami fɔ tek una kɔntri. Dɛn go aras una frɔm Amath na di nɔth te go dɔŋ na di watasay na Araba na di Sawt.”
A si wan vishɔn we PAPA GƆD we na GƆD sho mi: a si i mek bɔku bɔku lokɔs we apia afta dɛn dɔn kɔt di kiŋ in yon shia pan di plant fɔ di ɔs dɛn, dɔn di plant dɛn bigin fɔ gro bak.
A si di lokɔs dɛn de it ɔl di grin plant dɛn na di land. Na de a beg se, “PAPA GƆD we na GƆD, duya fɔgiv yu pipul. Aw dɛn go liv? Dɛn so smɔl ɛn wik.”
PAPA GƆD chenj in maynd ɛn tɔk se, “Wetin yu dɔn si so nɔ go bi igen”
A si ɔda vishɔn we PAPA GƆD we na GƆD sho mi: a si i de rɛdi fɔ pɔnish in pipul wit faya. Di faya bigin kech ɔnda di big oshɔn ɛn bigin bɔn di grɔn.
Na de a tɔk se PAPA GƆD we na GƆD lɛf, aw di pipul go liv? Dɛn smɔl ɛn wik.
PAPA GƆD we na GƆD chenj in maynd ɛn tɔk se dis sɛf nɔ go bi igen
PAPA GƆD mek a si ɔda vishɔn: a si i tinap nia wan wɔl we na plɔm layn dɛn yuz fɔ bil am, dɔn i ol di plɔm layn nain an,
ɛn aks mi se, “Emɔs, wetin yu si?” A ansa se na plɔm layn. Na de i se in de yuz am fɔ sho se in pipul tan lɛk wɔl we dɛn nɔ yuz plɔm layn fɔ bil. I se in go pɔnish dɛn ɛn i nɔ go chenj in maynd igen
I se ɔl di say dɛn we na de Ayzak in jɛnareshɔn dɛn de wɔship go pwɛl. I se ɔl di oli ples dɛn we Izrɛl de wɔship go pwɛl. I se in go dɔnawe wit Kiŋ Jɛroboam in kindɔm.
Amazaya we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na Bɛthɛl, sɛn ripɔt to Kiŋ Jɛroboam na Izrɛl se, Emɔs dɔn jɔyn pipul dɛn fɔ tɔn agens am. Wetin i tɔk, luk an yanda.
I se Emɔs de tɔk se Jɛroboam go day na wa, dɔn dɛn go kech di pipul kɛr dɛn go as rɛfyuji na ɔda kɔntri.
Amazaya tɛl Emɔs se, yu man we de tɛl pipul di fyuchɔ, rɔnawe go Juda go prich de, na de dɛn go pe am fɔ dat.
I tɛl Emɔs se lɛ i nɔ tɔk wan mɔ wɔd igen na Bɛthɛl bikɔs na de di kiŋ de wɔship, ɛn na de sɛf di wanol kɔntri in PAPA GƆD in os de.
Emɔs ansa am se in nɔ de prich fɔ mɔni. Sɛf, na kaw ship ɛn got i bin de mɛn ɛn de plant fig tik.
Bɔt na PAPA GƆD pul am kɔmɔt pan di mɛn ship wok ɛn tɛl am se lɛ i go prich to di Izrɛlayt dɛn.
So naw in de tɛl am wetin PAPA GƆD se bikɔs i de tap am nɔ fɔ tɔk wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl am fɔ tɔk, lɛ i nɔ go prich bad bɔt Izrɛl.

I se PAPA GƆD de tɛl in di Amazaya se, in wɛf go tɔn rare gyal na di siti ɛn dɛn go kil ɔl in pikin dɛn na wa. I se dɛn go sheb in kɔntri ɛn gi am to ɔda pipul ɛn na kɔntri we nɔ no bɔt PAPA GƆD, i go day. I se dɛn go kech di Izrɛlayt dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn go na ɔda kɔntri.
PAPA GƆD we na GƆD sho mi ɔda vishɔn. Insay dis vishɔn a si wan baskit frut.
PAPA GƆD aks mi wetin a si. A ansa am se na wan baskit frut. Dɔn i tɛl mi se na Izrɛl in dɔn wan dɔn kam so. I se in nɔ go chenj in maynd igen, in mɔs pɔnish dɛn.
I se da de de di gladi siŋ we dɛn go de siŋ na di kiŋ in os go tɔn bɛrin. I se na dedebɔdi dɛn go lidɔm ɔlsay. I se wan sawnd dɛn nɔ gɛt fɔ yɛri we dɛn de trowe di dedebɔdi dɛn na do.
Una lisin o, una we de tinap na poman ed ɛn siz advantej pan dɛn na di kɔntri.

Una kin tɔk na una at se ustɛm di nyu mun fɛstival go dɔn ɛn ustɛm di sabat de go dɔn lɛ una go bigin sɛl wetin una plant. Una kin de grɔmbul se mek di de mekes dɔn so dat una go bigin sɛl bak, we una go ova inchaj di pipul, kruk pan una mɛzhɔmɛnt ɛn rog una kostamɛnt dɛn,
so dat una go sɛl po ma fɔ mɔni ɛn begaman fɔ wan pia sandal ɛn sɛl di rɛs chaf chaf gi pipul.
PAPA GƆD we na GƆD fɔ Izrɛl dɔn swɛ. I se, “A nɔ go fɔgɛt una wikɛd we,
so di grɔn go plit opin ɛn di wanol kɔntri go de pan masibo, a go de mek lɛk aw swɛlin de mek na Riva Nayl.
Wande wande a go mek di san go dɔŋ santɛm dɔn di ples dak de tɛm. Na mi PAPA GƆD we na GƆD dɔn tɔk so.

A go tɔn ɔl una gladi-gladi to bɛrin ɛn chenj una gladi siŋ to bɛrin siŋ. A go mek una krep una ed ɛn wɛr saklɔth, una go tan lɛk we man ɛn uman de kray fɔ dɛn waŋren pikin. Da de de go bita fɔ una sote go.”
“Wande wande a go mek nɔn it nɔ de fɔ it. Pipul go aŋri bɔt nɔto fɔ bred; dɛn go tɔsti bɔt nɔto fɔ wata. Dɛn go aŋri ɛn tɔsti fɔ yɛri PAPA GƆD in mɛsej. Na mi PAPA GƆD we na GƆD de tɔk.
Pipul go de wirɔn frɔm di Rɛd Si to di Mɛditarenian ɛn ɔlɔbɔt frɔm nɔth to ist. Dɛn go de fɛn usay PAPA GƆD wɔd de bɔt dɛn nɔ go gɛt am.
Da de de, ivin dɛn yɔŋman ɛn yɔŋuman dɛn go fent wit tɔsti.
Dɛn wan we de swɛ to dɛn lay lay gɔd we de na Sameria we de se dɛn swɛ to di gɔd na Dan ɔ dɛn swɛ to di gɔd na Biashiba, dɛn ɔl go fɔdɔm ɛn nɔ grap igen”

A si PAPA GƆD nia di ɔlta. I gi ɔda se: “Una nak di pila dɛn na PAPA GƆD in os mek di fawndeshɔn dɛn go shek. Una brok dɛn lɛ dɛn fɔdɔm na di pipul dɛn ed. A go kil ɔl di pipul na wa, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go rɔnawe.
I lɛk dɛn dig go ayd na nɛks wɔl, na de a go kech dɛn; ɔl we dɛn klem go ɔp klawd, na frɔm de go briŋ dɛn kam dɔŋ.
If dɛn go ayd ɔp na Mawnt Kamɛl, a go fɛn dɛn ɛn kech dɛn. If dɛn go ayd ɔnda di si, a go tɛl di si mɔnsta fɔ bɛt dɛn.
If dɛn ɛnimi dɛn kech dɛn ɛn kɛr dɛn go as rɛfyuji, a go mek dɛn kil dɛn ɔl. A dɔn mekɔp mi maynd fɔ dɔnawe wit dɛn kpatakpata. A nɔ go sev dɛn.”
PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti de tɔch di grɔn nɔmɔ ɛn i go mɛlt; ɔl udat de de, go kray Di wɔl go tan lɛk sisɔ; i go go ɔp ɛn kan dɔŋ lɛk riva nayl wata.
Di wanol wɔl de tɔnɔbɔ lɛk Riva Nayl. I de bil in os na ɛvin ɛn put di skay oba di ath. I tek wata kɔmɔt na di si ɛn tɔn am na di ath. In nem na PAPA GƆD.

PAPA GƆD tɔk se: “Una dɛn Izrɛlayt dɛn, lɛkɛ aw una kin de tink bɔt dɛn pipul na Ithiopia na so a kin de tink bɔt una. Lɛkɛ aw a pul di Filistin dɛn kɔmɔt na Krit ɛn di Sirian dɛn na Kir, na so a pul una kɔmɔt na Ijipt.
Mi, PAPA GƆD we na GƆD, tek yay de luk dis Izrɛl we de kɔmit sin so, ɛn a go pul dɛn kɔmɔt na di wɔl kpatakpata. Bɔt nɔmɔ a nɔ go kil ɔl Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn.
“A go gi ɔda ɛn shek di pipul na Izrɛl lɛkɛ sid na shifta. A go shifta dɛn ɔl ɛn pul ɔl di wan dɛn we na yuslɛs mɔtalman.
Ɔl di wan dɛn we de kɔmit sin go day na wa, miks wit ɔl dɛn wan we de se PAPA GƆD nɔ go mek ɛnitin bad mit dɛn.”
PAPA GƆD tɔk se, “Wande wande, a go mek Devid in kindɔm, we dɔn tan lɛk os we dɔn brok, tinap bak. A go ripia di wɔl dɛn ɛn bil dɛn bak. A go mek lɛ i tan lɛk aw i bin tan lɔntɛm.
Dɔn di Izrɛlayt dɛn go tek wetin lɛf na Idɔm ɛn gi di ɔda kɔntri dɛn we bin de ɔnda mi. “Na PAPA GƆD we dɔn tɔk go mek dis apin.
PAPA GƆD se, “Wande wande, di plant go so de gro dat dɛn go jɛs de avɛst ɛn di wayn go so de bɔku wan dat wayn go de mit wayn; fayn fayn wayn go bɔsawt na di mawnten, ɛn ɔl go flo kam dɔŋ di il dɛn.
A go briŋ mi pipul kam bak na dɛn land, dɛn go bil dɛn siti bak ɛn tap de; dɛn go plant vayn ɛn drink in wayn, dɛn go plant ɛn it wetin dɛn plant.
A go put mi pipul na di land we a gi dɛn, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go pul dɛn kɔmɔt de igen” Na mi PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk so.
Na di tin dɛn dis we Obadaya si. Na di tin dis we PAPA GƆD we na GƆD, se bɔt Idɔm. Idɔm, PAPA GƆD dɔn sɛn mɛsej to dɛn ɔda neshɔn se dɛn fɔ rɛdi fɔ go fɛt yu, ɛn wisɛf dɔn yɛri.
PAPA GƆD se i go mek Idɔm nɔ ebul fɛt; ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go luk am wit bɛtɛ yay.
I se di kak we una de kak se nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul una, dɔn mek una ful. Una fil se bikɔs una get ay ay wɔl oba una ed, nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul una,
bɔt ivin if una go ɔp lɛk Igul, ɛn bil una os usay di sta dɛn de, PAPA GƆD se, in go briŋ una kam dɔŋ.
I se, una ɛnimi dɛn go pwɛl una kpatakpata. If tifman go na una os nɔto ɔltin dɛn go tif, ɛn dɛn pipul sɛf we de pik greps kin lɛf sɔm na di tik.
Di pipul dɛn na Idɔm, we na di sem pipul we na Isɔ in jɛnareshɔn, PAPA GƆD de tɛl una se, una ɛnimi dɛn go fɛn ɔl una jɛntri we una bin ayd.
Di wan dɛn we una se na una padi dɛn, we fɔ ɛp una, dɔn lay gi una. Una bin abop pan dɛn bɔt naw dɛn dɔn sɛt trap fɔ una, ɛn una nɔ ebul ɔndastand. Na dɛn naw de fos una fɔ muf na una land.
I se, we i rɛdi fɔ pɔnish una, i go mek una sɛnsman dɛn sɛns lɔs.
Di sojaman dɛn na Teman go fred ɛn dɛn go kil ɔl di sojaman dɛn na Idɔm.
I se ɔl dis bi to una bikɔs una de du bad ɛn una kil una brɔda dɛn we na Jekɔb in yon jɛnareshɔn dɛn. Dat go mek PAPA GƆD insɛf mek shem ɛn disgres mit una.

Una bin biev lɛk trenja di tɛm we di ɛnimi dɛn atak dɛn; di tɛm we dɛn fos fɔ go insay di siti, tek dɛn jɛntri ɛn kɛr am go; di tɛm we dɛn ivin gyambul bɔt wetin fɔ bi to Jerusɛlɛm; una jɛs lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf lɛk una na trenja.
Usay tru de fɔ tɔk, we una brɔda dɛn de pan trɔbul na Juda; unasɛf nɔ bin fɔ jɔyn fɔ provok dɛn pan dɛn trɔbul.
Da sem tɛm de, unasɛf jɔyn gɛŋ ɛn fala di pipul we kɔmɔt Babilɔn fɔ atak di siti. Una nɔ provok dɛn nɔmɔ, bɔt unasɛf tek wetin una ebul tek kɔmɔt na di siti.
Una nɔ jɛs jɔyn gɛŋ fɔ pwɛl di siti, una ivin tinap na di jɔnkshɔn fɔ kech di wan dɛn we de rɔnawe; udat una nɔ ebul andova una mek shɔ se una kil dɛn.
Di de de kam we PAPA GƆD go kam jɔj ɔl di neshɔn dɛn. Lɛk aw dɛn pas am pan dɛn kɔmpin, na so dɛn go pas am pan dɛn.
