PAPA GƆD de tɛl di pipul na Juda se lɛk aw dɛn sɔfa na mi oli mawnten, na so ɔl di ɔda neshɔn gɛt fɔ sɔfa ɛn dɛn go sɔfa mɔ. Dɛn go pɔnish lɛk aw pɔsin de drink wayn makoloŋ, dɔn, wɛn i dɔn wit dɛn, dɛn nɔn nɔ go lɛf.
Bɔt sɔm pipul na Juda nɔ go rɔnawe, dɛn go lɛf na Mawnt Zayɔn, di oli il; dɔn Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn go gɛt di land bak we na dɛn yon bay rayt.
PAPA GƆD se i go yuz di pipul na Juda ɛn Izrɛl fɔ sho aw in vɛks. In pɔnishmɛnt go kam lɛk faya ɛn na Idɔm go bi di chips. Dɛn go bɔn kpatakpata. Natin nɔ go lɛf, bikɔs na so PAPA GƆD se.
I se di wan dɛn we de na Sawt Juda go tek ova Idɔm; di wan dɛn we de na di Wɛst bɔda, dɛn go tek ova Filistia. Na di Izrɛlayt dɛn go gɛt Ifrem ɛn Sameria; dɔn di pipul dɛn na Bɛnjamin go gɛt Giliad.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn we de ɛgzayl go gɛt Kenan te rich Zarɛfat, di wan dɛn we de ɛgzayl we kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm, we de na Sadis, dɛn go tek ova di siti dɛn we de Sawt Juda.
Pipul dɛn go go sev Mawnt Zayɔn fɔ rul Mawnt Isɔ; ɛn PAPA GƆD go bi kiŋ bak fɔ dɛn ɔl.
PAPA GƆD tɔk to Jona we na Amitay in bɔypikin wande se,
“Grap go na da big siti we nem Ninivɛ, ɛn wɔn dɛn se a dɔn yɛri ɔltin bɔt di bad we dɛn de du.”

Bifo dat Jona grap ɛn rɔnawe go na Tashish lɛk fɔ se in go go usay PAPA GƆD nɔ de. I go na Jopa usay i mit wan ship we bin de rɛdi fɔ go Tashish. I bay tikit ɛn jomp insay di ship fɔ go Tashish usay i min to se PAPA GƆD nɔ go de.
So PAPA GƆD insɛf mek big big tinada blo ɛn i bin tan lɛk di ship wan skata.

Ɔl di siman dɛn bin de fred bad bad wan, dɛn ɔl at de na dɛn mɔt ɛn ɔlman bigin ala mek in yon gɔd ɛp dɛn. Dɛn trowe ɔl wetin de na di ship insay di wata mek di bot go layt. Ɔl da tɛm de Jonain bin lidɔm insay insay di ship de slip dip wan.
Di kapten go mit am de ɛn aks am wetin i de du, if na slip i de slip. Di kapten tɛl am se mek insɛf grap ɛn pre to in yon gɔd fɔ ɛp dɛn ɛn sɔntɛm i go sɔri fɔ dɛn ɛn mek dɛn nɔ day.
Ɔl di siman dɛn gri se fɔ luk grɔn mek dɛn go no udat mek dɛn de gɛt da kayn trɔbul de. We dɛn du am, i sho se na Jona mek wetin de bi, de bi.
Dɛn aks am udat i bi, wetin i de du, usay i kɔmɔt ɛn wetin mek dis de bi to dɛn.
I tɛl dɛn se in na Ibru ɛn dat na PAPA GƆD we na di GƆD we mek ɛvin ɛn ath i de wɔship.
I tɛl dɛn se in de rɔnawe pan PAPA GƆD ɛn dat mek di siman dɛn fred ɛn se na bad tin i dɔn du so. Dɛn aks am wetindu i de rɔnawe pan PAPA GƆD.
Ɔl da tɛm de di tinada jɛs de blo. So di siman dɛn aks Jona wetin dɛn fɔ du to am so dat di tinada go tap fɔ blo.
Jona se dɛn fɔ trowe am na di wata so dat di wata nɔ go rɔf igen. I se in no se di tinada de blo bikɔs ɔf wetin i du ɛn dat nain dɔn put dɛn pan trɔbul so.
Di siman dɛn nɔ bin wan du dat, so dɛn tray fɔ kɛr di ship go na dray land. Bɔt usay! I nɔ tek. Bifo dat di tinada jɛs de wɔs.
Nain dɛn pre to PAPA GƆD se lɛ i fɔgiv dɛn ɛn nɔ pɔnish dɛn fɔseka Jonain layf, bikɔs nain PAPA GƆD mek ɔl dat de bi.
As dɛn ib am na di wata so, di tinada lɛf fɔ blo ɛn di wata nɔ rɔf igen
We di siman dɛn si wetin bi, dɛn fred PAPA GƆD, mek sakrifays ɛn prɔmis fɔ sav am.
PAPA GƆD mek wan big big fish swɛla Jona ɛn i lɛf insay di fish in bɛlɛ fɔ tri de.
So Jona pre to PAPA GƆD we i de insay di fish in bɛlɛ,
i se, “Wɛn a bin de pan siriɔs trɔbul, a pre to PAPA GƆD, ɛn i ansa mi. Di tɛm we a de usay dayman de, a pre ɛn i yɛri mi.
I sɛn mi go rayt dɔŋ, rayt insay di wata, we na soso wata a de si, ɛn di wevs dɛn jɛs de baŋ mi.
A bin min se i dɔn fɔgɛt bɔt mi ɔltogɛda ɛn a nɔ go ebul go nain oli os igen
Di wata kɔba mi, a bin de dip dip insay di wata; ɛn di plant dɛnsɛf we kin de insay wata ɔl rap na mi ed.
I bin tan lɛk we pɔsin de bɔtɔm mawnten, we i nɔ gɛt fɔ si pantap am igen; bɔt PAPA GƆD, yu we na mi GƆD, pul mi kɔmɔt de ma.
Di tɛm we mi at ɔl dɔn pwɛl, a mɛmba PAPA GƆD, dɔn a pre to am, ɛn i yɛri mi insay in os we oli.
Dɛn wan we fasin fɔ wɔship dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn de pwɛl rod fɔ dɛnsɛf.
Bɔt a go tɛl yu tɛnki ɔltɛm; a go mek sakrifays ɛn du wetin a bin se a go du. Na PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ de pul pɔsin pan trɔbul.”
So PAPA GƆD tɛl di fish we bin swɛla Jona fɔ vɔmit am na di shɔ, ɛn i vɔmit am.
Afta dat PAPA GƆD tɔk to Jona ɛn sɛn am di sɛkɛn tɛm.
I se mek i grap go na Ninivɛ, da sem big siti we i bin sɛn am ɛn go tɛl di pipul dɛn wetin in se.
Dis tɛm naw, Jona grap go Ninivɛ, jɛs lɛkɛ aw PAPA GƆD se. Ninivɛ na bin big big siti ɛn na tri de yu de tek waka frɔm wan pat go na do ɔda pat.
Afta Jona dɔn waka fɔ wanol de, i tɔk nain at se na fɔti de mɔ Ninivɛ gɛt bifo PAPA GƆD go dɔnawe wit dɛn.
We i prich, di pipul dɛn na Ninivɛ biliv PAPA GƆD in wɔd; dɔn ɔlman, frɔm big to smɔl, wɛr munin klos fɔ sho aw dɛn sɔri ɛn dɛn ɔl gri se dɛn fɔ fast.
Wɛn di kiŋ na Ninivɛ insɛf yɛri, i grap nain tron, pul in klos ɛn wɛr di sem munin klos ɛn kɔba insɛf wit ashis.
I nɔ dɔn de, i anawns se, mɔtalman ɛn animal, dat na dɛn wan we dɛn de mɛn na os ɛn dɛn wan we tap na bush, nɔ fɔ it natin; dɛn nɔ fɔ drink wata ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ fid dɛn,
bɔt dɛn ɔl fɔ wɛr munin klos ɛn dɛn fɔ beg PAPA GƆD gud, ɛn di mɔtalman dɛn fɔ lɛf fɔ du bad ɛn lɛf fɔ fɛt ɛn wund ɛn chuk pɔsin.
Di kiŋ se sɔntɛm dat go mek PAPA GƆD in at kol ɛn i nɔ vɛks da bad bad vɛks we i bin vɛks igen, dɔn i go sɔri fɔ dɛn ɛn nɔ dɔnawe wit dɛn.
Wɛn PAPA GƆD si ɔl wetin dɛn du; aw dɛn lɛf fɔ du bad, i sɔri fɔ we i bin tɔk se i go dɔnawe wit dɛn ɛn i nɔ du dɛn natin.
We dis bi, Jona vɛks bad bad wan.

I tɛl PAPA GƆD se i bin no se na dat PAPA GƆD go du so na dat bin mek in rɔnawe fɔ go Tashish. I se in no se PAPA GƆD gɛt sɔri-at bad, i nɔ de vɛks so, ɛn in lɔv nɔ de ɛva chenj ɛn so i nɔ lɛk fɔ du bad.
I pre se mek PAPA GƆD tek in layf sins i go bɛtɛ fɔ am fɔ day pas fɔ gɛt layf.
PAPA GƆD insɛf aks am wetin mek i fɔ vɛks.
So Jona kɔmɔt na di siti, go na di istɛn pat, usay i go mek bafa fɔ insɛf. I sidɔm insay, de wet fɔ si wetin go apin to Ninivɛ.
So PAPA GƆD mek wan plant gro oba de so dat Jona go ɛnjɔy fɔ sidɔm ɔnda di shed. Dat mek Jona gladi bikɔs di plant gi am shed.
Bay di tɛm we do klin di nɛks de, PAPA GƆD mek wan tumbu it di plant, so i wida ɛn day.
Wɛn san kɔmɔt, PAPA GƆD mek wam wam briz we kɔmɔt na di ist, blo. Dɔn di san so wam dat i bin de bɔn Jonain ed we mek i fent, dɔn i pre fɔ day; i se i bɛtɛ if i day pas we i gɛt layf.
Dat mek PAPA GƆD aks Jona wetin mek i fɔ vɛks pan di plant. Jona se i gɛt rayt fɔ vɛks ɛn i so vɛks dat i want fɔ day.
PAPA GƆD se, “If yu de sɔri fɔ plant we yu nɔ no aw i gro bikɔs i bɔs na nɛt ɛn day na nɛt,
wetin mek mi nɔ fɔ sɔri fɔ di pipul dɛn na Ninivɛ, da big big siti de we gɛt pas wan ɔndrɛd ɛn twɛnti tawzin pipul de we nɔ no dɛn lɛfan frɔm dɛn raytan ɛn dɛn gɛt bɔku animal dɛn de?”
Dis na wetin PAPA GƆD tɛl Mayka we kɔmɔt Mɔrɛsheth bɔt Sameria ɛn Jerusɛlɛm di tɛm we Jotham, Eaz ɛn Ɛzikaya dɛn na bin kiŋ na Juda.
Una ɔl fɔ yɛri dis; Di wɔl, una lisin. Ɔl udat tap na dis wɔl fɔ yɛri dis! Lɛ PAPA GƆD we na GƆD, bi witnɛs as i de nain oli tɛmpul.
Una lisin, PAPA GƆD de kɔmɔt usay i de; ɛn i go kam dɔŋ, kam waka na ɔl wi ay ay ples dɛn.
We i pas, di grɔn ɛn di mawnten dɛn we de ɔnda in fut go mɛlt dɔn di vali dɛn go plit tu. Di mawnten dɛn go mɛlt lɛk kyandul bifo faya, lɛk we wata de rɔn dɔŋ il.
Ɔl dis go bi bikɔs Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn dɛn dɔn sin bad bad wan ɛn na Sameria ɛn Jerusɛlɛm fɔ blem.

Fɔseka dat PAPA GƆD se i go pwɛl Sameria ɛn mek i bi lɛkɛ aw dɔti de payl na grɔn na di opin fil. Nɔn bɛtɛ tin dɛn nɔ go plant de pas i bi ples fɔ plant greps gadin. Dɛn nɔ go ebul gɛda in stonston sɛf fɔ du ɛni ɔda tin.

Dɛn go nyamanyama ɔl di smɔl gɔd dɛn we dɛn mek dɔn dɛn go bɔn di tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz fɔ rare na di os we dɛn de wɔship. Na di sem tin we dɛn bin de du wit di tin dɛn we dɛn bin de rare wit, nain dɛn ɛnimi dɛn go du dɛn.
Mayka se na dat go mek in kray. Fɔ sho aw i de fil am, i go de nekɛd ɛn waka bia fut. I se in go kray lɛk aw dɛn Jakal ɛn da bɔd we dɛn kɔl Ɔstrich, de kray.
I kɔl dɛn pɔnishmɛnt, wund we nɔ go wɛl, bikɔs natin nɔ gɛt fɔ tap dɛn fɔ gɛt PAPA GƆD in pɔnishmɛnt. I se Juda go pwɛl lɛk Sameria ɛn Jerusɛlɛm, usay PAPA GƆD in pipul dɛn tap.
Nɔ mek wi ɛnimi dɛn, dat na di pipul na Gath, si wi we wi de kray atɔl. Di wan dɛn na Bɛth Liafra, fɔ rol na dɔti fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri;

Di wan dɛn we tap na Shafir, go pas wit dɛn shem ɛn nekɛdnɛs go dɛn we; di wan dɛn we tap na Zaanan nɔ go mistek kɔmɔt na do; wɛn dɛn go yɛri we di pipul dɛn na Bɛthɛzɛl de kray, dɛn no wantɛm se nɔto ples dat fɔ go ayd.
Di pipul na Marɔth de wet fɔ si wetin de apin bikɔs PAPA GƆD dɔn pwɛl di siti dɛn nia dɛn ɛn i dɔn rich Jerusɛlɛm.
Di pipul dɛn na Lakish fɔ mek di ɔs ɛn karej fɔ rɔnawe bikɔs na dɛn ɔl mek Jerusɛlɛm sin. Dɛn falamakata di bad tin dɛn we Izrɛl bin de du.
I se di pipul na Juda fɔ gi sɔntin we dɛn de pat kɔmpin wit Morɛshɛth Gath. Di kiŋ dɛn na Izrɛl nɔ fɔ abop se di pipul dɛn na Akzib go sɛn man dɛn fɔ ɛp dɛn fɛt.
I se PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn kech di pipul na Marisha ɛn kɛr dɛn go di tɛm we dɛn go kapchɔ di siti. Di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl go go ayd na di kev na Adulam.
I se di pipul dɛn na Juda fɔ krep dɛn ed fɔ sho aw dɛn fil am we dɛn tek dɛn pikin dɛn na dɛn an kɛr dɛn go. Dɛn fɔ fiba yuba we nɔ gɛt ia.
Eya! I go kɔmɔt bad pan dɛn wan we nɔ kin de slip na nɛt, bifo dat dɛn kin jɛs de mɛmba aw fɔ du bad. As do klin so, dɛn kin mekes fɔ go du di bad we dɛn plan wans dɛn gɛt di pawa.
Dɛn kin kapu pipul dɛn fil ɛn os dɛn ɛn pul dɛn kɔmɔt na dɛn an. Dɛn jɛs de fɔ buli pipul dɛn ɛn pul dɛn os ɛn ɔda prɔpati kɔmɔt na dɛn an.
PAPA GƆD se fɔseka dis, i go pɔnish dɛn kayn man dɛn de dɛn famili; i go gi dɛn lod we dɛn nɔ go ebul tot dɔn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ɛp dɛn. Da tɛm de dɛn go lɛf fɔ kak bikɔs tin go bad fɔ dɛn.

We da tɛm de kam, pipul go yuz dɛn mek ɛgzampul fɔ sho aw pɔsin de pe fɔ di bad we i du to ɔda pipul. Di pipul dɛn go mek siŋ bɔt dɛn lɛkɛ se na bɛrin dɛn gɛt: Ɔltin dɔn dɔn fɔ dɛn! PAPA GƆD dɔn pul dɛn land kɔmɔt na dɛn an I dɔn gi am to di wan dɛn we kapchɔ dɛn.
So we ɔlman kam bak, dɛn wan we bin de buli poman, nɔ go gɛt land fɔ dɛn fambul we dɛn de sheb.
We dɛn dɔn yɛri wetin Mayka se PAPA GƆD se, dɛn tɔk pan Mayka ɛn tɛl am se i nɔ fɔ prich so bikɔs PAPA GƆD nɔ tan so.

Dɛn aks Mayka se if i want tɛl dɛn se PAPA GƆD nɔ de peshɛnt wit Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn. Dɛn se PAPA GƆD nɔ tan so, i nɔ de vɛks kwik pan pipul dɛn, so i nɔ go du ɔl wetin Mayka se i go du. PAPA GƆD de trit udat de waka tret wit am, fayn.
Insɛf tɛl dɛn se, dɛn nɔ bɛtɛ pas di wan dɛn we kech dɛn; dɛn de biev lɛk di ɛnimi to di ɔda wan dɛn bikɔs dɛn de trit dɛn lɛk aw tifman de trit pɔsin, dat na we dɛn de tek dɛn klos dɛn na dɛn an.
Dɛn de drɛb di uman dɛn kɔmɔt na dɛn os dɔn dɛn nɔ de mek di pikin dɛn ɛnjɔy wetin PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ dɛn.
I se, dɛn fɔ grap go ɔdasay bikɔs ples nɔ de fɔ dɛn de igen; dɛn dɔn dɔti wata wit dɛn sin ɛn so na pwɛl nɔmɔ PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ pwɛl di ples.
Mayka se na pɔsin we de lay gi dɛn, nain dɛn want. I se if di pɔsin kam prich se dɛn go gɛt bɔku wayn ɛn rɔm fɔ drink, na da tɛm de dɛn go gladi fɔ lisin we i de tɔk.
Bɔt i tɛl dɛn se PAPA GƆD prɔmis se i go gɛda ɔl Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn, i se PAPA GƆD go mek ɔl udat lɛf pan di Izrɛlayt dɛn kam bak na wan ɔndasela ɛn dɛn go bɔku so we go de de.
I se PAPA GƆD we mek we dɛn kech dɛn kɛr go, nain sem wan go mek we fɔ dɛn fɔ kɔmɔt de. PAPA GƆD, nain go bi dɛn kiŋ ɛn nain go lid dɛn fɔ go na dɛn land bak.

Mayka kɔl di bigman dɛn to atɛnshɔn. I aks dɛn se if dɛn na di big wan dɛn na Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn ɔ dɛn na di wan dɛn we de jɔj na Izrɛl. I tɛl dɛn se bay rayt dɛn fɔ de mek shɔ se pipul dɛn de trit dɛn kɔmpin fayn,
bɔt bifo dat i tan lɛk se dɛn et wetin gud ɛn lɛk wetin bad. Dɛn de biev lɛk buchaman we de pul ɔl di bif kɔmɔt pan bon we i wan kɔt fɔ put na pɔt
ɛn lɛk wayl bif, na so dɛn de nyamanyama di pipul dɛn.
Dɛn go pre to PAPA GƆD bɔt i nɔ go ansa dɛn. I nɔ go lisin to dɛnsɛf bikɔs dɛn dɔn du bad.
Na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt di fɔls prɔfɛt dɛn: I se dɛn de ful di pipul. We dɛn gi dɛn tin fɔ it, dɛn de se ɔltin ɔrayt bɔt we dɛn nɔ gɛt fɔ gi dɛn, na da tɛm de dɛn de tɛl dɛn se dɛn go gɛt trɔbul.
PAPA GƆD se fɔseka dat, dɛn dɔn rich dɛn Watalo bikɔs dɛn nɔ go si ɛni vishɔn we go mek dɛn lay gi pipul
ɛn PAPA GƆD nɔ go ansa natin we dɛn aks fɔ.

Mayka tɛl dɛn se na PAPA GƆD in spirit nɔmɔ we de pan am de gi am pawa. I se i de gi am sɛns ɛn mek i ebul fɔ tɛl Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn bɔt di bad we dɛn de du ɛn fɔ tɛl Izrɛl bɔt di sin dɛn we dɛn de kɔmit.
I se ɔl di big wan dɛn na Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn ɛn di bigman dɛn na Izrɛl fɔ lɛf fɔ de twis di lɔ ɛn gi rayt to udat rɔŋ.
I se na bad, bad tin dɛn de du so we dɛn de mek soso kruk de na Jerusɛlɛm lɛk nain dɛn de bil di siti wit.

Di big wan dɛn we de bifo de tek brayb, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin de tek mɔni fɔs bifo dɛn du dɛn wok dɔn di prɔfɛt dɛn de tek pe bifo dɛn tɛl yu PAPA GƆD in mɛsej. Na ɔl dɛn bad tin ya dɛn de du bɔt dɛn de blɔf se PAPA GƆD de wit dɛn so natin nɔ go du dɛn.

Mayka se ɔl dɛn bad tin ya we dɛn de du go mek pipul nɔ de na Zayɔn, so dɛn go plant ɔlkayn tin de lɛk na fil; ɛn Jerusɛlɛm in go so pwɛl dat na stonston nɔmɔ go de de, dɔn PAPA GƆD in os go tɔn bush.
Wande wande di mawnten usay PAPA GƆD in os de go bi di mawnten we ay pas ɔl, ɛn i go ay sɛf pas di il dɛn. Bɔku ɔda neshɔn dɛn go wan fɔ go de,

dɔn dɛn pipul dɛn go se fɔ go ɔp na PAPA GƆD in mawnten, we na Mawnt Zayɔn usay PAPA GƆD in os de. I go tich wi wetin in want wi fɔ du; ɛn wisɛf go du wetin i want wi fɔ du. Na Jerusɛlɛm wetin PAPA GƆD wan tich de kɔmɔt; dɔn na Zayɔn i de de we i wan tɔk to in pipul dɛn.

I go de tɔk kes wɛn dɛn difrɛn neshɔn gɛt plaba, i lɛk dɛn de nia ɔ dɛn de fa; dɛn go nak nak dɛn sɔd fɔ mek tin fɔ yuz na fam, ɛn dɛn spia, dɛn go mek i bi nɛf fɔ kɔt na fam, di neshɔn dɛn nɔ go fɛt dɛnsɛf igen, so nid nɔ go de fɔ tren fɔ fɛt igen;
Ɔlman go sidɔm nain fam ɔ in gadin, ɛn natin nɔ go mek dɛn de fred; na PAPA GƆD, PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti insɛf dɔn tɔk.
Ɔl di neshɔn dɛn go de wɔship dɛn yon gɔd dɛn bɔt di wan dɛn we na PAPA GƆD in yon pipul go wɔship ɛn obe am sote go.
PAPA GƆD se da tɛm de, i go gɛda ɔl udat i bin dɔn mek go ɛgzayl bikɔs i bin wan pɔnish dɛn;
in go briŋ udat lɛf kam bak ɛn mek dɛn bigin layf bak. Dɛn go bi pawaful ɛn na frɔm Mawnt Zayɔn in go rul dɛn sote go.

I se Jerusɛlɛm na ples we PAPA GƆD de, de luk in pipul dɛn lɛk aw man we de mɛn ship kin sidɔm na kɔna de wach in ship dɛn. I tan lɛk aw sikyɔriti kin de na sɔn ay ples we dɛn bil de wach wetin de apin. I se di ples go bi di kayn big siti we i bin bi bak.
I se wetin mek di pipul dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm de ala kray so. Dɛn mek nɔys lɛk we bɛlɛ uman wan bɔn. I se dɛn de mek lɛk dɛn bigman dɛn dɔn day.
I se na naw dɛn fɔ kray ɛn rol na grɔn lɛk uman we wan bɔn bikɔs dɛn gɛt fɔ kɔmɔt na di siti go tap na opin ples. I se dɛn go go Babilɔn bɔt PAPA GƆD go pul dɛn na dɛn ɛnimi dɛn an.
I se difrɛn neshɔn dɛn dɔn mek gɛŋ pan dɛn. Dɛn de se Jerusɛlɛm mɔs pwɛl, dɛn de abop se dɛn go si in fɔdɔm wan.
Bɔt na bikɔs dɛn neshɔn dɛn de nɔ no wetin de na PAPA GƆD in maynd. Dɛn nɔ ɔndastand aw i de wok se na we i wan pɔnish dɛn mek i lɛ dɛn mek wanwɔd ɛn gɛda na wan ples lɛk aw dɛn kin gɛda sid fɔ gren.

Di tɛm dɔn kam fɔ mek dɛn grap ɛn dil wit dɛn ɛnimi. PAPA GƆD se i go mek Jerusɛlɛm traŋa lɛk man kaw we in ɔn tan lɛk ayɛn dɔn i tan lɛk na bras de nain fut dɛn. Dɛn go nyamanyama di ɔda neshɔn dɛn, tek ɔl dɛn jɛntri bay fos ɛn gi PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD fɔ di wanol wɔl.
I se dɛn dɔn sɔrawnd dɛn na dɛn siti we gɛt wɔl ɛn dɛn dɔn bit dɛn bigman sɛf ɛn gi am dɔti fɔ it.
PAPA GƆD se na Bɛtliɛm Ɛfrata we smɔl pas ɔl di siti dɛn na Juda, i go mek sɔmbɔdi kɔmɔt ɛn bi bigman insay Izrɛl ɛn na pɔsin we ɔlman go no bɔt bikɔs dɛn go no in fambul tik.
Bikɔs ɔf wetin dɛn de du, i go lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf te di uman we in tɛm dɔn rich fɔ bɔn, bɔn; da tɛm de ɔl udat bin dɔn skata ɔlsay na wɔl go kam to dɛn pipul bak.

Da pɔsin de go tan lɛk man we de mɛn ship, i go tinap ɛn fid di ship dɛn ɛn na PAPA GƆD go gi am pawa fɔ du dat. Na PAPA GƆD, we nain GƆD, in nem i go tek du am. In pipul dɛn nɔ go gɛt ɛni yagba ɛn ɔlman go no se na man da wande.
I go mek ɔlman gɛt kolat. Da tɛm de wɛn di Asirian dɛn go atak dɛn, dɛn go sɛn ɔl dɛn bigman dɛn fɔ go fɛt dɛn.
Dɛn go win di Asirian dɛn ɛn tek dɛn land ɛn di land usay Nimrɔd, da wɔndaful sojaman de. Dɔn i go pul dɛn na di Asirian dɛn an we di Asirian dɛn go go insay di Izrɛlayt dɛn yon siti go aras dɛn.
Da tɛm de di wan dɛn we lɛf na Jekɔb in jɛnareshɔn go de midul di ɔda pipul dɛn lɛk aw ren kin fɔdɔm pan plant fɔ mek i gro fayn. Na PAPA GƆD dɛn abop pan, nɔto pan mɔtalman.
Dɛn go tan lɛk layɔn midul di pipul dɛn lɛk aw layɔn kin de na bush ɔ lɛk we pikin layɔn kin go de wit ship dɛn we i kin so nyamanyama dɛn dat dɛn nɔ kin ebul pul ɛniwan nain an.
I se dɛn go ebul dɛn ɛnimi ɛn dɛn go dɔnawe wit dɛn.
PAPA GƆD se da tɛm de, dɛn nɔ go gɛt ɔs ɛn karej fɔ go fɛt wit bikɔs i go dɔn pwɛl dɛn ɔl
ɛn dɛn ples we dɛn dɔn mek fayn fɔ lɛ dɛn nɔ ambɔg dɛn, ɔl go pwɛl;
ɔl di tin dɛn we dɛn kin yuz fɔ ple wikɛd majik wit ɔl dɛn man we kin de luk grɔn fɔ dɛn, in go pwɛl ɔl;
in go pwɛl ɔl di tin dɛn we dɛn de mek ɛn tek wɔship dɛn ɔda gɔd dɛn so, dɛn nɔ go gɛt fɔ go wɔship natin we dɛn tek dɛn an mek;
Una Ashɛra dɛn statyu dɛn ɔl go kam dɔŋ ɛn di siti go pwɛl kpatakpata.
Dɔn i go put in vɛksteshɔn pan ɔl dɛn kɔntri we nɔ du wetin i want.
Lɛ wi yɛri wetindu PAPA GƆD vɛks pan Izrɛl. I se: lɛ di mawnten ɛn il dɛn kam yɛri wetin i de se.
Na di mawnten dɛn bin dɔn de frɔm di tɛm we i mek di wɔl, so dɛn fɔ lisin gud to wetin i wan se, as i dɔn rɛdi fɔ tɔk ɔl wetin Izrɛl dɔn du we mek i vɛks pan dɛn.
Na PAPA GƆD de tɔk so naw. I se, “Izrɛl, mi pikin dɛn, wetin a du una we una de trit mi so? Una ansa mi nɔ!
A pul una kɔmɔt pan di slev layf we una bin de pan na Ijipt ɛn sɛn Mozis, Erɔn ɛn Miriam fɔ lid una.

Mi pikin dɛn, una mɛmba wetin Belak, di kiŋ na Moab bin plan fɔ una ɛn aw Belam we na Beɔ in bɔypikin bin ansa am. Una mɛmba wetin bin apin na rod we una kɔmɔt Akesia fɔ go Gilgal. If una ebul mɛmba dɛn tin ya, una go mɛmba wetin PAPA GƆD du fɔ sev una.”
Una de aks se wetin una fɔ gi PAPA GƆD naw we una de go wɔship am, in we na di PAPA GƆD we de ɔp yanda. Una de aks if na fɔ bɔn animal as sakrifays ɔ na fɔ gi am fayn yɔŋ kaw dɛn.
Una aks se if PAPA GƆD go gladi if una gi am wan tawzin man got ɔ fɔ gi am bɔku bɔku ɔyl ɔ na una fɔs pikin dɛn fɔ tek pe di dɛt fɔ una sin so dat una go yuz wetin kɔmɔt pan una bɔdi fɔ pe fɔ di sin.
Bɔt i dɔn sho una wetin gud ɛn wetin i want. Dat na fɔ lɛ una trit una kɔmpin fia wan, ɛn lɛk fɔ du gud, gɛt lɔv we nɔ de ɛva chenj ɛn put unasɛf dɔŋ fɔ du wetin PAPA GƆD want una fɔ du.
PAPA GƆD in vɔys de ɔlsay we i de tɛl una se udat fɔ gɛt fred ɛn rɛspɛkt fɔ am, gɛt sɛns. I se, “Na una we gɛda na di siti a de tɔk to.
Aw a go fɔgɛt bɔt dɛn bad pipul dɛn we dɛn os ful wit soso gud tin dɛn we dɛn gɛt bay dɛn rikishi gem?
A go se pɔsin we na so so rog wet dɛn de nain bag, ɔ di wan we de lay pan di skel nɔ du natin?
Una man dɛn ɔl we jɛntri, bad, ɛn dɛn de lay lɛk wetin. Tru tɔk nɔ de na dɛn mɔt.
So misɛf dɔn bigin mek dɛn sɔfa fɔ dɛn sin. Na sik go kil dɛn.
Una go it bɔt dat nɔ go min natin to una bikɔs una go stil aŋri, una go kip tin dɛn bɔt i go bi fɔ natin bikɔs ɔl wetin una kip go pwɛl na wa.
We una plant ɛnitin i nɔ go gro, una nɔ go ivin ebul fɔ yuz di ɔyl we una kwis dɔn una nɔ go drink di wayn we una mek.
Ɔl dis go bi bikɔs una fala wetin Omri de du ɛn ɔl di bad we Eab sɛf de du; ɛn bikɔs ɔf dat, a go mek dɛn ɔda pipul dɛn sɔktit we dɛn si una bikɔs una go dɔn alaki.”

Mayka se i de wes in tɛm fɔ natin. I se i tan lɛk we pɔsin nɔ de fɛn frut fɔ it na tik di tɛm we i fɔ bia, ɔ wɛn dɛn dɔn pik ɔl di greps na di tik we i nɔ go gɛt wayn fɔ drink. Natin nɔ de fɔ it ɛn wetin i de aŋri fɔ sɛf, i nɔ go gɛt am.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ de na wɔl we gud, nɔbɔdi nɔ de du wetin rayt; dɛn ɔl de wach fɔ di tɛm we dɛn go ebul kech dɛn yon brɔda. Ɔlman jɛs de wet ɛn chuk ɛn kil.
If na fɔ bad, dɛn sabi aw fɔ du am we i nɔ go pwɛl. Ɔl di bigman dɛn de tek brayb ivin di jɔj dɛn. In ɛn di wan we gɛt pawa de du wetin dɛn lɛk ɛn natin nɔ de kɔmɔt biɛn dat.
Di wan we kin se i de du di rayt tin sɛf na lɛk smɔl smɔl chukchuk. Di wan we bɛtɛ pas dɛn ɔl tan lɛk dɛn bi big chukchuk. Na di tɛm dɔn rich so we dɛn go gɛt dɛn pɔnishmɛnt.
Nɔ fɔ abop pan pɔsin, ivin yu buzɔm frɛn, na fɔ tek tɛm wetin yu de tɛl am.

Dɛn bɔypikin dɛn kin mek dɛn papa dɛn ful dɔn di gyal pikin dɛn kin tinap lɛk se dɛn wan fɛt dɛn mami, dɔtɛnlɔ nɔ want fɔ si mɔdɛnlɔ. Ɔl dis de sho se na di wan we una ɔl de slip na di sem os, na yu ɛnimi.
I se fɔ in yon say, in go luk to PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ as nain na di GƆD we de sev am ɛn i go yɛri am.
I se lɛ in ɛnimi dɛn nɔ gladi we trɔbul mit am o, bikɔs if i fɔdɔm sɛf, i de grap ɛn we i tan lɛk ples dak fɔ am, PAPA GƆD de bi di wan we de gi am layt.
Na fɔ bia wetin PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ du bikɔs dɛn dɔn sin to am. I go fɛt fɔ dɛn ɛn mek ɔl udat fɔ gɛt rayt gɛt rayt. Dɔn i go mek ɔlman si wetin i du we i go sev dɛn.

Da tɛm de, in ɛnimi go si korokoro wan ɛn dɛn wan dɛn we bin de aks usay PAPA GƆD, we nain GƆD de, go shem. Insɛf go gladi fɔ si se ɔl wetin in ɛnimi bin de du to ɔda pipul, nain de apin to dɛn naw. Dɛnsɛf go si aw ɔda pipul go de trit dɛn lɛk aw dɛn de mas pɔtɔpɔtɔ na trit.
Na da sem tɛm de dɛn go mek ɔl di wɔl we bin dɔn brok na Jerusɛlɛm bak ɛn di siti go big pas aw i bin tan fɔs.
Pipul go kɔmɔt Asiria, Ijipt ɛn Riva Yufretis wit ɔl dɛn watasay ɛn mawnten kam na di siti.
Bɔt di land go dray so bikɔs ɔf di bad we di pipul dɛn we de de dɔn du.
Mayka beg PAPA GƆD fɔ lɛ i trit dɛn lɛk aw man we de mɛn ship kin trit di ship we i de mɛn. I se lɛ i tek dɛn go na Beshan ɛn Giliad we gɛt frɛsh gras we dɛn go it lɛk aw i bin de du fɔstɛm.
I se mek PAPA GƆD ple mirekul fɔ dɛn lɛk aw i bin du we dɛn kɔmɔt Ijipt.
Dat go mek dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn mɔt ful. Pan ɔl dɛn trɛnk we dɛn de mek, dɛn nɔ go gɛt mɔt fɔ tɔk igen ɛn dɛn nɔ go de yɛri sɛf;
dɛn go le bɛlɛ na grɔn lɛk snek ɛn dɔbalɛ, dɔn dɛn go tɔn to PAPA GƆD we na GƆD bikɔs dɛn go fred ɛn rɛspɛkt am.
Nɔn gɔd nɔ de we tan lɛk PAPA GƆD we kwik fɔ fɔgiv in pipul dɛn sin. I nɔ go jɛs vɛks pan di balans we lɛf afta dɛn ɛnimi dɔn aras dɛn bikɔs in lɔv nɔ de dɔn.
I go sɔri fɔ ɔlman ɛn mek lɛk se dɛn nɔ du natin.
PAPA GƆD go biev lɛk aw i bin de biev to Jekɔb, sho in lɔv we nɔ de dɔn to Ebram, jɛs lɛk aw i bin dɔn prɔmis dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn se i go du.
Neum we kɔmɔt Ɛlkɔsh in vishɔn we i bin si ɛn tɔk bɔt Ninivɛ
PAPA GƆD want wi fɔ lɛk In nɔmɔ bikɔs i jɛlɔs bad; we i vɛks I kin pɔnish in ɛnimi dɛn. We i vɛks fɔ tru, i de dil wit ɔl udat ambɔg am.
PAPA GƆD na PAPA GƆD we pawaful i peshɛnt i kin mek shɔ se udat de du bad gɛt di pe we i de fɛt fɔ. Wi de si am insay di briz we de blo; di klawd dɛn na di dɔti we in fut de mek.
Na tɔk nɔmɔ i go tɔk pan di si ɛn i go dray. Ɔl di watasay dɛnsɛf go dray. Di fil dɛn na Beshan ɛn Mawnt Kamɛl wit di flawa dɛn na Libanɔn go wida.
Di mawnten dɛn go trimbul, dɔn di il dɛn go mɛlt bifo in yay; di ath ɔl go trimbul usay i de, ɛn di wɔl wit in pipul dɛnsɛf go trimbul.
Udat ebul tinap bifo PAPA GƆD we i vɛks? Udat ebul am we i dɔn vɛks? We i vɛks i de blez lɛk faya, ivin dɛn big ston kin tɔn grabul-grabul usay i de.
PAPA GƆD na gud PAPA GƆD, i de pul pɔsin kɔmɔt pan trɔbul; i nɔ de lɛf udat go to am fɔ ɛp am to insɛf.
Lɛk aw wata de kɛr pɔsin go, na so i de nyamanyama in ɛnimi; dɛn; dɛn nɔ go gɛt nɔwe fɔ ayd.
Wetin yu de plan fɔ PAPA GƆD? I go dɔn wit yu kpatakpata. Yu nɔ go de fɔ plan bad fɔ am tu tɛm.
Lɛk aw chukchuk we taŋul de bɔn na faya na so una dɛn drɔnkɔman dɛn gɛt fɔ tan.
Na frɔm una sɔmbɔdi kɔmɔt we plan bad fɔ PAPA GƆD.
Dis na wetin PAPA GƆD se, I se i lɛk sɛf di Asirian dɛn bɔku ɛn gɛt pawa lɛk wetin, i go pwɛl dɛn kpatakpata ɛn dɔnawe wit dɛn. I se i bin dɔn mek una sɔfa bɔt i nɔ go du am igen
I se in go pul dɛn kɔmɔt biɛn una ɛn dɛn nɔ go ebul una igen

Na dis PAPA GƆD se bɔt di Asirian dɛn: I se nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛt fɔ lɛf wit dɛn nem ɛn i pwɛl ɔl dɛn gɔd dɛn we dɛn bin dɔn mek, we de insay dɛn os dɛn we dɛn put dɛn. Infakt sɛf i se in de mek wan big bɛriŋrɔn fɔ dɛn as dɛn tu bad.

Lɔd o! Na wi tɛm dɔn kam so. Sɔmbɔdi de pantap di mawnten de ala se di Asirian dɛn yon dɔn dɔn, so una fɔ kɔntinyu wit una sɛlibreshɔn ɛn gi PAPA GƆD wetin una bin dɔn se una go gi am bikɔs i go nyamanyama di Asirian ɛn dɛn nɔ go ambɔg una igen
Na siriɔs trɔbul Ninivɛ de pan so. Fɔ rɛdi man dɛn fɔ gyad di rod fɔ klem go ɔp di wɔl; wach di rod; rɛdi dɛnsɛf ɛn pik trɛnk. (
PAPA GƆD bin dɔn rɛdi fɔ mek Izrɛl bi wetin i bin bi bak bifo in ɛnimi dɛn ambɔg am.)

Di big shild we dɛn tek kɔba dɛnsɛf fɔ mek dɛn nɔ ebul dɛn, na rɛd. Dɔn dɛn wɛr rɛd yunifɔm. Di ayɛn dɛn pan dɛn chariɔt dɛn rɛd lɛk faya we dɛn dɔn rɛdi fɔ fɛt; di soja man dɛn we de rayd ɔs de pared.
Di chariɔt dɛn de pas wit spid na di trit dɛn, dɛn de pas ɔp ɛn dɔŋ di siti wit spid; di chariɔt dɛn de shayn lɛk we yu layt tɔchlayt, dɛn kin pas kwik lɛk we laytin flash.
Dɛn kɔl ɔl di ɔfisa dɛn; na so dɛn ɔl de staga we dɛn de go bifo. Di wan dɛn we de atak dɛn rɔn go to di wɔl usay dɛn go tek stand de wet fɔ rɛdi di tin we dɛn kin tek fɛt.
Wata bɔs insay di kiŋ in os di wanol ples tɔnoba.
Dɛn mek di kwin pul ɔl in klos ɛn kɛr am go, in nɔs dɛn ɔl lɛf de kray lɛk pijin ɛn nak nak dɛn chɛst fɔ sho se dɛn sɔri.
Di pipul dɛn de rɔn kɔmɔt na Ninivɛ lɛk aw wata kin bɔs we payp bɔs. Di ɔfisa dɛn de kɔl di pipul bak bɔt di pipul dɛn nɔ luk dɛnsɛf.
Dɛn tek ɔl di tin dɛn we gɛt valyu kɔmɔt na di siti.
Ninivɛ pwɛl kpatakpata, ɔlman at kɔmɔt nain atkes dɛn ɔlman bɔdi brok ɛn nɔ no wetin fɔ du; na so fred rayt na dɛn ɔl fes.
Usay Layɔn dɛn os de, di kev we yɔŋ layɔn dɛn de usay di layɔn kin kɛr bif we i dɔn kil, usay in pikin dɛn de ɛn nɔ gɛt nɔbɔdi fɔ ambɔg am?
Di layɔn kin chɛr di bif we go du gi in pikin dɛn ɛn gi di uman layɔn insɛf pan am; i de ful in kev wit animal dɛn we i dɔn kil, na so so af af bif kin de nain os.
PAPA GƆD we na GƆD we pas ɔl se i vɛks pan dɛn. I se in go bɔn ɔl wetin dɛn de yuz na wa ɛn dɛn go day de. I se dɛn nɔ go ebul fɔ de sɛn pipul dɛn go ɔdasay igen
Di siti dɔn alaki, na tin dɛn fɔ siz nɔmɔ de de- dɛn nɔ de tap fɔ tek pipul tin bay fos.
Yu kin yɛri we di wip we dɛn de yuz pan di ɔs dɛn de mek sway sway ɔlɔbɔt, di chariɔt dɛn de pas wit ay spid, di ɔs dɛn ɔl de mek nɔys we dɛn de pas pas.
Di man dɛn we de rayd di ɔs dɛn de pas ɛn dɛn de swiŋ swiŋ dɛn sɔd ɛn dɛn spia dɛn, pipul dɛn jɛs de day gbay di dedebɔdi dɛn ful trit yu nɔ go waka yu nɔ mas dedebɔdi.
Na ɔl di rare layf we Ninivɛ bin de pan dɛn de pe fɔ so, i kin tek kɔni kɔni drɔ pipul atɛnshɔn, dɔn i lɛf dɛn na spes wit di sem kayn layf.
PAPA GƆD we pas ɔl ɔda gɔd vɛks pan dɛn. I se in go mɔs pɔnish dɛn. I se in go trip dɛn nekɛd frɔnt di ɔda neshɔn dɛn, dɔn ɔlman go si dɛn disgres wan.
I se in go trowe dɔti pan dɛn ɛn mek se i nɔ no dɛn dɔn i go mek ɔlman de pas luk dɛn ɛn laf.
Da tɛm de ɔl udat de luk dɛn go shumɔ ɛn tɔk se, Ninivɛ dɔn dɔn; udat go sɔri fɔ am? Usay a go fɛn pipul dɛm we go koks am?
I se Ninivɛ tink se in bɛtɛ pas Thibis, da big siti na Ijipt? I gɛt Riva Nayl rawnd am fɔ protɛkt am. Na di wata nain wɔl.
Di pipul dɛn na Thibis bin de sho se dɛn gɛt pawa bay aw dɛn bin de rul Ithiopia ɛn Ijipt insɛf pan ɔl wetin dɛn de du. Na Libia bin de ɛp dɛn.
Pan ɔl dat, dɛn bin kech insɛf kɛr am go ɛgzayl. Na trit dɛn dil wit in pikin dɛn. Dɛn ivin gyambul fɔ no aw fɔ sheb di bigman dɛn we dɛn kech.
I se na so Ninivɛ insɛf go drɔnk wit pawa ɛn nɔ no wetin i de du. I go tray fɔ ayd pan in ɛnimi dɛn.
Ɔl di tin dɛn we i mek fɔ protɛkt insɛf tan lɛk fig tik we gɛt fig dɛn we rɛp, as yu shek am so di fig dɛn de fɔdɔm go insay di pɔsin we wan it dɛn in mɔt.
I se dɛn sojaman dɛn de biev lɛk uman dɛn. Dɛn nɔ ebul fɛt igen ɛn so dɛn nɔ ebul pul di kɔntri na dɛn ɛnimi dɛn an. Na faya go pwɛl di krɔsba dɛn na dɛn get.
Neum se dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn kip wata we dɛn sojaman dɛn go drink di tɛm we dɛn de fɛt ɛn dɛn fɔ tray fɔ mek usay wik. Dɛn fɔ mas mas di kle we dɛn wan yuz fɔ mek blɔk lɛ i saf.
Na de faya go bɔn bɔn dɛn ɛn dɛn go day na wa. Dɛn go so nyamanyama dɛn dat dɛn go fiba plant we lokɔs kin dɔn it.
Bɔku biznɛsman go de lɛk aw di sta dɛn kin de na di klawd bɔt we dɛn dɔn gɛt wetin dɛn want, dɛn go kɔmɔt de go lɛk aw lokɔs kin flay go we i dɔn it ɔl dɛn grin plant dɔn.
Di bigman dɛn tan lɛk lokɔs ɛn dɛn sikyɔriti na lɛk we lokɔs kin ayd we di ples kol dɔn we san kɔmɔt dɛn kin skata ɛn go usay dɛn wan go we pɔsin nɔ go no.

Ɔl dɛn wan we kin de ɛp di bɔsman fɔ di kiŋ dɛn wok, dɛn ɔl lidɔm day wan; dɛn de slip, slip we go mek dɛn opin yay oba yanda. Di pipul dɛn skata na di mawnten lɛk ship we nɔ gɛt ona ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ briŋ dɛn kam bak.
Natin nɔ de fɔ pul dɛn kɔmɔt pan di kayn trɔbul we dɛn fɛn fɔ dɛnsɛf. Ɔl udat yɛri bɔt wetin mit dɛn go dans wit gladi bikɔs nɔbɔdi nɔ de we nɔ tes dɛn bad wan.
Na di wɔd dis we PAPA GƆD gi to Prɔfɛt Abakɔk
“PAPA GƆD, Aw lɔŋ a go de kɔmplen ɛn bifo yu go yɛri ɛn tap bad fɔ mit wi?
Ɔ na wes a de westɛm se trɔbul de we yu de mek se yu nɔ no? Ɔltin dɔn tɔnoba na di ples. Na soso fɛt ɛn plaba de ɔlsay.
Lɔ nɔ de igen As fɔ fia ple, nɔ fɔ tɔk. Na di bad pipul bɔku pas udat de du tin tret so fia ple nɔ de”.
PAPA GƆD ansa am se, mek i jɛs luk di ɔda neshɔn dɛn ɛn si PAPA GƆD wɔnda. I se dɛn nɔn nɔ go biliv if dɛn tɛl dɛn wetin i du.
I se in go mek di Babilonian dɛn we rɔf lɛk wetin, tek ova bɔku siti dɛn we nɔto dɛn yon.
I se dɛn na bad bad pipul we ɔlman de fred. Aw dɛn nɔ gɛt kɔntrol, na so dɛn nɔ gɛt lɔ; dɛn de du wetin dɛn want.
Dɛn ɔs dɛn de rɔn pas lɛpɛt ɛn dɛn de biev lɛk aŋri wulf; dɛn man dɛn de rayd dɛn ɔs kɔmɔt fawe wit spid lɛk igul fɔ kam pwɛl wetin dɛn ebul.
Ɔlman de trimbul wit fred we dɛn si dɛn bikɔs dɛn bad ɛn dɛn kin de kech pipul dɛn plɛnti plɛnti lɛk sansan.
Dɛn nɔ bisin sɛf udat yu bi. Dɛn de provok di bigman dɛn ɛn trit di kiŋ dɛn bad. I lɛk aw di wɔl we de rawnd di siti ay, dɛn de brok am kam dɔŋ ɛn siz am.
Dɛn de du wetin dɛn fil fɔ du as dɛn fil se bikɔs dɛn gɛt pawa, dɛn na PAPA GƆD.
Abakɔk aks PAPA GƆD se if nɔto in na PAPA GƆD frɔm tɛm. Di PAPA GƆD we oli. I se in no se dɛn nɔ go day as na PAPA GƆD pik di Babilonian dɛn fɔ pɔnish dɛn.
I se in no se PAPA GƆD in yay tu gud fɔ de luk ɔl di bad we dɛn de du so wetin fɔ mek i de luk di Babilonian dɛn naw we dɛn de pas am pan dɛn, aftaɔl dɛn de du wetin rayt pas di Babilonian dɛn.
I se PAPA GƆD mek dɛn fiba fish ɔ ɛni ɔda kayn flay ɔ mut mut we nɔ gɛt bɔs fɔ sɔri fɔ dɛn.
We dɛn sɛn bet fɔ fish, we di bet kech di fish, nɔbɔdi nɔ de tɔk fɔ di fish. Abakɔk se na so PAPA GƆD de mek dɛn fiba bikɔs di Babilonian dɛn de gladi we dɛn de pas am pan dɛn.
We di Babilonian dɛn dɔn kech dɛn lɛk fish, dɛn kin mek sakrifays to dɛn nɛt dɛn, ɛn bɔn insɛns to di uk, bikɔs na di nɛt dɛn de mek dɛn liv gud, ɛn it gud it.
Abakɔk aks PAPA GƆD if na so i go lɛf di Babilonian dɛn fɔ de biev te go, fɔ lɛ dɛn de pas ɛn dil wit neshɔn dɛn aw dɛn fil fɔ ɛn nɔ de sɔri fɔ dɛn.
Abakɔk se in go tinap na wan ay ples de wach fɔ si ɛn yɛri wetin PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ se to am, ɛn wet fɔ si aw PAPA GƆD go dil wit in kɔmplen.
So PAPA GƆD gi am vishɔn ɛn tɛl am se i fɔ rayt ɔl wetin i si ɛn yɛri klia wan na tablɛt so ɔlman go ebul rid am..
I se di tɛm nɔ rich yet fɔ lɛ wetin i go si na di vishɔn apin; bɔt di tɛm gɛt fɔ kam jisnɔ, i go bi ma; i se i fɔ bia fɔ si wetin go apin bikɔs i go tan lɛk natin nɔ de bi bɔt na di rayt tɛm i go bi.
I se udat de pan rikishi ɛn bad trik nɔ go ebul bia bɔt udat de du tin tret wan go ɔrayt bikɔs i biliv PAPA GƆD.

Nɔ fɔ abop pan jɛntri. I de mek pipul ful ɛn de kak, bɔt dɛn kayn pipul de nɔ de bɛlful lɛk grev yad we nɔ de taya fɔ gɛt nyu tɛnant. So na dat mek di Babilonian dɛn ɔl di tɛm de atak difrɛn neshɔn dɛn ɛn siz di pipul dɛn.
Di pipul dɛn na ɔl dɛn neshɔn we dɛn dɔn kapchɔ go barɔf ɛn aks if i nɔ du so. Dɛn go swɛ dɛn fɔ we dɛn jɛs de buli pipul dɛn ɛn mek dɛn pe we go mek dɛn jɛntri.

Dɛn se if dɛn nɔ tek tɛm, aw dɛn de du ɔda neshɔn we dɛn bin de mek dɛn ɔda neshɔn dɛn pe dɛt, na so dɛn go fos dɛnsɛf fɔ pe dɛt wande wande. Ɛnimi dɛn go de we go pas am pan dɛn dɔn dɛn go tek ɔl wetin dɛn gɛt go.

Bikɔs dɛn dɔn pwɛl bɔku neshɔn dɛn wit fɛt ɛn tif, di wan dɛn we lɛf pan dɛn neshɔn dɛn de dɛnsɛf go pwɛl, fɛt ɛn tif dɛn bak, fɔ di pipul dɛn we dɛn dɔn kil, ɛn di bad tin dɛn we dɛn dɔn du to di ath.
Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt jɛntri bay kruk ɛn fɛt fɛt, go mɔs alaki pan ɔl we i go de tray fɔ mek ɔltin ɔrayt nain os.
Dɛn dɔn mek nɔbɔdi nɔ tek dɛn mek natin igen Dɛn dɔn put dɛnsɛf ɛn dɛn fambul pan shem we dɛn kil bɔku ɔda pipul dɛn. So dɛnsɛf dɔn alaki.
Di ston insay di wɔl go kray ɛn di bim dɛn go ansa..
Di wan dɛn we kil fɔ mɔni ɛn jɛntri ɛn tek tin dɛn we nɔto dɛn yon go alaki.
Di pipul dɛn we dɛn fos fɔ wok na fɔ natin bikɔs ɔl wetin dɛn bil gɛt fɔ bɔn na faya. Na dat PAPA GƆD go du.
Bɔt lɛk aw wata de ful na si, na so ɔlman go no bɔt PAPA GƆD in pawa ɛn di wɔndaful tin we i de du.
Ɛni kɔntri we mek in neba sɔfa we i vɛks ɛn mek i nɔ no wetin fɔ du, te i de nekɛd insɛf, go alaki.
Na so tin go bad fɔ dɛnsɛf. Pipul go trit dɛn bad we go mek dɛnsɛf staga lɛk udat drɔnk. PAPA GƆD go mɔs mek dɛn sɔfa ɛn dɛn gres go tɔn to gras.
Aw dɛn trit Libanɔn bad, na so dɛn go trit dɛn, dɛn animal dɛn we dɛn kil, dɛn gost dɛnsɛf, go tɔmɛnt dɛn bikɔs dɛn kil bɔku pipul na wɔl ɛn we tap na dɛn siti dɛn de.
Wetin dɛn smɔl gɔd we dɛn de mek min? Dɛn nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du pas dɛn de lay nɔmɔ. I fɔni fɔ si di wan dɛn we mek dɛn, de abop pan mumu fɔ tɔk, dɔn dɛn se na gɔd.

Di pɔsin we de go tinap frɔnt wud ɔ ston de tɛl am fɔ grap du sɔntin, alaki. We na lɛk dayman, wetin i gɛt fɔ du? I lɛk sɛf dɛn put ɔlkayn gold ɔ silva pantap am fɔ mek i fayn, i nɔ min natin bikɔs i nɔ gɛt layf.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD in de nain oli os na ɛvin ɛn ɔl udat de na wɔl fɔ jɛs sɛt in mɔt ɛn luk wetin i go du.
Na di pre dis we Abakɔk pre:

“PAPA GƆD, a dɔn yɛri bɔt wetin yu dɔn du, ɛn i ful mi mɔt ɛn mek a fred. Naw, we wi de so, du wetin yu bin dɔn du lɔntɛm; naw, we wi de so, lɛ ɔlman no bɔt wetin yu kin du. We yu vɛks sɛf, sɔri fɔ wi.
PAPA GƆD kɔmɔt Idɔm kam bak; di wan we oli de kɔmɔt na di il dɛn na Paran fɔ kam in brayt brayt layt de shayn na ɛvin ɛn ath, ɛn dat de mek ɔlman na wɔl wan fɔ prez am.
We i de kam so, di ples de brayt lɛk na laytin de flash, di laytin de flash pan in an ɔl, bikɔs na de i ayd in pawa.
I kin mek siknɛs lid am we i de go ɛn day fala am ɛnisay we i go.

I kin tek stand fɔ luk wetin de apin na wɔl; wɛn i luk, ɔl di pipul na wɔl de trimbul. Di mawnten dɛn we bin dɔn de frɔm tɛm kin skata; dɔn di il dɛnsɛf we bin dɔn de frɔm tɛm kin jɛs lɔs, na so i bin dɔn de du lɔntɛm.
A si we di pipul dɛn we de na Kush de sɔfa dɔn di Midianayt dɛn de trimbul wit fred.
PAPA GƆD, na di watasay dɛn yu vɛks pan so? Na di sɔlwata dɛn mek yu vɛks bad bad wan so? We yu de rayd ɔp na di klawd; na briz bin de kɛr yu go we yu kin sidɔm pan di chariɔt we dɔn de mek yu win.
Yu pul di klos we kɔba yu bo, ɛn rɛdi am fɔ shut di aro dɛn. Lɛk aw di laytin de flash, na so di grɔn de plit opin.
We di mawnten dɛn si wetin yu du, dɛn skyad; wata kɔmɔt ɔp klawd kam dɔŋ. Di wata we de ɔnda grɔn sɛf ala, ɛn bɔs kam pantap.
Di san ɛn di mun nɔ gri fɔ shayn igen we dɛn si aw yu aro dɛn de flay, ɛn yu spia de shayn na di laytin.
Yu jɛs de go ɔp ɛn dɔŋ pas di vɛks we yu vɛks; ɛn na di vɛksteshɔn yu de put pan di neshɔn dɛn.
Na fɔ pul yu pipul dɛn pan trɔbul, na dat mek yu kɔmɔt na do, mek di kiŋ we yu bin pik nɔ de pan trɔbul. Yu nyamanyama di bad wan dɛn edman ɛn pwɛl di wan dɛn we de biɛn am kpatakpata.
Yu yuz yu bo ɛn aro fɔ skata di sojaman dɛn edman di tɛm we dɛn bɔs lɛk briz pan mi; de gladi se dɛn go ebul du wetin dɛn want we pɔsin nɔ go si.
Yu bin dɔn mek yu ɔs dɛn waka midul wata, ɛn dat lɛ di wata mek frɔsh.
Wɛn a yɛri bɔt ɔl wetin yu du, mi bɔdi trimbul; a fred te a bɛt mi siti mi bɔdi ɔl brok wit fred, dat mek, a nɔ sabi waka igen a de sidɔm saful wet fɔ di de we trɔbul go mit dɛn wan we de ambɔg wi.

If ivin fig nɔ gro pan di fig tik, ɔ greps nɔ de na di vayn tik, ɔ di ɔliv tik nɔ bia natin, ɔ ivin if ɔl di tik dɛn na di fil nɔ bia igen, ɛn ɔl di ship ɛn got dɛn rɔnawe dɔn wan animal nɔ lɛf fɔ mɛn
dat nɔ du fɔ mek a givɔp. A go stil gladi fɔ we a gɛt PAPA GƆD, di PAPA GƆD we de pul mi pan trɔbul ɛn a go gladi bikɔs i de.

Na PAPA GƆD de gi mi trɛnk. I de mek mi fut dɛn trɔŋ na grɔn lɛk aw dia yon tan we kin mek i rɔn fast dɔn i de put mi ɔp na ay ples fɔ mek natin nɔ du mi. Dis na to di kwayamasta fɔ striŋ yuz instrumɛnt dɛn lɛk ap fɔ ple am.

PAPA GƆD tɔk to Zaɛfinaya we na Kushi in bɔypikin. Kushi na bin Gɛdalaya in bɔypikin. Gɛdalaya na bin Amaraya in bɔypikin. Amaraya na bin Ɛzikaya in bɔypikin. Da tɛm de na Josaya we na Amɔn in bɔypikin na bin di kiŋ na Juda.
PAPA GƆD se in go klia ɔltin kɔmɔt na wɔl.
I go klia mɔtalman o, animal o, bɔd o, fish o - ɔlman. I se in go mek dɛn bad wan dɛn ɔl kɔmɔt na rod bikɔs ɔlman go day na wɔl.

I se in go pɔnish di pipul dɛn na Juda ɛn ɔl udat tap na Jerusɛlɛm. I se in go pwɛl di balans tin we lɛf pan dɛn tin dɛn we dɛn de yuz fɔ wɔship Beal, wit dɛn man dɛn we de fɔ de mek sakrifays to Beal.
Ɛn dɛn ɔl we de klem go pantap dɛn os dɛn ruf fɔ wɔship dɛn tin dɛn we de ɔp klawd ɛn dɛn wan dɛn ɔl we de prɔmis am se dɛn go du wetin i want bɔt dɔn dɛn de swɛ bak to da fɔls gɔd we nem Molɛk.
I se in go nyamanyama ɔl dɛn wan we dɔn lɛf fɔ fala in, PAPA GƆD, ɛn nɔ de bɔda fɛnɔt bɔt wetin i want igen
Nɔ fɔ mek nɔys usay PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD de! Bikɔs di de we PAPA GƆD go kam dɔŋ de nia ɛn PAPA GƆD dɔn mek ɔl udat i invayt we na di ɛnimi dɛn dɔn rɛdi fɔ wutuwutu Juda.
PAPA GƆD se da de de in go pɔnish ɔl di bigman dɛn ɛn di kiŋ in bɔypikin dɛn, ɛn ɔl dɛn wan we de du wetin di fɔrina dɛn de du.
Da sem de de, i go pɔnish ɔl udat jomp go insay pipul yad ɛn we de ful dɛn bɔs dɛn os wit tif tin we dɛn buli pipul fɔ gɛt.
PAPA GƆD se da de de, dɛn go yɛri we di pipul dɛn na di Fish Get de kray, dɛn go yɛri kray de kɔmɔt na di Sɛkɛn Kwata pantap di il dɛn we di bildin dɛn go fɔdɔm.
I se dɛn wan dɛn we tap na di ɔda pat na di siti fɔ kray we dɛn yɛri bɔt dat, bikɔs nɔn biznɛsman nɔ go de igen Ɔl di biznɛsman dɛn go dɔn day.

I se da tɛm de i go tek lamp fɔ luk insay Jerusɛlɛm so dat i go pɔnish dɛn man we bikɔs dɛn satisfay wit di lili ɛn natin we dɛn gɛt, nɔ bisin bɔt PAPA GƆD. Dɛn de tɔk na dɛn at se PAPA GƆD nɔ gɛt dɛn tɛm sɛf.
Dɛn go wutuwutu dɛn jɛntri go ɛn ivin dɛn os dɛn nɔ go bɛtɛ igen fɔ mek dɛn tap de. We dɛn bil nyu os, dɛn nɔ go ɛva tap de. Pan ɔl we dɛn go plant vayn gadin, dɛn nɔ go ebul pul wayn kɔmɔt de.
Di big big de we PAPA GƆD de kam dɔn kam nia ɛn i de kam jisnɔ. Di sawnd we go kam wit am nɔ go fayn fɔ yɛri. Bigman dɛn ɔl go de kray bita bita wan.

Na de we PAPA GƆD go sho aw i vɛks, we siriɔs waala go fɔdɔm ɛn ɔlman go sɔri so, ɛn fil am insay dɛn bon we waala go de; na de we ɔltin go pwɛl ɛn nyamanyama; di ples go dak ɛn sik so, dɔn di klawd go kɔba wit di daknɛs,
na tɛm we wɛn di trɔmpɛt go blo so, ɔlman go ala se tɛm dɔn rich fɔ fɛt. Dɔn dɛn ples we dɛn bin min se nɔbɔdi nɔ go go bikɔs i trɔŋ, nain dɛn go atak wit ɔl dɛn ay ay wɔl.
PAPA GƆD se in go mek di man dɛn at pwɛl, dɔn dɛn go bigin du tiŋs lɛk udat blɛn bikɔs dɛn ɔl dɔn sin; dɛn blɔd nɔ go min natin igen ɛn dɛn dedebɔdi ɔl go skata na grɔn we nɔbɔdi nɔ go bisin.
We PAPA GƆD dɔn rɛdi fɔ du wetin i want, nɔn mɔni, i lɛk aw i bɔku nɔ go tap am. We PAPA GƆD dɔn jɛlɔs gud, i go jɛs mek faya bɔn ɛn dɔnawe wit ɔlman we tap na wɔl.
I se dɛn nɔ gɛt shem, dɛn fɔ kapu sɛns ɛn kam ripɛnt
bifo i drɛb dɛn, lɛk chaf chaf we briz de blo bifo PAPA GƆD in vɛksteshɔn kam pan una di de we PAPA GƆD go vɛks.
Ɔl udat de du wetin PAPA GƆD want fɔ kɔntinyu fɔ du so, dɛn fɔ mek shɔ se dɛn de waka tret wan wit PAPA GƆD ɛn put dɛnsɛf dɔŋ fɔ du wetin i want, sɔntɛm we i de jɔj i go sɔri fɔ dɛn.
Ɔl di pipul dɛn go kɔmɔt na Gaza bɔt na rɔnawe dɛn go rɔnawe kɔmɔt na Ashkɛlɔn; bɔt dɛn wan we de na Ashdɔd, dɛn go drɛb dɛn kɔmɔt de santɛm, dɔn ɔlman go kɔmɔt na Ɛkrɔn ɛn de sɛf go pwɛl kpatakpata.
Dɛn wan we tap nia watasay, alaki - dat na dɛn Filistin dɛn. PAPA GƆD dɔn tɔk se i go nyamanyama una ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go lɛf.
I se, na di dray ples we de nia di watasay nɔmɔ una go gɛt fɔ mek una animal dɛn de ple ɛn drink wata bikɔs na de di man dɛn we de mɛn dɛn go de.

Na nia di watasay de di wan dɛn we nɔ day na Juda in fambul layn go tap, ɛn na de dɛn go go fɔ mɛn dɛn ship ɛn got dɛn. Dɔn na di os dɛn na Ashkɛlɔn, dɛn go de slip ivintɛm. PAPA GƆD, dɛn PAPA GƆD go mɛmba dɛn ɛn gi dɛn ɔl wetin dɛn bin dɔn lɔs bak.
PAPA GƆD se, in dɔn yɛri aw di pipul dɛn na Moab de provok ɛn aw di wan dɛn na Amɔn de tɔmɛnt in pipul dɛn dɔn dɛn de blɔf se dɛn go siz dɛn land.

I se, wans in PAPA GƆD, we na Izrɛl dɛn PAPA GƆD, nɔ de day, in go mɔs mek Moab tan lɛk Sɔdɔm, dɔn i go mek di Amonayt dɛn lɛk Gomɔra. Di ples go gɛt soso chukchuk ɛn i go dray arara. I nɔ go fit fɔ natin. Di balans pipul dɛn we na PAPA GƆD yon, we nɔ bin day go wutuwutu dɛn ɛn tek dɛn yon land na dɛn an.
Na dat go bi to dɛn fɔseka di kak we dɛn de kak. Dɛn jɛs de fɔ de bost ɛn mek mɔt pan PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in pipul dɛn.
PAPA GƆD insɛf go dil wit dɛn traŋa traŋa wan. Yɛs, i go nyakanyaka dɛn ɛn mek dɛn gɔd nɔ fiba natin to dɛn ɛn ɔlman naw go butu ɛn wɔship am, usay dɛn de, na ɔl di neshɔn dɛn na wɔl.
Di pipul dɛn na Ithiopia dɛnsɛf go day na wa.
I go yuz in pawa fɔ du wetin i wan du na di nɔth ɛn i go nyamanyama Asiria, ɛn mek Ninivɛ dray arara lɛk ples we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.

Na ples we ɔlkayn animal go lidɔm togɛda; dɛn wan we pɔsin de mɛn o, dɛn wan dɛn we de na bush; dɛn yuba ɛn ɛjɔg ɔl go de tinap pan dɛn post we dɔn fɔdɔm, kɔkɔ ɛn minista bɔd go de mek nɔys insay de ɛn dɛn trɔŋ trɔŋ wud we de de ɔl go fɔdɔm.
Na di ples dis we bin de kak ɛn tink se i sɛf ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul am. I de blɔf se nɔbɔdi nɔ go tan lɛk am. I nɔ fit fɔ natin igen, bush sɛf tɛl lay! Ɛnibɔdi we de pas usay i de go jɛs sɔktit.
Trɔbul go mit di pɔsin we de mek lɛk rebɛl ɛn nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD in yay, di siti we de ɔprɛs pipul.
I nɔ de yɛri nɔbɔdi, i nɔ de tek kɔrɛkshɔn. I nɔ abop pan PAPA GƆD, i nɔ de go nia PAPA GƆD.
Dɛn bigman dɛn ɛn dɛn jɔj dɛn ɔl de biev lɛk aŋri layɔn ɔ wulf, dɛn de mekes it ɛnitin we dɛn gɛt ɛn nɔ de wɔri fɔ kip fɔ di nɛks de.
In prɔfɛt dɛn fulish, na man dɛn we nɔ de waka tret wit PAPA GƆD; di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin de dɔti wetin klin na PAPA GƆD yay, ɛn nɔ de rɛspɛkt di lɔ.
PAPA GƆD in de du tin tret wan ɔltɛm, i nɔ de du natin rɔŋ; ɛvride i nɔ de taya fɔ sho se i de du tin fia wan. Bɔt usay! Di pipul dɛn nɔ de chenj. Dɛn nɔ gɛt shem. Dɛn stil de du bad.

PAPA GƆD se pan ɔl we i dɔn dɔnawe wit dɛn neshɔn dɛn, ɛn nyamanyama dɛn siti, dɛn traŋa os ɛn wɔl dɛn. I dɔn mek dɛn trit dɛn fiba ples we nɔ fɔ pas, i dɔn mek di siti dɛn nɔ fit fɔ natin ɛn nɔ ivin lɛf wan pɔsin insay de.
I bin min se di pipul dɛn go fred am ɛn tek kɔrɛkshɔn ɛn nɔ go ɛva fɔgɛt wetin dɛn dɔn pas bɔt i tan lɛk na da tɛm de dɛn de bad mɔ ɛn mɔ.

PAPA GƆD se lɛ dɛn jɛs wet fɔ di tɛm we in go rɛdi fɔ tɔk bɔt ɔl wetin dɛn de du. I se in dɔn mekɔp in maynd fɔ briŋ ɔl di neshɔn dɛn togɛda dɔn i go sho dɛn aw i vɛks. Ɔl in jɛlɔs vɛksteshɔn nain i go put pan dɛn ɛn dɔnawe wit ɔlman na wɔl.
Dat tɛm de dɛn ɔl go de tɔk wan laŋwej, dat na fɔ de pre to PAPA GƆD nɔmɔ wit ɔl dɛn at ɛn du wetin i want.
Ɔl di pipul we dɔn skata te rich Ithiopia go kam to am ɛn mek sakrifays to am.

I se, da tɛm de dɛn nɔ go gɛt fɔ shem fɔ we dɛn bin mek lɛk rebɛl pan am, bikɔs in go pul ɔl di wan dɛn we bin de kak kɔmɔt midul dɛn. Dɔn di ɔda wan dɛn nɔ go gɛt chans fɔ de kak, bikɔs dɛn go de nain oli mawnten.
I se di pipul dɛn we go de da tɛm de go bi pipul we nɔ go de kak. Dɛn go de go to in di, PAPA GƆD fɔ ɛp dɛn.
Di wan dɛn we go lɛf na Izrɛl go bi wan dɛn we nɔ go de ambɔg; dɛn nɔ go de lay, ɛn dɛn nɔ go miks pan rikishi. Dɛn nɔ go gɛt wan yagba ɛn so dɛn nɔ go fred nɔbɔdi.
Lɛ di uman dɛn na Zayɔn siŋ lawd wan! Lɛ ɔlman na Izrɛl ala! Lɛ ɔlman na Jerusɛlɛm sho aw dɛn gladi wit ɔl dɛn at una di uman dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm.
PAPA GƆD dɔn pul di nambara we fɔ mit una I dɔn dil wit una ɛnimi dɛn PAPA GƆD we na Kiŋ fɔ Izrɛl de wit una; una nɔ gɛt natin fɔ fred igen
Da de de, dɛn go tɛl di pipul na Jerusɛlɛm se, “Una we de na Zayɔn siti, una nɔ fɔ fred! Una nɔ mek natin pwɛl una at.
PAPA GƆD de wit una; na sojaman so i mɔs mek una win. Dat go mek in at swit, dɔn, bikɔs i lɛk una, i go mek layf tan lɛk wetin i bin bi fɔs. Na una go mek i siŋ bikɔs in at gladi,
i go tan lɛk aw pɔsin kin gladi we i de sɛlibret.” I se in go pul ɔl di nambara na una ed so disgres nɔ go mit una.
Wande wande, i go dil wit ɔl dɛn wan we de ambɔg una. I go ɛp dɛn wan we nɔ ebul waka ɛn briŋ ɔl udat bin go ɛgzayl kam bak. Dɔn i go mek dɛn ɛnimi dɛn kɔle ɛn mek ɔlman no dɛn ɛn prez dɛn na wɔl.

Wande wande go briŋ ɔlman kam bak na os, di tɛm we a go gɛda una ɔl wan say I go mek dɛn femɔs na di wanol wɔl di wanol wɔl go no una ɛn i go mek dɛn bi wetin dɛn bin bi fɔs unasɛf go si. Na so PAPA GƆD se.

Insay di mɔnt we mek siks, afta we Dariɔs bin dɔn bi kiŋ fɔ tu ia, PAPA GƆD tɔk to Egay na di fɔs de na da mɔnt de. I sɛn Egay to Zerubabɛl we na bin Shialtiɛl in bɔypikin ɛn na gɔvna na Juda. I sɛn am bak to Jɔshwa we na bin di bigman fɔ ɔl dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn na Jɛozedak in bɔypikin.
I tɛl dɛn se PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, di pipul dɛn de se tɛm nɔ rich yet fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os bak.
So PAPA GƆD tɛl Egay we na prɔfɛt wetin fɔ tɔk.
I se fɔ aks dɛn if na tɛm fɔ dɛn fɔ bil os dɛn wit dia matirial fɔ dɛnsɛf, we PAPA GƆD in yon os de brok brok wan.
PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se dɛn fɔ tink gud bɔt wetin dɛn de apin to dɛn.
Dɛn de plant bɔku sid bɔt nɔto ɔl de bia, dɛn de it, bɔt dɛn nɔ de bɛlful; we dɛn wɛr klos sɛf, kol stil de kech dɛn ɛn i tan lɛk we dɛn pe dɛn na bɔs bag dɛn de put di mɔni.
PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti aks dɛn se if dɛn nɔ ebul tink bɔt wetin de apin to dɛn.
I se, if dɛn no wetin bɛtɛ, dɛn fɔ jɛs go ɔp di il; go kɔt bɔd ɛn kam bil PAPA GƆD in os bak saful. Dat go mek in at swit ɛn in go sho dɛn wetin i kin du de.

I se we dɛn kin dɔn plant, dɛn de abop se na bɔku tin dɛn go gɛt, bɔt usay! Di smɔl bit sɛf we dɛn kin briŋ kam na os kin jɛs skata lɛk na briz blo ɔl go. Dis na bikɔs dɛn jɛs lɛf Papa GƆD in os fɔ de brokbrok wan ɛn ɔlman bizi de mek in yon os fayn.
Dat mek ren nɔ de fɔdɔm ɛn so natin nɔ de gro.
PAPA GƆD se, nain dɔn mek di grɔn dɛn ɔl dray, di tin dɛn we dɛn de bia, nɔ bɛtɛ, ɛn ivin di animal ɛn mɔtalman nɔ de kɔmɔt fayn.

Zɛrubabɛl we na Shialtiɛl in bɔypikin ɛn Jɔshwa we na Jɛozedak in bɔypikin ɛn di bigman fɔ ɔl dɛn man we de mek sakrifays pipul sin wit ɔl di balans pipul obe Papa GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD ɛn du wetin Egay we i sɛn, se, bikɔs dɛn de fred ɛn rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD.
Dɛn Egay we na PAPA GƆD in midulman tɛl dɛn wetin PAPA GƆD se, dat na, i se in de wit dɛn.

PAPA GƆD mek Zɛrubabɛl we na gɔvna ɛn na Shialtiɛl in bɔypikin, Jɔshwa we na di bigman fɔ ɔl dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn Jɛozedak in bɔypikin, pik zil, jɔyn am wit di zil we di balans pipul dɛnsɛf gɛt, ɛn bigin wok fɔ bil PAPA GƆD we na dɛn PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti, in os bak.
Na di de we mek twɛnti - fo pan di mɔnt we mek siks insay di sɛkɛn ia afta Dariɔs bi kiŋ.
Insay di sɛkɛn ia we Dariɔs bi kiŋ, na di twɛnti-wande na di sem mɔnt, nain PAPA GƆD tɔk bak to di prɔfɛt Egeay bɔt di pipul dɛn.

I tɛl Egeay fɔ aks Zɛrubabɛl we na Shialtiɛl in bɔypikin ɛn na di gɔvna na Juda, Jɔshwa we na Jɛozedak in yon bɔypikin ɛn na di bigman fɔ dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, ɛn ɔl di balans pipul se,
udat lɛf we go mek PAPA GƆD in os fayn lɛk aw i bin fayn. I se lɛ dɛn kɔmpia am naw, if i nɔ fiba lɛk wetin nɔ min natin.

I se PAPA GƆD se Zɛrubabɛl nɔ fɔ pwɛlat, Jɔshwa, we na Jɛozedak in bɔypikin ɛn na di bigman fɔ dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin, insɛf nɔ fɔ pwɛlat wit ɔl di ɔda pipul na di land. PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ jɛs du di wok bikɔs in PAPA GƆD de wit dɛn,
lɛkɛ aw i bin dɔn prɔmis dɛn wɛn i bin pul dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt. In Spirit go de wit dɛn, so dɛn nɔ fɔ fred.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, i nɔ go te igen, i go ple wɔwɔ wan tɛm mɔ. I go mek ɛvin shek ɛn athkwek go bi na di wɔl, dɔn i go shek di si ɛn di dray land;
ɛn i go mek dɛn pawaful neshɔn dɛn lɔs dɛn pawa, so dat ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn gɛda go kam bi Jerusɛlɛm yon, dɔn PAPA GƆD in os go de fayn fayn wan. Na so PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se nain gɛt di silva ɛn di gold dɛn.
I se aw PAPA GƆD in os go fayn go pas aw i bin fayn fɔs. PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, i go mek shɔ se di pipul dɛn prɔspa, dɛn go ɛnjɔy gud gud tin dɛn ɛn liv wil kolat.
Na di twɛnti-fo de na di nɔmba nayn mɔnt insay di sɛkɛn ia we Dariɔs na bin kiŋ, PAPA GƆD tɔk to di prɔfɛt Egeay fɔ tɛl di pipul se,
in PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, Egeay fɔ aks di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin fɔ tɛl am wetin dis,
if pɔsin put oli bif nain skat pɔkit, dɔn di skat tɔch bred, ɔ pap ɔ ɔyl ɔ ɛni ɔda tin fɔ it, dɛn tin dɛn de sɛf go gɛt olinɛs? Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ansa am se, nɔ.

Dɛn Egeay as dɛn se, if pɔsin we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay bikɔs i dɔn tɔch dedebɔdi, tɔch dɛn tin ya, if di tin dɛnsɛf de tɔn tin dɛn we nɔ klin na PAPA GƆD yay. Di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ansa se, dɛn tin de dɛnsɛf nɔ go klin na PAPA GƆD yay.
Dɛn Egeay tɛl dɛn se, PAPA GƆD se na so i bi wit in pipul dɛn ɛn ɔl wetin dɛn de du ɛn ivin wetin dɛn de gi am we nɔ klin nain yay.
PAPA GƆD se naw dɛn fɔ de tink bɔt wetin gɛt fɔ apin bambay. I se bifo dɛn bin le di fawndeshɔn fɔ bigin bil PAPA GƆD in os bak,
wetin bin de apin? Wɛn dɛn kin ɛkspɛkt se dɛn de gɛt twɛnti tin pan wetin dɛn plant, na tɛn nɔmɔ dɛn kin gɛt; wɛn dɛn de ɛkspɛkt fifti galɔn wayn, na twɛnti galɔn, dɛn kin gɛt.
I se i bin de mek ɔl wetin dɛn plant mɛleju ɛn dɔn i kin lɛ da ren we fiba grabul-grabul pwɛl dɛn; bɔt pan ɔl dat dɛn nɔ tɔn dɛn at to PAPA GƆD.
I se frɔm da de de we na di twɛnti-fo de na di mɔnt we mek nayn, dɛn fɔ bigin de tink bɔt wetin gɛt fɔ apin. Frɔm di de we dɛn le fawndeshɔn fɔ PAPA GƆD in os, na fɔ de mɛmba dat.
I aks dɛn se, ivin if i tan lɛk se nɔn sid nɔ de, if dat min se di greps tik, di fig tik, di pomigranet tik ɛn di ɔliv tik dɛn, nɔ go bia natin. I prɔmis se, dɛn go gɛt ɔltin bak.
PAPA GƆD tɔk bak fɔ di sɛkɛn tɛm to Prɔfɛt Egeay, di twɛnti-fo de na di mɔnt.
I tɛl Egeay fɔ tɛl Zɛrubabɛl we na gɔvna na Juda se, in, PAPA GƆD dɔn rɛdi fɔ shek ɛvin ɛn ath,

ɛn i go ovatro di kindɔm dɛn; i se in dɔn rɛdi fɔ nɔnsɛns dɛn trɛnk dɛn na dɛn neshɔn wit kiŋ dɛn, ɛn i go mek dɛn ɔs ɛn karej ɛn di man dɛn we de rayd dɛn wit di ɔs dɛn ɛn dɛn yon rayda dɛn, ɔl day wan bay wan we dɛn kɔmpin dɛn go kil dɛn.

PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se fɔ tɛl Zɛrubabɛl we nain wokman ɛn we na Shialtiɛl in bɔypikin se, in PAPA GƆD se, na da de de i go mek i tan lɛk riŋ we dɛn de tek sayn, fɔ sho se i gɛt pawa, bikɔs nain PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti dɔn pik am.
Insay di mɔnt we mek et di tɛm we Dariɔs bin dɔn bi kiŋ fɔ tu ia, PAPA GƆD tɔk to Zɛkaraya we na Bɛrɛkaya in bɔypikin. Bɛrɛkaya na Ido we na prɔfɛt in yon bɔypikin. PAPA GƆD tɛl Zakaraya se,
in bin vɛks wit dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn.
PAPA GƆD se fɔ tɛl di pipul dɛn se, in we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se dɛn fɔ tɔn bak to am dɔn in we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go tɔn bak to dɛn.
I se dɛn nɔ fɔ tan lɛk dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn we dɛn lɔntɛm prɔfɛt bin de tɛl se lɛ dɛn lɛf di bad tin we dɛn bin de du, bɔt dɛn nɔ lisin ɔ braskitul PAPA GƆD sɛf.
I aks am se usay dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn de naw, ɛn di prɔfɛt dɛn, if dɛn liv sote go.
I se bɔt di tɔk we i bin tɛl di prɔfɛt dɛn fɔ tɔk de te naw. Dat mek dɛn beg padin ɛn se aw PAPA GƆD plan fɔ dil wit wi fɔ wetin wi de du, na so i dɔn dil wit wi.

Di de we mek twɛnti-fo na di mɔnt we mek ilɛvin, dat na di mɔnt we dɛn kɔl Shɛbat, insay di sɛkɛn ia we Dariɔs bi kiŋ, PAPA GƆD tɔk bak to Zɛkaraya we na Bɛrɛkaya in bɔypikin. Bɛrɛkaya na Ido we na prɔfɛt in yon bɔypikin.
I se, wande na nɛt, wantɛm wantɛm, in si wan man we bin de rayd rɛd ɔs. Di man bin de midul sɔm bush bush dɛn na di vali; dɔn rɛd, ɛn sɔntin lɛk grin ɛn wayt ɔs dɛn bin de biɛn am.
So i aks di man we i si se wetin dɛn wande. Di enjɛl ansa se in go sho am wetin dɛn bi.
So di man we bin tinap midul sɔm bush bush dɛn ansa am se, na tin dɛn we PAPA GƆD dɔn sɛn fɔ de paspas na di wɔl.
Da tɛm de naw, dɛn ansa di enjɛl se dɛn dɔn waka ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl ɛn si se ɔltin ɔrayt.
Dɛn di enjɛl aks PAPA GƆD if i nɔ go sɔri naw fɔ Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda. I se i dɔn vɛks pan dɛn fɔ sɛvinti ia naw.
PAPA GƆD tɔk fayn to di enjɛl we bin de tɔk to Zɛkaraya fɔ kol in at.
So di enjɛl we bin de tɔk to am tɛl am se, lɛ i tɔk lawd wan se PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se in de jɛlɔs fɔ Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Zayɔn bad bad wan.
Ɛn i vɛks bad wit dɛn kɔntri we nɔ bisin; bikɔs we i bin vɛks smɔl pan dɛn, dɛn tek am mek paspot fɔ du mɔ bad.
Dat mek PAPA GƆD se, naw, in dɔn go bak to Jerusɛlɛm wit in sɔri-at; dɛn go bil in os insay de ɛn i go mek shɔ se Jerusɛlɛm bi wetin i bin bi bak.
I se i fɔ tɔk lawd wan bak se, PAPA GƆD se in go mek di siti dɛn gɛt bɛtɛ tin ɛn in PAPA GƆD go koks Zayɔn ɛn pik Jerusɛlɛm bak.
We i es in ed ɔp, nain i si fo ɔn.
I aks di enjɛl we bin de tɔk to am bak se, wetin dɛn wande. I ansa am se na di pawa dɛn na di wɔl we dɔn skata Juda, Izrɛl ɛn Jerusɛlɛm.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD sho am fo blaksmith.

I aks am wetin dɛn de kam du. I ansa am se sins na di ɔn dɛn skata Juda we mek nɔbɔdi nɔ de de we kɔmɔt bɛtɛ, in go yuz di blaksmith dɛn fɔ put dɛn na dɛn ples. Dɛn go nyamanyama ɔl dɛn neshɔn we mek Jerusɛlɛm skata.
I es in ed ɔp ɛn si wan man we ol rop we fɔ tek mɛzhɔ nain an.
So i aks am usay i de go. Di man tɛl am se i de go mɛzhɔ Jerusɛlɛm fɔ si aw i wayd ɛn aw i lɔŋ.
Wantɛm, nain di enjɛl we bin de tɔk to am go bifo am ɛn wan ɔda enjɛl go mit am bifo de,
dɛn tɛl am se, i fɔ rɔn go tɛl di man we wan fɔ mɛzhɔ se, Jerusɛlɛm go ful wit bɔku pipul ɛn animal so nid nɔ go de fɔ bil wɔl rawnd am.
PAPA GƆD se in PAPA GƆD de ɔlsay ɛn i go de de fɔ sikyɔ am.
PAPA GƆD se i fɔ rɔnawe go na di nɔth bikɔs in PAPA GƆD dɔn mek i de ɔlsay lɛkɛ di fo kayn briz we de blo na ɛvin.
I se dɛn we de na Babilɔn fɔ go bak na Jerusɛlɛm.
So Papa GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti gi am dis mɛsej fɔ ɔl dɛn neshɔn we bin de ambɔg dɛn: I se if ɛnibɔdi ambɔg dɛn, nain dɛn ambɔg bikɔs dɛn nain bɔlyay.
I se in go sho dɛn in pawa dɔn i go mek dɛn tɔn slev to ɔl udat bin de slev fɔ dɛn. Zɛkaraya se na da tɛm de dɛn go no se na PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti sɛn am.
I se, PAPA GƆD se di pipul dɛn we kɔmɔt Jerusɛlɛm fɔ siŋ ɛn gladi bikɔs in PAPA GƆD go kam tap midul dɛn.
PAPA GƆD se da tɛm de bɔku dɛn ɔda neshɔn go go ɔnda in rul ɛn insɛf go tap midul dɛn, dɔn dɛnsɛf go bi in pipul dɛn ɛn ɔlman go no se na PAPA GƆD sɛn am.
PAPA GƆD go tek Juda as in yon prɔpati insay di oli land ɛn i go pik Jerusɛlɛm bak.
I se nɔ fɔ mek nɔys usay PAPA GƆD de nain os we oli.
Dɛn i si Jɔshwa we na di bigman fɔ dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin tinap bifo di enjɛl, dɔn Setan in tinap nia am fɔ le in kɔmplen.
PAPA GƆD tɔk traŋa wan fɔ mek Setan kɔmɔt bifo am. I tɛl am se, nain dɔn pik Jerusɛlɛm, so lɛ i kɔmɔt bifo am. I se if Jerusɛlɛm nɔto lɛk rɛd rɛd ayɛn we dɛn pul na faya.
Da tɛm de, Jɔshwa bin wɛr dɔti klos tinap bifo di enjɛl.
Di enjɛl tɛl ɔl udat bin tinap bifo am fɔ pul di dɔti klos pan am. I tɛl am se, i dɔn pul ɔl in sin dɛn pan am ɛn naw i go gi am dia dia klos.
Zɛkaraya in tɛl dɛn naw se, dɛn fɔ wɛr klin tɔban nain ed ɛn wɛr di klin klos dɛn pan am lɛk we di enjɛl de de so.
Dɛn di enjɛl wɔn Jɔshwa se,
PAPA GƆD se if i fala am ɛn du wetin i want, i go de inchaj ɔf in os ɛn ɔl in biznɛs, dɔn i go mek shɔ se di enjɛl dɛn de fɔ ɛp am.
I tɛl Jɔshwa we na di bigman fɔ dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin ɛn ɔl in padi dɛn we de wit am se, dɛn na gud man dɛn bɔt i go sɛn di pɔsin we go tɔk fɔ am we dɛn go kɔl di Branch.
I se na pan di ston we i go put bifo Jɔshwa nain i go gi sɛvin fes we i go tek luk am; PAPA GƆD se in go mek mak pan am dɔn i go pul ɔl di sin kɔmɔt na di land insay wande.
I se wɛn da tɛm de rich, ɔlman go kɔl in kɔmpin fɔ sidɔm wit am ɛn ɛnjɔy.
Di enjɛl we bin tɔk to am fɔs kam bak dɔn i skyad lɛkɛ se na slip i wek pan.
Di enjɛl aks am wetin i si. Zɛkaraya tɛl am se i si wan lampstand we dɛn tek gold mek dɔn i gɛt wan bolpantap am ɛn ɔda sɛvin lamp we gɛt sɛvin ples fɔ put wik pantap dɛn.
Tu ɔliv tik bin de nia am, wan nain raytan ɛn wan nain lɛfan.
Dɔn i aks di enjɛl we bin de tɔk to am se, wetin dɛnwande.
Di enjɛl we bin de tɔk to am aks am se if i nɔ no wetin dɛnwande. Nain i se nɔ sa.
Dɔn di enjɛl tɛl am se PAPA GƆD want am fɔ no se nɔto bay di trɛnk ɔ pawa we i gɛt bɔt na bay PAPA GƆD in Spirit.
So i lɛk aw da mawnten ay, we i de bifo Zɛrubabɛl, i go fiba flat grɔn; ɛn dɛn go ebul put di las ston pantap di siti bak ɛn ɔlman go ala se tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki, tɛl PAPA GƆD tɛnki.
Noto dat nɔmɔ, PAPA GƆD tɛl am se,
na Zerubabɛl le di os in fawndeshɔn ɛn nain go bil am dɔn. Dɔn dɛn go no se na PAPA GƆD bin sɛn am to dɛn.

Nain di enjɛl se di sɛvin lamp dɛn na di sɛvin yay we PAPA GƆD de yuz fɔ luk ɔl wetin de bi na wɔl. Udat bin dɔn se dɛn nɔ go ebul we dɛn bin jɛs bigin, go gladi we dɛn go si Zɛrubabɛl wit in tuls dɛn nain an.
So Zɛkaraya aks am wetin di ɔliv tik dɛn we de na di lampstand in lɛfan ɛn raytan de fɔ.
I aks am bak wetin dɛn tu branch pan di ɔliv tik dɛn we de nia dɛn tu payp we dɛn mek wit gold de fɔ. Di payp dɛn kin pul ɔyl.
Di enjɛl aks am if i nɔ no wetin dɛn bi. So insɛf se nɔ.
Dɔn i se dɛn stand dɛn de fɔ di tu pipul we PAPA GƆD dɔn pik fɔ de wok na di wɔl fɔ am.
We i es in yay ɔp, i si wan rol pepa de flay.
Di enjɛl aks am wetin i si, ɛn i ansa se in si wan rol pepa de flay. Di pepa lɔŋ lɛkɛ tati fut ɛn wayd fiftin fut.
I se na di swɛ dat we de pas ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl; ɛnibɔdi we tif go lɔs in ples na di land dɔn di wan we de swɛ dɔn i de lay insɛf go lɔs in ples na wɔl.
PAPA GƆD se aw i de flay so, na so in de sɛn am fɔ go insay di tifman in os ɛn insay pɔsin we de lay ɛn swɛ in os; i go de insay di os dɔn nain go pwɛl di os kpatakpata wɛda na stonos ɔ na simɛnt os.
Di enjɛl we bin de tɔk to am kam bifo ɛn tɛl am se, lɛ i es in ed ɔp ɛn si wetin de bi.
I aks am wetin da wande. Di enjɛl tɛl am se na wan kayn lod we de sho ɔmɔs sin di pipul dɛn na di land dɔn sin.
Dɛn di kɔba kɔmɔt pan di lod ɛn i si wan uman sidɔm insay di baskit we gɛt di lod.
Di enjɛl se na wikɛdnɛs da wande. Dɔn i push di uman bak insay di baskit ɛn put di ebi kɔba bak pan am.
I es in ed ɔp fɔ luk gud, nain i si tu uman de flay kam bifo am. Dɛn fɛda lɛk da bɔd we dɛn kin kɔl kaw enjɛl ɛn dɛn tot lod kɔmɔt na wɔl fɔ flay go.
So a aks di enjɛl usay dɛn de go wit di lod.
I se dɛn de kɛr am go na Babilɔn usay dɛn go bil os fɔ am ɛn we dɛn go dɔn bil di os dɔn, dɛn go put am de fɔ pipul dɛn fɔ go wɔship.
We i es in ed ɔp bak i si fo ɔs ɛn karej de kɔmɔt midul tu mawnten we dɛn mek wit bras.
Di fɔs karej bin gɛt rɛd ɔs dɛn, di sɛkɛn karej bin gɛt blak ɔs dɛn,
di tɔd karej bin gɛt wayt ɔs dɛn, dɔn di nɔmba fo karej in bin gɛt sɔntin lɛk layt gre ɔs dɛn.
We a si dɛn, a aks di enjɛl se wetin dɛn wande.
Di enjɛl se, dɛn na lɛk di fo kayn briz we de na wɔl. Dɛn bin de wit PAPA GƆD ɛn naw dɛn de go du wetin PAPA GƆD se dɛn fɔ du.
Di sɛkɛn wan we gɛt di blak ɔs dɛn, go na di nɔth to usay Babilɔn de, di wayt wan dɛn go na di wɛst ɛn di wan dɛn we tan lɛk layt gre go na di sawt.
We dɛn kɔmɔt na do, yu kin si se dɛn de majiji fɔ go du dɛn wok. So di enjɛl tɛl dɛn wantɛm fɔ go du dɛn patrol na di wɔl. Dɛnsɛf go wantɛm.
Di enjɛl tɛl am se, di wan dɛn we go nɔth na Babilɔn dɔn mek PAPA GƆD nɔ vɛks lɛk aw i bin vɛks igen
Na di wɔd dis we PAPA GƆD gi am.
PAPA GƆD se, pan di wan dɛn we kɔmɔt ɛgzayl na Babilɔn, i fɔ tek Ɛlday, Tobija ɛn Jɛdaya go na Josaya we na Zaɛfinaya in bɔypikin in os, di sem de.
I se, i fɔ kɔlɛkt silva ɛn gold frɔm dɛn we i fɔ tek mek krawn; dɔn i fɔ put di krawn na Jɔshwa we na Jɛozadak in bɔypikin in ed as di bigman fɔ dɛn man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin.
I se fɔ tɛl am se in PAPA GƆD se, sɔmbɔdi gɛt fɔ kam, we dɛn go kɔl Branch. I se nain go bi di wan we go kam bil PAPA GƆD in os.

I se i go bil PAPA GƆD in os ɛn ɔl wetin i de du go tan lɛk wetin kiŋ de du, dɔn nain go bi kiŋ fɔ rul in pipul. I go gɛt fɔ gɛt man we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nia am ɛn dɛn ɔltu go wok wit wanwɔd.
Na dis krawn dɛn go tek fɔ mɛmba Ɛlday, Tobija ɛn Jɛdaya.
Pipul we de fawe, dɛn ɔl go kam ɛp fɔ bil PAPA GƆD in os dɔn na da tɛm de dɛn go biliv se na PAPA GƆD bin sɛn am. Dɛn, na da tɛm de, dɛn go wan du wetin PAPA GƆD se.
Di ia we mek fo we Dariɔs bi kiŋ, PAPA GƆD tɔk to Zɛkaraya, di nɔmba fo de insay Kislɛv we na di nɔmba nayn mɔnt.
Da tɛm de, di pipul dɛn na Bɛthɛl bin sɛn Sharɛza ɛn Regɛmelɛk ɛn dɛn man dɛn fɔ go aks PAPA GƆD fɔ blɛs dɛn
ɛn fɔ aks ɔl di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin na PAPA GƆD in os wit ɔl di prɔfɛt dɛn, if dɛn fɔ go insay di os go mek sɔri wan lɛkɛ aw dɛn bin dɔn de du.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti tɔk to Zɛkaraya. I se,
Zɛkaraya fɔ aks di pipul na di land ɛn di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin se, in se, if we dɛn bin de fast di nɔmba fayv de na di nɔmba sɛvin mɔnt fɔ sɛvinti ia, if na fɔ in dɛn bin de fast.
I se fɔ aks dɛn if we dɛn bin de it ɛn drink, nɔto fɔ dɛnsɛf dɛn bin de du am.
I se aw Jerusɛlɛm bin tan we ɔltin bin ɔrayt fɔ am, we pipul bin tap ɔlsay ɛn biznɛs bin fayn, na wetin i bin dɔn mek di prɔfɛt dɛn tɔk.
PAPA GƆD tɔk bak to Zɛkaraya. I se,
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se dɛn fɔ mek fia ple de, trit dɛn kɔmpin fayn ɛn sɔri fɔ dɛn kɔmpin.
Dɛn nɔ fɔ buli dɛn uman we dɛn man dɔn day, dɛn pikin we nɔ gɛt papa, dɛn fɔrina ɛn di poman dɛn; nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ mɛmba bad fɔ in kɔmpin.
Bɔt usay! Dɛn nɔ lisin to wetin i se. Bifo dat, dɛn mek traŋayes ɛn kɔk dɛn yes so dat dɛn nɔ go yɛri.
Dɛn traŋa dɛn at fɔ mek dɛn nɔ yɛri PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in wɔd we i bin dɔn mek in Spirit we bin de insay dɛn fɔstɛm prɔfɛt tɔk. Dat mek PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti vɛks bad fɔ wetin dɛn de du.
I se we in tɔk, di pipul dɛn nɔ de yɛri, so, we dɛnsɛf pre to am, i nɔ go yɛri.
I se in go mek dɛn skata lɛk we tinada de blo go usay dɛn nɔ no bɔt dɛn. Na so di land we dɛn lɛf tek ɛmti. Da fayn fayn ples de ɛmti so.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti tɔk to Zɛkaraya bak. I se,
in se, i de jɛlɔs fɔ Jerusɛlɛm ɛn i de jɛlɔs bad wan.
PAPA GƆD se, fɔ tɛl dɛn se, in go go tap bak na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn ɔlman go no se na de PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti de, nain oli mawnten, dɔn dɛn go no se na siti we fethful.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, dɛn grani ɛn grampa dɛn ɔl go de sidɔm na Jerusɛlɛm in trit fɔ kip kɔmpin wit dɛn wɔkinstik.
I se, di trit dɛn go ful wit dɛn bɔbɔ ɛn titi we go de ple de.
I aks dɛn se, if bikɔs dɛn si dat lɛk se i nɔ pɔsibul, if i nɔ fɔ pɔsibul fɔ insɛf.
PAPA GƆD se, in go sev in pipul dɛn na di Ist ɛn di Wɛst;
ɛn i go mek dɛn kam tap insay Jerusɛlɛm; da tɛm de, in go lɛ dɛn no se dɛn nain pipul ɛn in na dɛn PAPA GƆD. Ɛn i go sho dɛn aw i fethful ɛn de du tin tret wan.
PAPA GƆD se, lɛ dɛn nɔ givɔp. Dɛn fɔ pik zil as dɛn dɔn de yɛri ɔl wetin in prɔfɛt dɛn bin dɔn de tɔk frɔm di tɛm we dɛn li fawndeshɔn fɔ bil PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in os bak.
I se, bifo da tɛm de, nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de pe fɔ in kɔmpin mɔtalman ɔ fɔ animal ɛn i nɔ bin izi fɔ man fɔ waka na trit ɛn in ɛnimi nɔ atak am, bikɔs in bin mek mɔtalman nɔ wan si in kɔmpin.
PAPA GƆD se, naw i nɔ go trit di wan dɛn we lɛf lɛk aw i bin de du fɔs.
Bikɔs pipul dɛn go de plant ɛn avɛst ɛn dɛn nɔ go gɛt nɔn yagba, kolat go de ɔlsay ɛn ren sɛf go de kam bɔku wan. I se in go mek di balans we lɛf pan di pipul dɛn gɛt ɔl dɛn tin de fɔ ɛnjɔy.

I se pipul bin de yus dɛn nem we dɛn de swɛ ɔda pipul, bɔt naw na dɛn sem pipul de go yus nem fɔ blɛs pipul dɛn bikɔs in go sev dɛn ɛn i go mek pipul de kɔl Juda ɛn Izrɛl dɛn nem we dɛn wan blɛs ɔda pipul. I se, mek dɛn nɔ fred, lɛ dɛn pik ɔp zil nɔmɔ.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, lɛk aw i bin tɛl dɛn fɔstɛm-papa dɛn se in go pɔnish dɛn we i vɛks, di tɛm we dɛn bin ambɔg am ɛn i nɔ sɔri fɔ dɛn,
na so we i dɔn se i go blɛs Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda, i go du; so mek dɛn nɔ fred.
I se, na dɛn tin ya dɛn fɔ du: fɔ de tɔk tru to dɛnsɛf, fɔ gi rayt jɔjmɛnt ɛn fɔ de mek pis,
dɔn dɛn nɔ fɔ gɛt badat fɔ dɛn kɔmpin, nɔ fɔ de lay dɔn dɛn de swɛ, bikɔs in PAPA GƆD et dɛn kayn tin dɛn de.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti tɔk to Zɛkaraya se,

dɛn fast we dɛn bin fast di mɔnt we mek fo, di mɔnt we mek fayv, di mɔnt we mek sɛvin, ɛn di mɔnt we mek tɛn, go briŋ gladi fɔ Juda ɛn dɛn go mek di ladida, so dɛn fɔ lɛk tin we na tru ɛn we de mek pis de.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, pipul dɛn go kɔmɔt na bɔku siti kam,
sɔm go kɔmɔt na wan ples go na di ɔda wan bikɔs dɛn go se dɛn de go fɛn PAPA GƆD in blɛsin; dɛn go se dɛn de go mek PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti blɛs dɛnsɛf.
Bɔku pipul frɔm difrɛn neshɔn go go fɔ mek PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we de na Jerusɛlɛm blɛs dɛn ɛn dɛn go go fɛn di blɛsin.
PAPA GƆD se, da tɛm de, tɛn man pan ɔl di trayb dɛn na wɔl, go grip wan Ju man in klos de se lɛ dɛn go wit am bikɔs dɛn dɔn yɛri se, PAPA GƆD de wit am.
PAPA GƆD tɔk bad bɔt Adrak ɛn di siti we na Damaskɔs. Na PAPA GƆD gɛt ɔl dɛn siti we de na Siria ɛn nɔto dɛn nɔmɔ, bɔt nain gɛt ɔl di Izrɛl fambul.
Amath we de na Adrak in bɔda o, Taya ɛn Saydɔn we gɛt ɔl di sɛnsman dɛn, nain gɛt dɛn.
Di pipul dɛn na Taya dɔn mek shɔ se, dɛn bil trɔŋ trɔŋ wɔl rawnd di siti, dɛn payl silva lɛk dɔti ɛn gold lɛk dɛn pɔtɔpɔtɔ we kin dɔn blɔk gɔta.
Bɔt PAPA GƆD go mek dɛn lɔs ɔltin. Wata go kɛr dɛn jɛntri go ɛn faya go bɔn sɔm di tin dɛn.
We di pipul dɛn na Ashkɛlɔn go si wetin apin, dɛn go skyad; di pipul dɛn na Gaza go sɔfa dɔn di wan dɛn na Ɛkrɔn go jɛs giv ɔp. Di kiŋ na Gaza go day, dɛn go lɛf Ashkɛlɔn to insɛf
ɛn muf go tap na Ashdɔd wit ɔda pipul, dɔn PAPA GƆD go brok di fɛda dɔŋ pan di pipul na Filistia ɛn dɛn go lɛf fɔ de kak.

I se in nɔ go gi dɛn bif fɔ it igen ɛn di tin dɛn we dɛn nɔ fɔ it, ɔl go tap. Di balans we lɛf fɔ bi PAPA GƆD in yon pipul. Dɛn go tan lɛk di pipul na di Juda fambul to PAPA GƆD dɔn di pipul na Ɛkrɔn go tan lɛk di Jɛbyusayt dɛn.
I se, da tɛm de nain go tɔn di sikyɔriti fɔ in os, so nɔbɔdi go de pas de fri wan go ɛn kam. Nɔbɔdi nɔ go buli dɛn igen as nainsɛf go de wach dɛn naw.

I se, di pipul na Zayɔn fɔ gladi bad. Di wan dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm fɔ ala big big wan bikɔs dɛn kiŋ de kam mit dɛn. Pan ɔl we i dɔn win batul dɛn, na ɔdinari dɔŋki i de rayd pan, di bebi wan lɛk se in nɔto natin.

I se, i go tek di ɔs ɛn karej we Izrɛl bin de yuz ɛn ivin di ɔs dɛn we di pipul na Jerusɛlɛm bin de tek go wa. Di bo we dɛn kin de yuz we dɛn go wa, ɔl go pwɛl dɔn pis go de ɔlsay na wɔl. I go rul frɔm wan siti to di ɔda wan ɛn frɔm Riva Yufretis te rich usay di wɔl dɔn.
I se, bikɔs ɔf di Kɔvinant we i bin dɔn mek wit dɛn we i yuz blɔd, i go fri ɔl dɛn prizina we de na ol we nɔ gɛt wata.
I se, dɛn fɔ gɛt op ɛn go bak to di ples we dɛn go sef. I se, da de de, in wan mek dɛn no se i go gi dɔbul wan fɔ ɔl wetin dɛn dɔn lɔs.
I se in dɔn mek Juda lɛk in bo ɛn Izrɛl lɛk in aro. I se in go pɔlish di wan dɛn na Zayɔn ɛn yuz dɛn fɔ fɛt di wan dɛn na Gris, bikɔs dɛn go tan lɛk in sɔd.
Da tɛm de, PAPA GƆD go bɔsawt pan in pipul dɛn ɛn di aro dɛn we i go de sɛn go tan lɛk laytin; PAPA GƆD we na PAPA GƆD de blo in trɔmpɛt fɔ lɛ dɛn tinada we kin blo na di sawt bigin blo.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti go kɔba dɛn ɛn dɛn go nyamanyama ɛn kil kil ɔl dɛn ɛnimi. Dɛn go drink dɛn blɔd lɛk wayn ɛn dɛn go bɛlful lɛk we bol fulɔp, ɛn dɛn go sok lɛ di kɔna dɛn na dɛn ɔlta.
Da de de, PAPA GƆD go sev dɛn bikɔs i go trit dɛn lɛk man we de mɛn ship. Lɛk aw dayamɔn pan krawn de shayn, na so dɛn go shayn na di land.
Di ples go fayn fɔ si, bɔbs! Yutman dɛn go plant bɔku tin we go mek layf bɛtɛ fɔ dɛn ɛn dɛn go mek wayn fɔ dɛn yɔŋgyal.
Aks PAPA GƆD fɔ ren, ren sizin. Na PAPA GƆD de mek di klawd dak we de briŋ ren kam, so dat mɔtalman go gɛt ren ɛn di plant dɛnsɛf go gɛt.

Dɛn man we de lukgrɔn de tɔk nɔnsɛns, na soso lay ful dɛn man dɛn we biliv se dɛn de tɔk to dɛn god; di wan dɛn we de drim de drim laylay drim, ɛn de gi laylay intapritteshɔn. Dat de mek di pipul jɛs de go lɛk we kayt kɔt. Dɛn de gɛt prɔblɛm bikɔs nɔbɔdi nɔ de fɔ lid dɛn.

PAPA GƆD se i dɔn vɛks wit ɔl di lida dɛn ɛn i go pɔnish di lida dɛn. PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in de luk afta in yon pipul dɛn, dat na di pipul dɛn na Juda fambul ɛn i go mek dɛn tan lɛk in ɔs dɛn we i de tek fɛt.
I se na pan dɛn i go pik lida dɛn we i go at fɔ du witawt dɛn bikɔs dɛn go trɔŋ lɛk di pɛg we de ol tɛnt, dɛn go fiba bo we dɛn de tek fɛt ɛn sɔm pan dɛn go bi kiŋ.
Dɛn ɔl go fiba sojaman dɛn we de go wa togɛda, we go gi dɛn ɛnimi dɔti fɔ it. Dɛn go so fɛt bikɔs PAPA GƆD de wit dɛn ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul bit di man dɛn we de pan ɔs, sɛf.

I se i go mek di pipul na Juda in fambul layn gɛt trɛnk ɛn i go sev di wan dɛn we de na Izrɛl. I se i go briŋ dɛn kam bak bikɔs i de sɔri fɔ dɛn ɛn dɛn go tan lɛk i nɔ wande lɛf dɛn to dɛnsɛf. I se in na PAPA GƆD so i go ansa dɛn.
Di Izrɛlayt dɛn go tan lɛk sojaman dɛn ɔl at go gladi lɛk udat drink rɔm. Dɛn pikin dɛn go si wetin de apin ɛn dɛn at go swit da tɛm de, dɛn go prez PAPA GƆD.
I se, in go gi dɛn signal ɛn gɛda dɛn ɔl wan say bikɔs in bin dɔn bay dɛn bak so in go mek dɛn bɔku lɛk aw dɛn bin tan fɔs.
I se, pan ɔl we i dɔn mek dɛn de ɔlɔbɔt na di neshɔn dɛn, dɛn go stil de mɛmba am na di fawe kɔntri we dɛn de. Dɔn dɛn ɛn dɛn pikin dɛn nɔ go day dɛn go tɔn bak wit di pikin dɛn.
I se, in go briŋ ɔl dɛn wan na Ijipt ɛn Asiria kam bak na dɛn yon kɔntri. I go lɛ dɛn sɛtul na Giliad ɛn Libanɔn. Dɛn go so bɔku dat di ples nɔ go du fɔ dɛn ɔl.
Dɛn go pas insay trɔbul lɛk aw dɛn bin de na Ijipt bɔt natin nɔ go du dɛn; di wata na Riva Nayl go dray, di kak we Asiria de kak go dɔn dɔn Ijipt go lɔs di pawa we i bin gɛt.
PAPA GƆD se, in go mek dɛn gɛt pawa insay am dɔn di pipul go du wetin in want. Na dat in PAPA GƆD se.
Libanɔn fɔ opin in do dɛn mek faya go bɔn ɔl dɛn sida tik.
Di babu kɔtlas tik dɛn fɔ kray, bikɔs kɔtin tri dɔn fɔdɔm, ɔl dɛn fayn fayn tik de dɔn pwɛl. Di ok tik dɛn na Beshan fɔ kray bikɔs dɛn dɔn kɔt ɔl di tik dɛn na di bush.
Lisin we dɛn kiŋ ɛn lida dɛn de kray, dɛn boŋo dɔn fɔdɔm! Lisin aw dɛn layɔn de grɔmbul di bush we dɛn tap na Jɔdan, ɔl dɔn pwɛl.
PAPA GƆD we na mi PAPA GƆD se mi fɔ tan lɛk we dɛn wan kil man we de mɛn ship in ship dɛn.
Di wan dɛn we de bay dɛn fɔ kil dɛn nɔ gɛt pɔnishmɛnt fɔ dat; dɔn di wan dɛn we de sɛl dɛn de blɛs PAPA GƆD fɔ we dɛn dɔn mek bɔku mɔni bikɔs di wan dɛn we de mɛn dɛn nɔ de sɔri fɔ dɛnsɛf.
PAPA GƆD se, in nɔ go sɔri fɔ di pipul dɛn we tap na di land igen I go mek dɛn bigman dɛn trit dɛn bad ɛn dɛn kiŋ dɛn nɔ go du natin bɛtɛ. Dɛn go nyamanyama di wɔl ɛn i nɔ go pul dɛn kɔmɔt de.
Na so Zɛkaraya tek bi wachman fɔ ship dɛn we dɛn dɔn rɛdi fɔ go kil. So i tek tu wɔkinstik we i gi di wan nem Gres, dɔn di ɔda wan i kɔl Wanwɔd. Na so i luk di ship dɛn.
Insay wan mɔnt, i pwɛl di ɔda tri lida dɛn wok. I nɔ bin peshɛnt wit dɛn ɛn dɛnsɛf nɔ bin lɛk am.
Dat mek i tɛl di pipul dɛn se i nɔ go bi dɛn lida igen I se wetin fɔ day go day, wetin fɔ pwɛl go pwɛl. Di wan dɛn we lɛf go it it dɛn kɔmpin.
I tek di wɔkinstik we i gi nem Gres ɛn brok am. Bay dat i brok di agrimɛnt we bin de bitwin in ɛn di pipul.
So frɔm da de de, di agrimɛnt we bin de bitwin in ɛn di wan dɛn we kin bay ɛn sɛl ship, dɔn. Dɛn ɔl we bin de wach am no se na wetin PAPA GƆD se fɔ du, i du.
Zɛkaraya tɛl dɛn se, if i ɔrayt wit dɛn, dɛn fɔ pe am; bɔt if dat nɔ rayt, dɛn kin ol am. So dɛn pe am tati silva kɔpɔ.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am se mek i put am usay dɛn kin kip mɔni, dat na di mɔni we dɛn pe am. So insɛf tek di tati silva kɔpɔ ɛn put am usay dɛn kin kip mɔni insay PAPA GƆD in os.
Dɔn i brok di sɛkɛn wɔkinstik we nem Wanwɔd. Dat sho se i dɔn pwɛl di brɔda biznɛs we bin de bitwin Juda ɛn Izrɛl.
PAPA GƆD tɛl am se, i fɔ mek lɛk in na dɛn man we de mɛn ship bɔt dɛn nɔ bisin bɔt di ship.
I se in de mek pɔsin kam we go bi lida we nɔ bisin bɔt wetin di ship de du ɛn i nɔ go bɔda fɔ go fɛn di wan we lɔs.
I se da kayn pɔsin de go alaki bikɔs i de lɛf di wan dɛn we i de lid to dɛnsɛf. I se ɔl in pawa go dɔn we i go wa. In an go day ɛn in rayt yay go blɛn.
Dis na di wɔd we PAPA GƆD tɔk bɔt Izrɛl: PAPA GƆD we mek ɛvin ɛn ath ɛn gi layf to mɔtalman se,
in dɔn rɛdi fɔ mek Jerusɛlɛm lɛkɛ rɔm we ɔl di neshɔn rawnd am go drink ɛn biev lɛk udat drɔnk. Dɛn go atak Juda dɔn dɛn go atak Jerusɛlɛm insɛf.
Da de de, Jerusɛlɛm go tan lɛk ebi ston ɛn ɔl udat tray fɔ es am go ambɔg insɛf. Da tɛm de, ɔl di neshɔn dɛn go mek gɛŋ fɔ kam mit am.
PAPA GƆD se na da tɛm de i go mek ɔl di ɔs we dɛn tek fɔ go fɛt fred ɛn di wan dɛn we de rayd dɛn go kres. Bɔt in go opin in yay fɔ de wach in pipul dɛn na Juda ɛn i go mek di ɔs dɛn blɛn.
Dat go mek di famili dɛn na di Juda fambul tɔk to dɛnsɛf se, na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na dɛn PAPA GƆD, gi di pipul dɛn na Jerusɛlɛm, trɛnk.

I se, da de de, i go mek di Juda fambul lɛk pɔt we de na faya insay bush, lɛk opin faya usay dray gras de; ɛn dɛn go nyakanyaka ɔl di neshɔn dɛn we lɛf, ɛn Jerusɛlɛm go lɛf usay i de, di sem Jerusɛlɛm.
PAPA GƆD go mek di wan dɛn we tap na Juda fɔs win so dat pipul go si aw Devid in os fayn ɛn di fayn we Jerusɛlɛm go fayn go pas wetin dɛn si na Juda.
Da de de, PAPA GƆD go fɛt fɔ di wan dɛn we tap na Jerusɛlɛm so dat di wan we nɔ gɛt trɛnk sɛf go tan lɛk Devid, dɔn Devid in os go tan lɛk PAPA GƆD to dɛn, lɛkɛ se in na PAPA GƆD in enjɛl.
Na da sem de de, nain PAPA GƆD go dɔnawe wit ɔl udat nɔ wan si Jerusɛlɛm.

I se in go gi Devid in os ɛn ɔl udat de na Jerusɛlɛm, sɔri-at fɔ de pre fɔ pipul so dat wɛn dɛn luk di wan we dɛn chuk, dɛn go sɔri fɔ am lɛk aw mama de sɔri fɔ in waŋren pikin, ɛn kray bita kray pan am lɛk aw mama de kray pan in fɔs pikin.
Da de de, di kray we go de na Jerusɛlɛm go so bɔku lɛk we dɛn kin de kray fɔ Adad Rimɔn na di flat grɔn na Mɛgido.

Ɔlman na di land go sɔri ɛn dɛn go de bay grup; ɔl udat de na Devid in famili go de bay insɛf bɔt di wɛf dɛn go de to dɛnsɛf; ɔl udat de na Nethan in famili go de bay insɛf bɔt dɛnsɛf yon wɛf dɛn go de to dɛnsɛf;
ɔl udat de na Livay in famili go de bay insɛf bɔt dɛn wɛf dɛn go de to dɛnsɛf, ɔl udat de na Shimɛay in famili go de bay insɛf bɔt dɛn wɛf dɛn go de to dɛnsɛf;
ɔl di famili we lɛf go de bay dɛnsɛf bɔt di wɛf dɛn ɔl go de to dɛnsɛf.
Da de de, wan fawnten go de we di pipul na Devid in os ɛn di pipul dɛn we tap na Jerusɛlɛm go go so dat dɛn go mek dɛnsɛf klin na PAPA GƆD yay ɛn dɛn sin go kɔmɔt.

PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se na da de de i go pul ɔl dɛn ɔda gɔd we dɛn mek fɔ wɔship na di land ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go de mɛmba dɛn, dɔn ivin dɛn prɔfɛt dɛn ɛn di spirit we de mek dɛn wan fɔ wɔship di ɔda gɔd dɛn nɔ go de igen

If ɛniwan stil de we de mek se in na prɔfɛt, in mama ɛn papa we bɔn am go tɛl am se i nɔ wan lɔŋ layf as na lay i de lay se i de tɔk fɔ PAPA GƆD; dɔn we i lay, in mama ɛn papa go chuk am fɔ di lay we i de lay.
Da de de, ɛni prɔfɛt we si vishɔn we fɔ mek i tɔk PAPA GƆD wɔd, go shem fɔ tɔk; i nɔ go wɛr di klos we dɛn kin wɛr fɔ lay pan pipul.
Bifo dat i go se in nɔto prɔfɛt, i go se in na fama ɛn dat na fam i de mek frɔm we i smɔl.
Dɔn if pɔsin aks am uskayn wund de nain bak, i go se na we i go nain padi dɛn os i wund.
PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, di sɔd dɛn fɔ rɛdi fɔ fɛt in lida dɛn we fɔ de wok wit am. I se we dɛn ambɔg di lida dɛn, di pipul dɛn go rɔnawe go ɔlɔbɔt, dɔn na di lili wan dɛn i go ebul dil wit.
PAPA GƆD se insay di wanol land, ɛni tu pam tri pɔsin go day, dɔn i go mek di wan nɔ day pan di tri pipul.

Da wande we lɛf, nain i go pas sɔntin we go mek i klin lɛk silva. I go tɛst am lɛk aw dɛn de tɛst gold na faya. Dɛn go kɔl PAPA GƆD in nem we dɛn de pre ɛn in go ansa dɛn. In go tɔk se dɛn nain pɔsin, dɔn dɛn go se PAPA GƆD na dɛn PAPA GƆD.
Fɔ tru tru, di de we PAPA GƆD go kam, de kam wɛn una go sheb ɔl dɛn tin we dɛn bin dɔn tek na una an.

PAPA GƆD go lɛ ɔl di neshɔn dɛn we nɔ wan si Jerusɛlɛm go fɔ fɛt am. Dɛn go kapchɔ di siti, lut na dɛn os dɛn, ɛn rep dɛn uman dɛn we go mek af ɔf di wan dɛn we tap na di siti go go ɛgzayl dɔn di balans nɔ go kɔmɔt na di siti.
Dɛn PAPA GƆD go fɛt dɛn neshɔn dɛn de lɛkɛ aw i bin de fɛt fɔstɛm.
Da de de, i go tinap pantap Mawnt Ɔliv we de bifo Jerusɛlɛm bay di Ist say; dɔn di mawnten go plit tu, frɔm ist to wɛst. Na wan vali go de midul dɛn we go mek wan pat de nɔth ɛn di ɔda pat de sawt.
Na dis vali ya we sheb di mawnten, nain dɛn go tek fɔ rɔnawe lɛkɛ aw di tɛm we Uzaya na bin kiŋ, dɛn fɔstɛm pipul bin rɔnawe we dɛn bin gɛt athkwek. PAPA GƆD gɛt fɔ kam wit ɔl in enjɛl dɛn.
Da tɛm de, nɔbɔdi nɔ go de tɔk bɔt ren ɔ dray sizin,
ɛn di ples go bi de tɛm ɔl di tɛm; nɔbɔdi nɔ go de tɔk bɔt de tɛm ɔ nɛt bikɔs di ples go brayt so ivintɛm.
Da de de, na wata we de gi layf nɔmɔ go de flo na Jerusɛlɛm, af go de go na di ist si, af de go na di wɛst si. Na so i go de bi ren sizin ɛn dray sizin.
Na PAPA GƆD go de rul di wanol wɔl; ɔlman go de wɔship am ɛn kɔl am di sem nem.

Di wanol ples go tɔn to flat grɔn frɔm Giba te rich Rimɔn we de sawt insay Jerusɛlɛm. Bɔt Jerusɛlɛm in go lɛf ay wan usay i de frɔm di Bɛnjamin Get te rich di ples usay di fɔs get bin de, to di Kɔna Get ɛn frɔm di Ananɛl Tawa te rich di say we dɛn kin de mek wayn fɔ di kiŋ.
Pipul dɛn go tap de ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go swɛ dɛn. Jerusɛlɛm go bi ples we sef fɔ de.
PAPA GƆD go mek bad sik mit di pipul dɛn we bin go fɛt Jerusɛlɛm. Dɛn go de layf wan bɔt dɛn bɔdi go rɔtin, dɛn yay sɛf go rɔtin ɛn ivin dɛn siti go rɔtin na dɛn mɔt.
Da de de, ɔlman go gɛt in yon trɔbul we PAPA GƆD de sɛn so dɛn go bigin fɛt dɛnsɛf
ɛn ivin Juda go grap fɔ fɛt Jerusɛlɛm. Dɛn go kapu di ɔda neshɔn dɛn jɛntri lɛkɛ dɛn gold, silva ɛn dɛn bɔku bɔku klos.
Di sem kayn bad sik go fɔdɔm pan dɛn ɔs dɛn, dɛn myul, dɛn kamɛl, dɛn dɔŋki ɛn ɛni ɔda animal we de na di kamp.

Dɛn di wan dɛn we nɔ day na dɛn neshɔn we bin atak Jerusɛlɛm, go go wɔship PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti lɛkɛ aw dɛn kin du we dɛn de sɛlibret di tɛm we dɛn kin tap na bafa fɔ mɛmba aw dɛn bin de wirɔn na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Bɔt if ɛniwan pan dɛn neshɔn de nɔ go Jerusɛlɛm fɔ wɔship PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti we na Kiŋ, ren nɔ go kam na di say we dɛn de.

If di Ijipshian dɛn nɔ jɔyn di ɔda wan dɛn fɔ go wɔship PAPA GƆD, i go mek dɛnsɛf gɛt bad sik lɛkɛ dɛn ɔda neshɔn we nɔ sɛlibret di tɛm we di Izrɛlayt kin tap na bafa fɔ mɛmba aw dɛn bin de wirɔn na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Na so PAPA GƆD go pɔnish di Ijipshian dɛn ɛn dɛn ɔda neshɔn we nɔ sɛlibret di tɛm we di Izrɛlayt dɛn kin tap na bafa fɔ mɛmba aw dɛn bin de wirɔn na di ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap.
Da de de, dɛn go rayt OLI FƆ PAPA GƆD pan di bɛl we ɛŋ pan di ɔs dɛn. Di pɔt dɛn we de na PAPA GƆD in os, go bi lɛkɛ bol frɔnt di ɔlta.

Ɔl di pɔt dɛn we de na Jerusɛlɛm ɛn Juda go de fɔ PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti so dat ɔl udat de kam mek sakrifays, go yuz am ɛn bwɛl wetin dɛn wan sakrifays de. Da de de, nɔbɔdi nɔ go de na PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti in os fɔ de sɛl.
Dis na di mɛsej we PAPA GƆD gi Malakay fɔ Izrɛl.
PAPA GƆD se in bin lɛk Izrɛl. Bɔt dɛn de aks am se aw i lɛk dɛn. I se i wan mek dɛn no se pan ɔl we Isɔ ɛn Jekɔb na brɔda, na Jekɔb in lɛk,
bɔt i et Isɔ; dat mek i dɔn lɛf di il dɛn fɔ tɔn ɛmti land we pɔsin nɔ go ebul tap gi wayl animal dɛn.
If di Idɔmayt dɛn se, ɔl dɛn ples dɛn dɔn pwɛl bɔt dɛn go mek am bak, PAPA GƆD go se ivin if dɛn mek dɛn bak, in go pwɛl dɛn te ɔlman no se na pipul dɛn we PAPA GƆD go vɛks pan sote go gɛt di kɔntri.
We pipul dɛn we nɔ de na Izrɛl si wetin PAPA GƆD du, dɛn go se PAPA GƆD gud.

I se bɔypikin kin rɛspɛkt in papa dɔn bɔy de rɛspɛkt in masta. I se, so, if dɛn de se in na papa, usay in yon rɛspɛkt de; ɛn if in na masta, usay in rɛspɛkt we i fɔ gɛt go. PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, di man dɛn we de mek sakrifays fɔ pipul sin nɔ gɛt wan rɛspɛkt fɔ am ɛn dɛn nɔ bisin sɛf bɔt in nem.

I se dɛn de sho se dɛn nɔ rɛspɛkt am we dɛn de bamfa di tin dɛn we dɛn de sakrifays to am. Bɔt dɛn de aks PAPA GƆD aw dɛn de bamfa di tin dɛn, so, i tɛl dɛn se wans dɛn tink se dɛn kin gi am ɛni kayn tin, dɛn nɔ rɛspɛkt PAPA GƆD in tebul.
I se na bad bad tin fɔ de sakrifays animal we blɛn, we nɔ de waka ɔ we sik. I se if dɛn gi dat to ɛni gɔvna ɔ prɛsidɛnt, if i go gladi fɔ dat.
I se bɔt dɛn de kam gi PAPA GƆD dɔn dɛn want am fɔ gladi fɔ dɛn, bɔt in PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti nɔ go gladi wit dɛn fɔ dat.
I se in bin de op se sɔmbɔdi go de we go tɛl dɛn nɔ fɔ wes dɛn tɛm bikɔs in nɔ go tek dɛn sakrifays as i nɔ gladi.

PAPA GƆD Ɔlmayti se, frɔm we san grap na mɔnin te di tɛm we i de go dɔŋ, nain in nem big to ɔl di neshɔn dɛn na wɔl ɛn ɔlsay we dɛn de mek sakrifays to am, nɔ kin bi bamfa wan bikɔs ɔl di neshɔn dɛn na wɔl no se in na big PAPA GƆD.
