Una no se Krays de du wetin rayt ɔltɛm, so una fɔ no se ɛni bɔdi we de du wetin rayt na Gɔd pikin.
Mi pikin dɛn we a lɛk, Gɔd so lɛk wi dat i kɔl wi in yon pikin dɛn ɛn wi nain pikin dɛn, fɔ tru. Plɛnti pipul dɛn na wɔl nɔ no se wi na Gɔd in pikin dɛn, bikɔs dɛn nɔ no Gɔd.
Mi padi dɛn we a lɛk, wi na Gɔd in pikin dɛn naw; wi nɔ no yet wetin wi go bi bambay, bɔt wi no se wɛn Krays insɛf kam bak wi go tan lɛkɛ am, bikɔs da tɛm de wi go si aw i tan fɔ tru.
Ɛni bɔdi we abop pan Krays go klin bikɔs Krays klin, i nɔ go gɛt bɔt nain layf.
Ɛni bɔdi we nɔ gri tap fɔ sin nɔ de du wetin Gɔd in lɔ se i fɔ du, bikɔs fɔ sin na fɔ brok Gɔd in lɔ.
Una no se Krays kam fɔ pul mɔtalman kɔmɔt pan sin ɛn Krays nɔ gɛt sin nain layf.
Ɛni bɔdi we de waka wit Krays, nɔ go de sin. Ɛni bɔdi we stil de sin nɔ no Krays yet ɛn i nɔ kechɔp sɛf se Krays de.
Mi pikin dɛn, mek nɔbɔdi nɔ mek una ful. Pɔsin we de waka tret, na pɔsin we de du di rayt tin, jɛs lɛkɛ aw Krays de du di rayt tin, i nɔ gɛt sin nain layf.
Ɛni bɔdi we nɔ de tap fɔ sin blant Setan, bikɔs Setan dɔn de sin frɔm we di wɔl bigin; na dat mek Gɔd in Pikin kam fɔ pwɛl Setan in wok.
Ɛni bɔdi we kɔmɔt to Gɔd nɔto pɔsin we go jɛs de sin ɛn nɔ gri fɔ tap, bikɔs i gɛt Gɔd nain at, ɛn we Gɔd nain Papa, i nɔ go jɛs de sin, i nɔ gri fɔ tap.
Gɔd in pikin dɛn ɛn Setan in pikin dɛn difrɛn: ɛni bɔdi we nɔ de du wetin rayt ɛn we nɔ lɛk in kɔmpin, nɔto Gɔd yon pikin. Na dat wi go tek no udat na Gɔd yon pikin dɛn ɛn udat na Setan yon.
Di mɛsej we una bin dɔn yɛri di tɛm we una fɔs bi Kristiɛn nain dis: wi fɔ lɛk wi kɔmpin mɔtalman.
Wi nɔ fɔ tan lɛkɛ Ken we bin kil in brɔda; Ken bin blant Setan. Wetin du Ken kil in brɔda? Na bikɔs i bin de du dɛn tin we Gɔd nɔ want, ɛn in brɔda bin de du wetin rayt na Gɔd yay.
So, mi brɔda dɛn, una nɔ wɔnda if di pipul dɛn na di wɔl nɔ lɛk una.
Wi no se wi dɔn lɛf di tin we bin de kil wi, wi dɔn gɛt layf; wi no dat bikɔs wi lɛk wi kɔmpin dɛn. Ɛni bɔdi we nɔ lɛk in kɔmpin, nɔ kɔmɔt na day rod yet.
Ɛni bɔdi we nɔ lɛk in kɔmpin, na pɔsin we kin kil in kɔmpin mɔtalman, ɛn una no se ɛni bɔdi we de kil in kɔmpin mɔtalman, na pɔsin we nɔ gɛt di layf we go de sote go.
Na dis mek wi no wetin lɛk min: Krays sakrifays in layf fɔseka wi. Semwe so, wisɛf fɔ sakrifays wi layf fɔseka wi kɔmpin mɔtalman!
If pɔsin jɛntri bɔt i nɔ gri fɔ ɛp in kɔmpin we nɔ gɛt, aw i go se in lɛk Gɔd?
Mi pikin dɛn, wi nɔ fɔ jɛs de tɔk se wi lɛk wi kɔmpin, bɔt wi fɔ de du dɛn tin we go sho se wi lɛk dɛn fɔ tru.
Na dat go mek wi no se wi de fɔ wetin na tru ɛn na dat go mek wi nɔ wɔri wɛn wi tinap bifo Gɔd.
If wi at tɛl wi se wi nɔ du rayt, wi no se Gɔd pas wi at ɛn i no ɔltin.
Mi padi dɛn we a lɛk, if wi at nɔ tɛl wi se wi du tin we nɔ rayt, wi nɔ go wɔri wɛn wi tinap bifo Gɔd.
Gɔd de gi wi ɛnitin we wi aks am fɔ, bikɔs wi de du wetin i de tɛl wi fɔ du ɛn dɛn tin we mek i satisfay.
Na di tin dis we Gɔd tɛl wi fɔ du: Wi fɔ biliv pan in Pikin, Jizɔs Krays, ɛn wi fɔ lɛk wi kɔmpin mɔtalman, lɛkɛ aw Krays dɔn tɛl wi fɔ du.
Ɛni bɔdi we de du wetin Gɔd tɛl am fɔ du, na pɔsin we jɔyn an wit Gɔd; Gɔd de nain at ɛn insɛf de waka wit Gɔd. Wi no se Gɔd de na wi at bikɔs i dɔn gi wi in Spirit.
Mi padi dɛn we a lɛk, nɔto ɔl spirit una fɔ biliv, bɔt una fɔ tray di spirit dɛn fɔ no if na to Gɔd dɛn kɔmɔt, bikɔs plɛnti lay prɔfɛt dɛn dɔn kam na di wɔl.
Una lisin aw una go no if na to Gɔd di Spirit kɔmɔt. If ɛni bɔdi tɔk se Jizɔs Krays bin kam lɛkɛ mɔtalman, Gɔd in Spirit de insay am.
Bɔt ɛni bɔdi we nɔ tɔk so bɔt Jizɔs Krays, nɔto Gɔd in Spirit de insay am, na di spirit we nɔ lɛk Krays. Una bin dɔn yɛri se dis spirit ya gɛt fɔ kam na wɔl ɛn i de na di wɔl naw naw.
Mi pikin dɛn, una na Gɔd yon ɛn di lay prɔfɛt dɛn nɔ ebul una, una dɔn win dɛn, bikɔs Gɔd in Spirit we de insay una gɛt pawa pas di spirit we de insay dɛn pipul we na di wɔl yon pipul.
Dɛn lay prɔfɛt de tɔk bɔt dɛn tin we de na di wɔl, ɛn di pipul dɛn na wɔl de lisin to dɛn bikɔs na dɛn yon prɔfɛt dɛn wande.
Bɔt wi na Gɔd yon pipul ɛn ɛni bɔdi we no Gɔd go lisin to wi, bɔt ɛni bɔdi we nɔ no Gɔd nɔ go lisin to wi. Na di we dis we wi go no Gɔd in Spirit we tru ɛn di spirit we de lay.
Mi padi dɛn we a lɛk, una mek wi lɛk wi kɔmpin bikɔs na Gɔd put lɛk na mɔtalman at. Ɛni bɔdi we lɛk in kɔmpin na Gɔd yon pɔsin ɛn i no Gɔd.
Ɛni bɔdi we nɔ lɛk in kɔmpin, na pɔsin we nɔ no Gɔd bikɔs Gɔd na di wan we nɔ de tap fɔ lɛk ɔltɛm ɛn nain de lɛk aw pɔsin fɔ lɛk fɔ tru.
Na di we dis we Gɔd sho wi se in lɛk wi: I sɛn in wangren Pikin kam na wɔl, so dat in Pikin kin mek wi gɛt layf.
Wetin na lɛk? Nain dis: Nɔto fɔ se wi lɛk Gɔd, bɔt in lɛk wi ɛn i sɛn in Pikin kam na wɔl fɔ sakrifays insɛf fɔ wi mek i go padin wi sin dɛn.
Mi padi dɛn we a lɛk, if na so Gɔd lɛk wi, wi fɔ lɛk wi kɔmpin.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ si Gɔd yet, bɔt if wi lɛk wi kɔmpin, Gɔd de insay wi ɛn di lɛk we Gɔd lɛk wi de mek wi lɛk wi kɔmpin mɔ ɛn mɔ.
Di tin we mek wi no gud wan se wi de waka wit Gɔd ɛn Gɔd de insay wi, na bikɔs i dɔn put in Spirit insay wi.
Wisɛf dɔn si in Pikin ɛn wi dɔn tɛl pipul se i sɛn in Pikin fɔ kam sev di wɔl.
Ɛni bɔdi we tɔk se Jizɔs na Gɔd in Pikin, Gɔd de insay da pɔsin de ɛn da pɔsin de de waka wit Gɔd.

So wisɛf biliv se Gɔd lɛk wi, ɛn wi dɔn fil di lɛk na wi layf. Gɔd na di wan we nɔ de tap fɔ lɛk ɔltɛm ɛn nain lɛk aw pɔsin fɔ lɛk fɔ tru, ɛn ɛni bɔdi we lɛk Gɔd ɛn mɔtalman, na pɔsin we de waka wit Gɔd ɛn Gɔd de insay am.

As wi de insay Krays, di lɛk we wi lɛk Krays go de gro mɔ ɛn mɔ, ɛn wi nɔ go wɔri fɔ tinap bifo Gɔd di de we i de jɔj ɔlman na wɔl, bikɔs wi no se na Krays we de insay wi de mek wi liv lɛkɛ aw wi liv na dis wɔl.
Da say we lɛk de, fred nɔ lib de, bikɔs if pɔsin lɛk fɔ tru, i nɔ de fred. If pɔsin de fred, dat na pɔnishmɛnt i de fred ɛn ɛni bɔdi we de fred, da pɔsin de nɔ lɛk Gɔd lɛk aw i fɔ lɛk am.
Wi lɛk Gɔd ɛn wi kɔmpin bikɔs na Gɔd fɔs lɛk wi.
If ɛni bɔdi se in lɛk Gɔd, bɔt i nɔ lɛk in kɔmpin, da pɔsin de de lay. Bikɔs if pɔsin nɔ lɛk in kɔmpin we i de si, aw i go lɛk Gɔd we i nɔ de si?
Na di tin dis we Krays tɛl wi fɔ du: pɔsin we lɛk Gɔd fɔ lɛk in kɔmpin insɛf.
Ɛni bɔdi we biliv se Jizɔs na di Mɛsaya na Gɔd pikin. Ɛni bɔdi we lɛk di Papa, go lɛk in Pikin.
Aw wi go no se wi lɛk Gɔd in pikin dɛn, na bay aw wi lɛk Gɔd ɛn aw wi de du wetin i tɛl wi fɔ du.
We wi lɛk Gɔd wi de du ɔl wetin i tɛl wi fɔ du. Wetin i tɛl wi fɔ du nɔ traŋa fɔ wi,
bikɔs ɛni bɔdi we na Gɔd pikin ebul fɔ win di wɔl. Wi ebul fɔ win di wɔl bikɔs wi biliv pan Jizɔs.
Udat go ebul win di wɔl? Na dɛn pipul nɔmɔ we biliv se Jizɔs na Gɔd in Pikin.
Jizɔs Krays wan kam na wɔl bay wata ɛn blɔd. I nɔ kam na wɔl bay wata nɔmɔ, i kam bay wata ɛn blɔd. Na Gɔd in Spirit mek wi no se dat na tru bikɔs in Spirit de tɔk tru.
Na tri witnɛs de:
Gɔd in Spirit, wata ɛn blɔd; dɛn ɔl tri de tɔk di sem tin.
If wi kin biliv wetin mɔtalman tɔk, wi fɔ biliv wetin Gɔd tɔk mɔ; Gɔd tɔk bɔt Jizɔs we nain Pikin.
Ɛni bɔdi we biliv se Jizɔs na Gɔd in Pikin, di tin we Gɔd tɔk de nain at, bɔt if ɛni bɔdi se in nɔ biliv wetin Gɔd tɔk bɔt in Pikin, da pɔsin de de se Gɔd de lay.
Di tin we Gɔd tɔk, nain dis: Gɔd dɔn gi wi di tru layf we go de sote go, ɛn dis layf ya de wit in Pikin.
Ɛni bɔdi we gɛt Gɔd in Pikin nain at, gɛt dis tru layf ya; bɔt ɛni bɔdi we nɔ gɛt Gɔd in Pikin nain at, nɔ gɛt di tru layf.
A de rayt dis lɛta ya to una we biliv pan Gɔd in Pikin fɔ mek una no se una gɛt di tru layf we go de sote go.
Wi biliv se wɛn wi kam bifo Gɔd ɛn aks am fɔ ɛnitin, i go yɛri wi ɛn gi wi, if na dat in want.
We wi no se i de yɛri wi wɛn wi aks am fɔ ɛnitin, wi no se i go ansa wi.

If ɛni bɔdi si in kɔmpin sin ɛn da sin de nɔto sin we go tap am mek i nɔ gɛt layf we go de sote go, i fɔ pre fɔ am ɛn Gɔd go gi am di tru layf. Bɔt di pre we i de pre nɔ go ɛp dɛn pipul we sin da bad bad sin we de mek pɔsin nɔ gɛt layf we go de sote go, ɛn a nɔ se una fɔ pre to Gɔd fɔ dɛn kayn sin de.
Ɛni bad tin we pɔsin de du na sin, bɔt sin de we nɔ go tap pɔsin mek i nɔ gɛt layf we go de sote go.
Wi no se ɛni bɔdi we de waka wit Gɔd nɔ de sin, bikɔs Gɔd in Pikin de gyad am ɛn Setan nɔ ebul am.
Wi no se wi na Gɔd yon pipul, pan ɔl we Setan de rul di ol wɔl.

Wi no se Gɔd in Pikin dɔn kam ɛn i dɔn gi wi di pawa fɔ no di tru Gɔd. Wi layf de wit di tru Gɔd ɛn wi layf de wit Gɔd in Pikin, Jizɔs Krays. Jizɔs Krays na di tru Gɔd ɛn di tru layf we go de sote go.
Mi pikin dɛn, una nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du wit dɛn tin we mɔtalman mek fɔ pre to we nɔto di tru Gɔd.
Mi, Jɔn we na una bigman na di chɔch, de rayt to di uman we Gɔd dɔn pik ɛn in pikin dɛn we a lɛk fɔ tru. Nɔto mi wangren, bɔt ɔlman we no wetin tru, lɛk una,
bikɔs wetin tru de na wi at ɛn i go de wit wi sote go.
Mek Gɔd wi Papa, ɛn in Pikin, Jizɔs Krays, blɛs wi, sɔri fɔ wi, ɛn gi wi kol at; mek ɔl dɛn tin ya bi to wi we no ɛn biliv wetin tru ɛn lɛk wi kɔmpin mɔtalman.
A bin gladi bad we a yɛri se sɔm pan yu pikin dɛn de fala wetin tru, lɛkɛ aw wi Papa tɛl wi fɔ du.
So, uman we a lɛk fɔ tru, a de beg yu: lɛ wi lɛk wi kɔmpin. Dis tin we a de rayt tɛl yu fɔ du, nɔto nyu tin; na tin we wi bin dɔn no frɔm we yu bi Kristiɛn.
Di kayn lɛk we a min nain dis: Wi fɔ lɛk wi kɔmpin lɛkɛ aw Gɔd tɛl wi fɔ du. Wetin una bin dɔn yɛri frɔm we una bi Kristiɛn nain dis: Una ɔl fɔ lɛk una kɔmpin.
Plɛnti pipul we de mek dɛn kɔmpin ful de ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl, dɛn nɔ de tɔk se Jizɔs Krays kam na wɔl lɛkɛ mɔtalman; dɛn de lay ɛn dɛn nɔ lɛk Krays.
Una tek tɛm, mek una nɔ lɔs wetin una dɔn wok fɔ, so una go gɛt ɔl wetin Gɔd dɔn prɔmis una.
Ɛnibɔdi we nɔ jɛs de lan pipul wetin Krays lan am nɔmɔ, bɔt i de lan dɛn ɔda tin miks, da pɔsin de nɔ gɛt Gɔd nain at. Ɛnibɔdi we de lan pipul wetin Krays lan am, di Papa ɛn in Pikin de nain at.
If ɛnibɔdi we nɔ biliv wetin Krays dɔn lan wi, kam to una fɔ lan una ɛnitin, una nɔ fɔ kip am na una os; una nɔ fɔ tɛl am adu sɛf.
Bikɔs ɛnibɔdi we tɛl am adu dɔn jɔyn an wit am fɔ du di bad wok we i de pan.
A gɛt plɛnti tin fɔ tɛl una, bɔt a nɔ want rayt ɔltin wit pɛn ɛn pepa; misɛf abop fɔ kam luk una ɛn tɔk to una fes to fes, so dat wi go gladi gud gud.
Yu sista, we Gɔd dɔn pik, in pikin dɛn de tɛl yu adu.
Mi Jɔn, we na bigman na chɔch de rayt to Geyɔs we a lɛk fɔ tru.
Mi padi, a de pre mek yu gɛt wɛlbɔdi ɔltɛm ɛn mek ɔltin fayn fɔ yu, lɛkɛ aw ɔltin fayn wit yu sol.
A bin gladi bad we sɔm Kristiɛn dɛn kam ɛn tɔk se yu nɔ de tap fɔ biliv di tru tin bɔt Krays ɛn aw yu de waka na di tru rod ɔltɛm.
Di tin we kin mek a gladi pas ɔl na we a kin yɛri se mi pikin dɛn de waka na di tru rod.
Mi padi we a lɛk, ɔltɛm yu de du gud wok fɔ di Kristiɛn dɛn, pan ɔl we dɛn na trenja.
Dɛn dɔn tɛl di chɔch pipul dɛn aw yu lɛk dɛn. Duya, ɛp dɛn fɔ rɛdi fɔ dɛn patrol lɛkɛ aw Gɔd want.
Dɛn Kristiɛn ya de go patrol fɔ du Krays in wok ɛn dɛn nɔ de tek natin na dɛn pipul we nɔ biliv Krays, dɛn an.
So wi we na Kristiɛn fɔ ɛp dɛn pipul ya, da we de wi go ɛp dɛn fɔ du Krays in wok.
A bin dɔn rayt lɛta to di chɔch, bɔt Dayɔtrɛfes we want put insɛf bifo na di chɔch, nɔ lisin wetin a tɛl am.

Wɛn a kam a go tɔk wetin i du: di bad tin dɛn we i dɔn tɔk bɔt wi ɛn dɛn lay we i dɔn lay. Bɔt dat nɔ du fɔ am; i nɔ gri fɔ mek di Kristiɛn dɛn tap to dɛn, wɛn dɛn kam, ɛn i tap dɛn wan we de gladi fɔ dɛn, i de tray sɛf fɔ drɛb dɛn Kristiɛn de kɔmɔt na di chɔch.
Mi padi we a lɛk, nɔ fala di bad we i de du, yu jɛs de du gud nɔmɔ. Ɛnibɔdi we de du wetin rayt na Gɔd pikin, bɔt ɛnibɔdi we de du bad nɔ no Gɔd yet.
Ɔlman de tɔk gud bɔt Dimitriɔs; aw i liv sho se wetin ɔlman de tɔk bɔt am na tru. Wisɛf de tɔk gud bɔt am ɛn unasɛf no se na tru wi de tɔk.
A gɛt plɛnti tin fɔ tɛl yu, bɔt a nɔ want rayt dɛn ɔl to yu.
I nɔ go te igen a go kam to yu ɛn wi go tɔk fes to fes.
Mek yu gɛt kol at. Yu padi dɛn ɔl de tɛl yu adu. Tɛl ɔl wi padi dɛn de adu fɔ wi wan bay wan.
Mi Jud, we de wok fɔ Jizɔs Krays ɛn we na Jems in brɔda, de rayt to una we Gɔd we na wi Papa lɛk, ɛn we i kɔl, ɛn una we Jizɔs Krays kip fɔ mek natin nɔ bi to una:
Mek Gɔd sɔri fɔ una mɔ ɛn mɔ, mek i gi una kol at mɔ ɛn mɔ, mek i lɛk una mɔ ɛn mɔ.

Mi padi dɛn we a lɛk, na bɔt di sev we Gɔd dɔn sev wi a bin want rayt una bad, bɔt a fil se a fɔ rayt beg una naw fɔ mek una fɛt fɔ stil biliv pan Jizɔs Krays lɛkɛ aw Gɔd dɔn mek in pipul dɛn biliv wan tɛm nɔmɔ, fɔ ɔltɛm.

A de tɛl una dat bikɔs sɔm pipul we nɔ gɛt Gɔd na dɛn at dɔn kam miks wit una sikrit wan; dɛn se bikɔs Gɔd gud, dɛn kin du ɛni kayn tin, ɛn Gɔd nɔ go kɔndɛm dɛn; dɛn tɔn dɛn bak pan wi wangren Masta Jizɔs Krays. Na lɔn, lɔntɛm, Gɔd in Buk bin dɔn tɔk se Gɔd go kɔndɛm dɛn pipul ya.
Una bin no se, Gɔd we na di Masta bin pul di Izrɛl pipul dɛn kɔmɔt na Ijipt, bɔt aftawɔd i kil dɛn wan we nɔ bin biliv, bɔt a want mɛmba una bak bɔt dat naw. Ɛn igen a want mɛmba una bɔt
dɛn enjɛl we bin lɛf fɔ rul na di say we dɛn bin de rul ɛn tɔn dɛn bak pan Gɔd, Gɔd dɔn chen dɛn na dak ples ɔnda dɛn grev te di big de we i go jɔj di wɔl.

Na di sem tin bin bi na Sɔdɔm ɛn Gomɔra ɛn dɛn ɔda tɔŋ we bin de klos dɛn: di pipul dɛn bin de du ɔl kayn dɔti tin wit dɛn bɔdi, man bin de lɛf in wɛf go kip in kɔmpin man, uman bin de lɛf in man go kip in kɔmpin uman. Fɔ mek ɔlman si ɛn bikyaful, Gɔd put dɛn pipul ya na faya we nɔ de ɔt fɔ pɔnish dɛn.

Semwe so, dɛn drim we dɛn pipul ya de drim de mek dɛn tek dɛn bɔdi du dɛn tin we fɔ mek dɛn shem ɛn we mek dɛn nɔ klin; dɛn nɔ de mek Gɔd kɔntrol dɛn layf, dɛn de tɔk bad bɔt di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa ɛn ɔna na ɛvin.

Maykɛl sɛf we na dɛn enjɛl dɛn chif, wɛn in ɛn Setan bin de agyu bɔt uswan pan dɛn tu fɔ gɛt Mozis bɔdi, i nɔ kɔs Setan wɛn i de tɛl am se wetin i de du nɔ rayt, bifo dat, i tɛl am se, “Mek Gɔd tɔk pan yu!”
Bɔt dɛn pipul ya de tɔk bad bɔt ɛnitin we dɛn nɔ sabi; dɛn de du ɛnitin we dɛn ed gi dɛn fɔ du lɛkɛ dɛn bif na bush, ɛn na dat de pwɛl dɛn.
Trɔbul de bifo dɛn! Na Ken in fut dɛn de fala ɛn fɔseka mɔni dɛn de mek di sem mistek we Belam bin mek, dɛn go day lɛkɛ aw Kɔra bin day wɛn i tɔn pan di wan we bin de oba am.

Wɛn una ɔl we biliv pan Krays gɛda wan ples fɔ it, bay aw dɛn pipul ya kin de it, yu kin si se dɛn nɔ gɛt shem ɛn dɛn nɔ de mɛmba ɔda pipul, dat mek dɛn tan lɛkɛ dɔti pan klin klos; dɛn tan lɛkɛ klawd we kin dak lɛkɛ se ren want kam, bɔt briz kin blo am go; ɛn igen, dɛn tan lɛkɛ dɛn tik we nɔ de bia di tɛm we dɛn fɔ bia, we sho se dɛn dɔn day ɛn wɛn pɔsin dɔn rut dɛn, dɛn day ɔltogɛda.
Dɛn disgres de sho lɛkɛ frɔsh we de lɛf biɛn wɛn dɛn big swɛlin fɔdɔm na sho; dɛn tan lɛkɛ dɛn big sta we nɔ de sidɔm na wan ples na di klawd, Gɔd dɔn kip dak dak ples fɔ put dɛn pipul ya sote go.
Na dɛn pipul ya, Inɔk, we de pan di nɔmba sɛvin jɛnareshɔn we bigin frɔm Adam, bin dɔn tɔk bɔt we i se: “A de tɛl una se di Masta de kam wit tawzin tawzin enjɛl dɛn we na Gɔd insɛf gi am
fɔ jɔj ɔlman, ɛn kɔndɛm ɔl dɛn pipul we nɔ gri du wetin Gɔd want, fɔ ɔl di bad bad tin dɛn we dɛn de du we Gɔd nɔ lɛk, ɛn fɔ ɔl dɛn bad bad tin we dɛn dɔn tɔk bɔt Gɔd!”

Dɛn pipul ya nɔ de satisfay, dɛn de grɔmbul ɔltɛm, dɛn de blem ɔda pipul, dɛn jɛs de fala dɛn at fɔ du bad, dɛn de bost bɔt dɛnsɛf, dɛn de tɛl pipul soso dɛn tin we go mek dɛn ed big so da tɛm de dɛn go gi dɛn wetin dɛn want.
Mi padi dɛn, una fɔ mɛmba wetin wi Masta Jizɔs Krays in apɔsul dɛn bin dɔn tɛl una.
Dɛn bin tɛl una se, “Bifo di wɔl dɔn, sɔm pipul go kam we go de laf una, dɛn go de fala dɛn at fɔ du ɔl wetin dɛn lɛk fɔ du, bɔt we Gɔd nɔ lɛk.”
Na dɛn pipul ya de mek pipul nɔ gɛt wanwɔd, dɛn de fala dɛn at fɔ du dɛn bad tin we de na wɔl, Gɔd in Spirit nɔ de wit dɛn.
Mi padi dɛn, una fɔ tinap traŋa pan di biliv we una biliv pan Gɔd. Una fɔ pre wit di pawa we Gɔd in Spirit de gi una.
We una de wet fɔ mek Masta Jizɔs Krays gi una layf we go de sote go, bikɔs i sɔri fɔ una, una fɔ du dɛn tin we go mek Gɔd stil de blɛs una bikɔs i lɛk una.
Una fɔ tɔk to dɛn pipul we de dawt, mek dɛn go biliv.

Una fɔ drɔ sɔm pipul kwik kɔmɔt na di faya ɛn sev dɛn; una fɔ tek tɛm we una de tek sɔri at ɛp sɔm pipul, una nɔ fɔ mek di klos sɛf we dɛn wɛr wɛn dɛn de pan sin tɔch una bɔdi, dat min se una nɔ fɔ go klos ɛnibɔdi we de du bad.

Lɛ Gɔd we ebul mek una nɔ sin ɛn we ebul mek sin nɔ de na una layf atɔl, briŋ una wit gladi na una at na di wɔndaful ples we i de. Nain na wi wangren Gɔd, we dɔn sev wi bay Jizɔs Krays, wi Masta, nain gɛt prez, pawa ɛn ɔna frɔm tɛm, naw ɛn sote go! Emɛn.

Insay dis buk dɛn rayt dɛn tin we Jizɔs Krays sho dɛn pipul we de du Gɔd wok. Na Gɔd fɔs sho Jizɔs Krays dɛn tin ya, so dat i kin mek dɛn wan we de du in wok no dɛn tin we mɔs bi. I sɛn in enjɛl go mit Jɔn we bin de wok fɔ am fɔ mek di enjɛl sho Jɔn dɛn tin ya.
Jɔn dɔn tɔk ɔl dɛn tin we i si; i dɔn rayt di mɛsej we Gɔd sɛn, we Jizɔs Krays insɛf sho am se na tru.

Blɛsin de fɔ ɛnibɔdi we go rid di wɔd dɛn we de na dis buk, we Gɔd insɛf tɔk, ɛn we gɛt fɔ kam bi. Semwe so, blɛsin de fɔ ɔlman we yɛri dɛn wɔd ya ɛn fala wetin dɛn se, bikɔs di tɛm we dɛn tin ya fɔ bi, nɔ fa igen.

Na mi Jɔn de rayt to una we de na dɛn sɛvin chɔch na Eshya. Mek Gɔd we de naw, ɛn we bin de bifo dis wɔl mek, ɛn we go kam bak na dis wɔl, sho una aw i gud ɛn gi una kol at; semwe so, mek Gɔd in sɛvin spirit dɛn, we tinap bifo am di say we i sidɔm de rul, du una gud ɛn gi una kol at;

mek Jizɔs Krays insɛf, we wi kin trɔs, ɛn we de tɛl pipul wetin tru ɔltɛm, sho una aw i gud ɛn gi una kol at. Nain fɔs Gɔd mek rayz frɔm di grev. Ɔl dɛn wan we de rul na dis wɔl de ɔnda am. I lɛk wi ɛn i day fɔseka wi so dat i kin lus wi kɔmɔt pan di tay we wi sin tay wi,
ɛn i dɔn mek wi kam ɔnda Gɔd in rul ɛn bi pipul we de mek sakrifays to Gɔd we nain Papa. Jizɔs Krays gɛt ɔna ɛn pawa sote go. Emɛn.

A de tɛl una se na midul klawd i go kam ɛn ɔlman go si am; dɛn pipul sɛf we bin chuk am go si am; pipul na ɔl dɛn kɔntri ɛn dɛn wan we de tɔk dɛn difrɛn difrɛn laŋwej na wɔl go sɔri bikɔs i de kam. Na so i go bi fɔ tru! Emɛn.
Gɔd we na wi Masta we gɛt pawa pas ɔl, we bin dɔn de bifo di wɔl mek, we de naw ɛn we go kam bak na dis wɔl, nain de tɛl wi se “Mi na di Fɔs ɛn di Las.”

Mi we de rayt dis buk na Jɔn, una brɔda, we wi ɔl de fala Jizɔs. Wi ɔl tinap traŋa pan ɔl di sɔfa we wi de sɔfa bikɔs wi tek Jizɔs Krays fɔ wi Kiŋ. Dɛn bin kɛr mi go lɛf mi na wan ples we dɛn kɔl Patmɔs we de midul wata, bikɔs a bin de tɛl pipul di mɛsej we Gɔd sɛn, we Jizɔs insɛf se na tru.
Wan Sɔnde, Gɔd in Spirit kam pan mi, nain a yɛri vɔys de tɔk lawd wan lɛkɛ trɔmpɛt biɛn mi.
Di vɔys se, “Rayt wetin yu go si na buk ɛn sɛn di buk go to dɛn Kristiɛn na: Ɛfisɔs, Smana, Pagamɔm, Tayatira, Sadis, Filadɛlfia, ɛn Laodisya.”
A tɔn rawnd fɔ si di pɔsin we de tɔk to mi. Wɛn a tɔn rawnd na de a si sɛvin lampolda dɛn we dɛn tek gold mek.
Midul dɛn lampolda ya a si sɔmbɔdi tinap we fiba mɔtalman. In klos lɔŋ te rich in fut, gold strap tay rawnd in chɛst.
In ia wayt lɛkɛ kɔtin wul, in yay rɛd lɛkɛ faya;
in fut bin de shayn lɛkɛ bras we dɛn bɔn na faya, dɔn dɛn shayn am; wɛn i tɔk, in vɔys big lɛkɛ dɛn big wata we de fɔdɔm kɔmɔt ɔp dɛn ay il.
I bin ol sɛvin sta dɛn nain raytan; sɔd we shap tu say bin kɔmɔt nain mɔt; in fes bin de shayn lɛkɛ aw san de shayn twɛlv oklɔk santɛm.
Wɛn a si am, a fɔdɔm flat nain fut lɛkɛ pɔsin we dɔn day. I put in raytan pan mi, i se, “Nɔ fred. Na mi na di fɔs pɔsin, na mi go bi di las pɔsin.
Na mi gɛt layf naw. A bin dɔn day bɔt a dɔn gɛt layf bak, ɛn a go gɛt layf sote go; na mi gɛt pawa oba day ɛn na mi ol di ki fɔ di say we dɛn spirit we dɔn kɔmɔt na dis wɔl de.
Rayt ɔl dɛn tin ya we yu dɔn si na buk dɛn tin we de bi naw ɛn dɛn tin we go bi bambay.

A de kam tɛl yu wetin dɛn sɛvin sta ya we a ol na mi raytan ɛn dɛn sɛvin gold lampolda, min; di sɛvin sta dɛn na di sɛvin enjɛl dɛn we de gyad dɛn sɛvin chɔch. Di sɛvin lampolda dɛn na di sɛvin chɔch dɛnsɛf.”
“Rayt dis mɛsej ya sɛn am go to di enjɛl we de gyad di Kristiɛn dɛn na Ɛfisɔs: “Na dis mɛsej ya di pɔsin we ol dɛn sɛvin sta nain raytan ɛn we de waka midul dɛn sɛvin gold lampolda, sɛn:

A no ɔl di tin dɛn we una dɔn du, a no se una dɔn wok traŋa ɛn a no aw una kin bia wɛn waala kam. A no se una nɔ de gri mek bad pipul de wit una; una dɔn luk dɛn pipul we se dɛn na apɔsul ɛn una dɔn si se na lay dɛn de lay.
Pan ɔl we una dɔn sɔfa plɛnti bikɔs una de fala mi, una de bia ɛn una nɔ lɛf fɔ fala mi.
Bɔt na wan tin una de du we a nɔ lɛk, una nɔ lɛk mi lɛkɛ aw una bin lɛk mi fɔstɛm;

so una mɛmba di we we una bin lɛk mi bifo una tap, ɛn una bigin fɔ lɛk mi bak lɛkɛ aw una bin lɛk mi di fɔs tɛm we una bigin waka wit mi. If una nɔ gri fɔ sɔri fɔ wetin una du so ɛn chenj, a go kam mit una, a go pul una lampolda kɔmɔt di say we i de;
bɔt na wan tin a prez una fɔ, una nɔ lɛk dɛn bad tin we dɛn pipul, we de fala Nikolas, de du, jɛs lɛkɛ aw misɛf nɔ lɛk dɛn.

“Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt yes, mek i yɛri dɛn wɔd ya we Gɔd in Spirit dɔn tɛl di Kristiɛn dɛn na dɛn difrɛn ples. “Pɔsin we stil tinap traŋa afta Setan dɔn tray am, a go mek i it pan di tin we di tik we de gi layf de bia, da tik de de gro na di gadin we Gɔd mek.
“Rayt dis mɛsej ya sɛn am go to di enjɛl we de gyad di Kristiɛn dɛn na Smana: “Na di mɛsej dis we di wan we na di fɔs ɛn las pɔsin, sɛn; nain bin day, ɛn i bin rayz frɔm di grev:
A no di waala we dɔn mit una, a no se una po, bɔt una nɔ po, una jɛntri. A no igen se, dɛn pipul we de lay, we se dɛn na Ju, de tɔk bad bɔt una. Dɛn nɔto Ju atɔl, na Setan dɛn de fala.

Una nɔ fred ɛnitin we una de kam sɔfa. Una lisin! Setan go tray una fɔ si if una biliv Gɔd fɔ tru, i go put una na jel. Na tɛn de nɔmɔ una go sɔfa da sɔfa de. Una nɔ lɛf fɔ biliv pan mi, if dat min sɛf se una go day fɔ mi sek, a go gi una layf we go de sote go, ɛn una go gɛt ɔna sote go na ɛvin.
“Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt yes mek i yɛri dɛn wɔd ya we Gɔd in Spirit de tɛl di Kristiɛn dɛn na dɛn difrɛn ples. “Ɛnibɔdi we stil tinap traŋa afta Setan dɔn tray am, di sɛkɛn day nɔ go mit am.
“Rayt dis mɛsej ya sɛn am go to di enjɛl we de gyad di Kristiɛn dɛn na Pagamɔm: “Na di pɔsin we gɛt da sɔd we shap tu say, na im sɛn dis mɛsej ya go to di Kristiɛn dɛn na Pagamɔm:

A no usay una de, una de na di say we Setan de rul. A no se wande una nɔ dinay se mi na una Masta. Di tɛm sɛf we dɛn kil Anti pas we bin biliv pan mi wit ɔl in at bikɔs i tɔk opin wan se in biliv pan mi, pan ɔl we dɛn kil am da say de we una de, ɛn we Setan insɛf de, dat nɔ mek una dinay se unasɛf biliv pan mi.

Bɔt sɔm tin dɛn de we a blem una fɔ, sɔm pan una de du dɛn tin we Belam bin tɛl pipul fɔ du; na Belam bin sho Belak aw fɔ trap di Izrɛl pipul dɛn mek dɛn sin. I bin mek dɛn it it we dɛn bin dɔn gi dɛn tin we mɔtalman mek fɔ pre to, ɛn i mek dɛn wan we bin dɔn mared, liv fri layf.
Semwe so, sɔm pan una de du dɛn sem kayn tin we dɛn pipul we de fala Nikolas de du.
So una fɔ lɛf fɔ du dɛn bad tin ya, if nɔ so, i nɔ go te igen, a go kam mit una, a go tek dis sɔd we de na mi mɔt fɛt di pipul dɛn we de du dɛn bad tin ya.

“Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt yes, mek i yɛri dɛn wɔd ya we Gɔd in Spirit de tɛl di Kristiɛn dɛn na dɛn difrɛn ples. “Dɛn wan we go stil tinap traŋa afta Setan dɔn tray dɛn, a go gi dɛn da it we dɛn kɔl mana we nɔbɔdi nɔ de si naw. Ɛn igen, a go gi dɛn wan wayt ston we wan nyu nem rayt pan. Nɔbɔdi nɔ go no di nem we rayt pan di ston pas di pɔsin we a gi di nem.

“Rayt dis mɛsej ya sɛn am go to di enjɛl we de gyad di Kristiɛn dɛn na Tayatira: “Na di mɛsej dis we Gɔd in Pikin sɛn; in yay dɛn rɛd lɛkɛ faya ɛn in fut dɛn de shayn lɛkɛ bras we dɛn bɔn na faya, dɔn dɛn shayn am:

A no di tin dɛn we una de du, a no se una lɛk pipul ɛn una nɔ lɛf fɔ biliv pan mi, una de wok wit ɔl una at ɛn una de bia insay di waala we de mit una. Ɛn a no se dɛn tin we una de du naw bɛtɛ pas di tin dɛn we una bin de du fɔstɛm.

Bɔt na wan tin a de blem una fɔ, una de gri mek da uman we dɛn kɔl Jɛzibɛl sidɔm wit una. I de se na Gɔd in pawa in de tek tɔk di wɔd dɛn we i de tɔk, bɔt na lay i de lay gi mi pipul dɛn; i de mek dɛn ful ɛn dat go mek dɛn wan we dɔn mared, liv fri layf; ɛn mek pipul it it we dɛn bin dɔn gi dɛn tin we mɔtalman de pre to.
A bin lɛf am lili bit mek i go gɛt chans fɔ lɛf fɔ sin, bɔt i nɔ gri lɛf.
A go mek i sik ledɔm na bed, ɛn a go mek in ɛn dɛn pipul we liv fri layf sɔfa plɛnti if dɛn nɔ lɛf fɔ du dɛn bad tin we dɛn de du.
A go mek ɔl dɛn wan we de fala am sik ɛn day. Dat go mek ɔl dɛn Kristiɛn ɔlɔbɔt no se a no wetin ɔlman na wɔl de tink ɛn a de si insay dɛn at. A go mek ɔlman gɛt di pe fɔ wetin i du.

“Bɔt, sɔm pan una de na Tayatira, we nɔ gri fɔ du dɛn bad tin we dɛn pipul we lib de, de lan ɔda pipul fɔ du; una nɔ lan dɛn bad tin we pipul se na Setan in sikrit. A nɔ gɛt ɛni ɔda tin fɔ tɛl una fɔ du,
pas fɔ se mek una biliv gud dɛn tin we una dɔn lan, te a kam bak.
Dɛn pipul we stil tinap traŋa afta Setan dɔn tray dɛn, ɛn we stil de du dɛn tin we a tɛl dɛn fɔ du, te a kam bak, a go gi dɛn pawa oba ɔl dɛn neshɔn na dis wɔl,
jɛs lɛkɛ we mi Papa dɔn gi misɛf pawa oba dɛn. Dɛn go tek lɔŋ ayɛn lɛkɛ di wan we chif de ol, rul oba dɛn neshɔn ya ɛn dɛn go skata dɛn pispis lɛkɛ kɔntri pɔt we pɔsin ib dɔŋ.
Dɛn a go gi dɛn di mɔnin sta.
“Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt yes, mek i lisin dɛn wɔd ya we Gɔd in Spirit de tɛl di Kristiɛn dɛn na dɛn difrɛn ples.

“Rayt dis mɛsej ya sɛn am go to di enjɛl we de gyad di Kristiɛn dɛn na Sadis: “Na dis mɛsej ya di pɔsin we gɛt Gɔd in sɛvin spirit dɛn ɛn we ol dɛn sɛvin sta, sɛn: A no di tin dɛn we una de du, pipul tink se una gɛt layf, bɔt una nɔ gɛt layf, una dɔn day.
So una grap, una tray mek di lili layf we una stil gɛt nɔ dɔn ɔltogɛda. A si se di tin dɛn we una de du nɔ tan yet lɛkɛ aw dɛn fɔ tan na Gɔd yay.

So una mɛmba dɛn tin we dɛn dɔn lan una we una bin biliv, ɛn una nɔ lɛf fɔ biliv dɛn wit ɔl una at, una lɛf fɔ du dɛn bad tin we una de du. If una nɔ grap wantɛm ɛn bigin du dɛn tin we a tɛl una, a go kam lɛkɛ tifman kam mit una ɛn una nɔ go no di tɛm we a go kam mit una.
Bɔt te naw sɔm pan una de na Sadis we nɔ dɔti una klos, bɔt una nɔ plɛnti. Dɛn pipul de go waka wit mi, dɛn go wɛr wayt klos bikɔs dɛn fit fɔ wɛr am, bay aw dɛn de du.

Dɛn pipul we go stil tinap traŋa afta Setan dɔn tray dɛn, dɛnsɛf go wɛr wayt klos. Ɛn a nɔ go pul dɛn nem kɔmɔt na di buk we dɛn pipul we gɛt layf, dɛn nem rayt. A go tɔk bifo mi Papa ɛn bifo in enjɛl dɛn se dɛn pipul de na mi yon.
“Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt yes, mek i yɛri dɛn wɔd ya we Gɔd in Spirit de tɛl di Kristiɛn dɛn na dɛn difrɛn ples.

“Rayt dis mɛsej ya sɛn am go to di enjɛl we de gyad di Kristiɛn dɛn na Filadɛlfia: “Na di mɛsej dis we Krays we na di tru wan, sɛn. Nain ol di ki we Devid bin ol. If i opin ɛni do, nɔbɔdi nɔ de we go ebul lɔk am. If i lɔk ɛni do, nɔbɔdi nɔ de we go ebul opin am:

A no di tin dɛn we una de du. Una lisin, a dɔn opin do fɔ una we nɔbɔdi nɔ ebul lɔk. A no se pan ɔl we una nɔ gɛt plɛnti trɛnk una dɔn du wetin a tɛl una fɔ du, wande una nɔ dinay se una de waka wit mi.
As fɔ dɛn wan we de fala Setan, we de lay se dɛn na Ju, a go mek dɛn kam fɔdɔm na una fut ɛn a go mek dɛn ɔl no se a lɛk una.

Una dɔn du wetin a tɛl una fɔ du una dɔn tinap traŋa ɛn una dɔn bia; fɔseka dat a nɔ go mek una sɔfa wɛn di tɛm kam we tin go traŋa na wɔl, fɔ tray ɔlman we de na di wɔl fɔ si if dɛn biliv pan Gɔd, fɔ tru.
A go kam bak, i nɔ go te igen. Una nɔ lɛf fɔ biliv wit ɔl una at dɛn tin we una dɔn lan, so dat nɔbɔdi nɔ go jɔg una blɛsin we una go gɛt bikɔs una dɔn tinap traŋa.

Ɛnibɔdi we go stil tinap traŋa afta Setan dɔn tray am, a go mek i bi lɛkɛ post we go mek Gɔd in Os tinap, i go tinap de sote go. A go rayt mi Gɔd in nem pan am, ɛn di tɔŋ we i bil, in sɛf yon nem pan am, dat na ‘di Nyu Jerusɛlɛm’, we go kɔmɔt to Gɔd na ɛvin kam dɔŋ. Ɛn a go rayt mi yon nyu nem pan am.
“Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt yes, mek i yɛri dɛn wɔd ya we Gɔd in Spirit de tɛl di Kristiɛn dɛn na dɛn difrɛn ples.

“Rayt dis mɛsej ya sɛn am go to di enjɛl we de gyad di Kristiɛn dɛn na Laodisya: “Na di mɛsej dis we di wan we de se ‘Emɛn’ fɔ ɔl Gɔd in wok, sɛn. Nain na di Wan we de tɔk tru ɔltɛm ɛn wɛn i tɔk pipul fɔ biliv wetin i se, nain an ɔl dɛn tin we Gɔd mek, bigin:
A no ɔl wetin una de du. Una tan lɛkɛ it we nɔ kol ɛn we nɔ ɔt we nɔ gɛt tes. A wish una bin de fala mi wit ɔl una at ɔ una bin lɛf fɔ fala mi ɔltogɛda.
So bikɔs una tan lɛkɛ it we nɔ ɔt ɛn we nɔ kol, a go pit una kɔmɔt na mi mɔt.
Una de tɔk se una jɛntri, di tin dɛn we una gɛt, dɔn plɛnti, ɛn natin nɔ de we una fɔ gɛt we una nɔ gɛt. Bɔt una nɔ kechɔp se una po, ɛn pipul de sɔri fɔ una, una de nekɛd ɛn una yay blɛn.

So a de advays una mek una kam to mi kam bay gold, we dɛn dɔn bɔn na faya te i klin so dat una go jɛntri fɔ tru; ɛn a de advays una igen mek una kam bay wayt klos fɔ wɛr, so dat una nɔ go shem bikɔs una de nekɛd, ɛn mek una kam bay mɛrɛsin fɔ rɔb na una yay mek una go si.
Dɛn pipul we a lɛk na dɛn a kin tɛl se dɛn de du rɔŋ tin ɛn a kin pɔnish dɛn mek dɛn go gɛt sɛns fɔ du wetin rayt. So una kechɔp unasɛf, ɛn lɛf fɔ sin.
Una lisin, a tinap nia di do, a de nak pan am; if ɛnibɔdi we yɛri mi vɔys opin di do, a go kam insay in os, mi ɛn in go sidɔm ɛn it togɛda.

Ɛnibɔdi we go stil tinap traŋa afta Setan dɔn tray am, a go mek i sidɔm wit mi na di say we a sidɔm fɔ rul jɛs lɛkɛ aw misɛf bin stil tinap traŋa afta Gɔd dɔn tray mi ɛn a kam sidɔm wit mi Papa na di say we i sidɔm de rul.
“Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt yes, mek i yɛri dɛn wɔd ya we Gɔd in Spirit de tɛl di Kristiɛn dɛn na dɛn difrɛn ples.”
Wɛn dat dɔn dɔn a si ɔda tin; a si do opin na ɛvin: a yɛri di vɔys bak we bin sawnd lɛkɛ trɔmpɛt de tɔk to mi. Di vɔys se, “Kam ɔp ya, so dat a kin sho yu dɛn tin we mɔs apin bambay.”
Wantɛm, Gɔd in Spirit kam pan mi; na de a si wan ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm pan, a si sɔmbɔdi sidɔm pan am.
Di pɔsin in fes bin de shayn lɛkɛ dayamɔn ɛn lɛkɛ wan ɔda shayn ston we dɛn kɔl rubi. Rembo we de shayn lɛkɛ da fayn ston we dɛn kɔl ɛmirald bin de rawnd di ay chia.

Twɛnti-fo ɔda ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm pan bin de rawnd di fɔs ay chia; a si twɛnti-fo bigman dɛn sidɔm pan di chia dɛn; dɛn bin wɛr wayt klos; ɛn dɛn tin we kiŋ kin wɛr we dɛn kɔl krawn, bin de na dɛn ed, na gold dɛn bin tek mek di krawn dɛn.
Laytin bin de flash, tɛnda bin de rol, plɛnti nɔys bin de na di say we di fɔs ay chia bin de, di sɛvin lamp dɛn bin layt frɔnt di chia, dɛn lamp ya na Gɔd in sɛvin spirit dɛn.
Bifo di sem ay chia a si sɔntin lɛkɛ wata we tan lɛkɛ se dɛn tek glas mek am. Ɔlɔbɔt klos di chia, frɔnt, bak ɛn sayd, fo tin we gɛt layf bin tinap, dɛn bin gɛt yay ɔlɔbɔt na dɛn bɔdi; bifo ɛn biɛn.
Di fɔs tin we gɛt layf bin fiba layɔn, di sɛkɛn wan bin fiba kaw pikin, di tɔd wan bin gɛt fes we fiba mɔtalman fes, di wan we mek fo bin tan lɛkɛ igul we de flay.

Dɛn ɔl fo bin gɛt siks siks wiŋ dɛn; soso yay bin kɔba dɛn ɔlɔbɔt. Ol de ol nɛt dɛn nɔ de tap fɔ siŋ se, “Gɔd na di Masta we gɛt pawa pas ɔl, nain wangren na Gɔd, i nɔ sin wande, i gud pas ɔl. I bin de bifo di wɔl mek, i de naw ɛn i go kam bak.”
Wɛn dɛn fo tin ya we gɛt layf de prez di wan we go de sote go, we sidɔm pan di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm, wɛn dɛn de sho am di rɛspɛkt we dɛn gɛt fɔ am ɛn tɛl am tɛnki,

di twɛnti-fo bigman dɛnsɛf kin fɔdɔm bifo di wan we go de sote go, we bin sidɔm pan di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm pan, ɛn dɛn kin bigin prez am; dɛn kin pul dɛn krawn na dɛn ed ib dɛn bifo di ay chia; dɔn dɛn kin siŋ se,
“Wi Masta ɛn wi Gɔd! Yu fit fɔ mek wi fɔdɔm na yu fut, ɛn prez yu, ɛn sho se yu gɛt pawa, bikɔs na yu mek ɔltin ɛn yu mek dɛn ɛn gi dɛn layf bikɔs na dat yu want.”
A si di Pɔsin we sidɔm na di fɔs ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm, i ol wan big big pepa we rol, nain raytan. Plɛnti tin bin rayt pan am, frɔnt ɛn bak, ɛn dɛn bin fasin am sɛvin say na di ɛj.
Dɛn a si wan enjɛl we gɛt pawa, i de tɔk lawd wan se, “Udat fit fɔ pul di tin dɛn we dɛn tek fasin dis pepa ya so dat i kin opin am?”
Bɔt nɔbɔdi nɔ bin de na ɛvin ɔ dis wɔl ɔ na di ples we dɛn dayman de, we bin fit fɔ opin di pepa we rol, fɔ rid wetin rayt pan am.
A kray bita wan bikɔs nɔbɔdi nɔ bin fit fɔ opin di pepa fɔ rid wetin rayt pan am.

Wɛn wan pan di bigman dɛn si se a de kray, i se, “Lɛf fɔ kray; luk, da pɔsin we dɛn kɔl di Layɔn we kɔmɔt na Juda trayb, di wan we na wan pan Devid in grampikin pikin dɛm, dɔn win ɔlsay. I kin pul di tin dɛn we dɛn tek fasin di pepa sɛvin say ɛn opin am.”

Dɛn a si wan Ship tinap klos di fɔs ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm pan, dɛn fo tin we gɛt layf ɛn dɛn bigman dɛn tinap rawnd am. Di Ship fiba lɛkɛ se dɛn bin dɔn sakrifays am. I bin gɛt sɛvin ɔn dɛn nain ed ɛn sɛvin yay dɛn we na Gɔd in sɛvin Spirit dɛn we i dɔn sɛn ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl.
A si di Ship waka go tek di pepa we rol kɔmɔt na di Pɔsin we sidɔm pan di ay chia, in raytan.

As i tek am so, di fo tin dɛn we gɛt layf ɛn di twɛnti-fo bigman dɛn fɔdɔm bifo di Ship. Dɛn ɔl bin gɛt wan wan tin fɔ ple myuzik we dɛn kɔl ap, ɛn gold besin dɛn we insɛns ful insay; dɛn insɛns ya na dɛn pre we Gɔd in pipul dɛn de pre.

Dɛn bigin siŋ wan nyu siŋ we se, “Na yu fit fɔ tek di pepa we rol ɛn pul di tin dɛn we mek i fasin. Bikɔs dɛn bin kil yu, ɛn na yu blɔd yu tek bay mɔtalman bak fɔ Gɔd; dɛn mɔtalman ya kɔmɔt pan ɔl dɛn trayb ɛn ɔl dɛn difrɛn neshɔn na wɔl, dɛn de tɔk ɔl dɛn difrɛn laŋwej, sɔm bin wayt, sɔm bin blak.
Yu dɔn mek dɛn kam ɔnda Gɔd in rul ɛn bi pipul we de mek sakrifays to wi Gɔd, ɛn na dɛn go kam rul na dis wɔl.”
As a es mi yay ɔp bak, na de a si enjɛl dɛn we bɔku lɛkɛ anch ɛn a yɛri dɛn vɔys! Dɛn tinap rawnd di fo tin dɛn we gɛt layf ɛn di twɛnti-fo bigman dɛn we bin de rawnd di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm.
Dɛn bigin siŋ lawd wan se, “Di Ship we dɛn bin kil, fit fɔ mek wi sho se i gɛt pawa, i jɛntri, i gɛt sɛns, i gɛt trɛnk, i gɛt ɔna, i wɔndaful, ɛn wi fɔ prez am.”

Dɛn a yɛri ɔl dɛn tin we gɛt layf na ɛvin, na dis wɔl ɛn na di wɔl we de ɔnda dis wɔl, ɛn ɔltin we de na wata, dɛn ɔl de siŋ se, “Wi fɔ prez ɛn rɛspɛkt di wan we sidɔm pan di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm pan ɛn di Ship, wi fɔ sho se dɛn wɔndaful ɛn dɛn gɛt pawa we go de sote go!”
Di fo tin dɛn we gɛt layf ansa se, “Emɛn!” Dɔn di twɛnti-fo bigman dɛn ledɔm flat na grɔn ɛn prez di wan we sidɔm pan di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm ɛn di Ship.
Dɛn a si di Ship opin di fɔs say pan di sɛvin say dɛn we bin fasin, dɛn a yɛri wan pan dɛn fo tin we gɛt layf ala tɔk wit vɔys we sawnd lɛkɛ tɛnda se, “Kam go!”
A tɔn luk, na de a si wan wayt ɔs. Di pɔsin we de rayd am, ol wan bo nain an fɔ fɛt, dɛn gi am krawn fɔ wɛr nain ed. I rayd in ɔs go, i dɔn win wan wa ɛn i de go fɔ win ɔda wa dɛn.
Dɛn di Ship opin di sɛkɛn say we di pepa we rol, fasin; a yɛri di sɛkɛn tin we gɛt layf se, “Kam go!”
Wan ɔda ɔs kɔmɔt, na bin rɛd ɔs. Dɛn gi di wan we bin de rayd am pawa fɔ briŋ wa kam na wɔl so dat mɔtalman kin de kil dɛn kɔmpin; dɛn gi am sɔd fɔ ol nain an.

Dɛn di Ship opin di say we mek tri we di pepa we rol, fasin; a yɛri di tɔd tin we gɛt layf se, “Kam go!” Wɛn a luk, na de a si wan blak ɔs. Di pɔsin we de rayd am ol skel we dɛn de tek fɔ we, nain an.

A yɛri sawnd lɛkɛ vɔys de kɔmɔt na di say we di fo tin dɛn we gɛt layf de. Di vɔys de tɔk se, “Pipul kin tek di mɔni we dɛn wok fɔ wande bay wan kɔp rɛs, ɛn dɛn kin tek da mɔni de bay tri kɔp kɔn. Bɔt ɔyl ɛn wayn go de ɔltɛm.”
Dɛn di Ship opin di pepa we rol di say we mek fo we bin fasin, ɛn a yɛri di tin we gɛt layf we mek fo, se, “Kam go!”

A tɔn luk bak, na de a si wan ɔs we in kɔla mek i fiba lɛkɛ se i want day. Di pɔsin we bin de rayd am bin nem Day, ɛn wan pɔsin we nem Ɛl bin de fala am. Dɛn gi dɛn pawa oba wan pat na di wɔl if yu sheb di wɔl fo say, so dat dɛn kin kil pipul na wa, ɔ mek dɛn day wit aŋri, ɔ sik ɛn day, ɔ mek dɛn wayl bif na wɔl sɛf kil dɛn.

Dɛn di Ship opin di pepa we rol na di say we mek fayv we bin fasin. Dɛn a si di tebul we dɛn de mek sakrifays to Gɔd, ɔnda am, a si dɛn pipul we dɛn bin kil na wɔl dɛn spirit; dɛn bin kil dɛn bikɔs dɛn bin de tɔk se Gɔd in wɔd na tru ɛn dɛn bin de tɛl pipul bɔt Gɔd.
Dɛn bin de ala lawd wan se, “Masta, yu we yu pawa pas ɔl pawa, yu we tru ɛn yu we na yu wangren na Gɔd, aw lɔŋ igen wi fɔ wet bifo yu go jɔj dɛn pipul na wɔl ɛn pɔnish dɛn bikɔs dɛn bin kil wi?”

Dɛn gi dɛn ɔl wan wan lɔŋ wayt klos fɔ wɛr; dɛn bin tɛl dɛn fɔ wet lili bit mɔ bikɔs dɛn nɔmba nɔ bin fulɔp yet, i bin lɛf dɛn brɔda we bin stil de wok fɔ Gɔd na wɔl ɛn we di pipul dɛn na wɔl bin gɛt fɔ kil lɛkɛ aw dɛn bin kil dɛnsɛf.
Dɛn a si di Ship opin di pepa we rol na di say we mek siks we bin fasin. Na de di grɔn bigin trimbul bad bad wan, di san blak, lɛkɛ dɛn tik blak klos, di mun rɛd lɛkɛ blɔd.
Di sta dɛn fɔdɔm kam na di wɔl, lɛkɛ dɛn plɔm we nɔ rɛp we kin fɔdɔm wɛn big briz shek di tik.
Di klawd lɔs lɛkɛ wɛn dɛn de rol dɛn big big pepa fɔ kip dɛn, ɛn ɔl dɛn ay il wit ɔl dɛn ples we de midul wata muf kɔmɔt na dɛn ples.
Dɔn, dɛn kiŋ na di wɔl wit ɔl dɛn ɔda rula, dɛn soja man dɛn bɔs, dɛn wan we jɛntri we gɛt pawa, ɛn ɔl dɛn ɔda pipul, slev ɛn fribɔn, dɛn ɔl rɔn go ayd midul dɛn big big ston na dɛn ay il.

Frɔm di ples we dɛn bin de na di ay il dɛn, dɛn bin de ala tɛl dɛn il ɛn dɛn big ston se, “Fɔdɔm pan wi, una ayd wi mek di wan we sidɔm pan di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm nɔ si wi ɛn mek di vɛks we di Ship vɛks nɔ kam pan wi!
Di tɛm dɔn kam we dɛn de sho se dɛn vɛks pan wi, udat go ebul sev insɛf?”

Wɛn dat dɔn, a si fo enjɛl dɛn tinap na di fo kɔna dɛn na di wɔl. We dɛn tinap de, dɛn bin de tap di briz we bin want fɔ blo kɔmɔt na di fo kɔna dɛn na di wɔl, mek dɛn nɔ blo pan di dray grɔn ɔ pan di wata ɔ pan dɛn tik.

Wɛn dat dɔn, a si ɔda enjɛl kɔmɔt na di say we di san de kɔmɔt. I bin ol Gɔd, we gɛt layf sote go, in stamp. I ala lawd wan tɔk to di fo enjɛl dɛn we Gɔd bin gi pawa fɔ pwɛl di wata ɛn di dray grɔn we de na di wɔl.
I se, “Una nɔ pwɛl di dray grɔn, di wata ɛn dɛn tik, te wi dɔn put Gɔd in stamp pan dɛn wan we de wok fɔ am, dɛn fɔrɛd.”
Dɛn a yɛri ɔmɔs pipul di enjɛl dɛn bin stamp; di nɔmba na bin wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fɔti-fo tawzin, dɛn bin kɔmɔt na ɔl dɛn trayb na Izrɛl.
Dɛn stamp twɛlv tawzin pan Juda in trayb; twɛlv tawzin pan Rubɛn in trayb; twɛlv tawzin pan Gad in trayb;
twɛlv tawzin pan Asha in trayb; twɛlv tawzin pan Naftali in trayb; twɛlv tawzin pan Manasɛ in trayb;
twɛlv tawzin pan Simiɔn in trayb; twɛlv tawzin pan Livay in trayb; twɛlv tawzin pan Isaka in trayb;
twɛlv tawzin pan Zɛbyulɔn in trayb; twɛlv tawzin pan Josɛf in trayb; ɛn twɛlv tawzin pan Bɛnjamin in trayb.

Wɛn dat dɔn, a luk bak, na de a si bɔku bɔku pipul we pɔsin nɔ ebul kɔnt. Dɛn bin kɔmɔt na ɔl dɛn trayb ɛn ɔl dɛn neshɔn na wɔl, dɛn bin de tɔk ɔl dɛn difrɛn difrɛn laŋwej na wɔl, sɔm bin wayt, sɔm bin blak. Dɛn bin tinap bifo di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm, na di say we di Ship insɛf bin de; dɛn bin wɛr wayt ɛn dɛn ɔl bin olpam.
Dɛn ɔl bin de ala lawd wan se, “Na Gɔd we sidɔm na di ay chia ɛn di Ship dɔn sev wi!”
Ɔl di enjɛl dɛn we bin tinap rawnd di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm, ɛn rawnd di bigman dɛn ɛn di fo tin dɛn we gɛt layf, bin ledɔm flat bifo di ay chia ɛn dɛn bin de prez Gɔd.
Dɛn bin de se, “Emɛn! Na wi Gɔd gɛt prez, nain wɔndaful, nain gɛt sɛns, nain gɛt ɔna, nain gɛt pawa ɛn nain na kiŋ sote go; wi de tɛl am tɛnki! Emɛn!”
Wan pan di bigman dɛn aks mi se, “Yu no udat na dɛn pipul ya we wɛr wayt? Yu no usay dɛn kɔmɔt?”
A ansa am se, “Mi nɔ no dɛn, sa. Na yu no dɛn, sa.” Na de i se, “Dɛn pipul ya na dɛn wan we bin tinap traŋa wɛn da big trɔbul bin fɔdɔm. Dɛn dɔn tek di Ship in blɔd was dɛn klos, mek dɛn wayt.
Na dat mek, de ɛn nɛt, dɛn tinap bifo di ay chia we Gɔd sidɔm pan, ɛn dɛn de nain os de sav am. Di wan we sidɔm na di ay chia go kɔba dɛn mek natin bad nɔ mit dɛn.
Aŋri nɔ go kech dɛn igen, dɛn nɔ go tɔsti igen, ɔt ɔt san nɔ go bɔn dɛn igen ɛn i nɔ go mek dɛn sɔfa pen,

bikɔs di Ship we de na di ples we di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm, de, insɛf go de gyad dɛn lɛkɛ pɔsin we de mɛn ship. Nain go kɛr dɛn go na di say we da wata we de bɔs na grɔn we de gi layf, de. Gɔd go mek dɛn nɔ kray igen.”
Wɛn di Ship opin di say we mek sɛvin we di pepa we rol bin fasin, ɛvin kwayɛt fɔ af awa.
Na de a si di sɛvin enjɛl dɛn we tinap bifo Gɔd. Sɔmbɔdi kam gi dɛn sɛvin trɔmpɛt.

Wan ɔda enjɛl kam tinap klos di tebul we dɛn bin de mek sakrifays to Gɔd, i bin ol wan insɛns pɔt we dɛn mek wit gold; sɔmbɔdi kam gi am plɛnti insɛns, i put am na di insɛns pɔt, dɛn i jɔyn am to di pre we Gɔd in pipul dɛn de pre; dɔn i put am na di gold tebul we dɛn bin de mek sakrifays to Gɔd, we de bifo di ay chia we Gɔd sidɔm.
We di enjɛl ol di insɛns pɔt bifo Gɔd, wɛn di insɛns de bɔn, di smok bin de go ɔp to Gɔd wit di pre we Gɔd in pipul dɛn bin de pre.

Dɛn di enjɛl tek di insɛns pɔt, i tek faya na di tebul we dɛn bin de mek sakrifays to Gɔd, put am insay di insɛns pɔt, dɔn i trowe am pan di wɔl. Na de tɛnda bigin krak, laytin bigin kɔt, big big nɔys bigin mek ɛn di grɔn bigin trimbul.
Dɛn di sɛvin enjɛl dɛn we bin ol di sɛvin trɔmpɛt dɛn, bin de rɛdi fɔ blo dɛn.

Di fɔs enjɛl blo in trɔmpɛt. Na de smɔl smɔl tin dɛn lɛkɛ ays ren, wit faya ɛn blɔd bigin fɔdɔm pan di wɔl. Wɛn wi sheb di wɔl tri say, wan pat bɔn, ɔl di tik dɛn na di wan pat ɛn ɔl di grin gras ɔlɔbɔt bɔn.
Dɛn di sɛkɛn enjɛl blo in trɔmpɛt. Na de dɛn tek sɔntin lɛkɛ ay il we faya de bɔn ib am insay di wata. Wɛn di wata sheb tri, wan pan di tri pat tɔn blɔd,
pan ɔl di tin dɛn we bin gɛt layf na di wata, wan pam tri day; pan ɔl di bot dɛn we bin de na dis wɔl, wan pam tri pwɛl.
Dɛn di enjɛl we mek tri blo in trɔmpɛt. Na de wan big sta we faya de kɔmɔt pan fɔdɔm kɔmɔt na di klawd pan wan pat pan dɛn riva ɛn wan pat pan dɛn wata we bɔs na grɔn, wɛn pɔsin sheb dɛn tri tri say.
Di sta nem Bita. Wan pam tri pat na di wata we di sta bin fɔdɔm pan bita wantɛm, ɛn plɛnti pipul we drink am day, bikɔs i bin bita.

Di enjɛl we mek fo blo in trɔmpɛt. Sɔntin nak wan pam tri pat pan di san we mek da pat de dak; sɔntin nak wan pan di tri pat pan di mun we mek da pat de dak; sɔntin nak wan pat pan di tri say we di sta dɛn de we mek dɛn dak; so dat mek, wan pat pam tri pat na de tɛm dak, ɛn na semwe so i bin bi na nɛt.
A luk bak, na de a yɛri wan igul we de flay tɔk lawd wan se, “Woyo, woy! Big big waala gɛt fɔ fɔdɔm pan dɛn pipul we de na wɔl wɛn di tri enjɛl dɛn we lɛf, blo di trɔmpɛt dɛn we dɛn fɔ blo!”
Di enjɛl we mek fayv, blo in trɔmpɛt. Na de a si wan sta we bin dɔn fɔdɔm kɔmɔt na ɛvin kam pan di wɔl; dɛn bin gi am di ki fɔ tek opin di domɔt fɔ go insay di dip ol we nɔ gɛt bɔtɔm.
Di sta opin di dip ol, na de plɛnti smok kɔmɔt insay de, lɛkɛ se na big big faya i de kɔmɔt; di san in layt nɔ shayn, bikɔs di smok mek di ples dak.
Lokɔs bɔs kɔmɔt insay di smok kam kɔba di wɔl ɛn dɛn gi dɛn pawa fɔ du bad lɛkɛ kɔktel.
Dɛn bin tɛl dɛn mek dɛn nɔ pwɛl di gras ɛn di tik dɛn ɔ ɛnitin we de gro; dɛn bin tɛl dɛn fɔ briŋ waala pan dɛn pipul nɔmɔ we nɔ bin gɛt Gɔd in stamp pan dɛn fɔrɛd.

Dɛn nɔ bin gri mek dɛn lokɔs ya kil di pipul dɛn so, na sɔfa dɛn bin fɔ jɛs mek dɛn sɔfa bad fɔ fayv mɔnt. Di pen, we dɛn pipul we di lokɔs dɛn bin stiŋ, bin gɛt fɔ bia, bin jɛs tan lɛkɛ wɛn kɔktel stiŋ pɔsin.
Da fayv mɔnt de, dɛn pipul ya go kɔl day so fɔ kam tek dɛn, bɔt i nɔ go kam; dɛn go want day so, bɔt day go rɔnawe go lɛf dɛn.
Di lokɔs dɛn bin fiba dɛn ɔs we dɔn rɛdi fɔ go fɛt wa; tin dɛn we fiba gold krawn bin de na dɛn ed, dɛn fes bin fiba pɔsin fes.
Dɛn ia bin fiba uman ia, dɛn tit bin fiba layɔn tit.
Dɛn chɛst bin tan lɛkɛ ayɛn klos we dɛn de wɛr na wa, wɛn dɛn de flay di nɔys we dɛn fɛda bin de mek bin fiba lɛkɛ wɛn plɛnti ɔs de drɔ dɛn tin we dɛn kɔl chariɔt we gɛt ayɛn wil, go wa.
Dɛn tel bin de stiŋ lɛkɛ kɔktel, ɛn na dɛn tel ya dɛn bin de tek mek pipul sɔfa pen fɔ fayv mɔnt.
Dɛn bin gɛt dɛn edman, dat na da enjɛl we de gyad da ol we nɔ gɛt bɔtɔm. Dɛn Ju pipul de kɔl am Abadɔn, dɛn Grik pipul de kɔl am Apolyɔn (dat min, “Di wan we de kil ɛn pwɛl”.)
Di fɔs big waala dɔn dɔn; tu mɔ gɛt fɔ kam.
Dɛn di enjɛl we mek siks blo in trɔmpɛt. Na de a yɛri vɔys de kɔmɔt na di fo kɔna dɛn na di gold tebul we de bifo Gɔd, da tebul we dɛn de mek sakrifays to Gɔd.
Di vɔys tɔk to di enjɛl we mek siks we bin ol di trɔmpɛt, i se, “Lus dɛn fo enjɛl we tay klos da riva we dɛn kɔl Yufretis!”
Di enjɛl we bin ol di trɔmpɛt lus di fo enjɛl dɛn; Gɔd bin dɔn put dɛn de rɛdi fɔ da sem ia de, da sem mɔnt de, da sem de de, ɛn da sem awa de fɔ mek dɛn kil wan pan ɛvri tri pɔsin.
Plɛnti plɛnti soja man dɛn we bin de rayd ɔs bin lib de. Sɔmbɔdi tɛl mi ɔmɔs soja man dɛn bin lib de; na bin tu ɔndrɛd milyɔn.

A si di ɔs dɛn ɛn di pipul dɛn we bin de rayd dɛn, klia wan: dɛn chɛst bin kɔba wit tin lɛkɛ ayɛn klos we pipul de wɛr na wa, di ayɛn bin rɛd lɛkɛ faya, blu lɛkɛ si wata, ɛn yala lɛkɛ sɔlfa. Di ɔs dɛn ed bin fiba layɔn ed, ɛn faya wit smok ɛn ɔt sɔlfa bin de kɔmɔt na dɛn mɔt.
Dɛn tri bad bad tin ya: di faya, di smok ɛn di ɔt sɔlfa we bin de kɔmɔt na dɛn mɔt bin kil wan pam tri mɔtalman.
Di pawa we dɛn ɔs ya bin gɛt, bin de na dɛn mɔt ɛn dɛn tel. Dɛn tel bin tan lɛkɛ snek we gɛt plɛnti ed, ɛn nain dɛn bin de tek wund pipul.

Di ɔda mɔtalman dɛn we dɛn bad bad tin ya nɔ kil, nɔ bin tap fɔ pre to dɛn tin we dɛn bin mek fɔ dɛnsɛf. Dɛn nɔ bin tap fɔ pre to dɛn dɛbul ɛn dɛn tin we dɛn mek wit gold, silva, bras, ston ɔ wud, we nɔ de si, we nɔ de yɛri ɛn we nɔ de waka.
Dɛn pipul ya nɔ bin sɔri fɔ wetin dɛn bin de du ɛn lɛf fɔ du dɛn, dat na di kil we dɛn bin de kil pipul, di wich we dɛn bin de wich, di fri layf we dɛn bin liv ɛn di tif we dɛn bin de tif.

Wɛn dat dɔn, na de a si wan ɔda enjɛl we gɛt pawa kɔmɔt na ɛvin kam dɔŋ. Klawd bin kɔba am lɛkɛ klos, rembo bin de rawnd in ed; in fes bin de shayn lɛkɛ di san, ɛn in fut dɛn bin fiba faya we tinap tret tret wan lɛkɛ post.
Wan smɔl pepa we rol we dɛn kɔl “skrol” bin de nain an, di pepa bin opin. I put in rayt fut pan di wata ɛn in lɛf fut pan di dray grɔn.
I ala lawd wan wit vɔys we fiba layɔn vɔys. Wɛn i dɔn ala dɔn, di sɛvin tɛnda dɛn krak fɔ ansa am.
Wɛn di tɛnda dɛn bigin tɔk, a bin jɛs want rayt, na de a yɛri vɔys de tɔk na ɛvin se, “Nɔ mek nɔbɔdi no wetin di sɛvin tɛnda dɛn se; nɔ rayt am!”
Dɛn di enjɛl we a bin si tinap, wit wan fut pan di dray grɔn ɛn wan fut pan di wata, es in raytan ɔp to ɛvin.
I swɛ bifo Gɔd we de naw ɛn we go de sote go, Gɔd we mek ɛvin ɛn ɔl wetin de insay de. I se, “Tɛm nɔ go wes igen!
Bɔt wɛn di enjɛl we mek sɛvin blo in trɔmpɛt, Gɔd go du wetin i bin dɔn mekɔp fɔ du we nɔbɔdi nɔ bin no, we i bin tɛl di prɔfɛt dɛn we bin de wok fɔ am.”
Dɛn di vɔys, we a yɛri, we kɔmɔt ɛvin, tɔk to mi bak se, “Go tek di pepa we dɛn kɔl skrol, we dɔn opin, we di enjɛl we tinap pan di dray grɔn ɛn di wata, ol.”
A go to di enjɛl go aks am mek i gi mi di lili pepa we dɛn kɔl skrol. I tɛl mi se, “Tek am, it am, i go sawa na yu bɛlɛ, bɔt i go swit lɛkɛ ɔni na yu mɔt.”
A tek di lili pepa we dɛn kɔl skrol na di enjɛl in an, ɛn it am; ɛn jɛs lɛkɛ aw di enjɛl bin se, i tes swit lɛkɛ ɔni na mi mɔt. Bɔt wɛn a dɔn swɛla am go dɔŋ, i sawa na mi bɛlɛ.
Dɛn a yɛri pɔsin de tɛl mi se, “Yu fɔ tɔk Gɔd in mɛsej bɔt plɛnti neshɔn, plɛnti difrɛn pipul dɛn we de tɔk difrɛn difrɛn laŋwej, ɛn bɔt plɛnti kiŋ dɛn wan tɛm mɔ.”
Wɛn dat dɔn, dɛn gi mi wan tik we dɛn de tek fɔ mɛnshɔ, dɔn dɛn tɛl mi se, “Grap, go mɛnshɔ Gɔd in Os ɛn di tebul we dɛn de mek sakrifays to Gɔd, ɛn kɔnt di pipul dɛn we de prez Gɔd insay in Os.
Bɔt nɔ mɛnshɔ di sɛkɛn opin ples we de rawnd Gɔd in Os bikɔs da ples de na fɔ dɛn pipul we nɔto Gɔd yon pipul, ɛn dɛn pipul de go mas Gɔd in tɔŋ ɔnda dɛn fut fɔ fɔti-tu mɔnt.
A go sɛn tu pipul we go tɔk bɔt mi, dɛn go wɛr di kayn klos we pipul kin wɛr wɛn dɛn gɛt bɛrin, ɛn fɔ wan tawzin, tu ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti de, dɛn go tɛl pipul di mɛsej we Gɔd gi dɛn.”
Di tu pipul dɛn we go tɛl pipul Gɔd in mɛsej na dɛn tu ɔliv tik ɛn dɛn tu lampolda dɛn we tinap bifo di Masta we mek di wɔl.
If ɛnibɔdi tray fɔ du dɛn tu pipul ya ɛni bad tin, faya go kɔmɔt na dɛn mɔt ɛn bɔn di pɔsin ɛn kil am; na so ɛnibɔdi we go tray fɔ du dɛn tu bad, go day.

Dɛn gɛt pawa fɔ ol di ren mek i nɔ fɔdɔm di tɛm we dɛn de tɛl pipul di mɛsej we Gɔd sɛn. Ɛn igen, dɛn gɛt pawa fɔ mek wata we bɔs na grɔn tɔn blɔd; dɛn gɛt pawa fɔ sɛn ɛni kayn bad bad tin kam na di wɔl, ɛnitɛm we dɛn lɛk.
Wɛn dɛn dɔn tɛl pipul di mɛsej dɔn, di wayl bif we kɔmɔt insay di ol we nɔ gɛt bɔtɔm go kam fɛt dɛn. I go win dɛn ɛn kil dɛn,
ɛn dɛn dedebɔdi go ledɔm na trit na di big tɔŋ we dɛn bin nel di Masta na di krɔs. Da tɔŋ de gɛt nem we gɛt minin, lɛkɛ Sɔdɔm ɔ Ijipt.

Ɔl kayn pipul, blak o, wayt o, we kɔmɔt na ɔl dɛn neshɔn ɛn ɔl dɛn trayb na wɔl ɛn we de tɔk ɔl dɛn difrɛn laŋwej go tek tri ɛn af de, de pas de luk di dedebɔdi dɛn, ɛn dɛn nɔ go gri fɔ mek dɛn bɛr dɛn.
Di pipul dɛn na wɔl go gladi we dɛn tu pipul ya day. Dɛn go mek pati ɛn dash dɛn kɔmpin bikɔs dɛn tu prɔfɛt ya bin de tɛl pipul Gɔd in mɛsej we bin de tɔmɛnt dɛn.
Wɛn di tri ɛn af de dɔn pas, Gɔd blo layf insay di tu pipul dɛn, na de dɛn tinap; ɔl dɛn wan we si dɛn, fred bad.
Dɛn di tu prɔfɛt dɛn yɛri lawd vɔys we kɔmɔt na ɛvin de tɔk to dɛn se, “Una kam ɔp ya!” Aw di pipul dɛn we nɔ lɛk dɛn tinap de luk dɛn, dɛn go ɔp na ɛvin insay wan klawd.
Da sem tɛm de, nain di grɔn trimbul bad bad wan; wan pan ɛvri tɛn say na di tɔŋ pwɛl pata pata, ɛn sɛvin tawzin pipul day. Di ɔda pipul dɛn we nɔ day, fred bad; dɛn bigin prez Gɔd we de rul na ɛvin.
Di sɛkɛn big big waala dɔn pas; bɔt luk o, di big waala we mek tri go fɔdɔm jisnɔ.

Dɛn di enjɛl we mek sɛvin blo in trɔmpɛt. Na de a yɛri plɛnti vɔys de tɔk lawd wan na ɛvin se, “Na Gɔd we na wi Masta ɛn Mɛsaya we i sɛn kam na dis wɔl dɔn gɛt di pawa naw fɔ rul, ɛn i go rul sote go!”
Dɛn di twɛnti-fo bigman dɛn we sidɔm pan dɛn chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm pan, fɔdɔm na Gɔd in fut ɛn bigin prez am.
Dɛn se, “Masta, yu we na Gɔd, we gɛt pawa pas ɔl, we bin de frɔm tɛm, ɛn we stil de naw! Wi tɛl yu tɛnki bikɔs yu dɔn tek yu pawa we pas ɔl ɛn bigin rul oba di wɔl!

Dɛn pipul we nɔto yu yon pipul bin vɛks bad pan yu, bɔt di tɛm fɔ mek yu sho se yu vɛks pan dɛn, dɔn rich; na di tɛm dis we yu go jɔj dɛn wan we dɔn day. Na di tɛm dis fɔ gi ɔl dɛn pipul we na yu yon dɛn pe, dat na dɛn prɔfɛt we de wok fɔ yu ɛn ɔl dɛn wan we rɛspɛkt yu, dɛn wan we gɛt pawa ɛn dɛn wan we nɔ gɛt pawa. Di tɛm dɔn rich fɔ kil dɛn wan we bin de pwɛl di wɔl!”

Wantɛm Gɔd in Os na ɛvin opin, na de a si di bɔks we dɛn put di tin we dɛn rayt di agrimɛnt we Gɔd mek wit mɔtalman pan. Dɛn laytin bigin kɔt, big big nɔys bigin mek, tɛnda bigin krak, di grɔn bigin trimbul, plɛnti plɛnti tin dɛn lɛkɛ ays ren bigin fɔdɔm.
Dɛn a si wan wɔndaful tin ɔp na di klawd. Wan uman bin de we di san kɔba lɛkɛ klos, di mun bin de ɔnda in fut, i bin wɛr krawn, we dɛn tek twɛlv sta mek, nain ed.
I bin lɛf lili bit fɔ am fɔ bɔn, so di pen we i bin de pas bin mek i de ala.
Wɛn dat dɔn, wan ɔda wɔndaful tin bin bi ɔp na di klawd. Wan big big rɛd snek we dɛn kɔl dragɔn bɔs kɔmɔt, i bin gɛt sɛvin ed ɛn tɛn ɔn, ɛn ɔl di sɛvin ed dɛn bin gɛt wan wan krawn pan dɛn.
I tek in tel drɔ wan pan ɛvri tri sta kɔmɔt ɔp na di klawd, ib dɛn dɔŋ pan di wɔl. I go tinap bifo di uman we bin fɔ bɔn, so dat i kin it in pikin jɛs i bɔn am so.
I nɔ tu te, di uman bɔn wan bɔy pikin, we go rul oba ɔl dɛn neshɔn wit staf we dɛn tek ayɛn mek. Bɔt sɔmbɔdi jɔg di pikin rɔn kɛr am go to Gɔd we sidɔm na di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm fɔ rul.
Di uman rɔnawe go na di dɛzat, na di say we Gɔd bin dɔn mek fɔ am, na de i go de fɔ wan tawzin, tu ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti de, ɛn pɔsin go de mɛn am.
Wantɛm, wa fɔdɔm na ɛvin, Maykɛl ɛn in enjɛl dɛn go fɛt di dragɔn, di dragɔn insɛf fɛt bak wit in yon mɛsenja dɛn;
bɔt Maykɛl ɛn in enjɛl dɛn win di dragɔn ɛn dɛn nɔ gri mek di dragɔn ɛn in mɛsenja dɛn tap na ɛvin igen.
Dɛn drɛb di big dragɔn kɔmɔt na ɛvin, ib am dɔŋ na wɔl! Nain na da snek we dɛn kɔl Dɛbul ɔ Setan, we bin de mek di ol wɔl ful. Dɛn ib am dɔŋ na wɔl, wit ɔl in mɛsenja dɛn.

Dɛn a yɛri lawd vɔys de tɔk na ɛvin se, “Di tɛm we Gɔd go sev in pipul dɛn, dɔn kam! Gɔd dɔn sho in pawa naw lɛkɛ kiŋ! Krays we i sɛn kam na wɔl dɔn sho in pawa! Di wan we bin tinap bifo Gɔd de tɔk de ɛn nɛt se wi kɔmpin Kristiɛn dɛn du bad, dɔn kɔmɔt na ɛvin, dɛn dɔn ib am na do.
Wi kɔmpin Kristiɛn dɛn tek di Ship in blɔd ɛn di tru wɔd we dɛn bin de tɛl pipul bɔt Gɔd win am, we i bin de fɛt dɛn; ɛn pantap dat, dɛn gri fɔ wok fɔ Gɔd ɛn day fɔ am.
So mek gladi de na ɛvin, mek ɔl dɛn wan we lib de gladi! Bɔt bad bad tin dɔn fɔdɔm pan di grɔn ɛn di wata bikɔs di Dɛbul dɔn kam dɔŋ to una ɛn i vɛks bad bikɔs i no se na smɔl tɛm nɔmɔ lɛf fɔ am.”
Wɛn di dragɔn si se dɛn dɔn ib am dɔŋ na wɔl, i bigin rɔnata di uman we bin bɔn di bɔy pikin.

Sɔmbɔdi bin gi di uman tu wiŋs, dat na da bɔd we dɛn kɔl igul, in big wan, in wiŋ dɛn, fɔ mek i flay go na di ples we de na di dɛzat, we dɛn bin dɔn kip fɔ am, dɛn go de mɛn am de fɔ tri ɛn af ia mek di dragɔn nɔ go ebul du am bad.
So di dragɔn bigin pul plɛnti wata kɔmɔt nain mɔt we bigin rɔn biɛn di uman fɔ kɛr am go.
Bɔt di grɔn ɛp di uman; i opin ɛn swɛla di wata we bin de kɔmɔt na di dragɔn in mɔt.
Fɔseka dat, di dragɔn bin vɛks pan di uman, so i go fɔ go fɛt in ɔda pikin dɛn, dat na ɔl di wan dɛn we de du wetin Gɔd tɛl dɛn fɔ du, ɛn we biliv di tru tin dɛn we Jizɔs sho dɛn ɛn dɛn de fala dɛn.
Dɛn di dragɔn go tinap klos di wata.
Dɛn a si wan wayl bif de kɔmɔt insay di wata kam ɔp. I bin gɛt tɛn ɔn ɛn sɛvin ed, ɔl di ɔn dɛn bin gɛt wan wan krawn pan dɛn; wan bad nem bɔt Gɔd bin rayt pan ɔl in ed dɛn.
Di wayl bif we a si bin fiba lɛpɛt, in fut bin fiba wan bif we dɛn kɔl bia, in fut, ɛn in mɔt bin fiba layɔn mɔt. Di dragɔn gi dis wayl bif ya ɔl di pawa we i bin gɛt oba ɔl dɛn tin we i bin de rul.
I bin tan lɛkɛ se sɔmbɔdi bin dɔn wund wan pan di wayl bif in ed dɛn, bɔt di wund we bin fɔ mek i day, bin dɔn wɛl. Di wan ol wɔl bin wɔnda, dɛn bigin fala di wayl bif.
Ɔlman bigin prez di dragɔn bikɔs i bin gi di wayl bif in pawa. Di pipul dɛn prez di wayl bif insɛf, dɛn se, “Udat gɛt pawa lɛkɛ di wayl bif? Udat ebul fɛt am?”
Dɛn bin gri fɔ mek di wayl bif tɔk ɔl kayn bad tin bɔt Gɔd ɛn tɔk dɛn tin we sho se i prawd; ɛn dɛn bin gri fɔ mek i rul fɔ fɔti-tu mɔnt.
I bigin kɔs Gɔd, pwɛl in nem, tɔk bad bɔt di ples we i de ɛn tɔk bad bɔt ɔl dɛn wan we de na ɛvin.
Dɛn bin lɛf am mek i fɛt Gɔd in pipul dɛn ɛn win dɛn, ɛn dɛn bin gi am pawa fɔ rul ɔl dɛn trayb, ɔl dɛn neshɔn, blak pipul ɛn wayt pipul ɛn pipul we de tɔk ɔl dɛn difrɛn laŋwej na wɔl.

Ɔl dɛn pipul na di wɔl go pre to di wayl bif, pas nɔmɔ if dɛn nem bin rayt na di Ship we dɛn kil, in buk. Bifo Gɔd mek di wɔl, nain dɛn pipul we gɛt layf sote go dɛn nem bin dɔn rayt na di Ship in buk.
“If ɛnibɔdi gɛt yes fɔ yɛri, mek i yɛri!

Ɛnibɔdi we Gɔd dɔn mak se dɛn fɔ kech, dɛn go kech am paopa; ɛnibɔdi we Gɔd dɔn mak se dɛn fɔ chuk ɛn kil, na chuk dɛn go chuk ɛn kil am. Na dat mek Gɔd in pipul dɛn fɔ tinap traŋa ɛn dɛn nɔ fɔ lɛf fɔ biliv pan Gɔd.”
Wɛn dat dɔn, na de a si wan ɔda wayl bif de kɔmɔt insay di grɔn kam ɔp. I bin gɛt tu ɔn dɛn we fiba ship pikin ɔn, ɛn i bin de tɔk lɛkɛ dragɔn.
Dis sɛkɛn wayl bif tek ɔl di fɔs wayl bif in pawa ɛn bigin yus di pawa bifo am. I fos ɔl di pipul dɛn na di wɔl fɔ pre to di fɔs wayl bif we in wund bin dɔn wɛl.
I du plɛnti tin we mek pipul wɔnda, i mek faya kɔmɔt na ɛvin kam dɔŋ pan di wɔl bifo ɔl di pipul dɛn.

I mek ɔl di pipul dɛn na wɔl ful wit di tin dɛn we dɛn gi am pawa fɔ du bifo di fɔs wayl bif; dɛn tin ya bin mek pipul wɔnda. Di sɛkɛn wayl bif tɛl ɔl di pipul dɛn na di wɔl se mek dɛn mek sɔntin we dɛn go tek mɛmba ɛn rɛspɛkt di fɔs wayl bif we dɛn bin wund wit sɔd, bɔt nɔ bin day.
Dɛn lɛf di sɛkɛn wayl bif mek i blo layf go insay di tin we dɛn mek fɔ tek mɛmba di fɔs wayl bif, so dat di tin kin tɔk ɛn kil ɔl dɛn wan we nɔ de pre to am.
Di sɛkɛn wayl bif fos mek dɛn put mak pan ɔlman, pan dɛn raytan ɛn pan dɛn fɔrɛd; dɛn put mak pan dɛn bigman ɛn dɛn smɔl pikin, dɛn po man ɛn dɛn wan we jɛntri, dɛn slev ɛn dɛn fribɔn.
Nɔbɔdi nɔ bin ebul bay ɔ sɛl ɛnitin pas nɔmɔ i gɛt da mak de, dat na di wayl bif in nem ɔ di nɔmba we tinap fɔ di nem.
So mɔtalman fɔ gɛt sɛns. Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt sɛns go ebul no wetin di wayl bif in nɔmba min, bikɔs da nɔmba de tinap fɔ mɔtalman in nɔmba. Di nɔmba na siks ɔndrɛd ɛn siksti siks.
Wɛn dat dɔn, a si di Ship tinap pantap di ay il we dɛn kɔl Zayɔn. Wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fɔti-fo tawzin pipul bin tinap de wit am. Di Ship in nem ɛn in Papa in nem bin rayt pan dɛn fɔrɛd.
Dɛn a yɛri vɔys kɔmɔt na ɛvin; di vɔys big lɛkɛ dɛn big wata we de fɔdɔm kɔmɔt ɔp dɛn il kam dɔŋ ɛn lɛkɛ wɛn tɛnda de krak. Di vɔys swit lɛkɛ di sawnd we kin kɔmɔt wɛn pipul de ple ap.

Di wan ɔndrɛd ɛn fɔti-fo tawzin pipul dɛn tinap bifo di ay chia we Gɔd sidɔm pan, bifo di fo tin dɛn we gɛt layf, ɛn bifo di bigman dɛn. Dɛn bin de siŋ wan nyu siŋ we na dɛn wan nɔmɔ, we Krays bin dɔn pe fɔ na wɔl wit in blɔd, bin ebul lan ɛn siŋ am.

Dɛn na man dɛn we nɔ bin miks pan uman biznɛs; dɛn bin de fala di Ship ɛni say i go. Na di Ship bin pik dɛn kɔmɔt to dɛn ɔda mɔtalman wɛn i bay dɛn, ɛn na dɛn fɔs i put wansay fɔ insɛf nɔmɔ ɛn fɔ Gɔd.
Wande nɔbɔdi nɔ yɛri dɛn lay; dɛn nɔba du ɛnitin we go mek pipul blem dɛn.

Dɛn a si wan ɔda enjɛl de flay ɔp ɔp, i bin de tɛl pipul di Gud Nyuz we go de sote go, dɛn pipul ya kɔmɔt na ɔl dɛn trayb, ɔl dɛn neshɔn ɛn dɛn de tɔk ɔl dɛn difrɛn laŋwej, blakman o, wetman o, ɔl de pan dɛn.

I tɔk lawd wan se, “Una fred Gɔd, ɛn prez am bikɔs i wɔndaful! Di tɛm dɔn kam fɔ mek i jɔj mɔtalman. Una fɔdɔm bifo am ɛn prez am, nain mek ɛvin, nain mek di dray grɔn, di big wata we de rawnd di dray grɔn ɛn dɛn wata we de bɔs na grɔn!”

Wan ɔda enjɛl bin de fala di fɔs wande tɔk se, “Babilɔn dɔn pwɛl! Da big tɔŋ, Babilɔn, dɔn pwɛl! Nain bin de gi ɔlman in wayn fɔ drink; da wayn de na di fri layf we pipul dɛn bin de pan, ɛn we kin mek dɛn du ɛni bad tin we dɛn at gi dɛn fɔ du.”
Wan ɔda enjɛl we mek tri, kam, i bin de ala lawd wan se, “Ɛnibɔdi we de pre to di wayl bif ɛn di tin we dɛn mek fɔ de tek mɛmba ɛn rɛspɛkt am, ɛn we gri mek dɛn put in mak pan in fɔrɛd ɔ pan in an,

insɛf go drink Gɔd in yon wayn, dat na di pɔnish we i go pɔnish bikɔs Gɔd vɛks pan am, da pɔnishmɛnt de tan lɛkɛ bita wayn we nɔ miks wit wata we i gɛt fɔ drink. Ɔl dɛn pipul we de du dɛn tin ya go pɔnish bifo Gɔd in enjɛl dɛn ɛn Gɔd in Ship insay faya we sɔlfa de bɔn.

Di faya nɔ go tap fɔ mek smok we go de tɔmɛnt dɛn sote go, so dɛn pipul we de pre to di wayl bif ɛn di tin we dɛn mek fɔ tek mɛmba ɛn rɛspɛkt am, ɛn we gɛt in mak nɔ go gɛt blo; de ɛn nɛt, dɛn go de pan tɔmɛnt.”
So mek Gɔd in pipul dɛn tinap traŋa, dat na dɛn wan we de du wetin Gɔd tɛl dɛn fɔ du ɛn dɛn nɔ lɛf fɔ biliv pan Jizɔs.

Dɛn a yɛri vɔys na ɛvin de tɔk se, “Rayt wetin a de kam tɛl yu naw: Dɛn pipul we go day fɔseka di Masta, go gladi!” Di Spirit ansa se, “Na tru yu de tɔk, dɛn dɔn dɔn di big wok we dɛn bin de du so, dɛn go blo naw ɛn dɛn go gladi bikɔs dɛn dɔn si wetin di wok we dɛn bin de du, dɔn briŋ.”

Wɛn dat dɔn, a luk bak, na de a si wan big wayt klawd. A si lɛkɛ wan mɔtalman sidɔm pan di klawd. I bin wɛr wan gold krawn nain ed ɛn i bin ol sɔntin nain an, dat na da nɛf we fɔ tek kɔt dɛn tin we dɛn plant wɛn dɛn dɔn rɛdi fɔ kɔt.

Wan ɔda enjɛl kɔmɔt na Gɔd in Os, i ala lawd wan tɛl di pɔsin we sidɔm pan di klawd se, “Tek yu nɛf kɔt dɛn tin we dɔn rɛdi fɔ kɔt, di rayt tɛm dɔn rich, di tin dɛn we dɛn bin plant na wɔl dɔn rɛdi fɔ kɔt!”
Di pɔsin we bin sidɔm pan di klawd swiŋ in nɛf pan di wɔl; di nɛf kɔt ɔl di tin dɛn we bin dɔn rɛdi fɔ kɔt.
Dɛn a si wan ɔda enjɛl insɛf kɔmɔt na Gɔd in Os na ɛvin, insɛf bin ol wan nɛf.

Dɛn wan ɔda enjɛl we bin de gyad di faya, kɔmɔt klos di tebul we dɛn bin de mek sakrifays to Gɔd, kam. I ala lawd wan tɛl di enjɛl we ol di nɛf se, “Tek yu nɛf, kɔt dɛn greps we dɛn go tek mek wayn, dɛn dɔn rɛp!”

Na de di enjɛl tek in nɛf swiŋ am rawnd pan di greps, i kɔt dɛn kɔmɔt pan di an dɛn, ɛn ib dɛn insay di ol we dɛn de kwis dɛn fɔ mek wayn. Dis sho aw Gɔd vɛks bad ɛn aw i go pɔnish dɛn wan we i vɛks pan.
Di ol we dɛn bin kwis di wata kɔmɔt pan di greps nɔ bin de insay di tɔŋ; plɛnti blɔd kɔmɔt insay di ol ɛn rɔn te i rich tu ɔndrɛd mayl ɛn na fayv fut di blɔd bin dip.

A si wan ɔda wɔndaful tin na di klawd we mek a bin jɛs de wɔnda. Sɛvin enjɛl dɛn bin de wit sɛvin bad bad tin dɛn, we na di las wan dɛn, bikɔs na di las tin dɛn dat, we Gɔd go tek sho mɔtalman se in vɛks pan dɛn.

Dɛn a si sɔntin we fiba big wata we tan lɛkɛ se dɛn tek glas mek am, faya bin de bɔn insay am. Pantap dat, a si dɛn pipul we bin dɔn win di wayl bif, we na nɔmba tinap fɔ in nem, ɛn di tin we pipul bin mek fɔ tek de mɛmba ɛn rɛspɛkt am. Dɛn bin tinap klos di big glas wata ɛn dɛn bin ol ap fɔ tek ple myuzik, we Gɔd bin dɔn gi dɛn.

Dɛn bin de siŋ di siŋ we Mozis, we de wok fɔ Gɔd, bin siŋ lɔntɛm. Da siŋ de na di Ship in siŋ; di siŋ se, “Masta, Gɔd we gɛt pawa pas ɔl, yu wok dɛn big ɛn dɛn wɔndaful! Na yu na di kiŋ we de rul oba ɔl dɛn neshɔn, yu de du wetin rayt, yu de tɔk wetin tru ɔltɛm!

Masta, udat de we nɔ go fred yu? Udat nɔ go gri fɔ tɛl ɔda pipul bɔt yu pawa? Na yu wangren na Gɔd. Ɔl dɛn pipul na ɔl dɛn neshɔn go kam fɔdɔm bifo yu ɛn prez yu, bikɔs ɔlman dɔn si se di jɔj we yu de jɔj, gud.”
Wɛn dat dɔn, a luk bak, na de a si di ples we Gɔd sidɔm nain bafa na ɛvin opin, dat na di ples we dɛn de kip di agrimɛnt we Gɔd mek wit mɔtalman.
Dɔn dɛn sɛvin enjɛl we bin gɛt dɛn sɛvin bad bad tin dɛn kɔmɔt insay de; dɛn bin wɛr klin linin klos, na so i bin de shayn, ɛn gold strap bin tay rawnd dɛn chɛst.
Dɛn wan pan di fo tin dɛn we gɛt layf gi di sɛvin enjɛl dɛn sɛvin gold kɔp; di pɔnish we Gɔd, we de sote go, go pɔnish di wɔl, nain bin ful insay di sɛvin kɔp dɛn.
Smok we sho Gɔd in pawa ɛn we sho aw i wɔndaful bin ful di ples, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ bin ebul go insay di ples te di sɛvin bad bad tin dɛn we di enjɛl dɛn bin briŋ, bin dɔn dɔn.
Wɛn dat dɔn, na de a yɛri vɔys insay Gɔd in Os de tɔk to di sɛvin enjɛl dɛn se, “Una go tek dɛn sɛvin kɔp we ful wit di vɛks we Gɔd vɛks, ɛn trowe am pan di wɔl!”

Di fɔs enjɛl go trowe di tin we de insay in kɔp pan di grɔn, na de plɛnti bad bad so bɔs pan dɛn wan we gɛt di wayl bif in mak ɛn dɛn wan we bin de pre to di tin we dɛn mek fɔ tek mɛmba ɛn rɛspɛkt am.
Dɛn di sɛkɛn enjɛl trowe di tin we de insay in kɔp na di si, nain di si tɔn blɔd lɛkɛ blɔd we de insay dedebɔdi; ɔltin we bin de insay di wata day.
Dɛn di enjɛl we mek tri, trowe di tin we de insay in kɔp pan dɛn riva ɛn dɛn wata we de bɔs na grɔn, na de dɛn tɔn blɔd.
A yɛri di enjɛl we bin de gyad di wata de tɔk se, “Yu we na yu wangren na Gɔd, yu we bin de frɔm tɛm ɛn we de naw, di we we yu de jɔj ɔltin, tret!
Dɛn pipul ya bin dɔn kil yu pipul dɛn ɛn dɛn wan we bin de tɔk di mɛsej we yu gi dɛn, dɛn bin mek dɛn blɔd rɔn so naw yu dɔn gi dɛn blɔd fɔ drink. Na wetin dɛn wok fɔ, nain dɛn gɛt!”
Dɛn a yɛri vɔys na di tebul we dɛn de mek sakrifays to Gɔd. Di vɔys de tɔk se, “Masta, Gɔd we gɛt pawa pas ɔl! Yu de jɔj rayt, ɛn yu de tɔk tru ɔltɛm!”
Dɛn di enjɛl we mek fo trowe di tin we de insay in kɔp pan di san, ɛn i lɛf am mek i bɔn mɔtalman wit faya.
Di pipul dɛn we di san in faya bin de bɔn, bigin kɔs Gɔd we gɛt pawa fɔ mek i tap dɛn bad bad tin ya. Bɔt dɛn nɔ gri lɛf fɔ sin ɛn dɛn nɔ gri prez Gɔd we gɛt pawa.

Dɛn di enjɛl we mek fayv trowe di tin we de insay in kɔp pan di wayl bif in chia we i kin sidɔm pan fɔ rul. Ɔl di say dɛn we di wayl bif bin de rul, dak wantɛm, pipul bigin sɔfa bad bad pen, we mek dɛn bɛt dɛn tɔŋ,
dɛn bigin kɔs Gɔd na ɛvin fɔ di pen we dɛn bin de sɔfa ɛn dɛn so we bɔs pan dɛn. Pan ɔl dat, dɛn nɔ gri lɛf di bad bad tin dɛn we dɛn bin de du.
Dɛn di enjɛl we mek siks trowe di tin we de insay in kɔp pan di riva we nem Yufretis. I dray wantɛm, i mek rod fɔ dɛn kiŋ we de kɔmɔt na dɛn kɔntri we de na di ist.
Dɛn a si tri spirit dɛn we kɔmɔt to Setan, dɛn bin fiba ɔkpɔlɔ. Dɛn bin kɔmɔt na di dragɔn in mɔt, di wayl bif in mɔt, ɛn da man we de mek pipul ful se in de tɔk Gɔd in mɛsej, in sɛf yon mɔt.

Dɛn spirit ya kɔmɔt to Setan ɛn dɛn de du plɛnti tin we kin mek pipul wɔnda. Dɛn de go mit ɔl dɛn wan we de rul na di wɔl, ɛn kɔl dɛn fɔ kam gɛda ɛn rɛdi fɔ di wa we go bi da big de we Gɔd, we gɛt pawa pas ɔl, go sho in pawa.
“Lisin! A de kam tɛm we una nɔ mekɔp, lɛkɛ wɛn tifman de kam! I go bɛtɛ fɔ di pɔsin we nɔ de slip ɛn we wɛr klos, so dat i nɔ go gɛt fɔ waka nekɛd ɛn shem bifo pipul!”
Dɛn di spirit dɛn we kɔmɔt to Setan gɛda di wan dɛn we de rul na wɔl na da ples we dɛn kɔl “Amagɛdɔn” na Ibru.
Dɛn di enjɛl we mek sɛvin trowe di tin we de insay in kɔp na di briz, na de lawd vɔys tɔk na di chia we Gɔd sidɔm insay in Os na ɛvin, i se, “Ɔltin dɔn dɔn!”
Laytin bigin kɔt, lawd nɔys bigin mek, tɛnda bigin krak, ɛn di grɔn bigin trimbul. Sins we Gɔd mek mɔtalman di grɔn nɔba trimbul bad wan so; na di tɛm dat we i trimbul bad pas ɔl!

Di big tɔŋ brok, i sheb tri say, ɛn dɛn tɔŋ ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl pwɛl. Gɔd nɔ fɔgɛt di big tɔŋ we dɛn kɔl Babilɔn, i mek di pipul dɛn drink di bita wayn we i mek fɔ dɛn, dat na di pɔnish we i de pɔnish dɛn fɔ ɔl di bad tin we dɛn du.
Ɔl dɛn ples we de midul wata lɔs, ɔl dɛn ay il dɛnsɛf lɔs.

Big big ays ren bigin fɔdɔm pan mɔtalman frɔm ɛvin. Wan wan pan di ays ren bin we lɛkɛ wan ɔndrɛd pawn so. Di pipul dɛn bigin kɔs Gɔd bikɔs i mek dɛn big big ays ren ya fɔdɔm pan dɛn, we mek dɛn sɔfa bad bad wan.

Wɛn ɔl dat dɔn, wan pan di sɛvin enjɛl dɛn we bin ol wan pan di sɛvin kɔp dɛn, kam tɔk to mi, i se, “Kam, mek a go sho yu aw dɛn go pɔnish da uman we liv fri layf we ɔlman no; di uman na da tɔŋ we dɛn bil klos dɛn plɛnti riva.
Ɔl dɛn wan we de rul na wɔl bin liv fri layf wit dis uman ya we ɔlman no, ɛn ɔl di pipul dɛn na wɔl bin drɔnk wit di wayn we i gi dɛn fɔ drink, dat na di fri layf we dɛn bin liv wit am.”

Di Spirit fɔdɔm pan mi, na de di enjɛl kɛr mi go na wan dɛzat. Dɛn a si wan uman sidɔm pan wan rɛd wayl bif we bin gɛt sɛvin ed ɛn tɛn ɔn; ɔlɔbɔt nain bɔdi plɛnti bad nem dɛn we nɔ sho rɛspɛkt fɔ Gɔd, bin rayt.

Di uman bin wɛr rɛd klos we dia, ɛn i bin drɛs fayn wit plɛnti gold tin, dɛn shayn shayn ston ɛn fayn fayn bid. I bin ol wan gold kɔp nain an, we bin ful wit dɛn dɔti dɔti dɔti tin we in fri layf briŋ.
Wan nem we gɛt sikrit minin bin rayt pan in fɔrɛd, we se “Babilɔn we ɔlman no, we de bɔn ɔl dɛn pipul we liv fri layf, ɛn we de du ɔl dɛn tin we mɔtalman nɔ fɔ du wit in kɔmpin mɔtalman.”
A si se di uman bin drɔnk wit Gɔd in pipul dɛn blɔd ɛn di blɔd we kɔmɔt pan dɛn pipul we dɛn bin kil bikɔs dɛn tɔk opin wan se Jizɔs na dɛn Masta. Wɛn a si am a wɔnda te a nɔ no wetin fɔ tɔk.
Di enjɛl aks mi se, “Wetin du yu de wɔnda?” I se, “A go tɛl yu wetin di uman ɛn di wayl bif we tot am, we gɛt sɛvin ed ɛn tɛn ɔn, min.

Di wayl bif we yu si bin gɛt layf fɔstɛm, bɔt i nɔ gɛt layf igen, i nɔ go te igen i go kɔmɔt na di ol we nɔ gɛt bɔtɔm, dɛn i go go na ples we dɛn go go kil am. Dɛn pipul we de na wɔl, we dɛn nem nɔ bin dɔn rayt bifo Gɔd mek di wɔl, na di buk we dɛn rayt dɛn pipul we gɛt layf sote go dɛn nem, dɛn ɔl go wɔnda wɛn dɛn de luk di wayl bif. I bin gɛt layf fɔstɛm, dɛn i day, bɔt i go kam bak.
“Na dat mek pipul fɔ gɛt sɛns ɛn dɛn fɔ sabi wetin dɛn tin ya, min. Di sɛvin ed dɛn na di sɛvin ay il dɛn we di uman bin sidɔm pan. Ɛn igen dɛn min sɛvin kiŋ:
fayv pan dɛn kiŋ ya nɔ de rul igen, na wan nɔmɔ de rul te naw, ɛn di las wan nɔ kam yet; wɛn i kam, na shɔt tɛm nɔmɔ i go rul.
Di wayl bif we bin gɛt layf fɔs, bɔt we dɔn day, insɛf na kiŋ we mek et we miks pan di sɛvin kiŋ dɛn, bɔt i gɛt fɔ go na ples we dɛn go kil am.
“Di tɛn ɔn dɛn we yu si na tɛn kiŋ dɛn we nɔ bigin rul yet, bɔt dɛn go gi dɛn pawa fɔ rul lɛkɛ kiŋ wit di wayl bif fɔ wan awa.
Na di sem tin ɔl dɛn tɛn kiŋ ya want du, dɛn ɔl de gi di wayl bif dɛn pawa.

Dɛn go fɛt di Ship bɔt di Ship ɛn dɛn wan we i kɔl ɛn pik fɔ du in wok, we nɔ lɛf fɔ fala am, go win dɛn. Na so i go bi bikɔs di Ship na di Masta we de oba ɔl dɛn masta, ɛn di Kiŋ we de rul oba ɔl dɛn kiŋ.”
Di enjɛl tɛl mi igen se, “Dɛn wata we yu si di uman we liv fri layf sidɔm pan, na ɔl dɛn difrɛn difrɛn kɔntri, ɛn ɔl dɛn difrɛn difrɛn pipul, wayt ɛn blak, we de tɔk ɔl dɛn difrɛn difrɛn laŋwej.

Di tɛn ɔn dɛn, ɛn di wayl bif we yu si, nɔ go lɛk di uman we liv fri layf; dɛn go tek ɔl wetin i gɛt kɛr dɛn go, ɛn lɛf am nekɛd; dɛn go it in bif nain bɔdi, dɔn dɛn go bɔn am na faya we i go day insay.
Gɔd go mek di kiŋ dɛn want fɔ du wetin in want, so dat dɛn ɔl go gɛt wanwɔd, ɛn dɛn go gi di wayl bif dɛn pawa fɔ rul, te ɔltin bi lɛkɛ aw i bin dɔn tɔk.
“Di uman we yu si, na da big tɔŋ we gɛt pawa oba dɛn wan we de rul na di wɔl.”
Wɛn dat dɔn, a si wan ɔda enjɛl kɔmɔt na ɛvin kam dɔŋ na wɔl, i bin gɛt wɔndaful pawa. Di layt we bin de shayn pan am, layt ɔl dɛn ples na wɔl.
I ala lawd wan se, “Babilɔn, da tɔŋ we ɔlman no, dɔn pwɛl, i dɔn pwɛl pata pata; na ɔl kayn bad spirit tap de naw, ɔl dɛn wan we kɔmɔt to Setan; dɛn bad bɔd we pipul nɔ lɛk na dɛn dɔn go gɛda de.

Na so i bi, bikɔs ɔl dɛn pipul na ɔl dɛn neshɔn dɔn drink in wayn, dat na di fri layf we dɛn dɔn liv wit am; dɛn wan we de rul na di wɔl dɛnsɛf dɔn liv di sem fri layf wit am, ɛn bikɔs i lɛk fɔ bay plɛnti plɛnti tin dɛn, dɛn wan we de tredin na dis wɔl dɛnsɛf dɔn jɛntri bikɔs i de bay to dɛn.”
Dɛn a yɛri wan ɔda vɔys de tɔk na ɛvin se, “Mi pipul dɛn, una mekes kɔmɔt na da tɔŋ de so dat unasɛf nɔ go bigin du di bad tin dɛn we i de du, ɛn unasɛf nɔ go sɔfa lɛkɛ aw i gɛt fɔ sɔfa.
Una fɔ no se Gɔd nɔ fɔgɛt di bad bad tin dɛn we i dɔn du, we dɔn payl te dɛn dɔn rich ɔp na ɛvin.
Lɛ di bad we i dɔn du tɔn pan am. Mek i sɔfa tu tɛm pas di sɔfa we i mek ɔda pipul sɔfa; da kɔp we i kin tek gi pipul in wayn fɔ drink, ful am wit wayn we trɔŋ pas in yon wayn, ɛn gi am mek i drink.
Mek i pɔnish gud fashin ɛn mek in at ebi lɛkɛ aw i bin mek insɛf impɔtant ɛn i bin de ɛnjɔy layf. I de tɔk to insɛf se, ‘Mi na kwin, mi nɔto uman we in man dɔn day; kray nɔ go de na mi yay.’

Bikɔs na dat i de mɛmba, di big waala we fɔ mit am go fɔdɔm pan am. Wan gren de, i go sik, in at go ebi, i nɔ go gɛt natin fɔ it, ɛn faya go bɔn am. Bikɔs Gɔd we na wi Masta, gɛt pawa ɛn nain dɔn kɔndɛm am.”
Dɛn wan we de rul na dis wɔl we bin dɔn liv fri layf ɛn ɛnjɔy layf wit am go si di smok we de kɔmɔt na di faya we de bɔn am, dɛn dɛn go put dɛn an na dɛn ed, ɛn bɔs kray.
Dɛn go fred wɛn dɛn si di big waala we mit di tɔŋ, dɛn go tinap fawe, de tɔk se, “Oya, da big tɔŋ, Babilɔn, we bin gɛt pawa, dɔn pwɛl; na wan awa nɔmɔ i tek fɔ bɔn kam dɔŋ na grɔn.”
Dɛn wan we de tredin na di wɔl go kray ɛn dɛn at go ebi bikɔs di tɔŋ dɔn pwɛl, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go de igen fɔ bay dɛn tin we dɛn de sɛl;

nɔbɔdi nɔ go bay ɔl dɛn tin we dɛn de sɛl, lɛkɛ gold ɛn silva, dɛn shayn shayn ston ɛn fayn fayn bid; dɛn fayn fayn klos, rɛd wan ɛn mov wan, silk ɛn linin; ɛn dɛn wud we gɛt fayn sɛnt, dɛn tin we dɛn tek ɛlifant tit ɛn dia wud mek ɛn dɛn tin we dɛn tek bras ɔ ayɛn ɔ mabul mek;

dɛn tin we de smɛl swit lɛkɛ sinamɔn, spays, insɛns, ɛn dɛn tin we dɛn kɔl ma ɛn frankinsɛns; wayn, ɔyl we dɛn de tek kuk, fayn flawa, kɔn, kaw ɛn ship, dɛn ɔs ɛn dɛn chariɔt, ɛn dɛn pipul we dɛn tek mek slev.

Dɛn wan we de tredin go tɛl am se, “Ɔl di tin dɛn we yu bin put yu at pan nɔ de igen; ɔl yu jɛntri dɔn dɔn, yu nɔ go si am igen, ɛn di fayn layf we yu bin liv bikɔs yu bin jɛntri dɔn dɔn, yu nɔ go liv so igen.”
Dɛn pipul we jɛntri bikɔs dɛn de sɛl dɛn tin ya go fred wɛn dɛn si di trɔbul we mit di tɔŋ, dɛn go tinap fawe, de kray ɛn wit ebi at, dɛn go se,
“Eya, oya! Da tɔŋ de we bin gɛt pawa, dɔn pwɛl, i bin tan lɛkɛ uman we drɛs wit fayn fayn linin, mov ɛn rɛd klos ɛn we kin tek gold ɛn dɛn shayn shayn ston ɛn fayn fayn bid drɛs insɛf!
Na wan awa nɔmɔ ɔl in jɛntri lɔs!” Ɔl dɛn kapten, ɔl dɛn wan we de go ɔp ɛn dɔŋ na dɛn big bot, wit ɔl dɛn siman, ɔl dɛn wan we de go si fɔ tredin, dɛn ɔl tinap fawe;
wɛn dɛn si di smok we bin de kɔmɔt na di faya we bin de bɔn di tɔŋ, dɛn ala se, “Nɔ tɔŋ nɔ de lɛkɛ dis wande!”

Dɛn ib dɔti na dɛn ed bikɔs dɛn at ebi, dɛn ala se, “Oya o! Oya, una fɔ sɔri fɔ da tɔŋ we bin gɛt pawa. Di jɛntri we dis tɔŋ bin jɛntri fɔs tɛm bin mek ɔl dɛn wan we bin gɛt bot we bin de go si fɔ tredin, jɛntri. Bɔt naw, wan awa nɔmɔ, i dɔn pwɛl pata pata.”
Mek ɔl dɛn wan we de na ɛvin gladi, mek ɔl Gɔd in pipul dɛn, in apɔsul dɛn, ɛn dɛn wan we de tɔk in mɛsej gladi bikɔs Gɔd dɔn pɔnish am fɔ di bad we i bin de du dɛn.
Wɛn dat dɔn, wan enjɛl we gɛt plɛnti pawa pik wan big big ston lɛkɛ pɛpɛ ston ib am insay di wata, i se, “Na semwe so dɛn go ib da big tɔŋ we nem Babilɔn dɔŋ ɛn brok am, ɛn nɔbɔdi nɔ go si am igen.

Insay da tɔŋ de, pipul nɔ go yɛri ɛnibɔdi de ple ap igen, dɛn nɔ go yɛri pɔsin de ple flut ɔ blo trɔmpɛt igen, dɛn nɔ go yɛri pipul de siŋ igen; ɔl dɛn pipul we de du ɔl kayn tin wit dɛn an, lɛkɛ dɛn wan we de mek dɛn pɔt ɛn dɛn fita dɛn so, nɔ go wok insay de igen. Nɔbɔdi nɔ go yɛri pɔsin de bit kɔn de igen;
lamp nɔ go layt de igen; man ɛn uman nɔ go mared de igen. Dɛn wan we bin de tredin insay de na bin dɛn bigman we ɔlman na wɔl, no. I bin de tek wich mek ɔl dɛn pipul na ɔl dɛn neshɔn ful.”
Ɛn i go sɔfa bikɔs nainsay de blɔd bin kɔmɔt pan dɛn wan we bin de tɔk Gɔd in mɛsej, pan ɔl Gɔd in pipul dɛn, ɛn pan ɔl dɛn pipul na wɔl we dɛn dɔn kil.
Wɛn dat dɔn, a yɛri lɛkɛ plɛnti pipul na ɛvin de siŋ lawd wan se, “Aliluya, una lɛ wi prez Gɔd, nain dɔn sev wi. I wɔndaful pas ɔl, ɛn i gɛt pawa pas ɔl!
I de tɔk tru ɔltɛm, ɛn i de jɔj tret! I dɔn kɔndɛm da fri uman we ɔlman no we in fri layf bin de pwɛl di wɔl, ɛn i dɔn mek i gɛt di pɔnishmɛnt we i fɔ gɛt bikɔs i bin kil dɛn wan we de wok fɔ Gɔd.”
Dɛn tɔk bak se, “Aliluya, una lɛ wi prez Gɔd, di smok we de kɔmɔt na di faya we de bɔn Babilɔn go de sote go.”
Dɛn di twɛnti-fo bigman ɛn dɛn fo tin we gɛt layf fɔdɔm bifo Gɔd we bin sidɔm pan di chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm fɔ rul ɛn prez am fɔ in pawa, ɛn se, “Emɛn! Aliluya, lɛ wi prez Gɔd!”
Dɛn a yɛri vɔys na di ay chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm fɔ rul. Di vɔys de tɔk se, “Una we wi ɔl de wok fɔ Gɔd, ɛn una ɔl we fred Gɔd, smɔl wan ɔ big wan, ɛn ɔl dɛn bigman, una, lɛ wi ɔl prez wi Gɔd!”

Dɛn a yɛri vɔys lɛkɛ wɛn plɛnti pipul de tɔk, ɛn lɛkɛ wɛn plɛnti big wata de rɔn ɛn lɛkɛ wɛn tɛnda de krak lawd wan; dɛn vɔys ya bin de se, “Aliluya! Di Masta, we na wi Gɔd we gɛt pawa pas ɔl, de rul, una lɛ wi prez am!
Lɛ wi gladi ɛn fɔdɔm bifo Gɔd ɛn prez am, bikɔs na big Gɔd! Di tɛm fɔ mek di Ship mared dɔn kam, ɛn in yawo dɔn drɛs de wet am.
Dɛn gi am fayn klin wayt linin klos fɔ wɛr.” (Di fayn linin de sho aw Gɔd in pipul dɛn de waka tret.)
Di enjɛl tɔk to mi, i se, “Rayt dis tin ya: Blɛsin de pan dɛn wan we dɛn kɔl fɔ go it na di Ship in mared.” I tɛl mi se, “Dɛn wɔd ya na di tru wɔd dɛn we Gɔd tɔk.”

Dɛn a fɔdɔm na di pɔsin, we de tɔk, in fut fɔ bigin prez am. Na de di pɔsin se, “Grap, nɔ du dat! Misɛf na Gɔd in savant lɛkɛ yu, ɛn misɛf na wan pan yu kɔmpin dɛn we bin biliv di tru wɔd we Jizɔs tɔk! Na Gɔd in fut yu fɔ fɔdɔm fɔ prez am!” Di tru wɔd we Jizɔs tɔk, nain dɛn prɔfɛt dɛnsɛf de tɔk.

Wɛn dat dɔn, na de a si wan domɔt na ɛvin opin, a si wan wayt ɔs tinap de, di pɔsin we bin de rayd am bin nem “Di wan we fit fɔ trɔs ɛn di wan we de tɔk tru”. I de jɔj tret ɔltɛm, ɛn wɛn i de fɛt sɛf na wa, i tret.
In yay bin rɛd lɛkɛ faya ɛn plɛnti krawn bin de pan in ed. Wan nem bin rayt pan am we nɔbɔdi nɔ bin no pas insɛf.
Dɛn bin dɔn put di klos we i wɛr insay blɔd. In nem na bin “Gɔd in Wɔd”.
Dɛn soja man na ɛvin bin de fala am, dɛnsɛf bin de rayd wayt ɔs ɛn dɛn bin wɛr klin wayt linin klos.

I bin ol wan sɔd nain mɔt, we i go tek fɛt ɛn win ɔl dɛn neshɔn we nɔ de fala am. Na ayɛn staf i go tek rul dɛn, ɛn i go mas mas dɛn greps na di say we dɛn de mas dɛn fɔ pul dɛn wata, we go sho se Gɔd, we gɛt pawa pas ɔl, vɛks bad bad wan.
Wan nem bin rayt pan in klos ɛn pan in lɛg, dat na “Kiŋ we de rul oba ɔl dɛn kiŋ, ɛn Masta oba ɔl dɛn masta.”
Dɛn a si wan enjɛl tinap na di say we di san de, de ala kɔl ɔl dɛn bɔd we de flay ɔp ɔp, ɛn tɛl dɛn se, “Una kam gɛda fɔ it di big it we Gɔd dɔn mek;

una kam it dɛn chif, dɛn kapten, ɛn dɛn bigman dɛn bɔdi. Una kam it dɛn ɔs dɛn bɔdi, ɛn dɛn wan we de rayd dɛn, dɛnsɛf yon; una kam it dɛn slev ɛn dɛn fri man dɛn bɔdi ɛn dɛn bigman ɛn dɛn pikin yon.”
Dɛn a si di wayl bif, ɛn dɛn wan we de rul na wɔl wit dɛn soja man. Dɛn bin de gɛda fɔ rɛdi fɔ fɛt di wan we bin sidɔm pan di ɔs ɛn in yon soja man dɛn.

Dɛn kech di wayl bif ɛn di pɔsin we bin de lay se na Gɔd in mɛsej i de tɔk, ɛn we bin de du dɛn tin we bin de mek pipul wɔnda bifo di wayl bif. Na dɛn tin de i bin de tek mek dɛn pipul ful we bin gɛt di wayl bif in mak pan dɛn ɛn we bin de pre to di tin we dɛn mek fɔ tek de mɛmba ɛn rɛspɛkt am. Dɛn trowe di wayl bif ɛn di layman layf wan insay di wata we faya de kech ɛn sɔlfa de bɔn.
Dɔn, di sɔd we di pɔsin we bin de rayd di ɔs bin gɛt, nain mɔt, dɛn tek am kil ɔl di ɔda soja man dɛn; dɛn, ɔl dɛn bɔd dɛn kam it dɛn bɔdi; dɛn it te dɛn bɛlful pasmak.
Wɛn dat dɔn, a si wan enjɛl de kɔmɔt na ɛvin kam dɔŋ. I bin ol di ki fɔ tek opin di ol we nɔ gɛt bɔtɔm, ɛn i bin ol wan ebi chen.
I kech di dragɔn, dat na da snek we bin dɔn de frɔm tɛm, dɛn bad spirit dɛn kiŋ, Setan; i tay am fɔ wan tawzin ia.

Dɛn di enjɛl tek am trowe am insay di ol we nɔ gɛt bɔtɔm, i lɔk am ɛn put waks we sil di lɔk, so dat i nɔ go kɔmɔt, ɛn i nɔ go mek dɛn pipul ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl ful igen, te di wan tawzin ia dɔn pas. Afta dat, dɛn fɔ lus am lili bit fɔs.

Wɛn dat dɔn, a si dɛn chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm fɔ rul, ɛn a si dɛn wan we bin sidɔm pan dɛn. Sɔmbɔdi bin gi dɛn pawa fɔ jɔj ɔda pipul, ɛn igen a si dɛn spirit we kɔmɔt pan dɛn pipul we dɛn bin kil na wɔl bikɔs dɛn bin de tɔk se Jizɔs na dɛn Masta ɛn dɛn bin de tɛl pipul Gɔd in mɛsej. Dɛn pipul ya nɔ bin fɔdɔm bifo di wayl bif fɔ pre to am ɛn dɛn nɔ bin pre to di tin we dɛn mek fɔ tek mɛmba ɛn rɛspɛkt am, ɛn di wayl bif in mak nɔ bin de pan dɛn fɔrɛd ɔ pan dɛn an. Dɛn gɛt layf bak, dɔn dɛn rul wit Krays fɔ wan tawzin ia.
Dɛn ɔda pipul we bin dɔn day nɔ bin gɛt layf bak te di wan tawzin ia dɔn pas. Na di fɔs tɛm dis we Gɔd mek pipul we bin dɔn day rayz frɔm dɛn grev.

Ɔl dɛn pipul we fɔs kam gɛt layf bak afta dɛn bin dɔn day na pipul we gɛt blɛsin, dɛn gɛt wɔndaful blɛsin. Di sɛkɛn day nɔ go du dɛn natin; dɛn go bi pipul we de mek sakrifays to Gɔd ɛn Krays, ɛn dɛn go rul wit am fɔ wan tawzin ia.
Wɛn di wan tawzin ia dɔn pas, dɛn go pul Setan kɔmɔt na di say we dɛn bin lɔk am,
ɛn wɛn i kɔmɔt de, i go go mek ɔl dɛn neshɔn ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl, ful. Di neshɔn dɛn na bin Gɔg ɛn Magɔg. Setan go gɛda dɛn ɔl fɔ fɛt; dɛn go plɛnti lɛkɛ sansan.
Dɛn go ɔlɔbɔt na wɔl go tinap rawnd di say we Gɔd in pipul dɛn bin de mit, dat na da tɔŋ we Gɔd lɛk. Bɔt faya kɔmɔt ɔp na ɛvin kam dɔŋ kam bɔn dɛn.

Dɛn tek Setan we bin de mek pipul ful, trowe am insay da wata we faya de kech ɛn sɔlfa de bɔn; na da sem ples de dɛn bin trowe da wayl bif ɛn da prɔfɛt we nɔ de tɔk tru; na de dɛn go tɔmɛnt, de ɛn nɛt, sote go.
Wɛn dat pas, na de a si wan big wayt chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm fɔ rul ɛn di pɔsin we sidɔm pan am. Ɛvin ɛn di wɔl jɛs lɔs bifo am; nɔbɔdi nɔ si dɛn igen.

Dɛn a si dɛn pipul we bin dɔn day, dɛn bigman ɛn dɛn ɔdinari pipul, dɛn ɔl tinap bifo di chia. Sɔmbɔdi opin sɔm buk dɛn, dɔn i opin wan ɔda buk we dɛn pipul we gɛt layf sote go dɛn nem bin rayt. Ɔl wetin dɛn pipul we bin dɔn day bin du bifo dɛn day, bin rayt insay di fɔs buk dɛn, ɛn nain Gɔd tek jɔj dɛn.

Ɔl dɛn wan we bin dɔn day na wata kɔmɔt na di wata kam ɔp; ɔl dɛn wan we bin dɔn day we bin de na grev, rayz; di wan we bin sidɔm na di chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm, jɔj dɛn ɔl bay di wok we dɛn bin du na wɔl.
Dɛn sɔmbɔdi tek day ɛn di ples we dɛn dayman de, ib dɛn na da wata we faya de kech. (Di tɔmɛnt we pɔsin go tɔmɛnt sote go na di wata we faya de kech, nain na di sɛkɛn day.)
Ɛnibɔdi we in nem nɔ bin rayt insay di buk we dɛn rayt dɛn pipul we gɛt layf sote go dɛn nem, dɛn trowe am insay di wata we faya de kech.
Wɛn dat dɔn, na de a si wan nyu ɛvin ɛn wan nyu wɔl. Di ɛvin ɛn di wɔl we bin de fɔs bin dɔn lɔs, di wata insɛf bin dɔn dray.
Dɛn a si Gɔd in tɔŋ, we dɛn kɔl, nyu Jerusɛlɛm, i bin de kɔmɔt to Gɔd na ɛvin kam dɔŋ, dɛn bin dɔn mek am fayn fayn rɛdi, lɛkɛ uman we jɛs mared we dɔn drɛs de wet fɔ go to in man.

A yɛri lawd vɔys we kɔmɔt na di say we di chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm fɔ rul, bin de; i bin de tɔk se, “Gɔd dɔn kam fɔ tap to mɔtalman, i go tap wit dɛn ɛn dɛn go bi in pipul. Gɔd insɛf go de wit dɛn ɔltɛm.
I go mek dɛn nɔ kray igen; dɛn nɔ go day igen; ebi at ɛn waala nɔ go de igen; nɔbɔdi nɔ go kray igen, bikɔs dɛn tin we bin de fɔs nɔ go de igen.”
Dɛn di pɔsin we sidɔm na di chia we kiŋ kin sidɔm fɔ rul, se, “Luk, a de mek ɔltin nyu!” Dɛn i se, “Rayt dɛn wɔd ya dɔŋ, bikɔs dɛn na tru ɛn pipul kin biliv dɛn.”

I tɔk igen se, “Ɔl dɛn tin ya dɔn bi. Mi na Alfa, dat na di wan we bigin ɔltin, ɛn Omɛga, dat na di wan we go dɔn ɔltin. If ɛnibɔdi tɔsti, mek i kam to mi, a go gi am pan di wata we de bɔs plɛnti plɛnti we de gi layf; ɛn we fri.
Ɛnibɔdi we stil tinap traŋa afta Gɔd dɔn tray am go gɛt ɔl dɛn tin ya, ɛn pantap dat, a go bi in Papa ɛn i go bi mi pikin.
